jobs.title: Deputy Director: HR Policy
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive remuneration package to be structured in accordance with the rules for MMS).
jobs.summary: Deputy Director role overseeing HR policy development, review, and implementation within the Department of Agriculture, requiring junior management experience and an NQF 6 diploma.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 certificate and a National Diploma (NQF 6) in Human Resource Management/ Public Management/ Public Administration. Minimum of 3 years’ experience at junior management level in HR Policy environment. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of Human Resource Policies. Knowledge of Human Resource Prescripts. Job related skills: Communication skills (verbal and written). Strategic planning and leadership. Presentation and facilitation skills. Conceptual skills and human relations. Policy drafting (Report writing). Negotiations and consultation with relevant key stakeholders. Computer literacy skills. Problem solving skills. A valid driver’s licence. Ability to travel and work irregular hours.
jobs.duties: Monitor the development, review, alignment, and implementation of human resource policies in the department. Identify policies to be developed/ amended and aligned. Undertake gap analysis/ identify problems/ challenges/ research and best practices as and when required. Compile/ draft policies. Request inputs/ comment from stakeholders. Consider and consolidate inputs/ comment. Finalise draft policy. Consult policy at relevant forums (components, task teams, labour, DBC, management meetings). Finalise policy for consideration for approval from management (prepare memorandum/presentation). Assist and manage implementation of policy (communication). Monitor Human Resource policies to ensure consistent implementation and application in the department. Identify HR functions to be delegated in accordance with prescripts/ legislation. Compile/ draft delegations. Request inputs/ comment from relevant stakeholders. Consider and consolidate inputs/ comment. Consult relevant role players (Labour, legal, relevant component). Compile and finalise draft delegations (set of Delegations). Consult draft delegation at relevant forums if necessary. Finalise delegations for consideration for approval from management (prepare memorandum/ presentation). Assist and manage implementation of delegations (communication). Advocate Human Resource policies to ensure consistent implementation and application in the department. Issue / distribute approved policy. Arrange information sessions to advocate relevant policy (via Teams, Zoom or venue). Prepare/compile presentation on matter. Issue / distribute DOACOMMS with details of the session. Render / Assist / deal / advise on issues / matters and cases. Develop human resource plan in the department. Examine the department’s strategic plan. Benchmark with other organisations. Compile HR Plan and its implementation plans. Submit HR Plan and its implementation plans. Submit HR Plan to the delegated authority for approval. Submit HR Plan to DPSA by 30 June as required. Ensure the alignment of the HR plan to address the gap between the demand and supply of human resources. Conduct workforce analysis and identify gaps (qualitative and quantitative). Identify human resource priority issues to determine the gaps. Conduct environmental scan internally and externally to determine trends that are likely to impact on HR planning. Compile monthly, quarterly and annual reports. Manage the review and alignment of HR plan to Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF). Analyse performance and forecast future expenses. Determine available budget and capacity to implement HR plan.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to 20 Steve Biko Street, Agriculture Place, Arcadia, Pretoria, 0002 or by email DDHRPrecruit94@nda.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Target: Africans, Whites, Indians and Persons with Disability To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc.) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme. Appointment is subject to successful competition of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Service (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Due to high volumes, the Department will not acknowledge receipt of applications. Communication will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DOA is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Onderdirekteur: HR Beleid
af.summary: Onderdirekteurpos wat toezig hou oor die ontwikkeling, hersiening en implementering van HR-beleid binne die Department of Agriculture, wat juniorbestuurservaring en 'n NQF 6-diploma vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur/ Publieke Bestuur/ Publieke Administrasie. Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring op juniorbestuursvlak in 'n HR-beleidomgewing. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van Menslike Hulpbronbeleid. Kennis van Menslike Hulpbronvoorskrifte. Werksverwante vaardighede: Kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Strategiese beplanning en leierskap. Voorleggings- en fasiliteringsvaardighede. Konseptuele vaardighede en menslike verhoudinge. Beleidsopstelning (verslagskrywing). Onderhandelings en raadpleging met relevante sleutelbelanghebbendes. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vermoë om te reis en ongereelde ure te werk.
af.duties: Hou toezig oor die ontwikkeling, hersiening, belyning en implementering van menslike hulpbronbeleid in die departement. Identifiseer beleid wat ontwikkel/ gewysig en belyn moet word. Onderneem gapinganalise/ identifiseer probleme/ uitdagings/ navorsing en beste praktyke soos en wanneer benodig. Stel op/ skryf beleid. Versoek insette/ kommentaar van belanghebbendes. Oorweeg en konsolideer insette/ kommentaar. Finaliseer konsepbeleid. Raadpleeg beleid by relevante forums (komponente, taakspanne, arbeid, DBC, bestuursvergaderings). Finaliseer beleid vir oorweging vir goedkeuring deur bestuur (berei memorandum/ voorlegging voor). Ondersteun en bestuur implementering van beleid (kommunikasie). Hou toezig oor Menslike Hulpbronbeleid om konsekwente implementering en toepassing in die departement te verseker. Identifiseer HR-funksies om gedelegeer te word ooreenkomstig voorskrifte/ wetgewing. Stel op/ skryf delegerings. Versoek insette/ kommentaar van relevante belanghebbendes. Oorweeg en konsolideer insette/ kommentaar. Raadpleeg relevante rolspelers (Arbeid, regs, relevante komponent). Stel op en finaliseer konsepdelegerings (stel Delegerings). Raadpleeg konsepdelegering by relevante forums indien nodig. Finaliseer delegerings vir oorweging vir goedkeuring deur bestuur (berei memorandum/ voorlegging voor). Ondersteun en bestuur implementering van delegerings (kommunikasie). Bepleit Menslike Hulpbronbeleid om konsekwente implementering en toepassing in die departement te verseker. Uitreik/ versprei goedgekeurde beleid. Reël inligtingsessies om relevante beleid te bepleit (via Teams, Zoom of plek). Berei/ stel voorlegging oor saak op. Uitreik/ versprei DOACOMMS met besonderhede van die sessie. Lewer/ Ondersteun/ hanteer/ adviseer oor kwessies/ sake en gevalle. Ontwikkel menslike hulpbronplan in die departement. Ondersoek die departement se strategiese plan. Vergelyk met ander organisasies. Stel HR-plan en sy implementeringsplanne op. Dien HR-plan en sy implementeringsplanne in. Dien HR-plan by die gedelegeerde gesag in vir goedkeuring. Dien HR-plan teen 30 June by DPSA in soos vereis. Verseker die belyning van die HR-plan om die gaping tussen die vraag en aanbod van menslike hulpbronne aan te spreek. Voer werkmaganalise uit en identifiseer gapings (kwalitatief en kwantitatief). Identifiseer menslike hulpbronprioriteitsake om die gapings te bepaal. Voer omgewingsskandering intern en ekstern uit om tendense te bepaal wat waarskynlik op HR-beplanning sal impakteer. Stel maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse verslae op. Bestuur die hersiening en belyning van HR-plan tot Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF). Analiseer prestasie en voorspel toekomstige uitgawes. Bepaal beskikbare begroting en kapasiteit om HR-plan te implementeer.

zu.title: Othunywayo Onjengomphathi: Inqubomgomo ye-HR
zu.summary: Isikhundla sothunywayo onjengomphathi esibhekele inqubo yokuthuthukisa, ukubuyekeza, kanye nokuphoqa kwenqubo yezinqubomgomo ze-HR ngaphakathi kwe-Department of Agriculture, sifuna olunye uhlwangabe olusezingeni lenqubo yokubusa kanye nediploma ye-NQF 6.
zu.requirements: Abafakelayo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma (NQF 6) ku-Human Resource Management/ Public Management/ Public Administration. Okungenani unyaka lengu-3 weminyaka yokuqashelwa esigabeni esincane sokubuza ezenqubeni zezinqubomgomo ze-HR. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngezinqubomgomo ze-Human Resource. Ulwazi ngemiyalo ye-Human Resource. Ikhono elihlobene nomsebenzi: Ikhono lokuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhala). Ukuhlela okuyisiqalo nokuqondisa. Ikhono lokubonisa nokuqukqa. Ikhono lokucabanga ngezinto ezingabonwa kalula kanye nokuhlobana nabantu. Ukuhluza izinqubomgomo (ukubhala imibiko). Ukuxoxisana kanye nokubonisana nabantu ababalulekile abahlobene nenhloso. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokwesibhamu. Ikhono lokuxazula izinkinga. Ilayisense evumelekile yokushayela. Ikhono lokuhamba kanye nokusebenza emahoreni aqondene kahle kancane kancane.
zu.duties: Qaphela inqubo yokuthuthukisa, ukubuyekeza, ukuqondanisa, nokuphoqa izinqubomgomo ze-HR emnyangweni. Qaphela izinqubomgomo okufanele zithuthukiswe/ zilungiswe futhi ziqondaniswe. Yenza ukuhlaziywa kwezikhala/ qaphela izinkinga/ izinselele/ ucwaningo kanye nezindlela ezinhle ezibuye zome ngesikhathi esifunekayo. Qamba/ hluza izinqubomgomo. Cela imibono/ imibono ebhaliwe kubantu abahlobene nhlobo. Cabanga uze uhlanganise imibono/ imibono ebhaliwe. Qedela inqubomgomo ehluziwe. Bonisana nganqubomgomo kumabhawo aso (izakhiwo, amaqembu asebenza ngomsebenzi, abasebenzi, DBC, ihibhu lokubeka izindaba phambili ezinkundleni zokubonisana ngokuqondile). Qedela inqubomgomo ukuze kucutshungulwe ukuze kuvunyelwe ukuphoqa emaRhwebo (luqashe imemorandamu/ isibonisiwo). Siza futhi uphathe ukusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo (ukuxhumana). Qaphela izinqubomgomo ze-HR ukuze kuqiniseke isetshenziswa ngokungafani nokusetshenziswa emnyangweni. Qaphela imisebenzi ye-HR okufanele idluliselwe endleleni ethile ngokwezinhlobo zemithetho/ ezinye izinhlobo zemithetho. Qamba/ hluza imigomo yesithunywa. Cela imibono/ imibono ebhaliwe kubantu abahlobene nhlobo. Cabanga uze uhlanganise imibono/ imibono ebhaliwe. Qaphela abantu abahlobene nenhloso yomgomo (Abasebenzi, izinhlobo zomthetho, izinhlobo eziphelele). Qamba uze qedela imigomo yesithunywa (uhla lwemigomo yesithunywa edluliselwe endleleni ethile). Qaphela imigomo yesithunywa kumabhawo aso uma kunesidingo. Qedela imigomo yesithunywa ukuze kucutshungulwe ukuze kuvunyelwe ukuphoqa emaRhwebo (luqashe imemorandamu/ isibonisiwo). Siza futhi uphathe ukusebenza kwemigomo yesithunywa (ukuxhumana). Sakaza izinqubomgomo ze-HR ukuze kuqiniseke isetshenziswa ngokungafani nokusetshenziswa emnyangweni. Zoba/ satshela abantu izinqubomgomo ezivunyiwe. Hlela izikhathi zokwazisa abantu ukuze zisakazwe izinqubomgomo ezihlobene (nge-Teams, Zoom noma endaweni ethize). Qamba/ bhala isibonisiwo ngombhalo ohlobene nenhloso yomsebenzi. Zoba/ qamba uKwaziswa mayelana nokwaziswa kwesikhathi esithize. Nikeza/ siza/ qaphela/ kwazisa ngezinkinga/ imibuzo kanye nezehlakalo ezihlobene nomsebenzi. Thuthukisa i-HR Plan emnyangweni. Cabangisisa i-HR Plan yesibili yenhloso yolwazi yolwazi yenhloso yolwazi yolwazi yolwazi yolwazi yenhloso yenhloso yolwazi yenhloso yenhloso. Bukela futhi wenze izinto ezinkulu ezithile ukuqonda nezinye izinkampani. Qamba i-HR Plan kanye nama-implementation planso ayo. Ngenisa i-HR Plan kanye nama-implementation planso ayo. Ngenisa i-HR Plan kumuntu onezikhalo zokulawula ukuze ivunyelwe ukusebenza. Ngenisa i-HR Plan ku-DPSA ngomhlaka 30 June njengoba kudingekayo. Qaphela ukuqondisa i-HR Plan ukuyilungisa ukusiza ukususa isikhala phakathi kokuthi kudingwa kanti kukhona amathuba okuthi kubekho abantu abangangeni. Yenza ukuhlaziywa kwabantu abathintwa kanye ne-HR kanye nokuphawula izikhala (ngokubala kanye nangokungabali). Qaphela izindaba ezibalulekile ze-HR ukuze kuqonde ukuthi zisukaphi. Hlola imvelonqangi ngaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze kuqonde ukuthi zizothinta kanjani ukucubungula i-HR. Qamba imibiko yanyanga zonke, yenyanga ngo-3 kanye nenyanga ngonyaka wonke. Phatha inqubo yokubuyekeza kanye nokuqondisa i-HR Plan kuyo i-Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF). Hlola ukuphumelela kanye nokucabanga ngemali ezothiswa ngosuku olungathinti. Qonda imali ekhona kanye namandla okusebenzisa i-HR Plan.

xh.title: Isekonyulu: Ipolisi ye-HR
xh.summary: Indima yesekonyulu yokulawula ukuphuhliswa, ukucwangciswa kwakhona, nokuphumeza iindlela zomsebenzi ezisemthethweni kwisebe le-Agriculture, efunwa amava obulungu bolawulo abaneminyaka emithathu nesiXhosa esingangoNQF 6.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seNqanaba le-12 kunye neDiploma yesiQondo (NQF 6) kwiHuman Resource Management/ Public Management/ Public Administration. Iminyaka ye-3 ubudala yamava kwinqanaba lobulungu bolawulo abancinci kwindawo ye-HR Policy. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngeNqanaba ze-HR Policies. Ulwazi nge-HR Prescripts. Amapulo ahambelana nomsebenzi: Amapulo e-communication (ngemilomo nangokubhalwayo). Ulawulo olusentsokotsho kunye nokuba ngumholi. Amapulo okubonelela nokuqhuba iindaba. Amapulo esicwangciso sokucatshula kunye neendlela zobuntu. Ukubhala iindlela ezisemthethweni (ukubhala iingxelo). Iinkcenkceshelo negqabantshathi nabathintekayo abafanelekileyo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amapulo okusombulula iingxaki. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni. Isakhono sokuhamba nokusebenza iiyure ezingatyelelaniyo.
xh.duties: Qwalasela ukuphuhliswa, ukucwangciswa, ukumiselwa, nokuphunyezwa kweenqanaba zomthetho wabasebenzi kwisebe. Qaphela iindlela ezisemthethweni eziza kuphuhliswa/ zilungiswe/ zimiswe. Yenza uhlalutyo lweengxaki/ qaphela iingxaki/ iingcinga kunye nezona ndlela zilungileyo njengoko kufuneka. Qamba/ bhala iindlela ezisemthethweni. Celisa iingcamango/ izimanga kwabathintekayo. Qwalasa kwaye udibanise iingcamango/ izimanga. Qedela iNdlela engalungisiyo. Qhubele iNdlela ezindaweni ezifanelekileyo (iindawo, iindawo zobusebenzi, abasebenzi, DBC, iindibano bolawulo). Qedela iNdlela ukuze iqwalaselwe ukugunyaziswa kolawulo (lungelelanisa umbhalo/ okubonelelwayo). Ncedisa kwaye ulawule ukuphunyezwa kweNdlela (ukunxibelelana). Qwalasela iNqanaba zomthetho wabasebenzi kuqinisekisa ukuphunyezwa nokusetyenziswa ngokungaphikisiyo kwisebe. Qaphela imisebenzi ye-HR ekufuneka yenziwe ngabanye ngokomthetho/ iNqanaba zomthetho. Qamba/ bhala imisebenzi ekufuneka yenziwe ngabanye. Celisa iingcamango/ izimanga kwabathintekayo abafanelekileyo. Qwalasa kwaye udibanise iingcamango/ izimanga. Qhubele abadlali abafanelekileyo (Abasebenzi, abamthetho, indawo efanelekileyo). Qamba kwaye uqedele imisebenzi ekufuneka yenziwe ngabanye (uhlu lweMisebenzi). Qhubele iMisebenzi ekufuneka yenziwe ngabanye ezindaweni ezifanelekileyo ukuba kuyimfuneko. Qedela iMisebenzi ekufuneka yenziwe ngabanye ukuze iqwalaselwe ukugunyaziswa kolawulo (lungelelanisa umbhalo/ okubonelelwayo). Ncedisa kwaye ulawule ukuphunyezwa kweMisebenzi ekufuneka yenziwe ngabanye (ukunxibelelana). Phakamisa iNqanaba zomthetho wabasebenzi kuqinisekisa ukuphunyezwa nokusetyenziswa ngokungaphikisiyo kwisebe. Nikela/ sasaza iNdlela egunyaziweyo. Lungisa iindibano zenkcazelo ukuze kuphakanyiswe iNdlela efanelekileyo (ngeTeams, Zoom okanye endaweni). Lungelelanisa/ qamba okubonelelwayo ngomcimbi. Nikela/ sasaza i-DOACOMMS ngeenkcukacha zendibano. Yenza/ Nceda/ jonga/ lucele ingcebiso kwiingxaki/ iingxelo name. Phuhlisa isicwangciso sabasebenzi kwisebe. Phengulula isicwangciso esentsokotsho sesebe. Qhathanisa nezinye iindaba. Qamba isicwangciso se-HR nemicimbi yaso yokuqatywa. Thumela isicwangciso se-HR nemicimbi yaso yokuqatywa. Thumela isicwangciso se-HR kolawulo olugunyazisiweyo ukuze ligunyaze. Thumela isicwangciso se-HR kwiDPSA ngo-30 June njengoko kufuneka. Qinisekisa ukumiselwa kwesicwangciso se-HR ukubetha iNqanaba ephakathi kwesicelo kunye neNkonzo yabasebenzi. Yenza uhlalutyo lwamasebenzi uze uqaphela iingxaki (ngobuninzi nangobungakanani). Qaphela iingxaki ezibalulekileyo zabasebenzi ukumisela iingxaki. Yenza ukuqwalasela indalo yangaphakathi nangaphandle ukumisela iintshukelo ezinokubetha isicwangciso se-HR. Qamba iingxelo znye znye, ziveki, kunye nezonyaka. Lawula ukucwangciswa nokumiselwa kwesicwangciso se-HR kumaxesha aphakathi (MTEF). Hlazi ulusebenzi kwaye ubethe ngaphambili iindleko zangomso. Misela ibhajeti ekhoyo nolwazi lokuphumeza isicwangciso se-HR.

jobs.title: Scientist Production Grade-a
jobs.salary_text: R791 604 per annum, (OSD), (all-inclusive package structured in accordance with the OSD rules)
jobs.summary: A Scientist Production Grade A position in Pretoria requiring a BSc Honours in Food Sciences and SACNASP registration, offering R791,604 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Science degree (BSc)(Hon) in Food Sciences / Food Technology or relevant qualification. Compulsory registration with South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) as a Professional Natural Scientist. Job Related Work Experience: Minimum of three (3) years post-qualification experience. Job Related Knowledge: Applicants must have knowledge of Public Service and Departmental prescripts/policies. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Agricultural Products Standard Act 119 of 1990. International agreements, conventions and bilateral agreements relating to sanitary and food quality matters. Relevant legislation and regulations, norms and standards. Export and import requirements. Job Related Skills: Programme & project management. Scientific methodologies. Research & development. Knowledge of legal compliance. Data analysis. Computer-aided scientific applications. Technical report writing. Creating a high-performance culture. Professional judgment. Presentation skills. Mentoring. Decision making. Team leadership. Analytical skills. Creativity. Financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication. Networking. Computer literacy. People management. Planning and organising. Conflict management. Change management. Problem solving and analysis. Extended working hours. Handling of hazardous chemicals.
jobs.duties: Develop and implement methodologies, systems and procedures. Evaluate, Compile and amend regulations, product standards, policies, guidelines with regard to the quality, composition, packaging, marking, labelling, inspection, control and monitoring of identified agricultural products destined for export, import and local markets and ensure that these are in compliance with international food safety and quality requirements. Obtain inputs from industry and other relevant role players with regard to the drafted product standards, policies, procedures and guidelines. Draft/amend regulations, export standards and requirements for local and imported agricultural products. Identify food safety and quality risks by monitoring international standards, best practices, and local conditions. Conduct a needs assessment and evaluate the results thereof. Compile draft legal framework and publish a government gazette notice to invite comments. Coordinate the publication of approved regulations in the government gazette. Improve internal processes by providing inputs into the drafting of policies and/or guidelines on the interpretation of the relevant Act and assisting with and reviewing of the implementation thereof by other divisions. Perform scientific analysis and regulatory functions. Provide technical advice and guidance on the interpretation and application of the legislative framework to stakeholders. Provide inputs in the drafting of policies and guidelines on the Agricultural Products Act (APS Act) and the implementation thereof by other divisions. Evaluate labels and / or marking requirements for agricultural products and make recommendations. Conduct import and export risk assessment on agricultural products and issue certification documentation accordingly. Process applications for dispensations, registrations, etc. Obtain, evaluate and disseminate information on international trends to local industries to keep them informed of new trends/requirements. Manage and maintain databases and information related to the following. registrations and /or cancellation of labels for the export of agricultural products, maximum residue limits (MRLs) for processed products, etc, destined for export, newly published regulations, import and export standards, notices and draft regulations and standards for gathering public comments, and Standard Operating Procedures. Research and Development. Liaise with national and international stakeholders, industry role players, other departments and DoA officials on technical matters related to food safety and quality assurance. Obtain, evaluate, update and disseminate the relevant international information to keep South African (SA) industries and other divisions informed of new trends/requirements. Participate in the formulation of SA’s positions in international meetings with regard to the harmonisation of food safety and quality assurance issues. Provide inputs (technical and scientific) on resolutions, guidelines, scientific papers, technologies, and production practices to ensure compliance with national and international food safety and quality requirements for agricultural products in terms of South Africa’s membership to international standard-setting bodies (e.g, United Nations Economic Commission for European, Codex Alimentarius Commission, and Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development etc.) Coordinate and participate in local meetings, workshops, seminars relevant to food quality and sanitary matters. Human Capital and Development. Mentor, train and develop staff in order to promote skills/knowledge transfer. Supervise scientific work and processes. Manage the performance and development of staff.

af.title: Wetenskaplike Produksie Graad-a
af.summary: 'n Wetenskaplike Produksie Graad A-pos in Pretoria wat 'n BSc Honneurs in Voedselwetenskappe en SACNASP-registrasie vereis, met 'n vergoeding van R791,604 per annum.
af.requirements: Wetenskaplike graad (BSc)(Hon) in Voedselwetenskappe / Voedseltegnologie of relevante kwalifikasie. Verpligte registrasie by die South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) as 'n Professionele Natuurwetenskaplike. Werkervaring in verband met die pos: Minimum van drie (3) jaar ervaring na kwalifikasie. Werkverwante kennis: Aansoekers moet kennis hê van Openbare Diens- en Departementele preskrifte/beleide. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Agricultural Products Standard Act 119 of 1990. Internasionale ooreenkomste, konvensies en bilaterale ooreenkomste rakende sanitêre en voedselgehalte-aangeleenthede. Relevante wetgewing en regulasies, norme en standaarde. Uitvoer- en invoervereistes. Werkverwante vaardighede: Program- en projekbestuur. Wetenskaplike metodes. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Kennis van wettige nakoming. Data-analise. Rekenaargesteunde wetenskaplike toepassings. Tegniese verslagskrywing. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Professionele oordeel. Aanbiedingsvaardighede. Mentoring. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Analitiese vaardighede. Kreatiwiteit. Finansiële bestuur. Kliëntefokus en -reaksie. Kommunikasie. Netwerking. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Mensebestuur. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur. Veranderingsbestuur. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Verlengde werksure. Hantering van gevaarlike chemikalieë.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en implementeer metodes, stelsels en prosedures. Evalueer, stel saam en wysig regulasies, produkstandaarde, beleide, riglyne met betrekking tot die gehalte, samestelling, verpakking, merking, etikettering, inspeksie, beheer en monitering van geïdentifiseerde landbouprodukte bestem vir uitvoer, invoer en plaaslike markte en verseker dat hierdie in ooreenstemming is met internasionale voedselveiligheids- en gehaltevereistes. Verkry insette van die industrie en ander relevante rolspelers met betrekking tot die opgestelde produkstandaarde, beleide, prosedures en riglyne. Stel op/wysig regulasies, uitvoerstandaarde en vereistes vir plaaslike en ingevoerde landbouprodukte. Identifiseer voedselveiligheids- en gehalterisiko's deur internasionale standaarde, beste praktyke en plaaslike toestande te monitor. Voer 'n behoeftebepaling uit en evalueer die resultate daarvan. Stel 'n konsep-wetlike raamwerk op en publiseer 'n Staatskoerantkennisgewing om kommentaar uit te nooi. Koördineer die publikasie van goedgekeurde regulasies in die Staatskoerant. Verbeter interne prosesse deur insette te lewer tot die opstel van beleide en/of riglyne oor die interpretasie van die betrokke Wet en bystand te verleen aan en die implementering daarvan deur ander afdelings te hersien. Voer wetenskaplike analises en regulatoriese funksies uit. Verskaf tegniese advies en leiding oor die interpretasie en toepassing van die wetlike raamwerk aan belanghebbendes. Lewer insette by die opstel van beleide en riglyne oor die Agricultural Products Act (APS Act) en die implementering daarvan deur ander afdelings. Evalueer etikette en/of merkbare vereistes vir landbouprodukte en maak aanbevelings. Voer invoer- en uitvoerrisiko-assesserings op landbouprodukte uit en reik sertifiseringsdokumentasie dienooreenkomstig uit. Prosesseer aansoeke vir dispansasies, registrasies, ens. Verkry, evalueer en versprei inligting oor internasionale tendense aan plaaslike industrieë om hulle in te lig oor nuwe tendense/vereistes. Bestuur en handhaaf databasisse en inligting met betrekking tot die volgende. registrasies en/of kansellasie van etikette vir die uitvoer van landbouprodukte, maksimum residuelimiete (MRL's) vir verwerkte produkte, ens., bestem vir uitvoer, nuut gepubliseerde regulasies, invoer- en uitvoerstandaarde, kennisgewings en konsepregulasies en -standaarde vir die insameling van openbare kommentaar, en Standaard Operasionele Prosedures. Navorsing en Ontwikkeling. Skakel met nasionale en internasionale belanghebbendes, industrierolspelers, ander departemente en DoA-amptenare oor tegniese aangeleenthede verbandhoudend met voedselveiligheid en gehalteversekering. Verkry, evalueer, werk op datum en versprei die relevante internasionale inligting om South African (SA) industrieë en ander afdelings in te lig oor nuwe tendense/vereistes. Neem deel aan die formulering van SA se posisies in internasionale vergaderings met betrekking tot die harmonisering van voedselveiligheids- en gehalteversekeringsaangeleenthede. Lewer insette (tegnies en wetenskaplik) oor resolusies, riglyne, wetenskaplike referate, tegnologieë en produksiepraktyke om nakoming van nasionale en internasionale voedselveiligheids- en gehaltevereistes vir landbouprodukte te verseker ooreenkomstig South Africa se lidmaatskap van internasionale standaardstellige liggame (bv. United Nations Economic Commission for European, Codex Alimentarius Commission, en Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development ens.) Koördineer en neem deel aan plaaslike vergaderings, werkswinkels, seminare relevant tot voedselgehalte- en sanitêre aangeleenthede. Menslike Kapitaal en Ontwikkeling. Mentor, train en ontwikkel personeel om vaardighede/kennisoordrag te bevorder. Oorsien wetenskaplike werk en prosesse. Bestuur die prestasie en ontwikkeling van personeel.

zu.title: Usoshayili Wezinkambu Isigaba A
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaSoshayili Wezinkambu Isigaba A ePretoria esidinga i-BSc Honours kwezeSayensi Yokudla nokubhaliswa kwi-SACNASP, sinikeza uR791,604 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: I-degree yesayensi (BSc)(Hon) kwezeSayensi Yokudla / Ubuchwepheshe bokudla noma iziqu ezifanele. Ukubhaliswa ngokuphothile ku-South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) njengoSoshayili Wezemvelo Oqeqeshiwe. Isipiliyoni sokusebenza esihlobene nomsebenzi: Okungenani iminyaka emithathu (3) yisipiliyoni emva kweziqu. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nolwazi ngemithetho yesevisi yakomphakathi nemicimbo/inqubo yomnyango. I-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). I-Agricultural Products Standard Act 119 of 1990. Izivumelwano zamazwe ngamazwe, izivumelwano, kanye nezivumelwano ezibonana ngaso sonke isikhathi mayelana nezindaba zokuhlanza nokuthi kakhulu kweyobungakanani bokudla. Umthetho kanye nemiyalo, izilinganiso nemigomo. Izidingo zokuthumela kwelanye nokuthola kwelanye. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphathwa kwenkqubomgomo namaprojekthi. Izindlela zesayensi. Ukuhlola nokuthuthukisa. Ulwazi ngokuvumelana nomthetho. Ukuhlaziywa kwemininingwane. Izinhlelo zesayensi ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe. Ukudala isiko lokusebenza ngamandla aphezulu. Ukwahlulela ngobungochwepheshe. Amakhono okwethula. Ukwelisa. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukubhekiswa kweqembu. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Ubuciko. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuqondiswa kumthengi kanye nokuphendula. Unxibelelwano. Ukuxhumana. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuphathwa kwabantu. Ukuhlela nokuhlela izinto. Ukuphathwa ngxayano. Ukuphathwa inguquko. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqhathanisa. Amahora okusebenza angeziwe. Ukuphathwa kwamakhemikhali engozini.
zu.duties: Buthuthukise futhi usebenzise izindlela, izimiso kanye nemicimbo. Hlola, hlela futhi ulungise imiyalo, izilinganiso zemikhiqizo, izinqubomgomo, imiqombo ngokwemigogonya, ukwakheka, ukupakisha, ukumaka, ukuletha ulwazi, ukuhlola, ukulawula kanye nokuqaphela kwemikhiqizo yezolimo ebonisiwe ehlelwe ukuthunyelwa kwelanye, ukufakwa kwelanye namakethe zasendaweni futhi qiniseka ukuthi lezi zivumelana nezidingo zokuphepha nokuthi kakhulu kweyobungakanani bokudla zamazwe ngamazwe. Thola iminikelo ezimbonini nakubanye abadlali abafanele ngokwemilinganiso yemikhiqizo ebhaliwe, izinqubomgomo, imicimbo kanye namagobongo. Bhala/lungisa imiyalo, izilinganiso nezidingo zokuthumela kwelanye zemikhiqizo yezolimo yasendaweni nezathunyelwa kwelanye. Hlola izengozi zokuphepha nokuthi kakhulu kweyobungakanani bokudla ngokuqapha izilinganiso zamazwe ngamazwe, izindlela ezinhle kakhulu, kanye nezimo zasendaweni. Yenza ukuhlola kwemfuneko futhi uhlole imiphumela yako. Hlela umthetho ohleliwe bese ushicilela isaziso kugazethi kahulumeni ukumemela izincomo. Hambisanise ukushicilelwa kwemiyalo evunyiwe kugazethi kahulumeni. Thuthukisa inqubo yangaphakathi ngokunikeza iminikelo ekubhaleni kwezinqubomgomo kanye/noma amagobongo ngokuhumusha kweMthetho ofanele futhi usize nokubuyekeza ukusetshenziswa kwawo eminye imigatfu. Yenza ukuhlaziywa kwesayensi kanye nemisebenzi yomthetho. Nikeza angcolo lwobuchwepheshe nomyalo ngokuhumusha nokusebenzisa umthaka womthetho kubathathi nxaxheba. Nikeza iminikelo ekubhaleni kwezinqubomgomo namagobongo ngokwe-Agricultural Products Act (APS Act) nokusetshenziswa kwawo eminye imigatfu. Hlola amalabhula kanye/noma izidingo zokumaka zezimikhiqizo yezolimo futhi wenze izincomo. Yenza ukuhlola izingozi zokuthumela kwelanye nokufaka kwelanye kumikhiqizo yezolimo futhi ukhiphe amadokhumenti wokuqinisekisa ngokokufanele. Cubungula izicelo zokukhululwa, ukubhaliswa, njll. Thola, hlola futhi usakaze ulwazi ngokwezimpikiswano zamazwe ngamazwe ezimbonini zasendaweni ukuze zigcine zikwazi ngemikhuba/izidingo ezisha. Phatha futhi ugcine okuyimininingwane kanye nolwazi mayelana nalokhu okulandelayo. ukubhaliswa futhi/noma ukukhanselwa kwamalabhula ngenxa yokuthumela kwelanye imikhiqizo yezolimo, imikhawulo emikhulu yamasala (MRLs) ezimikhiqizo ezucutshunguliwe, njll, ezihlelwe ukuthunyelwa kwelanye, imiyalo eshikiweusha, izilinganiso zokuthumela kwelanye nokuthola kwelanye, izaziso kanye nemiyalo ebhaliwe nezilinganiso ngenxa yokuqoqa izincomo zomphakathi, kanye nemiyalo YokuSebenza Eqondile. Ukuhlola nokuthuthukisa. Xhumana nabathathi nxaxheba bakulelo nakwamanye amazwe, abadlali bezimboni, eminye iminyango namaphayonkathi e-DoA ngeminduzo yobuchwepheshe ehlobene nokuphepha kokudla kanye noqiniseko lweyobungakanani bokudla. Thola, hlola, buyekeza futhi usakaze ulwazi oluhlobene namazwe ngamazwe ukuze ugcine izimboni ze-South Africa (SA) namanye emigatfu ikwazi ngemikhuba/izidingo ezisha. Thatha inxaxheba ekwakhiweni kwezikhundla ze-SA ehlanganweni kwamazwe ngamazwe ngokuhlanganiswa kwezindaba zokuphepha kokudla noqiniso lweyobungakanani kokudla. Nikeza iminikelo (yobuchwepheshe nesesayensi) ngeziphetho, amagobongo, amaphepha esayensi, ubuchwepheshe, namasiko okukhiqiza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvumelana nezidingo zokuphepha nokuthi kakhulu kweyobungakanani bokudla zamazwe ngamazwe kumikhiqizo yezolimo ngokwesigaba sase-South Africa kwizikhungo ezibeka izilinganiso zamazwe ngamazwe (isb, United Nations Economic Commission for European, Codex Alimentarius Commission, kanye ne-Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development njll.) Hambisanise futhi uthathe inxaxheba kumahlanganobe asendaweni, emikhosini, ezinkundleni zokucwa ngokufanele mayelana nobuhle bokudla nezindaba zokuhlanzeka. Ikhaphoyalo yabantu nokuthuthukiswa. Welisa, uqeqeshe futhi uthuthukise abasebenzi ngenhoso yokukhuthaza ukudluliswa kwamakhono/ulwazi. Qapha umsebenzi futhi inqubo yesayensi. Phatha ukusebenza nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi.

xh.title: Isayensi Yokwenza Inqanaba-A
xh.summary: Isithuba seSayensi Yokwenza Inqanaba A ePretoria esifuna iBSc Honours kwiSayensi Yokutya negunyaziso leSACNASP, sinika umvuzo weR791,604 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Idegree yesayensi (BSc)(Hon) kwiSayensi Yokutya / Iteknoloji Yokutya okanye izifundo ezihambelana nalo. Ugunyaziso oluyinyaniso kwiSouth African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) njengengcali yeSayensi yeNdalo. Imisebenzi ehambelana nesiithuba: Ngamafutshane iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava emsebenzini emva kokuqwalasela izifundo. Ulwazi oluhambelana nesiithuba: Kufuneka abafake isicelo bazi ngeNkonzo kaLuntu neemiso/magazethi zeSebe. I-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). I-Agricultural Products Standard Act 119 of 1990. Zivumelano zamazwe ngamazwe, iinkqubo zomthetho nezivumelano ezibini ngakumbi ezithatha ngqondo izinto ezimalunga nenkonzo yokwamkela iziguli nengqondo yemigangatho yokutya. Umthetho oqukiweyo namagazetho, imigaqo nemizinganiselo. Iimfuno zokurhweba ngaphandle nangaphakathi. Amandla ahambelana nesiithuba: Ulawulo lweenkqubo namaprojekthi. Iindlela ezisemthethweni zesayensi. Uphando nentluko. Ulwazi lokuzithoba ngokomthetho. Ukuhlola ulwazi. Izicelo zesayensi ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha. UkuBhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe. Ukudala inkqubo yentsfu ephezulu. Isiphawuli esisemthethweni. Amandla okubonisa. Ukukhuthaza. Ukwenza iigqibo. Ukulawula iqela. Amandla okuhlola. Ingqiqo. Ulawulo lwemali. Ukuqwalasela abathengi nokuvekuvana. Unxibelelwano. Ukudibana. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulawulo labantu. Uqoqosho nokuhlela. Ukulawula ingxabano. Ulawulo lotshintsho. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqwalasela. Iiyure ezinzima zokusebenza. Ukuqhuba iikhemikhali ezinobungozi.
xh.duties: Phuhlisa uze usebenzise iindlela, iinkqubo neenqobo ezisesemthethweni. Qwalasela, bhala uze ulungise imithetho, imilinganiselo yemikhiqizo, iimiso, iinkqubo zokwenza ngokwendalo, ukupakisha, ukumaka, ukubhalisa ukutya, ulawulo nokuqwalasela ukutya okukhethiweyo okumiselwe ukurhweba ngaphandle, ukungenisa kwilizim kunye namashishini angaphakathi uze uqiniseke ukuba la kunokuzithoba kwemigaqo yamazeke amanye nengqondo yokhuseleko nemilinganiselo yokutya. Fumana izimvo kwishishini nakwezinye iindaba ezibalulekileyo malunga nezigqibo zemilinganiselo yemikhiqizo, iimiso, iinkqubo neenkqubo zokwenza. Bhala/lungisa imithetho, imilinganiselo yokuRhweba ngaphandle nemiqulu yenkqubo yokuRhweba ngaphandle nakumashishini abalulekileyo angaphakathi. Phawula iingozi ezingathathwa phantsi kokhuseleko lokutya nengqiqo yemilinganiselo ngokuhlola imilinganiselo yamazwe amanye, iinkqubo ezilungileyo nokuqwalasela iimeko endawo. Hlela isicelo sokuvakalisa ngemfuneko uze uqwalasele imiba esiyiphumayo. Bhala iNkqubo yomthetho uze ushicilele isaziso kwigazethi kurhulumente ukumema izimvo. Lawula ukushicilelwa kwemithetho egunyazisiweyo kwigazethi kurhulumente. Phucula iinkqubo ezibangaphakathi ngokunikela izimvo ekuhleni lweemiso kwaye ube negalelo ekuchazeni umthetho ohambelana nesi siNgcaciso, ube negalelo ekusetyenzisweni kwaye uqwalasele ukusetyenziswa kwako kwelinye iqela. Yenza isayensi yokuhlola nemiqulu esemthethweni. Nikeza ingcebiso yobuchwepheshe nezikhokelo malunga nokuchaza nokusetyenziswa kwenkqubo yomthetho kubathathi nxaxheba. Nikeza izimvo ekubhalweni kweemiso neenkqubo malunga noMthetho wemikhiqizo yezolimo (I-APS Act) nangekusetyenzisweni kwayo kwamanye amaqela. Qwalasela ukubhalisa nokuba yimfuneko yokumaka kumikhiqizo yezolimo uze wenze izimvo. Yenza uhlaziyo lweengozi malunga nokungenisa nokurhweba ngaphandle kumikhiqizo yezolimo uze umke kwaye unike amaxwebhu okugunyaziswa. Phatha izicelo zokuRhweba ngaphandle, zegunyaziso, njl. Fumana, qwalasela uze usasaze inkcazelo malunga nokuqhuba phambili kwamanye amazwe kumashishini endawo ukubagcina bettyelela kwezintsha. Lawula uze ulondoloze idatabhesi nengcombolo malunga nale mininzi. Igunyaziso nokuyeka ukubhaliswa kwamagama kubemi bemikhiqizo yokurhweba ngaphandle, imida ephezulu yokushiywa kweziyobisi kwemikhiqizo esesemthethweni, njl, emiselwe ukurhweba ngaphandle, imithetho eshityiweyo kutsha, imilinganiselo yokungenisa nokurhweba ngaphandle, izaziso kunye namagazethi ayo yonke imithetho nemiqulu emiselwe ukuvakalisa izimvo, kunye neNkqubo esemthethweni YokuQhutywa. Uphando nokuQhuba Phambili. Thetha nabathathi nxaxheba basesibukweni nakumazwe amanye, oomanye abadlali bashishini, oonye basebe namaphakathi abasebenzi be-DoA kumangqibongo obuchwepheshe bobukhuseleko lobugcisa bezobulawa. Fumana, qwalasela, hlaziya uze usasaze ulwazi kwezazwekulu ukugcina amashishini aseSouth Africa (SA) nanye amaqela ekwazini ngezinto ezintsha. Thatha inxaxheba ekudaleni izigqibo kwiindibano zamazwe ngamazwe malunga nokuvumelana kwezinto ezimalunga nobukhuseleko bengqiqo yokutya. Nikeza izimvo (ezobuchwepheshe nzesayensi) malunga nezigqibo, iinkqubo zokwenza, amaphepha esayensi, iindlela zemveliso kunye nemisebenzi yokukhiqiza ukugcinwa kokuzithoba kwemigaqo yengingqi namazwe ngamazwe ngokukhuseleka nomlinganiselo wemfuneko yokutya kumikhiqizo ngokwamalungu eSouth Africa kwizikhulu zemigaqo yamazwe (umz., United Nations Economic Commission for European, Codex Alimentarius Commission, and Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development njl). Lawula uze uthathe inxaxheba kwindibano zangengqi, kwiiworkshop, nasezinye iindibano ezibalulekileyo ngokulungiselelwa ukutya nokuRhweba ngeeNgxaki ezingangenisa isigulo. Iinkonzo zokuHlinza abantu. Qhoboshela, qeqesha uze uphuhlise abasebenzi ukukhuthazwa ukuDluliselwa kolwazi. Qwalasela izinto zokwenza ezenziwa ngezayensi. Lawula ukusetyenziswa nokuQeqesha abantu.

jobs.title: Senior Auditor: Financial Audit
jobs.summary: Senior Auditor position in the Department of Agriculture based in Pretoria, requiring a National Diploma in Auditing or Accounting with at least two years of financial audit experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Auditing / Accounting (NQF Level 6). Minimum of 2 years’ experience in Financial Auditor. Membership of the Institute of Internal Auditors is recommended. Job related knowledge: The Standards of the Institute of Internal Auditors. Risk based internal audit methodologies and procedures and software. Job related skills: Communication skill (written and verbal). Interviewing skills. Analytical skills. Problem-solving skills. Computer literacy. Business process analysis skills. Risk and control assessment skills. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Perform the Planning of the annual audit plan projects according to the deliverables and timelines defined on the approved audit projects planning memoranda. Perform the compilation of the electronic audit software of the Planning Phase Deliverables of the performance and Financial Audit Directorate’s projects allocated to this position, in line with the Chief Directorate’s quality standards, methodologies, policies and procedures on a continuous basis, and report progress to the Assistant Director: Financial Audit on a weekly basis. Perform the Execution of the annual audit plan projects according to the deliverables and timelines defined on the approved audit projects planning memoranda. Perform the compilation of the electronic audit software of the execution phase deliverables of the performance and Financial Audit Directorate’s projects allocated to this position, in line with the Chief Directorate’s quality standards, methodologies, policies and procedures on a continuous basis, and report progress to the Assistant Director: Financial Audit on a weekly basis. Perform the defined scope of the Reporting of the annual audit plan projects according to the deliverables and timelines defined on the approved audit projects planning memoranda. Perform the compilation of the electronic audit software of the execution phase deliverables of the performance and Financial Audit Directorate’s projects allocated to this position, in line with the Chief Directorate’s quality standards, methodologies, policies and procedures on a continuous basis, and report progress to the Assistant Director: Financial Audit on a weekly basis. Perform the Closure of the annual audit plan projects according to the deliverables and timelines defined on the approved audit projects planning memoranda. Perform the compilation of the electronic audit software of the execution phase deliverables of the performance and Financial Audit Directorate’s projects allocated to this position, in line with the Chief Directorate’s quality standards, methodologies, policies and procedures on a continuous basis, and report progress to the Assistant Director: Financial Audit on a weekly basis
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to 20 Steve Biko Street, Agriculture Place, Arcadia, Pretoria, 0002 or by email SAFArecruit95@nda.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Target: African Males and Persons with disability. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc.) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme. Appointment is subject to successful competition of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. jobs.title: Land USE Officer
jobs.summary: Land Use Officer role at the Department of Agriculture in Pretoria, promoting preservation and sustainable development of agricultural land.
jobs.requirements: Applicant must be in possession of a Grade 12 certificate and a National Diploma within Agriculture disciplines (NQF Level 6). A minimum of one (1) year experience. Job related knowledge: Public Service Regulations. PFMA. CARA. SALA. PDALA. Natural agricultural resources of South Africa. Natural resources / environmental legislation. Job related skills: Ability to communicate well and interact with people at different levels. Planning. Management and Organising. Creativity. Law enforcement. Interpretation skills. Problem solving. Analytical skills. Negotiations skills. Listening skills. Computer literacy. Report writing. Valid driver’s license. Working extended hours and travelling.
jobs.duties: Promote the preservation and sustainable development of agricultural land. Assist with the development of norms and standards. Provide technical inputs on SALA / PDALA assessment criteria. Provide technical inputs on the development of PDALA Regulations. Promote the preservation of agricultural land by municipalities and other stakeholders. Review and update list of properties to be excluded from SALA / PDALA. Implement regulatory, technical, strategic and administrative frameworks. Conduct desktop analysis to provide technical inputs on the evaluation of SALA / PDALA applications, including compilation of maps. Determine land use status: agricultural land / non- agricultural land and nature of applications. Consult applicable legislations concerning land use. Review applications to ensure compliance with land use guidelines and legislations. Compile technical evaluation reports for the review of SALA / PDALA applications based on the desktop analysis and technical interpretation in relation to the application details. Submit applications to committee with recommendations to make determinations about application based on the guidelines, norms and standards. Present applications to the evaluation review committee for consideration by the Delegate of the Minister. Maintain a record of applications progress for applications under review. Provide monthly reports on hectares retained or lost and related statistical information on land used related applications. Verify completeness of new applications. Update the Helpdesk and related operational systems. Draft monthly progress reports. Assess, interpret and create maps, aerial photography and satellite images of Agricultural land. Collaboration with relevant spheres of government and affected stakeholders involved with the administration of land use. Apply technical and legislative and compliance in responding to land use and related enquiries. Advise stakeholders / applicants on procedures, norms and standards on land use matter related to SALA / PDALA to ensure compliance to the legislations. Attend to enquires of public, professional land surveyors, planning community and attorneys. Participate with demarcation of agricultural land with municipalities and departments responsible for municipalities and traditional areas. Participate in intergovernmental and other stakeholders’ forums. Advise and take remedial actions on the land use matters. Human Capital Development. Allocate and ensure quality of work. Ensure capacity and development of staff. Ensure proper utilization of equipment. Assess staff performance. Apply discipline.

af.title: Land USE beampte
af.summary: Land Use beampte pos by die Department of Agriculture in Pretoria, wat die bewaring en volhoubare ontwikkeling van landbougrond bevorder.
af.requirements: Aansoeker moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'Nasionale Diploma binne Landbou-dissiplines (NQF Level 6). 'n Minimum van een (1) jaar ervaring. Werkverwante kennis: Public Service Regulations. PFMA. CARA. SALA. PDALA. Natuurlike landboubate van South Africa. Natuurlike hulpbronne / omgewingswetgewing. Werkverwante vaardighede: Vermoë om goed te kommunikeer en met mense op verskillende vlakke te skakel. Beplanning. Bestuur en organisering. Kreatiwiteit. Regstoepassing. Interpretasievaardighede. Probleemoplossing. Analitiese vaardighede. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Luistervaardighede. Rekenvaardigheid. Verslagskrywing. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werking van uitgebreide ure en reis.
af.duties: Bevorder die bewaring en volhoubare ontwikkeling van landbougrond. Bystand verleen met die ontwikkeling van norme en standaarde. Verskaf tegniese insetsels oor SALA / PDALA-beoordelingskriteria. Verskaf tegniese insetsels oor die ontwikkeling van PDALA-regulasies. Bevorder die bewaring van landbougrond deur munisipaliteite en ander belanghebbendes. Hersien en dateer lys van eiendomme wat uitgesluit moet word van SALA / PDALA, op. Implementeer regulerende, tegniese, strategiese en administratiewe raamwerke. Voer lessenaaranalise uit om tegniese insetsels oor die evaluering van SALA / PDALA-aansoeke te verskaf, insluitend samestelling van kaarte. Bepaal landgebruikstatus: landbougrond / nie-landbougrond en die aard van aansoeke. Raadpleeg toepaslike wetgewing aangaande landgebruik. Hersien aansoeke om nakoming van landgebruikriglyne en wetgewing te verseker. Stel tegniese evalueringsverslae op vir die hersiening van SALA / PDALA-aansoeke gebaseer op die lessenaaranalise en tegniese interpretasie in verhouding tot die aansoekbesonderhede. Dien aansoeke by komitee in met aanbevelings om beslissings oor aansoeke te maak gebaseer op die riglyne, norme en standaarde. Lewer aansoeke aan die evalueringshersieningskomitee vir oorweging deur die Afgevaardigde van die Minister. Handhaaf 'n rekord van die vordering van aansoeke vir aansoeke onder hersiening. Verskaf maandelikse verslae oor hektaar behou of verloor en verwante statistiese inligting oor landgebruikverwante aansoeke. Verifieer volledigheid van nuwe aansoeke. Dateer die Helpdesk en verwante bedryfstelsels op. Opstel van maandelikse vorderingsverslae. Assess, interpret and create maps, aerial photography and satellite images of Agricultural land. Samewerking met tersaaklike sfere van regering en geteisterde belanghebbendes betrokke by die administrasie van landgebruik. Pas tegniese en wetgewende en nakoming toe in die reageer op landgebruik- en verwante navrae. Adviseer belanghebbendes / aansoekers oor prosedures, norme en standaarde oor landgebruikaangeleenthede verwant aan SALA / PDALA om nakoming aan die wetgewing te verseker. Bystaan staan navrae van die publiek, professionele landmeters, beplanninggemeenskap en prokureurs by. Neem deel aan afbakening van landbougrond met munisipaliteite en departemente verantwoordelik vir munisipaliteite en tradisionele areas. Neem deel in interregerings- en ander belanghebbendes se forums. Adviseer en neem remediërende aksies oor die landgebruikaangeleenthede. Menslike kapitaalontwikkeling. Allokasie en versekering van gehalte van werk. Verseker kapasiteit en ontwikkeling van personeel. Verseker behoorlike benutting van toerusting. Assesseer personeelprestasie. Pas dissipline toe.

zu.title: Ilikhulu Lokusebenzisa Izwe
zu.summary: Indima yelikhulu lokusebenzisa izwe eDepartment of Agriculture ePretoria, ukukhuthaza ukuhlakanipa kanye nentuthuko ethempelile yomhlaba wolimo.
zu.requirements: Umfuni kumele abe necertificate ye-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma emikhakheni ye-Agriculture (NQF Level 6). Ukwazinza okuncane konyaka omunye (1). Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Public Service Regulations. PFMA. CARA. SALA. PDALA. Imithombo yemvelo yezolimo yase-South Africa. Imithombo yemvelo / umthetho wendawo. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ikhono lokuxhumana kahle kanye nokusebenza nabantu emazingeni ahlukene. Ukulungelelisa. Ukuphatha kanye nokuhlela. Ukudala. Ukuphoqa umthetho. Amakhono okuhumusha. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Amakhono okuxoxisana. Amakhono okulalela. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukubhala imibiko. Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ukusebenza amahora angethemphu kanye nokuhamba.
zu.duties: Ukukhuthaza ukuhlakanipa kanye nentuthuko ethempelile yomhlaba wolimo. Ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni izindinganiso kanye nemigomo. Ukunika izinkomba zobuchwepheshe ekuhlolweni kwe-SALA / PDALA. Ukunika izinkomba zobuchwepheshe ekuthuthukiseni imithetho ye-PDALA. Ukukhuthaza ukuhlakanipa komhlaba wolimo ngamasipala kanye nabanye abahlanganyeli. Ukubuyekeza kanye nokubuyekeza uhlu lwakamuva nezindawo ezizosetshenziswa ekukhipheni ekuvaleni i-SALA / PDALA. Ukuphatha izinhlelo zomthetho, zobuchwepheshe, zamasu kanye nezokuphatha. Ukuhlaziya ngokudesktopa ukunikeza izinkomba zobuchwepheshe ekuhloleni izicelo ze-SALA / PDALA, okuhlanganisa nokubhaliswa kwemephu. Ukunquma isimo sokusetshenziswa komhlaba: umhlaba wolimo / ongolimo kanye nisimo sesicelo. Ukubuka imithetho ehlobene nokusetshenziswa komhlaba. Ukubuyekeza izicelo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zihambisana nemigomo yomhlaba kanye nemithetho. Ukubhalwa kwemibiko yokuqinisekisa ngobuchwepheshe ekubukeni izicelo ze-SALA / PDALA ngokusekelwe ekuhlaziyweni kudesktopa kanye nokuhumusha ngobuchwepheshe kuqhathaniswa neMininingwane yesicelo. Ukuhambisa izicelo ekomidini nezindulumiso zokwenza izinqumo ngamaphuzu ezicelo ngokusekelwe emigomeni, izindinganisweni kanye nemithego. Ukubonisa izicelo ekomidini lokubuyekeza ukuze kuhlolwe ngummeleli weNkantolo. Ukugcina irekhodi lenqubo yezicelo kwezicelo eziqhubekayo. Ukunikeza imibiko yenyanga ngamakhatha egcinile noma alahlekile kanye nolwazi oluhlobene nezibalo kwezicelo ezihlobene nomhlaba. Ukuqinisekisa ukugqam kwemvelo kwezicelo ezisha. Ukubuyekeza ukusesekwa kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlobene. Ukubhala imibiko yentuthuko yenyanga. Ukubuyekeza, ukuyahlulela kanye nokudala imaphu, izithombe-ezinhwebeni nasezithombeni zomsakazi komhlaba wezolimo. Ukusebenzisana nemikhakha ehlobene kahulumeni kanye nabahlanganyeli abathintekayo ekuphathweni komhlaba. Ukufaka ubuchwepheshe, umthetho kanye nokuhambisana ekuphenduleni imibuzo yokusetshenziswa komhlaba. Ukweluleka abahlanganyeli / abafuni izicelo ngenqubo, izindinganiso kanye nemigomo ezindabeni zomhlaba ezihlobene ne-SALA / PDALA ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulandelwa komthetho. Ukubhekana nemibuzo yomphakathi, abakushi bomhlaba ababhalile, abahleli bomphakathi kanye nabasomthetho. Ukubamba iqhaza ekuhlukaniseni umhlaba wolimo ngamasipala neminyango ephethe amasipala kanye nasemuva. Ukubamba iqhatha nakweminye yohulumene kwezinye izinkundla zabahlanganyeli. Ukubambisa kwezinye izikhulu ekusebenziseni kwezinye izinkundla zabahlanganyeli. Ukubamba iqhaza esimintweni yokuhlukanisa komhlaba wolimo ngamasipala kanye neminyango eboyiphayo emasipala kanye nendawo yamasiko. Ukubamba iqhaza emabhodini kahulumene kwezinye izinkomfa zabahlanganyeli. Ukubukeka futhi uthathe izinyathelo zokweluleka kwezinye izindaba ezinhle zokusetshenziswa kwomhlaba. Ukuthuthukiswa kwamandla abantu. Ukwabelwa kwayo imali kwenziwe kahle. Ukuthuthukiswa kwamandla abantu. Ukusetshenziswa kwezinto ezenziwe ngokusho kwesibopho. Ukubuyekisisa imigwaqo yokwenza umsebenzi. Ukulinganisa isimo sabantu ngokusho kwezinye izinto.

xh.title: iSebe loKusebenzisa uMhlaba
xh.summary: Indima yesebe lokusebenzisa umhlaba kwiSebe leZolimo ePretoria, ekukhuthazeni ukugcinwa nentlalo-ekuthi yenziwe ngokuzinza komhlaba wezolimo.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka umfaki isicelo abe nam-Certificate ye-Grade 12 kunye ne-Diploma yesiZwe kumacandelo eZolimo (i-NQF Level 6). Amava amabalwa amnye (1) unyaka. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Iimiconductor zeNkonzo zeRomlonge. IPFMA. ICARA. ISALA. IPDALA. Amacebo okuzalisa okwendalo wezulimo eSouth Africa. Amacebo okuzalisa / uraqululo5bezo zendalo. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukukwazi ukuthetha kakuhle nokusebenzisana nabantu kumanqanaba ahlukeneneyo. Ukuhlela. Ukuqulunqa. Ulungiselelo nokuhlela. Ubuchwepheshe be-zixhobo. Ukuchazwa kolwazi. Ukusombulula iingxaki. Amakhono okuqamba. Amakhono okudwelisa. Ukupela phantsi. Amakhono okuvakalisa. Ukwazisebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukubhala iiripoti. I-License yokushayela esemthethweni. Ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo nokuhambe.
xh.duties: Khuthaza ukugcinwa nentlalo-ekuthi yenziwe ngokuzinza komhlaba wezolimo. Nceda ngokuphuhlisa iimvisiswano namazinga.nika ngemveliso ngamagama ngamagama eziqinisekiso ezifunyanwa kwi-SALA / PDALA.nika ngemveliso ngamagama ngamagama ekuphuhliseni uraqululo5bezo zokuqhelaniselwa ne-SALA / PDALA.kuthaza ukugcinwa komhlaba wezolimo ngamasipala naye nabanye abathathi-nxaxheba.ngcani hlola uhlaziye uluhlu lwempahla ekufuneka itshandwe kwi-SALA / PDALA.phumezele uraqululo5bezo, okuqinisekisa, amacingo-nqanaba namakhowudi ngokomthetho.sebenzisa ulwazi ngamakhompyutha ukunika imveliso ngamagama ngamagama ngokuhlahlelwa kwezicelo ze-SALA / PDALA, kuquka necandelo le-relationship namaphondo ekwakhela iindlela ezahlukeneyo. Mhla kubakho imiba yomhlaba: umhlaba wezolimo / non-agricultural land kwaye iimpawu ngemizekelo.ngcani ngamagama ngamagama ekwazingwa ngokomthetho mayela nokusebenza komhlaba. Hlola izicelo ukuqinisekisa ukuzinza kumagama ngemigaqo nangamagama ngomthetho ngokusebenzisa komhlaba. Bhala iiripoti ezimfutshane ngokuhlola ukuphuhliswa kweempawu ze-SALA / PDALA ezisekelwe kuhlalutyo lwe-desktop kubandakanya nemigaqo yokuqonda ngokomsebenzi. Thumela izicelo kumakomiti ngeengcamu ngokumagama ngokwenza isigqibo ngemizekelo nangokusetyenziswa kwemigaqo, imiviswano namazinga. Bonisa izicelo kumakomiti ahlolahayo aze ajongwe nguMmunyethi woNgqungqushe. Gcina umbhalo wentshatshelo yezicelo ezisahlulwa phantsi kwesihloko.nika iiripoti nyanga zonke nge-hectares ezibhubhile okanye ezifunyanweyo nentsingiselo yobukhulu bwezicelo ngokusebenzisa komhlaba. Qinisekisa izicelo ezizitsha ngokuphela kwazo. Hlaziya i-Helpdesk neenkqubo ezihlobene nolwazi. Bhala iiripoti zentshatshelo nyanga zonke. Hlala, chaza kwaye udale iindidi ezahlukeneyo zamaphondo, iimbonakalo ezingabonakaliyo nezithombe ze-sathelayithi zamahlaba okulima. Sebenzisana namacandelo angathathu-ngingqi angafanele kwakunye nabanxaxheba abakhathale iindlela ezingathathu-ngingqi kubandakanya uraqululo5bezo abadibeneyo bengqungqusho. Phumeza ezobuchwepheshe, ngokomthetho kunye nokuqinisekisa xa uphendula imibuzo ngokusebenzisa komhlaba.nika inkcazelo kubanxaxheba / abafakeli ngenkqubo, imiviswano namazinga ngokusebenzisa komhlaba ngokusebenzisa kwecala le-SALA / PDALA ukwenza isiqinisekiso nangokomthetho. Yiba phakathi kwemibuzo yomntu wonke, abakwa-land surveyor, abakwiplanizi, abantu abanjengamagosa eqondo. Thabatha inxaxheba ekuthathyeni iinkqaba ngokusebenza komhlaba namaspala namasebe angamthatha-nxaxheba kwamaspala namadlelo asendulo. Thatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yolwazi lwamaxhosa abakwa-National Government. nika inkukacha kwaye uthabathe iinyathelo zokulungisa kwimiba ngokusebenza komhlaba. nika inkukacha ngokusebenza. nika ukugcinwa kwesikhundla kwecala elinye kubasebenzi. nika ukuqinisekiswa kokusebenza kwempahla. linganisa ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. sebenzisa isohlwayo.

jobs.title: Senior Agricultural Registration Officer
jobs.summary: Coordinate and oversee administrative services for the registration of agricultural inputs such as fertilizers, farm feeds and remedies in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Applicant must be in possession of a Grade 12 certificate and National Diploma or B-Degree in Public Management / Public Administration / Office Administration / Business Administration / Business management (NQF 6). Must have a minimum of two (2) years relevant experience of administration in the regulatory environment. Job-Related Knowledge: Knowledge of Fertilizer, Farm Feeds, Agriculture Remedies and Stock Remedies Act No.36 of 1947 together with its regulations and standard operating procedures. Public Service Regulations, Procurement procedures. Regulations relating to agricultural inputs, pest control operators and sterilizing plants. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Planning and organizing. DPSA HR policies and prescripts. Job Related Skills: Supervisory skills, Planning and executions, Good interpersonal skills, Problem solving skills, Computer literacy, report writing, Ability to communicate well with people at different levels. Customer services skills, Telephonic etiquette, Motivational skills, Innovative thinking and Communication skills (verbal & written). The candidate must be willing to work extended hours and be in a possession of a valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: To coordinate and oversee the provision of administrative services in the registration of agricultural inputs in line with relevant legislations. Manage the registration of agricultural remedies applications in terms of the Fertilizer, Farm Feeds, Agricultural Remedies and Stock Remedies Act (Act No. 36 of 1947). Respond to routine enquires with both the internal and external stakeholder. Develop and ensure maintenance of information databases and records management system. Verify the correctness of the registration documents issued to stakeholders. Compile correspondence to clients and external and internal stakeholders in relation to the registration applications. Compile statistical information/repots relating to the registration applications. Liaise with the Agricultural Management Advisors or Registrar for processing of registration applications. Represent the unit at the stakeholder liaison meetings. Oversee and provide general financial administrative support for registration of Agricultural Inputs. Facilitate payment to service providers for service rendered. Ensure that the prescribed registration application fees are paid as per the regulations. Locate and verify the payment of application received. Verify and reconcile the revenue collected through ledger notices. Provide support in the review of tariffs for services offered by the directorate. Facilitate the refunding of overpayments or duplicate revenue. Assist auditors with audit process in the directorate. Process minor Agricultural Inputs registration applications. Receive and verify documentation for minor applications (e.g. renewal of products, products name changes and product ownership changes). Ensure that the correct prescribed tariffs are paid. Approve minor applications and issue certificate accordingly. Staff Supervision. Allocate and ensure quality of work. Ensure capacity and development of staff. Ensure proper utilization of equipment. Assess staff performance. Apply discipline.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to 20 Steve Biko Street, Agriculture Place, Arcadia, Pretoria, 0002 or by email SAROrecruit99@nda.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Target: African Males and African, Coloured and Indian Females, and persons with disability. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc.) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme. Appointment is subject to successful competition of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Service (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Due to high volumes, the Department will not acknowledge receipt of applications. Communication will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DOA is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Senior Landbou-Registrasiebeampte
af.summary: Koördineer en hou toesig oor administratiewe dienste vir die registrasie van landbou-insette soos misstowwe, veevoer en middels in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Aansoeker moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma of B-graad in Openbare Bestuur / Openbare Administrasie / Kantooradministrasie / Besigheidsadministrasie / Besigheidsbestuur (NQF 6). Moet 'n minimum van twee (2) jaar se toepaslike ervaring van administrasie in die regulatoire omgewing hê. Werksverwante Kennis: Kennis van die Fertilizer, Farm Feeds, Agriculture Remedies and Stock Remedies Act No.36 van 1947 tesame met sy regulasies en standaard bedryfsprosedures. Public Service Regulations, Aankoopprosedures. Regulasies met betrekking tot landbou-insette, plaagbeheeroperateurs en steriliseringsaanlegte. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Beplanning en organisering. DPSA HR-beleide en voorskrifte. Werksverwante Vaardighede: Toesighoudende vaardighede, Beplanning en uitvoering, goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, probleemoplossingsvaardighede, rekenaargeletterdheid, verslagskrywing, vermoë om goed met mense op verskillende vlakke te kommunikeer. Kliëntediensvaardighede, telefoonetiket, motiveringsvaardighede, innoverende denke en kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling en skriftelik). Die kandidaat moet bereid wees om verlengde ure te werk en in besit wees van 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Om die voorsiening van administratiewe dienste by die registrasie van landbou-insette te koördineer en toesig te hou oor dieselfde in ooreenstemming met die toepaslike wetgewing. Bestuur die registrasie van aansoeke vir landbou-middels in terme van die Fertilizer, Farm Feeds, Agricultural Remedies and Stock Remedies Act (Act No. 36 of 1947). Reageer op roetine-navrae met beide interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Ontwikkel en verseker die instandhouding van inligtingsdatabasisse en 'n rekordbestuurstelsel. Verifieer die korrektheid van die registrasiedokumente wat aan belanghebbendes uitgereik word. Stel korrespondensie op aan kliënte en eksterne en interne belanghebbendes met betrekking tot die registrasie-aansoeke. Stel statistiese inligting/verslae op met betrekking tot die registrasie-aansoeke. Skakel met die Agricultural Management Advisors of Registrar vir die verwerking van registrasie-aansoeke. Verteenwoordig die eenheid by die belanghebbende-liaisonvergaderings. Hou toesig oor en verskaf algemene finansiële administratiewe ondersteuning vir die registrasie van Agricultural Inputs. Fasiliteer betaling aan diensverskaffers vir gelewerde dienste. Verseker dat die voorgeskrewe registrasie-aansoekgelde betaal word soos per die regulasies. Lokaliseer en verifieer die betaling van aansoeke ontvang. Verifieer en reconcile die inkomste wat ingesamel is deur middel van boekstaatkennisgewings. Verskaf ondersteuning by die hersiening van tariewe vir dienste wat deur die direktoraat aangebied word. Fasiliteer die terugbetaling van oorbetalings of duplikaat-inkomste. Help ouditeure met die ouditproses in die direktoraat. Verwerk klein Agricultural Inputs-registrasie-aansoeke. Ontvang en verifieer dokumentasie vir klein aansoeke (bv. hernuwing van produkte, verandering van produkname en verandering van produk-eienaarskap). Verseker dat die korrekte voorgeskrewe tariewe betaal word. Keur klein aansoeke goed en reik sertifikate dienooreenkomstig uit. Personeeltoesig. Allokeer en verseker die kwaliteit van werk. Verseker kapasiteit en ontwikkeling van personeel. Verseke behoorlike benutting van toerusting. Evalueer personeelprestasie. Pas dissipline toe.

zu.title: Umphathi Omkhulu Wokubhalisa Kwezolimo
zu.summary: Koordinatha futhi ulawule izinsizakalo zengqungquthela zokubhalisa okokuthunyelwa kwezolimo njengamabetha amakhula, ukudla kwesibaya nezifo e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Isicelo kufanele sibe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma noma i-B-Degree kwi-Public Management / Public Administration / Office Administration / Business Administration / Business management (NQF 6). Kufanele kube nokuhlomula kokuhlinzekile eminyakeni eyi-two (2) yamava afanele kwezokengqungquthela endaweni ebusayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngeli-Act i-Fertilizer, Farm Feeds, Agriculture Remedies and Stock Remedies Act No.36 of 1947 kanye nemithetho yayo kanye nendlela ezilandzelwayo ezingaba ngumgomo. I-Public Service Regulations, izinqubo zokuthenga. Imithetho ehlobene nokuthunyelwa kwezolimo, abalawuli bezilwane zezinambuzane nezitshalo ezisuse amagciwane. I-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), ukuhlela nokuhlelabuhlela. Izinqumela namapholisi we-DPSA HR. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Amakhono okulawula, ukucubungula futhi kwenziwe, amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukubhala imibiko, ikhono lokuxhumana kahle nabantu emazingeni ahlukene. Amakhono okukhonza abathengi, inhlonipho ngocingo, amakhono okukhuthaza, ukucabanga ngendlela entsha namakhono okuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Umqashi kufanele abe wulungele ukusebenza amahora amadedele futhi abe nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukukoordinatha futhi ukulawula ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo zengqungquthela ekubhaliseni okokuthunyelwa kwezolimo ngokuvumelana nemithetho ehlobene nakho. Ukuphatha ukubhaliswa kwezicelo zezifo zezolimo ngokusho kwe-Fertilizer, Farm Feeds, Agricultural Remedies and Stock Remedies Act (Act No. 36 of 1947). Ukuphendula imibuzo evamile kubathinteko bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukuthuthukisa futhi kuqinisekiswe ukugcinwa kwezokusazazulwazi kanye nenqubo yokugcina amarekhodi. Ukubheka ukuzwakala kwemibhalo yokubhalisa ethunyelwa kubathinteko. Ukulungisa izindlu ezixhumene namatheni nabathinteko bangaphandle nangaphakathi ngokuqhathaniswa nezicelo zokubhalisa. Ukuqoqa ulwazi olubhalwe ngemibalo nezibalo ngokuqhathaniswa nezicelo zokubhalisa. Ukuxhumana ne-Agricultural Management Advisors noma i-Registrar ukuze kucutshungulwe izicelo zokubhalisa. Ukumela iyunithi emihlanganweni yokuxhumana nabathinteko. Ukulawula futhi kunikeze ukusekela okujwayelekile kwezimali nengqungquthela ekubhaliseni kokuthunyelwa kwezolimo. Ukwenza kwenzeke ukukhokhelwa abanikezeli besevisi ngesebenzele. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imali ebiziwe yokubhalisa izicelo ikhokhelwe njengoba kushiwo imithetho. Ukuthola futhi ukuqinisekisa ukukhokhelwa kwesicelo esitholiwe. Ukuqinisekisa futhi ukuhambisanisa imali etholwe ngaziqukuqulu zemali. Ukunikeza ukusekela ekuhlola amanani ezinkonzini ezinikezwa yidirektore. Ukwenza kwenzeke ukubuyisela imali ebone khona noma ephindwe. Ukusiza abahlohlwegciwabe ngenqubo yokuhlolwa kudirektore. Ukuqhuba izicelo ezincane zokubhalisa kokuthunyelwa kwezolimo. Ukuthola futhi ukuqinisekisa imibhalo yezicelo ezincane (isb. ukuvuselelwa kwemikhiqizo, ukushintshwa kwezibizo semikhiqizo nokushintshwa kobunikazi bemikhiqizo). Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amanani alungele okuthunyelwe akhokhelwe. Ukugunyaza izicelo ezincane futhi kuhambiswe isitifiketi. Ukulawula abasebenzi. Ukwaba futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi womgomo kanye nendlela ezenziwa ngayo. Ukuqinisekisa amandla nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kuhle kwezinsizakalo. Ukuhlola ukuziphatha kwabasebenzi. Ukufaka isiyalimo.

xh.title: Umhlekazi wolawulo lokulunga izikhumsha
xh.summary: Ukuququzelela nokuqonda iinkonzo zolawulo ekubhaliseni kweziselo ezingathunyelwa ezolimo njengamaxa okutyala, indlela yokutyala, neziselo ekwindlela eliya kwindlela.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ommise kwisure kaqinisekile onemvuzo wokuqala, nangokwesiquguni esikwizinga lakho-mthetho (National Diploma) okanye i-Degree ekwindlela yequqiyo. Ukuba ngolwazi kulawulo lokuqonda imiceli-migaqo.
xh.duties: Ukucoordinata nokuqonda ukubonelela iinkonzo zolawulo ekubhaliseni kwamasiko ezolimo ngokwemithetho efanayo. Ukulawula ukubhaliswa kwezicelo ezoluliswa kwimithi yokulima ngokwe-Fertilizer, Farm Feeds, Agricultural Remedies and Stock Remedies Act (Act No. 36 of 1947). Ukuphendula imibuzo eqhelekileyo kunye nabahluli-baqlagada bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukuyila nokuqinisekisa igcinwe imiba yolwazi kunye nesixokelelwanini sokulawulwa kwerekhodi. Ukuqinisekisa ubuchane bezifundo zokubhaliswa ezinikwa kubahluli-baqlagada. Ukuqokelela kunye nokulungiselela iincwadana zabathengi nabo babeliyobangathwa kwimicelo yokubhaliswa. Ukubhala ulwazi lwezibalo/iingxelo ezimalunga nemicelo yokubhaliswa. Ukunxibelelana nama-Agricultural Management Advisors okanye u-Registrar ukuze kucutshungulwe imicelo yokubhaliswa. Ukumela iqela kwiiNkomfa zinamatshwe kuwo wonke abahluli-baqlagada. Ukuqonda kwaye kuqulunqwe inkonzo yemali yentlalo yeyureluncedo yokubhaliswa kwe-Agricultural Inputs. Ukukhokela abekekise abo bancediswa ngemali yemisesebenzi yokubhaliswa engeniswayo ngokusemthethweni wemali esetyenzisiweyo. Ukusebenzisa imali ezikhutshwa ngemisebenzi yokubhaliswa emiselwa ngokumiselweyo. Ukugcina kwaye uqinisekise ukubhaliswa kolwazi lwekhowudi yokuzenzela. Ukuqinisekisa nokulinganisa iyonke imali engeniswe ngakunxibelelwano. Unako yemisebenzi yolawulo lwentsimbi yegqwetha kwisixhobo sayo esikhulu-bakhulu-bantu. Ukuqinisekisa ukucwangciswa kwemiyalelo yemisebenzi yokunqamla amathafa. Ukuqonda kwisebe esibuyela kweli Londolwano lwemfundo kubantlasi-abakuvela. Ukuyalela inkonzo yokubhaliswa kwemfundo yokudluliswa okanye eyongamileyo yokulungiselela imicelo evela koluntu. Ukuqinisekisa nokulinganisa ulwazi lwezicelo zamava ngaphandle kwexesha elifanelekileyo. Ukuyalela nokuhambisa kwamava amadoda amakhulu nakwesityhente. Ukwamkelwa kwemicelo efanelekileyo yokubhaliswa nokuyikhusela ngakunyaka. Ukulandelela nokuyalela imicelo yokubhaliswa iyaqinisekiswa. Ukulungisa izikhalazo zabasebenzi. Ukulungisa izikhalazo zamafa. Ukulinganisa ngakuhle imisebenzi yokuhamba kwabantu. Ukuyalela nokugcina imisebenzi yamathafa. Ukuqinisekisa ukubonelelwa koluntu. Ukuyalela imisebenzi yendlela yokuhlangabezana nomgaqo. Ukuyalela nokuyalelwa imisebenzi yamandla omgaqo-siseko. Ukuphatha imisebenzi. Ukulunga nokuhamba-hamba imisebenzi yamakhaka.
