jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Losses & Claims
jobs.summary: Administration clerk needed to manage losses and claims, including compliance reviews, investigations and file management at the Department of Agriculture in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Applicant must be in possession of a Grade 12 certificate. No experience required. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of basic accounting principles. Knowledge of clerical duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate a computer and collecting statistics. Knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Knowledge of working procedures in terms of the working environment. Job related skills: Good verbal and written communication skills. Planning and organisation skills, Computer literacy. Interpersonal relations. Flexibility and Ability to work within a team.
jobs.duties: Administration of losses and claims. Conduct compliance review on losses and claims invoices. Ensure cases files are opened, labelled correctly and with supporting documents. Conduct investigations of losses and claims by liaising with different stakeholders. Follow-up timeously on any outstanding information. Compile memos to Legal Services to obtain a legal opinion. Maintain and update registers for losses and claims. Clearing of suspense account. Compile journals to clear the Damage Vehicle Suspense Account. Prepare reconciliation of processed journals to Losses & Claims Registers for accuracy and completeness. Provide personnel administration clerical support services within the component. Perform leave administration for component. Serve as Local Transport Control Officer. Provide financial administration support services in the component. Capture and update expenditure in the component. Check correctness of subsistence and travel claims of officials and submit to manager for approval. Handle telephone accounts and petty cash for the component.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to 20 Steve Biko Street, Agriculture Place, Arcadia, Pretoria, 0002 or by email ACLCrecruit96@nda.gov.za.
jobs.notes: EE Target: African Males, Coloured Males, Indian Females and Persons with disability. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme. Appointment is subject to successful competition of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. af.title: Administrasieklerk: Verliese en Eisings
af.summary: Administrasieklerk benodig om verliese en eisings te bestuur, insluitend nakomings hersienings, ondersoeke en lêerbestuur by die Department of Agriculture in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Aansoeker moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat. Geen ervaring vereis. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van basiese rekeningkundige beginsels. Kennis van klerklike pligte, praktyke sowel as die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en statistiek te versamel. Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Kennis van werksprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Werksverwante vaardighede: Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, Rekenaargeletterdheid. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Buigsaamheid en vermoë om in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Administrasie van verliese en eisings. Voer nakomingshersiening uit op verlies- en eisingsfakturas. Verseker dat saaklêers geopen, korrek geëtiketteer en met ondersteunende dokumente voorsien word. Voer ondersoeke van verliese en eisings uit deur met verskillende belanghebbendes te skakel. Volg tydig op enige uitstaande inligting. Stel memo's op aan Regsdiens om 'n regsvooruitsig te verkry. Onderhou en werk registers vir verliese en eisings by. Skakeling van skeptiese rekening. Stel joernale op om die Skadevoertuig Skeptiese Rekening te skakel. Berei afstemming voor van verwerkte joernale na Verliese en Eisings Registers vir akkuraatheid en volledigheid. Verskaf personeeladministrasie klerklike ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent. Voer verlofadministrasie vir komponent uit. Diens as Plaaslike Vervoerbeheerbeampte. Verskaf finansiële administrasie ondersteuningsdienste in die komponent. Lê uitgawes in die komponent vas en werk by. Kontroleer korrektheid van bestaans- en reisbewys-eisings van amptenare en dien by bestuurder vir goedkeuring in. Hanteer telefoonrekenings en klein kontant vir die komponent.

zu.title: Umhleli Wokuphathwa: Losses & Claims
zu.summary: Kudingeka umhleli wokuphathwa ukuphatha imisebenli eyilahlekile noma eyenziwa yizinkundla, okuhlanganisa nokubuyekezwa ngokuvumelana, uphenyo nokugciniwa kwamafayela e-Department of Agriculture e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Isicelo kufanele sibe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12. Asikho isidingo sobuzathu. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngemigomo esisiseko yobuhlakani. Ulwazi ngemisebenli yomhleli, endlela zokwenza kanye namandla okubhala izibalo, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuthola izibal zabantu. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda indlela esemthethweni ephatha i-Public Service. Ulwazi ngendlela zokusebenza ngaphakathi kwesimo sokusebenza. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenli: Amakhono amahle okuxoxa ngomlomo nokubhala. Amakhono okucabangela nokuhlela, Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ubudlelwano bobuntu. Ukuguquguquka kanye namandla okusebenza ngaphakathi kwesiqandu.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwezimalo ezilahlekile nezinkundla. Ukwenza umhloli wokuvumelana kwi-invhoyisi zeziyaliwe noma ezenziwa yizinkundla. Qinisekisa ukuthi amafayela ezehlakalo avulwe, abhalwe ngendlela efanele futhi anamadokhumenti asekelayo. Ukwenza uphenyo mayelana nezimalo ezilahlekile noma ezenziwa yizinkundla ngokuxhumana nabalingane abahlukene. Ukulandela ngasikhathi sini konke ulwazi olungakajiwa. Ukulungisa amemo anikwa isevisi lezomthetho ukuze kutholakale umbono womthetho. Ukugcina futhi kubuye kubuyekezwe okubhalwayo kwezimalo ezilahlekile noma ezenziwa yizinkundla. Ukusula kabuhlungu kwi-akhawunti yokubambezeleka. Ukulungisa amajenali ukuze kusulwe i-Damage Vehicle Suspense Account. Ulungelelanishe olwenziwe kwezinsiza ezibhalwe kuyo Losses & Claims ukuze kuqiniseke ukuphelellana kobuhlakani nokuba buphelele. Uluke imisebenli yomhloli wabasebenzi ekwabelwe ngayo ngaphakathi kwaleso sabelo. Ukwenza imisebenli yokuhlela eyokushiya esikhundleni, eyoguquguquleka nokuba ngabakwenzayo abangangeni ento eqinileyo.

xh.title: Msekeli Wolawulo: Iintsobo Nezitywina
xh.summary: Kufuneka kubekho msekeli wolawulo oza kulawula iintsobo nezitywina, kuquka ukuphonononga ukuze kubekho ulwalamano lwemithetho, iingxoxo zophando nolawulo lwamafayili kwiSebe leZolimo ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka umfaki isicelo abe nesisitifikedi seGrade 12. Akukho nqanaba lohambo lwehlo lofuna. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngeengqondo ezisisiseko zokubala imali. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yomsekeli, iindlela zokwenza imisebenzi nako ukuba nakba ukuthatha imininingwane, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqokelela izibalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda inguqu yomthetho elawula Inkonzo kaRhulumente. Ulwazi ngendlela zokusebenza ngokommandla wokusebenza. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Amakhono amabaliso okuthetha nokubhala. Amakhono okucwangcisa nokuqamba. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ubumi babantu. Ukuguquguquka nako ukuba nako ukusebenza kwinqanaba lababantu.
xh.duties: Ulawulo lweintsobo nezitywina. Ukwenza okuphononongwa ngeentsobo nezitywina zamamvesi. Kuqinisekiswe ukuba iifayili zezitywina zivulwe, zifakwe iilebhile ngendlela efanelekileyo zenze namaxwebhu axhasayo. Kwenziwe ingxoxo yophando lweentsobo nezitywina ngokuthetha nabantu abahlukeneyo. Kulandelwe ngexesha elichanekileyo naluphi na ulwazi olusengozini. Kubhalwe iimemo kwiInkonzo zeMithetho ukuze kufunyanwe isiphithiphithi somthetho. Kugcinwe kwaye kubuyekezelwe ziintsingiso zeentsobo nezitywina. Kususwe ngokucacileyo esikweni sokubekiwa kwemali. Kubhalwe iijonali ukuze kususwe iSiko seKhompyutha seMoto eNtsontsileyo. Kulungiselelwe ulungelelwaniso lwejonali ezinikezelwe kwiiSingiso zeZitywina neZintsobo ukuze kube nokuqinisekiswa nokupela. Kunikezelwe imisebenzi yomsekeli wolawulo babasebenzi ngaphakathi kwenxalenye. Kwenziwe ulawulo lwamalungu oluhamba kwenxalenye. Kubengumlawuli weNdlela zoRhulumente welali. Kunikelwe imisebenzi yamalawulo emali yenkxaso kwenxalenye. Kuthathwe kwaye kubuyekezelwe imali echithiweyo kwenxalenye. Kuqwalaselwe ukuchanekileyo kwezitywina zabasebenzi ezimalini nasekuhamaben bazo kuzinikwe umlawuli ukuze azamke. Kuphathwe iakhawunti zeefowuni nezimali ezincinane kwenxalenye.

jobs.title: Director: Muncipal Property Valuation
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (an all-inclusive remuneration package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package) and a flexible portion that may be structured in terms of the applicable guidelines.
jobs.summary: Director needed to oversee municipal property valuation compliance with the MPRA, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and 5 years of senior management experience.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification in Property Studies, Real Estates, Property Evaluation and Management or equivalent qualification at NQF 7 as recognised by SAQA. 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in the Property Valuation field. Proficient in Microsoft Office packages (MS Word, MS PowerPoint, MS Teams, MS Excel and Outlook etc.) Other: The Nyukela Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme is to be completed before appointment to the post. A valid driver’s license. Extensive travelling. Registration as a Professional Valuer in terms of Property Valuers Profession Act, 2000 (Act 47 of 2000). Core Competencies: Strategic capacity and leadership. People Management and Empowerment. Programme and project management. Financial management. Change management. Knowledge management. Service delivery innovation. Problem solving and analysis. Client orientation and customer focus. Communication (verbal and written). Technical Competencies: In-depth knowledge of: MPRA and provisions of any legislation that must be considered in valuing specific properties. Valuation principles and techniques. Undertaking valuations of all types of properties. Mass appraisal techniques and processes. Ability to create and analyse datasets. Geographical Information Systems (GIS).
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will perform the following duties: Provide directions on the development of guidelines/circulars / regulations and / or amendments to the MPRA. Oversee the monitoring and support of municipal compliance with the provisions of the Municipal Property Rates Act (MPRA) in respect of the preparation of valuation and supplementary valuation rolls. Oversee the investigation and issuing of a public report on the effectiveness, consistency, uniformity and application of municipal valuations for rates purposes with respect to selected municipalities. Oversee the monitoring and support provincial departments responsible for local government on the valuation aspects of the MPRA vested with provinces. Oversee the research and development in the professional valuation field for continuous improvement/enhancement where required, considering critical decisions of Valuation Appeal Boards and international developments in the property valuation field.
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted electronically via email to: dcog20@tttrecruitment.co.za For application enquiries contact: To the T Recruitment Tel No: (010) 102 3607 OTHER POSTS
jobs.notes: Applicants are advised that a new application for employment (Z83) has been in effect since 1 January 2021. The new application for employment form can be downloaded at http://www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp. Applications submitted using the old Z83 form will not be accepted. Applications must be accompanied by a comprehensive CV, with specific starting and ending dates in all relevant positions and clarity on the levels and ranks pertaining to experience, as well as current remuneration package, as well as at least 2 contactable references. A recommended CV template is available on the department’s website on www.cogta.gov.za, click on the jobs tab. Only shortlisted candidates will be requested to submit certified documents/ copies on or before the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Incomplete applications or applications received after the closing date will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS position will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessment to assess cognitive capability, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Core competencies: Strategic capacity and leadership. People management and empowerment. Advanced programme and project management. Change management. Financial management. Process Competencies: Knowledge management. Service Delivery Innovation. Advanced problem-solving and analysis. Client orientation and customer focus. Advanced communication skills (written and verbal). The successful candidate will be appointed to positive results of a pre-employment screening process which includes criminal, credit, citizenship checks and verification of educational qualification certificates. The successful candidate will be appointed to probation for a period of 12 months and will be required to sign a performance agreement. It is important to note that it is the applicant’s responsibility to ensure that all information and attachments in support of the application are submitted by the due date. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right to make an appointment. The requirements for appointment at Senior Management Service level include the successful completion of Senior Management Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government, which can be accessed using the following link:    https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Candidates must provide proof of successful completion of the course prior to appointment. Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Munisipale Eiendomswaardering
af.summary: Direkteur benodig om munisipale eiendomswaarderingsnakoming met die MPRA te oorsien, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en 5 jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie in Eiendomsstudies, Vastgoed, Eiendomswaardering en Bestuur of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF 7 soos deur SAQA erken. 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in die Eiendomswaarderingsveld. Bevoegd in Microsoft Office-pakette (MS Word, MS PowerPoint, MS Teams, MS Excel en Outlook ens.). Ander: Die Nyukela Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme moet voor aanstelling in die pos voltooi word. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Uitgebreide reis. Registrasie as 'n Professionele Waardeerder ooreenkomstig die Property Valuers Profession Act, 2000 (Act 47 of 2000). Kernbevoegdhede: Strategiese kapasiteit en leierskap. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Program- en projekbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Veranderingsbestuur. Kennisbestuur. Diensleweringinnovasie. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Tegniese bevoegdhede: Diepgaande kennis van: MPRA en bepalings van enige wetgewing wat in ag geneem moet word by die waardering van spesifieke eiendomme. Waarderingsbeginsels en -tegnieke. Die onderneem van waardering van alle tipes eiendomme. Massawaarderingstegnieke en -prosesse. Vermoë om datastelles te skep en te ontleed. Geografiese Inligtingstelsels (GIS).
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal die volgende pligte uitvoer: Verskaf rigting oor die ontwikkeling van riglyne/sirkulêres/regulasies en/of wysigings tot die MPRA. Oorsien die monitering en ondersteuning van munisipale nakoming van die bepalings van die Municipal Property Rates Act (MPRA) ten opsigte van die voorbereiding van waarderings- en aanvullende waarderingsrolle. Oorsien die ondersoek en uitreiking van 'n openbare verslag oor die doeltreffendheid, konsekwentheid, eenvormigheid en toepassing van munisipale waarderings vir tariefdoeleindes ten opsigte van geselekteerde munisipaliteite. Oorsien die monitering en ondersteuning van provinsiale departemente wat vir plaaslike regering verantwoordelik is oor die waarderingsaspekte van die MPRA wat aan provinsies opgedra is. Oorsien die navorsing en ontwikkeling in die professionele waarderingsveld vir deurlopende verbetering/verbetering waar nodig, met inagneming van kritieke beslissings van Valuation Appeal Boards en internasionale ontwikkelings in die eiendomswaarderingsveld.

zu.title: Director: Muncipal Property Valuation

Qaphela futhi useke ukubhekwa komthetho nokwesekwa kwamasende emithetho yokuqashwa kwempahla komphakathi nangokuhambisana nalawo okufunwe ngokwenza ukuqashwa kwempahla emi kwisikhathi esithize, nokubuyekeza kabanzi imiphumela yokuqashwa kwempahla ukuthi isebenza kahle na, futhi uhlole ukusebenza kwalo kakhulu emihlotshweni yakomphakatha emiyalezweni yayo. Ulingo lweminyaka engu-2-3 enkimeni ephathelene nalesi. Ukukhombisa ukuzidela kumaphakheji e-Microsoft Office (i-MS Word, i-MS PowerPoint, i-MS Teams, i-MS Excel ne-Outlook njll.) Amakhono Awoyidlayo: Ikhwalithi yomsebenzi. Ukuzethemba. Isigcawu sokwethula. Ukuxhumana. Izindlela zokuqhathanisa nabantu. Ukusebenza njengeqembu. Ukucubungula nokuphetha. Amakhono Okobuchwepheshe: Ulwazi olujulile ngo: Umthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zikahulumeni. Isakhiwo Sezokuphathwa Kwentengo Ehlangenwe ndawonye. Amasistimu apha nalapha, okuyithi i-LOGIS ne-BAS. Ukuphathwa kwemibhalo yamathenda namasivumelwano. Umthetho Wesakhiwo Senkambiso Yokuqamba Ukuthenga. Isakhiwo se-BBE noMthetho we-BBBEE.

Ukubika ngentuthuko yephulani yokuqembuka ukuthenga njalo ngenyanga, njalo kwesikhashana, futhi njalo ngonyaka. jobs.title: Senior Personnel Officer: Remuneration and Conditions of
jobs.summary: Facilitate human resource conditions of service, including appointments, leave, and remuneration, for the Department of Cooperative Governance in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A 3-Year National Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resource Management or equivalent qualification at NQF 6/7 as recognised by SAQA. 2 years’ experience in Human Resource environment. Advantage: Experience in service conditions and benefits environment will be an added advantage. Proficient in PERSAL and Microsoft Office packages (MS Word, MS PowerPoint, MS Teams, MS Excel and Outlook, etc.). Generic Competencies: Quality of work. Reliability. Initiative. Communication. Interpersonal relations. Teamwork. Planning and execution. Technical Competencies: Knowledge of: Human Resource Management practices. Public Service Act. Public Service Regulations. Human Resource Management Policy. Protection of Personal Information Act. Determinations on Leave and Special Leave in the Public Service. Financial Manual. Guide for members of the Executive. Broad knowledge of PERSAL. DPSA Professionalisation Directives.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will perform the following duties: Facilitate the process of conditions of service such as appointments, promotion, transfers, relocations, resettlement, long service awards, leave, Policy on Incapacity Leave and Ill Health Retirement (PILIR), Injury on duty (IOD), and allowances. Implement human resource information on PERSAL, as well as data integrity and reporting of remuneration and conditions of service matters. Implement Remuneration and Conditions of Service policies, procedures, systems and templates. Implement the process of Termination of Service such as retirement, resignation etc.
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted electronically via email to: response3@multilead.co.za For application enquiries contact: Mr. Sphamandla Ndlovu Tel No: (011) 763 1103/4
jobs.notes: Applicants are advised that a new application for employment (Z83) has been in effect since 1 January 2021. The new application for employment form can be downloaded at http://www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp. Applications submitted using the old Z83 form will not be accepted. Applications must be accompanied by a comprehensive CV, with specific starting and ending dates in all relevant positions and clarity on the levels and ranks pertaining to experience, as well as current remuneration package, as well as at least 2 contactable references. A recommended CV template is available on the department’s website on www.cogta.gov.za, click on the jobs tab. Only shortlisted candidates will be requested to submit certified documents/ copies on or before the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Incomplete applications or applications received after the closing date will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS position will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessment to assess cognitive capability, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Core competencies: Strategic capacity and leadership. People management and empowerment. Advanced programme and project management. Change management. Financial management. Process Competencies: Knowledge management. Service Delivery Innovation. Advanced problem-solving and analysis. Client orientation and customer focus. Advanced communication skills (written and verbal). The successful candidate will be appointed to positive results of a pre-employment screening process which includes criminal, credit, citizenship checks and verification of educational qualification certificates. The successful candidate will be appointed to probation for a period of 12 months and will be required to sign a performance agreement. It is important to note that it is the applicant’s responsibility to ensure that all information and attachments in support of the application are submitted by the due date. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right to make an appointment. The requirements for appointment at Senior Management Service level include the successful completion of Senior Management Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government, which can be accessed using the following link:    https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Candidates must provide proof of successful completion of the course prior to appointment. Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Senior Personeelbeampte: Remunerasie en Diensvoorwaardes
af.summary: Fasiliteer menslikehulpbron-diensvoorwaardes, insluitend aanstellings, verlof en remunerasie, vir die Department of Cooperative Governance in Pretoria.

A minimum of five (5) years’ experience at middle/senior managerial level within the environmental management space, primarily focusing on coordinating national enforcement activities and coordinating enforcement operations. Functional experience and knowledge of enforcement processes and criminal justice system. zu.title: Umphathi: Ukuphoqelelwa kwezomThango nezasiBingelelo
zu.summary: Umphathi wokuPhoqelelwa kwezomThango nezasiBingelelo ukuqondanisa ukuphenya izigwebo nezinkohlakalo kanye nokuphoqelela umthetho wezemvelo ohlobene nomthango nezasiBingelelo eCape Town.
zu.requirements: Isimo sokufunda esingaphansi kwesigaba (NQF7) kwezesayensi yemvelo/ukuvikela / isayensi yemvelo / ukuphathwa kwemvelo noma umthetho noma isimo esifanele ngaphakathi kwale nkambu njengoba sivunyiwe yi-SAQA. Isiphephelo seminyaka emihlanu (5) sokuqashwa ezingeni eliphakathi/phezulu lokuphatha ngaphakathi kwendawo yokuphathwa kwemvelo, okugqamise ukugqugquzela izinkomba zokuphoqelelwa ezingeni lesizwe kanye nokuhlela izimisebenzi zokuphoqelela. Ukuqedwa ngempumelelo kweNkqubo yeSangqa Sokungena Somphathi Ohlele njengoba kunconyiwe yiNyuvesi Yezwe (NSG) kumele inikezwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Ukuqashelwa nokwazi ngemisebenzi yokuphoqelela kanye nenkqubo yesigwebo sezonalomthetho. Ulwazi: Izinqubomgomo zemvelo/ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo, umthetho, izinsimbi zamazwe ngamazwe ezifanele, inkqubo yomthetho wesivila, inkqubo nezinqubo zomthetho wesigwebo, umthetho wosiko kanye nomthetho wokuphatha. Izinqubo zokuhlola kanye nokuphatha ingozi, Izinqubo nemithetho yesebe loMphakathi kanye nowaMnyango, ukuhlela nomthetho wokuphatha ukusebenza, Amakhono & Amandla: Amakhono amahle okubhala nokuKhuluma. Ikhono lokusebenzisana kanye nokunika usizo abantu abahlukahlukene kanye nokuqonda izinhlobonhlobo zokusebenzisana phakathi kahulumende nokubambisana ekubuseni. Amakhano amanele kokuSebenzisa ikhompyutha, Amakhono anele okuhlola ngokusesikweni nokuKhuluma emphakathini; Izinhlobonhlobo ezinhle zobuntu kanye namakhono obudiplomatic, ukuphatha izinhlobonhlobo zokuhlobene, ukuzibandakanya nabanomzabalazo, ukuHlobene nomPhakathi, Amandla ukuHlela noKukhokha, ukuphatha ukusebenza, ukuphatha amaQaka nokuHlela amaPhrojekthi, ukuphatha Imali, ukuphatha ukuShintsha, ukuphatha Ulwazi, ukuDlula eNqubweni yokuhlinzeka ngeNkonzo (SDI), ukuSombulula izinkinga kanye nokuHlola, ukuphatha Abantu kanye nokubakho amandla, ukuQondiswa kumthengi noKugxila kumthengi, ikhono lokusebenza wedwa nakube lilungu lenqembu, ikhono lokusebenza nabantu abanzima kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga, umuzwa wobuzwe kanye nobuqotho, ukuziphendukela, ukuQotho, ukuHlinzeka ngesebe, ukuQondisa uqobo, umuzwa oveziphozulu wobungaqqeki, ukuvikela ubumfihlo bamadokhumenti. Kumele abe nephepha elivunyiwe lokushayela kanye nesifiso sokuhamba.
zu.duties: Qondanisa ukuphenya izigwebo mayelana nokuqhuka umthetho wezemvelo ohlobene nomthango nezasiBingelelo. Phoqelela umthetho wezemvelo ohlobene nomthango nezasiBingelelo ngokuletha ukuqashwa kanye nokuphenya ukubona ukwedlula umthetho wezemvelo. Qondanisa izinhlelo ezihlanganyelwayo kanye namaphrojekthi ezwe. Khuthaza kanye nokwenza ulwazi ngokuziphendukela nakho ngokuziphendukela nokuzinakekelwa okugxile ekuzwelaneni nokuphoqelelwa koMthetho wokuPhathwa kweNda eqoqekile kanye nomthetho osetshenziswa ngaphakathi kwemvelo yomthango nokuBingelelo. Hlela futhi usebenzise ukukhetha okufundisayo koMphathi oCasha izigwebo, isiBingelelo kanye nezinye izinhlobo eziphoqelela umthetho. Ukuhlobana kwaBanomzabalazo nokusebenzisana naye ukuxhumana nabanoMzabalazo ngemayelana nokuphoqelelwa komthango nezasiBingelelo ezingeni lezwe, izinhlelo kanye namaphrojekthi.

xh.title: Umlawuli: Ukuqinisekiswa kolwandle nakumile
xh.summary: Umlawuli Wokuqinisekiswa kolwandle nakumile ukuqhuba iinkqubo zophando lemigewu kwaye acebise ngokusemthethweni kolwandle nakumile kwilizwe leCape Town.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kwabafundi abangenayo (NQF7) kumzimba wesayense/nolondolozo/nokusiNgqongileyo nesenzo sayensi yemikhaya ekuphela kwentsimi okhoyo apho inalisiwe. Isimemo sokuba nenyanga yokwazi kwizinto eziphila ndawonye, kwezamathuba, nasekuhlolelwini komsebenzi ovela kummandla wesayensi yezemvelo ekuphela kwentsimi kwilizwe elipheleleyo lisemthethweni kwaye lichanekile ekupheleni kweminyaka yobudala emihlanu (5) nokuba nolwazi phakathi kwamagosa aphakathi aphanayo. Kukho imfuneko ekuphela kwentsimi yokuba namagunya nokuba namandla okusebenzisa imigaqo yesizwe esemthethweni kwaye alawule iinkqubo ezichanekileyo zokuphanda nokwenza imigewu, kwindawo apho kugqitywa khona ukungenwa koluntu kulawulo kuphela kwentsimi efunekayo kwiziko labaNyuli balawulo lokulawuleka kweGumbu leSizwe leNgcono njengoko kuchazwe kwithikhidi leSizwe leLuntu laseBurhulamenthe (NSG) lingangeniswa ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Isipili namandla okusebenzisa iinkqubo zomthetho nemithetho yokuqinisekisa kwaye ulwazi lwe nkqubo yomthetho ojikeleze imigewu. Ulwazi: Iinkqubo namagunya olwazi ngokwendalo, imithetho yesiXhosa yemvelo, iinkqubo namagunya apho kuthethwa ngawo kwihlabathi jikelele, iinkqubo zomthetho wezini zomthetho, iinkqubo namagunya omthetho wobuntu, iinkqubo zolawulo kunye noqeqesho lokulawula imiba ekulawulo. Iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa nokulawula iingozi, iinkqubo zomZimba weNkunzi nesebe, namagunya okucwangcisa nokulawula iinkqubo ezichanekileyo zokwenza umsebenzi ojikeleze, Ukuzipholisa nokusebenza ngokomnqweno: Amandla okubhala okusesikweni nokuva okusesikweni. Amandla okuziphatha nokubonelela ngolwazi kubantu ababini ngendlela echanekileyo ngokusesikweni ekukwaziseni iinkqubo namagunya omthetho kwilizwe. Iinkqubo namagunya esidanga esipheleleyo
xh.duties: Qhubeza iindaba zophando lemigewu ngokuthintana nemithetho yemikhaya ebusoloko ibangela iingozi ekulawulweni kolwandle nakumile. Zama ukuqinisekisa imithetho yemvelo ehlelwe ngokwendalo ekulawulekweni kolwandle nakumile ngokusebenzisa iindawo ezahlukeneyo zokuzama ukuphanda ukunqanda ukulimala koluntu. Qhubeza imisebenzi edibene nentsimbi kuluntu nakwindalo iquka imizamo yokuzama ukubeka iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezikumgangatho ophezulu. Qhubeza namagunya amaninzi ekuphuhliseni amandla nokwazi okusesikweni ngokuhambelana nomthetho weNkqubo yoluntu lolwandle nakumile kwaye achaneke nezinye iinkqubo ezilawula uluntu lolwandle nakumile. Cwangcisa ukuqeqeshwa koluntu nakwindalo ngokubonelela ngezibonelelo ezikumgangatho ophezulu ngokweMthetho weNkqubo yoluntu, ngokwemisebenzi yemisebe yamagosa amakhulu, kwaye ngokommandla. Imbali ngokwakhiwo kunye nokusebenzela kwaye ukhululeke kubasebenzeli belizwe njengoko kuchaziwe kumathethu wezohambo lulwandle nakumile, iinkqubo namagunya asebenzayo kuluntu nakwindalo.

Three (3) years relevant scientific experience post BSc qualification and compulsory registration with SACNASP as a Professional Natural Scientist. Ability and willingness to work at sea.

Identify research gaps and contribute to the development of appropriate scientific interventions. Participate in Scientific Working Groups and provide scientific inputs into fisheries management and policy development. Engage with fisheries managers, industry, research institutions and other stakeholders. Perform scientific analysis and regulatory functions. Manage human capital development.

af.title: Wetenskaplike Produksie Vlak A: Klein Pelagiese Vis en
af.summary: Doen navorsing oor klein pelagiese vis en visshulpbronne in Cape Town, voer voorraadassesserings uit en verskaf wetenskaplike advies vir volhoubare visserbestuur.
af.requirements: BSc (Hons) Natuurwetenskappe (NQF Vlak 8) of tersaaklike kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Drie (3) jaar tersaaklike wetenskaplike ervaring na BSc-kwalifikasie en verpligte registrasie by SACNASP as 'n Professionele Natuurwetenskaplike. Teoretiese en/of praktiese kennis van visser- en biologiese navorsingsaktiwiteite. Klein pelagiese vis en visshulpbronne en die volhoubare bestuur daarvan. Wetenskaplike metodes en modelle. Wetenskaplike navorsing en ontwikkeling. Data-analise en statistiek met 'n sterk kwantitatiewe fokus. Vertroudheid met sagtewaretoepassings vir die berging en manipulasie van groot datastelle en statistiese ontleding van data, veral die MS Access-databasisomgewing en die statistiese programmeertaal 'R'. Bewese vermoë om kwantitatiewe ontledings uit te voer. Navorsing en ontwikkeling; Program- en projekbestuur; Besluitneming; Spanleierskap; Kommunikasie; Beplanning en organisering; en Rekenaarvaardigheid. Vermoë om verslae en wetenskaplike referate in vaktydskrifte asook wetenskaplike oorsigte op te stel en te skryf. Vermoë om beleide te ontwikkel en toe te pas. Vermoë om navorsingsgapings te identifiseer en 'n toepaslike navorsingsprogram te ontwikkel. Vermoë om inligting in te samel en te ontleed. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en dokumente binne die vereiste tydperke aan plaaslike en internasionale forums voor te lê. Vermoë om individueel en in 'n span te werk. Vermoë om onder uiterste druk te werk. Vermoë en bereidwilligheid om ter see te werk.
af.duties: Doen navorsing oor pelagiese vis en visspesies, voer navorsingsopnames uit, dra by tot voorraadassesserings, en verskaf wetenskaplike advies vir optimale hulpbronbenutting en volhoubare visserbestuur. Ontwikkel en implementeer metodes, beleide, stelsels en prosedures. Doen navorsing en ontwikkeling. Identifiseer navorsingsgapings en dra by tot die ontwikkeling van toepaslike wetenskaplike ingrypings. Neem deel aan Wetenskaplike Werkgroepe en verskaf wetenskaplike insette tot visserbestuur en beleidontwikkeling. Skakel met visserbestuurders, die nywerheid, navorsingsinstellings en ander belanghebbendes. Voer wetenskaplike ontleding en regulatoriese funksies uit. Bestuur menslike kapitaalontwikkeling.

zu.title: Usosayensi Wekhiqizo Izinga A: Inhlanzi Ephilayo Ezincane Nama-
zu.summary: Qhuba ucwaningo ngeminhlanzi ephilayo ezincane nezinsiza zokudoba e Cape Town, wenze ukuhlolwa kwesitashi futhi unikeze izeluleko zesayensi zokuphathwa kokuqhubekayo kokudoba.
zu.requirements: I-BSc (Hons) eNatural Science (NQF Level 8) noma iziqu ezifanele njengoba ziyamukeleka yi-SAQA. Iminyaka emithathu (3) yohluhlelo lwesayensi oluhambisanayo ngemva kweziqu ze-BSc kanye nokubhalisa ngokum Seya ku-SACNASP njengesosayensi we-Professional Natural Scientist. Ulwazi olubalulekile nolwezobuciko kokuqonda izinkalo zenqondo mayelana nemisebenzi yososayensi nokudoba. Iminhlanzi ephilayo ezincane nezinsiza zokudoba kanye nokuphathwa kokuqhubekayo. Izindlela namamodeli wesayensi. Ucwaningo nokuthuthukiswa kwesayensi. Ukuhlaziya idatha nezibalo ngokugqamisa izinombolo. Ukuqonda izinhlelo zokusebenza kwekhompyutha zokugcina nokuqamba idatha enkulu kanye nokuhlaziya idatha ngezibalo, ikakhulukazi kumazinga e-MS Access database nokulimi lokuhlela izibalo i-'R'. Ikhono elivezwe lokwenza ukuhlaziya izinombolo. Ucwaningo nokuthuthukiswa; Ukuphathwa kwezinhlela namaphrojekthi; Ukuthatha izinqumo; Ukubusa iqembu; Ukuxhumana; Ukuhlela nokuqamba; kanye nokugqamisa ukusebenza ngamakhompyutha. Ikhono lokubumba futhi ubhale imibiko kanye namaphepha wesayensi abuyekeziwe abe ngomtholampilo kanye nokubuyekeza ngobungcweti. Ikhono lokuthuthukisa futhi usebenzise izinqubomgomo. Ikhono lokubona izikhala zocwaningo nokuthuthukisa uhlelo olufanele locwaningo. Ikhono lokuthola nokuhlaziya ulwazi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkani futhi unikeze amadokhumenti emhlanganweni wasekhaya nowamazwe ngomhlaba ngosuku oludingekile. Ikhono lokusebenza ngabanye nangamaphakathi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkani enkulu. Ikhono nokuzithoba lokusebenza olwandle.
zu.duties: Qhuba ucwaningo ngeminhlanzi ephilayo ezincane nezinhlobo zeminhlanzi, qhuba izivivinyo zocwaningo, galela ekuxoxweni mayelana nokuhlolwa kwesitashi, futhi unikeze izeluleko zesayensi ngokususetwa kwezinsiza okuhle kakhulu nokuphathwa kokuqhubekayo kokudoba. Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise izindlela, izinqubomgomo, izimiso namagagasi. Qhuba ucwaningo nokuthuthukiswa. Ziba izikhala zocwaningo futhi galela ekuthuthukiseni ukungenela okufanele kakhulu kolimi lwesayensi. Zibandakanya kuma-Scientific Working Groups futhi nikele izidingo zesayensi ekuphathweni kokudoba nasekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo. Xhumana nabaphathi bokudoba, izimboni, izikhungo zocwaningo kanye nabanye abangenela kule midwango. Yenza ukuhlaziya ngokwesayensi kanye nemisebenzi yokulawula. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kwempilo yabantu.

xh.summary: Yenza upando lwezonyama kwezixhobo zaseNxwemeni ezincinane kwaye ulawule ulwazi oluthile kwindawo yokuphila kweentlanzi ezincinane, ukwenza isiqinisekiso sokwahlulahlula namaphakathi wokusetyenziswa kolwazi lwentsimi ekunika izigqibo zolwazi ngokulawula iindlela zokwenza ulwazi ngokutsho kwentsimi. Ulwazi olungokwethiyori okanye lwenziwa ngokwenzululwazi kwaye lusebenzisa iindlela zokuphila kwezixhobo zolwazi lwentsimi. Ukuqonda izicelo zesoftware kwi-gabinathi yamagama amakhulu nokuqondaniswa kwawo kunye nokuhlalutywa kwamagama ngesibalo, ngokukodwa kwindawo ye-MS Access database nolwimi lokusebenzisa amagama olwazi 'oluhlelekileyo' (R). Isakhono esingqongqo ekwenzeni iintlonipho ezibonakalayo. Ulwazi nokuqonda; ukulawula iinkqubo namaphakathiwo; ukwenza isigqibo; ukulawula iqela; ukunxibelelana; ucwangciso nokuqamba; kwaye ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Isakhono sokwenza nokubhala iingxelo ngephepha elihlolwe ngamachwephesha nokuqhela kwamanye amachwepheshe. Isakhono sokwenza nokusebenzisa iinkqubo. Isakhono sokubona iindawo ezingekho lulwazi kuze kulawulwe inkqubo ehlelekileyo yolwazi. Isakhono sokuqokelela nokuqondanisa ulwazi. Isakhono sokusebenza ngexesha elinzima kwaye ufake amaxwebhu kwindawo yamazwe ngamazwe ngexesha elifunekayo. Isakhono sokusebenza sodwa nakwethimba. Isakhono sokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo olukhulu. Isakhono nokuzimisela ukusebenza elwandle.
xh.duties: Yenza upando lwezonyama kwezixhobo zolwazi ngezixhobo ezingamajelwe njengentsimi yenyama, yenza iingxelo zolwazi, nika izigqibo ngolwazi ngezixhobo ezisebenzayo kwaye unikeze ingcebiso ngolwazi ngezixhobo ezifanelekileyo nezifuna ukusetenziswa kwawo kwaye ulawule inkqubo ehlelekileyo yento ekuthiwa ulwazi lwentsimi. Yenza iqhubeekisa phambili inkqubo yolwazi, amagama, iinkqubo, kunye namagama ahlelekileyo alawulwayo. Yenza upando lwezonyama kunye nophando ngenkqubo yolwazi. Yazi iindawo ezifuna ukuphanda kwaye unike ingcebiso ngokuthi ziphendwe njani iindawo ezifana nephepha lezicwangciso. Zithathe inxaxheba kwiQela elisebenzayo ngolwazi kwaye unike ingcebiso ngolwazi oluthile kumagama nezixhobo. Thintathule neenkqubo ezilawula ulwazi lwentsimi, noshishino, nentlaka yolwazi kunye namanye amaphakathiwo. Yenza uhlobo lokulawula iinkqubo ezihlelekileyo ezilawula imithetho. Lawula ulwazi ngokusebenza ngabasebenzi.

zu.duties: Nikeza inkxaso yokuphathwa kwemincimbi kumashisho alawula imicimbi yolwazi nasezweni ngemihla yamalanga ohlelo lwezemvelo, futhi kumimango futhi kwabangengabaphathi ngamanye amagatsha ukulawula, ihle futhi emhlanganweni nezinkulumo-mphendulwano. Nikeza inkxaso ekuletheni inkxaso kumakhalenda yolwazi nangemigomo ehamba phambili ngemihla yemvelo. Siza ngezohlelo futhi ngalezo ndlela abakwazi ukuba bakhulume futhi banikeze ngemibuzo emincimbi yemihla ngamanye amalanga, imihlangano nezinkulumo-mphendulwano.

Amandla okusebenza. Amandla amaninzi okuhlela nokuceba, amandla amaninzi okunxibelelana. Amandla okunxibelelana nabaphathi abakhulu, ubuhlobo obuhle bomntu nomntu. Amandla okusebenza iiyure ezininzi ngokuzimela, ukuba nakho ukuqokelela nokuqonda inkcazelo. Amandla okusebenzisa iinkqubo zomthetho nokuqondisa ukwenziwa kwazo, ukuba nakho ukusebenza wedwa nasemaqabeni, nokuqonda ukusebenza ngaphantsi kokubandezeleka kakhulu nokuqonda ukuhlela noyilo ngaphantsi kokucinezela. Iyanakwa iresponsibility nokuqonda ukulawula iqela elahlukeneyo nokuqonda ukuhlola ubandezeleko.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yokulawulwa kweZiganeko iinkqubo zemihla yemisebenzi yehlelo ekusingqongileyo naseziganekweni zabaphathi kwaye nangeziganeko ezingengabo abaphathi kunye namadibha. Nceda izinto ezingeyonto nentsingiselo yazo nokuNxibelelana nokuvelisa iziganeko, iinkqubo ezizeleyo nakunxibelelwanweni nababanini-vathathelwana.

af.title: Administratiewe Beampte: Akkommodasie en Hulpondersteuning
af.summary: Administratiewe Beampte word in Cape Town benodig om administratiewe ondersteuning te verleen, instandhoudingsprojekte, kantoorruimte en hulpondersteuningsdienste vir die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment te bestuur.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Openbare Bestuur/Administrasie of 'n relevante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van een jaar (1) relevante ervaring in 'n relevante veld. Kennis van administratiewe prosedures. Finansiële Bestuur, Projakbestuur, HR-praktyke. Uitgebreide administratiewe ervaring. Kennis van Kontrakbestuur, monitering en beheer, Openbare Dienst- en Departementele prosedures. Vaardighede, Kommunikasievaardighede (geskrewe en gesproke), Leierskaps- en bestuursvaardighede. Koördinasi-, organisasie- en beplanningsvaardighede, Administratiewe en verslagdoening. Beskik oor beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, probleemoplossings- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Vermoë om vrywillig lang ure te werk, in staat wees om inligting in te samel en te analiseer. Vermoë om beleid toe te pas, in staat wees om individueel en in spanne te werk en vermoë om onder uiterste druk te werk en onder druk te organiseer en te beplan. Sinn vir verantwoordelikheid en vermoë om 'n multidissiplinêre span te lei en konflikte op te los. In staat wees om inligting en verslae in te samel en te interpreteer.
af.duties: Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning vir die sub-direktoraat. Administreer Klein Werke Instandhoudingsprojekte en kantoorruimte. Fasiliteer voedselhulpdienste. Verseker nakoming van higiënediensstandaarde in streekskantore. Verseker dat diep skoonmaak van matte tweemaal per jaar gedoen word. Verseker dat die aangestelde skoonmakers altyd op die perseel teenwoordig is vir daaglikse skoonmaakdienste. Verskaf voorraadondersteuning. Opstel en uitreik van versoek om kwotasies aan diensverskaffers op die Departementele databasis. Verseker die aanstelling van diensverskaffers om herstel- en instandhoudingswerk te doen, hou 'n voorraadregister aan. Rapporteer oortollige toerusting en instandhoudingsverbruiksgoedere vir aanvulling.

zu.title: Administrative Officer: Accommodation and Auxiliary
zu.summary: I-Administrative Officer idingwa e-Cape Town ukunikela inkxaso yabaphathi, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi okugcina imisebenzi, isikhala sohlu futhi izinsiza ezifana nezonyango eziyingxenye ye-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yesizwe (NQF6) ekuphateni komphakathi/kuqondisweni noma isitifiketi esihambisanana nesidingo. Okungenani unyaka oyedde (1) wokudlulisela oluhambisanana noma umkhakha ohambisanana. Ulwazi mayelana nezinqubo zokuphathwa kwezomphakathi. Ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuphathwa kophikela, amasiko abasebenzi Olunye ulwazi lwezokuphathwa komphakathi. Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwezivumelwano, ukuqapha nokulawula, izinqubo zezinsiza zomphakathi nomnyango. Amakhono, amakhono okuxhumana (abhalwe noma okuthethwayo), amakhono okuhola nokuphatha. Ikhono lokuxhumanisa, ukulungiselela nokuqamba izinhlelo, amakhono okubhala umbiko. Ikhono lokulungiselela nokuhlela, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ikhono lokusebenzela amahora amanengi ngokuzithandela, ikhono lokuqoqa nokuqonde imininingwane. Ikhono lokusebenzisa izinqubo, ikhono lokusebenzela ngabanye nakumasakhsi, futhi ikhono lokusebenzela ngaphansi kwesigaba sokucindezelwa okuyingozi kanye nokuqamba izinhlelo nokuhlela ngokucindezelwa. Umbono wokuphathwa kwezibopho nokuhola iqembu elidabuka kwezinhlobonhlobo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ikhono lokuqoqa nokutolika imininingwane nemibiko.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkxaso yabaphathi kuququzelelwano olungaphansi kwesigaba. Phatha amaphrojekthi Okugcina Imisebenzi Elingaphansi Kakhulu nendawo yohlelo. Sikhuthaza izinsiza zokusiza ngokudla. Qinisekisa ukuzwiswa kwezinga lezinsiza zokuhlanzwa ezikhumulweni ezifunda-womakhelwane. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukusha okujulile kwamatshansi kwenziwa kabili ngonyaka. Qinisekisa ukuthi abahlanzwayo ababekiwe bahlale besiteshini bonke umzuzu ngezinsiza zokuhlanzwa kwansuku zonke. Nikeza inkxaso yohlu lwezinto. Bhala uphiya usicelo samaxabiso kubaphathi bohlelo ohlwini lwemininingwane loMnyango. Qinisekisa ukubekwa kubaphathi bohlelo ukuze benziwe izilungiso nokugcina imisebenzi, ukuze kugcinwe usuku lwesitokhwe. Bika izinto ezingasebenziseki ezixhunywe ekugcineni imisebenzi nokugcwalisa okushisiwe ngokushintshwa.

xh.title: IOfisa Olulawula iNtengiswano: Indlu nokuNxibelelanisa ngakumbi
xh.summary: Kufuneka iOfisa Olulawula iNtengiswano eCape Town ukunika inkxaso yentengiswano, ulawulo lweenkqubo zolungiselelo, indawo yofice nesebenzo ezongezelelweyo kwisebe leForestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
xh.requirements: National Diploma (NQF6) kuPublic Management/Administration okanye isifundo esilinganayo nesifanelekileyo. Ubuncinane lonyaka omnye (1) wamava ahambelanayo kwinkalo ehambelanayo. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zoLawulo. uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lweNkqubo, iindlela zeHR namava mahle kwiNtengiswano. Ulwazi lokuLawula iinkontrakti, ukuqaphela nolawulo, iinkqubo zeNkonzo kaRhulumente nesebe. Ikhono, ikhono lokunxibelelana (elibhaliweyo nokuTHethwa), ikhono lobuqhawe nolawulo. Ikhono lokuhlanganisa, ukulungelelanisa nokuCwangcisa, intengiswano nokubhala iingxelo. Ukuba nokhono lokucwangcisa nolungelelanisa, nokusombulula iingxaki nongaqhelwa ziingxaki. Ikhono lokusebenza iiyure ezinde ngokuzithandela, ukuba nakho ukuqokelela nokuCohlisa ulwazi. Ikhono lokusebenzisa iinkqubo, ukusebenza wedwa nakwiiqela nokuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo olumandla nolungelelanisa nokucwangcisa ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Inkundla yoxinyephiso nokuba nakho ukulawula iqela elinamabalashe kwaye nakho ukusombulula iingxabano. Ukuba nakho ukuqokelela nokutolika ulwazi nengxelo.
xh.duties: Inika inkxaso yentengiswano kwelinye iqela elilawulayo. Ulawulo lweenkqubo ezincinci zokuLungiselela nendawo yofice. Ukwazisa iinkonzo zokuncedisana ngokutya. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela iinkqubo zokucoca kwiiofisi zommandla. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba ukucoca iindonga kwenziwa kabini ngonyaka. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba abacoci abakhethiweyo bahlala besiza endaweni yonke imihla yeenkonzo zokucoca. Inika inkxaso yokulawula izinto. Ukubhala nokunika iindlela eziceliweyo zokuvala kubaphathi benkonzo kuludwe lwesebe. Ukuqinisekisa ukhetho labaphathi benkonzo ukwenza izilungiso nolungiselelo, ukugcina ulwandelo lwezinto. Ukuxela isixhobo esingasetyenziswa nolungelelwaniso lolungiselelo olufuna ukuqinisekiswa.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: TVET Management Information System
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: College Of Cape Town TVET College, Central Office
jobs.summary: Manage the TVET Management Information System at the College of Cape Town TVET College, overseeing data capture, quality control, and student data reporting.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/ Matric, with a bachelor’s degree in information management, computing, or relevant equivalent qualification. Three (3) to five (5) years’ working experience in Information Management, of which three (3) years must be at supervisory level. Computer literacy (MS Word, MS PowerPoint, MS Excel, MS Access, and MS Outlook). Excellent communication skills (written and verbal). Fully bilingual in at least two official languages (Preferably: English plus Afrikaans or Xhosa). A valid driver’s license. The ideal candidate must have knowledge of policies and governance environment of TVET Colleges including knowledge of the TVETMIS system, annual reporting requirements by the Higher Education Institutions. Knowledge and understanding of Information Management. Knowledge, understanding, application and interpretation of office management, Coltech, data warehouse and ITS prescripts. Knowledge of South African education and the TVET College sector (Recommended). Accurate administrative, as well as planning and organising skills. Financial management, including Report writing skills. Communication and interpersonal skills. Problem solving and Analytical skills. Be client service oriented. Project management skills. Team leadership skills. Planning and organising, as well as People management skills. Must have integrity, be committed, proactive and loyal.
jobs.duties: TVET MIS management, capturing and data extraction for the College. Set up the system in readiness for enrolment and support other processes. Control the quality of captured data and report if there are errors. Maintain the College TVET MIS system. Manage the student data. Use various tools, extract data to facilitate statistical reporting. Interact with service providers regarding upgrades and request assistance. Maintain data on student registration. Compile monthly reports to management and the DHET (Example: Submit reports on student registration regarding Ministerially approved programmes as well as on apprenticeships, skills and learnerships, and short skills learning programmes.) Compile and monitor academic examination and staff statistics of the college and submit reports on quarterly basis to management and DHET. Compile monthly, quarterly and annual reports as requested. Maintain, capture and validate inputs captured on ITS student and other related systems. Set up the student system for registration of students and ensure creditability and reliability. Maintain the ITS student system and other related systems. Monitor capturing, quality control, validation, run procedure, create files and ensure that entries are sent to DHET head office. Management of human, physical and financial services. Render management service to the staff. Ensure completion of performance agreements by all employees in the unit. Supervision of staff.
jobs.applications: Mr B. Klaas Tel No: (021) 404 6700, The Recruitment Officer, College of Cape Town for TVET, P.O Box 1054, Cape Town 8000, or Hand deliver to the Central Office, 334 Albert Road, Salt River, Cape Town, 7925 or email HRapplications@cct.edu.za
jobs.notes: The College is an affirmative action employer. Applicants are not required to submit any copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit a fully signed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae. Applications must be submitted on a new form Z83 obtainable from any Public Sector Department/TVET College website. The reference number and the post title must be quoted on the Z83 which must be originally signed and dated by the applicant. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be submitted by shortlisted candidates. Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with the requirements will not be considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications and national certificates (where applicable) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). The Department reserves the right not to fill the posts. The successful candidate will be subjected to personnel suitability checks and other vetting procedures. Applicants are respectfully informed that correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If notification of an interview is not received within three (3) months after the closing date, candidates may regard their application as unsuccessful. The Department will not be liable where applicants use incorrect/no reference number(s) on their applications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other will be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with the requirements will not be considered.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: TVET Bestuursinligtingstelsel
af.summary: Bestuur die TVET Bestuursinligtingstelsel by die College of Cape Town TVET College, met toesig oor data vaslegging, gehaltebeheer en studentdatarapportering.
af.requirements: Graad 12/ Matric, met 'n baccalaureusgraad in inligtingbestuur, rekenaarwetenskap, of 'n relevante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se werkervaring in Inligtingbestuur, waarvan drie (3) jaar op toesiggewende vlak moet wees. Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Word, MS PowerPoint, MS Excel, MS Access en MS Outlook). Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling). Ten volle tweetalig in ten minste twee amptelike tale (Voorkeur: Engels plus Afrikaans of Xhosa). 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Die ideale kandidaat moet kennis hê van beleide en die bestuursomgewings van TVET Colleges, insluitend kennis van die TVETMIS-stelsel en die jaarlikse rapporteringsvereistes van die Higher Education Institutions. Kennis en begrip van Inligtingbestuur. Kennis, begrip, toepassing en interpretasie van kantoorbestuur, Coltech, data warehouse en ITS-voorskrifte. Kennis van die Suid-Afrikaanse onderwys en die TVET College-sektor (Aanbeveel). Akkurate administratiewe, asook beplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede. Finansiële bestuur, insluitend verslagskryfvaardighede. Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Probleemoplossings- en analitiese vaardighede. Wees kliëntediens georiënteerd. Projektbestuursvaardighede. Spanleierskapsvaardighede. Beplanning en organisering, asook mensebestuursvaardighede. Moet integriteit hê, toegewyd, proaktief en lojaal wees.
af.duties: TVET MIS-bestuur, vaslegging en data-onttrekking vir die College. Stel die stelsel gereed vir inskrywing en ondersteun ander prosesse. Beheer die gehalte van vasgelêde data en rapporteer indien daar foute is. Onderhou die College se TVET MIS-stelsel. Bestuur die studentdata. Gebruik verskeie instrumente, onttrek data om statistiese rapportering te vergemaklik. Interakteer met diensverskaffers rakende opgraderings en versoek bystand. Onderhou data oor studentregistrasie. Stel maandelikse verslae op vir bestuur en die DHET (Voorbeeld: Dien verslae in oor studentregistrasie rakende Ministerieel goedgekeurde programme, asook oor leerlingskappe, vaardighede en leerderskappe, en kort vaardigheidsleerprogramme.) Stel akademiese eksamen- en personeelstatistieke van die kollege op en monitor dit en dien verslae op 'n kwartaalgewyse basis by bestuur en DHET in. Stel maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse verslae soos versoek op. Onderhou, lê vas en valideer insette wat op ITS-student en ander verwante stelsels vasgelê is. Stel die studentestelsel op vir registrasie van studente en verseker geloofwaardigheid en betroubaarheid. Onderhou die ITS-studentestelsel en ander verwante stelsels. Monitor vaslegging, gehaltebeheer, validasie, voer prosedures uit, skep lêers en verseker dat inskrywings na DHET-hoofkantoor gestuur word. Bestuur van menslike, fisiese en finansiële dienste. Lewer bestuursdiens aan die personeel. Verseker voltooiing van prestasie-ooreenkomste deur alle werknemers in die eenheid. Toesig oor personeel.

zu.title: Umsekeli Wezindlela: TVET Management Information System
zu.summary: Phatha i-TVET Management Information System e-College of Cape Town TVET College, ubukele ukuthwebwa kwemininingwane, ukulawula izinga, nokubika imininingwane yabafundi.
zu.requirements: Grade 12/ Matric, ngediploma leziqu ezinhloni kulemininingwane ephathelene nezincwadi, isibaluli, noma isiqinisekiso esifanayo. Iminyaka eyithathu (3) kuya kweyihlanu (5) yamava wokusebenza ekuPhathweni kwemininingwane, lapho eminyakeni eyisithupha (3) kumele ibe ngazinga lokubukelela. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, MS PowerPoint, MS Excel, MS Access, kanye ne-MS Outlook). Amandla amahle okuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokukhulunywa). Ukwazi kahle izilimi ezimbili ezisemthethweni okungenani (Okuncanyelwa: isiNgilisi kanye nesiBhunu noma isiXhosa). Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Umuntu ofanelekile kumele abe nolwazi ngemigomo nendlela yokuphathwa kwe-TVET Colleges kuhlanganise nalolwazi ngohlelo lwe-TVETMIS, izidingo zokubika ngaminyaka yonke ngabasunguli bemfundo ephakeme. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwemininingwane. Ulwazi, ukuqonda, ukusebenzisa nokutolula imithetho yokuphathwa kwezofikisi, i-Coltech, idatha esigcineni kanye ne-ITS. Ulwazi ngemfundo yaseNingizimu Afrika nangomkhakha we-TVET College (Okuncanyelwa). Amakhono okulawula izindlu zangasese, kanye nokuhlela nokuhlela. Ukuphathwa kwezimali, kuhlanganise namakhono okubhala imibiko. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuba nogudu lokukhonza abathengi. Amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi. Amakhono okuba ngumholi webhodi. Ukulungiselela nokuhlela, kanye namakhono okuphatha abantu. Kumele ube nolwazi, uzibophezele, ube ngaphambili futhi ube nomoya wokuthembeka.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwe-TVET MIS, ukuthwebula nokukhipha idatha yasoqoqoselo. Ukuhlela uhlelo ukulungele ukubhalisa nokusekela ezinye izinqubo. Lawula izinga ledatha ethathiwe futhi ubike uma kukhona amaphutha. Gcina uhlelo lwe-TVET MIS lwasoqoqoselo. Phatha idatha yabafundi. Sebenzisa izixhazo ezahlukene, kukhiphe idatha ukuze kuqedele ukubika izibalo. Sebenzisana ngokuphathwa ngamandla emikhiqizi ngezinto ezithuthukisiwe futhi ucele usizo. Gcina idatha ngokubhaliswa kwabafundi. Hlanganisa imibiko yanyanga zonke ekubusini nakwi-DHET (Isibonelo: Thumela imibiko ngokubhaliswa kwabafundi ngohlelo olugunyaziwe nguNgqongqoshe kanye nangokufundela izakhono, kanye nezinhlela zokufunda izakhono ezifushane.) Hlanganisa futhi ulawule izibalo zokuhlolwa kwezifundo namaphazili wesikole bese uthumela imibiko njalo ngesikhathi senyanga ezintathu ekubusini nakwi-DHET. Hlanganisa imibiko yanyanga zonke, yenyanga ezintathu nonyaka zonke njengoba kuceliwe. Gcina, thwebula futhi qinisekise okufakwe kuhlelo lwe-ITS labafundi nakwezinye izinhlelo ezihlobene. Hlela uhlelo labafundi ukubhaliswa kwabafundi futhi uqinisekise ukuthembeka nokuzigqaja. Gcina uhlelo lwe-ITS labafundi nakwezinye izinhlelo ezihlobene. Bheka ukuthwebula, ukulawula izinga, ukuqinisekisa, ukuqalisa inqubo, ukwakhelelwe amafayela futhi uqinisekise ukuthi okufakwayo kuthunyelwa ehhovisi eliyinhloko le-DHET. Ukuphathwa kwezinkonzo zabantu, ezomzimba nezemali. Nikeza inkonzo yokuphatha abasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukugcwaliswa kwezivumelano ngamandla ngawo wonke amalungu egumbi. Ukubukelela abasebenzi.

xh.title: Umzekeli weNgqalasela: Inqanaba le-4
xh.summary: Lawula inkqubo ye-TVET Management Information System kwi-College of Cape Town TVET College, ijonga ukuqokelelwa kwamaxhwebhu, ulawulo lolungelo, nokuchaza iinkcukacha zamaxhwebhu abafundi.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12/ Matric, enqanaba lesidanga se-bachelor kwulawulo lwenkcukacha, ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha, okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo esifanelekileyo. Iiminyaka elithoba (3) ukuya kwihlanu (5) yamava emsebenzini kuLawulo Lwenkcukacha, apho kwiminyaka elithoba (3) kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lokuhlola. Ukusebenza ngokulula ngekhompyutha (i-MS Word, i-MS PowerPoint, i-MS Excel, i-MS Access, ne-MS Outlook). Amakhono amanengamnelo obuntu aphelene nokuqonda (abhalwayo nokuThethwayo). Ukuba nesiqinisekiso sokubhalisa nokuziphilisa kweli laseMzantsi Afrika (Kuthandwa kakhulu: isiNgesi plus isiBhulu okanye isiXhosa). Ilayisensi evakalayo yokushayela umqhubi. Umsebenzisi ofanelekelayo kufuneka abe nolwazi ngemigaqo-nkqubo nendawo yolawulo kumaziko e-TVET Colleges kuquka nokulwazi ngenkqubo ye-TVETMIS, neemfuno zexesha lonyaka zokuchaza ngezikhungo zeNguqu-Higher Education Institutions. Ulwazi nokuqonda uLawulo Lwenkcukacha. Ulwazi, ukuqonda, ukusebenzisa nokutolika imigaqo yokulawula ofisi, i-Coltech, idata warehouse ne-ITS prescripts. Ulwazi ngemfundo yaseMzantsi Afrika nakumaziko e-TVET College (Kundululwa). Amanyathelo apheleleyo okulawula, kwakunye namakhono okucwangcisa nokuqamba. Ulawulo lwemali, kuquka namakhono okubhala iingxelo. Amakhono okunxibelelaneka namanyathelo okuziphatha. Amakhono okuxazula iingxaki nokuQonda. Ukuba nomlinganiselo wezimo zikaxhamla/ abathengi. Amakhono okulawula iprojekthi. Amakhono okuba ngumphathi wetim. Ukucwangcisa nokuqamba, kwakunye namakhono okulawula abantu. Kufuneka ube nolwazi oluzinzileyo, uzibophelele, ube ngumntu oqhutywa yiingcinga ezize ngenkampani, aphile ngokuzithembisa.
xh.duties: Ukulawula i-TVET MIS, ukuqokelela nokuqhothisa idata kumaziko. Misela inkqubo ulungele ukwamkela abafundi uze uxhase ezinye iinkqubo. Lawula umgangatho wedata ebaqokelelweyo uze uxele ngeempazamo ezikhoyo. Gcina inkqubo ye-TVET MIS yomaziko. Lawula idata yabafundi. Sebenzisa izixhobo ezahlukeneyo, qhothisa idata ukunceda ukuchaza ngesibalo. Nxibelela neenkqubo zezixhobo ngeenkqubo zokuqhuba phambili uze ucele inkxaso. Gcina idata ngokuqwalaselwa kwabafundi. Qamba iingxelo nyanga zonke kulawulo nakuwo onke amaziko e-DHET (Umzekelo: Zisa iingxelo ngokuqwalaselwa kwabafundi ngeenkqubo ezivunyiweyo nguNgqonyela nangomsebenzi wonkululeko, amakhono okuzifundisa, kunye neenkqubo ezimfutshane zamakhono okuzifundisa.) Qamba uze ulawule isibalo sezinto ezifundiswayo ngesibalo sabasebenzi bomaziko uze ufake iingxelo ngeenyanga ezintathu kulawulo nakuwo onke amaziko e-DHET. Qamba iingxelo nyanga zonke, ngeenyanga ezintathu nakumnyaka wonke njengoko celwa. Gcina, qokelela uze uqinisekise okuqokelelweyo kwabafudi kunye nabakunye oonxibelelwano abaqokelelweyo kwinkqubo yabafundi ye-ITS namanye oonxibelelwano. Misela inkqubo yabafundi ukwamkela abafundi uze uqinisekise ukuzinza nokuqiniseka. Gcina inkqubo yabafundi ye-ITS namanye oonxibelelwano abahlobene nayo. Qwalasela ukuqokelelwa kwamaxhwebhu, ulawulo lomgangatho, ukuqinisekisa, ukusebenzisa iinkqubo, ukudala amafayile uze uqinisekise ukuba okuqokelelweyo kuthunyelwa kofisi ebuDE e-DHET. Ulawulo lweenkonzo zabantu, ezoBuchwephesha nasezimalini. Yiza ngenkonzo yolawulo kubasebenzi. Qwalasela ukubakho kweenkqubo zobudlelwane beziga kwabo bonke abasebenzi kule ndawo. Ulawulo lwabasebenzi.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezibursari: Ukubhalisa
zu.summary: Kudingeka umphathi wezibursari ehhovisi elikhulu elise-King William's Town ukuphatha nokuhlela izinhlela zezibursari zabafundi nokuphathwa kwenkonzo yemsizo emali yezimali ze-TVET college.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuphatha njalo nokuhlela izinhlela zezibursari zabafundi nezinsiza zokuphathwa komsizo wezimali e-college yonke. Qinisekisa ukuphatha njalo nokuphatha inqubo yokufaka izicelo zezibursari nezinhlela zomsizo wezimali e-college yonke ngokuhlanganiswa nemihlahlandlela ye-NSFAS, isivumelwano sokuqashwa somnikazi wesimali/MOU/SLA kanye nemigomo. Qinisekisa ukuphatha njalo nokugunyaza ukukhishwa kwemali. Qinisekisa ukuphatha njalo nokwenza lula ezinye izinhlela zomsizo wezimali. Qinisekisa ukuphatha njalo, ukuqapha, ukuhlola ukusebenza kanye nokugcina isisekelo sedatha yazo zonke izicelo zabafungi ngokwesidingo se-Department of Higher Education and Training kanye ne-NSFAS. Qinisekisa ukuphatha njalo ukuthi uhlanganise imibiko yazo zonke izabelo zezibursari nomsizo wezimali e-college yonke. Ukulayisha ukubhala kwaye kukhishwe konke ukudluliselwa kwemali yokufundisa kwe-NSFAS kwabafundi kusistimu yase-Coltech kuhlanganise ukuqondanisa nokulinganisa. Lokho. Lungiselela futhi uqedele umbiko wonyaka wokuqondanisa i-NSFAS ngokwemali etholwe ngaphambili kanye nokwamukelwa kokufundisa/ukudluliselwa kwemali. Hlola konke ukukhokhelwa okungaphezulu kanye namasethingi enani elikhokhelwe ngentengo e-NSFAS okufanele kubuyiselwe futhi kukhokhwe kuleyo-NSFAS nsukuzonke. Landelela imibiko engaqediwe. Wenze lula izicelo eziku-inthanethi, qamatha idatha yabafundi kwamafomethi okubhalisa, futhi ulungise izinhlu zokufundiswa. Nikeza ulwazi ngomsizo wezimali ngesikhathi sokubhalisa nokuqalela abafundi abasha nalabo ababuya. Siza ngendlu yobungcweti, izimali zokuhamba, kanye nezicelo zemibiko yokubakhona kwabafundi. Phathela imibuzo yenani ngomlomo nangokubhala evela kubafundi, kubazali, kanye nokuphathwa kwe-college.

xh.title: Ofisi yesebe lemfundo: UkuBhalisa
xh.summary: Kufuneka ofisi yesebe lemfundo kwindawo ekuphela komntla eKing William's Town ukuba alawule aphinde alungelelanise iisikimu zemfundo yabafundi nokulawula incedo lemali eyimali ngenjongo yeKholeji yeTVET.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ulawulo jikelele nolungelelaniso lweesikimu zemfundo yabafunki nesevisi zolawulo luncedo lemali yemali zikwakhe lonke ikholeji. Qinisekisa ulawulo lolu jikelele lolawulo kwenkqubo yesicelo seemfundo yemali ezincedo zemali yemali kwakhe lonke ikholeji ngokwemigaqo yeNSFAS, ngeMOU/SLA yomnikelo-nemali neenkqubo. Qinisekisa ulawulo lolu jikelele negunya lokugcwathiswa kweemali. Qinisekisa ulawulo lolu jikelele nokulungelelanisa olunye uncedo lwemfundo yemali ezincedo. Qinisekisa ulawulo lolu jikelele, ulwelo, inkanuko zokulinganisa nokugcina isiseko se-data esikwazo zonke iicelo zabafundi ngokwemfuno zeSebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo noMzobo ngeNSFAS. Qinisekisa ulawulo lolu jikelele ukuze udibanise iingxelo kuzo zonke iindlela zemfundo yemali yemali ezincedo yabelwe kuyo yonke ikholeji. Ukulayisha nokuthumela zonke iNSFAS iinguqulo zemali yesifundo kwinkqubo yeColtech kuquka nokulinganisela nokulinganisa kwayo. Lukhokeleze uphinde ugcwalise ingxelo yonyaka yokulinganisa iNSFAS ngokwemali ethunyelwe phambili nokwamkelwa kwemali yesifundo/iinguqulo. Qaphela zonke iNSFAS iinkhokeleko ezingaphezu kweyalinganiswe nenzuzo enomvuzo ongawu qinisekiso ongawukufaka kwaye ibuyiswe kwiNSFAS ngonyaka. Landelela iingxelo ezingagqitywanga. Lungelelanise iicelo ezikwi-intanethi, tsala idatha yomfundi kwizikhokelo zokubhalisa, uphinde ulungelelanise uludwe oluncedo lemali. Yiba nolwazi olubekiweyo ngencelo lemali ngelithuba lobhaliso nokwaziswa kwabafundi abasha nabo babuyayo. Nceda ngendawo yokuhlala yabucala, ngezimali zokuhatyha, ngee ngxelo eziceliwo ngobukho babafundi. Phatha imibuzo emabala nengxelo ngeencelo zemali abafundi, abazali, nolawulo ikholeji.
