Verseker die implementering en monitering van die Voorsieningskettingbeleid. Stel 'n stelsel in vir voorsiening, verkryging, voorraadbeheer en verslaggewing. Identifiseer voorkeurpuntstelsel en toepaslike doelwitte per kommoditeit volgens voorkeurverkrygingsbeleiddoelwitte. Voer bewustheid oor goedgekeurde SCM-beleide.

zu.title: Isikhundla sezimpahla/Umuntu ongaphansi kwezohwebo: Isigaba sezimali
zu.summary: Isikhundla sezimpahla esigabeni sezimali ehhovisi elikhulu le-Department of Higher Education and Training, siphequlula izibuko sezimpahla nezinqubo zokulahla izimpahla.
zu.requirements: I-Matric noma i-NCV Level 4 kanye nediploma/degree evunyiwe yeminyaka emithathu (3) ku-Finance Management, Asset management, Accounting noma Auditing noma izifundo ezihlobene; minyaka yama-3-5 yamava emvelwaneni kwe-Financial Management nokuphothulwa komyalo othintekayo, wemibhalo, wenqubomgomo kanye nezinqubo. Ukwazi mayelana nesistimu ye-BAS/LOGIS & COLTECH. Ukwazi inqubo yokulahla izimpahla; Ulwazi nokuqonda umtholonye womthetho ophatha i-Public Services; Ulwazi nge-Assets Management; Ulwazi ngezinqubomgomo ze-Supply Chain; Ulwazi ngemsebenzi ongumgomo we-Department of Higher Education. Ulwazi namakhono: Okuphathwa kwamaphephandaba; Ukuhlela nokuqamba; Okuphathwa kwezimali; Ukubhala imibiko; Ukuxhumana nabantu; Ukuxazulula izinkinga; Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Ukuhlaziya; Ukuqondiswa kubathengi; Okuphathwa kwezinhlelo; Ukubusa iqembu; Ukuphatha abantu.
zu.duties: Ukuphothula nokuqapha izinqubomgomo nezinqubo ze-Asset management ngokuhambisana nezilinganiso ze-GRAP kanye nomthetho othintekayo. Ukuvumelanisa ukuhlolwa okuyisobaya kwezimpahla. Ukuphatha isibuko se-Fixed Asset (FAR) futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana ne-General ledger (GL). Ukuthuthuka, kuphothulwe futhi kuqashelwe izinhlelo zokuthola, ukugcina, kanye nokulahla izimpahla, futhi kuphothulwe ngempumelelo inqubomgomo ye-Asset Management ngaphakathi kwe-College. Ukuphatha ukubhaliswa kwamaphuzu ezimpahla nokulahla futhi kuqinisekiswe ukwaziswa okuqinisekileyo kwezimpahla kwimibiko yezimali yonyaka i-Annual Financial Statements AFS njengokuqondiwe ku-GRAP. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphothulwa nokuqaphwa kwenqubomgomo ye-Supply Chain. Ukuletha isistimu yokuhlinzeka, ukuthenga, ukulawula izinto ezikhona kanye nokubika. Ukuqamba isistimu yamaphuzu okuthandwayo kanye nemigomo efanele ngaphandle komsoco ngokomgomo wokuthenga okuthandwayo. Ukwazi ukululeka mayelana nezinqubomgomo ze-SCM ezamukelekile.

xh.title: Isikhulu seempahla/unikezelo lwezinto: Isigaba lezeimali
xh.summary: Isikhulu seempahla kwisigaba lezeimali ekomkhulu le Department of Higher Education and Training, eliphatha amarejista eempahla nemigaqo yokulahla iimpahla.
xh.requirements: Matric okanye NCV Level 4 kunye nedigima/idiploma evunyiweyo yeminyaka emithathu (3) kwiFinance Management, Asset management, Accounting okanye Auditing okanye ngesiifikitsho ezinxulumeneyo; 3-5 years’ experience kwimeko yeFinancial Management nanokusetyenziswa kwemigaqo ezithile, iimvumelwano, iinkqubo nemigaqo. Ulwazi ngeBAS/LOGIS & COLTECH system. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokulahla iimpahla; Ulwazi nokuqonda kwesakhiwo sezomthetho esilawula iinkonzo zorhwebo; Ulwazi ngeAssets Management; Ulwazi ngeSupply Chain Policies; Ulwazi ngomthetho weDepartment of Higher Education. Ulwazi namakhono: Administrative; Planning and organising; Financial management; Report writing; Communication and interpersonal; Problem solving; Computer literacy; Analytical; Client oriented; Project management; Team leadership; People management.
xh.duties: Zisebenzise ulilandele iinkqubo nemigaqo yeAsset management ngokulawulwa kweGRAP standards nemigaqo ezithile. Ulawulwe ukuqinisekiswa ngokomzimba kweempahla. Phatha iFixed Asset register (FAR) ukuze uqinisekise ulungelelwaniso kwiGeneral ledger (GL). Yakha, zisebenzise ulilandele iiplani zokufumana, ukugcina, nolahla iimpahla, uze usebenzise ngokufanelekileyo iAsset Management Strategy ngaphakathi kwiCollege. Phatha ukubhalwa kwangaphandle nokulahla iimpahla ukuze uqinisekise ukubaluleka kweAsset disclosure kwiAnnual Financial Statements AFS njengoko kumiselwe kwiGRAP. Qinisekisa ukusebenzisa nokuqonda iSupply Chain policy. Faka inkqubo yokubonelela, ukuthenga, ukulawula isitokhwe nokubika. Chonga indlela yamanqaku abekekileyo nemiqqabo efanelekileyo kwisekethe ngokomgqabiso wenkqubo yokuthenga abekekileyo. Yenza ulwazi mayela neendaba zemigaqo ezevunyiweyo zeSCM.

jobs.title: Human Resources Officer
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 – R398 277 per annum (Level 07), plus actual benefits
jobs.summary: Human Resources Officer needed at the Central Office in King William's Town to administer conditions of service, remuneration, pensions and employee leave.
jobs.requirements: Matric or NCV Level 4 with a recognized M+3 years Degree or National Diploma in Human Resource Management / Development; Relevant PERSAL Certificate; 3-5 years’ relevant experience in Human Resource environment; Understanding and utilisation of the PERSAL &COLTECH system; A valid driver’s license Understating of legislative framework governing the Public Services; Storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of Human Resources functions and policies coupled with excellent computer literacy, particularly in the MS Office Suite. The incumbent must demonstrate strong analytical, planning, and organizational skills with the ability to perform under pressure, maintain accuracy, and meet tight deadlines. Good interpersonal relations, along with effective verbal and written communication skills, are essential. The position requires a candidate who is client focused, committed, proactive, and able to work independently and within a team. Integrity, attention to detail, and the ability to supervise staff and manage Human resources effectively are critical for success in this role.
jobs.duties: Administer conditions of service and remuneration of employees Process Pension, Housing Allowance and Long Service benefits etc. Keep all signed contract of employment forms on salary levels 2 to 8. Process employee leave. Maintain staff files (employment contracts, details, leave forms etc.). Receive all termination paperwork and terminate employees as and when required. Process payroll for all employees and deal with all administration and queries relating to the Pension Fund and Medical Aid. Submit reports to management as required so that they are informed of HR related matters and can take informed decisions. Keep signed and completed Declaration of Interest and a Confidentiality Agreement for all employees. Keep staff records up to date and record changes to employee’s details (change of address / bank details etc.), Administer recruitment and selection, Manage records for the college. Provide Recruitment and Selection services to the College. Process applications, handle responses and shortlisting processes. Screen CV’s; prepare preliminary shortlists, final shortlists with responsible managers for submission to the shortlisting committee. Prepare for interviews (i.e. arrangements of interviews such as dates, venues, and invitations to candidates). Coordinate the verification of all applicants’ qualifications. Develop and update recruitment database. Provide an effective and efficient Records Management services. Open, archive and close save files for new and existing employees. Update personnel files. Safe keep all Human Resource Records. Provide records as and when required for auditing purposes. Dispose files in terms of the applicable legislations and approved College policy. Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence. Maintain a database of all incoming and outgoing mail. Maintain register of file index on (filing system).
jobs.enquiries: Ms P Xamesi / Ms N Mjonono / Ms U Ncethelo / Ms S Jali at 087 238 2223
jobs.applications: Please hand deliver or courier your applications to the reception area quoting the relevant reference number addressed to the Acting Principal, Lovedale TVET College, Corporate Office, 1 Amatola Row, Headquarters, Qonce, 5600 Please see the email address below for electronic applications. Email Address: rectruitment@lovedale.org.za
jobs.notes: All applications must be accompanied by a signed and fully completed NEW Z83 form obtainable from any public service Department or DPSA website, a comprehensive CV including at least three contactable references. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by a SAQA evaluation report. Successful candidates will be subjected to a vetting and financial disclosure process (criminal record, citizenship, qualification verification and employment verification). Lovedale TVET College is an equal opportunities employer and reserves the right not to fill the posts. People living with disability are encouraged to apply. If you have not been contacted within six months after closing date, please consider your application as unsuccessful. NB Please ensure that the Z83 form is completed in full. Incomplete Z83 will be disqualified. The college reserves the right to withdraw the posts at any time. Communication will only be entered into with the shortlisted and successful candidates. All shortlisted candidates may be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal records, citizenship, and qualification verification). The suitable candidates will be required to annually disclose their financial interests and declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

af.title: Personeelbeampte
af.summary: Personeelbeampte benodig by die Sentrale Kantoor in King William's Town om diensvoorwaardes, vergoeding, pensioene en werknemerverlof te administreer.
af.requirements: Matric of NCV Level 4 met 'n erkende M+3-jare Graad of Nasionale Diploma in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur / -ontwikkeling; Relevante PERSAL-sertifikaat; 3-5 jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n Menslike Hulpbron-omgewing; Begrip en benutting van die PERSAL- en COLTECH-stelsel; 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie Begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer; Berging en terugwinning van prosedures in terme van die werksomgewing. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van Menslike Hulpbron-funksies en -beleide gepaard met uitstekende rekenaargeletterdheid, veral in die MS Office Suite. Die ampshouer moet sterk analitiese, beplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede toon met die vermoë om onder druk te presteer, akkuraatheid te handhaaf en styf sperdatums te haal. Goede interpersoonlike verhoudinge, tesame met effektiewe mondelinge en skriftelike Kommunikasievaardighede, is noodsaaklik. Die pos vereis 'n kandidaat wat kliëntgefokus, toegewyd, proaktief is en in staat is om onafhanklik en binne 'n span te werk. Integriteit, aandag aan besonderhede en die vermoë om personeel te bestuur en Menslike hulpbronne effektief te bestuur, is krities vir sukses in hierdie rol.
af.duties: Administreer diensvoorwaardes en vergoeding van werknemers. Proseseer Pensioen, Behuisingsallowansie en Langdiens-bate ens. Hou alle getekende dienskontrakte vir vlakke 2 tot 8. Proseseer werknemerverlof. Onderhou personeellêers (dienskontrakte, besonderhede, verlofvorms ens.). Ontvang alle beëindigingsdokumentasie en beëindig werknemers soos en wanneer vereis. Proseseer loonstaat vir alle werknemers en hanteer alle administrasie en navrae rakende die Pensioenfonds en Mediese Hulp. Dien verslae aan bestuur in soos vereis sodat hulle ingelig word oor HR-verwante aangeleenthede en ingeligte besluite kan neem. Hou getekende en voltooie Verklaring van Belang en 'n Vertrouelikheidooreenkoms vir alle werknemers. Hou personeelrekords op datum en boek veranderinge aan werknemer se besonderhede (verandering van adres / bankbesonderhede ens.). Administreer werwing en keuring. Bestuur rekords vir die kollege. Verskaf Werwing- en Keuringsdienste aan die Kollege. Proseseer aansoeke, hanteer reaksies en kortlystprosesse. Keur CV's; berei voorlopige kortlyste voor, finale kortlyste met verantwoordelike bestuurders voor voorlegging aan die kortlyskomitee. Berei voor vir onderhoude (d.w.s. reëlings van onderhoude soos datums, plekke en uitnodigings aan kandidate). Koördineer die verifikasie van alle aansoekers se kwalifikasies. Ontwikkel en dateer die werwingsdatabasis op. Verskaf effektiewe en doeltreffende Rekordbestuursdienste. Maak, argiveer en sluit lêers vir nuwe en bestaande werknemers. Dateer personeellêers op. Bewaar alle Menslike Hulpbron-rekords veilig. Verskaf rekords soos en wanneer vereis vir ouditdoeleindes. Skik lêers van die hand in ooreenstemming met die toepaslike wetgewing en goedgekeurde Kollege-beleid. Hanteer inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie. Onderhou 'n databasis van alle inkomende en uitgaande pos. Onderhou register van lêerindeks op (filing system).

zu.title: Isikhundla Sezinsizakusebenza zabantu
zu.summary: Kudingeka isikhundla sezinsizakusebenza zabantu kwi-Central Office eKing William's Town ukuze kuphathwe izimo zokusebenza, inkokhelo, izipenzioni kanye nekhanseli yabasebenzi.
zu.requirements: I-Matric noma i-NCV Level 4 nge-Degree noma i-National Diploma ebekiwe yangemva kuka-M+3 eminyakeni kwi-Human Resource Management / Development; Isitifikedi se-PERSAL esifanelekayo; Uluvo lweminyaka engu-3-5 kumazinga okuqashelwa ohlotsheni lwemisebenzi yezinsizakusebenza zabantu; Ukuqonda nokusebenzisa isistimu ye-PERSAL &COLTECH; Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile nokuzuva ubumfihlo bomthetho ohola Izinsiza Zomphakathi; Izindlela zokulondoloza nokuthola ukwaziswa ngokohlelo lwendawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi namapholisi wezinsizakusebenza zabantu okuhambisana nokwazi kakuhle ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ikakhulukazi kwi-MS Office Suite. Umuntu othathiwe kumele abonise amakhono okuhlaziya, ukwelula, kanye nokuhlela ohlelweni ngekhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwezingxabo, ukugcina ukuqondisisa, kanye nokuhlangabeza izikhathi eziyisicinye. Kubalulekile ukuba nomphakathi kahle nabanye, kanye namakhono okuxhumana okusebenzayo okukhulunywayo nokubhaliwayo. Lesi sikhundla sifuna umuntu eqondiswe kumakhasimende, onikezelile, onesiphothi sokuhamba phambili, okwazi ukusebenza eyedwa nangaphakathi kweqembu. Integriti, ukuqondisisa izinkinga, ngekhono lokuphatha abasebenzi nokuphatha izinsizakusebenza zabantu ngokusebenzayo kubalulekile ukuze uphumelele kulesi sikhundla.
zu.duties: Phatha izimo zokusebenza kanye nekhokhelo yabasebenzi. Lungiselela izipenzioni, isibonelelo sezindlu nezinzuzo zokwenza isikhathi eside konke. Gcina wonke amafomu okusebenza asayiniwe amazingeni eholo a-2 kuye ku-8. Hlela ikhanseli yabasebenzi. Gcina amafayela abasebenzi (izinkontrokatho zokusebenza, imininingwane, amafomu ekhanseli njll.). Thola wonke amaphepha okuvala isikhundla kanye nokuvala abasebenzi uma kudingeka. Hlela izinkokhelo zabasebenzi bonke uphathze wonke umsebenzi wokuphatha kanye nemibuzo ehlobene ne-Pension Fund kanye ne-Medical Aid. Hindula imibiko kubaphathi njengoba kudingwa ukuze bazi ngezindaba ezihlobene ne-HR bathathe izinqumo eziqondile. Gcina i-Declaration of Interest ne-Confidentiality Agreement esayiniwe futhi iqediwe yabasebenzi bonke. Gcina irekhodi labasebenzi libe lokuqhubekayo kanye nokuqopha izinguquko kubabambe izikhundla (ushintsho lwedolobha ukwaziswa ngebhange njll.), Phatha ukubuyiselwa nokuwukhetha. Phatha amarekhodi ekholeji. Hlinzeka ngokubuyiswa nokukhethwa kwezinsiza ekholiji. Hlela izicelo uphendule kanye nezingqinamba zokubhalisa. Buka izi-CV; hlela uhlu lwabaphakathi kokuqala, uhlu lwemfanele nama-maneja abambe izikhundla okuthunyelwa kwiqembu lokubhalisa. Hlela izivivinyo (okungukuthi ukulungiselela izivivinyo njengamhlaniso, izindawo, kanye nememela abafakiwe). Hlanganisa ukuqinisekiswa kwamakhvalifikheshini wabafaki bonke. Athuthuke kanye nokuhlaziya isisekelo senqwaba yolwazi lokubuyiswa nokukhethwa. Hlinzeka ngenzuzo esebenzayo ne-Persal Records Management. Phatha amafayethi, vula, ziba kanye nokuvala amafayethi abasebenzi abasha kanye nalabo abakhona. Hlaziya amafayethi zabantu. Gcina ngokuphepha kwaye yonke imirekhodi ye-HR. Hlinzeka ngamarekhodi uma kudingeka izinjongo zokuqinisekiswa. Lalthe amafayethi ngokohlelo lomthetho osetshenziswa kwaye ngaphakathi koluhlu lwe-Kholeji. Linganisa ukungenisi nokuphumela kolwazi kanye negunya. Gcina idethibhesi yokungeniswa nokuphumela kolwazi. Gcina ukubhaliswa koluhlu lwegunya efayini.

xh.title: Iofisa Wabasebenzi
xh.summary: Kufuneka kufunwe Iofisa Wabasebenzi kwiNtlangano ePhakathi eKing William's Town ukulawula iimeko zolsebenzo, iivuzo, iimali ezixhuzulwayo kunye nenkcubeko yabasebenzi.
xh.requirements: I-Matric okanye i-NCV Level 4 eneedigri ekuqatshelweyo ye-M+3 eminyaka okanye iNasionali Dipholoma kwiHuman Resource Management / Development; Isatifikethi esibalulekileyo se-PERSAL; I-3-5 yeminyaka yamava akhoyo kwimeko ye-Human Resource; Iqondo nokusebenzisa inkqubo ye-PERSAL &COLTECH; Ilayisensi yokuqhayela elungileyo Nokuqonda kwendalo yolwabloko wolawulo kwiinkonzo zikarhulumntethe; Iinkqubo zokugcina nokuvelisa ulwazi ngokwemeko yokusebenza. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi kunye namagama abasebenzi e-Human Resources aphinda kukho nobuchule obuhle kwiikhompyutha, ngokukodwa kwi-MS Office Suite. Lo mntu makabonise amakhono anamandla okuhlola, ukuyila, nokuhlela abantu ane- bokwenza umsebenzi ngantsobu, ukugcina ukuchaneka, kunye nokugqiba ngexesha elifutshane. Iintlangano ezihle phakathi kwabantu, kunye nokuqhatha kakuhle ngomlomo nangokubhalayo, zibalulekile. Esi sithuba sifuna umntu ogxile kubakhiwa beclayinti, onqwenela, onesigqeba sokuqamba, onako ukusebenza eyedwa nangaphakathi kweqela. Ukuqinisekisa, kuqwalasela iinkcukacha, kunye nokuqasha kunye nokulawula abasebenzi ngokwe-Human resources kakuhle kubalulekile ukuphumelela kule ndima.
xh.duties: Lawula iimeko zolusebenzo kunye neevuzo zabasebenzi. Cubungula iimali ezixhuzulwayo, intlawulo yamayeza nemicilio ebandakanya iminyaka embalwa entsha kwezinye iinkonzo. Gcina zonke iifom zeesivumelwano zokusebenza ezifinyeziweyo kumanqanaba omvuzo a-2 ukuya ku-8. Lawula inkcubeko yabasebenzi. Gcina iifayile zabasebenzi (iinkqubo zokusebenza, iinkcukacha, iifom zokuhamba ngezinye). Wamkela onke amaphepha okushiya umsebenzi aze asuse abasebenzi njengoko kufuneka. Hlela inkoktelo yabasebenzi bonke uze uphathhe onke amalungelo namaxwebhu axhwitha iimali ezixhuzulwayo kunye nenkcitho yamayeza. Thumela iingxelo kubaphathi njengoko kufuneka ukuze bazi ngeendaba ezinxulumene ne-HR baze bathathe izigqibo ezinolwazi. Gcina i-Declaration of Interest esigqibeliweyo nese Confidentiality Agreement yabasebenzi bonke. Gcina uluhlu lwabasebenzi lusekuhlaziyiweyo uze uqqobe iinguqu zotoliko lwabasebenzi (uguquko lwedilesi / iinkcukacha zebhanki ngezinye), Lawula ukuqesha nentlalo, Phatha iifayile zekholeji. Bonezela iinkonzo zokuQesha nokuKhetha eKholeji. Sebenza izicelo, ziphathe iimpendulo noludwe. Phepha i-CV's; lungiseela uludwe oluphantsi, uludwe lokugqibela nabaphathi abathintelayo ukuze luziswe koomatshini abakha uludwe. Lungiseela iintervyu (kuko ukulungelelisa iintervyu njengokwemihla, iindawo, nammemvange kwiindwendwe). Hlelanga ukuqinisekisa zonke izatifikethi zabantu abaqeqeshwayo. Yila uze uhlaziye isiseko sedatha yokungena. Bonezela iinkonzo ezisebenzayo n ezichanekileyo zokuLawula iifayile. Vula, ugcine kwisiseko sedatha, uze uvale iifayile ezilondolozweyo abasebenzi abatsha nalabo abakhoyo. Hlaziya iifayile zabantu. Gcina ngokukhuselekileyo onke amagunya e-Human Resource. Bonezela amagunya njengoko kufuneka ukwenza ukuqinisekiswa. Tsala iifayile ngokomthetho osebenzayo kunye nenkqubo yeKholeji evunyiweyo. Phatha imibhobho eyayo nethumwayo. Gcina isiseko sedatha yemibhobho eyayo nethumwayo. Gcina irekhodi lesalathisi sefayile kwinkqubo yokugcina iifayile.

af.title: Administratiewe Beampte PLU
af.summary: Administratiewe Beampte om inkomsgenererende geleenthede te fasiliteer en vennootskappe by die Department of Higher Education and Training se sentrale kantoor te bestuur.
af.requirements: Matric of NCV Level 4 saam met 'n erkende driejaar (3) National Diploma (NQF 6) / in Project Management / Public Management of verwante kwalifikasie plus ten minste 2 tot 3 jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n Project Management/ Business Development en/of verwante omgewing, rekenaarvaardigheid en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis en ervaring in die bou van vennootskappe, innovasie, bemarking en entrepreneuriese insig, finansiële bestuur, mobilisering van hulpbronne, interpretasie van wette, kennis van die Public Service Act, PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies en ander raamwerke, besigheidsbeplanning, sigbaarheidsanalise, kennis en begrip van die administratiewe verslagdoeningsproses en prosedures. Vaardighede: Onderhandeling, kommunikasie, aanbieding, akademiese proses en modereringsprosedures, administratiewe beplanning en organisering, finansiële bestuur, verslagskrywing, kommunikasie en interpersoonlike probleemoplossing, rekenaarvaardigheid, analities, kliëntgerig, projekbestuur, spanleierskap, beplanning en organisering, mensebestuur.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met die identifisering en fasilitering van inkomsgenererende geleenthede deur die implementering van vennootskoopooreenkomste. Bystand met vennootskapsbestuur: Bou 'n databasis van plaaslike besighede en ander skakels. Neem deel aan besigheidsforums en identifiseer projektegeleenthede. Ontwikkel projekvoorstelle en planne vir gesamentlike inisiatiewe. Fasiliteer oorhandiging met die College-bestuurders. Sluit vennootskappe met die industrie en tersaaklike belanghebbendes. Skandering van besigheidsgeleenthede: Identifiseer geleenthede vir College-inkomsgenerering, bepaal die potensiaal vir werk omgewingsimulasie, verskaf besigheidsgevalrasionalisering vir markbehoeftes vir alle geleenthede, identifiseer 'n geskikte vennoot of diensverskaffer, koördineer die indiening van tenders en befondsingsvoorstelle, verskaf inligting en verslae oor programme, befondsing en vennootskap aan DHET en ander belanghebbendes, plaaslike en provinsiale regeringsbetrekkinge. Ontwikkel en werk die skedule van plaaslike regeringsprojekte en geleenthede by. Identifiseer die potensiële bydrae van College-sinergieë tot provinsiale departemente, bou verhoudings met tersaaklike amptenare, stel 'n databasis van sleutelkontakte op en neem waar toepaslik aan vergaderings deel. Ontwikkel voorstelle vir vennootskappe oor spesifieke praktiese geleenthede wat in lyn is met die College se kernbesigheid. Voer sigbaarheidsstudies uit vir alle nuwe en voorgestelde projekte. Ontwikkel die projek en begroting. Skakel met tersaaklike navorsingsorganisasies. Onderhandel en teken diensvlakooreenkomste en of kontrakte, wanneer nodig.

zu.title: Inkantshiki Yolawu PLU
zu.summary: Inkantshiki Yolawu ekwenzeni kube lula ithuba lokukhiqiza inzuzo nokuphatha ubudlelwano ohlwini lweNyuvesi evela eNyuvesi evela eNyuvesi, kanye nokuphatha ubudlelwano ohlweni oluqondile lwe-Department of Higher Education and Training.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samatikuletiko noma i-NCV Level 4 kanye nediploma yezwe (3) (NQF 6) / ekuqashweni kwezinhlelo / ekuqashweni kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni noma izifundo ezihlobene, kanye nokungenisa iminyaka emi-2 kuya kwengama-3 ngaphezu kwalokho okufanelekile ekulawulweni kwezinhlelo/ ekuthuthukisweni kwebhizinisi kanye nezindawo ezihlobene, ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha nephethe yethuluzi lokushayela. Ulwazi namava ekwakheni ubudlelwano, ezintshanini, ekuqashweni kwezinto ezingathengiswa, nasekuqondeni izindlela zokwenza imali, ekuqondeni ukuphathwa kwezimali, ekufundeni imithetho, ekuqondeni i-Public Service Act, i-PFMA, izilawuli ze-Treasury kanye nezinye izakhiwo, ekulungeniseni ibhizinisi, ekuqondeni indlela yokubonakala, ukwazi futhi uqonde inqubo nemigomo yokuqoqa imibiko yokuqashwa. Izakhono: ukuxoxisana, ukuxhumana, ukubamba izinkulumo zabantu, inqubo yezemfundo kanye nezinqubo zokuqinisekisa, ukulungiselela futhi uhlele izinhlelo zolawulo, ukuphatha izimali, ukubhala imibiko, ukuxhumana nabanye kanye nokuqonda izinkinga, ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuhlaziya, ukugxila kumthengi, ukuphatha izinhlelo, ukuba ngumholi weqembu, ukulungiselela futhi uhlele, ukuphatha abantu.
zu.duties: Siza ekuboniseni futhi kwakwenze kube lula ithuba lokukhiqiza inzuzo ngokuphatha izivumelwano zobudlelwano. Usizo ekuphathweni kwezobudlelwano: Akha isikhathi sezinhlu zabahlinzeki bendawo kanye nezinye izinhlonza. Thatha inxaxheba kumaphaneli webhizinisi futhi uqonde ithuba lezinhlelo. Hlola izinkampani kanye nezinhlelo zomzobo wezinhlelo ezihlangeneyo. Yenza kube luluha ukwethula ngabaphathi beKholeji. Qamba izinhlelo zokuxhumana nomkhakha kanye nalabo abahlobene. Ukuhlola ithuba lebhizinisi: Qaphela ithuba lokwenza inzuzo iKholeji, misa indlela yokulinga isimo sokusebenza, nikeza incazelo yesidingo sikamakethe samabhizinisi ngawo wonke amathuba, qaphela umlingani noma umhlinzeki ofanele, hlela ukulethwa kwemibiko yokuqashwa imali nezinhlelo, nikeza ulwazi nemibiko ngamaphrojekthi, imali nobudlelwano ku-DHET nabanye abahlobene, ubuhlobo kahulumeni wendawo nowesifundazwe. Hlola futhi ubuyekeze isikhathi sezinhlelo zohulumeni wendawo nasezintsheni. Qaphela isikhathi ngohwe iKholeji kumasebe wesifundazwe, ake ubuhlobo nabasebenzi abahlobene, misa isikhathi sezinhlu zoxhumana nabantu abaphambili futhi uthathe inxaxheba emihlanganweni lapho kufanele khona. Hlola izinkampani ngamathuba athile okuxhumana ahambisana nobulokho beKholeji. Yenza izifundo zokuqonda ukubonakala ngawo wonke amaphrojekthi amasha kanye nalawo acazelwe. Hlola iphrojekthi kanye nesabelo samali. Xhumana nabahlinzeki bezinto zokuqondisisa. Xoxisana futhi usayine izivumelwano zamazinga okukhonza noma izinkontileka, lapho kudingeka khona.

xh.title: Isebe lolulo PLU
xh.summary: Inkulu yolulo yokuncedisa iinkqubo zemisebenzi evelisa imali ehamba phambili noku Lawula iziqwenga-nkundla kwiofisi ephakathi kwiSebe lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuqeqesha.
xh.requirements: Ithosi okanye iNCV Level 4 kunye nediploma yeSizwe yeminyaka emithathu (3) evunyiweyo (iNQF 6) / ekuLawulweni kweePjrojekthi / ekuLawulweni kwezeRhulumente okanye isiqinisekiso esinxulumeneyo kunye nocwaningolwazi olufanelekileyo lweminyaka engama-2 ukuya kwi-3 kwimisebenzi ekuLawulweni kweePjrojekthi / ekuPhuhlisweni kweeShishini kunye nendalo enxulumene nayo, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nelayisensi yokushuka evunyiweyo. Ulwazi nolugqatsho lokwakhiwa kweziqwenga-nkundla, uQqamba izinto ezintsha, ukuNcedisa ukuthengiswa, nokuQonda ngokuQamba amashishini, ukuLawula iimali, ukuQoqa izixhobo zokwenza umsebenzi, ukuCacisa iimthetho, ulwazi ngoMthetho weNkonzo kaRhulumente, iPFMA, iimthetho yeNgxowa-mali nezinye iinkqubo zokuqonda izinto, uCwangcisa ishishini, ukuQwalasela ukubonakala, ulwazi nokuQonda inqubo nemiqathango yokubika kwindawo yolulo. Amakhono: ukuXoxisana, ukuThetha, ukuNika ipezentethshi, iNqubo yemfundo ephakamileyo nemiqathango yokulinganisela ngokulingana, ukuCwangcisa kolulo nokuHlela, ukuLawula iimali, ukuBhala iingxelo, ukuThetha nokuHlangana nakuXazulula iingxaki, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuQwalasela izinto, ukuQonda abaxhasi, ukuLawula iiprojekthi, ukuBeka iqela phambili, ukuCwangcisa nokuHlela, ukuLawula abantu.
xh.duties: Uncede ekuboni nakuncedeni iinkqubo zemisebenzi evelisa imali ngokusebenzisa iisivumelwano seziqwenga-nkundla. Ukuncedisa ekuLawulweni kweziqwenga-nkundla: Yakha isiseko sedatha yamashishini endawo nolunye uhlobo lweqhagamshelwano. Thatha inxaxheba kumacebo abashishini uze ubone amathuba amaprojekthi. Phepha iindlela zemibhalo ezingaphezulu nokuqwalasela iicebo zemisebenzi exhuliswe nayo. Qhube ekunikweni kolawulo kuwo onke amalungu eDyunivesithi okanye abaphathi beKholeji. Saka iziqwenga-nkundla namashishini nabo bonke abantu abanomdla. Ukuqwalasela amathuba emisebenzi: Qaphela amathuba okwenziswa iholo kwindawo emayidwelwe ukuxakeka kolusebenzo, nikela nengcombolo malunga neezifiso zendalo namathuba onke amakholi, qonda ukuba ngubani ophakathi okanye inkonzo kaqhawe, lawula iimveliso zevidiyo nokuqinisekisa imali efunekayo ukuyinika ukwazi ngakumbi ngokwenza ubunikazi benkqubo yoluntu ekuqwalaseleni ngokobugcisa obutsha kwaye ugqibe ekunikezeleni ngokuphuhliswa kwamaxabiso amakhulu. Thola ulwazi malunga namathuba okufumana iholo, ziiqondo ezisebenzayo kwindawo yokusebenza ngokulinganisa amandla okwenza ngokubakho kwamathuba, unike isizathu sebhizinisi seemfuno zemarike yamathuba onke, uchaze umhlobo wendawo ekufunekayo yindlebe okanye onke abaniki besebenza, ulongeze onke amagama ethunyelwe nakwinkxaso-mali ekuqwalaselwa, unike ulwazi nangemibhali ngokuqwalasela iinkqubo, iinkxaso-mali kunye neziqwenga-nkundla kwiDHET nakunye abantu abanomdla, uqhagamshelano loluntu ekuqwalaselwa ngokulwimi nakwisilumkisi sokusebenzela urhulumente. Yila kwaye uvuselele ishedyuli yamaprojekthi orhulumente wendawo namathuba. Qapqapela imisebenzi eqwalaselwa ngokugcina iinkalo ekuphuhlisweni koluntu lwasekhaya ngokusetyenziswa koluntu ngokusombulula iindaba ezilawula iindawo kwindalo yakho maye nendlela efuna ngokuqinisekileyo ikholi ingenelela kakhulu kulawulo lwexesha elidliweyo ngako. Yila inkqubo ehamba phambili nendlela elungelelanisa namathuba onke ukuzimisela kwezixhobo ngakumbi ekusebenzisa iinkalo kwindawo ekuyo. Qwalasela ukubonakala kolwazi ngokuvakalayo iiprojekthi zakho. Sebenzisa la manyathelo amathandathu ukuze uqinisekise isixhobo sakho seProjekthi xa kusenokwenzeka ukuba nthanda ngokuchanekileyo ukubakho koluntu malunga nokuqwalasela nokumisela imveliso ngokunxulumene nesalathiso esixhobo ngokubanzi norhulumente phakathi kweentyatyambo zonke ezikwasemva ukuba khona koluntu ekuqwalaselwa ukuba ngabaxhasi bexesha elide malunga noluntu olubonakala ngokusebenzela iinkalo ezahlukeneyo ezodwa. Yenza uvavanyo lobungcali ngolwazi kwiiprojekthi zonke ezitsha nakuqwalaselwa. Yila iProjekthi nemali ekuqwalaselwa. Qhagamshela nabaqwalaseli abafanelekileyo ekuqwalaselwa kwephulo. Xoxa usayine iisivumelwano essaya ngokulandela imilinganiselo yomsebenzi aze asayine ezi ngosetyenziso nobungcali ngokwemigqaliselo ekuqwalaselwa ekulula ukuyiqonda ngemigqaliselo efanayo.

jobs.title: Transport Officer
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 – R398 227 per annum (Level 07), plus actual benefits
jobs.summary: Manage and maintain TVET fleet vehicles, monitor kilometres and logbooks, authorise trips, and process monthly invoices at the Department of Higher Education and Training.
jobs.requirements: Matric or NCV Level 4 together with a recognised three-year (3) National Diploma (NQF 6) / in Transport Management, Business Management, Public Management or related qualification plus at least 2-3 years’ relevant experience in a TVET Fleet environment, computer literacy and a valid driver’s license. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge and experience in fleet or transport management, knowledge of Public Service Act, PFMA, Treasury regulations and other frameworks, Business planning, Visibility analysis, Knowledge and understanding of the administration reporting process and procedures. Skills: Negotiation, Communication, Presentation, Administrative Planning and organising, Financial Management, Report Writing, Communication and interpersonal Problem solving, Computer Literacy, Analytical, Client-oriented, Team Leadership, Planning and organising, People management.
jobs.duties: Ensuring day to day management and maintenance of fleet vehicles. Monitor daily kilometres before and after trips and ensure monthly closing of kilometres on the logbooks. Authorise trip itineraries/ trip authorization. Receive and certify invoices for processing of monthly payments. Maintain records of driver’s licenses, trip authorisation, and fines. Etc. Ensure service maintenance of vehicles. Redirect traffic fines. Pre and post inspections of vehicles. Quarterly inspections of subsidised vehicles and processing of new applications. Ensure compliance with the transport policies, processes and processes.

af.title: Vervoerbeampte
af.summary: Bestuur en onderhou TVET-vlootvoertuie, monitor kilometers en logboeke, magtig reise en verwerk maandelikse fakture by die Department of Higher Education and Training.
af.requirements: Matric of NCV Level 4 tesame met 'n erkende driejaar (3) Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) / in Vervoerbestuur, Besigheidsbestuur, Openbare Bestuur of 'n verwante kwalifikasie plus ten minste 2-3 jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n TVET-vlootomgewing, rekenaarvaardigheid en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis en ervaring in vloot- of vervoerbestuur, kennis van Public Service Act, PFMA, Treasury-regulasies en ander raamwerke, Besigheidsbeplanning, Sigbaarheidsanalise, Kennis en begrip van die administratiewe verslagdoeningsproses en prosedures. Vaardighede: Onderhandeling, Kommunikasie, Voorlegging, Administratiewe beplanning en organiserings, Finansiële bestuur, Verslagskrywing, Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike probleemoplossing, Rekenaarvaardigheid, Analities, Kliëntgerig, Spanleierskap, Beplanning en organiserings, Mensebestuur.
af.duties: Verseker daaglikse bestuur en onderhoud van vlootvoertuie. Monitor daaglikse kilometers voor en na reise en verseker maandelikse afsluiting van kilometers in die logboeke. Magtig reisroetes/ reismagtiging. Ontvang en sertifieer fakture vir verwerking van maandelikse betalings. Onderhou rekords van bestuurderslisensies, reismagtiging en boetes. Ensovoorts. Verseke diensonderhoud van voertuie. Stuur verkeersboetes om. Voor- en na-inspeksies van voertuie. Kwartaallikse inspeksies van gesubsidieerde voertuie en verwerking van nuwe aansoeke. Verseker nakoming van die vervoerbeleide, prosesse en prosesse.

Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi nokuhlangenwe nakho ekuphatweni kwethimba noma okuthuthweni, ulwazi ngo-Public Service Act, PFMA, imigoqo ye-Treasury kanye nezinye izakhiwo, ukuhlelwa kwebhizinisi, ukuhlaziya ukubonakala, ulwazi nokuzuva inqubo nezinqubo zokubika kohlelo lolawulo. Amakhono: Ukuxoxisana, Ukuxhumana, Okubhiyozayo, Ukuhlelwa Kokuphathwayo kanye nokuhlela, Ukuphathwa Kwezimali, Ukwabhuka Imibiko, Ukuxhumana nokuxazulula izinkinga zobuntu, Ukusebenzisa Ikhompyutha, Ukuhlaziya, Ukugxila Kumthengi, Ukuqondisa Ithimba, Ukuhlela nokuhlela, Ukuphatha Abantu.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuphathwa nsuku zonke kanye nolondolozo lwezimoto zethimba. Qapha amakhilomitha ansuku zonke ngaphambi nangemva kwezithuthi futhi uqinisekise ukuvalwa kwamakhilomitha nyanga zonke kwamabhukhu lokuhamba. Guna izinhlela zezithuthi / izigunyazvo zezithuthi. Thola futhi uqinisekise izikweletu ukuze ziqcadwe ukuhlelwa kwezinkokhelo zanyanga zonke. Gcina amarekhodi amalayisensi abashayeli, izigunyazvo zezithuthi, nezeshlawulo. Okunye. Qinisekisa ukwenziwa kohlengo lwezimoto. Qondisa izishlawulo zethrafikhi. Ukuhlola izimoto ngaphambi nangemva kokuhamba. Ukuhlola izimoto ezibhatalwa ngeminyaka yonke kanye nokuqeda izicelo ezintsha. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwemigomo zokuthutha, izinqubo kanye nezinqubo.

xh.title: Iofisa koThutho
xh.summary: Phatha kwaye ulondoloze izithuthi zeTVET fleet, qondisa iikhilomitha namabhuku eqela, vuma iindwendwe, kwaye ulungise iinvoices nyanga zonke kwiNqanaba lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seMatric okanye iNCV Level 4 kunye neDiploma yaseNzululwazi yeminyaka emithathu (3) (NQF 6) / kwiTransport Management, Business Management, Public Management okanye ngesimemo esinxulumeneyo kunye nokuba nokuhlahlelwa kokungathi kwiminyaka engama-2-3 yamava ahambelanayo kwindawo yeTVET Fleet, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi nobugcisa: Ulwazi namava ekulawulenweni kwezithuthi okanye ekuthuthweni, ulwazi ngePublic Service Act, iPFMA, iimigaqo yeTreasury namanye amagqabantshintshi, uqwalaselo lwezoshishino, uqwalaselo lobunakho, ulwazi nokuqonda inqubo namagqabantshintshi okubika kolawulo. Amakhono: Ukuxoxisana, Ukunxibelelwana, Okubekiweyo phambi kwabantu, uCwangciso lolawulo nokuqamba, uLawulo lwezeMali, ukuBhala amabali, Ukunxibelelwana nabantu nokuxazulula iingxaki, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuqonda ngokwezibaluli, ukujuka kwiklayent, uBukhosi beQela, uCwangciso nokuqamba, uLawuloabantu.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ulawulo ngemini yonke nokulondoloza izithuthi zeTVET fleet. Qwalasa iikhilomitha zemihla ngemihla ngaphambi nangemva kweendwendwe uze uqinisekise ukuvala nyanga zonke iikhilomitha kumabuku eqela. Vuma iindwendwe/igunya lokwendwendwa. Amkela uze uqinisekise iinvoices ukulungiselela ukuhlawula nyanga zonke. Gcina irekhodi yelayisensi zokushayela, igunya lokwendwendwa, netyala. Nkcnkceshe. Qinisekisa inkonzo yokulondoloza izithuthi. Tshintsela ityala lokuthutha. Ukuphonononga ngaphambi nangemva kwezithuthi. Ukuphonononga kwime yezinyanga izithuthi ezixhaswayo kunye nokuqhubela phambadi izicelo ezintsha. Qinisekisa ukuthobela iinkqubo zothutho, iinkqubo ngenkqubo.

af.title: Finansiële Hulpbeamptes
af.summary: Drie finansiële hulpbeamptes word benodig by die Sentrale Kantoor in King William's Town om studentbeurskemas te koördineer en NSFAS-finansiële hulpaansoeke te administreer.
af.requirements: Matric of NCV Level 4 tesame met 'n erkende drie-jarige (3) Nasionale Diploma in Finansiële Bestuur (NQF 6) of 'n verwante kwalifikasie plus ten minste 2-3 jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n TVET Finansiële omgewing en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van CET en PSET; Kennis van PSA en PSR 2016; Kennis van PFMA en departementele beleide. Kennis van die COLTECH-stelsel; Basiese kennis van praktyke sowel as die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedien en finansiële statistieke te versamel. Basiese kennis van Openbare Diens Finansiële Wetgewing, prosedures (PFMA, Finansiële Handleiding); Kennis van basiese finansiële bedryfstelsels (ITS ens.). Uitstekende kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik); Netwerking, onderhandeling, navorsing. Interpersoonlike vaardighede, beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, rekenaarvaardighede, basiese syferkundige vaardighede.
af.duties: Koördineer studentbeurskemas en administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste vir finansiële hulp by die Kampus. Administreer die aansoekprosesse vir beurs- en finansiële hulpskemas vir die kampus in ooreenstemming met NSFAS-riglyne, fondsgever MOU/SLA en beleide. Hersien aansoeke om finansiële hulp. Analiseer NSFAS-voorwaardelik gefinansierde studente. Koördineer die magtiging van uitbetalingsfondse. Fasiliteer ander finansiële hulpskemas, bv. WRSETA, HWSETA, ens. Rapporteer oor alle beurs- en finansiële hulptoekenings aan die komitee vir finansiële hulp en ander belanghebbendes. Outeur personeel.

zu.title: Abahlinzeki Bezimali Obusizo
zu.summary: Kudingeka abahlinzeki bezimali obusizo abathathu e-Central Office e-King William's Town ukuze bahlanganise amaschema wezibursari zabafundi babephethe izicelo zokwesekwa ngemali ze-NSFAS.
zu.requirements: I-Matric noma i-NCV Level 4 kanye ne-National Diploma yesikhathi seminyaka emithathu (3) ebonwayo kwi-Financial Management (NQF 6) noma izifundo ezihambisana nalokho kanye nokuba namava okulingene okungamnyaka angu-2-3 kwindawo ezamanzi ye-TVET futhi enelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi nge-CET ne-PSET; Ulwazi nge-PSA ne-PSR 2016; Ulwazi nge-PFMA nezinqubomgomo zomnyango. Ulwazi ngesistimu ye-COLTECH; Ulwazi olusisisekelo ngendlela yokwenza kanye nokuthi ukwazi ukungena idatha, usebenzise ikhompyutha ukuqoqa izibalo ezimayelana nezimali. Ulwazi olusisisekelo nge-Public Service Financial Legislations, izinqubo (PFMA, Financial Manual); Ulwazi ngezinhlelo eziyisisekelo zokusebenza ngemali (ITS etc.). Ukuxhumana okuhle (Ngomlomo nangokubhala); Ukuxhumana nabantu, Izenkonzimiriro, Ucwaningo. Amakhono Okuxhumana Nabantu, Amakhono Okuhlela Nokuqamba, Amakhono Ekhompyutha, Amakhono Okubala Okusisisekelo.
zu.duties: Hlanganisa amaschema wezibursari zabafinsi namasevisi okuhlolela okusemigomeni ngokwesekwa ngemali e-Campus. Bephethe izinqubo zokwenza izicelo zamaschema wezibursari nokwesekwa ngemali wesikhungo ngokuhambisana nemigomo ye-NSFAS, i-MOU/SLA yabanikazi bemali nezinye izinqubomgomo. Buka izicelo zokwesekwa ngemali. Hlaziya abafundi abaxhaswe ngokwesikhashana yi-NSFAS. Hlanganisa imvume yokuhlakaza imali. Qedela amanye amaschema okwesekwa ngemali okungaba yi-WRSETA, HWSETA, etc. Nikeza umbiko ngayo yonke imali yokwesekwa ngemali nezibursari ekomini lokwesekwa ngemali nakubanye abantu abathintekayo. Lawula abasebenzi.

xh.title: Financial AID Officers
xh.summary: Kufuneka abafundi bamashumi amathathu abakwindawo esebenzela i-Campus ekwindawo yokuzilolonga imali eKing William's Town, bancedise ekulawuleni iinkqubo zokubhaliswa kwemali yokufundela abafundi besebenzisa iinkqubo zokufakelwa kwe-NSFAS.
xh.requirements: Matriki okanye i-NCV Level 4 kunye nesidanga saleminyaka ezimbini n esithathu (3) kwi National Diploma eyaziwayo kwi Financial Management (NQF 6) okanye ngesidanga esifanayo, ngokusesigxekenokude ngamashumi amabini (20) ukuya kwamashumi amathathu (30) eminyaka yokuba ngcali ekwindawo apho kubhalwa khona imali ekelwa i-TVET. Ulwazi ngolu lawulo: ULwazi ngemigaqo yokusingatha imali yaseburhulumente, iinkqubo zokulawula imali (i-PFMA, i-Financial Manual); Ulwazi ngemithetho yezimali yenkqubo yorhulumente palamente (PFMA, i-Financial Manual); Ulwazi ngolawulo lweemveliso zemali kwinkqubo efunwayo (i-ITS etc.). Isidanga sobuchule ekunxibelelaneni ngezindlela ezahlukeneyo, ekuqhubeni intlalo-ngqiqo yemali kwinkqubo yezimali yorhulumente palamente. Ubuncinane bokuba nobulumko bokuzoba iimali zeendlela ezahlukeneyo zolawulo ezilungiselwa abasebenzi bayo kunye nokuqonda okubanzi kwemali yabantu basepalamente ekwindawo apho kuqulunqwa khona imigaqo yemali.
xh.duties: Lungelanisa amaxesha okufundela abafundi kunye nemisebenzi yoncedo lwezimali ezikwindawo yokusebenzela. Lawula iinkqubo zokufaka izicelo zamaxesha okufundela nokuncedwa ngezimali kwikhampasi ngokwesigaba se-NSFAS, isivumelwano se-MOU/SLA somnikazi nemigaqo. Hlalutyonke izicelo zocedo lwezimali. Yahlulela abafundi abaxhaswa bendlela encwadini yi-NSFAS. Lungelanisa igunya lokusetyenziswa kwemali. Sika ngokwenqanaba kolunye uncedo lwezimali njengelophelo le-WRSETA, i-HWSETA, kunye nezinye. Bingelela ngokwemigeqe yonke amaxaṣha efundela kunye neemikelio zoncedo lwezimali kumkomithi yoncedo lwezimali nakulabo abangenangtondagho ekwindawo apho kusebenza khona. Lawula abasebenzi ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo zolawulo lwemisebenzi ngaphantsi kwaseburhulumente.

jobs.summary: Supervise students at the Zwelitsha Campus residence, ensuring wellbeing, conducting inductions, and managing information flow between campus and bursary office.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 certificate (NQF Level 4) and/ or Certificate (NQF Level 5) in administration or equivalent qualification. 1-2 years’ relevant experience in supervising students in the College residence. Knowledge of policies and governance environment of TVET College including knowledge of the annual reporting requirements by the Higher Education Institutions. Knowledge and understanding of Knowledge and understanding of the Higher Education sector, especially the policies and relevant legislation. Administrative skills, Planning and organizing. Financial management Report writing. Problem solving. Computer literacy. Team leadership. Planning and organizing. People management skills.
jobs.duties: Ensure and monitor the wellbeing of students Conduct residence induction. Facilitate the election of block leaders, Ensure the effective flow of information and documents to and from the campus manager and bursary office. Ensure the effective flow of information and documents to and from the campus manager and bursary office. Provide conflict management to students and at the dining hall Draft residence code of conduct Maintain household records, admission and allocate rooms for students Distribute residence application forms. Collect application forms with relevant supporting documents. Conduct verification of information on COLTECH system. Record, file copies of student deposit slips and indemnity forms. Maintain written record of the movement of students out of the residence afterhours. Prepare and submit monthly reports on hostel activities and incidents. Allocate rooms for students based on admission criteria, pass rate, seniority demarcation and first come demarcation and first come first serve bases. Setup and administer duty roster. Monitor and ensure safety of students and their belongings in the hostel. Make regular rounds to ensure that students and residence are secured. Provide basic emergency first aid and summon medical assistance when necessary Ensure that students are aware of means of escape, fire regulation and equipment. Ensure maintenance and management of property and infrastructure at the residence. Identify damages in the residence and report to relevant officials for repairs. Ensure that all residence buildings and premises are in good condition.

af.title: Koshuishuishoudelike toesighouer Manlik
af.summary: Hou toesig oor studente by die Zwelitsha Campus-koshuis, verseker welsyn, voer induksies uit, en bestuur inligtingsvloei tussen die kampus en die beurskantoor.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat (NQF Level 4) en/of sertifikaat (NQF Level 5) in administrasie of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. 1-2 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring in die toesig oor studente in die kollegekoshuis. Kennis van die beleide en bestuursomgewing van 'n TVET-kollege, insluitend kennis van die jaarlikse verslagdoeningsvereistes deur Higher Education Institutions. Kennis en begrip van die Higher Education-sektor, veral die beleide en tersaaklike wetgewing. Administratiewe vaardighede, beplanning en organisering. Finansiële bestuur en verslagskrywing. Probleemoplossing. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Spanleierskap. Beplanning en organisering. Mensbestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Verseker en monitor die welsyn van studente. Voer koshuiskering in. Fasiliteer die verkiesing van blokleiers. Verseker die doeltreffende vloei van inligting en dokumente na en van die bestuurder van die kampus en die beurskantoor. Verskaf konflikbestuur aan studente en by die eetsaal. Stel 'n koshuisgedragskode op. Handhaak huishoudelike rekords, toelating en ken kamers vir studente toe. Versprei koshuisaansoekvorms. Versamel aansoekvorms met tersaaklike ondersteunende dokumente. Doen verifikasie van inligting op die COLTECH-stelsel. Neem op en lê afskrifte van studentdepositiestrokie en skadeloosstellingsvorms in. Handhaaf 'n skriftelike rekord van die beweging van studente uit die koshuis na ure. Berei maandelikse verslae oor koshuisaktiwiteite en voorvalle voor en dien dit in. Ken kamers aan studente toe op grond van toelatingskriteria, geslaagdekoers, senioriteitsafbakening en eerste-kom-eerste-bedien-basis. Stel 'n diensrooster op en administreer dit. Monitor en verseker die veiligheid van studente en hul besittings in die koshuis. Doen gereelde rondtes om te verseker dat studente en die koshuis veilig is. Verskaf basiese noodhulp en ontbied mediese bystand wanneer nodig. Verseker dat studente bewus is van ontsnappingmiddele, brandregulasies en toerusting. Verseker instandhouding en bestuur van eiendom en infrastruktuur by die koshuis. Identifiseer skade in die koshuis en rapporteer dit aan tersaaklike amptenare vir herstelwerk. Verseker dat alle koshuisgeboue en persele in 'n goeie toestand is.

zu.title: Umphathi Wokugcina Ihholo Labafundi Onduna (Indoda)
zu.summary: Qapha abafundi endlini yabafundi e-Zwelitsha Campus, qinisekisa impilo enhle yabo, yenza iziqondiso, uphendle ukuphakama kwenkcazelo phakathi kwe-campus ne-ofisi yezibursari.
zu.requirements: Ithifikethi le-Grade 12 (NQF Level 4) kanye/noma ithifikethi (NQF Level 5) kolawulo noma izifundo ezilinganayo. 1-2 iminyaka yokuhlolwa okuhlobene nokuqapha abafundi endlini yabafundi yase-College. Ulwazi ngemigomo nendawo yokuphatha ye-TVET College okuhlanganisa ulwazi ngemithesho yokubika ngonyaka eyenziwa izikhungo zemfundo eziphezulu. Ulwazi nokuqonda iqondo ngohlelo lwemfundo ephakeme, ikakhulukazi imigumo nomthetho ohlobene nayo. Amakhono oluLawulo, ukuhlela nokuhlanganisa. UkuLawula Imali nokubika. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ukukhokela iqembu. Ukuhlela nokuhlanganisa. Amakhono okuphatha abantu.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa futhi uqaphele impilo enhle yabafundi Yenza isiqondiso sendlini yabafundi. Siza ekukhethweni kwezinduna zezikhwama, qinisekisa ukuphakama kwenkcazelo namadokhumenti okuya kanye okuvela kumphathi we-campus nennqolobane yamabhursari. Qinisekisa ukuphakama kwenkcazelo namadokhumenti okuya kanye okuvela kumphathi we-campus nennqolobane yamabhursari. Nikeza abafundi ukulawula ingxabano futhi esidlweni Bhala umthetho wokuziphatha kwendlu yabafundi Gcina amarekhodi endlu, ukwamukela futhi wabelwe amagumbi abafundi Sabalisa amafomu esicelo sendlu yabafundi. Qoqa amafomu esicelo namadokhumenti okusekelo ahlobene. Yenza ukuqinisekisa kolwazi kwisistimu ye-COLTECH. Bhala, gcina amakhophi ezimpesheni zokufaka imali zabafundi namafomu ezenzayo. Gcina irekhodi elibhaliwe lokuhamba kwabafundi baphuma endlini yabafundi ngemva kahours. Hlela futhi uthumele imibiko yenyanga ngemisebenzi nezinkomba zendlini yabafundi. Wabele amagumbi abafundi ngokususelwa emigomeni yokwamukela, izinga lokuphumelela, ukubaluleka kokuhlukaniswa nokuhlukaniswa kwabafikele ngaso sonke isikhathi ngokwendlela yokwamukela abafikele ngaso sonke isikhathi. Hlela futhi ulawule uhlu lwemisebenzi. Qaphela futhi qinisekisa ukuvikeleka kwabafundi nezinto zabo endlini yabafundi. Yenza ukuhamba njalo ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi abafundi nendlu yabafundi bivikelekile. Nikeza usizo lokuqala lwezimo eziphuthumayo futhi bizelwa usizo lwezokwelapha uma kudingeka Qinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bayazindlela zokuphuma, imigomo yomlilo nemishini. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa nokuphathwa kwempahla nezakhiwo endlini yabafundi. Hlola ukwonakala endlini yabafundi futhi ukubike abasebenzi abahlobene ukwenza izilungiso. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amabhilidi endlu yabafundi nendawo bisezimeni ezinhle.

xh.title: Somlawuli Wokulawula Indlu Yokuhlala (Indoda)
xh.summary: Lawula abafundi kwindlu yokuhlala yeZwelitsha Campus, ukuqinisekisa impilo ezayo, ukwenza iindokulishi, nokulawula ukusasazwa kolwazi phakathi kwekampasi nakwiofisi yamabhaso.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 (NQF Level 4) kunye/okanye Isatifikethi (NQF Level 5) kulawulo okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo. 1-2 iminyaka yamava ahambelanayo ekulawuleni abafundi kwiziko lokuhlala leKholeji. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nokusingathwa kwezinto kwiTVET College kuquka ulwazi ngemfuno yokubika ngamnye ngeZiko leMfundo ePhakamileyo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngowuso-mmandla weMfundo ePhakamileyo, ngokukodwa imigaqo nomthetho ohambelanayo. Amakhono olawulo, ukuqamba kunye nokuhlela. Ulawulo lweemali. Ubhalo lwemibiko. Ukusombulula iingxaki. Ulwazi ngekhompyutha. Ukuba ngumlawuli weliqela. Ukuqamba kunye nokuhlela. Amakhono okulawula abantu.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ulandele impilo ezayo yabafundi Yenza iindokulishi zendlu yokuhlala. Yenza ukhetho labaholi beblocki, Qinisekisa ukusasazwa ngokufanelekileyo kolwazi namaxwebhu ukuya nakunye nomlawuli wekampasi nakwiofisi yamabhaso. Qinisekisa ukusasazwa ngokufanelekileyo kolwazi namaxwebhu ukuya nakunye nomlawuli wekampasi nakwiofisi yamabhaso. Nika uncedo lokulawula iingxabano kubafundi nasesameni Bhala ikhowudi yokuziphatha yendlu yokuhlala Gcina amarekhodi endlu, ukwamkelwa, kwaye wabelane amagumbi abafundi Sahlula iifomu zesicelo sendlu yokuhlala. Qokelela iifomu zesicelo namaxwebhu axhasayo ahambelanayo. Yenza ukuqinisekiswa kolwazi kwinkqubo yeCOLTECH. Bhala, gcina iikopi zesiliphu zentlawulo yomfundi namaxwebhu okuzivikela. Gcina irekhodi elibhaliweyo lokuhamba kwabafundi bendlu yokuhlala emva kweyure zomsebenzi. Lungisa kunye nokunika iimbiko zeminye yamanyanga ngezenzo nezigameko zendlu yokuhlala. Beka amagumbi abafundi ngokusekelwe kwiinkqubo zokwamkelwa, inqanaba lokuphumelela, ukwahlukanisa ngobudala nakwesisiseko sokuqala ukufika kuqala ukukhonza. Misela ulawule uluhlu lomsebenzi. Landela uze uqinisekise ukhuseleko labafundi nempahla yabo endlwini yokuhlala. Yenza ukujikeleza njalo ukuze uqinisekise ukuba abafundi nendlu yokuhlala bakhuselekile. Nika unyango lokuqala oluyimfuneko kwaye biza uncedo lwezempilo xa kuyimfuneko Qinisekisa ukuba abafundi bayazi iindlela zokubaleka, imigaqo yomlilo nezixhobo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa nokulawulwa kwempahla nolwakhiwo kwindlu yokuhlala. Qaphela ukonakala ekwindlu yokuhlala uze ubike abantu abafanelekileyo abakulawulweni ukuba balungise. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke izakhiwo zendlu yokuhlala nendawo zayo zilungileyo.

af.title: Finansiesklerk
af.summary: Finansiesklerk by Zwelitsha-kampus wat fakture, betalings, banktransaksies en skuldenaar/skuldheer-rekords vir die Department of Higher Education and Training hanteer.
af.requirements: Matriek / NCV Level 4 en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Finansiële Bestuur asook 'n erkende relevante kwalifikasie. 1-2 jaar se ervaring in 'n Finansiële Bestuur TVET-omgewing. zu.title: Umlobi Wezezimali
zu.summary: Umlobi Wezezimali e Zwelitsha Campus ophatha amafomu etintengo, izinkokhelo, izinkambu zebhange namarekhodi abanikazi bamadolobha/abanikazi betfula ku Department of Higher Education and Training.
zu.requirements: Matric / NCV Level 4 kanye ne National Diploma in Financial Management kanye nesitifikazi esamukelekayo esifanele. 1-2 years' experience in a Financial Management TVET environment. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olisisekelo ngemisebenzi yezimali, izindlela zokwenza kanye namandla okuqamba futhi uhlanganise izibalo eziphathelene nezimali. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi olusisekelo ngemithetho yezimali ye Public Service, izindlela kanye nemigoqo yesikhwama semali (PFMA, DORA, PSA, PSR and Financial Manual). Ulwazi ngamasistimu wemisebenzi yezimali olesisekelo (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS, COLTECH etc.). Amakhono ekhompyutha. Ukuhlela futhi uhlele. Ithemu elihle elomlomo nelayilwayo. Amandla okubala okusisekelo. Ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi ejwayelekile. Ukuguquguquka. Ubudlelwano nabantu kanye nokuqinisekisa ukunemba. Ukukwazi ukusebenza kakhulu namanani.
zu.duties: Thola bese ukuhlola amafomu etintengo ukuze qinisekise ukunemba, ukuqinisekisa nokuqinisekisa (ulawulo lwangaphakathi). Cululisela amafomu etintengo (isb. ucululisa izinkokhelo). Ukuyongwa kwemali. Qamba zonke izinkambu zezimali. Cacisa i-akhawunti yesikhwama esikhandelayo. Qamba abanikazi bamadolobha kanye nabanikazi betfula. Cululisela izinkambu zebhangi ekhompyutheni. Hlela amajornali. Fananisa ukuchithwa ngesikhathi sekharishi. Hlukanisa izinguquko. Qamba, uhlele izinto eziyisuswana kwesikhathi sekharishi. Sabalalisa amadokhumente ahlobene ngesikhathi sekharishi. Gcina wonke amadokhumenti. Thola bese uqamba izinkokhelo zemali. Thola bese uphatha izaziso zeoholo (isb. hlola izaziso ukuze qinisekise ukunemba konke, qamba amaholo, izinkokhelo ezingeziwe, ukulungiswa kwamaholo futhi uqamba yonke imikhawulo, etc.).

xh.title: Ikhlerkisi Zezimali
xh.summary: Ikhlerkisi Zezimali e Zwelitsha Campus esebenza ngee-invoisi, ngeenzalo, nangemisebenzi yebhanki nangerekhodi zabatyali-mali nabafumani-mali kwisebe le Higher Education and Training.
xh.requirements: Matric / NCV Level 4 kunye ne National Diploma kwi Financial Management nakwakhona ngesiqu esivunyiweyo esihambelana naleso. Iminyaka yamava emi-1-2 kwindawo ye Financial Management TVET. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olusisiseko ngomsebenzi wezimali, iindlela zokuqonda kum kunye nakhona namandla okuqamba kunye nokuhlanganisa izibalo ezingezimali. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngemiganu yekhompyutha. Ulwazi olusisiseko ngemithetho, iinkqubo nemigaqo yesixeko sezimali yoLuntu osebenzayo (PFMA, DORA, PSA, PSR ne Financial Manual). Ulwazi ngeenkqubo ezisisiseko zokuqhuba izimali (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS, COLTECH njl.). Amakhono ekhompyutha. Ukucwangcisa nokuqamba. I communication ilungileyo yenomleko nangezibhalo. Amakhono obuntshunci obusisiseko ngeenani. Ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo. Ukuguquguquka. Ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu kunye nokuqinisekisa ukuchanekile. Ikhono ngamanani.
xh.duties: Amkela ukuhlola ii-invoisi ukuze kubekho ukuqinisekisa ukuchanekile, ukuqinisekisa nokuvunywa (ulawulo langaphakathi). Qhuba ii-invoisi (umz. qamba iinzalo). Ukuqokelela imali etyalini. Qamba onke amashisho eze-mali. Susa i-akhawunti yesikrobhu. Bhala abatyali-mali nabafumani-mali. Qhuba amashisho ebhanki yekhompyutha. Hlanganisela iijornali. Thelekisa indleko nomalinge. Phawula iindaba ezingafaniyo. Qamba, bagqibelela iimvuzo kwisabelo somlinge. Sabelisa amaxwebhu ngokubandakanya isabelo. Gcina onke amaxwebhu. Amkela ukuqamba iinzalo zesanti. Amkela ukuqhuba izalathiso zemivuzo (umz. hlola izalathiso zonke ukuchanekile, qamba imivuzo, iibhonasi, ulungiso lemivuzo ukuze baqambe onke amasibo zipheliso, njl.).

af.title: Data-invoerder
af.summary: Data-invoerderpos by King Campus onder die Department of Higher Education and Training, wat Graad 12 en 'n diploma of graad in Besigheidstudies met data-invoervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Matrieksertifikaat / NQF Vlak 4 Sertifikaat. Nasionale Diploma / Graad in Besigheidstudies-kwalifikasie. 1-2 jaar se relevante werkservaring in 'n TVET / Openbare Diens Data-invoerstelsel. Sertifikaat of bewese kennis van MS Office sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis van rekenaarvaardigheid en inligtingbestuur. Kennis/ begrip, toepassing en interpretasie van kantoorbestuursvoorskrifte, COLTECH, data-warehouse en IT-stelsels. Kennis van die Skills Development Act, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations en Labour Relations Act. Beplanning en organisering, finansiële bestuur, verslagskrywing, kommunikasie en interpersoonlike verhoudings, probleemoplossing, analitiese denke, kliëntgerigtheid, projekbestuur, spanleierskap, personeelsbestuur en rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Voer data van beskikbare rekords in die vereiste formate in bv. stelsel(s), databasisse, tabelle en sigblaaie. Voer studentregistrasie, betalingsontvangs en uitreiking van studentnommers in. Voer inskrywingsvorms tydens die registrasieperiode in. Voer ICAS-, ISAT- en finale eksamenpunte in. Maak gereelde rugsteun van data. Onderhou en dateer stelselrekords; hou en onderhou rekords en lêers; verseker dat rekords en lêers behoorlik gesorteer en beveilig is. Verskaf inligting aan relevante komponente. E-pos skedule van uitslae aan Campushoofde, HOD's en Senior Dosente.

zu.title: Umbuki Zemininingwane
zu.summary: Isikhundla sombuki zemininingwane e King Campus ngaphansi kwe Department of Higher Education and Training, esifuna ibhodi ye Grade 12 nediploma noma iziqu kumabizo wezoshintshanisiwe kanye namava wokubuka imininingwane.
zu.requirements: Ibhasikidi ye Grade 12 / Isitifikedi se Matric / Isitifikedi se NQF Level 4. I Diploma Yezwe / Iziqu kumabizo wezoshintshanisiwe. Uluvo lolusebenza oluhambisanayo eminyakeni engu 1-2 kumshini wokubuka imininingwane kwi TVET / Public Service. Isitifikedi noma ulwazi oluzwakalayo le MS Office luzoba yinzuzo engeziwe. Ulwazi ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha nolwazi lokuphatha imininingwane. Ulwazi/ukuqonda, ukusebenzisa nokuhumusha imithetho yokuphatha ihhovisi, COLTECH, igumbi legcininhlangano yemininingwane kanye namashini e IT. Ulwazi ngomthetho we Skills Development Act, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations kanye ne Labour Relations Act. Ukuhlela futhi ukuhlela izinto, ukuphatha imali, ukubhala imibiko, ukuxhumana nobudlelwano bomuntu, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukuqondiswe kumthengi, ukuphatha amaphrojekhi, ukuphatha iqembu, ukuphatha abantu kanye nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Buka imininingwane ezicongweni ezitholakalayo ubuyise kumafomathi adingwayo njengashini, amagcininhlangano yemininingwane, amatafule namashidi. Buka ukubhalisa kwabafundi, ukwamukela imali yokukhokha futhi unike abafundi amanamba. Buka amafomu okubhalisa ngesikhathi sokuqinisekisa ukubhalisa. Buka amanamba okuhlola okuphakathi okungu ICAS, ISAT kanye namanamba okuhlola okugcinayo. Buka amanamba kumshini uze uwethule kuMphathi we EMIS. Buka ukungabikho kwabafundi kumshini. Hlola futhi qinisekisa yonke imininingwane ezicongweni futhi qinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane ebukiwe iyasimama. Hlukanisa imininingwane edingekayo kanye namaphutha abonwa ngesikhathi sokufaka imininingwane. Qedela amashidi amanamba (amakopi abukhali) futhi wenze amakopi okuzosetshenziswa njengamarekhodi ebandla lokuhlola. Yethula imininingwane kanye namashidi amanamba kubafundisi endaweni yokuhlola. Yenza ngokuvamile amakhophi okulondoloza imininingwane. Gcina futhi buyekeza amarekhodi eshini; gcina futhi uphathethe amarekhodi namafayela; qinisekisa ukuthi amarekhodi namafayela acazulwe kahle futhi avikelekile. Nikeza imininingwane kumakhasimana ahambisanayo. Thumela nge-imeyili ishejuli yeziphumelelo kubaphathi be Campus, kubaphathi wezinhleko kanye nabalufundisi abakhulu.

xh.summary: Isithuba somgcini weData kwiKing Campus phantsi koSebe loMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha, sifuna iGrade 12 nidiploma okanye isidanga kwiZifundo zeShishino zinomava wokuthatha idata.
xh.requirements: iGrade 12 / Isatifikethi seMatric / Isatifikethi seNQF Level 4, iDiploma yezwe / Isidanga kwiZifundo zeShishino, 1-2 yiminyaka yomava wokusebenza kwinkqubo yokuThatha idata kwiTVET / ukuQeqesha koRhwebo lwaseLuntu, Isatifikethi okanye ulwazi olugqiniweyo lweMS Office luya kuba lusizo olongeziweyo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuLawula ulwazi. Ulwazi/ukuqonda, ukusebenzisa nokutolika imigaqo yolawulo lezikhulu, COLTECH, indawo yokugcina idata nenenkqubo ze-IT. Ulwazi ngeSkills Development Act, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations neLabour Relations Act. Ukuqamba iplani nokuqamba, ukulawula imali, ukubala iingxelo, ukunxibelelana nokuqhathanisa nabantu, ukuxazula iingxaki, kuqamba ngengqondo, ukumelana naklijenti, ukulawula iprojekthi, ukulawula iqela, ukulawula abantu nokuqonda ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Thatha idata kumagama afumanekayo uze uyifake kwiindlela efunwayo njengenkqubo(nkqubo), iziseko zeenani, iitafile namaspredsheet. Thatha ubhaliso lwabafundi, ukufumaniswa kokuhlawulwa nokunika abaFundiumanani. Thatha amafomu okubhalisa phakathi kwexesha lokubhalisa. Thatha amagama e-ICAS, ISAT namgesilinganiselo sokugqibela sokuvavanya. Thatha amagama enkqubweni uze uwahlawulele kuPhathi we-EMIS. Thatha ukungabikho kwabafundi enkqubeni. Phawula uze uqiniseke onke amagama athathwe kumagama ukuqinisekisa ukuzinza kwedata ethathiweyo. Qaphela idata elahlekileyo nani iimpazamo ezibonakalayo ngelixa kungenwa idata. Gqiba ipeyipi yamagama (iikopi ezibambiweyo) uze wenze ikokpizi eziza kusetyenziswa njengeziko zokubakho kwindawo yovavanyo. Hlawulela idata nepeyipi yamaguma kubaphathi bendawo yokubala imigqa (ukubala ngaphakathi). Yenza iibhakhusi ezizeziko ze-data rhoqo. Sigcine uze uhlehlule amagama enkqubo; gcina uze ugcine amagama namafayile; qinisekisa ukuba amagama namafayile ahlelwe kakuhle aze axhonywe. Nikeza inkcazelo kwizahluko ezifanelekileyo. Thumela nge-email uluhlu lweziphumo kwiNtloko zeKhamphas, ooHOD nooPhathi abakhulu.

af.title: Koördinerende Beampte vir Bezoekerskomitee – Vcco
af.summary: Koördineer en hupbestuur Onafhanklike Korrektiewe Sentrum Besoekers oor die Sentrale Bestuursstreek, waarvoor 'n diploma in openbare bestuur en vyf jaar se ervaring in die justisieklauster vereis word.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Senior Sertifikaat/Graad 12, 'n Graad/Nasionale Diploma in Openbare Bestuur/Openbare Bestuurskantoor/Kantoorbestuur of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF 6 soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring in die Justisieklauster en 'n minimum van 2 jaar se bestuurservaring. Geldige Bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van die Openbare Finansiële Bestuurswet, Openbare Dienswet en -regulasies en Nasionale Tesourie-regulasies. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede: rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office, Excel en PowerPoint), goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge, kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling en skriftelik), beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, vermoë om onder druk te werk en onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span, bereidwilligheid om ekstra ure te werk, probleemoplossing- en leierskapsvaardighede, aandag aan besonderhede en goeie konflikoplossingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die verskaffing van bestuur, toesig en beheer van Onafhanklike Korrektiewe Sentrum Besoekers binne die streek. Koördineer en monitor ICCV-aktiwiteite, wys werk toe, hersien verslae, monitor bywoning en prestasie en fasiliteer induksie- en opleidingsreëlings. Bestuur klagtes, insluitend algemene, dringende en verpligte klagtes, verse behoorlike optekening en eskalasie van sake en volg uitstaande reaksies na. Koördineer Bezoekerskomitee- en belanghebbende-betrokkenheidsvergaderings, berei agenda's voor, stel notules op en hou treding met die implementering van besluite. Voer prestasie-evaluerings uit, stel statistiese en bestuursverslae op, hou rekords en registers aan, verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning aan streeks toesigaktiwiteite en skakel met korrektiewe sentrums, ICCV's, Bezoekerskomitees en interne belanghebbendes om doeltreffende toesig te ondersteun.

zu.title: Onogqoqwa Bekomiti Ababambi Abavela Umnyango Wezivakashi – Vcco
zu.summary: Koordinata futhi uphele ezivakashi Ezigunyazwe Ezingakhonteki Zasezindaweni Ezilungiswa Abasobala Kwizwe Ephakathi Kolawulo, kudingeka idiploma kulawulo kwabezimali kanye nesiphephelo seminyaka emihlanu kule minyaka yesikhathi seminyaka yobulungiswa.
zu.requirements: Abafaki izicelo kumelwe babe ne-Senior Certificate/Grade 12, Degree/National Diploma in Public Administration/Public Management/Office Management noma iziqu ezingabalulekiyo ezinga le-NQF 6 njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. Ukuze ube nesiphephelo seminyaka emi-5 ngaphezulu kwemisebenzi kwilunga le-Justice Cluster kanye nesiphephelo seminyaka emi-2 ngaphezulu kwemisebenzi yokulawula. Ithikithi le-Valid Driver’s License. Ulwazi nge-Public Finance Management Act, Public Service Act and Regulations kanye ne-National Treasury Regulations. Amakhono nendlela yokwenza: ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint), ukuba nobuhlobo obuhle nabantu, amakhono okuxoxa (ngomlomo nangokubhala), ukwazi ukulungiselela futhi uhlele, ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezingcindezi nokuzimele futhi njengelunga lqembu, ukuthanda ukusebenza ihora elikhulu, ukuxazulula izinkinga namakhono okuba ngumholi, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kono ukutholakale kanye namakhono ohlelo lokuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Umuntu oyintofa uyokwazi ukubeka abantu abalungele ukuphatha, ukubagqoza kanye nokulawula Ezivakashi Ezigunyazwe Ezingakhonteki endaweni yakhe. Yakha futhi uhlole imisebenzi ye-ICCV, abele imisebenzi, ubuye emibhalweni, uhlole ukubakhona kanye nentengo yomsebenzi futhi uhlele ukungeniswa kanye noqeqesho. Phatha izikhalazo, okuhlanganisa izikhalazo eziyisisekelo, ezibalulekile kanye nezoqobo, qinisekisa ukugcinwa okufanele kanye nokunyukelisa kwezindaba futhi ulandele izimpendulo ezingekho. Yakha eminye yezinkomfa ze-Visitors’ Committee kanye namaminitha ongqongqoshe, lungiselela izinhlelo zomsebenzi, qamba iminithi futhi ulandelele ukusetshenziswa kwezinqumo. Yenza ihlelo lokulinganisa ukusebenza, qamba imibhalo yezibalo kanye nokulawula, gcina imibhalo nemitshingo yokuqopha, nikeza inkosazo yokweseka imisebenzi yokugqamisa kommandla wendawo futhi uxhumane nezikhungo zokulungisa, ama-ICCV, ama-Visitors’ Committees kanye nabalawuli abangaphakathi ukuze useke ukugqamisa okusebenzayo.

xh.summary: Ukuqhula nezisebelisi ezizimeleyo ze-Correctional Centre Visitors kunye nokuqonda iindawo ezikwindawo yolawulo legumbi, kufuneka kubekho isatifikethi somatshini kwindawo yolawulo loluntu kunye nomyalelo weminyaka emihlanu kwindawo yolawulo bentlalo yenkqubo.

Ulwazi ngoMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu, uMthetho noMthetho wokuLawula iinkonzo zaBantu kunye noMthetho woLawulo lweTreasury yaseNingizimu Afrika. Amakhono namandla okusebenza: ukusebenza ngekhompyutha (MS Office, Excel noPowerPoint), ubudlelwane obuhle obuqu nabantu, amakhono okunxibelelwana (abhalayo nakuthethwayo), amakhono okuquka nezinkqubo, amandla okusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo nokuzimeleyo njengakwicala lomthetho wobuqu, ukuzimisela ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo, amakhono okusombulula iingxaki nakolawulo, ukunakela iinkcukacha kunye namakhono amde wokusombulula iingxaki.

Ukuqhula kwaye ulandele iindaba ze-ICCV, ukwaba umsebenzi, ukujonga iingxelo, ulandele iinkalo zobukhoyo nokusebenza, kwaye ulungiselele iinkqubo zokuqaliswa kunye nokuzimisela. Ukuqhula nabakwindawo yamabala aBantu kunye nabantu abaningi abahlukene, ukulungiselela iinhlela zokuqala nokugqibela, ukwenza amanqaku iingxelo, nokulandelela ukusebenza kwamagunya. Ukwenza isicelo sokuvavanya, ukwenza iingxelo zezibalo ezikwindawo yolawulo, ukugcina iingxelo nakwindawo yolawulo, ukubonelela ngokuseta izicelo eziyindlela yoluntu, kwaye unxibelelane nabakwindawo yolawulo beNqanaba, abe yi-ICCV, kubakwindawo yolawulo kunye nabantu abangenela iindawo ezikwindawo yolawulo olusebenzayo.

af.title: Onafhanklike Korrektiewe Sentrum Besoeker (VLAK 5 - 3/8ste)
af.summary: Onafhanklike Korrektiewe Sentrum Besoekers word vir verskeie korrektiewe sentrums landswyd gesoek om plekbesoeke uit te voer, gedetineerdes te ondervra en klagtes op Vlak 5 te bestuur.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12/Senior Sertifikaat hê. Rekenaargeletterd en akkuraat. 'n Aanbeveling of benoeming as 'n ICCV deur 'n gemeenskapsorganisasie (nie ouer as ses (6) maande nie). Vermoë om onafhanklik en as 'n span te werk. Publiekgesind en goeie kennis van die Batho Pele-beginsels. Selfversekerdheid en vermoë om onder druk te werk. Vermoë om te kommunikeer (mondelings en skriftelik). 'n Bestuurderslisensie sal 'n voordeel wees. Voorkeur sal gegee word aan kwalifiserende aansoeke ontvang van individue wat in gemeenskappe woon wat in die nabyheid van die korrektiewe sentrum is waar die pos gevul moet word.
af.duties: Die ampshouer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die uitvoer van plekbesoeke en verslagdoening oor dringende aangeleenthede. Om gereelde onderhoude en konsultasies met gedetineerdes en DCS-amptenare rakende klagtes en verpligte aangeleenthede uit te voer. Ontvang en vaslegging van alle klagtes/versoeke op die databasis. Oopmaak en onderhoud van saaklêers. Opvolg doen op uitstaande klagtes. Indiening van maandelikse verslae. Voorsien statistiese ontleding van alle klagtes ontvang. Na aanvrae aandag gee. Alle redelike opdragte deur die toesighouer/ Streeksbestuurder uitvoer.

zu.title: Isivakashi Esizimele Sesikhungo Sokulungisa Abaphosi (LEVEL 5 - 3/8th)
zu.summary: Kufunwa abavakashi bezikhungo zokulungisa abaphosi abazimele kumakhulu amakhulu ezikhungo nakho onke izwe ukuba kwenze izivakashi ezindaweni, kubuzwe ababoshiwe, kupalwe izikhalazo ezingeni i-Level 5.
zu.requirements: Abafakela kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12/Senior Certificate. Ukuba namakhono ekhompyutha nokuba ngemvume. Incomo noma ukhetho njenge-ICCV yenhlangano yomphakathi (ingadluli izinyanga eziyisithupha (6)). Ikono lokusebenza kodwa nakuba njengeliqembu. Ukuba nokwaziswa kwezomphakathi nokuba nezinhlalo ezinhle zemigidingo ye-Batho Pele. Ukuzigqaja nokuba nengalo yokusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezelekile. Ikhono lokuxoxa (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ilayisensi yokushayela izothsa isibusiso. Isikhundla siba sokuqala kubafakeli abahambisana nezidingo abatholwa kubantu abahlala emiphakathini esiseduze nesikhungo sokulungisa abaphosi lapho kufanele kugcwaliswe khona isikhundla.
zu.duties: Umntu othiswe isikhundla uzobe noguquko lokwenza izivakashi ezindaweni nokubika ngemida ephuthumayo. Ukuqhuba izivakashi ezivamile kanye nezingxoxo nababoshiwe namaphoyisa e-DCS maqondana nezikhalo nezindaba ezingaphezu kwemithesho yokuyincoma. Ukwamukela kanye nokubhala yonke imikhala/izicelo kule-database. Ukuqalwa kanye nokugcinwa kwamafayela ezenzo. Ukuqhuba imibiko yezikhalo ezingakalungiswa. Ukuthumela imibiko yanyanga zonke. Ukuhlinzeka ngenhlalokuthi yezibalo zayo yonke imikhala etholiwe. Ukuphendula imibuzo. Ukuze konke imiyalo engangakwaziyo ephathwa nomphathi/isikhulu lesifunda.

xh.title: Umngeni Wesebe Lokulungisa Izigwebo Ozingela (inqanaba 5 - 3/8th)
xh.summary: Kufunwa abangeni basebe lokulungisa izigwebo kumaziko amaninzi okulungisa izigwebo kuwo wonke umz ukuba benziindwendwe kwiindawo zokusebenza, bachathe nabanjwa, baphathe iimalungelo ngokwinqanaba 5.
xh.requirements: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seGrajiyethi 12/Abaphakamileyo. Bakwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, babe ngabantu abanembene. Kufunwe ukuba kunikelwe isindululo okanye isiphakamiso njengomngeni Wesebe Lokulungisa Izigwebo yintlalo ekwimeko yesixeko (ingangenziwa iinyanga ezithandatho (6) ezidlulileyo). Ububele bokusebenza kodwa nangaphandle kwamanye, kwaye unolwazi olululo ngezimvo ezilawula iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezifana neBatho Pele. Ukuzimisela nokukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo. Ukwazi ukunxibelelwana (ngentsomi nakubhalo). Ifayile yokuqamba iya kubayimaxabiso alumniki weentsobha. Abantu abahlala kumaxexesha amaxhaso edolophu ukuba balungele ukwenzela abantu abasakuba sekwimeko yamaplatso okulawula eendaweni ezikufutshane nesebe lokulungisa izigwebo apho kufuneka kuvalwe isithuba, baya kubakho iphuphu.
xh.duties: Umntu ophethe le ndima uya kubizwa ngokuba ngowokuqala ekwindwendwe le ndawo yokusebenza nokunika iinkcazelo ngemiba ephuthumayo. Ukwenza iintervyu ezizezihlandlo, negqibeko elenzeke nommangalelwa kodwa nangaphaya kokuqwalasela imfundiso yemihla ngemihla nemigaqo yolawulo ehambelana nokuqwalaselwa kolwangu nempawu eziyimfuneko. Ukubuza nokubeka iingxaki okwaye ungenise konke okuvela kolwazi nezicelo kwidatabase. Ukuqaliswa, ukugcinwa kolawulo kolwazi oluphathekayo kwimifanekiso ecinezelweyo. Ukuqwalasela ukuba inkqubela phambili eqhuba inkqubela phambili kwimiba equkene yegalelo elinqamlezileyo, nokwenzela ulwazi oluqhutywa lusetyenziswa kolwazi olusetyenziswayo oluqhutywa ngamaphupha.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator: Tenure Reform Implementation
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Coordinate communal land tenure reform implementation projects in Vryheid, requiring a National Diploma in Humanities, Social Sciences, or Legal and three years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in the field of Humanities / Social Sciences / Legal Qualification or related equivalent qualification. Minimum of 3 years’ experience in the relevant field. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Thorough knowledge of land tenure security matters. Relevant tenure legislation and policies. Strategic planning. Human resources management. Financial management. Supply chain management. Knowledge of economics. Job related skills: Communication (verbal and written). Negotiation and conflict resolution. Strategic management. Leadership and networking. Project management. Team management. Customer and client focus. Statistical forecasting. Willingness to travel.
jobs.duties: Implement communal land tenure projects. Initiate awareness and capacity building on communal land management and relevant laws to stakeholders. Liaise and provide support to land rights management structures by providing legal protection and awareness. Facilitate and mediate in case of land rights violation and disputes on communal land in terms of relevant legislation. Conduct the implementation of the communal tenure upgrade programmes. Implement of land rights projects. Respond to queries on land rights projects. Provide support to rights management structures by providing legal protection and awareness. Facilitate land rights mediation and adjudication processes. Conduct the implementation of land rights upgrade programmes. Provide support to Land Rights Management Facility. Implement the establishment and support of communal property entities. Initiate the establishment and implementation of Communal Property Associations (CPAs). Maintain the database of CPA’s and similar entities. Conduct awareness on of CPA activities. Perform investigations and intervene on the affairs and activities of registered CPA’s. Engage in the mediation and dispute resolution proceedings of the CPA’s. Provide supervisory support in the implementation of land tenure projects: Implement provincial implementation plan on tenure projects. Conduct stakeholder relations services. Represent and present the directorate at various fora. Facilitate CPAs compliance to legislation. Attend to external and internal audits. Implement of action plan. Implement risk and audit action plan. Compile reports.
