af.title: Projekkoördineerder: Implementering van Grondeienaarshervorming
af.summary: Koördineer implementeringsprojekte vir hervorming van gemeenskaplike grondeienaarskap in Vryheid, waarvoor 'n Nasionale Diploma in Geesteswetenskappe, Sosiale Wetenskappe of Regte, asook drie jaar se relevante ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma (NQF Vlak 6) op die gebied van Geesteswetenskappe / Sosiale Wetenskappe / Regte of 'n verwante ewekwaige kwalifikasie. Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in die relevante veld. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Deeglike kennis van kwessies rakende grondeienaarskapsekuriteit. Relevante grondeienaarskapswetgewing en -beleid. Strategiese beplanning. Menslikehulpbronbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Voorsieningskettingbestuur. Kennis van ekonomie. Werksverwante vaardighede: Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Onderhandeling en konflikoplossing. Strategiese bestuur. Leierskap en netwerk bou. Projekbestuur. Spanbestuur. Kliënt- en klantgefokus. Statistiese voorspelling. Bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Implementeer gemeenskaplike grondeienaarskapprojekte. Begin bewustheidskeping en kapasiteitsbou oor gemeenskaplike grondbestuur en relevante wette aan belanghebbendes. Skakel en verskaf ondersteuning aan grondeienaarskapsbestuursstrukture deur regtelike beskerming en bewustheid te verskaf. Fasiliteer en bemiddel in die geval van grondeienaarskapskendings en geskille oor gemeenskaplike grond ooreenkomstig die relevante wetgewing. Voer die implementering van die opgraderingsprogramme vir gemeenskaplike grondeienaarskap uit. Implementeer grondeienaarskapprojekte. Reageer op navrae oor grondeienaarskapprojekte. Verskaf ondersteuning aan regtebestuursstrukture deur regtelike beskerming en bewustheid te verskaf. Fasiliteer grondeienaarskapsbemiddeling en beslissingsprosesse. Voer die implementering van opgraderingsprogramme vir grondeienaarskap uit. Verskaf ondersteuning aan die Regtebestuursfasiliteit vir Grondeienaarskap. Implementeer die totstandstelling en ondersteuning van gemeenskaplike eiendomsentiteite. Begin die totstandstelling en implementering van Gemeenskaplike Eiendomsverenigings (GEV's). Onderhou die databasis van GEV's en soortgelyke entiteite. Voer bewustheidskeping oor GEV-aktiwiteite uit. Voer ondersoeke uit en tree in by die aangeleenthede en aktiwiteite van geregistreerde GEV's. Raak betrokke by die bemiddelings- en geskiloplossingsverrigtinge van die GEV's. Verskaf toesigondersteuning by die implementering van grondeienaarskapprojekte: Implementeer die provinsiale implementeringsplan vir grondeienaarskapprojekte. Voer belanghebbededienste uit. Verteenwoordig en bied die direktoraat by verskeie forums aan. Fasiliteer GEV-nakoming van wetgewing. Tree op rakende eksterne en interne oudits. Implementeer aksieplan. Implementeer risiko- en ouditaksieplan. Stel verslae op.

zu.title: Umqondisi Wephrojekthi: Ukusetshenziswa Kolungiso Lobunikazi
zu.summary: Coordinatha amaphrojekthi okusetshenziswa kolungiso lobunikazi bentwadi evamile eVryheid, adinga i-National Diploma kuma-Humanities, i-Social Sciences, noma i-Legal kanye namaphesheka eminyaka emithathu ohlobene nawo.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaka izinto kumele benesitifikedi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) emkhakheni we-Humanities / i-Social Sciences / i-Legal Qualification noma izifiso ezihlobene ezinganingi. Okuncane ukuphila kweminyaka engu-3 emsebenzini ohlobene nawo. Ilayisense yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi oluzinze oludingekayo ngemibhulu yokuvikela ukuphatha kwentwadi. Umthetho wezenzo zolungiso nobuqondiswa bokubeka imigomo. Ukulungiselela ngendlela ephumelelayo. Ukuphatha abantu abasebenzayo. Ukuphatha izimali. Ukuphatha uchungechunge lokuhlinzeka. Ulwazi lwezomnotho. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhala). Ukuxoxisana nokuqeda izinkinga. Ukuphatha ngendlela ephumelelayo. Ukubeka indlela nokuxhuma nabanye. Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi. Ukuphatha iqembu. Ukugcizelela abathengi nalabo abafunayo. Ukubikezela ngemibhalosithathistikhi. Ukuzijabulisa ukuhamba.
zu.duties: Sisetbenzise amaphrojekthi obunikazi bentwadi evamile. Qala ukwazisa nokwakha amandla ekuphathweni kwentwadi evamile kanye nemithetho ehlobene kubantu abathintekayo. Xhumanisa futhi unikeze inkundla yokusekela izinhlobo zokuphatha amalungelo obuhlobo ngokunikeza ukuvikelwa ngokomthetho nokuqwashisa. Yenza futhi uxhume izinkulumo ezinkundleni zokuqeda ububi onamalungelo entwadi kanye nenhlanganisela entwadi evamile ngokomthetho odingekayo.enza ukusetshenziswa kwamaphrojekthi olungiso kobunikazi bentwadi evamile. Yenza amaphrojekthi amalungelo obuhlobo. Phendula imibuzo ngamaphrojekthi amalungelo obuhlobo. Nikela inkundla yokusekela izinhlobo zokuphatha amalungelo ngokunikeza ukuvikelwa ngokomthetho nokuqwashisa. Yenza izinkulumo zoxhumisano lwezimalungelo kwentwadi nemicimbi yokuhlulela inkinga. enza ukusetshenziswa kwamaphrojekthi olungisa amalungelo obuhlobo. Nikela inkundla yokusekela isikhungo sokuphatha amalungelo obuhlobo. Yenza ukusungula kanye nokusekela izinkampani zempahla evamile. Qala ukusungula kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlangano zempahla evamile (CPAs). Gcina ukudatha kwezinhlangano zempahla evamile (CPAs) kanye nezinye ezifanayo. Yenza ukuqwashisa ngemisebenzi ye-CPA.enza ukuphenya futhi ungene ezindabeni nasezimisweni zenhlangano eziyingqayizivele zama-CPA. Linganisela kulo ukuhweba ngemininingwane nokuxazulula izinkinga ezinkundleni zama-CPA. Nikela inkundla yokuhlola ekusetshenzisweni kwamaphrojekthi obunikazi obuhlobo: Setshenziswa ipulani yesifundazwe ekwenzeni amaphrojekthi obunikazi obuhlobo.enza izinsiza zokuxhumana nabathintekayo. Mela futhi umeme izinhlobo ezahlukene zomnyango emihlanganweni. Yenza ukuzinza kwe-CPAs ngokomthetho. Zibandakanya ekuhloleni okungaphandle nakwangaphakathi. Setshenziswa ipulani yomsebenzi. setshenziswa ipulani yengozi yomsebenzi yokuhlola. Hlola imibhalo.

xh.title: Umququzeleli Weprojekthi: Ukusebenzisa Ingqinelwano Yokuba Nolawulo Kwendumzi
xh.summary: Ukuququzelela iiprojekthi zokusebenzisa ingqinelwano yolawulo kwendumzi jikelele eVryheid, kufuneka kubekho i-National Diploma kwi-Humanities, i-Social Sciences, okanye i-Legal nangaphezulu kweminyaka emithathu yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno eziphakamileyo: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe ne-Sathifikethi se-Grade 12 kunye ne-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) kwinkqubo ye-Humanities / Social Sciences / Legal Qualification okanye isiqui esihambelanayo. Kufuneka kubekho iminyaka engu-3 yamava kwinkqubo ehambelanayo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhambelanayo nesebe: Ulwazi olulungelelanisiweyo malunga neemfumba zokhuseleko lolawulo lwendlu. Umtsetho weengqinelwano zolawulo nemigaqo. Uplano oluceba ngakumbi. Ukuqondwa koluntu. Ulawulo lwemali. Ulawulo lwe-supply chain. Ulwazi lwezoqoqosho. Amakhono ahambelanayo nesebe: Ukunxibelelana (ngomlomo nangobuwemi). Iinkqubo zokuxoxisana nokusombulula iingxabano. Ulawulo oluceba ngakumbi. Ukuyila nokwakha ukudibana nabantu. Ulawulo lweprojekthi. Ulawulo loqembu. Ukujongwa kwabathengi nabaxhasi. Uchungechunge olubhala ngaphambili. Ukulungelelana ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Ukuphumeza iiprojekthi zengqinelwano yolawulo lwendumzi jikelele. Qalisa ukuqonda nokwakha amandla kwilawulo lwendimi jikelele kunye nemithetho ehambelanayo kumahlakani. Qinisekisa udibaniso nancedo kwiinkqubo zolawulo lamalungelo olawulo ngokunika ukhuseleko komthetho nokuqonda. Qokelela kwaye ulawule xa kunokubakho kokwaswayo kwamalungelo nokuphikiswana kolawulo lwendlu jikelele ngokomthetho. Yenza ukusebenza kwesiphakamiso seengqinelwano zolawulo jikelele. Phumeza iiprojekthi zamalungelo. Phendula kwimibuzo ngeeprojekthi zamalungelo. Nikela ncedo kumagunya yolawulo ngokunikela ngekhuseleko lomthetho nokuqonda. Qokelela kwaye ulungelelanise iinkqubo zoxoxo nomanyano lwamalungelo. Phumeza inkqubo yesiphakamiso samalungelo. Nikela ncedo kwinkqubo yoLawulo Lwamalungelo. Phumeza ukumisela nokuxhasa iziko lempahla yomxhasi. Qalisa ukumisela nokusebenzisa i-Communal Property Associations (CPAs). Gcina i-data ye-CPA kunye namanye amagunya afanayo. Yenza ukuziqondisa ngeenkqubo ze-CPA. Yenza iingxoxo kwaye ungenelele kumashishini namashishini e-CPA. Linganisela kwaye ulawule ukusingathwa nokuphathwa kwe-CPA. Thatha inxaxheba kuxoxo nokusombulula iingxabano ze-CPA. Nikela ncedo lokulawula ekuphumezeni iiprojekthi zengqinelwano yolawulo: Yenza iplano yophumezo lolawulo kwiprojekthi. Yenza iinkonzo zodibaniso namahlakani. Umeli kwaye ukhombise idirekhate kwiziko elahlukileyo. Qokelela ukuzaliseka komthetho kwe-CPA. Yiza kwi-audit ezangaphakathi nangaphandle. Yenza iplano yomsebenzi. Yenza iplano ye-audit yengozi. Bhala iiripoti.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Budget
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: The Department of Land Reform and Rural Development seeks an Assistant Director: Budget to coordinate budgeting programmes and compile MTEF integrations in Pietermaritzburg.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and National Diploma in Cost and Management Accounting / Auditing / Public Finance / Financial Management / B.COM Accounting (Accounting) or related equivalent qualifications. Minimum of 3 years' supervisory experience in the budget environment. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of Public Service Policies and Regulations. Treasury Regulations and Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Basic Accounting System (BAS). Ability to monitor Budgets. Ability to liaise at different levels of management. Job related skills: Computer literacy (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project). Communication (verbal and written). Planning and organising. Time management and Liaison. Minimum van 3 jaar se toesigervaring in die begrotingsomgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van Openbare Diensbeleid en Regulasies. Tesourie-regulasies en die Wet op Openbare Finansiële Bestuur (PFMA). Basiese Rekeningkundige Stelsel (BAS). Vermoë om begrotings te monitor. Vermoë om op verskillende bestuursvlakke te skakel. Werksverwante vaardighede: Rekenaarvaardigheid (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project). Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Beplanning en organisering. Tydbestuur en Skakeling. Werk onder druk en haal sperdatums en gebruik 'n rekenaar vir lang tydperke.
af.duties: Fasiliteer en koördineer begrotingsprogramme en -projekte. Fasiliteer en stel die begrotingsintegrasies op (Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE) en Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE). Fasiliteer en dien maandelikse projeksies in. Fasiliteer en dien tekenings in. Monitor begroting volgens Standard Chart of Accounts (SCOA)-toewysing. Hou toe met die vordering van joernale. Monitor verbintenis. Verifieer die toewysings volgens die vasgelegde begroting. Verseker volledigheid en akkuraatheid van finansiële inligting. Koördineer begrotingsprestasie en verslagdoening. Verskaf maandelikse uitgaweverslae. Analiseer en verklaar afwykings. Rapporteer ongemagtigde uitgawes en rapporteer onreëlmatige en vermorsde uitgawes. zu.title: Onxibelelabantu Abakhokelayo: Ukusebenza kweMali
zu.summary: Isebe lokuThuthukiswa koMhlaba naseMakhaya lifuna uOnxibelelabantu Abakhokelayo: Ukusebenza kweMali ukuba ahlelele imikhakha yokusebenza kwemali abukhoma abuze ukudityaniswa kwe-MTEF e-Pietermaritzburg.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi: Abafaki isicelo kufanele kube nokuba besinesatifikethi se-Grade 12 kanye neDiploma yezwe ku-Accounting yokuHlawula nokuPhatha / ukuHlolwa kwezimali / i-Public Finance / ukuPhathwa kwezeMali / i-B.COM Accounting (Accounting) noma izifundo ezihambisanayo ezilinganayo. Okungenani eminyaka engu-3 yokuqashwa njengomphathi kwendawo yokusebenza kwemali. ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lwezindlela nemiQondiso yeNkonzo kaZwelonke. I-Treasury Regulations kanye noMthetho wokuPhathwa kwezeMali kahulumeni (PFMA). Isistimu yokuBala i-Accounting eyisiseko (BAS). Ukukwazi ukugcina amehlo kumaphuzu okusebenza kwemali. Ukukwazi ukuxhumana namazinga ahlukene obuholi. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lokusebenza ngemishini (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project). Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ukuhlela futhi uhlele. UkuPhatha isikhathi kanye nokuXhumana. Ukusebenza ngaphansi kwenkinga, uhlangabezane namaphuzu wokuqedisisa, futhi usebenzise ikhompyutha isikhathi eside.
zu.duties: Yenza kube lula futhi uhlele imikhakha yamaphuzu okusebenza kwemali nezinhlelo. Yenza kube lula futhi uqhube idatha yokudityaniswa kwamaphuzu okusebenza kwemali (Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE) kanye ne-Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE). Yenza kube lula futhi wethule ulwazi lokuhlela ngenyanga. Yenza kube lula futhi wethule izinto ezingadwetshwa. Gcina amehlo ngokusebenza kwemali njengoba kumiswe ngokwaba kwe-Standard Chart of Accounts (SCOA). Qaphela inkambiso yamajenali. Gcina amehlo kwizibopho. Qinisekisa izabelo njengoba kunikeziwe kumaphuzu okusebenza kwemali abukhumiwe. Qinisekisa ukugcwaliswa nokungaba naliphutha kolwazi lwezimali. Hlela amaphuzu okusebenza kwemali nokubika. Nikela ngemibiko yokuchithwa kwemali yenyanga. Hlaziya futhi chaza izinto ezingahambisani. Bika ukusebenziswa kwemali okungavunyelwe futhi bike ukusebenziswa kwemali okungalungile nakunaqile. Nikela ngeluleko kobuholi ngokuthi amaphuzu okusebenza kwemali ahlale kahle kanjani. Ligcine ibhajethi yesifundazwe. Hlaziya futhi ugeze ngetrend yokuchithwa kwemali kubhajethi yesifundazwe. Qinisekisa ukuba ibhajethi yesifundazwe ithunyelwe komshini ngokuhambisana ne-Demand Management Plan kanye ne-Procurement Plan. Qinisekisa ukuba ukulungiswa kwamaphuzu okusebenza kwemali kwenziwa njalo kumanonyaka.

Ukusebenza ngoxinzelelo nokuqedela imisebenzi ngexesha eliqeshiweyo nokusebenza ngomkhumbi ixesha elide.
xh.duties: Qhagamshelaze futhi ulungelelanise iinkqubo zebhajeti kunye neprojekthi. Qhagamshelaze futhi uquke iincombo zebhajeti (i-Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), i-Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE) kunye ne-Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE). Lawula inkqubela phambili yamajornali. Qwalasa izibhambathiso. Qinisekisa izabelo njengoko zibhalwe kubhajeti. Qinisekisa ukuzinza nokuchaneka kolwazi lwezezimali. Chaza ukuchithwa kwemini engemthethweni futhi uchaze ukuchithwa okungalunganga nokutshatyalalisa. Nikeza ingcebiso kulawulo malunga nenkqubela yebhajeti. Gcina ibhajeti yephondo. Hlaziya futhi uchaze ngendlela ekuchithwa ngayo ibhajeti yephondo. Qinisekisa ukuba ibhajeti yephondo ibhaliwe ngokwokuQhagamshela i-Demand Management Plan kunye ne-Procurement Plan. Qinisekisa ukuba ukulungelelaniswa kobhajeti kwethatu kwenyaka kwenziwe.

af.summary: Bestuur begrotings, besteding, inkomste en bankdienste by die Eastern Cape Deeds Registry in Mthatha, wat 'n diploma of graad in rekenkunde vereis asook drie jaar se toesigervaring.

Nikeza izimpikiswano ngomyalezo wokuqapha phakathi konyaka. Nikeza okokufaka ukuze lungiselelwe ibhajethi. Phatha inzuzo, imali yohhovu, nezinsiza zebhange. Qapha ukufakwa kwemali yombuso ebhange. Qapha ukuphathwa kwe-Petty Cash. Qapha umyalezo wokususwa kokuqedwa kwezimali. Phatha ababhalisiwe. Qapha ukubuyiswa kwemali esele kwaye uqokele imibiko yokuqokolelwa. Hlaziya izimpikiswano emabhalini ababhalisiwe nenzuzo uthathe izinyathelo zokulungisa. Lawula ukusetshenziswa kwemali engakasetshenziswa. Lawula ukuvulwa kwezinkontileka. Lawula ukumiswa kwezinkontileka ezingeke zikhokhwe. Nikeza izincomo ezimpinisweni nemibuzo, phendula uqaphe umyalezo wemibuzo. Buka izinkomba zekhredithi, ama-B-accounts kanye namaphathi ahlobene. Lawula izinkomba zedethi nekhredithi. Lawula ababhalisiwe bangaphakathi. Phatha abakholisiwe. Qapha ukukhokhwa kwezinsiza / abanikezeli. Gumaza izikweletu esimisini. Gumaza ukulungiswa ususe i-akhawunti yesikhashana. Buka ulinganiselo olwenziwe. Qinisekisa izimango ze-S&T nezibhakelana.

Ondersoek, lost op, of eskaleer en monitor geregistreerde oproepe. Verskaf netwerkondersteuning. Bied bystand aan eindgebruikers met LAN-konnektiwiteit. Monitor beskikbaarheid en prestasie van netwerk. Evalueer die behoefte aan, versoek en monitor die proses van installasie van netwerkpunte. Ondersoek, lost op, of eskaleer en monitor geregistreerde oproepe. Verskaf bedienerkamerondersteuning. Monitor bedienerkameromgewing en neem regstellende stappe. Okungenani unyaka oyi-2 wokuhlolojilo oluhambisanayo. Uhlolojilo ngeziqoqo ezinkulu futhi ngezinhlelo. Uhlolojilo ngamaseva. Uhlolojilo ekuxhaseni ubuchwepheshe be-IT. Uhlolojilo olufanele ekuphatheni amaseva namanethiwekhi. Imininingwane yobuchwepheshe yempahla namasevisi ezobuchwepheshe lwolwazi nokuqhweba. I-Information Technology Acts kanye neziqondiso. Ukuqondiswa ngaphakathi kanye nokuphatha ingozi. Amakhono okuhlela. Amakhono okuhlanganisa. Amakhono okuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Amakhono okusebenza nabantu.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza uxhaso lwamadesktopi kubasebenzisi abaphelayo. Ukufaka, ukubuyekeza, futhi ukulungiselela izinto zokusebenzisa zomsebenzisi ophelayo. Ukufaka, ukubuyekeza futhi ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokusebenza zenkampani. Ukuphenya, ukuxazulula, noma ukukhulisa futhi uqaphe amakholo abhalwe. Ukunikeza uxhaso lwamanethiwekhi. Ukusiza abasebenzisi abaphelayo ngenxhanye yokuxhuma kwi-LAN. Ukuqaphela ukutholakala kanye nokuqhuba kahle kwamanethiwekhi. Ukubuyekeza isidingo, ukucela futhi uqaphe inqubo yokufaka amaphoyinti ezenethiwekhi. Ukuphenya, ukuxazulula, noma ukukhulisa futhi uqaphe amakholo abhalwe. Ukunikeza uxhaso legumbi lamaseva. Ukuqaphela imvelo yegumbi lamaseva futhi uthathe izinyathelo zokulungisa. Ukuqaphela ukuziphendulela kwamakontulethi wokulungiselela igumbi lamaseva. Ukuqaphela ukufinyelela kwabantu egumbini lamaseva kanye nokugcina irejista. Ukusiza ukufaka izingxenye ezishintshwayo ngumthengi zamalungu amaseva. Ukuyaletha izinyathelo zokuvikeleka kohlelo lolwazi. Ukuhlola ukuthi abasebenzisi babhalisile kwidomini. Ukuhlola ukuthi i-Antivirus ifakiwe, ibuyekeziwe, futhi iyasebenza. Ukususa yonke imikhakha nabezinhlelo abangemvume. Ukudala futhi ukugcina irejista noma isisekelo sedatha yempahla ye-IT. Ukunikeza imibiko ye-ICT. Ukunikeza imibiko yezehlakalo kanye nokutholakala kohlelo. Ukunikeza okufakwe emibikweni engahambisani ne-SLA. Ukunikeza uxhaso ekuthengeni nasekukhipheni impahla ye-IT.

Ukuncedisa ukufakwa kwezixhobo ezibuyiseleka kumthengi ekuqwenenisweni kwezixhobo zeseva. Ukusebenzisa izinyathelo zokhuseleko lwenkqubo yolwazi. Ukukhangela ukuba ngaba abasebenzisi bakwingingqi. Ukukhangela ukuba i-Antivirus ifakiwe, ihlaziyiwe, kwaye iyasebenza. Ukususa zonke iinkqubo nesoftware ezingamkelwayo. Ukudala nokugcina irekhodi okanye idatabase yempahla ye-IT. Ukuhlinzeka ngeNgxelo ye-ICT. Ukuhlinzeka ngeNgxelo yokuvela kwezehlo kunye nokufumaneka kwenkqubo. Ukuhlinzeka ngeniseliso kwingxelo engahambelaniyo ne-SLA. Ukuhlinzeka ngentlon ekuthengeni nasekutshatyaleni impahla ye-IT.

af.summary: Junior-ondersoekerpos by die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Mbombela, waar 'n Nasionale Diploma in Regte of LLB vereis word en geen ondervinding nodig is nie.

af.duties: Berei aktes voor vir ondersoek. Koppel bondels, endorseer aktes, voeg gelde in en voltooi al die endossemente. Verifieer registrasie-inligting teen data-inligting. Qinisekisa ulwazi lokubhalisa ngokubhekisela kulwazi lwedatha. Qedela ukuvezwa kwemali mali, khombisa isigaba sokukhethwa kanye negunya. Hlola izidlu namadokhumenti. xh.duties: Lungiselela i-deeds ukuze ziqwalaselwe. Xhumanisa ii-batches, qinisekisa i-deeds, faka iimali kwaye uqede zonke iinqinisekiso. Qinisekisa ulwazi lobhaliso ngokuthelekisa nolwazi lwedatha. Qeda ukuqinisekisa iimali, chaza udidi lokhululeko negunya. Qwalasela i-deeds naxwebhu. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kokubhalwa kwe-deeds. Phakamisa iziphumo ezithumela kwigunya elichanekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuzalathiswa kweziphumo kwi-deeds ezibuyiselwayo kwaye ususe iziphumo ukuba kuzalathiwe. Jongana nokulungiswa iimpazamulo zeofisi. Gcina i-acts ezihlaziyiweyo, i-manual nemiqathango. Gqiba ifomu yezaziso/ukuqinisekisa isilumkiso kumanyuze omnye (i-diagram, njl). Qinisekisa ulwazi lobhaliso. Khangelo kutolike iintshixo, kwaye uqamathe iinkcukacha zazo. Khangelo kutolike iifayile zesihloko sexesheni. Phakamisa imibuzo ukuba akuzalathwanga kwaye uqinisekise i-deeds. Khangelo kutolike iifayile zedolobha, ipleyani jikeleze ukuqinisekisa iimeko zesihloko ezifanelekileyo/ i-DOTS slip kwaye uskeni i-deeds, ukuze uhlele kwaye usasaze i-deeds ngokweentshukumbo naku-batches kubaQwalaseli. Sasaza amaxwebhu okwabelo kuqwalaseli. Qamba idolobha, izicwangciso zesicwangciso, i-roster. Ukulungisa ukwakhiwa nokulungiselelwa kwe-deeds ngokukhawuleza.

jobs.title: Human Resource Clerk
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Human Resource Clerk needed in Pretoria to implement HR administration, recruitment, and conditions of service at Level 5.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of Grade 12 Certificate or relevant equivalent qualification. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of registry duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, and operate a computer. Working knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Knowledge of storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment. Understanding of the work in registry. Job related skills: Planning and organisation. Computer literacy. Language. Communication (verbal and written). Interpersonal relations. Flexibility. Teamwork.
jobs.duties: Implement human resource administration practices. Recruitment and Selection (advertisements, appointments, transfer, verification of qualifications, secretariat functions at interviews, absorptions, probationary periods e.g.). Implement conditions of services (leave, housing, medical, injury on duty, long service recognition, overtime, relocation, pension, allowances, Policy and Procedure on Incapacity Leave and Ill-Health Retirement (PILIR) etc.). Performance management. Termination of service. Adress human resource administration enquiries. Respond to enquiries from internal and external clients.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 600 Lilian Ngoyi Street (formerly known as Van Der Walt Street) Berea Park, Pretoria, 0001 or by email to Post278@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE targets: African, Coloured and White Males, and Indian Females, and Persons with Disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form, (a nomination letter if required) and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re-advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. af.title: Personeelklerk
af.summary: Personeelklerk in Pretoria benodig om personeeladministrasie, werwing en diensvoorwaardes op Vlak 5 te implementeer.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of 'n tersaaklike gelykwaardige kwalifikasie hê. Werkverwante kennis: Kennis van registerpligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê en 'n rekenaar te bedryf. Werkende kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Kennis van berging en ontsluiting van procedures in terme van die werksomgewing. Begrip van die werk in die register. Werkverwante vaardighede: Beplanning en organisasie. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Taal. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Buigsaamheid. Spanwerk.
af.duties: Implementeer personeeladministratiewe praktyke. Werwing en keuring (advertensies, aanstellings, oorplasings, verifikasie van kwalifikasies, sekretariaatsfunksies by onderhoude, absorpsies, proeftydperke bv.). Implementeer diensvoorwaardes (verlof, behuising, medies, besering tydens diens, erkenning vir lang diens, oortyd, hervestiging, pensioen, toelaes, Beleid en Procedure oor Onbevoegdheidsverlof en Gesondheidsverwante Vroeë Uitdiensstelling (PILIR) ens.). Prestasiebestuur. Beëindiging van diens. Hanteer personeeladministratiewe navrae. Reageer op navrae van interne en eksterne kliënte.

zu.title: Clerk wemisebenzi yabantu
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-Clerk wemisebenzi yabantu e-Pretoria ukuze kusetshenziswe imisebenzi yolangiso yabantu, ukubungaza abantu, kanye nemibandela yenkonzo ezingeni 5.
zu.requirements: Izidingo eyisisekelo: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nobufakazi be-Graathi 12 noma izifundo ezidingekayo ezefana nabuchwepheshe. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokubhalisa kwabokusini, izindlela kanye namandla okugcina ulwazi, nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi lokusebenza nokuqonda umthetho ophatha asebenza koMnyango kazwelonke. Ulwazi lwenqubo yokugcina nokuthola ulwazi ngokwemikhakha yokusebenza. Ukuqonda umsebenzi kubhalisa kwabokusini. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuhlela nokuqasha. Ukubhalisa ngekhompyutha. Ulimi. Unxibelelwano (olwenziwa ngomlomo nolubhalwe phansi). Izinto ezimayelana nabantu. Ukuguquguquka. Ukusebenza njengeqembu.
zu.duties: Kusetshenziswe izindlela zolangiso yabantu. Ukubungaza ukhetho (izikhangiso, ukumiswa kubasebenzi, ukudluliswa kwabasebenzi, ukuqinisekiswa kwezifundo, imisebenzi yesikhwama kuma-interview, ukumiswa komsebenzi okudelelekayo, isikhathi sokuhlolwa sasebungxowenali njll). Kusetshenziswe imibandela yasebenza (ukuphumayo, indlu, ezokwelapha, ukulimala ngemuva kwesikhathi somsebenzi, ukubonwa ngokusukela kudala esikhundleni sokwenza umsebenzi, ukugqamisa ngenxa yokusebenza ixesha elide, ukushintshwa kwesikhundla sokusebenza, isibonezela esimaphakathi, izimali ezongezwayo, imibandela ebusweni bokuNxibelelwano kwiNkokhelo eNgekho kanye no-Holo lokuHlala ekhaya ngenxa Yokugula (PILIR) njll). Ukuphathwa kokusebenza kahle kwabasebenzi. Ukupheliswa komsebenzi. Ukuphendula imibuzo ehlobene nolangiso yabantu. Ukuphendula imibuzo evela kubakhasimbe bangaphakathi nangaphandle.

xh.title: Umsebenzisi Wabasebenzi Wezomthetho
xh.summary: Kufuneka abasebenzisi abalawula izinto zabasebenzi ezifana nokwaziswa kwabasebenzi, ukubhalisa abasebenzi, nemigama yesebenza kwelona candelo le-5.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno eziyimfuneko: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe ne-Certificate ye-Grade 12 okanye izidanga ezifanayo ezihambelana nesi simo. Ulwazi olusesimeni sesebenza: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokulawula iifayili namaxesha, kunye nokuqonda ukubeka iinkcukacha kunye nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuba nolwazi ngokusebenza nokuziphatha ngokomthetho oLawula iNkonzo yoLuntu. Ulwazi ngemisulelo yokugcina nokuphinda ukufumane iinkcukacha ngokwesimo esisebenza kuso. Ukuqonda ngemisebenzi yokulawula iifayili. Iimpha ezisesimeni sesebenza: Ukucwangcisa nokuhlela. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwimi. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhalayo). Ukuqhathaniswa ngabom. Ukuhamba nokuguquka. Ukusebenza ngokubini.
xh.duties: Ukuza kusebenzisa imisebenzi yokulawula izinto zabasebenzi. Ukubhalisa nokukhetha abantu (ukwenza izikhangiso, ukumisela abantu kumsebenzi, ukudlulisa abantu, ukugqiba izidanga, ukubakho kwabaholi bakuqonda iimviwo, ukugcinwa kwabantu kumsebenzi, ixesha lokuzama umsebenzi njl). Ukusebenzisa imigaqo yesebenza (ukuphumla izikhathi ezithile, ukufumana indlu, izibonelelo zonyango, ukulimala kumsebenzi, ukubonwa ngokwenza umsebenzi isikhathi eside, ukwenza umsebenze ngaphandle kweyure ezimisiweyo, ukutshintsha iindawo zokuhlala, iimbuyekezo zemali ezenziwa kwangaphambili okanye ukungafikeleli kumsebenza, iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokugqiba umsebenzi njl). Ukulawula ukwenza umsebenzi kakuhle. Ukuphela kwesebenza. Ukuphendula imibuzo malunga nokulawula izinto zabasebenzi. Ukuphendula imibuzo evela kumthengi angaphakathi nangaphaandle.

jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Secretary providing secretarial and receptionist support to the Director in Pretoria, requiring a Grade 12 certificate and computer literacy.

Job related knowledge: Computer literacy (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, etc.). Job related skills: Good telephone etiquette. Sound organisational ability. Good people skills. Computer literacy. Ability to communicate well with people at different levels and from different backgrounds (both written and verbal). Ability to act with tact and discretion.
jobs.duties: Provide a secretariat/receptionist support service to the Director. Receive telephone calls and refer the calls to the correct role players if not meant for the relevant senior manager. Record appointments and events in the diary. Type documents for the senior manager and other staff within the unit. Operate office equipment e.g. computers and photocopiers. Provide a clerical support service to the Senior Manager. Liaise with travel agencies to make travel arrangements. Check arrangements when relevant documents are received. Arrange meetings and events for the senior manager and the staff in the unit. Identifies venues, invite role players, organise refreshments and sets up schedules for meeting and events. Process the travel and subsistence claims for the unit. Process all invoices that emanate from the activities of the work of the senior manager. Records basic minutes of meetings of the senior manager where required. Draft routine correspondence and reports. Do filing of documents for the senior manager and the unit where necessary. Administer matters like leave registers and telephonic accounts. Receive, records and distributes all incoming and outgoing documents. Handle the procurement of standard items like stationary, refreshments etc. Collects all relevant documents to enable the Director to prepare for meetings. Remains up to date with regard to prescripts/policies and procedures applicable to her / his work environment to ensure efficient and effective support to the senior manager. Study the relevant public service and the departmental prescripts / policies and other documents to ensure that the application thereof is understood properly. af.title: Sekretaresse
af.summary: Sekretaresse wat sekretariële en ontvangsondersteuning aan die Direkteur in Pretoria verskaf, wat 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en rekenaarvaardigheid vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of relevante ekwivalent. Werksverwante kennis: Rekenaarvaardigheid (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, ens.). Werksverwante vaardighede: Goeie telefoonetiket. Gesonde organisatoriese vermoë. Goeie mensevaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Vermoë om goed met mense op verskillende vlakke en uit verskillende agtergronde te kommunikeer (sowel skriftelik as mondelings). Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n sekretariële/ontvangsondersteuningsdiens aan die Direkteur. Neem telefoonoproepe in aan en verwys die oproepe na die korrekte rolspelers indien dit nie vir die betrokke seniorbestuurder bedoel is nie. Neem afsprake en gebeurtenisse in die dagboek op. Tik dokumente vir die seniorbestuurder en ander personeel binne die eenheid. Bedryf kantoor-toerusting bv. rekenaars en fotostaatmasjiene. Verskaf 'n klerkundige ondersteuningsdiens aan die Seniorbestuurder. Skakel met reisagentskappe om reiereëlings te tref. Kontroleer reëlings wanneer tersaaklike dokumente ontvang word. Reël vergaderings en gebeurtenisse vir die seniorbestuurder en die personeel in die eenheid. Identifiseer plekke, nooi rolspelers uit, organiseer vermaaklikhede en stel skedules vir vergaderings en gebeurtenisse op. Verwerk die reis- en onderhouds Eisen van die eenheid. Verwerk alle fakture wat voortspruit uit die aktiwiteite van die werk van die seniorbestuurder. Neem basiese minute van vergaderings van die seniorbestuurder waar nodig op. Stel roetinekorrespondensie en verslae op. Doen indien nodig lêerwerk van dokumente vir die seniorbestuurder en die eenheid. Administreer sake soos verlofregisters en telefoonrekeninge. Ontvang, teken aan en versprei alle inkomende en uitgaande dokumente. Behartig die verkryging van standaarditems soos skryfbehoeftes, vermaaklikhede ens. Versamel alle tersaaklike dokumente om die Direkteur in staat te stel om vir vergaderings voor te berei. Bly op hoogte van voorskrifte/beleide en prosedures wat op haar/sy werkomgewing van toepassing is om doeltreffende en effektiewe ondersteuning aan die seniorbestuurder te verseker. Bestudeer die tersaaklike openbare diens- en departementele voorskrifte/beleide en ander dokumente om te verseker dat die toepassing daarvan behoorlik verstaan word. Hou treding met die prosedures en prosesse wat in die kantoor van die seniorbestuurder van toepassing is.

zu.title: Unobhala
zu.summary: Unobhala ohlinza ngokusebenza njengonobhala nangokwamukela abantu ababhekayo kuMdondosheshi ePretoria, ofuna isitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye nokwazi ukusebenza ngamakhompyutha.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okungenani: Abafaki izicelo kumele benesitifiketi se-Grade 12 noma okulingana noma esingako. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukwazi ukusebenza ngamakhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, etc.). Amandla ohlobene nomsebenzi: Indlela elungile yokuxoxa kocingo. Amandla ahlelekile wokuqukatha. Amandla ahlakaniphile bokusebenza nabantu. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngamakhompyutha. Amandla okuxhumana kahle nabantu abezinga elihlukene nabebezimuva ehlukene (kokubhaliwe nakukhulunywayo). Amandla okuziphatha ngobungcweti bengqondo nokugcina imfihlo.
zu.duties: Nikela ngesevisi yokusekela ngokusebenza njengonobhala nangokwamukela abantu ababhekayo kuMdondosheshi. Amukela amakholi ocingo awabe usedlulisela kwabanye abahilelekile uma engakahlose nomphathi ophakeme ohlobene nawo. Bhalisa izinhleso zemihlangano nemicimbi kwidairi. Bhala amadokhumenti ayiswa komphathi ophakeme nakubanye basebenzi bakuwo wonke isigaba. Phatha izinsiza zohluzo njengamakhompyutha namashini okushaja amaphepha. Nikela ngesevisi yokusekela ngomsebenzi ohlelekile kuMphathi ophakeme. Xhumana namasevisi wokuhamba azenzele izinhlela zokuhamba. Hlola izinhlela uma amadokhumenti ahlobene etholakala. Hlela imihlangano nemicimbi yomphathi ophakeme nakbasebenzi bakuwo wonke isigaba. Thola izindawo, menga abahilelekile, hlela okuphuzwayo futhi uhlele izikhathi zemihlangano nemicimbi. Qhuba izimangalo zoku-hamba nokuhlala kwakuwo wonke isigaba. Qhuba wonke ama-invoisi asuka emsebenzini womphathi ophakeme. Bhalisa iminithi yemihlangano yomphathi ophakeme lapho kudingeka khona. Bhala izincwadi ezivamile nemibiko. Gcina amadokhumenti omphathi ophakeme nakawo wonke isigaba lapho kudingeka khona. Phatha izindaba njengamarejista wokuhlala phansi nemakhonti ocingo. Thola, bhalise futhi wahle abantu wonke amadokhumenti angena nawaphuma. Phatha ukuthenga izinto eziyisisekelo njengesithunywa, okuphuzwayo etc. Qoqa wonke amadokhumenti ahlobene ukuze kutholwe okudingeka kuMdondosheshi alungiselele imihlangano. Gcina ulwazi olusha mayelana nemithetho/inqubo nezinqubo ezingezile endaweni yakhe yomsebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusekela okuphumelelayo nokusebenza kahle komphathi ophakeme. Funda imithetho/inqubo yomnyango kanye namadokhumenti angeziyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ayasebenza akananga futhi aqondwe kahle. Zazi izinqubo namaxaxaziba okusebenza asebuthweni lomphathi ophakeme.

xh.title: Inkokeli yesebe
xh.summary: Inkokeli yesebe enika inkxaso yomsebenzi wekhansile nokwamkelelabantu kumlawuli ePretoria, efuna izatifikethi seGrede 12 nokuqonda ukusebenzela ikhompyutha.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezazingunxibelelwani: Kufuneka abafaki bomngeni babe neSatifikethi seGrade 12 okanye okulinganayo noko. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukusebenzisana nekhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, njl.njl.). Amandla okusebenza ahlobene nomsebenzi: Iindlela ezilungileyo zothetha kunxibelelwano lusetyhini. Amandi ahleliweyo okuzoba. Amandla okusebenza ngabantu. Ukusebenzisana nekhompyutha. Amandla okuxoxa kakuhle nabantu abakwezinga elahlukileyo nendawo abavela kuyo (kokubhalayo nokuthethwayo). Amandla okuziphatha ngokuqonda nokuzigcina.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yomsebenzi wekhansile nowokwamkelelabantu kumlawuli. Yamkela iinkqubo zocingo uze uzidibanise nabantu abafanelekileyo ukuba le nto ingengelolu lawula ophakamileyo. Qamba iindwendwe nemihla yemiganu kwincwadi yemiganu. Chaza amaxwebhu kulawula ophakamileyo nabenzi bnye basebenza kwicandelo. Sebenzisa izixhobo zofice njengekhompyutha nezoqamba iikopi. Nika inkxaso yomsebenzi wolawulo kulawula ophakamileyo. Thetha neenekampani zohambo ukuze ulungise iindlela zokuhamba. Hlola iindlela xa kufika amaxwebhu ahlobene noku. Lungele iindibano nemihla yomsebenzi kulawula ophakamileyo nabenzi basebenza kwicandelo. Phawula iindawo, mema abantu abafanelekileyo, lungisa iziselo uze umishe iinkqubo zama ndibano nemihla yomsebenzi. Qhuba iingxelo zohambo nezondwendweni kwicandelo. Qhuba onke ama-oda abavela kumisebenzi yolawula ophakamileyo. Qamba imizuzu yendibano yolawula ophakamileyo xa kufuneka. Bhala iincwadi nemixholo eqhelekileyo. Gcina amaxwebhu kulawula ophakamileyo nakwicandelo xa kuyimfuneko. Lawula izinto ezinjengeenguqulelo zoluxazo namanolage ecalo. Yamkela, qamba yaye wahlule onke amaxwebhu angena naphuma. Yiba ngegonyama lemidada edla ngokuthengwa njengezixhobo zesikhathi eside, iziselo ezinkqanjwayo njl. Qokelela onke amaxwebhu ahlobene noku ukuze umlawuli akwazi ukulungelela iindibano. jobs.duties: Provide a secretariat / receptionist support service to the Director. Receive telephone calls and refer the calls to the correct role players if not meant for the relevant senior manager. Record appointments and events in the diary. Type documents for the senior manager and other staff within the unit. Operate office equipment e.g. computers and photocopiers. Provide a clerical support service to the Senior Manager. Liaise with travel agencies to make travel arrangements. Check arrangements when relevant documents are received. Arrange meetings and events for the senior manager and the staff in the unit. Identifies venues, invite role players, organise refreshments and sets up schedules for meeting and events. Process the travel and subsistence claims for the unit. Process all invoices that emanate from the activities of the work of the senior manager. Records basic minutes of meetings of the senior manager where required. Draft routine correspondence and reports. Do filing of documents for the senior manager and the unit where necessary. Administer matters like leave registers and telephonic accounts. af.title: Sekretaresse
af.summary: Sekretaresse wat sekretariële en ontvangsondersteuning aan 'n Direkteur bied, wat 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en rekenaargeletterdheid vereis, en in Pretoria gesetel is.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of 'n toepaslike ekwivalent. Werksverwante kennis: Rekenaargeletterdheid (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, ens.). Werksverwante vaardighede: Goed telefoonetiket. Goeie organisatoriese vermoë. Goeie mensevaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Vermoë om goed met mense op verskillende vlakke en uit verskillende agtergronde te kommunikeer (sowel skriftelik as mondelings). Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n sekretariële / ontvangsondersteuningsdiens aan die Direkteur. Neem telefoonoproepe aan en verwys die oproepe na die korrete rolspelers indien dit nie vir die betrokke senior bestuurder bedoel is nie. Neem afsprake en geleenthede in die dagboek op. Tik dokumente vir die senior bestuurder en ander personeel binne die eenheid. Bedryf kantoorstoerusting bv. rekenaars en fotostaatmasjiene. Verskaf 'n klerklike ondersteuningsdiens aan die senior bestuurder. Skakel met reisagentskappe om reëlings vir reise te tref. Kontroleer reëlings wanneer toepaslike dokumente ontvang word. Rëel vergaderings en geleenthede vir die senior bestuurder en die personeel in die eenheid. Identifiseer plekke, nooi rolspelers, reël versnaperings en stel skedules op vir vergaderings en geleenthede. Verwerk die reis- en leef-toelaes vir die eenheid. Verwerk alle fakture wat voortspruit uit die aktiwiteite van die werk van die senior bestuurder. Neem basiese notule van vergaderings van die senior bestuurder waar nodig. Stel roetinekorrespondensie en verslae op. Doen lê van dokumente vir die senior bestuurder en die eenheid waar nodig. Administreer sake soos verlofregisters en telefoonrekenings. Ontvang, neem op en versprei alle inkomende en uitgaande dokumente. Hanteer die verkryging van standaarditems soos stasienery, versnaperings ens. Versamel alle toepaslike dokumente om die Direkteur in staat te stel om vir vergaderings voor te berei. Bly op hoogte van voorskrifte / beleide en prosedures wat van toepassing is op sy / haar werksomgewing om doeltreffende en effektiewe ondersteuning aan die senior bestuurder te verseker. Bestudeer die toepaslike staatsdiens- en departementele voorskrifte / beleide en ander dokumente om te verseker dat die toepassing daarvan behoorlik verstaan word. Hou tred met die prosedures en prosesse wat in die kantoor van die senior bestuurder van toepassing is.

zu.title: Unobhala
zu.summary: Unobhala ohlinzeka ngokusekelwa okobhalwe nokwamukeli kwiDirector, ofuna isitifiketi seGrade 12 nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha, esePretoria.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi: Abafakabhungabhunga kumele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 noma okulinganayo okuhlobene nomsebenzi. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, njll.). Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Isiko elihle lokuthinta inombolo yocingo. Ikono elihle lokuhlela izinto. Amakhono amahle abantu. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ikono lokuxhumana kahle nabantu babo onke amanqan futhi abavela kwezahlukene (kokubhaliwe nokuqambiwe). Ikono lokuziphatha ngobungcali futhi ngokufihla izinto.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngesevisi yobhalwa / yamukeli ocingweni kuDirector. Yamukza amakhol ocingo ususize kwelabadlali beqhaza uma engenalawo mlombo omkhulu ohlobene naye. Bhala ithuba lemihlangano nezinkathi kwidari. Bhala amadokhumenti komkhulu ohlobene nomsebenzi nabalabo abanye baseyunithini. Sebenzisa izinto zendawo yokusebenza njengekhompuyutha nezimoto zokushaja amakhophi. Hlinzeka ngesevisi yokuqashwa emsebenzini kumKhulu Ohlobene nomsebenzi. Xhumana nabaqashi bokuhamba ukubeka izinhlela zokuhambe. Hlola izinhlela lapho kwamukwa amadokhumenti ahlobene nayo. Hlela imihlangano nezinkathi komkhulu ohlobene nomsebenzi futhi kwabasebenzi kuyunithi. Ithola izindawo, imema abadlali beqhaza, ihlela iziphuzo futhi ibeka ishejuli yemihlangano nezinkathi. Culula imikhondo yokuhambe neyokuhlala yeyunithi. Culula wonke amabhili ahole kwizinkqubo zomsebenzi komkhulu ohlobene naye. Bhala iminithi yemihlangano yomkhulu ohlobene nomsebenzi lapho kudingeka. Bhala imiyalezo ejwayelekile nemibiko. Yenza ifayela lamadokhumenti komkhulu ohlobene nomsebenzi nakuyunithi lapho kudingeka. Lawula izindaba ezinjengoba bhalwa kwamakhol kanye nama-akhawunti ocingo. Yamukza, abhale futhi asabalalise onke amadokhumenti ahambayo nafikayo. Phatha ukuthenga izinto ezivamile ezinjengokhaya, iziphuzo njll. Qoqa onke amadokhumenti afanele ukunika iDirector ikhono lokulungiselela imihlangano. Uhlale uyazi ngemithetho / izinqubo namapholisi asebenza endaweni yakhe yokusebenza ukuze aqinisekise ukusekelwa okuphumelelayo nokuqhubekayo komkhulu ohlobene nomsebenzi. Funda imithetho yesevisi yomphakathe nangomnyango / amapholisi namanye amadokhumenti ukuze uqinisekise ukuba ukusetshenziswa kwawo kuqondwe kahle. Hlala uyazi ngezenqubo nemitshina esebenza ohofisini komkhulu ohlobene nomsebenzi.

Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, njl.). Iakhobho ezihambelana nomsebenzi: Indlela elungileyo yokuthetha kumfonow. Ikhono elilo lokuzihlanganisa. Iakhono elilo kubantu. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokunxibelelana kakuhle nabantu abakumazinga ahlukeneyo nase kwimvelaphi ehlukileyo (kokubhalayo nakokuthethwayo). Ikhono lokuziphatha ngobugca kwaye zintsikele.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yobhala nophulo wamangcwelakuso kuMlawuli. Thatha amangxelo emfonowh kwaye uze uqhubele kubafundi abachanekileyo ukuba engengowomlawuli ophakamileyo ogqitywe ngokwemfuneko. Qamba iindibano nezenzongalo kwisiqulatho-datesi. Thepha amaxwebhu omlawuli ophakamileyo nakwelinye igumbi abasebenzayo. Sebenzisa izixhobo zofisi njl. ikhompyutha namashishini lokukopisha. Nikezela ngenkxaso yeenkonzo zolawulo kumLawuli oPhakamileyo. Zanana neekhaya ezihamba abantu ukulungiselela iindlela zokuhamba. Pheqa izigqibo xa kufikelwa ngamaxwebhu ahambelanayo. Hlela iindibano nezenzongalo kumlawuli ophakamileyo nakubasebenzi basesingxeni. Zithole iindawo, mema abafundi abafaka izicelo, hlela ukutya kwaye ulungiselele iipesheji zexesha leendibano nakuzenzongalo. Ced' amaxwebhu wokuhamba nokuhlala kwesigqeba. Ced' onke amaxwebhu evela kumsebenzi womlawuli ophakamileyo. Bhala iingqwalasela eziyimfuneko zamaxwebhu eendibano zomlawuli ophakamileyo apho kufuneka khona. Thepha iindaba ezisuke zisoloko zithunyelwa namaxwebu. Zenza ifayile yamaxwebhu omalawuli ophakamileyo nakwesithuba apho kuyimfuneko. Lawula izinto ezinjengeefayile zokuhamba nii-akhawunti zocingo. Thatha, qamba kwaye ulahle onke amaxwebhu angenayo naphumayo. Thatha izinto ezisemthethweni ezinjengamapensile, ukutya, njl. Qokelela onke amaxwebhu afunekayo ukuze uMlawuli akwazi ukulungiselela iindibano. Zihlale kulwazi malunga neemithetho / iinkqubo nemigaqo esetyenziswa kwindawo yakhe yokusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswa inkxaso ekhuselekileyo nesebenzayo kumlawuli ophakamileyo. Funda imithetho kaqoqo-lwazi kaqoqo-lwazi kawonke-wonke nesebe kunye namaxwebhu nemiqathango eqoqwe ndawonye ukwenzela kuqinisekiswa ukwazi okuchanekileyo. Zihlale zikumaxesha namaxesha nemiqathango yokuqhuba ibanga kwindawo yakokubhalisa umlawuli ophakamileyo.

af.title: Voorsieningskettingklerk
af.summary: Voorsieningskettingklerk word in Pretoria gesoek om klerklike ondersteuning vir batebestuur te verskaf; 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en basiese kennis van die voorsieningsketting word vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of 'n relevante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie hê. Geen ervaring word vereis nie. Basiese kennis van voorsieningskettingpligte en -praktyke, asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en statistiek te versamel. Basiese kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die openbare diens regeer. Basiese kennis van werksprosedures binne die werksomgewing. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede. Taal. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Tussenmenslike verhoudings. Buigsaamheid. Spanwerk.
af.duties: Verskaf klerklike ondersteuning vir batebestuur. Stel en onderhou rekords byvoorbeeld baterekords / databasisse). Kontroleer en reik meubels, toerusting en bybehore aan komponente en individue en individue uit. Identifiseer oortollige, onbruikbare en verouderde toerusting vir beskikking. Verifieer bateregister. Verskaf klerklike ondersteuning vir vraag en verkryging. Werk en onderhou 'n verskafferdatabasis (insluitend kontrakteurs). Registreer verskaffers op LOGIS of 'n soortgelyke stelsel. Versoek en ontvang kwotasies. Lys spesifikasies op die elektroniese aankope-stelsel vas. Plaas bestellings. Reik en ontvang boddokumente uit en onderskeidelik in. Verskaf sekretariaat- of logistieke ondersteuning tydens die bodoordwegings- en kontraksluitingsproses. Stel konsepdokumente op soos vereis. Verskaf logistieke ondersteuningsdienste. Plaas bestellings vir goedere. Ontvang en verifieer goedere van verskaffers. Lys goedere in registers databasisse vas. Ontvang versoeke vir goedere van eindgebruikers. Reik goedere aan eindgebruikers uit. Onderhou goederegister. Werk en onderhou 'n register van verskaffers by.

Ulwazi nokuqonda oluyisiseko ngohlelo lokusebenza olubusa imisebenzi kahulumeni. Ulwazi oluyisiseko ngaphakathi kwendlela yokwenza umsebenzi ngokohlelo lwendawo yokusebenza. zu.duties: Nikela inkxaso yemisebenzi yepheshana ekuqpheni kwamafa. Hlanganisa futhi ulondoloze iziquko ezinjengamarekhodi okuphathwa kwamafa. jobs.title: Registry Clerk
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Registry Clerk position in Pretoria requiring a Grade 12 certificate, offering R237,453 per annum at Level 5, with duties including mail handling and counter services.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of Grade 12 Certificate. No experience required. Knowledge of registry duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, and operate computer. Working knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Knowledge of storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment. Understanding of the work in registry. Planning and organization. Computer literacy. Language. Good Verbal and written communication skills. Interpersonal relations. Flexibility. Teamwork.
jobs.duties: Provide registry counter services. Attend to clients. Handle telephonic and other enquiries received. Receive and register hand delivered mail/files. Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence. Receive all mails. Sort, register and dispatch mail. Distribute notices on registry issues. Receive and capture invoices. Render an effective filling and record management service. Opening and close files according to record classification system. Filing/storage, tracing (electronically/manually) and retrieval of documents and files. Complete index cards for all files. Operate office machines in relation to the registry function. Open and maintain Franking machine register. Frank post, record money and update register on daily basis. Undertake spot checks on post to ensure no private post is included. Open & maintain remittance register. Record all valuable articles as prescribed in the remittance register. Hand delivers and signs over remittances to finance. Send wrong remittances back to sender via registered post and record reference number in register. Keep daily record of number of letters franked. Process documents for archiving and/ disposal. Electronic scanning of files. Sort and package files for archives and distribution. Compile list of documents to be archived and submit to the supervisor. Keep records for archived documents.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: North Gauteng Deeds Registry, at 600 Lilian Ngoyi Street, Berea Park, 0002, Pretoria (Department of Land Reform and Rural Development: Head Office). Candidates are also encouraged to apply by using this link: http://deedsportal.deeds.gov.za before the closing date, as no late applications will be considered
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males and Indian and White Females, and Persons with Disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form, (a nomination letter if required) and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re-advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. af.title: Registrasieklerk
af.summary: Registrasieklerkpos in Pretoria vereis 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat, bied R237,453 per jaar op Vlak 5, met pligte wat poshantering en toonbankdienste insluit.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat hê. Geen ervaring word vereis nie. Kennis van registrasiepligte en -praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê en 'n rekenaar te bedien. Werkende kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens beheer. Kennis van bergings- en terugkryprosedures in terme van die werksomgewing. Begrip van die werk in die registrasie. Beplanning en organisasie. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Taal. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Buigsaamheid. Spanwerk.
af.duties: Verskaf registrasietoonbankdienste. Hanteer kliënte. Hanteer telefoon- en ander navrae wat ontvang word. Ontvang en registreer met die hand afgelewerde pos/lêers. Hanteer inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie. Ontvang alle pos. Sorteer, registreer en stuur pos uit. Verspreid kennisgewings oor registrasiekwessies. Ontvang en lê fakture vas. Lewer 'n doeltreffende lêer- en rekordbestuursdiens. Open en sluit lêers volgens die rekordklassifikasiestelsel. Lêer/berging, opspoor (elektronies/ handmatig) en terugkry van dokumente en lêers. Voltooi indekskaarte vir alle lêers. Bedien kantoormasjiene in verband met die registrasiefunksie. Open en onderhou frankmasjienregister. Frank pos, teken geld aan en werk register daagliks by. Doen steekproewe op pos om te verseker dat geen private pos ingesluit is nie. Open en onderhou remittance-register. Teken alle waardevolle artikels soos voorgeskryf in die remittance-register aan. Lewer met die hand en teken remittances aan finansies oor. Stuur verkeerde remittances via geregistreerde pos terug aan afsender en teken verwysingsnommer in register aan. Hou daagse rekord van die aantal gefrankeerde briewe. Verwerk dokumente vir argivering en/of besinking. Elektroniese skandering van lêers. Sorteer en verpak lêers vir argiewe en verspreiding. Stel 'n lys op van dokumente om geargiveer te word en dien dit by die toesighouer in. Hou rekords van geargiveerde dokumente.

zu.title: Umsebenzisi we-Registry
zu.summary: Isikhundla somsebenzisi wokubhalisa ePretoria esidinga isitifiketi se-Grade 12, sinikeza i-R237,453 ngonyaka ezingeni le-Level 5, nomsebenzi okubandakanya ukuphatha imali bese kusetshenziswa izinkonzo zokubhalisa.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi kwalezi: Abafaki izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12. Akukho njongo edingekayo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokubhalisa, izinqubo kanye nenhlelokusebenza yokwazi ukufaka idatha, bese kusetshenziswa ikhomphyutha. Ulwazi olusebenzayo nokugonda kohlakahlwasiseko oluphethe ezinkonzweni zomphakathi. Ulwazi lwezinqubo zokulondoloza nokulondolozwa ngokomtholampilo wokusebenza. Ukuqonda komsebenzi wokubhalisa. Ukubusiswa nokuhlela. Ukusebenzisana ngekhomphyutha. Ulimi. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokuqamba izincwadi. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ukuguquka. Ukusebenza njengeqembu.
zu.duties: Nika izinsiza zokubhalisa ngasese esikhundini sokubhalisa. Phathelana namakhasimende. Phathelana nemibuzo etholakala ngocingo neminye. Thola bese ubhalisa iposi/amafayela alethwe ngesandhla. Phathelana nokuxhumana okungenayo nokuphumayo. Thola yonke imali. Hlukanisa, bhalisa bese uyithumela imali. Yahlukanisa izaziso ngemibuzo yokubhalisa. Thola bese uqamba amafomu enkontileka. Nikezwa insiza efanele yokugcina nokulawula imibhalo. Vula bese uvala amafayela ngokwesistimu yokuhlelwa kwemibhalo. Ukugcina/ukulondolozwa, ukuqhuba (ngokuhlelekile/nangesandhla) kanye nokuthola amaxhasi namafayela. Qedela amakhadi ohlu lwamafayela wonke amafayela. Sebenzisa imishini yenhlangothi ngokuhlobene nomsebenzi wokubhalisa. Vula buse ulondoloza isibhalo samashini eFranking. Shaya iposi, bhalisa imali buse uvuse isibhalo nsuku zonke. Yenza ukuhlolwa okungalindelekile kweposi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ayikho iposi yangasese. Vula buse ulondoloze isibhalo sokuthumela imali. Bhalisa zonke izinto eziguqukayo njengoba kucacisiwe esibhalweni sokuthumela imali. Ithumela ngesandhla buse uyisayina ngaphezulu imali eya ekubhalisa izimali. Thumela imali encane emuva kumthumeli ngeposi ebhalisiwe buse ubhalise inombolo yokubhalisa kwisibhalo. Gcina irekhodi nsuku zonke yelinani lezincwadi ezishiwo. Hlela amaxhasi okugcinwa kwelabhulali noma okulahliwe. Ukuskena amafayela ngokuhlelekile. Hlukanisa buse uphakethe amafayela ayokugcinwa kwelabhulali nakokwabiwa. Hlela uhlu lwamaxhasi okugcinwa kwelabhulaki buse uwuhlinzeke kumlawuli. Gcina imibhalo yamaxhasi agciniwe kwelabhulali.

xh.title: Um Clerk Werekoda
xh.summary: Isithuba som Clerk Werekoda e Pretoria esifuna isatifikethi se Grade 12, sinika umvuzo we R237,453 ngonyaka kwi Level 5, nomsebenzi oquka ukujongana nemeyile nesevisi yecawunte.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafakeli kufuneka babe nesatifikethi se Grade 12. Akukho mfundo yamava idunyelweyo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yerekoda, iinkqubo nokwazi ukugcina i-data, nokuqhuba ikhompyutha. Ulwazi lokusebenza nokuqonda iinkqubo zomthetho ezilawula inkonzo kaRhulumente. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zokugcina nokubuyisa iifayile ngokwemisebenzi. Ukuqonda umsebenzi werekoda. Ukuqamba nokuhlela. Ukusebenza nekhompyutha. Ulwimi. Amakhono amabalulu ethethwayo nawabhalwayo. Ubudlelwane nabantu. Ukuguquguquka. Ukusebenza njengoteam.
xh.duties: Nika isiseko sezekada inkonzo yecawunte. Jongana namaxhasi. Jongana nemibuzo ngentlabathi nayo yamanye abafikiweyo. Yamkela ubhalise imeyile/ezifayile ezilethwe ngesandla. Jongana nothungelwano olungena noluphuma. Yamkela yonke imeyile. Hlengahlengisa, bhala kwaye thumela imeyile. Sazisa ngeendaba zerekoda. Yamkela ugcine i-invoice. Nikezela ngoluhlelo lokugcina iifayile nolawulo kwirekhodi. Vula ukuze uvale iifayile ngokweenkqubo zokwahlulahlula kwirekhodi. Ukuza iifayile/okugcinwayo, ukulandela (ngekhompyutha/ngesandla) nokubuyisa amaxwebhu ngee fayile. Gqiba amakhadi endawo yazo yonke iifayile. Qhuba oomatshini befiki kwinkqubo yerekoda. Vula ugcine irekhodi lomatshini weFranks. Franka iposi, bhala imali uze uhlahle ibali ngemini yonke. Yenza iindawo zokuqinisekisa iposi ukuze kuqiniseke ukuba akukho poso yabucala ifakiweyo. Vula ugcine irekhodi lembuyekezo. Bhala yonke into enexabiso njengoko kucetyiwe kwirekhodi lembuyekezo. Nika ngomzimba utyikitye imbuyezo kwimali. Thumela imbuyezo esemva emthumeli ngeposi ebhalisiweyo ubhale inombolo yesalathiso kwirekhodi. Gcina ibali lemihla yonke ngenani leeleta ezifrankiweyo. Qhuba amaxwebhu ngokoyilo nangokulahlwa. Iskena iifayile ngekhompyutha. Hlengahlengisa uphokele iifayile ziye kolwimi lwezithuba nasekuthunyelweni. Lula uludwe lwamaxwebhu okuyiwa kwindawo yokugcina uthumele kumphathi wesiseko. Gcina oovimba bamaxwebhu agciniweyo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Statistician
jobs.centre: Northern Cape Division of The High Court: Kimberley
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 – R573 897 per annum (Level 09). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Statistician role at the Northern Cape High Court in Kimberley, managing and analysing judiciary data and reporting on statistical findings.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a National Diploma/Degree in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Accounting or equivalent qualification at NQF level six (6) as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of three (3) years practical and relevant experience in statistical analysis and reporting of which one (1) year should be at managerial/supervisory level at least salary level seven (7). Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of data collection, data collation and verification, data analysis, and Information Management. Skilled in report writing, leadership, problem solving, computer literacy (MS Office especially Excel), communication (verbal and written), planning, organising, numerical and interpersonal skills.
jobs.duties: Manage and administer data collected on Quasi-Judicial and Judge’s Secretaries, checking data quality, report on statistical analysis and advice management on findings, data analysed and packaged as per requirements, verify Quasi-Judicial files and Judiciary information and validation of monthly, quarterly and annual figures. Coordinate training of data collectors and the development of training manuals, supervise and develop Data Capturers, Legal Administration Clerks and support of performance management, manage the performance of the Legal Administration Clerks with signing of Performance Agreement, Mid-term Reviews and Annual Assessment.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Ms L Wymers: Tel No: (053) 492 3533 HR Related Enquiries: Ms T E Methu: Tel No: (053) 492 3497
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/145/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which can be downloaded           on        internet       at       www.judiciary.org.za       / www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Statistikus
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur: Statistikus-pos by die Northern Cape High Court in Kimberley, wat regbankdata bestuur en ontleed en oor statistiese bevindings verslag doen.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Nasionale Diploma/Degree in Statistiek, Ekonomie, Wiskunde, Rekenkunde of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF vlak six (6) hê soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van three (3) jaar praktiese en relevante ervaring in statistiese ontleding en verslagdoening waarvan een (1) jaar ten minste op bestuurlike/toesigvlak op minstens salarisvlak seven (7) moet wees. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van data-insameling, data-samestelling en verifikasie, data-ontleding, en inligtingbestuur. Vaardig in verslagdoening, leierskap, probleemoplossing, rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office veral Excel), kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), beplanning, organisering, syferkundige en interpersoonlike vaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur en administreer data wat oor Quasi-Judicial en Judge's Secretaries ingesamel is, kontroleer datakwaliteit, doen verslag oor statistiese ontleding en adviseer bestuur oor bevindings, data ontleed en verpak soos per vereistes, verifieer Quasi-Judicial lêers en Regbank-inligting en validering van maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse syfers. Koördineer opleiding van data-insamelaars en die ontwikkeling van opleidingshandleidings, hou toesig oor en ontwikkel Data Capturers, Legal Administration Clerks en ondersteun prestasiebestuur, bestuur die prestasie van die Legal Administration Clerks met ondertekening van Prestasieooreenkoms, Mid-term Reviews en Annual Assessment.

zu.title: Umncedisi Weqonga: Isitathistikhi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somncedisi weqonga: isitathistikhi eNkantolo ePhakamayo yasenyakatho-Ningizimu Afrika eKimberley, ephatha futhi ehlaziya idatha yezinkantolo nokubika ngemiphumela yesitathistikhi.
zu.requirements: Abafake izicelo kufanele babe ne-National Diploma/Degree ku-Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Accounting noma isifundo esilinganayo esizingeni le-NQF level six (6) njengoba somunywa i-SAQA. Okungenani iminyaka emithathu (3) yokusebenza okubalulekile naseqiniso ukuhlaziya idatha yokubika, lapho kunyakeni lunye (1) kufanele kube ngaphezu kwezinga leholo elingu-seven (7) nobe ngumphathi. Ulwazi nezikhono: Ulwazi ngokuqoqa idatha, ukuhlanganisa nokugcina idatha, ukuqinisekisa idatha, ukuhlaziya idatha, kanye no-Information Management. Kubukeka ngokubika, ubuholi, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ulwazi lwekhompyutha (i-MS Office ikakhulukazi i-Excel), ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangesibhali), ucwangciso, ukuhlela, izibalo nobuntu.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi ulawule idatha eqoqiwe nge-Quasi-Judicial kanye no-Judge's Secretaries, ukuqinisekisa ikhwalithi yedatha, ubike ngokuhlaziwa kwesitathistikhi futhi uwulekele abaphathi ngemiphumela, idatha ihlaziwe ibuye iqoqwe ngokwesidingo, qinisekisa amafayela e-Quasi-Judicial nolwazi lwabantu beNkantolo kanye nokuqinisekisa izinamba zanyanga zonke, zesikhashana kanye zomnyaka. Lungele ukulolonga abaqoqi bedatha ekuthuthukiseni izincwadi zokulolonga, lawule futhi uthuthukise ababambi be-Data Capturers, abakliniki be-Legal Administration Clerks, kanye nesekelo sezinhlelo zokusebenza, phatha ukusebenza kwabakliniki be-Legal Administration Clerks ngokusayina izivumelwano zokusebenza, ukuhlola ekuhambeni kwesikhathi kanye nokuhlolwa komunyaka wonke.

xh.title: Umahluleli oLawulwayo: iStyoloji
xh.summary: Indlela yokuba nguMgqatswa woluhlu: iStyoloji kwindawo iBhunga lendlela ekwaziswa kwakhona kwabakhuseli bomthetho eKimberley, ukulawula nokuhlohla amaza obulungiswa kwinkqubo yomthetho nokubika ngenkqubo yoluhlu lwamaza okukhoyo.
xh.requirements: Abafuna ukuba kufuneka banayo iNkqubo yeNqanaba leSikolo seStyoloji neDigrante ekuyimyeye yokufundiswa kwamaza kunye neendlela zokulawula ekuyiyo kulungiselelwa koluhlu lweziqendu ezinxulumene neqondo elitsha lokucwangciswa kwamaza kunye nokuqhatha imizekelo yamaza. Kufuneka abe nenqanaba lesithandathu ngesiNdyili esiLuhlu lwamaza afunyanwe ngokwentsimbi eLifundo eliphakamileyo. Kufuneka babe nokubaqatha kakhulu kwindlela ezilungileyo ekwenzeni ubuncwane bokwenza inkqubo yoluhlu lokuqonda iinkqubo zeziqendu ezilungele iNqanaba lesithandathu. Kufuneka babe nokutsha amaza kwakhona okusebenza ekulawulweni iinkqubo ezilungileyo ekunokubakho kwiNqanaba yokuqala yamaza okubhalweyo.
xh.duties: Lawula ulawulo lenkqubo yothutho kwakhona lawula iinkcukacha zamafa afunyenweyo kwiBhunga lendlela ekwaziswa ngayo kwabo bagcini bomthetho nokubhalisa kwamagosa abo bagcini bomthetho, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo samaza, ukulungiselelwa kokubika ngokuhlaziyo lwamaza nokunikela iingcebiso kwabakhuseli be nkqubo ngemikhuba ephawulekayo. Lawula iinkqubo zokubeka amaza kwelungelelaniswe ngokwemfuno yomsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuba amaphila eBhunga okwendlu yokugqibela yokomthetho kwakhona namaza obuLawuli bekamva ngoncwangca. Lawula iinkqubo zokukhulisa amaza abaqokeleli kunye namaxesha okulungiselelwa iinkqubo zokukhulisa amaza aphathwayo, ukukhulisa amaza kunye nemisebenzi yokuyilwa kwamaza okuqokelelwa ndawonye, lawula inkqubo yokuba kugqitywe iinkqubo zenkqubo yokukhulisa amaza abaqokeleli ngokuphila kwexesha lokusolula kwamaza okuthiwa ngokuthi 'Performance Agreement' nokunikela iingcebiso ngemikhonza ephawulekayo.
