af.title: Webmeester
af.summary: Webmeester benodig by Constitutional Court in Braamfontein om websuite-inhoud, ontwerp, sekuriteit en databeskerming te onderhou.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Nasionale Diploma in Webontwerp/Rekenaarwetenskap of 'n relevante kwalifikasie op NQF Vlak six (6) met 360 krediete soos deur SAQA erken, hê. 'n Minimum van three (3) jaar se ervaring in die relevante veld. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in Webontwerp/Rekenaarwetenskap of 'n relevante kwalifikasie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Vaste kennis en ervaring in programmeertoepassings. 'n Vaste begrip van hoe webtoepassings werk, insluitend sekuriteit, sessiebestuur en die beste ontwikkelingspraktyke. Ervaring (UX) en kliëntkant-tegnologieë insluitend HTML5, CSS, inhoudbestuurstelsels, PHP, JQuery en JSON en kennis van programmeertaal en tegniese terminologie. Kennis en ervaring in Paure en CRV Dynamics. Kennis en begrip van C,'C+. Visual Basic, C#. Java, XYL. Angula' en enige BI-rapporteringsnutsmiddel. Kennis van Search Engine Optimisation-proses, voldoende kennis van relasionele databasisstelsels, Object Ori. Vaardig in rekenaarvaardigheid, goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), voorlegging, projekbestuur, beplanning en organisering, analitiese vaardighede, tegniese vaardighede, probleemoplossing en besluitnemingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Onderhou websuite-inhoud en nakoming in ooreenstemming met standaardpraktyke; onderhou die gehalte, ontwerp en styl van die organisatoriese websuite in ooreenstemming met die websuite-stylgids en websuite-beleid; verseker websuite-sekuriteit en databeskerming deur die nodige maatreëls en protokolle te implementeer; onderhou webplatforms se Security Validation Programme en databasisse; monitor werfverkeer en los tegniese probleme op om werfprestasie vir soekenjins (Google, Bing, Yahoo) en AI Harvesting te optimaliseer; implementeer websuite-probleemoplossing en -optimalisering; hou tred met ontluikende tegnologieë/bedryfstandendele en pas dit toe op bedrywighede, opleiding en aktiwiteite; verskaf advies oor nuwe websuite-ontwerpe en opgraderingsimplementering; tree alle administratiewe pligte na soos deur die toesighouer aangewys.

zu.title: Umlawuli we-webhusayithi
zu.summary: Kudingeka umlawuli we-webhusayithi e-Constitutional Court e-Braamfontein ukugcina okuqukethwe, ukwakheka, ukuvikeleka, nokuvikelwa kwemininingwane yewebhusayithi.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izifundo kufanele babe ne-National Diploma ekwakheni i-web/ Computer Science noma izifundo ezifanele ezingeni le-NQF Level six (6) ezinamaphoyinti angu-360 njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA. Ukuze ube nobuhle bokusesimweni kule nkolo yezimali, kumele ube no-National Diploma ekwakheni i-web/Computer Science noma izifundo ezifanele. Isipesheli esingavunyelwa. I-Diploma eyisiqu ngemuva kokuqeda izifundo ezifanele izobe inikeza inzuzo ethile. Ulwazi nemakhono: Ulwazi olusobala noluhamba phambili mayelana nokusebenza kwezinhlelo zokusetha ikhompyutha. Isiqondiso esihle sokuthi izinhlelo zewebhusayithi zisebenza kanjani kuhlanganise ukuvikeleka, ukuphathwa kwesikhathi, kanye nezindlela ezihamba phambili zokwakha. Ulwazi (UX) kanye nobuchwepheshe obuhlangothi lokumthengi buhlanganise i-HTML5, CSS, izinhlelo zokuphathwa kokuqukethwe, i-PHP, i-JQuery ne-JSON kanye nokuqonda izilimi zokusetha ikhompyutha namagama obuchwepheshe. Ulwazi namakhono ekuphathweni kwe-Paure kanye ne-CRV Dynamics. Ulwazi nekuqonda i-C,'C+, i-Visual Basic, i-C#, i-Java, i-XYL, i-Angula' nanoma yisiphi isixhumi esibukiwe se-BI. Ulwazi lwenqubo yokulungiselelwa kwesibonakaliso samaphoyinti ezinhlelwini zamamininingwane, amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuxhumana okuhle (ngomlomo nakubhalwe), ukubukusa, ukuphatha amaphrojekhi, ukuhlela nokuhlela izinto, amakhono okuhlaziya, amakhano obuchwepheshe, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo.
zu.duties: Gcina okuqukethwe kwewebhusayithi kanye nokuhambisana nezinqubo eziyisizingcomfanelo ezingagxekwa, gcobisa ikhwalithi, ukwakheka kanye nesitayela sewebhusayithi yenhlangano ngokuhambisana nesitayela sekhasimale elifaniswa noma imithetho yekhasimale, qinisekisa ukuthi le webhusayithi ikhuselekile futhi ihlengiwe ngokuhambisa izinyathelo eziyisizihloko, zibe ubuso obuqotho bezinhlelo zokuvikela ngamaphoyinti nemithetho ehlelwe ngokwesikhathi, gcina izinkalo zokuvikeleka kwenqubo yokuqinisekiswa kokuthungatha kwewebhusayithi, qonda ukuthutha okuwukuthungatha kanye nokuzulula izinto zokuxazulula imikhuba ehlelo ikhasimale ukuthi kuyisibonisi sezinkalo zokuthungatha i- (Google, Bing, Yahoo) kanye ne-AI Harvesting, hlela ukuthungatha amakhasimale, gcina inkondelo yohlobo lwe-webhusayithi kanye nezinkondolo ezintsha zamakhono nobuchwepheshe obubangelwa isikhathi esisha ukuze kusetshenziswe emiseni, emfundweni nasemisebenzini, nikeza izeluleko ngezincazelo ezintsha zewebhusayithi nokusetshenziswa kokuthuthukiswa kohlelo, kube khona ekwenzeni imisebenzi yonke yobulungiswa ehlelwe ngumlawuli ngokwemiyalo.

Ulwazi ngokuqhutywa kwenkqubo yokulungisa i-Sarch Engine Optimisation, Ulwazi olwaneleyo ngenkqubo zedatabase ezinceleniswayo, Object Ori. Ukhwelo ekusetyenzisweni kwekhompyutha, ikhomunikashini elungileyo (yomlomo nobhalwe phantsi), ezokuvelisa, ulawulo lwe-project, uqwalaselo lolungiselelwa, izakhono zokuqonda, izakhono zobuchwepheshe, ukusombulula iingxaki nezakhono zokuthatha izigqibo.
xh.duties: Gcina iziqulatho zewebhusayithi nokuhambelana namagqabantshintshi endlela eziqhelekileyo, gcina umberthe, ukuyila nesimbo sewebhusayithi yeqela ngokwamanqanaba esimbo kwayo kwaye kwangokwinkqubo-ntsika yokumiselwa kolwazi ngokwemigaqo yewebhusayithi, qinisekisa ukhuseleko nokhuselo ololude ukuvikela ukusetyenziswa ngokufakela iziphelo kunye neenkqubo-migaqo, gcina inkqubo yesiqinisekiso sokhuseleko kwezindawo ezingamvelaba zesiphaluka zokulawula iinkqubo ne-database, qwalasela imithambo ekwindawo zeSayithi kwaye usombulule iingxaki ezinzima ukuzigqibelela ukuze ubenmdele wokusebenza kwandawo yakho (Google, Bing, Yahoo) ne-AI Harvesting, wenze ukusombulula iingxaki ekusebenziseni iwebhusayithi nalungiselelwe ukuphucula ukusebenza, zigcine unolwazi ngendlela ezitsha ezivelayo/nolwandle nemvelaphi yazo kwaye uzisebenzise kumasebe ngokumiselwa, wakho nemisebenzi yonikezelwa ngeenkcukacha zemibuzo ngamayilo aman otsha awebhusayithi nokusetyenziswa kwamagqabantshintshi, nceda kumsebenzi wonke wolawulo njengoko kuqulunwe sisikhokelo.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk
jobs.centre: KwaZulu-Natal Division of The High Court: Pietermaritzburg
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 – R279 708 per annum (Level 05). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Administration clerk providing general clerical support at the KwaZulu-Natal High Court in Pietermaritzburg, requiring a Grade 12 certificate with no prior experience needed.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a Grade twelve (12) certificate. No experience required. A driver’s license will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of working procedures in terms of the working environment, registry processes and practice, storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment, understanding of legislative frameworks governing the Public Service, filling system, mail procedure manual, promotion of access to information Act, National archives and Batho Pele Principles. Skilled in computer literacy (Microsoft Office), communication, numeracy, interpersonal skills, problem solving, analysing, time management and administrative skills.
jobs.duties: Render general clerical support services. Record, organise, store, capture and retrieve correspondence and data, update registers and statistics, receive, determine nature of request/documents and distribute all incoming and outgoing documents and follow-up on outstanding matters, keep a complete filing system and does filing and tracing of documents for the manager and the component (where required), type letters and/or other correspondence when required, keep and maintain the incoming and outgoing document register of the component (district offices), provide supply chain clerical support services within the component, handle sub-inventory controller for the manager’s office, liaise with internal and external stakeholders in relation to procurement of goods and services, handle the procurement of standard office items like stationery, refreshments, etc. by obtaining quotations and completing procurement forms, keep and maintain the asset register of the component (district offices), provide personnel administration clerical support services within the component, maintain a leave register for the component, keep and maintain personnel records and attendance register within the component, make suitable travel arrangements and check that the relevant documentation on receipts correspond with the arrangements (e.g. accommodation, flight scheduling, passports, visas, etc.), process travel and subsistence claims for the manager and members of the Unit, provide administrative support service, provide logistical arrangements to meetings, provide secretariat support services to the meetings, compile minutes and memos, handle incoming and outgoing office correspondence, ensure a proper filling system for all the records and provide support with stationery supplies within the sub-directorate.

af.title: Administrasieklerk
af.summary: Administrasieklerk wat algemene klerklike ondersteuning by die KwaZulu-Natal Hooggeregshof in Pietermaritzburg verskaf, wat 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat vereis met geen vorige ondervinding nodig nie.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad twaalf (12) sertifikaat. Geen ondervinding nodig. 'n Bestuurderslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van werksprosedures met betrekking tot die werksomgewing, registerprosesse en -praktyke, stoor- en onttrekkingsprosedures met betrekking tot die werksomgewing, begrip van wetgewende raamwerke wat die Openbare Diens regeer, lerstelsel, posprosedurehandleiding, bevordering van toegang tot inligtingswet, Nasionale argiewe en Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardig in rekenaargeletterdheid (Microsoft Office), kommunikasie, syfergeletterdheid, interpersoonlike vaardighede, probleemoplossing, analise, tydbestuur en administratiewe vaardighede.
af.duties: Verleen algemene klerklike ondersteuningsdienste. Rekord, organiseer, stoor, neem op en onttrek korrespondensie en data, werk registers en statistieke by, ontvang, bepaal die aard van versoeke/dokumente en versprei alle inkomende en uitgaande dokumente en volg op op uitstaande sake, hou 'n volledige lerstelsel en doen ler en opsporing van dokumente vir die bestuurder en die komponent (waar nodig), tik briewe en/of ander korrespondensie wanneer nodig, hou en onderhou die inkomende en uitgaande dokumentregister van die komponent (distrikskantore), verskaf voorsieningskettingklerklike ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent, hanteer sub-voorraadbeheerder vir die bestuurder se kantoor, skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes met betrekking tot die verkryging van goedere en dienste, hanteer die verkryging van standaard kantoorartikels soos skryfbehoeftes, verfrissings, ens. deur kwotasies te verkry en verkrygingsvorms te voltooi, hou en onderhou die bate-register van die komponent (distrikskantore), verskaf personeeladministrasie-klerklike ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent, onderhou 'n verlofregister vir die komponent, hou en onderhou personeelrekords en bywoningsregister binne die komponent, maak geskikte reisreëlings en kontrolleer dat die relevante dokumentasie op kwitansies ooreenstem met die reëlings (bv. akkommodasie, vlugskedulering, paspoorte, visums, ens.), verwerk reis- en onderhoudsklawules vir die bestuurder en lede van die Eenheid, verskaf administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste, verskaf logistieke reëlings vir vergaderings, verskaf sekretariële ondersteuningsdienste aan vergaderings, stel notule en memo's op, hanteer inkomende en uitgaande kantoorkorrespondensie, verseker 'n behoorlike lerstelsel vir alle rekords en verskaf ondersteuning met skryfbehoeftes binne die sub-direktoraat.

zu.title: Iklekishi Yokuphathwa Kwezindaba
zu.summary: Iklekishi yokuphathwa kwezindaba enikeza inkuxa yokubhala evamile eNkantolo Ephakeme ye-KwaZulu-Natal e-Pietermaritzburg, edinga isitifiketi se-Grade 12 ngaphandle kokuthi kube nolwazi lwangaphambili oludingekayo.
zu.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade twelve (12). Akukho lolunye ulwazi oludingekayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela izoba usizo olwengeziwe. Ulwazi nezikhono: Ulwazi ngemikhakha yokusebenza ngokohlelo lwendawo yokusebenza, inqubo nezilungiselelo zeregistry, inqubo yokugcina nokuveza imibhalo ngokohlelo lwendawo yokusebenza, ukuqonda izimiso zomthetho ezibusa isevisi yokomphakathi, indlela yokugcina imibhalo, umhlahlandlela wenqubo yamelayithi, umthetho wokukhuthaza ukufinyelelela kwemininingwane, i-National archives kanye ne-Batho Pele Principles. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Office), ukuxhumana, ukubala, izikhono zokuxhumana namanye abantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlaziya, ukuphatha isikhathi kanye nezikhono zokuphathwa kwezindaba.
zu.duties: Nikela inkuxa yokuqasha evamile. Qamba, hlela, gcina, bhalisa futhi iveze imibhalo nedatha, buyekeza izinkomba nokubalwa kwesibalo, amukele, qonde uhlobo lwesicelo/imibhalo bese uyahlukanisa yonke imibhalo eqa qile nokuqhamuka, bese ulandela izindaba ezingaxolugqama, gcise indlela ephelele yokugcina imibhalo wenze ukugcina nokuqondisa imibhalo kumaneja nakwesoqoqo lwezinsizakalo (lapho kudingeka khona), thepha izincwadi kanye/noma omunye umbhalo lapho kudingeka khona, gcine futhi ulondoloze inkomba yemibhalo ezingena nephuma kusoqoqo (amahhovisi esifundazwe), nikeze inkuxa yokuqasha kwenqubo yokuhlinzeka nezinkonzo zohlelo ngaphakathi kusoqoqo, phatha isilawuli sezimpahla ezincane ehhovisi likamaneja, xhumanisa nabaphathi bezinsizakalo abangaphakathi nabangaphandle ngokuhlotshaniswa nokutholwa kwezimpahla nezinsizakalo, phatha ukutholwa kwezimpahla zehhovisi eziyisilinganiso ezinjengesibhededethi, okokuphuzwayo, njl. ngokucesha izinani bese upheda amafomu okuthenga, gcine futhi ulondoloze inkomba yezimpahla kusoqoqo (amahhovisi esifundazwe), nikeze inkuxa yokuqasha yokuqashwa kwabasebenzi ngaphakathi kusoqoqo, gcize inkomba yokunqamula ukusebenza kusoqoqo, gcine futhi ulondoloze imibhalo yabasebenzi nenkomba yokuhamba emsebenzini ngaphakathi kosoqoqo, hlela izinhlelo zokuhamba ezifanele bese uhlola ukuthi imibhalo ehihliwe ihambisana nezinhlelo (isb. endaweni yokulala, ukuhlela amabhodi, amaphasipoti, izivumelwano, njl.), cabelwa izinkokhela zokuhamba nokweshwa kubamanja namalungu esiGoxo, nikeze inkuxa yokuphathwa kwezindaba, nikeze izinhlelo zokuhlela izinsizakulo emihlanganweni, nikeze inkuxa yebhodi lababhalisi emihlanganweni, qamba imibhalo yesikhathi emifushane namamepho, phatha imibhalo yehhovisi ezingena nephuma, qinisekisa isisindo sokugcina imibhalo ngokwanele futhi nikeze inkuxa ngamakhethi ehhovisi ngaphakathi kwesiqondankulu.

xh.title: Iclerka yolawulo
xh.summary: Iclerka yolawulo enika inkxaso yemisebenzi egqithisileyo yobukhosi kwiKhotya eliPhezulu leKwaZulu-Natal ePietermaritzburg, efuniqiqmaq esitifikati seGraji 12 ngaphandle kokutsalwa kokugqithileyo.
xh.requirements: Iingxaki kufuneka zibe nesitifikati seGraji yeshumi elinesithoba (12). Akukho tsalwa luni funekayo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba iya kuba sisixhaso esongezelelweyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi lweenkqubo zomsebenzi ngokwemilinganiselo yendalo yomsebenzi, iinkqubo nokusebenza kweregistri, iinkqubo zogcino lokubuyiswa ngokwemilinganiselo yendalo yomsebenzi, ukuqonda iinkqubo zomthetho ezilawula inkonzo kaRhulumende, inkqubo yokuvala, isandla sesixele esibhalwe ngokomthetho wokwenza, ukuvunywa kwemithetho yemfihlakalo yegazethi, uluntu olubandakanyekileyo iNkqubo ye-Batho Pele. Ukuzezi ekwilwazi lekhompyutha (Microsoft Office), unxibelelwano, ukuqonda amanani, amakhono obudlelwane nabantu, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuhlalutya, ulawulo lwexesha namakhono olawulo.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yemisebenzi yolawulo ngokubanzi. Qamba, hlunga, gcina, batha uze ubuyisele oonobumba nedatha, hlaziya amarejista nemibalwe, wamkele, qamba ubume bomcimbi/oxwebhu wazidibanisa konke okuvela nokuhamayo kolwazi uze ulandele izinto ezingagqitywanga, gcina inkqubo epheleleyo yamafayile uze wenze ukuvalwa nokulandelwa kwamaxwebhu komphathi nakwicomponent (apho kufunekayo), chwetheza oonobumba nokunye na okukhankanyiweyo xa kufuneka, gcina uze ulonde irejista lwamaxwebhu angenayo naphumayo ecomponent (iziko kwiziko lesithili), nike inkxaso ekwenzweni kwenkqubo yokubonelela ngaphakathi kwecomponent, yiba nomngxiba wokulawula izibonelelo kwindlu komphathi, nxibelelane nabanikwezigqibo abangaphakathi nangaphandle malunga nokunikelwa kwemibonelelo nemisebenzi, yiba nokunikelwa kwemibonelelo eqhelekileyo yendlu njengamawoti, iziselo, njl. ngokuqoqwa kweengxelo nokugqiba iifomu zokuqokelela, gcina uze ulonde irejista lemibonelelo yecomponent (iziko kwiziko lesithili), nike inkxaso kwabasebenzi abangaphakathi kwecomponent, gcina irejista yokubaleka yecomponent, gcina uze ulonde iirekhodi zabasebenzi nerejista lokungangeni kwecomponent, yenza izicwangciso zokuhambelela ezifanelekileyo uze uqiniseke ukuba amaxwebhu afanelekileyo ahambelana nezicwangciso (umz. indlu yokuhlala, ukuhlelwa kweeklabhathi, iipaspoti, iiviza, njl.), qhuba iingxelo ezimalunga nohambo nokuhlala komphathi namalungu eNyango, nike inkxaso yolawulo, nike izicwangciso zokuhamba kwangaphambili kwiindibano, nike inkxaso yeselekhali kwizibhozo, qamba iiminithi namemo, qhuba oonobumba abangenayo naphumayo bendlu, qinisekisa inkqubo elungileyo yokuvala yonke imigaqo uze unike inkxaso nokuqokelela kwezibonelelo ngaphakathi kwenqanaba lesibangi esingaphantsi.

jobs.summary: Typist needed at the Gauteng Division of High Court in Johannesburg to type court orders, documents and reports, requiring a Grade 12 certificate with knowledge of legal terminology.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a Grade twelve (12) certificate or NQF level four (4) qualification as recognised by SAQA. No experience required. one (1) year relevant experience will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of the legal terminology, court procedures, rules and environment. Counter services, filing system, Case- flow management, understanding of legislative governing the Public Service (Batho Pele & PSR). Skilled in computer literacy (Microsoft Office), typing (speed 35 words per minute, dictaphone typing, problem-solving, communications (written and verbal), time management. Along with the following attributes: Ability to work under pressure, client orientation, customer focus, resilience, honesty, integrity, flexibility, personal motivation, creative thinking, reliability, ability to work in a team, accuracy and attention to detail.
jobs.duties: Type court orders, court documents and reports, type the court orders and relevant court documents in line with endorsement on front of court file, typing of appeals, reviews, memorandums, reports, minutes, circulars, notice of set downs, witness statements, taxing master reports, type Rule 6(12) orders and make available in terms of the rule, ensure that orders are typed in the correct format and provided to the registrar for checking, ensure that corrections to orders are done in line with the registrar’s instruction, ensure that all incorrect court orders and court documents are reported to the supervisor, type judgments, sort and distribute incoming and outgoing files, attend to requests from Legal fraternity and public, type court orders, judgments from judges in format provided (Dictaphone, written notes), make amendments on judgments as per judges’ request/instruction, audit format of judgment, type urgent applications, type apostilles and authentication and J349 for the public and others in accordance with the rule and format, and delivering to general office. Compile term roll, week roll and un/opposed motion roll and maintain registers, draft term rolls for each court term in line with the Gazette terms, type opposed and unopposed motion court roll in terms of the required format inserting the judges’ names, type supplementary rolls, communicate roll to registrars and Judge Presidents Office, ensure consecutive numbering and that files are categorized, compile and submit relevant orders and judgments to relevant stakeholders, check Index Statistics SA forms and a copy of divorce order and forward Statistics SA, ensure that copy of Divorce orders is forwarded to Home Affairs Head Office, send Advocates enrolment orders to the Department of Justice and Constitutional Development, sent all judgments provided to the typing unit, in the required format, to the elected person (for reporting purposes on Saflii). Communicate court rolls to stakeholders through electronic mail, develop and maintain court rolls register, provide administrative support, scan, save draft orders and record work in register for monthly statistics.

af.title: Tikster
af.summary: Tikster benodig by die Gauteng Divisie van die Hooggeregshof in Johannesburg om hofbevele, dokumente en verslae te tik, wat 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat met kennis van regsterminologie vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad twaalf (12) sertifikaat of NQF vlak vier (4) kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken, hê. Geen ondervinding word vereis. Een (1) jaar relevante ondervinding sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van die regsterminologie, hofprosedures, reëls en omgewing. Toonbankdienste, argiefstelsel, Saakvloei-bestuur, begrip van wetgewing wat die Openbare Diens reël (Batho Pele & PSR). Bedrewe in rekenaargeletterdheid (Microsoft Office), tik (spoed 35 woorde per minuut), diktafoon-tik, probleemoplossing, kommunikasie (geskrewe en mondeling), tydbestuur. Saam met die volgende eienskappe: Vermoë om onder druk te werk, kliëntgerigtheid, kliëntfokus, veerkragtigheid, eerlikheid, integriteit, buigsaamheid, persoonlike motivering, kreatiewe denke, betroubaarheid, vermoë om in 'n span te werk, akkuraatheid en oog vir detail.
af.duties: Tik hofbevele, hofdokumente en verslae, tik die hofbevele en relevante hofdokumente in ooreenstemming met die endorsie op die voorkant van die hoflêer, tik van appèlle, hersienings, memorandums, verslae, notule, sirkulêrs, kennissings van verhore, getuieverklarings, belastingmeester-verslae, tik Rule 6(12) bevele en maak dit beskikbaar ooreenkomstig die reël, verseker dat bevele in die korrekte formaat getik en aan die registrateur vir nasien voorsien word, verseker dat korreksies aan bevele gedoen word in ooreenstemming met die registrateur se instruksies, verseker dat alle onkorrekte hofbevele en hofdokumente aan die toesighouer gerapporteer word, tik vonnisse, sorteer en versprei inkomende en uitgaande lêers, attendeer versoeke van die Regsprofessie en publiek, tik hofbevele, vonnisse van regters in verskafde formaat (Diktafoon, geskrewe notas), maak wysigings aan vonnisse soos deur regters versoek/instrueer, ouditeer formaat van vonnis, tik dringende aansoeke, tik apostille en authentifikasie en J349 vir die publiek en ander ooreenkomstig die reël en formaat, en aflewering aan die algemene kantoor. Stel term-roll, week-roll en un/teengespreekte motion-roll op en handhaaf registers, opstel van term-rolle vir elke hoftermyn in ooreenstemming met die Gazette-termyne, tik teengespreekte en onteengespreekte motion-hofrol in ooreenstemming met die vereiste formaat deur die regters se name in te voeg, tik aanvullende rolle, kommunikeer rol aan registrateurs en Regter Presidente Kantoor, verseker opeenvolgende nommering en dat lêers gekategoriseer word, stel relevante bevele en vonnisse saam en stuur dit aan relevante belanghebbendes, kontroleer Indeks Statistieke SA-vorms en 'n afskrif van egskeidingsbevel en stuur dit aan Statistiek SA, verseker dat 'n afskrif van egskeidingsbevele aan die Binnelandse Sake Hoofkantoor gestuur word, stuur Advokate se inskrywingsbevele aan die Departement van Justisie en Konstitusionele Ontwikkeling, stuur alle vonnisse wat aan die tik-eenheid verskaf is, in die vereiste formaat, na die verkose persoon (vir verslagdoeningsdoeleindes op Saflii). Kommunikeer hofrolle aan belanghebbendes deur middel van elektroniese pos, ontwikkel en handhaaf hofrolle-register, verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning, skandeer, stoor konsep-bevele en registreer werk in register vir maandelikse statistieke.

zu.title: Umlobi ohlobothayo
zu.summary: Kudingeka umlobi ohlobothayo esikhungweni se-Gauteng Division of High Court e-Johannesburg ukuze aholothe imiyalo yenkantolo, amadokhumenti nemitshingo yezindaba, kudingeka ibe nephasiphoti le-Grade 12 elinolwazi ngemibandela yomthetho.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade twelve (12) noma iziqu ezinga le-NQF level four (4) njengoba kutshingwa yi-SAQA. Akukho namandla okuhlolwa. one (1) year relevant experience izoba ngelomunye wenzele abone umphumela omuhle. Ulwazi nobuchwepheshe: Ulwazi ngokusetshenziswa kwamagama omthetho, izinqubo zenkantolo, imithetho nendawo yenkantolo. Isevisi yaku-counter, uhlelo lokulondoloza amafayela, ukuphathwa kokuhamba kwezins案件, ukuqonda komthetho ophatha Isevisi Yomphakathi (Batho Pele & PSR). Ukube nokuzazi izinhlelo zekhompyutha (Microsoft Office), ukuhlobothayo (isivinini 35 words per minute, ukuhlobothaya ngedictaphone, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokukhulunywayo), ukuphatha isikhathi. Kanye nezimpawu ezilandelayo: Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo, ukuqondiswa kumthengi, ukugxila kumthengi, ukumelana nexinzelelo, ukuqotho, ukuziphathe kahle, ukuguquguquka, ukuzikhandelisa, ukucabanga ngokudalayo, ukuthembeka, ikhono lokusebenza ohlwini, ukuchaza nokunakwa imininingwane.
zu.duties: Hlobotha imiyalo yasekhantolo, amadokhumenti asekhantolo nemitshingo yezindaba, hlobotha imiyalo yasekhantolo namadokhumenti ahambisana nayo ngokwezinkomba ezisesiqondweni sefayela lekhantolo, hlobotha izikhalazo, izibuyekezo, imibhalo eqoshiwe, imitshingo yezindaba, amaminithi, izexwayiso, izaziso zokubekwa ezinkantolo, izinkulumo zofakazi, imitshingo yomhloli wamashifu, hlobotha imiyalo ye-Rule 6(12) uyibeke etholakalayo ngokomthetho, qinisekisa ukuthi imiyalo ihlobothiwe ngendlela efanele inikezwe umgcini wezinkantolo ukuze ayihlole, qinisekisa ukuthi izilungiso ezwenziwa emiyalweni zenzelwe ngokwemiyalo kamgcini wezinkantolo, qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amiyalo namadokhumenti aze ahlobothiwe angalungile abikwe kumlawuli, hlobotha izinkantolo, hlela futhi wabelwe amafayela angenayo aphumayo, uphendwe izicelo ezivela kubantu bomthetho nKomphakathi, hlobotha imiyalo yasekhantolo, izinkantolo ezivika kwabahluleli ngendlela ephakeliwe (Dictaphone, okubhaliwe), wenze izilungiso ezinkantolo njengoba kuceliwe/inikwe umyalo abahluleli, hlolela ukulunga kwesakhiwo sezinkantolo, hlobotha izicelo eziphephayo, hlobotha ama-apostille, ukugunyaza kwe-J349 ebalulekile komphakathi nabanye ngokwezindlela ezisetshenziswa nendlela efanele, uwahambise kumhhofisi jikelele. Hlanganisa uhlu lwesikhathi, uhlu lwamasonto kanye nohlu lwezicelo eziphikiswe nongaphikiswe ulugcine kuma-register, hlobotha uhlaka luhlu lwezinsimba kuleso sikhathi sekhantolo ngokuhambisana nezinsimba ze-Gazette, hlobotha uhlu lwezicelo eziphikiswe nongaphikiswa ngokohlelo oluceliwe ufake amagama abahluleli, hlobotha uhlaka olwengeziwe lwamaphuzu, thumela oluhlu kwabagcini nabaku-Office kaJudge President, qinisekisa ukubhalwa ngokulandelana kwamafayela kanye nokuthi amafayela aze ahlelwe, hlanganisa uthume imiyalo ezibalulekile kanye nezinkantolo kubantu abahlobene nayo, hlola ifomu le-Index Statistics Sa kanye nokuqothwa kwesibani se-divorce order ulithume kwa-Statistics Sa, qinisekisa ukuthi isibani se-divorce order sithunyelwa kwa-Home Affairs Head Office, thumela imiyalo yokuwethulwa kwa-Advocates kwa-Department of Justice and Constitutional Development, thumela yonke imiyalo inkantolo enikelwe kulelo hlwa kohlobo, endlela ephakeliwe, kumuntu okhethiwe ukuze abike ngemigomo yokuqopha kwa-Saflii. Yazisa ohlaka lwamaphuzu abantu abahlobene nalolu hlelo nge-mail yamageshwaphi, akhe futhi aqophe izinkomba zohlaka lwamaphuzu, nikeza inkxaso yabaphathi, skane, ulondoloze imiyalo evaliwe uqophe umsebenzi kuma-register ngenhloso yokubala izibalo zenyanga zinyanga.

xh.title: Umshicileli
xh.summary: Kufuneka kude kubeneyomshicileli kwisiKolo esiPhakamileyo saseGauteng saseJohannesburg ukushicilela iimiyalelo yegenqeba, amaxwebhu neengxelo, kwaye kufuneka abe nesiqinisekiso seQela lesi-12 ane nolwazi ngemigaqo yomthetho.
xh.requirements: Iingaveli kufuneka zibe nesiqinisekiso seQela lesi-12 noma isemigqeni yesine (4) ekuqatshelwa yiSAQA. Akukho naluphi na uluvo olufunekayo. Unyaka omnye (1) woluvo oluhambelanayo uya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemigaqo yomthetho, iinkqubo zegenqeba, imithetho nendawo yegenqeba. Iinkonzo zikawonwadi (counter), inkqubo yokugcina amaxwebhu, ulawulo lokuqhuba iimeko (Case-flow management), ukuqonda koMthetho wolawula inkonzo kaRhulumente (Batho Pele & PSR). Ukuba nobuchule ekusebenzeni ngekhompyutha (Microsoft Office), ukushicilela (njengesantya semizwi engama-35 ngomzuzu, ukushicilela ngedictaphone, ukuxazula iingxaki, unxibelelwano (elubhalwe noluthethwayo), ulawulo lwexesha). Kwaye nabuphi na obuqondele kule minxhengepha ilandelayo: Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, ukuqondisela kumthengi, ukugxila kumthengi, ukomelela, inyaniso, ukuzithembisa, ukuguquguquka, inkuthazo yomntu ngamntu, ukucinga ngokuyilayo, ukuthembeka, ikhono lokusebenza kwiqela, ukuqinisekisa ukuchaneka nokuchasisa iinkcukacha.
xh.duties: Shicilela imiyalelo yegenqeba, amaxwebhu egenqeba neengxelo. Shicilela imiyalelo yegenqeba namaxwebhu afanelekileyo egenqeba ngokwemiyalelo ebhaliweyo phambili kwifayile yegenqeba. Ukushicilela iingxelo zokurhoxiswa kwagqigqi, zokuqwalasela, amanqaku, iingxelo, imizuzu, iindonga ezisentloko, izaziso zokuwisa iimeko, izinkcamiso zeziqendu, iingxelo zokuhlola abaphathi, ukushicilela imiyalelo yeRule 6(12) kwaye yenziwe iyafumaneka ngokwemigaqo. Qinisekisa ukuba imiyalelo ishicilelwe kwifomathi elungileyo kwaye inikwe umgcinisi wezenkantolo ukuze ayiqwalasele. Qinisekisa ukuba iinguqulo kumiyalelo zenziswa ngokwemiyalelo kamgcinisi wezenkantolo. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imiyalelo yegenqeba engalungileyo namaxwebhu egenqeba abalulewe kumlawuli. Shicilela iigqibo. Hlela kwaye uhle iifayile eziza nezihlabelo. Phendula iimfuno ezisuka kwindawo yamalungu omthetho nakuzwakum. Shicilela imiyalelo yegenqeba, iigqibo ezivela kumanxusa kwifomathi efunekayo (Dictaphone, amanqaku abhaliweyo). Yenza iinguqulo kwiigqibo ngokwesicelo/imiyalelo yamanxusa. Qwalasela ifomathi yegqibo. Shicilela izicelo ezibalekileyo. Shicilela amapostiles nokungqinisisa kunye neJ349 nkuzwakum nabanje ngokomthetho nangokwefomathi kwaye uze kwindawo yemisebenzi jikelele. Qamba irhulu yethentu, irhulu yeveki kunye nerhulu yentshukumo exhaphakileyo/engachaswanga kwaye ugcine izibhalo. Bhala iirhulu zethentu ngamaxesha egenqeba ngamnye ngokwamaxesha eGazette. Shicilela irhulu yentshukumo echasiweyo nengachaswanga ngokwefomathi efunekayo ufake amagama amanxusa. Shicilela iirhulu ezongezelelweyo. Xabathisa irhulu kubagciniwe kunye naseKundlwini lukaMongameli wamanxusa. Qinisekisa ukubala ngokulandelelana nokuba iifayile zihlulwe ngokudidi. Qamba kwaye unikeze imiyalelo negqibo efunekayo kubantu abafanelekileyo. Qwalasela iifomu zeStatistics SA index nakopi yomyalelo wahlukaniselwa lwabashadile kwaye uze kuStatistics SA. Qinisekisa ukuba ikopi yemiyalelo yohlukaniselwa abashadile ithunyelwa eNtloko yokuSebenza kweZamaphakathi. Thumela imiyalelo yokubhalisa abashumayeli kwisebe loBulungiswa noPhuhliso koMgaqo-siseko. Thumela yonke iigqibo ezinikiwe kwindawo yokushicilela, kwifomathi efunekayo, kumntu okhethiweyo (ngamaphuphu okubika kwiSaflii). Xabathisa iirhulu zegenqeba kubantu abafanelekileyo nge-imeyile. Phuhlisa kwaye ugcine isibhalo seerhulu zegenqeba. Nikeza inkxaso yolawulo. Skena, gcina iimiyalelo esekelweyo kwaye urekhode umsebenzi kwisibhalo ngenjongo yezibalo zenyanga.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Property Sector Analysis
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 101 468 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), (Total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the Middle Management service
jobs.summary: Deputy Director role analysing property sector policies and legislation at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure Head Office in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Policy Studies / Law / Real Estate/ Commercial/Management Sciences. Relevant years of work experience in real estate, property law, policy and legislative development at a Junior Management level/ Assistant Director equivalent level. Knowledge: Research, Policy formulation and analysis. Strategic planning, programme and project management. Legislation managed and administered by DPWI; National Policy Development Framework; Socio Economic Impact Assessment System (SEIAS); Policy & Legislative Formulation and Development Processes: Public Property Sector Regulatory Framework; Public procurement Regulatory Framework; Project Management and Law of Property; PFMA, PSA; Structure and functioning of the Department and linkages with government clusters; Broad understanding of the property sector in South Africa. Skills: Budgeting and Financial Management. Stakeholder liaison and management; Advanced communication (verbal and written); advanced report writing; research methodologies; language proficiency; negotiation, mediation and conflict management; problem solving skills; decision making skills; advanced interpersonal and diplomacy skills; programme and project management; public speaking and presentation; computer literate. Personal Attributes: Analytical thinking; innovative; creative; resourceful; self-reliant; energetic; hard-working; self-motivated; ability to work independently. Drivers’ license; prepared to travel; willing to adapt work schedule in accordance with professional requirements.
jobs.duties: Ensure effective and efficient analysis of relevant sources for purposes of the development of property policies and legislation; Consider and report on the policy gaps between the existing white papers and Government’s current policy priorities and developmental objectives with respect to the Property industry; Undertake research on relevant Property sector related topics approved by the Department; Consult with all relevant stakeholders; Develop policy position papers that will form an integral part of the Public Works function; Research and liaise with state and non-state parties through various fora to glean and collate relevant information to inform the policy and legislation making process; and Ensure provision of property policy and legislation support to DPWI and PMTE line functions as applicable. Manage the development and review of policy and legislative frameworks, in the Sub-Directorate: Property Sector Regulation. Undertake research on relevant property industry related topics approved by the Department. Lead the development and execution of comprehensive property industry analysis. Ensure that all policies, guidelines and standards are developed in line with applicable prescripts and are aligned to the Department’s strategic objectives. Monitor policy implementation and ensure compliance with applicable policies and directives. Facilitate policy integration with the PMTE and Provincial Departments responsible for Public Works function. Support the promotion of transformation agenda of the property sector by collaborating with the Property Sector Charter Council. Manage the Sub-Directorate, develop and manage the operational plan of the Sub-Directorate and report on progress as required, provide all required administrative reports, manage the budget allocated to the Sub-Directorate. Provide support for the overall success of the Policy, Research & Regulation Branch of the Department.
jobs.applications: Applications for the position of Deputy Director: Property Policy & Legislative Analysis Property Sector Regulation must be emailed to: Recruitment26- 80@dpw.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /SMS-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. IMPORTANT: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Ontleding van die Eiendoomsektor
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur-rol vir die ontleding van beleid en wetgewing rakende die eiendomsektor by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure se hoofkantoor in Pretoria.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum driejaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Level 06) / Nasionale Diploma in Beleidsstudies / Regte / Eiendom / Kommersieel / Bestuurswetenskappe. Relevante jare se werkervaring in eiendom, eiendomsreg, beleids- en wetgewingsontwikkeling op 'n Junior Management-vlak / Adjunkdirekteur ekwivalente vlak. Kennis: Navorsing, beleidsformulering en -ontleding. Strategiese beplanning, program- en projekbestuur. Wetgewing wat deur DPWI bestuur en geadministreer word; National Policy Development Framework; Socio Economic Impact Assessment System (SEIAS); beleids- en wetgewingsformulering en ontwikkelingsprosesse; Public Property Sector Regulatory Framework; Openbare aanwysings reguleringsraamwerk; projekbestuur en eiendomsreg; PFMA, PSA; struktuur en werking van die departement en skakels met regeringsklusters; breë begrip van die eiendomsektor in Suid-Afrika. Vaardighede: Begroting en finansiële bestuur. Belanghebbende-skakeling en -bestuur; gevorderde kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik); gevorderde verslagskrywing; navorsingsmetodes; taalvaardigheid; onderhandeling, bemiddeling en konflikbestuur; probleemoplossingsvaardighede; besluitnemingsvaardighede; gevorderde interpersoonlike en diplomatieke vaardighede; program- en projekbestuur; openbare spraak en aanbieding; rekenaargeletterd. Persoonlike eienskappe: Analitiese denke; innoverend; kreatief; vindingryk; selfstandig; energiek; hardwerkend; selfgemotiveer; vermoë om onafhanklik te werk. Bestuurslisensie; bereid om te reis; gewillig om werkskedule ooreenkomstig professionele vereistes aan te pas.
af.duties: Verseker doeltreffende en doeltreffende ontleding van relevante bronne vir die ontwikkeling van eiendomsbeleid en -wetgewing; Oorweeg en rapporteer oor die beleidsleemtes tussen die bestaande witboeke en die Regering se huidige beleidsprioriteite en ontwikkelingsdoelwitte ten opsigte van die eiendomsbedryf; Ondersoek relevante onderwerpe rakende die eiendomsektor wat deur die departement goedgekeur is; Raadpleeg alle relevante belanghebbendes; Ontwikkel beleidsposisiedokumente wat 'n integrale deel van die Openbare Werke-funksie sal vorm; Doen navorsing en skakel met staats- en nie-staatspartye deur verskeie forums om relevante inligting te versamel en te kolligeer om die beleids- en wetgewingsproses in te lig; en Verseker voorsiening van eiendomsbeleid- en wetgewingsondersteuning aan DPWI en PMTE-lynfunksies soos van toepassing. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en hersiening van beleids- en wetgewingsraamwerke, in die Sub-Directorate: Property Sector Regulation. Ondersoek relevante onderwerpe rakende die eiendomsbedryf wat deur die departement goedgekeur is. Lei die ontwikkeling en uitvoering van omvattende ontleding van die eiendomsbedryf. Verseker dat alle beleide, riglyne en standaarde in ooreenstemming met toepaslike voorskrifte ontwikkel word en met die departement se strategiese doelwitte belyn word. Monitor beleidsimplementering en verseker nakoming van toepaslike beleide en richtlyne. Fasiliteer beleidsintegrasie met die PMTE en Provinciale Departemente wat vir die Openbare Werke-funksie verantwoordelik is. Ondersteun die bevordering van die transformasie-agenda van die eiendomsektor deur met die Property Sector Charter Council saam te werk. Bestuur die Sub-Directorate, ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die Sub-Directorate en rapporteer oor vordering soos vereis, verskaf alle vereiste administratiewe verslae, bestuur die begroting wat aan die Sub-Directorate toegewys is. Verskaf ondersteuning vir die algehele sukses van die Policy, Research & Regulation Branch van die departement.

zu.title: Umongameli Ophethe: Ukuhlaziya Indikimba Yezindawo
zu.summary: Isikhundla somongameli ophethe sokuhlaziya izinkambiso nemithetho yendikimba yezindawo e Department of Public Works and Infrastructure Head Office e Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-thertiary zeminyaka emithathu (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma kwi-Policy Studies / Law / Real Estate / Commercial / Management Sciences. Eminyakeni ehambisanayo yeminyaka yohlaka lwemisebenzi kwi-real estate, property law, ukuthuthukiswa kwenkambiso nomthetho ezingeni le-Junior Management / ezingeni elingana nalokhu kokwesibili umlawuli. Ulwazi: Ukuqeqesha ucwaningo, ukwakuhlela nokuhlaziya izinkambiso. Ukuhlela kohlelo, ulawulo lwe-programme neprojekthi. Umthetho ophathiwe nowolawulwa yi-DPWI; National Policy Development Framework; Socio Economic Impact Assessment System (SEIAS); Inqubo yokwakuhlela nokuthuthukisa izinkambiso nomthetho; Public Property Sector Regulatory Framework; Public procurement Regulatory Framework; Project Management and Law of Property; PFMA, PSA; Isakhiwo nokusebenza komnyango kanye nokuhlobana namaklaster kahulumeni; Ukuqonda okubanzi ngesimo sendikimba yezindawo e Ningizimu Afrika. Amakhono: Ukwenza ibhajethi kanye noLawulo lwezezimali. Ukuxhumana nokuphatha abahlanganyeli; Ukuxhumana okuphakeme (okushiwo nangokubhalwayo); ukubhala okuphumelelayo kwezibalo; izindlela zocwaningo; ukusebenzisana kolimi; ukuziba, ukumisa izingxabano nokuphatha izinkinga; amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga; amakhono okwenza izinqumo; amakhono aphakeme okuxhumana nabantu nobu sofihlo; ulawulo lwe-programme neprojekthi; ukukhuluma esidlangalaleni nokwethula; ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Izici Zomuntu: Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya; ukubumba izinto ezingushajintshi; ukudala; ukubakho izinsiza; ukuzethemela; ukuba namandla; ukusebenza kanzima; ukuzikhuthaza; ikakhulu ukusebenza kodwa. Ilayisense yokushayela; ukulungele ukuhamba; ukulungele ukushintsha isikhathi sokusebenza ngokufaneleka kwezidingo zomsebenzi.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuhlaziya okusebenzayo nokuphumelelayo kwemithombo ehambisanayo ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa izinkambiso nomthetho wezindawo; Cabanga ubuye ucathe ngokwezinkambiso ezingekho phakathi kwama-white paper akhona nezimo ezintsha zenkambiso zikahulumeni nemigomo yokuthuthukisa uma kuziwa enkampanini yezindawo; Yenza ucwaningo ngezihloko eziya ngendikimba yezindawo ezihambisana nezindikimba ezimukelekwe umnyango; Xhumana nabo bonke abahlanganyeli abahambisanayo; Hlela amaphepha okuba yinkambiso okuzoba ingxenye ebalulekile yomsebenzi wePublic Works; Cwaninga uthintane namaphoyinti ahilelekile kanye nalawo angahilelekanga kahulumeni ngamaphilathi ahlukene ukuze athole aqoqe ulwazi oluhambisanayo lokuqondisa inqubo yokwenza izinkambiso nomthetho; futhi Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kokusekelwa ngemithetho kanye nenkambiso yezindawo kumasevisi e-DPWI ne-PMTE lapho kufanele khona. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokubuyekezwa kwamashekethi wezinkambiso nomthetho, eSub-Directorate: Property Sector Regulation. Yenza ucwaningo ngezihloko eziya ngendikimba yezindawo ezimukelekwe umnyango. Hola ukuthuthukiswa nokwenziwa kokuhlaziya ngokubanzi indikimba yezindawo. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinkambiso, izinhloso nemigomo yakhwa ngokuvumelana nemibhalo ethize futhi zihambisana nezinhloso eziyisikompompo zomnyango. Lilisele ukuphumelelwa kwenkambiso bese uqinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nezinkambiso neziyalezo ezingezayo. Khokhelela ukufakwa kwenkambiso e-PMTE nasemicimbi ye-Provincial Departments eqeqesha umsebenzi wePublic Works. Sekela ukukhuthazwa kwe-agenda yokushintsha indikimba yezindawo ngokusebenzisana ne-Property Sector Charter Council. Phatha i-Sub-Directorate, hlela uphathe iplan yokuqhuba i-Sub-Directorate bese umbike ngokuqhubeka njengoba kudingeka, nikeza wonke umbiko oyimfuneko wokuphatha, phatha ibhajethi enikezwe i-Sub-Directorate. Nikeza ukusekelwa ekuphumeleleni okuphelele kwe-Policy, Research & Regulation Branch yomnyango.

xh.title: Sekela-Mlawuli: Ukuhlalulwa Koluntu ngokweQesha lePropati
xh.summary: Isithuba seSekela-Mlawuli: Ukuhlalulwa koluntu ngokusebenziswa kwamaphepha epropati nokuhamba kwemithetho kwikomkhulu leSebe lezoBasebenzi baseRiphabliki neziNkonzo zeRhulumente ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Iminyanya emithathu yokum ekwikholejini, nakwingcungcuthe ezilwazalazise okanye evela kwindlu yemfundo ngokungangena esidumbini xa echaza imithetho ekubakwa kwayo ehlangabezana nemigaqo yenqanaba lesithandathu, ukuya kwelobuma kwezoQoqosho. Ulwazi: Ulwazi ngokulandela imiqathango yoluntu. Ukusebenza okumandla kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo. Imiqathango yamathanga amakhulu; Imiqathango yoluntu ekulawulwa yayo kwiSebe; Imigaqo yoluntu ekulungele ukuba ihlele kakuhle ngokuhamba kwexesha; Ukuhlalulwa koluntu ngokwesithintathelwa kweqesha ekuqwalaselwa ngemigaqo yenqanaba eliphezulu ekulungele iimfuno zesimanje ekwindlu eqondwe ngayo kwelaseMzantsi Afrika; Iziseko ezingekho ezakulunge iqesha ekulungele ukuba kuzakwe kakhulu. Indlela ezokuzisebenzela ngayo ekulungele iqesha xa lisakuba ngamaphakama ngenye imini ekunge. Ulwazi ngokusebenza kwindlu eqondwe ngayo ngokomthetho wezeNgqungquthela. Ukukwazi ukuchaza nangokusingatha iingxoxo ezahlukeneyo; Ulwazi olukhulu lokuchaza nangokusingatha iingxoxo ezahlukeneyo; Ukusebenza kakuhle ngokomndilili wemfundo.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuhlalulwa okusebenzayo nokusebenza kakuhle kwemithombo ephathelene nayo ngenjongo yokuphuhliswa kwemigaqo yepropati nemithetho; Thatha umba kwangomzimba kwaye uchaze ngeendleko zegumbi phakathi kwamaphepha amhlophe alikhoyo kunye neenjongo zamangangaphakathi okuqwalaselwayo okwamananje nezinto eziphuhliswayo ezibandakanya umthamo weqesha elipropati; Qamba ngokutsha izinto ezithintela ishishini lepropati ekuqwalaselweni. Qhuba izifundo kwimihombo ephathelene naleyo yehlabathi lepropati eqinisekiswe yiSebe; Dibana nababanjwa isihlombe kulabo bonke abathintekayo; Hlaziya amaphepha eqondo ekuzakuba ngumbalwa ophangalelwe kakhulu ekusebenzeni koRhulumente; Ukuseta imiqathango emihlanu nemiceli yokunikela inkuthazo. Gcoba kuqwalaselwa ngokuhamba kwexesha imisebenzi ehamba noPhuhliso kweso rhulumente; Qhuba izifundo ekuxoxwa ngazo kwipropati eqinisekiswe liSebe ngokusebenza kweziko elisebenza ngayo ngase mthethweni wokulandela imiqathango yoluntu; Hlola izifundo ezisebenza kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo, ziquka iindawo ezinomthetho nadinga ukusetyenziswa kwazo zoluntu ekungeniseni iinkcukacha eziqingatha okuvela kutho zisenze iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo kuqwalaselwa kwepropati nokusebenza komgaqo-nkqo wokuthweswa izidanga kunye nomyolezamo wokuphuhliswa kwabasebenzi abakwindawo yesebe ekusebenzeni; Hlola amacebo okusebenzisa iinkqubo ezingathathwa ngokulawulwayo ngokuvumelana neenzululwazi ezahlukeneyo ezifundwa kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo kunye neempahla ezahlukeneyo zoluntu kunye nasekuphuhlisweni kwabasebenzi ngokomthetho wokulawula iindawo ezahlukeneyo. Qwalasela isimo esiyingozi kumzi wenqanaba elifanelekileyo lokungena ngokusebenza kwisebe njengesidumbu kwiphiko eligqibele lokuqinisekisa. Qhuba nokuba ngummandwa wokuqinisekiswa kwabantu abatsha bokulawula. Lawula iSebe ngokutsha ekungezeni amaphepha abakuzo aze achaze ngemisebenzi ahamba nayo xa encediswa kuluntu ngasemva kokulawula abasebenzi ngabasemagunyeni kwilungu elingange aze azikhumbuze ngokomgaqo-nkqo woluntu eqondwa ngokulawula imisebenzi yesebe.

jobs.title: Control Works Manager: Mechanical and Electrical
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Manage mechanical and electrical maintenance and repairs at state-owned facilities in Nelspruit, requiring an engineering qualification and registration as an engineering technician.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 6) (T/N/S Streams) with appropriate experience in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering or (N3 plus trade test certificate in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering with a Registration as an Engineering Technician and more than 6 years appropriate experience). The candidate must be in possession of a valid driver’s license. Applicable knowledge and understanding of PFMA, OHSA, National Building Regulations and Building Standards, Project Management, Property and Facilities Management, Government procurement processes and systems. willing to travel and computer literate. Ability to manage, negotiate, plan, communicate and work under pressure. Professional registration will serve as an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Ensure appropriate maintenance and repairs of electrical and mechanical installations and components in the state-owned facilities to the required standards as guided by Laws and Regulations. Ensure registration and listing of all components and installations to the facilities register. Plan and execute the service contracts of mechanical and electrical installations and contribute extensively to the budgeting process for maintenance. Manage expenditure of day-to-day maintenance budget as per PFMA. Ensure compliance with OHSA, National Building Regulations Act. Manage and monitor performance of Chief Works Managers and ensure implementation of PMDS.

jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. af.title: Beheer Werke Bestuurder: Meganies en Elektries
af.summary: Bestuur meganiese en elektriese onderhoud en herstelwerk by staatsbesitte fasiliteite in Nelspruit, wat 'n ingenieurskwalifikasie en registrasie as 'n ingenieurstegnikus vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum driejaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 6) (T/N/S Strome) met toepaslike ervaring in Elektriese of Meganiese Ingenieurswese of (N3 plus ambagsertifikaat in Elektriese of Meganiese Ingenieurswese met Registrasie as 'n Ingenieurstegnikus en meer as 6 jaar toepaslike ervaring). Die kandidaat moet in besit wees van 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie. Toepaslike kennis en begrip van PFMA, OHSA, Nasionale Bouregulasies en Boustandaarde, Projekbestuur, Eiendom en Fasiliteitebestuur, Regeringsverkrygingsprosesse en -stelsels. Gewillig om te reis en rekenaargeletterd. Vermoë om te bestuur, te onderhandel, te beplan, te kommunikeer en onder druk te werk. Professionele registrasie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien.
af.duties: Verseker toepaslike onderhoud en herstelwerk van elektriese en meganiese installasies en komponente in die staatsbesitte fasiliteite tot die vereiste standaarde soos gelei deur Wette en Regulasies. Verseker registrasie en lys van alle komponente en installasies by die fasiliteite-register. Beplan en voer die dienskontrakte van meganiese en elektriese installasies uit en dra breedvoerig by tot die begrotingsproses vir onderhoud. Bestee bestee bestuursbesteding van die dag-tot-dag onderhoudsbegroting volgens PFMA. Verseker nakoming van OHSA, Nasionale Bouregulasies-wet. Bestuur en monitor prestasie van Hoof Werke Bestuurders en verseker implementering van PMDS.

zu.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Yokulawula: Umshini kanye Nombane
zu.summary: Ukuphathwa kokugcinwa nokulungiswa kwemishini nombane ezindaweni zikahulumeni eNelspruit, okudinga iziqu zobunjiniyela nokubhaliswa njengomuntu oqeqeshiwe emkhakheni wobunjiniyela.
zu.requirements: Isidingo seminyaka emithathu yesiqu sezikole ephakeme (NQF Level 6) (T/N/S Streams) ngolwazi olufanele kwi-Electrical noma Mechanical Engineering noma (N3 kanye nesitifiketi somsebenzi wesikhundla kwi-Electrical noma Mechanical Engineering nokuBhaliswa njengo-Engineering Technician kanye neminyaka engaphezu kuka-6 yolwazi olufanele). Umphakeli kufanele abe nelayisensi yokushayela ethi ngokusemthethweni. Ulwazi nokwazi i-PFMA, i-OHSA, i-National Building Regulations and Building Standards, i-Project Management, i-Property and Facilities Management, izinqumo zokuthenga zahulumeni kanye namasistimu. Ukuze ukwazi ukuhamba ube nolwazi lwekhompyutha. Ikhono lokuphatha, ukuxoxisana, ukucubungula, ukuxhumana kanye nokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkulumo. Ukubhaliswa ngobunjiniyela kuzoba yinzuzo eyengeziwe.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukugcinwa nokulungiswa okufanele kwezinhlelo zombane nemishini ezindaweni zikahulumeni ngokwezinga elidingwa njengokuqondiswa nguMthetho kanye Nomthethonqondo. Qinisekisa ukubhaliswa nokubhalwa kwengxenye yazo zonke izingxenye kanye nezinhlelo kusiqaleko sezindawo. Cubungula futhi ufeke izinkontileka zokusebenza zezemishini nombane, usize kakhulu inqubo yokwenza iholo lemisebenzi. Phatha ukuchithwa kwemali yansuku zonke ebalwa njengeholo ngokuka-PFMA. Qinisekisa ukuthobela i-OHSA, i-National Building Regulations Act. Phathe futhi ulawule ukusebenza kwabaphathi abakhulu bemisebenzi bese qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwe-PMDS.

xh.title: Mola wezoMsebenzi wokuLawula: iMekhanikal ne-elektrikal
xh.summary: Lawula ukonakalisa nokulungisa kwezakwoMsebenzi zombane netimekaniki kumaziko evela kurhulumente apha eNelspruit, kufuneka ube nesigqibo sezobuqwathi nangomhla wokubhalisa njengotitshala wamaphutukrhs (technician) wezoNjiniyelwa.
xh.requirements: Isigqibo esingaphantsi kwamaxesha amathathu ezifundo eziphakamileyo (NQF Level 6) (T/N/S Streams) kunye namava afanelekileyo kwezoNjiniyelwa zomBane okanye zamaGqabhaza-Dubula, okanye (N3 plus trade test certificate kwezoNjiniyelwa zomBane okanye zamaGqabhaza-Dubula kunye noBhaliso njengoQqambi wezoNjiniyelwa wamava angaphezu kweminyaka elithandathu (6). Umzobo kufuneka abe nelayisensi yokushayela ekusebenzayo. Ulwazi olusebenzayo nokuqonda iPFMA, iOHSA, iNational Building Regulations and Building Standards, ukuLawulwa kweeProjekthi, ukuLawulwa kweePropoti nokuLawulwa kwezaHlangothi/zeNdawo ezingaziwa ngokuba ziiFacilities, iinkqubo nendlela zorhwebo karhulumente. ulungele ukuhamba kwaye uthethe ngokwekhompyutha. Ulawulo, ukuqeqesha, ulungelelwaniso, unxibelelwano, nokuSebenza phantsi koxinzelelo. Ubhaliso njengomYili kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelekayo.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukonakaliswa nokulungiswa kolungelelwaniso nezinto eziliqhagamshela kumzila wakhoGqabhaza-Dubula kwindawo ezakhelwa ngowarhulumente ukuze kufikelelwe kwemigangatho efunwayo ngokomthetho nangemigaqo eqondwayo. Qinisekisa ukubhaliswa nokubhalwa koludwe lwazo zonke izinto nolungelelwaniso kwabhalo lweziNdwendwe. Cwangcisa kwaye uphumeze iinkqubo zokuNika inkonzo yolungelelwaniso lwamaGqabhaza-Dubula nokuNceda kakhulu kwindlela yokwakha ibhajeti yokonakaliswa. Lawula indlela yokuchithwa kolwabiwo mali wemihla yonke njengoko kulindelekwe ngumthetho wePFMA. Qinisekisa ukwamkelwa kolwazi olumiselwe ngeOHSA, umthetho weNational Building Regulations. Lawula kwaye ulawule ukusebenza ngemigaqo ephezulu koManyuze weMisebenzi weQhina eliya kusekela ukuphunyezwa kokuQeqeshwa ngokweenkcukacha ngokusebenza ngokwemigaqo yamawebhusayithi ePalamente wezohlu lwesoLwazi emandla.
