zu.title: Umcebisi weNduna: Ukulahlwa kwezimpahla Ezingasetshenziswa
zu.summary: Umcebisi weNduna ophethe ukulahlwa kwezimpahla eziyamukelekayo ezingasetshenziswa esikhungweni sesifunda iNelspruit, ofuna iziqu ezingaphezulu kwezemfundo ezindlini noma ezenza impahla.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphezulu kwesikhathi esingeminyaka emithathu ze-tertiary (NQF Level 6) ku-Real Estate Management, Property Management, Law/Property law, Land Administration, Valuation, Town or Regional Planning noma iziqu ezihlotshaniswe nempahla. Okuhlomula okusemthethweni olukhulu. Ulwazi: I-Public Finance Management Act. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Imininingwane nezinqumo zokuthenga. Ukucubungula amaphrojekthi namaphrogremu. Izindlela zokubika. I-GIAMADISPOSAL ACT. I-Deeds. I-Registry Act. I-Financial Assistance Land Act (FALA) BBBEE. Imininingwane ye-Treasury. Amandla: Ukubika. Ukubala kwezimali namakhadi. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Amandla okuxhumana. Amandla okuxhumana nabantu. Amandla okuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuhlela nokulungiselela. Ukugqwayiza ngamaphoyisa nezindlela zokuqedela. Ukuzigqaja. Ukuzinikela kubantu nakumakhili. Ukusebenza ngobuciko. Amandla okusebenza kumadinga eziqine. Ukusebenza kanzima. Amandla okuxhumana kumazinga onke.
zu.duties: Qalisa futhi ukhulise izinqumo eziphatha izindlu neminye imisebenzi: Qalisa futhi ukhulise izinqumo eziphatha izindlu neminye imisebenzi. Nikeza imininingwane ngokulandela imithetho yokusebenza. Yedlulise onke amaphoyisa aphaathwayo abantu kubantu abahlobene. Hlela inqubo yokulahla izindlu ezingasetshenziswa: Nikeza imininingwane ngomsebenzi wokuqaphela izindlu ezithathwa njengeziqhenya ezingasetshenziswa. Hlela futhiusize inqubo yokuziqaphela. Yenza ukuhlola ukuthola isimo sezindlu. Hlela ukukhishwa kwesithiyo somhlaba ukuze kuqedele imigomo ye-Government Land Reform: (Restitution, Distribution, Human Settlements development). Hlela futhi usize inqubo. Qinisekisa ubunikazi bomhlaba ongawedlulisa. Hlela ukukhishwa kwesithiyo somhlaba ukuze kuqedele imigomo ye-Government Land Reform: - (Restitution, Distribution, Human Settlements development). Hlela futhi usize inqubo. Qinisekisa ubunikazi bomhlaba ongawedlulisa. Faka isandla ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza okuphumelelayo kokuphathwa kwempahla: (Conveyancing and disposal from PMIS). Hlela futhi usize ukuqoqa imibhalo. Qinisekisa ukuthi imiyalezo ifike e-Office of the State Attorney. Yamukela imibhalo leyo ebekwe i-Office of the State Attorney. Qaphela abasebenzi ukuthi basebenza kahle.

xh.title: Umcedisi weNkulumbuso: Ukulahla iRems
xh.summary: Umcedisi weNkulumbuso wokulahla ipropati ezingafunekiyo nenezithile ezingenziwa nto ezinokunyuka zihamba eNkantolo yeSithili yeNelspruit, efuneka isitifiketi semfundo ephakamileyo ekulawulweni kwepropati okanye ekulawulweni kwezindlu.
xh.requirements: Isigqibo semfundo ephakamileyo esingaphantsi kwamashumi amathathu eminyaka (NQF Level 6) ekulawulweni kweReal Estate, ekulawulweni kwepropati, kuMthetho/umthetho wepropati, eNkulawulweni komhlaba, ekuqwalaselweni, eCebo losixeko okanye esithili okanye kwisifundo esithunyelweyo epropati Uluhlu lokuqalisa kwinkalo. Ulwazi: Umthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente. Ulawulo lweimali. Iimiyalelo nendlela zokuthenga. Uqalelo lweenkqubo namaphuzu amakhulu okusingathwa. Iindlela zokuxela. Umthetho we-GIAMADISPOSAL. Izindlu. Umthetho woBhalo. Umthetho woNcedo lweMali womHlaba (FALA) i-BBBEE. Iimali zeNqanaba lezo zibangelwa ngumthetho. Amakhono: Ukubhala ingxelo. Amakhono ezibalo nemifanekiso. Ukuqonda ngokuhlalutya. Amakhono okunxibelelwana. Amakhono obudlelwane phakathi kwabantu. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki. Ukuqamba nokuqulunqa. Ukuqonda ngokujoliswa kweliso kumgaba nosombululo. Ukuzimisela. Ukuqonda ngokujoliswa kweliso kubantu nakumaxhaswa. Ukwenza izinto ngeendlela ezintsha. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi kwezimeko ezinzima. Ukusebenza ngamandla. Amandla okunxibelelana kuzo zonke iinqanaba.
xh.duties: Ukuqalisa kugcine iinkqubo, iindlela namacebo okulawula ipropati: Qalisa ugcine iinkqubo, iindlela neesiseko ezilawula ipropati.nika inkqubo ngenkqubo yokuziphatha ngokwemigaqo, iimvume nendlela ezinxulumene nayo. Yezisa zonke iinkqubo nendlela ezilawula ipropati kwabahlumele babalulekileyo. Linganisa inkqubo yokulahla ipropati zangaphakathi ezingafunekiyo nezehla ngamandla: Nike inkqubo ngenkqubo yokuchonga ipropati zangaphakathi ezingafunekiyo nezehla ngamandla eziza kudityaniswa. Linganisa futhi usekele inkqubo yokuchonga ipropati zangaphakathi ezingafunekiyo nezehla ngamandla. Qwalasele ukuqinisekisa isimo/izimo zepropati zangaphakathi ezingafunekiyo nezehla ngamandla. Linganisa inkqubo yokukhulula izigqibi zomhlaba ezingenamntu ukuze kufezelwe iinjongo zoLwazi oluPhambili lukaRhulumente: (Ukubuyiselwa, ukuHlaba-hlaba, ukuSungulwa kwezindlu) Linganisa futhi usekele inkqubo yokuchonga izigqibi zomhlaba ezingenamntu eziza kukhululwa. Qinisekisa isimo sobunikelo bamasahlulela umhlaba ongenamntu onezelelweyo. Linganisa inkqubo yokukhulula izigqibi zomhlaba ezingenamntu ukuze kufezelwe iinjongo zoLwazi oluPhambili lukaRhulumente: - (Ukubuyiselwa, ukuHlaba-hlaba, ukuSungulwa kwezindlu) Linganisa futhi usekele inkqubo yokuchonga izigqibi zomhlaba ezingenamntu eziza kukhululwa. Qinisekisa isimo sobunikelo bamasahlulela umhlaba ongenamntu onezelelweyo. Navye ekuphuculeni ukusebenza okunamandla nangempumelelo ekulawulweni kwepropati yelizwe: (Ukuhambisa nokulahla kwi-PMIS) Linganisa futhi usekele ukuqokelela imibhalo yokuqala yokuhambisa nokuDlulisa. Qinisekisa ukuba kuye kufike imiyalelo eKantolo lomGwebi welizwe. Yamkele uYilo lomThetho weNkulumbuso namaxwebhu okuDlulisa avela eKantolo lomGwebi welizwe kulungiselelo loGunya loKuzinikelaokusayina. Qwalasele abasebenzi ukuze kubekho ukusebenza okunamandla nokwenza izinto zibe sezantsi.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Occupational Health & Safety
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Assistant Director overseeing Occupational Health and Safety compliance at the Gqeberha Regional Office of the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF level 06) / National Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical). Relevant years of experience in a build environment field including experience at a supervisory level. (Safety Management qualification / Certificate will serve as an added advantage). Extensive knowledge of the build environment. Application and understanding of the Occupational Health & Safety Act, 85 of 1993 and other relevant acts and regulations. Understanding of the National Building Standards (SANS10400) and its prescripts including Municipality by laws. Understanding of the procedures with moved regard to the safe operation of the Lifts, Boilers, Incinerators, stand-by generators and water treatment plant equipment. Basic knowledge of the Departmental Policies and Procedures, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Good verbal and written communication skills. Computer literacy. Good interpersonal relations. Problem solving skills, listening and observation, Negotiations, conflict management and leadership skills. Incident investigation, report writing and presentation skills. Valid driver’s license. Prepared to travel and willing to adapt to working schedule in accordance with the office requirements.
jobs.duties: Ensure and facilitate the implementation of the Occupational Health and Safety Act and regulations within the Region. Effectively manage general administration and safety regulations. Conduct proactive and reactive inspection in a state and leased facilities including construction projects. Facilitate the issuance of the occupancy certificate for various facility issued by the local authority. Ensure workplaces are accessible to people with disabilities. Conduct incidents investigation and generate the report recommendation. Facilitate the appointment of health & safety representative, First Aiders and Fire Marshals. Facilitate the training sessions for health safety committee members including the information sessions. Compile and conduct presentations and facilitation the activation of the emergency evacuation procedures in accordance with the building regulation & Municipality by-laws. Provide technical advice to clients’ departments and attend internal and external meetings on OHS matters. Consolidate the monthly/quarterly and annual reports for the OHS directorate in the regions.
jobs.applications: for the position of Assistant Director: Occupational Health & Safety must be emailed to: RecruitPE26-43@dpw.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /SMS-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. IMPORTANT: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur wat toesig hou oor Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid-nakoming by die Gqeberha Streekkantoor van die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum driedeurige tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF level 06) / Nasionale Diploma in Ingenieurswese (Meganies). Relevante jare ervaring in 'n bou-omgewingsveld, insluitend ervaring op toesighoudende vlak. (Veiligheidsbestuur-kwalifikasie / Sertifikaat sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien). Uitgebreide kennis van die bou-omgewing. Toepassing en begrip van die Occupational Health & Safety Act, 85 of 1993 en ander relevante wette en regulasies. Begrip van die National Building Standards (SANS10400) en sy voorskrifte, insluitend Munisipale verordeninge. Begrip van die prosedures met betrekking tot die veilige bedryf van hyisers, ketels, verbrandingsoonde, noodkragopwekkers en watertestingsaanlegtoerusting. Basiese kennis van die Departementele Beleide en Prosedures, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede, luister en waarneming, onderhandelings-, konflikbestuurs- en leierskapsvaardighede. Voorvalondersoek, verslagskryf en voorstellingsvaardighede. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bereid om te reis en gewillig om aan te pas by werkskedules in ooreenstemming met die kantoorvereistes.
af.duties: Verseker en fasiliteer die implementering van die Occupational Health and Safety Act en regulasies binne die Streek. Bestuur algemene administrasie en veiligheidsregulasies effektief. Voer proaktiewe en reaktiewe inspeksies uit in staats- en huurfasiliteite, insluitend konstruksieprojekte. Fasiliteer die uitreiking van die bewys van bewoning vir verskeie fasiliteite wat deur die plaaslike owerheid uitgereik word. Verseker dat werkplekke toeganklik is vir persone met gestremdhede. Voer voorvalondersoeke uit en genereer die verslag se aanbevelings. Fasiliteer die aanstelling van gesondheids- en veiligheidsverteenwoordigers, Eerste Hulp-verskaffers en Brandmaarskalke. Fasiliteer oefensessies vir lede van die gesondheids- en veiligheidskomitee, insluitend inligtingsessies. Stel voorstellings op en voer dit uit, en fasiliteer die aktivering van die noodevaluasieprosedures in ooreenstemming met die gebouregulasies en Munisipale verordeninge. Verskaf tegniese advies aan kliëntdepartemente en woon interne en externe vergaderings oor OHS-aangeleenthede by. Konsolideer die maandelikse/kwartaallikse en jaarlikse verslae vir die OHS-direktoraat in die streke.

zu.title: Umsizi Weqonga: Ukuphepha Kwezempilo Nokuphepha Esebenzini
zu.summary: Umsizi Weqonga oqapha ukuthobela imithetho Yokuphepha Kwezempilo Nokuphepha Esebenzini Ekhishini Langesifundazwe i-Gqeberha leMnyango Wezomsebenzi Womphakathi Nomphakathi.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esingezansi se-Minyaka yeminyaka yonke yeziqu ezingaphezulu (NQF level 06) / Isatifikethi Sezwe eNjenini (Yomshini). Eminyakeni yokuhlangenwe nakho enezinga kuleyo ndawo yokwakha kufaka phakathi nokuhlangenwe nakho kwesigaba sokubeka. Isiqu lesiqu / isatifikethi sokuphepha sezeBhalwe njengento ebangethwe ngcono. Ulwazi olujulile ngesimo sezakhiwo. Ukusetshenziswa nokukuqonda iMthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Esebenzini, 85 of 1993 kanye namanye amathetho nemithetho ehlobene. Ukuqonda Izilinganiso Zokwakha Kwesizwe (SANS10400) nokumiswa kwawo kuhlanganisa imithetho kaMasipala. Ukuqonda izinqumela ezithinteka ukuphepha okuhlotshaniswa nokusebenza kweLift, Ama-boiler, Izitsha zokushiswa, ama-generator okumi naye kanye namapulanga ezingozi amanzi. Ulwazi lwasemqoka lwezinqubomgomo nezinqubo zeMnyango, uMthetho Wezimali Kahulumeni Womphakathe (PFMA). Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Ukusebenzisana nekhompyutha. Ubudlelwano obuhle kantu abantu. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, ukulalela nokuqaphela, Ukuxoxisana, ukuphatha izinkinga kanye namakhono okuba ngumholi. Uphenyo lwezehlakalo, ukubhala imibiko kanye namakhono okubumba. Ilayisensi yokushayela. Ukulungele ukuhamba nokuthanda ukuzivumelana nohlelo lokusebenza ngokwezidingo zesikhungo.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa futhi uhlose ukusetshenziswa koMthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Esebenzini emithethweni ngaphakathi Kwisifunda. Phatha ngempumelelo ukulawulwa okujwayelekileyo kanye namathetho okuphepha. Yenza ukhangelo okuyilungele nokuzibandakanya izikhungo zikahulumeni ezinikezwe abanye kuhlanganise namaprojekthi owakhiyo. Hlose ukunikwa kocwadiso lokusebenzisa izinkomishi ezinikezwe ugwegwana lommandla. Qinisekisa ukuthi izikhungo zokusebenza zitholakala kubantu abasuke khona. Yenza uphenyo lwezehlakalo usuke ukhiqize ukumiswa kwesincoko. Hlose ukubekwa kwabameluleki bokuze kwenzeke kwiNdawo yokuhlolwa kwezempilo nezokuphepha, abasizi bokuphuma kubaphephileyo. Hlose izikhathi zokuqeqesha kwelunga lokuqeqesha ukuphepha ngokuhlangenwe nakho, ngokuhlanganisa ukuze kwazi konke. Hlela futhi wenze izibonakaliso nokulandelwa kokukhishwa kwabantu kwezinsiza eziyisicupho ngokuhambisana nemithetho yokwakha kanye nemithetho kaMasipala. Nikeza izeluleki zezobuchwepheshe kumadepartimenti abakhasimeli futhi ubhukude emihlanganweni yangaphakathi nangaphandle kwezindaba ze-OHS. Hlanganisa imibiko yenyanga/zinyanga zingxenye nenyanga ngononngakhona ye-OHS Directorates kumimango.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso: UkuKhuselwa kweMpilo yabaSebenzi noKhuseleko
xh.summary: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso ongumniki wokuqonda nokuhambelana nemigaqo yokuKhuselwa kweMpilo yabaSebenzi noKhuseleko eKantolo loNdwelwane laseGqeberha leSebe loMsebenzi woWakhiwo nokuZinza.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esingaphantsi kwamashumi amathathu esidanga sinyanga (NQF level 06) / Isidanga seZizwe kwiNjinoli ( yeMishini). Iiminyaka ephathwa ngayo yamava kwindawo yokuwakha ngokubandakanya amava kwinqanaba lokulawula. (Isidanga / Isatifikethi sokulawula uKhuseleko siza kuba lusizo olongezelelekileyo). Ukuqonda okubanzi ngendawo yokwakha. Ukusebenzisa nokuqonda uMthetho wokuKhuselwa kweMpilo yabaSebenzi, 85 ka-1993 namanye oomthetho ophathwa ngawo nemigaqo ekhoyo. Ukuqonda iMigaqo yoWakhiwo yeZwelonke (SANS10400) nokuqondwa kwayo ngokubandakanya imigaqo kaMasipala. Ukuqonda iindlela ezisetyenziswa ngokuphephileyo kokuSebenza kweLifts, iiBoilers, iiIncinerators, iistand-by generators nemishini yesixhobo sophuhliso lwamanzi. Ulwazi olusisiseko lweMigaqo nendlela zoMsebenzi weSebe, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA). Amakhono amabaliso ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu. Amakhono oksombulula iingxaki, ulalelo nokutyhila, ukuCocwa, ukulawula ingxabano namakhono okuba ngumntu ophambili. Uphononongo lwezenzakalo, ukubhala iingxelo namakhono okubonisa. Ilayisense yokushuka. Ukulungiselela ukuhamba nokuzithoba ekulawulweni kwexesha lokusebenza ngokwemfuno yekantilo.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa uze uncede ukusebenziswa koMthetho wokuKhuselwa kweMpilo yabaSebenzi nemigaqo ngaphakathi kuWommandla. Lawula ngempumelelo ukulawulwa kokubhala okubanzi nemigaqo yokhuseleko. Yenza ukuqaphela okungayilanga nongayilanga tyala kwindawo zikarhulumente nokuqashwa ze kubandakanya imigcaqo yokuwakha. Uncede ukunikwa isatifikethi sokuhlala kwindawo ngeziqu ezahlukeneyo ezinikelwa ligunya lendawo. Qinisekisa ukuba iindawo zokusebenza zifikeleleka ngokulula kubantu abakhubazekileyo. Yenza uphononongo lwezenzakalo uze uvelise ingxelo yezindululo. Uncede ukubekwa komntu omele impilo noxolo abambe iqhaza, abantu abakhusa ngeSiza xa kunexeshoba nabagcini bamlilo. Unceda iindibano zokufundisa abalungu bekomiti lokhuseleko lwempilo ngokubandakanya iindibano yolwazi. Qamba uze wenze iinkcazelo nokucaleliswa kokwenziwa kweenkqubo zokusishiwa koluntu ngokuhambelana nemigaqo yokuwakhiwa namagqabantshi kaMasipala. Nikeza ingcebiso ngamandla kumasebe abathengi uze uzihlanganise kwindibano zangaphakathi nangaphandle kwezomkhwa wokuKhuseleka kweMpilo yabaSebenzi. Hlanganisa iingxelo nyanga zinye/kota yexeshoba nezonyaka zekomkhulu lesebe ngokwalo mmandla.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Demand Management
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Coordinate the regional procurement plan, draft terms of reference, and manage procurement initiation processes for the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Gqeberha.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 06)/ National Diploma in Supply Chain Management or Logistics or Procurement or Finance or Auditing or similar related qualification. Relevant years of working experience in Supply Chain Management Demand and or Supply Chain Management Acquisition of which relevant years working experience must be on a supervisory level in Demand and or Acquisition Management. Experience in Infrastructure Procurement Demand or Acquisition Management will serves as an added advantage. A valid Driver’s license. Goede mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede; basiese syferkennis; gevorderde interpersoonlike en diplomasie-vaardighede; probleemoplossingsvaardighede; besluitnemingsvaardighede; vermoë om onder stresvolle omstandighede te werk; vermoë om op alle vlakke te kommunikeer; vermoë om selfstandig te werk. Bereid om werkskedule in ooreenstemming met kantoorvereistes aan te pas. Moet oor die volgende vaardighede beskik: voorlegging, verslagskrywing, syferkennis, kommunikasie en probleemoplossing. Rekenaargeletterd.
af.duties: Koördineer die opstel van die Streeksinkoopplan en verseker behoorlike administrasie en koördinasie van die goedgekeurde Inkoopplan. Bestuur die nominasies van verskaffers van voorafgoedgekeurde panele vir RFQ vir alle nakomende gebruikersversoeke binne 3 werksdae na ontvangs. Konsolideer en dien die kwartaalverslae van die uitvoering van die inkoopplan in. Verseker dat SCM-voorskrifte en prosesse nagekom word in ooreenstemming met die inkoopstrategie. Bepaal of spesifikasies enige spesiale voorwaardes moet bevat. Koördineer Bodspesifikasiekomitees. Verseker volledige administrasie van die Bodspesifikasiekomitee. zu.title: Umengu weNhloko: Ukuphathwa Kwesidingo
zu.summary: Kuhlanganise icebo lokuthenga lendawo, kubhalwe izimo zokubhekiswa, futhi kuphathe inqubo yokuqalisa ukuthenga komnyango Wezomsebenzi Womphakathi Nezokwakha eGqeberha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikole samaphakathi ezithatha iminyaka emithathu (NQF Level 06)/ i-Diploma Yezwe ekuphathweni kwenhlangano yezinsiza noma Ekuhambiseni noma Ekuthengeni noma Kwezimali noma Ekuhloleni noma eyunifomu ehambisana naleyo. Uhambo oluhambisana lweminyaka yokusebenza ekuphathweni kwenhlangano yezinsiza Isidingo kanye noma ekuphathweni kwenhlangano yezinsiza Ekuhwebeni okuyiminako iminyaka yokusebenza kumele ibe ngazinga lobuhlule ekuphathweni kwesidingo noma kwesidingo sokuthenga. Uhambo ekuThengeni kwezokwakha ukuphathwa kwesidingo noma kwesidingo sokuthenga kuzosiza njengenye ihele. Ilayisensi yokushayela eqinisekisiwe. Ulwazi olujulile futhi ukuqonda izimiso zokuthenga kahulumunde nomthetho ohambisana nokuphathwa kwenhlangano yezinsiza; umthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali zomphakathi; inqondo kanye nendlela yokubeka izinto kanye nokuqashwa; izimiso zokubeka izinto kanye nokuqashwa. Amandla okukhuluma nokubhala kahle; ukubala okuyisisekelo; amandla aphakeme okuxhumanana nabantu kanye nobugqi; amandla okuxazula izinkinga; amandla okuthatha izinqumo; ikono lokusebenza ezimeni ezinomfutho; ikono lokuxhumana kwawo onke amanqanaba; ikono lokusebenza kodwa. Ukuzimisela ukulungiselela isikhathi sokusebenza ngokohlelo lwezidingo zohhovu. Kumele abe nokuze kule mathuba: ukubamba inkulumo yokwethula, ukubhala umbiko, ukubala, ukuxhumana, kanye nokuxazula izinkinga. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Ukuhlanganisa ukuqamba icebo lokuthenga lesifunda futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa okulungile kanye nokuhlanganisa icebo lokuthonga elivunyiwe. Kuqinisekiswe ukuhlanganisa ukubhalwa kwezimo zokubhekiswa/izinkomba. Kunikezwa usizo oluhambisana imisebenzi yesigaba ngenkathi kuqaliwa inqubo yokuthenga. Kuphatwe ukuqabisa abathengisi abakhethiwe kuma-panels okwamukelekwa kuma-RFQ wonke izicelo zomsebenzisi ezihambisana emini yokuqala yesithathu yokuthola. Kuhlanganisiwe futhi kuthunyelwe umbiko wekota ngayinye wokuqhuba icebo lokuthenga. Kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziyalezo ezinhle zokuphathwa kwenhlangano yezinsiza kanye nenqubo zilandatwa ngokohlelo lokuthenga. Kubonwe ukuthi izinkomba kumele zibe nemiqulu ekhethekile. Kuhlanganiswa ikomiti lezinkomba zokwenza isibhejo. Kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa okuphelele kwekomiti lezinkomba zokwenza isibhejo. Kubuzwe abasebenzi futhi kubhalwe izinkomba ze-tender/izinkomba njengoba kudingeka. Kubhalwa futhi kushicilelwa izicelo zemibhalo yemithengo kanye namabhijidi njengoba kudingeka. Kubuzwe abasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe isimo esizuze ekuphathweni kwesidingo.

xh.title: Umcebisi weNqanaba: ulawulo lokuFuna
xh.summary: Lungelelanisa icebo lokuthenga lendawo, lungelelanisa ulwabiwo lwezimagqibo, ulawule iinkqubo zokuqalisa ukuthenga kwisebe leZoLimo loMphakathi nokuZinzo eGqeberha.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zesikolo samabanga aphakamileyo zeminyaka emithathu (NQF Level 06)/ National Diploma kwakuLawula uQoqosho lwezinto ezihamba nenyathelo okanye iLogistics okanye ukuThenga okanye iNzuzo okanye ukuQinisekisa okanye ngesiqui elifanayo nelinxulumeneyo. Eminyaka elungeleleneyo yamava okusebenza ekulawulweni koQoqosho lwezinto ezihamba nenyathelo iDemand nakwilawulo lokuThenga kokuQoqosho lwezinto ezihamba nenyathelo apho iminyaka elungeleleneyo yamava kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lokulawula kulawulo lokuFuna nokulawula nokuThenga. Amaxesha amava ekuthengeni iZinfrastruktsha nokuFuna nokulawula ukuThenga kuya kuba ngumvuzo ongaphezulu. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ukuqonda ngokucokisekileyo nokuva ngononelo iinkqubo zikarhulumente zokuthenga nemigaqo ephathelene nokulawula uQoqosho lwezinto ezihamba nenyathelo; uMthetho wokuLawula iNzuzo yoLuntu; ingcamango nendlela yokulinganisela nokuqwalasela; iinkqubo zokulinganisela nokuqwalasela. Amakhono amabalwa mbalwa okuthetha nokubhala; isiphumo sezibalo; amakhono aphakamileyo abantu nokuba nobugcisa bokucinga; amakhono oksombathuxazi; amakhono okwenza izigqibo; isakhono sokusebenza kwimeko ezinzima; isakhono sokuvasiya kumanqanaba onke; isakhono sokusebenza kodwa. Ukuzimisela ukulungelelanisa uluhlu lwemisebenzi ngokwemfuno zehhovisi. Kufuneka abe nalamakhono: okuLungisa iLungelo, iNqaku, isiphumo, isixhobo, nokuxazulula iingxaki. Ulwazi lokusebenza ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Ukulungelelanisa ukuLungisa uLuhlu oluQulunqwa lokuThenga kwendawo waqinisekisa ulawulo olufaneleyo nolungelelaniso oluLuhlu oluVunyiweyo lokuThenga. Ukuqinisekisa ukulungelelanisa iLungelo oluLungiselelwa ulwabiwo lwezimagqibo. Unike inkxaso kumsebenzi womgca oovunyiweyo wokuqalisa inkqubo yokuthenga. ULawula amagama abathengisi beqela elivunyiwe kwangaphambili le-RQF kuyo yonke imiceli yomthengi ethobela imithetho phakathi kwamabhagquba angama-3 okusebenza ukususela kumini yokwamkela. Ukuqokelela kunye nokuhambisa iingxelo zesikwedlana zokuThenga uLuhlu oluSetyenziswa. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba imiyalelo ye-SCM neenkqubo zithobwa ngokwemigaqo yokuthenga. Ukugqiba ukuba iinkcazelo zifanele ukuba neemeko ezizelelwayo. ULungelelanisa amaQela oLungiselelwa iMibuthano. Ukuqinisekisa ulawulo olupheleleyo lweQela oLungiselelwa iMibuthano. Ukulawula abasebenzi nokuqokelela iinkcazelo ezithengwayo noma eziceliwayo njengoko kufuneka. Ukuqokelela ashicilele izicelo zamaxabiso namaMibuthano njengoko kufuneka. ULawula abasebenzi ukuqinisekisa inkonzo yokuFuna ephumeleleyo.

Good verbal and written communication and listening skills. Typing skills with knowledge of Call Logging systems. The candidates should be prepared to work 24/7 shifts, including weekends and holidays.
jobs.duties: Answer and/or make calls (inbound and/or outbound) and respond to emails. Handle customer (internal & external) inquiries both telephonically and by email. Research required information by clients (internal/external) using available resources. Manage and resolve customer (internal & external) complaints/queries/FM service requests, IT related faults etc. Enter and update new customer information into appropriate systems. Process orders, forms, applications and calls on relevant systems. Identify and escalate priority issues/queries according to available Call Centre and Facility Management business processes. Assign or route calls to appropriate resource and/or in line with the Call Centre call logging process. Follow up customer calls where necessary and update customers accordingly. Update all call information on relevant systems according to Call Centre standard operating procedures. Complete and/or close call logged on system as well as update with appropriate comments. Maintain and improve Service Level Agreement. Conduct customer service surveys. ENQUIRES : Ms L Skhosana Tel No: (012) 406 1286

af.title: Service Desk Agente: Onderhoud: Stelselbedrywighede
af.summary: Service Desk Agente benodig by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure om oproepe, e-pos en kliëntenavrae in 'n stelselbedrywighede-onhoudsrol te hanteer.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum Senior Certificate/Grade 12/ ekwivalente NQF Vlak 4 kwalifikasie. Relevante blootstelling in 'n kliëntediens-, ICT- of Fasiliteitsbestuursomgewing. Opleiding in telefoonetiket, kliëntediens en PFMA sal 'n voordeel wees. Rekenaarvaardighede soos 'n begrip van Ms Word, Excel, internetblaai, taaktoewysing en e-pos. Goeie verbale en skriftelike kommunikasie- en luistervaardighede. Tikvaardighede met kennis van oproep-aantekeningstelsels. Die kandidate moet bereid wees om 24/7-skofte te werk, insluitend naweke en vakansiedae.
af.duties: Beantwoord en/of maak oproepe (inkomende en/of uitgaande) en reageer op e-posse. Hanteer kliënt (interne & eksterne) navrae beide telefoonies en per e-pos. Doen navorsing oor vereiste inligting deur kliënte (intern/ekstern) met behulp van beskikbare hulpbronne. Bestuur en los kliënt (interne & eksterne) klagtes/navrae/FM-diensversoeke, IT-verwante foute ens. op. Voer nuwe kliëntinligting in en werk dit op in toepaslike stelsels. Verwerk bestellings, vorms, aansoeke en oproepe op relevante stelsels. Identifiseer en escaleer prioriteitskwessies/navrae volgens beskikbare Call Centre en Facility Management besigheidsprosesse. Wys oproepe toe of roeteer dit na toepaslike hulpbronne en/of in ooreenstemming met die Call Centre oproep-aantekeningsproses. Volg kliëntoproepe op waar nodig en lig kliënte dienooreenkomstig in. Werk alle oproepinligting op relevante stelsels op volgens Call Centre standaard bedryfsprosedures. Voltooi en/of sluit op die stelsel aangetekende oproepe af en werk dit by met toepaslike kommentaar. Handhaaf en verbeter Service Level Agreement. Voer kliëntediens-opnames uit. NAVRAE : Ms L Skhosana Tel No: (012) 406 1286

zu.title: Abasebenzi Bedesk Yesevisi: Ukugcinwa Kwezinto: Izisebenzi Zamasistimu
zu.summary: Kudingeka Abasebenzi Bedesk Yesevisi eDepartment of Public Works and Infrastructure ukuphatha amakhol, ama-imeyili nemibuzo yekhasimonde esikhundleni sokugcinwa kwezisebenzi zamasistimu.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Esiphezulu/Kuleya 12/ noma ifanelo elingana ne-NQF Level 4. Ukuvezwa okuhambisana nokusebenza endaweni yesevisi yekhasimonde, ICT noma Yolawulo Kwezinsiza. Ukuzifundela ngokuziphatha kumakholi, isevisi yekhasimonde kanye ne-PFMA kuzoba yinzuzo. Amakhono ekhompyutha anjengokuqonda i-Ms Word, Excel, Ukucinga kwi-Internet, ukwenza imisebenzi kanye nama-imeyili. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala okwenziwayo nakulalele. Amakhono okuthayipha anokusazilela ngamasistimu Okushicilela Amakholi. Abafaka izicelo kufanele bazibe ukuthi bazosebenza amashifu angu-24/7, okuhlanganisa amasonto namaholide.
zu.duties: Phendula futhi/wenza amakhol (okuqhamuka ngaphakathi futhi/weya ngaphandle) uphendule nama-imeyili. Phatha imibuzo yekhasimonde (yangaphakathi nangaphandle) ngokukhuluma efonini nangeyimeyili. Cwaninga ulwazi oludingwa amakhasimonde (angaphakathi/angaphandle) kusetshenziswa izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lawula uphumeze izikhalazo/imibuzo/ izicelo zesevisi ye-FM zikhasimonde (angaphakathi nangaphandle), amaphutha ahlobene ne-IT njll. Faka ubuyekeze ulwazi olusha lwekhasimonde kwizistimu ezifanele. Cubungula izimemo, amafomu, izicelo namakholi kwizistimu ezihambisanayo. Hlakaniphile ukhuphule izindaba/imibuzo edinga ukunakwa ngokuya ngeminikelo Yase Call Centre nezinqubo Zomabhizinisi Wolawulo Wezinsiza. Nika amakholi umuntu ofanele noma awaholele endleleni efanele nangokuhambisana nenqubo Yeshicilelo Lamakholi Ye Call Centre. Landela amakholi ekhasimonde lapho kudingeka khona ubuyekeze abakhasimonde ngokufanele. Buyekeza lonke ulwazi ngamakholi kwizistimu ezifanele ngokuhambisana nezinqubo Ezijwayelekile Zokusebenza Ze Call Centre. Qedelela/vala ikholi eloshicilelwe esistimini futhi uyibeke ngezimemo ezifanele. Gcina uthuthukise Isivumelwano Samazinga Esevisi. Yenza inhlolovo yesevisi yekhasimonde. IMIBUZO : Ms L Skhosana Tel No: (012) 406 1286

xh.title: Abasebenzi be-Service Desk: Ukulungisa: Iintshukubo zeNkqubo
xh.summary: Kufuneka abasebenzi be-Service Desk kwi-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure ukubamba amagama, ii-imeyile nimibuzo yabakhilyenti kwindima yokulungisa iintshukubo zenkqubo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Senior/Isiqalelo 12/ esalingana nengaba le-NQF Level 4. Uqonda oluhambelanayo kwindawo yenkonzo yabakhilyenti, i-ICT okanye i-Facilities Management. Uqeqesho lokuziphatha kufowuni, inkonzo yabakhilyenti ne-PFMA kuya kuba lusizo. Amakhono ekhompyutha afana nokuqonda i-Ms Word, i-Excel, ukucinga kwi-Internet, ukwenza umsebenzi nge-imeyile. Amakhono amahle okuthetha nokubhala nokulalela. Amakhono okuthayipha eloluqondileyo ngeenkqubo zokuLoga amagama. Kuya kufuneka abakhethiwebe bate mkhelwe ukusebenza i-24/7 shifts, kuquka iweekendi nangemihla yiholide.
xh.duties: Phendula kwaye/okanye uqhobe amagama (okungenayo nakuphuma) uphendule ii-imeyile. Phatha imibuzo yabakhilyenti (ngaphakathi nangaphandle) ngefowuni nakwi-imeyile. Phonononda ulwazi olufunwayo ngabakhilyenti (ngaphakathi/ ngaphandle) usetyenzise izixhobo ezikhoyo. Phatha uze usombulule iingxaki/imibuzo/izicelo zenkonzo ye-FM zabakhilyenti (ngaphakathi nangaphandle), iimpazamo ezinxulumene ne-IT, njl. Ngenisa uhlaziye intsingiselo entsha yabakhilyenti kwiinkqubo ezifanelekileyo. Cedula iiodolo, iifom, izicelo namagama kwiinkqubo ezinxulumene nalawo. Chonga uze unyuse iingxaka ezibalulekileyo/imibuzo ngokweenkqubo zobuCall Centre nobuFacility Management ezikhoyo. Yahlula okanye uqhonde amagama kumntu ofanelekileyo nokanye ngokweenkqubo zokuLoga amagama zeCall Centre. Landela umva ngamagama abakhilyenti apho kufunekileyo uze uhlaziye abakhilyenti ngoko. Hlaziya yonke intsingiselo yamagama kwiinkqubo ezifanelekileyo ngokweenkqubo ezisesikweni zokuSebenza zeCall Centre. Qedisa nokanye uvala igama eloLogiweyo kwinkqubo nakanye uhlaziye ngamazwi afanelekileyo. Gcina uze uphucule isiSazindo se-Service Level Agreement. Yenza iingxelo zovavanyo lenkonzo yabakhilyenti. IMIBUZO : uMs L Skhosana Tel No: (012) 406 1286

af.title: Rekeningklerk: Finansies (Lotbeheerder)
af.summary: Rekeningklerk (Lotbeheerder) by die DPWI Mthatha Streekkantoor, verantwoordelik vir die veilige bewaring van dokumente en lotbeheer onder die Staatsrekenaar.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van 'n Senior Sertifikaat/Graad 12. Geen ervaring vereis nie. Kennis van 'n finansiële omgewing. Kennis van tersaaklike wetgewing, regulasies en beleid. Goed ontwikkelde interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede, rekenaarvaardig, multitaakvaardighede, selfgedrewe, resultaatgerig, gemotiveerd, haal sperdatums en aanvaar verantwoordelikheid. Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Aan die Staatsrekenaar rapporteer, sal die ampshouer van hierdie pos verantwoordelikheid neem vir: Die hoofverantwoordelikheid van hierdie pos hou verband met die veilige bewaring en bestuur van dokumente (Lotbeheer), insluitend die monitering en beheer van die nakoming van deeglike rekenkundige en NPDW-praktyke, voorgeskrewe beleid en regulasies in alle transaksies. Monitor en beheer alle dokumente wat verband hou met die verskillende transversale stelsels. Verseker korrekte toewysing van besteding en inkomste. Trek finansiële en ander BAS-verslae ter ondersteuning van die aktiwiteite van die eenheid. Daar mag van die ampshouer verwag word om te help met die begrotingsformulering, die opstel van 'n kontantvloebegroting asook die maandelikse verslagdoening. Asook die verrigting van pligte wat verband hou met die kassierfunksies.

Ukuba namakhono abantu nokuxhumana, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukwazi ukwenza imisebenzi eminingi ngesikhathi esisodwa, ukuzibophezela, ukugxila kumiphumela, ukuzimotivatha, ukuhlangabeza izikhathi ezimisiwe nokwamukela izibopho. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukubika kuSikhalazi wezimali saseHulumeni lowo osebenza kulesi sikhundla uzothatha inza ngokulondolozwa okuphephile kwezimoto nokuphatwa kwamadokhumenti (Batch Control) okuhlanganisa ukubheka nokulawula ukuthi kuhlonatshwe njani amasu amahle ezimali nokuqondisa kwe-NPDW, imigumo nemilayo emisiwe kuyo yonke imiyalezo. Kubheke futhi ulawule yonke imibhalo ehlobene nezinhlelo ezihlukene eziyehla. Qinisekisa ukwabiwa okulungile kwemali echithwayo naleyokuqashwayo. Hudula imibiko yezimali, kanye nemiyalo evela kwi-BAS, ukwesekela imisebenzi yeqoqo. Kungadingeka kusizakale lowo osebenza kulesi sikhundla ekwakheni isabelo, ekuqoqeni isabelo se-cash flow kanye nokubika ngenyanga. Kuhlanganise nokwenza imisebenzi ehlobene nemisebenzi yomlawuli wemali etholwayo.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Human Capital Management
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum. This inclusive remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the states’ contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion that may be structured i.t.o. the applicable rules. The successful candidate will be required to enter into a performance agreement and to sign an employment contract.
jobs.summary: Chief Director overseeing human capital management for the Department of Social Development in Pretoria, requiring an NQF Level 7 qualification and five years' senior management experience.
jobs.requirements: A qualification at NQF Level 7 as recognised by SAQA in Human Resources Management, Industrial Psychology, Public Management, Public Administration or Business Administration Plus five (5) years’ experience in senior management level. Knowledge and understanding of the relevant Public Service Act and Regulation. Knowledge and understanding of SETA’s, SAQA, processes and curriculum development. Knowledge and understanding of performance management frameworks and best practice. Knowledge and understanding of Employment Equity Act and Labour Relations Act. Knowledge and understanding of Treasury Regulation and PFMA. Knowledge and understanding of dispute resolution, collective bargaining and CCMA process. Knowledge and understanding of EHWP. Knowledge and understanding of White Paper on Social Welfare. Knowledge of relevant policies and strategies pertaining to SSP. Understanding of National Gender Policy and Framework. Competencies needed: Strategic capability and leadership skills. Policy analysis and development skills. Budget planning and monitoring skills. Service delivery innovation skills. Programme and project management skills. Financial management skills. Information and knowledge management skills. Communication (verbal and written) skills. Problem solving and change management skills. People Management and empowerment skills. Client orientation and customer focus skills. Stakeholder management skills. Presentation and facilitation skills. Risk management skills. Conflict management skills. Monitoring and evaluation skills. Quality Management skills. Attributes: Good interpersonal relations. Ability to work under pressure. Innovation and creativity. Ability to work in a team and independently. Adaptability. Emotional intelligence. Independent thinker. Cost consciousness. Honesty and integrity. Assertiveness.
jobs.duties: Manage and facilitate the provision of human resource management services. Manage and coordinate the provision of employee relations and wellness services. Manage and facilitate the provision of training, development and performance management services. Manage and facilitate the development, review and monitor implementation of policies, regulations, guidelines, frameworks, norms and standards in relation to Social Service Professionals. Manage the implementation and mainstreaming of gender and disability throughout the organisation. Oversee, manage, and report on the budget, human resources, and performance of the chief directorate in line with the set regulations and prescripts.
jobs.applications: Please forward your application, quoting the relevant reference number, to the Director-General, Department of Social Development, Private Bag X901, Pretoria, 0001. Physical Address: HSRC Building, 134 Pretorius Street In the event of hand delivery of applications, applicants must sign an application register book as proof of submission. af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Menslike Kapitaalbestuur
af.summary: 'n Hoofdirekteur wat toesig hou oor menslike kapitaalbestuur vir die Departement van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling in Pretoria, wat 'n NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 7 soos deur SAQA erken in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, Bedryfsielkunde, Openbare Bestuur, Openbare Administrasie of Besigheidsadministrasie plus vyf (5) jaar se ondervinding op senior bestuursvlak. Kennis en begrip van die tersaaklike Openbare Dienswet en -regulasies. Kennis en begrip van SETA's, SAQA, prosesse en kurrikulumontwikkeling. Kennis en begrip van prestasiebestuursraamwerke en best practices. Kennis en begrip van die Wet op Arbeidsreg en Wet op Arbeidsverhoudinge. Kennis en begrip van Tesourie-regulasies en PFMA. Kennis en begrip van geskilbeslegting, kollektiewe onderhandeling en CCMA-prosesse. Kennis en begrip van EHWP. Kennis en begrip van die Witboek oor Maatskaplike Welsyn. Kennis van tersaaklike beleide en strategieë rakende die SSP. Begrip van die Nasionale Genderbeleid en -raamwerk. Bevoegdhede benodig: Strategiese vermoë en leierskapsvaardighede. Beleidsanalise- en ontwikkelingsvaardighede. Begrotingsbeplannings- en moniteringsvaardighede. Dienslewering-innovasievaardighede. Program- en projektebestuursvaardighede. Finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Inligtings- en kennisbestuursvaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Probleemoplossings- en veranderingsbestuursvaardighede. Menslike bestuurs- en bemagtigingsvaardighede. Kliëntoriëntasie- en klantfokusvaardighede. Belanghebbende bestuursvaardighede. Voorleggings- en fasiliteringsvaardighede. Risikobestuursvaardighede. Bestuur en fasiliteer die ontwikkeling, hersiening en monitering van die implementering van beleide, regulasies, riglyne, raamwerke, norme en standaarde met betrekking tot Maatskaplike Diensprofessioneles. Hou toesig oor, bestuur en verslag doen oor die begroting, menslike hulpbronne en prestasie van die hoofdirektoraat in ooreenstemming met die vasgestelde regulasies en voorskifte.

Ulwazi nokukuqonda uMgaqo-nkqubo woLuntu weMzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi nokukuqonda i PAJA, i POPIA ne PAIA. Ulwazi lomgaqo-nkqubo nentswikihlazo ku Population and Development. Ulwazi lokuqonda inxaxheba yohlengahlengiso kwindalo yoluntu nentlwikihlazo. Ulwazi ngendlela zenziwa ngayo inkonzo yobugcisa. Ulwazi ngendlela zokuhoywa ngamaxhoba obugcisa. Omezeli obumbekwa kuye inkqubo nentsimbi yoluntu phakathi kwesithuba sabantu. Isipho ngokululwa kwabathengi nokubambisana koluntu. Isipho ngokuyila iindlela ezintsha zenziwa ngayo inkonzo. Isipho ngokugcinwa kweendleko. Ulwazi lokudibanisa amagama. Isipho ngokubhala iingxelo. Isipho sokuzoba ikhompyutha. Isipho sobubambano babantu. Isipho ngokuyila iindwelling phakathi kwamaXesha. Isipho ngokuvezwa kwaye nalapho kwenziwa isibini. Isipho ngokuphanda, ukubeka umqondiso nokucukuceza ukusebenza. Ulwazi ngokwakheka kwabulali. Ukubakho kwendlala nobuhle boya. Ubuchule bokwenza inkonzo ngaphantsi. Ukuzimisela nokuyila izixhobo ezintsha. Ubuchule bokwenza inkonzo phakathi kwamaqela nangokwedwa. Ukuzeza kwaye uhlengahlengiseke. Isipho sabantu abangenamkhiwa. Isipho soqiqa. Ukuzimisela ngokulinganisa izixhobo zonke. Inyaniseko, ukuzinikela nokuzimisela. Ukuzimisela.

Lawula inkqubo nolawulo lophuhliso, ulawulo, ugcinwa kwamamehlo nokulinganisa isu seMzantsi Afrika ngokwabantu nentlwikihlazo kwilizwe lonke. Lawula abantu ngokulandela inkqubo yoluntu, iindaba zokusebenza nokuphuhlisa abantu ngokwemigaqo yokuqokelelwa nokubeka umqondiso.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Systems Development
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum. This inclusive remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the states’ contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion that may be structured i.t.o. the applicable rules.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Systems Development at the Department of Social Development in Pretoria, requiring an NQF Level 7 IT qualification and 3-5 years' junior management experience.
jobs.requirements: A qualification at NQF Level 7 as recognised by SAQA in Business Information Systems/ Information Technology in Software Development and Systems Development / Computer Sciences Plus 3-5 years’ experience at a junior management level. Knowledge and understanding of Digital Transformation Strategy of the Public Services. Knowledge and understanding of Public Service Act and Regulation. Knowledge and understanding of the relevant Public Service Regulatory Frameworks such as MISS, SDLC, MIOS, National Archives and Records Service Act, PAJA, PAIA and ECT. Knowledge and understanding of the DPSA Corporate Governance for ICT Policy Framework. Knowledge and understanding of Information and Communication Technology frameworks. Knowledge and understanding of business systems. Knowledge and understanding of database and development standards. Knowledge and understanding of business process principles, practices, techniques and tools. Knowledge and understanding of business concepts and requirements. Knowledge and understanding of database development. Knowledge and understanding of Information security principles and practices. Knowledge and understanding of Network management. Knowledge and understanding of IT Infrastructure Principles. Knowledge and understanding of vendor management and contract negotiation. Knowledge and understanding of system development methodology and project management. Knowledge and understanding of information technology business systems. Knowledge and understanding of ASP.net, VB.net, SQL, XML, HTML, JavaScript. Knowledge and understanding of business processes, principles, practices, technics and tools. Competencies needed: Database development skills. Systems development skills. Communication skills. Policy analysis and development skills. People management. Project coordination skills. Problem-solving skills. Computer literacy skills. Facilitation and presentation skills. Stakeholder and client liaison skills. Monitoring skills. Report writing skills. Attributes: Good interpersonal relations. Ability to work under pressure. Innovative and creative. Ability to work in a team and independently. Adaptability. Emotional intelligence. Independent thinker. Cost consciousness. Honesty and integrity. Assertiveness.
jobs.duties: Develop, review and implement systems database and development plans, policies and strategies to align with business needs, policies, legislative requirements, norms and standards. Develop databases, computerised systems, software applications and integrations to meet specific information systems requirements. Maintain and support all databases, computerised systems, and software applications to ensure their availability, reliability, and security. Monitor the implementation and utilisation of systems and processes in line with relevant standards, data security policies, and regulatory requirements, and compile performance reports. Manage, and report on human resources, and performance in line with the set regulations and prescripts.
jobs.applications: Please forward your application, quoting the relevant reference number, to the Director-General, Department of Social Development, Private Bag X901, Pretoria, 0001. Physical Address: HSRC Building, 134 Pretorius Street In the event of hand delivery of applications, applicants must sign an application register book as proof of submission. Applicants may also email their applications to the following email addresses: Chief Director: Human Capital Management-erecruit.HCM2@dsd.gov.za; Deputy Director: Population Policy and Strategy Implementation, Monitoring and Evaluation-e- recruit.PPSIME@dsd.gov.za; Deputy Director: Systems Development- erecruit.DDSD2@dsd.gov.za; HR Information Systems Officer-e- recruit.HRISO@dsd.gov.za. FOR ATTENTION : Mr S Boshielo
jobs.notes: In terms of the Department’s employment equity targets, African, Coloured, Indian and White males and African, Coloured and White females as well as persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Curriculum vitae with a detailed description of duties and the names of two referees must accompany your signed application for employment (Z83). If applying for more than one position, applicants must submit separate applications for each position. Shortlisted candidates for a post will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and identity documents on the date of the interview. Applicants are advised that from 1 January 2021, a new application for employment (Z83) form is effective and must be completed in full, failure to use the new Z83 will result in disqualification. The new form can be downloaded online at www.dpsa.gov.za-vacancies. Applicants applying for SMS posts are required to successfully complete the Certificate for entry into the SMS (submitted prior to appointment) and full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/. Applicants are expected to pay for the course and may enroll for it at a cost of R417.00. The duration of the course is 120 hours. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Following the interview and technical exercise, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments). The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. The successful candidate will sign an annual performance agreement, complete a financial discloser form and will also be required to undergo a security clearance. Candidates nominated for posts on salary levels 2 - 12 may be subjected to a competency assessment during the selection process. If the candidate is applying for an OSD post, certificates of service must be submitted on the date of the interview. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Failure to submit the requested documents will result in your application not being considered. Personnel suitability checks will be conducted on shortlisted candidates, and the appointment is subject to positive outcomes of the checks. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. The selection of candidates will be done with due regard to the relevant aspects of the selection process as set out in the Public Service Amendment Regulations, 2023, Regulation 67. Applications received after the closing date will not be taken into consideration. If you have not been contacted within three months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Candidates requiring additional information regarding the advertised post may direct their enquiries to the person as indicated above. Internal applicants must submit and register their employment applications at the register book in the DSD reception area for the attention of Mr S Boshielo. DSD reserves the right to cancel the filling/ not to fill a vacancy that was advertised during any stage of the recruitment process. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Stelselontwikkeling
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur: Stelselontwikkeling by die Department of Social Development in Pretoria, wat 'n NQF-vlak 7 IT-kwalifikasie en 3-5 jaar juniorbestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: A kwalifikasie op NQF Level 7 soos erken deur SAQA in Business Information Systems/ Information Technology in Software Development and Systems Development / Computer Sciences Plus 3-5 years’ ervaring op 'n juniorbestuursvlak. Kennis en begrip van die Digital Transformation Strategy of the Public Services. Kennis en begrip van die Public Service Act and Regulation. Kennis en begrip van die tersaaklike Public Service Regulatory Frameworks soos MISS, SDLC, MIOS, National Archives and Records Service Act, PAJA, PAIA en ECT. Kennis en begrip van die DPSA Corporate Governance for ICT Policy Framework. Kennis en begrip van Information and Communication Technology-raamwerke. Kennis en begrip van besigheidstelsels. Kennis en begrip van databasis- en ontwikkelingstandaarde. Kennis en begrip van besigheidsprosesbeginsels, -praktyke, -tegnieke en -nutsgoed. Kennis en begrip van besigheidskonsepte en -vereistes. Kennis en begrip van databasisontwikkeling. Kennis en begrip van inligtingsekuriteitsbeginsels en -praktyke. Kennis en begrip van netwerkbestuur. Kennis en begrip van IT Infrastructure Principles. Kennis en begrip van verkopebestuur en kontrakonderhandeling. Kennis en begrip van stelselontwikkelingsmetodologie en projekbestuur. Kennis en begrip van inligtingstegnologie-besigheidstelsels. Kennis en begrip van ASP.net, VB.net, SQL, XML, HTML, JavaScript. Kennis en begrip van besigheidsprosesse, -beginsels, -praktyke, -tegnieke en -nutsgoed. Bevoegdhede benodig: Databasisontwikkelingsvaardighede. Stelselontwikkelingsvaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede. Beleidsontledings- en ontwikkelingsvaardighede. Mensebestuur. Projekkoördinasievaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheidsvaardighede. Fasiliterings- en voorleggingsvaardighede. Belanghebbende- en kliëntlaisonvaardighede. Moniteringsvaardighede. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Eienskappe: Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Innoverend en kreatief. Vermoë om in 'n span en onafhanklik te werk. Aanpasbaarheid. Emosionele intelligensie. Onafhanklike denker. Kostebewustheid. Eerlikheid en integriteit. Beslistheid.
af.duties: Ontwikkel, hersien en implementeer stelseldatabasis- en ontwikkelingsplanne, beleide en strategieë om in te skakel by besigheidsbehoeftes, beleide, wetlike vereistes, norme en standaarde. Ontwikkel databasisse, gerekeniseerde stelsels, sagtewaretoepassings en integrasies om spesifieke inligtingstelselsvereistes te bevredig. Onderhou en ondersteun alle databasisse, gerekeniseerde stelsels en sagtewaretoepassings om hul beskikbaarheid, betroubaarheid en sekuriteit te verseker. Monitor die implementering en benutting van stelsels en prosesse in ooreenstemming met tersaaklike standaarde, datasekuriteitsbeleide en reguleringsvereistes, en stel prestasieverslae op. Bestuur en rapporteer oor menslike hulpbronne en prestasie in ooreenstemming met die vasgestelde regulasies en voorskrifte.

Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda izinhlelo zenhinga. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda imininingwane kanye nemizinhlaba yomuntu oqamba izinto ezintsha. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda izinhlobo, imikhondo, izindlela, kanye namathuluzi okwenza izinqubo zenhinga. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda izinkomba zenhinga. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda izidingo zenhinga. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda ukuthuthukiswa kwemininingwane. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda imisebenzi yokuvikela imininingwane. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwenethiwekhi. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda i-ASP.net, VB.net, SQL, XML, HTML, JavaScript. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda izinqubo zenhinga, imigedo, imikhondo, izindlela kanye namathuluzi. Ukuphathwa kwabantu. Amakhono wokuqalisa inqubo. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okusebenzisa amakhompyutha. Amakhono yokubeka izinkomba kanye nemikhondo yokuthinta. Amakhono wokuthinta futhi ohlelweni ngohlelweni. Amakhono wokuqaphele. Amakhono okubhala imibiko. Izinkomba: Ubuhle bokuhlobana ngemoyocanso. Isikhakha sokusebenza ngaphansi kwezinga eliphezulu lezinhleba. Isikhakha sokuqamba futhi wakhe izinto ezintsha. Isikhakha sokuqashelwa eqoqweni elizime futhi elizele. Isikhakha sokuqasha ngokuthobeka komzimba. Isikhakha sezwa sikanhliziyo. Isikhakha sokucabangela ngokuzimela. Isikhakha sokuqaphela amakhotho. Isikhakha sokuziba ngokomoya kanti nangezwi. Amakhono obunye.
zu.duties: Bumba, phinda ubuke futhi uze kusebenze izinhlelo zemininingwane zesistimu kanye namaphulani, inqubomgomo kanye nemikhuba efanelo ukuze ihambisane nezidingo zenhinga, inqubomgomo, izidingo zomthetho, imigexo nemizinhlaba. Bumba imininingwane, izinhlelo ezibhalwe kumakhompyutha, izinhlelo zesoftware kanye nokuhlanganiswa ukuze kuhlangatswe izidingo ezithile zenhlelo zemininingwane. Gcina futhi uxhase wonke imininingwane, izinhlelo ezibhalwe kumakhompyutha, nezinhlelo zesoftware ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi ziyatholakala, zithembekile futhi zivikelekile. Qaphela ukuze kusetshenziswe futhi kusetshenze izinhlelo kanye nenqubo ngokuhambisana nemizinhlaba efanele, inqubomgomo yokuvikela imininingwane, nezidingo zolawulo, futhi uqoqe imibiko yokusebenza. Phatha, futhi umbike ngeminyanga yabasebenzi, kanye nokusebenza ngokuhambisana nomthetho kanye nemiyalo esethuliwe.

Sigcine uze uxhase zonke i-database, iinkqubo zekhompyutha, nizicelo zesoftware ukuze kuqiniseke ukuba zikho, ukuzipho nokuqina. Lawula uze uxele ngabantu nangemigangatho ngokomthetho nemiyalelo ecatshuliweyo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Gender Focal Point
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Arts and Culture (DSAC)
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package), consisting of a basic salary (70/ 75% of the total remuneration package), State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund (13% of basic salary) and a flexible portion that may be structured in terms of applicable rules and guidelines.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Gender Focal Point at the Department of Sport, Arts and Culture in Pretoria, responsible for gender mainstreaming and transformation strategic planning.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate or equivalent qualification; A minimum Three-year Degree/National Diploma (NQF level 6)/ Degree (NQF Level 7) as recognised by SAQA in Gender Studies / Sociology/ Public Management & Governance/ Humanitarian Studies/ Social Sciences/ specializing in gender and transformation development or any relevant gender studies qualification; 3-5 years relevant experience, at least 3 years at an Assistant Director level in transformation, gender mainstreaming, gender analysis, social inclusion or any relevant gender equality, and special programs/ projects environment; Valid driver licence; Knowledge and understanding of Gender and Disability mainstreaming in the Public Service; Knowledge of relevant legislations and policies, Transformation agenda in the public service; Knowledge of 194 International conventions/agreements on targeted groups; Knowledge and understanding of National Gender Knowledge of gender analysis; Knowledge of promoting human rights; Knowledge of Commission on Gender Equality Act; Public Service Transformation frameworks (Batho Pele, Diversity Management); Knowledge of Human Resource policies and governance structures; Knowledge of Reporting frameworks (EEA2/EEA4, DPSA templates, M&E tools); Knowledge of Public Service Act and Regulations; Knowledge of transformation policies and legislative frameworks; Understanding of convention on the elimination of all forms of discrimination against women (CEDAW); Presentation skills; Negotiation skills; Financial management and leadership skills; Ability to conduct research; Project management and administration skills; Computer literacy; Planning and organisational skills Policy Framework; Good communication and interpersonal relations; Problem solving skills; Ability to work independently and within a team; Ability to meet deadlines and work well under pressure.
jobs.duties: Develop and manage gender mainstreaming and transformation strategic plans; Champion gender equality and gender-responsive planning across the department; Provide advice on gender mainstreaming, transformation and diversity matters; Ensure implementation of national gender frameworks, policies and legislative prescripts; Manage the integration of gender perspectives into departmental strategic and operational plans; Oversee the maintenance of gender specialist networks and stakeholder partnerships database; Represent the Department in gender mainstreaming structures, forums, workshops and intergovernmental engagements; Prepare reports, speeches, presentations and briefing documents on gender mainstreaming and transformation matters; Facilitate awareness programmes on Gender Based Violence (GBV), sexual harassment, gender rights and diversity; Facilitate the implementation of departmental gender mainstreaming programmes and initiatives; Oversee the integration of gender mainstreaming policies, programmes and projects within the departmental; Manage and coordinate the capacity-building and awareness programmes within the Department; Monitor the implementation of interventions addressing cross- cutting gender challenges and transformation priorities; Nominate and establish gender mainstreaming and transformation committees; Conduct gender audits and assessments to evaluate; Ensure implementation of transformation and diversity management initiatives within the Department; Facilitate the promotion of the integration of gender and transformation perspectives across departmental operations; Develop guidelines, tools and frameworks to support gender mainstreaming processes; Oversee the coordination of gender-related training and competence development programmes; Conduct research, benchmarking and project visits to identify challenges and opportunities across gender mainstreaming and transformation; Facilitate organisational transformation initiatives aimed at promoting equity, inclusion and diversity; Liaise with relevant stakeholders, institutions and government departments on women empowerment, gender equality and transformation initiatives; Promote collaboration with key gender institutions and relevant stakeholders; Coordinate and participate in national and international awareness campaigns and commemorative events; Oversee the promoting of inclusive and equitable workplace culture through advocacy and awareness initiatives; Coordinate the implementation of programmes relating to Women’s Month, GBVF, Human Rights, Disability Rights and related campaigns; Facilitate awareness sessions on gender rights, diversity, inclusion and workplace transformation; Coordinate communication and advocacy initiatives supporting departmental priorities; Provide input into strategic operational planning of the directorate; Coordinate the development, review and implementation of gender mainstreaming and transformation policies; Ensure departmental policies align with gender equality and diversity frameworks; Monitor compliance with gender mainstreaming and transformation legislative and policy frameworks; Prepare reports on gender mainstreaming and transformation programmes; Monitor and track departmental performance against gender equality and transformation targets; Identify gaps, risks and corrective measures relating to gender mainstreaming implementation.

zu.duties: Bhekisa kanye nokuphatha inhlelo yokufaka ngqondo ngokobulili kwezomnotho; Zisa iqhaza ekulinganiseni ngokobulili nakuhlelweni ngokobulili emphakathini; Nikeza ngeluleko ngefunda ngokobulili, ekuguqulweni nakwezinhlobo ezahlukene; Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwamasu ezifunda ngokobulili, amapholisi nemithetho; Phatha ukufakwa kwemibono ngokobulili kwizinhlelo eziyisimo sokubheka kanye nalezoqhuba; Qaphela ukugcinwa kwezinkulungwane zezazi ngokobulili kanye nokuxhumana nabahlanganyeli; Mela i-Department kumakhasimende ekuqondweni ngokobulili, emihlanganweni, emiklomong nasokuhlangana phakathi kwahulumende; Lungelela izibhalo, okulandelwayo, izibonakaliso namafayela ngokufaka ngqondo ngokobulili; Hlinzeka ngamaphathi okuqonda i-Gender Based Violence (GBV), ukusetshenziswa ngokocansi, amalungelo ngokobulili nangokwezinhlobo; Hlinzeka ngamaphathi okuqonda ngokobulili nakwezinhlelo emphakathini nokwamaphrojekthi; Qaphela ukuhlanganiswa ngokobulili kanye namapholisi kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi; Phatha kanye nohlela izinhlelo zokwazisa abantu ngokobulili nakwezinye izinhlela ekuguqulweni; Hlola ukuqashelwa kokusebenza kokuqonda izinkinga ngokobulili kanye nokubuyekezwa kokubaluleka kokuguqulwa; Caphula kanye nowakha amakomidi ngokobulili nakwezinhlelo zokuguqula; Qaphela ukuhlanganiswa kwamasu okuguqula nokuphatha kwezinhlobo ezahlukene; Hlinzeka ngokuhlanganisa imibono ngokobulili nakwezinhlela zokuguqula; Lungelela izinkomba, amathuluzi kanye namapholisi okusekela ukufaka ngqondo ngokobulili; Qaphela ukuhlela amaphathi ngokobulili nakamaphathi okukhulisa amakhono; Yenza ucwaningo, ukuqondanisa nokuvakashela amaphrojekthi ukuthola izinkinga kanye nezithakazelo; Hlinzeka ngenhlela zokuguqula ezibhekele ukuthuthukisa ukulingana, ukufaka ngqondo nokwezinhlobo; Xhumana nabahlanganyeli, izikhungo namahhovimenti kwamandla abantu, ukulingana ngokobulili kwezinhlela; Khuthaza ukusebenzisana nezikhungo ezibalulekile ngokobulili; Hlela futhi uthathe inxaxhebe emkhankasweni wezifunda naselwelwini lwezinsimbi zomhlaba; Qaphela ukukhuthaza indalo yokusingatha ngokobulili nokulingana emsebenzini; Hlela ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo ezihlobene nenyanga yabantu besifazane, i-GBVF, kwamalungelo abantu, kwamalungelo abakhubazekile nakwezinye imikhankaso; Hlinzeka ngezinkulumo ngamalungelo ngokobulili, ukubandakanywa kokusetshenziswa, ukusetshenziswa ngokobulili nokuguqulwa emsebenzini; Hlela ukuxhumana kanye nokwazisa okusekela izifiso zedirektorathi; Hlela ukulungiselela, ukubuyekeza nokusebenzisa amapholisi okufaka ngqondo ngokobulili; Qinisekisa ukuvumelana kwamapholisi nomthetho ngokobulili; Hlola ukuvumelana kwezinhlela ngokobulili kwezomnotho; Lungelela izibhalo ngokususela kumapholisi; Hlola kanye nokulandela imisebenzi yokulingana ngokobulili; Hlola izikhala, izingozi nezexhula ezihlobene nokufaka ngqondo ngokobulili.

xh.title: Ikomityana Yomlawuli: Iqela Loxwebhu Lobulili
xh.summary: Ikomityana Yomlawuli: Iqela Loxwebhu Lobulili kwiSebe leMidlalo, iNkcaphe neMveliso kwiPretoria, nenzobe ekubeni ngamandla indima yokulinganisa nobulili nokuguqulwa kweenkqubo zolweleleqela.
xh.requirements: Isetifikethi EsPhezulu/Isetifikethi seMatric /Isetifikethi leBanga le-12 okanye isifaniso sawo; Iminyaka emithathu yezidanga/EliNational Diploma (NQF level 6)/ Igcina (NQF Level 7) njengoko kugunyazwa yiSAQA kwiZifundo zobulili/ iSociology/ uLawulo koluntu noBulungisa/ iZifundo zobubele/ iNzululwazi yeZentlalo/ izifundo ezithi ngakumbi kuhlaziyo lobulili nenguqulo okanye nanye iphawu lobulili; Iimbonekelo ezahlayo zonyaka ema-3-5, ixesha elingaphantsi kweminyaka emi-3 kwinqanaba lomlawuli oncedisayo kunguqulo, ukuqwalasela ngokulinganisa nobulili, ukuhlalutywa kobulili, ukuhlanganiswa koluntu okanye nakuphi na okuhambelana nolingo nobulili, nakunyango/ inkqubo okukhethekileyo; Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni; Ulwazi nomqondo wokuqwalasela kobulili neyokubandakanya abakhubazekayo kuQhinga loluntu; Ulwazi ngemigaqo yomthetho namagqabantshintshi, kanjalo neGqabantshintsha leGenda kummandla woluntu; Ulwazi nge-194 yoMthetho jikelele/izivumelwano kumagqabantshintsha aqeqeshwayo; Ulwazi nomqondo weeNzululwazi eZizwe zabantu ngokobulili; Ulwazi ngokusahlulwa-hlulwa kobulili; Ulwazi lokukhuthaza amalungelo obuntu; Ulwazi ngomthetho weKomishoni yeLungiselelo lobulili; Inkqubo yenguqulo yoluntu (iBatho Pele, uLawulo lweNhlobo-mveliso); Ulwazi ngamagqabantshintshi eNkampani yamacebo aluntu neyongamileyo; Ulwazi ngamakhabhodi okubika (iEEA2/iEEA4, amakhopyi eDPSA, iimpahla zeM&E); Ulwazi ngomthetho weNkonzo yaBantu neMithetho; Ulwazi ngamagqabantshintshi amacebo namakha womthetho; Ukuqonda ngomthetho wonyuso lawo onke iindidi zohlukaniso ngokwesini (CEDAW); Amandla okubonisa; Amandla okuxoxisana; Ulawulo lweMali namandla okubusa; Amandla okwenza uphando; Ulawulo lweProjekthi nolawulo lokuqhuba; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Amacebo aloQweliso nokuqwalasela iNkqubo yeGqabantshintsha; Ilungiselelo elincerce kwaye lanobuntu obuhle; Amandla eSixhexhe lokusombulula iingxaki; Amandla okusebenza eyedwa nakwinqanaba eliya kwinqanaba eliya kwikhomityi; Amandla okuyifikela iinkalo kwaye akwazi ukusebenza ngantsika phantsi koxinzelelo.
xh.duties: Yakha ulawule iinkqubo ezinesigqibo sokulinganisa nobulili nenguqulo; Phakamisa amandla olwelo lwabesini nokulungelelanisa amacebo ngokobulili kulo lonke isebe; Nikela ngengcebiso ngokulinganisa nobulili, unguqulo neendaba zokuqhuba; Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zesizwe ngokobulili, amagqabantshintshi nomthetho ophoqelelweyo; Lawula ukudityaniswa kwezimvo ngokobulili kumacebo abucala nakwendalo esebe; Qwalasela ukugcinwa kweenkqaba zobugcisa ekwaziswa ngokobulili nakubathathi-nxaxheba ngokobulili; Mela iSebe kwinkqubo yokuqwalasela kobulili, kumaza, kumakomityi nakuluntu olukwaziyo; Lungelelanisa amaxwebhu okubika, iinkulumo, iinkqubo zokubonisa namaxwebhu okucacisa nokuqwalasela kobulili nokuqwalasela kobulili nenguqulo; Khokela iinkqubo zolwazi ngeNkohlakalo eQhutywa ngesini (GBV), ukuxhatshazwa ngokwesini, amalungelo obulili nobunyulu; Khokela ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zesebe ngokulinganisa nobulili nokuqala kweenkqubo; Qwalasela ukudityaniswa kweenkqubo ngokobulili, iinkqubo neeprojekthi ngaphakathi kusebe; Lawula ukuqwalasela nokulungelelanisa iinkqubo zokwakha amandla nolwazi kuleSebe; Qwalasela ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo ezisombulula iingxaki zomthetho ezidlulayo kwaye zihlangabezana nobulili obuxhumekekayo nobugcweleyo; Cinga uze umise amakomityi ngokobulili nenguqulo; Yenza iindaba zokuhlola nokuhlaziya iinkqubo zokulinganisa nobulili; Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kweekhomishini zolwazi kuleSebe; Khokela ukukhuthaza ukudityaniswa kwemvelaphi zobulili nenguqulo kulo lonke ukuqhuba kweSebe; Phuhlisa iinkqubo, izixhobo nokuqwalasela ukuxhasa iinkqubo zokuqwalasela kobulili; Qwalasela ulungelelwaniso lokuqeqesha ngokobulili nokuqamba iinkqubo zokwakha amandla; Yenza uphando, ukuthelekisa nokundwendwela iiprojekthi ukuze ukwazi ukufumana iingxaki namehlo alo kwinguqulo kwaye usebenze ngokobulili; Khokela iinkqubo zenguqulo eziphuhliswa ukuze khuthazwe ulwelo lokulingana, ukubandakanyeka nobunyulu; Xhumana nabathathi-nxaxheba, nasezikolo nakumasebe urhulumente ngeenkqubo zokukhuthaza iimfuno zabafazi, ulwelo lobulili nenguqulo; Khuthaza ukusebenzisana namaziko abalulekileyo nabathathi-nxaxheba ngokobulili; Lungiselela kwaye ulungelelanise kwikomityi yamazwe nasemhlabeni jikelele nakwiinkqubo ezikhankanywayo; Qwalasela ukukhuthaza inkqubo yokusebenza ngendlela efikelele kwaye ilungelelaniswe ngokwemigaqo yokukhuthaza nakwinkqubo yokuqwalasela; Lungisa ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo ezithetha ngeNyanga yabaFazi, iGBVF, iMalungelo eBotu, iMalungelo abaKhubazekileyo nakweekhomityi ezahlayo; Khokela iinkqubo zolwazi ngamalungelo obulili, nobunyulu, ukubandakanyeka nokuqwalasela kwindalo yesebe; Lungiselela ukuqhuba koluntu nokukhuthaza iinkqubo ezixhasa amagqabantshintshi esebe; Nikela ngeengcali kwinkqubo yokuqwalasela neyokuqhuba yeqela; Lungiselela ukwakhiwa, ukuhlaziywa nokusetyenziswa kweenkqubo ngokobulili nenguqulo; Qinisekisa ukuba amagqabantshintshi esebe ayahambelana nokulinganisa kobulili nobunyulu; Qwalasela ukulandela umthetho weenkqubo ngokobulili nenguqulo; Lungelelanisa iingxelo ngeenkqubo zokuqwalasela kobulili nenguqulo; Qwalasela ulandelelwano lokuqhuba kwisebe ngokobulili nokuqwalasela amagqabantshintshi; Fumana iingxaki, iingozi nezisombululo ezihambelana nokusetyenziswa kweenkqubo ngokobulili.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Translation and Editing: Isindebele
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Arts and Culture (DSAC)
jobs.summary: Assistant Director providing translation and editing services between English and isiNdebele for the Department of Sport, Arts and Culture in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate or equivalent qualification; A minimum three-year National Diploma (NQF level 6)/ Degree (NQF level 7) as recognised by SAQA in Language Studies, Linguistics, Translation and Interpreting Studies majoring in the relevant language and/or translation, or relevant language qualification; 2–3 years relevant experience at least 2 years as an isiNdebele Language Practitioner in the translation environment; Successful completion of a departmental isiNdebele translation and editing test; Knowledge of Public Service Regulations; Knowledge and understanding of relevant language policies and prescripts; Knowledge of translation/ editing/ language administration; Excellent command of at least two official languages including English; Strong editing, proofreading and writing skills; Ability to translate and edit text electronically; Good communication interpersonal relations; Planning and organising skill; Computer literacy; Research skills.
jobs.duties: The purpose of this position is to promote access to information by providing translation and editing services; Translating official documents from English into isiNdebele and vice versa; Receive and review official documents for translation requirements; Study, analyse and excerpt problematic terms from source documents; Translate documents from English into isiNdebele; Translate documents from isiNdebele into English; Consult with subject matter experts or language specialists when necessary; Editing, checking and proofreading official documents translated into isiNdebele; Editing official documents written in isiNdebele; Checking and verifying the accuracy of edited documents; Proofreading final versions of official documents translated into isiNdebele; Ensuring quality and consistency in all translated and edited materials; Performing quality checks on all documents before final approval; Conduct research and develop terminology terms; Conduct research and consultation on translation issues; Review and revise existing terminology for clarity and accuracy; Provide administrative support and liaison service; Archiving all translated and edited documents electronically; Reporting on progress; Liaise with stakeholders; Carry out tasks as requested by the supervisor; Assist and give advice to clients on language matters; Supervision of subordinates–Supervise translation activities of subordinates.
