af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Vertaling en Redigering: Isindebele
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur wat vertaling- en redigeringsdienste tussen Engels en isiNdebele vir die Department of Sport, Arts and Culture in Pretoria verskaf.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate/Grade 12-sertifikaat of ekwivalente kwalifikasie; 'n Minimum driejaar Nasionale Diploma (NQF level 6)/ Graad (NQF level 7) soos deur SAQA erken in Taalstudie, Linguistiek, Vertaling en Tolkstudie met die betrokke taal en/of vertaling as hoofvak, of 'n toepaslike taalkwalifikasie; 2–3 jaar se toepaslike ervaring waarvan ten minste 2 jaar as 'n isiNdebele-taalkundige in die vertalingsomgewing; Suksesvolle voltooiing van 'n departementele isiNdebele-vertaling- en redigeringstoets; Kennis van Public Service Regulations; Kennis en begrip van toepaslike taalbeleid en voorskrifte; Kennis van vertaling/ redigering/ taaladministrasie; Uitstekende beheer van ten minste twee amptelike tale insluitend Engels; Sterk redigerings-, proeflees- en skryfvaardighede; Vermoë om teks elektronies te vertaal en te redigeer; Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike verhoudings; Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede; Rekenaargeletterdheid; Navorsingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Die doel van hierdie posisie is om toegang tot inligting te bevorder deur vertaling- en redigeringsdienste te verskaf; Vertaal amptelike dokumente van Engels na isiNdebele en omgekeerd; Ontvang en hersien amptelike dokumente vir vertalingsvereistes; Bestudeer, analiseer en haal problematiese terme uit brondokumente uit; Vertaal dokumente van Engels na isiNdebele; Vertaal dokumente van isiNdebele na Engels; Raadpleeg vakspesialiste of taalspesialiste wanneer nodig; Redigeer, kontroleer en proeflees amptelike dokumente wat na isiNdebele vertaal is; Redigeer amptelike dokumente wat in isiNdebele geskryf is; Kontroleer en verifieer die akkuraatheid van geredigeerde dokumente; Proeflees finale weergawes van amptelike dokumente wat na isiNdebele vertaal is; Verseker gehalte en konsekwentheid in alle vertaalde en geredigeerde materiaal; Voer gehaltekontroles op alle dokumente uit voor finale goedkeuring; Doen navorsing en ontwikkel terminologieterme; Doen navorsing en raadpleeg oor vertalingskwessies; Hersien en hersien bestaande terminologie vir duidelikheid en akkuraatheid; Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning en skakeldienste; Argiveer alle vertaalde en geredigeerde dokumente elektronies; Rapporteer oor vordering; Skakel met belanghebbendes; Voer take soos deur die toesighouer versoek uit; Help en gee advies aan kliënte oor taalaangeleenthede; Toesig oor ondergeskiktes–Hou toesig oor vertalingsaktiwiteite van ondergeskiktes.

zu.title: Umncedisi weNduna: Ukuhumusha nokuHlela: IsiNdebele
zu.summary: UMncedisi weNduna ohumusha futhi ehlela amadokhumenti phakathi kweNgilisi nesiNdebele kuMnyango wezemidlalo, Ubuciko namasiko ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zomabanga aphezulu/Iziqu zeMatric/Isitifikedi seGrade 12 noma iziqu ezingangalezo; IDiploma yezwe ezingaba iminyaka emithathu (NQF level 6)/ IDigri (NQF level 7) njengoba kubonwa yiSAQA kwezolimi, Izilimi, Ukuhumusha nokuhumusha ngomlomo ehlotshaniswa nolimi oluhambisana naleso kanye/noma ukuhumusha, noma iziqu zolimi ezihambisana naleyo; Uholo lwezikhathi eziyiminyaka engu-2-3 okungenani okungenyanga eziyi-2 njengomsebenzi wolimi lwesiNdebele emkhakheni wokuhumusha; Ukuphumelela ukuvivinywa kwesiNdebele komnyango ekusetshenziswa ukuhumusha nokuhlela; Ukwazi Izinto ezilawula Imisebenzi kahulumeni; Ukwazi futhi kuqondwe izinqubomgomo zolimi ezihambisana nezokuhumusha; Ukwazi ngokuhumusha/nokuhlela/izokuphathwa kolimi; Ikhono elikhulu kakhulu lolimi olusemthethweni okungenani ngamazwi amabili okuhlanganisa iNgilisi; Ikhono elikhulu lokuhlela, ukuhlola futhi kubhale; Ukukwazi ukuhumusha nokuhlela amadokhumenti ngokusetsenziswa kwekhompuyutha; Ikhono elihle lokuxhumana nabantu; Ikhono lokuhlela izinkombo nokubumbana; Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha; Ikhono lokupenya.
zu.duties: Inhloso yesikhundla ukukhuthaza ukufinyelela kwemininingwane ngokuhumusha nokuhlela; Ukuhumusha amadokhumenti asemthethweni esiNgisini abe yisiNdebele futhi kwelinye icala; Ukuthola bese kuhlolwa amadokhumenti asemthethweni ngenhloso yokuhumusha; Ukufunda, ukuhlaziya futhi ukukhipha amagama abunzima emadokhumentini; Ukuhumusha amadokhumenti esiNgisini abe yisiNdebele; Ukuhumusha amadokhumenti esiNdebele abe yisiNgisi; Ukubonisana nabakwenzokuhlele kumaqhingamabala noma ochwepheshe bolimi uma kudingekile; Ukuhlela, ukuhlola nokuphinda kuhlole amadokhumenti asemthethweni ahumushwe esiNdebele; Ukuhlela amadokhumenti asemthethweni abhalwe esiNdebele; Ukuhlola futhi kuqinisekiswe ukunembeka kwamadokhumenti ahlelwe; Ukuphinda kuhlolelwe izinhlaka eziphelile zamadokhumenti asemthethweni ahumushwe esiNdebele; Ukuqinisekisa izinga nobunembeka ezintweni zonke ezihumushiwe nezihleliwe; Ukwenza ukulandwa kwenani lemigomo yonke amadokhumenti phambi kokugunyazwa okokugcina; Ukwenza ucwaningo futhi wakhe amagama; Ukwenza ucwaningo nokubonisana ngemibuzo yokuhumusha; Ukubuyekeza futhi ulungise amagama ajeke imininngwane ngenhloso yokucaciswa nokunembeka; Ukunika inkokhelo yokuphathwa koshintshiswano wezocwango; Ukugcina ngokusetsenziswa wekhompyutha wonke amadokhumenti ahumushiwe futhi ahlelwe; Ukubika ngenhluko yomsebenzi; Ukwazisa izinhlangano; Ukwenzisa imisebenzi njengobacelwa umbonisi; Ukusiza futhi unikezezelane ngamabhodi ngemithetho yolimi; Ukugada abangansi—Ukugada imisebenzi yokuhumusha yabangansi.

xh.title: Umncedisi woMlawuli: ukuGuqula nokuHlengahlengisa: Isindebele
xh.summary: Umncedisi woMlawuli onikezela ngezikhonzo zokuguqula nokuhlengahlengisa phakathi kosiNgesi nesiNdebele kwiSebe lezemidlalo, zonobumba nenkcubeko ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samatikiti aphakamileyo/Isatifikethi somatrikulet /Isatifikethi leGrede 12 okanye isifundo esilinganayo; Iqondo lesizwe leminyaka emithathu (inqanaba leNQF 6)/ Idegree (inqanaba leNQF 7) njengoko evunyelwe yiSAQA kwiZifundo zolwimi, iLinguistics, iZifundo zokuGuqula nokuhumusha ezikho ezifundweni ezibalulekileyo kolwimi kwaye/nokuguqula, okanye isifundo solwimi esifanelekileyo; 2–3 iminyaka yamava afanelekileyo ubuncinane iminyaka engama-2 njengomenzi wolwimi lwesiNdebele kwimeko yokuguqula; Ukuphumelela kuvavwe lokuguqula nokuhlengahlengisa olwesiNdebele lwesebe; ulwazi ngeekhadelezo zeNkonzo kaRhulumente; ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo zemigaqo yolwimi ezifanelekileyo nemiqathango; ulwazi lokuguqula/ ukuhlengahlengisa/ ulawulo lolwimi; ulawulo oluhle kakhulu kolwimi olusemthethweni olunye ubuncinane olubandakanya isiNgesi; amakhono amaninzi okuhlengahlengisa, ukupruvida nokubhala; ikhono lokuguqula nokuhlengahlengisa umbhalo ngokwekhrompyutha; ukunxibelelana kakuhle nabantu; ikhono lokucwangcisa nokuqamba; ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhrumputha; amakhono okuphanda.

jobs.title: Procurement Admin Officer
jobs.summary: Procurement Admin Officer in Pretoria administering the supplier database and sourcing quotations for the Department of Transport.
jobs.requirements: A qualification at NQF level 6 as recognised by SAQA in Supply Chain Management / Logistics Management / Public Procurement Management with 1 year's experience in supply chain management. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of SCM policies, prescripts and practices, Knowledge of Public Service Regulations and Public Service Act, Computer Literate (SCM System, MS Word, Excel), Understanding and application of SCM and PFMA prescripts, Knowledge of Treasury Regulations, Planning and Organising skills, Good Verbal and writing communication skills, Financial management skills and Project Management skills.
jobs.duties: Administer the supplier database. Receive RFQ’s and check compliance before sourcing quotations (Check budget, that the specifications are not biased), Verify sourcing strategy to be implemented and its engagement model, Use Central Supplier Database (CSD) and other applicable sourcing strategies to acquire quotations in a fair and equitable manner, Monitor quotations and make sure they are in line with the time indicated when quotations were sources, Evaluate quotations and compile a comparative schedule , Ensure that suppliers are complaints on CSD, Make sure that the awarded supplier is the one that scores the highest points, Make sure that the comparative schedule is approved by the delegated authority, Proactively advise the LOGIS unit and Chief users on quotation status, Maintain daily liaising with chief users and suppliers, Handle internal and external queries with chief users and suppliers and Submit finalized quotations,VAS2 to logistics for further processing. Obtain quotation for services (Consultants), Receive Terms of Reference (TOR), Ensure that the is approved Case and Gap Analysis, Ensure that there is an approval submission to appoint specifications and Evaluations committee and that it is in line with treasury regulations 16 A and SCM Policy, Check the specification and make sure that it complies with SCM templates and Policy, Arrange the specification meeting and Compile a specifications report. Publish the TOR on e-tenders and departmental website, Invite security and internal control, receive the documents, make sure that there registers to record all proposals received during the closing date, Compile evaluation report to be approved by the delegated authority, Publish the results on e-tenders and the website, Ensure safe keeping of documents for audit purposes and Submit finalized projects to Contract Management for contract and logistics for further processing. Administer Quotation Process for IT related services, Receive DITCOM form with the specifications, Use RFB 740 and other applicable sourcing strategies by SITA to acquire quotations in a fair and equitable manner, Ensure that supplier are complaint on CSD, Daily liaising with chief users and suppliers, Handle internal and external queries with regards to quotation. Implement and administer all SCM policies, prescripts, and legislations. Implement and ensure compliance to all SCM policies, prescripts and legislation, Interact with the CSD/DTI and National Treasury, Assist in guiding services providers on steps to follow to comply with the Departmental requirements. Compile monthly statistical report. Update quotation register both manually and electronically, Weekly report to Manager on RFQ’s and Update the deviations register as an when it happens.

Applicants must fill in full new Z83 form part A, B, C, and D. A recent updated comprehensive CV (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed, i.e. positions held and dates). xh.title: Procurement Admin Officer
xh.summary: Procurement Admin Officer ePretoria elawula igcino labahanjiswa kwaye efumana izithuba ze-Department of Transport.
xh.requirements: IthIFICATION kwinqanaba le-NQF 6 njengoko kwayamkelwa yi-SAQA kwi-Supply Chain Management / Logistics Management / Public Procurement Management kunye neminyaka emi-1 yamava kwi-supply chain management. Ulwazi nezakhono: Ulwazi ngemigaqo ye-SCM, imiyo-mgqaliswe kunye nemisebenzi, Ulwazi lweziyikelo ze-Public Service kunye ne-Public Service Act, Ulwazi ngekhomputha (Inkqubo ye-SCM, MS Word, Excel), Ukuqonda nokusebenzisa imiyo-mgqaliswe ye-SCM kunye ne-PFMA, Ulwazi lweTreasury Regulations, Amakhono eplanning kunye ne-Organising, Amakhono ethetho eluhle kunye nokubhala, Amakhono eFinancial management kunye ne-Project Management.
xh.duties: Lawula igcino lenkcumaza. Yamkela ii-RFQ kwaye khangela ukuzinza ngaphambi kokufumana iindawo ezithunyelweyo (Khangala umgangatho wemali, ukuba iinkcazelo azikhethi), Qinisekisa indlela yokufumana izithuba ezizakwenziwa nendlela yazo yokusebenzisana, Sebenzisa i-Central Supplier Database (CSD) nezinye iindlela ezifanelekileyo zokufumana izithuba ngendlela elungileyo nengathandabuzekayo, Qwalasela izithuba kwaye uqinisekise ukuba zihambelana nexesha elibalwe xa bekusungulwa izithuba, Hlola izithuba kwaye ulungise ishedi yokuthelekisa, Qinisekisa ukuba abahanjiswa bakhuselekile kwi-CSD, Qinisekisa ukuba umhanjisi ofumana isithuba ngowona umphumo-mathatha uphezulu, Qinisekisa ukuba ishedi yokuthelekisa ivunyiwe ngumphathi owabelwe igunya, Ngaphambi kwexesha ulungelelanise iqela le-LOGIS namabaphathi abasebenzisana ngolu lwazi kwesimo sezithuba, Gcina ukunxulumana kwangemihla namabaphathi abasebenzisana ngolu lwazi nabahanjiswa, Phatha imibuzo yangaphakathi nangaphandle namabaphathi abasebenzisana ngolu lwazi nabahanjiswa kwaye ungenise izithuba ezigqityiweyo, ii-VAS2 kwilahji ukwenziwa kwemisebenzi eyolandelayo. Fumana izithuba zeemfuno (Amaphanga), Yamkela i-Terms of Reference (TOR), Qinisekisa ukuba kukho uvavanyo oluvunyiweyo lwe-Case ne-Gap Analysis, Qinisekisa ukuba kukho isimumo esivunyelweyo sokumisela iinkcazelo nekomiti ye-Evaluations nangokuba ihambelana nemigaqo yesikhendlula yokulinganisa i-16 A kunye nenqaku ye-SCM, Khangala iinkcazelo kwaye uqinisekise ukuba zihambelana neefom ze-SCM kunye nenqaku, Lungiselela indibano ye-pecifications kwaye ulungise ishwada le-pecifications. Pamphisa i-TOR kwi-e-tenders kunye nnekhasi lesebe le-DITCOM, Mema isikhuzelo lolawulo langaphakathi, yamkela amaxwebhu, qinisekisa ukuba kukho amarekhodi ukubhala zonke iinkqubo ezamkelweyo phantsi komhla wokuvala, Lungiselela ishwada lokuqwalasela elizakuvunyelwa ngumphathi owabelwe igunya, Pamphisa iziphumo kwi-e-tenders kunye nekhasi, Qinisekisa ukhuseleko kwamaxwebhu ngenjongo yovavanyo kwaye ungenise iiprojekthi ezigqityiweyo kwi-Contract Management yonqginisiso nangezithuba ukwenziwa kwemisebenzi eyolandelayo. Lawula inqubo yesithuba yeemfuno ezihlobene ne-IT, Yamkela ifomu ye-DITCOM ngeenkcainkcazelo, Sebenzisa i-RFB 740 kunye nezinye iindlela ezifanelekileyo ze-SITA zokufumana izithuba ngendlela elungileyo nengathandabuzekayo, Qinisekisa ukuba abahanjiswa bakhuselekile kwi-CSD, Kunxulumana kwangemihla namabaphathi abasebenzisana ngolu lwazi nabahanjiswa, Phatha imibuzo yangaphakathi nangaphandle malunga nezithuba. Zisebenzise kwaye ulawule zonke iinqula ze-SCM, imiyo-mgqaliswe nemiGaqo. Zisebenzise kwaye uqinisekise ukuzinza kuzo zonke iinqula ze-SCM, imiyo-mgqaliswe nemiGaqo, Sebenzisana ne-CSD/DTI kunye ne-National Treasury, Yuncede kumalunga abonelela ngezithuba ngamanyathelo okulandela ukuze bazinze ngokuchanekileyo kwimfuno yesebe. Lungiselela ishwada le-fatshi yengcamango ngenyanga.uhlaziye umbhalo wesithuba ngesandla nangekhomputha, Yongeza ishwada ngeveki kumjongi we-RFQ kwaye uhlaziye umbhalo we-deviation naxa kwenzeka.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokuphathwa Kwezinhlalo Zamafomula
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaMphathi Wezeminininingwane we-Procurement ePretoria, oqondisa idatha yabathumki futhi athole amafomula eholo kwi-Department of Transport.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezinga le-NQF level 6 njengoba kugunyazwe i-SAQA kwi-Supply Chain Management / Logistics Management / Public Procurement Management nabayiminyaka eyi-1 ngokuhlolwa kwi-supply chain management. Ulwazi nemikhando: Ulwazi lwezinkambiba kanye nobulembu beziqondiso ze-SCM, nokwazi umthetho wesimemezeli sabasebenzi bomphakathi kanye noPublic Service Act, ukuqonda ukubhala ngaphansi komakhelwane (I-SCM System, i-MS Word, i-Excel), ukuqonda futhi ukusetshenziswa kwemitsetho yesimanje ne-SCM ne-PFMA, ukwazi imithetho yesikhungwa kwesichengamazwe, ukwazi ukulethelela nokuqonda ukubeka nokugcina izinkondolo ezinhle, ukwazi okuhle ukukhuluma kanye nokuqamba izindaba, nokwazi nokuphathwa kwezimali kanye nokuphathwa kwamaphulo. Ukwazi okuhle kokuphathwa kwamaphulo nokuqinisekisa imikhandlu.
zu.duties: Qondisa idatha yabathumki bempahla. Thola ama- RFQ’s bese uhlola ukuziphendula ngaphambi kokuthola amafomula wamanani (Hlola izibiligi, ukuthi izinkomba azikhwezi), Qinisekisa isu lokuthola amafomula ezothathwa nokuthi kuzohlatshazwa kanjani, Sebenzisa i- Central Supplier Database (CSD) nezinye izindlela eziye ukusetshenziswa ukuthola amafomula kahle nangokulinganisela lwembe. Hlola amafomula kahle futhi wawugcine ku-elekhtronikhi nakomuntu. Landa izinsulu ezingangeni phansi kwemisebenzi efakiwe esikhundleni somphathi. Bika ukuthi uhlobo oluthunyelwe kwi-National Treasury luyahambisana nesikhulu esiphezulu. Landela inqubo emayelana nokuxhumana kanye nokubika kwe-National Treasury, Landela inqubo yokubika kahle ukuze kubonakale emsebenzini ekubonwa ngamagobho awo. Landela isimo sokungasebenzi kwamaqaphambo ezinkundla emadolobheni kanye nokuvunyelwe kwemisebenzi phakathi komnyango. Landela amaqiniso ezenzakalo akulayini yempahla ebeliba ngokusemthethweni nangokwezezandla zokuqinisekisa izinkomba eziseluleko ebufakazini bomgomo. Landa ukuthi isiyatshengisa kanjani abakhokhi begcina baxhuma izinkokhelo inani phansi. Landela ukuhlola amafomula angavunyelwe ababikwa inani elingalingiselwa kakhulu nezinye. Landela ukuthi ukucwiliswa ngokushesha kwe-Memorandum Agreement kukhombisa ukuthi izinkokhelo zifakiwe kumaphoyisa kuphela. Landela isinqumo ngamafomula evela ecolandweni, ngokwezezandla nomnyango wezohamba nabantu abakhokhelwa. Landela ukuthi zihlolwe kahle inqubo yokuba ngumthengi. Landela imithetho nemicwango emayelana no-Risk Assessment Report Futhi. Faka ngokushesha amafomula ukuba kuncikiswe kumasevisi e-National Treasury kuphela futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuba umuntu ofanelekile ukwenza futhi ethunyelwe lomnyango ofanele uthumela ikhasi elikhokhelwayo kwayo. Landela imithetho yokuthi ukwaziswa kwamanani wokuthola kubumbene ngocingo nobunikwa bamaphayona. Landela izinsulu ezingangeni phansi kakhulu nokusebenzela nokuthi kwenzani ekulandeleni izinsulu. Landela ukuba ngumsebenzisi kwezezinkundla. Hlola kahle kwezilulumkile zezezinkalo emnyakathweni. Faka kwezokudlondlobala. Landa izincwadi ezingangenwa yisibhaliwekiwe esisemthethweni. Faka isibhaliwekiwe esisuka kwenye inkondlo. Faka kwelika-National Treasury ukuze sibe ngokusemthethweni. Faka wonke amaphrofayili ezentela nabathengi be-National Treasury. Landela imisebenzi yokucobelelana kwezinsulu. Landa imininingwane yamafomula ahlehlwe kwamaphoyisa. Landela imisebenzi yokubikisa abathengi nokuthi bazokwenza yini impahla. Landela isikhundla sezimali ezothunyelwa kubathengi. Faka amaphoyisa abathengi abayikhokhelwe ukuba kubonwe yizipho. Landela ukusukela kwabakulomkhicilili. Faka kabusha impahla ekhokhelwe i-Logistics kubathengi abalandela imithetho ye-Contract Management namaphoyisa. Landela imithetho engafanele nokubanomndeni e-Departmental Regulation. Landela izinsulu ezingangenwa izinsulu ze-National Treasury kuphela. Landela imisebenzi efakiwe. Landela imisebenzi emayelana nokuhlinzeka izinsulu ze-National Treasury. Landa imisebenzi efanayo. Faka amapulofula. Hlola izindlu ezidakulwe ku-e-tenders nekuqoqiwe ngaphansi. Landa izinsulu ze-DTI kanye nase-National Treasury. Landela imisebenzi egqamile eyisikhulumi esisuka kubathengi. Hlola imisebenzi. Faka ukubika kwamaviki, wabe kudinga ngangakini isikhulu esibhaliwe.

af.summary: Administreer die verskafferdatabasis en die verkryging van kwotasies vir die Department of Transport in Pretoria, wat 'n NQF-vlak 6-kwalifikasie in Supply Chain Management vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 6 soos deur SAQA erken in Supply Chain Management / Logistics Management / Public Procurement Management sonder ondervinding. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van SCM-beleide, voorskifte en praktyke, Kennis van Public Service Regulations en Public Service Act, Rekenaargeletterd (SCM-stelsel, MS Word, Excel), Begrip en toepassing van SCM- en PFMA-voorskifte, Kennis van Treasury Regulations, Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Administreer die verskafferdatabasis. Ontvang RFQ's en toets nakoming voor kwotasies verkry word (toets begroting, dat die spesifikasies nie bevooroordeel is nie), Verifieer die verkrygingsstrategie wat geïmplementeer moet word en sy betrokkenheidsmodel, Gebruik Central Supplier Database (CSD) en ander toepaslike verkrygingsstrategieë om kwotasies op 'n billike en regverdige wyse te verkry, Monitor kwotasies en maak seker dat dit ooreenstem met die tyd aangedui toe kwotasies verkry is, Evalueer kwotasies en stel 'n vergelykende skedule op, Verseker dat verskaffers op CSD geregistreer is, Maak seker dat die bekroonde verskaffer die een is wat die hoogste punte behaal, Maak seker dat die vergelykende skedule deur die gedelegeerde gesag goedgekeur is, Proaktief adviseer die LOGIS-eenheid en hoofgebruikers oor kwotasiestatus, Onderhou daaglikse skakeling met hoofgebruikers en verskaffers, Hanteer interne en externe navrae met hoofgebruikers en verskaffers en Dien gefinaliseerde kwotasies, VAS2 by logistiek in vir verdere verwerking. Verkry kwotasies vir dienste (konsultante), Ontvang Terms of Reference (TOR), Verseker dat daar 'n goedgekeurde Business Case en Gap Analysis is, Verseker dat daar 'n goedkeuringsindiening is om spesifikasie- en evalueringskomitee te benoem en dat dit ooreenstem met treasury regulations 16 A en SCM-beleid, Toets die spesifikasie en maak seker dat dit voldoen aan SCM-sjablone en beleid, Reël die spesifikasievergadering en stel 'n spesifikasieverslag op. Publiseer die TOR op e-tenders en die departementele webwerf, Nooi sekuriteit en interne beheer uit, ontvang die dokumente, maak seker dat daar registers is om alle voorstelle wat gedurende die sluitingsdatum ontvang is, aan te teken, Stel evalueringsverslag op om deur die gedelegeerde gesag goedgekeur te word, Publiseer die resultate op e-tenders en die webwerf, Verseker veilige bewaring van dokumente vir ouditdoeleindes en Dien gefinaliseerde projekte by Contract Management in vir kontrak en logistiek vir verdere verwerking. Administreer kwotasieproses vir IT-verwante dienste, Ontvang DITOM-vorm met die spesifikasies, Gebruik RFB 740 en ander toepaslike verkrygingsstrategieë deur SITA om kwotasies op 'n billike en regverdige wyse te verkry, Verseker dat verskaffers op CSD geregistreer is, Daaglikse skakeling met hoofgebruikers en verskaffers, Hanteer interne en externe navrae rakende kwotasie. Implementeer alle SCM-beleide, voorskifte en wetgewing. Implementeer en verseker nakoming van alle SCM-beleide, voorskifte en wetgewing, Skakel met die CSD/DTI en National Treasury, Bystand verleen aan diensverskaffers oor stappe om te volg om aan die departementele vereistes te voldoen. Stel maandelikse statistiese verslae op. Dateer kwotasieregister beide manueel en elektronies op, Verskaf weeklikse verslag oor RFQ's en Dateer die afwykingsregister op soos dit gebeur.

zu.title: Umsizi Wezokulawula Ukuthenga
zu.summary: Ukuphatha isisekeli sedatha yabanikezeli nokuthola izikokelo ku-Department of Transport e-Pretoria, okudinga iziqu ze-NQF level 6 kwi-Supply Chain Management.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezinga le-NQF level 6 njengoba kunikwa amandla yi-SAQA kwi-Supply Chain Management / Logistics Management / Public Procurement Management ngaphandle kokuhlolwa. Ulwazi nokusebenza: Ulwazi ngemithetho yokusebenza, imithetho yokulawula izinto, kanye nendlela yokusebenza, Ulwazi nge-Public Service Regulations nesiNgathiso se-Public Service Act, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhomphyutha (SCM System, MS Word, Excel), ukuqonda nokusebenzisa imithetho yokusebenza ye-SCM kanye ne-PFMA, ukwazi nge-Treasury Regulations, amakhono ahlela nokuhlela imisebenzi, amakhono okukhuluma nokubhala kahle.
zu.duties: Lawula isisekeli sedatha yabanikezeli. Thola i-RFQ's ukuhlola ukuzilandela ngaphambi kokuthola izikokelo (Hlola uhlelo lwemali, ukuthi izindlela azikhethi kalule), Qinisekisa isu lokuthola izikokelo ezizosethenziswa nenqubo yalo yokuzibandakanya, Sebenzisa isisekeli sedatha sabanikezeli esikhungweni (CSD) kanye nezinye izindlela ezifanele zokuthola izikokelo ngendlela efanele nenhloniphekile, Qaphula izikokelo ukuze qinisekise ukuthi ziseduze nethemu evezwe ngesikhathi zitholakala, Hlola izikokelo udwebe uhlelo lokuthola izikokelo ezinhle kakhulu, Qinisekisa ukuthi abanikezeli bame kwi-CSD, Qinisekisa ukuthi umnikezeli okhethiwe ngu wona ongowona ophakeme amaphuzu, Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo lokuthola izikokelo ezinhle kakhulu lumisiwe igunya elithunyiwe, Phumelela ngeleminye ngaphambili eqoqa imininingwane mayelana nesimo sezikokelo, Gcina ukuxhumana nsuku zonke nomphathi nabanikezeli, Phatha imibuzo yangaphakathi nangaphandle kanye nomphathi nabanikezeli bese ukuhamba izikokelo eziseduze, i-VAS2 ukuhamba kulezo zokuthutha ukwenziwa kwenqubo. Thola izikokelo kwezinsizakalo (Oceli), Thola imininingwane yokuxhumana (TOR), Qinisekisa ukuthi kunobufakazi bokusebenza bokwamukelwa kanye nokuqonda okukhombisa izikhala, Qinisekisa ukuthi kunegunya elizosebenzisa i-commitee ukuqinisekisa nokuba igunya elitumiwe lifanele ngemithetho yokusebenza yokuhamba 16 A nenqubo ye-SCM, Hlola i-mininingwane bese ukwenza isu ukuze qinisekise ukuthi ihambisana nemininingwane nasekuqinisekiseni ukuzinaka kwemithetho, Lunge izinkulumo ezithinta i-mininingwane bese kudwebwa ingxoxo naye i-mininingwane. Shicilela i-TOR kwi e-tenders naku i-webhusayithi yomnyango, Mema izinsiza, ukuphuma kwento yegunya lokulawula bese ukwenza umsebenzi ohlobene, qinisekisa ukuthi bakhona ukwaziswa okuqophela bonke abaphakamisayo bafikelwe ngesikhathi esiseduze, Uhlu i-mininingwane lokuhlola abaphakamisayo kuqinisekiswe igunya elitumiwe, Shicilela imiphumela ku e-tenders nakwi webhusayithi, Qinisekisa izinsiza ezivikelekile zokuqopha ukuze kudede imibuzo, bese ukwazi ukudlula imininingwane kuhlelo lokuhamba ukuze kudluliselwe kubasebenzi naku mininingwane yokuthutha ukwenziwa kwemisebenzi. Lawula imisebenzi eholela kwezobuchwepheshe okuhlobene nezinsizakalo, Thola i-mininingwane ne-DITCOM ehamba kanye ne-mininingwane, Sebenzisa i-mininingwane ne-RFB 740 bese kwesinye isikhathi uma kukhona ezinye izindlela ezingasetshenziswa, qinisekisa ukuthi zihamba kahle ngokuzethulela kwe-CSD, bese kusukela lapho ukwenza imisebenzi, ukunaka kwabantu nabaphakamisayo, ukweluleka imisebenzi yokwazisa ngokuhlobene naleyo imisebenzi yokuhamba inqubo efanayo. Hamba ngemithethonqubo, imithetho yokusebenza, kanye nemithethonqubo yonke. Hlola ukuze uhambise imithethonqubo yonke, imithetho yokusebenza, nemithetho efanayo, Bhekana ne-CSD/DTI nasephaketheni likahulumendi, Siza abanikezeli ngokubakhombisa ezinye izinto okufanele bazilandele ukuze bazedze imithetho yomnyango. Qamba izikhwama zeminye yemibhalo evezwa inyanga zonke. Qaphela inani lemininingwane yezikokelo ngokubhala nangokusebenzisa izinto ezingabantu, Nikeza ingxoxo ngezinsuku ezinhlanu mayelana ne-RFQ bese uhlela imininingwane yokuhamba kwezidingo ezingasetshenziswa njalo.

xh.title: Umncedi weenkonzo zolawulo lokuthenga
xh.summary: Lawula isiseko seenkcukacha zabathengisi nokufumana iintengiso kwiSebe lezoKuthutha ePretoria, kufunekelo izidanga kwinqanaba le-6 le-NQF kulawulo lokuthengisa inkqubo yamathunga.
xh.requirements: Isidanga kwinqanaba le-6 le-NQF njengokuqatshiweyo ngu-SAQA kuLawulo lokuthengisa inkqubo yamathunga / uLawulo loQhinga / uLawulo lokuthengisa koluntu ngaphandle kokugqityiswa. Isaziso namakhono: Isaziso semigaqo, iimiyalelo kunye nokwenza kwe-SCM, Isaziso seQela lamagqabantshintshi loLuntu kunye noMthetho woQhinga loLuntu, Ukuqonda ekhompyutheni (iNkqubo ye-SCM, i-MS Word, i-Excel), ukuqonda nokusebenzisa imiyalelo ye-SCM ne-PFMA, isaziso seemigaqo yeTreasury, amakhono okucwangcisa nokuhlela, amakhono abalawuli mahle ookulumkisa nokubhala.
xh.duties: Lawula isiseko seenkcukacha zabathengisi. Yamkela ii-RFQ kwaye uqinisekise ukuzithoba phambi kokufumana iintengiso (qinisekisa umgangatho wesibh警惕elo ukuba asikho ngxamxamo), qinisekisa indlela yokufumana iintengiso ezakusebenziswa kunye nenkqubo yayo yokunxibelelwana, Sebenzisa isiseko seenkcukacha sabathengisi esiqhelekileyo (CSD) nezinye iindlela zokufumana iintengiso ngendlela ethembekileyo nokulinganayo, Qwalasela iintengiso uze uqinisekise ukuba zikwmgangatho nexesha elalibekiweyo xa zifunwa, Hlola iintengiso uze wakhe uluhlu oluthe ngqo, Qinisekisa ukuba abathengisi bayazithoba kwi-CSD, Qinisekisa ukuba umthengisi onikezelweyo ngowo ofumana amanqaku aphezulu kakhulu, Qinisekisa ukuba uluhvu oluthe ngqo lumisiwe ngummandu ochaziweyo, Phantse yonke imini yalule iyunithi ye-LOGIS kunye nabasebenzisi abangungangabhalela ngemimiselo yentengiso, Phatha ubudlelwane bomhooko nabasebenzisi abangungangabhalela kunye nabathengisi, Phatha imibuzo yangaphakathi nangaphandle nabasebenzisi abangungangabhalela kunye nabathengisi uze wonikeze iintengiso ezigqityiweyo, i-VAS2 kuloQhinga ukuba kuphuhliswe. Fumana intengiso yeenkonzo (oBhungu), Yamkela iMigaqo yoBulumko (TOR), Qinisekisa ukuba kukho imeko yeshishini egunyaziweyo kunye noNohlalutyo loPhawu, Qinisekisa ukuba kukho isivumelwano sokumisa iinkqubo kunye nekomiti yoBuhlalutyo nokuba ilandelana nemiqulu ye-treasury 16 A kunye noMgomo we-SCM, Qwalasa iinkqubo uze uqinisekise ukuba zihambelana neefomu ze-SCM nayo na kanye noMgama, Lungelelanisa indibano yeinkqubo uze wakhe ingxelo yeinkqubo. Shicilela i-TOR kwi-e-tenders nakwindawo yonke yesebe, Memaza ngolawulo lokhuseleko langaphakathi, yamkela amaxwebhu, qinisekisa ukuba kukho izibhengezo ukubhala zonke izindlu ezathunyelwa ngexesha lokuvala, Yakha ingxelo yohlalutyo egunyaziweyo ngummandu ochaziweyo, Shicilela iziphumo kwi-e-tenders nakwindawo yonke, Qinisekisa ukugcina amaxwebhu ngokhuseleko ngenjongo yokukhangwa, uze wonikeze amaphulo egqityiweyo kuLawulo loQwalaselwa kolwazi ngeqwalaselwa nolawulo loqunge. Lawula iNkqubo yoQhobozelelo leentengiso ezidityaniswe ne-IT, Yamkela ifomu le-DITCOM ngeenkqubo, Sebenzisa i-RFB 740 nezinye iindlela zokufumana iintengiso ezenziwe ngumntu we-SITA ngendlela ethembekileyo nokulinganayo, Qinisekisa ukuba umthengisi uyazithoba kwi-CSD, Kudibana ngokudibana nabasebenzisi abangungangabhalela kunye nabathengisi nsuku zonke, Phatha imibuzo yangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokwale ntengiso. Zisebenzisa zonke imigaqo, imiyalelo, kunye namathetho we-SCM. Zisebenzisa uze uqinisekise ukuzalathana nawo onke amanye amathetho kunye namathetho ngokusemthethweni, Dibana nabaqulunqaba nge-CSD/DTI nakwiNational Treasury, Nceda ukulumkisa abaniki zokhetho ngamanyathelo okulandela ukuzalathana neemfuno zeSebe. Yakha iingxelo zonyanga ezibhekisa kwibhalo. Hlaziya isikhangeli sentengiso ngokubhalwa ngesandla nakwe-elekthronikhi, Nika iNgxelo ygeveki nge-RFQ uze uHlaziya isikhangeli sokutshatyalaliswa nakunini na xa kusenzeka.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Neighbourhood Development Programme
jobs.summary: Chief Director needed at National Treasury in Pretoria to lead the Neighbourhood Development Programme, overseeing strategy, policy development, and urban planning initiatives.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required coupled with a minimum Bachelor’s degree (equivalent to NQF level 7) in Project Management or Civil Engineering or Urban Development or Town and Regional Planning or Economics or Commerce or Social Sciences or Public Administration or Law. A minimum 5 years’ experience at a senior managerial level obtained in urban planning. Knowledge and experience in management of infrastructure initiatives and funds, financing of property and related expenditure. Knowledge and experience of municipal service delivery legislation framework, e.g. Municipal Finance Management Act (MFMA), Treasury Regulations, etc. In-depth knowledge of government departments operations, e.g. Cooperative governance and their supporting entities. Knowledge and experience in the management of urban and/or economic infrastructure development, e.g. project analysis oversight and contractual matters. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government available as an online course on https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, prior to finalisation of an appointment.
jobs.duties: Implement Strategy and Policy Development: Develop and implement an annual strategy aligned with IFISA and NDP mandates. Consult stakeholders and identify key performance indicators for the strategy. Monitor and evaluate progress against targets and provide stakeholder feedback. Lead unit plans, process improvements and implementation initiatives. Monitor turnaround times and quality standards, resolve service delivery issues and implement dispute-resolution mechanisms. Monitor, evaluate and ensure compliance with organisational policies and procedures. Contribute to business planning and strategy development and oversee the unit budget. Municipal Project Development Preparation: Identify and prioritise municipal projects for planning, feasibility assessment and bankability. Manage initiatives that expand blended-finance, bankable programmes and projects to maximise development impact and financial sustainability. Develop business strategies and opportunities to build a bankable project pipeline and secure governance approval. Review and communicate the Urban Networks Strategy, and guide urban planning, implementation and innovation. Review municipal business cases and feasibility studies for IFISA funding consideration. Review spatial targeting, precinct design, investment phasing, management and project plans for alignment. Provide input on the prioritisation and implementation of municipal capital projects. Private and Public Sector Investment: Support priority municipalities to identify, package, structure and implement projects that attract private sector investment at scale. Collaborate with IFISA units to mobilise spatially targeted private sector investment for priority municipalities. Prioritise high-impact private sector investment strategies in targeted precincts and urban hubs. Engage public and private sector decision-makers to strengthen stakeholder partnerships and investment cooperation. Operations Management: Provide direction in executing strategy and management of portfolios. Support diversity strategies and related initiatives, Engage and build synergies and cooperation with stakeholders. Promote business and organisational values and sustain a high-performance culture. Assist with developmental initiatives and optimise capability to improve organisational performance. Contribute to IFISA pipeline: Determine value of projects originated and approved into the IFISA pipeline. Calculate projects packaged and submitted for funding consideration of approvals, Prepare projects committed for IFISA pipeline private sector funding catalysed for approved projects/programmes. Partner with established leaders promoting IFISA infrastructure development opportunities. Determine the number of agreements concluded with strategic partners for the implementation of IFISA's objectives and mandate in alignment with structured MoU/ MoAs.
jobs.enquiries: enquiries only (No applications): Recruitment.Enquries@treasury.gov.za OTHER POST
jobs.applications: To apply visit: https://erecruitment.treasury.gov.za/eRecruitment
jobs.notes: Effective from 7 April 2021, the National Treasury now utilises an e-Recruitment System which means all applicants must login/register to apply for positions, we only accept hand delivered/posted applications should an applicant prove that he/she tried to apply via e-Recruitment with no success and the National Treasury ICT unit was unable to assist. The applicant’s profile on the e- Recruitment is equivalent to the newly approved Z83, and it is the responsibility of applicants to ensure their profiles are fully completed or their applications will not be considered, as per the DPSA Practice Note. Certain documentation will still be required to be uploaded on the system such as copies of all qualifications including National Senior Certificate/Matric certificate, ID, etc., however these documents need not be certified at point of application, however certification will be required prior to attending the interview. Please note: All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. It should be noted that the National Treasury does not support the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in any of its recruitment and selection processes and will disqualify an application if it picks up the use of AI when completing assessments without acknowledging the source of information. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government,            available       as      an       online       course      on https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, prior to finalisation of appointment, is a requirement for all SMS positions. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All qualifications, criminal and SA citizenship checks will be conducted on all short-listed candidates and, where applicable, additional checks will be conducted in line with the new DPSA Directive effective 01 April 2024. Please note that by responding to our advertisement/s, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information for internal HR processes in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), Act No. 4 of 2013. In the event that your application is unsuccessful, the Department will retain your personal information only for audit purposes as required by policies, only for a specific period, of which the submitted documents will then be destroyed as legislated in the National Archives Act. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all their foreign qualifications (this includes O and A level certificates) evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at your own expense. Upon appointment, successful candidates will be required to disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests and to sign a Performance Agreement within 3 months from date of appointment and for candidates whose appointment exceeds 12 calendar months will be appointed on probation for the period of twelve (12) calendar months excluding leave taken as prescribed by Public Service Regulation 68. The status of your application will be visible on the e-Recruitment system. However, if you have not received feedback from the National Treasury within 3 months of the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Note: The National Treasury reserves the right not to fill the below-mentioned posts, withdraw or to put on hold a position and/or to re-advertise a post. All queries must be submitted via email addressed to the Human Resources Recruitment Support Team on Recruitment.Enquiries@treasury.gov.za. Kindly note that all National Treasury adverts published/LIVE on the eRecruitment System have a closing date listed and closing time of 12h00 (Midday) on that closing date. The system is designed to automatically remove the advert from public view at exactly 12h00 (Midday) of the said closing date for that post. There are no other means to submit applications post the closing date and time, if you have missed or delayed in submitting on time. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Neighbourhood Development Programme
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur benodig by National Treasury in Pretoria om die Neighbourhood Development Programme te lei, met toesig oor strategie, beleidsontwikkeling en stadsbeplanningsinisiatiewe.
af.requirements: 'n Grade 12 word vereis tesame met 'n minimum Bachelors-graad (gelykstaande aan NQF vlak 7) in Project Management of Civil Engineering of Urban Development of Town and Regional Planning of Economics of Commerce of Social Sciences of Public Administration of Law. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak wat in stadsbeplanning opgedoen is. Kennis en ervaring in die bestuur van infrastruktuurinisiatiewe en -fondse, finansiering van eiendom en verwante uitgawes. Kennis en ervaring van die wetgewende raamwerk vir munisipale dienslewering, bv. Municipal Finance Management Act (MFMA), Treasury Regulations, ens. Diepgaande kennis van die bedrywighede van regeringsdepartemente, bv. Cooperative governance en hul ondersteunende entiteite. Kennis en ervaring in die bestuur van stads- en/of ekonomiese infrastruktuurontwikkeling, bv. projeksanalise, toesig en kontraktuele aangeleenthede. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme soos deur die National School of Government goedgekeur, beskikbaar as 'n aanlyn kursus op https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, voor die finalisering van 'n aanstelling.
af.duties: Implementeer Strategie en Beleidsontwikkeling: Ontwikkel en implementeer 'n jaarlikse strategie wat met IFISA- en NDP-behoeftes ooreenstem. Raadpleeg belanghebbendes en identifiseer sleutelprestasie-aanwysers vir die strategie. Monitor en evalueer vordering teenoor teikens en verskaf terugvoer aan belanghebbendes. Lei eenheidsplanne, prosesverbeterings en implementeringinisiatiewe. Monitor deurlooptye en kwaliteitsstandaarde, los diensleweringsprobleme op en implementeer geskikbilikingsmeganismes. Monitor, evalueer en verseker nakoming van organisatoriese beleide en prosedures. Dra by tot besigheidsbeplanning en strategieontwikkeling en hou toesig oor die eenheidsbegroting. Munisipale Projeksontwikkeling en Voorbereiding: Identifiseer en prioriteer munisipale projekte vir beplanning, haalbaarheidsassessering en bankabiliteit. Bestuur inisiatiewe wat gemengde finansiering, bankbare programme en projekte uitbrei om ontwikkelingsimpak en finansiële volhoubaarheid te maksimeer. Ontwikkel besigheidsstrategieë en geleenthede om 'n bankbare projekpyplyn te bou en goewermenteurgoedkeuring te verkry. Hersien en kommunikeer die Urban Networks Strategy, en lei stadsbeplanning, implementering en innovasie. Hersien munisipale besigheidsgevalle en haalbaarheidsstudies vir IFISA-finansieringoorweging. Hersien ruimtelike teikening, ontwerp van presinte, beleggingsfasering, bestuur en projeksplanne vir belyning. Verskaf insette oor die prioritering en implementering van munisipale kapitaalprojekte. Private en Publieke Sektorebelegging: Ondersteun voorrangmunisipaliteite om projekte te identifiseer, te verpak, te struktureer en te implementeer wat privatesektorbelegging op skaal aantrek. Werk saam met IFISA-eenhede om ruimtelik geteikende privatesektorbelegging vir voorrangmunisipaliteite te mobiliseer. Prioriteer hoë-impak privatesektorbeleggingstrategieë in geteikende presinte en stedelike spilpunte. Betrek publieke en privatesektorbesluitnemers om belanghebbendevennootskappe en beleggingssamewerking te versterk. BedrywighedeBestuur: Verskaf rigting in die uitvoering van strategie en bestuur van portefeuljes. Ondersteun diversiteitsstrategieë en verwante inisiatiewe, Betrek en bou sinergieë en samewerking met belanghebbendes. Bevorder besigheids- en organisatoriese waardes en handhaaf 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Bystand met ontwikkelingsinisiatiewe en optimaliseer vermoë om organisatoriese prestasie te verbeter. Dra by tot IFISA-pyplyn: Bepaal die waarde van projekte wat vir die IFISA-pyplyn ontwikkel en goedgekeur is. Bereken projekte wat verpak en vir finansieringoorweging van goedkeurings ingedien is, Berei projekte voor wat vir die IFISA-pyplyn vir privatesektorfinansiering vir goedgekeurde projekte/programme gekataliseer is. Werk saam met gevestigde leiers wat IFISA-infrastruktuurontwikkelingsgeleenthede bevorder. Bepaal die aantal ooreenkomste wat met strategiese vennote gesluit is vir die implementering van IFISA se doelwitte en mandaat in ooreenstemming met gestruktureerde MoU/MoAs.

zu.title: Umphathi Omkhulu: I-Neighbourhood Development Programme
zu.summary: Kudingeka uMphathi Omkhulu e-National Treasury e-Pretoria ukuba ahole i-Neighbourhood Development Programme, abheke inqubomgomo, ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo, kanye nemizamo yokuhlela izindawo zasedolobheni.
zu.requirements: Kudingwa i-Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor's degree okungenani (elingana ne-NQF level 7) ku-Project Management noma i-Civil Engineering noma i-Urban Development noma i-Town and Regional Planning noma i-Economics noma i-Commerce noma i-Social Sciences noma i-Public Administration noma i-Law. Kudingwa okungenani eminyaka engu-5 yamava ezingeni eliphezulu lokuqashwa etholwe ekuhleleni izindawo zasedolobheni. Ulwazi namava ekuphathweni kwemizamo yezinsiza ezinhle nemali, ekufinanseleni izindawo kanye nezindleko eziphathelene nakho. Ulwazi namava ngohlelo lomthetho lokulethwa kwesevisi yomasipala, njenge-Municipal Finance Management Act (MFMA), i-Treasury Regulations, njll. Ulwazi olujulile ngemisebenzi yeminyango kahulumeni, njenge-Cooperative governance kanye nezinhlangana ezinisekelayo. Ulwazi namava ekuphathweni kokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza ezinhle zasedolobheni kanye/noma zezomnotho, njengokuhlola ukuhlaziwa kwephrojekthi kanye nezindaba zesivumelwano. Ukuqedwa ngempumelelo kwe-Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme njengoba kuncoma i-National School of Government etholakala njengekhosi inthanethi ku-https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, ngaphambi kokugqitywa kokumiswa esikhundleni.
zu.duties: Ukuze kusetshenziswe Inqubomgomo kanye noKuthuthukiswa kweNqubomgomo:uthuthuke futhi asetshenzise inqubomgomo yonyaka ehambisana namandla we-IFISA kanye ne-NDP. Axoxe nabanomzamo futhi ahloniphe izinkomba eziyisihlome somgomo wokuqonda ukusebenza. Abheke futhi ahlolisise inqubo ehambisana nemigomo futhi anikeze impendulo kabanomzamo. Ahole izinhlelo zeyunithi, ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubo kanye nemizamo yokusebenza. Abheke izikhathi zokuqonda futhi ahlolisise izinga lokuphila, axaze izinkinga zokulethwa kwezinsiza futhi asetshenzise izindlela zokuqedwa yezingxabano. Abheke, ahlolisise futhi aqiniseke ukuzethemba ngeminqumo yentengo nezinqumo kahulumeni. Axhasa ukuhlelwa kwebhizinisi nokuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo futhi abheke ibhajethi yeyunithi. Ukuhlakaniswa kokuThuthukiswa kwePhrojekthi yaBamasipala: ahloniphe futhi acabange izinhlobo zamaphrojekthi abamasipala ngenhlobonhlobo, ahlolisise ukuzinza kwawo futhi ukwazi ukuqinisekiswa kwemali. Aphathe imizamo ekwandiseni imali ehlanganiswe, amaphrojekthi anamandla nokuhamba kahle ukuze kuthuthukiswe impumelelo yokuthuthukiswa nokuzinza kwezemali. Athuthukise izinhlela kanye namathuba ebhizinisi ukwakha ipayiphalayini yamaphrojekthi anamandla futhi asize ukugunyazwa kahulumeni. Ahlaze futhi axoxe ngohlelo lwe-Urban Networks, futhi ahole ukuhlelwa kwamasiko, ukusebenza kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasedolobheni. Ahlaze izinkomba zebhizinisi zabamasipala kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwamaphrojekthi ukuze kuhlolwe ukufakwa kwemali ku-IFISA. Ahlaze ukuqondwa kwezindawo, ukwakhiwa kwendawo, ukwabiwa kwemali, ukuphathwa kanye nezinhlelo zamaphrojekthi ukuze zihambelane. Anikeze imibono ngokuqondwa kwezinhlobo zokuqala nokusetshenziswa kwamaphrojekthi abamasipala. Ukutshuliswa kweMali yiBhunga leHulumeni nangeBhunga loBumbi: axase abomasipala abaphambili ukuthi bathole, bahlanganise, bahlele futhi basebenzise amaphrojekthi ezothuta ukutshuliswa kwemali yababungeli ngesikhathi eside. Axoxe neyunithi ye-IFISA ukuthola imali yokutshuliswa kwababungeli kubomasipala abalubhaxo. Ahloniphe izinhlela ezinamandla zokutshuliswa kwemali kubabungeli ezindaweni ezihlosiwe kanye nasezikhungweni zasedolobheni. Axoxe nabantu abaphatha izinqumo kuhulumeni nasebumbini ukuze kwandise ukuhlobana nabanomzamo nokuhlanganyela kwemali. Ukuphathwa koKusebenza: anikeze isiqondiso ekusebenzeni kwenqubomgomo nakuphathweni kwamasu. Axase izinhlela zokuqonda izinto ezahlukene kanye nemizamo ehlobene nalokho, axoxe futhi akhe ukubambana nokusebenza ndawonye nabanomzamo. Athuthukise izimilo zebhizinisi nenhlangano futhi agcine isiko eliphakeme lokusebenza kahle. Asize emizamweni yokuthuthuka futhi athuthukise ikhono ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwenhlangano. Axase ukwakhiwa kwe-IFISA pipeline: aqonde inani lamaphrojekthi aqukethwe futhi agunyazwe abangenwe kwe-IFISA pipeline. Abale amaphrojekthi ahleliwe futhi athunyelwe ukuze kuhlolwe ukufakwa kwemali, alungise amaphrojekthi avumiwe kwe-IFISA pipeline imali yokutshuliswa kubabungeli etholwe yamaphrojekthi/izinhlela ezagunyazwa. Axhumanise nabaholi abasungule ukuthuthukisa amathuba we-IFISA ezinsiza. Aqonde inani lezivumelwano ezifakwe nabahlanganyeli abaphambili ukuze kusetshenziswe amagoso kanye namandla e-IFISA ehambisana ne-MoU/ MoAs.

xh.title: Umphathi weNqanaba eliphezulu: Inqubo yeNtshukumo yeNdawo ekuhlalwa kuyo
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe nguMphathi weNqanaba eliphezulu kwi-National Treasury ePretoria ukuba anikele ingqeqesho kwiNeighbourhood Development Programme, aze alawule iindlela ezisetyenziswayo, uphuhliso lweenqobo ezethutyana, nemiqathango yokucwangciswa kwedolophu.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ibe nekwasimatriki, ngokuhambelana nedayimani yakwa-Bachelor's (elingu NQF level 7) kwiProject Management okanye iCivil Engineering okanye uRhuqulo lweZima okanye iTown and Regional Planning okanye uMnozo-mali okanye iNtengiso okanye uMfundo yeNzululwazi zeZenkcubeko okanye uLawulo lweLuntu olusebenzela urhulumende okanye uMthetho. Kufuneka abe namava iminyaka engu-5 ubukhulu bokusebenza kwinqanaba eliphakamileyo lolawulo awafumene kucwangciswa lwendawo dolophu. Ulwazi namava ekulawulweni kweenqobo zeziseko eziyimozulu nemali, uxhaso lemali yempahla nentlawulo ebanda. Ulwazi namava ngohlobo lothetho olucacisa inkqubo yamasebe abantu ngabemi, umzekelo iMunicipal Finance Management Act (MFMA), iNqobo-mali yeTreasury, njalo njalo. Ulwazi lokuqondileyo ngemisebenzi kumasebe ka-rhulumente, umzekelo uLawulo ngokuhlangeneyo nemithelela encedayo. Ulwazi namava ekulawulweni kokuphuhlisa iziseko eziyimozulu nedolophu okanye yomdya-bantu nakwezozo-mali, umzekelo ulawulo lwesahluko nesinxibelelwano samagama okulinganisa kwaye nemiba yamagama. Ukuphuma ngempumelelo kuNyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme njengoko igunyazwe yi-National School of Government etholakala njengenkqubo yamakompyutha kwelinye ihlobo mayela nayo at https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, ngaphambi kokugqitywa kobulumko lokuqesha umntu.
xh.duties: Ukuqaliswa kweenkqobo nobuChwephesha bobuLungisa-Mthetho: Qamba uphuhlise uze usebenzise iNqobo yonyaka ehambelana namagunya e-IFISA ne-NDP. Nxibelela nabadlali beentlangano uze wachaze izalathisi ezibalulekileyo zenzuzo yobuyenza kwinqobo. Landa uphuhlise igqondo lokwenza ngokuchanekileyo kumgama oqeqeshwa, uze unike abadlali beentlangano ingxelo ngenkqubo yobuyenza. Qhagamshela iinkqobo zeeyunithi, uphuhliso lwenkqubo yemisebenzi yomzobo wemikhankanyo yokuzisebenzisa. Landa ixesha elithathwa kwenziwa into, inqobo, izigqibo zemiba yokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo, kwaye usebenzise iindlela zokuqondanisa iingxabano. Landa, hluza uqinisekise ukuzalathana namacebo okuziphatha okwentlangano nolwelwimi lwayo. Ncedisa ekucwangcisweni kwezoshishino nakwindlela yokuphuhlisa isu, uze ulawule isedu yeyunithi. ULungiselwo loPpululo lweMimisimayeli yaseBaya: Chaza uphawule amaphulo e mimisimayeli yokucwangciswa, ukulingana ngokwethutyana nokwamkelwa ngokuzinikela kwemali. Lawula imikhankanyo ekwandisayo inxibelelwano lemali elungele amacelo ukwanelisa amaphulo nokuzinikela ngokweemali. Phuhlisa iindlela zeshishino namlatha ukwakha iqela lamaphulo alungele imali uze wafumana isigqibo solawulo. Phinda uziveze iNqobo yokuzonakaliswa kweZakhiwo kwi Dolophu, uze ulawule iNkqubo yokucwangciswa kwedolophu, ukusetyenziswa nokuphuhliswa kweendlela entsha. Phinda uhlole amacelo abasebenzi be mimisimayeli ngezifundo zokwethutyana kolwazi oluqinisekisa ukwamkelwa kwe IFISA. Phinda uhlole ukujolisa indawo ngokommandla, iNqobo yokuziphatha, amaxesha okuchitha izityalo, ulawulo nokuqulunqwa kwamaphulo ukuqinisekisa ukulungelelanisa. Nika isalathiso ngokubaluleka nokusetyenziswa kwamaphulo e rhulumente abe mawuso. I Zukathi lwaMacebo oShishino: Xhasa abajongiweyo be mimisimayeli ekubeni bachaze, bahlole, balungelelanise uze basebenzise amaphulo azakuba negalelo lokuzinikela kwamazwe emihla ngemihla ngokuchanekileyo esebenza. Sebenzisana neeyunithi ze IFISA ekubeni izinikelo ezibekwe kwindawo ezithile zichaze ukuqinisekisa ukuba kuya kuhanjiswa amacebo amakhulu. Qaphela iindlela eziphakamileyo ezichaze ukuba angazizuzisa amacebo amakhulu kunxibelelwano neyona ndawo ithintelwe ukuqina koluntu. Nxibelela nabagqibelayo somhlahlweze woshishino nokurhulumente ukugcina ubudlelwane namadlali kuze kube mnye umbuzo wokuhlangeneyo. ULawulo lokuSebenza: Nikezela inkqubo ngenkqubo yokusetyenziswa ephantsi kwemikhankanyo yolawulo ephantsi kwayo. Ncedisa ukuba uhlobo lonke lwento kwiimeko nemicimbi engamaminiselwa. Yanxibelela uze wakhe isiphithiphithi kwabanye abajongiweyo. Qinisekisa inkqubo entsha yamacebo ohlelo olukuzo nokugcina isiko lokuzinikela ngokuphumelela. Ncedisa kumathuba okuzibonelela nokusetyenziswa ngokubanzi kolwazi ukuze kube kona ukwandiswa kweNkqubo yokusebenza kwentlangano. Nceda kumxholo ovela e-IFISA: Chaza ixabiso lamaphulo aqaliweyo asuka kwamanye amaphulo asetyenziselwa ukuvunywa kwemali evela e-IFISA. Balula amaphulo axhotyiweyo angeniswayo ukuze axelwe kwinkqubo ukuze avunywe. Lungiselela amaphulo athunyelwe kwindlela e IFISA yemali ekhoyo ekhankanyiweyo ngaphandle kobulumko bobuChwephesha. Sebenzisana nabanikazi beNqanaba eliphezulu abaxhasa iindaba zokuphuhliswa kweziseko ze-IFISA. Balula inani lezivumelwano ezifunyanwe kunxibelelwano namadlali beNqanaba eliphezulu ekuphumeleleni iNqobo nethamsanqa le-IFISA ngokutsho kumthetho oqulunqwe njengesivumelwano ngokwemigaqo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Expenditure and Revenue Management
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Expenditure and Revenue Management at National Treasury in Pretoria, requiring a bachelor's degree and four years' financial management experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required coupled with a minimum Bachelor’s Degree (equivalent to NQF level 7) in Financial Accounting or Business Management or Public Administration. A minimum 4 years’ experience of which 2 years should be at an Assistant Director level or equivalent obtained in financial accounting and supply chain management environment. Knowledge and experience of the government financial management framework. Knowledge and experience of revenue and expenditure dissemination and reconciliation.
jobs.duties: Process transactions of creditors and departmental payments: Process and reconcile transactions concerning all creditors. Authorise payments on BAS and LOGIS Procurement Integration. Generate management reports concerning creditors and other related payments. Communicate with internal and external stakeholders on confirmation of receipt of payments. Transfer funds to government departments, entities, and agencies: Initiate the transfer of funds to provinces, municipalities and entities in compliance with regulatory requirements. Verify transfers through the reconciliation of the transfer schedule. Cash deposits, departmental revenue, and petty cash: Issue cash receipts as proof of confirmation of deposits paid. Allocate departmental revenue and justify the support documents as proof of payments. Issue petty cash advances and record in Petty Cash Register for record purposes. Manage the National Treasury ‘s bank accounts: Initiate the clearing of control and bank accounts as prescribed. Execute banking transactions with the relevant supporting documents. Perform bank reconciliations and minimise discrepancies. Co-ordinate requested funds based on designated drawings schedules and facilitate through SAFETYWEB. Monitor allocations to control and suspense accounts: Engage affected institutions when recover amounts allocated to control/ suspense accounts. Review reconciliations and ensure that amounts allocated to control/ suspense accounts are cleared. Review management reports and other relevant information pertaining to control/suspense accounts for correctness.
jobs.applications: To apply visit: https://erecruitment.treasury.gov.za/eRecruitment
jobs.notes: Effective from 7 April 2021, the National Treasury now utilises an e-Recruitment System which means all applicants must login/register to apply for positions, we only accept hand delivered/posted applications should an applicant prove that he/she tried to apply via e-Recruitment with no success and the National Treasury ICT unit was unable to assist. The applicant’s profile on the e- Recruitment is equivalent to the newly approved Z83, and it is the responsibility of applicants to ensure their profiles are fully completed or their applications will not be considered, as per the DPSA Practice Note. Certain documentation will still be required to be uploaded on the system such as copies of all qualifications including National Senior Certificate/Matric certificate, ID, etc., however these documents need not be certified at point of application, however certification will be required prior to attending the interview. Please note: All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. It should be noted that the National Treasury does not support the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in any of its recruitment and selection processes and will disqualify an application if it picks up the use of AI when completing assessments without acknowledging the source of information. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government,            available       as      an       online       course      on https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, prior to finalisation of appointment, is a requirement for all SMS positions. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All qualifications, criminal and SA citizenship checks will be conducted on all short-listed candidates and, where applicable, additional checks will be conducted in line with the new DPSA Directive effective 01 April 2024. Please note that by responding to our advertisement/s, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information for internal HR processes in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), Act No. 4 of 2013. In the event that your application is unsuccessful, the Department will retain your personal information only for audit purposes as required by policies, only for a specific period, of which the submitted documents will then be destroyed as legislated in the National Archives Act. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all their foreign qualifications (this includes O and A level certificates) evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at your own expense. Upon appointment, successful candidates will be required to disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests and to sign a Performance Agreement within 3 months from date of appointment and for candidates whose appointment exceeds 12 calendar months will be appointed on probation for the period of twelve (12) calendar months excluding leave taken as prescribed by Public Service Regulation 68. The status of your application will be visible on the e-Recruitment system. However, if you have not received feedback from the National Treasury within 3 months of the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Note: The National Treasury reserves the right not to fill the below-mentioned posts, withdraw or to put on hold a position and/or to re-advertise a post. All queries must be submitted via email addressed to the Human Resources Recruitment Support Team on Recruitment.Enquiries@treasury.gov.za. Kindly note that all National Treasury adverts published/LIVE on the eRecruitment System have a closing date listed and closing time of 12h00 (Midday) on that closing date. The system is designed to automatically remove the advert from public view at exactly 12h00 (Midday) of the said closing date for that post. There are no other means to submit applications post the closing date and time, if you have missed or delayed in submitting on time. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Uitgawe- en Inkomste-bestuur
af.summary: Onderdirekteur: Uitgawe- en Inkomste-bestuur by National Treasury in Pretoria, wat 'n bachelorsgraad en vier jaar se finansiële bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: A Grade 12 word vereis tesame met 'n minimum Bachelor's Degree (gelykstaande aan NQF level 7) in Financial Accounting of Business Management of Public Administration. 'n Minimum 4 jaar ervaring waarvan 2 jaar op 'n Assistant Director-vlak of gelykstaande behoort te wees, verkry in 'n finansiële rekenkundige en voorsieningskettingbestuursomgewing. Kennis en ervaring van die regerings se finansiële bestuursraamwerk. Kennis en ervaring van inkomste- en uitgaweverspreiding en -afstemming.
af.duties: Verwerk transaksies van skuldeisers en departementele betalings: Verwerk en stem transaksies aangaande alle skuldeisers af. Magtig betalings op BAS en LOGIS Procurement Integration. Genereer bestuursverslae aangaande skuldeisers en ander verwante betalings. Kommunikeer met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes oor bevestiging van ontvangs van betalings. Dra fondse oor na regeringsdepartemente, entiteite en agentskappe: Begin die oordrag van fondse na provinsies, munisipaliteite en entiteite in ooreenstemming met regulatoriese vereistes. Verifieer oordragte deur die afstemming van die oordragskedule. Kontant Deposito, Departementele Inkomste en Kleinkontant: Reik kontantkwitansies uit as bewys van bevestiging van Deposito betaal. Ken Departementele Inkomste toe en regverdig die ondersteuningsdokumente as bewys van betalings. Reik Kleinkontant vooruitbetaling uit en teken dit in die Kleinkontantregister vir doeleindes van rekordhouding. Bestuur die National Treasury se bankrekeninge: Begin die skoonmaak van beheer- en bankrekeninge soos voorgeskryf. Voer banktransaksies uit met die tersaaklike ondersteunende dokumente. Doen bankafstemmings en minimaliseer teenstrydighede. Koördineer versoekte fondse op grond van aangewese trekkedules en fasiliteer deur SAFETYWEB. Monitor toekenning aan Beheer- en verh accounte: Raadpleeg getroffe instellings wanneer bedrae wat aan Beheer-/verh accounte toegewys is, teruggevorder word. Hersien afstemmings en verseker dat bedrae wat aan Beheer-/verh accounte toegewys is, skoongemaak word. Hersien bestuursverslae en ander tersaaklike inligting aangaande Beheer-/verh accounte vir korrektheid.

zu.title: Isiphathindhuna: Ukuphathwa Kokusebenzisa Imali Nentrye Yemali
zu.summary: Isiphathindhuna: Ukuphathwa Kokusebenzisa Imali Nentrye Yemali e-National Treasury e-Pretoria, kudingeka iziqu ze-bachelor neminyaka emine yohlu lokusebenza ekuphathweni kwezezimali.
zu.requirements: Kudingeka ibhalwe i-Grade 12 kanye neziqu ze-Bachelor's Degree (ezilingana ne-NQF level 7) kwi-Financial Accounting noma i-Business Management noma i-Public Administration. Kudingwa omunyaka emide weminyaka emi-4 okokuba iminyaka engu-2 kumele ibe kwazinga lase-Assistant Director noma okulingana nayo etholakale esimeni sezimali nezibalo kanye nemikhakha yokuphathwa kwesinxephe. Ulwazi loluhlu lokuphathwa kwezezimali kahulumeni. Ulwazi lolwazi mayelana nokusakazwa nokuvumelanisa kwentrye yemali nokusebenzisa imali.
zu.duties: Bhekisisa ukutholakala kwemali ekhokhwayo nokwenza izinkokhelo zomnyango: Hlela bese uvumelanisa ukutholakala kwemali mayelana nabo bonke abakwezimali. Vumela izinkokhelo ku-BAS kanye ne-LOGIS Procurement Integration. Dala imibiko yabaphathi mayelana nabakwezimali kanye nezinye izinkokhelo ezihlobene. Xhumana nabaholi bangaphakathi nabangaphandle ekwaziseni ngokuqinisekiswa ukuthi izinkokhelo zitholakele. Dlulisa imali eminyangweni kahulumeni, emasikhundleni, nasemapentshini: Qala ukudlulisa imali esifundazweni, emakhaphetheni kumasikhundla ngokuhambisana nezidingo zemithetho. Qinisekisa ukudluliswa ngokuvumelanisa ohlelweni lokudluliswa imali. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezimali ngokuzihlawulela, intrye yemali yomnyango, nemali encane: Khuphula izibambo sezimali ngokuzihlawulela njengesibonakaliso sokugunyazwa kokuhlawulwa. Qamba intrye yemali yomnyango futhi chaza amadokhumenti okusekela njengesibonakaliso sezinkokhelo. Khuphula imali encane njengamali esikhathi futhi ibhalwe kusiblalo se-Petty Cash ngenjongo yokugcina irekhodi. Phatha amasikola ebhange lika-National Treasury: Qala ukusula amasikola okulawula kanye namabhange njengoba kumisiwe. Hlela izinkokhelo zebhange namadokhumenti okusekela ahambisanayo. Yenza ukuvumelanisa kwamabhange futhi unciphise ukungahambelani. Hlela imali eceliwe ngokwemihlela yokuhlela ukubekwa kwemali futhi ukwenze ngokusebenzisa i-SAFETYWEB. Qaphela ukwabiwa kwemali kwizikhiye zokulawula nezokubeka imala: Xhumana nabezikhungo ezithintekile uma kutholwa imabiwe kwizikhiye zokulawula/ezokubeka imala. Hlola ukuvumelanisa futhi uqinisekise ukuthi imali ebalwe kwizikhiye zokulawula/ezokubeka imala isuliwe. Hlola imibiko yabaphathi kanye nemininingwane ezohlobene nezikhiye zokulawula/ezokubeka imala ukuthi ifanele.

xh.title: I-Mputy Director: Expenditure and Revenue Management
xh.summary: I-Deputy Director: Expenditure and Revenue Management kwi-National Treasury ePretoria, ifuna isidanga se-bachelor's kwaye neminyaka emi-4 yamava owonakele ngokulawula imali.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ibekho i-Grade 12 ekunye nokuqinisekisiwa ngesiqu se-Bachelor's Degree (elingana ne-NQF level 7) kwi-Financial Accounting okanye i-Business Management okanye i-Public Administration. Amava angu-4 apho kwawo emnyaka mibini kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lase-Assistant Director okuba lingana nalo, abafunyanwa kwimeko yokubhalwa kwemali nolawulo lwendlela yokuhlinzwa. Ulwazi namava kolawulo lwemali lolawulo karhulumthe. Ulwazi namava ngokusasazwa nokulinganisa imali ezuza kunye nalowo echithayo.
xh.duties: Qhuba izinto ezizuzisa nokuhlinzwa kwesebe: Qhuba ulinganise izinto ezithintela onke abazuzi. Vimba imahlawuliyo kwi-BAS nakwi-LOGIS Procurement Integration. Velisa iinkcukacha ezilawulayo malunga ngezizuzi nakunye namahlawuliwo ahlobene nawo. Thetha nabathathi nxaxhebangaphakathi nabangaphandle nokuqinisekiswa kokufunyanwa kwamahlawuliwo. Duduzela imali kurhulumathe wamasebe, izinto, kunye namagunyaziswa: Qalisa ukududuzela imali kumaphondo, kwii-municipalities nakwezinto ngokuthobeka imigaqo efunwayo. Qinisekisa ukududuzelwa ngokulinganisa ijogra yokududuzela. Iimali ezibhukhwe ngokutsha, imali esebe, kunye nencwadi encinci yemali: Nikela ngesitifikedi samali njengoxa bobakholo lokungena kwamali. Yabelisa imali esebe kwaye nika isigqibo ngamaxwebhu akuthembisa njengoxa bobakholo bamahlawuliwo. Nikela ngemali encinci yokuqhubela phambili kwaye ubhale kwi-Petty Cash Register ngenjongo yokugcina irekhodhi. Lawula ii-akhawunti zebhanki ze-National Treasury: Qalisa ukucoca ii-akhawunti ezilawulayo nezobhanki njengoko kumiselwe. Zenza izinto zobhanki ekunye namaxwebhu axhasa okufanelekileyo. Yenza ukulinganisa iibhanki kwaye unciphise ukungahambelani. Lawula imali eceliweyo ngokwesiseko sokutsala njengoko kukhethiwe kwaye yenza ngaphakathi kwi-SAFETYWEB. Qwalasela ukwabelwa ii-akhawunti ezilawulayo nezazimeleyo: Thetha namanobangela axhomekeke kuso isikhathi sokubuyiswa kwamabeliswa ii-akhawunti ezilawulayo/ezazimeleyo. Phinda ulinganise kwaye uqinisekise ukuba amabeliswa ii-akhawunti ezilawulayo/ezazimeleyo acociwe. Phinda uqwalasele iinkcukacha ezilawulayo kunye nolunye ulwazi oluhlobene nazo ii-akhawunti ezilawulayo/ezazimeleyo ngenjongo yokuzichanxa.

Understanding of financial, change and knowledge management. Service delivery and innovation. Problem solving and analysis. People management and empowerment. Client orientation and customer focus. Excellent communication skills both (verbal and written). Accountability and ethical conduct.

Implement review mechanisms to regularly assess compliance with prescribed standards and practices. Oversee and lead the establishment, implementation, and effective operation of corporate governance structures, procedures, practices, controls and safeguards. Oversee the drafting of directives to be issued by the Minister to water governance entities. Collaborate with legal and regulatory teams to ensure directives are clear, enforceable and support legislative objectives. ENQURIES : Mr Vincent Molatana Tel No: (012) 336 8610

Successful completion of the Pre-entry Certificate for SMS as endorsed by the National School of Government. Begrip en toepassing van finansies. Kennis van die regulering en toesig oor statutêre liggame. Kennis van tersaaklike wetgewing binne die watersektor. Kennis en toepassing van projek- en programleierskapsbestuur. Begrip van die besigheids- en begrotingsbeplanningsraamwerk van die Suid-Afrikaanse regering. Begrip van tersaaklike openbare diens voorskrifte. Strategiese kapasiteit en leierskap. Begrip van finansiële, veranderings- en kennisbestuur. Dienslewering en innovasie. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Kliëntgerigtheid en kundefokus. Uitstekende Kommunikasievaardighede beide (mondelings en skriftelik). Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Hou toesig oor en lei die vestiging en ontbinding van watersektor-instellings (wat waterhulpbronne en -dienste oorskry). Lei die ontwikkeling en implementering van raamwerke en beleide vir die skep of ontbind van instellings binne die watersektor. Hou toesig oor die monitering van instellings, sake, praktyke, aktiwiteite, gedrag en optrede om ooreenstemming met wetgewende en ooreengekome norme te verseker. Implementeer hersieningsmeganismes om gereeld aan die voorgeskrewe standaarde en praktyke te voldoen. Hou toesig oor en lei die vestiging, implementering en effektiewe werking van korporatiewe bestuursstrukture, prosedures, praktyke, kontroles en veiligheidsmaatreëls. Hou toesig oor die opstel van direktiewe wat deur die Minister aan waterbestuursentiteite uitgereik moet word. Werk saam met regs- en regulatoriese spanne om te verseker dat direktiewe duidelik, afdwingbaar is en wetgewende doelwitte ondersteun. NAVRAE : Mr Vincent Molatana Tel No: (012) 336 8610

zu.title: Umphathi Oyinhloko: Ukuphathwa Kwezikhungo Zamanzi
zu.summary: Kudingeka umphathi oyinhloko okubheke ukuphathwa kwezikhungo zesekhethi yamanzi e-Office Elikhulu le-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikhathi esingaphansi kokuphothule uhlelo oluhambisana (izinga le-NQF 7) njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA kwi-Public Administration, Management, Governance, Economics, Corporate Governance, Water Resource Management, Environmental Management kanye ne-Engineering Science okuhambisana neminyaka eyishanu (5) yamava ezingeni eliphezulu lolawulo. Ukuqedwa ngemvu kwe-Pre-entry Certificate ye-SMS njengokuqinisekiswa yi-National School of Government. Ukuqonda nokusebenzisa izimali. Ulwazi ngokulawula nokugcina amehlo ezikhungo ezithunyelwe umthetho. Ulwazi ngomthetho ohambisana neseckhethi yamanzi. Ulwazi nokusebenzisa ukuphatha nokuhola amaphrojekthi namaprogram. Ukuqonda inqubo yokuhlela ibhizinisi nalebhalansi kahulumeni wase-South Africa. Ukuqonda imithetho ehambisana nesevisi yomphakathi. Amandla okubukeka phambili nokuhola. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwezimali, okushintshayo nolwazi. Ukuletha isevisi nokusungula izinto ezintsha. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqonda. Ukuphatha abantu nokubakhushulula. Ukuqondisa iklayenti nokuqwalasela umthengi. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana (okwenyayo nakubhalwayo). Ukubeke ukuzibophezela nokuziphatha ngokuzotha.
zu.duties: Ukubheka futhi ukuhola ukusungulwa nokuyekwa kwezikhungo zeseckhethi yamanzi (okubheka amanzi nemisebenzi). Ukuyala ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo kanye namapholisi ukuze kudalwe noma kuyekwe izikhungo ngaphakathi kweseckhethi yamanzi. Ukubheka ukulandelwa kwezikhungo, izindaba, izindlela, imisebenzi, ukuziphatha nokuphatha ukuze kuqiniseke ukuhambisana nemithetho kanye nezindinganiso ezivunyelwe. Ukusebenzisa izindlela zokuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhlolwa ngokuvamile ukuziphathisa ngokwemithetho okumisiwe kanye nezindlela. Ukubheka futhi ukuhola ukusungulwa, ukusetshenziswa, nokusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwebhizinisi, izinqubo, izindlela, izilawuli kanye nezinto zokuvikela. Ukubheka ukubhalwa kwemiyalo ekufanele inkululewe nguNgqongqoshe kumabutho okuphatha amanzi. Ukusebenzisana namaqembu omthetho nolawulo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiyalo icacile, ingaqiniswa futhi isekele imigomo yomthetho. IMIBUZO : Mr Vincent Molatana Tel No: (012) 336 8610

Qwalasela ukulawula kweentshisho, izinto ezinzima, iindlela, izinto ezenziwayo, iinkqubo zokuziphatha nokuziphatha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambelana ngokomthetho nangokumiswa ngokuvunywanene. Misela iinkqubo ezijongene nokuqwalasela ngokutsha ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela imigqaliselo eqatshiweyo nemiqathango yamava. Qwalasela kwaye uzulule ukuMiswa, ukusebenza kwaye kusebenze ngokugcweleyo iinkqubo, iindlela, izinto ezenziwayo, ulawulo kunye nezicwangciso zokuLawula amakhaya eKampani. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Toetreedsertifikaat vir die Senior Management Service (SMS) soos deur die National School of Government goedgekeur. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, nie-vervalle bestuurderslisensie word vereis. Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet goeie kennis toon van die watersektor, ingenieursbeginsels en -praktyke, ingenieursprojekbestuur, program- en projekbestuur, menslikehulpbronbestuur, finansiële bestuur, die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), en Tesourie-regulasies en verkrygingsprosesse. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi abaluleke kakhulu kumahlezi kuhambisana nomvumelano osayinwe ngamaphuleli ahlobene. Ukubhataza ngokwemithombo kanye nokuphatha abantu.
