jobs.title: Chief Engineer Grade a
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 108 – R1 504 797 per annum, (all-inclusive OSD salary package), (Offer will be based on years of experience)
jobs.summary: Chief Engineer managing water and sanitation technical services, project analysis and technical support for the Department of Water and Sanitation in Bellville.
jobs.requirements: An Engineering degree (B Eng/ BSc (Eng) or relevant qualification. Six (6) years’ post qualification experience required. Compulsory registration with Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as a Professional Engineer. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver's license. Extensive experience in water and sanitation services planning and implementation, including feasibility studies and designs. Knowledge of programme, project, financial management and ability to effectively liaise with a range of sector role players. Knowledge of water sector and relevant legislation (including but not limited to, the Water Services Act No. 108 of 1997, National Water Act No. 36 of 1998 as well as the National Environmental Management Act No. 107 of 1998) among others. Engineering, legal and operational compliance, Engineering operational communication. Process knowledge and skills. Maintenance skills and knowledge. Mobile equipment operating skills. Engineering design and analysis knowledge. Research and development. Computer-aided engineering applications. Creating high-performance culture. Technical consulting. Engineering and professional judgment, Strategic capability and leadership. Problem solving and analysis skills. Decision making, Team leadership and creativity, financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness, Communication, computer skills, people management, planning and organizing, Conflict management, negotiation skills and change management.
jobs.duties: Manage technical services and support in conjunction with Engineers, Technologists, Technicians, and associates in filed, workshop and technical office activities. Provide support in the analysis and project management of water and sanitation services projects. Provide technical support to the water and sanitation sector. Strategic analysis of Water Services themes and topics. Development of related business perspectives with recommendations. Liaison and engagements with all stakeholders and water and sanitation sector players with regards to project planning and implementation. Provide support to WSAs to ensure implementation of Planning and implementation frameworks and methodologies. Monitoring and reporting on the adherence to these planning and implementation frameworks and methodologies. Identification, prioritization and initiation of projects through and the associated financial management to structure the required budgets for planning and implementation. Co-ordination of planning to ensure integrated planning and management of water and sanitation projects in all spheres of government (Water Boards, WSAs and other WSPs) to improve water and sanitation services, and the reliability and sustainably of infrastructure. Investigation, assessment, monitoring and reporting on all aspects of Water and Sanitation Services delivery. Ensure all data, information, reports and results of analyses are packaged and made accessible to the sector via the Water Services Knowledge System and National Integrated Water Information System. Liaison with, and maintenance of data sharing and information partnerships with key Water and Sanitation Services, Sector role-players and stakeholder such as Statistics South Africa, National Treasury, Cooperative Governance and Office of the Presidency. Ensure quality assurance of technical designs with specifications and authorize/make recommendations for the approval by the relevant authority. Monitor and ensure projects are implemented in accordance with prescribed norms and standards. Monitoring and evaluation of water and sanitation services delivery projects. The provision of guidance to the water sector regarding technical and engineering aspects of the operations and maintenance of water and sanitation services infrastructure. Support and provide guidance on All Town Reconciliation Studies, implementation of WCWDM, Bulk Water and Sanitation Master Planning and Disaster Management. Continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures. Research/Literature studies on technical engineering technology to improve expertise. Allocate, control and monitor expenditure according to budget to ensure efficient cash flow management. Manage the development, motivation and utilization of human resources for discipline to ensure competent knowledge base for the continued success of engineering services according to organizational needs and requirements. Manage subordinates' key performance areas by setting and monitoring performance standards and taking actions to correct deviations to achieve departmental objectives.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: This appointment will be made on the minimum notch of the salary range, however, a higher notch within the salary range of Grade A will be considered based in relation to the provisions of the Public Service Regulation 2016 as amended, i.e. provision of the candidate’s current salary advice. Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofingenieur Graad A
af.summary: Hoofingenieur wat water- en sanitasie tegniese dienste bestuur, projekontleding en tegniese ondersteuning vir die Department of Water and Sanitation in Bellville.
af.requirements: 'n Ingenieurswysheid (B Eng/ BSc (Eng) of tersaaklike kwalifikasie. Ses (6) jaar se na-kwalifikasie-ervaring vereis. Verpligte registrasie by die Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as 'n Professionele Ingenieur. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, nie-vervalle bestuurderslisensie. Uitgebreide ervaring in water- en sanitasiediensbeplanning en -implementering, insluitend haalbaarheidsstudies en ontwerpe. Kennis van program-, projek- en finansiële bestuur en die vermoë om doeltreffend met 'n reeks sektorrolspelers te skakel. Kennis van die watersektor en tersaaklike wetgewing (insluitend maar nie beperk tot die Water Services Act No. 108 of 1997, National Water Act No. 36 of 1998 asook die National Environmental Management Act No. 107 of 1998) onder andere. Ingenieurs-, regs- en operasionele nakoming, ingenieursoperasionele kommunikasie. Proseskennis en -vaardighede. Onderhoudsvaardighede en -kennis. Mobiele toerustingbedryfsvaardighede. Ingenieursontwerp- en ontledingskennis. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Tegniese konsultasie. Ingenieurs- en professionele oordeel, strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Probleemoplossing- en ontledingsvaardighede. Besluitneming, spanleierskap en kreatiwiteit, finansiële bestuur. Klantfokus en response, kommunikasie, rekenaarvaardighede, mensebestuur, beplanning en organisering, konflikbestuur, onderhandelingsvaardighede en veranderingbestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur tegniese dienste en ondersteuning in samewerking met Ingenieurs, Tegnoloë, Tegnici en medewerkers in velde, werkswinkel- en tegniese kantooraktiwiteite. Verskaf ondersteuning in die ontleding en projekbestuur van water- en sanitasiediensprojekte. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan die water- en sanitasiesektor. Strategiese ontleding van Water Services-temas en -onderwerpe. Ontwikkeling van verwante besigheidsperspektiewe met aanbevelings. Skakeling en betrokkenheid met alle belanghebbendes en water- en sanitasiesektorrolspelers met betrekking tot projekbeplanning en -implementering. Verskaf ondersteuning aan WSAs om implementering van beplannings- en implementeringsraamwerke en -metodes te verseker. Monitering en verslagdoening oor die nakoming van hierdie beplannings- en implementeringsraamwerke en -metodes. Identifikasie, prioritisering en inisie van projekte en die gepaardgaande finansiële bestuur om die vereiste begrotings vir beplanning en implementering te struktureer. Koördinering van beplanning om geïntegreerde beplanning en bestuur van water- en sanitasieprojekte in alle regeringsfere (Water Boards, WSAs en ander WSPs) te verseker ten einde water- en sanitasiedienste te verbeter, en die betroubaarheid en volhoubaarheid van infrastruktuur. Ondersoek, assessering, monitering en verslagdoening oor alle aspekte van Water and Sanitation Services-lewering. Verseker dat alle data, inligting, verslae en resultate van ontledings verpak en vir die sektor toeganklik gemaak word via die Water Services Knowledge System en National Integrated Water Information System. Skakeling met, en instandhouding van data-delings- en inligtingvennootskappe met sleutel Water and Sanitation Services, sektorrolspelers en belanghebbendes soos Statistics South Africa, National Treasury, Cooperative Governance en Office of the Presidency. Verseker gehaltversekering van tegniese ontwerpe met spesifikasies en magtig/maak aanbevelings vir goedkeuring deur die tersaaklike owerheid. Monitor en verseker dat projekte ooreenkomstig voorgeskrewe norme en standaarde geïmplementeer word. Monitering en evaluering van water- en sanitasiediensleweringprojekte. Die verskaffing van leiding aan die watersektor met betrekking tot tegniese en ingenieursaspekte van die bedryf en onderhoud van water- en sanitasiediensinfrastruktuur. Ondersteun en verskaf leiding oor All Town Reconciliation Studies, implementering van WCWDM, Bulk Water and Sanitation Master Planning en Disaster Management. Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Navorsing/literatuurstudies oor tegniese ingenieurstegnologie om kundigheid te verbeter. Allokeer, beheer en monitor besteding volgens begroting om doeltreffende kontantvloei bestuur te verseker. Bestuur die ontwikkeling, motivering en benutting van menslike hulpbronne vir die dissipline om 'n bekwame kennisbasis vir die voortgesette sukses van ingenieursdienste volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en vereistes te verseker. Bestuur ondergeskiktes se sleutelprestasie-areas deur prestasiestandaarde te stel en te monitor en maatreëls te tref om afwykings reg te stel om departementele doelwitte te bereik.

zu.title: Injiniyela Ohleziwe Isibanga a
zu.summary: Injiniyela Ohleziwe ohlela izinsizakalo zezobuchwepheshe zamanzi nokucoza, ukuhlazoya amaphrojekthi kanye nenxusa ezobuchwepheshe koMnyango wamanzi nokucoza e-Bellville.
zu.requirements: I degree Yezobunjiniyela (B Eng/ BSc (Eng) noma iziqu ezihambisana nalokho. Kudingeka iminyaka eyisithupha (6) yeminyaka yokuqashaeminyaka yesipiliyoni. Ukuqashelwa ngokuphoqelele ku-ECSA njengoba ungumgunyazi wezobunjiniyela. Ukumemela ilayisensi yokushayela ephumelelayo kanye engaphelelwa isikhathi. Isipiliyono esibanzi ekuhlelweni kanye nokusebenzisa izinsizakalo zamanzi nokucoza, okuhlanganisa izifundo zokwenzeka kanye nezakhiwo. Ulwazi lwenqubo, iphrojekthi, ukuphathwa kwezimali kanye nenhlokomo yokuxhumana ngokusebenza nabadlali abanengi baleso sikhungo. Ulwazi ngemikhakha yamanzi kanye nomthetho ohambisana nawo (okuhlanganisa kodwa lingakwenqabelwa, umthetho wamasevisi wamanzi u-No. 108 ka-1997, umthetho wamanzi kazwelonke u-No. 36 ka-1998 kanye noMthetho wokuPhathwa kwezeMvelo kazwelonke u-No. 107 ka-1998) phakathi kwalabo bakunye. Ukuziphathisa ngokomthetho kanye nezokusebenza kwezobunjiniyela, Unxibelelwano lokusebenza kwezobunjiniyela. Ulwazi kanye namakhono eminqakweni. Amakhono kanye nolwazi lokugcina. Amakhono okuphatha izinsiza ezihambahambayo. Ulwazi lokuklama kanye nokuhlazoya kwezobunjiniyela. Ucwaningo kanye nentuthuko. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisekwe khompyutha ezingobunjiniyela. Ukudala isiko lokusebenza ngamandla aphezulu. Ukubonisana ngochwepheshe. Isibindi sezobunjiniyela kanye nesoqongqothi, ikhono lokubamba iqhaza nokubusa. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuahlazoya. Ukwenza izinqumo, ukubusa iqhaza kanye nokudala, ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokusabela, Ukuxhumana, amakhono ekhompyutha, ukuphathwa kwabantu, ukuhlela kanye nokuqamba, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga, amakhono okuxoxisana kanye nokuphathwa koshintsho.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha izinsizakalo ezobuchwepheshe kanye nokuqasha abahwebi ekuhambisaneni nama-Injiniyela, abobuchwepheshe, abenobuchwepheshe abancane, kanye nabo bokuhlolana emsebenzini ophansi, emhlanganweni kulo nkampani kanye emzamweni wezobuchwepheshe. Ukunika inkxaso ekuqondanisweni nasekuphathweni kwephrojekthi zamaphrojekthi ezinkonza zamanzi nokucoza. Ukunika inkxaso ezobuchwepheshe kolunye uhla lwamasevisi wamanzi nokucoza. Ukuhlazoya ngesu lwesu lwamasevisi wamanzi ngokomchasiso. Intuthuko yokuqonda ngobuphathe nezwakomkhulu kanye nokulandisa. Ukuxhumana nokuxoxa nanabantu bonke abathintekayo nalabo baphathi bengxenye yamanzi nokucoza mayelana nohlelo nokusebenza kwephrojekthi. Ukunika inkxaso kuma-Wsa ukuba kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kwezimiso nokuyisebenzisa ngokuma kwezindlela. Ukubuka nokwenza umbiko mayelana nokulandelana ngokuzincasisa kwalezi zindlela zokuqamba nokusebenza ngazo. Ukuqondana, ukugxininisa kanye nokwethula amaphrojekthi kanye nokuphathwa kwezimali ehambisana nazo ukuze kuhlelwe amabhajeti abalulekile kuqoqo nokusebenza. Ukubumba kwezinto ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlanganiswa kokuhlela kanye nokuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi zamanzi nakucoza emazingeni onke ohulumeni (Amabhodi wamanzi, ama-Wsa kanye abanye aba-WSPs) ukuze kuthuthukiswe insizakulo yamanzi nokucoza, kanye nokuqiniseka kwakho ngokusimama kwezimiso. Ukuphenya, ukubuka, ukubhekisisa nokwenza umbiko ngazo zonke izinhlaka zenkonzakamano yamasevisi wamanzi nokucoza. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba yonke imininingwane, imininingo, imibiko kanye nemiphumela yokuhlazoya ihlelwe ngenhloso yokuba ifikeleleka kulowo ofanele ngaphakathi kwesistimu yolwazi ngamasevisi wamanzi kanye nesistimu kazwelonke ehlanganisile yemininingo yamanzi. Ukuxhumana nokugcina ngokuhlanganyela imininingwane kanye namaqhinga wokwazi nabalingani abayisihluthi kumasevisi wamanzi nokucoza, abadlali bakuleso sikhungo kanye nabo befuna okuthile njengabeSebenza amanani kazwelonke, iSikhungu seziMali, iziNhloko zoMbuso kanye neSiKhwama seSilo. Ukuqinisekisa izinga lezobuchwepheshe ezinhlelweni ezinokumiswa ngemithetho yokulandelwa, ukugunyaza/nikela ngemininingwane ebalulekile ekuqinisekisisweni nguwo ofanele. Ukubheka futhi uqinisekise amaphrojekthi ahambele ngokuhambisana namagebhozi namasiza. Ukubhekisisa nokuhlolisisa imigqa yamaphrojekthi wokulethela inkonza yamanzi nokucoza. Ukunika isiqondiso kulo uhla lwamanzi mayelana nezindaba zobuchwepheshe kanye nezobunjiniyela mayelana nokusebenza ukugcina kanye nokuphathwa kwamasevisi wamanzi nokucoza. Ukusekela futhi unike isiqondiso kuyo yonke imigwaqo yesifundo sokubuyelana, ukusetshenziswa kwa-WCWDM, ukuhlela amapulani amakhulu wamanzi nokucoza, kanye noMphatha wezinsizakulo. Ukuphila ukuze uqhube nokuziphilisa ngobungcweti ukuze uhambisane namateknoloji namasu amasha. Ukucwaninga imigqa yesifundo sobuchwepheshe ekuqondaniswenen kanye nezinsiza zobuchwepheshe ukuphucula ubuchwepheshe bakhona. Ukwabiya, ukulawula kanye nokubheka izimali ezichithwa ngokuhamba kwesabelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba okuhle kwemali. Ukulawula intuthuko, ukukhuthaza kanye nokusebenzisa abantu abaphelele ngokwobuchwepheshe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwaziswa okuhlakaniphile ukuphila komkhakha wezinsizakalo zobunjiniyela ngokuhamba nemiqondo yentsika. Ukulawula imisebenzi ebalulekile yabaphansi ngokusetha kanye nokubheka imilinganiselo yokusebenza bese uthatha amagalelo okulungisa amaphutha ukufeza imigomo yomnyango.

xh.title: Injiniya Ephambili Inqanaba a
xh.summary: Injiniya Ephambili ephatha iinkonzo ezisezantssweni ezinamanzi noluhoyi-hoyi, uhlalutyo lweenqubo nekhowudi yeenkxwaleko zoxhobo lweNdlu yoManzi nokuHlambulula eBellville.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-injiniya (B Eng/BSc (Eng) okanye isigqibo esifanelekileyo. Kufuneka ubambe isixa seminyaka eyisiqhoboshana (6) yamava emva kokufumana isidanga. Ukubhalisa ngokunyanzeliswa kuBunge baboMjini bayoMzantsi Afrika (ECSA) njengoko kukhankanyiwe njengomsebenzi opheleleyo. Iinkcukacha zelayisensi yokushayela evisisayo neyowazise iintsuku zayo kufuneka zibhaliswe. Amava amaninzi ekulungiseleleni nokuqhuba iinkonzo zamanzi noluhlambulula, kuquka iifasabhithi ezifundwayo neemodeli ezizotyiweyo. Ulwazi malunga nokulawula iinkqubo, iiprojekthi, imali kunye nolwazi lokusebenzisana kakuhle nabanolwazi bemithelela kulo naliphi na igumbi kummandla. Ulwazi lommandla wamanzi kunye nemigwetya enjengamanzi, amazwe ngamazwe ekuLungelelweni kwamanzi (Water Services Act No. 108 of 1997, National Water Act No. 36 of 1998 kunye ne-Environmental Management Act No. 107 of 1998) exeshana nalawo. Injiniya, ulwangelelo lokuSebenza ngokumthetho kwaye iziko oluqinisekisa ukulandwa kwemigaqo, kunye noQoqosho oluLungelelweni lweMisebenzi yeNjiniya. Ulwazi neminweba yemikhozo. Ulwazi nolwandiso lokulondoloza. Imbinzana yolwazi ematasa. Ulwazi lokukhawulwa nokuqonda iinkqubo. Uphando nentsuthukiso. Ukubhekiswa kweenkqubo ze-injiniya ezisebenzisa iikhompyutha. Ukuyila inkqubo ekuzuzwa kuyo eyona mpumelelo. Ingcebiso ngokusezantsi. Ukupathiswa nokwahlulela ngokwendalo, ulwazi lokuqonda iindlela ezisa kwizigqibo, kunye nobuntu bokulawa. Ulwazi lokuxazula iingxaki nokuqonda iindlela ezahlukahlukeneyo. Ukwenza isigqibo, ukulatha iqela nokuziphumeza, ukulawula imali. Ukugxila kwabathengi, ukwaziswa ngoko nangoko, ukunxibelelana, amakhono ekhompyutha, ukulatha abantu, ukulungiselela nokuhlelela, ukulawula ingxabano, amakhono ecelomculo, nokulawula ukutshintsha.
xh.duties: Phatha iinkonzo ezisezantsi noko xhaso ngokubambisana koomatshini bobugcisa, oonjingcali bolwazi, oonjingcali bexesha elithile, nabanxulumene nabo, ukuya kwimisebenzi ekwindlu yobugcisa, kwindlu yokulungiselela iimpahla zomsebenzi nasemagumbini obugcisa boneemfuno ezibalulekileyo. Nikela ngesixhaso sokuhlalutya nokuqwalasela iiprojekthi zolonwabo noluhlambulula. Nikela ngesixhaso ngokwamandla oqobo ekuqwalaselweni iindawo ezitholakala kwiinkonzo zokuhamba kwamaza. Qwalasela iinkalo zamaza. Phuhlisa izimvo ezahlukeneyo zentshiseni ezingakumbi ezinamacebiso. Qhubela phambili nokubekela abo batshintsile nabaqeshiyo bemigudu yonwabo oluvela kwelinye ibizo ukubonisa izimvo ezakulungisa olu hlobo lwezicwangciso ukuqwalasela iinkalo ezikwindawo yonkoku. Bukela nokumela kwezaziso kummandla wokuza kwisigqibo nokusebenzisa iimbonakaliso ezixhaswe ngokupheleleyo. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imidata nolonwabo lwenkcazelo ihlohliwe kwaye ifikeleleka kalula kubantu abanomdla wokuqwalasela. Bukela nokumema kwezaziso ngokubakho kwamava kwamaza nokulungiselelwa iindlela ezizakusetyenziswa. Lungiselela okanye uqwalasele inkalo ezahlukeneyo zolwazi ngokubandakanya nayiphi na iindlela ezahlukeneyo. Qwalasela ukusetyenziswa kolwazi ngokubukela nokuphawula iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezikumgangatho ophezulu. Hlengahlengisa imisebenzi ebalulekileyo yokwenza amava amaninzi wolwazi. Qwalasela nokulandela iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ekulawulweni nokugcina ulwazi olululo, kwindawo ezikumgangatho ophezulu ngokwemithetho yesiZwe esemthethweni weNdlu yoManzi.

jobs.title: Scientist Manager Grade a
jobs.salary_text: R1 143 468 per annum, (all-inclusive OSD salary package)
jobs.summary: Manage strategic water quality planning and assessment studies at the Department of Water and Sanitation's Pretoria Head Office, requiring an MSc in a natural science and SACNASP registration.
jobs.requirements: MSc Degree in chemistry, biochemistry or microbiology or relevant qualification in Water Resource Management. Six (6) years of applicable post qualification of BSc Natural Scientific experience. Compulsory professional registration with SACNASP a s a professional Natural Scientist. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Extensive knowledge of, and relevant experience in water quality management. Computer literacy. A sound knowledge and the ability to integrate the management of water quality into the holistic management of water resources. Must possess excellent written and verbal communication skills. Good comprehension skills. The ability to interpret data and information, the ability to work with a wide range of stakeholders.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will join a team of professionals responsible for strategic water resource planning, focusing on water quality through the development and maintenance of integrated water quality planning solutions. This requires conducting assessment studies to address data and information gaps and needs for water quality planning. Will be responsible for forward planning utilising predictive modelling tools, among other methods. Formulate planning goals, including the determination of Water Quality Planning Limits. Responsible for intervention planning through scenario analysis, reconciliation and allocation of water quality, and the development of programmes, thematic plans and strategies to maintain or improve water resource quality in catchments. Provision of water quality planning decision support and related management information in support of the implementation of water quality interventions. Provision of water quality planning related capacity building. Contribute to providing national and strategic guidance or advice on resource directed water quality management and water quality planning. Assisting in the planning and conducting of studies or projects, as well as in the writing and compilation of technical scientific reports and documents. The activities will also relate to the development, implementation and refinement of policies, strategies, guidelines and methodologies related to water quality planning and management. Promote integrated planning through stakeholder participation, coordination and management.

af.title: Wetenskaplike Bestuurder Graad a
af.summary: Bestuur strategiese waterkwaliteitsbeplanning en assesseringsstudies by die Department of Water and Sanitation se Pretoria-hoofkantoor, waarvoor 'n MSc in 'n natuurwetenskap en SACNASP-registrasie vereis word.
af.requirements: MSc-graad in chemie, biochemie of mikrobiologie of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie in Waterhulpbronbestuur. Ses (6) jaar van toepaslike na-kwalifikasie BSc Natuurwetenskaplike ervaring. Verpligte professionele registrasie by SACNASP as 'n professionele Natuurwetenskaplike. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, ongeërfde bestuurderslisensie. Uitgebreide kennis van, en tersaaklike ervaring in waterkwaliteitsbestuur. Rekenaarvaardigheid. 'n Deeglike kennis en die vermoë om die bestuur van waterkwaliteit in die holistiese bestuur van waterhulpbronne te integreer. Moet oor uitstekende skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede beskik. Goeie begripsvaardighede. Die vermoë om data en inligting te interpreteer, die vermoë om met 'n wye reeks belanghebbendes te werk.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal by 'n span professionele persone aansluit wat verantwoordelik is vir strategiese waterhulpbronbeplanning, met die fokus op waterkwaliteit deur die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van geïntegreerde waterkwaliteitsbeplanningsoplossings. Dit vereis die uitvoer van assesseringsstudies om data- en inligtinggappe en -behoeftes vir waterkwaliteitsbeplanning aan te spreek. Sal verantwoordelik wees vir vooruitskuiwingsbeplanning deur gebruik te maak van voorspellingsmodelleerinstrumente, onder andere metodes. Formuleer beplanningsdoelwitte, insluitend die bepaling van Waterkwaliteitsbeplanningslimiete. Verantwoordelik vir intervensiebeplanning deur scenario-analise, versoenning en toekenning van waterkwaliteit, en die ontwikkeling van programme, tematieke planne en strategieë om waterhulpbronkwaliteit in opvanggebiede te handhaaf of te verbeter. Voorsiening van waterkwaliteitsbeplanningsbesluitnemingondersteuning en verwante bestuursinligting ter ondersteuning van die implementering van waterkwaliteitsintervensies. Voorsiening van kapasiteitsbou verbonde aan waterkwaliteitsbeplanning. Dra by om nasionale en strategiese leiding of advies te verskaf oor hulpbrongerigte waterkwaliteitsbestuur en waterkwaliteitsbeplanning. Bystand met die beplanning en uitvoer van studies of projekte, asook met die skryf en samestelling van tegniese wetenskaplike verslae en dokumente. Die aktiwiteite hou ook verband met die ontwikkeling, implementering en verfyning van beleide, strategieë, riglyne en metodes verbonde aan waterkwaliteitsbeplanning en -bestuur. Bevorder geïntegreerde beplanning deur belanghebbendedeelname, koördinering en bestuur.

zu.title: Isiphathi Sesayensi Sama-Science izinga a
zu.summary: Phatha izifundo zokuhlela nokuhlola ukweseka ngokobuchwepheshe e-Head Office ye-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Pretoria, kudingwa i-MSc kwisayensi yemvelo nokubhaliswa kwi-SACNASP.
zu.requirements: I-degree ye-MSc ekhemisini, ekubiochem noma kumicrobiology noma izifundo ezihambisana kwi-Water Resource Management. Isikhathi esingamashumi ayisithupha (6) seminyaka yokuhlangabezela emumva kokuqeda izifundo ze-BSc Natural Scientific. Kuyadingeka ukubhalisa ngesikhundla se-SACNASP njengesayensi yemvelo yomunyuzo. Ukuzivula ngelayisensi yokushayela engavinyiwe nengagqamile. Ulwazi olubanzi kanye nesipiliwo esihambisana ekuphathweni komgangatho wamanzi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ulwazi oluhle kanye namandla okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa komgangatho wamanzi ekuphathweni okubanzi kwamanzi. Kudingeka ube namandla aphumelelayo okuxoxa noshicilela ngokubhaliwe nangokukhulumwa. Amandla okuqonda okushiwo kahle. Amandla okuhlola ukwaziswa nemininingwane, namandla okusebenza nabantu abaningi abahlukene.
zu.duties: Omele ukwamukelwa uzohlangana nqo nenkundla yabaphathi abaphathe ukubekwa kwamanzi ngokobuchwepheshe, begxile emgangathweni wamanzi ngokusungula kanye nokuqinisekisa izixazululo zokuqamba kwamanzi. Lokhu kudinga ukwenza izifundo zokuqinisekisa ukuze kuxazulule amathuba nokuqonda okushiyekile ekucubunguleni ukweseka amanzi. Ozobekwa negunya lokuhlela ikusasa ngokusebenzisa izinto zokubikezela ngokomthetho wesayensi, phakathi kwezinye izindlela. Mhlize isihloko somsebenzi wekusasa, kuhlanganise nokubeka imingcele yokuhlela umgangatho wamanzi. Uzobe negunya lokuhlela ukungenelela nge-analysis yamehlo abantu, ngokulinganisa futhi ukwabelana umgangatho wamanzi, kanye nokusungula izinhlelo, izinhlelo zokuhlela ngokwezifiso nezinqubomgomo zokugcina noma ukuphakamisa umgangatho wamanzi emawuseni. Ukunika ukweseka okuyisinqumo ekucubunguleni umgangatho wamanzi kanye nemininingwane ephathelene nokuphatha, ukuze kusekelwe ukuqaliswa kwezinto zokungenelela umgangatho wamanzi. Ukunika isandla ekwakheni amandla ngokusebenza ekucubunguleni umgangatho wamanzi. Ukufaka konke ekunikezelweni kolwazi nokuhleleka ngomphakathi nangobuchwepheshe ekuphathweni nomgcwaliso wamanzi ngokomgangatho. Ukusiza ekuhleleni nasekwenzweni izifundo noma izinhlelo, kanye nokubhala ukuhlela imibhalo yesayensi noma yobuchwepheshe. Izinkomba zizonke zibophezile ekusunguleni, ukuqalisweni nasekulungeniseni izinqubomgomo, izinhlelo, iziqondiso kanye nezindlela eziphathelene nokuhlela nokuphatha umgangatho wamanzi. Ukukhuthaza ukubekwa ngokubanzi ngokubamba kwabantu, ukuhlanganisa nokuphatha.

jobs.title: Scientist Manager Grade a
jobs.salary_text: R1 143 468 per annum, (all-inclusive OSD salary package)
jobs.summary: Manage and provide strategic leadership for geohydrological services, overseeing groundwater monitoring and assessment programmes for the Department of Water and Sanitation.
jobs.requirements: MSc Degree or equivalent qualification in Geohydrology/Hydrogeology/Earth Science. Six (6) years of post-qualification natural sciences experience required. Compulsory registration with SACNASP as a Professional Natural Scientist. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Experience in groundwater exploration, monitoring, assessment and sustainable resource management. Experience in water resource management. Scientific methodologies and models. Research and development. Scientific presentation. Analysis and management of groundwater data. Business processes to ensure data flow. Professional judgement. Scientific mentoring. Strategic capability and Leadership. Financial Management. Change Management. Problem solving and analysis. Knowledge management. People Management and Empowerment. Client Orientation and Customer Focus. Excellent communication, report-writing and presentation. Conflict management. Accountability and ethical conduct. Knowledge of the National Water Act and related water-sector legislation. Experience in scientific research, project management, stakeholder engagement, technical report writing and the management of professional scientific personnel. Knowledge of GIS and groundwater-modelling tools such as MODFLOW will be an added advantage. Accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: Manage and provide strategic leadership for geohydrological services. Plan, coordinate and oversee groundwater-resource monitoring, assessment and information management programmes. Provide specialist geohydrological advice to management, municipalities, water-sector institutions and other stakeholders. Oversee groundwater-quality and groundwater-level monitoring programmes. Manage groundwater data, modelling and dissemination of scientific information. Lead scientific research and promote the application of innovative groundwater management approaches. Provide input on groundwater projects, budgets and procurement processes. Manage staff performance and development. Mentor candidate scientists and facilitate scientific skills transfer. Represent the department in technical committees, stakeholder forums and intergovernmental structures. Ensure compliance with applicable legislation, policies, professional standards and scientific codes of practice. Develop and implement geohydrological methodologies, policies, strategies, procedures and technical standards. Review and approve scientific reports, groundwater studies, models and technical recommendations. Ensure the development and implementation of policies, systems, and procedures. Review and recommend/approve scientific projects; facilitate the setting of scientific standards, specifications, and service levels according to organizational objectives to ensure optimum operational service. Monitor scientific efficiencies according to organizational goals; and facilitate the compilation of innovation proposals to optimize limited resources in achieving increased levels of compliance within industry.

af.title: Wetenskaplike Bestuurder Graad a
af.summary: Bestuur en verskaf strategiese leierskap vir geohidrologiese dienste en hou toesig oor grondwatermonitering en assesseringsprogramme vir die Department of Water and Sanitation.
af.requirements: MSc-graad of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie in Geohidrologie/Hidrogeologie/Aardwetenskap. Ses (6) jaar se ervaring in natuurwetenskappe na kwalifikasie word vereis. Verpligte registrasie by SACNASP as 'n Professionele Natuurwetenskaplike. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Ervaring in grondwaterverkenning, monitering, assessering en volhoubare hulpbronbestuur. Ervaring in waterhulpbronbestuur. Wetenskaplike metodes en modelle. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Wetenskaplike voorlegging. Analise en bestuur van grondwaterdata. Besigheidsprosesse om datavloei te verseker. Professionele oordeel. Wetenskaplike mentorskap. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Finansiële bestuur. Veranderingsbestuur. Probleemoplossing en analise. Kennisbestuur. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Kliëntgerigtheid en klantefokus. Uitstekende kommunikasie, verslagskrywing en voorlegging. Konflikbestuur. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag. Kennis van die National Water Act en verwante watersektorwetgewing. Ervaring in wetenskaplike navorsing, projekbestuur, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, tegniese verslagskrywing en die bestuur van professionele wetenskaplike personeel. Kennis van GIS en grondwatermodelleringsnutsprogramme soos MODFLOW sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Bestuur en verskaf strategiese leierskap vir geohidrologiese dienste. Beplan, koördineer en hou toesig oor grondwaterhulpbron-moniterings-, assesserings- en inligtingsbestuursprogramme. Verskaf spesialis-geohidrologiese advies aan bestuur, munisipaliteite, watersektorinstellings en ander belanghebbendes. Hou toesig oor grondwatergehalte- en grondwaterpeilmoniteringsprogramme. Bestuur grondwaterdata, modellering en verspreiding van wetenskaplike inligting. Lei wetenskaplike navorsing en bevorder die toepassing van innoverende grondwaterbestuursbenaderings. Verskaf insette oor grondwaterprojekte, begrotings en verkrygingsprosesse. Bestuur personeelprestasie en -ontwikkeling. Mentor kandidaatwetenskaplikes en fasiliteer wetenskaplike vaardigheidsoordrag. Verteenwoordig die departement in tegniese komitees, belanghebbende-forums en interowerheidsstrukture. Verseker nakoming van toepaslike wetgewing, beleide, professionele standaarde en wetenskaplike gedragskodes. Ontwikkel en implementeer geohidrologiese metodes, beleide, strategieë, prosedures en tegniese standaarde. Hersien en keur wetenskaplike verslae, grondwaterstudies, modelle en tegniese aanbevelings goed. Verseker die ontwikkeling en implementering van beleide, stelsels en prosedures. Hersien en beveel/keur wetenskaplike projekte aan; fasiliteer die vasstelling van wetenskaplike standaarde, spesifikasies en diensvlakke volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om optimale operationele diens te verseker. Monitor wetenskaplike doeltreffendheid volgens organisatoriese doelwitte; en fasiliteer die opstel van innovasievoorstelle om beperkte hulpbronne te optimaliseer in die bereiking van verhoogde vlakke van nakoming binne die bedryf.

zu.title: Umphathi Wesayensi izinga a
zu.summary: Phatha futhi unikeze ubuholi obuhlelekile emasevisini e-geohydrology, ubukele izinhlelo zokuqapha nokuhlola amanzi aphansi ku-Department of Water and Sanitation.
zu.requirements: IDigiri ye-MSc noma izifundo ezilinganayo ku-Geohydrology/Hydrogeology/Earth Science. Kudingeka ukuba nenkathi yeminyaka eyisithupha (6) yokuhlangana emsebenzini wezansi emva kokuthola izifundo. Ukuqokwa ngokuyisikhashana ku-SACNASP njengensayensi Yemvelo Yobuchwepheshe. Ukuchaza ilayisenisi yokushayela okuvumelekile okungalupheli. Isipiliyoni ekuphenjeni, ukuqapheni, ukuhloleni nokuphathwa kwemithombo yamanzi ngendlela egcina imvelo. Isipiliyoni ekuphathweni kwemithombo yamanzi. Izindlela nezifanekiso zesayensi. UCwaningo nentuthuko. Kwenziwa kwesayensi. Ukuhlaziya nokuphatha idatha yamanzi aphansi. Inqubo yebhizinisi ukuze kuqiniseke ukuphakama kwedatha. Isahluleko sobuchwepheshe. Ukweseka ukukhula kolwazi ngemikhakha yesayensi. Ikhandlela noBubholi. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuphathwa kokushintsha. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuphathwa kolwazi. Ukuphatha nokwabusuza iminyuzi. Ukubheke kubathengi ngendlela ebuqameli. Ukubhekisisa kolwazi ngendlela ebuqameli.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi unikeze ubuholi obuhlesekile emasevisini e-geohydrology. Hlela, hlanganisa futhi ubukele izinhlelo zokuqapha amanzi aphansi, ukuhlola futhi ulawule ulwazi. Nikela ngeluleko elifanele le-geohydrology kubaphathi, masipala, izikhungo zesigaba samanzi kanye nabanye abahlalo bezindaba. Hlolisisa imithelela yohlelo lokuqapha izinga lenani namaphuzu emanzi aphansi. Lawula idatha yamanzi aphansi, imodeli kanye nokuqakuliswa kolwazi kwesayensi. Beka ngaphambili ucwaningo lwesayensi futhi ukhuthaze ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela ezintsha eziphucukile ekuphathweni kwamanzi aphansi. Nikela ngesandiso kumaprojekthi amanzi aphansi, ama-odyuli kanye nama-inqubo zokuthenga. Lawula imisebenzi nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Qeqesha abathwetshuli besayensi uphinde ukhuthaze ukudluliswa kolwazi ngemikhakha yesayensi. Mela umnyango kunabagange ngobuchwepheshe, kwizinkundla zababambisene naye kanye nabalawuli phakathi kwamasikhombiso. Qinisezisa ukuziphendulela kolwazi emthethweni osencane, izindlela, amasiko wobungcweti namakhowudi ukwenziswa kolwazi yesayensi. Hlela futhi uvuse izindlela ezenziwayo ze-geohydrology, amapholisi, amasu, amagugu nobuchwepheshe obuyisibalo. Buka futhi uvume imibhalo yesayensi, izifundo zamanzi aphansi, amamodeli kanye nezindulo zobuchwepheshe. Qinisezisa ukuthi kuhlelwa kusetshenziswa amapholisi, izinhlelo nezindlela ezibekiwe. Buka futhi incoma/vuma amaprojekthi esayensi; ukhuthaze ukubekwa kolwazi ngobuchwepheshe, imithetho namazinga abeke izigaba zendlela ngokuhleleka kwezinhloso zenhlangano ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinga elihle lemsebenzi. Qapha izinga lokusebenza kwesayensi ngokuhleleka kwezinhloso zenhlangano; futhi ukhuthaze ukuhlelwa kwesandiso sezindulo ezintsha ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinsiza ezimbalwa ekufezeni amazinga aphanayo okuziphendulela esimisweni sabanumzane.

xh.title: Umphathi weSayensi Inqanaba a
xh.summary: Phatha kwaye nikezela nolawulo oluthe ngqololwe kumsebenzi wamalunga namanzi emhlabeni, ulawule iinkqubo zokuqonda nokuqinisekisa amanzi angaphantsi komhlaba kwisebe lamanzi nokucocekisa.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seMSc okanye izifundo ezingekho ngaphantsi kweGeohydrology/Hydrogeology/Earth Science. Ukuxela ibhashe elisebenzayo nangoku elingenayo ilayisenisi. Amava ekuphenjeni amanzi angaphantsi komhlaba, ekuqondeni nokuqinisekisa nasekulawuleni iindalo ngendlela ezelulekayo. Amava ekulawulweni kweendalo zamanzi. Iindlela nezimodeli zesayensi. Uphononongo nentluko. Izeluleko zesayensi. Ukuhlalutya nokulawula iingxelo zedatha yamanzi angaphantsi komhlaba. Iinkqubo zoshishino ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba kwedatha. Isigqibo sabuchwepheshe. Ukukhokela ngesayensi. Ikhondo elihle kwilawulo kwaye nokuBeka ngaphambili. uLawulo lweMali. uLawulo lokuTshintsha. ukuSombulula iingxaki nokuHlalutya. uLawulo lolwazi. uLawulo lwaBantu kwaye nokuNika amandla. uKumisela iNtengiso kwiKhasi kuqwalaselwa iNdlela abathengi bakhangwa ngayo. Unxibelelwano oluhle, ukubhala iingxelo nokuvelisa. uLawulo loNxibelelwano. uNxibelelwano noMntu. uLawulo iNtibano. uBomi obuNhlobo nendlela yokuziphatha. ULwazi ngoMthetho weNdalo yamaZi nawamanye oMthetho onxulumene nesebe lamanzi. Amava kuphononongo lwesayensi, ekulawulweni amaphulo, kunkxibelelwano nabaqhubi beendaba, ekubhalweni kweengxelo zobugcisa nasekulawulweni abantu basebenzayo kwizayensi. Ulwazi ngeGIS nezixhobo zokwakha imodeli yamanzi angaphantsi komhlaba njengakwiMODFLOW kuya kuba lusizo. uNxibelelwano noMntu.
xh.duties: Phatha kwaye nikezela nolawulo oluthe ngqololwe kumsebenzi wamalunga namanzi emhlabeni. Cwangcisa, lungisanisa kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zokuqonda nokuqinisekisa amanzi angaphantsi komhlaba kwaye ulawule ulwazi. Nikezela ngengcebiso yobugcisa kwizayensi yamalunga namanzi emhlabeni kulawulo, kumasipala, kubuchwepheshe beendaba zamanzi nakubantu abangenisa imibuzo. Lawula iinkqubo zokuqonda iimeko namazinga amanzi angaphantsi komhlaba. Lawula idatha yamanzi angaphantsi komhlaba, ukuyila nokusasaza ulwazi lwesayensi. Khokela uphononongo lwesayensi kwaye uncedise ekusebenziseni iindlela ezitsha ezinolwazi ekulawulweni amanzi angaphantsi komhlaba. Nikezela ngegalelo kumaphulo amanzi angaphantsi komhlaba, kumabhajeti nasekuwungeniseni iinkqubo zoshishino. Lawula ukusebenza kwaye uphuhlise abasebenzi. Khokela abafundi bezayensi kwaye uncocisele ukudluliswa kolwazi lobugcisa. Mela isebe kumagqwethi obugcisa, kumabandla abangenisa imibuzo nakuwo onke amagumbi olawulo phakathi karhulumente. Qinisekisa ukuzigcina ngokomthetho osebenzayo, iinkqubo, izigqibo zobugcisa namaxabiso amathuba emisebenzi yezayensi. Yakha kwaye usebenzise iindlela zamalunga namanzi emhlabeni, iinkqubo, iindlela ezizuzisayo nokuqinisekiswa ngobugcisa. Phinda ubuye uqinisekise iingxelo zesayensi, iifundo zamanzi angaphantsi komhlaba, iimodeli neengcebiso zobugcisa. Qinisekisa ukwakhiwa nokusebenziswa kweenkqubo nendlela zokwenza izinto. Phinda ubuye uqinisekise onke amaphulo ezayensi; uncocisele ukumiswa kwezigqibo zesayensi, iingobo ezigqithiswe ngazo nezinga zenkonzo ngokumalunga neenjongo zeshishino ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kukho inkonzo esebenzayo ngokugqithisileyo. Qaphela iziphumelelo zesayensi ngokumalunga neenjongo zeshishino; kwaye uncocisele ukulungiselelwa kweeproposal ezitsha ukuze kusetyenziswe ngendlela ezigqithiswe ngayo iindalo ezingezo mvela ukuze kuphuhliswe iinqanaba zokuzigqibela kubomi bezobugcisa.

zu.title: UMengezi Wephrojekthi
zu.summary: UMengezi Wephrojekthi osekela izinhlelo zezibonezelo ze-insfrastrukthi yamasevisi amanzi e-Mmabatho, ofuna isifundo se-engineering namaphuzu amahlanu okuphatha iphrojekthi.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esihambisanayo se-NQF level 7 ku-Civil Engineering noma ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi emcondweni we-engineering. Amaphuzu amahlanu (5) okuphatha emcondweni wokuphathwa kwephrojekthi ye-engineering. Ukwaziswa kwelayisense yokushayela eyiyo evuliwe. Ukuba nokuqonda jikelele ngokuphathwa kwezinhlaka, imigidingo yebhizinisi, nomthetho webhizinisi. Amakhono aphumelelayo okuphatha nokuholwa. Amakhono aphumelelayo ekhompyutha; ithimba le-software ye-Microsoft Office, i-Lotus Notes, nanhlobo yomunye we-software yekhompnayo nediscipline-specific. Amakhono aphumelelayo okuxhumana ngomlomo nangokubhaliya kubaphathi nabanikabelo bangaphakathi nabangaphandle, okuhlanganisa amakhano okubonisa, okubika nokuxhumanisa. Amakhono aphumelelayo okuhlaziya nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuphathwa kwe-progremu nephrojekthi. Ulwazi ngokuthuthukiswa nokusebenziswa imigidingo ye-Division of Revenue Act (DoRA) ne-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-National Water Act (NWA), i-Water Services Act (WSA) nomthetho ohlobene. Ulwazi nokuqonda umthetho wokuphathwa kwabasebenzi, imigidingo, izindlela nenhleleleko. Isikebhe esilawula ulwazi lokusebenza. Ulwazi ngokusebenzisa imigidingo ye-PMDS. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuHlaziya. Ukuphathwa kwabantu nobuhlukahlukeno. Isikhundla sikakhasimende nokuqondiswa kwakho. Ukuxhumana. Ubunye nokuziphatha ngokukhona.
zu.duties: Nikela inkxaso ekusebenziseni nasekuphathweni izinhlelo zezibonezelo ze-insfrastrukthi yamasevisi amanzi emisebenzini yesifunda. Qinisekisa ukuhlanganisa nokuHLaziya okufakwayo okuyingqayi kanye nokuhlela ama-budget. Lungiselela izinhlela zokusebenza nokubiza ngemali yephrojekthi. Nikela inkxaso yengcebongobuchwepheshe ekwenzeni izinhlelo ze-insfrastrukthi ehlangene. Nikela inkxaso ekuthuthukeni kokuhlela iphrojekthi ngokuthatha inxaxheba kwizigaba zokwakha nokuphuhliswa. Khuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kurhulumende, izikhungo zikawonkewonke, ibanga lasesontweni kanye nentengiso mayelana ngezinhlelo zezibonezelo ze-insfrastrukthi yamasevisi amanzi. Sekela ukuthuthukiswa nokuHlola imibiko ye-Implementation Readiness Study (IRS). Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zezibonezelo ze-insfrastrukthi yamasevisi amanzi zibhalwa ku-medium-term expenditure framework (MTEF). Qapha futhi uHlole ukusetshenziswa kwayo yonke imiphumela yokuthuthukiswa kwe-insfrastrukthi yamasevisi amanzi emisebenzini yesifunda. Yenza futhi uqaphele ukudluliswa kwemali yezibonezelo kubaphathi bamasevisi amanzi ukuze kusetshenziswe izinhlelo ze-insfrastrukthi yamasevisi amanzi.

xh.title: Isiphathi esiNcedo sikaMlawuli woMsebenzi
xh.summary: Isiphathi esiNcedo sikaMlawuli woMsebenzi esixhasa iinkqubo zemali yovuzo yemisebenzi yamaza manzi kwiZiko laseMmabatho,elifuna isifundo sobugcisa bokwakha kwaye namava eminyaka emihlanu ekulawuleni imisebenzi.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekileyo kumgangatho weNQF level 7 kwiCivil Engineering okanye ekulawuleni imisebenzi kwindawo yobugcisa bokwakha. ABA (5) leminyaka yamava ekulawuleni kwindawo yokulawula imisebenzi yobugcisa bokwakha. Ukuvaza ilayisenisi yokushayela egqithiswe ixesha layo efanelekileyo nengamashwa amaxesha. Ukuba nokuqonda ngokubanzi kwendlela yokulawula iinkqubo,emiqathango yeshishini,nemigaqo yeshishini. Amandla apheleleyo ekulawuleni nasekuhleni. Amandla apheleleyo ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha; Microsoft Office Software, Lotus Notes, nananye na software ekwayenziwe yinkampani nendlela ethile ekunikezelwe kuyo. Amandla apheleleyo ekunxibelelaneni ngokwethu nokubhala nabalawuli nabaninxibelelanisi bangaphakathi nangaphandle, kuquka namandla okubonisa,okubika nokuxhuma. Amandla apheleleyookuhlola nokusombulula iingxaki. Ekulawuleni iinkqubo nemisebenzi. Ulwazi ngokuphuhlisa nokusebenzisa iimo zoDivision of Revenue Act (DoRA) nePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA), National Water Act (NWA), Water Services Act (WSA) nemigaqo edibana nayo. Ulwazi nokuqonda koMthetho wezeRhabaxa woLuntu, iinkqubo, iindlela neenkqubo zokuwasebenzisa. Isakhiwo sokulawula ulwazi ngemisebenzi. Ulwazi ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo zoPMDS. Ukuhlola iingxaki nokuzahlulela. Ukulawula abantu ngokwahlukano. Ukumiselwa kunye nokuqwalasela ngabaxhamli. Unxibelelwano. Ixabiso nendlela ethe ngqo.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso ekusebenziseni nasekulawuleni iinkqubo zemali yovuzo yemisebenzi yamaza manzi kumisebenzi yephondo. Qiniseksa ukuqhagamshelana nokwahlula imveliso ezibalulekileyo nokuceba isikhathi semali. Lungiselela iindlela zokuzebenzisa iindleko zemisebenzi. Nika inkxaso yobuchwephesha kumisebenzi yokuhlela ukwakhiwa okudityanisiweyo. Nika inkxaso ekuphuhliseni ukuhlela imisebenzi ngokuthatha inxaxheba kwindlela yokuyila okanye kwicala lokuvavanya. Khuthaza ubudlelwane phakathi kurhulumente, iziko loluntu, kalunga lobuso nimanyano waluntu mayela nemali yovuzo yemisebenzi yamaza manzi. Xhasa ukuphuhlisa nokuhlola iingxelo zeImplementation Readiness Study (IRS). Qiniseksa ukuba iinkqubo zemali yovuzo yemisebenzi yamaza manzi zifakwe kwichedi yemali esexesheni eliphakathi (MTEF). Lilawule ukuze uphawule nokuhlola ukusebenza ngokupheleleyo kwazo zonke iinkqubo zemali yovuzo yemisebenzi yamaza manzi kumisebenzi yephondo. Yenza ulawulo ludlule kwimali yovuzo iye kumagunya oMthetho wezaManzi ukuze kusebenziswe iinkqubo zemali yovuzo yamaza manzi.

zu.title: Umongameli oPhethwe: Ukuthuthukiswa kweNhlaka yoMnyango
zu.summary: Umongameli ophethwe obuka ukuthuthukiswa kwenhlaka yomnyango, ukulinganiswa kwemisebenzi kanye nokwakhiwa kwenqubo yebhizinisi eHhovisi Eliyinhloko loMnyango wezaManzi nokuThuthuzisa ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezinga le-NQF level 7 kumasevisi abaphathi/Operations Management/Production Management/Industrial and Organizational Psychology. Eminyakeni emihlanu (5) yokuba namava okuphatha endaweni yokuthuthukiswa kwenhlaka yomnyango. Namava adingekayo kumanqubo okuhlola imisebenzi nasohlelwini oluhambisana nayo. Ulwazi nokuqonda imigomo yokuthuthukiswa kwenhlaka yomnyango kanye nokuqamba kwayo. Ulwazi ngamathuluzi okuphatha izindlela zokusebenza. Ulwazi ngokuqashwa komoya woshintsho. Ikhono lokuthuthukisa ukunqamula kolwazi kumanani okuphatha izindlela zokusebenza. Ikhono lokwenza izifundo zokubika okuphezulu ngokuzenzakalela. Ulwazi ngokuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo. Ukuqonda ubulungiswa bemithetho nezinqubomgomo ebusa umkhakha kahulumeni. Ikhono lokuxhumana elihle kokubili (elisho nokuqoshiwe). Amakhono okubonisa, ukubhalwa kwezibiko kanye nokuxhumana nomphakathi. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaprojekthi. Ikhono lokubusa nokuholisa. Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokubanika amandla. Ukuphathwa kolwazi. Ukulethwa kwezinsiza kanye novuju. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziywa. Ukuqondiswa kubathengi nokugxila kubathengi. Ukuba nesibopho nokuziphatha ngokungakhanga.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokubuyekeza inhlaka yomnyango, izinhlobo zemisebenzi kanye nokulinganiswa kwemisebenzi. Yenza iziphepho ezingamisebenzi nasekubunjweni kwezikhungo. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubo yebhizinisi, i-SOP's kanye namazinga asevisi. Thuthukisa imihlahlandlela yamathuluzi okuphatha izindlela zokusebenza. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwayo yonke imishintsho ekuhleliwe. Cwaninga futhi uthuthukise izinhlela zoshintsho ezizibambelela kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni umnyango. Buka futhi uhlasiswe ukusetshenziswa kwenhlaka yomnyango, izinhlobo zemisebenzi, ukulinganiswa kwemisebenzi, ukungenelela ekuphatweni kwezindlela zokusebenza kanye nokuthuthuka okuqhubekayo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwenhlaka yomnyango, izinhlobo zemisebenzi, ukulinganiswa kwemisebenzi, ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo kwenqubo yebhizinisi, amazinga asevisi e-SOP's nenqubomgomo yezindlela zokusebenza. Ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi. IMIBUZO : Mr J Khoza Tel No: (012) 336 7405

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ukuphuhliswa kokuLungelelanisa iNhlangano
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli elibukelela ukuphuhliswa kwesakhiwo senhlangano, ukulinganiswa kwezikhundla nokuyila iinkqubo zoshishino eNdiweni yeZamanzi nokuThuthuzela kwiNtloko ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-NQF level 7 kwiZinkonzo zoBuphangela/uQwalaselo lokuSebenza/uPhatho lokuKhiqiza/uBuchwepheshe bokwenza neNhlangano. Iminyaka yamakhulu amatlanfu (5) yamava obuphangela kwindawo yokuphuhliswa kwenhlangano. AmaZizo nokuQonda amagunya okulinganisa izikhundla; namacebo ahambelana nawo. ULwazi nokuQonda imigaqo yokuphuhliswa nokuqamba ibhizo leNhlangano. ULwazi ngamacebo oluPhatho lokuSebenza. ULwazi lokuLawula iNtshukumo. Isakhono sokuphuhliswa koxinegelo lokuSebenza lulwazi oluPhatho. Isakhono sokwenza izifundo ezingangeni ezisezantsi ze ZINQanaba eziphezulu. ULwazi ngokuyiwa nokuQatywa koluhlu lweenkqubo. UkuQonda iNkqubo nemiQathango elifuna lawulo. Isakhono esiluhlazi sesiNcedo somXholo nakubhalwa nokuQamba. Isakhono seMibhalo eYilwayo, iNgxoxo nokuQamba ibhizo. UkuQonda uQeqesho nemiSebenzi yeNkqubo. Isakhono esiBuko nezakhono zoBukhosi. Isakhono soLawulo lwabantu nokuBa masikhulule. ULwazi lokuLawula iNkxubo yeNhlangano. Isakhono soKuso imiSebenzi yokuNika nokuQamba. Isakhono soKusombulula iingxaki nokuQamba ibango. UkuQonda iNkqubo yeNxwari kwaye igqibe ukuba yinTyantya. ISidima nobuNene bokuziphatha.
xh.duties: Lawula ukuphuhliswa nokuQwalasela isakhiwo senhlangano, iNcwadi kaXa efuna isakhundla nokuQamba iNqanaba lesakhundla. Qhuba iziFundo ngokusebenza kweNkxubo yomXholo weNkqubo. Lawula ukuphuhliswa kweNkqubo yoQeqesho. Qamba iNkqubo ezakunceda abantu besebenzisa amacebo oluPhatho. Lawula ukuQhutywa kokuQhutywa kwexesha elidlulileyo. Qeqesha nokuQamba iinkqubo ezikulungele ukuba zifakelelele kwaye zibe nguLawulo olulungileyo. Qwalasela nokuQwalasela nokuQhutywa kwiNkqubo esezantsi kwenhlangano, iNcwadi yoxa, iQhinga lesakhundla, amacebo oluPhatho nokuQamba ibhizo ngokungangayiyo ekuQambe iNkqubo. Qinisekisa ukuba ngokwakho usakhiwo senhlangano, iziKhundla, iNqanaba lesakhundla, ukulungiswa kwesakhiwo soQeqesho soBukhosi. Lawula nokuQhutywa kweNkqubo yemisebenzi yabantu. IIMBUZO : Mr J Khoza Tel No: (012) 336 7405

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Corporate Support Services
jobs.summary: Deputy Director to oversee corporate support services including HR, IT, communications and employee wellness at the Department of Water and Sanitation in Bloemfontein.
jobs.requirements: A relevant NQF level 7 qualification in Public Administration/Public Management/Human Resource Management/Industrial Psychology. Five (5) years management experience in corporate support environment at Assistant Director level. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Competencies: Knowledge of policy development and implementation. Knowledge of Administration processes. Knowledge of human Resource Management. Knowledge of Communication and Information Technology. Knowledge of HR information. Disciplinary knowledge of HR information. Understanding of government legislation. Financial management and knowledge of PFMA. Knowledge of techniques and procedures for the planning and execution of operations. Programme and project management. Problem solving and analysis. People and diversity management. Client orientation and customer focus. Good Communication skills. Accountability and ethical conduct. Knowledge of analytical procedures.
jobs.duties: Oversee the corporate support services functions such as HR Management, Information Technology, Communication, Auxiliary Services, Employee Health and Wellness, Occupational Health and Safety, Safety and Security, and Labour Relations. Lead the development and implementation of Corporate Support Services Operational Plan. Compile and submit monthly, quarterly, and annual reports (finance, performance, and risk) for the component. Manage budget and procurement processes of the component. Support the Provincial Head on the event, information and business continuity management for the Free State. Analyse policies and recommend necessary amendments. Management of audit process for the component. Ensure implementation of policies in various disciplines within the component and compliance thereof. Ensure that Corporate Services forms business partnership with line management. Manage and supervise human resources.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Korporatiewe Ondersteuningsdienste
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur om korporatiewe ondersteuningsdienste, insluitend HR, IT, kommunikasie en werknemerswelstand, by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Bloemfontein te oorsien.
af.requirements: 'n Relevante NQF vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Openbare Administrasie/Openbare Bestuur/Menslike Hulpbronbestuur/Industriële Sielkunde. Vyf (5) jaar bestuurservaring in 'n korporatiewe ondersteuningsomgewing op Assistantsdirekteurvlak. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van beleidsontwikkeling en -implementering. Kennis van administratiewe prosesse. Kennis van Menslike Hulpbronbestuur. Kennis van Kommunikasie en Inligtingstegnologie. Kennis van HR-inligting. Dissiplinêre kennis van HR-inligting. Begrip van regeringswetgewing. Finansiële bestuur en kennis van die PFMA. Kennis van tegnieke en prosedures vir die beplanning en uitvoering van bedrywighede. Program- en projekbestuur. Probleemoplossing en analise. Menslike- en diversiteitsbestuur. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag. Kennis van analitiese prosedures.
af.duties: Oorsien die korporatiewe ondersteuningsdiensfunksies soos HR-bestuur, Inligtingstegnologie, Kommunikasie, Hulpdienste, Werknemergesondheid en -welstand, Beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid, Veiligheid en Sekuriteit, en Arbeidsverhoudinge. Lei die ontwikkeling en implementering van die Operasionele Plan vir Korporatiewe Ondersteuningsdienste. Stel maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse verslae (finansies, prestasie en risiko) vir die komponent op en dien dit in. Bestuur begroting en verkrygingsprosesse van die komponent. Ondersteun die Provinciale Hoof op gebeurtenis-, inligtings- en besigheidskontinuïteitsbestuur vir die Free State. Analiseer beleide en beveel nodige wysigings aan. Bestuur van die ouditproses vir die komponent. Verseker implementering van beleide in verskeie dissiplines binne die komponent en nakoming daarvan. Verseker dat Korporatiewe Dienste 'n besigheidspartnerskap met lynbestuur vorm. Bestuur en hou toezig op menslike hulpbronne.

zu.title: Isikhundla sokuba nguMqondisi ongesiPhathi: Isevisi Yokusekela NgokwemiQondo
zu.summary: UMqondisi ongesiPhathi okuyiwo ophatha isevisi yokusekela ngokweminqondo ehlanganisa i-HR, i-IT, unxibelelwano, nempilo yabasebenzi e Department of Water and Sanitation e Bloemfontein.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esifanele esingu-NQF level 7 kwi-Public Administration/Public Management/Human Resource Management/Industrial Psychology. Ukuze kube ngu-Five (5) iminyaka yamava ephathwa emhlabeni wokusekela ngokwemiqondo ezingeni lika-Assistant Director. Ukufakazela ukuthi unelayisense yokushayela okusebenzayoongazange uphelelwe yisikhathi. Ikhono nolwazi: Ulwazi ngokuthuthukiswa nokuphathwa kwamaselula. Ulwazi ngemikhakha yomphathwa. Ulwazi ngokuPhathwa kwabantu. Ulwazi ngokuNxibelelwana nokuQoqwa kwemininingwane. Ulwazi ngemininingwane ye-HR. Ulwazi olunzulu ngemininingwane ye-HR. Ukuqonda imithetho kahulumeni. Ukuphathwa kwezimali nolwazi nge-PFMA. Ulwazi ngamasu nemigudu yokuhlela nokuphatha imisebenzi. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaprojekthi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuqonda. Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokwehlukana kwabo. Ukuqondisa iklayenti nokugxila kulo. Amakhono ohlezi kahle wokuxhumana. Ukubeka ukuziphendulela nokuziphatha ngokuzethemba. Ulwazi ngemigudu yokuqonda.
zu.duties: Phatha imisebenzi yesevisi yokusekela ngokweminqondo njengokuthi ukuPhathwa kwe-HR, i-Information Technology, ukuNxibelelana, i-Auxiliary Services, i-Health kanye ne-Wellness yabasebenzi, i-Occupational Health and Safety, i-Safety and Security, kanye ne-Labour Relations. Qondisa ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwenkathi ye-Corporate Support Services Operational Plan. Qamba futhi uthume imibiko yanyanga zonke, yenyanga, nango-nyaka (i-financial, i-performance, kanye ne-risk) yalolu hlobo. Phatha imali yokuqoqwa nokuthengwa kwezinto kwalolu hlobo. Sekela i-Provincial Head kumacamu okuqondisa, umininingwane, nokuphathwa kokuqhubeka kwezentengiselwano i-Free State. Hlola izinkululeko uze uphakamise izinguquko eziyimfuneko. Ukuphathwa kokuhlolwa kwale ndawo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinkululeko emikhakheni ehlukene kule ndawo nokuthi kuhlelwa njalo. Qinisekisa ukuthi i-Corporate Services ihlanganyela ubudlelwano nabaphathi bamagatsha. Phatha futhi uqobo ulawule abantu.

xh.title: Isekela-Nikela uMlawuli: Iinkonzo eziyiNgeniso zoNtsapo
xh.summary: Isekela-Nikela uMlawuli ukuba alawule iinkonzo eziyiNgeniso zoNtsapo eziquka i-HR, i-IT, unxibelelwano namaphupha abasebenzi kwisebe leWater and Sanitation eBloemfontein.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo se-NQF level 7 kwi-Public Administration/Public Management/Human Resource Management/Industrial Psychology. Iiminyaka ezihlanu (5) zemveliso yolawulo kwimeko yonxibelelwano loNtsapo kwinqanaba leAssistant Director. Ukuzivula ngeelayisensi yokushayela echanekileyo engazange iphelelwe lixesha. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngophuhliso nokusebenzisa iinkqubo. Ulwazi ngamanyathelo oBala. Ulwazi loLawulo lweZisebenzi. Ulwazi loNxibelelwano neTekhnoloji yoNxibelelwano. Ulwazi ngeenkcukacha ze-HR. Ulwazi olubhekisa ngeenkcukacha ze-HR. Ukuqonda umthetho welawulo karhulumente. ULawulo lweziXhobo zokuRhuzula nolwazi lwe-PFMA. Ulwazi ngeendlela namanyathelo eceliweyo ukuyila nokwenza ukusebenza. ULawulo lweNkqubo namaphrojekthi. Ukuxazula iingxaki nokuqhathanisa. ULawulo abantu nobohlatshwa. UQhagamshelwano namaxhomekeki kunye nolondolozo lwabo. Aakhobho ezibalulekileyo kuNxibelelwano. INgxaki nokuziphatha ngeendlela ezithembekileyo. Ulwazi ngamanyathelo oqondo.
xh.duties: Ukuqhuba amagunya einkonzo eziyiNgeniso zoNtsapo njengokuLawulwa kweZisebenzi, iTekhnoloji yoNxibelelwano, iNkqubo yoNxibelelwano, iinkonzo ezuncedo, iNtlalo yoBomi noMphefumlo wabaSebenzi, iMpilo yoNyilo neZikhuseleko, uKhuseleko nokuQinisekiswa, noNxibelelwano kaBasebenzi. UkuKokela ekubeniweni nokusebenziseni iNkqubo eSebenzayo yeNkonzo eziyiNgeniso zoNtsapo. Ukuqokelela nokungenisa iingxelo zenyanga, nethatyathiga, nezomnyaka (iimali, inkqubo, ingozi) kwelungelo. UkuLawula ibhajethi namanyathelo okuThenga axhwebe ngokwentsimbi elungelo lenkqubo. UkuNxusela iNtloko yasePhondo ngeenkqubo zokwazi nokuqhubela phambili kweshishini kuFree State. UkuHlaziya iinkqubo nokusikisa izinto eziyimfuneko ukuba zilungiswe. UkuLawula inkqubo yokuvavanya ngokwendlela kwelungelo. UkuQinisekisa ukusebenza kweendlela kwizifundo ezahlukeneyo ngaphakathi kwentsimbi nokuvisiseka kwayo. UkuQinisekisa ukuba iinkonzo zoNtsapo zidibana nomthintso wolawulo ogunyaziweyo. UkuLawula nokugcina kwakho iindleko zabantu.
