af.title: Beheeringenieurstechnoloog Graad a
af.summary: Beheeringenieurstechnoloog benodig in Bellville om tegniese dienste en ondersteuning te bestuur, met 'n vereiste van 'n BTech in Ingenieurwese en ECSA-registrasie.
af.requirements: 'n Baccalaureus in Tegnologie in Ingenieurwese (BTech) of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie. Ses (6) jaar ervaring as ingenieurstechnoloog na kwalifikasie word vereis. Verpligte registrasie by die Ingenieursraad van Suid-Afrika (ECSA) as professionele ingenieurstechnoloog. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Begrip van programme- en projektebestuur. Tegniese ontwerp- en ontledingskennis. Begrip van navorsingsontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurswese-toepassings. Kennis van regsversoenheid. Tegniese verslagskrywing en konsultasie. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Besluitneming, kreatiwiteit en spanwerk. Begrip van personeel- en finansiële bestuur. Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (sowel mondelings as skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardighede. Beplanning en organisering. Bestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur tegniese dienste en ondersteuning in samewerking met ingenieurs, technoloë en medewerkers in die veld, werkswinkel en tegniese kantooraktiwiteite. Verseker die bevordering van veiligheid in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulerende vereistes. Evalueer bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie in te lyf. Verseker gehalteversekering van tegniese ontwerpe met spesifikasies en magtig/maak aanbevelings vir goedkeuring deur die tersaaklike gesag. Verskaf insette tot die begrotingsproses. Stel verslae op en dien dit in soos vereis. Verskaf en konsolideer insette tot die tegniese/ingenieursbedryfsplan. Verseker die ontwikkeling, implementering en onderhoud van databasisse. Bestuur, hou toesig oor en beheer tegnies-verwante personeel en bates. Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Navorsing/literatuurstudies oor tegniese ingenieurstechnologie om kundigheid te verbeter. Skakel met tersaaklike liggame/rade oor ingenieursverwante aangeleenthede.

zu.title: I-Control Engineering Technologist Grade a
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-Control Engineering Technologist e-Bellville ukuphatha imisebenzi yobuchwepheshe nenkxaso, kudingeka i-BTech ku-Engineering nokubhaliswa kwe-ECSA.
zu.requirements: I-Bachelor of Technology in Engineering (BTech) noma izifundo ezihambisana nalokhu. Kudingeka amawula ayisithupha (6) iminyaka yokuholela ngemuva kokuthola iziqu njengomlingisi webuchwepheshe bokwakha. Kuyadingeka ukubhaliswa kwi-Engineering council of South Africa (ECSA) njengomlingisi webuchwepheshe bokwakha osemthethweni. Ukwetula ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile ezingapheli. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi. Ulwazi lwesign sebuchwepheshe nokuhlaziya. Ukuqonda ukuthuthukiswa kocwaningo. Izinhlelo zokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha zobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi lokuhambisana nomthetho. Ukubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe nokweluleka. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo, ukwakha nokusebenza ndawonye. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwabantu nezimali. Ukuqondisisa izidingo zakhasimende nokuphendula. Amakhono amahle okuxhumwa (okukhulunywayo nokubhalwayo). Amakhono wekhompuyutha. Ukucubungula nokuhlela. Ukuphatha.
zu.duties: Phatha imisebenzi yobuchwepheshe nenkxaso kanye no-Engineers, abo-Technologist nabahambisana nabo emhlabeni, kwemikhando nasemhlabathini wemisebenzi yobuchwepheshe. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kokuphepha ngokuhambisana nemithetho nemithethelana ezingabe ikhona. Hlaziya imibhalo yobuchwepheshe ekhona, izithombe eziyisizingathe kumanye namaphrosedha ukuze kufakelwe inqubo entsha yobuchwepheshe. Qinisekisa izinga lobuchwepheshe kumadizayini nobuchwepheshe ngokuhambisana nezinkomba futhi uvume/enze izincomo zokuvunywa ngumnyango ongabuzwayo. Nikeza iminikelo enkundleni yokwenza izabelo mali. Hlanganisa futhi uhambise imibhalo njengoko kudingeka. Nikeza futhi uhlanganise iminikelo kwicebo lokusebenza lobuchwepheshe/bokwakha. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa nokugcinwa kweziqukathi zolwazi. Phatha, qaphaza futhi lawule abantu abahlobene nobuchwepheshe nezimpahla. Ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono okungapheli ukuze ugcine ngenqubo entsha yobuchwepheshe namaphrosedha. Ucwaningo/Imfundo yemibhalongobuchwepheshe bokwakha ukuze kwandiswe ulwazi. Xhumana namabhungo/amakhansili ahlobene ngemikhakha yokwakha.

xh.title: Control Engineering Technologist inqanaba elincinane
xh.summary: Kufuneka kubekho Control Engineering Technologist eBellville ukulawula iinkonzo zezentlalo kunye nenkxaso, kufuneka abe ne-BTech kwi-Engineering nokubhaliswa kwi-ECSA.
xh.requirements: I-Bachelor of Technology kwi-Engineering (BTech) okanye isifundo esifanelekileyo. Kufuneka kube nkam yamava yeminyaka eyi-six (6) emva kokufumana isifundo njengongeniselelwe kwamasebe obunjiniyela. Kuyimfuneko ukubhaliswa kwi-Engineering council of South Africa (ECSA) njengongeniselelwe obungcali obuphezulu kwamasebe obunjiniyela. Ukuvula ikhaladi yokuqhuba eyesezantsi ebeyingeniso okwenzelwa isithuba. Ukuqonda ukulawula kwamacebo kunye namaprojekthi. Ulwazi lokuyila ngobuchwepheshe nokuhlalutya. Ukuqonda ukuphuhliswa kophando. Iinkonzo zobunjiniyela ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuzithintelwa ngokomthetho. Ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe kunye nokuvela ngokubuzwa. Ukusombulula iingxaki kunye nohlalutyo. Ukuthatha izigqibo, ukudala ngokwengqondo nokusebenza njengesiqhenga. Ukuqonda ukulawula abantu kunye nezimali. Ugqitho lokugxila kumthengi nokuphendula ngokukhawuleza. Amabali aguquguqukayo obuxhakaxhaka ngokomlomo (nokubhaliweyo). Amabali obuchwepheshe bekhompyutha. Ukuceba kwaye uqhelanise. Ulawulo.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkonzo zobuchwepheshe kunye nenkxaso ngokudityaniswa nabaGcini-bugcobo, abaQhoboshela-bugcobo nabahlawulwa kwindawo yokusebenza, esixhweni nakwindawo yamasebe obuchwepheshe. Qinisekisa ukukhuthaza ukhuseleko ngokwemigaqo nokulinganisela ngokomthetho. Hlenga iimanuali zobuchwepheshe ezikhoyo, iintsinga ezingamagqabi kunye neenkqubo ukuze ufake ubuchwephesha obutsha. Qinisekisa uqinisekiso lomgangatho wezinto eziyiliweyo zobuchwepheshe ngokwemigaqo yezinto kwaye uvume/enze izindululo eziza kuvunywa ngurhulumeni othintelayo. Nikela nengongoma kwinkqubo yokwenza igumbi. Hlanganisela kwaye uze ungenise iingxelo njengoko kufuneka. Nikela kwaye uhlanganise izongongomo kule nkqubo yamasebe obuchwepheshe/obunjiniyela. Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa, ukusebenzisa nokugcina iidata. Lawula, qwalasele kwaye ulawule abantu abahlotsheni nobuchwepheshe nezinto. Ukuphuhliswa ngokuqhubelekayo kobugcobo bobuchwepheshe ukuze uqonde nobuchwephesha obutsha kunye neenkqubo. Iphononongo/Ifundo yemibhalo ngobuchwepheshe bekhompyutha ukuze kuphuculwe ulwazi. Ukuhlangana namagunya/amarhanga ahambelanayo ngemiba ehlobene nobunjiniyela.

jobs.title: Control Engineering Technologist Grade a
jobs.salary_text: R958 776 per annum, (all-inclusive OSD salary package)
jobs.summary: Control Engineering Technologist position at Midmar Dam, Department of Water and Sanitation, requiring a B-Tech in Mechanical Engineering and ECSA registration with six years' experience.
jobs.requirements: A Bachelor of Technology (B-Tech) in Mechanical Engineering as recognised by SAQA. Compulsory Registration with the Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as a Professional Engineering Technologist. A minimum of six (6) years post qualification experience as an Engineering Technologist or Technician. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s licence (except for persons with disabilities). Demonstrated experience in infrastructure condition assessment, project management, design and analysis of water related infrastructure, preparation of procurement documentation and site supervision of construction works. Proven practical experience of mentoring graduate interns and facilitating training and development. Knowledge and experience of works management SAP will serve as an added advantage. Sound knowledge of contract administration and project management, with ability to interpret and review technical drawings and designs. Understanding of public sector procurement processes, financial planning and management principles. Knowledge of applicable legislation, including National Water Act, Water Services Act, environmental legislation, and Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Knowledge of standard forms of contract used in infrastructure projects, Problem solving and decision-making skills are essential as well as the ability to work in a multi-disciplinary team. Willingness to work outside normal working hours. Compulsory and extensive travelling throughout the KwaZulu-Natal and other provinces as and when required. Good communication skills both (verbal and written). Conflict management and negotiation skills.
jobs.duties: Work in the cluster office Technical Services sub directorate as one of the technical personnels that supports Area Offices. Manage Water Infrastructure O&M work streams with technical support from a team of Engineers, Technologist, Technicians, Artisans and maintenance personnel in the field. Ensure the promotion of safety in line with statutory and regulatory requirements. Lead work streams that involve evaluation of existing technical manuals, standard drawings, and procedures to incorporate new technology. Implement and manage projects in terms of the best practice and policy requirements. Ensure quality assurance of technical designs with specifications and authorize, make recommendations for approval by the relevant authority. Undertake condition assessment of infrastructure and update the relevant database and produce detailed reports on assessment results. Ensure that all infrastructure assets are properly maintained. Manage administrative activities, human resources related functions. Financial Management and provide inputs into the budgeting process, operational plan, procurement plan and related matters. Compile and submit reports as required. Participate in cluster performance enabling committees such as OHS committee, Disposal committee, BID committees, , Management Committees as per operations need. Attend to Risk and Disaster Management matters. Research and Development through continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures. Laise with relevant bodies/councils on engineering related matters. Must be prepared to work away from the office and travel extensively across the KwaZulu-Natal Province and other provinces as and when required. Provide mentorship and supervision of personnel. Research / literature studies and technical engineering technology to improve expertise. This is one of the Senior Technical roles in the cluster therefore, the candidate is required to have good leadership skills and will be expected to mentor the junior technical personnel.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Beheer Ingenieurstechnoloog Graad a
af.summary: Beheer Ingenieurstechnoloog pos by Midmar Dam, Department of Water and Sanitation, vereis 'n B-Tech in Mechanical Engineering en ECSA registrasie met ses jaar se ervaring.
af.requirements: A Bachelor of Technology (B-Tech) in Mechanical Engineering soos erken deur SAQA. Verpligte registrasie by die Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as 'n Professionele Ingenieurstechnoloog. 'n Minimum van ses (6) jaar na-kwalifikasie ervaring as 'n Ingenieurstechnoloog of Tegnikus. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, nie-verstreke bestuurderslisensie (behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede). Agetoonde ervaring in infrastruktuurtoestandassessering, projekbestuur, ontwerp en ontleding van waterverwante infrastruktuur, voorbereiding van verkrygingsdokumentasie en werkskontrole van konstruksiewerke. Bewese praktiese ervaring in die mentorskap van gegradueerde internes en die fasilitering van opleiding en ontwikkeling. Kennis en ervaring van werksbestuur SAP sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Deeglike kennis van kontrakadministrasie en projekbestuur, met die vermoë om tegniese tekeninge en ontwerpe te interpreteer en te hersien. Begrip van openbare sektor verkrygingsprosesse, finansiële beplanning en bestuursbeginsels. Kennis van toepaslike wetgewing, insluitend National Water Act, Water Services Act, omgewingswetgewing, en Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Kennis van standaardvorms van kontrakte wat in infrastruktuurprojekte gebruik word. Probleemoplossing en besluitnemingsvaardighede is noodsaaklik asook die vermoë om in 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. Bereidwilligheid om buite normale werksure te werk. Verpligte en uitgebreide reis deur KwaZulu-Natal en ander provinsies soos en wanneer vereis. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede beide (mondelings en skriftelik). Konflikbestuur en onderhandelingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Werk in die tuisgebiedkantoor Tegniese Dienste subdirektoraat as een van die tegniese personeel wat Gebiedskantore ondersteun. Bestuur Water Infrastruktuur O&M werkstrome met tegniese ondersteuning van 'n span Ingenieurs, Technoloë, Tegnici, Ambagsmanne en instandhoudingspersoneel in die veld. Verseker die bevordering van veiligheid in ooreenstem met statutêre en regulerende vereistes. Lei werkstrome wat die evaluering van bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures behels om nuwe tegnologie te inkorporeer. Implementeer en bestuur projekte volgens die beste praktyk en beleidsvereistes. Verseker gehalteversekering van tegniese ontwerpe met spesifikasies en magtig, maak aanbevelings vir goedkeuring deur die betrokke gesag. Onderneem toestandassessering van infrastruktuur en dateer die betrokke databasis op en produseer gedetailleerde verslae oor assesseringsresultate. Verseker dat alle infrastruktuur bates behoorlik onderhou word. Bestuur administratiewe aktiwiteite, menslike hulpbronne-verwante funksies. Finansiële Bestuur en verskaf insette in die begrotingsproses, operasionele plan, verkrygingsplan en verwante aangeleenthede. Stel verslae op en dien dit in soos vereis. Neem deel aan tuisgebiedprestasie-bystondernde komitees soos OHS komitee, Afsetter komitee, BID komitees, Bestuurskomitees soos per operasionele behoefte. Spreek Risiko en Rampbestuur aangeleenthede aan. Navorsing en Ontwikkeling deur deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Skakel met betrokke liggame/raad oor ingenieursverwante aangeleenthede. Moet voorbereid wees om weg van die kantoor af te werk en uitgebreid oor die KwaZulu-Natal Provinsie en ander provinsies te reis soos en wanneer vereis. Verskaf mentorskap en toesig van personeel. Navorsing / letterkunde studies en tegniese ingenieurswese tegnologie om kundigheid te verbeter. Dit is een van die Senior Tegniese rolle in die tuisgebied daarom word die kandidaat vereis om goeie leierskapsvaardighede te hê en sal verwag word om mentor te wees vir die junior tegniese personeel.

zu.title: Isikhundla Sobuchwepheshe Sokulawula Kobunjiniyela Isigaba a
zu.summary: Isikhundla sobuchwepheshe sokulawula kobunjiniyela e Midmar Dam, Department of Water and Sanitation, sifuna i-B-Tech kwi-Mechanical Engineering nokubhaliswa kwi-ECSA eminyakeni eyisithupha yohambo.
zu.requirements: I-Bachelor of Technology (B-Tech) ku-Mechanical Engineering njengoba kuniketwa yi-SAQA. Ukubhaliswa ngokuyisimiso ne-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengo-Professional Engineering Technologist. Okungeziwayo eminyakeni eyisithupha (6) yokuhamba emva kokuthola izifundo njengo-Engineering Technologist noma njengo-Technician. Ukwaziswa kolayisense yokushayela onevulalo engakapheli (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Ukubonakaliswa kohambo olusezingeni eliphezulu ekuqoqweni kwezimo zezinto eziyisisekelo, ekuqondiseni amaphrojekthi, ekwakheni nasekuhlaziyeni izakhiwo ezihlobene namanzi, ekulungiseni amadokhumenti okuthenga nasekuqondiseni izindawo zokwakha. Ukubonakaliswa kokuhola ngokomzimba kwabafundi abangakwazi ukuthola iziqu kanye nokuqondisa ukugqama nentuthuko. Ulwazi noluhambelo lwe-SAP yokuphatha imisebenzi kuzoba yinzuzo engezwe. Ulwazi olujulile ngokuphatha izinkontileka nokuqondisa amaphrojekthi, nendlela yokuthi ungapenya futhi uhlole izithombe ezikluxiwe nezakhiwo zobuchwepheshe. Ukuqonda izinqubo zokuthenga zesifunda sabantu, ukuhlela izimali kanye nemigomo yokuphatha. Ulwazi ngemithetho esebenzayo, okuhlanganisa i-National Water Act, i-Water Services Act, umthetho wezimo zendlu, kanye ne-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Ulwazi ngamafomu ajwayelekile emithetho yezinkontileka esetshenziswa kumaphrojekthi ezakhi-mphakathi; amakhono okuxazula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumbo abalulekile kanye nenhlonipho yokuzeqwa emsakweni ezinhlobonhlobo zabanini. Ukulungele ukusebenza ngemahora angajwayelekile. Ukuhamba ngokuyisimiso nangokujulile kuyo yonke i-KwaZulu-Natal nakwezinye izifundazwe njengoba kudingeka. Amakhono mahle okuxoxa (ngomlomo nangokubhala). Amakhono okuphatha izingxabano kanye nokuweluleka.
zu.duties: Usebenza kohhovu lokuhlanganisa komnyango ohlinzela ngamasevisi abuchwepheshe njengomunye wabantu basezansi bokulawula abasiza amahhovu ezindawo. Phatha imisebenzi ye-Water Infrastructure O&M ngosizo lobuchwepheshe othola kwiqembu labaBenjiniyela, abaChwepheshe, abaQondisi, abaZoyi nokugcinwa kwabantu emkhatsini. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kokuvikeleka ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho nemithethonqubo. Hola imisebenzi ebandakanya ukuhlola izandiso zobuchwepheshe ezikhona, izithombe ezingajwayelekile, kanye nezinqubo zokufaka nobuchwepheshe obusha. Sebenzisa futhi uphathe amaphrojekthi ngokukaqoqo nobuhle bokwenziswa nemigomo. Qinisekisa ukhotho kobuchwepheshe bezakhiwo ngemiyalo bese unika imvume, wenze izincomo ukuze zogcotshwa ngamandla. Hlola izinto ezisetshenziswa ezindawo zokwakha ukuze zixazulwe izinkinga bese ubhalisa ezinhlaka ezizihlanganisa ukuze zenze imibiko eminingi. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amakhasimende ezakhiwo agcinwe kahle. Phatha imisebenzi yezinto ezibhalwe ngokomthetho, nemisebenzi ehlobene nabantu. Uphatha izimali futhi unike izincomo ohlelweni lokuhlela imali yesabelo, inhlelo yokusebenza, uhlelo lokuthenga kanye nezinto ezihlobene. Hlola futhi unike amabalana njengoba kudingwa. Hlanganyela emakomini ekuqondiseni amandla emnyangweni njenge-OHS committee, i-Disposal committee, ama-BID committee, nabaBaphathi njengoba kuyisidingo. Ukusebenza kwezingozi kanye nokuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza kanye nezezikali. Ukucwaninga nokuthuthuka ngokuqhubeka nokuphathwa kobuchwepheshe ukuze ugqame nobuchwepheshe nobuchwepheshe. Thinta izikhungo/amaKhansili ahlobene ngemisebenzi yezobuchwepheshe. Kudingeka ukuba ulungele ukusebenza kude nenhlovu yohhovu futhi uhambe kabanzi kuyo yonke i-KwaZulu-Natal nakwezinye izifundazwe njengoba kudingeka. Nikeza ngokuhola kanye nokuphatha abantu. Cwaninga / uhlolisise okubhaliwe bese usebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bezobuchwepheshe ukuthuthuka okukhulu. Lesi esinye sezikhundla eziba yizinga eliphezulu kuleyo ndawo ngakho-ke, kudingeka ukuba othile anamakhono amahulu okubusa futhi bazofuna ukuba abone ukuba ugqamise abantu basesikhundleni esincane.

xh.title: Iteknoloji yokuLawula iNjineli inqanaba a
xh.summary: Isithuba seTeknoloji yokuLawula iNjineli e Midmar Dam, kwisebe leZoManzi nokuQothula, kufuneka kube ne-B-Tech kwiNjineli yeeMekile kwaye kubhaliswe kwi-ECSA kunye neminye yeminyaka elithandathu yamava okusebenza.
xh.requirements: I-Bachelor of Technology (B-Tech) kwi-Mechanical Engineering njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Ukubhalisa ngokuyiyimfuno kwi-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengoMmisebenzi weTeknoloji weNjineli oPhathe kakhulu. Ubuncinane beminyaka elithandathu (6) yeminyaka yamava emva kokufumana isidanga njengoTeknoshi weNjineli okanye njengoTishini. Ukuvula ilayisensi yokushayela ekusebenzayo nengaphelelwa lixesha (ngaphandle kwezabo banokuphela okubuthathaka). Ubungqina bemigaqo ekulinganisweni komthamo wesiseko, ulawulo lwaprojekthi, ukuyila nokwahlula iziseko ezingamanzi, ulungiselelo lwamaxwebhu okuthenga nokuqonda indawo yolwakhiwo. Amava obonwayo aqinisekileyo ekukhuliseni abafundi abangakwisikhundla sokuqeqeshwa nokukhuthaza uqeqesho nophuhliso. Ulwazi namava kwinkqubo yabasebenzi ye-SAP kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Ulwazi olululu ngolawulo lweenkonzo nemigaqo yeprojekthi, kunye namandla okuqonda nokuphonononga iimveliso ezizeIculo nokuqamba kwemizobo yobugcisa. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zokuthenga kwikomkhulu lezorhwebo, iplani nezizathu zolawulo lwemali. Ulwazi ngemithetho esebenzayo, kuquka i-National Water Act, i-Water Services Act, umthetho weendalo, kunye ne-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Ulwazi ngeendlela ezingagqibekanga zemvume yeenkonzo ezisetyenziswa kumapjekthi wesiseko, amakhono okuxazulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo zibalulekile, kanjalo nokuba namandla okusebenza kwindawo esuka kwangaphesheya kolwazi oluninzi. Ukulungele ukusebenza ngaphandle kweeyure ezingatshintshanga. Ukuhamba kakhulu nangaphezu koko kuyimfuno kuyo yonke i-KwaZulu-Natal nakwezinye iiphondo njengoko kufuneka. Amakhono amnandi onxibelelwano womlomo nombhalo. Amakhono okulawula iingxabano nokuthengiselana.
xh.duties: Sebenza kwindawo yeklasi yamakhosi aseko Amanzini eNjineli njengomnye wabantu baseko oqinisekisa amakhosi amanini. Lawula imisebenzi yokugcina nokulungisa iziseko zanamanzi ngenkxaso yobugcisa kwiqela labaBengineli, abaTeshinshi, abaTishini, abaZokulungisa nabasebenzi bolungiso kummandla. Qinisekisa ukukhuthazwa kokhuseleko ngokuvumelana nemithetho nemigaqo. Qhatha imisebenzi equka isilinganiselo samaxwebhu obugcisa, iimveliso ezizeIculo, nemiqathango yokubuyisa ingqiyo entsha. Zisebenzise uphuhliso lwamapjekthi ngokuvumelana nobukhulu bomsebenzi nokuqonda kuhlelo. Qinisekisa ukukhuseleka kokuyila okuzikrobiso nemiqatsho, uvume, uze unike izindululo zokuqatywa ngugunyathi olubalulekileyo. Yenza isilinganiso sokuqina kwesiseko uze uhlaziye isiseko sedatha esifanelekileyo uphinde unike iingxelo ezipheleleyo ngesiphumo. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iziseko zisilondolozwe kakuhle. Lawula imisebenzi yolawulo, imisebenzi ehlobene nabasebenzi. Ulawulo LweMali nokunika iziphakamiso kwinkqubo yokwabiwa kwemali, iplani yokusebenza, iplani yokuthenga nokuqalisana. Qamba uze ungenise iingxelo njengoko kufuneka. Thatha inxaxheba kumakhomithi aqhutshwa kuqhagamshelo lwesiko njengamakhomithi OHS, Disposal, BID, Management ngokweemfuno zenkqubo. Xinzelela izindaba zoMngeni nokuLawulo kwelubalo. Ulwazi nophuhliso ngokuzithutha kakhulu kwamakhosi ibucala kugcino nobuchule ukugcina ushishimo ngeenkqubo nobuchule. Jongana nemizimila emibali izekwezi ngendawo yophando kumacandelo abucukubhede. Makulungele ukusebenza kude nendawo yokusebenza ahamba kakhulo kummandla we-KwaZulu-Natal nakwezinye iziphondo nangokuba njalo. Nikela ngokukhulisa nokuqonda ngokomsebenzi abantu. Phengulula / uqeqeshe izifundo zemibhalo nobugcisa beBucucu bokuphucula ubugcisa obulula. Esi sikhundla ngosomakhosomsa obalulekileyo kurhulumente ngoko ke, ogqithwayo uya kudinga amakhono amnini okukhulisa abantu abanobugcisa abaneminye ubudala bonke imisebenzi ehlobene neprojekthi.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: HR Information Management
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for HR Information Management at the Department of Water and Sanitation in Pretoria, requiring PERSAL expertise and five years of management experience.
jobs.requirements: A relevant NQF level 7 qualification in Human Resource Management/Public Management. Five (5) years management experience in Human Resource Information management and Human Resource Systems i.e. PERSAL. Departmental PERSAL Controllers Certificate. Proven extensive PERSAL experience. Extensive knowledge of MS Excel, Word and databases. HR analytics and reporting. HR dashboards, workforce analytics, management information trends and evidence-based decision making. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Strategic knowledge of HR information management and HR systems. Strong understanding of government legislations (PSA, PSR, POPIA, NARSSA, Act, PFMA, MS frameworks). Understanding of data governance, analytics, and reporting. Policy development, monitoring and evaluation. Understanding of people empowerment, change management and business process improvement. Knowledge of finance, risk management and audit compliance. Strategic capacity building and leadership. Understanding of project and programme management. Understanding of people, change and financial management. Client orientation and customer focus. Ethical conduct and accountability. Good communication skills both (verbal and written). Stakeholder management, ethical conduct and accountability. Problem solving and decision making.
jobs.duties: Management of Human Resource Information system. Monitor the administration, maintenance and optimisation of HR systems e.g. PERSAL. Management of the implementation and maintenance of the approved departmental structure on PERSAL. Post establishment. Management of the vacancy rate. Manage the provision of HR information. Human resource reporting by assessing user requirements, quality assurance and formatting HR. Oversight reports and Vulindlela. Management of HR databases. Storage and data integrity of human resources information in line with relevant legislation. Manage the provision of the PERSAL management report on a monthly basis. Management of HR information systems i.e. PERSAL, e-leave. Departmental PERSAL controller. Ensuring adherence to the departmental PERSAL policy. Management of PERSAL user access control, PERSAL training and system changes. Liaison with National Treasury. Management of human resource registry. Oversee the classification, storage, retrieval and disposal of HR records in line with legislative requirements. Manage and supervise staff performance, development and productivity. Manage the unit budget, including planning, monitoring and reporting on expenditure. ENQURIES : Ms P Naidu Tel No: (012) 336 7762

Ukubaluleka okungenamthengi, okungenasimo, ngokugqamisa imithetho yezigaba zemfundvo zomphakathi; ukuzinza imiso yenqubo yezinsiza zasemhlabeni; ukutholwa kwesihlonipho nokugugisa ukusetshenziswa kwemithetho yokumiswa kwemali. Ulwazi ngemithetho yezevaliwe. Ulwazi lokugcina ukubhaliswa kwemali nokuqagela imisebenzi yale mali. Ulwazi lwezindlela zokukhetha nokubeka izinhloso zokuqashwa kwemisebenzi ukuze kuhlotshiswe izinsiza zokuqasha. Ukutholakala kwemisebenzi ehlukene kwendlela yokuphatha imisebenzi ehlotshaniswe nezinhloso ezithunyelwe. Indlela yokuxhumana nabantu kanye nokuhlaziya imisindo yomuntu ngamunye. Ukuxazulula izinkinga ukuhlaziya imisindo. Ukuphatha abantu nemithetho yokuhlukahlukana kwemindeni. Ukugqamisa isihlalo sokuthengisa nokubaluleka komthengi. Ukukhuluma kahle ngesiZulu (ngokubhala nokukhuluma). Ukubhaliswa kwemisebenzi nokuziphatha ngokuziphatha.
zu.duties: Uhlela, wonga futhi ume ngokuhlela imisebenzi. Uhlela futhi wonga okufakwayo kwemibhalo yokuhlela nokugcina imisebenzi yonyaka. Uphatha imibuzo kanye nemibhalo evela kule hhovisi. Uhlela izinto eziphathelene nezinkinga zomkhankaso wamaphoyisa, imithetho yokuholela inkinga yamaphoyisa; amaphuzu okungenisa imali esigabeni, imibuzo yesiGungu somthetho, imithetho yokuphatha inkinga yomuntu nokulawula izinto ukuthi zenzeke ngesikhathi esihle. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwemibhalo. Yakha ukuhlala uhlelo lokuphatha imisebenzi kule hhovisi ukuthi lisize ukuthi kuhlolwe imisebenzi yamaphoyisa. Nikeza ukusekelwa ngokuphatha imisebenzi ohhovisi futhi ume ngomkhankaso weNhloko yokuqhathanisa imisebenzi emihlanganweni, emahhovisi namaphoyisa. Bhala amaminethi, izinqumo ukuthi zithunyelwe kubantu ababalulekile; ulandele isinqumo esihle ukuthi sizothi senzeni, ulungise imibhalo yokwazisa izinto zokwenza kanye neminye imibhalo ekahle ukuze kutholakale ukuthi iNhloko yokuqhathanisa imisebenzi iphume ngemphumelelo. Nikeza ukusekelwa okuhle ngokuphatha imali ohhovisi. Hlola ukuthi imali yohhovisi idinga imali. Uphatha abantu ngokuphatha imisebenzi yokuqhathanisa imisebenzi.

Ukuqonda ukulawula iinkqubo namaprojekthi. Amakhono amabalengi kubemi beluntu nendlela zokuhlalutya. Ukuzingela iingxaki nokuhlalutya. Ukulawula abantu nokuqezo. Ukujolisa kumthengi kwaye ugqamise iimfuno zabathengi. Amakhono amabalengi okunxibelelwana (nokuthetha nokubhala). Ukuba nesibindi nokuziphatha ngokweenkolo ezilungileyo.
xh.duties: Ukuhlanganisa, ukuqokelela ekubeni kwelinye nokuvelisa ingxelo ngocwangciso. Ukuhlanganisa nokubeka ndawonye izinto ezingenayo zocwangciso lwamasiko neminyaka yonke. Ukulawula imibuzo nenyundwa yababhalayo engaphakathi kweso ziko. Ukuhlanganisa izinto ezinxulumene neendaba zekomiti, izinto ezithunyelwa kwenye indawo, iimphumela zovavanyo, imibuzo yepalamente, ukulawula iingozi naxa njalo ukwenza iqinisekiso ukuba kusikelwa iintsuku zonke okanye okuya kusetyenziswa kule mimibuzo. Qinisekisa ulawulo lweefayili. Ukuyila nokugcina inkqubo kwiso ziko ezakuthsa nzuzo ekukhuluzeni kubambelelo. Ukunika inkxaso yolawulo kuso isikhombela futhi umele iNtloko eMisebenzi yoMmandla kwimibhobonono, kwinkquzo nakuze naxa zisenjalo. Ukubhala iingxelo zemibhobonono, izigqibo nokuba zidluliselele kubantu abamagunya, ukulandela inkqubo yentlube, ukulungisa izikhokelo nemibhalo evela ngasenzahlo xa kunjalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulungelelwaniso lweNtloko eMisebenzi yoMmandla. Ukunika inkxaso yemali yolawulo kuso ziko. Ukukhetha nokubeka ndawonye iinkcukacha ngemali efunwa kuso ziko. Ukulawula imisebenzi yemizimba yabasebenzi eMisebenzi yoMmandla.

Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurslisensie. Kennis en begrip van toepaslike staatsdiensbeleid en -strategieë. Begrip van administratiewe prosesse. Dissiplinêre kennis van HR-inligting. Begrip van regeringswetgewing. Kennis van finansiële bestuur en die PFMA. Kennis van tegnieke en prosedures vir die beplanning en uitvoering van bedrywighede. Begrip van program- en projekbestuur. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede en analitiese prosedures. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Mens- en diversiteitsbestuur. Kliëntgerigtheid en kliëntfokus. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (sowel mondeling as skriftelik). Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Koördineer, konsolideer en rapporteer oor beplanningsake binne die kantoor van die Provinciale Hoof. Koördineer en konsolideer insette vir strategiese en jaarlikse prestasieplanne en verwante verslagdoeningsvereistes. Bestuur en koördineer navrae, korrespondensie en voorleggings binne die kantoor. Koördineer sake rakende portefeuljekomitees, verwysings, ouditbevindings, parlementêre navrae, risikobestuur en ander bestuursake wat relevant is tot provinsiale bedrywighede en verseker nakoming van voorgeskrewe tydlyne en sperdatums. Verseker doeltreffende rekord- en dokumentbestuur binne die kantoor. Ontwikkel, onderhou en verbeter administratiewe en bestuursondersteuningstelsels wat bydra tot die doeltreffendheid en werkverrigting van die kantoor van die Provinciale Hoof. Verskaf uitvoerende, strategiese koördinasie- en administratiewe bestuursondersteuning aan die Provinciale Hoof. Verteenwoordig die Provolipale Hoof by vergaderings, werkswinkels en ander betrokkenheidsgeleenthede, waar toepaslik gedelegeer. Koördineer en boekstaaf sleutelbesluite en besluite, kommunikeer dit aan tersaaklike rolspelers en monitor en volg vordering rakende implementering op. Berei voor en konsolideer kortingsnotas, verslae, aanbiedings, voorleggings en ander bestuursinligting wat vereis word om die Provolipale Hoof toereikend te ondersteun en voor te berei vir vergaderings, toesigbetrokkenheidsgeleenthede en ander uitvoerende verantwoordelikhede. Verskaf finansiële administratiewe ondersteuning aan die kantoor, insluitend die bepaal en konsolideer van inligting rakende begrotingsvereistes en die monitering van tersaaklike uitgawesake. Koördineer en ondersteun menslikehulpbron-administratiewe sake wat relevant is tot die kantoor en Provinciale Bedrywighede, binne toepaslike delegasies en voorskrifte.

zu.title: Onozimele: Ukusekela Ihhovisi
zu.summary: Onozimele: Ukusekela Ihhovisi e Department of Water and Sanitation e Mmabatho, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF 7 kanye neminyaka emihlanu yohlu lwemisebenzi ekuqondweni nokulawuleni.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezihambisanayo ezinga le-NQF 7 kuqondisa ku Public / Business Administration / Management. Iminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yohlu lwemisebenzi kwesimo sokulawula. Ukulula ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile nengakapheli. Ulwazi nokuqonda izinqubomgomo nezindlela zesevisi yomphakathi ezifanelekayo. Ukuqonda inqubo yokulawula. Ulwazi olukhethekile lwemiyalezo ye-HR. Ukuqonda umthethosivivinyo kahulumeni. Ulwazi lokuqondisa imali kanye ne-PFMA. Ulwazi lobuchule kanye nezinqubo zokuhlela futhi kuqhutshekwe izindlela. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo kanye nezinhlela zomsebenzi. Amandla okusebenza nabantu kanye nezinqubo zokuhlaziya. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuphatha abantu kanye nokubaluleka kobubninguni. Ukugxila kthlent nobuntu abakhe izidingo. Amasenthombi anuhle noku khuluma futhi okubhalwayo. Ukuba nesibopho nokuziphatha kwayesabekayo.
zu.duties: Nhlanganysa, qoqalisa futhi ukutshela mayelana nezindaba zohlela ngaphakathi kohhovisi loMphathi weSifunda. Hlanganisa futhi uqoqose okungenayo okuhlelekwe okuhle kwezinhlelo zokusebenza kwesikhathi eside kanye nezikulumulo zonyaka kanye nezidingo ezihlobene nokubika. Phatha futhi uhlange imibuzo oylxaxa izinsiza ezingxoxweni eziseduze ohhovisini. Hlanganisa izindaba mayelana nezigaba sefndlu iseluleko, okufakwayo, izinxulumo zokuhlola, izibuzo zenshlamano, iphathiengo yengozi, kanye nalezinye izindaba zentlontlo ezibandakanya ukusingathwa kwebamba uhlelo kanye nokubaluleka kolwazi lwemithetho futhi unike isikhathi esiqondiwe namageci ohovili oludingekayo imali etholwe ngeenjngamibhalu kahulumeni namagunyazwe anelisa.

xh.title: Iputyathi Direktha: Inkxaso yeOfisi
xh.summary: Iputyathi Direktha: Inkxaso yeOfisi kwisebe leWater and Sanitation eMmabatho, lifuna izifundo ze-NQF 7 namava eminyaka emihlanu yocalulo wolulawulo kwintengiselwano.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo se-NQF level 7 kwindawo yezifundo kwi-Public / Business Administration / Management. Iiminyaka elishumi (10) yamava olulawulo kwindawo yolawulo. Inkingiso yelayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo nengapheliyo. Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo nezicwangciso zenkonzo kahulumble ezifanelekileyo. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zolawulo. Ulwazi ngolwazi lwe-HR. Ukuqonda umthetho kahulumble. Ulwazi lolawulo lwemali ne-PFMA. Ulwazi lweendlela nendlela zokwenza izicwangciso nokuphumeza iinkqubo. Ukuqonda ulawulo lwalamulo namaprojekthi. Amandla amabalasela obuntu nemigaqo yokuhlalutya. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya. Ulawuloabantu olwahlukileyo. Imbonakalo kwabathengi nokuqwalasela abathengi. Amandla amabalasela abalulekileyo (abalandelayo nobhalwe). Iresponsibility nokuziphatha ngokungakhathazwa.
xh.duties: Qhoboshela, hlanganisa nxamle uxela ngenkcazelo malunga nemiba yokucwangcisa ofisini yeProvincial Head. Qhoboshela uze uhlanganise imincili yamacebo okuquka ihora namacebo abakho ngokwamava nokuqwalasela. Lawula uze uqhobothe imibuzo nokuqwalasela kofisi. Qhoboshela imiba emalunga neendlela zodweliso, iindlela ezithunyelweyo, imiphumalo yokucinga, iingxaki zepalamente, ulawulo lweengxaki naye nanye imiba yolawulo ethintela ukusebenza koluntu uze uqinisekise ukulandelwa kolwazi-migaqo nokuqwalasela. Qwalasela ukuqinisekiswa kwegunya lokubhalisa kwabasebenzi ofisini. Cwangcisa, gcina uze uphucule iinkqubo zolawulo nezinxibelelwano ezenza isoxulunxi kwinkqubo yocwangciso nokusebenza kahle ofisi yeProvincial Head. Yiba nolwazi, uqhobothe ngamacebo abakhokheli abakhulu uze unike inkxaso yolulawulo abakhokheli abakhulu kwi-Provincial Head. Mela i-Provincial Head kwizibinxo, kumashishini nakwezinye iindawo, apho igunywa khona. Hlanganisa uze ubhale izigibo ezibalulekileyo nezigqibo, zenze ulwazi kubathintekayo baze uqwalasele ulandele inkqubo yophumeziso. Lugqibo nemiba ethile.

jobs.title: Engineer Production Grade a – C
jobs.salary_text: R914 517 – R1 376 199 per annum, (all-inclusive OSD salary package), (Offer will be based on years of experience)
jobs.summary: Production Engineer Grade A–C supporting water services authorities with WSDPs, master plans and infrastructure assessment; requires ECSA registration as Professional Engineer.
jobs.requirements: An Engineering degree (B Eng/BSc (Eng) in Civil Engineering. Three (3) years’ relevant post-qualification engineering experience in civil and water engineering. Compulsory registration with the Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as a Professional Engineer. The disclosure of a valid, unexpired driver’s licence is required, as site visits and travel form part of the duties. Sound knowledge and experience in municipal water services planning; Water Services Development Plans (WSDPs), water services master plans and five- year reliability plans; water demand, balances, backlogs, infrastructure capacity, performance and risk assessments; feasibility studies, business plans, project identification, prioritisation, packaging and implementation readiness. Working knowledge of the Water Services Act, National Water Act, Municipal Systems Act and applicable environmental, public-finance, supply- chain and engineering prescripts. Competence in programme, project, contract, risk and financial management; technical report-writing; stakeholder coordination; and Microsoft Office. Experience with GIS, hydraulic modelling and engineering design software will be an advantage. Strong analytical, problem-solving, planning, presentation, facilitation and communication skills. Sound professional judgement, teamwork, client orientation, accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: Support Water Services Authorities to prepare, review and update WSDPs, water services master plans, five-year reliability plans and aligned Integrated Development Plan inputs. Assess current and future service needs, backlogs, demand, water balances, infrastructure capacity, condition and performance, and supply risks; evaluate planning and operational scenarios. Identify, prioritise and package projects; quality-assure scoping and feasibility studies, business plans, engineering reports, designs, cost estimates, programmes, risk registers and implementation-readiness information. Provide engineering and project-management support to MIG, WSIG, RBIG and other funding processes. Conduct site inspections and technical investigations; verify geo- referenced project and infrastructure information. Support the Comprehensive Infrastructure Plan, water conservation and water demand management, Free Basic Services, Municipal Priority Action Plan, Municipal Strategic Self- Assessment and sector reporting. Coordinate planning inputs with municipalities, sector departments, departmental programmes and service providers. Prepare reports and Annual Performance Plan inputs. Promote compliance, value for money, safety and environmental responsibility. Mentor Candidate Engineers, graduate interns and engineering technicians.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: NB: Shortlisted candidates will be required to undergo technical and ethical assessments. Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Ingenieur Produksie Vlak A – C
af.summary: Produksie-ingenieur Vlak A–C wat waterdienste-owerhede met WSDP's, meesterplanne en infrastruktuurassesserings ondersteun; vereis ECSA-registrasie as Professionele Ingenieur.
af.requirements: 'n Ingenieursgraad (B Eng/BSc (Eng) in Siviele Ingenieurswese. Drie (3) jaar se relevante na-kwalifikasie-ingenieurservaring in siviele en wateringenieurswese. Verpligte registrasie by die Ingenieursraad van Suid-Afrika (ECSA) as 'n Professionele Ingenieur. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onvervalle bestuurderslisensie word vereis aangesien werksbesoeke en reis deel van die pligte uitmaak. Deeglike kennis en ervaring in munisipale waterdienste-beplanning; Waterdienste-ontwikkelingsplanne (WSDP's), waterdienste-meesterplanne en vyfjaar-betroubaarheidsplanne; wateraanvraag, balanse, agterstande, infrastruktuurkapasiteit, prestasie-en risiko-assesserings; haalbaarheidsstudies, besigheidsplanne, projektidentifikasie, prioritisering, verpakking en implementeringgereedheid. Werkende kennis van die Waterdienste-wet, Nasionale Waterwet, Munisipale Stelsels-wet en toepaslike omgewings-, openbare finansieel-, voorsieningsketting- en ingenieursvoorskrifte. Bevoegdheid in program-, projek-, kontrak-, risiko- en finansiële bestuur; tegniese verslagskrywing; belanghebbendeskoördinering; en Microsoft Office. Ervaring met GIS, hidrouiese modellering en ingenieursontwerp-sagteware sal 'n voordeel wees. Sterke analitiese, probleemoplossing-, beplanning-, aanbiedings-, fasiliterings- en kommunikasievaardighede. Deeglike professionele oordeel, spanwerk, kliëntoriëntasie, aanspreeklikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Ondersteun Waterdienste-owerhede om WSDP's, waterdienste-meesterplanne, vyfjaar-betroubaarheidsplanne en belynde Geïntegreerde Ontwikkelingsplan-insette voor te berei, te hersien en op te dateer. Assesseer huidige en toekomstige diensbehoeftes, agterstande, aanvraag, waterbalanse, infrastruktuurkapasiteit, toestand en prestasie, en voorsieningsrisiko's; evalueer beplannings- en operasionele scenario's. Identifiseer, prioritiseer en verpak projekte; verseker gehalte van omvang- en haalbaarheidsstudies, besigheidsplanne, ingenieursverslae, ontwerpe, kosteberamings, programme, risikoregistries en implementeringgereedheidsinligting. Verskaf ingenieurs- en projekbestuursondersteuning aan MIG-, WSIG-, RBIG- en ander befondsingsprosesse. Voer werksbesigtigings en tegniese ondersoeke uit; verifieer geo-verwysingsprojek- en infrastruktuurinligting. Ondersteun die Omvattende Infrastruktuurplan, waterbewaring en wateraanvraagbestuur, Gratis Basiese Dienste, Munisipale Prioriteits-aksieplan, Munisipale Strategiese Self-assessering en sektorverslagdoening. Koördineer beplanningsinsette met munisipaliteite, sektordepartemente, departementele programme en diensverskaffers. Berei verslae en Jaarlikse Prestasieplan-insette voor. Bevorder nakoming, waarde vir geld, veiligheid en omgewingsverantwoordelikheid. Mentorskap Kandidaat-ingenieurs, afgestudeerde interns en ingenieurstegnici.

zu.title: Injiniya Yokukhiqiza Izinga A – C
zu.summary: Injiniya Yokukhiqiza Izinga A–C exhasa izigunyazwe ezinikeza izinsiza zamanzi nge-WSDP, iziplani eziphambili nokuhlola insimbi; kudingeka ukubhaliswa kwi-ECSA njengenjiniya oyingcwelengqondo.
zu.requirements: Idegree yenjiniyela (B Eng/BSc (Eng) ku-Civil Engineering. Izimfihlakalo ezintathu (3) zeminyaka yokuhlangabezana ngenqubo yokusebenza njengenjiniya ezinhlobonhlobo zomsebenzi wocwango nokuqoqwa kwamanzi. Ukubhaliswa okuyisimiso ku-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengenjiniya oyingcwelengqondo. Ukwazisa ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile, engazange iphelelwe isikhathi kudingeka, njengoba ukuvakashela iziza nokuhamba kuyingxenye yemisebenzi. Ukwazi okumile nokuhlangabezana ngenqubo ekwelweni kwezinsiza zamanzi zikamasipala; Izinkomba Zentuthuko Yezinsiza Zamanzi (WSDP), iziplani eziphambili zezinsiza zamanzi nezinsimu zethemba ezinhlanu zeminyaka; isidingo samanzi, ukulingana, imikhawu engagciniwe, amandla ensimbi, ukwenza kanye nokuhlola ingozi; izifundo zokwenzeka, iziplani zebhizinisi, ukuhlukaniswa, ukuqondisa, ukupakisha nokulungiselela ukuphumelelisa. Ulwazi lokusebenza loku-Water Services Act, National Water Act, Municipal Systems Act nezimiso ezisebenzayo zezinto zemvelo, izimali zomphakathi, unxibelelwano lokuthenga kanye nezinkomba zenjiniyela. Ukukghona ekuphathweni uhlelo, iphrojekthi, inkontilaka, ingozi nezemali; ukubhala ingxoxo yobuchwepheshe; ukuhlanganisa abahlanganyeli; kanye ne-Microsoft Office. Okuhlangenwe nakho oku-GIS, ukumodela amanzi kanye nesoftwe yokuhlela njengenjiniya kuzoba yinzuzo. Amandla okuhlaziya, okuxazulula izinkinga, okuhlela, okuphakamisa, okukhuthaza kanye nokuxhumana okumile. Isahlulelo esimile sochwepheshe, ukusebenza ndawonye, ukuqondiswa kumthengi, ukubekephula nokuziphatha ngokwemigaqo.
zu.duties: Xhasa izigunyazwe ezinikeza izinsiza zamanzi ukulungiselela, ukubuyeza nokuvuselela i-WSDP, iziplani eziphambili zezinsiza zamanzi, izinsimu zethemba ezinhlanu zeminyaka kanye nezinsizo ezihambisanayo ze-Integrated Development Plan. Hlola izidingo zenkonzo zanje nangomuso, imikhawu engagciniwe, isidingo, ukulingana kwamanzi, amandla ensimbi, isimo nokwenza, futhi ungoze izinsiza eziyingozi; ihlola izimo zokuhlela nokusebenza. Hlakanisa, qondisa uphakishe amaphrojekthi; qinisekisa izinga lwezifundo zomkhawu nokwenzeka, iziplani zebhizinisi, ingxoxo yenjiniyela, ukuhlela, ukulinganisa izindleko, amahlela, okubhalwa kwezingozi nolwazi lokulungiselela ukuphumelelisa. Nikeza izehlakalo zenjiniyela nokuphathwa kwephrojekthi ekuMIG, WSIG, RBIG kanye nanye izinqubo zemali. Yenza izivakashi ezindaweni kanye nokuphenya ngezobuchwepheshe; qinisekisa ulwazi oluxhunyiwe lwezindawo ngokwendawo ngokwephrojekthi nensimbi. Xhasa i-Comprehensive Infrastructure Plan, ukugcinwa kwamanzi nokuphathwa kwesidingo samanzi, Izinsiza Ezimahhala Eziyisiso, iMunicipal Priority Action Plan, ukuqokwa kwakho nokubuyeza ngokwakho ngamasu ikamasipala kanye nokubika ngomkhakha. Hlanganisa izinsizo zokuhlela namasipala, iminyango yomkhakha, izinhlela zomnyango kanye nabahlinzeki. Lungiselela ingxoxo nezinsizo ze-Annual Performance Plan. Khuthaza ukulandela izimiso, inani lemalu, ukuphepha kanye nenxaxheba kwemvelo. Qondisa abafundi benjiniyela, abafundi abasha kanye nabahlinzeki bobuchwepheshe.

xh.title: Injiniye Yokuvelisa inqanaba A – C
xh.summary: Injiniye Yokuvelisa inqanaba A–C exhasa oolawulo beezenzo zamanzo nge-WSDP, iinkqubo ezilandelelanayo kunye nokuhlola isiseko sezakhiwo; kufuneka kubhaliswe kwi-ECSA njengenjiniye yobuchwepheshe.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-Engineering (B Eng/BSc (Eng) kwi-Civil Engineering. Iyahlu iminyaka elithathu (3) yamava ohlelo lokusebenza emva kwesidanga kwi-civil nakumanzi. Ibalulekile ukubhaliswa koluntu kwiiNjini zeKhabhinethi yaseMzantsi Afrika (ECSA) njengenjiniye yobuchwepheshe. Kufuneka kubhaliswe ilayisenisi yokushayela evumelekileyo engaze ipheliyo njengoko ukutshaya iindawo nokuhamba kuyinxalenye yemisebenzi. Ulwazi olubalulekileyo namava kwicandelo lokuqulunqa amanzi kwimasipala; amacebo abavelisi amanzi (WSDPs), amacebo amakhulu abavelisi amanzi namacebo athembisa iminyaka emihlanu; imfuneko yamanzi, ukulingana, izigcawu ezingazalisekanga, isiseko sezakhiwo, ukusebenza nokuqonda iingozi; iifasakhathi zokuphumeza, amacebo ebhizinisi, ukuqonda iiprojekthi, ukubeka kubaluleko, ukudityaniswa nokulungelelana ukuphumeza. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngomthetho weZiczoo zamanzo, uMthetho weSizwe weManzi, uMthetho weNkqubo yeMasipala namagunya alo ohluma iindawo zeendalo, zezimali zikawonke-wonke, zesixhobo-mali nezabachwephesha. Ukuziphatha kakuhle ekulawulen iinkqubo, iiprojekthi, iinkqubo zovimba, iingozi nezimali; ukubhala iingxelo zobugcisa; ulawulo lweentlangano; kunye neMicrosoft Office. Ava kwi-GIS, ukumodela i-hydraulic kunye nesoftwe yoYilo lweNjiniye kuya kuba luncedo. Iakhono ezomeleleyo zokuhlola, zokuxazulula iingxaki, zokuqulunqa, zokubonisa, zokunceda kunye nokuqhathanisa. Isigqibo esomeleleyo sobuchwephesha, ukusebenza ngokubambisana, ukuzinikela kumthengi, ukuziphathisa ngokuziphendulela nokuziphatha ngokutshanileyo.
xh.duties: Xhasa oolawulo beezenzo zamanzo ukuze balungise, baqonde ngokutsha kabini bahlaziye i-WSDP, amacebo amakhulu abavelisi amanzi, amacebo athembisa iminyaka emihlanu kunye nezongezo zecebo elibambisene lokuPhuhliswa. Hlola iimfuno eziphila namhlanje nangomso, izigcawu ezingazalisekanga, imfuneko yamanzi, ukulingana kwamanzi, amandla esiseko sezakhiwo, imeko nokusebenza, kunye neengozi zokuzelelwa; hlola iinkqubo zokuqulunqa nezokusebenza. Qaphela, yiba kubaluleko udibanise iiprojekthi; qinisekisa ukusondezwa, izifundo ezisebenzayo, amacebo ebhizinisi, iingxelo zobugcisa, ayilo, amaxabiso abakho, iinkqubo, ubhalo lweengozi nolwazi lolungelelwaniso lokuphumeza. Nikeza ixhaso lobugcisa lweeprojekthi-mlawulo kwi-MIG, WSIG, RBIG nayeinye iinkqubo zokunikela imali. Yenza iindwendwe zendawo nophando lobugcisa; qinisekisa inkcazelo yeprojekthi kunye nesesiko sezakhiwa esiqhagamshelweyo. Xhasa iCebo eliqulunqwe ngokupheleleyo leSiseko, ukugcina amanzi nolawulo lwemfuneko yamanzi, Iinkonzo eziNguBheduza Mahlela, iCebo lokuziphendulela lokuqalisa kwakho, ukuZihlola ngokuzimele iNgqungquthela kwiNqanaba iSiseko nokunikwa iingxelo kwicandelo. Lawula idibaniso lokulunga iinkqubo kunye neemasipala, iindawo eziseziko, iinkqubo zesebe kunye nabahanahanisi besebenza. Lungiselela iingxelo ezongezo kwi-Nqanaba loNyaka lokuSebenza. Khuthaza ukuthobela, ixabiso lemali, ukhuseleko nokuqhathamisa iindawo zendalo. Qhweba abakhenkethesi boBunini, abafundi abangenamava kunye nabasebenzi bamalungu obugcisa.

jobs.title: Engineer Production Grade A-C
jobs.salary_text: R914 517 - R1 376 199 per annum, (all-inclusive OSD salary package), (Offer will be based on years of experience)
jobs.summary: Production engineer (Grade A-C) needed at Midmar Dam to plan, design and maintain bulk raw water infrastructure; requires a mechanical engineering degree, ECSA registration and a driver's licence.
jobs.requirements: An Engineer degree (B Eng/BSc Eng) in Mechanical Engineering or relevant engineering qualification. Three (3) years post qualification engineering experience in water infrastructure maintenance. Compulsory Registration with the Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as a Professional Engineer (Pr Eng). The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s licence. Knowledge of project, asset management and financial management principles. Sound understanding of engineering design and analysis. Sound knowledge of integrated water resource management and water resource protection. Understanding of programme and project management. Knowledge of engineering design and analysis including but not limited to pumps and pump stations, dam outlet works mechanical structural designs and Water Resources Infrastructure Operations. Knowledge and understanding of operations and maintenance of bulk raw water infrastructure. Knowledge of Legal compliance, Occupational Health and Safety principles. Understanding of the National Water Act, Water Services Act, Government Immovable Asset Management Act, National Environmental Management Act, Public Service Regulations and Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) Computer literacy with strong technical report writing skills and the ability of exercising professional judgement within the engineering environment. Knowledge of supply chain management processes. Knowledge of contractual and legal requirements. Good communication skills both (verbal and written) and analytical skills. Professional and ethical conduct. Knowledge and understanding of computer- aided engineering applications. Creating a high-performance culture.
jobs.duties: Plan, design, install, operate and maintain bulk raw water infrastructure assets. Manage and co-ordinate all aspects of bulk raw water infrastructure maintenance projects. Develop and implement the short term and long-term infrastructure maintenance plan/program. Guide the project planning, implementation, monitoring, reporting and evaluation in line with project management methodology. Development, interpretation and customization of functional and technical norms and standards from an engineering perspective. Review and compile operations and maintenance manuals/plans for the bulk raw water infrastructure within the Cluster Compile briefing documentation and tender specifications from a technical engineering perspective. Inspect and test mechanical engineering installations and equipment and prepare reports. Undertake and implement corrective measures to ensure operational efficiency and compliance. Oversee implementation and commissioning of mechanical engineering installations on bulk raw water infrastructure. Manage resources and Budget Planning. Develop cost effective solutions according to Standards. Ensure training and development of technicians, technologists and candidate engineers to promote skills/knowledge transfer and adherence to sound engineering principles and code of practice. Office administration and budget planning. Innovative techniques and inputs to water resource development/ operational planning and management. Compulsory and extensive official travelling within the KZN Province and other provinces as and when required.

af.title: Ingenieur Produksie Vlak A-C
af.summary: Produksie-ingenieur (Vlak A-C) by Midmar Dam benodig om massa-ruwaterinfrastruktuur te beplan, te ontwerp en te onderhou; vereis 'n meganiese ingenieursgraad, ECSA-registrasie en 'n bestuurslisensie.
af.requirements: An Ingenieursgraad (B Eng/BSc Eng) in Meganiese Ingenieurswese of 'n relevante ingenieurskwalifikasie. Three (3) jaar post-kwalifikasie ingenieurservaring in waterinfrastruktuuronderhoud. Verpligte Registrasie by die Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as 'n Professionele Ingenieur (Pr Eng). Die openbaarming van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurslisensie. Kennis van projek-, bates- en finansiële bestuursbeginsels. Goed begrip van ingenieursontwerp en -analise. Goeie kennis van geïntegreerde waterhulpbronbestuur en waterhulpbronbeskerming. Begrip van program- en projekbestuur. Kennis van ingenieursontwerp en -analise, insluitend maar nie beperk tot pompe en pompstasies, dam-uitlaatwerke meganiese strukturele ontwerpe en Water Resources Infrastructure Operations. Kennis en begrip van bedryf en onderhoud van massa-ruwaterinfrastruktuur. Kennis van regs nakoming, Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheidsbeginsels. Begrip van die National Water Act, Water Services Act, Government Immovable Asset Management Act, National Environmental Management Act, Public Service Regulations en Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) Rekenaarvaardigheid met sterk tegniese verslag-skryfvaardighede en die vermoë om professionele oordeel binne die ingenieursomgewing uit te oefen. Kennis van voorsieningskettingbestuursprosesse. Kennis van kontraktuele en regsv sejaes. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede beide (mondelings en skriftelik) en analitiese vaardighede. Professionele en etiese gedrag. Kennis en begrip van rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur.
af.duties: Beplan, ontwerp, installeer, bedryf en onderhou massa-ruwaterinfrastruktuurbates. Bestuur en koördineer alle aspekte van massa-ruwaterinfrastruktuuronderhoudsprojekte. Ontwikkel en implementeer die korttermyn- en langtermyn-infrastruktuuronderhoudsplan/program. Lei die projekbeplanning, -implementering, -monitering, -rapportering en -evaluering in ooreenstemming met projekbestuurmetodologie. Ontwikkeling, interpretasie en aanpassing van funksionele en tegniese norme en standaarde vanuit 'n ingenieursperspektief. Hersien en stel bedryfs- en onderhoudsmanuals/planne op vir die massa-ruwaterinfrastruktuur binne die Cluster. Stel voorligtingsdokumentasie en tenderspesifikasies vanuit 'n tegniese ingenieursperspektief op. Inspekteer en toets meganiese ingenieursinstallasies en -toerusting en berei verslae voor. Onderneem en implementeer korrektiewe maatreëls om bedryfseffektiwiteit en nakoming te verseker. Hou toesig oor implementering en inbedryfstelling van meganiese ingenieursinstallasies op massa-ruwaterinfrastruktuur. Bestuur hulpbronne en Begrotingsbeplanning. Ontwikkel kostedoeltreffende oplossings volgens Standaarde. Verseker opleiding en ontwikkeling van tegnici, tegnoloë en kandidaat-ingenieurs om vaardighede/kennisoordrag en nakoming van goeie ingenieursbeginsels en gedragskode te bevorder. Kantooradministrasie en begrotingsbeplanning. Innoverende tegnieke en bydraes tot waterhulpbronontwikkeling/bedryfsbeplanning en -bestuur. Verpligte en uitgebreide amptelike reis binne die KZN Provinsie en ander provinsies soos en wanneer benodig.

zu.title: Injiniyesi Yokukhiqiza Izinga A-C
zu.summary: Kudingeka injiniyesi yokukhiqiza (Izinga A-C) e-Midmar Dam ukuze uhlele, udize futhi ugcothe izakhiwo ezinkulu zamanzi angahluziwe; kudinga iziqu zobunjiniyela zensimbi, ukubhalisa kwi-ECSA nelayisensi yokushayela.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Injiniyesi (B Eng/BSc Eng) eZobunjiniyela Bensimbi noma iziqu ezihambisanayo zobunjiniyela. Unyaka omithathu (3) weminyaka yokuhlangabezana nezidingo kemisebenzi yobunjiniyela egcotsheni kwezakhiwo zamanzi. Ukubhalisa ngokuphoqelele ku-Komidi Leliqiniso Lobunjiniyela eNingizimu Afrika (ECSA) njengenjiniyesi ekhethekile (Pr Eng). Ukwembula i-licence evumelekileyoengakapheli yesikhathi yokushayela. Ulwazi ngemigomo yokuphatha amaprojekthi, iphathi kwamafa nobuhlengi. Ukuqonda kahle ukudiza nokuhlaziya kobunjiniyela. Ulwazi oluhle ngokuphathwa kwamafa amanzi ahlangene nokuvikelwa kwamafa amanzi. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwenkqubu kanye namaprojekthi. Ulwazi ngokudiza nokuhlaziya kobunjiniyela okuhlanganisa kodwa okungagcini lapha kuma-pumpi kanye nesisindo sama-pumpi, imisebenzi yokukhishwa kwamanzi edamu ukudiza kobunjiniyela bokwesakhiwo kanye noKusebenza Kwamafa Amanzi. Ulwazi kanye nookuqonda ukusebenza nokugcotsha izakhiwo ezinkulu zamanzi angahluziwe. Ulwazi ngokuqathaniswa kwemithetho, imigomo ye-Vuselelo Lomzimba kanye Nekusulelwa Kwezempilo Nokuphepha. Ukuqonda i-National Water Act, Water Services Act, Government Immovable Asset Management Act, National Environmental Management Act, Public Service Regulations and Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Ukusebenzisana ikhompyutha ngamakhono obuhlakani bokubhala imibiko nobukhono bokuphethe ukwahlulela ngobunjiniyela. Ulwazi ngokuhlatshwa kwamashidi womnikelo. Ulwazi ngemithetho futhi ngemithetho yezinkinga. Amakhono okuxhumisana omuhle (ngokukhulunywa nokubhaliwaye) namakhono okuhlaziya. Ukuziphatha ngobungcweti nangesoqotho. Ulwazi kanye no ukuqonda ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokwemukela ikhompyutha zobunjiniyela. Ukudala inkambiso yokusebenza ngemizinga ephezulu.
zu.duties: Cela, diza, faka, sebenzisa futhi gcotsha amafa esakhiwo amanzi amakhulu angahluziwe. Phatha futhi uhlobo zonke izici zophathi lwezakhiwo amanzi amakhulu angahluziwe. Bumba futhi ufake uhlelo/inkqubo yokugcoca izakhiwo kumashamu amafushane namade kube phakathi kwaye nangeminyaka. Hola inkqubo yokuphatha, ukuphatha, ukwelulekwa nokuhlolwa kweprojekthi ngokuhambisana nendlela yokuphatha amaprojekthi. Ukuthuthukisa, ukuthiya kwaye ekuqondiseni ukwakheka kwemigomo yemisebenzi nobuchwepheshe ngokusuka kubuqlqobunjiniyela. Phinda ubhale futhi uhlanganise imanuali/izinkqubo zokusebenza nokugcota ngesakhiwo samanzi amakhulu angahluziwe eduze kweqela. Bhala imibhikhi wezinkomba futhi izintjhebha zokuthengisa ngokusuka ebukhulu bobunjiniyela obusemthethweni. Hlola futhi uvivithe ukufakwa kwensimbi yobunjiniyela namaphuzu futhi ulungiselela imibiko. Thatha futhi ufake izinyathelo zokuqondisa ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza okuhle kweqiniso kwaye ngokusuka emthethweni. Qaphela ukufakwa kwaye ukubhalisa ukufakwa kwobunjiniyela bensimbi ezakhiweni zezinkulungwane zamafi amakhulu angahluziwe. Phatha amafa kanye nohlelo lwesabelo. Bumba izixazululo ezibiza kakhulu ngokwezinga. Qinisekisa ukulolwa nokuthuthukiswa kobuchwepheshe, ochwepheshe bezobunjiniyela namaqanda okwaba ngendlela yokuthuthukisa ulwazi/ukudlulisa amakhono kwaye ekuvumelaneni nobunjiniyela ngokwemigomo nangokuhamba kwemikhuba. Uphathe ibhuloho kwezinsizakusebenza futhi ucabange isabelo. Izindlela ezintsha nobunikelo ekwakheni amafi amanzi/ukuhlela ukusebenza nokuphatha. Ukuhamba okuphoqelekile futhi okubanzi ngokusemthethweni ngaphakathi KwaZulu-Natal Province kwaye eminye imigangatho njengoba nangasikhathi sindingeke.

xh.title: InjiniyezokuQamba umQobo inqanaba A-C
xh.summary: Kufuneka injiniyezokuQamba umQobo (Inqanaba A-C) kwi-Midmar Dam ukuya kucwangcisa, kuyila kunye nokugcina iziseko zolwazi olubzekiyo ngokubanzi; kufuneka kubekho degree yobunjiniyela bendalo, ukuqatshelwa kwi-ECSA kunye nelayisensi yokushuka.
xh.requirements: Degree yobunjiniyela (B Eng/BSc Eng) kwi-Mechanical Engineering okanye isiqinisekiso sobunjiniyela esifanelekileyo. Iminyaka emithathu (3) yokuguquguquka kwamava obunjiniyela emva kokuqatshelwa ekugcineni iziseko zolwazi. Ukuqatshelwa ngokunyanzelekileyo kwi-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengobe nguProfessional Engineer (Pr Eng). Ukubhengeza ilayisensi yokushuka esebenzayo engagqitywanga. Ulwazi lwezixhobo ezikwisixhobo, eziphathwayo kunye nemigaqo yolawulo lwezemali. Ukuqonda kakuhle ukuyila nokuhlalutya kobunjiniyela. Ulwazi olululo ngokulawulwa kwexabiso lolwazi ngokuhlangeneyo nokukhuselwa kolwazi. Ukuqonda ukulawula iinkqubo nezixhobo. Ulwazi lokuyila nokuhlalutya kobunjiniyela kuquka kodwa kungadingekiyo kuphela iipampu nendawo yeepampu, imisebenzi yokuphuma kwamadam ayilwe ngokwendalo yamandla kunye noLawulo lweZiseko zeZixhobo zoLwazi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukusebenza nokugcina iziseko zolwazi olubzekiyo ngokubanzi. Ulwazi lokuzeleleko ngokomthetho, nemigaqo yeMpiqondelo yokuSinwa kweMfihlo neMpezulu. Ukuqonda i-National Water Act, Water Services Act, Government Immovable Asset Management Act, National Environmental Management Act, Public Service Regulations kunye ne-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokubhalwa kweendaba ezinamandla obuchwepheshe kunye nokuqonda ukusebenzisa isigqibo sokuchwephesha kwendawo yobunjiniyela. Ulwazi lweendlela zolawulo lweqela lezixhobo ezithunyelwayo. Ulwazi lweemfuno zomthetho kunye nezeqela. Amakhono mahle okunxibelelwano (ngomlomo nokubhalwe) kunye namakhono ukuhlalutya. Ukuziphatha ngokuchanekileyo nangokungenamthetho. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukusetyenziswa kwezicelo zobunjiniyela ezenziwa ngekhompyutha. Ukudala inkqubo yokusebenza ngamandla amakhulu.
xh.duties: Cwangcisa, yila, faka, sebenza ugcine iziseko zolwazi olubzekiyo ngokubanzi. Lawula uhambelise zonke iindawo zeeprojekthi zokugcina iziseko zolwazi olubzekiyo ngokubanzi. Yaza uze ucacise inkqubo yexesha elifutshane kunye nelifutshane elide lokugcina iziseko. Qondisa ucwangciso lwenkqubo, ukuyisebenzisa, ukulawula, ukubika nokuhlolwa ngokwemigaqo yolawulo lwenkqubo. Ukuqamba, ukucazulula nokwenza ngokwezifundo iimfuno namagunya obunjiniyela. Phinda uhlole uze uqokelele iinkqubo zokusebenza nokuqokeleela iindlela zokugcina iziseko zolwazi ngokubanzi ngaphakathi kweqela. Qamba uze uqokelele iinkcukacha zokubhaliweyo kunye neendawo ezichaziweyo ezithengiswa ngokuchwepheshe. Hlola uze uvavanye ukufakwa kweenkqubo zokusebenza zobunjiniyela bendalo uze ulungise iindaba. Thatha uze usebenzise iindlela zokuqamba ukuze uqinisekise ukusebenza kakuhle nokuzeleleko. Lawula ukusebenzisa nokugqiba ukufakwa kweenkqubo zobunjiniyela kumasini. Lawula iziseko neCwangciso leSabelo seMali. Qamba iindlela ezilungele ixabiso ngokwemigaqo. Qinisekisa ukuqeqeshwa nokuqeqeswa kwabaqambi bobuchwepheshe, abaqambi bobuchwephesha kunye neenjiniyela zangaphambi komgangatho ukukhuthaza ukudluliselwa kolwazi/phando kunye nokuzinikela ngokwezimvo zobunjiniyela ezilungele. Ulawulo lwehhofisi nokuqokeleela sabelo. Iindlela ezintsha nokuqokeleela ukuthuthwa kolwazi ucwangciso lokusebenza ngokwamanzi. Ukuhamba ngokunyanzelekileyo kunye nobubanzi ngokusemthethweni ngaphakathi kwi-KZN Province kunye namanye amaphondo njengoko kufuneka.

af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma in Meganiese/Skeikundige Ingenieurswese. Ses (6) jaar na-kwalifikasie tegniese ingenieurswese toesigervaring in water- of sanitasieverwante infrastruktuur. zu.title: Ithini Yobuchwepheshe Bolawulo Ezingeni le-A
zu.summary: I-Department of Water and Sanitation ifuna Ithini Yobuchwepheshe Bolawulo yokuphatha imikhalulo nezinhlelo zemisebenzi yemiyalo yamanzi nokuhlanzwa kwezindleko e-Mbombela.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma e-Mechanical/Chemical Engineering. Emva kokuqeqeshwa, minyaka yisithupha (6) emisebenzini yobuchwepheshe bokulawula emkhakheni wamanzi noma okuhlobene nokuhlanzwa kwezindleko. Ukubhalisa ngokuyisimo esiphothule ku-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengoba Ithini Yobuchwepheshe Buchwepheshe. Ukwethula ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile ngaqothuki. Ukwazi ngemithetho yamanzi namapholisi ahlobene nayo. Ukubekezela kakhulu kwezinhlelo zekhompyutha, ikakhulukazi i-MS Office Software (Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint). Amakhono alungiselela futhi ahlele kahle. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuxhumana angcono, kokubili (okukhulunywayo nokuqoshiwe). Amakhono okuxazulula izingxabano. Izinhlobonhlobo zabantu, ukuphatha amaphrogremu namaphrojekthi.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha imiyalo yamanzi nokuhlanzwa kwezindleko kanye namaphrogremu. Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi okuthuthukiswa kwemiyalo axhaswa ngemiyalo yokuthuthukiswa-RBIG kanye ne-WSIG. Ukunikeza izinsiza zokwesekwa ekusebenzeni kwamaphrojekthi kuma-Water Services Authorities (WSAs). Ukunikeza izinsiza zokwesekwa kobuchwepheshe. Ukunikeza futhi ukuhlanganisa okufakwe ohlelweni olusebenzayo lwobuchwepheshe/injini. Kuqiniseke ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa kanye nokugcinwa kophu lwemininingwane. Ukuphatha, ukulawula futhi ulawule abantu abahlobene nobuchwepheshe nemibhalo. Ukuhlanganyela nabaholi/amacala ahlobene emashishini obuchwepheshe.

Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava ekulawulweni koVimba wabantu/nasekuqhubeni koVimba wabantu (egxile ekuqhubeni koVimba wabantu, inkqubo yokuLawula ukuSebenza (PMDS), uQeqesho lwezakhono, iindlela zoQeqesho lweNdawo yoSebenza (WSP), iiNkqubo zoQeqesho). Ukuqhuba iinkqubo zoqeqesho zesebe: ukubakhetha bencwadi yendlela yokwaziswa/ngokujonga iindawo ezizezobugcisa ezenzakalayo, ukukhokela iinkqubo zoQeqesho lwokuFunda iintsapho ezinkulu, ukukhetha iindawo zoqeqesho, ulawulo lweNkqubo yeBhasari yesebe. Ukulawula uVimba wabantu: ukuqulunqisa, ukukhokela nokulungelelanisa imisebenzi yecandelo, ukulawula ukusebenza nokuphuhliswa kwabasebenzi, ukuhamba nabantu abanikezelwe imisebenze nokujonga intshukela yabo, ukuqinisekisa ulandelo ngemigaqo ye-HR, okunikelweyo nangemithetho ekhoyo, ukukhokela ulwazi nokuqhagamshelana kwicandelo nakumanye amaqela abalawuzayo, ukulawula iNdlela yoMsebenzi yeNqanaba eliPhantsi, isabelo kunye namacebo esebenze.

Berei visuele toerusting voor. Verseker dat water en ander versterkings tydens vergaderings beskikbaar is. Verseker dat koerierpakkies oopgemaak en aan relevante amptenare versprei word. Verseker dat die registerkantoor netjies gehou word en lêers aan verskeie amptenare wat dit benodig, versprei word. Monitor die korrespondensie wat aan verskeie amptenare versprei word. Ukuhlinzeka ngama-akhawuntu futhi ukuziphatha ngendlela ehloniphekile.

Setshenzisa izinqubomgomo zokulawula nemikhakha ehlukene. Phakamisa ukulungiswa kwezinqubomgomo. Yizinkomba ezidlula indawo onke ixoxa nomnyango ngemigqwenzana ephathelene nezinqubomgomo. Dweba abaphathi ngemigomo ephathelene nezinqubomgomo. Nikeza inceku ekulawulweni kwezinkontilakthi. Qinisekisa ukuthi imigomo yokuhlose isetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Bheka ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo. Qinisekisa ukuthi izigodi zokuxoxa zihlale zicocekile ukuba zisetshenziselwe ukuhlangana. Qinisekisa ukuthi amawofisi namapuleti acocekile. Qinisekisa ukuthi i-ofisi yokulondoloza amafayela igcinwe kahle futhi amafayela anikwe abasebenzi abahlukene abawadingayo. Bheka incwadi ehlukene enikwe abasebenzi abahlukene. Ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo. Hlaziya imigqa ephathelene nokuqhuba abantu. Nikeza inceku ngokulungiswa kwezinqubomgomo. Bheka ukuchithwa kwemali kulelo qembu. Yenza izinhlelo zexesha elide. jobs.title: Senior Occupational Health and Safety Officer
jobs.summary: Senior Occupational Health and Safety Officer based at the Hartbeespoort Cluster Office, providing OHS support and monitoring for the Department of Water and Sanitation.
jobs.requirements: A relevant NQF level 6 qualification in Occupational Health and Safety. Minimum Three (3) to four (4) years’ experience in Occupational Health and Safety environment. The disclosure of valid unexpired driver’s license (Annotate such details on the CV). Knowledge of strategic and operational plan in Occupational Health and Safety Management. OHS Policy implementation. Monitoring and evaluation principles. Knowledge of research procedures and techniques. knowledge in Occupational Health and Safety and its application within the Operations and Maintenance (O&M) environment. Disciplinary knowledge in public administration. Knowledge of health and safety management systems design, techniques and tools. Ability to write, review and proof-read OHS reports. Understanding of Government legislation. Knowledge of OHS Act and Regulations (Act 85 of 1993). Knowledge of the risk management theory and practical auditor’s assessment. Computer literacy skills. Good written and verbal communication skills. Have experience related to Safety management within the Operations and Maintenance environment. Having any professional registration associated with Occupational Health and Safety will be an added advantage. Willing to travel extensively and work irregular hours.
jobs.duties: To be based at the Technical Services Sub-Directorate at the Northern Operations Cluster Office, reporting directly to the sub-directorate Head: Technical Services, and provide Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) support, coordination, monitoring and assurance to the Hartbeespoort, Groblersdal and Tzaneen Area Offices. Coordinate and support the implementation of the Occupational Health and Safety Act, Regulations and applicable DWS OHS policies, procedures and standards. Develop and maintain SHE/OHS management systems, procedures and programmes. Coordinate the implementation of Hazard Identification and Risk Assessments and monitor the effectiveness of risk-control measures. Conduct regular OHS inspections and compliance assessments at DWS operational facilities, including dams, pump stations, canals, workshops, construction sites and other workplaces. Investigate OHS incidents, accidents and near misses, conduct root-cause analysis and monitor the implementation and closure of corrective and preventative actions. Coordinate statutory reporting of reportable incidents and manage COIDA-related processes. Interpret and coordinate the implementation of recommendations arising from internal and external audits, inspections and compliance assessments. Monitor OHS compliance of contractors and service providers and provide technical advice to managers, supervisors, employees and OHS representatives. Compile monthly, quarterly and annual OHS performance reports, including incidents, injuries, fatalities, near misses, risks, trends and corrective actions in accordance with the approved reporting matrix. Coordinate emergency preparedness, fire safety programmes, emergency procedures and drills, and liaise with relevant emergency services and regulatory bodies. Develop and facilitate OHS awareness, training, workshops and safety promotion programmes. Provide OHS input into maintenance procedures, safe systems of work and operational practices to promote the application of best practices. Assist with the planning and management of the OHS budget and resources. Maintain appropriate OHS records, registers and compliance documentation. Promote a positive safety culture, employee participation, innovation and continuous improvement, including initiatives for reporting hazards, near misses and safety improvement suggestions. Provide specialist OHS advice and regular performance feedback to the Head: Technical Services and relevant management structures and provide technical input into the strategic and operational planning of the OHS function.
