af.title: Senior Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheidsbeampte
af.summary: Senior Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheidsbeampte gebaseer by die Hartbeespoort Cluster Office, wat BGV-ondersteuning en monitering vir die Department of Water and Sanitation verskaf.
af.requirements: 'n Tersaaklike NQF vlak 6-kwalifikasie in Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid. Minimum Drie (3) tot vier (4) jaar se ondervinding in 'n Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid-omgewing. Bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie (aanmerk sulke besonderhede op die CV). Kennis van strategiese en operasionele plan in Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheidsbestuur. BGV-beleidsimplementering. Monitering en evalueringsbeginsels. Kennis van navorsingsprosedures en -tegnieke. Kennis van Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid en die toepassing daarvan binne die Operasionele en Onderhouds (O&O)-omgewing. Dissiplinaire kennis in openbare administrasie. Kennis van ontwerp, tegnieke en instrumente van gesondheids- en veiligheidsbestuurstelsels. Vermoë om BGV-verslae te skryf, te hersien en te proeflees. Begrip van regeringswetgewing. Kennis van die BGV-wet en Regulasies (Wet 85 van 1993). Kennis van risikobestuursteorie en praktiese ouditeurs-assessering. Rekenvaardigheidsvaardighede. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Het ondervinding wat verband hou met veiligheidsbestuur binne die Operasionele en Onderhouds-omgewing. Enige professionele registrasie wat met Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid geassosieer word, sal 'n voordeel wees. Bereid om uitgebreid te reis en onreëlmatige ure te werk.
af.duties: Om gevestig te wees by die Tegniese Dienste Sub-direktoraat by die Northern Operations Cluster Office, wat direk verslag doen aan die sub-direktoraat Hoof: Tegniese Dienste, en om Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid (BGV) ondersteuning, koördinering, monitering en versekering te verskaf aan die Hartbeespoort, Groblersdal en Tzaneen Area Offices. Koördineer en ondersteun die implementering van die Occupational Health and Safety Act, Regulasies en toepaslike DWS BGV-beleide, prosedures en standaarde. Ontwikkel en handhaaf SGO/BGV bestuurstelsels, prosedures en programme. Koördineer die implementering van Gevaaridentifisering en Risiko-assessering en monitor die doeltreffendheid van risikobeheermaatreëls. Voer gereelde BGV-inspeksies en nakoming-assessering uit by DWS operasionele fasiliteite, insluitend damme, pompstasies, kanale, werkswinkels, konstruksieterreine en ander werkplekke. Ondersoek BGV-voorvalle, ongelukke en amptelike mislukkings, voer oorsaak-analise uit en monitor die implementering en afsluiting van korrektiewe en voorkomende maatreëls. Koördineer statutêre verslagdoening van rapporteerbare voorvalle en bestuur COIDA-verwante prosesse. Interpreteer en koördineer die implementering van aanbevelings wat voortspruit uit interne en eksterne oudite, inspeksies en nakoming-assessering. Monitor BGV-nakoming van kontraktuers en diensverskaffers en verskaf tegniese advies aan bestuurders, toesighouers, werknemers en BGV-verteenwoordigers. Stel maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse BGV-prestasieverslae op, insluitend voorvalle, beserings, sterftes, amptelike mislukkings, risiko's, tendense en korrektiewe maatreëls in ooreenstemming met die goedgekeurde verslagdoeningsmatriks. Koördineer noodgereedheid, brandsveiligheidsprogramme, noodprosedures en oefeninge, en skakel met tersaaklike nooddiens en regulatoriese liggame. Ontwikkel en fasiliteer BGV-bewustheid, opleiding, werkswinkels en veiligheidsbevorderingsprogramme. Verskaf BGV-insette tot onderhoudsprosedures, veilige werkstelsels en operasionele praktyke om die toepassing van beste praktyke te bevorder. Help met die beplanning en bestuur van die BGV-begroting en hulpbronne. Handhaaf toepaslike BGV-rekords, registers en nakomingsdokumentasie. Bevorder 'n positiewe veiligheidskultuur, werknemerdeelname, innovasie en deurlopende verbetering, insluitend inisiatiewe vir die rapportering van gevaare, amptelike mislukkings en voorstelle vir veiligheidsverbetering. Verskaf spesialistiese BGV-advies en gereelde prestasieterugvoer aan die Hoof: Tegniese Dienste en tersaaklike bestuursstrukture en verskaf tegniese insette tot die strategiese en operasionele beplanning van die BGV-funksie.

zu.title: Umphathi Ophakemei Wezokuphepha Kwezempilo Nomsebenzi
zu.summary: Umphathi Ophakemei Wezokuphepha Kwezempilo Nomsebenzi osekela eHartbeespoort Cluster Office, ethi nika inkxaso yezokuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi futhi iyalalela kuDepartment of Water and Sanitation.
zu.requirements: Ithifikasi elifanele leNQF level 6 ezokuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi. Okungenani uhlelo lweminyaka elinguThree (3) kuye kwayengu-four (4) lokusebenza emhlabeni wokuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi. Ukwembula ilayisense yokushayela esevikile nangekasho (ibhale le mininingwane kwi-CV). ulwazi lweplani ebuso kanye neyokusebenza ekuphatweni kokuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi. ukuqaliswa kwenkambiso yezokuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi. imigomo yokuqapha kanye neyosetenziswa. ulwazi lwenqubo kanye namasu okucwaninga. ulwazi ngokuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi nokusetshenziswa kwalo emhlabeni we-Operations and Maintenance (O&M). ulwazi lwebanga lokuphatha emphakathini. ulwazi lwezilungiselelo zokuphatha ukuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi, ukwakheka, amasu namathuluzi. ikono lokubhala, ukuhlola futhi ukuqagela imibhalo yezokuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi. ukuqonda ukumiswa komthetho kahulumeni. ulwazi lwe-OHS Act and Regulations (Act 85 of 1993). ulwazi loyini lokuqamba inqubo yokuphatha ubungozi kanye nehlola isibindi sikahloli. ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. amakhono okuxhumana ngokubhaliwe nangokukhulunywa. okube unrund oluqondene nokuphatha ukuphepha emhlabeni we-Operations and Maintenance. ukuba noma yikuphi ukubhaliswa okusebenza ngaphansi kwesifundo sezokuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi kuzoba ngumusa. ukuthanda ukuhamba kakhulu futhi usebenze amahora angajwayelekile.
zu.duties: Uzakuba sekwa-Technical Services Sub-Directorate eNothern Operations Cluster Office, abika ngokuqondile kuwo oyinhloko wesifunda: Technical Services, futhi anike inkxaso yokuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi (OHS), ukuhlanganisa, ukuqapha kanye nokuqinisekisa kumasevisi eHartbeespoort, Groblersdal neTzaneen Area Offices. ahlanganise futhi asize ukuqaliswa kwe-Occupational Health and Safety Act, Regulations kanye nemigomo, inqubo kanye nemigomo nemiqondo ye-DWS OHS. aakhe futhi agcine izilungiselelo, izinqubo kanye namaprograms we-SHE/OHS. ahlanganise ukuqaliswa kokubona ingozi nokuhlolwa kubungozi futhi alalele ukusebenza kwemigomo yokulawula ubungozi. enze ukuhlolwa ngamahora okuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi kanye nehlola ukuziphendulela emakade wokusebenza e-DWS, okuhlanganisa izibhelu, iziteshi zokupompa, amakhwalakwala, amawokshophu, izindawo zokwakhiwa kanye nezinye izindawo zokusebenza. phenya ngemikhubakubungozi kwizokuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi, izehlo kanye naseminceminceni, enze ukuhlaziywa komzimba wembangela futhi alalele ukuqaliswa kanye nokunqamula ukwenziwa kwezinyatholo zokulungisa nokuqopha. ahlanganise ukubika komthetho ngemikhuba yezehlo ezibikwayo futhi aphathe izinqubo ezihlobene ne-COIDA. hicaphice futhi ahlanganise ukuqaliswa kwezincomo ezivela kohlolo bangaphakathi nangaphandle, ukuhlola kanye nehlola ukuziphendulela. alalele ukuziphendulela kokuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi kwabatheni kanye nabahlinzeki futhi anike izeluleko zobuchwepheshe kubaphathi, abahloli, abasebenzi kanye nabamele izokuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi. qoqa imibalo yokuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi yamanyanga yonke, yenyanga ezintathu kanye neminyaka yonke, okuhlanganisa imikhubakubungozi, izilimele, ukushona, iminceminche, ubungozi, umgwaqo kanye nezinyatholo zokulungisa ngokuvumelana nomlando wokubika ovunyiwe. ahlanganise ukulungelelwa yisimo esiphuthumayo, amaprograms okuphepha komlilo, izinqubo zesimo esiphuthumayo kanye nokuqeqesha, futhi axhumane namasevisi ahlobene nesimo esiphuthumayo namasiko alawula. aakhe futhi aqeqeshe ukwaziswa ngokuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi, ukuqeqesha, amawokshophu kanye namaprograms okukhuthaza ukuphepha. anike imibono yokuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi ezinqdobenwini zokulungisa, izilungiselelo zokusebenza okuphepha kanye namaphiliso okusebenza ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwezinto ezinhle kakhulu. asize ngohlelo kanye nokuphatha ibhajethi kanye namathuluzi okuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi. gcina ukurekhoda okufanele, izibalo kanye nomlando wokuzebunyulu kokuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi. khuthaza isiko elihle lokuphepha, ukubamba iqhaza kwabasebenzi, ukwakhiwa okusha kanye nokuthuthukiswa ngokuqhubekayo, okuhlanganisa izinkomba zokubika ubungozi, iminceminche kanye nezinkomba zokuphucula ukuphepha. nikeza izeluleko zobuchwepheshe ngokuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi kanye nokuqondisa ngokusebenza njalo kuye kuHead: Technical Services kanye nosezinye izakhiwo zokuphatha, futhi anike imibono yobuchwepheshekuhlelo obusabusa kanye nokusebenza komsebenzi wokuphepha kwezempilo nomsebenzi.

Lungiselela wanike inkxaso ekusebenziseni umthetho weMisebenzi yoMpilo noKhuseleko, iimiso kunye namacebo alo kunye namapolisi, iinqqubo neemiqulubo ze DWS OHS. Lungiselela ukusebenziswa kokuqamba iingozi kunye nokulinganisa iingcipho zeengozi uze uqwalasele ukusebenza kwemiilinganiselo yokulawula iingcipho. Yenze ukutya okuthe ngqindilva kwe khololo ye OHS kunye nokuqwalaselwa kokuhanahaniso kwi ndawo zokusebenza ze DWS, kuquka imiba zamantshontsho, iindawo zokupompa, izithuba, amakhemikhali, iindawo zokwakhiwa kunye namanye amabala okusebenza. Ukuba ngaphakathi kwiindawo ezikhuselwayo ezinobungcali (professional bodies).

af.summary: Senior Human Resource Practitioner-posisie binne die Department of Water and Sanitation, met die fokus op toesig oor pensioenadministrasie en bestuur van HR-databasisse in Gauteng.

zu.requirements: Izifundo ezihambisanayo ezinga le-NQF (National Diploma) ezinkombweni zokuphathwa kwamabungu ezingeni le-NQF level 6. Uhambo lweminyaka emithathu (3) lokusebenza enkombeni yokuphathwa kwamabungu. Uhambo lwonyaka owodwa (1) kuya kwabayiwe (2) olusebenzayo ekuhloleni izindinganiso ezingeni eliphezulu emsebenzini wokuphathwa kwamabungu kuzoba yindlela ebangela ukuthi kube nokuba muva ekugcineni. Ukuzivumela ngenkambo yokuqinisekisa ukuphila okuhle kwezimali ezisebenzayo ngokusemthethweni. Ulwazi olujulile kanye noqondwelo lomsebenzi kahulumeni, isivumelwano sehlanga kanye nomthetho ohlobene nalawo. Abafaka izicelo kumele babe namathifikheithi e-PERSAL kanye nolwazi lwemisebenzi ehlezi isisekelo sedatha yamabungu esibhekene namaphoyisa aqinisekiswe kahle ngohlelo i-PERSAL. Ulwazi olubalulekile nganoma yimiphi imikhakha yomsebenzi nokuba nolwazi olubalulekile ngolimi olufundwayo nolubhaliwayo. Ulwazi kanye nolwazi ngokubumbwa, ukukhethwa kanye nokumiswa kwabasebenzi. Ulwazi ngemikhuba yomsebenzi yokumiswa kwabantu abavela kwamanye amanye amathemu, ukuphathwa kwamalungu e-OSD, kanye nezinkinga eziphathelene nemiqondo yomsebenzi, okungukuthwa, ukuphumula kwamaphoyisa, izibonezo ezithuthukisayo nokuba namalungelo emvula. Ulwazi olubalulekile lokusebenza e-OSD. Ukusebenza ngaphansi kwesigcushwa. Ukusebenzisana nemiyalo yohlelo.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola indima yokuphathwa kwezimali zabantu abasebenza emaphoyisa, ukuphatha imithetho kanye nezindlela zomsebenzi ohlezi esibhekene namaphoyisa, kanye nokugcina imininingo engezwa ngemisebenzi yokuphathwa kwesimali sabantu eku-Pension Administration ekuqinisekisiwe ngosuku. Ukuqinisekisa imininingo egcinwayo ephathelene nomthetho ohlezi kanye nezinkinga zomsebenzi. Ukugcina imininingo egcinwayo ehlobene nobuchwepheshe besimali sabantu. Ukubamba iqhaza ekuphathweni kokuqinisekiswa kwamaselula, izinkambiso kanye nemikhakha yomsebenzi. Ukunika izeluleko ekuhloleni ukuphumelela komsebenzi wamaphoyisa abantu abasemaphoyisa kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwemisebenzi yamaphoyisa. Ukusebenzisana nazinyathelo zomsebenzi wokuphumelela kwezimali zabantu ekuqinisekisiwe ngenhlangano yokuqala ukwenza imisebenzi. Ukubeka iqhaza kwindima yokwenza imisebenzi yamaphoyisa ezinkambiseni ezihlukene kanye noqeqesho lwamaphoyisa abantu abakuqinisekisiwe ngenhlangano ekuphumeleleni imisebenzi yamaphoyisa. Ukusebenza ngokuqinisekiswa kwemisebenzi ekhuluma ngokuqinisekiswa kwabasebenzi eseqophelweni elikhulu. Ukuxhumana ne-National Treasury kanye no-Compensation Commissioner, ukuhlola kanye nokuhlaziya yonke imisebenzi ekhuluma ngokutholakala kwezimali zabantu, ukuphathwa kwezinto ezithinteka kumaphoyisa nokunika abantu abasemaphoyisa izinga eliphezulu. Ukuphumelela imisebenzi yokuphumelela kwabantu ekuqinisekisweni kwesikhathi eside esihamba phambili. Ukulungiselela imininingwane eminingi (uhlu olude), amakhasi okubala kanye nezicelo ezivela esixazululweni se-Z83. Ukunika izibalo ngokuqinisekiswa kwamalungelo abantu. Ukuphumelela emsebenzini wokuqinisekiswa kwabantu kumaphoyisa. Ukulungiselela izicelo zokuphumelela kwabantu kumaphoyisa kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwesikhathi eside. Ukufaka kanye nokugcina imininingwane eminingi yonke imisebenzi ekhuluma ngamaphoyisa.

xh.title: Oseqela kuMmanga wokuZiinkcukacha zoBantu
xh.summary: Isithuba sokuba nguOseqela kuMmanga wokuZiinkcukacha zoBantu kwiSebe lezaManzi nokuThwala kuni, ngeniso lenkqubo yolawulo lweelayisense namaphuphu kwiGauteng.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso esifanelekileyo sikaNQF ngeNqanaba leDiploma yeliZwe kwakuNqamlwa kwamaphuphu eBantu siseNqanaba le-6 leNQF. Amava eminyaka emithathu (3) kwinkundla yoLawulo lwaManqina aBantu. Amava emnyaka om (1) ukuya kweminyaka mibini (2) ekulawuleni abantu abancedo kwiLawulo lwaManqina aBantu kuya kuba yinyezakalo ekhoyo. Ukubonisa ilayisenisi yokushwela efanelekileyo ebigqityiweyo. Ukuqonda kakuhle nokuva ngoncwadi lwenceba ka rhulumende, isivumelwano sababini nolunye ulwimilongolo oluqhagamshelanayo. Abafaka isicelo kufuneka baneZiqinisekiso zePERSAL babe namava okusebenzisa inkqubo yePERSAL. Amakhono amabini alulwimi ekubhaleni nakuthetheni. Ulwazi namava ekubizweni, ekukhetheni ekubekeni abantu. Amava ekubekeni abantu ngendlela yeOSD, urhwebo lwamaphuphu kunye nemiba yemimiselo yomsebenzi, oko kukuthi iNkunzi, iMali yamakhaya, iNgqungqutsha ngenkululeko eBekelweyo, ukuValelwa ngokugula (PILIR), iNkriza yokubekwa, kwaye nolumke lwamaphuphu alo. Ukuqonda kakuhle nokuva kwiOSD. Ukusebenza ngapantsi kwingcinezelo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Ukulawula inkqubo yokuphathwa kwamaphuphu, ukuQhagamshela kolwimilongolo lweGEPF nendlela, ukuqinisekisa amatyala amaphuphu kwinkqubo yePCM. UkuGcina ibhanki-datha malunga nemiba ekubangelwa sisimilo somsebenzi. UkuGcina ibhanki-datha ezaneleyo ezidityaniswa noLawulo lwaBantu. UkuQhuba nokuthengisa iNgqungqutsha zamaphuphu, iindlela zamaphuphu, iNgqungqutsha nemigaqo ekubangelwa yinkqubo yokuLawula oBantu. UkuNika inkonzo yoBulumko kubo bonke basebenzi besithili, kulawulo nakulawulo oluphezulu. UkuQhagamshelana neQhina leSizwe noMlawuli woMvuzo, ukuQaphela nokuQonda ngokulinganisa yonke imigca yolawulo lweMigqabiso yoBantu, ukulawula, ukuQeqesha nokwakhisa abasebenzi. UkuQhagamshela inkqubo yokuBiza nokuKhetha abantu. UkuLungiselela izifanekiso ezineenkcukacha (uludwe olude), amaphepha ooponti neze nfakeni ezivela kwinkqubo yeZ83. UkuNika izibalo malunga nolungelelwaniso lomsebenzi. UkuQhagamshela iinkqubo zokuLudwa nokuTyhila. UkuPhepha iNgeniso yokubekwa ukuze ithunyelwe kwiNkriza yokuvunywa. UkuTsala kuvume iMigqabiso yeBantu kwinkqubo yePERSAL.

jobs.title: Senior State Accountant: Financial Accounting
jobs.summary: Senior State Accountant role in Gqeberha handling financial accounting, creditor reconciliations, payroll management and SAP/PERSAL payments for the Department of Water and Sanitation.
jobs.requirements: A relevant NQF level 6 qualification (National Diploma) in Financial Management or any related qualification in the field. Three (3) to four (4) years’ experience in finance. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Knowledge of SAP and PERSAL system. Knowledge and understanding of financial legislation, policies, practices, and procedures. Knowledge and understanding of financial prescripts such as the PFMA, Treasury Regulations, and the Division of Revenue Act (DORA). Knowledge of application of International Financial Reporting Standards applicable to expenditure management, generally recognized accounting practice, public service anti- corruption, Strategy, fraud, and prevention. Knowledge of equal opportunities and affirmative action guidelines, and laws. Knowledge of administrative, clerical procedures, and systems. Knowledge and understanding of departmental policies and procedures. Provide a framework for managing performance information. Knowledge of implementing policies of PMDS. Problem-solving and analysis. People and diversity management. Client orientation and customer focus. Good communication skills both (verbal and written). Accountability and ethical conduct. Be able to work Independently.
jobs.duties: Ensure compliance with management of invoices. Manage creditors by ensuring major accounts are reconciled with suppliers. Ensure payments are paid within 30 Days in compliance with 30-day payments. Administer Payroll Management. Authorize on SAP and PERSAL payments including journals. Monitor Petty Cash and supervise bank payments. Oversee safeguarding of state funds. Ensure proper documents control pertinent to financial documents. Compliance with monthly reporting including payables and accruals, 30-day reports, creditor reconciliation reports, petty cash reconciliation and suspense account reconciliation. Attend internal and external audit queries. Provide assistance to internal and external clients regarding general budgeting and financial reporting requirements. Supervise and evaluate personnel.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Senior Staatsekstant: Finansiële Rekeningkunde
af.summary: Senior Staatsekstant-positie in Gqeberha wat finansiële rekeningkunde, skuldeisaanstoeings, salarisadministrasie en SAP/PERSAL-betalings vir die Department of Water and Sanitation behartig.
af.requirements: 'n Relevante NQF-vlak 6-kwalifikasie (Nasionale Diploma) in Finansiële Bestuur of enige verwante kwalifikasie in die veld. Drie (3) tot vier (4) jaar se ervaring in finansies. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van SAP- en PERSAL-stelsel. Kennis en begrip van finansiële wetgewing, beleide, praktyke en prosedures. Kennis en begrip van finansiële voorskrifte soos die PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies en die Division of Revenue Act (DORA). Kennis van die toepassing van International Financial Reporting Standards van toepassing op bestuursbesteding, algemeen erkende rekeningkundige praktyk, openbare diens anti-korrupsie, strategie, bedrog en voorkoming. Kennis van gelyke geleenthede en regstellende rigerlyne en wette. Kennis van administratiewe en klerklike prosedures en stelsels. Kennis en begrip van departementele beleide en prosedures. Verskaf 'n raamwerk vir die bestuur van prestasie-inligting. Kennis van die implementering van PMDS-beleid. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Mense- en diversiteitsbestuur. Kliëntgerigtheid en kliëntefokus. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede beide (mondelings en skriftelik). Verantwoordbaarheid en etiese gedrag. In staat wees om onafhanklik te werk.
af.duties: Verseker nakoming van die bestuur van fakture. Bestuur skuldeisers deur te verseker dat groot rekenings met verskaffers aangestoot word. Verseker dat betalings binne 30 Dae gedoen word in ooreenstemming met 30-dag-betalings. Administreer Salarisbestuur. Magtig SAP- en PERSAL-betalings insluitend joernale. Monitor Kleingeld en hou toesig oor bankbetalings. Hou toesig oor die beskerming van staatsfondse. Verseker behoorlike dokumentbeheer ten opsigte van finansiële dokumente. Nakoming van maandelikse verslagdoening insluitend skulde en toekomstige uitgawes, 30-dag-verslae, skuldeiseraanstootverslae, kleingeldaanstootverslae en wagrekening-aanstootverslae. Bywoon van interne en eksterne ouditnavrae. Verskaf bystand aan interne en eksterne kliënte rakende algemene begrotings- en finansiële verslagdoeningsvereistes. Hou toesig oor en evalueer personeel.

zu.title: Omeluleki Wezimali Kasembuso: Izezimali
zu.summary: Isikhundla someluleki wezimali kasembuso eGqeberha ukuphatha izezimali, ukuhlenganisa ama-akhawunti abanikazi, ukuphatha inkokheliso kanye nentlawulo ye-SAP/PERSAL kuMnyango Wezamanzi Nokuswela Isiphuzo.
zu.requirements: Ithifikheyithi elifanele elingu-NQF level 6 (National Diploma) kwi-Financial Management noma noma yisiphi isifundo esihlobene kule ndawo. Ukuqashelwa okungu-Three (3) kuya kwaye ngaphezulu kwe-four (4) iminyaka ekuphatheni kwezezimali. Ukwembula ilayisensi yokushayela evuziweyo ezigembini. Ukwazi isimiso se-SAP kwaye nokwazi inkqubo ye-PERSAL. Ulwazi kwaye nokuqonda imithetho yezimali, iinkqubo, amasiko, kwaye nohlangothi lokuqhuba imisebenzi. Ulwazi kwaye nokuqonda izalatho ezimalini njenge-PFMA, iinkqubo ze-Treasury Regulations, kwaye noMthetho Wokwabiwa Kwemali (DORA). Ulwazi lokusebenzisa amagunya ezimali emazweni mayelana nokuphatha ukuchithwa kwemali, amasiko ozezimali aqaphelekayo ngokubanzi, inkqubo yokulwa inkukhethwana emphakathini kahulumende, iNdlela yokusebenza, ukukhwelana kwaye nokuthintela. Ulwazi malunga nokulingana kwamathuba kwaye noMthetho wokuthintela ukukrwada. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yolawulo, iinkqubo zolawulo, kwaye nezinhlelo. Ulwazi ngemithetho nezinqumo zikamongamele nemigudu yayo. Nikeza inkqubo yokuphatha ulwazi ngemisebenzi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iinkqubo ze-PMDS. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuphatha abantu nokuqhuba ukwahlukana kwabantu. Ukugxila kubathengi nakwindlela yokubakhonza. Amandla okunxibelelhana kahle ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo. Ukuqhathaniswa nokuziphatha ngokwesimilo. Ukuba nokwazi ukusebenza eyedwa.

xh.title: Umphathi Wee-akhawunti Zikarhulumente Ophakamileyo: Ukuhamba kweziMali
xh.summary: Isithuba somPhathi wee-akhawunti zikarhulumente ophakamileyo eGqeberha sokuhamba kwemali, ukuqwalasela kwezimali zabathengisi, ulawulo lwekhadi elihlawulayo kunye nentlawulo yeSAP/PERSAL kwiSebe leZamanzi kunye nokuQhwayula.
xh.requirements: Ifikeligqithu elifanelekileyo leNQF level 6 (National Diploma) kwiFinancial Management okanye naliphi na ifikeligqithu elinxulumene kule ndawo. Amava eminyaka emithathu (3) kuneyine (4) kwezemali. Ukuvula ilayisenisi yomqhubi egqityiweyo engazange iphelelwe yisikhathi. Ulwazi ngokuhamba kweSAP kunye nenkqubo yePERSAL. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngomthetho wezimali, iinkqubo, iinkqubo zokusebenza, kunye nemigaqo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemiyalelo yezimali enjengePFMA, iTreasury Regulations, kunye neDivision of Revenue Act (DORA). Ulwazi lokusebenzisa amagqabantshintshi e-International Financial Reporting Standards angasebenza kulawulo lwentlawulo, izinto ezaziwayo ngomxholo wee-akhawunti, ukuchasa ukurhweba ngokungalungileyo kwinkonzo yoluntu, iNqamba, ukurhweba ngokungalungileyo, kunye nokuthintela. Ulwazi malunga namathuba alinganayo kunye nemigaqo yentla yesinye isazi, kunye nomthetho. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yolawulo, iinkqubo zomsebenzi weofisi, kunye nenkqubo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemigaqo nendlela zokusebenza kwisebe. Ukunikela ngohlweyimbo lokulawula ulwazi ngokusebenza. Ulwazi ngokuphumeza iinkqubo zePMDS. Ukuxazula iingxaki nokuyahlaziya. Ulawulo abantu nobuninobani. Umdla womthengi nokubeka umdla komthengi. Amandla okunxibelelana amabalule kakhulu (okuthethwayo nokubhalwayo). Ukuze ibe nalwelo lokuziphatha okanye indlela yokuziphatha ethe eyeba. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngodidi.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuzinikela ekulawuleni ii-invoisi. Lawula abathengisi ngokuqinisekisa iia-akhawunti eziphambili ziqwalaselwa nabathengisi. Qinisekisa ukuba iintlawulo zihlawulwa ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezingama30 ngokuzinikela kwi30-day payments. Lawula iakhawunti yemihlahlo. Gunyaza iintlawulo kwiSAP nakuPERSAL kuquka iijurnali. Qwalasela iPetty Cash ilawule iintlawulo zebhanki. Qwalasela ukugcina imali karhulumente. Qinisekisa ulawulo lwamaxwebhu alungileyo ahlobene namaxwebhu ezimali. Ukuhambelana nokubika ngenyanga kuquuka izinto ezihlawulwayo nezoqoqosho, iinguqulelo zangama30 zentsuku, iinguqulelo zokuqwalasela abathengisi, ukuqwalaselwa kwePetty Cash kunye nokuqwalaselwa kwe-akhawunti yesithuba. Thatha amaxwebhu okuqinisekisa uhlobo lwangaphakathi nangaphandle. Nikela ngenkxaso kumthengi wangaphakathi nangaphandle ngakumbi malunga nokuquka nokuchotha imali. Lawula vavanye abantu.

The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Certification in the following Certified Microsoft Engineer, Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate (MCSA) or Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE). A+ and Network+ certification is required. Knowledge of Windows 7; Windows 8; Window 10; MS Office 2010, 2013 and Office 365; Symantec Ant-virus; Microsoft MS; Transversal systems (PERSAL, SAP and LOGIS) and ITIL will serve as an advantage. Good communication skills both verbal and written. Exposure to different business application platforms.

Perform installation, maintenance and upgrading of computer hardware and software as second fault-finding identification. Install and upgrade software applications not performed by resources from the outsourced partner. Provide and maintain internet and e- mail client services. Ensure that antivirus software signature and operating systems patches are up to date. Initiate and co-ordinate the change control procedures. Provide technical input for training and development of computer end-user skills. Perform routine back-ups for all the available servers. Compile monthly performance reports. The appointees will be expected to perform overtime and standby duties when necessary.

af.title: Inligtingtegnoloëtegnikus
af.summary: IT-tegnikus benodig in Mbombela om eindgebruiker-hardeware en sagtewareondersteuning te verskaf, geregistreerde oproepe te bestuur, en LAN-infrastruktuur te onderhou.
af.requirements: 'n Relevante NQF-vlak 6-kwalifikasie in Inligtingstegnologie. Drie (3) jaar toepaslike ervaring in Inligtingstegnologie. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, ongeïerde bestuurderslisensie. Sertifisering in die volgende: Certified Microsoft Engineer, Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate (MCSA) of Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE). A+ en Network+-sertifisering word vereis. Kennis van Windows 7; Windows 8; Window 10; MS Office 2010, 2013 en Office 365; Symantec Ant-virus; Microsoft MS; Transversal systems (PERSAL, SAP en LOGIS) en ITIL sal 'n voordeel wees. Bereidwilligheid om na verskeie afgeleë terreine en kantore te reis Bevoegdhede: Diepgaande kennis van 'n kliënt-bediener IT-omgewing. Leierskapseienskappe asook sterk kliëntediens en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Goeie rekenaarkennis en vaardighede (Ms Word, Excel en PowerPoint). Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede beide mondeling en skriftelik. Blootstelling aan verskillende besigheidstoepassingsplatforms.
af.duties: Bestuur oproepe wat op die oproepbestuurstelsels geregistreer is. Verskaffing van eindgebruikerondersteuning met betrekking tot hardeware, sagteware en netwerkverbinding. Verseker dat alle IT-beleide, norme en standaarde afgedwing word. Voer kwaliteitsbeheer uit vir die Local Area Network (LAN). Voer installasie, onderhoud en opgradering van rekenaarhardeware en sagteware uit as tweede foutopsporing-identifisering. Installeer en gradeer sagteweretoepassings op wat nie deur hulpbronne van die uitbestee vennoot uitgevoer word nie. Verskaf en onderhou internet- en e-poskliëntdienste. Verseker dat antivirus-sagtewarehandtekeninge en bedryfstelselpeile op datum is. Inisieer en koördineer die veranderingsbeheerprosedures. jobs.title: Engineering Technician Production Grade a – C
jobs.centre: Worcester 2 Ref No: 301026/25 George 2 Ref No: 301026/26
jobs.summary: Engineering technician needed for water data collection and maintenance team management, requiring an ECSA-registered diploma in civil engineering with three years' experience.
jobs.requirements: A National Diploma in (Civil) Engineering or relevant qualification. Three (3) years’ post qualification technical engineering experience. Compulsory registration with Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as a Professional Engineering Technician. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver's license. Understanding of programme and project management. Technical design and analysis knowledge. Understanding research development. Computer-aided engineering applications. Knowledge of legal compliance, technical report writing and technical consulting. Problem solving and analysis. Decision making, teamwork, Customer focus and responsiveness. Good communication skills both (verbal and written). Computer Skills. People management. Planning and organizing skills. Creativity and Change Management. Ability to work in a team. Must be punctual, productive, and loyal. Must be able to work in or near rivers, dams, and canals.
jobs.duties: Collection of primary and secondary data within the applicable water management Areas. Evaluation and processing of secondary data. Management of primary data collection and data bases. Management of real- time data and processed data. Management of maintenance/constructions teams for hydrological gauging infrastructure. Management of human resources and administration activities. Management, set-up and installation of Hydrological measuring equipment. Survey and calibration of gauging weirs. Inspection and Supervise maintenance of flow gauging stations. Hydrological Data editing and processing. Management of hydrological data bank. Procurement of maintenance material / equipment. Travel extensively as and when required. Assist Engineers, Technologists and associates in field, workshop and technical office activities, promote safety in line with statutory and regulatory requirements; project implementation support services to full project life cycle and Risk mitigation; Evaluate existing technical manuals, standard drawings and procedures to incorporate new technology; Produce and evaluate technical designs with specifications and submit for evaluation and approval by the relevant authority. Provide input into the budgeting process as required; Compile and submit reports as required; Provide and consolidate inputs to the operational plan and Annual Performance Plan; Develop, implement and maintain databases; Supervise and control technical and related personnel and assets. Continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures. Research/literature studies on technical engineering technology to improve expertise; and to liaise with relevant bodies/councils on engineering-related matters. Effective coordination and management of Infrastructure development projects. The provision of project implementation support services to the Water Services Authorities (WSAs) and the provision of technical engineering support services.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. af.title: Ingenieurstegnikus Produksie Graad a – C
af.summary: Ingenieurstegnikus benodig vir waterdata-insameling en instandhouding van spanbestuur, wat 'n ECSA-geregistreerde diploma in siviele ingenieurswese met drie jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma in (Siviele) Ingenieurswese of relevante kwalifikasie. Drie (3) se jare se tegniese ingenieurservaring na kwalifikasie. Verpligte registrasie by die Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as 'n Professionele Ingenieurstegnikus. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, nie-verstreke bestuurslisensie. Begrip van program- en projektbestuur. Tegniese ontwerp en analise-kennis. Begrip van navorsingsontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings. Kennis van regsvereistes, tegniese verslagskrywing en tegniese konsultasie. Probleemoplossing en analise. Besluitneming, spanwerk, kunderigtheid en responsiwiteit. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede beide (mondeling en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardighede. Menslike hulpbronbestuur. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Skeppende vermoë en verandering bestuur. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk. Moet stip, produktief en lojaal wees. Moet in staat wees om in of naby riviere, damme en kanale te werk.
af.duties: Insameling van primêre en sekondêre data binne die toepaslike waterbestuursgebiede. Evaluering en verwerking van sekondêre data. Bestuur van primêre data-insameling en databasisse. Bestuur van intydse data en verwerkte data. Bestuur van instandhoudings/konstruksiespanne vir hidrologiese meetinfrastruktuur. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne en administratiewe aktiwiteite. Bestuur, opstelling en installasie van hidrologiese meettoerusting. Opname en kalibrering van meetdamme. Inspeksie en toesig oor instandhouding van vloeimeetstasies. Hidrologiese databewerking en verwerking. Bestuur van hidrologiese databank. Verkryging van instandhoudingsmateriaal/toerusting. Reis uitgebreid soos en wanneer benodig. Assisteer Ingenieurs, Tegnoloë en medewerkers in veld-, werkswinkel- en tegniese kantooraktiwiteite, bevorder veiligheid in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulatoriese vereistes; projekimplementering-ondersteuningsdienste tot volle projeklewensiklus en risikobeperking; Evalueer bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie te inkorporeer; Produseer en evalueer tegniese ontwerpe met spesifikasies en dien in vir evaluering en goedkeuring deur die tersaaklike gesag. Voer insette tot die begrotingsproses soos vereis in; Stel verslae soos vereis op en dien dit in; Verskaf en konsolideer insette tot die operasionele plan en Jaarlikse Prestasieplan; Ontwikkel, implementeer en onderhou databasisse; Ooreesig en beheer oor tegniese en verwante personeel en bates. Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Navorsing/literatuurstudies oor tegniese ingenieurstegnologie om kundigheid te verbeter; en om met tersaaklike liggame/raade oor ingenieurswese-verwante aangeleenthede te skakel. Effektiewe koördinering en bestuur van infrastruktuurontwikkelingsprojekte. Die verskaffing van projekimplementering-ondersteuningsdienste aan die Water Services Authorities (WSAs) en die verskaffing van tegniese ingenieursondersteuningsdienste.

zu.title: IJikhini Lobuchwepheshe Bolwandozo Okukhiqizayo Izinga a – C
zu.summary: Kudingeka ijikhini lobuchwepheshe bolwandozo elizobe liqoqa ulwazi ngamanzi nalibophelele ekuphateni iqembu labasebenzi bokulungisa, kudingeka idiploma ebhalisiwe kwi-ECSA kubuchwepheshe bolwandoziso benhlelelelo nomawonke amasu kanhlalo eminyakeni emithathu isiphephelo.
zu.requirements: Idiploma yezwe ku-(Civil) Engineering noma iziqu ezifanelekayo. Amashumi amathathu (3) eminyaka yokuhlangabezana nesiphephelo sobuchwepheshe bolwandozo. Ukubhalisa ngokumqondo neSouth African Engineering Council (ECSA) njengejikhini lobuchwepheshe bolwandozo ngobuchwepheshe. Ukwaziswa kolayisensi yokushayela evumelekile eke yangapheli. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwenhlelelo nezinhlelwo. Ulwazi lokwakha ngobuchwepheshe kanye nokuhlaziya. Ukuqonda ukuthuthukiswa kokucwaninga. Izinhlelo zokuqoqa ulwazi ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho, ukubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe kanye nokuqoqa izeluleko zobuchwepheshe. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuqoqozisa. Ukuthatha izinqumo, ukusebenza ngokubambisana, ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokusabela. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle (okukhulumayo nokubhalwayo). Amakhono ekhompyutha. Ukuphatha abantu. Amakhono okuhlela kanye nokuhlelisa. Ukubumba izinto ezintsha kanye noQobo Lwokuqondisa. Ukuthola ukusebenza ngokubambisana eqenjini. Kufanele ukuba uhambisane nesesikhathi, ukhiqize kakhulu, futhi ube nokuzinza. Kufanele ukuthi ukwazi ukusebenza eduze noma eseduze namagwazi, namathambo, namapayipi.
zu.duties: Ukuqoqa ulwazi oluyisisekelo nolwesibili endaweni ezihambisana nokuphathwa kwamanzi. Ukuhlola nokucubungula ulwazi lwesibili. Ukuphathwa kokuhlola ulwazi oluyisisekelo kanye namagumbi olwazi. Ukuphathwa kolwazi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kanye nolwazi olucubunguliwe. Ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo/amagumbi okulungiswa okuqhathaniswa nokuqashelwa kwesakhiwo. Ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zabantu kanye nomyalelo wemisebenzi. Ukuphathwa, ukuhlela nokufaka izinto zokulinganisa ezihlobene namanzi. Ukuhlola kanye nokulinganisa imigodi yamanzi. Ukubheka futhi ukuqondisa ukulungiswa kweziteshi ezingalinganisa ukugeleza kwamanzi. Ulwazi lwezamanzi ukuhlela nokucubungula. Ukuphatha igumbi lolwazi lwezamanzi. Ukuthola izinto zokulungisa / izinto zokusetshenziswa. Ukuhamba kude njengoba kudingeka. Ukusiza ojikhini, abachwepheshe, nabahlanganyeli emisebenzini emvelana, ekhandweni kanye nasezindaweni zobuchwepheshe, ukuthuthukisa ukuphepha ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho; izinsiza zokusiza ekwenziweni kwezinhlelo ngokuphila kwazo ngokupheleleyo kanye nokunciphisa izengozi; Ukubuyeza imaphaswela ekhona yobuchwepheshe, imidwebo esemgangathweni kanye nendlela yokwenza ukufaka ithiyonoloji entsha; Ukuqala kokuqoqozisa futhi ukuhlola imiklamo yobuchwepheshe eneminingwane bese uyithumela ukuze ihlolwe futhi ivunyelwe uhulumeni obizayo. Ukupha izimangalo enkombandleleni yokubala njengoba kudingeka; Ukuqamba futhi ukuthumela imibalo njengoba kudingeka; Ukuze kuphathwe futhi kuhlanganiswe imibhalo yohlelo lokuqoqozisa ohlelweni lwale minyaka yomsebenzi; Ukuthuthukisa, ukusetshenziswa nokugcina amagumbi ulwazi; Ukuphatha futhi ulawule izinsizakalo ezihlobene nobuchwepheshe kanye nezimpahla. Ukuthuthukiswa ngokuphelele kobuchwepheshe ukuze kuhambisane ngezinto zezitsha zezinhlelo. Ukufunda ngokusesibonweni noma izincwadi ngobuchwepheshe bolwandozo ukuze kube khona ukwaziswa okungcono; kanye nokuxhumana nemikhakha/amahhovisi ahlobene ngemibuzo yobuchwepheshe bolwandozo. Ukuqondisa ngokuphelele ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo zokusakaza ezintsha. Ukunika izinsiza zokusiza ekwenziweni kwezinhlela kumyalelo onikwa amandla okuNikela Amanzi (WSAs) nokunika izinsiza zokusiza ngobuchwepheshe bolwandozo.

Ukusombulula iingxaki kunye nokuqwalasela. Ukwenza izigqibo, ukusebenza ngokwamaqela, ukujolisa kumthengi kunye nokuphendula. Indlela ezintle zokunxiba (ngokuqhuba nokubhala). Izikrwele zekhompyutha. Kufuneka akwazi ukusebenza kufuphi okanye kumile omanzi, amalahle, nakumjelo wamanzi.

Ukulawula amaqela abakhi beendlela / abakhi beendawo ezikwalaselwa amanzi. Ukulawula iziseko zenkcubeko yabantu nemisebenzi yokulawula iindaba. Ukulawula, ukumisa nokufaka izixhobo ezilinganisa amanzi. Ukulinganisa nokulungisa iindawo ezikwalaselwa amanzi ezingaboni. Ukuqwalasela nokugqiba ukugcinwa kweendawo ezilinganisa amanzi. Ukuzihlengahlengisa nokuhlela iinkcukacha zamanzzi. Ukulawula indawo egcina iinkcukacha zamnzi. Ukuthenga iinto zokulungisa izixhobo / iindawo zokulungisa. Ukuhamba kakhulu njengoko kuyimfuneko. Ukunceda abaQambi, abaQondi nabahlobene kwindawo yokusebenza, kwindawo yokulungisa iinto nakwindawo yamashishini obugcisa, ukukhuthaza ukhuseleko ngokwemigaqo nemithetho; ukunika inkxaso yokuqaliswa kwamaphulo ngokupheleleyo kwixesha elididiyelweyo lophuhliso nokunciphisa ingozi; Ukuphengwa iincwadi ezichaza ubugcisa, iintswela ezikwanwe ngaphambili nezinkqubo ukugcina iindlela ezitsha zoncedo; Ukwenza nokuphawula ukulunga kweendlela ezintsha ezinokubakho kwaye zithunyelwe ukuba ziqwalaselwe nokugunyaziswe ngumanyano onamandla. Ukunikela isimangazana ekwenziweni kwesithuba seenkcukacha zemali njengoko kuyimfuneko; Ukuqamba nokunika iingxelo njengoko kuyimfuneko; Ukunikela nokudibanisa iimfuno kwinkqubo yamaphulo eminye yomsebenzi kunye nesithuba somsebenzi woNyaka oyi-1; Ukuphuhlisa, ukuyisebenzisa nokugcina amagama egama lemibhalo; Ukulawula nokulawula abaGcini bomsebenzi obugcisa abanengqondo ngezinye iziseko ezingahoywa ngaphandle kwendlela. Ukuphuhlisa amandla okuqhuba inkqubo ukugcina amandla ekusebenziseni iindlela ezitsha zobugcisa neenkqubo zolwazi. Imizamo yophando / yemifanekiso yobuchwepheshe obuhleliyo ukuphucula ulwazi oluthile; nokuba nxaxhe kumaziko aqondene nexesha ekunxibelelanwa ngalo ngemiba eqondene nobuvelwano. jobs.duties: Monitor Compliance to Water Use Efficiency standards and compilation of the relevant reports with recommendations. Monitor the development and implementation of Water Conservation and Water Demand Management (WC/WDM) programmes, strategies, business plans and relevant projects by Water Management Institutions including Water Services Authorities. Ensure the roll out of WC/WDM improvement systems, measures, and procedures is compliant with sectoral determined benchmarks and water use efficiency practices. Monitoring the development and submission of the standard International Water Association (IWA) Water balances by Water Services Authorities. Assessment and monitoring of Water losses and non-revenue water using the IWA water balance information, to regulate the municipal sector. Preparations, and conducting of assessments relating to No Drop regulatory programme. Coordinating submission and monitoring implementation of submitted corrective action plans for the No Drop programme. Monitoring the loading of water use efficiency data by Water Services Institutions in the Integrated Regulatory Information System (IRIS). Compilation of presentations for catchment management forums and DWS management. Provide regulatory findings to be used for the development and facilitation of the provision of appropriate training, training manuals and courses to relevant stakeholders within the Local Government sector. Provide inputs to the Operational Plan of the Directorate. Assist with compilation and submission of monthly, quarterly and annual reports (performance and risk).

af.title: Omgewingsbeampte Produksie
af.summary: Omgewingsbeampte Produksie pos by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Kugompo, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in Natuurwetenskappe vereis om nakoming van doeltreffende watergebruik en WC/WDM-programme te monitor.
af.duties: Monitor nakoming van standaarde vir doeltreffende watergebruik en samestelling van die relevante verslae met aanbevelings. Monitor die ontwikkeling en implementering van Waterbesparing en Waterbestuursvraag (WC/WDM)-programme, strategieë, besigheidsplanne en relevante projekte deur Waterbestuursinstellings, insluitend Waterdiensowerhede. Verseker dat die uitrol van WC/WDM-verbeteringstelsels, -maatreëls en -prosedures voldoen aan sektoraal bepaalde riglyne en praktyke vir doeltreffende watergebruik. Monitor die ontwikkeling en voorlegging van die standaard International Water Association (IWA)-waterbalanse deur Waterdiensowerhede. Assesserings en monitering van waterverliese en nie-inkomste-water deur gebruik te maak van die IWA-waterbalansinligting, om die munisipale sektor te reguleer. Voorbereiding en uitvoering van assesserings met betrekking tot die No Drop-reguleringsprogram. Koördineer voorlegging en monitor implementering van voorgelêde regstellende aksieplanne vir die No Drop-program. Monitor die laai van data oor doeltreffende watergebruik deur Waterdiensinstellings in die Integrated Regulatory Information System (IRIS). Samestelling van aanbiedings vir opvanggebiedbestuursforums en DWS-bestuur. Verskaf reguleringsbevindings wat gebruik kan word vir die ontwikkeling en facilitering van die voorsiening van toepaslike opleiding, opleidingshandleidings en kursusse aan relevante belanghebbendes binne die Plaaslike Regering-sektor. Verskaf insette tot die Operasionele Plan van die Direktoraat. Bystand verleen met die samestelling en voorlegging van maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse verslae (prestasie en risiko).

zu.title: Inkokeli Yemvelo EkuKhiqizeni
zu.summary: Isikhundla senkokeli yemvelo ekuKhiqizeni eDepartment of Water and Sanitation eKugompo, sifuna i-National Diploma kwi-Natural Sciences ukuze kugqamise ukuthobela ekusebenziseni amanzi ngendlela enomsila kanye nokuhlelwa kwe-WC/WDM.
zu.duties: Qapha ukuthobela emazingeni okusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela enomsila bese uhlanganisa imibiko ehambisana nayo enemibuzo yesixazululi. Qapha ukuthuthukiswa nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo zokuGCINA amanzi nokuphathwa kokufuna amanzi (WC/WDM), izu, amaphuzu ezwe, amaphulani-ebhizinisi kanye namaphrojekthi ahambisana nawo Izikhungo Zokuphatha Amanzi kuhlanganise Izimbusano Zezinsizakalo Zamanzi. Qinisekisa ukusakazwa kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa i-WC/WDM, izinyathelo, kanye nezinga lokuziphatha kuthobele imigomo ebaluliwe kwisingxi kanye namasu okusebenzisa amanzi ngomsila. Qapha ukuthuthukiswa nokungeniswa kwemilinganiselo yezalanisi zamanzi ye-International Water Association (IWA) Izinsizakalo Zamanzi. Hlola bese uqapha ukulahleka kwamanzi namanzi angezi ngenzuzo usebenzisa ulwazi lwezalanisi zamanzi ze-IWA, ukuze kulawulwe ingxenye yamasipala. Lungelelisa bese uthola ukubuka izinhlelo ezibaluliwe ezingena ngaphansi kwe-No Drop. Hlela ukungeniswa bese uqapha ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo zokwenza izinguquko ezingenwe ngaphansi kwe-No Drop. Qapha ukufakwa kolwazi ngokusebenzisa amanzi ngomsila Izikhungo ezitholakala kwi-Integrated Regulatory Information System (IRIS). Hlanganisa imiboniso yamapheshana emihlanganweni yokuphatha imikhakha kanye nabaphathi beDWS. Nikezela izimemo zokulawula ezizosetshenziselwa ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlelwa kokunikelwa ukuqeqesha okufanele, izincwadi zokuqeqesha kanye namakilasi abahlanganyeli abahlobene ngaphakathi kwenkundla kahulumeni wasekhaya. Nikeza okungenwayo kuPhulani-Ophezu ye-Directorate. Siza ngokuhlanganisa nokungeniswa kwemibiko yanyanga zonke, yenyanga kanye yonyaka (ukusebenza kanye nobungozi).

xh.title: Environmental Officer Production
xh.summary: Isithuba sika Environmental Officer Production kwi Department of Water and Sanitation e Kugompo, sifuna i National Diploma kwi Natural Sciences ukugqola ukuthobela ekusebenziseni amanzi ngokusebenzayo naku kumaprogram e WC/WDM.
xh.duties: Gqola ukuthobela kumazinga okusebenzisa amanzi ngokusebenzayo kwaye uqokelele iimbuyekezo ezifanelekileyo ezineecezelo. Gqola ukuphuhliswa nokuphunyezwa kumaprogram, iindlela, iplani zoshishino namaprojekthi ahlobelye ekuGcinweni kwaManzi nokuLawulweni kufuneko lwamanzi (WC/WDM) ziiWater Management Institutions kuquka neWater Services Authorities. Qinisekisa ukuba ukusetenziswa kweekqubo, iindlela neenqubo zokuphucula iWC/WDM kuyathobela iimilinganiselo eqqonywe kwicala nakunokusebenzisa amanzi ngokusebenzayo. Ukugqola ukuphuhliswa nokungeniswa kweeksalansi zamanzi ze International Water Association (IWA) ezisamabala zeWater Services Authorities. Ukunqunula kwaye ugqole ukulahleka kwamanzi namanzi angazuzi ngenxa ngokusebenzisa iinkcukacha zeeksalansi zamanzi zeIWA, ukuze kulawulwe icandelo lemasipala. Ulungelelwaniso, nokwenza ukunqunula okuhambelana neprogram elawulayo iNo Drop. Ukuqamba ukungeniswa nokugqola ukuphunyezwa kweplani zonyeso zolungiso ezingeniweyo zeprogram iNo Drop. Ukugqola ukufakelwa kweedatha zokusebenzisa amanzi ngokusebenzayo ziiWater Services Institutions kwi Integrated Regulatory Information System (IRIS). Ukuqokelelwa komboniso weeplatejwa kumajelo olawulo lwe-catchment nolawulo lweDWS. Nikezela iintsingiselo ezilawulayo eziza kusetyenziswa ekuphuhliseni nakukhokeleni ukubonelela kolungelelwaniso olufanelekileyo lokuzilolonga, iimanwali zokuzilolonga neenkosi kwabaphathephatho abafanelekileyo ngaphakathi kwicala likaMasipala. Nikezela izigqibo kwiplani yokuSebenza yeDirectorate. Nceda ukqokelela nokungenisa iimbuyekeko zenyanga, zexesha kwikota nezonyaka (nkqo kunye nobungozi).

The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Computer skills (MS Office). Data analysis, good presentation and communication skills. Technical report writing and professional judgement skills. Understanding of the National Water Act, Water Services Act and related legislation. An understanding of the National Green Drop Program. Willingness to travel and drive long distances.

Monitoring compliance to wastewater effluent quality standards and compilation of relevant reports with recommendations. Issuing letters of non-compliance to wastewater effluent quality standards and monitoring remedial actions. Monitoring compliance of onsite sanitation to relevant guidelines and regulations. Evaluate and provide comments on Environmental Impact Assessment, Basic Assessment Reports, and Environmental Management Plans relating to infrastructure developments projects (e.g. housing developments, shopping centres, etc.).

af.title: Omgewingsbeampte Produksie Vlak a - C
af.summary: Omgewingsbeampte in Bloemfontein wat rioolwater-inspeksies uitvoer, voldoen aan effluentstandaarde moniteur en verslae vir die Department of Water and Sanitation opstel.
af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma in Omgewingsbestuur/Natuurwetenskappe. Ervaring in waterdienste-bestuur of regulering sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, nie-verstreke bestuurderslisensie. Rekenaarvaardighede (MS Office). Data-ontleding, goeie voorlegging en kommunikasievaardighede. Tegniese verslagskryf en professionele oordeelsvaardighede. Kennis van die National Water Act, Water Services Act en verwante wetgewing. 'n Begrip van die National Green Drop Program. Bereidwilligheid om te reis en lang afstande te bestuur.
af.duties: Uitvoer van inspeksies op rioolwaterstelsel-infrastruktuur en opstel van gedetailleerde inspeksieverslae met aanbevelings. Monitering van voldoening aan rioolwater-effluentkwaliteitstandaarde en opstel van relevante verslae met aanbevelings. Uitreik van briewe van nie-voldoening aan rioolwater-effluentkwaliteitstandaarde en monitering van regstellende maatreëls. Monitering van die laai van rioolwaterdienste-data deur Water Services Institutions in the Integrated Regulatory Information System (IRIS). Opstel van voorleggings vir opvanggebied-bestuursforums en DWS-bestuur. Voorbereiding en uitvoer van assesserings rakende die regulatoire Green Drop-regulasiogram. Koördineer van indiening en monitering van implementering van ingediende regstellende aksieplanne vir die Green Drop-program. Koördineer met Catchment Management Agency's oor ondersoeke en verslagdoening oor riool stortings en besoedelingsvoorvalle. zu.title: Isikhundla Sezokuhlinzwa Kwezomnotho Grade a - C
zu.summary: Isikhundla Sezokuhlinzwa Kwezomnotho eBloemfontein esibhekele ukupenya ukubheka kamanzi adingiwe, ukuqapha ukwezela kokuhambisana kwezidingo kanye nokuqoqa imibiko zahulumo wamanzi nokuhlanzwa.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezwe ezibambele ezintweni eziphathelene nokuphathwa kwemvelo/Amasayensi okwemvelo. Ulwazi ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zokulethwa kwamanzi noma ekulawuleni kuzoba lusizo olwengeziwe. Ukubonakalisa ilayisensi yokushayela evunyiwe futhi engagibeleli. Amakhono o khaladi lekhompyutha (MS Office). Ukuhlaziya idatha, amakhono okubonakalisa okuhle nokuxhumana. Amakhono okubhala imibikoobuchwepheshe kanye nobuqonda obusemgangathweni. Ukuqonda umthetho wezwe wamanzi, umthetho wezinsiza zamanzi kanye nemithetho ehlobene nawo. Ukuqonda iNqubomgomo yezwe yeGreen Drop. Ukuzethabela ukuhamba kanye nokushayela ibanga elide.
zu.duties: Ukupenya nokubheka izinsiza zokuthutha amanzi adingiwe kanye nokuqoqa imibiko ecacile yokubheka ngokucophelela ngenhlahlelo. Ukuqapha ukuhambisana namazinga wemithambisi yamanzi adingiwe nokubhala imibiko ephathelene nalokhu ngenhlahlelo zokuhlinzekwa ngayo. Ukukhipha amagwemu angahambisani namazinga wemithambisi yamanzi adingiwe nokubheka izenzo zokulungisa. Ukuqapha ukulayishwa kwedatha yezinsiza zamanzi yizikhungo ezihambeleka khona amanzi kwi-Integrated Regulatory Information System (IRIS). Ukuqoqa okuboniswa ekuqotheni kwemibuzo yenhlangano yokuqoka amanzi kanye nophatho lwe-DWS. Ukuhlinzeka, kanye nokwenza izibuyekezo eziphathelene nenqubomgomo yokulawula iGreen Drop. Ukulawula ukuthunyelwa nokubheka ukuqaliswa kwenhlahlelo zokulungisa ezingeniswa ngenqubomgomo i-Green Drop. Ukusebenza kanye nemi bhangano yokulawula ukuphathwa kwamanzi ekuphenyeni nokubhala imibiko ngokuchitheka kwegceke kanye nokuqhutshwa kwempilo yomphakathi e hhubeke. Ukuqapha ukuhambisana nokuhlanzwa endaweni ngokuthi kuhlangabezwe imihlahlelo nemithethonkambiso ephathelene nokuqatshwa kwemithethonkambiso yokuhlinza. Ukuhlola futhi nikeza imibono ephathelene nokubonisa ukuphenya kwemvelo, imibiko yokuqoqa okuyisiseko, kanye nohlelo lokuphathwa kwemvelo oluphathelene nokuqhutshwa kolwazi mayelana nezinkinga (isb. izingodi ezindlini, izikhungo zoku thenga, jj.).

xh.title: ISIbe Sobuqukuqo Kobveliso Inqanaba a - C
xh.summary: ISIbe Sobuqukuqo eBloemfontein esenza iimpelo zolwahlulo lwamanzi angcolileyo, lilungelelanisa ukuzithoba kweeffluent kwaye lihloma iingxelo zesebe Lamanzi nokuQinisekiswa kokuhlamba.
xh.requirements: I-Diploma yezilvl zikawonke-wonke kuLawulo koBuphilo bendalo/Izayensi eZalathwayo. Iimfundo ekulawulweni okanye ulawulweni lweenkonzo zamankzi ziza kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Isaziso solayisenisi yokushuka epheleleyo engazange iphelelwe lixesha. Isikhokelo kwiikhompyutha (i-MS Office). Ukuhlaziya iingcombolo, ukubonakalisa kakuhle namakhono onxibelelwano. Amakhono okubhala iingxelo zobugcisa kunye nokuza ngamawombo obungcallobukhulu. Ukuqonda iSahluko seZwe ngamanzi, isiSahluko seenkonzo zamankzi nemithetho ehlobene nayo. Ukuqonda iNkqubo yeZwe ye-Green Drop. Ukulungelelana ukuhamba kwaye uqhube ibanga elide.
xh.duties: Ukuza kwenziwa iimpelo ezinkqubo zolwahlulo lwamanzi angcolileyo nokuhlolwa kweengxelo zeempelo ezinziicatshulwa nezigqibo. Ukulungelelanisa ukuzithoba ngokwemilinganiselo yemveliso yamankzi angcolileyo nokuhlolwa kweengxelo ezithintekileyo ezinezigqibo. Ukupela oonxibelelwano bokungazithobi ngokwemilinganiselo yamankzi angcolileyo nokulungelelanisa iintshukumo zokulungisa. Ukulungelelanisa ukufakwa kweenkonzo zolwahlulo lwamanzi ziBhunga Beenkonzo zamankzi kwinkqubo yeNkcubeko yolwazi lolawulo (IRIS). Ukuhlohwa kwezibonakaliso ezibekelwe iifodom zoLawulo loMthwalo-mhlaba nabaphathi beDWS. Ulungelelano, nokwenza iingqiniseklo ezithinta inkqubo yolawulo ye-Green Drop yolawulo. Ulungelelaniso lokungenisa nokulungelelanisa ukusebenza kweenkqubo ezalathwa zokulungisa zenkqubo ye-Green Drop. Ulungelelaniso namaQumrhu oLawulo loMthwalo-mhlaba kuphando nokuxela ngotshintsho lwamaxa esiwatsho ngokondlakhona olungalunganga. Ukulungelelanisa ukuzithoba kwendalo yakudose ngokwemigaqo nemithetho ethintekileyo. Ukuhlola nokunika iimboxo ngeNkqubo yoPhando loBuphilo bendalo, iingxelo zoPhando olusisiseko, neNkqubo yoLawulo koBuphilo bendalo ezithinta iinkqubo zophuhliso (umzekelo: uphuhliso lwezindlu, iindawo zothengiso, njl.).

af.summary: Menstylpraktisyn benodig in Mbombela om diensvoorwaardes, verlof, aanstellings en PERSAL-verwante aangeleenthede vir die Departement of Water and Sanitation te administreer.
af.requirements: 'n Relevante NQF vlak 6-kwalifikasie (Nasionale Diploma) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur of 'n relevante kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van een (1) jaar ervaring in Menslike Hulpbronadministrasie. Praktiese, uitgebreide kennis en ervaring van die PERSAL-stelsel. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurslisensie. Kennis van die HR-wetgewende voorskrifte. Kennis en begrip van menslike hulpbronbeleid en sirkulaires. Kennis, begrip en interpretasie van DPSA-sirkulaires, besluite en riglyne. Kennis en begrip van Beroepspecifieke Dispensasie. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Basiese kennis van finansiële bestuur en van die PFMA. Probleemoplossing, kreatiwiteit, interpersoonlike en analitiese vaardighede. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede beide (mondelings en skriftelik). Kliëntgerigtheid en klieënsfokus.

Hou toesig oor en verrig algemene klerklike ondersteuningsdienste deur voorleggings, notules en briewe te tik, na te gaan en te verifieer. Reël vergaderings en lêer goedgekeurde notules weg. Bestuur die korrespondensieregister. Onderhou die lêerstelsel. Hanteer navrae oor ondersteuningsdienste en roetine-navrae. Bestuur fotokopieerders en enige ander administratiewe verwante funksies vir die Subdirektoraat. Hou toesig oor en verskaf kettingvoorsiening- en batesbestuursklerklike ondersteuningsdienste in ooreenstemming met die KVS- en Batesbestuursprosesse binne die Subdirektoraat deur kantoorvoorraadbeheer, bate-register en stoorkamerbestuur te handhaaf. Hou toesig oor en verskaf personeeladministrasie-klerklike ondersteuningsdienste binne die Subdirektoraat deur die verlofregister, bywoningsregister, personeelrekords, aftredevorms, verlofrekords te handhaaf en reisreëlings te tref. Hou toesig oor en verskaf finansiële administrasie-ondersteuningsdienste binne die Subdirektoraat deur te verseker dat begrotingsinligting en bestuur akkuraat vasgelê word, amptelike eise verwerk en telefoon/selfoonrekeninge monitor. Hou toesig oor en verskaf mentorskap aan ondergeskiktes deur werk toe te ken en die gehalte daarvan te verseker, personeelontwikkeling, die prestasie van ondergeskiktes te assesseer en dissipline toe te pas.

zu.title: Umphathi Womphathi Wabaluleki Bokuqashwa
zu.summary: Qapha izinsizakusebenza zokubhalisa kanye nezokuphathwa kwezinsiza eNdiweni Lezinsiza Zamanzi i-Boskop, okuhlanganisa ukuphatha uxhumo, ukuhlela izinkhomphano kanye nokugcina amaphepha okungeniswa.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Senior/Grade 12 noma izifundo ezinhle. Ubudala obungeminyaka emithathu (3) kuya kohlanu (5) weminyaka kusebenziswa ukuphatha ihhovisi. Isitifikedi/I-diploma yezwe ekuphathweni kohhovisi noma izifundo ezinhle kuzoba usizo olwengeziwe. Ukwazi okuphephayo ngemisebenzi yokubhalisa, izindlela eziyisisekelo zezimali kanye nenkokhelo yokungenisa idatha ne-zinto ezitholakala kusetshenziswa izibalo zezokuphatha. Ukwazi nokuqonda ngokusimama kokuqashwa okuphatha Izinsiza Zomphakathi. Ukwazi ngamasistimu wemali osebenzayo (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS). Ukwazi nokuqonda ngemithetho yokubuyekeza yezinsiza zabantu. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenza eqenjini futhi ube nokuqina kwemindingo. Ukwazi kwekhompyutha okuhle, ukulungisa, ukuhlela, ukuqhuba, ukuzethemba, kanye nezindlela zokuphatha. Izindlela ezinhle zokukhuluma nokubhala. Izindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga, ukudala okusha, kanye nokuqhuba phambili. Ukubekecezi kanye nokuhamba ngokulunga. Ukuphumelela kokuhumusha ngokwazi ukunakela imininingwane nokuphatha ulwazi olulinganisayo. Ukwazi ukwenza izinto eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa kanye nokusebenza ngokucindezela. Ukwethemba iklayenti nokugxila kumthengi.
zu.duties: Nika kanye nokuphatha ukusekela kokuphatha kwe-Sub Directorate. Hydrological Services. Qapha kanye nokunikeza izinsizakusebenza zokubhalisa okujwayelekile ngokubhala, ukuhlola kanye nokufingqa ukungeniswa, amaminithi kanye namagama. Hlela izinkhombano kanye nokugcina amaminithi avunyiwe. Phatha irekhodi loxhumano. Gcina isistimu yokulondoloza amafayela. Phatha imibuzo yezinsizakusebenza kanye nemibuzo eqondile. Phatha imishini yokushaja amakhophi nanoma yiziphi ezinye izigci zokuphatha ezingxenyeni ye-Sub-Directorate. Qapha kanye nokunikeza izinsizakusebenza zokubhalisa zokusungula ingxubevange kanye nokuphathwa kwemikhiqizo ngokuhambisana namapulsesi wokuphathwa kwe-SCM kanye nokuphathwa kwemikhiqizo engxenyeni ye-Sub-Directorate ngokulondoloza ukulawula izinto zohhovisi, ukulondoloza imikhiqizo nempatho yendawo yokugcina. Qapha kanye nokunikeza izinsizakusebenza zokubhalisa zokuphatha izinto zabantu engxenyeni ye-Sub-Directorate ngokulondoloza irekhodi lokushiya, irekhodi lokubakho, imibhalo yabantu, amafomu okuqashwa, amarekhodi okuqashwa, kanye nokuqasha izinhlelo zokuhamba. Qapha kanye nokunikeza izinsizakusebenza zokuphatha imali engxenyeni ye-Sub-Directorate ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lwebhajethi kanye nechibi ngenwetshiwa ngokunembile, ukuphatha izikhalazo eziyisiphakeme kanye nokubuka ama-akhawunti ocingo/ocingo lweselula. Qapha kanye nokunikeza isikhuthazo kwabaphansi ngokwaba futhi ukuqinisekisa izinga lomsebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwabantu, ukubheka ukusebenza kwabaphansi kanye nokusebenzisa isithunywa.

xh.title: Somlungu wokuQondisa oZabelo kuBuntu kuBakho beNkonzo ezakuQondiswa kumSebenzi
xh.summary: Qondisa iinkonzo zoxhaso lwabakho bobuchwephesha nemisebenzi yolawulo kwiZiko leBoskop Hydrological Services, kuquka nokuLawula umbhalo othunyelwayo, ukuCwangcisa iintlanganiso nokuQonda izicelo ezithunyelwayo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSenior/Grade 12 okanye isigqibo esinamsebenzi. Iimvezo zeminyaka eyiThree (3) ukuya kwesiFive (5) yokusebenza kulawulo leofisi. Isatifikethi/iNazhonal Diplom ekulawulweni kweofisi okanye isigqibo esinamsebenzi siza kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yabakho bobuchwephesha, izetho ezingundoqo zemali nokwazi ukuqokelela iingcombolo nezibalo zolawulo. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwendlela yomthetho elawula inkonzo kaSebenzi. Ulwazi ngendlela ezisebenza ngayo iinkqubo zemali (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS). Ulwazi nokuqonda ngezikhokelo zemisebenzi yabantu. Makabe nakho isakhono sokusebenza eqela nokuqhwagamela. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyuthwe ngokufaneleyo, ukuCwangcisa, ukuRhola, ukuzenza, ukuthembeka, nokuNdemba ngokulawula. Isakhono esihle sokuthetha nokuBhala. Isakhono sokuSombulula iingxaki, ukuyila nokuzithabangqondo. Ukuziphendulela nokuziphatha ngenyaniso. Isakhono esihle sokuQonda nokuPela ingcombolo nengqondo ekugqithiseni iingxaki ezifihliweyo. Isakhono sokuSebenza imisebenzi emininzi ngexesha elinye nangxwinya yokubandakanyeka. Ukuzinikela kumXhasi nokuQwalasela iimfuno zabaXhasi.
xh.duties: Zela nokuLawula uxhaso lolawulo kwiNqila elingundoqo. Iinkonzo eziqondiswayo zokuQonda iNgcwatywa leNkcubakaphakathi eLawulwa. Qondisa uze unike ixhaso ngokujikelezi ngokuchwetheza, ukulungisa nokuQinisekisa izicelo ezithunyelwayo, iMamitha nemiBhalwe. Cwangcisa iintlanganiso zeze iMamitha ezivunyiweyo ezibhalwe ngokutsho kwamagama. Lawula umbhalo othunyelwayo oseNqanaba. Gcina uluhlu lokuQwalasela isimo. Phathwa imibuzo engalunganga nemiBuzo yemisebenzi ngokujikelezi. Lawula iinkqubo ezidityanisiweyo nokuzityhunga imisebenzi ehamba nawo na nawo onke oonqwenela ngezinye iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo ezifana neNqila elingundoqo. Qondisa uze unike iinkonzo zoxhaso ngokwemali okanye ngokwemisebenzi ngokutsho kweSibini seNkqubo yeNkonzo nokulungelelisa nokwethulwa kweNkqubo yeNkonzo ngokuchanekileyo kwiiNkonzo eziSebenzayo zokuQala iNkqubo ngokulungelelisa ixabiso leNgxowa-mali yeSiseko kunye nokulawula nokugcina iSiko seNgxowa-mali kunye nokulungelelisa ukugcinwa kwemiSebenzi yasekhaya namaxabiso eNkxaso-mali. Qondisa uze unike iinkonzo zolawulo lwemisebenzi yabantu ngokulawula iNqila elingundoqo ngokugcina iFayile yokushiywa, ukulungiselelwa koluhlu, iNkcukacha zamasebenzi, iindlela zokuhla, iNkqubo yokubhalisa nokugcina iziko ekubhaliselelweni kumXhasi weLali yokulungelelisa ukuNgcelwa kwamadoda oovakashi. Qondisa uze unike iNkqubo yoLawulo lokuLawula iNkqubo yeNtengiso okanye iNkxaso-mali ekuLawulwa kwiNqila elingundoqo ngokuQinisekisa ukuba iNkqubo yeNgxowa-mali yeengxwinya zempilo nokuSetyenziswa kweNgxowa-mali kusetyenziswa ngokutsho kwamagama agqityiweyo nokuQwalasela iNkqubo yoLawulo nokuQwalasela iMisebenzi ekuLawulwa ngayo iNkqubo yeNtengiso yamaKhadi okuLawula iNkxaso-mali nokuLawula nokuHlola iSiko seNgxowa-mali nokuLungelelisa ukuLawula iSiko seNtengiso. Qondisa uze uNike isakhono esiNikiweyo kwiiNkonzo ezilawulwayo ngokwethula iNkonzo nokuSetyenziswa nokuLawula isakhono esiNikiweyo kwiNkonzo ekuLawulwa ngokubeka kwaye uQinisekise isakhono esiNikiweyo kwiNkonzo iNkqubo yokulungelelisa ukulungelelisa iNkqubo yokubakho nokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nokulungelelisa iNkqubo yokuhlolwa nokugcina iNkcukacha zolawulo nokulawula nokuSetyenziswa kweNkxaso-mali.

jobs.requirements: A Senior/Grade 12 Certificate or relevant qualification. A Certificate or Diploma in Records Management; Information Services will serve as an added advantage. A minimum of Three (3) to (5) five years registry experience. Computer literacy (Microsoft packages). Knowledge of human resources functions, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computers and collate administrative statistics. Basic knowledge and insight of human resources prescripts. Knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the public service. Knowledge of registry duties, practices and procedures. Knowledge of storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment. Good communication skills both (verbal and written). Client orientation and customer focus. Ability to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Supervise and provide registry counter services. Supervise the handling of incoming and outgoing correspondence. Supervise and render an effective filling and record management services. Supervise the operation and operate office machines in relation to the registry function. Supervise the processing and process documents for archiving and disposal. Supervise human resources/staff.

af.title: Registerklerk Toesighouer
af.summary: Hou toesig oor registerkliëntediens, hantering van korrespondensie, liasering en rekordbestuur vir die Department of Water and Sanitation in Mbombela.
af.requirements: 'n Senior/Grade 12-sertifikaat of 'n relevante kwalifikasie. 'n Sertifikaat of diploma in Rekordbestuur; Inligtingsdienste sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. 'n Minimum van Drie (3) tot (5) vyf jaar se registerervaring. Rekenaarvaardigheid (Microsoft-pakkette). Kennis van menslike hulpbronfunksies, praktyke asook die vermoë om data in te voer, rekenaars te bedryf en administratiewe statistiek byeindig. Basiese kennis en insig van menslike hulpbronvoorskrifte. Kennis en begrip van die wetlike raamwerk wat die openbare diens beheer. Kennis van registerpligte, praktyke en prosedures. Kennis van bergings- en ontslagprosedures in terme van die werksomgewing. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede beide (mondeling en skriftelik). Kliëntoriëntasie en klliefokus. Vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Hou toesig oor en verskaf registerkliëntediens. Hou toesig oor die hantering van inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie. Hou toesig oor en lewer 'n doeltreffende liaserings- en rekordbestuursdiens. Hou toesig oor die bedryf en bedryf kantoormasjiene in verband met die registerfunksie. Hou toesig oor die verwerking en verwerk dokumente vir argivering en beskikking. Hou toesig oor menslike hulpbronne/personeel.

zu.summary: Qapha izinsizakalo zedeski le-ofisi yokuqophela izimpushana, ukuphathwa kwezincwadi, ukuqoqwa kwayo nokuphathwa kwezinkomba zokuqopha ngaphansi kwe-Department of Water and Sanitation eMbombela.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Senior/Grade 12 noma iziqu ezinhle. Isitifiketi noma i-Diploma ekuphathweni kwezinkomba zokuqopha; Izinsizakalo zelwazi ziba ngosizo olwengeziwe. Ukwazisa okungenani kokuthathu (3) kuya (5) eminyakeni yamahuvo ekuphathweni kwe-ofisi yokuqophela izimpushana. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (izinhlelo ze-Microsoft). Ulwazi ngemisebenzi ngezinsiza zomuntu, kanye namandla okuyilawula ukusakaza kwemibhalo yokulinganisa emisebenzini. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo nokuqonda imithetho elawula izinsiza zabantu. Ulwazi nokuqonda uhlelo lomthetho olubusa inkonzo yomphakathi. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi, ezokwenza nendlela yemisebenzi yenhlebo yokuqopha izimpushana. Ulwazi lokuqoqa futhi ulondoloze izimpushana ngokusho hlelo lokusebenza. Amakhono amahle wokukhuluma (okwenyathelo nokuqoshiwe). Ukuqondiswa kumthengi nokugxila kumthengi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwezinkandla.
zu.duties: Qapha futhi unike izinsizakalo zokuphathwa kwedeski le-ofisi yokuqopha izimpushana. Qapha ukulawula kwezincwadi ezifakayo nezinkhulelayo. Qapha futhi unike izinsizakalo ezisebenzayo zokuqoqwa nokuphathwa kwezinkomba zokuqopha. Qapha ukusetshenziswa futhi usebenzise izimoto zekhompuyutha ohlelweni lwenhlebo yokuqopha izimpushana. Qapha ukucutshungwa futhi ucutshunge izimpushana zokugcina endaweni ethile kanye nezokulahla. Qapha izinsiza zabantu/abasebenzi.

xh.title: Umphathi Weenkqrego zokuBhalisa kwiiFayile
xh.summary: Qondisa iinkonzo zezadeski zokubhalisa kwifayile, ukuphatha unxibelelwano, ukubeka kwiifayile nolawulo lwerekhodi kwiSebe lamanzi namaNdlebe-ntle eMbombela.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 okanye isiqu esifanelekileyo. Isatifikethi okanye iDiploma kwiLawulo lweRekhodi; Iinkonzo zeNkcukacha ziya kuba ngumvuzo ongezelelekileyo. Ulwazi olusisiseko nokuqonda iimiyalelo yemisebenzi yabantu. Ulwazi nokuqonda inkqubo yomthetho elawula inkonzo kaRhulumnde. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokubhalisa kwifayile, iinkqubo nendlela yokwenza izinto. Ulwazi lendlela yokugcina nokukhupha iifayile ngokwendawo yokusebenza. Amakhono amahle oNxibelelwano (olomlomo nolubhaliweyo). Umlindo kumthengi nogqalisio lwamathenga. Amandla okusebenza ngocinezelo.
xh.duties: Qondisa kwaye unike iinkonzo zedeski zokubhalisa kwifayile. Qondisa ukuphathwa kokubhalisa kunye nokuphuma kweenxulumano. Qondisa kwaye unike iinkonzo ezisebenzayo zokubeka kwifayile nolawulo lweekhaladi. Qondisa ukusebenza kwaye usebenzise iimishini zofisi ngokwendima yokubhalisa. Qondisa ukuqhuba kwaye uqhube amaxwebhu okugcina iafayile nokulahla. Qondisa imisebenzi yabantu/abasebenzi.

jobs.title: Chief Assistant Technical Officer (SCIENTIFIC Support)
jobs.summary: Chief Assistant Technical Officer providing scientific support for geohydrological assessments and groundwater data collection at the Department of Water and Sanitation in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 4 (Senior/Grade) 12 certificate with Mathematics/Mathematics Literacy/Physical Science. Six (6) to (10) ten years’ experience in surface or groundwater technical environment i.e. collecting and processing of water related data. The disclosure of a valid Code 10 unexpired driver’s license and PDP. Six (6) to (10) ten years’ experience in the groundwater technical environmental in collecting and processing of water-related data. Good verbal and written communication skills. Computer literate. Willingness to travel extensively. Knowledge in handling laboratory and monitoring equipment. Knowledge of OHS. High knowledge of geohydrological processes and systems.
jobs.duties: Provide support in geohydrological assessments, the collection of groundwater quality samples and groundwater level data. Support Technicians and Scientists in the execution of their tasks including quality control. Provide On- job training in scientific data collection processes including contributing to training material for data collection and data processing - provide internal and external training in relevant fields of expertise; aid and guide data collectors in applying the correct data collections; provide assistance in processes (fault correction – equipment calibration etc); provide inputs for the training materials in data processing; provide monthly feedback on the training interventions and its successes or failures. The official will hold a supervisory role, supervising subordinates involved in data collection and processing activities. The official will travel extensively and remain in the field for extended periods, working away from the office.

af.title: Hoofassistentegniese beampte (WETENSKAPLIKE ondersteuning)
af.summary: Hoofassistentegniese beampte wat wetenskaplike ondersteuning vir geohidrologiese assesserings en grondwaterdataversameling by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Pretoria verskaf.
af.requirements: 'n NQF-vlak 4 (Senior/Grade) 12-sertifikaat met Wiskunde/Wiskundige Geletterdheid/Natuurwetenskap. Ses (6) tot (10) tien jaar se ondervinding in 'n oppervlakte- of grondwatertegniese omgewing, d.w.s. die versameling en prosessering van waterverwante data. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke Code 10-bestuurslisensie en PDP. Ses (6) tot (10) tien jaar se ondervinding in die grondwatertegniese omgewing in die versameling en prosessering van waterverwante data. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaarongeletterd. Bereidwilligheid om uitgebreid te reis. Kennis in die hantering van laboratorium- en moniteringstoerusting. Kennis van OHS. Hoë kennis van geohidrologiese prosesse en stelsels.
af.duties: Verskaf ondersteuning in geohidrologiese assesserings, die versameling van grondwatergehalte-monsters en grondwaterpeildata. Ondersteun tegnici en wetenskaplikes in die uitvoering van hul take insluitend gehaltebeheer. Verskaf indiensopleiding in wetenskaplike dataversamelingsprosesse insluitend bydraes tot opleidingsmateriaal vir dataversameling en dataprosessering - verskaf interne en eksterne opleiding in relevante vakgebiede van kundigheid; help en lei dataversamelaars in die toepassing van die korrekte dataversameling; verskaf bystand in prosesse (foutkorreksie - toerustingkalibrering ens.); verskaf insette vir die opleidingsmateriaal in dataprosessering; verskaf maandelikse terugvoer oor die opleidingsintervensies en die sukses of mislukking daarvan. Die amptenaar sal 'n toesighoudende rol beklee en ondergeskiktes toesien wat betrokke is by dataversamelings- en prosesseringsaktiwiteite. Die amptenaar sal uitgebreid reis en vir lang periodes in die veld bly en weg van die kantoor af werk.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esibambe Isandla Ezechwebo (UKUSEKELA KWEZESAYENSI)
zu.summary: Isikhulu Esibambe Isandla Ezechwebo esinikeza ukusekela kwezesayensi okuphathelene nokuhlaziya izimo zomhlaba omanzi nokuqoqa idatha yamanzi emhlabathi e Department of Water and Sanitation e Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-NQF level 4 (Senior/Grade) 12 esine-Mathematics/Mathematics Literacy/Physical Science. Ukuba nokuhlelelekwanga okungu-Six (6) kuyoku- (10) ten iminyaka kwindawo yamandla echwebo ebufuzini noma emanzini emhlabathi okuwukuthi ukuqoqa nokucubungula idatha ehlotshaniswa namanzi. Ukuvezwa ikhadi lokushayela elisezinhlungwini ze-Code 10 elingakapheli kanye ne-PDP. Ukuba nokuhlelelekwanga okungu-Six (6) kuyoku- (10) ten iminyaka kwindawo yamandla echwebo emanzini emhlabathi ekuqoqweni nokucubungulweni kwedatha ehlotshaniswa namanzi. Ukukhuluma nokubhala kahle. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba kakhulu. Ulwazi lokuphatha amabhuloho we-laboratory kanye nempahla yokulawula. Ulwazi lwe-OHS. Ulwazi oluphezulu lwezinqubo nezimiso zomhlaba omanzi.
zu.duties: Nikeza ukusekela ekuhlola izimo zomhlaba omanzi, ekuqoqeni okuyisampula kwegadi yamanzi emhlabathi nakwidatha yzinga lamanzi emhlabathi. Sekela abachwebo nabasayensi ekwenzeni imisebenzi yabo kuhlanganise kolawulo lokhiye. Nikeza ukwesekela ekugadweni ngenkathi usebenza ekuqoqweni kwedatha yesayensi kuhlanganise nokufaka isandla kumaphhhhasi okuqeqesha ukuthi idatha iqoqwe kwaye icubungulwe - nikeza ukuqeqesha ngaphakathi nangaphandle kumabhuloho obuchule obuhlobene; siza futhi uhola abaqoqi bedatha ekusebenziseni izindlela ezifanele zokuqoqa idatha; nikeza usizo ezindlebini zezinqubo (ukulungisa amaphutha - ukulinganisa impahla njll); nikeza izinto ezingangeniswa kumaphhhhasi okuqeqesha ekucubungulweni kwedatha; nikeza umbiko wanyanga zonke ngezinyathelo zokuqeqesha kanye nempumelelo noma engaphumeleli kuzo. Lowo msebenzi uzoba nendima yokuhola, ehola abaphansi ababandakanyekayo ekuqoqeni nokucubungulweni kwedatha. Lowo msebenzi uzohamba kakhulu futhi ahlale ensimini izikhathi ezinde, esebenza kude ne-ofisi.
