xh.summary: Isikhulu esincedisayo somsebenzi wotekhniki esinika inkxaso yezonzululwazi kwiingqinisiso zegeohydrological nokuqokelela iingcombolo zegazi elingaphantsi komhlaba kwiSebe leManzi noKuhlambulula ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seNQF level 4 (Senior/Grade) 12 ngeMathematics/Mathematics Literacy/Physical Science. Phakathi kweSix (6) ukuya kwe-(10) ten iminyaka yamavaqngaba kwindawo yotekhniki yamanzi aphezu komhlaba okanye angaphantsi komhlaba oko kukuthi ukuqokelela nokucubungula iingcombolo ezinxulumene namanzi. Ukuzisa ilayisenisi esebenzayo yeCode 10 engakaqwalaselwa nePDP. Phakathi kweSix (6) ukuya kwe-(10) ten iminyaka yamavaqngaba kwindawo yotekhniki yegazi elingaphantsi komhlaba ekuqokeleleni nokucubungulweni iingcombolo ezinxulumene namanzi. Amakhono amabalulu okuthetha nokubhala. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuzimisela okukhulu okuhamba-hamba. Ulwazi ekuphatheni ipeleki yelaborathori nemisebenzi yokumobelela. Ulwazi lweOHS. Ulwazi oluphezulu lwemisebenzi nezakhiwo zegeohydrological.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso kwiingqinisiso zegeohydrological, ukuqokelela iisampulu zomgangatho wegazi elingaphantsi komhlaba nengcombolo yemilinganiselo yegazi elingaphantsi komhlaba. Ncedisa abaTekhnikhian nabasayensi ekuphumeleleni imisebenzi yabo kuquka ulawulo lomgangatho. Nikela isikhokelo kumsebenzi kwinkqubo yokuqokelela iingcombolo zezonzululwazi kuquka nokwenza isigqibo kwizixhobo zokuqokelela iingcombolo nokucubungula iingcombolo - nikeza isikhokelo sangaphakathi nangaphandle kwimimandla ehambelanayo yamakhono; ncedisa atshatise abaqokeleli bangcombolo ekusebenziseni iindlela ezifanelekileyo zokuqokelela iingcombolo; nikeza incedo kwindlela (ukulungisa iimpazamo - ukulinganisa izixhobo njl njl); nikeza izimvo kwizixhobo zesikhokelo ekucubungulweni iingcombolo; nikeza ingxelo yenyanga ngeenkxaso zesikhokelo nempumelelo okanye impazamo yazo. La maphakathi aza kubamba inqanaba lokulawula, elawula abasebenzi abangenzantsi abatrhintywe kwindlela zokuqokelela nokucubungula iingcombolo. La maphakathi aza kuhamba-hamba kakhulu ahlale emsebenzini ithafa elide, esebenza kude ne-ofisi.

jobs.summary: Collect, process and archive hydrological data at Boskop Hydrological Services Office, requiring a Grade 12 certificate with mathematics or physical science and six to ten years' relevant technical experience.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 4 (Senior/Grade) 12 certificate with Mathematics/Mathematics Literacy/Physical Science. Six (6) to (10) ten years’ experience in surface or groundwater technical environment i.e. collecting and processing of water related data. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. High level in computer literacy in Microsoft Excel and Word. Ability to use data management system (HYDSTRA). Knowledge of surface water monitoring instruments and data processing and administration. Knowledge and understanding of hydrological, geo-hydrological processes and the relevant database systems. Knowledge of relevant equipment’s and OHS. Understanding of tendering processes, purchasing of instruments and materials. Problem solving and analysis. Good interpersonal relations, organizational skills, technical report writing skills and understanding of relevant software. Good communication skills both (verbal and written). Willingness to travel.
jobs.duties: Assist in the collection, processing and archiving of hydrological data (stream flow data / surface water levels data, evaporation and rainfall data etc). Ensure that data and field forms for surface water hydrological data are received, registered and processed Use data and information systems (HYDSTRA) to perform duties (data processing data archiving and data quality control). Ensure that processed hydrological data is archived according to departmental standards. Ensure that recommendations from field visits are reported to supervisor. Convert binary (raw logger) data to suitable data format in preparation for import to relevant systems. Assist with dissemination of hydrological data and information to various stakeholders within DWS. Support Technicians, Assistant Technical Officers and Scientists in the execution of their tasks including quality control. Provide inputs for the training materials in data processing. Provide On-the-job training in the field of expertise.

af.title: Hoofassistent Tegniese Beampte (WETENSKAPLIKE Ondersteuning)
af.summary: Versamel, verwerk en argiveer hidrologiese data by Boskop Hidrologiese Dienste-kantoor, wat 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat met wiskunde of fisiese wetenskap en ses tot tien jaar se relevante tegniese ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n NQF vlak 4 (Senior/Graad) 12-sertifikaat met Wiskunde/Wiskunde Geletterdheid/Fisiese Wetenskap. Ses (6) tot (10) tien jaar se ervaring in 'n oppervlaks- of grondwater tegniese omgewing, d.w.s. die versameling en verwerking van waterverwante data. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurslisensie. Hoë vlak van rekenaargeletterdheid in Microsoft Excel en Word. Vermoë om databestuurstelsel (HYDSTRA) te gebruik. Kennis van oppervlakwater-moniteringsinstrumente en dataverwerking en -administrasie. Kennis en begrip van hidrologiese, geohidrologiese prosesse en die relevante databasisstelsels. Kennis van toerusting en VGV. Begrip van tenderprosesse, aankoop van instrumente en materiaal. Probleemoplossing en analise. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge, organisatoriese vaardighede, vaardighede in die skryf van tegniese verslae en begrip van relevante sagteware. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (sowel mondeling as skriftelik). Bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Bystaan met die versameling, verwerking en argivering van hidrologiese data (stroomvloeidata / oppervlakwatervlakdata, verdampings- en reëndata, ens). Verseker dat data en veldvorms vir oppervlakwater-hidrologiese data ontvang, geregistreer en verwerk word. Gebruik data- en inligtingstelsels (HYDSTRA) om pligte uit te voer (dataverwerking, data-argivering en data-kwaliteitsbeheer). Verseker dat verwerkte hidrologiese data volgens departementele standaarde geargiveer word. Verseker dat aanbevelings van veldbesoeke aan die toesighouer gerapporteer word. Skakel binêre (rou logger-) data om na 'n geskikte dataformaat ter voorbereiding vir invoer na relevante stelsels. Bystaan met die verspreiding van hidrologiese data en inligting aan verskeie belanghebbendes binne DWS. Ondersteun Tegnici, Assistent Tegniese Beamptes en Wetenskaplikes in die uitvoering van hul take insluitend kwaliteitsbeheer. Verskaf insette vir die opleidingsmateriaal vir dataverwerking. Verskaf werksafrigting op die terrein in die gebied van kundigheid.

zu.title: Igosa eliyisisekelo elinobuchwepheshe (ISEKELA ESAYENSINI)
zu.summary: Qoqa,处理 hlobo amanzi kanye nokugcina idatha yamanzi eBoskop Hydrological Services Office, kudingeka isitifiketi seGrade 12 esinohwebo lwemathematics noma physical science kanye neminyaka eyisithupha kuye kwayishumi yamava obuchwepheshe ahambisana naleso sikhundla.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seNQF level 4 (Senior/Grade) 12 esinobuMathematics/Mathematics Literacy/Physical Science. Emva kweminyaka eyisithupha (6) kuya kwengamashumi (10) yamava kwimvelo yobuchwepheshe yamanzi angaphezulu komhlaba noma angaphansi komhlaba okuyiqoqo nokuhlela idatha ehlobene namanzi. Ukwazisa ukuthi unelayisense yokushayela okusebenzayo. Ukuqeqeshwa okuphezulu ekusebenziseni ikhompuyutha ohlelweni lweMicrosoft Excel kanye noWord. Ikhono lokusebenzisa ohlelo lolawula idatha (HYDSTRA). Ulwazi ngamabhola wokuhlola amanzi angaphezulu komhlaba kanye nokuqoqa idatha kanye nokuphatha. Ulwazi kanye nekuqonda imiqondo yezinto ezenzeka emanzini kanye nezozenzeka emhlabeni ophansi kanye namasistimu wezidatha eziphathelene nalawo. Ulwazi ngemishini kanye ne-OHS. Ukuqonda inqubo yokuthengiselana, ukuthenga imishini kanye nezinto ezingenampahla. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqonda. Kubuhle ukuba namakhono okwazisana, ukwelana, ukubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe kanye ne software. Kubuhle ukuba namakhono okuxoxa ngomlomo kanye nokuqamba. Ukuthanda ukuvakatshela.
zu.duties: Siza ukubamba inqwaba yezinkomba zokuthola idatha, hlobo kanye nokugcina idatha ngendlela ehlelekile. Ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi idatha kanye namafomu okuthola idatha atholakala, abhaliswe futhi ahlelwe. Sebenzisa idatha kanye namasistimu we-WhatsApp okuyiWhatsApp (HYDSTRA) ukuze kwenziwe imisebenzi (ukuqoqa idatha, ukugcina idatha ngokuhlelekile, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi idatha ihleleke kahle). Ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi idatha yezinto ezenzeka emanzini ehleliwe igcinwe ngokuhambisana namazinga womnyango. Ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi izincomo ezoqoqwa ezindaweni ezithile zethulwa kumlawuli. Umsebenzi wokuguqula i-binary (raw logger) data kube yidatha ohlelwini olufanelekile ukuze ilungele ukufakwa kumasistimu afanele. Sisa ekwaziseni idatha yamanzi kanye nezinye izinto eziyingqikithi ezithile ezinkundleni ezihlukene ezitholakala ngaphakathi kweDWS. Ukusiza abasebenzi besayensi, abayioffisa abaye bagqamile basebenza emanzini abaye bavela ngisho nasezinkundleni zamasistimu ukwenza imisebenzi yabo ngokuhlanganisa ukutholwa kwebhalansi. Ngokuletha umbhalo wemfundiso yokutholakala kwamanye amasistimu. Ukuletha imisebenzi yokuba ukuvakatshela isikhundla noma indawo ethile.

xh.title: Isikhulu Esibi Ngumncedisi Weempiko zobuGcisa (INKXASO yeZiZATU)
xh.summary: Qokelela, qlobele eziko kunye neliziqhagaqhisa iidata yamanzi kwiZiko leeNkonzo zoMthondo wamanzi eBoskop, kufuneka kubekho isatifikethi seGrede 12 esinobuMzingeli okanye isiZATU somzimba kunye neentsuku ezintandathu ukuya kweshumi zomzila wamava obugcisa ahambelana nalo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seNQF level 4 (Isebe/Grede) 12 esinoMathematics/Mathematics Literacy/Physical Science. Amava eminyaka yamandundu (6) ukuya kwelishumi (10) kwimojula yobugcisa yamanzi aphezu komhlaba okanye aphezu kobumnini bakwonke_woxhumo olutholwayo ngokwandiso wesixhobo, nangokwandiswa kweendlela zokuqokelelwa kolwazi olubhekise kwiinkqubo zolwazi ekudini kolwazi lokuqokelelwa kolwazi ngokuphelene nomthi othile. Isityhila isatifikethi sesixhobo sokushukuma somntu. Inqanaba eliphezulu kwindalo yeempembelelo ekusebenziseni iinkqubo ezifana noMicrosoft Excel noMicrosoft Word. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa inkqubo yolawulo lwedata (HYDSTRA). Ulwazi ngamacebo okuhlalutya amanzi angaphezu komhlaba kunye neenkqubo zolwazi ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi nakuqonda iinkqubo ngokwamanzi ahamba, iinkqubo ngokwamanzi aphantsi komhlaba nolwazi ngobugcisa oluhlobene nolu. Ulwazi ngolwazi oluhlobene ngamaxhobo oogqirha kunye noogqirha beengalo. Isazulu nangeziganeko ezihlobene nobugcisa bokwenza amacebo okuhombisa izixhobo ezibalulekileyo ekusebenzeni kolwazi. Ukuphumeza izisombululo zehlabathi kunye noqando oluqhutywayo lwezinto. Iimpawu zokunxibelelana ngokusuka kwamanye amaqela. Ulwazi lokuphumeza izibalo ngokubhalwayo, nokuphumeza ulwazi oluhlobene nobugcisa ekubhaleni iingxelo zobugcisa, nokusebenzisa izixhobo ezingalinganiyo zeSazisi seNtlangano yokuBala lomntu wonke. Ukuzinikela ngokwazisa ngakumbi ngokubakho kolwazi oluhambelana nokuhamba kolwazi lwakho.
xh.duties: Nceda ekubeni, ukwahlula nokugcina iidata yamanzi ahamba (iidata ezisetyhwa ziyimfuneko yokwenza izinto ezihlukene ngokwemeko yomntu omdala kunye nokukhetha iidatha eziliqela, iidata ezifana neenkqubo zokulinganisa amanzi ahamba ezahlukeneyo). Qinisekisa ukuba iidatha kunye namafomu esiNqanaba seSazisi seNtlangano yokuBala zikho ukuboneela iidatha ezithunyelwa ngokutsha ngokwexabiso lokuqulunqa iidatha ezahlukeneyo esezantsi. Sebenzisa iidatha nezixhobo zeinkqubo (HYDSTRA) ekwenzeni imisebenzi (ukulungiselela iidatha, ukugcina iidatha, ukulawula iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zolwazi ngokwemeko yentsuku). Qinisekisa ukuba iidatha ezahlukeneyo zisetyhwa zihlolwe ngokwemigaqo yaseNyangweni yakho yokubakho kolwazi lokuqulunqa iidatha ezahlukeneyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iingcebiso ezivela kwindawo yokuhamba kwexesha lokubakho kolwazi zibhalwe kwaye zithunyelwe kwicala lokubakho kolwazi ngokwemeko yemeko yomntu omdala. Qhubela iidatha ezingazange zifundwe kwiiyaqhubela iidatha ezingafanelekanga ukuba zisebenze ngokwemeko yexabiso elincinci kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezifana nolonikezelo kunye nokulinganisa ngokubakho kolwazi olufanelekileyo kwinkqubo. Nceda ngokunika iinkcukacha ngenkqubo ekuthengwa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezibangelwa ukubakho kolwazi olufanelekileyo kwindawo ngokubakho kolwazi. Sebenzela abaqulunqi bezixhobo, abancedisi beNqanaba seNtlangano yokuBala, kunye nabasebenzi bezixhobo ngokwemeko yemeko yentsuku. Nceda ukunikela ngemigaqo ekubakho kolwazi ekuthethwa ukubakho kolwazi ekusebenzeni kolwazi ezinika inkqubo yeSazisi seNtlangano yokuBala. Nikeza ngemiyalelo yokuhamba ngokwemeko yentsuku ekubakho kolwazi ngokwemeko yemeko yomsebenzi.

af.summary: Projekadministrateur gesoek om waterdienste-infrastruktuurontwikkelings subsidieprogramme binne die Department of Water and Sanitation te koördineer en te ondersteun.

zu.summary: ufuna umlawuli weProyekthi ukuba ahlele, axhase neenkqubo zemiginqo yophuhliso lweziko leenkonzo zamanzi kurhulumente wezaManzi nokuQulunqa.
zu.requirements: Ifaneleka njengomntu onelayisensi njengotyali-mfundi. Isatifikethi kuphela kwaye kulindelekile ukuba unamava emisebenzini ye-IT okanye inyani esetyenziswa kule minyango inika inkxaso emisebenzini yamathanga nolu hlolo. Ungumnikazi wesatifikethi esekelwe kwiinkqubo zeMicrosoft Office kwaye usazi ngcono iziseko ze-intanethi, iinkqubo ze-database, iinkqubo ze-backup kunye nokulawula isicima. Iminikelo yakho efanelekileyo iqinisekisa ukuba ubomi bakho bumgangatho ophezulu kwaye unendalo ethile yokuphatha imicimbi.
zu.duties: Nika inkxaso yobuqu bokulawula kwaye uhlele ekuphumezeni iinkqubo zemiginqo yophuhliso lweziko leenkonzo zamanzana. Hlela okubaliweyo ngamaprojekthi, iindwendwe kumawebhusayithi, kunye nenkokhelo yamaprojektho wophuhliso lweziko lamanzana. Nikezela ngolawulo lweemali zamaprojekthi, kuquka ukumonitha imali echiyiweyo nokunceda ngepapasha ezimalini ezinxulumene imiginqo. Lilise ukuqonda izicwangciso ezamkelekileyo, iinjongo, kunye namagqabi okuvela. Yondla ulawulo oluchanekileyo loluqulatho lwawo onke amaxwebhu anxulumene namaprojekthi nempendulo kwiiMvela kunye neMeliyo ePhumezayo ukuze kugcinwe kolunye ulwazi oluchanekileyo lube lula ukubuyiswa. Hlanganisa ugcine isiseko sedatha yabalimi abaswela amathuba njengabahlawulezwa iinkqubo zokuqokelela amanzi embewu.

xh.title: Mlawuli weProjekthi
xh.summary: Kufunekiwa uMlawuli weProjekthi ongakoordinatha nokuxhasa iinkqubo zezibonelelo zophuhliso lolwakhiwo lweenkonzo zamazi kuSebe loManzi noKuhlamba.
xh.requirements: Isigaba esifanelekileyo seNQF level 6 kwizayensi yentlalo/kuLawulwa kawonke-wonke/kuLawulwa kolawulo okanye isifundo esifanelekileyo. Ikwiminyaka eyi-One (1) ukuya kwi-(2) two yamava kwimeko yolawulo lweeprojekthi zolwakhiwo loManzi noKuhlamba. Ulawulo lwemali yezibonelelo zolwakhiwo luya kongeza ilungeleliso. Isetifikathi kuLawulo lweProjekthi nayo iya kongeza ilungeleliso. Ukuqonda kothelelelo namacebo olawulo alawula le ndawo. Ukuqonda kolawulo lwenkqubo, yeprojekthi nyoqoqosho. Ulwazi ngophuhliso nokusebenzisa amacebo. Ukuqonda kothelelelo namacebo olawulo alawula icandelo likawonke-wonke. Amapawu amabalwa okuncoma (angomlomo nangokubhalwayo). Ulwazi ngokubika nangokubhalwa kweephethe. Ixabiso nokuziphatha ngokumesikweni.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo nokucoordinatha ekusebenziseni iinkqubo zezibonelelo zophuhliso lolwakhiwo lweenkonzo zamazi. Coordinatha iingxelo zeprojekthi, iindwendwe zasendaweni, nokuqinisekisa iiprojekthi zophuhliso lolwakhiwo lwamanzi.nika inkxaso yolawulo lweemali zeprojekthi, kuquka nokugcina amava eentswalo nokunceda ngamaxwebhu eemali ezinxulumene nolwakhiwo. Qaphela nokuhluza iindibano zeprojekthi ukuqinisekisa ukuba ukusebenza kuhambelana namacebo avunyiweyo, iinjongo, noko kufuneka kwenziwe. Phucula ulawulo kolondolozo ngokuchanekileyo kwamaxwebhu onke olwakhiwo-olunxulumene neprojekthi nokunxibelelwana nabaMasipala nabaBaLuli ukuqinisekisa ukugcina iirekhodi ngokuchanekileyo nokuyikhupha ngokulula ulwazi. qokelela ulwazi ngabantu abaswimali abayiziphambelela kumaxwebhu aqokelelweyo

jobs.title: Chief Security Officer
jobs.summary: Chief Security Officer role at the Department of Water and Sanitation in Gauteng, overseeing security operations, risk analysis, firearm compliance, and emergency procedures.
jobs.requirements: A relevant NQF level 4 (Senior/Grade) 12 Certificate. A valid Security Grade A PSIRA Certificate. National Diploma in Security Management will serve as an added advantage. A valid SAPS Firearm Competency for Rifle, Shotgun and Pistol. Three (3) years’ supervisory experience in the security environment. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Computer literacy and skills in MS Office Software package. Knowledge of prescribed security legislation e.g. MISS, Protection of Information Act, etc. Knowledge and experience of emergency procedures. Knowledge of Occupational Health and Safety. Sound knowledge in interpretation and application of security code of conduct, security legislations and directives. Good listing, communication, and interpersonal skills. Ability to interact with people at all levels and work in a team environment. Analytical thinking. Problem-solving and analysis. Ability to handle conflicts and excellent report writing skills. Work under pressure, willingness to travel throughout the Area Office and work extended hours.
jobs.duties: Implement security polices in line with relevant acts and national directives as determined. Monitor threats and risk analysis Ensure firearm regulation is implemented accordingly. Manage deployment and the functioning of security operations. Implement emergency contingency and procedures. Conduct site inspections on offices. Safeguard Departmental assets. Conducts investigations of security incidents and breaches. Liaise with National Intelligence Agency (NIA), South African Police Services (SAPS), other security agencies and DWS National Security Manager, Coordinate security awareness and training. Ensure the safe custody and protection of officials, assets and information through the implementation and adherence to the MISS/MPSS. Supervision of human resources. Manage and evaluate staff performance on an on-going basis. Manage private security service provider’s contracts. Provide operational and administrative assistance regarding security activities, forums, training, vetting, risk assessments and security reports. Conduct investigations where necessary.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Candidates may be required to complete a practical and theoretical test. Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofsekuriteitsbeampte
af.summary: Hoofsekuriteitsbeampte-rol by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Gauteng, wat toesien hou oor sekuriteitsbedrywighede, risiko-analise, vuurwapennakoming en noodgevalsprosedures.
af.requirements: 'n Relevante NQF level 4 (Senior/Grade) 12-sertifikaat. 'n Geldige Security Grade A PSIRA-sertifikaat. 'n Nasionale Diploma in Sekuriteitsbestuur sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. 'n Geldige SAPS-vuurwapenbevoegdheid vir geweer, haelgeweer en pistool. Drie (3) jaar se toesigervaring in die sekuriteitsomgewing. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurslisensie. Rekenaargeletterdheid en vaardighede in die MS Office-sagtewarepakket. Kennis van voorgeskrewe sekuriteitswetgewing bv. MISS, Protection of Information Act, ens. Kennis en ervaring van noodgevalsprosedures. Kennis van Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid. Deeglike kennis van interpretasie en toepassing van sekuriteitsgedragskode, sekuriteitswetgewing en riglyne. Goeie luister, kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Vermoë om met mense op alle vlakke te kommunikeer en in 'n spanomgewing te werk. Analitiese denke. Probleemoplossing en analise. Vermoë om konflik te hanteer en uitstekende verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Werk onder druk, bereidwilligheid om deur die Area Office te reis en oortyd te werk.
af.duties: Implementeer sekuriteitsbeleid in ooreenstemming met tersaaklike wette en nasionale riglyne soos bepaal. Monitor dreigemente en risiko-analise. Verseker dat vuurwapenregulasies dienooreenkomstig geïmplementeer word. Bestuur ontplooiing en die funksionering van sekuriteitsbedrywighede. Implementeer noodplanne en prosedures. Voer terreininspeksies op kantore uit. Beskerm departementele bates. Voer ondersoeke na sekuriteitsvoorvalle en -skendings uit. Skakel met National Intelligence Agency (NIA), South African Police Services (SAPS), ander sekuriteitsagentskappe en die DWS National Security Manager. Koördineer sekuriteitsbewustheid en -opleiding. Verseker die veilige bewaring en beskerming van amptenare, bates en inligting deur die implementering en nakoming van die MISS/MPSS. Toesig oor menslike hulpbronne. Bestuur en evalueer personeelprestasie op 'n deurlopende basis. Bestuur kontrakte van privaat sekuriteitsdiensverskaffers. Verskaf operasionele en administratiewe bystand aangaande sekuriteitsaktiwiteite, forums, opleiding, kieskeurigheidsondersoeke, risiko-assesserings en sekuriteitsverslae. Voer ondersoeke uit waar nodig.

zu.title: Inhloko Yesebe Lokuvikela
zu.summary: Isikhundla se-Inhloko Yesebe Lokuvikela e-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Gauteng, okuhloselwe ukuphatha izindlela zokuvikela, ukuhlaziya ingozi, ukuziphatha ngokwemithetho yezikhali, kanye nendlela zokuphathwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi esifanele esingu-NQF level 4 (Senior/Grade) 12. Isitifikedi se-Security Grade A PSIRA esivunyiwe. I-National Diploma in Security Management izoba yinentsika. Ukuziphatha ngokwemithetho kwe-SAPS Firearm Competency ngesibhamu segunya, isibhamu esincane nesibhamu esincane. Iminyaka yonke (3) yokuhlola abantu emkhakheni wokuvikela. Ukubhala ithuba lokushayela eliyingalo neliyinsimbi. Ulwazi lwegama nekhono ekusetshenzisweni kwesoftware ye-MS Office package. Ulwazi ngemithetho yokuvikela okuhlukaniswe njengokwalawulwa ngemithetho yezwe, okufana ne-MISS, Protection of Information Act, njll. Ulwazi nokuhlaziya izindlela zokuphathwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Ulwazi lwe-Occupational Health and Safety. Ulwazi oluzwake ekuphethweni nasekusebenziseni imithetho yokuvikela nokuqondiswa ngaphakathi. Amakhono okuzwa, okukhuluma, kanye nokuxhumana nabantu. Ikhono lokusebenza nabantu ngamazinga onke nokusebenza esigabeni. Ukucabanga ngesikhathi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuqhathanisa. Ikhono lokuphatha izinkinga nokubhala okuhle. Ukusebenza ngomzimba, ukuzithoba okuhle ukuzula emhlabeni jikelele esikhundleni sokuhlola ukuba uthole isikhathi eside nesincane.
zu.duties: Ukusebenzisa imithetho yokuvikela ngokuvumelana nemithetho ephathelene nemithetho yezwe ekubalulekile. Ukulawula ukutshengula ingozi nokuqhathanisa isidingo. Ukulandisa ukusetshenziswa kwemithetho yezikhali ngokwezinkomba. Ukuphatha ukwakhiwa kanye nokusebenza kokuvikela. Ukusebenzisa izindlela zokuqondisa izimo eziphuthumayo. Ukwenza ukubuyekeza izindlu zolawulo. Ukuvikela izimpahla zikamnyango. Ukuphenya izehloko ezinkomba ukuvikelwa nokudlula emthethweni. Ukuxhumanisa i-National Intelligence Agency (NIA), South African Police Services (SAPS), ezinye izinhlangano zokuvikela nomanjuba we-DWS National Security Manager, ukulawula ukwaziswa nokuhlolwa kokuvikela. Ukugcina nokuvikela izikhulu, izimpahla nolwazi ngokusebenzisa nokulandela i-MISS/MPSS. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuphatha nokuqhathanisa ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ngokokuqhubekayo. Ukuphatha izinkambiso zonakekelweziwenhlangano zokuvikela. Ukunikela ngosizo ekusebenzeni nasekubhalweni ngokuvikela, emihlanganweni, ekugadweni, ekuhlweni, ekwahluleleni ingozi kanye nemibhalo yokuvikela. Ukuphenya lapho kudingeka khona.

xh.title: Igunya eliphezulu loMlawuli woKhuseleko
xh.summary: Indima yoGunya eliphezulu loMlawuli woKhuseleko kwiSebe leManzi nokuQhuywa kwangaphakathi eGauteng, elibhekisa kumisebenzi yokhuseleko, uhlalutyo lobungozi, ukuvumelana nokusebenza ngokwesibini kweekhawu zomlilo, namanyathelo apho kubakho iingozi ezibhubhingayo.
xh.requirements: Iqinisekiso le-NQF level 4 (Senior/Grade) 12 elifanelekileyo. Iqinisekiso le-Security Grade A PSIRA elisebenzayo. I-National Diploma kwi-Security Management izakuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Ukuzinza ngokusebenza kwe-SAPS Firearm Competency nge-Rifle, i-Shotgun ne-Pistol. Amava eminyaka emithathu (3) yokuba ngumphathi kwimeko yokhuseleko. Icophulo lobutsha belayisensi yokushayela oluqinisekisiweyo olungaphelelanga lixesha. Ukuba nokwazi nokuqonda ikhompyutha nakhono kwisoftware ye-MS Office. Ulwazi ngemithetho yokhuseleko ecaiwayo njenge-MISS, i-Protection of Information Act, njl. Ulwazi namava ngamanyathelo apho kubakho iingozi. Ulwazi nge-Occupational Health and Safety. Ulwazi oluqinileyo lokutolika nokuqwalasela ikhowudi yokuziphatha komkhosi wokhuseleko, imithetho nokulawula ukhuseleko. Ukulalela kakuhle, nakhono bokunxibelelana nabantu nokuva izinkubo. Ikhono lokuchitha ngokutsha isimo ngengqondo. Ikhono lokusombulula iingxaki nohlalutyo. Ikhono lokuphatha iingxabano nokubhala iingxelo ngenkqubo. Ukusebenza ixesha elide, ukuvuma ukuhamba kuwo wonke amaphandle e-ofisi nakwindawo yokusebenza njengomanyano.
xh.duties: Ukuqhuba phambili iinkqubo zamapolisa okhuseleko ngokuvumelana ne-acts ezifanelekileyo nezikhokelo zabarhuluwe njengoko kumisiwe. Ukulawula iingozi nokwenza uhlalutyo lobungozi; Qinisekisa ukuba ukulawulwa kokusebenza ngokwesibini kwekhawu kunziqwenkisishwa ngendlela efanayo. Ukulawula ukubekwa kwabantu baye benze umsebenzi nokusebenza kwemisebenzi yokhuseleko. Ukusebenzisa amanyathelo angenisa isigqibo aza kwangaxeshanye namanyathelo anqamlezela iingozi. Ukwenza uqwalaselo lwamabanga kwiiofisi. Ukugcina izinto ezinobungozi zesebe. Ukuphanda ngemisebenzi ehle abayibangela abaqhubi nokusilela ukhuseleko. Unxibelelwano neNational Intelligence Agency (NIA), i-South African Police Services (SAPS), ezinye iiajensi zokhuseleko noMphathi webhuza lokhuseleko lwe-DWS. Ukulawula ulwazi ngokhuseleko nokulungiselela utitshala. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kakuhle nokhuselo lwabasebenzi, izinto ezinobungozi nolwazi ngokusebenzisa nokuzithoba kumanyathelo ama-MISS/MPSS. Ukulawula abantu abangabenzi baka-rhuluwe. Ukulawula nokulinganisela inkqubo yabasebenzi ngokwenza isicwangciso isahlaziya ixesha. Ukugcina nokulawula iinkqubo zabashiki besebe banika iinkonzo zokhuseleko. Ukunikela ngoluncedo lokuqhuba nokusebenza ngokusambekileyo ngakumbi ngemisebenzi yokhuseleko, iindawo zokulalela amanqaku, ukulungiselela ukutsha abasebenzi, i-vetting, ukulinganisela ubungozi kunye nokubhala iingxelo. Ukuphanda ngemisebenzi apho kufuneka khona.

Ensure publicity projects and events meet set objectives and expectations. Liaise with stakeholders to coordinate contributions to the newsletter. Establish and nurture strong stakeholder relations to support internal communications.

af.title: Kommunikasiebeampte
af.summary: Kommunikasiebeampte by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Bellville, wat 'n NQF-vlak 6-kwalifikasie en een jaar se kommunikasie-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike NQF-vlak 6-kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken in Kommunikasie. Een (1) jaar relevante ervaring in 'n kommunikasie-omgewing. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, nie-verstreke bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van kommunikasie en mediastudies. Dissiplinêre kennis in politieke wetenskap en beleide. Dissiplinêre kennis in publieke administrasie. Kennis van ontwerpbeginsels, tegnieke en gereedskap. Kennis van die skryfproses, hersiening en proeflees. Kennis en begrip van watersektorwetgewing, finansiële bestuur en PFMA. Kennis, tegnieke en prosedures vir die beplanning en uitvoering van operasies. Begrip van program- en projekbestuur. Kennis van verhoudingsbestuur. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Mens- en diversiteitsbestuur. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (sowel mondeling as skriftelik). Konflikbestuur, kreatiewe en kulturele bewustheid. Professionele ontwikkeling. Kliëntoriëntasie en klienstefokus. Stabiliteit en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Koördinering van departementele geleenthede. Ontwikkel en implementeer kommunikasieplanne ter ondersteuning van veldtogte. Ontleed departementele strategiese doelwitte en bely kommunikasie-pogings dienooreenkomstig. Beveel wysigings aan bestaande beleide aan om kommunikasie-effektiwiteit te verbeter. Raak betrokke by sleutelrolspelers om belyning en samewerking te verseker. Skep uitvoerbare planne om mediadekking van geleenthede en inisiatiewe te verkry. Verseker tydige en akkurate verspreiding van skriftelike en visuele kommunikasiemateriaal aan belanghebbendes. Opstel en stuur skriftelike uitnodigings aan belanghebbendes vir departementele geleenthede. Tree op as 'n sleuteldeelnemer in die Watersektor strategiese plan. Bystand in die opstel van die strategiese plan en begrotingsbestuur vir die kommunikasie-afdeling. Bou en handhaaf positiewe belanghebbende verhoudings. Verseder toepaslike plekke vir departementele geleenthede. Stel werknemers en belanghebbendes in kennis van geleentheidlokasies en besonderhede. Publiseer en versprei inligting met betrekking tot die geleenthede.: Bystand in die samestelling en handhawing van departementele gaslyste. Stuur uitnodigings onmiddellik aan relevante belanghebbendes. Handhaaf 'n opdatum gaslys in die departement se databasis. Hou departementele kalenders huidig en bely met beplande aktiwiteite. Skryf en stel artikels saam vir die departement se interne nuusbrief. Verskaf logistieke ondersteuning vir die kommunikasiekomponent. Verseker publisiteitsprojekte en geleenthede voldoen aan gestelde doelwitte en verwagtinge. Skakel met belanghebbendes om bydraes tot die nuusbrief te koördineer. Vestig en koester sterk belanghebbende verhoudings om interne kommunikasie te ondersteun.

zu.title: Inkantshelwa Yokuxhumana
zu.summary: Inkantshelwa Yokuxhumana e-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Bellville, edinga izifundo ezitholakalayo ezingeni le-NQF level 6 unyaka owodwa wokuhlolwa kokuxhumana.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esihambisanayo sezinga le-NQF level 6 njengoba sibonwa yi-SAQA kuleyokuxhumana. Unyaka (1) owodwa wokuhlolwa okuhambisanayo emhlabeni wokuxhumana. Ukwazisa ngelesihego lezimoto elisebenzayo elingenalo isikhathi esiphelelwe. Ulwazi ngokuxhumana nokuqoqwa kwezindaba. Ulwazi lwesifundo ngabezopolitiki nezinqubomgomo. Ulwazi lwesifundo ngabaphathi bomphakathi. Ulwazi ngemigomo yokuklama, izindlela nezixhobo. Ulwazi ngokuqoqwa, ukuhlola nokuhlola nokufunda ukulungiselela imibhalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemithetho yedraya lezulane, ukuphathwa kwezimali i-PFMA. Ulwazi ngemikhuba nezindlela zokuqamba nokwenza izinhlelo zokusebenza. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwezimibono. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuqoqa. Ukuphathwa kwabantu noluhluko. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana ngomlomo nangokubhala. Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga, ukwazisa ngamasiko nokukhanya. Ukuthuthuka ngobuchwepheshe. Ukuzinikela kumthengi nokugqamisa kumthengi. Ukuzinza ngokomoya kanye nokuziphatha ngokukhetha.
zu.duties: Ukuhlanganisa izenzakalo zomnyango. Ukuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze kusekelwe amakhasimendi. Ukuqoqa izinjongo zomnyango ezibalulekile zenhlelomumo kubahambisana nemizamo yokuxhumana. Ukuphakamisa izinguquko kulezinqubomgomo ezikhona ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kokuxhumana. Ukusebenza nomuntu abalulekile ukuze kuboniswe ukulungelelana nokusebenza ndawonye. Ukudala izinhlelo ezisebenzayo nokuqinisekisa isiqophiwo sezindaba ngezenzakalo nezinhloso. Ukuqinisekisa ukusatshalaliswa ngokusheshayo nokukunikelwa ukuxhumana okubhaliwe okubhaliwe. Ukubhala ukuthumela izimemo ezibhaliwe abathintekayo ngezenzakalo zomnyango. Ukusebenza njengomuntu osemgceni wokuqavula isikhathi kuqavule i-Water Sector. Ukusiza ukubumba isikhathi esibalulekile sokuhlela imali yokuxhumana. Ukuqinisa ukugcina izimibono ezinhle zomphakathi. Ukuzinza izindawo ezifanele izenzakalo zomnyango. Ukwazisa abasebenzi kanye nabalulekile ngendawo yezenzakalo nemininingwane. Ukushicilela nokuqoqa imininingwane ehlobene nezenzakalo.; Ukusiza ukuqoqa kugcine uhlu lwabangikhaya bomnyango. Ukuthumela izimemo kulabo ababalulekile ngokusheshayo. Ukugcina uhlu lwabangikhaya lubhalwe ngosuku ngekhompyutha yomnyango. Ukugcina amakhalenda omnyango abhalwe ngosuku ahambisane nemicimbe ehleliwe. Ukubhala ukuqoqa izindatshana ezincane ezingezansi ze-nyuzela yangaphakathi yomnyango. Ukunikeza ukusekelwa ngemidlalo yokuxhumana. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imiklamo yokushicilelwa kwezindaba noma izenzakalo ihambisana nezinhloso nezinkambu ezibekiwe. Ukuxhumana nalabo ababalulekile ukuqoqa iminikelo ezinhlokweni ze-nyuzela. Ukuqamba nokondla izimibono ezinamandla kubalulekile ukuze kusekelwe ukuxhumana ngaphakathi.

xh.title: Inkampani Yonxibelelwano
xh.summary: Inkampani Yonxibelelwano kwisebe Lamanzi nokuCoceza kwindawo ethi Bellville, kufuneka kunqanaba le-NQF level 6 kwaye kunyaka omnye wom精通ononjululwano wonxibelelwano.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo se-NQF level 6 njengoko sivunyiwe yi-SAQA kwinxibelelwano. Unyaka omnye (1) wamava afanelekileyo kwimeko yonxibelelwano. Inika inkcazelo ngelayisenisi yomqhubi egunjisiweyo engazange iphelelwe lixesha. Ulwazi kunxibelelwano nendlela yokufunda nezindlela zokwazisa. Ulwazi ngolwazi kwezopolitiko kunye neenkqubo. Ulwazi ngolwazi kulawulo loluntu. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zokwakha, iindlela nezixhobo. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yokuqamba ekuyibukeleni nokuqamba konxibelelwano. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemithetho yegumbi lamanzi, ulawulo lwemali kunye ne-PFMA. Ulwazi, iindlela kunye neenkqubo zocwangciso nokwenza imisebenzi. Ukuqonda ngolawulo lweenkqubo namaphulo. Ulwazi ngolawazi lunxibelelwano nabanye. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqhathanisa. Ukulawula abantu nolwahlukano. Amakhono amabalawulo onxibelelwano ngomlomo nakubhalwe. Ukulawula iingxabano, ukuqamba nokuqonda amasiko. Uphuhliso lwabasebenzi. Ukuqwalasela abathengi nogqwalaselo. Ukuzinikela ngokusesikweni.
xh.duties: Ukuhlanganisa amaxesha kwisebe. Ukwenza nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zonxibelelwano ukuxhasa iinkqubo. Ukuhlalutela iinjongo zocwangciso zesebe uze ulungelelanise amakhono onxibelelwano ngokweemfuno. Ukunikela ingcebiso ngeenguqu ezikwindalo yokuphucula ukusebenza kwonxibelelwano. Ukuthetha nabadlali abakhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulungelelwaniso nokusebenza kunye. Ukwenza iinkqubo ezisebenzayo ukuzigcinela indwendwe yamaxonawo ngamaxesha nemigcagciso. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthunyelwa ngexesha elifanelekileyo nangokuchanekileyo kweenkqubo ezibhaliweyo nezibonakalayo zonxibelelwano kubathathi nxaxheba. Ukubhala ukumemeza abathathi nxaxheba ababhalweyo ngamaxesha esebe. Ukuba ngumthathi-nxaxheba ophambili kwindima elawula amaxesha elisebe Lamanzi. Ukuncedisa ekubhalweni kocwangciso kunye nolawulo lwexeshu elilawula ulwazi, Ukuxhasa ukwakhiwa kwangaxeshu kubathathi nxaxheba abasebenzayo. Ukuzigcinela iindawo ezifanelekileyo zamaxeshu esebe. Ukuzisela abasebenzi nabathathi nxaxheba ngokumayela nendawo namaxesha. Ukupapasha ukusasaza ulwazi ngokumayela namaxesha.: Ukuncedisa ukuqamba nokugcina uluhlu lwabamhlayo basebe. Ukudlulisela imibuzo kwabathathi nxaxheba abalungeleleneyo ngexesha. Ukulungelelanisa uluhlu olutsha lwabamhlayo kulawulo lwesebe. Ukuzigcina ikhalenda esebe ihlaziweyo uze ulungelelanise nemisebenzi ecwangcisiweyo. Ukubhala ukuqamba iingxelo zamaphepha ezangaphakathi kwesebe. Ukunika inkxaso yokulawulwa kocwangciso. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba amaxesha namaxeshu athathe iinjongo ezicwangiweyo. Ukuxhumana nabathathi nxaxheba ukuze ulungelelanise ukunikela kwezinto kwizindaba zamaphepha. Ukwenza nokukhusela ulungelelwaniso olusebenzayo kubathathi nxaxheba ukuze kuxhaswe ukwaziswa okungaphakathi.

jobs.title: Personal Assistant
jobs.summary: Personal Assistant providing secretarial and receptionist support to senior management at the Department of Water and Sanitation in Bellville.
jobs.requirements: A Secretarial Diploma or equivalent qualification. Three (3) to five (5) years ‘experience in rendering a support service to Senior Management. Excellent computer literacy skills. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office suite. Good office management skills and knowledge of administrative procedures. Sound organisational skills. Good people skills. High level of reliability. Ability to act with tact and discretion. Ability to research and analyse documents and situations. Good grooming and presentation skills. Self-management and motivation. Knowledge of dispute resolution process. Knowledge of basic financial management. People and Diversity management. Problem solving and Analysis. The successful candidate must be highly reliable, self-motivated, flexible, creative, client and customer focused. Remains up to date regarding the prescripts, policies and procedures applicable to her / his work terrain to ensure efficient and effective support to the manager. Excellent communication skills (verbal and written). Good accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: Provide a secretarial / receptionist support service to the manager. Implement administrative procedures for the component. Receive telephone calls and visitors on behalf of the manager. Implement policies and procedures. Engage supplier regarding purchased materials. Develop implementation plan. Ensure that financial procedures are observed in the section. Compile monthly reports and present to the managers. Do early warning systems. Liaise with travel agencies to make travel arrangements for the DDG office. Arrange meetings and events for the manager and staff in the unit. Process all invoices that emanate from the activities of the work of the manager including the travel and subsistence claims for the unit. Draft routine correspondence and reports including records of basic minutes of the meetings of the manager where required. Administer matters like leave registers and telephone accounts and proper filing of documents. Receive, record and distribute all incoming and outgoing documents. Collect all relevant documents to enable the manager to prepare for meetings. Provide feedback on identified administrative gaps. Provide records on goods and services procured and handle all the procurement items for the office.

af.title: Persoonlike Assistent
af.summary: Persoonlike Assistent wat sekretariële en receptionisondersteuning aan senior bestuur by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Bellville verleen.
af.requirements: 'n Sekretariële Diploma of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in die lewer van 'n ondersteuningsdiens aan Senior Bestuur. Uitstekende rekenaargeletterdheidsvaardighede. Gevorderde vaardigheid in die Microsoft Office-suite. Goeie kantoorbestuursvaardighede en kennis van administratiewe prosedures. Degelike organisatoriese vaardighede. Goeie mensevaardighede. Hoë vlak van betroubaarheid. Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree. Vermoë om dokumente en situasies te ondersoek en te ontleed. Goeie versorging en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Selfbestuur en motivering. Kennis van geskilbeslegtingsproses. Kennis van basiese finansiële bestuur. Mense- en diversiteitsbestuur. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet hoogs betroubaar, selfgemotiveerd, buigsaam, kreatief, kliënt- en kusetergerig wees. Bly op hoogte van die voorskrifte, beleide en prosedures wat op haar / syns werkterrein van toepassing is om doeltreffende en effektiewe ondersteuning aan die bestuurder te verseker. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Goeie verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n sekretariële / receptionisondersteuningsdiens aan die bestuurder. Implementeer administratiewe prosedures vir die komponent. Neem telefoonoproepe en besoekers namens die bestuurder in ontvangs. Implementeer beleide en prosedures. Skakel met verskaffer aangaange aangeskafte materiaal. Ontwikkel implementeringsplan. Verseker dat finansiële prosedures in die afdeling nagekom word. Stel maandelikse verslae op en bied dit aan die bestuurders aan. Doen vroeë waarskuwingstelsels. Skakel met reisagentskappe om reëlings vir die DDG-kantoor te tref. Reël vergaderings en gebeurtenisse vir die bestuurder en personeel in die eenheid. Verwerk alle fakture wat voortspruit uit die aktiwiteite van die bestuurder se werk, insluitend die reis- en bestedingsaansprake vir die eenheid. Stel roetine-korrespondensie en verslae op, insluitend notule van basiese vergaderings van die bestuurder waar nodig. Administreer sake soos verlofregisters en telefoonrekenings en behoorlike indiening van dokumente. Neem alle inkomende en uitgaande dokumente in ontvangs, teken dit op en versprei dit. Versamel alle relevante dokumente om die bestuurder in staat te stel om vir vergaderings voor te berei. Verskaf terugvoer oor geïdentifiseerde administratiewe leemtes. Verskaf rekords van aangeskafte goedere en dienste en hanteer alle verkrygingsitems vir die kantoor.

zu.title: Umkelwe ohlomula umphathi
zu.summary: Umkelwe ohlomula umphathi ohlinzela ngeminikelo yokusekela kwezobunhloli nokwamukele abanye emphakathini ebelulekweni okuphezulu oMnyangweni wezaManzi nokuQeda izinkimbinkimbi eBellville.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi seDiploma sobuhloli noma iziqu ezingabalwa njengalo. Iminyaka eyintathu (3) kuye kwayisihlanu (5) yokusebenza ngokunika inkonzo yokusekela ebelulekweni okuphezulu. Ikhono elihle lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ukuzijwayeza ngokugqamile kuhlelo lwe-Microsoft Office. Ikhono elihle lokuphatha ihhovisi nolwazi mayelana nemikhuba yolawulo. Ikhono elihle lokuhlela. Ikhono elihle lokusebenza nabantu. Izinga eliphezulu lokwethembeka. Ikhono lokuziphatha ngobungcalu nangokubeka izinto endaweni yazo. Ikhono lokuphola futhi ukuhlaziya amafayela nezimo. Ikhono elihle lokuzigqokisa futhi nokuzethula. Ukuzilawula nokuzikhandla. Ulwazi lwenqubo yokuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi olusisekelo lokuqashwa kokubili. Ukulawula abantu nenhlobonhlobo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuzihlaziya. Kuyadingeka umuntu okhethwayo ethembekile kakhulu, azikhandle, abe uyikhaya lokucabanga, edala izinto, akhombise ukunaka abakufunayo kanye nabathengi. Kuhlale ezolwini ngemithetho, izinqubo nemiyalo ephathelene nendawo yakhe yokusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusekelwa okusebenza kahle nangempumelelo kumphathi. Ikhono elihle lokuxhumana (elisho nangokubhala). Ukuziphathela izinto kahle nokuqonda okuhle.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkonzo yokusekela ngobuhloli nakokwamukela abantu kumphathi. Phatha imikhuba yolawulo yeligumbi. Thola imibhalo yocingo nabavakashi ngalesibambe sekomphatha. Phatha izinqubo neziyalezo. Xhumana nabahlinzeki ngematerials abathengile. Linganisela iphulani yokuphumeza. Qinisekisa ukuthi imikhuba yokubhalisa imali ithotywa kulesigaba. Hlela imibiko yanyanga zonke futhi uyiveze kubaphathi. Yenza izinhlelo zokuqapha kusenesikhathi. Xhumana nabehhovisi bahamba abantu ukuze uhlele ukuhamba kwehhovisi likaDDG. Hlela izinkundla zemihlangano nezenzakalo komphathi kanye nabadluli balehhovisi ukhondle. Phatha zonke izikweletu ezitholakala ngemicimbi yomsebenzi komphathi okuhlanganisa izikweletu zokuhamba nokudla kwalehhovisi ukhondle. Bhala izinkulumo ezidumile futhi imibiko okuhlanganisa ukuqamba amaminithi wemihlangano yomphathi lapho kudingeka khona. Lawula izinto ezinjengokubhaliswa kwamavacashi nokubhaliswa kwesikweletu socingo nokulondolozwa kwemibhalwe kahle kwezinkomba. Thola, qamba ukubhaliswa futhi ukhiqize bonke imibhalwe ehamba ngenhlobo noma ebuya. Qedela imibhalwe edingekile ukuze umphathi akwazi ukuqasha izinto ngemihla. Nikeza umbiko ngokungabi khona kwezinto kumsebenzi wolawulo. Landa izinkomba ngemisho yokuthengiswa nezinkonzo futhi uphathe konke okuthengiswa ohhovisi.

xh.title: Umncedisi womntu
xh.summary: Umncedisi womntu onika inkxaso yababali-basekretari nabamkele abantu kubaphathi abaphezulu kwiSebe lamanzi nokuCocekwa kwindawo yeBellville.
xh.requirements: I-Diploma yasekretari okanye isifaniso sayo. Iiminyaka ezintathu (3) ukuya kwezintlanu (5) yamava kwinkxaso yenkonzo kubaphathi abaphezulu. Amakhono aphambili okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ubuchule obuphezulu kwiMicrosoft Office suite. Amakhono amahlebolulo lolawulo kwaye ulwazi lweendlela zolawulo. Amakhono amahle oluqulo. Amakhono amahle abantu. Inqanaba eliphezulu lokuthemba. Ikhono lokuziphatha ngokunesithembu nangasese. Ikhono lokuphanda nokuhlalutya amaxwebhu neemeko. Amakhono amahle okuzigqoka nokubonakalisa. Ukuzilawula nokuzikhuthaza. Ulwazi lwenkqubo yoxolelwanano ngexabiso. Ulwazi lwalawulo lemali olusisiseko. Ulawulo labantu nolwahlukahlukanabo. Ukuxazulula iingxaki noHlalo. Oyileweyo kufuneka athembeke kakhulu, azikhuthaze, abe nomzobo, adala, aqhelisise nakulixhaso labathengi nabakhuphi. Kufuneka ahlale usemva ngemigaqo, iinkqabo neendlela ezisebenza kwindawo yakhe yokusebenza ukuqinisekisa inkxako efanelekileyo nesebenzayo kumphathi. Amakhono aphambili okunxibelelwana (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo). Ukuzimisela okuhle nokuziphatha ngokusesikweni.
xh.duties: Nika inkxako yababali-basekri nabamkele abantu kumphathi. Sebenzisa iinkqabo zolawulo lolwahluho. Yamkela amacingo abantu nabashiyieli ngokomphathi. Sebenzisa iinkqabo neendlela. Nxibelelane nabanikezeli ngeeziqikizo ezithengiweyo. Yila icebo lokusebenzisa. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqabo zemali zihoywa kwicandelo. Hlazi ingxelo nyanga ngenyanga uzinike abaphathi. Yenza iinkqabo zokuqaliswa kwesilumkiso kwangaphambili. Nxibelelane nee-ajentsi zokuhambla ukuze ulungise iilungiselelo zokuhambla kolwabiwo lwe-DDG. Lungiselela iindibano neentsenzo kumphathi nabasebenzi kwicandelo. Qhuba onke amaNdivayisi ahamba kumisebenzi yomphathi kuquka neenkcazelo zokuhambla nokuhlala kwicandelo. Bhala iindaba zemigaqo neengxelo kuquka nokubhala iinqununu ezisisiseko zeendibano zomphathi apho kufuneka khona. Lawula izinto ezinjengamarejista obhala ii-akhawunti zocingo nokulungiselela ngokuchanekileyo amaxwebhu. Yamkela, uqophe waze usasaze onke amaxwebhu angena naphuma. Qokelela onke amaxwebhu ahambelanayo ukuze umphathi akwazi ukulungiselela iindibano. Nikela ingxelo ngamathuba olawulo athoniweyo. Nikela ngeerekhodi kweziqikizo neenkonzo ezithengiweyo uphathile nayo onke oovimba bakho basekhidden iofisi yakhe.

af.summary: Hulp met hidrologiese dataverwerking en veldwaarnemings by meetposte, wat 'n NQF-vlak 4-kwalifikasie en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Relevante NQF-vlak 4-kwalifikasie (met wiskunde/Wiskunde Geletterdheid/Fisiese Wetenskap). Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. zu.title: Onkosini Wezobuchwepheshe Osizayo

af.summary: Assistent-tegniese beamptes word by Worcester en George benodig om watermonsters te versamel, meetplekke te monitor en waterpeildata vir die Department of Water and Sanitation aan te teken.
af.requirements: NQF vlak 4 (Senior/Graad 12-sertifikaat) met Wiskunde/Wiskunde Geletterdheid/Fisiese Wetenskappe. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. af.duties: Roetebeplanning vir datapunte. Ligte onderhoud van meetdam/datamonitoringplek. Skoonmaak van plantegroei, skoonmaak van meetplaat, skoonmaak van kabinet, skoonmaak van obstructies uit die dam. Versamel watermonsters. Voltooi plekinspeksievorm. Neem meetplaat- en grondwaterpeilmeting. Laai data af van datalogger. Versamel verdampingsdata van waarnemers. Voer veldwaarnemings uit tydens hoëvloeitoestande. Versameling van waterkwaliteit-veldmetings. Werking en onderhoud van waterkwaliteitsmeetinstrumente. Onderhoud van bote en buiteboordmotors (werking van bote) Laai velddata af. Teken meetplaatmeting aan vir datavalideringsdoeleindes. Redigering van data - verifikasie van vloei in verhouding tot aangrensende datapunte en meetplaatmeting. Skrap rekords wat ongeldige data bevat. Pas datakurwe aan by meetplaatmeting. Vaslegging van veldmetings. Ontvang monsters met spesifieke toetsversoeke. Voorbereiding van laboratoriummonsters en materiaal (monsterbottels, etikette en filtreerpapier). Verifikasie en skoonmaak van laboratoriumglasware. Vaslegging van monsterinligting op die datasiestel. Bestuur van onderhoudsbenodighede en toerusting. Verskaf vorderingsverslae. Voer voorraadopname van laboratoriumverbruiksgoedere uit. Teken data en inligting aan volgens gehaltebestuursisteme (vorms). Leg hidrologiese (oppervlakwater-)data vas op die relevante databasisse en stelsels. Onderhou (redigeer) oppervlakwaterdatabasisse. Bestuur (lê) dokumente wat verband hou met oppervlakwaterdata en -stelsels. Onderhou die tegniese oppervlakwaterbiblioteek, argief en gedokumenteerde stelsels. Versprei oppervlakwaterdata op versoek aan bestuurders en kliënte. Bied hulp met die vaslegging van kalibrasie-inligting en die verwerking van sulke data.

Yenza amakhophi futhi wamukele uthumela ama-facsimiles. Sula amadokhumenti/amasendlulelo kubambiqwamba abahlukene njengoba kudingeka. Gcina futhi ulondoloze isistimu yokugcina amafayela esigaba. Bhala amagama kanye/noma eminye iminyuzo lapho kudingeka khona. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irejista lamadokhumenti ayingenayo naphumayo esigaba. Nika amasevisi okwesekela okuphathwa kwenhlangano yezinto esigaba. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irejista lokushiya kwabasebenzi esigaba. Gcina futhi ulondoloze izinkomba zabasebenzi esigaba. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irejista lobukhona esigaba. Hlela ukuhamba nendawo yokuhlala. Nika amasevisi okwesekela kolawulo lwezimali esigaba. Thwebule futhi buyekeze izindleko esigaba. Hlola ukulungile kwamaclaim okuhamba okunenselo nabasebenzi uwathumele kumphathi ukuze avunyiwe. Phatha ama-akhawunti efoni nemali encane esigaba.

xh.summary: Kufuneka isikhulu sengoqqibo ezMaminigqi eGqeberha ukunika inkxaso engomculo ophathwa ngesandla, ulawulo lokuxumana kunye nokubamba idatha kwiSebe leManzi kunye nezeMihlamba.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSinyathi/Klasi 12 okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi engomculo ophathwa ngesandla, iindlela zayo kunye nokuqonda ukubamba idatha nokuhlanganisa izibalo ezengowolawulo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngemikhumbulu. Ulwazi ngamakhaka alo msebenzi wezimali osemgangathweni osisiseko (SAP). Ulwazi ngendlela ezisebenzwa ngayo imisebenzi kwindawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi olusisiseko lokusombulula iingxaki nokuhlola. Amakhono amabalwela omanyano. Ukujolisa kumthengi kunye nokubeka umthengi phambili. Amandla okusebenza eqela kunye nokuiba namanxaxheba amabalwela ehlabathi.
xh.duties: Inika iinkxaso ezisisiseko ngomculo ophathwa ngesandla. Icregode, ihlele, igcine, ibambe idatha naphinde idanise iinkxwelo ezahlukeneyo. Ihlaziya irejista nezibalo. Iphatha imibuzo eqhelekileyo. Yenza amakhophi okutya kwaye yamkela okanye ithumele izixhobo zokudlulisela amaxabiso ezixhobo zamahambo. Yahlula amaxwebhu/ipayikiji kubahlali abahlukeneyo njengoko kufunekile. Igcina yondlula inkqubo yokugcina iifayile eli candelo. Ihinda iileta nezinye iinkxwelo ezingalunganga nje kuphela xa kuyimfuneko. Igcina inikwazi ukuvula kunye nokuvala okwamanje, neqhosha elithumela namaxwebhu phandle ukuya kwindawo ethile, kwaye elisebenzela kwelixa ukubaluleka kwelixa elithile ekuqwalaselweni kwelixa elilodwa.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk Production

Knowledge of clerical functions, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collate administrative statistics. Basic knowledge and insight of human resources prescripts. Knowledge of basic financial operating systems (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS etc). knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Knowledge of working procedures in terms of the working environment. Interpersonal relations. Flexibility. Teamwork. Basic knowledge of problem solving and analysis. People and Diversity Management. Client Orientation and Customer focus. Communication. Accountability and Ethical Conduct. Computer literacy. Planning and organizing. Language. Good verbal and written communication skills.
jobs.duties: Provides secretarial, receptionist and administrative support service to the Sub-Directorate. Receive telephone calls and messages for the Provincial Office and channel calls to relevant role players if needs be. Coordinate and arrange meetings all meetings and events of the office of the Corporate Support Services Sub-Directorate. Compilation and coordination of documents for the Sub-Directorete. Operate office equipment like photocopy machines. Laise with external and internal stakeholder. Render general clerical support services. Coordinate and arrange all meetings and events for the office of Sub- Directorate: Corporate Support Services. Collects all relevant information to enable Deputy Director: Corporate Support Services to prepare for the meetings. Record minutes for the management of the Sub- Directorate as and when required. Process and manage all travel management arrangements for the Sub-Directorate. Process all travel and subsistence claims and all invoices that emanates from the activities of the work of the Sub-Directorate. Receive and, record and distribute Provide supply chain management support services within the component. Provide personnel administration clerical support services within the component. Provide financial administration support services in the component.

af.title: Administrasieklerk Produksie
af.summary: Administrasieklerk wat sekretariële en administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Subdirektoraat by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Mmabatho verleen.
af.requirements: 'n Senior/Grade 12-sertifikaat of tersaaklike kwalifikasie. Kennis van klerklike funksies en praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en administratiewe statistiek saam te stel. Basiese kennis en insig van menslikehulpbronne voorskryfte. Kennis van basiese finansiële bedryfstelsels (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS ens). Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Kennis van werkprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Buigsaamheid. Spanwerk. Basiese kennis van probleemoplossing en analise. Mense- en diversiteitsbestuur. Kliëntgerigtheid en kundefokus. Kommunikasie. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Beplanning en organisering. Taal. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Verleen sekretariële, ontvangs- en administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste aan die Subdirektoraat. Neem telefoonoproepe en boodskappe vir die Provinsiale Kantoor aan en skakel oproepe na tersaaklike rolspelers deur indien nodig. Koördineer en reël alle vergaderings en gebeurtenisse van die kantoor van die Korporatiewe Ondersteuningsdienste Subdirektoraat. Samestelling en koördinering van dokumente vir die Subdirektoraat. Bedryf kantoortoerusting soos fotokopieermasjiene. Skakel met eksterne en interne belangehebbendes. Verleen algemene klerklike ondersteuningsdienste. Koördineer en reël alle vergaderings en gebeurtenisse vir die kantoor van Subdirektoraat: Korporatiewe Ondersteuningsdienste. Versamel alle tersaaklike inligting om die Adjunkdirekteur: Korporatiewe Ondersteuningsdienste in staat te stel om vir vergaderings voor te berei. Neem notule vir die bestuur van die Subdirektoraat soos en wanneer vereis. Verwerk en bestuur alle reisbestuurreëlings vir die Subdirektoraat. Verwerk alle reis- en bestaansvoorsieneise en alle fakture wat voortspruit uit die werkaktiwiteite van die Subdirektoraat. Ontvang, rekord en versprei. Verskaf voorsieningskettingbestuurondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent. Verskaf persoonlike administrasie klerklike ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent. Verskaf finansiële administrasieondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent.

zu.title: Clerk Wezokuphatheka Kokukhiqizwa
zu.summary: Clerk wezokuphatheka ohlinzeka ngokwesekela okuyimfihlo kanye nokwesekela ngokokuphatheka kwesub-directorate eMnyangeni Wamanzi Nokuhlanzeka oMmabatho.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Senior/Grade 12 noma iziqu ezifanele. Ulwazi ngezinkalo zocansi, izinqubo kanye nenhlelomsebenzi yokungenisa idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuhlanganisa izibalo zokuphatheka. Ukwazi okuyisisekelo nokuqonda imithetho yamaphoyisa abantu. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zomhlaba wangemali (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS njll). Ulwazi nokuqonda umthethosisekelo ohola kumnyango kahulumeni. Ulwazi lwezinqubo zokusebenza ngokohlelo lokusebenza. Izinto eziyizothando. Ukuguquguquka. Ukusebenza njengothimba. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo lokuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Ukuphathwa kwabantu namahlukahluko. Ukuqondiswe kwisethentesi nokuqondiswa kumthengi. Unxibelelwano. Ukuphathwa ngokubhekele kanye nokuziphatha ngokuzethemba. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukulungisa futhi uhlele. Ulimi. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhukuda anoxhoxho.
zu.duties: Ulinzeka ngokwesekela okuyimfihlo, okwamamotho bokumamukela kanye nokwesekela ngokokuphatheka kwesub-directorate. Ukumamukela amakhol efonu kanye nemilayezo yenhhovu esiyingxenye yegumbi elikhulu kwaye adlulise amakhol kolunye uhhafu abayidingayo kungakho okudingeka. Ukuhlela futhi uhlele kwaye yonke imihlangano nezehlakalo zenhhovu yesub-directorate eziphathe ngokulawulwa okusekela i-corporate support services. Ukulungiselela futhi uhlele uxwebhu lwesub-directorate. Ukusebenzisa izinto zenhhovu ezinjengemishini yokutshekisa. Ukudibanisa nabantu abangenaphandle nangaphakathi. Ukunika ulutsha lwemisebenzi yocansi. Ukuhlela futhi uhlele yonke imihlangano nezehlakalo zenhhovu yesub-directorate: Corporate Support Services. Ukuqoqa yonke imininingwane ebalulekile ukuvumela i-Deputy Director: Corporate Support Services ukuba azilungisele imihlangano. Ukubhala imizuzu yokuphathwa kwesu-directorate lapho kudingeka khona. Ukulungiselela futhi uphathe konke okuphathelene nokuhamba kwe-sub-directorate. Ukulungiselela yonke imiklamo yokuhamba nokuzinza kanye nezikhadana ezivela emisebenzini yesub-directorate. Ukumamukela, ukubhala nokuhambisa ngokunika ngesekela kwezokuphathwa komchabela wokulethwa kwakunye nokulethelwa kwezinsizakuxhumano. Ukunika ngesekela kwabasebenzi abayincwadi yezocansi ngaphakathi kwebalazwe. Ukunika ngesekela ngokuphatheka kwemali ngaphakathi kwebalazwe.

xh.title: Mncedisi Wezolawulo Production
xh.summary: Mncedisi wezolawulo onika inkxaso engasese yolawulo kwelasebe elingaphantsi kwe-Sub-Directorate kwiSebe leZamanzi nokuQhukambisa eMmabatho.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Senior/Grade 12 okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yoluleko, iindlela zayo nokwazi ukuqokelela iidata, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqokelela iistatistics zolawulo. Ulwazi olusisiseko nokuqonda ngemigaqo yamandla abantu. Ulwazi ngemithetho yemali esisiseko (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS njl). Ulwazi nokuqonda kwesakhiwo semithetho esilawula iNkonzo kaRhulumente. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zokusebenza ngokommandla wokusingqongileyo lokusebenza. Uqhagamshelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ukuguquguquka. Ukusebenza njengeqela. Ulwazi olusisiseko lokusombulula iingxaki nokuhlaziya. Ukulawula abantu nokuLawula Uhlubo. Uqhelaniso nakuxhaso lwabathengi. Unxibelelwano. Ixanduva nokuPhatheka ngendlela ethe nkqo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Uqalelo lokuCwangcisa. Ulwimi. Amakhono amabalise aphakathi kwaye abhalwe phantsi okunxibelelwano.
xh.duties: Inika inkxaso engasese yoluleko nolawulo kwi-Sub-Directorate. Yamkela amangxwebe kunye nemiyalezo ye-Provincial Office kwaye uqhube amangxwebe kumalunga afanelekileyo ukuba kuyimfuneko. Lolungelelanise aze ahlele onke amanyulwe nemimiselo kwindlu yenkokhelo ye-Sub-Directorate ye-Corporate Support Services. Ukuqokelela nokuqamba amaxwebhu e-Sub-Directorate. Usebenzisa izixhobo zofice njengemishini yekopi. Unxibelelana nabaqhelanisi baphandle nangaphakathi. Unika iinkonzo zoluleko jikelele. Lolungelelanise aze ahlele onke amanyulwe nemimiselo yendlu yenkokhelo ye-Sub-Directorate: Corporate Support Services. Uqokelela yonke inkcazelo efunekayo ukuvumela uMongameli oNgunyi: Corporate Support Services ukuba alungiselele amanyulwe. Igxiba imizuzu yokulawulo ye-Sub-Directorate njengoko kufuneka. Yaqhuba kwaye ilawule onke amalungelelwanwo okuhamba e-Sub-Directorate. Yaqhuba onke amaqhalo okuhamba nokuzinza yonke iinkoliso evela kumisebenzi ye-Sub-Directorate. Yamkela, aze abreke aze ahlakazele inkonzo yoxhaso lwe-supply chain management ngaphakathi kwecandelo. Inika inkxabo yoluleko yolawulo labantu ngaphakathi kwecandelo. Inika inkxaso yolawulo lwemali ngaphakathi kwecandelo.

jobs.title: General Foreman
jobs.centre: Worcester Ref No: 301026/46 George Ref No: 301026/47
jobs.summary: Supervise and implement routine and structural maintenance activities at water gauging stations, requiring a Grade 8 certificate and one to two years of civil maintenance experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 8 certificate. One (1) to two (2) years relevant experience in general work of Civil maintenance. The disclosure of a valid unexpired drivers license. Knowledge and experience in building and construction. Good communication skills, Computer literacy. Knowledge in controlling and managing bulk water supply maintenance on equipment. Knowledge in policy implementation. Knowledge of supervising personnel & equipment. Disciplinary knowledge of Occupational Health and Safety. Disciplinary knowledge of public administration. Knowledge of supporting water utilization & water resource strategy. Understanding of government legislation. Ability to work in a team. Must be punctual, productive, and loyal. Must be able to work in or near rivers, dams, and canals. The incumbent will work away from the office for extended periods of time. He must be willing to travel in the execution of his duties.
jobs.duties: Supervise and mentor subordinates. Transport subordinates to and from sites to Implement planned routine maintenance activities (painting, weed control, etc.) at gauging stations (river, canals, dams, evaporation stations, estuaries.). Implement planned structural maintenance activities (replacements of steel components, etc.) at gauging stations (river, canals, dams, evaporation stations, estuaries.). Implement refurbishment projects at gauging stations (rivers, canals). Conduct inspections according to set standards. Construction of gauging weirs and infrastructure. Assist with technical and special tasks (Instrument installations and flood monitoring) as and when requested. Implement general maintenance and housekeeping of camping facilities. Ensure that machinery, equipment, tools and goods are maintained and looked after. Clear and maintain access roads to gauging points. Dever damaged equipment to supervisor. Perform general maintenance. Keep job cards up to date. Perform basic risk assessments at gauging stations before work commences. Comply with Occupational Health and Safety Act and all related safety regulations. Report faults, defects, and safety hazards to supervisor promptly.

af.title: Algemene Voorman
af.summary: Toesig hou oor en implementeer roetine- en strukturele instandhoudingsaktiwiteite by watermeetstasies, wat 'n Graad 8-sertifikaat en een tot twee jaar se siviele instandhoudingservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 8-sertifikaat. Een (1) tot twee (2) jaar se relevante ervaring in algemene werk van siviele instandhouding. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurslisensie. Kennis en ervaring in bou en konstruksie. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede, rekenaarvaardigheid. Kennis van die beheer en bestuur van massa watervoorsieninginstandhouding aan toerusting. Kennis van beleidsimplementering. Kennis van die toesig hou oor personeel en toerusting. Dissiplinêre kennis van Arbeidsgesondheid en Veiligheid. Dissiplinêre kennis van publieke administrasie. Kennis van die ondersteuning van waterbenutting- en waterhulpbronstrategie. Begrip van regeringswetgewing. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk. Moet stip, produktief en lojaal wees. Moet in staat wees om in of naby riviere, damme en kanale te werk. Die ampsdraer sal vir lang tydperke weg van die kantoor af werk. Hy moet bereid wees om te reis in die uitvoering van sy pligte.
af.duties: Toesig hou oor en onderrig ondergeskiktes. Vervoer ondergeskiktes na en van werkspersele om beplande roetine-instandhoudingsaktiwiteite (verf, onkruidbeheer, ens.) by meetstasies (rivier, kanale, damme, verdampingstasies, mondgate) te implementeer. Implementeer beplande strukturele instandhoudingsaktiwiteite (vervanging van staalkomponente, ens.) by meetstasies (rivier, kanale, damme, verdampingstasies, mondgate). Implementeer opknappingsprojekte by meetstasies (riviere, kanale). Voer inspeksies volgens vasgestelde standaarde uit. Konstruksie van meetdamwalle en infrastruktuur. Bystand met tegniese en spesiale take (instrumentinstallasies en vloedmonitorering) soos wanneer versoek. Implementeer algemene instandhouding en huisvesting van kampeergeriewe. Verseker dat masjinerie, toerusting, gereedskap en goedere in stand gehou en versorg word. Hou toegangspaaie na meetpunte oop en in stand. Lewer beskadigde toerusting aan toesighouer. Voer algemene instandhouding uit. Hou werkkaarte op datum. Voer basiese risiko-assessmente by meetstasies uit voordat werk begin. Voldoen aan die Wet op Arbeidsgesondheid en Veiligheid en alle verwante veiligheidsregulasies. Rapporteer foute, gebreke en veiligheidsgevaar onmiddellik aan toesighouer.

zu.title: Induna ejwayelekile
zu.summary: Qaphaza futhi ufake ezinye izindlela zokulondoloza ezijwayelekile nezakhiwo eziteshini zokulinga amanzi, kudingeka isitifiketi se-Grade 8 nokuthole ukuthobela emsebenzini wokulondoloza izakhiwo zesithuthukisi komuntu siqu.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 8. Okungenye (1) kuya kokubili (2) unyaka wokutholwa komsebenzi wokulondoloza izakhiwo. Ukuzivula ngephasiyethhi echanekileko engajwayelekile yesehloko sokudubula. Amakhono nemfundo kumsebenzi wokwakha nokuhlanganisa. Amakhono okuxhumana aluhlaza kumakhompyutha. Ulwazi ekulawuleni nasekuphatheni ukulondoloza kwezobisi kumanothi obandl. Ulwazi ekusebenziseni izinqubomgomo. Ulwazi ekuqaphazeni abantu nezinto zomsebenzi. Ulwazi ngamakhono oMgomo Wokuvikeleka Ngemisebenzi Nokuqinisekiswa Kwezempilo. Ulwazi ngamakhono oMgomo Wezenhlalakuhle Yanamuhla. Ulwazi osekeleni imigomo yoku kusetshenziswa kwamanzi nemithombo yamanzi. Ukuqonda ngezomthetho kahulumeni. Ukukwazi ukusebenza esixazanweni. Kudingeka abe nehlonipha isikhathi, akhiqize futhi aze ahanise. Kudingeka akwazi ukusebenza eduze noma esibhakabhakeni samanzi, emigqeni nasezibhayinini. Lowo ohlotshanwe kulo uzosebenza kude nekhaya isikhathi eside. Kudingeka afune ukuhamba phakathi nokwenza imisebenzi yakhe.
zu.duties: Qaphaza futhi ulule abantu abakusekelweni. Hambisa abantu abakusekelweni ukuze bafike futhi bathathe ema webhusela azenzakalayo ukulondoloza (ukugcoba, ukulawula udoti, njl.) eziteshini zokulinga amanzi (emlanjeni, ezibhayinini, emanzini amakhulu, eziteshini zokuqhuba amanzi, emagunyazini). Faka imisebenzi yokulondoloza izakhiwo (okufana nokushintsha izingxenye zensimbi, njl.) eziteshini zokulinga amanzi (emlanjeni, ezibhayinini, emanzini amakhulu, eziteshini zokuqhuba amanzi, emagunyazini). Faka imiklamo yokuvuselela eziteshini zokulinga amanzi (emlanjeni, ezibhayinini). Yenza ukuhlola ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso. Ukwakhiwa kweziteshini zokulinga namaxhaxha ezinto. Siza ngemisebenzi yobuchwepheshe nezinketho ezikhethekile (ukufaka izinkombandlela nokubheka amanzi ajiyile) lapho kucelwa khona. Faka ukulondoloza okujwayelekile kanye nokulondoloza izindawo zokulala. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinto zomsebenzi, izikhali, amathuluzi kanye nezimpahla zigcinwa futhi zibhekwe kahle. Sula futhi ulondoloze izindlela ezihamba ezinqoleni zokulinga amanzi. Bika ngemishini esonakele kumlawuli wakho. Yenza imisebenzi yokulondoloza okujwayelekile. Gcina amakhadi emisebenzi abe sesimweni. Yenza ukulingisiswa okulula kwezengozi eziteshini zokulinga amansi ngaphambi kokuba umsebenzi uqale. Landela umthetho Wokuqinisekiswa Kwesikhathi Sezempilo Nezomthetho Wokuphepha Onke Izinhlelo. Bika ngoswayo, izono, kanye nezingozi zokuphepha kumlawuli ngokushesha.

xh.title: I-Foreman Jikelele
xh.summary: Lawula kwaye usebenzise imisebenzi yonq维护otho eqhelekileyo kunye nolwakhiwo kumajelo amanzi okulinganisa, efunisa isatifikethi se-Grade 8 kunye nexesha elithatha elinye ukuya kweli-2 leminyaka yamava egunyazisiweyo kumsebenzi we-civil maintenance.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Grade 8. Elinye (1) ukuya kweli-(2) lamashumi amabali amnyaka amava ahambelanayo kumsebenzi jikelele we-civil maintenance. Ukutyhila ilayisenesi yokuqhuba evumelekileyo engaze iphindle. Ulwazi kunye namava kulwakhiwo nokuqalwa kwezinto. Iziqu ezinxibelelanayo ezikumgangatho ophezulu; ulwazi ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi lokulawula nokuqonda ukugcinwa kwamanzi amaninzi kwizixhobo. Ulwazi malunga nokusebenzisa iinkqubom-phambiso. Ulwazi lokulawula abantu nezixhobo. Ulwazi lwesigaba ngokhuseleko lwe-msebenzi kunye nempilo. Ulwazi olubhekisa kumaphethelo olawu. Ukuba nolwazi ngokusika kwiqela. Ukubakho nako ukusebenza ngexesha elithize. Imfuneko ingekho macala onke. Iya kubakho imfuneko yokuba ngumntu othembekileyo kwaye ungacingelanga nanto ngokwakhe. Kuya kufuneka akwazi ukusebenza emlanjeni nasemzileni. Kufuneka afunde izindaba ezilungileyo nokuziphatha okuhle. Kufuneka agcine ukuba mfundi ongaze agqibe kwi-post yodwa.
xh.duties: Lawula kwaye ulandele abasebenzi abangaphantsi kwakho. Thutha abasebenzi abangaphantsi kwakho ukuya kwendawo yokusebenza nasekubuyeni ukuyenzela imisebenzi yokulungisa eqhelekileyo (okwepeyinti, ukulawula utyiya, nj.) kumajelo okulinganisa (umlambo, amajelo, iindam, iziko elinganisa ukutsha, ii-estuaries.). Yenza imisebenzi yokulungisa ulwakhiwo (ukutshintsha izixhobo zentsimbi, nj.) kumajelo okulinganisa (umlambo, amajelo, iindam, iziko elinganisa ukutsha, ii-estuaries.). Yenza amaprojekthi okulungisa kunye nophuhliso kumajelo okulinganisa (iimirha, amajelo. Yenza iindinganiso ngokwemigangatho echaziweyo. Ukwakhiwa kwezixhobo zokulinganisa kwaye zibe ngokulandelelanayo. Nceda nangemisebenzi yezobuqeqesho nokwenziwa ngaphandle (ukufakwa kwezixhobo ukulawula imigede) xa kusetyenziswa. Yenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo yokuqonda nokulawula ii-camping. Qinisekisa ukuba izixhobo, iimpahla kunye nezixhobo ziyagcinwa. Susa kwaye ugcine iindlela zokuya kumajelo. Linganisa izixhobo ezonakalisiweyo kwaye uze kumlawuli. Yenza imisebenzi yokulungisa eqhelekileyo. Gcina iinkcazelo zomsebenzi zihlaziyiwe. Yenza iqondo lokulinganisa iingozi kumajelo okulinganisa phambi kokuba umsebenzi qalise. Landela umthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act nayo yonke imigaqo yokhuseleko. Iixela iingxaki, iimposiso, kunye neengozi ezikhoyo. Kwaye iixela ngokukhawuleza.

jobs.title: Maintenance Vehicle Operator
jobs.summary: Operate light and heavy motor vehicles and construction machinery during maintenance at hydrological infrastructure in Worcester, requiring a Grade 12 certificate and valid heavy-vehicle driver's licence with PDP.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 4 (Senior/Grade 12 certificate. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license Code EC1 or relevant to driver’s license with PDP. Certified competency/operating certificate for relevant heavy plant/machinery. At least five (5) years’ experience in driving HMV’s and operating heavy equipment. Knowledge of driving services. Knowledge of operating services. Knowledge of organisational policies and procedures. Knowledge in process flow. Basic knowledge of technical services. Knowledge of organizational and government structures. Knowledge of procedures and processes. Knowledge of government regulations, practice notes, circulars, and policy frameworks. Delegation authority. Financial management and knowledge of PFMA. Client Orientation and customer focus. Communication skills. Accountability and ethical conduct. Knowledge of analytical procedures. Knowledge of library science.
jobs.duties: Operation of light and heavy motor vehicles and construction machinery during maintenance at hydrological infrastructure. Keep record of logbooks, implement best practices of driving services, analyses logistics operations, delivery and collection of passengers, packages, documents and small volume supplies and construction material, maintenance of register regarding deliveries and pickups. General maintenance of light/ heavy motor vehicles. Check records of vehicles to be serviced every month, formulate procedures on issuing vehicles, function in accordance with applicable transport policy requirements, routine maintenance of vehicles, routine inspection for visible defects around the exterior of the vehicle. Maintenance of light/heavy motor vehicles/construction machinery. Recording of fuel and fluid levels and operations of vehicles. Storage of light/heavy motor vehicles/construction machinery. Ensure vehicles are kept safe, ensure hazards are cleared where vehicles are parked, ensure that vehicles are parked and issued according to government legislation.
