af.title: Onderhoudsvoertuigoperateur
af.summary: Bestuur ligte en swaar motorvoertuie en konstruksiemasjinerie tydens onderhoud aan hidrologiese infrastruktuur in Worcester, wat 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n geldige swaarvoertuigbestuurderslisensie met PDP vereis.
af.requirements: An NQF level 4 (Senior/Grade 12 certificate. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie Code EC1 of tersaaklike bestuurderslisensie met PDP. Gesertifiseerde bevoegdheids-/bedryfsertifikaat vir tersaaklike swaar aanleg/masjinerie. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in die bestuur van HMV's en die bedryf van swaar toerusting. Kennis van bestuursdienste. Kennis van bedryfsdienste. Kennis van organisatoriese beleide en prosedures. Kennis van prosesvloei. Basiese kennis van tegniese dienste. Kennis van organisatoriese en regeringsstrukture. Kennis van prosedures en prosesse. Kennis van regulasies, praktyknotas, sirkulaires en beleidsraamwerke van die regering. Delegeringsgesag. Finansiële bestuur en kennis van PFMA. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Kommunikasievaardighede. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag. Kennis van analitiese prosedures. Kennis van biblioteekwetenskap.
af.duties: Bedryf van ligte en swaar motorvoertuie en konstruksiemasjinerie tydens onderhoud aan hidrologiese infrastruktuur. Hou rekord van logboeke, implementeer best practice van bestuursdienste, ontleed logistieke bedrywighede, aflewer en versamel passasiers, pakkette, dokumente en klein volume voorrade en konstruksiemateriaal, onderhou register aangaande aflewerings en afhalings. Algemene onderhoud van ligte/swaar motorvoertuie. Kontroleer rekords van voertuie wat elke maand gediens moet word, formuleer prosedures vir die uitreiking van voertuie, funksioneer in ooreenstemming met toepaslike vervoerbeleidvereistes, roetine-onderhoud van voertuie, roetine-inspeksie vir sigbare defekte rondom die buitekant van die voertuig. Onderhoud van ligte/swaar motorvoertuie/konstruksiemasjinerie. Opteken van brandstof- en vloeistofvlakke en bedrywighede van voertuie. Berging van ligte/swaar motorvoertuie/konstruksiemasjinerie. Verseker dat voertuie veilig gehou word, verseker dat gevare waar voertuie geparkeer is, uit die weg geruim word, verseker dat voertuie geparkeer en uitgereik word volgens regeringswetgewing.

zu.title: Umuntu Oshayela Izimoto Zokulungisa
zu.summary: Ukuphatha izimoto ezihlokadlake nenkulu kanye namashidi wezokwakha ngesikhathi senkonzo yokulungisa emifuhlweni yamanzi e-Worcester, idinga isetifiketi sama-Grade 12 nelayisensi yokushayela inqwaba enkulu nephephile.
zu.requirements: Uqeqe lweNQF izinga 4 (Isetifiketi sama-Senior/Grade 12. Ukubeka phambilini isitifiketi sokushayela esingasebenzi na sekhodi EC1 noma uma kunendatshi ngokushe­kelwa esihanjweni sokushayela. Isetifiketi sokusebenza esiqinisekisiwe sokushayela inqwaba enkulu. Okungenani iminyaka eyisikhombisa (5) yokushayela i-HMV. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokushayela. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokuphatha. Ulwazi ngezinqubo zomnyango. Ulwazi ngomgqamo wemisebenzi yobuciko. Ulwazi ngomkhakha kahulumeni nemithetho. Ulwazi ngemithetho nangokuhamba komgwaqo. Ulwazi ngomgwaqo kahulumeni wakwa-Ningizimu Afrika. Ulwazi ngamalungelo abantu abakhubazeke kakhulu.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha izimoto ezihlokadlake nenkulu kanye namashidi wezokwakha ngesikhathi senkonzo yokulungisa emifuhlweni yamanzi. Ugqamula imibhalo yamabhuku ohambo, ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwezinsizakalo zokushayela, ukuhlaziya imisebenzi yamazwe, ukulethwa nokubuyiswa abahambayo, amaphakishi, imibhalo kanye nezipho ezingakhula kakhulu nezinto zokwakha, ukugcina umgqamulo ngemikhozo yokuletha nokuthatha. Ukulungisa ngokujwayelekile izimoto ezihlokadlake nenkulu. Ukuhlola imibhalo yezimoto okufanele zilungiswe njalo minyanye yonke, ukwakhela izindlela zokupha izimoto, ukusebenza ngokwemiyalo yokuthutha, ukulungisa izimoto ngokujwayelekile, ukuhlola ngokujwayelekile ukuba kungekho kona okubonakala ngaphandle kwemoto. Ukulungisa izimoto ezihlokadlake nenkulu namashidi wezokwakha. Ukubhala inani laphethini namanani wamanisi kanye nokusetshenziswa kwemoto. Ukugcina izimoto ezihlokadlake nenkulu namashidi wezokwakha. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba izimoto zigon­diwe ngokuphephile, ukuqinisekisa ukuba kungekho kona okuyingozi lapho izimoto zibekwa khona, ukuqinisekisa ukuba izimoto zibekwe futhi ziphiwe ngokwemithetho kahulumeni.

xh.title: Umlawuli Wezithuthi Zokonakalisa
xh.summary: Kusebenzisa izithuthi ezinzima nezikhanya kunye nemishini yokuakha ngexesha lokonakalisa kumaziko anamanzi eWorcester, kufuneka ifom yeGreyidi 12 nelayisensi esemthethweni yokushayela izithuthi ezinzima enePDP.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba le-NQF level 4 (Isatifikethi se-Senior/Grade 12. Ukuvezwa kolayisensi esemthethweni engaze iphelelwe yisikhathi yekhowudi EC1 okanye efanayo nelayisensi yomshayeli ene-PDP. Isatifikethi sokuzinza esiqinisekisiweyo sokusebenza kwemishini/izityhantyebhu ezinzima. Ubuncinane ihlobo elithatha (5) iminyaka yokugcinwa kwamava ekushayela i-HMV's nasekusebenziseni izixhobo ezinzima. Ulwazi ngamakhonkco okushayela. Ulwazi ngamakhonkco okusebenza. Ulwazi ngeenqobo zecebengongoma nezinkqubo zalo. Ulwazi kumaziko asebenzayo. Ulwazi olusisiseko lwezikhonzo ezibuchule. Ulwazi ngeenkonzo ezingqongqo zoluntu norhulumente. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo namaziko. Ulwazi ngomthetho worhulumente, iimemo zokusebenza, iintlobo zamagazathi, nangohlaka lweenqobo. Igunya lokumela abanye. Ukuqondisa kweemali nolwazi nge-PFMA. Ukumiselwa kumthengi nokuzinika kumthengi. Amandla okunxibelelana. Ixabiso lokubamba inxaxheba nokuziphatha ngokungenisa pateni. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zohlalutyo. Ulwazi ngesayensi yolugcinwa lwamabhuku.
xh.duties: Ukusebenza kwezithuthi ezikhanya nezinzima kunye nemishini yokuakha ngexesha lokonakalisa kumaziko anamanzi. Ugcinho lmabali womshayelo, ukuphumeza izinto ezilona alona qhinga lamakhonkco okushayela, uhlalutyo lwezinto eziphathekayo ekubeni umva, ukulethwa nokubuyiswa kooyakuthwala, kubaphathiweyo, kubalu, ngeempahla ezincinci kwaye nalwakhiwo, ukulondoloza ukubhaliswa kwinto ngeento ezithunyelwa nokuvela ngayo. Ukulondoloza ngokubanzi izithuthi ezikhanya/ ezinzima. Ukuqwalasela okubhalisiweyo kwezithuthi ezikufuneka zinkonze ekuhleni ngamnye, ukubumba iinkqubo ngokunikwa kwesithuthi, ukusebenza ngokuhambisana neemfuno zenqobo yamanyathelo etransport, ukulondoloza iinkqubo zethuthi, ukupenda rhoqo nje iimpawu ezibonakalayo ngaphandle kwethuthi. Ukulondoloza izithuthi ezikhanya/ezinzima/ imishini yokuakha. Ukubhala igazi kwemoto neetsimbi kwiinkqaba ezingaphantsi nangaphezulu kwezithuthi. Ukugcina izithuthi ezikhanya/ezinzima/imishini yokuakha. Ukwenza iziqinisekiso sokuba izithuthi zigcinwe zikho, kwilifa elingenayo iindorbe phezu koko kubekho izinto ezingayinzi meko nazingozi kwizithuthi, ngenkatha iindwangube zikwibini elihamba phantsi komthetho karhulumente.

jobs.centre: Worcester 3 Ref No: 301026/49 George 3 Ref No: 301026/50
jobs.summary: General workers needed at Worcester and George to perform maintenance activities at gauging stations using hand and power tools.

Knowledge of the pruning and trimming process and techniques. Knowledge of chemical use (dilution/mix) and chemical product knowledge. Knowledge of daily maintenance procedures for efficient machine/equipment performance. Basic knowledge in supporting water utilization and water resource strategy. Knowledge of health and safety procedures. Knowledge of garden maintenance and planting practices. Communication skills and ability to work in a team. Must be punctual, productive, and loyal. Must be able to work in or near rivers, dams, and canals. Must be willing to travel in the execution of his duties on a continuous basis.

Perform maintenance activities on the premises when required to do so. Maintenance of embankments at gauging structures by stabilizing and clearing of vegetation. Clear and maintain access roads, refurbishment of gauging stations (rivers, canals) using hand and power tools. Construction of gauging weirs and infrastructure. Assist with technical and special tasks (Instrument installations and flood monitoring) as and when requested. General maintenance and housekeeping of camping facilities. Maintain and take care of machinery, equipment, tools and goods. Load and offload equipment and materials. Comply with Occupational Health and Safety Act and all related safety regulations. Report faults, defects, and safety hazards to supervisor promptly. The incumbent will work away from the office (in the field) for extended periods of time. Must be able to work in or near rivers, dams, and canals.

af.title: Algemene Werknemer
af.summary: Algemene werkers nodig by Worcester en George om instandhoudingsaktiwiteite by meetstasies uit te voer met behulp van hand- en kraggereedskap.
af.requirements: 'n ABET-sertifikaat. Een (1) tot twee (2) jaar relevante ervaring sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis van tuinmaaktoerusting en apparate. Kennis van grasonderhoudsprosesse. Kennis van die snoei- en snyproses en tegnieke. Kennis van chemikalieëgebruik (verdunning/meng) en kennis van chemiese produkte. Kennis van daaglikse instandhoudingsprosedures vir doeltreffende masjien/toerustingsprestasie. Basiese kennis van die ondersteuning van waterbenutting en waterhulpbronstrategie. Kennis van gesondheids- en veiligheidsprosedures. Kennis van tuinonderhoud en plantpraktyke. Kommunikasievaardighede en vermoë om in 'n span te werk. Moet stiptelik, produktief en lojaal wees. Moet in staat wees om in of naby riviere, damme en kanale te werk. Moet bereid wees om voortdurend te reis terwyl hy sy pligte uitvoer.
af.duties: Voer roetine-instandhoudingsaktiwiteite (verf, onkruidbeheer, ens.) by meetstasies (rivier, kanale, damme, verdampingstasies, riviermondings.) uit met behulp van hand- en kraggereedskap volgens departementele standaarde. Voer strukturele instandhoudingsaktiwiteite (vervanging van staalkomponente, ens.) by meetstasies (rivier, kanale, damme, verdampingstasies, riviermondings.) uit met behulp van hand- en kraggereedskap. Voer instandhoudingsaktiwiteite op die perseel uit wanneer daartoe versoek. Instandhouding van oewers by meetstrukture deur stabilisering en skoonmaak van plantegroei. Skoonmaak en instandhouding van toegangsroetes, opknapping van meetstasies (riviere, kanale) met behulp van hand- en kraggereedskap. Konstruksie van meetdamwalle en infrastruktuur. Bystand met tegniese en spesiale take (instrumentinstallasies en vloedmonitering) soos wanneer gevra word. Algemene instandhouding en huishouding van kamptgeriewe. Instandhouding en sorg van masjinerie, toerusting, gereedskap en goedere. Laai en aflaai van toerusting en materiaal. Voldoen aan die Wet op Beroepsveiligheid en Gesondheid en alle verwante veiligheidsregulasies. Rapporteer foute, defekte en veiligheidsgevare onverwyld aan die toesighouer. Die ampshouer sal vir lang tydperke van die kantoor af (in die veld) werk. Moet in staat wees om in of naby riviere, damme en kanale te werk.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Jikelele
zu.summary: Badingeka abasebenzi jikelele eWorcester naseGeorge ukuba benze imisebenzi yokunakekelwa kwiziteshi zokulinganisa kusetshenziswa amathuluzi angasandla namanedlule.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-ABET. Ukuze kube yinto ethile ukuthi ukuthole amava okusebenza okufanele konyakeni owodwa (1) kuya kumawu amabili (2) kuzokusiza. Ulwazi mayelana nempahla nezicu zokwenza umthaka. Ulwazi lwenqubo yokunakekelwa komthaka. Ulwazi lwenqubo namasu okusika nokuhlola izihlahla. Ulwazi lokusetshenziswa kwamakhemikhali (ukuncibilika/ukuxuba) kanye nolwazi ngemikhiqizo yamakhemikhali. Ulwazi lwenqubo yansuku zonke yokunakekelwa ukuze kusebenze kahle imishini/impahla. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo lokusekela ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi nomyalelo wemithombo yamanzi. Ulwazi ngemiyalelo yezempilo nokuphepha. Ulwazi ngokunakekelwa kwezinkomba kanye nokuqwalasela izitshalo. Amakhono okuxhumana kanye nokuba ukwazi ukusebenza eqenjini. Kufanele uhambisane nesikhathi, ukhiqize, futhi ube nomzondo. Kufanele ukwazi ukusebenza eduze noma kumaphandlenemikhonto, emadhinini, nasemigwaqweni yamanzi. Kufanele uvumele ukuhamba ukuze usebenze imisebenzi yakhe ngokuqhubeka.
zu.duties: Ukwenza imisebenzi eqhubekayo yokunakekelwa (ukupenda, ukulawula izitshalo ezingezinhle, njll.) eziteshini zokulinganisa (emiphakathi, emigwaqweni yamanzi, emadhinini, iziteshi zokushisa, nakumagojwini.) kusetshenziswa amathuluzi angasandla namanedlule ngokomazinga omnyango. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokunakekelwa kwakho konke okwakhiwe (ukushintsha izingxenye zensimbi, njll.) eziteshini zokulinganisa (emiphakathi, emigwaqweni yamanzi, emadhinini, iziteshi zokushisa, nakumagojwini.) kusetshenziswa amathuluzi angasandla namanedlule. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokunakekelwa endaweni lapho kucelwa khona. Ukunakekelwa kwezibhodi ezingezansi kumakamu okulinganisa ngokuzinza nokuhlanza izitshalo. Ukuhlanza futhi unakekele imigwaqo yokuwela, ukulungisa iziteshi zokulinganisa (imiphakathi, emigwaqweni yamanzi) kusetshenziswa amathuluzi angasandla namanedlule. Ukwakhiwa kwamakhemikhali nokulinganisa namapayipi. Ukusiza ngemisebenzi yobuchwepheshe neyikakhono (ukufakwa kwamathuluzi kanye nokuqaphela amafoloshi) njengoba naxa kucelwa khona. Ukunakekelwa okujwayelekile nokugcina izindawo zokulala ezinkampini. Ukunakekela nokulondoloza imishini, impahla, amathuluzi nemikhiqizo. Ukufaka nokukhipha impahla nezinto ezingasetshenziswa. Ukubambelela kuMthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kusebenzo kanye nayo yonke imithetho yokuphepha. Ukumela iziphazamisi, iziphukelele, nezingozi zokuphepha kumphathiwe ngokushesha. Owoyilo lomsebenzi uzosebenza kude nenhlangano (esimobeni) isikhathi eside. Kufanele ukwazi ukusebenza noma eduze nemiphakathi, emadhinini, nasemigwaqweni yamanzi.

xh.title: Umguli weNqanaba 1
xh.summary: Abasebenzi abafuniwa eDordrecht kunye neBhisho ukuba bagcualise imisebenzi yolungiso kwizikhululo zokulinganisa kusetyenziswa amathuluzi esandla kunye nambane.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-ABET. Eyoku-1 (1) ukuya kweyi-2 (2) yeminyaka yokqiqa ekwinkqubo yamava eza kuba yinzuzo kwakhona. Ukuqonda ngemiphene yolimiweyo kumaziko aphethelwe ngamaphetho wezenzo. Ukuqonda inkqubo yokutsha iinduli. Ukuqonda inkqubo yomlando kunye namandla okutsha izityalo kunye neendlela zokwenza umsebenzi. Ukuqonda ngokusebenzisa iimveliso ezibekelwe ukusetyenziswa kwetyhefu kwemithi yamakhemikhali kunye nokuqonda ukwazi ngokwenziwa kwamakhemikhali. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zolondolozo olwenziwa njengemini kwicala lokuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwamathuluzi/izixhobo. Isiseko seziqhinga ekuxhaseni ukusetyenziswa kwamanzi kunye nengqalelo ngamandla okulinganisa ixesha namandla amaninzi. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zinikwa isaziso esizoba ngokulungele imisebenzi eqhelekileyo yonke imihla eqinisekisa ukusebenza kakuhle kwezixhobo ngezixhobo. Isiseko sokwenza imisebenzi yonke imihla ekuxhaseni ukusetyenziswa kwamanzi kunye nengqalelo ngamandla okulinganisa ixesha namandla amaninzi. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zorho axe lwezingozi nemiphetho. Ukuqonda ngemiphetho yolondolozo namandla ezityalo. Amakhono onxibelelwano nendlela yokusebenza ngengqondo. Kuya kufuneka abe ngumsebenzisi ozele ngokuchaneka, ngokwenza imisebenzi, nengowethembekileyo. Kuya kufuneka akwazi ukusebenza eduze nemilambo, amaxhaphozi, nakwinduli zamakhwelo. Kuya kufuneka azimisele kwicala lokuhamba-hamba njengoko kuphambili ngokuchaneka imisebenzi yakhe.
xh.duties: Gcualisa iinkqubo zolungiso olwenziwa njengenkqubo eqhelekileyo (ukugquma, ukulawula iintyatyambo, njl.) kwindawo zokulinganisa umoya (umlambo, iinqanaba, amaxhaphozi, iindawo zokuwohloka kwamanzi, amangxowa) kusetyenziswa amathuluzi esandla nembane ngokwemigangatho yesebe. Gcualisa imisebenzi yemisebenzi yoshicilelo ekusekweni kwakho esebenzisa izinto ezilungenwe izinyani, njl. kwizikhululo zokulinganisa (umlambo, iinqanaba, amaxhaphozi, iindawo zokuwohloka kwamanzi, amangxowa) zisebenzisa amathuluzi esandla nombane. Qhuba imisebenzi yokulondoloza kummandla oqhelekileyo xa kufuneka kwakhona. Ulungiso lwemithi yokulinganisa kumagoqi kumasebe ngokuzinza nokucoca ubuhle. Coca ukugcina indlela ezingangena, ukutsha iindawo zokulinganisa (iintlanzi, amanzi) ukusebenzisa iintsimi ezisesandleni. Ukulungelelanisa iindawo zokulinganisa (iintlanzi, amanzi) kusetyenziswa amathuluzi esandla nombane. Yokusebenza kwamathuluzi ngokusemgangathweni. Yenza imisebenzi yobugcisa kunye nenkqubo ezizelekileyo (ufakelo lwezixhobo kunye nokugcina amanzi) njengoko kucelwa. Ulungiso ngokubanzi kunye nokugcina iindawo zokhempa. Gcina ulungelelanise amathuluzi, izixhobo, ukhunjulwana, amathuluzi kunye nempefumlo. Gcwala kwaye ukhuphe izixhobo nezinto ezibalulekileyo. Landela umthetho we occupational Health and Safety Act nayo yonke imithethonqubo yolondolozo. Ngenisa iintsingisileyo, iimfuno kunye neengozi kumqakathi kuyo nayiphi na imini ngokukhawuleza. Umsebenzisi uya kusebenza kude ne-ofisi (emzantsi) ixesha elide. Kuya kufuneka akwazi ukusebenza ecaleni kwemilambo, iinduli kunye namakhwelo emilambo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Financial Management
jobs.department: Department of Community Safety, Roads and Transport
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Financial Management position in Bloemfontein requiring a degree in Accounting or Financial Management with completed SAICA or SAIPA articles and five years of experience.
jobs.requirements: Candidates must be in possession of a Grade 12 or Matric plus a SAQA- recognised degree or equivalent at NQF level 7 in Accounting and/or Financial Management. Must have completed a South African Institute of Chartered Accountants (SAICA) or South African Institute of Professional Accountants (SAIPA) articles. The candidate must have a minimum of five years relevant financial experience, of which at least three years must be at management level. A valid driver’s licence is required. Skills and Competence: The ideal candidate will demonstrate strategic capability and leadership, people management and empowerment, financial management, knowledge management, problem-solving and analysis, customer focus and strong communication skills, together with a thorough understanding of Public Service Acts, policy analysis and interpretation, have working knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations and the Standards of Generally Recognised Accounting Standards(GRAP). Due to the large databases used the official is required to be an expert in Microsoft Excel and Access.
jobs.duties: The core duties are extensive since the candidate facilitates financial planning for the entity, prepares monthly financial reports, monitors cash flow, and ensure that the entity complies with financial prescripts. The candidate is also responsible to perform year-end financial procedures, assist with the preparation of financial statements in terms of GRAP, preparation of audit files as required by the Auditor General, identifying correcting journals, compiling a detailed asset register for leased assets in accordance with GRAP. The position further requires the candidate to manage revenue including the calculation of the entity’s tariffs and computing the quarterly leased schedules of clients. Revenue collection duties involve monitoring the policy and legislative framework, tracking revenue collected and expenditure incurred, and ensuring cashier, banking, debt management, and reporting services are rendered. The candidate will be required to perform risk functions by analysing the detail fleet expenditure. The candidate is also responsible to authorise transactions for the entity on BAS, monitors payroll, and undertakes expenditure management, accounting work, including identifying and authorising journals. Finally, the post manages human, financial and equipment resources, including, staff performance and development, discipline, leave matters and ensuring spending is aligned with strategic objectives. This is a demanding leadership role suited to a finance professional who can manage teams, work under pressure and uphold sound governance.
jobs.applications: can also be emailed to the following address: fleetassistantdir@freetrans.gov.za
jobs.notes: Directions to applicants: All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which         can        be         downloaded        on          internet      at www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialled by the Applicant. The application must indicate the correct Job title, the office where the position is advertised and the Reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to fully complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in a possession of Foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Dual citizenship holders must provide the Police Clearance certificate from country of origin when shortlisted. All non-SA Citizens will be required to submit a copy of proof of South African permanent residence when shortlisted. Applications that do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements will not be considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. The Department does not accept applications via fax. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the Application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointments. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Finansiële Bestuur
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur: Finansiële Bestuur-pos in Bloemfontein wat 'n graad in Rekeningkunde of Finansiële Bestuur vereis met voltooide SAICA- of SAIPA-artikels en vyf jaar se ervaring.
af.requirements: Kandidate moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12 of Matriek plus 'n SAQA-erkende graad of ekwivalent op NQF-vlak 7 in Rekeningkunde en/of Finansiële Bestuur. Moet 'n South African Institute of Chartered Accountants (SAICA)- of South African Institute of Professional Accountants (SAIPA)-artikels voltooi het. Die kandidaat moet 'n minimum van vyf jaar se tersaaklike finansiële ervaring hê, waarvan ten minste drie jaar op bestuursvlak moet wees. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie word vereis. Vaardighede en Bevoegdheid: Die ideale kandidaat sal strategiese vermoë en leierskap, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, finansiële bestuur, kennissbestuur, probleemoplossing en analise, klintefokus en sterk kommunikasievaardighede toon, tesame met 'n deeglike begrip van Openbare Diens-Wette, beleidsontleding en -interpretasie, en werkkennis hê van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Tesourie-regulasies en die Standards of Generally Recognised Accounting Standards(GRAP). As gevolg van die groot databasisse wat gebruik word, word van die beampte vereis om 'n kundige in Microsoft Excel en Access te wees.
af.duties: Die kernpligte is omvattend aangesien die kandidaat finansiële beplanning vir die entiteit fasiliteer, maandelikse finansiële verslae voorberei, kontantvloei monitor, en verseker dat die entiteit aan finansiële voorskrifte voldoen. Die kandidaat is ook verantwoordelik om jaareinde-finansiële prosedures uit te voer, bystand te verleen met die voorbereiding van finansiële state in ooreenstemming met GRAP, ouditlêers voor te berei soos deur die Auditor General vereis, korrigerende joernale te identifiseer, 'n gedetailleerde bate-register vir geleasedde bates in ooreenstemming met GRAP op te stel. Die pos vereis verder dat die kandidaat inkomste bestuur, insluitend die berekening van die entiteit se tariewe en die berekening van die kwartaalse geleasedde skedules van kliënte. Inkomste-insamelingpligte behels die monitering van die beleids- en wetgewingsraamwerk, die opspoor van ingesamelde inkomste en gemaakte uitgawes, en die versekering dat kassier-, bank-, skuldbestuur-, en verslagdoeningsdienste gelewer word. Die kandidaat sal vereis word om risikofunksies uit te voer deur die gedetailleerde vlootuitgawes te analiseer. Die kandidaat is ook verantwoordelik om transaksies vir die entiteit op BAS te magtig, loonstawwe te monitor, en uitgawebestuur, rekeningkundige werk te onderneem, insluitend die identifisering en magtiging van joernale. Ten slotte bestuur die pos menslike, finansiële en toerusterbronne, insluitend, personeelprestasie en -ontwikkeling, dissipline, verlofsake en die versekering dat besteding met strategiese doelwitte in lyn is. Dit is 'n veeleisende leierskapsrol wat geskik is vir 'n finansieële professionele persoon wat spanne kan bestuur, onder druk kan werk en goeie bestuur kan handhaaf.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esibiyo: Abalawe Imali
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaisikhulu esibiyo: abalawe imali esithweni eBloemfontein esifuna idigri ekuBaleni noma ekuPhathweni Kwezimali okuhambisana namagridi ama-SAICA noma ama-SAIPA kanye neminyaka emihlanu yohambo lokusebenza.
zu.requirements: Oqeqeshiwe kufanele ukuba basipho Isitifikadi seGrade 12 noma iMatric kanye nendigri ekuqashwe yiSAQA noma okulinganayo esigabeni 7 seNQF ekuBaleni noma ekuPhathweni Kwezimali. Kumele babaqedile amagridi eSouth African Institute of Chartered Accountants (SAICA) noma iSouth African Institute of Professional Accountants (SAIPA). Oqeqeshiwe kumele abe nokuze kweminyaka emihlanu ubudala bokuhamba kwemali, lapho kweminyaka kubade kufanele kube yizinga lokuphatha. Kudingeka ibe nelayisensi evumelekile yokushayela. Amakhono nokuqeqeshwa: Oqeqeshiwe oyisibonelo kufanele abonise ukuzikwazisa kwangaphambili ekwelulekeni nokuqondisa, ukuphathwa kwabantu nokuqeqeshwa kwabo, ukuphathwa kwemali, ukuphathwa kolwazi, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukugxila kubath negi namakhono okukhuluma aqinileyo, kanye nokwazisa ngokujulileyo ngomthetho wezinkonzo zikahulumeni, ukuhlaziya nokuhumusha izinqubomgomo, ukwazi ngomthetho wezimali wezinkonzo zikahulumeni (PFMA), imiyalo yesikhulu sechwe negi nezigaba eziqinisekiswe njengamanani kaGRAP. Ngenxa yokusetshenziswa kwezibalo ezikhulu kufuneka lowo muntu azi ngokuphelela iMicrosoft Excel neAccess.
zu.duties: Imisebenzi eyinhloko mina futhi kule mina ingxenye yokuhlelela imali ngokwezinhloso zendawo, ukulungisa imibiko yemali yanyanga zonke, ukugqamisa imali esebenzayo, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi indawo ihambisana nemiyalo yemali. Kufuneka udle imisebenzi yokugcina unyaka, usize ekwenzeni izitatimende zemili ngokweGRAP, ukulungisa amafayili okuqinisekisa njengoba kudingwa nguAuditor General, ukuthola izibuko eziholela ekugcineni, ukwenza ubhalo olubhaliswe ngokweGRAP. Leli khanda lithi kufanele uphathe imali kubhalo lolwazi kuhlangene nemisebenzo ehleliweyo nokuqinisekisa ulwazi. Imisebenzi ekuqoqeni imali ngokwezinqubo ezilandelwa. Kufanele uhlaziye imali esebenzayo. Kufuneka uphathe imisebenzi ephathe kakhulu ngemali, kuhlanganise ukuqashwa kwemali. Ekugcineni, lo muntu uzophatha imali, abantu nemicimbe. Lesi sikhundla sibiza ukuba uqeqeshe abantu, ukuba nokugqamisa imali ngaphandle kokugqamisa kwezinhloso eziyinhloso. Lesi sikhundla sibiza umuntu oqeqeshiweyo oazi ukuphatha abantu, ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezinkinga nokugqamisa imali ngendlela ezinhle.

xh.title: Isiphathi seNgqalasela Sembali: uLawulo lweMali
xh.summary: Isikhundla sokuba nguSiphathi seNgqalasela Sembali: uLawulo lweMali siseBloemfontein sifuna idigri kwi-Accounting okanye uLawulo lweMali kunye nokuqwalaselwa kweekhadi ze-SAICA okanye i-SAIPA kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava.
xh.requirements: Oqeqeshiweyo kufuneka abe neGrade 12 okanye iMatric kunye nedigri eqwalaselwa yi-SAQA okanye esilinganayo kumqondo we-NQF inqanaba 7 kwi-Accounting kunye/nokanye uLawulo lweMali. Kufuneka aqede iikhadi ze-South African Institute of Chartered Accountants (SAICA) okanye i-South African Institute of Professional Accountants (SAIPA). Oqeqeshiweyo kufuneka abe nembali yamava amabhulu anqonge kumashumi amahlanu kwimicimbi yemali, apho ubuncinane kufuneka kubekho iminyaka elithathu engqalaseleni yabalawuli. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo iyafuneka. Ikhono nokuZinza: Oqeqeshiweyo oqhayiyayo uya kubonisa ikhono lokuqamba amacebo nokuba ngumahluleli, ukulawula abantu noku ba namandla, ukulawula imali, ukulawula ulwazi, ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuqhathanisa, ukugxila kumthengi kunye nakhono lokuthetha eliqinileyo, kunye nokuqonda ngokucokiseleyo iMithetho yokuSebenza kaRhulumente, uhlalutyo lweendikimba zomthetho nokutolika, akuze nalo alwazi olusebenzayo ngoMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA), iMithetho yoLawulo lweNkqubo zezezimali kunye nezoMiso zeZindlu zeMali ezivunywe ngokubanzi. Ngenxa yedatabase ezingasentla ezisetyenziswa, oqeqeshiweyo kufuneka abe ngumntu ogqithisileyo kwiMicrosoft Excel kunye ne-Access.
xh.duties: Imisebenzi yokuqala yomele kuba oqeqeshiweyo ulungiselela icebo leminyaka yentengiso, ulungise iveki ngamanye amaxesha ingxelo zemali, ujonge ukuhamba kwemali, aze aqinisekise ukuba entengiso ihambelana nemigaqo yemali. Oqeqeshiweyo nayo ithembekile ekwenzeni iinkqubo zemini yokuphela kwamnyaka zemali, ukuncedisa kolungiselelwa iinkcukacha zemali ngokomthetho we-GRAP, ukuqamba iifayile zokuhlolwa njengoko kufunwa nguMhloli-ngowarhulwe, ukuqaphela nokulungisa iijonali, nokwenza irejista esembindi yempahla eqashiweyo ngokwemigaqo ye-GRAP. Esi sikhundla sifuna oqeqeshiweyo ukuba alawule imali engenayo kuquka nokubala izalathiso zentengiso kunye nokubala iinkqubo zenyanga zokuqashiwa kwabantu abaqashiweyo. Imisebenzi yokuthwala imali engenayo iquka ukujonga umthetho nobungqina bomthetho, ukulandela imali ethwalwe neyihafunwa, nokwenzinisekisa iinkonzo zokuqokelela imali, zokubhankisha, zokulawula izikolwe, zokwenza ingxelo ezinikwa. Oqeqeshiweyo uya kufuneka enze imisebenzi yengozi ngokuhlalutya iinkcukacha zentengiso yamafutha ezimoto. Oqeqeshiweyo nayo ithembekile ekuvumeleni iinkqubo zemali kumthengisi kwi-BAS, ukuqaphela imali yabasebenzi, nokwenza umsebenzi wolawulo lwemali, isixhobo esibhalwa phantsi kweenkqubo zezezimali, kuquka ukubona nokuvuma iijonali. Ekugqibeleni, esi sikhundla silawula imithombo yamathambo, yemali nezixhobo, kuquka nokwenza umsebenzi wokuziphumezelela kwabasebenzi, intlawulo, izinto ezimalunga nexesha lokuphumla kwindlela echanekileyo kwaye kuqinisekiswa ukuba imali ichithwa hambelana neenjongo zamacebo asembindi. Le nkqubo yobuqhawe ibalulekile kwaye ihambelana negcoba lezemali elikwazi ukulawula iqela, ukusebenza ngocango kunye nokuzinza ngokomthetho.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Financial Management
jobs.department: Department of Community Safety, Roads and Transport
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Financial Management at the Department of Community Safety, Roads and Transport in Bloemfontein, requiring a diploma or degree in Financial Management with 3-5 years experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate with a recognized National Diploma or a recognised Bachelor’s Degree /Advanced Diploma (NQF Level 7) in Financial Management. A minimum of 3 to 5 years experience in the Financial Management/Senior State Accounting environment, of which 3 years must be supervisory experience. Skills and Competencies: Knowledge and understanding on Human Resource Management legislation, policies, practices and procedures. Knowledge and understanding of Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations and Guidelines. Understanding of departmental policies and procedures, government financial systems, principles and practice of financial accounting. Understanding of framework for managing performance information. Knowledge of business strategy transaction and alignment. Problem solving and analysis. People diversity management. Client orientation and customer focus. Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written). Accountability and ethical conduct. A valid driver’s license. BAS experience.
jobs.duties: Cashier, banking service and electronic payments. Monitor and review the procedures for the collection and safekeeping of all monies and compliance with the relevant financial prescripts. Monitor and review the receipts and collection of monies to ensure that it is in accordance with the appropriate tariffs and properly recorder. Oversee that banking of monies is done in accordance with the prescribed processes. Oversee that bank reconciliations are performed and are correct. Oversee the verification of the validity and allocation of payments received via electronic transfers. Oversee the safeguarding of source documents and face value. Debt Management. Oversee the identification and accurate recording of debts owed to the Entity. Liaise with debtors to determine payback conditions and time span. Oversee the accurate allocation of monies received. Monitoring and reporting on revenue: Compile and ensure the distribution of monthly invoices and statements to all clients. Oversee and monitor income and review reconciliations. Oversee and undertake the development of corrective measures when required. Oversee and collate financial supporting information for planning purposes. Ensure completeness and accuracy of financial information. Expenditure Management: Compensation of employees: Oversee the verification of the capturing of payroll transactions on the accounting system. Oversee the quality assure of all payroll transactions. Authorizes reimbursement transactions on the BAS accounting system. Oversee the reconciliation of transactions (interface) on the payroll (PERSAL) with the accounting system (BAS). Authorizes payments. Oversee verification of information for payroll certification. Goods and services: Oversee verification of source documents. Oversee the quality assurance and verification of transactions on BAS. Oversee the correct capturing of banking details on the accounting system. Oversee creditor reconciliation (ensure that service providers are paid timely and correctly). Reporting: Oversee the processing of information to determine expenditure. Review and analyse expenditure reports. Assist with the compilation of interim and annual financial statements of the entity. Ensure the safeguarding of all source documents. Supervise employees to ensure an effective financial accounting service including: General supervision of employees. Allocate duties and do quality control of the work delivered by supervisors. Advise and lead supervisors with regard to all aspects of the work. Manage performance, conduct and discipline of supervisees. Ensure that all supervisees are trained and developed to be able to deliver work of the required standard efficiently and effectively. Develop, implement and monitor work systems and processes to ensure efficient and effective functioning.

If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. The Department does not accept applications via fax. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the Application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointments. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Finansiële Bestuur
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Finansiële Bestuur by die Department of Community Safety, Roads and Transport in Bloemfontein, waar 'n diploma of graad in Finansiële Bestuur met 3-5 jaar ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat met 'n erkende Nasionale Diploma of 'n erkende Baccalausgraad/Gevorderde Diploma (NQF Level 7) in Finansiële Bestuur. 'n Minimum van 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring in die Finansiële Bestuur/Senior Staatsrekeninge-omgewing, waarvan 3 jaar toesigervaring moet wees. Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Kennis en begrip van Wetgewing, beleide, praktyke en prosedures rakende Menslike Hulpbronbestuur. Kennis en begrip van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Tesourie-regulasies en -riglyne. Begrip van departementele beleide en prosedures, staatsfinansiële stelsels, beginsels en praktyk van finansiële rekenkunde. Begrip van die raamwerk vir die bestuur van prestasie-inligting. Kennis van besigheidsstrategie-transaksie en belyning. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Bestuur van mense-diversiteit. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (sowel mondeling as skriftelik). Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. BAS-ervaring.
af.duties: Kassier, bankdienste en elektroniese betalings. Monitor en hersien die prosedures vir die invordering en veilige bewaring van alle geld en nakoming van die tersaaklike finansiële voorskrifte. Monitor en hersien kwitansies en invordering van geld om te verseker dat dit in ooreenstemming met die toepaslike tariewe is en behoorlik aangeteken is. Hou toe dat bank van geld gedoen word ooreenkomstig die voorgeskrewe prosesse. Hou toe dat bankafstemmings uitgevoer word en korrek is. Hou toe die verifikasie van die geldigheid en toewysing van betalings wat deur elektroniese oorplasings ontvang is, na. Hou toe die veilige bewaring van brondokumente en nominale waarde. Skuldbestuur. Hou toe die identifikasie en akkurate optekening van skuld wat aan die Entiteit verskuldig is, na. Skakel met skuldenaars om terugbetalingsvoorwaardes en tydperk te bepaal. Hou toe die akkurate toewysing van ontvangde geld na. Monitering en verslagdoening oor inkomste: Stel maandelikse fakture en state op en verseker die verspreiding daarvan aan alle kliënte. Hou toe en monitor inkomste en hersien afstemmings. Hou toe en onderneem die ontwikkeling van korrigerende maatreëls wanneer vereis. Hou toesig en versamel finansiële ondersteunende inligting vir beplanningsdoeleindes. Verseker volledigheid en akkuraatheid van finansiële inligting. Uitgawesbestuur: Vergoeding van werknemers: Hou toe die verifikasie van die vaslegging van loontransaksies op die rekenkundige stelsel. Hou toe die gehalteversekering van alle loontransaksies. Magtig terugbetalings-transaksies op die BAS-rekenkundige stelsel. Hou toe die afstemming van transaksies (koppelvlak) op die loonstelsel (PERSAL) met die rekenkundige stelsel (BAS). Magtig betalings. Hou toe verifikasie van inligting vir loonsertifisering. Goedere en dienste: Hou toe verifikasie van brondokumente. Hou toe die gehalteversekering en verifikasie van transaksies op BAS. Hou toe die korrekte vaslegging van bankbesonderhede op die rekenkundige stelsel. Hou toe skuldeisaarafstemming (verseker dat diensverskaffers betyds en korrek betaal word). Verslagdoening: Hou toe die verwerking van inligting om uitgawes te bepaal. Hersien en ontleed uitgaweverslae. Bystand verleen met die opstel van tussentydse en jaarlikse finansiële state van die entiteit. Verseker die veilige bewaring van alle brondokumente. Superviseer werknemers om 'n effektiewe finansiële rekenkundedienst te verseker, insluitend: Algemene toesig oor werknemers. Ken pligte toe en doen gehaltebeheer van die werk wat deur toesighouers gelewer word. Adviseer en lei toesighouers rakende alle aspekte van die werk. Bestuur prestasie, gedrag en dissipline van toesighouers. Verseker dat alle toesighouers opgelei en ontwikkel word om in staat te wees om werk van die vereiste standaard doeltreffend en effektief te lewer. Ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor werkstelsels en prosesse om doeltreffende en effektiewe funksionering te verseker.

zu.title: Onobhala Omncane: Ukuphathwa Kwezimali
zu.summary: Onobhala Omncane: Ukuphathwa Kwezimali eDepartment of Community Safety, Roads and Transport eBloemfontein, kudinga idiploma noma idigri kuFinancial Management eneminyaka 3-5 yokuhlangenwe nakho.
zu.requirements: Abafakeli kumele babe nesatifikethi seGrade 12 ezifanayo ngeNational Diploma evunyiwe noma iBachelor's Degree /Advanced Diploma (NQF Level 7) evunyiwe kuFinancial Management. Umkhawulo weminyaka engu-3 kuye ku-5 yokuhlangenwe nakho kwendawo yeFinancial Management/Senior State Accounting, okuyingxenye yalokho iminyaka engu-3 kumele ibe nguhlangenwe nakho lokuphatha. Amakhono namandla: Ulwazi nokuqonda ngomthetho, izinqubomgomo, amasu namaphrosedha kaHuman Resource Management. Ulwazi nokuqonda iPublic Finance Management Act (PFMA), iTreasury Regulations namasu. Ukuqonda izinqubomgomo namaphrosedha esikhungo, izinhlelo zikahulumeni zezimali, izimiso nokwenzeka kokubhalwa kwama-akhawunti nezimali. Ukuqonda isakhiwo sokuphatha ulwazi ngemikhiqizo. Ulwazi ngokuqondanisa kwenhinga webhizinisi nezinhlelo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuphatha ukubuhlukaniswa kwabantu. Ukugxila kukhasimende nokuqondiswa kwabo. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle kakhulu (okukhulunywayo nokuqoshiwe). Ukuba necwaka nokuziphatha ngokuzethemba. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Uhlangenwe nakho kwi-BAS.
zu.duties: Ukusebenza njengomkhonto wemali, isevisi yokubhanka noku khokha nge-elekthronikhi. Qaphisisa futhi uhlole izinqubo zokuqoqa nokugcina kabanzi konke okuthengiswa kanye nokuvumelana nezinqubo ezihambisana nezimali. Qaphisisa futhi uhlole ukutholwa nokuqoqwa kwemali ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi kuhambisana namatharifu ahambisanayo futhi kubhalwe kahle. Qinisekisa ukuthi imali ibhankiwe ngokuhambisana nezinqubo ezilawulwayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukubhalwa kabushwa kwe-akhawunti yebhanka kwenziwe futhi kulungile. Qinisekisa ukuhlola ukusemthethweni kokunikelwa kwezimali ezitholwa ngesidlulisela nge-elekthronikhi. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kabanzi kwamadokhumenti evela kanye nenani elibonakalayo. Ukuphatha izikweletu. Qinisekisa ukuhlakaniswa nokubhalwa okuhlakaniphile kwezikweletu ezibwele isikhungo. Xhumana nabakweletu ukuba kwenziwe isinqumo ngemibandela nesikhathi soku khokha. Qinisekisa ukunikelwa okuhlakaniphile kwemali etholwe. Qapha futhi ubike ngemali etholwe: Hlela futhi uqiniseke ukusatshaliswa kwe-inovasi yenyanga nentshela kubo bonke abakhasimende. Qinisekisa futhi qapha ukungena kwemali futhi uhlole ukubhalwa kabushwa. Qinisekisa futhi uthathe inxaxheba ekuthuthukiseni izinyathelo zokulungisa lapho kudingeka khona. Qinisekisa futhi uqoqe ulwazi olusekela izimali ngenjongo yokuhlela. Qinisekisa ukugqamisela nokuqiniseka kolwazi lwezimali. Ukuphatha okushisayo: Inkokhelo yabasebenzi: Qinisekisa ukuhlola kokungenisa izinhlelo zokukhokha kwabasebenzi kuhlelo lokubhalwa kwama-akhawunti. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa kwekhwalithi kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokukhokha abasebenzi. Gunyaza izinhlelo zoku khokha kabusha kuhlelo lokubhalwa kwe-akhawunti i-BAS. Qinisekisa ukubhalwa kabushwa kwezinhlelo (isixhumi esiphakathi) ekukhokheni (PERSAL) ngehlelo lokubhalwa kwe-akhawunti (BAS). Gunyaza izinkokhelo. Qinisekisa ukuhlola kolwazi ngenjongo yokufakazela ukukhokha abasebenzi. Izimpahla namasevisi: Qinisekisa ukuhlola kwamadokhumenti evela. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa kwekhwalithi nokuqiniseka kwezinhlelo kwi-BAS. Qinisekisa ukungenisa okuhlelekile kwemininingwane yebhanka kuhlelo lokubhalwa kwe-akhawunti. Qinisekisa ukubhalwa kabushwa kwezikweletu (qinisekisa ukuthi abanikeli besevisi bakhokhelwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi futhi ngendlela efanele). Ukuhlolwa nokubika: Qinisekisa ukucubungula kolwazi ukuze kutholwe ukuchithwa kwemali. Hlola futhi uhlaziye imibiko yokuchithwa kwemali. Siza ekwenzeni izitatimende zamasikhathi aphakathi nezinyanga zonke zezimali zesikhungo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kabanzi kubo bonke amadokhumenti evela. Qapha abasebenzi ukuba kutholakale iseva ephumelelayo yokubhalwa kwama-akhawunti ezimali okuhlanganisa: Ukuqapha ngokuvamile kwabasebenzi. Nika imisebenzi futhi wenze ukulawulwa kwekhwalithi komsebenzi ohlinzekwa abaphathi. Yala futhi uhlose abaphathi ngakho konke okubandakanya umsebenzi. Phatha ukusebenza, ukuziphatha nokuhlinzekwa kwabaphathiwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abaphathiwa bafundiswa futhi bathuthukiswa ukuba bakwazi ukuletha umsebenzi wezinga elidingekayo ngokusebenza ngokuphumelelayo nangempumelelo. Thuthukisa, faka esebenzini futhi uqaphe izinhlelo zomsebenzi namaphrosedha ukuze kuqiniseke ukusebenza ngokuphumelelayo nangempumelelo.

xh.title: iNkulumbuso oNcedayo: uLawulo lweMali
xh.summary: iNkulumbuso oNcedayo: uLawulo lweMali kwiSebe loKhuseleko lokuQhuba iNtengiso noGqithiso kwiBloemfontein, kufuneka abe nediploma okanye isidanga kokuLawula iMali enamava eminyaka emi-3 ukuya kwemi-5.
xh.requirements: Abafaki-mabhalo kufuneka babe neSatifikethi seGrade 12 eneDiploma yesiQonga esamkelwayo okanye iDiploma ePhakamileyo yeBachelor's edumileyo / iDiploma ePhakamileyo (iNqanaba le-NQF 7) kokuLawula iMali. Iqondo lenyanga elingu-3 ukuya kulu-5 leminyaka yamava kwindawo yokulawula iMali / ekuTyenjweni kweSizwe kumaKhadi eBekee ePhakamileyo, apho kweminyaka emi-3 kufuneka ibe ngamava okulawula abantu. Amaphepha nobuchwepheshe: ulwazi nokuqonda ngomthetho weNkokhelo yabaSebenzi, iinkqubo, izentatho-nxaxheba neenkqubo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngokuMiswa kwesiKolo seMali sikaRhulumente (PFMA), iLa zikaRhulumente lweMali neziQondiso. Ukuqonda iinkqubo neenkqubo zesebe, iinkqubo zimali zorhulumente, iimpawu nenkqubo yokuBala imali. Ukuqonda umthetho wokulawula ulwazi ngenkqubo. Ulwazi ngokudibanisa urhwebo nomgama wokusombulula iingxaki. Ukuqonda nokusombulula iingxaki. Ukulawula ukubakwa kwabantu. Ukuqwalasela abathengi nokubeka abathengi phambili. Amandla abalulekileyo okuThetha (nokubhala). UkuPendula nokwenza izinto ngokwezwi. Ilayisenisi yokuQhuba esemthethweni. Amava kwiBAS.
xh.duties: Ukuba ngumkhoki, inkonzo yobunkeki nobhatalo ngekhompyutha. Qwalasela ukuze uphinde ubuke iinkqubo zokuqokelela nokugcina yonke imali nokuthobela imithetho yemali edibeneyo. Qwalasela uphinde ubuke ukufumaniswa nokusokenzelwa kwemali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kuhambelana neentengiso ezifanelekileyo zekhompyutha nezicwangcisiweyo. Qwalasela ukuba imali iyabhalwa njalo kwindlu yoxhaso ngokweendlela eziyimiso. Qwalasela ukuba ulungelelwaniso lwebhanki lwenziwa lulungele. Qwalasela ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwaye ulungelelwaniso lwebhanki lwenziwa ngokuchanekileyo. Qwalasela ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwaye ulungelelwaniso lwebhanki lwenziwa ngokuchanekileyo. Qwalasela ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwemali efumaniswa ngeenkonzo ezidityaniswe ngokukhawuleza. Qwalasela ukusika kumthombo wamaxwebhu namaxabiso. uLawulo lweYikwerhu. Qwalasela ukuqonda nokubhala ngokuchanekileyo iikwerhu ezirekhodwa kwiNtlalo. Thetha namagwerhu ukuze kugqitywe iimeko zokuHlawula urhwebo. Qwalasela ukusika kumthombo wamaxwebhu naxabiso aboniswayo. uLawulo lweYikwerhu. Qwalasela ukubalwa ngokuchanekileyo kwemali ethunyelwe. uLawulo nokubika ngeNgeniso: Hlela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusasazwa kweebhili ezinyanga nezityhala kubo bonke abathengi. Qwalasela uphinde ulawule ingeniso ulibuke ulungelelwaniso. Qwalasela uphende usebenze ekwenziweni kweendlela zolungiso xa kufuneka. Qwalasela uphende uqokelele ulwazi lwemali oluxhasa iinkcukacha zokuCwangcisa. Qwalasela ukubakwa kwamaxwebhu nemibhalo. Qwalasela ukugcinwa kolwazi ngqo. uLawulo lweNtlalo: iNtlalo yabaSebenzi: Qwalasela ukusika kumthombo wamaxwebhu. Qwalasela ukusika nokubona ulungelelwaniso lwebhanki ekuthunyelwa kwayo imali. Qwalasela ulungelelwaniso lweKhompyutha kweNkqubo (interface) kwiPayroll (PERSAL) neNkqubo (BAS). Qwalasela iNkqubo yokuQinisekisa amaxwebhu nobhalo. Qwalasela ukubakwa kolwazi ngqo kwiPayroll. Iinkonzo nokuLawula: Qwalasela ukuqinisekisa ukuba inkonzo yenziwe ngokuchanekileyo. Qwalasela iNkqubo yokugcina amaxwebhu. Qwalasela ukubakwa kolwazi ngqo. Qwalasela ulungelelwaniso lweekreditwa. Qwalasela ukuPendula nokusika kwamaxwebhu. Qwalasela ukusika nokusebenza kolwazi ngqo. Qwalasela iinkqubo zokugcina iNtlalo kwiNkqubo. Qwalasela iNkqubo yokuQinisekisa ulwazi. Qwalasela iinkqubo zokwakha ulwazi. Qwalasela iinkqubo zokuCwangcisa. Qwalasela iinkqubo zokuLawula nokwakha ulwazi. Qwalasela iinkqubo zokuSebenzisa ulwazi.

jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 1-3
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 041 402 – R1 121 241 per annum Grade 2: R1 188 255 – R1 297 089 per annum Grade 3: R1 375 245 – R1 713 534 per annum all -inclusive package consists of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible portion that be structured in terms of the applicable rules, Medical Aid (Optional) Employee must meet the prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Medical Officer Grade 1-3 sought for John Daniel Newberry Hospital in the Free State to manage medical conditions, perform commuted overtime, and supervise junior staff.
jobs.requirements: Matric. Appropriate qualification that allows for registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice). Current annual registration with HPCSA. Grade 1: None after registration with HPCSA as Medical Practitioner in respect of South African qualified employees. 1 year relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of Foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years appropriate experience after registration with HPCSA as Medical Practitioner in respect of South African qualified employees. 6 years relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of Foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience after registration with HPCSA as Medical Practitioner in respect of South African qualified employees. 11 years relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of Foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa Knowledge And Skills: Extensive knowledge on Public Service legislation, policies and procedures. Excellent communication skills (verbal, written, report writing, medico-legal reports). Good interpersonal skills as well as display of honesty, integrity and excellent work ethics.
jobs.duties: Management of all medical conditions to ensure that a competent service is provided to all patients. Candidates will have to perform commuted overtime duties (compulsory & non-negotiable). Supervise junior staff in order to provide adequate medical care and to train them to be able to do key medical interventions. Consult patients on an outpatient basis to have optimal chronic disease management and good long term follow up. Briefing, informing and counselling patients and where appropriate relatives regarding prevention, treatment operative, complications and rehabilitation. Endeavour to become skilled in resuscitative measures and intensive care treatment to assure survival of critically ill-patients.

Only short-listed candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on, or before the day of the interview following an invitation from the Department to attend an interview, and such qualification(s) and other related document(s) should be in line with the requirements of the advertisement. Enrolment for the course should be made on the NSG’s website at https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms- pre-entry-programme. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. af.title: Mediese Beampte Vlak 1-3
af.summary: Mediese Beampte Vlak 1-3 gesoek vir John Daniel Newberry Hospitaal in die Free State vir die bestuur van mediese toestande, die verrig van oorgeplaasde oortyd, en die toesig oor junior personeel.
af.requirements: Matriek. Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn (Onafhanklike Praktyk) moontlik maak. Huidige jaarlikse registrasie by HPCSA. Vlak 1: Geen na registrasie by HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 1 jaar tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn met 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad ten opsigte van Buitelands gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis is om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 6 jaar tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn met 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad ten opsigte van Buitelands gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis is om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Vlak 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 11 jaar tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn met 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad ten opsigte van Buitelands gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis is om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Uitgebreide kennis van Openbare Diens-wetgewing, beleide en prosedures. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings, skriftelik, verslagskrywing, medies-regtelike verslae). Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede asook vertoon van eerlikheid, integriteit en uitstekende werketiek.
af.duties: Bestuur van alle mediese toestande om te verseker dat bekwame diens aan alle pasiënte gelewer word. Kandidate sal oorgeplaasde oortyddienste moet verrig (verpligtend en nie-onderhandelbaar). Toesig hou oor junior personeel om voldoende mediese sorg te verskaf en hulle op te lei om sleutelmediese ingrypings te kan uitvoer. Konsulteer pasiënte op 'n buitepasiëntbasis om optimale chroniese siektebestuur en goeie langtermyn-opvolg te verseker. Voorligting, inligting en berading van pasiënte en, waar toepaslik, familie ten opsigte van voorkoming, behandeling, operatiewe prosedures, komplikasies en rehabilitasie. Streef daarna om vaardig te raak in reanimasiemaatreëls en intensiewe sorgbehandeling om oorlewing van kritiek siek pasiënte te verseker.

zu.title: I-Practitioner Yezokwelapha Izinga 1-3
zu.summary: Kufunwa i-Practitioner Yezokwelapha Izinga 1-3 e-John Daniel Newberry Hospital esifundazweni sase-Free State ukuphatha izimo zezokwelapha, ukwenza ihora elengeziwe lokusebenza, kanye nokulawula abasebenzi abangaphansi kwabo.
zu.requirements: I-Matric. Isifundo esifanelekile esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhulu sezokwelapha (Independent Practice). Ukubhalisa kwamanje ngonyaka kwi-HPCSA. Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekile ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhulu sezokwelapha maqondana namaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika athunyelwe izifundo. Unyaka o-1 wokuhlangabezana nolwazi olufanele ngemva kokubhalisa njengesikhulu sezokwelapha neKhonseli Yezempilo Yamaphoyisa Avezwe phesheya maqondana namaphoyisa phesheya athunyelwe izifundo, okungadingeki ukuba benze isevisi yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Okungenani eminyaka engu-5 yohlelo lokusebenza olufanele ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhulu sezokwelapha maqondana namaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika athunyelwe izifundo. Eminyakeni engu-6 yohlelo lokusebenza olufanele ngemva kokubhalisa njengesikhulu sezokwelapha neKhonseli Yezempilo Yamaphoyisa Avezwe phesheya maqondana namaphoyisa phesheya athunyelwe izifundo, okungadingeki ukuba benze isevisi yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 3: Okungenani eminyaka engu-10 yohlelo lokusebenza olufanele ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhulu sezokwelapha maqondana namaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika athunyelwe izifundo. Eminyakeni engu-11 yohlelo lokusebenza olufanele ngemva kokubhalisa njengesikhulu sezokwelapha neKhonseli Yezempilo Yamaphoyisa Avezwe phesheya maqondana namaphoyisa phesheya athunyelwe izifundo, okungadingeki ukuba benze isevisi yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi olubanzi ngemithetho, izinqubomgomo kanye nezindlela zesevisi yomphakathi. Amakhono okuxhumana aphezulu (okukhulunywayo, okubhaliwe, ukubhala imibiko, imibiko yezokwelapha ngezomthetho). Amakhono ahle abantu kanye nokubonisa ukuthembeka, ukuqotho kanye nomthetho ohle wokusebenza.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha zonke izimo zezokwelapha ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi kunikezwa isevisi ekwaziyo kuyo konke okuhlangabezana neziguli. Oqeqeshiwe kuzodingeka benze imisebenzi yehora elengeziwe lokusebenza (okuyisinyathelo esinyakame kwaye akukho nqabela). Ukulawula abasebenzi abangaphansi kwabo ukuze kunikezwe ukunakekelwa okufanele kokwelapha kwaye bagqatshelwe ukuba bakwazi ukwenza izindaba eziyinhloko zokungenelela kokwelapha. Ukuhlangana neziguli ngendlela yesiguli esingangenisi esibhedlela ukuze kubekho ukuphathwa okugqamile kwesifo esihlala isikhathi eside kwaye kubekho ulandelo oluhle lokulandela isikhathi eside. Ukwazisa, ukwazisa kwaye uxhase iziguli kwaye apho kufanelekilewo usapho ngokuthintela, ukwelapha ukusebenza, iziphazamiso kwaye uphinde ulungise. Uzame ukuba namakhono ezindlela zokuvusa futhi ukwelashwa kokunakekelwa okujulile ukuze uqiniseke ukuphila kwabagulayo abakhulu.

xh.title: Isebe Lonyango Lokwemela Inqanaba 1-3
xh.summary: Kufunwa Isebe Lonyango Lokwemela Inqanaba 1-3 kwiJohn Daniel Newberry Hospital eFree State ukulawula iimeko zonyango, ukwenza iure ezongezelelweyo zokusebenza, nokulawula abasebenzi abancinci.
xh.requirements: Matric. Iifomali ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha Wezonyango (Ukuzilolonga Ngokuzimeleyo). Ukubhalisa kwangoku nyaka zonke kwi-HPCSA. Inqanaba 1: Akukho nto emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha Wezonyango malunga nabasebenzi abagqithiswe eSouth Africa. Unyaka o-1 wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengoGqirha Wezonyango neBhungana Lemimandla Yezempilo elidumeileyo malunga nabasebenzi bangaphandle abagqithiswe kumazwe angaphandle, abangafunelwanga ukwenza Inkonzo Yoluntu njengoko kufunwa eSouth Africa. Inqanaba 2: Amava afanelekileyo angaphantsi kweminyaka elingu-5 emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha Wezonyango malunga nabasebenzi abagqithiswe eSouth Africa. Unyaka o-6 wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengoGqirha Wezonyango neBhungana Lemimandla Yezempilo elidumeileyo malunga nabasebenzi bangaphandle abagqithiswe kumazwe angaphandle, abangafunelwanga ukwenza Inkonzo Yoluntu njengoko kufunwa eSouth Africa. Inqanaba 3: Amava afanelekileyo angaphantsi kweminyaka elingu-10 emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha Wezonyango malunga nabasebenzi abagqithiswe eSouth Africa. Unyaka o-11 wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengoGqirha Wezonyango neBhungana Lemimandla Yezempilo elidumeileyo malunga nabasebenzi bangaphandle abagqithiswe kumazwe angaphandle, abangafunelwanga ukwenza Inkonzo Yoluntu njengoko kufunwa eSouth Africa. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi olubanzi malunga nemithetho, iinkqubo neenqonga zomphumo woLuntu. Amakhono amaningi okunxibelelwana (okuthethwayo, okubhaliweyo, okubhaliweyo kwiingxelo, iingxelo zonyango-mthetho). Amakhono amaningi okusebenza nabantu kunye nokubonisa inyaniso, intlonipho kwaye nemigaqo emhle yokusebenza.
xh.duties: Ukulawula zonke iimeko zonyango ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba abantu bonke bafumana inkonzo esebenzayo. Abathunyelwa baya kufunela ukwenza imisebenzi yeeure ezongezelelweyo (eyinyani nengaqhawuleki). Ukulawula abasebenzi abancinci ukuze kubonelelwe ngononozo olunyango olufanelekileyo nokuqeqesha abo bakhulelwe ukwenza ukungenelela ngokonyango okubalulekileyo. Ukubonisana nabaguli ngokusekelwe kwindlela yokuziwasela ukuze kuqatshwe kakuhle iintshaba ezingapheliyo kwaye kulandelwe kakuhle ixesha elide. Ukwazisa, ukwazisa nokuleka abagazi nakuba ufanele kuso isini abantsalwa ngokuthintela, ukuba sengozini, ukwelapha, iindaba ezibi nokubuyisela komzimba. Ukuzama ukuba namakhono ekwenza izinto zokuvusa abaguli kunye nonyango lwesiqhithi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphila kwabagazi abakhoyo kakhulu.

jobs.summary: Pharmacist sought for Embekweni District Hospital in the Free State to provide comprehensive pharmaceutical services and manage medicines across three grading levels.
jobs.requirements: Matric, appropriate Bachelor of Pharmacy Degree that allows registration with South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) as a Pharmacist. Current registration with South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) (2026/2027) Grade 1: Experience: None after registration with SAPC as Pharmacist in respect to South African qualified employees. One-year relevant experience after registration as a Pharmacist with recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom is not required to perform community service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: Registration with SAPC as a Pharmacist. Experience: Minimum of 5 years after registration with SAPC as Pharmacist in respect to South African qualified employees. required in South Africa. Problem solving, Interpersonal skills, Communication skills, Planning, Computer Literacy.
jobs.duties: Render a comprehensive, professional and quality pharmaceutical service in the form of support, assistance, execution of duties and performing of acts, in line with relevant policies, standard operational procedures and legislation. Management of pharmaceutical addendums. Ensure availability of medicine stock through drug supply management and stock control principles. Keeping statistics and compiling reports. Ensure compliance with national core standards. Dispense medication to patients and clinics. Management and control of medicine stock. Issuing of stock and scheduled medication, calculating of stock levels, control expired medication and maintain drug registers (scheduled 5,6 and donation). Reduce risk in pharmacy, compile risk assessment and action plan. Ensure adherence to good pharmacy practice rules and regulations. Training of staff, Pharmacy Assistants, interns, and other pharmacy support personnel.

af.title: Apteker
af.summary: Apteker gesoek vir Embekweni Distrikshospitaal in die Free State om omvattende farmaseutiese dienste te verskaf en medisyne oor drie graderingsvlakke te bestuur.
af.requirements: Matriek, toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad in Farmasie wat registrasie met die South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) as 'n Apteker moontlik maak. Huidige registrasie met die South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) (2026/2027) Graad 1: Ervaring: Geen na registrasie met SAPC as Apteker ten opsigte van Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers nie. Een jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as 'n Apteker met 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad ten opsigte van buitelands gekwalifiseerde werknemers, wat nie verplig is om gemeenskapsdiens te lewer soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Graad 2: Registrasie met SAPC as 'n Apteker. Ervaring: Minimum van 5 jaar na registrasie met SAPC as Apteker ten opsigte van Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers. soos in Suid-Afrika vereis. Graad 3: Registrasie met SAPC as 'n Apteker. Ervaring: Minimum van 13 jaar na registrasie met SAPC as Apteker ten opsigte van Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Kennis en Vaardighede: Gesondheids- en Veiligheidsbeleid, Pasienteregtehandves., Batho-Pele-beginsels, Infeksiebeheerbeleid. Probleemoplossing, Interpersoonlike vaardighede, Kommunikasievaardighede, Beplanning, Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Lewer 'n omvattende, professionele en gehalte farmaseutiese diens in die vorm van ondersteuning, bystand, uitvoering van pligte en verrigting van handelinge, in ooreenstemming met tersaaklike beleide, standaard operasionele prosedures en wetgewing. Bestuur van farmaseutiese bylaes. Verseker beskikbaarheid van medisynevoorrade deur medisynevoorsieningsbestuur en voorraadbeheerbeginsels. Hou statistieke aan en stel verslae op. Verseker nakoming van nasionale kernstandaarde. Skryf medikasie aan pasiënte en klinieke voor. Bestuur en beheer van medisynevoorrade. Uitreik van voorrade en geskeduleerde medikasie, berekening van voorraadvlakke, beheer van vervallegte medikasie en handhaaf medisyne registers (skedule 5,6 en skenkings). Verminder risiko in apteek, stel risikobevaluating en aksieplan op. Verseker voldoening aan goeie apteekpraktyk-reëls en -regulasies. Opleiding van personeel, Apteekassistenten, internas en ander apteekondersteuningspersoneel.

zu.title: Usolobhelwane wezamuthi
zu.summary: Kufunwa usolobhelwane wezamuthi ohlezi e-Embekweni District Hospital esifundazweni sakwa-Free State ukuze ahlinze ngezinsizakalo ezibandakanya konke mayelana nezamuthi aphinde alawule imithi kumaqofo amathathu abalwa ngamazinga.
zu.requirements: Ibhalomatriki, idigri efanele ye-Bachelor of Pharmacy evumela ukubhalisa e-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) njengesolobhelwane wezamuthi. Ukubhalisa njengamanje e-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) (2026/2027) Izinga 1: Isipiliyoni: Akukho okudingekile emva kokuqokwa e-SAPC njengesolobhelwane wezamuthi kubasebenzi abathole izifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Isipiliyoni esihamba unyaka owodwa ohambisana nendima emva kokuqokwa njengesolobhelwane wezamuthi e-HPCSA evunyiwe yabasebenzi basemaphandleni, ongadingeki ukuba enze inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Ukubhalisa e-SAPC njengesolobhelwane wezamuthi. Isipiliyoni: Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-5 ithole kokuqokwa e-SAPC njengesolobhelwane wezamuthi kubasebenzi abathole izifundo eNingizimu Afrika. njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 3: Ukubhalisa e-SAPC njengesolobhelwane wezamuthi. Isipiliyoni: Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-13 ithole kokuqokwa e-SAPC njengesolobhelwane wezamuthi kubasebenzi abathole izifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi Nemakhono: Inqubomgomo yokuQinisekiswa kwezempilo nokuphephwa, isitifiketi samalungelo esiguli, izimiso ze-Batho-Pele, inqubomgomo yokulawula ukutheleleka. Ukuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okuxhumana nabantu, amakhono okukhuluma, ukuhlela, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngesevisi eyisiphephelo ezibandakanya konke, eyingcowo yomsebenzi enhle kuleyo yokusekela, ukusiza, ukwenza imisebenzi nokuqeda imisebenzi, ngokuhambisana nezinqubomgomo ezihlobene, izinqubo ezilawula imisebenzi yansuku zonke kanye nomthetho. Ukuphatha okwengeziwe kwezamuthi. Qinisekisa ukuthi kukhona isitoko samuthi ngokusebenzisa izimiso zokulawula ukulethwa kwemithi kanye nokulawula isitoko. Ukugcina izibalo kanye nokulungisa imibiko. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana namazinga abalwe azele abavela ezweni. Phatha imithi kubasiziwe nabasezikhungweni. Ukulawula nokulawula isitoko samuthi. Ukuphepha isitoko nemithi ehloliwe, ukubala izinga lesitoko, ukulawula imithi edlule isikhathi kanye nokugcina ukubhalisa kwemithi (abashada 5, 6 kanye nezokupha. Yahla isibhaxa kusolobhelwane, hlela isilinganiso sesibhaxa kanye nenhlelo yokwenza. Qinisekisa ukuthi kulandelwa imithetho nezinhlelo zokuziphatha okuhle ekusebenzeleni kwamuthi. Ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, abasiza kusolobhelwane, abafundi, nabanye abantu abasekela usolobhelwane.

xh.title: Umqedeli wezithethe zezempilo
xh.summary: Kufunwa umqedeli wezithethe zezempilo we-Embekweni District Hospital ese-Free State ukunika iinkonzo ezizibonakalisoyo nezibanzi zezithethe kwaye alawule izithethe kuwo onke amanqanaba amathathu okulinganisa.
xh.requirements: I-Matric, i-Degree ye-Bachelor of Pharmacy efanelekile evumela ubhaliso kwi-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) njengomqedeli wezithethe zezempilo. Ubhaliso olusekeloyo kwi-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) (2026/2027). I-Grade 1: Uluhlu lwezezonqaniso: Akukho nzima emva kobhaliso kwi-SAPC njengomqedeli wezithethe zezempilo mayela nababasebenzi abafunde eMzantsi Afrika. Unyaka omnye woluhlu lwezezonqaniso oluhambelana nemisebenzi emva kobhaliso njengomqedeli wezithethe zezempilo kwi-Health Professional Council ezedulelayo ngokwasemazwe mayela nababasebenzi abafunde ngaphandle kwawo onke amazwe, abangekafunelweni ukwenza inkonzo yoluntu njengoko kufuneka eMzantsi Afrika. I-Grade 2: Ubhaliso kwi-SAPC njengomqedeli wezithethe zezempilo. Uluhlu lwezezonqaniso: Ubuncinane kwiminyaka engama-5 emva kobhaliso kwi-SAPC njengomqedeli wezithethe zezempilo mayela nababasebenzi abafunde eMzantsi Afrika. njengoko kufuneka eMzantsi Afrika. I-Grade 3: Ubhaliso kwi-SAPC njengomqedeli wezithethe zezempilo. Uluhlu lwezezonqaniso: Ubuncinane kwiminyaka engama-13 emva kobhaliso kwi-SAPC njengomqedeli wezithethe zezempilo mayela nababasebenzi abafunde eMzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi Namakhono: Inqubomgomo ye-Health and Safety, i-Patient Rights Charter., iimpazamgama ze-Batho-Pele, inqubomgomo yolawulo lotywalayo. Ihlaziya iingxaki, amakhono okuxhumana nabaningi, amakhono okunyaniseka ekuthetheni, uqhelaniso, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo ezibanzi, yobungcali negangatheli ngezithethe ngendlela yenkxaso, ncedo, ukuphumeza imisebenzi nokuwenza izenzo, ngokuhambelana neenqubomgomo ezifanelekileyo, iinkqubo zokusebenza ezingagqibekanga nomthetho. UkuLawula izandiso zezithethe. Qinisekisa ukubakho kwemith yesihteki ngokulawula ukubonelelwa ngezithethe nemiqulunqo yemithi. Ukugcina izibalo kwaye udibe iingxelo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela iindingo ezisisiseko zenarha. Khupha imithi kwabagulayo nakumaziko. UkuLawula nokulawula imithi yesihteki. Ukunika imithi yesihteki kwaye uqikelele inqanaba lemithi yesihteki, ulawule imithi ephelelwe yisikhathi kwaye ugcine izitshixo zomceli (eziqgoqwe njenge-5, 6 ncedo). Yehlisa ingozi kwigumbi lemithi yesihteki, daba ingxelo yokulinganisa ingozi nenkqubo yomthetho ophethe kuko. Qinisekisa ukuzinikela kumagunya namacebo esiqu se-senate elungiselelwe ukwenza umsebenzi kwaye ancedise abantu ukuba baphile ngokweNkosi uYehova. Ukuqeqeswa kwabasebenzi, abancedisi bemithi yesihteki, abafundi, nakunye abancedisi bemithi yesihteki.

Qhube iinkqubo zokubeka izinto ezizakusebenza kwinkqubo ekwasebenza ngayo isakhiwo ngasinye kwisazulu esilawula urhwebo, urhwebo oluchanekileyo olumiselweyo ngokweemfuno zexpenditsha, ukulungelelanisa amaxabiso, ukuthathwa kwezexpenditsha ngokusemthethweni, kunye nokuphendula ngenkqubo ebonelelwa. Qhube ukusetyenziswa kolwazi ngeBhajithi eKho njengengcebiso yeinkxaso-mali kwesi sebe. Qhube ukubonelelwa kweenkxaso-mali kwiinkqubo ezikwisazulu seNqanaba lePhondo nakweminye imisebenzi. Qhube iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezifuna inkxaso-mali kwisazulu, ukuze ihlanganiswe nenkqubo yokubonelelwa. Qhube ukulungelelanisa ukwenza izinto kwinkqubo yokwenza iinkonzo ezinikiweyo ekuqhuba iinkqubo zokwenza okuhle. Qhube izazithuba ezahlukeneyo ngokuphendula kwezamagama, inkxaso-mali, iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Qhube iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezinikiweyo kwisazulu nakwezinye izazithuba ezikumaziko. Qhube izazithuba ngokuphendula iinkxaso-mali, iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo, amaxabiso, izimali ezichithwayo. Qhube iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezikumaziko nakuMnyama weKhabhthi.

Ability to provide mentoring, team building, supervisory skills and couching to her/his supervisees. Good communication, interpersonal relations, counselling, conflict management skills and decision making. Labour Relations Act, Grievance Procedures and finance policies etc. Leadership organization decision making and problem solving conflict handling and counselling. Co- ordination and planning skills.
