zu.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi (PNB3): Ukunakekelwa Kwezempilo Okuyisisekelo
zu.summary: Umphathi Wemisebenzi wemizuzu yokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo eThabo Mofutsanyane, ofuna iziqu zokuhlinza nokubhaliswa kwi-SANC.
zu.requirements: I-Matric, kanye neziqu ezibekiweyo ezincane: Isiqu se-Basic R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/idigri ekunakekelweni kokugula) noma isiqu esilinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesibhedlela esibhalisiwe ekunakekelweni kokugula jikelele. NOKU - Idigri yobudokotela wezeminyaka eyi-4 ekunakekelweni kokugula (R174) evumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoguli ochwepheshe ekunakekelweni kokugula jikelele. Ukubhaliswa kwiNdlu YabaChwepheshe: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengesibhedlela esibhalisiwe ekunakekelweni kokugula jikelele kanye nokubelethiswa kanye nesiqu sokuhlinza esibalwe ngemva kwesiqu esisisekelo ezenzululwazi zokuhlinza eklinikhini, ukuhlola izempilo. Ukwelapha nokunakekela (Ukunakekelwa Kwezempilo Okuyisisekelo) ngasesikhathini esingaphansi konyaka oyisikhombisa osesikhundeni se-1 esamukelekwe yi-SANC. Ukwazi ukusebenza okulinganayo / okubonakalayo okungu-9 eminyakeni ekunakekelweni kokugula ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengoguli ochwepheshe kwi-SANC. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yaleso sikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube yisipiliyoni esifanele/okubonakalayo ekuphatweni kwezokuhlinza. Ukubhaliswa kwangoku kwi-SANC 2026/2027. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi Nekhono: ikhono elihle lokubhala imibiko nolawula isikhathi. Ukuqonda umthetho wezokuhlinza, amasiko okuhlinza ahloniphekile nendlela lokho okuphunyulwa ngayo ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Ikhono lokunikela ngokuqondisa, ukwakha iqembu, amakhono okuhlola nokukholisa abantu abangaphansi kwakhe. Unxibelelwano oluhle, ubuhlobo nabantu, imibuzo yezingqondo, amakhono okuphatha izinkinga kanye nokwenza izinqumo. Ulwazi ngawo onke amathambo athintekayo njengakumthetho Wezokuhlinza, umthetho Wezempilo Yengqondo, i-OH&S Act, Imigomo Yabathandi Izigidi noMthetho Wamalungelo Abaguli. Umthetho Wezabasebenzi, Izinqubo Zezinkinga kanye nemigomo yezimali njll. Ukuba ngumholi, ukwenza izinqumo nokuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga kanye nokweluleka. Ikhono lokuhlela futhi lolawula. Ikhono losiza ekwenzeni imigomo ehlobene nokunakekelwa kwabaguli. Umhwebi kumele akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha abe nelayisensi evumelekile enganamaphutha yokushayela kanye nobuchwepheshe bokushayela. Abathunyiwe bazohlolwa ukubona ukuthi bakhono kangakanani ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, kuzotholakala ukuxhumana kuphela nalabo abantu abahlangabezana nezidingo. Ikhono lokucubungula futhi ulungise umsebenzi wakhe nalabo abamsiza ukuze kuqiniseke ukunakekelwa kokuhlinza okuhle. Unxibelelwano olusebenzayo nabantu abathe xaxa kanye nakhono lokubhala imibiko. Ukubhukuda ngokwesibopho esingaqedi ekunakekelweni kwabaguli, ukukhuthaza nokukhusela ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okufanele kuhlanganise nokuqonda nokuzinika ukuthola ukuphendula izidingo, izidingo kanye nezinhlobo zabaguli (Batho Pele). Ukubonisa ukuqonda umthetho wezokuhlinza kanye nezinye izakhiwo ezihlobene nomthetho.
zu.duties: Ukucubungula, ukulungisa futhi uhlolisise inhloso zemizuzu ye-PHC ngokubonisana neNdlu Yolawulo kanye Nabalawuli. Ukunikeza Ukunakekelwa Kokuhlinza Kwekhwalithi ngokusebenzisa izinga, imigomo kanye nezinqubo kanye nokuhlola ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zihlolwa ngendlela efanele. Ukunikeza indawo ethuthukisa impilo kubasebenzi, kubaguli nakuzwelonke. Ukulawula ngempumelelo ukusetshenziswa nokuqondisa abantu, izinto nezimali. Ukuqondisa ukunikezwa kwemfundo nokuphande okusebenzayo. Ukugcina ukukhula ngobuchwepheshe / amasiko ahloniphekile nokuqonda. Ukusebenzisa kanye uhlolisise izinkolelo ze-PMDS. Ukusebenzisa nokuphatha Imithetho Yokuvimba Ukutheleleka kanye Nezinqubo Zokuvikela kanye Nezinga Lokuphepha Kwabasebenzi. Ukugcina ukushicilela ngokunembile kanye nokubuka ukugcwaliswa kwemibhalo yabagili ngokwesimiso somthetho. Ukuphatha futhi ulawule izimiso Ezokuphatha Ulwazi Lezempilo Ebandela (DHIMS), ikakhulukazi ukukhiqiza idatha ephiqele. Ukuthatha inhlalothonyana ekwelulekeni nasezenzweni zokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi. Ukuba nobono futhi ukwazi ukwenza ukulinganisa kokuzuzwa Izindlela Zesibhedlela Esihle. Ukuba nobono obuzoqondwa ngemidlalo ye-OHSC nemiqulu. Ukwenza izivivinyo zokuhlinza ngokuhamba isikhathi. Ukuthatha inhlalothonyana ekuthuthukiseni abasebenzi kanye nabafundi. Ukwenza ukulawula okuzimele ngaphezu kwemithetho yokuqothuka, izinkinga kanye nezindaba zabasebenzi ngokwezinqubo kanye nemigemo ekhona. Ukuqapha, ukuthuthukisa futhi ukusebenzisa ukuphatha ukubeka ezingenwe yingozi endaweni yokusebenza. Ukuxhumana neNgingasemuva, Isifunda nabo bonke abanye abahlulelekile. Ukugcina futhi uhlolisise ukusebenza kwezinsizakalo ezunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo kanye neso ngaphakathi kwesikhala sezinsizakalo esinikelwe ngokuhambisana nezinkomba zezempilo zomphakathi, imithetho, izinga kanye nezinhlolojwana ngokubona ukushicilela futhi ukwenza ukulungisa ngokushesha. Ukuphendla imigemo yezempilo kanye nezenzo ebalulekile ngokubona ukwakha izindlela zokwenza eziqondisiwe ukuyosiza abanakekeli bakunakekelwa kokugula kuyisisekelo kuleso sikhala.

xh.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi (PNB3): Eza kunikelwa iNkonzo yeMpilo Yoqobo
xh.summary: Umphathi Wemisebenzi kumaziko eza kunikelwa iNkonzo yeMpilo Yoqobo eThabo Mofutsanyane, ofuna izifundo zokuzisa nokuqwalaselwa kolwazi kwi-SANC.
xh.requirements: I-Matric, ngaphezulu koko ifundo esemthethweni efunekayo: Isifundo esisisiseko se-R425 (okt. idiploma/izidanga kubuchwepheshe bokuzisa) okanye isifundo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi oqwalaselweyo kuQeqesho luqobo lweMipi. OKT - Isidanga se-Bachelor Degree samyanga i-4 kuQeqesho (R174) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoMongikazi oGqithiweyo kuQeqesho luqobo lweMipi. Ukubhalisa kwiBhungo leMfundo: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi oqwalaselweyo kuQeqesho luqobo lweMipi & kokuSula ngaphakathi kwamnye ngesifundo sokuzisa sangemva kwesisisiseko kwiSayensi yokuQeqeshwa kweMipi, ukuQinisekiswa koMzimba. Isondlulo nokuKhathalela (iNkonzo yeMpilo Yoqobo) ngexesha elingangaphezulu konyaka owodwa ovunyiwe yi-SANC. Amanqanaba amabini angaphezulu kweminyaka eliqrobha/eshiwayo emsebenzini wokuzisa emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi ogqithiweyo kwi-SANC. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yexesha elitshiwo ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava amafanelekileyo/aziwayo kulawulo lokuzisa. Ukubhalisa kwangoku kwi-SANC 2026/2027. Ilayiseni yokuqeshelaimoto esemthethweni. Ulwazi namakhono: Amakhona amabalisa iingxelo elungileyo nokulawula ixesha. Ukuqonda umthetho wokuzisa, iindlela zokuzisa ezisezisa nendlela eziqela ngayo inkonzo ekubonelelweni. Ulwazi lokunika isakhono, ukwakhiwa kweqela, amakhono okulawula nokukhokeza abalawuli bakhe. Ukunyaniseka kolwazi nokuqonda abantu bethu, iimvisiswano, ukulawula ngcono ukungavumelani namakhono okwenza izigqibo. Ulwazi ngomthetho wonke othintelayo njengakumthetho wokuzisa, umthetho weMental Health, umthetho we-OH&S, iimvela zenjongo zeBatho Pele neMvela zamalungelo abaguli. Umthetho weLabour Relations, iinkqubo ezisilawa ngaphakathi namapolisi ezimali naxa. Ukuqhuba umba, ukwenza izigqibo nokusombulula iingxaki zokukhathalela nokuqonda. Amakhono okuququumbela nokuqwalaselwa kokuqamba amapolisi ahlotshaniswa nokukhathalela kwabaguli. Umphumeleli kufuneka abe nolwazi lokusebenzise ikhompyutha anaye nelayiseni yokuqeshelaimoto esemthethweni engenaziphazamisi, kuqatwe nokuqhuba ngokusemthethweni. Ootuliweyo baza kuvavanywa ngolwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukunyaniseka nokubandakanywa kwenziwa kuphela nabathwele abo bahlanka zonke iimfuno. Ulwazi lokuyicwangcisa nokuqamba inkqubo yomsebenzi wakhe nalawo abakhuselayo ukuqinisekisa ukukhathalela ngokuzisa okulungileyo. Unyano lokunyaniseka kubo bonke abathintatho namacandelo nokuqamba iingxelo elungileyo. Ukuzithembisa ngokukhathalela ngokungalibaliyo abaguli, ukukhuthaza nokuzimela ukukhathalela ngokutsho nokwazi ukubuyisela iimfuno, iimfuno nemiqondiso yabaguli (Batho Pele). Ukuqondakalisa umthetho wokuzisa namaphu ambali ngokomthetho ahlobeneyo.
xh.duties: Ukuqamba, ukuqhuba nokulawula iinjongo zamaziko e-PHC ngokubonisana noLawulo loMmandla nabanuncwadi. Ukunika iNkonzo yokuzisa elungileyo ngokusebenzisa iinqanaba, amapolisi nokuqwalaselwa kwamaxwebhu kunye nokuqwalaselwa nokulandelela imisebenzi yawo. Ukubonelela izembo zokuchachamba kubasebenzi, abaguli nolutsha. Ukulawula ngcono ukusetyenziswa nokulawula abantu abasebenzayo, izinto ezibonakalayo nezimali. Ukuququumbela ukubonelela kolwazi ngokutsha nokuphanda olusemthethweni. Ukugcina ukukhula ngokuzisa / iinqanaba zokuzisa nokuqeqeshwa komntu. Ukusebenzisa nokuqwalaselwa iinjongo ze-PMDS. Ukusebenzisa nokulawula iinkqubo zokuLawula nokuThintela uKusuleleka nakuQinisekiso lokuHamba kolunye noMoya oKhuselweyo. Ukugcina iingxelo zabaguli ngokuchanekileyo nokuqwalaselwa ukugqibela kwamaxwebhu ngokumthetho. Ukusebenzisa nokulawula iinkqubo zoLawulo loLwazi lweZempi zoMmandla (DHIMS), ngokukodwa ukubonelela ngenani eliphezulu lemininingwane. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumaxwebhu nolwazi lwenkqubo yamaphupha nokwenza amaxwebhu aphuculweyo. Ukuba nolwazi lokwenza uKuqwalaselwa kokwenzeka kweMpi yeMpi eqhubekayo. Ukuba nolwazi oluqondileyo ngokwenzeka kolunye nokuqamba kwe-OHSC. Ukwenza ukuvavanywa ngokuchanekileyo kolunye nokuqwalaselwa kwamaxwebhu aphuculweyo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kolwazi nokuqeqeswa kolwazi bosawolunye nabafundi. Ukuzimela ngokukhululeka kulawulo lwesigqibo, iinkqubo zokuGxeka nokuQwalaselwa kolunye kumthetho ngokwamaxwebhu nokuqhuba ngokweenqobo. Ukubona, ukuyila nokusebenzisa ulawulo lwengozi kwindawo yokusebenza. Ukuqwalaselwa kweSahlulo, uMmandla nabo bonke abathintatho abalawulayo. Ukulawula nokuqinisekisa ukusebenzela kolunye lwesixeko ngokulawulwa ngokwemilinganiselo yolwazi yoluntu ngokubheka iindawo eziqhelweyo nokuqwalaselwa ukuze kubaliswe nokuba ngexesha ukuyilwa kolunye.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Mondhiëgiene: H/a/38/2026
af.summary: 'n Assistentdirekteur: Mondhiëgiene word benodig by die Free State Department of Health Corporate Office om provinsiale mondgessondheidsbeleid en die skoolgesondheidsprogram te koördineer.
af.requirements: Matriek plus 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA in mondhiëgiene toelaat. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in mondhiëgiene en 5 jaar moet toepaslike ervaring in toesighoudende/Bestuurservaring wees. Huidige registrasie by HPCSA in Mondhiëgiene (2026/2027). Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en vaardighede: Uitstekende fasilitering, kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik). Basiese begrip van HR en finansiële beleide en praktyke. Kennis van beplanning, organisering, leiding, beheer, delegasie, toesighouding, motivering, besluitneming en probleemoplossing. Kennis van relevante beleide, prosesse en regulasies. Basiese rekenaarvaardigheid (Word, Excel en Power point).
af.duties: Koördineer en bestuur die provinsiale implementering van die Mondgesondheidsbeleid oor alle distrikte. Hou toesig oor die provinsiale Skoolgesondheidsprogram en monitor vordering teen NIDS-teikens. Verskaf strategiese leierskap en tegniese ondersteuning aan Distrik Mondgesondheidskoördineerders. Monitor en evalueer die kwaliteit van mondgessondheidsdienste om nakoming van kliniese standaarde te verseker. Fasiliteer opleiding van personeel, veranderingbestuur en professionele ontwikking terwyl die provinsiale mondgessondheidsafdeling in strategiese bestuursvergaderings verteenwoordig word. Verseker dat dienslewering aan gehaltstandaarde en Batho Pele-klantediens voldoen. Bestuur die menslike, finansiële en fisiese hulpbronne van die provinsiale mondhiëgienies-afdeling.

zu.title: Umncedisi Wezikhulu: Ukunakekelwa Kwezinyo: H/a/38/2026
zu.summary: Uwuncedisi Wezikhulu: Ukunakekelwa Kwezinyo odingeka eFree State Department of Health Corporate Office ukulungiselela inqubomgomo yezempilo yezinyo yesisifunda kanye nenqubo yezempilo yezikole.
zu.requirements: Umatric kanye nesifundo esifanelekile esivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA ekunakekelweni kwezinyo. Okungenani unyaka wengu-3 wokuhlangenwa okufanelekile emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA ekunakekelweni kwezinyo futhi kumele kube unyaka wengu-5 wohluva lokuhlangenwa okufanelekile ekubhekeni/nakwenziwa. Ukubhalisa okusamanje ku-HPCSA Ekunakekelweni Kwezinyo (2026/2027). Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi Nobuchwepheshe: Ukuba bulele, ukuxhumana (ngomsindo nakubhalwe). Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kwezinqumo zemisebenzi kanye nezinqumomali kanye nokwenza. Ulwazi lokuhlela, ukulungiselela, ukukhokha, ukulawula, ukwabelana, ukubheka, ukugqugquzela, ukwenza izinqumo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi lwezinqubomgomo ezihambisana naleyo, kanye nemithetho. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha oluyisisekelo (Word, Excel kanye nePower point).
zu.duties: Lungiselela futhi uphathe ukusetshenziswa kweNqubomgomo Yezempilo Yezinyo yesisifunda kuzo zonke izifunda. Bhekelele iNqubo Yezempilo Yezikole yesisifunda futhi ulandele inqubo yokuhamba kuyo ngokuhambisana namagasu e-NIDS. Nikeza ukubusa okuyisikhashana kanye nokwesekwa ngobuchwepheshe kubaluleki Bephilho Yezinyo Bezifunda. Bheka futhi uhlole umgangatho wamasevisi ezempilo yezinyo, ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi hambisana namagugu okwelapha. Lwisa ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, ukushintsha ukuphathwa, kanye nentuthuko yobungcweti ngenkathi umela ingxenye yezempilo yezinyo yesisifunda kumihlangano yokuphathwa okuyisikhashana. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukulethwa kwezinsiza kuhlangabezwa namagagu omgangatho futhi kuhlangabezwa nesevisi yamakhasimende kaBatho Pele. Phatha izinsiza zangabantu, ezomali kanye nezomzimba zengxenye yezempilo yezinyo yesisifunda.

xh.title: Umkekeli wohlelo: Ukonga amazinyo: H/a/38/2026
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umkekeli wohlelo: Ukonga amazinyo kwindawo yeFree State Department of Health Corporate Office ukulungelelanisa inqubomgomo yamaphondo ekongeni impilo yamazinyo nenkqubo yempilo yezikolo.
xh.requirements: Ukugqiba ibanga leshumi lokugqatsha nokuba nelayisensi efanelekileyo evumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA ekongeni amazinyo. Kufuneka kube nokunesipho sobuchule sobuchule besiqu okungenani kwiminyaka engu-3 emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA ekongeni amazinyo kwaye eminye iminyaka engu-5 kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo ekulawuleni/buphathi. Ukubhalisa kwangoku kwi-HPCSA Ekongeni amazinyo (2026/2027). Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi nobuchule: Ukulungelelanisa, ukunxibelelana (ngolwimi lwasemlonyeni nolubhaliweyo) okugqithisileyo. Ukuqonda okusemngciphekweni kweenkqubo ze-HR nezeemali nemisebenzi yazo. Ulwazi lokuceba, ukuhlela, ukulawula, ukulawula, ukwabelana abanye umsebenzi, ukulawula abasebenzi, ukukhuthaza, ukwenza izigqibo nokuxazulula iingxaki. Ulwazi lweenkqubomgomo ezifanelekileyo, iinkqubo neemithetho. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha olusesixhoseni (i-Word, i-Excel ne-Power point).
xh.duties: Lungelelanise ulawule ukusebenza kwephondo kwenkqubomgomo yokuLunga amazinyo kuzo onke amaphondo. Qwalasela inkqubo yempilo yamiphondo yezikolo ulindele inkqubela ngokumgamaniso namagqabo e-NIDS. Nikela nokuqhankqalaza nokuxhasa ngamazinga obuchule abalawuli bamaphondo beMpiI yeMazinyo. Qwalasela lenze isiqondo ngangakumbi ngokwemigaqo yohle lo lwazi ngokwamazinga obuchule bokulingana namagqabo ekliniki. Khuthaza ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, uguqulo lolawulo, nokuqhuba nabaphuhlisa abantu ngexesha lokumela candelo lemiphondo yokuhlonipha amazinyo kwindibano zolawulo ezibalulekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba isixekelelo singezwa iinxalenye zemigaqo ezifanelekileyo ize kwenza okuBatho Pele ngokwamacebo okukhululeka kubathengi. Lawula izixhobo ezingatyiwa zandisiweyo zolwazi, zemali namaziko obomi bakho hlanga nakwindawo apho uqeqeshwa khona.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager: Community Development
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R602 361 - R688 737 per annum plus, Cheque, Housing Allowance, Medical Aid (Optional, Employee must meet the prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Coordinate and manage integrated community development interventions in the Thabo Mofutsanyana District, requiring a tertiary qualification and eight years of experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus an appropriate three year tertiary qualification. Experience: minimum of 8 year recognisable experience in Community Development after obtaining the required qualification. Knowledge And Skills: Strong stakeholder engagement, financial management. Planning and Organizing Policy formulation and implementation. Written and verbal communication skills. Problem solving and Conflict management. Influencing skills and Computer literate.
jobs.duties: Coordinate the identification, facilitation and implementation of integrated development interventions in partnership with other relevant stakeholders through the efficient, effective and economical utilisation of resources by the service delivery area(s). Coordinate and manage a community development service delivery area(s) to ensure that an efficient and effective community development service is delivered through the proper utilisation of human, financial and physical resources. Keep up to date with new developments in the community development and management fields to enhance service delivery. Plan and ensure that research on community development is undertaken including the facilitation of complex community development research.
jobs.applications: Free State Provincial Department of Health utilises an e-Recruitment System (applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://www.erecruitment.fs.gov.za
jobs.notes: all applicants must login/register to apply for positions. The applicant’s profile on the eRecruitment is equivalent to the newly approved Z83, and it is the responsibility of applicants to ensure their profiles are fully completed or their applications will not be considered, as per the DPSA Practice Note. Applicants should upload their Curriculum Vitae (CV) on the e-Recruitment system. (Please ensure is in PDF format & maximum size 3MB). The Curriculum Vitae should be specific regarding previous positions occupied and the start date and end date of the position(s) should be indicated. Accompanying relevant documentation required to be uploaded on the system such as copies of all qualifications including National Senior Certificate/Matric certificate, Driver’s license, ID, etc., such documents need not be certified at point of application, however, certification will be required prior to attending the interview. Only short-listed candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on, or before the day of the interview following an invitation from the Department to attend an interview, and such qualification(s) and other related document(s) should be in line with the requirements of the advertisement. Successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) is required for being considered for this SMS post prior to appointment. Enrolment for the course should be made on the NSG’s website at https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms- pre-entry-programme. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other will be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with these instructions will not be considered. The onus is on the applicants to ensure that their applications are submitted online timeously. Candidates who possess foreign qualifications and/or short courses certificates must take it upon themselves to have their qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). The highest relevant qualification should be captured/listed as the first qualification on the e-recruitment profile. Applicants are respectfully informed that if no notification of appointment is received within 4 months of the closing date, they must accept that their applications were unsuccessful. Communication will be limited to short-listed candidates only. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial assets check, qualification verification and reference checks). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations and/or record. The Department reserves the right not to make appointments on the advertised post(s). Free State Provincial Department of Health is compliant with the requirements of POPIA. The Department of Health is an equal opportunity affirmative action employer. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of this post(s) with a candidate whose transfer / promotion / appointment will promote representativity in line with the numerical targets as contained in our Employment Equity Plan. af.title: Assistentbestuurder: Gemeenskapsontwikkeling
af.summary: Koördineer en bestuur geïntegreerde gemeenskapsontwikkelingsintervensies in die Thabo Mofutsanyana District, wat 'n tersiêre kwalifikasie en agt jaar ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Matriek plus 'n toepaslike driejaar-tersiêre kwalifikasie. Ervaring: minimum van 8 jaar herkenbare ervaring in gemeenskapsontwikkeling na verwerwing van die vereiste kwalifikasie. Kennis en vaardighede: Sterk belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, finansiële bestuur. Beplanning en organisering van beleidsformulering en -implementering. Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Probleemoplossing en konflikbestuur. Beïnvloedingsvaardighede en rekenaargeletterdheid.
af.duties: Koördineer die identifisering, facilitering en implementering van geïntegreerde ontwikkelingsintervensies in samewerking met ander relevante belanghebbendes deur die doeltreffende, effektiewe en ekonomiese benutting van hulpbronne deur die diensleweringarea(s). Koördineer en bestuur 'n gemeenskapsontwikkelingsdiensleweringarea(s) om te verseker dat 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe gemeenskapsontwikkelingsdiens gelewer word deur die behoorlike benutting van menslike, finansiële en fisiese hulpbronne. Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelings in die gemeenskapsontwikkelings- en bestuursvelde om dienslewering te verbeter. Beplan en verseker dat navorsing oor gemeenskapsontwikkeling onderneem word, insluitend die facilitering van komplekse gemeenskapsontwikkelingsnavorsing.

zu.title: Umsekeli Womphathi: Inhlanganisela Yomphakathi
zu.summary: Kohelela futhi aphathe izinyathelo zokuhlanganisa inhlanganisela yomphakathi esifundeni i-Thabo Mofutsanyana District, okudinga izifundo eziphakeme kanye neminyaka eyisishiyagalombolhe yesiphiwo.
zu.requirements: I-Matric kanye nefomula ezinhle ngesifundo esiphakeme samashumi eminyaka emithathu. Isiphiwo: okuncane kweminyaka eyisishiyagalombolhe yesiphiwo esihlonishwayo kwi-Community Development ngemuva kokuthola izifundo ezingezofuneka. Ulwazi Nakhono: Ukuhlanganyela okuqinile nabahlanganyeli, ukuphatha imali. Ukuhlela kanye nokuhlela inqubomgomo nokuyisetenziswa. Amakhono okubhaliwe nokukhuluma. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuphatha ingxabano. Amakhono okuthonya kanye nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Cohelela ukuhlukanisa, ukwenza lula kanye nokusetenziswa kwamaphrojekthi ohlanganisela wophuhliso ngokubambisana nabanye abahlanganyeli abahlobene ngokusebenzisa ngokusebenza kahle, ngempumelelo nangokwezimali okuncane amadistributed azenjalo. Lohelela futhi uphathe i-Customer service area yomphakathi ukuze aqiniseke ukuthi ukwenza kahle kanye nokusebenza ngempumelelo kuhlinzeka ngomphakathi kusetenziswa ngokufanele imindeni yomphakathi imali kanye nemindeni yemvelo. Gcina ulwazi olusha mayelana nezinhlobonhlobo zophuhliso komphakathi nasekuqondeni ukuthi kube yinhlalo kwezenhlalo kakhulu. Hlela futhi uqinise ukuthi kwenziwa ucwaningo mayelana nokuba yindawo ngesimo somphakathi.

xh.title: Umlawuli oncedo: Uluntu Olutsha
xh.summary: Lawula kwaye ulawule iindaba ezenzela ukuba kendu kweendawo zoluntu ngokubambisana nabanye kwi Thabo Mofutsanyana District, kufuneka kubekho isidanga semfundo esilula neleminyaka elishumi elisixhenye esimanyeneyo yokuba kendu.
xh.requirements: Umatricidayithi kunye nesidanga semfundo esifanelekileyo kwikhondo lemfundo elingqwalasela iminyaka emithathu. Isipho: Iminyaka evunyelwayo engu 8 yokuba kendu Kuluntu emva kokufumana isidanga esifunekayo. Ulwazi Nezakhono: Ukuzibandakanya okusesikweni nabathathi-nxaxheba, ulawulo lwemali. Ukucwangcisa nokuhlelwa kweendaba ezilungeleleneyo nokubhaliwa kweendaba ezisetyenziswayo. Izakhono zokubhala nokuthetha.
xh.duties: Lawula kuqaphula, ukwenza lula nokuphumeza iindaba ezenzela ukuba kendu kweendawo zoluntu ngokubambisana namanye abathathi-nxaxheba abafanelekileyo ngesixokelekwane seendlela ezilungele ngokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo, ngokusesikweni nangokulinganiseleko kweendobo. Lawula kwaye ulawule indawo orhangqwa kuyo ukubakwa kendu kweendawo zoluntu ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho ukubakwa kendu olusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nangokulinganiseleko kwimisebenzi yendawo zoluntu ngokupheleleyo kwimisebenzi esetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo yabantu, nezimali nezenzo ezibonakalayo. Gcina ulwazi olutsha ehlebeni ngokuba kendu kweendawo zoluntu nakwilabo yolawulo ukuze kuzuze ukuphumeza imisebenzi. Cwangcisa uze uqinisekise ukuba kwenziwa kuphando ngendawo zoluntu kuquka nokwenza lula kuphando olunzulu ngokuphela malunga nokuba kendu kweendawo zoluntu.

jobs.title: Clinical Programme Coordinator (INFECTION Prevention and
jobs.salary_text: R571 161 – R654 285 per annum, plus 13th Cheque, Housing Allowance, Rural Allowance, Medical Aid (Optional, Employee must meet the prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Clinical Programme Coordinator for infection prevention at Winburg District Hospital, requiring a nursing qualification and SANC registration as a Professional Nurse.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. OR – A 4-year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. Advantageous Certificate in Infection Prevention and Control. Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse and Midwife. Appropriate Diploma/Degree in Nursing Education with a duration of at least one year accredited by SANC. A minimum of 7 years appropriate or recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC General Nursing. Valid Drivers license. Computer literacy Knowledge And Skills: Demonstrate understanding of infection Control and Prevention policies and practices. Good understanding of Occupational Health and Safety policies and Act, Infection Control management and all treatment policies and guidelines. Ability to work independently and under pressure. Good communication, interpersonal, problem solving, driving and conflict management skills. Knowledge of key priority health programs and key priority health programs. Knowledge of all clinical programmes, including HAIs. Be willing to travel for trainings and meetings.
jobs.duties: Ensure the implementation and reviewing the facility IPC operational plan and annual work Programme. Coordinate and facilitate IPC Committee meetings and conduct regular IPC audits. Ensure implementation of IPC policies, protocols and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Coordinate and train personnel according to the training plan, including relevant stakeholders. Participate in the analysis of data on programme indicators and assist in developing action plans to address identified needs. Monitor compliance with national and provincial IPC standards. Actively participate in patient care during support visits. Detect, investigate and manage outbreaks promptly. Conduct outbreak investigations and compile reports with recommendations. Participate in health promotion and infection prevention control initiatives. Coordinate surveillance of Healthcare-Associated Infections (HAIs). Conduct nursing staff meetings to disseminate information such as new Infection Prevention Control policies, circulars etc. Promote hand hygiene, PPE use and standard precautions among healthcare workers. Apply the scientific process of nursing and principles to the nursing care of individuals, groups and communities. Review the effectiveness of the application of the scientific approach to nursing and principles for IPC. Continuously review, explore and utilize opportunities for professional development to enhance professional knowledge. Develop good working relationships within the department and with stakeholders. Participate with members of health team in decision-making regarding to health care delivery. Consult and collaborate with multi-disciplinary health teams, organizations and special interest groups. Participate in and represent the institution at various forms. Liaise and coordinate with governmental, non- governmental institutions, other structure and organizations. Attend meeting and communicate on a regular basis with various stakeholders. Develop relationships across diverse groups of stakeholders. Participate in the development of the business plan and promote or identify ways containing health care costs without compromising standards. Analyse infection surveillance data and identify trends Prepare and submit monthly. Quarterly and annual IPC reports. Monitor notifiable medical conditions and outbreak reports. Monitor IPC registers and surveillance databases. Ensue the spending is maximized in line with strategic objectives. Monitor occupational exposures, needle-stick injuries and infection risks among staff. Promote staff immunization programs and post-exposure management. Assess isolation facilities and ventilation requirements. Participate in Ideal Hospital and quality assurance programs

af.title: Kliniese Programkoördineerder (Infeksievoorkoming en
af.summary: Kliniese Programkoördineerder vir infeksievoorkoming by Winburg Distrikshospitaal, wat 'n verpleegkwalifikasie en SANC-registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige vereis.
af.requirements: Matriek plus basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. OF – 'n 4-jarige Bachelorgaad in Verpleegkunde (R174) wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. Voordeelig: Sertifikaat in Infeksievoorkoming en -beheer. Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige en Vroedvrou. Toepaslike Diploma/Graad in Verpleegonderwys met 'n duur van ten minste een jaar geakkrediteer deur SANC. 'n Minimum van 7 jaar toepaslike of herkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC Algemene Verpleegkunde. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Kennis en Vaardighede: Toon begrip van infeksiebeheer- en voorkomingsbeleid en -praktyke. Goeie begrip van Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheidsbeleid en -wet, infeksiebeheerbestuur en alle behandelingsbeleide en -riglyne. Vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk. Goeie kommunikasie-, interpersoonlike, probleemoplossings-, bestuurs- en konflikhanteringsvaardighede. Kennis van sleutelprioriteitsgesondheidsprogramme en sleutelprioriteitsgesondheidsprogramme. Kennis van alle kliniese programme, insluitend HAIs. Bereid wees om vir opleidings en vergaderings te reis.
af.duties: Verseker die implementering en hersiening van die fasiliteit se IPC-operationele plan en jaarlike werkprogram. Koördineer en fasiliteer IPC-komiteevergaderings en voer gereelde IPC-oudites uit. Verseker implementering van IPC-beleid, protokolle en standaardbedryfsprosedures (SBPs). Koördineer en lei personeel op volgens die opleidingsplan, insluitend relevante belanghebbendes. Neem deel aan die analise van data oor program-aanwysers en help met die ontwikkeling van aksieplanne om geïdentifiseerde behoeftes aan te spreek. Monitor nakoming van nasionale en provinsiale IPC-standaarde. Neem aktief deel aan pasiëntsorg tydens ondersteuningsbesoeke. Bespeur, ondersoek en besteer uitbreke onmiddellik. Voer uitbrekondersoeke uit en stel verslae met aanbevelings op. Neem deel aan gesondheidsbevordering en infeksievoorkomings- en -beheer-inisiatiewe. Koördineer waarneming van Gesondheidsorggeassosieerde Infeksies (HAIs). Hou verpleegpersoneelvergaderings om inligting te versprei soos nuwe Infeksievoorkomings- en -beheerbeleide, sirkulêre dokumente, ens. Bevorder handhigiëne, gebruik van PPE en standaardvoorsorgmaatreëls onder gesondheidswerkers. Pas die wetenskaplike proses van verpleegkunde en beginsels toe op die verpleegsorg van individue, groepe en gemeenskappe. Hersien die doeltreffendheid van die toepassing van die wetenskaplike benadering tot verpleegkunde en beginsels vir IPC. Hersien, ondersoek en benut deurlopend geleenthede vir professionele ontwikkeling om professionele kennis te verbeter. Bou goeie werksverhoudinge binne die departement en met belanghebbendes. Neem met lede van die gesondheidspan deel aan besluitneming rakende gesondheidsorglewering. Raadpleeg en werk saam met multidissiplinêre gesondheidspanne, organisasies en spesiale belangegroepe. Neem deel aan en verteenwoordig die instelling by verskeie forums. Skakel en koördineer met regerings-, nie-regeringsinstellings, ander strukture en organisasies. Woon vergaderings by en kommunikeer gereeld met verskeie belanghebbendes. Bou verhoudinge oor diverse groepe belanghebbendes. Neem deel aan die ontwikkeling van die besigheidsplan en bevorder of identifiseer maniere om gesondheidsorgkoste te beheer sonder om standaarde in boete te stel. Analiseer infeksie-waarnemingsdata en identifiseer tendense. Berei voor en dien maandelikse, kwartaal- en jaarlike IPC-verslae in. Monitor aanmeldbare mediese toestande en uitbrekverslae. Monitor IPC-register en waarnemingsdatabasisse. Verseker dat bestedings maksimeer word in ooreenstemming met strategiese doelwitte. Monitor beroepsblootstellings, naaldpynbeserings en infeksierisiko's onder personeel. Bevorder personeel se inentingsprogramme en post-blootstellingbestuur. Assesseer isolasiefasiliteite en ventilasiebehoeftes. Neem deel aan Ideale Hospitaal- en gehalteversekeringsprogramme.

zu.title: Umcoordinator Wezinhlelo Zokwelapha (Ukuvimbela Ukutheleleka Nokuvikelwa Kokutheleleka)
zu.summary: Umcoordinator Wezinhlelo Zokwelapha wokuvimbela ukutheleleka esibhedlela saseWinburg District, ofuna iziqu zobuhlengikazi nokuqashelwa kwi-SANC njengenhlengikazi ezigidi.
zu.requirements: I-Matric kanye nesiqui esiyisisekelo se-R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/iziqu zobuhlengikazi) noma isiqui esilingana nesiqui esivumela ukuqashelwa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengenhlengikazi ezigidi. NOKU – I-Bachelor Degree yeminyaka eyi-4 kubuhlengikazi (R174) evumela ukuqashelwa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengenhlengikazi ezigidi. Kubalulekile: Ifayekhede ekuVimbeleni Nokulawula Ukutheleleka. Ukuqashelwa kwi-SANC njengenhlengikazi ezigidi nongumsizi. Idiploma/iziqu ezifanele eNcedisweni Kobuhlengikazi ezithatha isikhathi esingavoti ngaphansi konyaka ezivunyiwe yi-SANC. Okungeqwayo okungenani okuyiminyaka engu-7 kokuhlolwa okufanele noma okubonakalayo kubuhlengikazi emva kokuqashelwa njengenhlengikazi ezigidi kwi-SANC General Nursing. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi Nobuso Bokusebenza: Bonisa ukuqonda kwezindlela zokulawula nokuvimbela ukutheleleka. Ukuqonda okuhle kwezinhlela kanye neMthetho Yokuphathwa Kwezempilo Nokuvikelwa Esikhundleni Somsebenzi, ukuphathwa kokulawula ukutheleleka kanye nazo zonke izinhlela zokwelapha kanye nezinhlela zokuqondisa. Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa futhi nokusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezeleka. Amakhono okuxhumana okuhle, kokuhlobana nabantu, kokuxazulula izinkinga, okokushayela nokuphatha izinkinga. Ulwazi ngezinhlelo ezibalulekile zezempilo kanye ngezinhlelo ezibalulekile zezempilo. Ulwazi ngazo zonke izinhlelo zokwelapha, okuhlanganisa i-HAIs. Ukube ukulungele ukuhamba uyokholwa noma ukuhamba emihlanganweni.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuphunyuliswa kokuqashelwa futhi uhlole inhleleliso yokusebenza yesikhungo se-IPC nenhleleliso yomsebenzi yonyaka. Hlanganise futhi uthuthukise imihlangano yekomidi ye-IPC futhi wenze ukuhlola okujwayelekile kwe-IPC. Qinisekisa ukuphunyuliswa kwezindlela ze-IPC, amaphrotokholo kanye nezinqubo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza (SOPs). Hlanganise futhi uqeqeshe abasebenzi ngokuya ngenhleleliso yokuqeqesha, okuhlanganisa nabalenge ezibalulekile. Thatha inxaxheba ekuhloleni idatha ngezinkomba zenhleleliso futhi usize ekwakheni izinhlelo zokwenza izinto ukuze uzulule izidingo ezitholakele. Hlola ukuziphatha ngokwezinga le-IPC lelizwe nangesifundazwe. Thatha inxaxheba ngokuzifaka ekunakekelweni kwesiguli phakathi nokuvakashela ukwesekwa. Thola, uphenye futhi uphathe ukwanda kokutheleleka ngokushesha. Yenza ukuphenya ukwanda kokutheleleka futhi uhlanganise imibiko nezinhlobo. Thatha inxaxheba ekukhuthazeni impilo kumasu okuvimbela nokulawula ukutheleleka. Hlanganisa ukugqamisa izifo ezihlotshaniswa nezokunakekelwa kwezempilo (HAIs). Yenza imihlangano yabahlengikazi ukusakaza ulwazi olunjengoba zindela ezintsha zokuVimbela Nokulawula Ukutheleleka, izindikimba, njll. Khuthaza ukuhlamba izandla, ukusebenzisa i-PPE kanye nokuqaphela okujwayelekile phakathi kwabasebenzi bezempilo. Faka inqubo yesayensi yokuhlenga kanye nemitapo yolwazi eNakekelweni Lobuhlengikazi babantu abayodwa, amaqembu kanye nemiphakathi. Hlola ukusebenza kokusetshenziswa kwesu lokuhlenga isayensi Nobuhlengikazi kanye nemigomo ye-IPC. Hlola njalo, uphenye futhi usebenzise ithuba elinzuzo kokuthuthukiswa ngobudalo ukuze ukhulise ulwazi lwakho lobudalo. Phatha ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza ngaphakathi komnyango kanye nabalenge ezibalulekile. Thatha inxaxheba kanye namalungu eqembu lezempilo ekwenzeni izinqumo ngokuhanjiswa kwezempilo. Yixoxe futhi usebenzisane namaqembu okuhlanganyela ezempilo, izinhlangano kanye namaqembu anentshisekelo ekhethekile. Thatha inxaxheka futhi umele isikhungo kumhlangano woluhlobo olwahlukene. Xhumanisa futhi uhlanganyele nezikhungo zahulumende, ezingowahulumende, ezinye izakhiwo kanye nezinhlangano. Yiba emihlanganweni futhi uxhumane njalo nabalenge abahlukene. Phatha ubudlelwano kubalenge abahlukene basebenzayo. Thatha inxaxheba ekuthuthukiseni inhleleliso yamabhizinisi futhi khuthaza noma uthole izindlela zokuqinisekisa izindleko zezempilo ngaphandle kokwehlisa izinga. Hlola idatha yokugqamisa ukutheleleka futhi uthole izinhlobo. Lungiselela futhi ufakela imibiko yenyanga. I-IPC yenyanga kanye yonyaka. Hlola izimo zezo ezibikwayo kanye nemibiko yokwanda kokutheleleka. Hlola izibhalo ze-IPC kanye namadatabheyisi wokugqamisa. Qinisekis ukuthi ukusebenziswa kwezimali kuyakha ngokwezinhloso ezibalulekile. Hlola ukutheleleka ngaphandle komsebenzi, izilimi zezinala kanye nobungozi bokutheleleka phakathi kwabasebenzi. Khuthaza izinhlelo zokuqunjelwa kwesisindo sabasebenzi kanye nokuphatha emva kokutheleleka. Hlola izikhungo zokuhlukaniswa nezidingo zokuhamba komoya. Thatha inxaxheba kuhlelo lwe-Ideal Hospital nezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa izinga.

xh.title: Iqukunyuswa Lenkqubo yezempilo (Ukuvinjwa kwezifo ezithathelanayo)
xh.summary: Iqukunyuswa Lenkqubo yezempilo ekujoliswe kukuvinjwa kwezifo ezithathelanayo kwi-Winburg District Hospital, lifuna isifundo sokuhlola neregistilesho kwi-SANC njengomongikazi oGqithisileyo.
xh.requirements: I-Matric kunye nesifundo esisisiseko se-R425 (okt. idiploma/degree ekukhonweni kwezempilo) okanye isifundo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi oGqithisileyo. OKanye – I-Degree yeminyaka emi-4 ekukhonweni kwezempilo (R174) evumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi oGqithisileyo. Kuyamnceda i-Certificate ekujoliswe kuVinjwa lolawulo lwezifo ezithathelanayo. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi oGqithisileyo nomancedisi wokuzalwa. Idiploma/degree eifanelekileyo ekwazisiweni kwezempilo ixesha elinganganga unyaka owodwa egunyaziswe yi-SANC. Amava amncinci eminyaka engama-7 afanelekileyo okanye awaziwayo ekukhoneni ikwizempilo emva kokuqaliswa njengomongikazi oGqithisileyo kwi-SANC General Nursing. Ilayisensi yokuqhayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha Ulwazi Namakhono: Ukubonisa ukuqonda iindlela ezisemthethweni nezithanda zokuLawula nokuVinjwa kwezifo ezithathelanayo. Ukuqonda kakuhle iindlela ezisemthethweni nokuMthetho woLawulo loMpilo nokhuseleko kolwazi, uLawulo lokuVinjwa kwezifo ezithathelanayo nazo zonke iindlela nolawulo lokwelapha. Ikelo lokusebenza yedwa naphantsi koxinzelelo. Amakhono amabalaa ekunxibelelaneni, kokunxibelelana nabantu, kokusombulula iingxaki, okuqhayela nokuLawula iingxabano. Ulwazi ngenkqubo eziphambili zezempilo. Ulwazi lwezonke iinkqubo zezempilo, kuquka i-HAIs. Ukulungele ukuhamba iindlela ezinde ukuya kokuqeqeshwa nemiqulu.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukusebenzisa kwaye uvavule inkqubo yokusebenza ye-facility IPC nomenzi wemisebenzi yonyaka. Qhube kwaye uxhase iindibano ze-IPC Committee kwaye uqeqeshe ngokwesiqhelo izikwere ze-IPC. Qinisekisa ukusebenzisa iindlela ezisemthethweni ze-IPC, iinkqubo nendlela ezisemthethweni zokuSebenza (i-SOPs). Qhube kwaye uqeqeshe abasebenzi ngokwethuli yokuqeqeshwa, kuquka nabaqaphi abafanelekileyo. Thatha inxaxheba kwuhlalutyo lwedata ngemigangatho yenkqubo kwaye uncede ekwaziseni izicwangciso zentlalo ukujongana neemfuno ezibonwayo. Qaphela ukuthobela imigangatho yaseburhulumente nenguwumbi ye-IPC. Thattha inxaxheba ngokuchaseni kukhathalelo lomntu ngamnye ngesikhathi sondloso ekubuyeleni. Botfa, uphando kwaye ulawule imo yapha ukudibana kwangoko. Qeqesha imaphupha yophando kwaye uqokele iingxelo ngezindululo. Thattha inxaxheba kukhuthazo lokuzivocavo nokuvalelwa kwezifo ezithathelanayo. Qhube umkhondo wezifo ezithathelanayo ezibakaliswa ngokubonelela impilo (i-HAIs). Qeqesha iindibano zabasebenzi bakho ukusasaza ulwazi njengethuttu ezintsha ze-Infection Prevention Control, amacebiso, nokunye. Khuthaza ukuzihlamba izandla, ukusebenzisa i-PPE nokuqaphela okuqhelekileyo phakathi kwabasebenzi bezempilo. Sebenzisa inkqubo yezesayense yokhathalelo nemigaqo ekhathalelweni kwabantu, amaqela namaphondo. Cingeza ukusebenza kobuchwepheshe bokusebenzisa inkqubo yezesayense kwizinto nemigaqo ye-IPC. Phakamisa, zingxilimela kwaye usebenzise ithuba lokuphuhlisa ukuziphumelela kwemvelo ukukhulisa ulwazi lomsebenzi. Yakhisela imixhaka emihle yokusebenza ngaphakathi kwesebe kunye nabaqaphi. Thattha inxaxheba namalungu eqela lezempilo ekwenzeni isigqibo ngenkqubo yezempilo. Biza kwaye usebenze nobo wamakhamphani amaninzi ezempilo, iindalo neeqela elinoxanduva olukhethekileyo. Thattha inxaxheba kwaye umele isiqendu kuzo zonke iindlela ezahlukeneyo. Nxibelelanisa kwaye uqhube nemicimbi karhulumente, engowurhulumente, nazinye iindalo kwaye uqhube. Ziya kundibano kwaye unxibelelane ngokwesiqhelo nabaqaphi abahlukeneyo. Yakhisela imixhaka phakathi kweqela elihlukeneyo labaqaphi. Thattha inxaxheba ekwaziseni isicwangciso sezentlalo kwaye ukhuthaze okanye uchaze iindlela zokulawula iindleko zezempilo ngaphandle kokukrazalaza imigangatho. Hlalutya idatha yophando lezifo ezithathelanayo kwaye uqaphele iindlela. Lukhulise kwaye ufake iingxelo zenyanga ze-IPC. Qaphela imiba yezempilo ekuqapheelwayo kwaye ufake iingxelo yophando. Qaphela amagama abhaliweyo e-IPC needa yophando lungakafiki. Qinisekisa ukuba ukuchithwa kwenani lwezimali kulungelelaniswa neenjongo ezibalulekileyo. Qaphela ukuchazeka ngokomsebenzi, iingozi ezibangelwa ziikhadini nokutsha kwamagciwane phakathi kwabasebenzi. Khuthaza inkqubo yokugonywa kwabasebenzi nolawulo ngemva kokuchazeka. Hlola iindawo zokuzimeleyo neemfuno zokuqhuba umoya. Thattha inxaxheba kwi-Ideal Hospital nakwiinkqubo zokuqinisekisa izinga

jobs.title: Clinical Practitioner Nurse (PNB1-2):(PRIMARY Health Care)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 - R571 161 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 - R741 783 per annum plus 13th Cheque, Housing Allowance, Medical Aid (Optional, Employee must meet the prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Clinical practitioner nurse position in primary health care within the Thabo Mofutsanyana District, requiring a nursing diploma or degree with SANC registration and relevant post-basic qualification.
jobs.requirements: Matric, plus Diploma/Degree in nursing that allows registration with the SANC as a Registered Nurse in General Nursing plus post basic nursing qualification in Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and care (Primary Health Care) with duration of at least 1 year accredited with SANC. Grade 1: Minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognisable experience after registration as Registered Nurse in General Nursing with the SANC in General Nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate/recognizable experience after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience after obtaining the 1 year post basic qualification as mentioned above. Current registration with SANC (2026/2027) Knowledge And Skills: Ability to plan and organise own work and that of support personnel to ensure proper nursing care. Effective communication with all stakeholders & report writing aptitude. Display uncompromising concern for patients, promoting and advocating proper treatment and care including awareness and willingness to respond to patients' needs, requirements and expectations (Batho Pele). Demonstrate an understanding of nursing legislation and other related legal frameworks.
jobs.duties: Management of comprehensive PHC services and PHC re-engineering, key priority programmes, ideal health facility and regulated standards. Provide more complex and advanced comprehensive nursing treatment and care to patients in a cost effective, efficient and equitable manner. Act as a leader, plan and implement health promotion and prevention activities. Link to the community structures and community-based services. Competently collect and manage data generated and be able to report on it. Exercise and maintain high and quality record-keeping standards. Oversee and supervise subordinates within the facility. Provide PHC services to other facilities in Sub-District 3 & 4 as and when the need arises.
jobs.applications: Free State Provincial Department of Health utilises an e-Recruitment System (applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://www.erecruitment.fs.gov.za

Applicants should upload their Curriculum Vitae (CV) on the e-Recruitment system. (Please ensure is in PDF format & maximum size 3MB). The Curriculum Vitae should be specific regarding previous positions occupied and the start date and end date of the position(s) should be indicated. Accompanying relevant documentation required to be uploaded on the system such as copies of all qualifications including National Senior Certificate/Matric certificate, Driver’s license, ID, etc., such documents need not be certified at point of application, however, certification will be required prior to attending the interview. Only short-listed candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on, or before the day of the interview following an invitation from the Department to attend an interview, and such qualification(s) and other related document(s) should be in line with the requirements of the advertisement. Successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) is required for being considered for this SMS post prior to appointment. Enrolment for the course should be made on the NSG’s website at https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms- pre-entry-programme. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other will be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with these instructions will not be considered. The onus is on the applicants to ensure that their applications are submitted online timeously. Candidates who possess foreign qualifications and/or short courses certificates must take it upon themselves to have their qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). The highest relevant qualification should be captured/listed as the first qualification on the e-recruitment profile. Applicants are respectfully informed that if no notification of appointment is received within 4 months of the closing date, they must accept that their applications were unsuccessful. Communication will be limited to short-listed candidates only. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial assets check, qualification verification and reference checks). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations and/or record. The Department reserves the right not to make appointments on the advertised post(s). Free State Provincial Department of Health is compliant with the requirements of POPIA. The Department of Health is an equal opportunity affirmative action employer. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. af.title: Kliniese Praktisyn Verpleegkundige (PNB1-2):(PRIMÊRE Gesondheidsorg)
af.summary: Kliniese praktisyn verpleegkundige posisie in primêre gesondheidsorg binne die Thabo Mofutsanyana Distrik, wat 'n verpleegkundige diploma of graad met SANC-registrasie en 'n relevante post-basiese kwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: Matriek, plus Diploma/Graad in verpleegkunde wat registrasie met die SANC as 'n Geregistreerde Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleging moontlik maak, plus 'n post-basiese verpleegkundige kwalifikasie in Kliniese Verpleegkundige Wetenskap, Gesondheidsassessering, Behandeling en sorg (Primêre Gesondheidsorg) met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar geakkrediteer by die SANC. Graad 1: Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie as Geregistreerde Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleging by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring wees na die verkryging van die 1 jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie soos hierbo genoem. Huidige registrasie met SANC (2026/2027). Kennis en Vaardighede: Vermoë om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Doeltreffende kommunikasie met alle belanghebbendes en verslaggewingsvaardigheid. Toon oncompromitterende sorg vir pasiënte, bevordering en voorstanderskap van behoorlike behandeling en sorg, insluitend bewustheid en bereidwilligheid om op pasiënte se behoeftes, vereistes en verwagtings te reageer (Batho Pele). Toon begrip van verpleegkundige wetgewing en ander verwante regskaders.
af.duties: Bestuur van omvattende PHC-dienste en PHC-heringenieuring, sleutelprioriteitsprogramme, ideale gesondheidsfasiliteit en gereguleerde standaarde. Verskaf meer komplekse en gevorderde omvattende verpleegkundige behandeling en sorg aan pasiënte op 'n koste-doeltreffende, doeltreffende en billike wyse. Tree as 'n leier op, beplan en implementeer gesondheidsbevordering en -voorkomingsaktiwiteite. Skakel met die gemeenskapsstrukture en gemeenskapsgebaseerde dienste. Versamel bevoegd data wat gegenereer word en bestuur dit en wees in staat om daaroor verslag te doen. Oefen en handhaaf hoë en gehalte standaarde van rekordhouding. Hou toesig oor en bestuur ondergeskiktes binne die fasiliteit. Verskaf PHC-dienste aan ander fasiliteite in Sub-distrik 3 & 4 soos wanneer die behoefte ontstaan.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wezokwelapha Onzulu (PNB1-2):(Ezokunakekelwa Kwezempilo Eziyisisekelo)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somsebenzi wezokwelapha onzulu ezokunakekelwa kwezempilo eziyisisekelo ngaphakathi kwesifundazwe saThabo Mofutsanyana, sifuna idiploma noma iziqu zokwelapha ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-SANC kanye nokuqeqeshwa okufanele okuba ngemuva kokuqeqeshwa okuyisisekelo.
zu.requirements: I-Matric, kanye ne-Diploma/Iziqu ezikwelapheni ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengogqaji wezokunakekela oqeqeshe ngokuvamile kanye nokuqeqeshwa okufanele okungemuva kokuqeqeshwa okuyisisekelo kwezokwelapha onzulu sayensi yezokwelapha, ukuhlola impilo, ukwelapha nokunakekela (Ezokunakekelwa Kwezempilo Eziyisisekelo) ngexesha elingangethemu ngaphezu konyaka owodwa oqinisekisiwe ku-SANC. I-Grade 1: Okungenani iminyaka engu-4 yohlu loqeqesho olufanele/oluhlonishwayo emva kokubhaliswa njengogqaji wezokunakekela oqeqeshe ngokuvamile ku-SANC. I-Grade 2: Okungenani iminyaka engu-14 yohlu loqeqesho olufanele/oluhlonishwayo emva kokubhaliswa njengogqaji wezokunakekela oqeqeshe ngobuchwepheshe ku-SANC. Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele ibe yiqeqesho elifanele/elahlelekile emva kokuthola ukuqeqeshwa kweminyaka engu-1 okungemuva kokuqeqeshwa okuyisisekelo njengakuwo. Ukuqinisekisa ukubhaliswa njengamanje ku-SANC (2026/2027) Ulwazi Nemakhono: Ukukwazi ukuhlela futhi uhlele umsebenzi yakho nalawo abasekeli ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa okufanele kwezokunakekela. Ukuxhumana ngempumelelo namakhasimende onke kanye namakhono okubhala imibiko. Ukubonisa ukukhathalela abaguli ngaphandle kokwehluleka, ukukhuthaza nokukhulekela ukwelapha nokunakekela okufanele okuhlanganisa ukuqonda nokulungele ukuphendula izidingo, izifiso nezinzuzo zabaguli (I-Batho Pele). Ukubonisa ukuqonda umthetho wezokunakekela kanye nezinye izakhiwo zomthetho ezihlobene nalokhu.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza eziphelele ze-PHC nokwakhiwa kabusha kwe-PHC, ohlelo lwezinhlelo ezibaluleke kakhulu, iziteshi sezempilo eziphelele kanye nemithetho yokuhlolwa. Ukunikeza ukwelapha nokunakekela okuyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu nokuqhubekayo kubaguli ngendlela engabizi kakhulu, ephumelelayo futhi ehlangabezayo. Ukubeka isibonelo njengengqalasizinda, uhlele futhi ucuphe izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kokunakekelwa nokuvikelwa kwempilo. Ukuhlanganisa izakhiwo zomphakathi kanye nezinsiza ezingaphansi komphakathi. Ukuthola ngamakhono futhi uphathe ulwazi olukhiqizwe ulwazi futhi ukwazi ukubhala imibiko ngalokho. Ukuzigcina ezindeni eziphezulu futhi wazi ukuqinisekisa izinga eliphezulu leziqu ezibhalwayo ngohlelo lwezokulondoloza imibhalo. Ukuphatha futhi ulawule abangaphansi kwakho esiteshini. Ukunikeza izinsiza ze-PHC kwezinye iziteshi kwi-Sub-District 3 & 4 noma lapho kunesidingo sikhona.

xh.title: I-Nurse yesigulane (PNB1-2):(Ezempi lo Mpilo ekuQaleni)
xh.summary: Isithuba senurse yesigulane kwimpilo yempilo ekuqaleni ngaphakathi kwesiKondre seThabo Mofutsanyana, esifuna idiploma okanye idigrhi yokongeza egunyaziswe kwi-SANC nephumelelo elifanelekileyo lokongeza kwisiqalo.
xh.requirements: Amagama eMatric, idiploma/idigrhi yamazwi apendulwayo kwizinto ezahlukeneyo, igunya eliphezulu elizimeleyo lokuba ngumsebenzisi wezempilo, ukuvunywa kwezifundo, amagama eGenuine ne-Genuflection ngokutsha kwesiKwendalo seNyanga, izidanga ezahlukeneyo ezikwaziyo ukwazi ukubonelela ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo ezingekoyo ngokutsha kummandla wakho, igunya eliphezulu elikwaziyo ukuzimela ngokusebenzisa izazisiweyo namacebo asetyenziswa kwimpilo yempilo yonke iindlela ezahlukeneyo. Kufuneka ulinganise amagama ezezimali ahamba phambili, kwaye kubekho izidanga ezahlukeneyo.
xh.duties: Cocisa ulawulo olubanzi lweenkonzo ze-PHC nokuqaliswa kwaba kukhoyo, iinkqubo eziphambili, iziko lezempilo, namagama obungcali obulungele igunya elichanekileyo. Bonelela ngemisebenzi ebanzi nokwazi ukubeka amanye amagama ezezimali ahamba phambili kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo. Yiba ngumntu onamandla okwahlukahluka, uqalise kwaye usesule izinto ezahlukeneyo. Qwalasela iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo kwaye ulawule iindawo ezahlukeneyo. Gcina ukuxoxwa ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo kwaye ulawule izinto ezahlukeneyo. Lwela amagama ezezimali ahamba phambili, ukwazi ukuyilawula, kwaye ukwazi ukuyibuyisela.

A post-basic nursing qualification in Advanced Theatre Tech, with a duration of a least 1 year, accredited with SANC as Professional Nurse. Current registration with SANC (2026/2027). Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate/ recognisable experience in nursing after registration with SANC as Professional Nurse. Perform a clinical nursing practice in accordance with the scope of practice and nursing standards as determined by the relevant health facility. Promote quality of nursing care as directed by the professional scope of practice and standards as determined by the relevant health facility. Demonstrate effective communication with patients, supervisors and other clinicians, including report writing when required. Work as part of the multi- disciplinary team to ensure good nursing care. Work effectively, co-operatively, amicably with persons of diverse intellectual, cultural, racial or religious differences. Able to plan and organise own work and support personnel to ensure proper nursing care. Display a concern for patients, promoting and advocating proper treatment and care including awareness and willingness to respond to patients needs, requirements and expectations (Batho Pele).

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit (PNB1-2) Teater
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige spesialiteit in Teater by Thusanong Distrikshospitaal in die Free State, wat SANC-registrasie en 'n post-basiese Gevorderde Teater Tegniek-kwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: Matric, basiese R425 (d.w.s. Diploma/Grade in verpleegkunde of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die South African Nursing Council as Geregistreerde Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleegkunde toelaat. 'n Post-basiese verpleegkundige kwalifikasie in Gevorderde Teater Tegniek, met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer met SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Huidige registrasie met SANC (2026/2027). Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie met SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie met SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ten minste 10 jaar van die hierbo genoemde tydperk moet toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit wees na verkryging van die 1 jaar- post-basiese kwalifikasie van die hierbo genoemde tydperk. Kennis en Vaardighede: Goeie kommunikasie; Interpersoonlike verhoudings; Vermoë om onder druk te werk; Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Toon begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante regs- en etiese verpleegpraktyke. Voer 'n kliniese verpleegpraktyk uit in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde soos bepaal deur die tersaaklike gesondheidsfasiliteit. Bevorder gehalte van verpleegsorg soos gerig deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde soos bepaal deur die tersaaklike gesondheidsfasiliteit. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers en ander klinici, insluitend verslagskryf wanneer dit vereis word. Werk as deel van die multi-dissiplinêre span om goeie verpleegsorg te verseker. Werk effektief, saamwerkend, vriendelik met persone van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdienstige verskille. In staat om eie werk te beplan en te organiseer en personeel te ondersteun om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Toon bekommernis vir pasiënte, bevorder en beywoord behoorlike behandeling en sorg insluitend bewustheid en bereidwilligheid om aan pasiënte se behoeftes, vereistes en verwagtinge te voldoen (Batho Pele).

zu.title: Ungili ongclassisemkhakheni (PNB1-2) Theatre
zu.summary: Ungili ongclasasemkhakheni eTheatre eThusanong District Hospital eFree State, ofuna ukubhalisela ku-SANC nesesitifiketi se-post-basic Advanced Theatre Tech.
zu.requirements: Matric, i-R425 esisathek (okwukuthi I-Diploma/Isidzimu sokwelapha noma isimfuneko esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kuSouth African Nursing Council njengongili ohlotshaniswa nakho General Nursing. Isimfuneko sokwelapha esisathek kwi-Advanced Theatre Tech, esinowokwethuba ongacashile unyaka oyi-1, esamukelekwa yi-SANC njengongili ohlotshaniswa nakho. Ukubhalisa okwamanje yi-SANC (2026/2027). Isigaba 1: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-4 yokuhluzwa kwezinhlobonhlobo zokwelapha emva kokubhalisa ku-SANC njengongili. Isigaba 2: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-14 yokuhluzwa kwezinhlobonhlobo zokwelapha emva kokubhalisa ku-SANC njengongili. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 yesikhathi esinikwe ngenhla kumele ibe yisiphephu sokuhluzwa kwezinhlobonhlobo zokwelapha ohlotshaniswa nakho emva kokuthola isimfuneko esisathek unyaka oyi-1 sebesikhathi esinikwe ngenhla. Ulwazi Nemakhono: Ukuxhumana kahle; Izindlela zokuhlobana nabantu; Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwezinga elimyipelikayo; Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhomphyutha.
zu.duties: Kubonise ukuqonda komthetho wokwelapha kanye nemisebenzi ehlobene nokwelapha ngokomthetho nangokwezimiso ezithile. Benza imisebenzi yokwelapha kanye nommandla ohambisana nommandla wokwelapha nemigomo yokuqonda njengoba kunqunyiwe esikhungweni sezempilo esihambisana. Khuthaza izinga lemisebenzi yokwelapha njengoba kuqondwe ngummandla wokusebenza kwezengoma nemigowo njengoba kunqunyiwe esikhungweni sezempilo. Kubonise ukuxhumana okusebenzayo neziguli, abaphathi nabanye ochwepheshe bokwelapha, okuhlanganisa nokubhala imibiko uma kudingeka. Sebenza njengengxenye yethimba elinabochwepheshe abahlukene ukuqinisekisa ukwelapha kahle. Sebenza ngokusebenza, ngokubambisana, ngokuzwana nabantu abahlukene ngokobuchwepheshe, isiko, uhlanga noma inkolo. Akwazi ukuhlela nahlela imisebenzi yakhe nokusekela abasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunyukiwa kahle kokwelapha. Kubonise ukukhathaleka ngeziguli, ukukhuthaza nokumela ukwelashwa nokunyukwa kahle okuhlanganise ukuqonda nokuba ngayinglyelethu ukuphendula izidingo zeziguli, izidingo nemithelela yazo (Batho Pele).

xh.title: Ugqatswa weMali weNkundla (PNB1-2) kwiThiyetha
xh.summary: Ugqatswa weMali weNkundla kwiThiyetha eThusanong District Hospital eFree State, efuna ukubhalisa kwiSANC nokuba nengqikitho ye-Advanced Theatre Tech yasemva kwesixeleko.
xh.requirements: I-Matric, i-R425 esisiseko (oko kukuthi iDiploma/iNqanaba kwizokolwa okanye ngokulinganayo ekuvumela ukubhalisa kuSouth African Nursing Council njengogqatswa weMali mabini wezo Kolwa. Ingqikitho yezokolwa yasemva kwesixeleko kwi-Advanced Theatre Tech, nobude bonyaka omtsha owodwa, evunyiweyo yiSANC njengogqatswa weMali. Ukubhalisa okwangoku kwiSANC (2026/2027). Inqanaba 1: Unyaka omncinane weminyaka elishumi elinane (4) yamava afanelekileyo / aqatyiweyo kwizokolwa emva kokubhalisa kwiSANC njengogqatswa weMali. Inqanaba 2: Unyaka omncinane weminyaka elishumi eline (14) yamava afanelekileyo / aqatyiweyo kwizokolwa emva kokubhalisa kwiSANC njengogqatswa weMali. Ubuncinane kwiminyaka elishumi (10) kwexesha elidweliswe ngasentla kufuneka kube ngamava afanelekileyo / aqatyiweyo kwindawo ethile yobugcisa emva kokufumana ingqikitho yonyaka omnye yasemva kwesixeleko ekuthethwe ngayo ngasentla. Ulwazi Namakhono: Unxibelelwano olulungileyo; Iingxibaniso phakathi kwabantu; Ikhono lokusebenza ngoxinzelelo; Ulwazi lokusebenzelaikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Bonisa ukuqonda ngomthetho wezokolwa nomthetho ongqinelanayo nezokuziphatha ezifana nawo ezokolweni. Zenza inkqubo yokugcina imicili yesiGqirha ngokwamagama omsebenzi namazinga ezokolwa njengoko kumiswe sikhululo seenkcitha ngokwemithetho esinokuthi sisebenze ngayo. Khuthaza ukhuseleko lomsebenzi wezokolwa njengoko kukhokelelwa kukhadi lamagama obugcisa bomsebenzi namazinga njengoko kumiswe zikhululo seenkcitha ezinokuthi zisebenze ngomthetho. Bonisa inxibelelwano elisebenzayo namayeza, nabaphathi, neentsapho nabantu abanika imbuyekezo xa kusetyenziswa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezikwazisa ukubhala iinkcukacha ezahlukeneyo ezibonelela inkcukacha ezingabonelelwa ngabanye.

af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige wat spesialiseer in gevorderde vroedvroukunde gesoek vir Thusanong Distrikshospitaal in die Free State, wat omvattende kliniese verpleegsorg in 'n spesiale eenheid bied.
af.requirements: Grade 12, Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.i. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of 'n ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegstersraad (SANC) as 'n Geregistreerde Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleegkunde toelaat. OF - 'n 4-jarige Bachelorgaad in Verpleegkunde (R174) wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegstersraad (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. OF - 'n 3-jarige Diploma in Algemene Verpleegkunde (R171) wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegstersraad (SANC) as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige toelaat. Registrasie by 'n Professionele Raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige of Algemene Verpleegkundige. 'n Postbasiese verpleegkwalifikasie in Gevorderde Vroedvroukunde en Neonatologie. Ervaring: Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit wees na verkryging van die 1-jarige postbasiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. af.duties: Verskaf omvattende verpleegbehandeling en -sorg aan pasiënte in 'n spesiale eenheid op 'n kostedoeltreffende, doeltreffende en billike wyse. Voer 'n kliniese verpleegpraktyk uit ooreenkomstig die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde soos bepaal deur die tersaaklike gesondheidsfasiliteit. Stel eenheidsgebaseerde statistieke op en dien dit by Operasionele Bestuurder Algemene Eenheid in vir verifikasie en voorlegging aan tersaaklike belanghebbendes. Wees 'n alrounder deur in ander eenhede van die hospitaal te help waar behoeftes ontstaan. Tree as skiftleier in eenheid op (waar nodig). Koördineer die verskaffing van doeltreffende opleiding en waar moontlik insluitend navorsingsprojekte vir verpleegdienste spesifiek tot Kraameenheid. Verskaf en demonstreer veilige pasiëntsorgpraktyke. Bestuur pasiënte se rekords ooreenkomstig tersaaklike wetgewing. Bestuur voorraad en toerusting ooreenkomstig kliniese en ekonomiese imperatiewe. Toon begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante regs- en etiese verpleegpraktyke.

zu.summary: Kufunwa umsebelekazi wezokwelapha ohlukaniswe ekuqeqeshweni okuqhubekayo kokubeletha esibhedlela se-Thusanong District Hospital e-Free State, onikeza ukunakekelwa okuphelele kokwelapha kogogo ohlakeni ngobuchwepheshe.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12, iziqu zemfundo ezingaphansi kwesidingo: Isiqui se-Basic R425 (okuyidiploma/degree kwezokwelapha) noma isiqui esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomsebelekazi obhalisiwe ekuqeqeshweni kwesidumbu. NOKU - I-Degree ye-Bachelor yeminyaka emi-4 kwezokwelapha (R174) evumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomsebelekazi ohlotshanisiwe. NOKU - I-Diploma yeminyaka eyi-3 ekuqeqeshweni kwesidumbu (R171) evumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomsebelekazi wesidumbu. Ukubhaliswa kwiNkambu yabaphathi abahlotshanisiwe: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomsebelekazi ohlotshanisiwe noma umsebelekazi wesidumbu. Isiqui sokubhalisa ngemva kokufunda i-post basic kwezokwelapha ekuleso sikhundla sokubeletha okuqhubekayo kanye nokunakekelwa kwabayasebenza abasha. Isipiliyoni: I-Grade 1: Isipiliyoni esingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-4 esifanele/esiqashelwayo ekwelapheni emva kokubhaliswa njengomsebelekazi ohlotshanisiwe kwi-SANC ekuqeqeshweni kwesidumbu. I-Grade 2: Isipiliyoni esingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-14 esifanele/esiqashelwayo ekwelapheni emva kokubhaliswa njengomsebelekazi ohlotshanisiwe kwi-SANC ekuqeqeshweni kwesidumbu. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 yaleso sikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele ibe yisipiliyoni esifanele/esiqashelwayo kulowo obuchwepheshe okuthize emva kokuthola isiqui se-post basic senyaka eyi-1 kulelo nhlobo lobuchwepheshe. Ukubhaliswa okwamanje kwi-SANC (2026/2027). Ulwazi nanamehlo abalulekile: Amandla okukhuluma kahle. Ubuqotho nokuxhumana kahle nabantu. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcindezi. Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokunakekelwa nokwelaphwa ngokuphelele kogogo ohlakeni ngobuchwepheshe ngendlela engabizi kakhulu, esebenza kalula futhi ngokuqoqana.enze imisebenzi yokwelapha ngokomthetho wokusebenza nemigomo yokwelapha njengokuqashwa isikhungo sempilo esithintekayo. Qoqa izibalo ezingxenyeni zesibhedlela futhi uzinikeze ku-Operational Manager General Unit ukuze qinisekiswe futhi zithunyelwe kubaphathi abathintekayo. Yiba ngumuntu ongakwazi ukwenza konke ngokusiza emanyunwini amanye esibhedlela lapho kunesidingo. Yiba ngumholi wesikhathi ohlakeni (lapho kunesidingo). Hlela ukunikezwa kokufundisa okusebenzayo futhi lapho kungenzeka kufake phakathi imiklombo yocwaningo kumasevisi okwelapha ohlotshaniswa nenhlobo yokubeletha. Nikeza futhi khombisa izindlela ezivikela ukunakekelwa kwesiguli. Phatha irekhodi leziguli ngokomthetho othintekayo. Phatha izinto kanye nemishini ngokwezidingo zokwelapha nangokwezimali. Khombisa ukuqonda komthetho wezokwelapha namanye amathemu okwelapha ngomthetho nangokuziphatha.

xh.title: Ummeli wokuQhelisela eNgcaleni (PNB1-2) uBunyuzulu beSozulwa ePhambili
xh.summary: Kufuneki kuye kwinjengelwa yommeli wezempilo oqhelisela sobunyuzulu besozulwa ephambili kwiSibhedlele saKawonke wonke saseThusanong kwi-Free State, abonelela ngosikeleko lwezempilo lokhathalelo lucelisayo kwicandelo eliqheliselayo.
xh.requirements: Ithatu leKhaya lesi-12, Isidanga sokuFunda esingowona: Isidanga seR425 esiseNqanaba (okuthathwa njengesatifikethi/isidanga ekunyuselelweni lokhathalelo) okanye isidanga esifana neso esivumela ukubhalisa kwiBandla leZoQheliselo eZaseMzantsi Afrika (SANC) njengomQheliseli oBhaliweyo kuKhathalelo loWonke lweNtlalo. OKANYE - Isidanga seNyanga ezine seBachelor ekunyuselelweni (R174) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiBandla leZoQheliselo eZaseMzantsi Afrika (SANC) njengoMmeli weZoQheliselo. OKANYE - Isatifikethi seemNyaka ezintathu esiKunyuselelweni lokKhathalelo loWonke (R171) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiBandla leZoQheliselo eZaseMzantsi Afrika (SANC) njengoMqheliseli woKhathalelo loWonke. UkuBhalisa kwiBandla leZoQheliselo: UkuBhalisa kwiSANC njengoMmeli weZoQheliselo okanye uMqheliseli woKhathalelo loWonke. Isidanga seNqanaba sokuba ngumQheliseli oBhalisiweyo kuBunyuzulu beSozulwa ePhambili neNasali yoNtshungu. ImaPhakamiso: Inqanaba eli-1: Ukuba uneminyaka emi-4 nangaphezulu yamava ahambelana nokuqatshelwa kulondolozo lwabantu emva kokubhalisa njengoMmeli weZoQheliselo kwiSANC kulondolozo loWonke. Inqanaba eli-2: Ukuba uneminyaka eli-14 nangaphezulu yamava ahambelana nokuqatshelwa kulondolozo lwabantu emva kokubhalisa njengoMmeli weZoQheliselo kwiSANC kulondolozo loWonke. Okona ngaphezulu kweenyanga ezili-10 kule minyaka etshiwo ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava ahambelana nokuqatshelwa kweso qheliselo ngokuchanekileyo emva kokufumana isidanga seNyaka elinye seNqanaba sokuba ngumQheliseli oBhalisiweyo kweso qheliselo. UkuBhalisa ngoku kwiSANC (2026/2027). ULwazi neNtleRhozo: Amandla amnandiwo okunyaniseka kwentetho. Ubuhlobo obumnandi nobuPhakathi nabantu. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcindezelo. Amandla okuSebenza ngokuQamba ngokwecomputer.
xh.duties: Bonelela ngolondolozo lokhathalelo olucelisayo nolugqithiselayo kubantu abagulayo kwicandelo eliqheliselayo ngenkululeko efikelelekayo ngokuchanekileyo ngexabiso elincinaneyo ngokusebenza kakuhle nangokulinganayo. Wenze ulondolozo lokhathalelo ngokwemigaqo yemisebenzi nangokwemilinganiselo yokhathalelo njengoko kucetywe ngumzi wezempilo ongummandla. Uqulunqe izibalo ezingekwenziwa kwicandelo kwaye uzinikele kuMphathi weMisebenzi yoBucala webandla oQheliselayo ngenjongo yokufumanisa isiqiniseko nangokunika izigqibo kubantu abahambelana nale ndima. Uba ngumntu onokuziphatha kwimizekelo yonke ngokuncedisa kwamanye amacandelo esibhedlele apho kudingeka khona. Yiba ngumphathi welanga wemisebenzi kwicandelo (apho kudingeka khona). Qhelanisa ubonelelo lwemfundo ekusebenzeni njengoko kunokwenzeka ingapela imizekelo yokuphandwa kumasebe ukhathalelo ukhethwa ngokukodwa kwicandelo loNtshungu. Bonelela ubonise iindlela ezikhuselekileyo zokhathalelo lwesigulayo. Lawula iirekhodi zabagulayo ngokomthetho ohambelana nalo. Lawula isitoreki neMpahla ngokusika isigqibo ekubakho kwezempilo kunye nezoQoqosho. Bonisa ukuqonda komthetho wokhathalelo kunye nemisebenzi yamathetho ahambelana nomthetho nokuziphatha okuzimeleyo ngokomthetho kulondolozo lwabantu.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Human Resources
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 – R573 897 per annum plus, Cheque, Housing Allowance, Medical Aid (Optional, Employee must meet the prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director of Human Resources at Boitumelo Regional Hospital in the Free State, managing HR services, conditions of service and HR provisioning.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus tertiary qualification in Human Resource Management or related areas at NQF 6. 3 years relevant experience at supervisory level. Relevant PERSAL certificates. Valid driver license. Knowledge and Skills: Ability to communicate issues in a tactful manner. Problem solving skills. Computer skills. Numeracy skills. Literacy skills Knowledge of policies/ implementation strategies. Knowledge of Human Resource Management Legislation/ Directives. Knowledge and understanding of Human Resource Management environment.
jobs.duties: Rendering a professional human resource management service on: Conditions of Service and service benefits (Leave, Housing, Medical, Injury on Duty, Terminations, Long Service Recognition, overtime, re-allocation, Pension, Allowances etc.). HR Provisioning (Recruitment and Selection, Appointments, Transfer, temporary employment, verification of qualifications, secretariat functions at interviews, probationary periods etc.). Address human resource management enquiries to ensure the correct implementation of human resource management administration. Prepare and consolidate reports on personnel administration issues. Provide inputs on the development / amendments of Human Resource Management Policies. Inform, guide and advice Department / personnel on human resource administration matters to enhance the correct implementation of personnel administration policies. Conduct HR Audits. Coordinate submission of information for audit queries. Monitor implementation of Audit action plan. Attend to queries/ complaints pertaining to Human Resource Practices. Report on activities of the Sub- Directorate. Management of staff within the component. The development and updating of Job Descriptions for reporting staff. The performance management of staff within the component. Facilitation of training interventions. Give direction, guidance and advice to staff within the component.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Menslike Hulpbronne
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur van Menslike Hulpbronne by Boitumelo Streekshospitaal in die Free State, wat HR-dienste, diensvoorwaardes en HR-voorsiening bestuur.
af.requirements: Matriek plus tersiêre kwalifikasie in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur of verwante areas op NQF 6. 3 jaar relevante ervaring op toesigvlak. Relevante PERSAL-sertifikate. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis en vaardighede: Vermoë om kwessies op 'n taktvolle wyse te kommunikeer. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Rekenaervaardighede. Wiskundige vaardighede. Geletterdheidsvaardighede Kennis van beleide/implementeringsstrategieë. Kennis van Menslike Hulpbronbestuurwetgewing/Riglyne. Kennis en begrip van die Menslike Hulpbronbestuursomgewing.
af.duties: Lewer 'n professionele menslike hulpbronbestuursdiens oor: Diensvoorwaardes en diensbyvoordae (Verlof, Behuising, Medies, Besering aan diens, Beëindigings, Langdiensteverlening, oortyd, hertoewysing, Pensioen, Toelaes ens.). HR-voorsiening (Werwing en Keuring, Aanstellings, Oorplasing, tydelike diens, verifikasie van kwalifikasies, sekretariaatsfunksies by onderhoude, proeftydperke ens.). Hanteer menslike hulpbronbestuursnavrae om die korrekte implementering van menslike hulpbronbestuursadministrasie te verseker. Berei en konsolideer verslae oor personeeladministrasiekwessies voor. Verskaf insette oor die ontwikkeling/wysigings van Menslike Hulpbronbestuursbeleide. Stel Departement/personeel in kennis, lei en adviseer oor menslike hulpbronadministrasiekwessies om die korrekte implementering van personeeladministrasiebeleide te bevorder. Voer HR-oudits uit. Koördineer die indiening van inligting vir ouditvrae. Monitor die implementering van die Oudit-aksieplan. Hanteer vrae/klas aangaande Menslike Hulpbronpraktyke. Rapporteer oor die aktiwiteite van die Subdirektoraat. Bestuur van personeel binne die komponent. Die ontwikkeling en bywerking van Werksbeskrywings vir rapporterende personeel. Die prestasiebestuur van personeel binne die komponent. Fasilitering van opleidingsintervensies. Gee rigting, leiding en advies aan personeel binne die komponent.
