xh.duties: Ukuhlolwa nokwelapha abaguli abangenayo, abaphuma, nabatyholo ngokusemthethweni wemisebenzi. Ukuncedisa ekuhlelweni kwezomphatha wesebe, ekuthotyelweni kwesiphithiphithi, nakwiinkqachı ezikwimo yesibonelo. Ukunikela ngemveliso kule ntshukumiso yokuqhubela phambili nokukhula kwisebe lephysiotherapy. Ukwenza ulawulo lwesixhobo sabafundi bephysiotherapy. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumathuba amanqanaba wamakhono eSebe. Umphathi kufuneka abe nakho ukujikeleza abe nexesha elithile kummandla ogqithiswe lephysiotherapy, akwenze imisebenzi engaphezu kwexesha ngeekweekend.

jobs.title: Occupational Therapist Grade 1-3
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R413 121 - R 472 359.per annum Grade 2: R482 499 - R 550 389.per annum Grade 3: R564 822 - R 683 808 per annum plus 13th Cheque, Housing Allowance, Medical Aid (Optional, Employee must meet the prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Occupational Therapist Grade 1 to 3 sought for Free State Psychiatric Complex Hospital, requiring an Occupational Therapy degree and HPCSA registration.
jobs.requirements: Degree in Occupational Therapy. Completion of community service year in Occupational Therapy. Registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as an Occupational Therapist independent practitioner. Current registration for the period 2026/2027. Work exposure or further training & education will be an added advantage. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa in the relevant professional (where applicable) in respect of RSA qualified employees who performed Community Service, as required in South Africa. One-year relevant experience after registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in the relevant professional (where applicable) in respect of foreign qualified employees, of who it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 2: Minimum of 10 years after registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa in the relevant professional (where applicable) in respect of RSA qualified employees who performed Community Service, as required in South Africa. Minimum of 11 years relevant experience after registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in the relevant professional (where applicable) in respect of foreign qualified employees, of who it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 3: Minimum of 20 years after registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa in the relevant professional (where applicable) in respect of RSA qualified employees who performed Community Service, as required in South Africa. Minimum of 21 years relevant experience after registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in the relevant professional (where applicable) in respect of foreign qualified employees, of who it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Valid driver’s license. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge, skills and competence required: Computer literacy (MS Word, MS Excel). Knowledge of public service legislations, policies, and procedures. Good written and communication skills. Ability to work as a member of a multidisciplinary team. Analytical thinking, independent decision-making, and problem-solving skills. Good communication and interpersonal relation skills. Ability to work under pressure. Computer literacy will be an added advantage (appears twice). Active participation in planned programs/plans to enhance involvement, capacity building, open communication and participative management in the Therapeutic and Medical Support services Division. Good record management skills.
jobs.duties: Assess and treat all adult or paediatric patients with physical or psychiatric disorders, within allocated clinical load. Assist with other clinical loads as needed. Partake in allocated administrative duties. Adhere to provincial, hospital and departmental policies, procedures, guidelines, and regulations. Participate in quality assurance methods. Communicate effectively with all stakeholders. Follow the correct channels of communication. Oversee allocated officials. Participate in CPD activities. Supervise OT students. Exercise care with all consumables and equipment. Effective and efficient implementation of clinical occupational therapy services to ensure compassionate and quality Occupational Therapy Services rendered according to the OT scope of practice and Mental Health Care Act. Participate in quality assurance projects in Occupational Therapy service delivery. Training and supervision to relevant staff and students. Participate in intra and inter departmental collaboration with relevant stake holders including the University of the Free State, licensed NGO`s and Rehabilitation services. Participate in information & risk management in Occupational Therapy. Management of allocated resources (consumables and equipment). Ongoing professional development in Occupational Therapy Contribute to policy development when required. Administrative functions required by the job and the area practice profile.

af.title: Ergoterapeut Graad 1-3
af.summary: Ergoterapeut Graad 1 tot 3 gesoek vir Free State Psychiatric Complex Hospital, wat 'n graad in Ergoterapie en HPCSA-registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: Graad in Ergoterapie. Voltooiing van gemeenskapsdiensjaar in Ergoterapie. Registrasie by die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Ergoterapeut, onafhanklike praktisyn. Huidige registrasie vir die periode 2026/2027. Werkblootstelling of verdere opleiding en opvoeding sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa in die relevante professie (waar van toepassing) ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat Gemeenskapsdiens gedoen het, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis. Een jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in die relevante professie (waar van toepassing) ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te doen nie, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis. Graad 2: Minimum van 10 jaar na registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa in die relevante professie (waar van toepassing) ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat Gemeenskapsdiens gedoen het, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis. Minimum van 11 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in die relevante professie (waar van toepassing) ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te doen nie, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis. Graad 3: Minimum van 20 jaar na registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa in die relevante professie (waar van toepassing) ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat Gemeenskapsdiens gedoen het, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis. Minimum van 21 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in die relevante professie (waar van toepassing) ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te doen nie, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis En Vaardighede: Vereiste kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdheid: Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, MS Excel). Kennis van openbare diens-wetgewing, beleide en prosedures. Goeie skriftelike en kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoe om as lid van 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. Analitiese denke, onafhanklike besluitneming en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Goeie kommunikasie- en interpersoonlike verwantskapsvaardighede. Vermoe om onder druk te werk. Rekenaarvaardigheid sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees (verskyn twee keer). Aktiewe deelname aan beplande programme/planne om betrokkenheid, kapasiteitsbou, oope kommunikasie en participatiewe bestuur in die Therapeutic and Medical Support services-afdeling te verbeter. Goeie rekordbestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Evalueer en behandel alle volwasse of pediatriese pasiënte met fisiese of psigiatriese afwykings, binne die toegewysde kliniese lading. Bystand verleen met ander kliniese ladings soos benodig. Deelneem aan toegewysde administratiewe pligte. Voldoen aan provinsiale, hospitaal- en departementele beleide, prosedures, riglyne en regulasies. Neem deel aan gehalteversekeringsmetodes. Kommunikeer doeltreffend met alle belanghebbendes. Volg die korrekte kommunikasiekanale. Hou toesig oor toegewysde amptenare. Neem deel aan CPD-aktiwiteite. hou toesig oor OT-studente. Oefen sorg uit met alle verbruiksgoedere en toerusting. Doeltreffende en doeltreffende implementering van kliniese ergoterapiedienste om deernisvolle en gehalte Ergoterapiedienste te verseker wat gelewer word volgens die OT-werkingsbestek en die Mental Health Care Act. Neem deel aan gehalteversekeringsprojekte in ergoterapiedienslewering. Opleiding en toesig aan relevante personeel en studente. Neem deel aan intra- en interdepartementele samewerking met relevante belanghebbendes, insluitend die University of the Free State, gelisensieerde NGO`s en Rehabilitasiedienste. Neem deel aan inligting- en risikobestuur in Ergoterapie. Bestuur van toegewysde hulpbronne (verbruiksgoedere en toerusting. Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling in Ergoterapie. Bydrae tot beleidsontwikkeling wanneer vereis. Administratiewe funksies wat deur die werk en die area practice profile vereis word.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wokwelapha (Occupational Therapist) Isigaba 1-3
zu.summary: Kufunwa Umsebenzi Wokwelapha (Occupational Therapist) Isigaba 1 kuye ku-3 we-Free State Psychiatric Complex Hospital, ofuna iziqu ze-Occupational Therapy nokubhalise kwi-HPCSA.
zu.requirements: Iziqu kwi-Occupational Therapy. Ukuqedwa kwesikhathi somsebenzi womphakathi ku-Occupational Therapy. Ukubhalisa kuHealth Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomsebenzi Wokwelapha (Occupational Therapist) ozimele. Ukubhalisa kwamanje kosuku lwango-2026/2027. Ukuba nanoma yikuphi ukuziphothula emsebenzini noma ukuqhubeka nemfundo kuzoba yinzuzo. Isipiliyoni: Isigaba 1: Akukho okuthile okudingekayo emva kokubhalisa kuHealth Professions Council of South Africa kwelobu bokwenza ngokomthetho (lapho kusebenza khona) mayelana nabasebenzi abazuule e-RSA abaye benza umsebenzi womphakathi, njengoba kudingeka eSouth Africa. Isipiliyoni sonyaka owodwa esifanelele emva kokubhalisa kuHealth Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) kwelobu bokwenza ngokomthetho (lapho kusebenza khona) mayelana nabasebenzi bezizwe zangaphandle abazuule, okungadingeki ukuba benze umsebenzi womphakathi, njengoba kudingeka eSouth Africa. Isigaba 2: Okuncane isikhathi seminyaka eyi-10 ngemva kokubhalisa kuHealth Professions Council of South Africa kwelobu bokwenza ngokomthetho (lapho kusebenza khona) mayelana nabasebenzi abazuule e-RSA abaye benza umsebenzi womphakathi, njengoba kudingeka eSouth Africa. Okuncane isikhathi seminyaka eyi-11 yesipiliyoni esifanelele emva kokubhalisa kuHealth Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) kwelobu bokwenza ngokomthetho (lapho kusebenza khona) mayelana nabasebenzi bezizwe zangaphandle abazuule, okungadingeki ukuba benze umsebenzi womphakathi, njengoba kudingeka eSouth Africa. Isigaba 3: Okuncane isikhathi seminyaka eyi-20 ngemva kokubhalisa kuHealth Professions Council of South Africa kwelobu bokwenza ngokomthetho (lapho kusebenza khona) mayelana nabasebenzi abazuule e-RSA abaye benza umsebenzi womphakathi, njengoba kudingeka eSouth Africa. Okuncane isikhathi seminyaka eyi-21 yesipiliyoni esifanelele emva kokubhalisa kuHealth Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) kwelobu bokwenza ngokomthetho (lapho kusebenza khona) mayelana nabasebenzi bezizwe zangaphandle abazuule, okungadingeki ukuba benze umsebenzi womphakathi, njengoba kudingeka eSouth Africa. Ilayisense yokushayela okusemthethweni. Ulwazi Nezikhono: Ulwazi, izikhono nokuziqonda okudingekayo: Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, MS Excel). Ulwazi ngomthetho, izinqubomgomo nezinqubo zomphakathi. Izikhono ezinhle zokubhala nokuxhumana. Ikono lokusebenza njengelunga lqembu elihlangabezene izinhlobo zobuchwepheshe ezahlukene. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukuzimisela ukwenza izinqumo, nezikhono zokusombulula izinkinga. Izikhono ezinhle zokuxhumana nezinhlobonhlobo zobudlelwane. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegciwane. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuzoba yinzuzo (kubekwe kabili). Ukubamba iqhaza kuhlelo olucubunguliwe/amasu ukuze kube khona ukuthonyana, ukwakha amandla okusebenza, ukuxhumana ngokuvulekile kanye nokuphathwa ngokubandakanya bonke kwesebe le-Therapeutic and Medical Support services. Izikhono ezinhle zokuphatha okubhaliwe.
zu.duties: Hlola futhi uphathonke abaguli abadala noma abantsha abanokugula komzimba noma kwengqondo, ngaphakathi kwenani labaguli ababelwe ukusebenza nabo. Siza ngamanye amaqoqo emisebenzi evela kubaguli lapho kudingeka khona. Bamba iqhaza emisebenzini okuqashiswe ababelwe ukuyenza. Hambisana nemithetho, izinqubomgomo, izinhlela zokusebenza kanye nemithetho yesifundazwe, esibhedlela nengamaphakethe. Bamba iqhaza kwezindlela zokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi. Xhumana ngokuphumelelayo nabo bonke abahlotshaniswe nomsebenzi. Landela izindlela ezifanele zokuxhumana. Qaphela ababhalisiwe ababelwe kubo. Bamba iqhaza kumasebe we-CPD. Qaphela abafundi be-OT. Qaphela konke okusetshenziswa namaphathini. Ukuphatha ngokusebenza kahle futhi ngempumelelo imisebenzi yokwelapha ukuze kuqiniseke ukunakekelwa okunobubele nekwalithi ephezulu emisebenzini Yokwelapha (Occupational Therapy) okuhambisana nenedingonqangi yokusebenza ye-OT kanye neMental Health Care Act. Bamba iqhaza kumaphulo ekuqinisekiseni ikhwalithi ekulethweni isebe lokuWelapha. Ukolisa nokulalela abasebenzi abafanele kanye nabafundi. Bamba iqhaza kuhlelo lokuxhumana ngaphakathi nangaphandle kweminyango nabahlotshaniswa nomsebenzi kubandakanya i-University of the Free State, ama-NGO avunyelwe izinkomba kanye namasebe okwelapha. Bamba iqhaza ekuphathweni kwemininingwane nezinkinga ekwelapheni. Ukuphathwa kwemithombo (okusetshenziswa namaphathini) ababelwe ukusebenza nabo. Ukuthuthuka ngokomsebenzi kuqhubeka ku-Occupational Therapy. Sebenzela ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo lapho kudingwa khona. Imisebenzi yokuphatha idingwa umsebenzi kanye nenani elithinta ukusebenza indawo.

xh.title: I-Occupational Therapist Grade 1-3
xh.summary: I-Occupational Therapist Grade 1 ukuya kwi-3 iyafunwa ukuba ifikelele kwi-Free State Psychiatric Complex Hospital, ngokufuna inqanaba le-Occupational Therapy kanye nokubhalwa kwi-HPCSA.
xh.requirements: Degree kwi-Occupational Therapy. Ukuqeda unyaka wesebe lomntu wonke kwi-Occupational Therapy. Ukuqatshelwa ne-HPCSA njengompraktisi wolwazi we-Occupational Therapy ongajonganga kuye. Ikhodi yangoku kaqatshiweyo ukusukela ngo-2026/2027. Amava okusebenza okanye ukuphuhliswa kwezemfundo & iindlela ziya kuba luncediso. Amava: Grade 1: Akukho nto kwindlela yokuba ngumpraktisi we-HPCSA ngokwesigaba sokusebenza (ngoko ukuba kuyimfuneko) ngesi samaborhu abakhoyo abo abayasebenzela i-RSA ukhankanywe ngokwenza iNkonzo yomntu wonke, njengoko kuceliwe eMzantsi Afrika. Unyaka o-1 wamava afanelekileyo ukuba kufunyenwe kwindlela yokuba ngumpraktisi wolwazi (HPCSA) kwinkqubo ekhoyo ngokwezifundo zabantu basezweni abangajongiswa kubahlali bawo abavela kwamanye amazwe, abo abangaqatshiwa ukuba bagqithe iNkonzo yomntu wonke njengoko kuceliwe eMzantsi Afrika. Grade 2: Ubuncinane iya kwiminyaka eli-10 kwindlela yokuba ngumpraktisi we-HPCSA kwinkqubo ekhoyo (ngoko ukuba kuyimfuneko) kubasebenzi base-RSA abo bayenze iNkonzo yomntu wonke njengoko kuceliwe eMzantsi Afrika. Ubuncinane iminyaka eli-11 yamava okuhambelanayo kwindlela yokuba ngumpraktisi wolwazi (HPCSA) kwinkqubo ekhoyo ngokwezifundo zabantu basezweni abangajongiswa kubahlali bawo abavela kwamanye amazwe, abo abangaqatshiwa ukuba bagqithe iNkonzo yomntu wonke njengoko kuceliwe eMzantsi Afrika. Grade 3: Ubuncinane iminyaka eli-20 kwindlela yokuba ngumpraktisi we-HPCSA kwinkqubo ekhoyo (ngoko ukuba kuyimfuneko) kubasebenzi base-RSA abo bayenze iNkonzo yomntu wonke njengoko kuceliwe eMzantsi Afrika. Ubuncinane iminyaka eli-21 yamava okuhambelanayo kwindlela yokuba ngumpraktisi wolwazi (HPCSA) kwinkqubo ekhoyo ngokwezifundo zabantu basezweni abangajongiswa kubahlali bawo abavela kwamanye amazwe, abo abangaqatshiwa ukuba bagqithe iNkonzo yomntu wonke njengoko kuceliwe eMzantsi Afrika. Ilayisense yokushayela ebhalwayo eyasebenzayo. Ulwazi nakhono: Ulwazi, amakhono nendlela yokuziphatha efunekayo: Ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha (MS Word, MS Excel). Ulwazi malunga nemigaqo yemithetho yaba-only base-RSA njengoko bekuceliwe kumthetho wakwonke uhulumeni waseMzantsi Afrika. Amakhono okuyaleka naxoxwa nempiliso yakho. Indlela yokusebenza njengomsebenzi weqela elinganabanye abantu. Isakhono sokucinga ngokuchanekileyo, ukwenza izigqibo ezilungele ukuzimisela, kunye nezakhono ezithembekileyo zokuxazulula iingxaki ezahlukeneyo. Ukuba ngumntu onesikhindi esihle ekuxoxweni nokubambisana nabanye abantu. Isakhono sokusebenza ngaphantsi kwezoyikekileyo ezinxulumene nomsindo. Ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha kuya kuba luncediso (kubonwa kabini). Ukuzibandakanya ngokusebenzayo kumapleni amagqabakho amacandele afuna ukulunga izinto ezifuna ukuba abantu bakwazi ukuzimela abo bathatha inxaxheba kwicandelo leNkonzo yeTherapeutic nezeMedikali. Amakhondo amakhulu okulawula iirekhodi.
xh.duties: Hlola kunye nokwelapha onke amakhulu okanye abantwana abanesifo sezempilo-okuthilewa okanye kobuchopho, ngaphakathi kwesigqibo sokusebenza esabelwe kuso. Nceda kwezinye izigqibo zokusebenza xa kuyimfuneko. Thatha inxaxheba kumsebenzi olungiselwe yokurhoxiswa amakhomitya. Landela iindlela ezilungele iindlela zolononqo, ze zigunyazwe sisebe, isibhedlele namaphondo. Thatha inxaxheba kweendlela zokuqinisekiswa kwizinga lokwenzeka. Xoxa ngokusebenzayo nabo bonke abahlobeneyo. Landela iindlela ezichanekileyo zoxoxo. Qhweba abasebenzi ababelwe kuso. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo ezahlukahlukeneyo ze-CPD. Qondisa abaFundi be-OT. Cinga ngokusigcina ngokwemisebenzi yawo yonke into edliwayo. ukusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo kwemisebenzi yaba-Occupational Therapist kwezona zinto zibalulekileyo ukuqinisekisa ukuba abantu banikwa imisebenzi yaba-Occupational Therapist ethath' inxaxheba ngokuzimisela nokulunganisa imisebenzi yaba-Occupational Therapist ngokwemigaqo yomsebenzi we-OT nentethelelo ye-Mental Health Care Act. Thatha inxaxheba kwimisebenzi eyimfuneko yokwenza iiprojekthi kwindlela yokwenza imisebenzi yaba-Occupational Therapist. Unqunya nokuqondisa abasebenzi abathintelweyo nabaFundi. Thatha inxaxheba kwintsebenziswano ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwezinye izigqibo nakumathandabuhla abahlobeneyo ne-University of the Free State, NGO ezifanelekileyo nezikhungo ezisebenzela ukubuyisa imizimba endluliniyo. Thatha inxaxheba ekulawuleni ulwazo neengozgo kwi-Occupational Therapy. Kulawulo kwemisebenzi esabelwe kuyo (into edliwayo nempahla). Unyuzo olunguye ngokuphuhliswa kwemisebenzi yaba-Occupational Therapist. Nceda ekuphuhliseni amagqabakho xa kuthintelwa. Iinkqubo ezilungele imisebenzi edliwayo yeqela nendlela yokusebenza esabelwe kuyo.

jobs.title: Pharmacy Assistant
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R275 340 -R310 422 per annum Grade 2: R318 666 - R337 083 per annum Grade 3: R343 761 - R390 396 per annum
jobs.summary: Pharmacy Assistant post in Thabo Mofutsanyana District requiring a Post-Basic Pharmacist Assistant qualification with current SAPC registration to support pharmaceutical service delivery.
jobs.requirements: Post-Basic Pharmacist Assistant qualification that allows registration with the SAPC as Pharmacist Assistant (Post Basic). Current registration with the SAPC as a Pharmacist Assistant (Post Basic) (2026/2027). Grade 1: Experience: None after registration with the SAPC as Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Pharmacist Assistant after registration as a Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) with the SAPC. Grade 3: A minimum of 13 years’ appropriate experience as Pharmacist Assistant after registration as a Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) with the SAPC. Knowledge And Skills: Own discipline, Knowledge of relevant legislations, regulations, policies implementation and information management, quality assurance and improvement programmes, communication and problem solving, computer literacy, stress tolerance objectiveness and empathy. Acquaintance with standard operating procedures and health care standards treatment guidelines, work effectively as part of a team.
jobs.duties: Assist with the delivery of a good pharmaceutical service to patients. Provide instructions regarding the correct use of medicine supplied (not counselling). Receiving and unpacking of received of stock. Assist with the ordering of medicine and scheduled substances up to schedule under supervision. Assist with the distribution of pharmacy stock (Schedule 0 -6). Checking stock and cleaning of shelves. Checking of expired stock, stock levels and stock taking. Maintenance of pharmacy hygiene. Pre-packing or re-packing. Provide pharmacy related tasks (statistics, records, registers, stock cards, customer care and answering of phones).
jobs.applications: Free State Provincial Department of Health utilises an e-Recruitment System (applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://www.erecruitment.fs.gov.za

af.title: Apteekassistent
af.summary: Apteekassistent-pos in Thabo Mofutsanyana Distrik wat 'n Post-Basiese Aptekersassistent-kwalifikasie met huidige SAPC-registrasie vereis om farmaseutiese dienslewering te ondersteun.
af.requirements: Post-Basiese Aptekersassistent-kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SAPC as Aptekersassistent (Post-Basies) moontlik maak. Huidige registrasie by die SAPC as 'n Aptekersassistent (Post-Basies) (2026/2027). Graad 1: Ervaring: Geen na registrasie by die SAPC as Aptekersassistent (Post-Basies) nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Aptekersassistent na registrasie as 'n Aptekersassistent (Post-Basies) by die SAPC. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 13 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Aptekersassistent na registrasie as 'n Aptekersassistent (Post-Basies) by die SAPC. Kennis en vaardighede: Eie dissipline, kennis van tersaaklike wetgewing, regulasies, beleidstoepassing en inligtingsbestuur, gehalteversekering en verbeteringsprogramme, kommunikasie en probleemoplossing, rekenaarvaardigheid, strestoleransie, objektiwiteit en empatie. Bekendheid met standaardbedryfsprosedures en gesondheidsorgstandaarde behandelingsriglyne, doeltreffend as deel van 'n span werk.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met die lewering van 'n goeie farmaseutiese diens aan pasiënte. Verskaf instruksies aangaande die korrekte gebruik van verskafde medisyne (nie voorligting nie). Ontvangs en uitpak van ontvangde voorraad. Bystand verleen met die bestelling van medisyne en geskeduleerde stowwe tot by skedule onder toesig. Bystand verleen met die verspreiding van apteekvoorraad (Skedule 0-6). Kontroleer van voorraad en skoonmaak van rakke. Kontroleer van verlopen voorraad, voorraadvlakke en voorraadopname. Onderhoud van apteekhigiëne. Voorverpakking of herverpakking. Verskaf apteekverwante take (statistiek, rekords, registers, voorraadkaarte, klintensorg en antwoord van telefoone).

zu.title: Pharmacy Assistant
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaMsizi wePharmacy eThabo Mofutsanyana District sidinga iziqu zakwa-Post-Basic Pharmacist Assistant nokubhaliswa kwamanje kwi-SAPC ukuze kusasandwe ukulethwa kwenkonzo yamakhemisi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zakwa-Post-Basic Pharmacist Assistant ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SAPC njengo-Pharmacist Assistant (Post Basic). Ukubhaliswa kwamanje kwi-SAPC njengo-Pharmacist Assistant (Post Basic) (2026/2027). Grade 1: Experience: Akukho okunemva kokubhaliswa kwi-SAPC njengo-Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) Grade 2: Okungenani eminyaka eyi-5 yokusebenza okufanele njengo-Pharmacist Assistant ngemva kokubhaliswa njengo-Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) kwi-SAPC. Grade 3: Okungenani eminyaka eyi-13 yokusebenza okufanele njengo-Pharmacist Assistant ngemva kokubhaliswa njengo-Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) kwi-SAPC. Knowledge And Skills: Ukwuzilawula, ulwazi ngemithesho, imithethonqubo, amapholisi asebenzayo nolawulo lolwazi, ikuwalithi u-assurance nokuqinisekiswa kuhle kwahle izinhlelo zokuswela ukuze azwele phansi ukuthi enzani ukusebenza ngezinsuku, ushuidelwe imvama eloliseka inkampani yokuhlukana imbhede nemigwaqo ekwaziseka kanyiswa kakhulu, ukuxoxa ngezinhlupheko eziciniwe zokomkhulu welwazi, siza ekuthi abahleli bethu bathole imfundo yokusebenza njengabantu abayiyo ibandakanya okuhle kwami nokunye ukubekezela mva kwezombhangamthetho, amagunya esidlavela, kulo lonke okuhle ngamaziko, siza isikole ngohlelo iyiputha, imilolwe nokunye okuhle okuhle imivundo, lusekelo alukhombise ukuthula imithando eva nobunye imvama yezinkampani ezahlukene, ukusebenza kahle njengenhloko eqenjini.
zu.duties: Siza ekuletheni inkonzo ehle yamakhemisi kubaphathi. Nikeza imiyalo ngokusetshenziswa okuhle kwemithi ethunyelwe (akuyiwona ukweluleka). Ukwamukela nokuqoqa inkambu etholiwe. Siza ekuodweni kwemithi nemikhathi ekelawulwayo kufike esigabeni ngaphansi kokuqondiswa. Siza ekusabalaliseni inkambu yekhemisi (Schedule 0 - 6). Ukuhlola inkambu nokuhlanza izigaxa. Ukuhlola inkambu edlule umhla, izinga lenkambu nokubala inkambu. Ukugcina ihhavini yekhemisi ihlanzeke. Ukuphakela noma ukuqoqisa kabusha. Ukwenza imisebenli ephathelene nesekhemisi (izibalo, irekhodi, izibuyekezo, amakhadi enkambu, ukunakekelwa kwabatholankeli nokuuphendula amafulani).

xh.title: Umncedi wePharmacy
xh.summary: Isithuba somncedi wePharmacy kummandla wase Thabo Mofutsanyana District esifuna ifomalo yomncedi wePharmacy ongemva kweBASIC ongamanqaku anokusibhalisa kwiSAPC ukuze axhase ukunikwa kweenkonzo zezezamayeza.
xh.requirements: Ifomalo yomncedi wePharmacy ongemva kweBASIC evumela ukubhalisa kwiSAPC njengomncedi wePharmacy (ongemva kweBASIC). Ubhaliso lwangoku kwiSAPC njengomncedi wePharmacy (ongemva kweBASIC) (2026/2027). Inqanaba 1: Isiphiwo: Akukho ngemva kokubhalisa kwiSAPC njengomncedi wePharmacy (ongemva kweBASIC). Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-5 yamava afanelekileyo njengomncedi wePharmacy emva kokubhalisa njengomncedi wePharmacy (ongemva kweBASIC) kwiSAPC. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-13 yamava afanelekileyo njengomncedi wePharmacy emva kokubhalisa njengomncedi wePharmacy (ongemva kweBASIC) kwiSAPC. Ulwazi nobugcisa: Iyalelo elizimeleyo, ulwazi ngemigaqo-nqamlezala ephathwayo, iimigaqo, ukusebenzisa iinkqubomathetho nokulawula ulwazi, iinkqubonqumbo zokuqinisekisa nokuze kwenzeke umgangatho ongangcono, unxibelelwano nokusombulula iingxaki, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukumelana nokuxinzelelo, ukuzinza nokuzipatha ngokuzonda. Ulwazi ngemigaqo esemgangathweni yokusebenza neemigangatho yezempilo ezingamagqabantshintshi bokwelapha, ukusebenza ngokusebenzisana njengenxalenye yeqela.
xh.duties: Uncede ekunikezeni inkonzo yamayeza elungileyo kubaguli. Nikela izikhokelo malunga nokusetyenziswa okuchanekileyo kwamayeza anikiweyo (akukho ncoko yelwazi). Ukamkelwa nokuqhuqha izinto ezifunyenwe zithe zifike. Uncede ekuleteni amayeza nezinto ezilawulwayo ukuya kwisikhathi esilawulwayo ngaphantsi kolawulo. Uncede ekusasazeni izinto zamayeza (isiKhathi 0 -6). Ukuhlola izinto nokucoca amashelufu. Ukuhlola izinto eziphelelwe ligama, amanqanaba ezinto nokuqhela izinto. Ukugcina ihlebo elicocekileyo kwipharmacy. Ukupakisha ngaphambili okanye ukupakisha kwakhona. Nikela ngeemisebenzi ehlobene neyepharmacy (izibalo, iirekhodi, iirejista, amakhad ezinto, ukunakekelwa kwabathengi nokuphendula iingxoxo zobucingo).

jobs.centre: Boitumelo Regional Hospital Electrician (X1 Post) Carpenter (X1 Post)

Produce objects with material and equipment according to job specification and recognized standards. Quality assurance of produced objects and inspect equipment and or facility for technical faults. Repair equipment and facility defects according to standards. Test and repair equipment and machinery in the facility in terms of the specifications. Service equipment and machinery in the facility according to maintenance plan schedule. Quality assure serviced and maintained equipment in the facility. Compile and submit reports. Provide inputs to the operational plan. Keep and maintain job records/ register, supervise and mentor staff. Continuous individual development to keep up new technologies and procedure.

af.title: Ambagsman Produksie
af.summary: Twee ambagsman-produksie poste by Boitumelo Regionale Hospitaal wat Graad 12 en 'n tersaaklike ambagsman-toetsertifikaat vereis, met geen vooraf ondervinding nodig nie.
af.requirements: Graad 12 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie met geen ondervinding nie. Toepaslike Ambagsman-toetsertifikaat (Passer). 'n Volledige vakleerling en bewys van die slaag van 'n ambagsman-toets in terme van Artikel 13(2)(h) van 1981, van die Mannekragwet, 1981 soos gewysig of 'n sertifikaat uitgereik onder bepalings van Artikel 28 of 30 van die Mannekragwet, 1981, soos gewysig of uitgereik onder die bepalings van die herroep Artikel 27 van die bedoelde Wet. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van die Beroepsveiligheid en Gesondheidswet, 1993 (Wet No. 85 van 1993) (BVG Wet). Rekenvaardigheid. Uitstekende tydbestuur, Kommunikasie (geskrewe en mondeling), goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede met kollegas en ander departemente en verslagdoeningsvaardighede.
af.duties: Produceer ontwerpe volgens kliëntspesifikasie en binne die perke van produksievermoë. Produceer voorwerpe met materiaal en toerusting volgens werkspesifikasie en erkende standaarde. Kwaliteitsversekering van geproduceerde voorwerpe en inspekteer toerusting en of fasiliteit vir tegniese foute. Herstel toerusting en fasiliteitsdefekte volgens standaarde. Toets en herstel toerusting en masjinerie in die fasiliteit in terme van die spesifikasies. Onderhou toerusting en masjinerie in die fasiliteit volgens die instandhoudingsplanskedule. Kwaliteitsverseker onderhoude en instandgehouden toerusting in die fasiliteit. Stel en dien verslae in. Verskaf insette tot die operasionele plan. Hou en onderhou werksrekords/ register, hou toesig en mentorspersoneel. Deurlopende individuele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures.

zu.title: Ukukhiqiza kwenkosi
zu.summary: Amasikhundla amabili okukhiqiza kwenkosi e-Boitumelo Regional Hospital adinga i-Grade 12 nesitifikedi esifanele sokuhlola ithrade, ngaphandle kokuhlwa kuqashwe ulolwazi lwangaphambilini.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 noma izifundo ezilinganayo ngaphandle kolwazi. Isitifikedi esifanele Sokuhlola Ithrade (Fitter). Umgwetfisi ophelele kanye nobufakazi bokudlula ukuhlolwa kweythrade ngokusho kweSigaba 13(2)(h) sika-1981, seManpower Act, 1981 njengokushintshiwe noma isitifikedi esikhishwe ngaphansi kwezinhlinzeko zeSigaba 28 noma 30 seManpower Act, 1981, njengokushintshiwe noma esikhishwe ngaphansi kwezinhlinzeko zeSigaba 27 esesisusiwe somthetho okushiwo. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngo-Occupational Health & Safety Act, 1993 (Act No. 85 of 1993) (OHS Act). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuphatha isikhathi ngendlela ehle kakhulu, Ukuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokuqhamayo), amakhono ahle wokuxhumana nabasebenzi nomnyango omunye nokubhala imibiko.
zu.duties: Kukhiqize izinhlelo ngokusho izidingo ziklayenti nangaphakathi kwemikhawulo yamandla okukhiqiza. Kukhiqize izinto ngezinsiza namathuluzi ngokusho izidingo zomsebenzi nemigomo esemthethweni. Ukuqinisekisa ikhwalithi yezinto ezikhiqiziwe futhi uhlole amathuluzi noma isikhungla ukuthi kunoma yiphi iphutha lobuchwepheshe. Kulungise amaphutha amathuluzi nasezikhungleni ngokusho imigomo. Ukuhlole futhi ulungise amathuluzi namashini esikhungleni ngokusho izidingo. Ukukhonza amathuluzi namashini esikhungleni ngokushohhodi yohlelo lokugcina. Ukuqinisekisa ikhwalithi yamathuluzi akhonziwe futhi agcinwe esikhungleni. Ukuqamba futhi unikeze imibiko. Ukunikeza okokufaka ohlelweni lokusebenza. Ukugcina futhi ukulondoloza irekhodi yomsebenzi/irejistha, ukuqapha futhi uholele abasebenzi. Ukuthuthuka kwakho ngamunye ngokuqhubekayo ukuze ugqame ezobuchwepheshe ezintsha nasezendleleni zokwenza umsebenzi.

xh.title: Ukukhiqiza kwe-Artisan
xh.summary: Izithuba ezimbini zokukhiqiza kwe-Artisan e-Boitumelo Regional Hospital ezifuna i-Grade 12 nesatifikethi esifanelekileyo sovavvo lwebhondo, ngaphandle kokuba nolunye uqeqesho lwangaphambini.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 okanye isidanga esilinganayo ngaphandle kolunye uqeqesho. Isatifikethi esifanelekileso Sovavvo lweBhondo (i-Fitter). Ukuba ngumfundi ofundela ibhondo ngokupheleleyo kunye nesiqinisekiso sokuphumelela uvavvo lwebhondo ngokweqela le-Section 13(2)(h) ka-1981, loMthetho weBasebenzi, ka-1981 njengoko ulungisiwe okanye isatifikethi esinikiweyo ngokwezinqixezelo ze-Section 28 okanye i-30 loMthetho weBasebenzi, ka-1981, njengoko ulungisiwe okanye esinikiweyo ngokwezinqixezelo ze-Section 27 oyinyuselwa umthetho othethiweyo. Ulwazi namaKhono: Ulwazi ngoMthetho wezaMafa nokuKhuseleka kweMisebenzi, ka-1993 (uMthetho uNo. 85 ka-1993) (uMthetho we-OHS). Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqamba ixesha ngokugqwesileyo, Unxibelelwano (olubhaliweyo nolwenziwe ngomlomo), amakhono amahle okusebenzisana nabasebenzi nasezinye iimbelekazo nokubhala iingxelo.
xh.duties: Kukhiqize iindizo ngokwezicwangciso ziklayenti nangaphakathi kwemida yamandla okukhiqiza. Kukhiqize izinto ngezixhobo nezinto zokwakha ngokwezicwangciso zomsebenzi nangokweemigangatho eziyaziwayo. Qinisekisa umgangatho wezinto ezenziweyo ihlole izixhobo okanye isiseko sezixhobo ukubakho iimpazamo zezobuchwepheshe. Lokuba lulungise iimpazamo ezingezixhobo nakwisiseko sezixhobo ngokweemigangatho. Lavavise ulungise izixhobo nemishini esisekeni ngokwezicwangciso. Phathela izixhobo nemishini esisekeni ngokohlelo lweplani yokunakekelwa. Qinisekisa umgangatho wezixhobo ezinakekelweyo nasezigcinweni esisekeni. Lungisa uhluwe ngokweenkcukacha iingxelo uzinike. Nikezela izigqibo kwiplani yokuqhuba. Sigcine saze silungelelanise iirekhodi zomsebenzi/irejista, ulawule uze ulungele uluntu abasebenzi. Ukuzithuthukisa ngokuqhubekayo ukuze ulandele iindlela ezitsha zezobuchwepheshe nezinqubo.

jobs.summary: Staff Nurse position in Thabo Mofutsanyana District, Free State, providing patient education, vital signs monitoring, HIV counselling and treatment literacy across three grade levels.

Appropriate experience in the management of HIV treatment. Confidentiality.

Provide treatment literacy to clients on chronic medication to enhance adherence. Offer quality HIV Counselling and Testing services on site including HIV SS and Index Testing. Provide quality TB, STI & COVID Screening. Assist professional nurses with clinical procedures, preparation of patients for diagnostic and surgical procedures., effective utilization of resources such as to order stock and equipment in a cost-effective manner and immediate report of lost or damaged resources) and maintain professional growth/ethical standards and self-development: To maintain the code of conduct as required in the Public Service and by the Professional Body. af.title: Verpleegkundige
af.summary: Verpleegkundige pos in Thabo Mofutsanyana Distrik, Free State, wat pasiëntopvoeding, monitering van lewensfunksies, MIV-berading en behandelingsgeletterdheid oor drie graadvlakke bied.
af.requirements: Graad 1: Ervaring: Geen; Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC as Ingeskrewe Verpleegkundige. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC as 'n Ingeskrewe Verpleegkundige. Huidige registrasie by SANC (2026/2027) Kennis en Vaardighede: Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike verhoudings. Sterk vermoë om in 'n span te werk. Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk, onder druk te werk en sperdatums te haal. Bereid wees om uitgebreid te reis. Kennis van beleide en MIV/Vigs-bestuur, alle behandelingsbeleide en riglyne. Toepaslike ervaring in die bestuur van MIV-behandeling. Vertroulikheid.
af.duties: Verskaf Gesondheidsopvoeding aan pasiënte wat sorg ontvang. Meet, interpreteer en registreer lewensfunksies. Bedryf alle relevante apparaat en toerusting. Verskaf behandelingsgeletterdheid aan kliënte op chroniese medikasie om nakoming te verbeter. Bied gehalte MIV-berading en toetsdienste op die perseel aan, insluitend MIV SS en Indekstoetsing. Verskaf gehalue TB, STI & COVID ondersoek. Help professionele verpleegkundiges met kliniese prosedures, voorbereiding van pasiënte vir diagnostiese en chirurgiese prosedures., effektiewe benutting van hulpbronne soos om voorraad en toerusting koste-doeltreffend te bestel en onmiddellike verslagdoening van verlore of beskadigde hulpbronne) en handhaaf professionele groei/etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling: Handhaaf die gedragskode soos vereis in die Openbare Diens en deur die Professionele Liggaam. Handhaaf gehalte databestuur in ooreenstemming met die SOP's.

zu.title: Umongikazi Ohlangene
zu.summary: Isikhundla somongikazi ohlangene Thabo Mofutsanyana District, Free State, esinikeza imfundo kubafundi, okokulinganisa izimpawu eziphilayo, neluleko ngesandulela ngculaza kanye nokwaziswa ngokwelashwa kumaqoqo amathathu amaningi.
zu.requirements: Grade 1: Experience: None; Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as Enrolled Nurse. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as a Enrolled Nurse. Current registration with SANC (2026/2027) Knowledge And Skills: Good Communication and interpersonal relations. Strong ability to work within a team. Ability to work independently, under pressure and meet deadlines. Be willing to travel extensively. Knowledge of policies and HIV/AIDS management, all treatment policies and guideline. Appropriate experience in the management of HIV treatment. Confidentiality.
zu.duties: Provide Health Education to patients accessing care. Measure, interpret and record vital signs. Operate all relevant apparatus and equipment. Provide treatment literacy to clients on chronic medication to enhance adherence. Offer quality HIV Counselling and Testing services on site including HIV SS and Index Testing. Provide quality TB, STI & COVID Screening. Assist professional nurses with clinical procedures, preparation of patients for diagnostic and surgical procedures., effective utilization of resources such as to order stock and equipment in a cost-effective manner and immediate report of lost or damaged resources) and maintain professional growth/ethical standards and self-development: To maintain the code of conduct as required in the Public Service and by the Professional Body. Maintain quality data management in line with the SOP's.

xh.title: Urhwebo loGqirha oBhalisiweyo
xh.summary: Isithuba soGqirha oBhalisiweyo eThabo Mofutsanyana District, eFree State, sinika imfundo kubasemelwe, ukulandela imiba ebalulekileyo yomzimba, ukulumkisa ngoHIV nolwazi ngamayeza kumagqre amathathu.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Isipili: Akukho nalinye; Inqanaba 2: Inani elifingqiweyo leminyaka engama-10 isipili esifanelekileyo/esiqondekayo kwinsele ekunakekelwa kwabaphilwe emva kokubhalisa kwiSANC njengoGqirha oBhalisiweyo. Inqanaba 3: Inani elifingqiweyo leminyaka engama-20 isipili esifanelekileyo/esiqondekayo kwinsele ekunakekelwa kwabaphilwe emva kokubhalisa kwiSANC njengoGqirha oBhalisiweyo. Isibhalo sanamhlanje kwiSANC (2026/2027) ULwazi nakhono: Ikhomunicheyshenin elilula nolutshutshiswa phakathi kwabantu. Ikhono elikhulu lokusebenza ngaphakathi kothotho. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimeleyo, ngaphantsi kwexinzelelo nokuze afikelele kwizicwangciso zexesha. Mke ukuba uvakatshule kakhulu. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nolawulo iHIV/AIDS, bonke imigaqo yolawulo lwekrhasi neelayini ezilawulayo. Isipili esifanelekileyo ekulawulweni ikrhasi yeHIV. Ikhomfidentshaliyithi.
xh.duties: Nikeza imfundo yezeempilo kubasemelwe abafumana ukunakekelwa. Linganisa, the kakuhle, wenze irekhodi lwemiba ebalulekileyo yomzimba. Sebenzisa zonke iiarments nezixhobo ezifanelekileyo. Nikeza ulwazi ngamayeza akrhas abasemelwe abasele imithi yeerkenzo ukuphucula ukulandela imithi. Nikeza iinkonzo ezilula zokuLumkisa ngoHIV nokuVavanya kwendawo kubandakanya iHIV SS nokuVavanya ngeNkomba. Nikeza isikrhasi seeThhu, iSTI neCOVID. Siza oogqirha bezamaphakathi ngemigaqo yodlamo, ulungiselelo lwebarhelwele kwimigaqo yokuvavanywa nangaphezulu kwesisu; ukusetyenziswa kakuhle kwemiGinno njengokutula iStock nezixhobo ngeNdlela eGcweleyo kwaye ulange ngokukhawuleza ngemiGinno ephilakeleyo okanye eonakalisiweyo; kwaye ugcine ukukhula ngamakhondo / izimo ezilungileyo nokuPhehlelelwa kwesiqu: ukuze uGcine iKhowudi yokuziphatha njengoko kufuneka kwiNkonzo kaZulu nakwiLunga leMigaqo. Gcina ulawulo lwesidata egcweleyo ngokweSOPs.

jobs.title: Director: Infrastructure Procurement
jobs.summary: Director of Infrastructure Procurement at the Gauteng Department of Human Settlements in Johannesburg, requiring an NQF 7 degree and five years of senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: A Matric plus an undergraduate qualification Degree (NQF level 7) as recognized by SAQA in Supply Chain Management / Logistics / Commerce / Finance. A minimum of 5 years relevant experience at middle/senior managerial level. Possession of a Pre-Entry Certificate for SMS (required prior to appointment). The candidate should have knowledge of all the Public Service prescripts applicable to the role as well as the Department’s mandate. Knowledge of performance management frameworks applicable in the Public Service and proven strategies in performance improvement. Understanding of Infrastructure Delivery Management System (IDMS). Competencies: Strategic capability and Leadership, People Management and empowerment, Programme and Project Management, Financial Management and Change Management. Problem solving and analysis, Client orientation and customer focus, Service Delivery Innovation, Honesty and Integrity. Personal Attributes and Skills: Good written and verbal communication skills. Planning and organising skills. Time management. Problem solving, flexibility and innovative. Good interpersonal skills. Supportive and knowing how to draw the best energy out of the team. Reliable and Responsible. Positive attitude.
jobs.duties: Develop, design and manage infrastructure procurement policies, processes and procedures. Establish construction procurement processes and procedures. Promote correct implementation and sound infrastructure procurement practices. Manage the design and implementation of a system to monitor performance of suppliers and the performance of the Contracting Institution. Manage the appointment, training and vetting of Tender Committee members. Manage and direct inputs to the Strategic and Annual Performance Plans to support the achievement of the construction procurement policy in the Institution. Manage finalisation of Bid Specification Documentation, Advertisement processes and Tender Clarification Meetings. Determine clearly closing time and date of tenders and the physical location of the tender box and/or related procurement procedures. Manage the tender evaluation and monitoring. Manage the sourcing of bids from the database according to the threshold values determined by the National Treasury. Manage the design and implementation of controls to comply with contract requirements. Manage and review all cancellations, amendments, expansions, variations, extensions or transfer of contracts awarded through the Bid Committee System. Manage motivations to authorise increases in the total prices excluding price adjustment for inflation in excess of the amount stated in the contract and make recommendations. Management of sub-directorate. Develop and manage the operational plan of the unit and report on progress as required. Compile and submit all required administrative reports. Quality control of work delivered by employees. Functional technical advice and guidance. Plan and allocate work.
jobs.applications: Please apply online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/
jobs.notes: The Department is committed to achieving employment equity and diversity in accordance with its approved Employment Equity Plan. Preference will be given to suitably qualified Coloured (Male & Female), White female, African male and Persons with disability (PwD) candidates in order to advance the Department’s Employment Equity objectives and address identified under- representation at the relevant occupational level. Requirement of applications: No late applications will be considered. No faxed or emailed applications will be accepted. The Gauteng Department of Human Settlements promotes equal opportunity and aims to implement affirmative action measures to address the disadvantages in employment. Preference may be given to appointable applicants from the underrepresented designated groups in terms of the department’s equity plan. Candidates whose appointment will promote representativity in terms of race, disability, youth & gender will receive preference. Whites, Indians, Coloureds and Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applications should be submitted strictly online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za and it should be accompanied by a new Z83 and a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV) only. Certified copies of qualifications, Identity and valid driver’s license (where driving/travelling is an inherent requirement of the job) will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Correspondence will only be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. For all SMS positions, the successful completion of the Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government and possession of the SMS Pre-Entry Certificate is required prior to appointment. For more details on the pre-entry course visit: https://www.thensg.gov. za/training course/sms pre-entry-programme/. Following the interview and exercise, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic management competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency- based assessments). All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The competency assessment will be testing generic management and development for SMS posts. The Department reserves the right not to make appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Infrastruktuurverkryging
af.summary: Direkteur van Infrastruktuurverkryging by die Gauteng Department of Human Settlements in Johannesburg, wat 'n NQF 7-graad en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: ‘n Matriek plus ‘n voorgraadse kwalifikasie-graad (NQF vlak 7) soos deur SAQA erken in Toevoerkettingbestuur / Logistiek / Handel / Finansies. ‘n Minimum van 5 jaar relevante ervaring op middel-/seniorbestuursvlak. Besit van ‘n Voortoelatingsertifikaat vir SMS (word voor aanstelling vereis). Die kandidaat behoort kennis te dra van al die Openbare Diens-skrywes wat op die rol van toepassing is, asook die departement se mandaat. Kennis van prestasiebestuursraamwerke wat in die Openbare Diens van toepassing is en bewese strategieë vir prestasieverbetering. Begrip van die Infrastructure Delivery Management System (IDMS). Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, personeelbestuur en bemagtiging, program- en projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur en veranderingbestuur. Probleemoplossing en ontleding, kliëntgerigtheid en klieńsfokus, diensleweringinnoviasie, eerlikheid en integriteit. Persoonlike eienskappe en vaardighede: Goedge skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Tydbestuur. Probleemoplossing, buigsaamheid en innoverend. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Ondersteunend en weet hoe om die beste energie uit die span te haal. Betroubaar en verantwoordelik. Positiewe houding.
af.duties: Ontwikkel, ontwerp en bestuur infrastruktuurverkrygingsbeleid, prosesse en prosedures. Stel konstruusieverkrygingsprosesse en -prosedures in. Bevorder korrekte implementering en gesonde infrastruktuurverkrygingspraktyke. Bestuur die ontwerp en implementering van ‘n stelsel om die prestasie van verskaffers en die prestasie van die Kontrakterende Instelling te monitor. Bestuur die aanstelling, opleiding en sifting van Tenderkomiteelede. Bestuur en rig insettes tot die Strategiese en Jaarlikse Prestasieplanne om die bereiking van die konstruusieverkrygingsbeleid in die Instelling te ondersteun. Bestuur die finalisering van Byspesifikasiestandaratsiedokumentasie, Advertensieprosesse en Tenderverhelderingsvergaderings. Bepaal duidelik die sluitingstyd en -datum van tenders en die fisiese ligging van die tenderkassie en/of verwante verkrygingsprosedures. Bestuur die tenderevaluering en monitering. Bestuur die verkryging van biedskrywings uit die databasis ooreenkomstig die drempelwaardes wat deur die Nasionale Tesourie bepaal word. Bestuur die ontwerp en implementering van kontroles om aan kontrakvereistes te voldoen. Bestuur en hersien alle kansellasies, wysigings, uitbreidings, variasies, verlengings of oordragte van kontrakte wat deur die Biedkomiteestelsel toegeken is. Bestuur motiverings om magtigings te gee vir verhogings in die totale pryse, uitgesluit prysaangaüting vir inflasie, bo die bedrag wat in die kontrak vermeld is, en doen aanbevelings. Bestuur van sub-direktoraat. Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die eenheid en doen verslag oor vordering soos vereis. Stel al die vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in. Kwaliteitsbeheer van werk wat deur werknemers gelewer word. Funksionele tegniese advies en leiding. Beplan en wys werk toe.

zu.title: Umqondisi: Ukuthenga Izinto Zokwakha
zu.summary: Umqondisi Wokuthenga Izinto Zokwakha e Gauteng Department of Human Settlements e Johannesburg, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF 7 neminyaka emihlanu yohlu lokusebenza njengomphathi ophakeme.
zu.requirements: I-Matric kanye nokuqeqeshwa okuphezulu kwabafundi abafunda iziqu (izinga le-NQF 7) njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA kwi-Supply Chain Management / Logistics / Commerce / Finance. Umkhulu weminyaka emi-5 yohlu lokusebenza oluhambisana nalesi sikhundla ezingeni lomphathi wesiqintile/ophakeme. Ukuba nesiqinisekiso se-Pre-Entry Certificate for SMS (esidingwa ngaphambi kokwethweswa isikhundla). Umuntu ophakanyiswayo kufanele abe nolwazi ngawo wonke amagama asebenzayo e-Public Service ahambisana nale minyaka nendima yomnyango. Ulwazi ngohlelo lokupatha ukusebenza esilwenzelayo i-Public Service kanye nezindlela ezivezisiwe zokuthuthukiswa kwezinto ezisebenzayo. Ukuqonda i-Infrastructure Delivery Management System (IDMS). Izindlela ezivezisiwe: Ikhono elihambisana ne-Leadership, ukuphatha abantu nokubakhwebisa, ukuphatha i-Programme and Project Management, i-Financial Management kanye ne-Change Management. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqonda izinto ezibaliwe, ukugxila kubathengi kanye nekhondo yomthengi, ukuthuthukiswa kwe-Service Delivery Innovation, ukuba nesibindi nokwethembeka. Izici zomuntu kanye namakhono: Amakhono amahle okuxoxa ngomlomo kanye nokubhala. Amakhono wokuhlela kanye nokuqamba. Ukuphatha isikhathi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuguquguquka nokuba nokwanda okuqambiwe. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nothisha. Ukusekela kwaye ukwazi ukukhipha amandla amahle eqembu. Ukethembeka futhi ukube nesibindi. Ukuba nomumo ohle kahle.
zu.duties: Bumba,hlela futhi uphathe izinqubomgomo, izinqubo kanye nezinyathelo zokuthenga izinto zokwakha. Hlela izinqubo kanye nezinyathelo zokuthenga izinto ezisetshenziswa ekwakheni. Khuthaza ukusetshenziswa ngendlela efanele kanye nokuqhuba kahle izinqubo zokuthenga izinto zokwakha. Phatha ukubunjwa nokusetshenziswa kohlelo okuyibele ukugcina ukusebenza kwabathengisi kanye nokusebenza kwe-Contracting Institution. Phatha ukukhethwa, ukuqeqeshwa kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwamalungu e-Tender Committee. Phatha futhi uholele iminikelo kwi-Strategic and Annual Performance Plans ukuze usekele ukufezekezwa kwenqubomgomo yokuqasha izinto zokwakha kule ndawo. Phatha ukugqitywa kwe-Bid Specification Documentation, izinqubo zokumemeza kanye ne-Tender Clarification Meetings. Qinisekisa ngokucacile isikhathi nosuku lokuvala ama-tender kanye nendawo ethile yebhokisi le-tender kanye/noma ezinye izinqubo zokuthenga ezihlobene. Phatha ukuhlola nokugcina isikhulumi phezu kwama-tender. Phatha ukutholwa kwebhili ekudatabeni ngokwe-values ezinqunyiwe i-National Treasury. Phatha ukubunjwa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezilawulo ukuze kuhambisane nezidingo zinkhishi. Phatha futhi uphinde ucabange ngawo wonke ukukhanselwa, ukuqalwa kwesisindo, ukwandiswa, okuhlotshaniswa, ukunwetshwa noma ukudluliselwa kwamakhontrathi anikezwa ngehlelo le-Bid Committee System. Phatha izinombolo zokugunyaza ukukhulisa ixabiso lilonke ukubandakanya ukulungiswa kwexabiso ngegciwane esibekwe kumakhontrathi futhi unikeze izincomo. Ukuphatha isabelo esincane. Hlela futhi uphathe uhlelo lokusebenza yilolu hlelo bese usendula ngokuya phambili njengoba kudingeka. Hlela bese usithumela wonke amarekhodi okuphatha abaluleke kakhulu. Ukulawula ngokwenza isithunywa kwenza imisebenzi ethunyelwe abasebenzi. Amai-advice kanye nohlelo lokusebenza ngokusobanayo uhlelo lwe-theori. Hlela bese ubanike imisebenzi.

xh.title: Isalathiso sokuLawula uTyhila
xh.summary: Isalathiso sokuLawula uTyhila kwiSebe lezeNtlaluthe eGauteng eJohannesburg, kufuneka idigri ye-NQF 7 kunye neminyaka eli-5 yamavaqanaba abaphathi abakhulu.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samatirikulu kunye neNgqinisekiso lokugquma kwidigri yesiNganga yeNgqondo esinomgangatho we-NQF level 7 njengoko samkelwe yi-SAQA kwinkqubo yoLawulo loTyhila kwi-Supply Chain Management / Logistics / Commerce / Finance. Ukuze ube nomvuzo we-5 yeminyaka yokwaziswa emgangathweni weqela eliphezulu / eliphakathi kulawulo. Isatifikethi seNkqubo esingenwa kwiSMS (sifuneka ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni). Ikratya kufuneka ibe nelwazi ngawo onke amagqabantshintshi eNkonzo zoLuntu ahambelana nalomsebenzi njengoko kunye nako uMthetho weNkcwaba yeNtlangano. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yolawulo lweNkonzo ephilayo kwiNkonzo yoLuntu kwaye izicwangciso ezinengqondo ekuphuculweni kokusebenza. Ukuqonda iNkqubo yoLawulo lokuTyhila izakhiwo (IDMS). Iindlela: Ikhono lokucwangcisa nokuQonda uLawulo, ulawulo lwabantu nemandla, ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphrojekthi, ulawulo lweMali nokuTshintsha ulawulo. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqwalasela, ulungelelaniso kuluxolwa noqhagamshelwano nomxhasi, iNkonzo yokuTyhila ukutyhila izinto ezintsha, inyaniso nokwamkela. Ubuntu nobuqhawe: Ikhono elihle lokubhala nokuThetha. Ikhono lokucwangcisa nokuLungelelanisa. Ikhono lokulawula ixesha. Ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuguquguquka nokuyila izinto ezintsha. Ikhono elihle elibini nabantu. Ukuxhasa nokwazi ukutsala amandla aphezulu eqela. Ethembekileyo neNyaniso. Isimo esihle sokuzipatha.
xh.duties: Phuhlisa, yila kwaye ulawule iinkqubo, iindlela nezithethe zokuthenga izakhiwo. Misela iindlela nezithethe zokuthenga ezindlwini zokwakha. Khuthaza ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nokwakho iindlela ezilungileyo zokuthenga izakhiwo. Lawula uyilo nokusebenza kwenkqubo yokulandela ukusebenza kwabanikezeli nakusebenza kweSikhulu sokuQamba Iinkqubo. Lawula ukuqeshwa, uqeqesho nokuhlolwa kwamalungu eKomiti yeTender. Lawula kwaye uqokele izinto ezifuneka kuCwangciso loBuchule neMiSebenzo yeMihla ngemihla yokuQhuba ukuze axhaswe ukufezwa kwenkqubo yendlela yokuthenga ezindlwini zokwakha kwiSikhulu. Lawula ukupheliswa koxelo lwamaxwebhu eNgcebiso esokuQamba, iindlela zoKuthumela isiKele kwaye kuQhutywe iintlanganiso zokuQaqamba kwiTender. Mgqaqo esele isikhathi nomhla wokucima kwamatender nendawo enye ekuyo iqosha lamatender nakwezinye iinkqubo zokuthenga. Lawula ukuqwalaselwa nokulandwa kwamatender. Lawula ukuqokelelwa kwamatender esidateni ngokomda omiswe nguMgcinwe weQhawe laseLizwe. Lawula uyilo nokusebenza kwezilawulo ukuze kuhwaywe iimfuno zenkqubo. Lawula kwaye uqwalasele ukukhutshwa okukhulu konke, izongezo, iinkqubo ezandisiweyo, izongezo, ukwandiswa okanye iNtshukhumo kwiinkqubo ezifiwa ngeNkqubo yeKomiti yeNtengiso. Lawula iingcinga zokuvuma ukwandiswa kwexabiso lilonke ingakunyiwa ukulungiswa kwexabiso lempompo ngaphezu kwemali echaziweyo kwinkqubo kwaye wenze izindululo. Ulawulo lwequlu elingaphantsi koqulu oluyintloko. Phuhlisa kwaye ulawule uCwangciso lokuQhuba lolunithi kwaye uluxe inkqondo ngemiba njengoko kufuneka. Qamba kwaye uthume wonke iingxelo ezifuneka zolawulo. Lawula ngangobuchule umsebenzi osikwa ngabasebenzi. Nika ulwazi lwabuchule ngemisebenzi. Cwangcisa kwaye ulungenise umsebenzi.

jobs.title: Director: Organisational Efficiency
jobs.summary: Director of Organisational Efficiency at the Gauteng Department of Human Settlements, responsible for operations strategy, standard operating procedures and change management.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus an undergraduate qualification (NQF7) in Public Administration / Business Management / Human Resource Management / Production/Operations Management / Management Services as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 5 years relevant experience at middle/ senior managerial level in Organisational Development / Service Delivery Improvement / Human Resource Planning & Systems environment or related field. Possession of the SMS Pre-Entry Certificate (required prior to appointment). Possession of a valid driver’s license. Knowledge: Public Service Act and Regulations, Labour Relations Act of 1995, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Employment Equity Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Public Finance Management Act and Treasury Regulations. Job Evaluation and organisational design principles. Certification as a Job Evaluation Analyst or Panel will be an added advantage. Competencies: Strategic capability and Leadership, People Management and empowerment, Programme and Project Management, Financial Management and Change Management. Problem solving and analysis, Client orientation and customer focus, Service Delivery Innovation. Skills: Good written and verbal communication skills. Planning, organising and execution skills. Knowledge management. Negotiation skills. Change management. Language proficiency and ability to manage conflict.
jobs.duties: Manage and monitor the implementation of Operations Strategy and Design. Manage and monitor the development of Standard Operating Procedures and Business Process for the department. Develop change management and communication strategies to ensure smooth transition of employees. Initiate and manage Organisational Design. Plan, implement, monitor and institutionalise Service Delivery Improvement programmes. Manage the implementation of the Diversity Management programmes in the department. Assess and analyse Service Delivery Model to identify service improvements by identifying resource and functional alignment inefficiencies. Manage the development and implementation of human resource strategy and plan. Manage the development and implementation of Employment Equity Plans. Manage resources of the unit (human resources, finance, assets)
jobs.applications: Please apply online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/

Preference will be given to suitably qualified Coloured (Male & Female), White female, African male and Persons with disability (PwD) candidates in order to advance the Department’s Employment Equity objectives and address identified under- representation at the relevant occupational level. Preference may be given to appointable applicants from the underrepresented designated groups in terms of the department’s equity plan. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar relevante ervaring op middel-/ seniorbestuursvlak in die Organisasieontwikkeling / Diensleweringverbetering / Menslike Hulpbronbeplanning en -stelsels-omgewing of verwante veld. Kennis: Public Service Act and Regulations, Labour Relations Act of 1995, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Employment Equity Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Public Finance Management Act and Treasury Regulations. Werkevaluering en organisasie-ontwerpbeginsels. Sertifisering as 'n Werkevalueringsontleder of paneel sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, programme- en projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur en veranderingbestuur. Probleemoplossing en analise, kliëntgerigtheid en kundersfokus, diensleweringinnovatie. Vaardighede: Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Beplannings-, organiseer- en uitvoervaardighede. Kennisbestuur. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Veranderingbestuur. Taalvaardigheid en die vermoë om konflik te bestuur.

Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van menslike hulpbronstrategie en -plan. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van Indiensnemingsgelykheidplanne. Bestuur hulpbronne van die eenheid (menslike hulpbronne, finansies, bates).

zu.title: Umongameli: Ukusebenza kahle kwe-Organisational
zu.summary: Umongameli we-Organisational Efficiency e-Gauteng Department of Human Settlements, obhekene nohlelo lwemisebenzi, izinqubo zokusebenza ezivamile kanye nokuphathwa koshintsho.

Izindawo zokugqoka: Ukukwazi ukuhlela ngokusobala kanye noMbuso, ukuPhathwa kwabantu kanye namandla okuzenzela, ukuPhathwa kwezinhlelo kanye noMsebenzi wokuQoqwa, ukuPhathwa kweMali kanye noMbuso wokuShintsha. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqoqa, ukuqondiswa kumthengi kanye nokugxila kumthengi, ukuHlola ukulethwa kwezinsiza. Amakhono: Amakhono amahle okubhala nokuKhuluma. Amakhono okuHlela, ukuHlela kanye noMbuso wokuQoqwa. Ulwazi lokuPhatha. Amakhono okuXoxisana. uMbuso wokuShintsha. Ulwazi lolimi kanye namandla okuphatha izinkinga.
zu.duties: Phatha kanye nokuhlola ukusetshenziswa kwe-Operations Strategy and Design. Phatha kanye nokuhlola ukuthuthukiswa kwe-Standard Operating Procedures and Business Process zomnyango. Hlela, setha, hlola kanye nokwakha izinhlelo ze-Service Delivery Improvement. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo ze-Diversity Management kumnyango. Hlola kanye nokuqoqa i-Service Delivery Model ukuze kutholwe izinto ezingcono ngokuqoqa izinsiza ezingasebenzi kahle kanye nezindawo ezingahambelani. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwe-human resource strategy and plan. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwe-Employment Equity Plans. Phatha izinsiza zenq不知不觉 (human resources, finance, assets).

xh.duties: Qwalasela ulandele imigaqo yokusebenza kwaye ulawule Iplani yokuSebenza. Qwalasela ulandele uphuculo lwe-Standard Operating Procedures kwaye ulawule iNkqubo yokuSebenza yesebe. Phuhlisa ulawulo lwenguquko nolwazi olusebenzayo kumigaqo ukuze kuqiniseke isithuba esoyikeleyo somsebenzi kubasebenzi. Qala ulawule uQwalaselo Lwebhloro. Cwangcisa, yenze, ulandele uvuselele iNkqubo zokuPhucula iNkonzo. Lawula imigaqo yesigqeba kuwo wonke umsebenzi wesebe. Qwalasela ulungelelwaniso lweNkqubo yokulawula ulwahlakunye ecaleni koluntuLwemisebenzi kwisebe. Qwalasela uphuhliso nokusetenziswa koluntuLwemisebenzi kwiplani yesebe. Lawula ukuphuhliswa nokwenzwa kweNkqubo zokuSebenza kabini nezinye iMigangatho kwisebe.

af.title: Direkteur - Tegniese Ondersteuning
af.summary: Direkteur van Tegniese Ondersteuning by die Gauteng Department of Human Settlements, wat 'n graad in siviele ingenieurswese of argitektuur en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring in infrastruktuur vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Matrieksertifikaat plus 'n Baccalaureusgraad/BTech in Siviele Ingenieurswese / Argitektuur / Argitektoniese Tegnologie / Bouaannemer / op NQF Level 7 soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op Middle/Senior Managerial-vlak in infrastruktuur-tegniese ondersteuningsdienste in die beboude omgewing en/of behuysingslewering in argitektuur/siviele ingenieurswese/bouaannemery/. Besit van 'n Pre-Entry-sertifikaat vir SMS. Besit van 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie. Die kandidaat moet diep kennis hê van die National Building Standards Act of 1977 and Regulations; PFMA/DoRA/Treasury Regulations, Practice Notes, Instructions, Circulars; Construction Industry Development Board Act of 2000 and Regulations; Project and Construction Management Act of 2000. Quantity Surveyors Profession Act of 2000. Registrasie by erkende professionele liggame in enige van bogenoemde kwalifikasies sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Bevoegdheide en vaardighede: Tegniese ontwerp en ontleding van beboude omgewing-tekeninge. Konstruksie-kwaliteitsbestuur in die behuising en/of beboude omgewing. Bevoegdheid in Green Building Standards en innovering in die beboude omgewing sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Finansiële bestuur. Strategiese en leierskapsbestuur. Veranderingsbestuur. Konflikbestuur. Goeie skriftelike en mondelingse kommunikasievaardighede. Selfgemotiveerd. Werk goed onder druk. Interpersoonlike vaardighede en vermoë om veelvuldige spanne te bestuur. Betroubaar en verantwoordelik. Positiewe houding, vermoë om op alle vlakke van bestuur te kommunikeer en veelvuldige spanne te bestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwikkeling en hersiening van die departement se norme en standaarde en verseker nakoming van die NHBRC Home Building-manual. Ontwikkel, hersien en monitor die implementering van beboude omgewing-innovasies en beste praktyke. Bestuur en verbeter die doeltreffendheid van die projek-kwaliteitsversekerings-inspektoraat se werk in ingenieurswese en argitektuur, tegniese ondersteuningsdienste in ooreenstemming met standaard bedryfsprosedures. Hou toesig oor die bestuur van die proses van finale inspeksies op huise wat gebou is om nakoming van bouregulasies, norme en standaarde en insluitend standaard bedryfsprosedures voor betaling aan kontrakteurs te verseker. Bestuur die proses van kwaliteitsinspeksies teen ontwerpe, norme en standaarde en bouregulasies. Bestuur die voorsiening van tegniese ondersteuningsdienste aan die departement. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van alternatiewe energie en monitor die implementering van energie-doeltreffendheidsinisiatiewe en identifiseer geskikte hernubare-energie-inisiatiewe vir gesubsidieerde behuising in die provinsie. Bestuur van die besigheidseenheid. Onderhoud van dissipline. Bestuur van prestasie en ontwikkeling.

zu.title: Umphathi - Ukwesekwa Ngokobuchwepheshe
zu.summary: Umphathi Wokwesekwa Ngokobuchwepheshe kuGauteng Department of Human Settlements, ofuna idiploma egcwele kubuchwepheshe bezakhiwo noma isimo sezakhiwo kanye neminyaka emihlanu yokuhlola emphakathini abaphezulu ekwakheni izinsiza.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samatikuletelo kanye ne-Bachelor’s Degree/BTech ku-Civil Engineering / Architecture /Architectural Technology /Quantity Surveyor / ezingeni le-NQF Level 7 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-5 esimenzini sobuMphathi ohlangothini lwesiqansi/obuphezulu ekwesekweni ngokobuchwepheshe kwezinsiza kwakhiwo ezakhiwe kanye noma ekuletheni izindlu ezibunjweni/ukwakhiwa kwezakhiwo/ukulinganiswa kwezinto/. Ukuba nesitifiketi se-Pre-Entry Certificate for SMS. Ukuba nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Umfunwa kufanele abe nolwazi olujulile ngo-National Building Standards Act of 1977 and Regulations; PFMA/DoRA/Treasury Regulations, Practice Notes, Instructions, Circulars; Construction Industry Development Board Act of 2000 and Regulations; Project and Construction Management Act of 2000. Quantity Surveyors Profession Act of 2000. Ukuqashelwa kwemfihlakalo kumaphuzu abanye ahlonitshiwe azedwaza konke okuthunywe kuleso sikhundla kuzongeza nqotho. Amandla kanye namakhono: Ukudizayina ngokobuchwepheshe kanye nokuhlaziya imidwebo yamaphuzu ezakhiwe. Ukuphathwa kwekhwalithi yokwakha ezindlini noma kumaphuzu ezakhiwe. Amandla emisebenzi nge-Green Building Standards kanye nokubumbuluvo emaphuzweni azakhiwe kuzongeza nqotho. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuphathwa okucabangayo kanye nokubusa. Ukuphathwa koshintsho. Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga. Amakhono okubhala nokukhuluma kahle. Ukuzikhandla. Ukusebenza kahle ngaphansi koxhuza. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu kanye namandla okuphatha ohlelo lwabantu abaningi. Othembekayo nophathekayo. Isimo soqobo nerkhono lokukhuluma emazingeni obuso obuqondene nokuphatha amaqembu amaningi.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokuhlaziwa kwemigomo kanye nezilinganiso ze-Department kwaye uqinisekise ukuvunywa koku-NHBRC Home Building manual. Ukuthuthukisa, ukuhlaziya kanye nokulalela ukusebenza kwamaphuzu amasha ukwakhiwa kwezinto ezilula ekwakhiweni kanye nezindlela ezinhle. Ukuphatha kanye nokuphucula ukusebenza kombuso wokuthuthukiswa kohlelo lokuhlolwa ngemigomo kwezimiso zobunguxhwepheshe kwaye ngoko ukuqashelwa komthetho wokusebenza kahle ohlelweni. Ukuphatha kwaye ubheke imicabango yokuhlola kwezindlu ezakhiwe ukuqinisekisa ukulandela imithethonqubo yokwakha, imigomo kanye nezilinganiso kuhlanganise imithethonqubo yamaphuzu ngenkathi kuzokwehliswa imali kulawo abakhi. Ukuphathwa kombono wokuhlola inqondokuqamba ivumelana nezomiswe, imigomo kanye nezilinganiso kwakhiwo ngemithetho. Ukuphathwa kwesibopho sokunika ukwesekwa ngobuchwepheshe e-Department. Ukuphatha ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokwamukelwa kokulinganiswa kwamandla amasha nokuhlola ukwamukelwa kwamaphuzu ayo Energy Efficiency kwaye aqhamuke amaphuzu ayo Renewable Energy afanele kwezindlu ezigcwaliswayo esifundazweni. Ukuphatha ikhaya lemsindakanya. Ukugcinwa kokuzethemba. Ukuphathwa kokuqhakambisa nokwethula.

xh.title: Umlawuli - Inkonzo eNgreji ngeTsobakalo
xh.summary: Umlawuli weNkonzo eNgreji ngeTsobakalo kwiSebe lezeNdlu zikuHlala eGauteng, elifuna isidanga kwiNzululwazi ngeZakhiwo okanye iNzululwazi ngamakhowa namashumi eminyaka emihlanu yamava aphakamileyo ebalulekileyo kulawulo kolwakhiwo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric esithe ngakunye neDegree yeBachelor/BTech kwiNzincivil Engineering / Architecture /Architectural Technology /Quantity Surveyor / kwinqanaba leNQF Level 7 njengokwamkelwa yiSAQA. Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-5 kwinqanaba lokulawula kwelinye eliphakamileyo samava kwiinkonzo zengeniso lwendalo ezenziweyo nasekunikweni izindlu kwi-architecture/civil engineering/quantity surveying/.
