Umama kufuneka abe nolwazi olujulileyo ngoMthetho weZimiso zokuWakha iZwe ka-1977 neZimiso; i-PFMA/DoRA/Izimiso zeNqela yamahlawula, Iindaba zoBuchule, Iimiyalelo, Iindaba eziyimigca; uMthetho weBhodi yoPhuhliso lweMveliso yoLwakhiwo ka-2000 neZimiso; uMthetho woLawulo loQhingwa noLwakhiwo ka-2000. uMthetho wokuSebenza koBungcali be-Quantity Surveyors ka-2000. Ukuqwalaselwa kwabantu ngamagunya amakhulu kuyo nayiphi na kwezi zimfuno inguAdvantage ekuyo. Iimpawu namaphulotshwa: Ukulunga ngokwakhiwa ngenkqubo nophando lwezolwazi ezibalwewe izandlu. Ukulawula ubunzuluzisa kwezindlu kwaye na ekubakhiweni kwendlu. Ukulunga kwamazinga eMnyama kwezakhiwa nentshinga ekubakhiweni izindlu inguAdvantage. Ukulawula iMali. Ukulawula amaQhinga nokuba nguMlawuli ohamba phambili. Ukutshintsha uLawulo. Ukulawula iNgxabano. Ulwimi ngokubhala nokuthetha oluhle. Ukuqondisa nokuzithanda. Ukusebenza kakuhle phantsi koxinzelelo. Ulwazi lokusebenza kwabathintsana nokuqwalasela iindaba ezininzi. Ukuthembeka kwaye uDedele. Isimo esilungileyo elowo ukwazi ukuvela kumagunya onke okulawula kuqwalasela iindaba ezininzi.
xh.duties: Ukulawula uPhuhliso noQqwalaselo lweZiseko neZimiso zeSebe kuqinisekisa ulandela iNqaku leNHBRC ngeZakhiwo zokuSetyenziswa eziNgamagunya. UPhuhliso, uQqwalaselo noQwalaselo lokuSetyenziswa kwezinto ezintsha neendlela ezilungileyo ekuBakhiweni iZindlu. Ulawulo nokuphucula ukusebenza koluntu oluQqwalaselwa ngeSimo seQhinga ngokusebenzisa iNkqubo eQhinga yeNgcivil neNkqubo yeNtango, iNkonzo yeNkxaso yeNqanaba ngokulandela iNqumilela ezizeZimiso. Ukujongana nokuLawulwa kwenkqubo kweZibhalo ezigqithisiweyo kweZindlu ezakiweyo ukugcina ngokulandela uMthetho wokuSela, iSiseko neZimiso nendlela ezizeZimiso phambi kwentlawulo yamaxhoba. Ukulawula inkqubo kweNdlela ezikwaZimiso ngeSiseko neZimiso. Ulawulo lweNkonzo yeNkqubo ngokwemigaqo kuluntu. Ukulawula uPhuhliso lweNkqubo yeMveliso yamandla esuntswana noQwalaselo lokuSetyenziswa kolwakhiwo ngamandla alungileyo lokuQwalasela iNdlela ezilungileyo zeMveliso yamandla eNgesuntswana zeMvuzo weNyulo yendlu kwiphondo. Ulawulo lweNdalo eNgcwele. Ukugcina iNyaniso. Ulawulo lokusebenza nokulunga.

jobs.title: Professional Construction Project Manager Grade a (X6
jobs.centre: Incremental Housing Development - West Rand Region Ref No: REFS/056653 (X2 Posts) Incremental Housing Development – Head Office Ref No: REFS/056654 (X4 Posts)
jobs.salary_text: R914 517 – R1 172 184 per annum, all-inclusive OSD package, (i.e. Salary will be determined in accordance with the applicable Occupation Specific Dispensation for Engineering Professions and Related Occupations, subject to verification of qualifications, professional registration and appropriate recognisable experience)
jobs.summary: The Department of Human Settlements seeks six Professional Construction Project Managers to coordinate construction projects across Gauteng, requiring a built environment diploma and relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Senior Certificate / National Senior Certificate; plus a minimum National Diploma / National Higher Diploma / equivalent NQF Level 6 qualification as recognised by SAQA in the Built Environment, Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Architecture or a related Built Environment field, with a minimum of four years and six months’ appropriate confirmed experience in the Built Environment / Construction Project Management environment; or BTech / equivalent NQF Level 7 qualification as recognised by SAQA in the Built Environment, Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Architecture or a related Built Environment field, with a minimum of four years’ appropriate confirmed managerial / construction project management experience; or an Honours Degree / equivalent NQF Level 8 qualification as recognised by SAQA in the Built Environment, Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Architecture or a related Built Environment field, with a minimum of three years’ appropriate experience in the Built Environment / Construction Project Management environment. Compulsory valid registration with the South African Council for the Project and Construction Management Professions ASCPCMP) as a Professional Construction Project Manager (PrCPM) Candidate registration or registration in another category will not satisfy this requirement. A valid driver’s licence. Willingness to travel and conduct site inspections. Knowledge: Knowledge of programme and project management principles and methodologies; construction project management within the built environment; human settlements/ housing delivery in the public and or private sector, internal and or bulk municipal services , infrastructure delivery, PFMA, Treasury Regulations, SCM prescripts and construction procurement; CIDB prescripts; Occupational Health and Safety National Building Regulations; construction /infrastructure contract management and standard forms of contract such as JBCC, GCC and/or NEC; project planning and scope management , cost control, quality control as per building regulations , project risk management, project financial management , project reporting up to close out and handover , technical report writing, stakeholder management and including working with multiple teams contractors , professional teams and developers, project document management. Competencies: Project planning and programme, contract management; professional judgement; technical consulting; decision-making; analytical thinking; problem-solving; planning and organising; financial management; stakeholder relations management ,customer focus and responsiveness; communication; computer literacy; conflict management; people management; change management; innovation; research and development; and ability to work with professional teams, contractors, municipalities, communities and other stakeholders.
jobs.duties: Manage and coordinate all aspects of construction projects within the human settlements / built environment portfolio. Develop project implementation plans, prepare and monitor project schedules (implementation programme0 g, site monitoring, project performance reporting evaluation in line with approved project management methodologies and infrastructure delivery prescripts/ programme Develop, execute and review project work plans, project schedules and implementation plans. Identify project resources, risks, dependencies and corrective actions. Manage day-to-day operational aspects of projects, including scope, time, cost, quality, risk, project resources and stakeholder coordination. Monitor project progress, conduct site inspections, attend project and site technical and project committee meetings, and ensure compliance with applicable legislation, policies, norms, standards and contract requirements. Project financial management, Monitor and report on project budgets, expenditure, cash flow, verifying payment certificates, manage cashflow projections, ensure compliance with PFMA and other treasury requirements and project performance. Monitor project performance, adherence to approved specifications, building requirements and norms and standards of the Department. Report project progress to the Chief Construction or equivalent and provide timely technical and management reports. Provide inputs into tender documentation, bid specifications, procurement planning, evaluation processes and contract administration, where required. Liaise and interact with service providers, contractors, professional teams, municipalities, clients, communities and management. Maintain proper project records, documentation, registers and reports. Support audit readiness and ensure that project information is complete, accurate and accessible. Undertake research and development. Keep abreast of new technologies, construction methods, project management methodologies, built environment trends and SACPCMP professional requirements. Participate in continuous professional development in accordance with SACPCMP guidelines. Provide technical guidance and mentoring to Candidate Construction Project Managers and related technical or administrative personnel, where applicable. Promote skills transfer, adherence to professional standards and sound project management practice.
jobs.applications: Please apply online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Employment Equity targets apply: preference will be given to suitably qualified African males, Indian males, Coloured males and Persons with Disabilities (PWDs). Youth candidates are encouraged to apply. Requirement of applications: No late applications will be considered. No faxed or emailed applications will be accepted. The Gauteng Department of Human Settlements promotes equal opportunity and aims to implement affirmative action measures to address the disadvantages in employment. Preference may be given to appointable applicants from the underrepresented designated groups in terms of the department’s equity plan. Candidates whose appointment will promote representativity in terms of race, disability, youth & gender will receive preference. Whites, Indians, Coloureds and Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applications should be submitted strictly online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za and it should be accompanied by a new Z83 and a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV) only. Certified copies of qualifications, Identity and valid driver’s license (where driving/travelling is an inherent requirement of the job) will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Correspondence will only be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. For all SMS positions, the successful completion of the Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government and possession of the SMS Pre-Entry Certificate is required prior to appointment. For more details on the pre-entry course visit: https://www.thensg.gov. za/training course/sms pre-entry-programme/. Following the interview and exercise, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic management competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency- based assessments). All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The competency assessment will be testing generic management and development for SMS posts. The Department reserves the right not to make appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Professionele Konstruksieprojekbestuurder Graad a (X6)
af.summary: Die Department of Human Settlements soek ses Professionele Konstruksieprojekbestuurders om konstruksieprojekte regdeur Gauteng te koördineer, waarvoor 'n diploma in die bou-omgewing en relevante ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Senior Certificate / National Senior Certificate; plus 'n minimum National Diploma / National Higher Diploma / ekwivalente NQF Level 6-kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken in die Bou-omgewing, Konstruksiebestuur, Siviele Ingenieurswese, Hoeveelheidsopmeting, Argitektuur of 'n verwante Bou-omgewingsveld, met 'n minimum van vier jaar en ses maande toepaslike bevestigde ervaring in die Bou-omgewing / Konstruksieprojekbestuursomgewing; of BTech / ekwivalente NQF Level 7-kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken in die Bou-omgewing, Konstruksiebestuur, Siviele Ingenieurswese, Hoeveelheidsopmeting, Argitektuur of 'n verwante Bou-omgewingsveld, met 'n minimum van vier jaar se toepaslike bevestigde bestuurs- / konstruksieprojekbestuurservaring; of 'n Honours Degree / ekwivalente NQF Level 8-kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken in die Bou-omgewing, Konstruksiebestuur, Siviele Ingenieurswese, Hoeveelheidsopmeting, Argitektuur of 'n verwante Bou-omgewingsveld, met 'n minimum van drie jaar se toepaslike ervaring in die Bou-omgewing / Konstruksieprojekbestuursomgewing. Verpligte geldige registrasie by die South African Council for the Project and Construction Management Professions (SACPCMP) as 'n Professionele Konstruksieprojekbestuurder (PrCPM). Kandidaatregistrasie of registrasie in 'n ander kategorie sal nie aan hierdie vereiste voldoen nie. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om te reis en terreininspeksies uit te voer. Kennis: Kennis van program- en projekbestuursbeginsels en -metodologieë; konstruksieprojekbestuur binne die bou-omgewing; menslike nedersettings / behuisinglewering in die publieke en/of privaatsektor, interne en/of buitenskap munisipale dienste, infrastruktuurlewering, PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies, SCM-voorskrifte en konstruksie-aanbesteding; CIDB-voorskrifte; Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid National Building Regulations; konstruksie / infrastruktuurkontrakbestuur en standaardvorms van kontrakte soos JBCC, GCC en/of NEC; projekbeplanning en omvangbestuur, kostebeheer, gehaltebeheer volgens bouregulasies, projekrisikobestuur, projekfinansiële bestuur, projekaverslae tot by afsluiting en oorhandiging, tegniese verslagskrywing, belanghebbendebestuur insluitend die werk met veelvuldige spanne, kontrakteurs, professionele spanne en ontwikkelaars, projekdokumentbestuur. Bevoegdhede: Projekbeplanning en program, kontrakbestuur; professionele oordeel; tegniese konsultasie; besluitneming; analitiese denke; probleemoplossing; beplanning en organisering; finansiële bestuur; belanghebbende-verhoudingsbestuur, kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë; kommunikasie; rekenaarvaardigheid; konflikbestuur; mensebestuur; veranderingsbestuur; innovasie; navorsing en ontwikkeling; en vermoë om met professionele spanne, kontrakteurs, munisipaliteite, gemeenskappe en ander belanghebbendes te werk.
af.duties: Bestuur en koördineer alle aspekte van konstruksieprojekte binne die portefeulje van menslike nedersettings / bou-omgewing. Ontwikkel projekimplementeringsplanne, berei voor en monitor projekskedules (implementeringsprogram), terreinmonitering, projekprestasieverslagdoening en evaluering in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde projekbestuurmetodologieë en infrastruktuurleweringvoorskrifte / program. Ontwikkel, voer uit en hersien projekwerksplanne, projekskedules en implementeringsplanne. Identifiseer projekhulpbronne, risiko's, afhanklikhede en korrektiewe maatreëls. Bestuur daaglikse operationele aspekte van projekte, insluitend omvang, tyd, koste, gehalte, risiko, projekhulpbronne en belanghebbendekoördinering. Monitor projekvoortgang, voer terreininspeksies uit, woon projek- en terreintegniese en projekkomiteevergaderings by, en verseer nakoming van toepaslike wetgewing, beleide, norme, standaarde en kontrakvereistes. Projekfinansiële bestuur, monitor en rapporteer oor projekaudgette, uitgawes, kontantvloei, verifieer betaalsertifikate, bestuur kontantvloeiprojeksies, verseker nakoming van PFMA en ander tesourievereistes en projekprestasie. Monitor projekprestasie, voldoening aan goedgekeurde spesifikasies, bouvereistes en norme en standaarde van die departement. Rapporteer projekvoortgang aan die Chief Construction of ekwivalent en verskaf tydige tegniese en bestuursverslae. Verskaf insette in tenderdokumentasie, biedspesifikasies, aanbestedingsbeplanning, evalueringsprosesse en kontrakadministrasie, waar vereis. Kommunikeer en interaksioneer met diensverskaffers, kontrakteurs, professionele spanne, munisipaliteite, kliënte, gemeenskappe en bestuur. Handhaaf behoorlike projekaantekeninge, dokumentasie, registers en verslae. Ondersteun ouditgereedheid en verseker dat projekinligting volledig, akkuraat en toeganklik is. Ondertneem navorsing en ontwikkeling. Bly op hoogte van nuwe tegnologieë, konstruksiemetodes, projekbestuurmetodologieë, bou-omgewingstendense en SACPCMP-professionele vereistes. Neem deel aan deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling in ooreenstemming met SACPCMP-riglyne. Verskaf tegniese leiding en mentorskap aan Kandidaatkonstruksieprojekbestuurders en verwante tegniese of administratiewe personeel, waar van toepassing. Bevordervaardigheidoordrag, voldoening aan professionele standaarde en deeglike projekbestuurspraktyk.

zu.title: Umengezeli Wezinhlela Zokwakha Ezingeni Likamunye (X6
zu.summary: Isebe Lezinsizakalo Ezingokwabantu lfunza abaphathi bezhulebo zokwakha abanyu bezenhlalo ukuba bahlole izinhlelo zokwakha kulo lonke i-Gauteng, befuna idiploma yendawo ekhiyiwe kanye nemfundo ebambekayo.
zu.requirements: Izinga le-12 / Isitifikedi Ephakeme / Isitifikedi Esiphakeme Sezwe; kanye nediploma yesizwe encane / idiploma yesizwe ephakeme / iziqu ezingana ne-NQF Level 6 njengoba zivunyiwe yi-SAQA kwindawo ekhiyiwe, ephathelene nokulawula inyundo, inzululwazi yezokwakha, ukuqhathaniswa kwezidingo, izakhiwo noma inkalo ephathelene nendawo ekhiyiwe, okungenani eminyakeni yane nenyanga ezintathu yemfundo ebambekayo eqinisekisiwe kwindawo ekhiyiwe / ekuqondweni kwezhulebo zokwakha; noma iziqu ze-BTech / iziqu ezingana ne-NQF Level 7 njengoba zivunyiwe yi-SAQA kwindawo ekhiyiwe, ekuqondeni izinhlelo, inzululwazi yezokwakha, ukuqhathaniswa kwezidingo, izakhiwo noma inkalo ephathelene nendawo ekhiyiwe, okungenani eminyakeni yane yemfundo ebambekayo eqinisekisiwe ekuqondeni / ekuqondeni izinhlelo zokwakha; noma iziqu ezingana ne-NQF Level 8 njengoba zivunyiwe yi-SAQA kwindawo ekhiyiwe, ekuqondeni izinhlelo, inzululwazi yezokwakha, ukuqhathaniswa kwezidingo, izakhiwo noma inkalo ephathelene nendawo ekhiyiwe, okungenani eminyakeni mitatu yemfundo ebambekayo kwindawo ekhiyiwe / ekuqondeni izinhlelo zokwakha. Ukubhalisa okuphoqele kweqinisekisiwe ne-South African Council for the Project and Construction Management Professions ASCPCMP) njengoba ngumengezeli wezinhlelo zokwakha (PrCPM) Ukubhalisa njengomfundi noma ukubhalisa kwelinye izinga ngeke kuzadale lesi sidingo. Ilayisensi yokushayela eqinisekisiwe. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba kanye nokwenza izivakashi zendawo yokwakha. Ulwazi: Ulwazi ngemigomo kanye nezindlela zokuqonda kwezinhlelo; ukuqonda izinhlelo zokwakha kwindawo ekhiyiwe; ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo ezingokwabantu / ezokwakha emkam, kungaba kwelomphakathi noma yangasese, izinsizakalo zasemaphakathi futhi / noma izinsizakalo ze-municipality ezingaphandle, ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo, i-PFMA, Imithetho ye Treasury, imiyalo ye-SCM kanye nokuthengisa izinhlelo zokwakha; imiyalo ye-CIDB; Izimo Eziphephile Zokusebenza Namazwe Nezokwakha; ukuqonda izinkontilaka zokwakha / ezokwakha imilolongele kanye namafomu ajwayelekile enkontilaka afana ne-JBCC, GCC kanye / noma i-NEC; ukuhlela izinhlelo kanye neqophelo lezinhlelo, ukulawula izindleko, ukulawula izinga lokuhlolwa njengoba kuchazwe emthethweni wokwakha, ukuqonda izengozi ezingenzeka ezinhlelweni, ukuqonda imali ezinhlelweni, ukubika ngokwenza izinhlelo kuze kugcine kudluliselwe, ukubhala umbiko obuchwepheshe, ukuqonda abahlanganyeli kanye nokusebenza namaqembu amaningi abaqashi, amaqembu abasebenzi ngamandla, kanye nabathuthukisi, ukuqonda imibhalo yezinhlelo. Ukukwazi: Ukuhlela izinhlelo kanye nenqubomgomo, ukuqonda izinkontilaka; isipho sokwahlulela ngamandla; ukweluleka ngezobuchwepheshe; ukwenza izinqumo; ukucabanga ngokuhlola; ukuxazulula izinkinga; ukuhlela kanye neqophelo; ukuqonda imali; ukuqonda ubudlelwano babahlanganyeli, ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokuphendula; ukuxhumana; ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; ukuqodinga izinkinga; ukuqonda abantu; ukuqoda izinguquko; ukudala okusha; ucwaningo kanye nentuthuko; kanye nenhlonipho yokusebenza namathimu abasebenzi ngamandla, abaqashi, emadolobheni, emiphakathini namanye abahlanganyeli.
zu.duties: Qondisa kanye nokuhlolela zonke izinkalo zenhlelo zokwakha ngaphakathi kwemibhalo ngezinsizakalo / kwendawo ekhiyiwe. Hlela izinhlelo zokusebenza kwamaphrojekthi, lukela kanye nokulawula isikhathi sezinhlela (uhlelo lokusebenza0 g, ukuhlola indawo yokwakha, ukubika ngemisebenza yephrojekthi ukuze uhlole ngokuhambisana nezindlela ezemukelekile zokuqonda izinhlelo kanye nemiyalo yokuqhubekela phambili kwamaphrojekthi. Hlela, phumeza futhi uhlolo izinhlela zokusebenza zamaphrojekthi, isikhathi sezinhlelo kanye nezinhlelo zokuphumeza. Qaphela izinsiza zephrojekthi, izingozi, okuncike kuzo kanye nezinyathelo zokulungisa. Lawula izinkalo zokusebenza kwansuku zonke zamaphrojekthi, okuhlanganisa neqophelo, isikhathi, izindleko, izinga, izingozi, izinsiza zephrojekthi kanye noqondise abahlanganyeli. Qaphela ukuthi iphrojekthi ihamba kanjani, yenza izivakashi zendawo yokwakha, uzakalele imihlangano yamaphrojekthi kanye nendawo yokwakha ebuya ema-committee, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kuhambisana nomthetho, imigomo, okujwayelekile, izinga kanye nezidingo zenkontilaka. Ukusebenzisa imali yephrojekthi, Qaphela futhi ubike ngemali ejejiswe kumphrojekthi, imali echithiwe, ukuhamba kwemali, ukuqinisekisa izitifikedi zokukhokha, lawula ukubikeka kwemali, qinisekise ukuthi kuhambisana ne-PFMA kanye nezinye izidingo ze-treasury kanye nemisebenza yephrojekthi. Qaphela ukuthi iphrojekthi isebenza kanjani, ukulandelwa kwezimilo ezeMukelekile nezidingo zokwakha kanye namajubulolo nezinga leSebe. Bika ngokwenza kwephrojekthi kuChief Construction noma ofana naye futhi unikeze izibiki ezingobuchwepheshe kanye nokuqondisa ngokufanele. Nikeza izinkalo ezibekiwe emagazini wenkontilaka, izimilo zokuthengisa, ukuhlela ukuthengisa, inqubo yokuhlola kanye noqondweni wenkontilaka, lapho kudingeka. Xhumana kanye nokusebenzisana nabahlinzeka ngesevisi, abaqashi, amaqembu abasebenzi ngamandla, emadolobheni, abathengi, emiphakathini nakuqondiseni. Lugela imibhalo yephrojekthi, amadokhumenti, ama-register kanye nemibiki. Sekela ukulungelelana kokuhlola futhi qinisekise ukuthi ulwazi lwebhrojekthi luphelele, lilungile futhi lutholakala kalula. Yenza ucwaningo kanye nentuthuko. Gcina ulwazi ngamakhono amasha, izindlela zokwakha, izindlela zokuqonda izinhlelo, okusha kwindawo ekhiyiwe kanye nezidingo eziphoqelelwe ze-SACPCMP. Thatha inhlavo ekuthuthukiseni amakhono emisebenzi njengoba kuhamba emigqeni ye-SACPCMP. Nikeza ngokuqondisa ngobuchwepheshe kanye nokukhuthaza abaphathi abangamafundo bezinhlelo zokwakha kanye nobucwepheshe noma abantu bokuphatha, lapho kufanele. Khuthaza ukudlulisela amakhono, ukulandelwa kwamazinga obuchwepheshe kanye nokwenza okuhle kokuqonda izinhlelo.

xh.title: Umlawuli woPhuhliso lwamaPhakathi woKwakha ongengoqaphela Banga a (X6
xh.summary: Isebe leZindlu zoLuntu lifuna abaphathi abalithoba ngesixhenxe bePhakathi loKwakha oQaqululiyo ukuze balungelelanise amaphakathi okwakha kuwo wonke amaGauteng, kufuneka kube negazidilesi yendawo eyakhwayo kunye nolwazi oluhambelana nayo.
xh.requirements: I-GRADE 12 / Isatifikethi samabakala / Isatifikethi seSizwe samabakala; kananjalo nceda kubekho iNATIONAL DIPLOMA / NATIONAL HIGHER DIPLOMA okanye isiqinisekiso esilingana neNQF LEVEL 6 njengoko kuhlukaniswa yiSAQA kwindawo eYakhiwayo, ekuLawulweni koKwakha, kuNjineli yoZoBuchwepheshe, ekuBaleni koMiseto, ezoBakeli okanye kwindawo ethile eyakhwayo, inyakeni elibhejasayo kweminyaka elithoba nethandathu yangunyaka kwaye ngenyanga yamasi altavie aqinisekisiweyo ngokukhoyo kwindawo eYakhiwayo / kumaxesha oLungeleliso yaba kukwakhwa kolwazi, okanye iBTECH / Isiqinisekiso esilingana neNQF LEVEL 7 njengoko kuhlukaniswa yiSAQA kwindawo eYakhiwayo, ekuLawulweni koKwakha, kuNjineli yoZoBuchwepheshe, ekuBaleni koMiseto, ezoBakeli okanye kwindawo ethile eyakhwayo, inyakeni elibhejasayo kweminyaka emine yangunyaka eqinisekisiweyo ekulawulweni / ekulawulweni kolwazi kumaphakathi eNjineli yaba kukwakha; okanye iHONOURS DEGREE / isiqinisekiso esilingana neNQF LEVEL 8 njengoko kuhlukaniswa yiSAQA kwindawo eYakhiwayo, ekuLawulweni koKwakha, kuNjineli yoZoBuchwepheshe, ekuBaleni koMiseto, ezoBakeli okanye kwindawo ethile eyakhwayo, inyakeni elibhejasayo kweminyaka emithathu yangunyaka isipho esifanelekileyo kwindawo eYakhiwayo / ekulawulweni kolwazi kwamaphakathi eNjineli yaba kukwakha. Kuyimfuneko ukuba ubhaliswe ngokusemthethweni kwiSOUTH AFRICAN COUNCIL FOR THE PROJECT AND CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT PROFESSIONS ASCPCMP) njengomLawuli oQaqululiyo woPhuhliso lwamaPhakathi woKwakha (PrCPM). Ukubhaliswa njengomzobi okanye ukubhaliswa kolunye uluhlu akuyonakalisi le ndawo. Idrayivha elifaneleyo nesemthethweni. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba nokwenza iinpeto zommandla. Ulwazi: Ulwazi ngemigaqo nezindlela zolawulo lolwazi kunye namaphakathi; ulawulo lolwazi lokuqhutywa kolwazi kwindawo eYakhiwayo; ukunikela ngamakhaya / izindlu kummandla kawo wonke womntu wonke okanye kumabanga abucala, iinkonzo zasemaphandleni zangaphakathi okanye ezibetha iinxa, ukunikela ngesiseko esingundoqo, i-PFMA, iZiqendu zeNqole, iinkqubo ze-SCM neendlebe zemigaqo eNjineli yolwazi, iindlela ze-CIDB; iMigaqo yeSizwe yoLungiselelo lweMiba yokwakha; ulawulo lolwazi lokuqhutywa kolwazi / isiseko nendlela ezingqinelanayo njengakwiJBCC, i-GCC kunye / okanye i-NEC; ukucwangcisa ulwazi lulungiselelo lommandla, ulawulo lwamaxabiso, ulawulo lwenkundla njengoko kuchazwe kumagunya eNjineli yolwazi lolwazi lulungiselelo lweNqanaba, ulawulo lwemiba kwamaphakathi, ukubika ngokutsha kokubhaliswa kolwazi, ukubhala ipeyimengqondiso yobuchwepheshe, ulawulo lolwazi lokuqhutywa kunye nabathathi-nxaxheba ngakumbi ukusebenza ngeqembu elininziabo bakhiwo, amaqembu eNjineli nabaphuhlisi, ulawulo loxwebhu lolwazi. Ikhono: Ukucwangcisa iProjekthi namaphakathi, ulawulo lweNqole; isigqibo sokuba yingcalwe; iingcalwe zobuchwepheshe; ukwenza isigqibo; ukucinga ngokuhlalutya; ukuxazulula iingxaki; ukucwangcisa nokuqokelela; ulawulo lwamalahle; ulawulo lobudlelwane nabathathi-nxaxheba; ukuzinikela kumthengi nokuphendula; ungeno lwazi; ukusebenza ngekhompyutha; ukulawula iingxabano; ulawulo labantu; ulawulo lolutshintsho; ukuvakalisa izimvo; uphando nophuhliso; nokuwohloka kokusebenza niiqembu ezingcali, abakhiwo, oomasipala, iindawo zoluntu ngeentshaba abo.
xh.duties: Ukulawula nokuqokelela iindawo zonke zamaphakathi akuqhutywa kolwazi kwindlu yoluntu / kwendawo ekhoyo eYakhiwayo. Ukuphehlelelisa amacebo okuphumeza iProjekthi, ulungiselelo nokulawula iinkqubo zamaphakathi (olwazi lokwenza inkqubo0 g, ukujongwa kolwazi kwamaphakathi, ukubika ngokuqhutywa kolwazi ekuqwalaselweni ngokusiba kwemigaqo eyamkelekileyo yolawulo lolwazi kwaye emthethweni weNjineli / uphuhliso loLwazi lulungiselelo Inkqubo. Phehlelelisa, phumeza ulwazi ulungeleliso lwamaphakathi, iProjekthi yiNkqubo nokuqwalaselwa kolwazi luqwalaselwe. Qaphela imithombo yamaphakathi, iingxaki, iindlela ezikhusela kwaye uqwalasele iNyathelo elimbaxa. Lawula iinkqubo ezihamba ngemini yemini zamaphakathi, kubandakanywa ulungeleliso, isixa, ixabiso, imigaqo, iingxaki, imithombo yamaphakathi nokuqokelelwa kolwazi lwabantu abathathi-nxaxheba. Qaphela inkqubo yamaphakathi, qwalasela iindawo ezakhiweyo, zibandakanye kwiiNkomfa zamaphakathi, iNkomfa yoBugcisa bamaphakathi nekomiti yeProjekthi, qinisekisa ulawulo olukumthetho oqhelekileyo, imigaqo, imilinganiselo nemigangatho kwaye ngokwemfuneko yeNqole. Ulawulo lweNqole lamaphakathi, Qaphela nokuBika ngemithetho yolwazi kumaphakathi, ekuHlabeni imali ethengwayo, iNkqubo yeMali, ukuqinisekisa isatifikethi seMali, ulawulo lokuqhutywa kwemali, qinisekisa ngokulandela i-PFMA ngenye imfuneko yendlu yamamali nokuqhutywa kolwazi. Qaphela ukwenza kolwazi, ukuzithoba ngokumila okuvunyweyo, imigaqo yokwakha nokuqinisekisa imilinganiselo nolwazi olusemthethweni noluqinisekisiweyo yaseNyakatho. Yongeza ulwazi ngokuqhutywa kolwazi kwiNqanaba yeNjineli eqondo loyilo okanye esiyingcala kwaye nike iingxelo zobugcisa nolawulo ngesixa. Yongeza izimvo kumaxwebhu owothiso, iinkqubo ezidinga isaziso, ukucwangcisa ukuthenga ukuthengisa, iinkqubo zokuqwalasela ulawulo lweNqole apho kufuneka. Thetha naye undwendwe naye abaniki besebenza, abakhiwo, amaqembu eNjineli, oomasipala, abathengi, iindawo yoluntu nolawulo. Gcina iinkqubo zamaphakathi ezingagqibekanga, amaxwebhu, iindawo ezibhalwe kunye neNqole yolwazi. Nceda usebenze nolungeleliso lokulungelelisa isiphico, ukuqinisekisa ukuba ulwazi lokuqhutywa luyigqibele, lichanekile lize lufikeleleke. Sebenzela uphando nophuhliso lwolwazi. Qhubeka ujonge iindlela ezintsha ezokwazi ngeNjineli yolwazi lolwazi, iindlela ezintsha zoLawulo lwamaphakathi, okuqhubela phambili kwindawo eyakhiweyo nokuqhutywa kolwazi, nokulingana nokufunwa yiSACPCMP ekubeni ingcalwe. Thatha inxaxheba kwisiseko sokuphumeza amakhosi esiNgcalwe ngokuchasene neenkcukacha zeSACPCMP. Nike ingcamango ngezixhobo ezingcali ezingcali kulawulo lolwazi, nezize sezobugcisa nezabasebenzi abalawulwayo, apho luyimfuneko. Khuthaza ukudluliswa kolwazi, ukuzithoba ngokwemigaqo yokuba yiNgcalwe nokuqhubela phambili ngesiseko esilungileyo sokulawula lolwazi.

Oversee the project initiation, business case development, feasibility assessment, sustainability for project funding, monitoring and evaluation and contract management, to the point of bankability. af.title: Hoof: Projekontwikkeling
af.summary: Lef infrastruktuurprojekontwikkeling by die Gauteng Infrastructure Financing Agency en hou toesig oor projekinisiëring, besigheidsgevalle en haalbaarheidsassessering.

Okungenani eminyakeni engu-5 yokuthunjwa emazingeni aphakeme kobuphathi embonini yenhlangano yomphakathi/yabumhlabakhulu ngebhalansi eqinisekisiwe ePhathweni Yephrojekthi yezakhiwo. Nikeza ubulungiswa obuhle kanye nokuhambisana kolunye uhlobo oluhle komthetho weyuniti yebhizinisi. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza.

xh.summary: Umphathi Wamaphondo Ohlelo kwiSebe lezeMfuyo noPhuhliso lwaseLokishini eCedara, oqwalasela ukuqumba, ukulandelela nokuqhuba amaphando ezolimo.

jobs.summary: Professional Scientist (Agrometeorologist) at Cedara Research Station in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring SACNASP registration and experience in agricultural risk reduction and disaster management.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 08 in Agricultural Science or BSc Honours in Agricultural Science - Agrometeorology, compulsory registration with SACNASP as a Professional Natural Scientist and a valid driver’s licence. Experience: 3 years’ post- qualification experience in Agriculture Risk Reduction and Disaster Management. Knowledge: Disaster risk reduction, agricultural risk assessment, vulnerability assessment, exposure analysis and disaster impact assessment. Climate variability and change, drought, floods, veld fires, severe weather, pests, diseases and other hazards affecting agriculture. Early warning systems, seasonal monitoring, agricultural advisory services, and preparedness planning. Agricultural research methodology, data collection, data analysis, interpretation, GIS mapping and technical reporting. Relevant legislation, policies, norms and standards applicable to disaster management, agricultural risk management, natural resource management and public administration. Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Directive on Human Resources Management and Development for Public Service Professionalisation, Public Finance Management Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act and Departmental Policies. Skills: Technical: Agricultural disaster risk assessment, climate and hazard analysis, vulnerability and impact assessment, early warning interpretation, GIS and computer-aided mapping applications, date analysis, applied research, technical report writing, scientific presentation, project planning, monitoring and evaluation. Generic: Analytical thinking, problem-solving, communication, stakeholder engagement, planning and organising, professional judgement, teamwork, customer focus, financial awareness, adaptability, ethics and accountability.
jobs.duties: Develop and implement methodologies, polices, systems and procedures. Perform scientific analysis and regulatory functions. Conduct research and development. Human capital development. Perform administrative and professional duties.

zu.title: Isayensi Yobuchwepheshe Izinga A/B/C: - Isayensi Yezulu Yezolimo –
zu.summary: Isayensi Yobuchwepheshe (Isayensi Yezulu Yezolimo) eCedara Research Station eKwaZulu-Natal, edinga ukubhaliswa kwi-SACNASP nokuthwaba kokubhaliswa nemisebenzi yokunciphisa ingozi ezolimeni nokuqondiswa kwezinsipho.
zu.requirements: I-NQF level 08 kusayensi yezolimo noma i-BSc Honours kusayensi yezolimo - Isayensi Yezulu Yezolimo, ukubhaliswa okuphoqelekile kwi-SACNASP njengesayensi yemvelo yobuchwepheshe nedrayiveli elisebenzayo. Okuthwabayokuthwaba: 3 years okuthwaba kokusebenza emva kokuthola iziqu ekunciphiseni ingozi ezolimeni nokuqondisa i-insipho. Ulwazi: Ukunciphiswa kwengozi yezinsipho, ukuhlukaniswa kwengozi ezolimeni, ukuhlukaniswa kokungavikeleki, ukuhlazwa kokuntuleka kanye nokuhlukaniswa kokuthwaba kwezinsipho. Ukushintshashintsha kwezulu nokuqonda, isomiso, amafolodi, izimlilo veld, isimo sezulu esinzima, izinambuzane, izifo kanye nezinye izingozi ezithinta ezolimo. Izinhlelo zokuxwaya kusenesikhathi, ukubheka izikhathi zonyaka, imisebenzi yeseluleko yezolimo, kanye nokuhlela ukulungiselela. Indlela yokucwaninga ezolimeni, ukuqoqa imininingwane, ukuhlaziya imininingwane, ukuhumusha, ukumepha i-GIS nokubika ngokobuchwepheshe. Umthetho ohlobene, izinqubo, izimiso kanye nezindinganiso ezisebenza ekubeni ngqo yezinsipho, ekuphathweni kwengozi ezolimeni, ekuphathweni kwezinto zemvelo nakuphathweni kawonke wonke. I-Public Service Act, I-Public Service Regulations, I-Directive on Human Resources Management and Development for Public Service Professionalisation, I-Public Finance Management Act, I-Occupational Health and Safety Act kanye nezinqubo zeMnyango. Amakhono: Ngokobuchwepheshe: Ukuhlukaniswa kwengozi yezinsipho ezolimeni, ukuhlaziya isimo sezulu nengozi, ukuhlukaniswa kokungavikeleki nokuqonda, ukuhumusha ukuxwaya kusenesikhathi, izinhlelo zokucomoza i-GIS nakhompyutha, ukuhlaziya imininingwane, ucwaningo olusebenzayo, ukubika ngokobuchwepheshe, ukubonakalisa isayensi, ukuhlela iphrojekthi, ukubuka kanye nokuqhathanisa. Jikelele: Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuthumela imilayezo, ukuxhumana nabalalelebe, ukuhlela nokuqamba, ukwahlulela ngobuchwepheshe, ukusebenza njengeqembu, ukugxila kumthengi, ukuzwa ngemali, ukuzivumelanisa, izimilo nokubhekana nezialo.
zu.duties: Thutha futhi usebenzise izindlela, izinqubo, izinhlelo kanye nemithetho yokuqhuba. Yenza ukuhlaziya ngokusayensi kanye nemisebenzi yokulawula. Yenza ucwaningo nokuqhuba. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kwemithwalo yabantu. Yenza imisebenzi yokuphatha nangobuchwepheshe.

xh.title: Isayensi yegaba elungileyo ngesidanga A/B/C: - Agrometeorologist –
xh.summary: I-Professional Scientist (Agrometeorologist) kwisebe lophando iCedara Research Station eKwaZulu-Natal, efuna ukubhalisa kwiSACNASP nolwazi ekunciphiseni ingozi ezolimo nakulawulo iingozi.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seNQF 08 kwisiSayensi zeZolimo okanye iBSc Honours kwisiSayensi zeZolimo - iAgrometeorology, ukubhalisa ngokuyimfuno ngeSACNASP njengomVulandlela weNzululwazi wezinto zendalo nelayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi: unyaka we-3 wamava emva kokuzaliseiswa kwemfuno ekunciphiseni Ingozi eZolimo nakulawulo lweengozi. Ulwazi: ukunciphisa ingozi yengozi, ukuhlola ingozi ezolimo, ukuhlola ubutyhafi, uhlalutyo lokuqondiswa kwingozi nokuhlola nomphumo weengozi. Ukuhlukahluka nokutshintsha kwemozulu, isomiso, imimoya manzi, iindlela zomlilo zasendle, imozulu embi, izinsect ezonakalisa, iirhulumente nezinye iingozi ezichaphazela izolimo. Iindlela zokuqwembelela kwixesha ngaphambili ngengozi, ukuqwalasela ngokuhamba kwamaxesha, iinkonzo zokweluleka ezolimo, nokucinga ngokulungiselela. Iindlela zophando lwezolimo, ukuqokelela iingcombolo, uhlalutyo lwegama, ingcaciso, ukuzoba i-GIS nokubhalwa kweengxelo zobuchwepheshe. Umthetho oqhagamshelwayo, iinkqubo, iindatshu namazinga oqobo agqithiselwe kulawulo lweengozi, ulawulo lwengozi ezolimo, ulawulo lwamathuba endalo nolawulo lolawulo lwentlalo. Umthetho Wesebe Lomphakathi, Iimigaqo Yesebe Lomphakathi, Umthetho Wokuqondisa Ngolawulo Nokuphuhliswa Kwamathambo Abantu Kulesi Sebe Ukuba Ngochwepheshe Womphakathi, Umthetho WoLawulo LweMali Yomphakathi, Umthetho WokuQonda nokuGcina ukuZe Kunye Namaza Osebenza, namacandelo eNkqubo Zesebe. Amandla: Obuchwepheshe: ukuhlola ingozi yengozi ezolimo, uhlalutyo lwemozulu nengozi, ukuhlola ubutyhafi nomphumo, ingcaciso yokumakwa kwexesha elihamba ngaphambili iingozi, ukuzoba nge-GIS nakwizicelo zekhompyutha ezuncedayo, uhlalutyo lwemihla, uphando olusetyenziswayo, ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe, ipezenteyshini yezayensi, ukuqwalasela iprojekthi, ukuqwalasela nokuqwalasela ukusebenza kwento. Ngokubanzi: Ukucinga ngokuhlalutya, ukusombulula iingxaki, unxibelelwano, ukubandakanya abantu basebenza nabo, ukuqwalasela nokuqwalasela, ukwahlulela ngobuchwepheshe, ukusebenza njengesiqhelo, ukukhathalela abathengi, ukuziphendulela ngemali, ukuziqhelanisa nezimo, amabali amnandi nokuqwalasela.
xh.duties: Phuhlisa yakusebenzisa iindlela, iinkqubo, iindlela zokusebenza nokuqhuba. Yenza uhlalutyo lwesayensi nemisebenzi yolawulo. Yenza uphando nokuphuhlisa. Ukuphuhliswa kwamathambo abantu. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo nobuchwepheshe.

Diensleweringsinnovasie, kennibestuur, probleemoplossing en -analise, kommunikasie, kliëntoriëntasie en klantefokus hê.

Verseker doeltreffende menslike hulpbronbestuur in ooreenstemming met riglyne en voorskrifte van die departement van gesondheid. Hou toesig oor die voorsiening van gehalte- en veilige pasiëntsorg by klinieke en die Gemeenskapsgesondheidsentrum. Verseker doeltreffende stelselbestuur ter ondersteuning van kliniese dienste d.w.s. (Wassery, vervoer, instandhouding, Gronde, Sekuriteit, Skoonmaak en Skakelbord).

Ukuzisebenzisa iindlela zocwangco lweemali, ukulandelela nokulawula iindleko. Ukwakha kwaye kuqalise amacebo namagqabantshathi ukuze kuqaliswe ukusebenza okubandakanya iinkqubo zezeMela. Ukuphuhliswa kwaye kuqaliswe ucwangco lweenkqubo zezeMela zeziKolo eziNcedisa. Ukulawula ukubonelelwa kweenkonzo zezeMela ngaphakathi kweziKolo eziNcedisa kunye neziKliniki zayo. Ukunika ingqondo elawulayo igunya lokunxiba amathuba kubasebenzi ukuze bakhuthazwe kwaye sikhuthazwe umsebenzi wokuqhelana. Ukulawula ngokusebenzayo ulawulo lweemisebenzi yabantu ngokulandela iindlela namagqabantshathi esebhu loNyango. Ukuvakalisa iinkqubo zoBuntu bomsebenzi ezilungileyo ngaphakathi kweziKolo eziNcedisa kunye neziKliniki zayo. Ukulawula ngokusebenzayo izinto eziphakathi nangaphandle kwaseKolo (izithinteli). Ukuzisebenzisa ngokusebenzayo amagqabantshathi olwazi lwezeMela oqinisekileyo kuquka ukuphuhliswa kolungelelwaniso nokugcina iKliniki ekuyiyona. Ukulawula ukubonelelwa ngenkonzo elungileyo nokuNakekela igazi kwiKliniki naseKolo eziNcedisa. Ukuqinisekisa ukulawula iindlela ezisebenzayo ezixela iinkonzo zezeMela oko kukuthi (okuHlamba impahla, ukuHamba, ukugcina, iNdlela zokuQhweba, ukuQinisekisa, ukuCoca kunye noQhagamshelwano).

jobs.title: Medical Specialist: Paediatric Pulmonology
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 395 528 per annum, all-inclusive salary package, (excluding commuted overtime). Grade 2: R1 592 274 per annum, all-inclusive salary package, (excluding commuted overtime). Grade 3: R1 844 151 per annum, all-inclusive salary package, (excluding commuted overtime).
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Paediatric Pulmonology needed at IALCH to manage paediatric pulmonary and intensive care duties including bronchoscopy and lung function testing.
jobs.requirements: MB; ChB; Current registration as a Specialist in Paediatrics with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Additional Qualification Registration in the Sub-specialist of Paediatric pulmonology Experience: Grade 1 No Experience required. Grade 2: 5 Years appropriate experience as a Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist (Paediatrics). Grade 3: 10 Years appropriate experience as a Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist (Paediatrics). Knowledge, Skills, training and Competencies required: Broad knowledge of working in general Paediatrics and Ethics. Good communication and supervisory skills. Appropriate specialist assessment, diagnosis and management of patients. Familiarity with procedures and management protocols within the subspecialty of Paediatric pulmonology. Working with multi-disciplinary teams. Supervision and teaching of Undergraduates and post-graduates. Behavioural attributes: Stress tolerance. Ability to work within a team. Self-confidence. Capacity to build and maintain relationships.
jobs.duties: Undertake ward rounds in the paediatric pulmonology, high care unit and intensive care unit. Bronchoscopy, lung function testing analysis, evaluation of advanced pulmonology investigations, skills related to insertion of invasive monitoring devices and treatment in critically ill children. Consultation for referrals of children with acute and chronic respiratory disorders. Perform after hours calls in the pulmonology and paediatric ICU/HCU. Training of fellows in subspecialty training. Teaching of undergraduate medical students. Training post graduate students (registrars/medical officer) in child health. Expected to undertake outreach at tertiary/regional hospitals. Community engagement. Involved in clinical governance and quality improvement plan.
jobs.applications: All applications must be addressed to the Human Resources Manager, and should be placed in the application box situated at Security at the entrance to the Management Building at IALCH or to applications@ialch.co.za
jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. An Application for Employment Form (Current Z83) must be completed and forwarded. This is obtainable from any Public Service Department or from the website www.kznhealth.gov.za. af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Pediatrise Pulmonologie word by IALCH benodig om pediatriese pulmonale- en intensiewe sorgpligte te bestuur, insluitend bronchoskopie en longfunksietoetsing.
af.requirements: MB; ChB; Huidige registrasie as 'n Spesialis in Pediatrie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Bykomende kwalifikasieregistrasie in die subspesialiteit Pediatrise pulmonologie. Ervaring: Grade 1 Geen ervaring vereis. Grade 2: 5 Jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis (Pediatrie). Grade 3: 10 Jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis (Pediatrie). Vereiste kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede: Breë kennis van werk in algemene Pediatrie en Etiek. Goeie kommunikasie en toesighoudende vaardighede. Toepaslike spesialisassessering, diagnose en bestuur van pasiënte. Behoorlike kennis van prosedures en bestuursprotokolle binne die subspesialiteit Pediatrise pulmonologie. Werk in multidissiplinêre spanne. Toesig en onderrig van voor- en nagraadse studente. Gedragskenmerke: Strestoleransie. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk. Selfvertroue. Vermoë om verhoudings te bou en te handhaaf.
af.duties: Onderneem saalronde in die pediatrise pulmonologie, hoësorgeenheid en intensiewesorgeenheid. Bronchoskopie, analise van longfunksietoetsing, evaluering van gevorderde pulmonologie-ondersoeke, vaardighede wat verband hou met die plaas van indringende moniteringstoestelle en behandeling van kritieke siek kinders. Raadpleging vir verwysings van kinders met akute en chroniese respiratoriese afwykings. Doen buite-ure oproepe in die pulmonologie en pediatrise ICU/HCU. Opleiding van genote in subspesialiteitsopleiding. Onderrig van voorgraadse mediese studente. Opleiding van nagraadse studente (registrateurs/mediese beamptes) in kindergesondheid. Verwag om bystand te verleen by tersiêre/regionale hospitale. Gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid. Betrokke by kliniese bestuur en gehalteverbeteringsplan.

zu.title: Iziqu Ezikhethekile Esezomtholampilo: I-Paediatric Pulmonology

Ukubuyekeza okufanele kwabachwepheshe, ukuxilonga kanye nokuphathwa kwabagulayo. Ukuqonda izinqubo nemiqathango yokuphatha ngaphakathi kwesigaba esikhethekile se-Paediatric pulmonology. Ukusebenza namateamu ahlukene. Ukuphathwa nokufundisa abafundi abangenazo futhi abaneminyaka yemfundo ephezulu. Izimpawu zokuziphatha: Ukubekezela ngaphansi koxinzelelo. Ikhono lokusebenza aphakathi kwebhola. Ukuzethemba. Ikhono lokwakha kanye nokuqhuba izinhlobonhlobo zokuxhumana.
zu.duties: Ukwenza ukuphamba phakathi kweziguli kwi-paediatric pulmonology, i-high care unit kanye ne-intensive care unit. I-bronchoscopy, ukuhlola kanye nokuhlaziya imiphumela yokusebenza kwamaphaphu, ukubuyekeza iziphonso eziphushumayele zokuhlola isifuba, amakhono ahlobene nokufaka izinto ezingangenisa umzimba eziyokweluleka kanye nokwelapha izingane ezikrwele kakhulu. Ukubonisana ngesinkinobho sabantwana abanesifo esibuhlungu noma esihlale isikhathi eside samaphaphu. Ukwenza amakholi emva kwezinsuku kwi-pulmonology kanye ne-paediatric ICU/HCU. Ukuqeqeshwa kwabafundi phakathi kwesigaba esikhethekile. Ukufundisa abafundi bezemfundo ezingeni elingaphansi kwezoqobo. Ukuqeqeshwa kwabafundi abaneminyaka yemfundo ephezulu (abarejista / ofisa wezomtholampilo) ezempiloni yentingane. Kulindelekile ukwenza i-outreach ezibhedlela ezingunaphakade noma ezifundeni. Ukuxhumana nomphakathi. Ukuba ngaphakathi kolawulo lwekliniki kanye neplani yokuthuthukisa izinga.

UkuYiva iNdingo yakuNcedo lwamaza azele kwiPulmonology nasecandelo lokunakekelwa okuzinze kwi-Paediatric ICU/HCU. UkuQeqeshwa kwamaza azele esiCandeni sePulmonology. Ukufundisa abafundi beZiqu ezingekasibhalwa kumizi yamagqirha. UkuQeqeswa kwamaza afikelela kwamaza azele kwiZiqu eziphakamileyo kwiNkcukacha yokuQaphela abantwana abakhulu basa. xh.title: Isexhibe sezonzulwathi: I-Nephrology
xh.summary: Kufunekiwe isexhibe sezonzulwathi kwinqabamntu ye-nephrology kwisebe le-IALCH nakwindawo yase-Durban, kufunekise ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesebenziwo sezonzulwathi ixhoba lempilo, ngemivuzo eqala ukusuka kwi-R1.4m ukuya kwi-R1.8m ngonyaka.

Ukuba nobunkosi obuhle ekubungenisa, ekulawuleni iindaba, ekuthatheni iigqibo, nakunxibelelwano. Ulwazi ngolawulo lwe-clinical governance, nokuphuculwa kwesidwedwe, nezinkqubo zokuhlahleba iinkqubo zoclinical. Ulwazi ekuphenyweni koclinical nasezikhundleni zekhondo. Ukusondelela kwizigibo zokuziphatha ngokwendalo nokuziphatha ngekhondo.

Ukuhlinzeka ngezinkonzo ezibambeleyo zangaphakathi nangaphandle kwezempilo kwi-Nephrology. Ukulawula iinkonzo ze: nephrology jikelele, inkqubo yenhlahlunzima ngesiqwenga-mzimba i-peritoneal dialysis, iinkonzo ze-haemodialysis acute nephrology, nasekuhambeni kwesikhathi, iinkonzo zangaphandle ze-kidney transplant, Ukubamba iqhaza ekulawulweni kwezinkonzo ze-haemodialysis kwi: Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital (IALCH), DFR. Ukwenza nentshukumo yamakhono e-procedural aquka: ukutumba izintso ezingabhalanga nalawo ezihlukiweyo i-haemodialysis vascular access procedures, ukufakwa kwe-percutaneous Tenckhoff catheter. Ukuqeqesha nokuxhasa oogqirha abasengozini, abongikazi, nogoqirha abancedisayo bokhathalelo lwezempilo. Ukubamba iqhaza kwezindwendwe zolawulo, i-clinical governance, nentshukumo yamakhondo. Ukuzibandakanya ngokusukuba ngaphandle kwentshukumo kwi-Nephrology departments kunye neqela lophandlo. Ukubamba iqhaza kwiinkqubo zokuhlahleba i-clinical governance, ukuphucula isidwedwe, noko ayimicimbi yokuphuhliswa kwezinkonzo. Ukufaka isandla ekuphuculeni abafundi nangaphaya kwesidwedwe kwinkqubo yamakhondo ase-Nelson R Mandela School of Medicine, aquka: ukufundisa abafundi, ukuqeqesha oogqirha abancedisayo, ukuhlolwa kwabafundi nangaphaya kwesidwedwe Ukubamba iqhaza ngemiyalelo yasebusuku, nangaphandle kweyure ezimiselweyo, kwinkqubo yokubizwa ngokomgxweme ngokwemfuno yesebe.

jobs.requirements: Senior certificate/ Grade 12. Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner. Appropriate tertiary qualification in the Health Science (MBChB) an appropriate qualification that allows registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Obstetrics & Gynaecology. Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in O&G. Current HPCSA registration 2026/2027. Grade 1: No experience required. Registrars who have completed their training may also apply on condition that their appointment will be subjected to them submitting documentary evidence of registration with the HPCSA. Grade 2: In addition to the requirements for a Grade 1 specialist post, a minimum of five (05) years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in O&G is required for appointment as a grade 2 specialist. Grade 3: In addition to the requirements for a Grade 1 specialist post, a minimum of ten (10) years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in O&G is required for appointment as a grade 3 specialist. Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competencies Required: - Sound knowledge and experience in O&G. knowledge of current health and public service legislation, regulations and policies including medical ethics, epidemiology and statistics. Good communication, leadership, decision-making and clinical skills. Ability to teach junior doctors and participate in continuing professional development. Sound knowledge of clinical procedures and protocols within the discipline. assessment and management of patients.
jobs.duties: Strengthen and deliver Neonatal clinical services in the department of Obstetrics &Gynaecology at Newcastle Regional Hospital. Assist with the O&G services coordination between levels of care. Assist in quality improvement activities including clinical audit, data management, monitoring and evaluation and regular reporting on key indicators related to O&G burden of disease. Actively participate in the academic under-end post-graduate O&G training program (including clinic teaching). Perform and supervise O&G operational research activities in the Speciality Department. Perform overtime as required in the Speciality Department. Participate in the academic and teaching programme and meetings in the O&G department. Participate in the multi- disciplinary team discussions in the unit. Responsibility for care of patients in the out-patient and in-patient setting. Provide outreach to PCH’s, CHC’s and District Hospitals. ENQURIES : Dr. JJN Duze – Senior Manager: Medical Services Tel No: (034) 328 0000
jobs.applications: All applications should be posted to: The Recruitment Officer, Newcastle Regional Hospital, Private Bag X6653, Newcastle, 2940 OR can be done on S’thesha Waya-Waya website. Applications: can also be emailed to Thembalami.Zwane@kznhealth.gov.za

af.title: Mediese Spesialis
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Verloskunde en Ginekologie gesoek vir Newcastle Regional Hospital om neonatale kliniese dienste te lewer en O&G-sorg oor vlakke te koördineer.
af.requirements: Senior certificate/ Grade 12. Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Toepaslike tersiêre kwalifikasie in die Gesondheidswetenskap (MBChB) 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Verloskunde & Ginekologie toelaat. Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in O&G. Huidige HPCSA-registrasie 2026/2027. Graad 1: Geen ervaring vereis. Registrars wat hul opleiding voltooi het, kan ook aansoek doen op voorwaarde dat hul aanstelling onderhewig sal wees aan die voorlegging van dokumentêre bewys van registrasie by die HPCSA. Graad 2: Benewens die vereistes vir 'n Graad 1 spesialispos, word 'n minimum van vyf (05) jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in O&G vereis vir aanstelling as 'n graad 2 spesialis. Graad 3: Benewens die vereistes vir 'n Graad 1 spesialispos, word 'n minimum van tien (10) jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in O&G vereis vir aanstelling as 'n graad 3 spesialis. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding En Bevoegdhede Vereis: - Deeglike kennis en ervaring in O&G. Kennis van huidige gesondheids- en openbare dienswetgewing, regulasies en beleide insluitend mediese etiek, epidemiologie en statistiek. Goeie kommunikasie-, leierskaps-, besluitnemings- en kliniese vaardighede. Vermoë om junior dokters te onderrig en aan te neem in voortgesette professionele ontwikkeling. Deeglike kennis van kliniese prosedures en protokolle binne die dissipline. Assessering en bestuur van pasiënte.
af.duties: Versterk en lewer Neonatale kliniese dienste in die departement Verloskunde &Ginekologie by Newcastle Regional Hospital. Bystand verleen met die koördinering van O&G-dienste tussen vlakke van sorg. Bystand verleen in kwaliteitsverbeteringsaktiwiteite insluitend kliniese oudit, databestuur, monitering en evaluering en gereelde verslagdoening oor sleutel-aanwysers rakende O&G-siekteboerd. Neem aktief deel aan die akademiese voor- en nagraadse O&G-opleidingsprogram (insluitend kliniese onderrig). Voer en hou toesig oor O&G-operationele navorsingsaktiwiteite in die Spesialiteitsdepartement. Doen oortyd soos vereis in die Spesialiteitsdepartement. Neem deel aan die akademiese en onderrigprogram en vergaderings in die O&G-departement. Neem deel aan multidissiplinêre teambesprekings in die eenheid. Verantwoordelikheid vir sorg van pasiënte in die buitepasiënt- en binnepasiëntopset. Verskaf uitreik na PCH's, CHC's en Distrikshospitale. Navrae: Dr. JJN Duze – Seniorbestuurder: Mediese Dienste Tel No: (034) 328 0000

zu.title: Uchunjathatha Wezokwelapha
zu.summary: Kufunwa uchunjathatha wezokwelapha kwi-Obstetrics and Gynaecology eNewcastle Regional Hospital ukuze atholele izinsizakalo zokwelapha kwezokubeletha nabasakhula noxhaxhe lumise inakekelwa kwe-O&G kulo lonke izinga.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi senkosi/ Ibanga 12. Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengodokotela wezokwelapha. Isiqu esifanele semfundo ephakeme kwezEmpilo (MBChB) nesiqu esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengochunjathatha wezokwelapha ku-Obstetrics & Gynaecology. Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengochunjathatha wezokwelapha kwe-O&G. Ukubhalisa kwamanje kwe-HPCSA 2026/2027. Ibaqi 1: Akukho mkhuleko ofakiwe odingekayo. Owayengabhalisiwe ekufundeleni iziqu bangakwazi futhi ukuthumela izicelo zabo ngaphansi kwezimo ukuthi ukwamkelwa kwabo kuzobe kusekwe ekushonweni kwebizo elibuyekeza ukubhalisa kwabo kwi-HPCSA. Ibaqi 2: Kwesinye isidingo sebaqi 1 sophando lweziqu, kudingeka unyakenzi omncani ngaphansi kokubhalisa kwe-HPCSA njengochunjathatha wezokwelapha kwe-O&G ukuze ukwamukele ukuba yibaqi 2 weziqu. Ibaqi 3: Kwesinye isidingo sebaqi 1 sophando lweziqu, kudingeka unyakenzi omkhulu ngaphansi kokubhalisa kwe-HPCSA njengochunjathatha wezokwelapha kwe-O&G ukuze ukwamukele ukuba yibaqi 3 weziqu. Ulwazi, Amakhono, ukuqeqeswa Namakhono a-Ofunekayo: - Ulwazi olunjalo nomkhuleko kwe-O&G. ULwazi ngomthetho wamanca wezempilo kanye nomthetho wemisebenzi yomphakathi, imithetho kanye nenqubo ehlongakade ngokulawula nokuziphatha kwezokwelapha, isayensi yokulwelana nezibalo. Amakhono okuxhumana okuhle, ukuba ngumholi, ukwenza izinqumo kanye namakhono ezokwelapha. Isikhono sokufundisa odokotela abasha kanye nokuthatha inxaxheba ekuthuthukiseni ngokulawula ngamandla emisebenzi yawo wonke umuntu. ULwazi oluqotho ngenqubo nezinhlobo zemisebenzi ezokwelapha ngaphakathi kwesibangqwana. Ukukalwa kanye nolawulo lwabagulayo.
zu.duties: Ukugcina kanye nokuletha izinsizakalo zokwelapha kwezokubeletha nabasakhula emnyangweni we-Obstetrics & Gynaecology eNewcastle Regional Hospital. Ukusiza ekuxhumuxhumaneni izinsizakazo kwe-O&G phakathi kwalezizinga zokwelapha. Ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni izinga lemininingwano ehlongakade ngomkhakha wokwelapha, ukuphathwa kwenani lemininingwano, ukuqapha kanye nokuhlolwa kanye nokubika njalo ngamabalengwe abalulekile ohlotsheni lwesifo le-O&G. Ukubamathatha inxaxheba ekuqeqeshweni kweziqu ezingaphansi kanye nabaphothule iziqu ze-O&G (kuhlanganise nokuqeqesha esikhungweni sezokwelapha). Ukwenza kanye nokuhlola imisebenzi yocwaningolwazi kwe-O&G esibangqwaneni semikhakha eqeqeshwayo. Ukwenza amahora amaningi njengoba kudingeka esibangqwaneni semikhakha eqeqeshwayo. Ukubamathatha inxaxheba ohlelweni lokufunda nokufundisa kanye nasemihlanganweni emnyangweni we-O&G. Ukubamathatha inxaxheba emihlanganweni yeqembu elihlukene emkhakheni. Ithemba lokunakekelwa kwabagulayo kuleyodwa kwezinsizakazo ezingangaphandle kanye nalabo abasengozini. Ukunikeza insiza yokweseka kuma-PCH, ama-CHC nasemapitala oMmandla. IMIBUZO : Dr. JJN Duze – Umphathi Omkhulu: Izinsizakulo Zokwelapha Ucingo: (034) 328 0000

xh.title: Igcwele kwezamokhula
xh.summary: Kufunwa igcwele kwezamokhula kwi-Obstetrics and Gynaecology kwizibhedlele i-Newcastle Regional Hospital ukunika iinkonzo zokwelapha kwezabantu basemzimba futhi ulawule inkonzo ye-O&G kuzo zonke iinqanaba.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga aphakamileyo/ Grade 12. Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengogqirha. Isifundo esifanelekileyo samaziko emfundo ephakamileyo kwi-Health Science (MBChB) nesifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha oyiNgcwele kwi-Obstetrics & Gynaecology. Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha oyiNgcwele kwi-O&G. Ukubhalisa kwangoku kwi-HPCSA 2026/2027. Inqanaba 1: Akukho nalunye ulwazi olufunekayo. Abarhistrada abagqibilele imfundo yabo banako nakube bafaka isicelo ngaphantsi kwezemigaqo yokuba ukwabo kuya kuxhomekeka ekuzeni ubungqina bekwamaxwebhu bokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA. Inqanaba 2: Ngaphezu kweemfuno zesithuba segcwele lesinqanaba 1, kufuneka kube nokosizi olungu- (05) iminyaka emisiweyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha oyiNgcwele kwi-O&G ukuba kubekho isikhundla njengesigcwele sesinqanaba 2. Inqanaba 3: Ngaphezu kweemfuno zesithuba segcwele lesinqanaba 1, kufuneka kube nokosizi olungu- (10) iminyaka emisiweyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha oyiNgcwele kwi-O&G ukuba kubekho isikhundla njengesigcwele sesinqanaba 3. Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho nemisebenzi efunekayo: - Ulwazi olulula olunamava ngokuthi wazi nangokusebenza kwangaphambili kwi-O&G. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yamagazethi, iimviso neenkqubo zokuqamba ngokwemfundo yomphakathi, urhwebo neyamagazethi ekuphela kwezobugqirha, amaxwebhu obomi kunye noqeqesho ngokubanzi. Ulwazi ngokugqithisa, amandla okuziphatha, ukuze ukwazi ukuba unako nakube woyike ukudlula amandla abanye, ukulawula nokuthatha iigqibo ezifanelekileyo ezibhalwe ngaphantsi namandla okukwazi ukusebenza ngokusuka kumngeni ophantsi. Ukuba nakho ukufundisa oogqirha abangazange bafe ezinkqubo zokusimama ngomsebenzi, isikhundla nokusetyenziswa kwamandla ngaphantsi komthetho wezempilo othe htla kwaye kusetyenziswa iinkqubo namacebo obomi njengesiseko. Ulwazi olulula ngokusuka kubomi, amandla, isakhono kunye nokusebenza okusuka kumaphupha okuqonda ukuya kwamaphupha alawulwayo wezempilo ekuqalweni, umsebenzi ekwangaphakathi kwamaphupha, ulwazi olutsha ngokusuka kubomi, ukungagqibi ukubakho kwezinto ezinzileyo ngokusuka kumsebenzi wakho nokuba wazi imigaqo nezicwangciso.
xh.duties: Ukwandisa nokubonelela ngeenkonzo zokwelapha kwezamantyathanga abasemzimba kwisebe le-Obstetrics & Gynaecology kwizibhedlele i-Newcastle Regional Hospital. Ukunceda ngokulawula iinkonzo ze-O&G phakathi kwee-Nqanaba ezahlukeneyo zokhathalo. Ukunceda kumisebenzi yokuphucula umgangatho kuquka ukuhlolwa kwezobugqirha, ukulawula idatha, ukuqwalasela nokulinganisa nokuvela ngokuchanekileyo kumaxwebhu abalulekileyo ahambelana nobunzima be-O&G. Ukubamba iqhaza kwinkqubo yokufundisa i-O&G yasemva kwesidanga (ukubandakanya ukufundisa kwiklinikhi). Ukwenza nokulawula imisebenzi yokuphanda ngokusebenza kwe-O&G kwisebe leziNgcwele. Ukwenza umsebenzi wexesha elongeziweyo njengoko kufunekayo kwisebe leziNgcwele. Ukubamba iqhaza kwinkqubo yokufundisa nasekuqeqesheni kunye nemibingelelo kwisebe le-O&G. Ukubamba iqhaza kwiingxoxo zeqela elihlangene ngokusuka kumisebenzi ngokusuka kwamaphupha ahlukeneyo. Ukuzimisela ngokhathalo lwamagundi kwindawo yokuphumla nakwindawo yokuhlala kwisibhedlele. Ukubonelela ngokubakho kweeklinikhazi kwesiNtaba kunye neziBhedlele zeSithili.

jobs.salary_text: R1 101 468 per annum (Level 12), (an all-inclusive MMS salary package of salary)
jobs.summary: Chief Executive Officer positions at six KwaZulu-Natal hospitals, requiring a health degree, professional registration and five years of management experience.
jobs.requirements: A Degree/Advanced Diploma in a health related field, registration with relevant professional council; Plus, A degree/diploma in health management OR a Degree/Advanced Diploma in a Management field. Plus, At least 5 (five) years management experience in the health sector. Experience as a health service manager or significant experience in management in a health service environment. Unendorsed valid Code B driver’s license (Code 08). Operational Manager and Clinical Programme Co-ordinator with five (5) years’ experience as Operational Manager and Clinical Programme Co-ordinator respectively may apply. NB: All shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of work experience endorsed and stamped by the employer/s prior to the date of the interview. Competencies: Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competencies Required: Competencies: Knowledge: Knowledge of relevant legislation such as National Health Act, Public Finance Management Act (PMFA), Public Service Act and related regulations and policies. Core Competencies: Strategic capability and leadership, programme and project management, financial management, change management, people management and empowerment. Progress Competencies: Service delivery innovation, knowledge management, problem solving and analysis, communication, client orientation and customer focus.
jobs.duties: Job Purpose: To plan, direct co-ordinate and manage the efficient and delivery of clinical and administrative support services through working with the key executive management team at the hospital within the legal and regulatory framework, to represent the hospital authoritatively at provincial and public forums, to provide strategic leadership to improve operational efficiency within the health establishment to improve health outcomes. Strategic Planning: Prepare a strategic plan for the Hospital to ensure that it is in line with the 10- point plan, national, provincial, regional and district plans. Financial Management: Maximise revenue through collection of all income due to the Hospital, ensure that adequate policies, systems and procedure are in place to enable prudent management of financial resources, planning of financial resource mobilisation, monitoring and evaluation, asset and risk management. Facility Management: Ensure business support and systems to promote optimal management of the institution as well as optimal service delivery, ensure that systems and procedures are in place to ensure planning and timeous maintenance of facilities and equipment. Human Resource Management: Develop, implement and maintain human resource management policies and guidelines, systems and procedures that will ensure effective and efficient utilisation of human resources, promote a safe and healthy working environment through compliance with relevant legislation including occupation health and safety committees. Ensure continuous development and training of personnel and implement monitoring and evaluation of performance. Procurement and Management of Equipment and Supplies: Implement a procurement and provisioning system that is fair, transparent, competitive and cost effective in terms of provincial delegated authority and in line with the PFMA, ensure that goods and services are procured in a cost effective timely manner. Clinical and Corporate Governance: Oversee clinical governance to ensure high standards of patient care, establish community networks and report to the Hospital. Responsible for corporate governance inclusive of infrastructure planning and maintenance as well as occupational health and safety, manage the institution’s risk to ensure optimal achievement of health outcomes. Implement good governance, transparency, and accountability practices. Drive the hospital and its catchment clinics towards achieving and sustaining a clean audit. Responsible for providing strategic leadership and overall management of all health services within the hospital and its catchment area, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, equitable, and patient-centred care across the facility and associated clinics, while driving compliance, efficiency, and continuous improvement. Effectively manage and optimise all resources under your stewardship, including physical, and technological assets, to ensure efficiency, accountability, and maximum impact on service delivery. Drive and implement innovative strategies that advance progress towards Universal Health Coverage (UHC) in alignment with the National Health Insurance (NHI) framework. Build and maintain strong relationships with community structures, oversight bodies, NGOs, and other health sector partners. Participate in Operation Sukuma Sakhe (OSS) and other intersectoral collaborations. Ensure hospital and catchment clinics on readiness for audits, inspections, and quality assurance assessments. Promote a positive organisational culture.
