af.title: Hoofuitvoerende beampte: Verskeie Sentrums
af.summary: Hoofuitvoerende beampte-posisies by ses KwaZulu-Natal-hospitale, wat 'n gesondheidsgraad, professionele registrasie en vyf jaar se bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Graad/Vorderde Diploma in 'n gesondheidsverwante veld, registrasie by die relevante professionele raad; Plus, 'n graad/diploma in gesondheidsbestuur OF 'n Graad/Vorderde Diploma in 'n Bestuursveld. Plus, Ten minste 5 (vyf) jaar se bestuurservaring in die gesondheidssektor. Ervaring as 'n gesondheidsdiensbestuurder of noemenswaardige ervaring in bestuur in 'n gesondheidsdiensomgewing. Ongesindepte geldige Code B-bestuurslisensie (Code 08). Operasionele Bestuurder en Kliniese Programkoördineerder met vyf (5) jaar se ervaring as Operasionele Bestuurder en Kliniese Programkoördineerder onderskeidelik mag aansoek doen. NB: Alle kortelyskandidate sal verplig wees om bewys van werkservaring, onderskryf en gestempel deur die werkgewer(s), voor die datum van die onderhoud voor te lê. Bevoegdhede: Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding En Vereiste Bevoegdhede: Bevoegdhede: Kennis: Kennis van relevante wetgewing soos die National Health Act, Public Finance Management Act (PMFA), Public Service Act en verwante regulasies en beleide. Kernbevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, program- en projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur, verandering bestuur, mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Vorderingsbevoegdhede: Dienslewering innovasie, kennisbestuur, probleemoplossing en analise, kommunikasie, kliënt oriëntasie en kliëntfokus.
af.duties: Werksdoelwit: Om die doeltreffende beplanning, aanstuur, koördinering en bestuur van kliniese en administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste deur samenwerking met die sleutel-uitvoerende bestuurspan by die hospitaal binne die regs- en regulatoriese raamwerk te behartig, om die hospitaal gesaghebbend by provinsiale en openbare forums te verteenwoordig, om strategiese leierskap te bied om operasionele doeltreffendheid binne die gesondheidsinstelling te verbeter ten einde gesondheidsuitkomste te verbeter. Strategiese Beplanning: Berei 'n strategiese plan vir die Hospitaal voor om te verseker dat dit in ooreenstemming is met die 10-punt plan, nasionale, provinsiale, streeks- en distrikspresent. Finansiële Bestuur: Maksimeer inkomste deur die invordering van alle inkomste wat aan die Hospitaal verskuldig is, verseker dat voldoende beleide, stelsels en prosedures in plek is om versigtige bestuur van finansiële hulpbronne moontlik te maak, beplanning van finansiële hulpbronmobilisering, monitering en evaluering, bate- en risikobestuur. Fasiliteitsbestuur: Verseker besigheidsondersteuning en stelsels om optimale bestuur van die instelling asook optimale dienslewering te bevorder, verseker dat stelsels en prosedures in plek is om beplanning en tydige onderhoud van fasiliteite en toerusting te verseker. Menslike Hulpbronbestuur: Ontwikkel, implementeer en handhaaf beleide en riglyne vir menslike hulpbronbestuur, stelsels en prosedures wat effektiewe en doeltreffende benutting van menslike hulpbronne sal verseker, bevorder 'n veilige en gesonde werkomgewing deur nakoming van relevante wetgewing insluitend beroepsgezondheids- en veiligheidskomitees. Verseker deurlopende ontwikkeling en opleiding van personeel en implementeer monitering en evaluering van prestasie. Aankope en Bestuur van Toerusting en Voorrade: Implementeer 'n aanbiedings- en voorsieningstelsel wat billik, deursigtig, mededingend en kostedoeltreffend is in terme van provinsiale gedelegeerde gesag en in ooreenstemming met die PFMA, verseker dat goedere en dienste op 'n kostedoeltreffende en tydige wyse verkry word. Kliniese en Korporatiewe Goewernance: Hou toesig oor kliniese goewernance om hoë standaarde van pasiëntsorg te verseker, vestig gemeenskapsnetwerke en rapporteer aan die Hospitaal. Verantwoordelik vir korporatiewe goewernance insluitend infrastruktuurbeplanning en -onderhoud asook beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid, bestuur die instelling se risiko om optimale bereiking van gesondheidsuitkomste te verseker. Implementeer goeie goewernance, deursigtigheid en verantwoordingspraktyke. Dryf die hospitaal en sy opvangsklinieke na die bereiking en handhawing van 'n skoon oudit. Verantwoordelik vir die bied van strategiese leierskap en algehele bestuur van alle gesondheidsdienste binne die hospitaal en sy opvangsgebied, wat die levering van hoë gehalte, regverdige en pasiëntgesentreerde sorg oor die fasiliteit en geassosieerde klinieke verseker, terwyl nakoming, doeltreffendheid en deurlopende verbetering gedryf word. Bestuur en optimaliseer alle hulpbronne onder u beheer doeltreffend, insluitend fisiese en tegnologiese bates, om doeltreffendheid, verantwoording en maksimale impak op dienslewering te verseker. Dryf en implementeer innoverende strategieë wat vordering na Universal Health Coverage (UHC) in ooreenstemming met die National Health Insurance (NHI) raamwerk bevorder. Bou en handhaaf sterk verhoudings met gemeenskapsstrukture, toesigliggame, NGO's en ander gesondheidssektorvennote. Neem deel aan Operation Sukuma Sakhe (OSS) en ander intersektorale samewerkings. Verseker dat die hospitaal en opvangsklinieke gereed is vir oudite, inspeksies en gehalteversekeringsassesseringe. Bevorder 'n positiewe organisatoriese kultuur.

zu.title: I-Executive Officer Ephambili: Amasikhungo Ahlukahlukene
zu.summary: Izikhundla ze-Executive Officer ephambili kulesi sikhashana samasibhedlela ayisithupha e-KwaZulu-Natal, esidinga idigri empilweni, ukubhalwa ngemqondo kubalandeli bonsimu kanye neminyaka emihlanu yomkhankaso walawulo.
zu.requirements: Idigri noma i-Advanced Diploma enkundleni ephathelene nezempilo, ukubhalwa kubalandeli bonsimu abahlobene; Futhi, idigri noma idiploma ekuphathweni kwezempilo noma idigri noma i-Advanced Diploma enkundleni yolawulo. Futhi, okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 (nhlanu) yomkhankaso wolawulo emsebenzini wezempilo. Umkhankaso njengomphathi wezinsiza eziphilayo noma umkhankaso omkhulu ekuphathweni kwemikhankaso yezinsiza eziphilayo. Ilayisense lesikhwebi esivunyiwe sekhodi B (Khodhi 08) okungagcwaliswa amagama. I-Operational Manager kanye no-Coordinator Wezinhlelo Zokwelapha abaneminyaka eyi-5 (hlanu) yomkhankaso njengo-Operational Manager kanye no-Coordinator Wezinhlelo Zokwelapha ngokulandzelana bangase faka isicelo. QAPHELA: Bonke abaqeqeshiwe abakwi-listi emfushane bazodinga ukuthumela isibonakaliso somkhankaso wokusebenza esigcinwe kwaye sifakwe isitembu ngumqashi/ngabamqashi ngaphambi kosuku lokuxoxisana. Amakhono: Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqesha Kanye Namakhono Adingekayo: Amakhono: Ulwazi: Ulwazi ngemithetho ephathelene nalokho efana ne-National Health Act, i-Public Finance Management Act (PMFA), i-Public Service Act kanye nemithetho kanye nezinqumela ezihlobene nayo. Amakhono Obulele: Ikhono elibonakalayo ukubusakwakhono nesikhokelo, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo kanye nezinhlela, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuphathwa koshintsho, ukuphathwa kwabantu kanye nokunika amandla. Amakhono Okuqhubeka: Innovation ekulethweni kwezinsiza, ukuphathwa kolwazi, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqoqa, ukuxhumana, ukuqondiswa kumthengi kanye nokugqamisa umthengi.
zu.duties: Inhloso Yomsebenzi: Cwaba ukwenza uhlelo, qondisa ubeke uhlelo uphathe ngenkinobho yokulethwa ngempumelelo kwezinsiza zokwelapha kanye nezinsiza zokweseka ezokuphathwa kusetshenziswa ukusebenza neqembu eliphambili lokuphathwa kwe-executive kulesi sibhedlela ngaphakathi kwezezomthetho kanye nezimiso zokulawula, ukumela lesi sibhedlela ngamandla emithetho emhlanganweni wesifundazwe kanye nomphakathi, ukunika isikhokelo esinamandla sokuphucula ukusebenza kahle kwezokusebenza ngaphakathi kwaso isikhungo sezempilo ukuze kuphuculwe imiphumela yezempilo. Ukucwaba Uhlelo Ngobuchule: Hlela uhlelo lobuchule lesi Sibhedlela ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi luhambisana nohlelo lwamaphoyinti ayi-10, amahlelo omphakathi, wesifundazwe, wesifunda nakomasipala. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali: Yandisa inzuzo ngokuqoqa yonke imali efanayo lesi Sibhedlela, qinisekisa ukuthi kunemithetho ehlelekile, izimiso nezinqumela ezenza ukuthi kwenzeke ukuphathwa ngokujabula kwezinsiza zezimali, ukuhlela ukuhlanganiswa kwezinsiza zezimali, ukubuka nokuhlolwa kanye nokuphathwa kwamasheya nezingozi. Ukuphathwa Kwesikhungo: Qinisekisa ukwesekwa kwebhizinisi kanye nezimiso ezenza ukuphathwa okuhle kwesikhungo kanye nokulethwa kwezinsiza ngokugqamile, qinisekisa ukuthi izimiso nezinqumela zikhona ukuze kuqiniseke ukuhlela kanye nokuqashwa ngesikhathi esifanele kwesikhungo nagesisetshenziswa. Ukuphathwa Kwezinsiza Zabantu: Hlola, khombisa futhi gcina imithetho kanye nezinkomba zokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu, izimiso nezinqumela eziyoqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa ngempumelelo nangokuhle kwezinsiza zabantu, wkhusula umkhakha wezokuphila nokuphila kahle emsebenzini ngokuqondana nomthetho ohlukene okubandakanya amakomidi ezempilo nokuphepha emsebenzini. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa ngokuqhubeka nokwelaphwa kwabantu futhi ufake ukuqoqwa kanye nokuqoqwa kokusebenza. Ukuthenga Nokuphathwa Kwesisetshenziswa Kokuqedwa Imisebenzi: Ukukhipha isimiso sokuthenga nokulethwa okungakhethi, sibonakalile, sikhuliswa ngesibalo nangokuhle kwezimali ngokwamandla anikezwe yisifundazwe nangokuhambisana ne-PFMA, qinisekisa ukuthi impahla kanye nezinsiza zithengwa ngenani elihle ngosuku. Ukuphathwa Kwamakhono Esekela Ikhaya Kwaye Esihle: Buza ngokuphathwa kolwazi ngokuhle ukulwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuphila kwamakhono onke, hlela imithetho yokuxhumana nomphakathi kwaye uze uthinte isibhedlela. Hlala ulungele ukukhululeka kwezomthetho ezibandakanya ukuhlela nokugcina izinkomba ngokulawula imisebenzi kwaye uphephe umsebenzi oyingozi, ulawule ukuba yingozi kwesisetshenziswa ukuze kufikelelwe ngokuphumelelayo ezigqweni zemiphumela yezempilo. Ukusebenzisa izinkomba zokulawula, ukubonakala, kwaye ukuziphendula. Qhuba isibhedlela nakamasu waso otholwa ngokuba ngesikhathi esihle sokuhlolwa. Phatha ngokuphumelela ukulawula nangokuphumelela yonke imisebenzi yezempilo ngaphakathi kwesibhedlela nasemzimbeni waso wonke, ukuqinisekisa ukulethwa kokulunyadwa okuhle, okulinganayo, nokujwayela isiguli ngokuphela kwesisetshenziswa nasemasu ahlobene, lapho ukhulisa ukulalela, isibalo nangokuphucula ngokuphumelelayo. Yenza ukuthi kusetshenziswe ngokuphumelela kwaye ngokuphumelela zonke izinsiza onazo, okubandakanya izimpahla zomzimba, kwaye ezobuchwepheshe, ukuze kuqiniseke isibalo, ukuziphendula, kwaye kuthuthukiswe ngokugqamile. Qhuba kwaye ufake amasu okuphumelela okungenela kokuqhubela phambili ekufikeni nokugcina ulwazi olukhulu mayelana nekhulu elizodlula wonke uhlelo lokwelashwa mayelana nokuqinisekiswa kwezomthetho nangokuhle kwezomphakathi.

xh.title: Sikhulu esiNtloko seNtshona: Iindawo ezahlukeneyo
xh.summary: Izithuba zikabaphathi abaphezulu ezibhedlele ezintandathu ze-KwaZulu-Natal, zifuna isidanga seqondo ezempilo, ukubhalisa ngokuchanekileyo kwabaphathi abaqondiswe kwelawulo lezempilo kunye neminyaka eliwaka umlinganiselo yamava kwilawulo lempilo.
xh.requirements: Degree/Advanced Diploma kwicala lezo empilo, ukubhalisa kwikomkhulu lemigaqo yesimo sabuchule; Kananjalo, Degree/Diploma kwilawulo lezempilo OKanye Degree/Advanced Diploma kwicala leLawulo. Kananjalo, ubuncinane i-5 (intlanu) iminyaka yamava kwelawulo kwicala lezempilo. Amava njengomphathi wezekomkhulu ezempilo okanye amava amakhulu kwelawulo kwinkqubo yezempilo. Ifayidhi yokutyhala esemthethweni evuziyo ekhomityiweyo ekhawulweyo ukuyigcina (ikhodi B) (Ikhodi 08). Abaphathi besebenzo kunye nalabo balawula iinkqubo zomsebenzi wezempilo abaneminyaka emi-5 (intlanu) bamava njengabaphathi besebenzo kunye no-balathi beenkqubo zomsebenzi wezempilo ngokulandelelana ngakunye banako ukungenisa izicelo. QAPH велик: Onke abagqabiweyo baya kufuneka bangenise isiqinisekiso sembalo ngomhla wokugqiba kwemisebenzi eqinisekisiweyo nokuqinisekiswa nguqobo ngumsebenzi wabo phambi kwomhla wegesiba lokuvavanya. Iimpawu zokuqonda: Ulwazi, Amandla, Uqeqesho nokuqonda okufunekayo: Iimpawu zokuqonda: Ulwazi: Ulwazi ngemithetho elandelayo njengoko kubekwe kwisiGqeba sikaZwelonke seMithetho yezo empilo, i-Ayili yokuLawula imali yaHlabathi (PMFA), isiGqeba seMithetho sikaRhulumente kunye nemithetho elongezelelekayo nengamacebo. Iimpawu eziyintloko zokuqonda: Ikhono lokubonelela ngolwazi ngokutshintshiselwa kwembonisano nokulatha iqela, ukulatha iinkqubo zokwenza imisebenzi nokwenza imisebenzi ngokuchanekileyo, ukulawula imali, ukulawula kutshintsho, ukulawula abantu nokubanika amandla. Iimpawu zokuqonda ezisezantsi: Ukwenza imisebenzi ngokutsha, ukulawula ulwazi, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuzihlola, ukunxibelelwana, ukujolisa kumthengi kunye nokuqwalasela umthengi.
xh.duties: Injongo yomsebenzi: Ukucwangcisa, ukulatha, ukulinganisa nokulawula ukusebenza ngokusemthethweni nokuhanjiswa kolunye nolwabo lweenkalo zemisebenzi yamazinga ebalulekileyo kunye nemisebenzi yolawulo ngokusebenzisa iqela elibalulekileyo labaphathi abaphezulu esibhedlele ngaphakathi kwendlela ezisezantsi kwemigaqo nemithetho ekhoyo, ukumela isibhedlele ngamagunya eprovinsi nakwiindaba ezibalulekileko zikawonke-wonke, ukunikela iqondo eliphezulu lobuqhawe ukuphucula ukusebenza kakuhle kwindalo yokugcinwa kwempilo ukuze kuphukeke imiphumo yezempilo. Ukucwangciswa ngokutshintshiselano kwembonisano yokulingana nemfuno: Ukulungiselela icebo lokuzimisela kwesibhedlele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba lidibana neplani ye-10-point plan, iindawo ezizilwayo ngokwesizwe, esiphaladle, ngasemantla nakummandla weqondo elinganiselweyo kunye neendawo ezingaqondiswa ngokweziganeko. Ulawulo lwemali: Ukuphucula ukuzuza imali ngokufumana onke amaxhala afanelwe isibhedlele, ukuqinisekisa ukuba zikhona iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo, iindlela zokuqamba izinto ezikwindawo yokulawula ukuba kunganyangeki imali nemithombo yayo, ukucwangciswa kokubambisa imali, ukulawulwa nokulinganiswa kokusebenza kwento ekhoyo nokusingathwa kwengozi. Ulawulo lweziko: Ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kolunye nolwabo kunye neendlela ezibhalwe ngokutshintshiselwa kwembonisano yokulingana nemfuno kwindawo yokulawula ngokulinganiselelweyo ukusebenza kakuhle kokusingathwa koluntu, ukuqinisekisa ukuba zikhona iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuqamba izinto ezikwindawo yokulawula ukuba kunganyangeki imali nemithombo yayo. Ulawulo lwabasebenzi: Ukulungiselela, ukuphumeza nokugcina iinkqubo kunye neengcebiso zolawulo lwemisebenzi yabantu, ukunyanzelisa ukusebenza ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezikwindawo yokulawula ukuba kunganyangeki imali nemithombo yayo, ukulawulwa nokusingathwa kwengozi. Ukulawula imithesho yemisebenzi yamathafa nokugcina imali yamathafa: Ukuphumeza inkqubo yokulawula nokugcina imithesho yemisebenzi yamathafa engangenwa, ethanda ukuba ibonakalise ngokucaceleyo, enomgangatho ophezulu kunye nengingqiyo ngokweemeko ezikhoyo nakummandla wezinyani ekuthiwa zikhona. Ukulawula imithesho yemisebenzi yamathafa nokugcina imali yamathafa: Ukuphumeza inkqubo yokulawula nokugcina imithesho yemisebenzi yamathafa engangenwa, ethanda ukuba ibonakalise ngokucaceleyo, enomgangatho ophezulu kunye nengingqiyo ngokweemeko ezikhoyo nakummandla wezinyani ekuthiwa zikhona.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Facilities Management
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 – R1 098 195 per annum (Level 11), all-inclusive salary package
jobs.summary: Deputy Director overseeing facilities management at Newcastle Regional Hospital, coordinating cleaning, portering, linen, transport and security services.
jobs.requirements: Matric / Senior certificate Plus, Degree / National Diploma in Public Management / Public Administration / Health Service Management. 3 years managerial experience at Assistant Director level in the Facilities Management. A valid drivers’ License. Computer Literacy. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies required: Knowledge of Public Service Act, Labour Relations Act, Public Service Regulations, National Health Act, Skills Development Act, Employment Equity Act. People management, financial management, Planning and organizing. Time management. Leadership, Organizational, decision making and problem-solving abilities. Financial and budgetary knowledge. Human Resource Management and Communication skills. Self-discipline and ability to work under pressure with minimum supervision. Independent, Patience, Commitment, Trustworthiness, Honesty, Accountability, Commitment to excellence, Continuous learning, Amenable to change, Cultural awareness and Project Management.
jobs.duties: Ensure effective co-ordination, management and quality of work all the functional components of the systems department within the Hospital i.e. Cleaning, Portering, Linen management, Mortuary, Transport, Messengers, Registry, Food Service, accommodation, Safety & Security, IT and Patient Administration. Ensure the effective, efficient and economical utilisation of resources allocated to the institution including the development of staff. Manage Contracts of all out-sourced services provided by private companies to ensure compliance with service level agreement. Ensure that risk management, safety programs and Ideal Hospital Norms and Standards requirements are adhered to by all staff. Ensure the effective, efficient and economical management of allocated resources of the Division. Ensure that staff wear proper PPE and Uniform in line with KZN Health Uniform code. Develop policies and strategies aimed at improving service delivery. Perform regular walk abouts in the institution. Present reports at management meetings about the state of the institution. Ensure the effective, efficient and economical management of allocated resources of the Division. Ensure utilities and critical systems reliability with zero downtime for life support systems e.g generators, medical, gases, HVAC, water and sewer boilers. Ensure delivery of services within budget, PFMA, Treasury Regulations and improve efficiency. Compile leave plan and update leave registers. Implement performance management and development system for staff support clinical services to deliver patient care. Ensure adherence to health, safety standards and safe environment for patients, staff and visitors. Actively support the implementation of revenue enhancement strategy. Provide facilities leadership to support planning, implementation and maintenance of infrastructure in line with operational requirements. Liaise with internal and external stakeholders. Enforce disciplinary code and procedure. Ensure compliance to quality standards.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs. T.T. Vilakazi – Chief Executive Officer Tel No: (034) 328 0000
jobs.applications: All applications can be submitted through hand delivery /courier to: The HR Recruitment Office or emailed to: Thembalami.Zwane@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : The Recruitment Officer

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Fasiliteitebestuur
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur wat toesig hou oor fasiliteitebestuur by Newcastle Regional Hospital, en skoonmaak, porterdienste, linne, vervoer en sekuriteitsdienste koördineer.
af.requirements: Matric / Senior certificate Plus, Degree / National Diploma in Public Management / Public Administration / Health Service Management. 3 years managerial experience at Assistant Director level in the Facilities Management. A valid drivers’ License. Computer Literacy. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies required: Knowledge of Public Service Act, Labour Relations Act, Public Service Regulations, National Health Act, Skills Development Act, Employment Equity Act. People management, financial management, Planning and organizing. Time management. Leadership, Organizational, decision making and problem-solving abilities. Financial and budgetary knowledge. Human Resource Management and Communication skills. Self-discipline and ability to work under pressure with minimum supervision. Independent, Patience, Commitment, Trustworthiness, Honesty, Accountability, Commitment to excellence, Continuous learning, Amenable to change, Cultural awareness and Project Management.
af.duties: Verse doeltreffende koördinering, bestuur en gehalte van werk van alle funksionele komponente van die stelsels departement binne die Hospitaal d.w.s. Skoonmaak, Porterdienste, Linnabestuur, Lykhuis, Vervoer, Boodskappers, Register, Voedseldiens, Akkommodasie, Veiligheid en Sekuriteit, IT en Pasientadministrasie. Verse die doeltreffende, effektiewe en ekonomiese benutting van hulpbronne aan die instelling toegeken, insluitend die ontwikkeling van personeel. Bestuur kontrakte van alle uitbesteede dienste wat deur private maatskappye verskaf word om te verse dat aan diensvlakooreenkoms voldoen word. Verse dat risikobestuur, veiligheidsprogramme en Ideal Hospital Norms and Standards vereistes deur alle personeel nagekom word. Verse die doeltreffende, effektiewe en ekonomiese bestuur van toegekende hulpbronne van die Divisie. Verse dat personeel toepaslike PPE en uniforms dra in ooreenstemming met die KZN Health Uniform kode. Ontwikkel beleide en strategieë wat daarop gemik is om dienslewering te verbeter. Voer gereelde staptoere in die instelling uit. Lewer verslae by bestuursvergaderings oor die toestand van die instelling. Verse die doeltreffende, effektiewe en ekonomiese bestuur van toegekende hulpbronne van die Divisie. Verse betroubaarheid van nutsdienste en kritieke stelsels met nul stilstandtyd vir lewensondersteunende stelsels bv. generators, mediese gasse, HVAC, water en riool-ketels. Verse lewer van dienste binne begroting, PFMA, Treasury Regulations en verbeter doeltreffendheid. Stel verlofplan op en dateer verlofregisters op. Implementeer prestasiebestuur en ontwikkelingstelsel vir personeel ondersteun kliniese dienste om pasientsorg te lewer. Verse nakoming van gesondheids- en veiligheidsstandaarde en 'n veilige omgewing vir pasiente, personeel en besoekers. Ondersteun aktief die implementering van inkomsteverbeteringstrategie. Verskaf fasiliteite-leierskap om beplanning, implementering en instandhouding van infrastruktuur te ondersteun in ooreenstemming met operasionele vereistes. Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Handhaaf dissiplinêre kode en prosedure. Verse voldoening aan gehaltestandaarde.

zu.title: Isikhundla sikaSekela Mqondisi: Ukuphathwa Kwemisebenzi
zu.summary: Sekela Mqondisi ohlolwa ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi e-Newcastle Regional Hospital, ehlanganisa izinsizakalo zokuhlanzwa, okokubathatha, amagugu, ezokuthutha kanye nokuvikeleka.
zu.requirements: Matric / Senior certificate Plus, Degree / National Diploma in Public Management / Public Administration / Health Service Management. Unyaka we-3 wokuhlangabezela njengomenzi ohola esikhundleni sikaSekela Mqondisi kwi-Facilities Management. Ilayisense evumelekile yokushayela. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi, amakhono nempilo efunekayo: Ulwazi nge-Public Service Act, Labour Relations Act, Public Service Regulations, National Health Act, Skills Development Act, Employment Equity Act. Ukuphathwa kwabantu, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukuphathwa kwesikhathi. Abambe iqhaza, ukuzoba iqhaza, ukwenza izinqumo nethonyana lokuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi lwemali nembali. Ukuphathwa kweHuman Resource kanye namakhono okuxhumana. Ukuzethembela nokukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwegxugu okuncane ngokuhlakanipha. Zipethe, Ukubekezela, Ukuzinikela, Ukuthembeka, Uqobo, Ukubophela, Ukuzinikela ekuhle, Ukufunda ngokuphelele, Ukuvumelana nokushintsha, Ukuqonda izinkululo kanye nokuphathwa kwePhrojekthi.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuhleleka okusebenzayo, ukuphathwa nenhlelo yomsebenzi kuyo yonke ingxenye yemisebenzi esikhundleni sezinsizakalo ezisebentweni ngaphakathi kwe-Hospital okuyilowo nalowo, ukwesula, ukuhlinza, ukuphathwa kwamagugu, iMortuary, ezokuthutha, abathumela imilayezo, ukuhlelwa kwemibhalo, ukukhonza ukudla, izindlu, ukuvala nokuvikela, IT kanye nokuphathwa kwesiguli. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo, okuguquguqukayo nenzuzo okuyilowo nalowo imithombo ekiwe phansi kule ndawo okuhlanganisa ukuba khona kwabantu. Phatha izivumelwano zazo zonke izinsizakalo eziyisipesheli ezenziwa izinkampani ngasese ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela isivumelwano sokuqinisekiswa kokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuphathwa kwezingozi, izinhlelo zokuvikeleka kanye nezidingo zamaNomu neZinqumo eZinhle ze-Hospital zithotywe bonke abasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo, okuguquguqukayo nenzuzo kwezinsizakalo ezahlinzekwe kulesi sigaba. Qinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bagqoka izimpahla zokuvikela ezifanele nokugqoka izimfanela njengoba kushiwo uhlelo lokugqoka kokunyakaza ko-KZN Health. Hlola izinqobo noma amapholisi nokuqondisa ukuze kwenziwe izinsizakalo ngcono. Yenza ukuhamba njalo esikhundleni. Yethula imibiko emihlanganweni yokuphathwa mayelana nesimo sendawo. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo, okuguquguqukayo nenzuzo kwemithombo ebanjwayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi kusebenza kahle izinsizakalo nezinhlelwe kanti akukho sikhathi lapho kungekho konke khona ezinhlelweni zokunikela impilo njengakumshini wokukhiqiza umbane, wezokwelapha, amagesi, i-HVAC, amanzi kanye namadobi. Qinisekisa ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo ngaphakathi kwesabelo, i-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations nokukhuthaza ukusebenza kahle. Hlela icebo lokuphumula ukuze kuhlaziywe izibhalo zokuphumula. Faka esebenzisa uhlelo lokuphathwa nokuqashwa kwabasebenzi ukuze kusekele izinsizakalo zokwelapha ukunika iziguli ukunakekelwa. Qinisekisa ukuthobela izimo, izimo zokuvikeleka nendawo ekhululekile kuziguli, abasebenzi nabavakashi. Sekele ngokusebenzayo ukuphunyuka kwenkambiso yokukhulisa imali. Hlinzeka ngegunya elikhokha ukuze kusekele ukuhlela, ukusebenzisa nokugcina imiyalo ngokuhambisana nezidingo zokusebenza. Xhumana namagugu angaphakathi nangaphandle. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nomthethosisekelo wezothando nezindlela zokuwenzayo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela izinga lekhwalithi.

Ulawulo lwabantu, ulawulo lweemali, ucwangco loluhlelo. Ulawulo lwexesha. Amandla okukhokela, olwanda lweqela, okuthatha izigqibo nokusombulula iingxaki. Ulwazi ngeemali namajelo ezimali. Ulawulo lweZemidlalo yabasebenzi namakhono onxibelelwano. Izinzo nokwazi ukusebenza ngxamiseko ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nangaphandle kolawulo oluncinci. Okuzimeleyo, Ukunyamezela, Uzinzo, Ukuthembeka, Uqotho, Ukuxelwa iingxaki, Uzinzo ekufeni ngokupheleleyo, Ukufunda ngokungapheli, Ukuvuma utshintsho, Ukuqonda iindalo ezahlukeneyo noLawulo loPhando.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ulungelelwaniso olusebenzayo, ulawulo nangangobuphi na ubuncinane bemisebenzi kuzo zonke iindlela ezisebenzayo zesebe lenkqubo esibhedlele ibi ngokucwangcisiweyo, ukuthwala abantu, ulawulo lwezitya, iindonga ezibeka abafi, izithuthi, abathunywa, indawo yokugcina amafa, inkonzo yokutya, indawo yokuhlala, Ukhuseleko noQiniseko, i-IT noLawulo lweGazi loMntu. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokusebenzayo, ngokuchanekileyo nangokugcinwa kwemali yamandla onikezelo kwisebe ngokubandakanya ukuphucula abasebenzi. Lawula iinkonzo ezithunyelwe kwamanye amakompany akhutshwe ngaphandle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthobela isivumelwano ngenqanaba lenkonzo. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa kweengozi, iinkqubo zokhuseleko neemfuno zeNgcwangca eLungileyo neSigqibo seZibhedlele ezithobwayo ngamasebenzi onke. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa ngokusebenzayo, ngokuchanekileyo nangokugcinwa kwemali kwamandla onikezwe kuQela. Qinisekisa ukuba abasebenzi bagqoka i-PPE efanelekileyo neNqanaba lemivundo ngokuvumelana neKZN Health Uniform code. Phuhliza iinkqubo namacebiso ahlose ukuphucula ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Yenza ukuhamba njalo kwisikhululo ekuqwalaselweni. Misa iingxelo kwintlanganiso yolawulo ngolwazi lwendalo yesikhululo. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa ngokusebenzayo, ngokuchanekileyo nangokugcinwa kwemali kwamandla onikezwe kuQela. Qinisekisa ukuzinza kwamandla okusebenza amva kakhulu nangaphandle kwethutyana lokungasebenzi kwizixhobo zokuxhasa ubomi umzekelo izigqijana, iimonya yezamokhanya okanye umoya ohlukanisayo ozaliswa kumazantsi, i-HVAC, amanzi kunye neesulungelo ezingqinelwe nangaphezulu. Qinisekisa ukulethwa kwezonkonzo ngaphakathi kwesixa semali, i-PFMA, iTreasury Regulations nokuphucula ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo. Hlela isicwangciso senkcubeko yabasebenzi uze uhlaziye iifesiledi zenkcubeko. Yila inkqubo yolawulo lokwenza kwaye uphuhlize isixhobo sabasebenzi sixhase iinkonzo zokunyanga ukunika abantu inkcubeko. Qinisekisa ukuthobela iimigangatho yempilo yomntu nokhuseleko nendawo ekhuselekileyo kumagula, abantu abakhangele kunye nangabakhangeleli bolwazi. Xhasa ngokuzimisela ukuphunyezwa kwenkqubo yokwandisa inkonzo. Nikela ngamandla okukhokela ulawulo ukuze uxhase ucwangciso, ukuphunyezwa nokulondolozwa kwendalo eya kumfuneko wolawulo. Thintana nabantu abangaphakathi nangaphandle abanomdla. Qinisekisa ukuthobela ikhondo yokuqwaleka nendlela yokuyisebenzisa. Qinisekisa ukuthobela kwimigangatho yekhwalithi.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist: Trauma and Burns (5/8TH Post)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R872 205 per annum, all-inclusive salary package, (excluding commuted overtime). Grade 2: R995 172 per annum, all-inclusive salary package, (excluding commuted overtime). Grade 3: R1 152 594 per annum, all-inclusive salary package, (excluding commuted overtime).
jobs.summary: Medical specialist in trauma and burns needed at Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring FCS(SA) or MMed Surg and HPCSA registration as a trauma surgeon.
jobs.requirements: MBChB or equivalent; Applicants must be in possession of an appropriate higher surgical qualification (FCS(SA) and/or MMed Surg) and currently registered with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as a Trauma Surgeon. Registration Certificate as a Specialist Trauma Surgeon. Additional Qualifications: eFAST course, MIMMS and, or ACLS/PALS. DSTC or Burns experience. Cert Trauma (SA) sub-specialist training complete. Preference will be given to applicants who have completed the Cert Trauma (SA) sub- specialist exam. Experience: Grade 1: Experience Not applicable requires the Fellowship in Surgery of the College of Medicine of South Africa or equivalent, and registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa. Applicants must be registered as a specialist in surgery at the commencement of duties. Grade 2 requires appropriate qualification, specialist registration certificate plus 5 years experience after registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as a Medical Specialist in General Surgery. Grade 3 requires appropriate qualification, specialist registration certificate, plus 10 years’ experience after registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as a Medical Specialist in General Surgery.
jobs.duties: Participation in the clinical trauma and burns services: inter disciplinary in- house coordination of the management of the patients: supervision of the surgical trainees rotating through the trauma and transplant units: ensuring the highest standards of clinical, professional, and ethical behaviour: assist in teaching of undergraduate medical students, postgraduate surgical trainees: conduct, assist, and stimulate research within the ethical guidelines of the Health Care Act: promote education in trauma prevention and transplant community awareness. Physical presence on arrival of scene calls and unstable cases expected.
jobs.enquiries: Dr T C Hardcastle Tel No: (031) 240 1000, ext 2389 or speed dial 6195
jobs.applications: All applications must be addressed to the Human Resources Manager, and should be placed in the application box situated at Security at the entrance to the Management Building at IALCH or to applications@ialch.co.za
jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. An Application for Employment Form (Current Z83) must be completed and forwarded. This is obtainable from any Public Service Department or from the website www.kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies of qualifications, proof of registration and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only which may be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview. Original signed letter from your current employer, confirming current and appropriate work experience related to the requirements and recommendations of the advert to be submitted only when shortlisted. People with disabilities should feel free to apply for the posts. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83, e.g. ref APRO/1/2006. Please note that failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify applicants. It is the short listed candidate’s responsibility to have the foreign qualification, which is the requirement of the post, evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such evaluation on or before the day of the interview. Failure to comply will result in the application not being considered. The selected candidate will be subjected to a pre-employment screening and verification process including a CIPC (Companies Intellectual Property Commission) screening. Due to the large number of applications we receive, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged. Should you not be advised within 60 days of the closing date, kindly consider your application as unsuccessful. Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T claims. This Hospital is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer whose aim is to promote representatively in all levels of all occupational categories in the Hospital. Person with disabilities and African males are encouraged to apply. Please note that other race groups are also not restricted from applying.

af.title: Mediese Spesialis: Trauma en Brandwonde (5/8TH Pos)
af.summary: Mediese spesialis in trauma en brandwonde benodig by Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, met vereiste van FCS(SA) of MMed Surg en HPCSA-registrasie as 'n traumachirug.
af.requirements: MBChB of ekwivalent; Aansoekers moet oor 'n toepaslike hoër chirurgiese kwalifikasie (FCS(SA) en/of MMed Surg) beskik en tans by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n Trauma Surgeon geregistreer wees. Registrasiesertifikaat as 'n Specialist Trauma Surgeon. Addisionele kwalifikasies: eFAST-kursus, MIMMS en, of ACLS/PALS. DSTC- of brandwonde-ervaring. Cert Trauma (SA) subspesialis-opleiding voltooi. Voorkeur sal gegee word aan aansoekers wat die Cert Trauma (SA) subspesialis-eksamen voltooi het. Ervaring: Graad 1: Ervaring Nie toepaslik nie vereis die Fellowship in Surgery of the College of Medicine of South Africa of ekwivalent, en registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa. Aansoekers moet by aanvang van pligte as 'n spesialis in chirurgie geregistreer wees. Graad 2 vereis toepaslike kwalifikasie, spesialisregistrasiesertifikaat plus 5 jaar ervaring na registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n Medical Specialist in General Surgery. Graad 3 vereis toepaslike kwalifikasie, spesialisregistrasiesertifikaat, plus 10 jaar se ervaring na registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n Medical Specialist in General Surgery.
af.duties: Deelname aan die kliniese trauma- en brandwondedienste: interdissiplinêre huiskoördinering van die bestuur van die pasiënte: toesig oor die chirurgiese opleidings wat deur die trauma- en transplanteenhede roteer: verseker van die hoogste standaarde van kliniese, professionele en etiese gedrag: hulp met die onderrig van voorgraadse mediese studente, nagraadse chirurgiese opleidings: uitvoer, help met, en stimuleer van navorsing binne die etiese riglyne van die Health Care Act: bevorder van opvoeding oor traumaprevensie en transplantaatgemeenskapsbewustheid. Fisiese teenwoordigheid by aankoms van toneelroepe en onstabiele gevalle word verwag.

zu.title: Isikhulu Sezokwelapha: Izingodo Lamasunda Nokushiswa (Isikhundla se-5/8TH)
zu.summary: Kudingeka isikhulu sezokwelapha ezigidini zamasunda nokushiswa e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal, sifuna i-FCS(SA) noma i-MMed Surg kanye nokubhaliswa kwe-HPCSA njengochirha wamasunda.
zu.requirements: I-MBChB noma okulinganayo; Abafaka isicelo kumele babe nokwesigaba esifanele sokufundela unhloli (i-FCS(SA) kanye/noma i-MMed Surg) futhi njengamanje babhaliswe e-HPCSA njengochirha wamasunda. Isitifiketi sokubhalisa njengoChirha Ohlankhuli Wamasunda. Izifundo ezingeziwe: Isifundo se-eFAST, i-MIMMS kanye noma, i-ACLS/PALS. Utheleleko lwe-DSTC noma ngokushiswa. Ukuqeda ukwesigaba kwe-Cert Trauma (SA). Izinto ezingathandwa zizonikezwa abafaka isicelo abaqedile isivivinyo sokwesigaba kwe-Cert Trauma (SA). Uthelelelo: Isigaba 1: Utheleleko abusebenzi kudinga i-Fellowship unhloli we-College of Medicine of South Africa noma okulinganayo, kanye nokubhaliswa e-HPCSA. Abafaka isicelo kumele babe ngabochirha bahlankhuli ngasekuqaleni kwemisebenzi. Isigaba 2 sifuna ukwesigaba okufanele, isitifiketi sokubhalisa sochirha kanye nokuqotha iminyaka 5 ngemuva kokubhalisa e-HPCSA njengoChirha Ohlankhuli Kuzo. Isigaba 3 sifuna ukwesigaba okufanele, isitifiketi sokubhalisa sochirha, kanye nokuqotha iminyaka 10 ngemuva kokubhalisa e-HPCSA njengoChirha Ohlankhuli Kuzo.
zu.duties: Ukubambe iqhaza ekunakekelweni kwezokwelapha kwabagulwa basemasundeni futhi bashisiwe: ukulawula izintaba phakathi kwezindlu ukunakekelwa kwabagulwa: ukugada abafundi bezenhloli abajwayele emazingeni okwelashwa ngamasunda kanye nokufuduka: ukuqinisekisa izinga eliphezulu kakhulu lokuziphatha ngokwelapha, ngobuhlakani, kanye nokuqonda: ukusiza ekufundiseni abafundi bezokwelapha abangakaphathi, abafundi bezenhloli: ukwenza, ukusiza, kanye nokuvusa ucwaningo ngaphakathi kwenkomba yezenzo ze-Health Care Act: ukukhuthaza ukufundisa ekuvikeleni ngamasunda kanye nokwazisa umphakathi ngesimo sokwelashwa. Kulindeleke ukuba ukhona ngokomzimba ekufikeni kwamakholo endaweni kanye nalezimo ezingazinzile.

xh.title: UGqithiswa Wezempilo Ochwepheshe: Iingozi kunye Nokutsha Umzimba (Isithuba se-5/8)
xh.summary: Kufuneka ugqithiswa wezempilo ochwepheshe kwiingozi nokutsha kumzimba e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal, esafuna i-FCS(SA) okanye i-MMed Surg kunye nobhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengogodoli weengozi.

Isatifikethi Sobhaliso njengoGcisa Ochwepheshe weengozi. IziPhumezo ezengeziwe: ikhosi ye-eFAST, i-MIMMS kunye, okanye i-ACLS/PALS. Isiphiwo se-DSTC okanye amava okutsha umzimba. Uqeqesho olugqityiweyo lwe-Cert Trauma (SA) lwesiqu esizele bengugcisa ochwepheshe. Ukhetho uya kunikwa abafaka isicelo abagqibileyo ngevavayo le-Cert Trauma (SA) lwesiqu esizele bengugcisa ochwepheshe. Amaxa: Inqanaba 1: Amaxa abalulekanga, kufuneka iFellowship yokugodola kwiKholeji YoNyango waseMzantsi Afrika okanye efanayo, kunye nobhaliso kwiKhaphu Lezamava Ezesempilo zaseMzantsi Afrika. Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babhaliswe njengogcisa ochwepheshe wokugodola ekuqaleni kwemisebenzi. Inqanaba 2 kufuneka kube nesipumezo esifanelekileyo, isatifikethi sobhaliso segcisa ochwepheshe kwaye uluwonke uneminyaka engama-5 yamava emva kobhaliso kwiKhaphu Lezamava Ezesempilo zaseMzantsi Afrika njengoGcisa Ochwepheshe Wokugodola Ngokubanzi. Inqanaba 3 kufuneka kube nesipumezo esifanelekileyo, isatifikethi sobhaliso segcisa ochwepheshe, kwaye uluwonke uneminyaka engama-10 yamava emva kobhaliso kwiKhaphu Lezamava Ezesempilo zaseMzantsi Afrika njengoGcisa Ochwepheshe Wokugodola Ngokubanzi.
xh.duties: UKuthatha inxaxheba kweenkonzo zezempilo ezimalunga neengozi kunye nokutsha kumzimba: ulungelelwaniso lwangaphakathi phakathi kweendawo ezahlukeneyo ekuphathweni kwabagula: ukulawula abafundi bokugodola abajikelezayo kwiindawo zengozi nokushintshelwa kwezitho: ukuqinisekisa iimfunoziphezulu zokuziphatha kwezempilo, zobugcisa, kunye nezobugcotya: ukuncedisa ekufundiseni abafundi bokuqala bezokwelapha, abafundi bakaqeqeshwa kwakhona ekugodolweni: ukuqhutywa, ukuncedisa, nokukhuthaza ucwaniso ngaphakathi kwemiqathango yokuziphatha ngokweMthetho Wezempilo: ukukhuthaza imfundo ekuthinteleni iingozi nokwazisa uluntu malunga nokushintshelwa kwezitho. Kulindeleke ukuba kukho ubukho bomzimba xa kufika izimemo zendawo kunye namacala angazinzayo.

Ability to teach undergraduate and post-graduate students and participate in research and continuing professional development. Maintain good clinical, professional and ethical standards in the unit.

Ensure the efficient and effective provision of in- and out-patient services. Assist with quality improvement imperatives, including clinical audits, morbidity and mortality reporting, and reviewing clinical documentation and clinical governance procedures. Ensure that cost-effective service delivery is maintained within the unit. Manage and direct performance and EPMDS of junior staff within the unit as required. Actively participate in the academic programme for the training of sub-specialist fellows. Clinical teaching, examination and administration of undergraduate and postgraduate students. Engage in academic research culminating in the publication of papers in scientific journals or the presentation of the results of such research at scientific congresses and supervise registrar research. Partake in outreach programmes of the unit. After-hours participation in the call roster. Assist with additional duties as delegated by the Head Clinical Unit.
