af.title: Mediese Spesialis Sessies
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde met Cardiologie subspesialiteit gesoek vir sessiewerk by IALCH in KwaZulu-Natal.
af.requirements: Grade in Geneeskunde (MBCHB) en Spesialisregistrasie in Interne Geneeskunde. Registrasiesertifikaat by die Gesondheidsprofessiesraad (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde. Bykomende Kwalifikasie Subspesialis in Cardiologie. Ervaring – Graad 1: Die aanstelling tot graad 1 vereis toepaslike kwalifikasies en 'n registrasiesertifikaat by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis. Graad 2: Die aanstelling tot graad 2 vereis toepaslike kwalifikasies en 'n registrasiesertifikaat by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis plus vyf (5) jaar ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis. Graad 3: Die aanstelling tot graad 3 vereis toepaslike kwalifikasies en 'n registrasiesertifikaat plus tien (10) jaar ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Soliede kliniese kennis, vaardighede en ervaring in Cardiologie. Bevoegdheid in die kliniese evaluering, interpretasie van spesiale ondersoeke en bestuur binne die subspesialiteit. Goeie menslike verhoudings, kommunikasie, leierskap en spanbouvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid plus soliede onderhandeling-, beplannings-, organisasie-, besluitnemings- en konflikbestuursvaardighede. Vermoë om voorgraadse en nagraadse studente te onderrig en aan navorsing en voortgesette professionele ontwikkeling deel te neem. Handhaaf goeie kliniese, professionele en etiese standaarde in die eenheid.
af.duties: Die ampsdraers van die posisies moet die Hoof Kliniese Eenheid bystaan in die volgende areas: Ontwikkeling en bestuur van die aangewese subspesialiteitsdienste vir die streek. Verseker die doeltreffende en effektiewe lewering van in- en uitpasiëntdienste. Formuleer beleide en prosedures vir kliniese dienste soos vereis, en verseker dat dit in ooreenstemming is met die huidige statutêre regulasies en riglyne. Verskaf leierskap, bestuur en ondersteuning aan alle mediese personeel onder hul toesig. Bystaan met gehaltsverbeteringsimperatiewe, insluitend kliniese oudits, morbiditeit en mortaliteitsverslagdoening, en die hersiening van kliniese dokumentasie en kliniese bestuursprosedures. Verseker dat koste-effektiewe dienslewering binne die eenheid gehandhaaf word. Bestuur en rig prestasie en EPMDS van junior personeel binne die eenheid soos vereis. Neem aktief deel aan die akademiese program vir die opleiding van subspesialisgenote. Kliniese onderrig, eksaminering en administrasie van voorgraadse en nagraadse studente. Neem deel aan akademiese navorsing wat uitloop op die publikasie van artikels in wetenskaplike tydskrifte of die aanbieding van die resultate van sodanige navorsing by wetenskaplike kongresse en onderhou registraraatnavorsing. Neem deel aan uitreikprogramme van die eenheid. Buitelure deelname aan die oproeprooster. Bystaan met bykomende pligte soos gedelegeer deur die Hoof Kliniese Eenheid.

zu.title: Amaseshini Onongqondwane Bezempilo
zu.summary: Kudingwa ongquguqulelo besibalo ngaphakathi kwesibalo samaphuzu ngaphakathi kwendawo kaKwaZulu-Natal, eKwaZulu-Natal eHPCSA njengongquguqulelo besibalo. Umsebenzi wokusiza abantu abakwesikhundla sokuhlinzela abantu abakhulu.
zu.requirements: Isiqu samaphuzu (MBCHB) nokubhalisa kwengidingo ngaphakathi kwesibalo. Isitifikedi sokubhalisa neHPCSA njengongquguqulelo besibalo ngaphakathi kwesibalo kwemikhakha yezempilo ekuqeqeshwe kuyo. Iziqu ezengeziwe, ukuba ngummeli wesibalo ngokusebenza kokulawula inhliziyo. Isikhundla 1: ukugqashwa esikhundleni se-1 sifuna izidingo ezifanele nesisitifikedi sokubhalisa eHPCSA njengongquguqulelo besibalo.
zu.duties: Abagcinwe besikhundla balezabelo bafanelwe ukusize intloko yesikhungo sezempilo ezindaweni ezilandelayo: Ukuthuthukiswa nokuphathwa kwemisebenzi yohlobo oluthize olungele umkhakha wesifundo ngabalidi. Qinisekisa ukulethwa ngokusebenzela nangokusemandla kwemisebenzi yabaguli b abasedukeni nangaphandle. Amaxabiso anconywe kusukela ezimalini zokubhalisa eHPCSA njengengidingo lezo zazi. Isikhundla 2: ukugqashwa esikhundleni se-2 sifuna izidingo ezifanele nesitifikedi sokubhalisa eHPCSA njengongquguqulelo besibalo, okukodwa nezi (5) zahamba nonyaka lisezixazini zempilo. Isikhundla 3: ukugqashwa esikhundleni se-3 sifuna izidingo ezifanele nesitifikedi sokubhalisa, okukodwa nezi (10) zonyaka zemisebenzi ngemva kokubhalisa eHPCSA njengongquguqulelo besibalo. Ulwazi, Amandla, Ukuyala, Amakha Wokusebenza Nokwazisa: Ulwazi oluseduze, amandla nomyalezo wesibalo sokuxilonga amafinyila, ukupela nokuphatwa kolwazi ezindaweni ezisemthethweni zokulawula ukugula kwentambo yamapayipi, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi kusemthethweni nokuhambisana nemiyalelo nemikhakha yamanammedathi yemizwana namakhomiti. Ukunikeza icebo lokuhola, ukuphathwa nokwesekwa kubasebenzi bezempilo abasebanzi ngaphansi kwesigaba sabo. Ukusiza ngokulawula izinga lezimpilo ezibalulekile, okuhlanganisa nokuhlola imibhalo yezempilo, nokubika kokuhamba nangokushona, kanye nokuhlela umbhalo wokusetshenziswa kwezinto ezingangenwa ngqo ngamalungu eqembu. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuyigugu ukusetshenziswa kwemali emsebenzini usuku lonke. Yini okufanele iyenziwe ngabasebenzi abaseshasheni, iholo lokulinganiselwa kobudlo nemisebenzi. Bukhoma mayelana nemfundo yamanga nenkonzo yokuqeqesha abantu abakwesikhundla sokuhlinzela abantu abakhulu. Ngesikhathi sokuya emsebenzini, kufanele uhlele imisebenzi yamalungu eqeqeswa abantu abanesibalo. Isebenzo sokuhola, ukuhweba nangokuphathwa kwabafundi ababafundi abangenamkhakha nabafundi abahamba kahle nabangenamkhakha. Ukuxhumana kakhulu emkhakheni wezifundo kuye kwaba nguquko-mculo ekushandeni kanye nokuthutha izindaba zolwazi kumagazini wezolwazi noma ukuthi kwethulwa izibalo kwizinkomba zezulu, nokuhlela abagqugquzeli ngemisebenzi yeqeqesho labo. Ukubambe iqhaza emkhakheni wezemisebenzi eyenziwa esikhungweni. Ukusetshenziswa kwesikhathi ngemva kwamahora emsebenzini ohlelweni lokushintshana. Ukusiza ngemisebenzi eyehlukene njengoba kuqushiwe yintloko yesikhungo sezempilo.

xh.title: Iintsimbo zeNgcali yezEzonyo
xh.summary: Kufunwa iNgcali yezEzonyo kwiNgcali yangaphakathi enomsebenzi ongaphakathi weKhadiyoloji ukwenza umsebenzi wesithuba kwa-IALCH eKwaZulu-Natal.
xh.requirements: Isidanga kwezNyanga (MBCHB) kunye nobhaliso lweNgcali kwiNgcali yangaphakathi. Isatifikethi sobhaliso kuKhonsele yamaGqwethi wezeMpilo (HPCSA) njengeNgcali yezEzonyo kwiNgcali yangaphakathi. I Mgqatso lwamava oluthile: Ukuqatshwa kwabakwi-grade 1 kufuna iimfuno ezifanelekileyo nesatifikethi sobhaliso kuHPCSA njengeNgcali yezEzonyo. Grade 2: Ukuqatshwa kwabakwi-grade 2 kufuna iimfuno ezifanelekileyo nesatifikethi sobhaliso kuHPCSA njengeNgcali yezEzonyo nenyanga ezintlanu (5) zemva kobhaliso kuHPCSA njengeNgcali yezEzonyo. Grade 3: Ukuqatshwa kwabakwi-grade 3 kufuna iimfuno ezifanelekileyo nesatifikethi sobhaliso kunye neminyaka elishumi (10) yamava emva kobhaliso kuHPCSA njengeNgcali yezEzonyo. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho namaLungisa aFunekayo: Ulwazi olulungileyo lweklinikhi, amakhono namava kwiKhadiyoloji. Ukuphumelela kwixinzwelo leklinikhi, ingcaciso yepephakathi ezikhethekileyo nolawulo ngaphakathi kwesebe. Amakhono amabalwa obudlelwane bomntu, unxibelelwano, ulawulo nokwakha iqela. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kunye namakhono olungelelwaniso, uqeqesho, lolulawulo, ukuthatha isiigqibo nolawulo lwamaxhantya. Ikhono lokufundisa abafundi abangagqithanga kwaye abagqithileyo kwaye athabathe inxaxheba kuphando nokuqhubela phambili unyuso lwemphilo yanobungcali. Ukugcina iimigangatho elungileyo yamava, ubungcali namathambo eentlawulo kwilogo.
xh.duties: Ababambe iimbobo zakwabo kwezithuba baya kuncedisa uNtloko weNgcango yokuQondisa kule minndawo ilandelayo: Ukuphucula nolawula iinkonzo ezichaziweyo zomsebenzi ongaphakathi wekhadiyoloji kummandla. Kuqinisekiswe ukubonelelwa ngokusebenza ngokusebenzayo nangokuchanekileyo kwezenkonzo zabaguli abangangena nabanagaseli nidawo. Ukumisela iinkqubo nolwazi olusesikweni ngezinkonzo zonyango njengoko kufuneka kwaye kuqinisekiswe ukuba zimalana nothethe lwangoku nemigaqo ebusayo. Kubonelelwe ulawulo, olawulo ninkxaso kubo bonke oonyango bonyango abangesiseko sawo. Uncede ngakumbi kumthetho wephuculo lomgangatho oluqulathe iindaba ezingqinelanayo nekhlinikhi ekwangqongqo, ingxelo yohlolwe ngokubuhlungu nangokushukunyiswa kwethamsa, nokuphinda uhlolye imibhalo yamava ingqinelana nothethe lwekhlinikhi kunye nemithetho yamava. Kuqinisekiswe ukuba iinkonzo ezingabizi kakhulu ziyagcinwa ngaphakathi kwilogo. Ulayilo oluqondiswayo lonyuso nolawa okwenziwa ukulinganisa abasebenzi abasezantsi kwilogo ngokwesibuyekezo se-EPMDS njengoko kufuneka. Unxaxheba ngokuzimisela kwinkqubo yonyango efundisa abafundi bokuqeqeshwa ekwlinika ekhethekileyo. Ukufundisa nokuqamba ngengxelo yeKhlinikhi, uqeqesho nolawulo abafundi abangagqithileyo nabanagqithileyo. Ukuveza inkxaso ngophando oluvela ebuntwini kweshishini lokupapasha izibini zenoveli okanye sikaqwenga ingxelo ngale mveliso kwiphando kwiindaba zamakhowudi nabakhusela abafundi ngenkqubo yokulandela umnqamiso. Unxaxheba koguquko olungeniswayo ngokusebenza kwilogo nomsebenzi wonxibelelwano. Unxibelelwano lwemihla ngemihla kumaxesha ongenangomhla kwinkqubo yokuqesha. Unceda ngemisebenzi ezenziweyo ngokumiselwa nguNtloko weNgcango yokuQondisa.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist Sessions: Endocrine
jobs.centre: Hospital: Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital (IALCH)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R697 840 per annum Grade 2: R796 640 per annum Grade 3: R922 480 per annum Hourly Rate Per Session/ (Notch Per Annum)
jobs.summary: Medical specialist in endocrinology sought for sessional work at Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, providing outpatient endocrine services.
jobs.requirements: MBCHB Degree; Current registration with Health Professions Council of South Africa as a Medical Specialist including both FCP(SA), or equivalent. Additional Qualification Sub-specialist in endocrinology Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competencies Required: Sound clinical knowledge within the discipline. Ability to deal with all medical emergencies, especially acute hypoadrenalism, diabetic ketoacidosis and hyperosmolar hyperglycaemia. Knowledge of ethical medical practice. Ability to assess, diagnose and manage patients in medicine and endocrinology.
jobs.duties: Provide specialist endocrine outpatient services, including assessment and management of new and follow-up patients with diabetes mellitus, dyslipidaemia, thyroid disorders, pituitary/adrenal conditions, parathyroid disorders, osteoporosis, other metabolic bone diseases, disorders of sex development and other endocrine and metabolic diseases. Provide teaching and case-based supervision to medical officers and registrars attached to the Department of Medicine, on rotation in the Department of Endocrinology as well as teaching and supervision of sub-specialist trainees in Endocrinology. Inter-departmental consultation with other disciplines at IALCH, regarding patient care. Collection of departmental statistics and assistance with clinical audits, as directed by the HOD / HCU. Bi-annual review of performance according to the EPMDS agreements.
jobs.applications: All applications must be addressed to the Human Resources Manager, and should be placed in the application box situated at Security at the entrance to the Management Building at IALCH or to applications@ialch.co.za
jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. An Application for Employment Form (Current Z83) must be completed and forwarded. This is obtainable from any Public Service Department or from the website www.kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies of qualifications, proof of registration and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only which may be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview. Original signed letter from your current employer, confirming current and appropriate work experience related to the requirements and recommendations of the advert to be submitted only when shortlisted. People with disabilities should feel free to apply for the posts. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83, e.g. ref APRO/1/2006. Please note that failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify applicants. It is the shortlisted candidate’s responsibility to have the foreign qualification, which is the requirement of the post, evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such evaluation on or before the day of the interview. Failure to comply will result in the application not being considered. The selected candidate will be subjected to a pre-employment screening and verification process including a CIPC (Companies Intellectual Property Commission) screening. Due to the large number of applications we receive, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged. Should you not be advised within 60 days of the closing date, kindly consider your application as unsuccessful. Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T claims. This Hospital is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer whose aim is to promote representatively in all levels of all occupational categories in the Hospital. Person with disabilities and African males are encouraged to apply. Please note that other race groups are also not restricted from applying.

af.title: Mediese Spesialisessies: Endokrien
af.summary: Mediese spesialis in endokrinologie gesoek vir sessiewerk by Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, wat buitepasiënt-endokriene dienste lewer.
af.requirements: MBCHB-graad; Huidige registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n Mediese Spesialis, insluitend beide FCP(SA), of gelykwaardig. Bykomende kwalifikasie: Subspesialis in endokrinologie. Kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede vereis: Deeglike kliniese kennis binne die dissipline. Vermoë om alle mediese noodgevalle te hanteer, veral akute hipoadrenalisme, diabetiese ketoasidose en hiperosmolêre hiperglikemie. Kennis van etiese mediese praktyk. Vermoë om pasiënte in geneeskunde en endokrinologie te assesseer, te diagnoseer en te bestuur.
af.duties: Verskaf spesialis-endokriene buitepasiëntdienste, insluitend assessering en bestuur van nuwe en opvolgpasiënte met diabetes mellitus, dislipidemie, skildklierafwykings, pituïtêre/bynieraandoenings, bysklierafwykings, osteoporose, ander metaboliese beenkwale, afwykings van geslagsontwikkeling en ander endokriene en metaboliese siektes. Verskaf onderrig en gevalgebaseerde toesig aan mediese beamptes en registrateurs wat verbonde is aan die Departement of Medicine, wat rotasie doen in die Departement of Endocrinology, asook onderrig en toesig van subspesialis-sportbeoefenaars in Endocrinology. Interdepartementele konsultasie met ander dissiplines by IALCH, rakende pasiëntsorg. Versameling van departementele statistieke en bystand met kliniese oudits, soos deur die HOD / HCU gerig. Tweejaarlikse hersiening van prestasie ooreenkomstig die EPMDS-ooreenkomste.

zu.title: Izikhathi Somunyamisi Wezokwelapha: IsiGogela Sokunempelisa
zu.summary: Kufunwa umunyamisi wezokwelapha osezingeni eliphezulu ngesigogela sokunempla ocashelwe umsebenzi wesikhathi esithile e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal, ethula izinsizakalo zesigogela sokunempla zabagula abahlolwa bengangenwa esibhedlela.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-MBCHB; Ukbhalisa ngokwamanje ne-Health Professions Council of South Africa njengomunyamisi wezokwelapha okufaka phakathi bobabili i-FCP(SA), noma okulinganayo. I-Qualification yokwengeza njengomunyamisi wezokwelapha osezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu ngesigogela sokunempla ULwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Namakhono Adingekayo: Ulwazi olujulile lokwelapha ngaphakathi kwesifundo. Ikono lokubhekana nawo wonke amakeba ezokwelapha, ikakhulukazi i-hypoadrenalism eqhubekayo, i-diabetic ketoacidosis ne-hyperosmolar hyperglycaemia. Ulwazi ngokuziphatha okuhle ezokwelapha. Ikono lokuhlolisisa, ukuthola isifo nokuviniswa kwesifo kwabagula emkhakheni wezokwelapha nangesigogela sokunempla.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngemisebenzi yesigogela sokunempla somunyamisi wezokwelapha ocashelwe abagula abangangenwa esibhedlela, okuhlanganisa ukubhalisa nokuviniswa kwesifo kwabagula abasha nalabo ababuya ukuqhubeka nokubhekwa abanesifo sikashukela, i-dyslipidaemia, izifo seglandula yamathambo, izifo se-pituitary/adrenal, izifo se-parathyroid, i-osteoporosis, ezinye izifo zamathambo anyibilika, ukuphazimiseka kokuthuthuka kocansi nezinye izifo zesigogela sokunempla nanyibilika. Nikeza izifundo nokuqondisa okusekelwe ezimeni zodaba abambe izikhundla zezokwelapha nalabo ababhala igama emnyangweni we-Department of Medicine, labo abajwayele ukushintshashintsha emnyangweni we-Department of Endocrinology kanye nezifundo nokuqondisa kwabaqeqeshi abangamunyamisi wezokwelapha abasezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu se-Endocrinology. Ukuhlangana nokubonisana phakathi kweminyango namanye amaphethini e-IALCH, ngokuphathwa kwabagula. Ukuqoqa izibalo zomnyango nokusiza ngokuhlola izinto zokwelapha, njengokuqondiswa i-HOD / HCU. Ukuhlolwa konyaka kabili ngemisebenzi ngokwezivumelwano ze-EPMDS.

xh.title: Iziqendu Zezikhetsi Zezempilo: Endocrine
xh.summary: Kufunekwa isikhetsi sezempilo ekwizinga le-endocrinology ngenjongo yokusebenza ngeziqendu e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, libonelela ngokwenzeka kwezakhono ezithile kule ndawo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-MBCHB; Ukubhalisa ngoku kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa njengesikhetsi sezempilo kubandakanya i-FCP(SA), okanye into efanayo. Isidanga esongezelelweyo sobuchwephesha ekwizinga ngeziqu phantsi kwe-endocrinology ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho Namandla afunekayo: Ulwazi olunzulu lwenkqubo yezempilo kule ndali. Ikhono lokujongana naziphi na iingxaki zezempilo eziphuthumayo, ngokukodwa i-hypoadrenalism ekrwala, i-diabetic ketoacidosis ne-hyperosmolar hyperglycaemia. Ulwazi ngokuziphatha ngokwenene kwinkqubo yezempilo. Ikhono lokuhlohla, ukuyiloza noku lawula abaguli kwindawo yedlozi nakwi-endocrinology.
xh.duties: Ukubonelela ngezakhono ezithile ezibonakalisa ulwazi kwindawo yedlozi ngokwenzeka kwamaxesha athile; kuqala ngezigulana entsha nakuqhubeka nokuqwalasela nokulawula abaguli abasandula kubuye kakhulu nabaguliswa ngokutsha neziyokulahlekelwa ngokutsha ziya kudlova kakhulu nemicu yedlova, amathumba endlebe, ukuphuka kwamathambo, ukukhula ngokungaqhelekanga kwamathambo, ukusilela nokutshona kwamathambo. Ukubonelela ngokufundisa nokulawula abasebenzi basekhaya kunye nabanikazi bemisebenzi abalawulwayo, kwi-Department of Medicine, abajikelezayo kwi-Department of Endocrinology ngokunjalo nokuqeqesha nokuqwalasela abafundi abakwizinga ngaphantsi kobugcisa be-Endocrinology. Ukubonisana phakathi kwezindlu ezahlukeneyo nezinye izindlu e-IALCH, malunga nokuqwalasela umguli. Ukuthathwa kweenkcazelo-magama kwindlu yamathumba kunye noncedo kwi-audit yezempilo, njengoko kuqhelwe ngu-HOD / HCU. Ukuhlola inkqubo yokusebenza ngokweminyaka emibini ngokwezi sivumelwano ze-EPMDS.

jobs.title: Clinical Programme Co-ordinator (QUALITY Assurance)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R571 161 – R654 285 per annum. 13th cheque, Plus Medical Aid (Optional), 8% inhospitable allowance, Plus Housing Allowance (Employee must meet prescribed condition)
jobs.summary: Clinical programme co-ordinator for quality assurance at Newcastle Regional Hospital, requiring a nursing degree or diploma, SANC registration and seven years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric/ Senior Certificate PLUS. Bachelor’s Degree / National Diploma in Nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse and Midwife. A minimum of 07 years appropriate/ recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Current registration with the SANC as a Professional nurse and Midwife (2026). Grade 1: 07 years appropriate/ recognizable experience in Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Demonstrate an in-depth understanding in nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practices and how these impacts on service delivery. Ensure clinical nursing practice by the nursing team (unit) in accordance with the scope of practice and nursing standards. Promote quality of nursing care as directed by professional scope of practice and standards as determined by the relevant health facility. Demonstrate the basic understanding of HR and Financial policies and practices. Strong interpersonal communication and presentation skills. Knowledge of Total Quality Management (TQM). Knowledge of norms and standards and Provincial Quality Initiatives (Human Rights, Batho Pele Principles and Patient Rights Charter). Understanding of OHSC guidelines and requirements.
jobs.duties: Work as part of a multi-disciplinary team to ensure good nursing care by the nursing team. Performance quality improvement audits and survey monthly, quarterly and when required to report senior management. Monitor and evaluate delivery of quality care at the institution and clinics. Ensure implementation of standards compliance and provincial initiatives clinical governance, ideal hospital, ideal clinic etc. Monitor patient safety incidents and complains and report accordingly. Report on annual returns and early warning system to office of Health Standards Compliance. Coordinate quality improvement initiatives at the institutions. Monitor and evaluate delivery of quality care at the institutional level including clinical care, waiting times and patients experience of care. Provide advice on various aspects of quality care to the institution and clinics. Monitor and evaluate compliance to the National and Provincial Quality Programmes e.g norms and standards for the District Hospitals package of care. Identify facilitate and co-ordinate all QIP’S. Manage the accreditation programme for the institution. ENQURIES : Mrs. P.N. Masondo Tel No: (034) 328 0000
jobs.applications: All applications should be posted to: The Recruitment Officer, Newcastle Regional Hospital, Private Bag X6653, Newcastle, 2940 OR can be done on S’thesha Waya-Waya website. Applications: can also be emailed to Thembalami.Zwane@kznhealth.gov.za
jobs.notes: This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer, whose aim is to promote representivity in all levels of all occupational categories in the Department. Note: The contents of this Circular Minute must be brought to the notice of all eligible officers and employees on your establishment of all Institutions. Institutions must notify all candidates who qualify for post in this circular minute even if they are absent from their normal places of work to apply. Direction to Candidates: the following documents must be submitted: Application for Employment form (Z83) which is obtainable from any Government Department OR from the website - www.kznhealth.gov.za. The application form (Z83) must be accompanied by a detailed Curriculum Vitae, Certified copies of ID, Highest educational qualification and other relevant documents will be requested for submission only from shortlisted candidates. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83 and on the back of the envelope, e.g. NE01/2016. NB: Failure to comply with the above instructions will be disqualify applicants. Person with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the NIA the following checks (security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience employment verification). Due to the large number of applications, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged. However, correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Please note that due to financial constraint no S&T claims will be considered for payment to the candidates that are invited for an interview.

af.title: Kliniese Programkoördineerder (Kwaliteitsversekering)
af.summary: Kliniese programkoördineerder vir kwaliteitsversekering by Newcastle Regional Hospital, wat 'n verpleeggraad of -diploma, SANC-registrasie en sewe jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Matric/ Senior Certificate PLUS. Baccalaureusgraad / Nasionale Diploma in Verpleegkunde of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige en Vroedvrou moontlik maak. 'n Minimum van 07 jaar toepaslike/ erkende ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Huidige registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele verpleegkundige en Vroedvrou (2026). Graad 1: 07 jaar toepaslike/ erkende ervaring in Verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Toon 'n diepgaande begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante regs- en etiese verpleegpraktyke en hoe dit dienslewering beïnvloed. Verseker kliniese verpleegpraktyk deur die verpleegspan (eenheid) in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde. Bevorder gehalte van verplegsorg soos bepaal deur professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde soos vasgestel deur die tersaaklike gesondheidsfasiliteit. Toon basiese begrip van HR- en Finansiële beleide en praktyke. Sterk interpersoonlike kommunikasie en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Kennis van Totale Kwaliteitsbestuur (TQM). Kennis van norme en standaarde en Provinciale Kwaliteitsinisiatiewe (Menseregte, Batho Pele-beginsels en Pasiënteregte-handves). Begrip van OHSC-riglyne en vereistes.
af.duties: Werk as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span om goeie verplegsorg deur die verpleegspan te verseker. Voer gehaltesverbeteringsoudits en opnames maandeliks, kwartaalliks en wanneer nodig uit om aan senior bestuur te rapporteer. Monitor en evalueer lewering van gehaltesorg by die instelling en klinieke. Verseker implementering van standaardnakoming en provinsiale inisiatiewe kliniese bestuur, ideale hospital, ideale kliniek ens. Monitor pasiëntveiligheidsvoorvalle en klagtes en rapporteer dienooreenkomstig. Rapporteer oor jaarlikse opgawes en waarsefstelsel aan die kantoor van Health Standards Compliance. Koördineer gehaltesverbeteringsinisiatiewe by die instellings. Monitor en evalueer lewering van gehaltesorg op instellingsvlak insluitend kliniese sorg, wagtye en pasiënte se ervaring van sorg. Verskaf advies oor verskeie aspekte van gehaltesorg aan die instelling en klinieke. Monitor en evalueer nakoming van Nasionale en Provinciale Kwaliteitsprogramme bv. norme en standaarde vir die Distrikshospitaal sorgpakket. Identifiseer, fasiliteer en koördineer alle QIP'S. Bestuur die akkreditasieprogram vir die instelling. NAVRAE : Me. P.N. Masondo Tel No: (034) 328 0000

zu.title: Umco-ordinator Wezinhlelo Zokwelapha (Ukuqinisekisa Ikhwalithi)
zu.summary: Umco-ordinator wezinhlelo zokwelapha wokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi eNewcastle Regional Hospital, ofuna idigri noma idiploma yokongwa, ukubhaliswa kwe-SANC kanye neminyaka eyisikhombisa yokuhlangenwe nakho.
zu.requirements: Imatriki/ Isitifiketi Samabanga Aphansi PLUS. I-Degree ye-Bachelor/ Idiploma Likazwelonke Ekongweni noma izifundo ezingalinganayo ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwe-SANC njengoguliwe Ohlinzayo kanye Nomabelethisi. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-07 yohlangenwe nakho olufanelekile/ oluhlonishwayo ekongweni emva kokubhaliswa njengoguliwe Ohlinzayo kwe-SANC Ekongweni Jikelele. Ukubhaliswa kwamanje kwe-SANC njengoguliwe Ohlinzayo kanye Nomabelethisi (2026). Isigaba 1: Iminyaka engu-07 yohlangenwe nakho olufanelekile/ oluhlonishwayo Ekongweni emva kokubhaliswa njengoguliwe Ohlinzayo kwe-SANC Ekongweni Jikelele. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Kanye Namakhono Adingekayo: Khombisa ukuqonda ngobunjalo emthethweni wokonga kanye nemithetho ehlobene nokuziphatha okusemthethweni ekongweni nokuthi lokhu kubavelelani kanjani ekulethweni kwenkonzo. Qinisekisa ukuzilolonga kokwelapha iqembu lokonga (ikhaya) ngokommandla wokuzilolonga namazinga okonga. Khuthaza ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa kokonga njengoba kuqondiswa ummandla wokuzilolonga obhalisiwe namazinga njengoba kumisiwe isikhungo sezempilo esihlobene. Khombisa ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kwezintando zomthetho wezabasebenzi nezamali kanye nokuziphatha. Amakhono amakhulu okuxhumana nabantu nokwenza okuqhamelayo. Ulwazi lwe-Total Quality Management (TQM). Ulwazi lwamaphuzu namazinga kanye Nezinhlelo Zekhwalithi Zesifunda (Izelo Lungalo Lobuntu, Imigomo KaBatho Pele noMthethosisekelo Wezelo Zesiguli). Ukuqonda imihlahla nezidingo zika-OHSC.
zu.duties: Sebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elinemikhakha eminingi ukuze kuqinisekiswe inakekelo elihle lokonga iqembu lokonga. Yenza ukuhlola ukuthuthuka kokusebenza ikhwalithi nokesinye isikhashana, kafuzu noma nxa kudingeka ukubika abaphathi abaphezulu. Qaphela futhi uhlole ukulethwa kwenakekelo yikhwalithi esikhungweni nasemakliniki. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kokuhambisana namazinga kanye nezinhlelo zesifunda ukubuswa kokwelapha, isibhedlela esihle, ikliniki eihle njll. Qaphela izehlakalo zokuphepha kwesiguli nezimalo futhi ubike ngokufanele. Bika ngemibuyiselo yonyaka kanye nesistimu yokuxwayisa ngaphambi kwesikhathi ehhovisi leHealth Standards Compliance. Hlanganisa izinhlelo zokuthuthuka kwikhwalithi emasikhungweni. Qaphela futhi uhlole ukulethwa kwenakekelo yikhwalithi ezingeni lesikhungo okuhlanganisa nokwelapha, izikhathi zokulinda nokuhlangenwe nakho kwesiguli ngokunakekelwa. Nikeza izeluleko ngemikhakha ehlukene yenakekelo lekhwalithi esikhungweni nasemakliniki. Qaphela futhi uhlole ukuziphatha ngokwezinhlelo Zekhwalithi Zikazwelonke Nezesisunda njll amaphuzu namazinga ephasela yokunakekelwa kwezibhedlela Zesifunda. Hlola futhi uhlele bonke ama-QIP'S. Phatha ihlelo lokuhlinzwa ngokuvunyelwe isikhungo. IMIBUZO : Mrs. P.N. Masondo Tel No: (034) 328 0000

xh.title: UMququzeleli wenkqubo yamaganga (uQinisekiso lweMgangatho)
xh.summary: Umququzeleli wenkqubo yamaganga wokuqinisekisa imigangatho eNewcastle Regional Hospital, ofuna izidanga okanye idiploma yokunesa, ukubhalisa kwi-SANC kunye neminyaka eyi-7 yamava.
xh.requirements: I-Matric/ Isatifikethi seBanga eliPhezulu PLUS. Isidanga se-Bachelor’s / i-National Diploma ekuNursing okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengogqatso weProfeshoni kwezeNursing noMamatyala. Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-07 yamava afanelekileyo/ aqaqambiswayo kwinzima yamaganga emva kokubhalisa njengogqatso weProfeshoni kwezeNursing kwi-SANC kwiNzima yeGanga jikelele. Ukubhalisa ngoku kwi-SANC njengogqatso weProfeshoni kwezeNursing noMamatyala (2026). Inqanaba le-1: Iminyaka eyi-07 yamava afanelekileyo/ aqaqambiswayo kwiNzima yamaganga emva kokubhalisa njengogqatso weProfeshoni kwezeNursing kwi-SANC kwiNzima yeGanga jikelele. Iziqiqego, amakhono, uqeqesho namandla aFunekayo: Kubonisa ukuqonda okujulileyo kwimithetho yamaganga namasebe athintelaayo, nakunye nenzima yamaganga esemthethweni nasekuziphatheni kwemithetho yamaganga nendlela ebona ngayo ukuphathwa kweenkonzo. Qinisekisa inzima yamaganga eqeshwa qeqeshwa lilungu leqela (icandelo) ngokommandla wenzima namazinga amaganga. Khuthaza umgangatho wezighelo zaganga njengoko kulawulwa ngummandla wezighelo zobugcisa namazinga njengoko iqheliswe sisiseko sezempilo esichwayekileyo. Bonisa ukuqonda okuyintsingiselo kwezicwangciso zamabango e-HR nezeMali nendlela ezenziwa ngayo. Amandla amakhulu okunxibelelana nabantu nokubonisa inkqubo. Ulwazi nge-Total Quality Management (TQM). Ulwazi ngezingqi namazinga nokuQaliswa kweMigangatho esiPhondo (iLungelo loMntu, iZimaphakathi zeBatho Pele noMthetho weLungelo lweGxaki). Ukuqonda iindlela nemfuno ze-OHSC.
xh.duties: Sebenza njengesiqu selungu leqela elinezisebe ezininzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe izighelo ezilungileyo zaganga eligqatsha qeqesha amaganga.enza uqeqesho lokuphucula umgangatho wemisebenzi yamaganga nokuqwalasela nyanga zonke, kwikota noko kufunwa ukuba kwenziwe ukuya kubika kuqeqesho lokulawula. Qwalasa futhi ulinganise ukunikezelwa kwezighelo zamaganga eziseko nakumathandabuzi. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kwezimagama ezinqweni kwemigangatho nokuqaliswa kwezicwangciso zesiphondo ukulawulwa kwezamaganga, isibhedlele esigqibeleleyo, ikliniki ezigqibeleleyo njalo-njalo. Qwalasa iinkcidenko zokhuseleko lwegxaki nemvezo kwaye uxeke ngokufanelekileyo. Xela ngenyaka ezibuyiswayo nendlela yokulumkisa kwangaphambili kwi-ofisi yeNqumoniso yeMigangatho eVela kuMntu. Lunganisa iinjongo zokuphucula imigangatho kumasebe. Qwalasa futhi ulinganise ukunikezelwa kwezighelo zamaganga kwinqanaba lomntu wonke kuquka ukuganga amaganga, iinkqubo ezilindela ixesha kakhulu namava abaguli kumaganga. Nikela ngenceba ngeembandi ezahlukeneyo zamaganga kumasebe nakumathandabuzi. Qwalasa futhi ulinganise ukuzinikela kwiNqanaba lesiZwe nesiPhondo kumacandelo eMigangatho amaganga ezib. izimagama kwaye zibe zihleleleke ngokomgangatho wokuganga i-District Hospitals. Qaphela, wenze futhi ulungelelanise zonke i-QIP'S. Lawula inkqubo yokuvunywa kumasebe. iMBUZO : U-Nks. P.N. Masondo Tel No: (034) 328 0000

jobs.title: Radiation Oncology Radiographer (RADIOTHERAPIST)
jobs.centre: eThekwini Oncology complex (Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital and Addington Hospital)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R510 906 per annum Grade 2: R598 260 per annum Grade 3: R703 785 per annum Plus 13th cheque, Medical Aid - Optional & Housing Allowance: Employee must meet prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Radiation oncology radiographer sought for eThekwini Oncology complex to perform radiotherapy planning, treatment preparation and brachytherapy procedures.
jobs.requirements: Diploma or Bachelor degree in Radiography. Registration with HPCSA as Radiographer oncology, Current registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as a Radiographer (Radiotherapy Oncology). Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competences Required: Knowledge of radiotherapy standard techniques, dose protocols, equipment and accessories associated with relevant techniques and including and cialized techniques. Knowledge of basic quality assurance in Radiotherapy, radiation effects & Radiation protection on patients. Anatomy vs. tumor treatment vs. effects on physiology care patterns for patients. Taking and evaluating of Portal images / C.T. scans and MRI scans for treatment planning purposes. Knowledge of Radiotherapy Planning. Good interpersonal skills and basic supervisory skills. Must have the ability to perform effectively in a team. Knowledge of basic patient care.
jobs.duties: Undertake all basic radiation planning and treatment preparation including the tumor localization, graphic planning, radiation dose calculation and the necessary data preparation needed for treatment accessory construction. Undertake Brachytherapy Planning and treatment procedure. Liaise with the Physicist, Oncologist, Oncology nurses, relatives and the patient. Safely operate, care and construct accessories and immobilization devices used in the planning and treatment of the patient. Dosimetry checks done before delivery of treatment. Ensure accurate records kept of the course of Radiotherapy treatment delivered. Serve as Health and Safety Representative. Provide afterhours duties and rotate between Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital Radiotherapy department and Addington Hospital Radiotherapy department when needed.
jobs.applications: All applications must be addressed to the Human Resources Manager, and should be placed in the application box situated at Security at the entrance to the Management Building at IALCH or to applications@ialch.co.za
jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. An Application for Employment Form (Current Z83) must be completed and forwarded. This is obtainable from any Public Service Department or from the website www.kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies of qualifications, proof of registration and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only which may be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview. Original signed letter from your current employer, confirming current and appropriate work experience related to the requirements and recommendations of the advert to be submitted only when shortlisted. People with disabilities should feel free to apply for the posts. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83, e.g. ref APRO/1/2006. Please note that failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify applicants. It is the shortlisted candidate’s responsibility to have the foreign qualification, which is the requirement of the post, evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such evaluation on or before the day of the interview. Failure to comply will result in the application not being considered. The selected candidate will be subjected to a pre-employment screening and verification process including a CIPC (Companies Intellectual Property Commission) screening. Due to the large number of applications we receive, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged. Should you not be advised within 60 days of the closing date, kindly consider your application as unsuccessful. Please note that due to financial constraints, There will be no payment of S&T claims. This Hospital is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer whose aim is to promote representatively in all levels of all occupational categories in the Hospital. Person with disabilities and African males are encouraged to apply. Please note that other race groups are also not restricted from applying.

af.title: Radiasie-onkologie-radiograaf (RADIOTERAPIES)
af.summary: Radiasie-onkologie-radiograaf gesoek vir eThekwini-onkologiekompleks om radioterapiebeplanning, behandelingsvoorbereiding en brachiterapieprosedures uit te voer.
af.requirements: Diploma of Bachelors-graad in Radiografie. Registrasie by HPCSA as Radiograaf-onkologie, huidige registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n Radiograaf (Radiotherapy Oncology). Kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede vereis: Kennis van standaardtegnieke in radioterapie, dosisprotokolle, toerusting en bybehore wat verband hou met relevante tegnieke, insluitend gespesialiseerde tegnieke. Kennis van basiese gehaltversekering in radioterapie, stralingseffekte en stralingsbeskerming op pasiënte. Anatomie versus tumorbehandeling versus effekte op fisiologiese sorgpatrone vir pasiënte. Neem en evalueer portaalbeelde, CT-skanderings en MRI-skanderings vir behandelingsbeplanningsdoeleindes. Kennis van radioterapiebeplanning. Goed interpersoonlike vaardighede en basiese toesighoudende vaardighede. Moet die vermoë hê om doeltreffend in 'n span te funksioneer. Kennis van basiese pasiëntesorg.
af.duties: Onderneem alle basiese stralingsbeplanning en behandelingsvoorbereiding, insluitend tumorlokalisering, grafiese beplanning, stralingsdosisberekening en die nodige data-voorbereiding wat benodig word vir die konstruksie van behandelingsbybehore. Onderneem brachiterapiebeplanning en behandelingsprosedures. Skakel met die fisikus, onkoloog, onkoloogverpleegkundiges, familie en die pasiënt. Bedryf, versorg en konstrueer veilig bybehore en immobilisasietoestelle wat gebruik word in die beplanning en behandeling van die pasiënt. Dosimetrie-kontroles word voor aflewering van behandeling gedoen. Verseker dat akkurate rekords gehou word van die verloop van die radioterapiebehandeling wat gelewer is. Tree op as Gesondheids- en Veiligheidsverteenwoordiger. Verskaf buite-ure pligte en roteer tussen die Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital Radiotherapy department en die Addington Hospital Radiotherapy department wanneer nodig.

zu.title: Umculi we-Radiography e-Radiation Oncology (RADIOTHERAPIST)
zu.summary: Kufunwa umculi we-radiography e-radiation oncology osebenza evela kwe-Thekwini Oncology complex ukwenza ukulungiselwa kokwelashwa nge-radiation, ukulungiselela kokwelashwa kanye nemicimbo ye-brachytherapy.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma noma i-Bachelor degree kwi-Radiography. Ukuqashelwa ne-HPCSA njengoba ngumculi we-Radiography oncology, Ukuqashelwa kwamanje ne-Health Professions Council of South Africa njengoba ngumculi we-Radiography (Radiotherapy Oncology). Ukwaziswa, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa nezikhonza ezidingekayo: Ukwaziswa ngamasu ajwayelekile e-Radiotherapy, izimiso zedose, izisetshenziswa nezinto ezingezisezinhlobonhlobo ezihambisana namasu ahlobene kanye nezinye izasu ezibhalwe ngendlela. Ukwaziswa ngokuhlonza ikhwalithi e-Radiotherapy, imiphumela yomuvo nokuvikelwa komuvo kwabagulayo. Isimo semizimba iqhathaniswa nokwelashwa kwesimila sokudlula emaphethelweni, iqhathaniswa nemiphumela ekuhlalweni kwabagulayo. Ukuthatha nokubuyekezwa kwemifanekiso ye-Portal / C.T. scans ne-MRI scans ngenjongo yokulungiselwa kokwelashwa. Ukwaziswa ngokulungiselwa kokwelashwa nge-Radiotherapy. Amakhono amahle abantu nentela yokuhlakanipha nokuqondisa abanye. Kumele abe nethemba lokusebenza ngokuphumelelayo egqamini. Ukwaziswa ngokunakekela abagulayo.
zu.duties: Ukwenza wonke ukulungiselwa kokwelashwa ngomuvo nokulungiselela kokwelashwa okuhlanganisa ukutholwa kwesimila, ukulungiselwa kwemidwebo, ukubala kwedose komuvo nolwazi oludingekayo ekwakheni izinto ezingezisezinhlobonhlobo zokwelashwa. Ukwenza ukulungiselwa kokwelashwa nge-brachytherapy nemicimbo yokwelashwa. Ukuhlanganyelana ne-Physicist, i-Oncologist, othunywa be-ncology, osibe abantu noguli. Ukusebenza ngokuphepha, ukukhathalela nokwakha izinto ezingezisezinhlobonhlobo nezinto zokuvala okusetshenziswa ekulungiselweni nakokwelashwa kweguli. Ukubuyekeza idose ngaphambi kokulethwa kwakho konke kokwelashwa. Ukugcina ukubhala ngokwenyani ukulandelwa kwendlela ye-Radiotherapy yokwelashwa. Ukuba ngumelwe i-Health and Safety. Ukwenza imisebenzi yemuva kwamasikhathi nokushintshashintsha phakathi kwe-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital Radiotherapy department kanye ne-Addington Hospital Radiotherapy department uma kudingeka.

xh.title: Radiation Oncology Radiographer (RADIOTHERAPIST)
xh.summary: Kufunwa Radiation oncology radiographer wase eThekwini Oncology complex ukuze enze icebo lokurhahulwa kokwelapha ngokuthunyelwa kwemitha, ulungiselelo lokwelapha kwaye wenze iindlela zokurhahulwa i-brachytherapy.
xh.requirements: Diploma okanye isidanga se-Bachelor kwi-Radiography. Ubulungiselelo kwi-HPCSA njengoba Radiographer oncology, Ubulungiselelo okwangoku kunye neHealth Professions Council of South Africa njengoba Radiographer (Radiotherapy Oncology). Ulwazi, Amakhono, Uqeqesho kunye namakhono afunekayo: Ulwazi ngeendlela ezisisiseko zokuthunyelwa kwemitha yokwelapha, i-protocol yedose, izixhobo nezinto ezidityaniswayo ezidityanisiweyo ngeendleza eziphathwayo kuquka iindlela ezitsalwe ngokukodwa. Ulwazi ngeNkqubo yesisiseko yokuqinisekisa imigaqo kwi-Radiotherapy, imiphumela yemitha nokhuseleko lomthunywa kumagula. I-Anatomy vs. ukwelapha i-tumor vs. imiphumela kumaphethu wokunakekelwa komzimba wamagula. Ukuthatha nokuhlolwa kwemifanekiso ye-Portal / i-C.T. scans nezipeleti ze-MRI ngenjongo yokurhahulwa ukwelapha. Ulwazi nge-Radiotherapy Planning. Amakhono amabalide okunxibelelana nabantu kunye namakhono abalide okulawula. Kufuneka ube namandla okusebenza ngokuchanekileyo kwingqungumbhala. Ulwazi ngokunakekelwa kwesisiseko komthunywa.
xh.duties: Yonke icebo elisisiseko lokurhahulwa kokuthunyelwa kwemitha nolungiselelo lokwelapha kuquka ukumisela indawo ye-tumor, ukurhahula ngemifanekiso, ukubala idose yemitha nokulungiselela i-data efunekayo ukuze yakhiwe izinto ezidityaniswayo ezingezemveliso ngenjongo yokwelapha. Yenza i-Brachytherapy Planning nendlela yokwelapha. Nxibelelana noPhysicist, Oncologist, oogqatsha be-Oncology, oosapho kunye nomthunywa. Sebenzisa ngokhuseleko, znakekele yakhe izinto ezidityaniswayo ezingezemveliso nezixhobo zokuthintela ukunyuka kwesimo esithile ezisetyenziswa ekurhahulweni nokwelapheni komthunywa. Ukuhlolwa kweDosimetry kwenziwe ngaphambi kokunikela unyango. Qinisekisa ukuba kugcinwe iirekhodi ezichanekileyo zohambo lonke lonyango lweRadiotherapy elunikwayo. Zive njengomthunywa wezeempilo Nokhuseleko. Nikela ngemisebenzi yamaxesha angasemva kwaye utshintshe phakathi kwisebe le-Radiotherapy lase-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital nesebe le-Radiotherapy lase-Addington Hospital xa kudingeka.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Specialty Operating Theatre (GRADE 1
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 – R581 931 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 – R752 913 per annum 13th cheque, Plus Medical Aid (Optional), 8% inhospitable allowance, Plus Housing Allowance (Employee must meet prescribed condition)
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse specialty operating theatre position at Newcastle Regional Hospital, KwaZulu-Natal, requiring SANC registration and relevant nursing qualifications with competitive salary and allowances.
jobs.requirements: Senior certificate/ Grade 12. Diploma / Degree in General Nursing. Registration with the South African Nursing Council as a General Nurse and Midwifery. Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate / recognizable experience in Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing and Post Basic qualification in Operating Theatre Technique. Grade 2: A minimum of 4 years appropriate / recognizable experience in Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing of which at least 10 years of the period must be experience in the specific speciality after obtaining the one year Post Basic qualification in Operating Theatre Technique. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Knowledge of nursing care process and procedures, nursing statutes and other relevant legal frameworks. Good verbal and written communication and report writing skills. Co-ordination and liaison skills. Decision making and problem-solving skills. Conflict management and negotiation skills. Ability to prioritize issues and other work-related matters and to comply with timeframes. Ability to understand challenges facing the public sector. Empathy and counselling skills and knowledge. Financial management skills and budgeting knowledge. Team building and supervisory skills. Be able to work under pressure and in a stressful environment. Be innovative and show interest in research processes.
jobs.duties: Provide comprehensive, quality nursing care to patients in a speciality unit in a cost-effective, equitable and efficient manner within the professional/legal framework and standards. Display concern for patients, promoting and advocating timeous, proper treatment and care including awareness and willingness to respond to patient’s needs, requirements and expectations. (Batho Pele). Provide a safe, therapeutic and hygienic environment for colleagues, patients as laid down by the National, Provincial, Professional prescripts and Norms and Standards. Demonstrate effective communication with the patients, patient relatives, supervisors and other clinicians and assist in decision-making about health care delivery. Ensure clear and accurate record keeping of nursing documents. Provision of nursing care that leads to improved service delivery. Participate in the analysis, review and formulation and implementation of policies and procedures. To complete patient-related data and partake in research. Promote quality specialised nursing care as directed by the scope of practice and standards determined by the relevant speciality. Work as a team leader in the absence of the unit manager. To partake in overall specialised unit functions, i.e. team building, and conduct unit-specific audits. Effective and efficient management and utilisation of all resources. To honour rotation to provide and achieve optimum care to patients when allocated and per service delivery needs. To nurse all types of patients regardless of diagnosis and according to disease profile within the nursing directorate. Execute duties and functions with proficiency in support of the vision, mission and strategic objectives of the institution. Maintain professional growth / ethical standards and self-development. Provide emergency care for all life-threatening emergencies. Take charge of the unit during the absence of the Operational Manager in charge and manage the unit accordingly. To protect and advocate the rights of patients regarding health care. Conduct clinical audits and compile summary reports. Ensure accurate reliable statistics and reports are submitted timeously, including care of medical records. Maintain client satisfaction through quality service innovation and professionalism. Participate in the implementation of priority programs and strategies to reduce morbidity, mortality, and communicable and non-communicable diseases. Report and keep clear and accurate records on all procedures done and PSI’s that occur in the unit. Prevent the occurrence of complaints and ensure such complaints are resolved at the immediate level of management. Maintain clinical competency by ensuring that the scientific principles of nursing care are maintained, and observing the principles of Infection Prevention and Control practices. Participate in the development of Quality Improvement Plans and ensure implementation of such. Maintain a professional and ethical nursing practice as well as an enabling environment for ethical practice. Provide direct and indirect supervision of personnel in the unit on day and night duties. Monitor and evaluate the care and management of patients and ensure the maintenance of accurate and complete patient records. Overlook CSSD and Pack room sterility functions. Demonstrate effective and effective peri- operative care nursing. Be dynamic and flexible to be able cope with changes. Be able to work with multi-disciplinary team. ENQURIES : Mrs. N.R. af.title: Beroepsverpleegkundige Spesialiteit Operasiesaal (GRAAD 1
af.summary: Beroepsverpleegkundige spesialiteit operasiesaal pos by Newcastle Regional Hospital, KwaZulu-Natal, wat SANC-registrasie en relevante verpleegkwalifikasies benodig met mededingende salaris en toelaes.
af.requirements: Senior sertifikat/ Graad 12. Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige en Vrouensiekteverpleging. Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in Verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Beroepsverpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde en Post Basiese kwalifikasie in Operasiesaaltegniek. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in Verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Beroepsverpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde waarvan ten minste 10 jaar van die periode ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit moet wees na die verkryging van die een jaar Post Basiese kwalifikasie in Operasiesaaltegniek. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van verpleegsorgproses en prosedures, verpleegstatutes en ander relevante regsraamwerke. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasie en verslagskryfvaardighede. Koördinasie en skakelvaardighede. Besluitneming en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Konflikbestuur en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Vermoë om kwessies en ander werkverwante aangeleenthede te prioriteer en om tydraamsters na te kom. Vermoë om uitdagings wat die openbare sektor in die gesig staar, te verstaan. Empatie en beradingsvaardighede en kennis. Finansiële bestuursvaardighede en begrotingskennis. Spanbou en toesigvaardighede. In staat wees om onder druk en in 'n stresvolle omgewing te werk. Wees innoverend en toon belang in navorsingsprosesse.
af.duties: Verskaf omvattende, gehalte verpleegsorg aan pasiënte in 'n spesialiteiteenheid op 'n kostedoeltreffende, billike en doeltreffende wyse binne die professionele/regtelike raamwerk en standaarde. Toon besorgdheid oor pasiënte, bevorder en pleit betyds, behoorlike behandeling en sorg insluitend bewustheid en gewilligheid om aan pasiënte se behoeftes, vereistes en verwagtinge te voldoen. (Batho Pele). Verskaf 'n veilige, terapeutiese en higiëniese omgewing vir kollegas, pasiënte soos voorgeskryf deur die Nasionale, Provinciale, Professionele voorskrifte en Norme en Standaarde. Demonstreer effektiewe kommunikasie met die pasiënte, pasiëntverwante, toesighouers en ander klinici en help met besluitneming oor gesondheidsorglewering. Verseker duidelike en akkurate rekordhouding van verpleegdokumente. Verskaffing van verpleegsorg wat lei tot verbeterde dienslewering. Neem deel aan die ontleding, hersiening en formulering en implementering van beleide en prosedures. Voltooi pasiëntverwante data en neem deel aan navorsing. Bevorder gehalte gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg soos gerig deur die omvang van praktyk en standaarde bepaal deur die relevante spesialiteit. Werk as 'n spanleier in die afwesigheid van die eenheidsbestuurder. Neem deel aan algehele gespesialiseerde eenheidsfunksies, d.w.s. spanbou, en voer eenheidspesifieke oudite uit. Effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur en benutting van alle hulpbronne. Eer rotasie om optimale sorg aan pasiënte te verskaf en te bereik toegeken en volgens diensleweringbehoeftes. Verpleeg alle tipes pasiënte ongeag diagnose en volgens siekteprofiel binne die verpleegdirektoraat. Voer pligte en funksies uit met bekwaamheid ter ondersteuning van die visie, missie en strategiese doelwitte van die instelling. Handhaaf professionele groei / etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling. Verskaf nood sorg vir alle lewensbedreigende noodgevalle. Neem beheer van die eenheid gedurende die afwesigheid van die Operasionele Bestuurder in beheer en bestuur die eenheid dienooreenkomstig. Beskerm en pleit die regte van pasiënte ten opsigte van gesondheidsorg. Voer kliniese oudite uit en stel opsommingsverslae op. Verseker akkurate betroubare statistieke en verslae word betyds ingedien, insluitend sorg van mediese rekords. Handhaaf kliënttevredenheid deur gehalte diens innovasie en professionaliteit. Neem deel aan die implementering van prioriteitsprogramme en strategieë om morbiditeit, mortaliteit, en oordraagbare en nie-oordraagbare siektes te verminder. Rapporteer en hou duidelike en akkurate rekords van alle prosedures gedoen en PSI's wat in die eenheid voorkom. Voorkom die voorkoms van klagtes en verseker dat sulke klagtes op die onmiddellike vlak van bestuur opgelos word. Handhaaf kliniese bevoegdheid deur te verseker dat die wetenskaplike beginsels van verpleegsorg gehandhaaf word, en deur die beginsels van Infeksievoorkoming en Beheerpraktyke na te kom. Neem deel aan die ontwikkeling van Kwaliteitsverbeteringsplanne en verseker implementering daarvan. Handhaaf 'n professionele en etiese verpleegpraktyk sowel as 'n bemagtigende omgewing vir etiese praktyk. Verskaf direkte en indirekte toesig van personeel in die eenheid op dag- en nagdienste. Monitor en evalueer die sorg en bestuur van pasiënte en verseker die handhawing van akkurate en volledige pasiëntrekords. Hou toesig oor CSSD en Pakkamer steriliteitsfunksies. Demonstreer effektiewe en effektiewe peri-operatiewe sorg verpleegkunde. Wees dinamies en buigsaam om veranderinge te kan hanteer. In staat wees om met multidissiplinêre span te werk. NAVRAE : Mev. N.R. Tshabalala Tel No: (034) 328 0000

zu.title: Isikhundla sokunakekela ababelethi abakhweli ohlinzwa (Grade 1)
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokunakekelwa kwesifo somuntu oqeqeshiwe kwi-Newcastle Regional Hospital, KwaZulu-Natal, esidinga ukubhalwa kwi-South African Nursing Council futhi iziqu ezihlobene nezezezokunakekelwa kwababelethi, kanti kuhamba iholo elifanele kanye namaholo.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samathambo / Isitifikati se-Grade 12. I-diploma / i-degree yokunakekelwa kwendlela eqinile. Ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council njengomunakekeli ohlelele futhi nomhlengi wesifiso. Grade 1: Ubuncane beminyaka eyi-4 yokusebenza okuhlelekile / okuhlobene nendlela yokunakekelwa kwesifiso emva kokubhaliswa njengomunakekeli ohlelele kwi-SANC ekunakekelweni kwendlela eqinile nasekufundeni i-Post Basic qualification ku-Operating Theatre Technique. Grade 2: Ubuncane beminyaka eyi-4 yokusebenza okuhlelekile / okuhlobene nendlela yokunakekelwa kwesifiso emva kokubhaliswa njengomunakekeli ohlelele kwi-SANC ekunakekelweni kwendlela eqinile kuleyo okumele kube yiminyaka eyi-10 yokusebenza esimeni esikhulu uma kushiwo i-Post Basic qualification eyodwa eyikhulu ekubhekeni kweminyaka eyi-1 yokuqonda ukwelapha. Isikhalo, izindlela, ukulolonga kanye nezezezinto ezidingekayo: Isikhalo sezinto ezimali nezindlela ezithile ekunakekelweni, izincazelo zokunakekelwa kanye nemithelela emikhulu ehlobene. Izindlela ezihle zokuxhumana ngesiZulu nangesiNgisi kanye nokuqwelisa imibiko. Izindlela zokubumba iqhaza kanye nezindlela zokuthembana nabanye. Izindlela zokuthatha izinqumo kanye nokuqonda izinkinga. Izindlela zokuphatha izingxabano kanye nokuqondana nabanye. Ukukwazi ukuqagela okubaluleke kakhulu futhi nakwezinye izinto ezihlobene nomsebenzi kanye nokuphumelela ngemithelela yesikhathi. Ukukwazi ukuqonda izinkinga ezibhekwa yizinsizakalo zomphakathi. Ukuzwela kanye nokuqonda izindlela zokweluleka abanye. Izindlela zokuphatha imali kanye nesikhalo sokwakha isikhwama semali. Izindlela zokwakha iqembu kanye nokuphatha abasebenzi. Ukukwazi ukusebenza emaphansi kukanqenqenganqa emandla futhi nasemaphoyisa amaningi. Ukukwazi ukubona kanye nokuqonda izinto ezintsha futhi ukuba nentshisekelo ekwakheni izinhlelo ezintsha.
zu.duties: Faka kanzima ukunakekelwa kwababelethi okuyikhithi futhi kunothando kunalokho okhokhelwa kahle, okulingana futhi okusebenza kahle endleleni eqinisekiswa ngemithesho nezinkomba ezithile kanye nendlela eqinisekiswa yikhalenda lezokwelapha. Bonisa ukuzwa ngababelethi, ukukhuthaza futhi ukusiza ekutheni kuhlinzwe futhi kunakekelwa ngokushesha futhi kahle kubandakanya ukwazi futhi ukubekezela ekuphendula izidingo, izinto ezingadingeki futhi ethile ababelethi abazifisayo. (Batho Pele). Faka isikhungo esihle, esiphilisayo futhi esicocekile for abasebenzi, ababelethi njengoba kubekwe ngumthetho weSifunda, wesifunda, ngabasebenzi futhi nangemithethonqubo nezinkomba. Bonisa ukuxhumana okuhle nabezinye, izihambi zababelethi, abaphathi kanye nalabo ababelana nabo ukwelapha futhi usize ekutheni kuthathwe izinqumo ngokuhlinzwa kwempilo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kushicilelo okuyiqiniso futhi okuhlanjwe kahle kwamadokhenda ekhaya. Ukuhlela kokunakekelwa kwababelethi okuholela ekutheni kutholakale imiphumo engcono. Bamba iqhaza ekucwazisweni, ukuphenyweni futhi ekwakheni nasekuqedeni imitheshonqubo futhi ekwenzeni ibe yinto esetshenziswa. Ukuqedela izincazelo zababelethi futhi bamba iqhaza ekuhlweni. Khuthaza inqubo yokunakekelwa kwababelethi okukhuthazwa kabanzi njengoba kubekiwe yisibalo samabutho futhi nangemithethonqubo esetshenziswa. Sebenza njengomholi wegemu lapho engekho enye yabaphathi. Bamba iqhaza kumasevisi onke aphansi kweli nhlobo, njengokwakha iqembu, futhi ukwenza ukuhlolwa okuncike esimeni esikhulu. Ukuphatha futhi ukusebenzisa ngokuhlakuleka konke okuyimpahla. Ukuvuma ukuya kolunye ukuze kube nokutholakala kwesimo esingcono kubabelethi uma kuthunywe futhi njengoba kudingwa yisikhungo. Ukunakekela bonke ababelethi kungakhathaliseki isifo futhi njengoba kubekiwe yisibalo sesifo phansi kobuso bekhono lokunakekela ababelethi. Yenza imisebenzi futhi nokunye ngokuhlakuleka ekuxhaseni isiqondiso, umgomo futhi nemigomo yendawo yokusebenza. Gcina ukukhula ngobuchwepheshe futhi ngokuziphilisa kwakho. Faka isibonelo sekhalenda lezokwelapha uma kunosimo esibi ngempela. Qhuba ibhathi ngesikhathi engakho enye yabaphathi bokuqonda futhi ulibonge ngokohlelo lwayo. Ukuvikela futhi ukukhuthaza amalungu ababelethi ekutheni bathole ukwelaphwa ngempilo. Hlela ukuhlolwa kwezokwelapha futhi wakhe imibalo eqinisekiswe kahle. Qinisekisa ukuthi izibalo ezifanele futhi ezithembisayo zitholakala ngokushesha, kubandakanya ukugcinwa kwesikhungu semibhalo yokwelapha. Gcina ukwaneliseka kwabasebenzisi ngokuhlinzwa okungcono futhi nangokuhlakuleka. Bamba iqhaza ekwenzeni izinhlelo ezibalulekile kanye nezinye izinhla zokunciphisa ukubhebhetheka kwesifo nokufa kwababelethi, kanye nezifo ezithathelana nabantu futhi ezingathathelani nabantu. Bika futhi ugcine izibalo ezihlanjwe kahle futhi ezifanele ngayo yonke imisebenzi eyenziwe futhi ezinto ezenzeka esimeni esibhebhethekayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi kungekho izifiso ezithile futhi uma zikhona ziphathwe ngokushesha esimeni esingaqondiswa kahle. Gcina ukukhula ngobuchwepheshe ngokuhlola izincazelo ezifundwa kabanzi futhi ngokugcina imithethonqubo yokwelapha ehle futhi ehlanjwe kahle futhi ngokuqapha imithethonqubo yokuhlonza futhi nokuqinisekisa ukungangcoliki. Bamba iqhaza ekuqedeni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa inqubo yokunakekela futhi qinisekisa ukuthi zisetshenziswa. Gcina ukusebenza ngobuchwepheshe futhi ngokuhlonipha kwabasebenzi kanye nokwakha isimo esikhululekile futhi esingangenwa moya ongcolile. Yenza ukuphatha ngokuqondisa futhi ngokungaqondisi abasebenzi esimeni nosuku nokusiku. Qapha futhi uhlolo lokunakekelwa nokuphathwa kwababelethi futhi qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwemibalo eqinisekiswe kahle futhi eqeda yonke imibalo yababelethi. Qapha futhi ukusebenza kwe-CSSD nendawo yokupakisha futhi uqinisekise ukuthi izinto zicoceke. Bonisa ukwelapha okuhle futhi okuyiqiniso kwababelethi esimeni sokuhlinzwa. Yiba nokuhlakanipha futhi ubengumuntu ongaguquguquki ukuba ukwazi ukubhekana nezinto ezisha. Yiba nokusebenza ngokuhle ngokuhlangana nabalabo abahlukaneko ngemisebenzi. UBUZU: Nkosikazi N.R. xh.title: Umongikazi weGazwe yeNsele (Inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Isithuba somongikazi ohlotiweyo kwindawo yokusebenza kwezokwelaphwa iindwelinco eNewcastle Regional Hospital, KwaZulu-Natal, sifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC nemvume yamagazwe okongikazi ahambelana nesiithuba, ngomvuzo ongentengiso namaxabiso ahambelana nayo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSini / Inqanaba le-12. Idiploma / Isidanga kwiNkqubo eYilwayo yeNgangathwa. Ukubhalisa iSouth African Nursing Council njengoGqirha weGazwe loMongikazi kaBaNtuna bokubeletha. Inqanaba 1: Ukhetho olungangatshatshadi kwiminyaka elinganiselwa kwi-4 yamava ahambelana / ahlonithekayo kwiNkqubo eYilwayo yeNgangathwa emva kokubhalisa njengoGqirha weGazwe loMongikazi e-SANC kwiNkqubo eYilwayo yeNgangathwa nokuqedela isidanga sengangaphakathi seMfundo yeNqanaba ePhakamileyo kwindima yokusebenza kwezokusebenza kwendlu yokudibana nemigama. Inqanaba 2: Ukhetho olungangatshatshadi kwiminyaka elinganiselwa kwi-4 yamava ahambelana / ahlonithekayo kwiNkqubo eYilwayo yeNgangathwa emva kokubhalisa njengoGqirha weGazwe loMongikazi e-SANC kwiNkqubo eYilwayo yeNgangathwa apho kufuneka kube nonyaka we-10 wesiquphela obekelwe ukusebenza ohlotiweyo emva kokuqeqeshwa kwangonyaka kwindawo yokusebenza kwendlu yokudibana nemigama. Ulwazi, Amanyathi, Iqeqesho Namandla Okusebenza Abalulekileyo: Ulwazi ngendlela nendlela yokukhothoza nokonga iindwelinco, izigaba zeMithetho yokongikazi nolunye ulwazi malunga nemithetho ekhoyo. Amanyathi amaninzi ekwazisana nokuwroteya iirepothi nokuvela ngezihlwini. Amanyathi okulungelelanisa noKumanyano. Amandla okwenza iigqibo nokusombulula iingxaki. Amanyathi okulawula iingxabano noKumanyano neNgxaki. Amandla okubeka kuqala iingxaki nezinye izinto ezinxulumene nomsebenzi nokuzalathisa kwexesha. Amandla okuqonda iingxaki ezibhekisa kumphakamo kaRhamente. Ukuziphatha ngokuqhawula noLwazi loKumanyano neNgcebiso. Amanyathi okulawula iimali nolwazi ngokuqwalasela imali. Amanyathi okwakha iqela nokuqondisa. Ukuba namandla okusebenza ngaphantsi kwenkqubo ephithizelayo nendawo enkqubela phantsi. Ukuba nobuchule bokwenza izinto ngokutsha nokubonisa inzulu yokukhathalele inkqubo yokuphanda.
xh.duties: Kwela nkqubo ephakamileyo ngokwentsika, ukukhothoza iindwelinco eze ngokwentsika ngexabiso elingazinzi, ngokulingana ngenkqubo ethile ngaphantsi kommandla weGazwe /ngokwemithetho nezigaba. Ukubonisa ukukhathalela iindwelinco, ukuthuthuzela nokukhuthaza ukunikwa kwexesha, ukukhothoza okufanelekileyo nokukhathalela nokuziphendulela kwiimfuno ezifunwa ngumntu, iimfuno nolindelo lwakhe. (Batho Pele). Kubonelele ngenkundla ekhuselekileyo, nepholileyo nendlula ethile kwizakhamzi, iindwelinco njengoko kuchazwe nguRhumente weSizwe, oRhumente wePhondo, namaGazwe amaninzi nokuQwalasela iNkqubo. Bonisa ukuchuma ekwazisana neendwelinco, oohlobo beendwelinco, oonotshebeziwo nabanye oodokotela bexesha ukuba bancede ekwenzeni iigqibo malunga neNkqubo yokunika iindwelinco. Qinisekisa ukuwroteya okucacileyo nokuchanileyo kwezixhobo ezibhalwayo zokukhathalela iindwelinco. Ukunikwa kwamava okukhathalela okuholela ekuphuculweni kwenkqubo. Ngenxa yokukhanka kweso somphakathi ekuyiqhingqo lokuqwalasela iinkqubo zentsika kwaye ukuyiphume ezinkqubo eQwalaselwayo zeGazwe namava. Ukuphumelela kweso sixhobo esiQwalaselwa kweso siphakathi ekuphando. Ukuba ngumkhosi kwindawo ethile ngokwentsika efana nesikhokelo esinikwa yiNkqubo yentsika neSigaba esinokwenziwa nguRhumente. Ukuba ngumkhosi webhodi xa engekho oyena mphathi. Ukwenza izinto ezinxulumene nemisebenzi yendawo ethile, oko kukuthi, ukwakha iqela, kwaye uqhube iNkqubo eQwalaselwa kweso sixhobo esithile. Ukulawula nokusebenzisa zonke izixhobo ngokuchanileyo nangexesha elifanelekileyo. Ukuzinikela ekujikelweni kwemisebenzi ukunika amava abalulekileyo kumntu onelayithensi. Ukukhathalela zonke iindwelinco ngokwemfuno yamathempu ngaphandle kwezigulo ezikho ngezigulo ngokweNkqubo yeGazwe. Ukwenza imisebenzi ngokuchanileyo nokuza nendlela yokulawula ukuze kuxhamkele iNkqubo noMhla wokuthi kube njani. Ukugcina ukukhula kwamava / amagama esiGqibo nokuzithuthuzela. Ukunikela ngeNkqubo yokukhuluma ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Ukuba ngumlawuli welayithensi xa engekho umlawuli oNqamlezileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iNkqubo ekuyiqhingqo ithunyelwa ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Ukukhankanywa kwesizathu sokuqwalasela iinkqubo kwaye iNkqubo iqwalaselwe ngokuchanileyo. jobs.title: Professional Nurse Specialty Paediatrics (GRADE 1-2)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 – R581 931 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 – R752 913 per annum 13th cheque, Plus Medical Aid (Optional), 8% inhospitable allowance, Plus Housing Allowance (Employee must meet prescribed condition)
jobs.summary: Professional nurse specialising in paediatrics sought at Newcastle Regional Hospital to provide quality nursing care and manage unit resources.
jobs.requirements: Senior certificate/ Grade 12. Diploma / Degree in General Nursing. Registration with the South African Nursing Council as a General Nurse and Midwifery. Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate / recognizable experience in Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing and Post Basic qualification in Child Nursing Science. Grade 2: A minimum of 4 years appropriate / recognizable experience in Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing of which at least 10 years of the period must be experience in the specific speciality after obtaining the one year Post Basic qualification in Child Nursing Science. Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competencies Required: Knowledge of nursing care process and procedures, and other legal frameworks. Good verbal and written communication and report writing skills. Decision making and problem-solving skills. Conflict management and negotiation skills.
jobs.duties: Provide comprehensive, quality nursing care to patients/ clients in a specialty unit in a cost effective, efficient manner. Assist in planning, organizing and monitoring of objectives of the specialized unit. Manage resources within the unit effectively and efficiently to ensure optimum service delivery. Able to plan all and organize own work and that of support personnel to ensure proper nursing care. Display a concern for patients, promoting and advocating proper treatment and care including awareness and willingness to respond to patient’s needs, requirements and expectations (Batho Pele). Work as part of the multi- disciplinary team to ensure good nursing care. Demonstrate effective communication with the patient, patient’s relatives, supervisors and other clinicians including report writing when required. Ensure compliance with National, Provincial and professional prescripts in order to render a safe patient service and improve client satisfaction. Participate in the analysis and formulation of nursing policies and procedures. Assist in EPMDS evaluation of staff within the unit and participate in monitoring the training need of staff. Provide direct and indirect supervision of all staff within the unit and give guidance. Order and monitor appropriate level of consumables. Ensure that equipment in the unit is adequate, checked and in working order. Provide for safe, therapeutic and hygienic environment. Assist in orientation, induction and mentoring of all nursing personnel. Demonstrate an understanding of Human Resource and Financial Management Policies and Procedures. Monitor and evaluate the care and management of patient and maintenance of accurate and complete patient’s records. Provision of support to nursing services. ENQURIES : Mrs. N.R. Tshabalala Tel No: (034) 328 0000
jobs.applications: All applications should be posted to: The Recruitment Officer, Newcastle Regional Hospital, Private Bag X6653, Newcastle, 2940 OR can be done on S’thesha Waya-Waya website. Applications: can also be emailed to Thembalami.Zwane@kznhealth.gov.za
