af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit Kindergeneeskunde (GRAAD 1-2)
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige wat in kindergeneeskunde spesialiseer, gesoek by Newcastle Regional Hospital om gehalte verpleegsorg te verskaf en eenheidshulpbronne te bestuur.
af.requirements: Senior certificate/ Grade 12. Diploma / Degree in General Nursing. Registrasie by die South African Nursing Council as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige en Vrouensiekte. Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike / erkende ervaring in Verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging en Post Basic-kwalifikasie in Child Nursing Science. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike / erkende ervaring in Verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging waarvan ten minste 10 jaar van die tydperk ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit moet wees na verkryging van die een jaar Post Basic-kwalifikasie in Child Nursing Science. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding En Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van verpleegsorgproses en prosedures, en ander regsraamwerke. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasie en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Besluitneming en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Konflikbestuur en onderhandelingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf omvattende, gehalte verpleegsorg aan pasiënte/ kliënte in 'n spesialiteiteenheid op 'n koste-effektiewe, doeltreffende wyse. Bystaan in beplanning, organisering en monitering van doelstellings van die gespesialiseerde eenheid. Bestuur hulpbronne binne die eenheid effektief en doeltreffend om optimale dienslewering te verseker. In staat wees om alle werk te beplan en eie werk sowel as dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Toon besorgdheid vir pasiënte, bevorder en beykelê behoorlike behandeling en sorg insluitend bewustheid en bereidwilligheid om op pasiënte se behoeftes, vereistes en verwagtinge te reageer (Batho Pele). Werk as deel van die multi-dissiplinêre span om goeie verpleegsorg te verseker. Demonstreer effektiewe kommunikasie met die pasiënt, pasiënt se familielede, toesighouers en ander klinici insluitend verslagdoening wanneer nodig. Verseker nakoming van Nasionale, Provinciale en professionele voorskrifte om 'n veilige pasiëntediens te lewer en kliëntetevredenheid te verbeter. Neem deel aan die ontleding en formulering van verpleegbeleid en -prosedures. Bystaan in EPMDS-evaluering van personeel binne die eenheid en neem deel aan monitering van die opleidingsbehoeftes van personeel. Verskaf direkte en indirekte toesig oor alle personeel binne die eenheid en gee leiding. Bestel en moniteer toepaslike vlak van verbruiksgoedere. Verseker dat toerusting in die eenheid voldoende is, nagegaan is en in werkende toestand is. Verskaf 'n veilige, terapeutiese en higiëniese omgewing. Bystaan in oriëntering, inductie en mentorskap van alle verpleegpersoneel. Demonstreer 'n begrip van Menslike Hulpbron- en Finansiële Bestuursbeleid en -prosedures. Monitor en evalueer die sorg en bestuur van pasiënt en onderhoud van akkurate en volledige pasiëntrekords. Verskaffing van ondersteuning aan verpleegdienste. NAVRAE : Me. N.R. Tshabalala Tel No: (034) 328 0000

zu.title: Umsizi Wezolimo Ochwepheshe Izindlebe Zezingane (IZIQA 1-2)
zu.summary: Kudingwa umuhlengikazi ochwepheshe ohlolwe izinkinga zezingane eNewcastle Regional Hospital ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kohlelo lokwakha kanye nokuphatha izinsiza zesigaba.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi samatasa / Izinga 12. Isidiploma / I-degree kwezokwelapha kanye nokuqashwa kwabahlinzeki bezempilo. Ukuqashiselwa enkonzweni kahulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika ngesiZulu jikelele. Iqapha ezinye izinkomba ezichazwe kumthethosisekelo ohlinzeka ngokwemiyalelo. Isizinda 1: Ukutholwa kokuqala kwezinhlelo ezilandela ekuphathweni kwesifundo esingenisa inqubo enkulu yokuvakashela izinkathi ezinkulu zendabuko ngeminye imikhakha efanayo ekuphathweni. Isizinda 2: Amafomula ekuphila ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza nemisebenzi ehlotshaniswa nokuqashwa kwabantu abanamakhono ahleliwe ngokwemithetho yesiNgisi njengoba kudingwa njengenhlangano yezempilo ekuphathwa. Ukwaziswa, amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa kanye namakhono okuhlangabezana: Ukukhombisa okucacile ngokwelashwa kwamalunga nomndeni. Ukutholakala kwezinkomba eziyingxenye yamaphoyisa nokususwa kwabahlinzeki bamathuluzi. Ukwenza izinqumo nokuxazulula izinkinga ngokuthi okuhlangenwe nakho. Amakhono okwelashwa amaphuzu acishe alingane namagugu omgomo othile noma kufanele akhombiswe indlela yokuvumelana nokwenza isinqumo.
zu.duties: Nika ukunakekelwa okuphelele nokuhle kokwelapha abagulayo / abathengi esikhungweni sokuhlola izinkinga ngendlela ehle kahle futhi enentengo. Siza ekubeni uhlela, uhlela futhi ulawula izinhloso zesikhungwa esikhethekile. Phatha izinsiza ngaphakathi kwesikhundla ngendlela efanele nangempumelelo ukunikeza inkonzo efinyelelwe. Ukwazi ukucubungula konke futhi ulethe umsebenzi wakho nowabasizi ukunikeza isibopho esikahle. Khombisa ukukhathazeka ngabagulayo, ukuthuthukisa nokukhuthaza isiciko sokwelashwa nokunakekelwa okuhlanganisa ukuqonda nokufuna ukuphendula izidingo zabagulayo, izidingo nokulindzele (Batho Pele). Sebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elihlukene ukunikeza isibopho esihle. Khombisa ukuxhumana kuhle nomgulayi, izihlobo zomgulayi, abaphathi kwezinye izinkomba ezifaka ukubhala umbiko lapho kudingeka. Qinisekisa ukuziphendulela ngemithetho yesiZulu, samaphrovinshi nesezifundazwe ukunikeza inkonzo ephephile yomgulayi. Hlanganyela ekuhlalweni koshintsho lohuho. Phatha amaphuzu abasebenzi abangakapheli bese ekhuliseni imigomo emisha yezinkomba. Hlela ukuphathwa nokuhlola imigomo yohlelo lokusebenza. Siza ekubeni ngumqeqeshi weziqu zomuntu ngamunye. Siza ekubeni nomphi wokuqeqesha abaqashi abasha. Hlola ukuthi athanda ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwesikhundla, ahlole, futhi asebenze kahle. Hlinzeka ngendawo ephephile, ethambisa futhi ehlanza. Phathwa kwemisebenzi ekhethekile yezinhlelo zabasebenzi. Hlola ukuqashwa nokugcina amarekhodi ahlanzekile nomgulayi. Nikela ngokwesekwa kohlelo lokunakekelwa. Imibuzo: Nkosazana N.R. Tshabalala Ucingo: (034) 328 0000.

xh.title: Umongikazi Ochwepheshe Oqheliswe kwiZiko leBantwana (GRADE 1-2)
xh.summary: Kufunwa umongikazi ochwepheshe oqheliswe kwindalo yabantwana eNewcastle Regional Hospital ukunika konke konke umngeni wokusingathwa kolunye uhlobo kwaye alawule izixhobo zesebe.
xh.requirements: Isetifiketi samabanga aphezulu / Grade 12. Idiploma / Isidanga kwiNtengiso yeJolwa. Ubulungu kwiSouth African Nursing Council njengoGqirha weJolwa jikelele nakuMzalezeli. Inqanaba 1: Ubuncinci beminyaka emi-4 yamava afanelekileyo / aqatyiweyo kwiNtengiso emva kokubhalisa njengoMongikazi uchwepheshe kwiSANC kwiNtengiso yeJolwa jikelele nokuGqiba izifundo zePhaphu eBhungcwini lokusingathwa koBantwana. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinci beminyaka emi-4 yamava afanelekileyo / aqatyiweyo kwiNtengiso emva kokubhalisa njengoMongikazi uchwepheshe kwiSANC kwiNtengiso yeJolwa jikelele apho kunokubakho ubuncinci beminyaka eli-10 kwelo xesha kufuneka ibe ngamava kweli candelo ithile emva kokuGqiba unyaka wePhaphu eBhungcwini lokusingathwa koBantwana. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho kwaye namakhono aFunekayo: Ulwazi ngomgcobo wokusingathwa kwezempilo nemigaqo, naye eminye imigaqo yolwango. Amakhono amabalawuli abalulekileyo okuthetha nokubhala kwiphepha lokuxela ngokusembaxweni nokubhala iingxelo. Amakhono okwenza izigqibo nokusombulula iingxaki. Amakhono okulawula ingxabano nokuxoxisana.
xh.duties: Nika konke konke, umngeni wokusingathwa wezempilo ogqwesileyo kumaguli / abathengi kwisebe esichwepheshileyo ngendlela ehlawulisekayo, esebenza kakuhle. Nceda kuqeqesho, uqulunqe ulwazi lwangaphakathi nokuqwalasela iinjongo zesebe esichwepheshileyo. Lawula izixhobo ngaphakathi kwesebe ngokusebenza kakuhle nangokuchanekileyo ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho inkonzo egqithisileyo. Yiba nakho ukuqulunqa yonke imisebenzi yakho nokuqulunqa imisebenzi yabancedisi ukuqinisekisa ukusingathwa kolunye uhlobo oluchanekileyo. Bonisa inkathalo ngamaguli, ukukhuthaza nokuxhasa ukwelatwa nokusingathwa okuchanekileyo kuquka ukuqonda nokuzibophelela ukuphendula iimfuno, iimfuno nemithelela yamaguli (Batho Pele). Sebenza njengenxalenye yeqela elisebenza ngokuhlangeneyo ukuqinisekisa ukusingathwa kolunye uhlobo oluhle. Bonisa ukunyaniseka ekuthetheni namaguli, abazala bamaguli, abalawuli nabanye bachwepheshe bezempilo kuquka nokubhala iingxelo xa kufuneka. Qinisekisa ukuthobela imigaqo yesizwe, yephondo n eyabachwepheshe ukuze unike inkonzo ekhuselekileyo yamaguli ukuphucula uthabathe kakhulu abathengi. Thatha inxaxheba kuqwalaselo nokwenza imigaqo nangokusembaxweni kwezempilo. Nceda kwiqwalaselo leEPMDS yabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwesebe uthathe inxaxheba ekujoliseni iimfuno zeqeqesho zabasebenzi. Nikezela ngokulawula ngqo nangokungalawulanga ngqo bonke abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwesebe unike imikhokelo. Faka ioda uze ulawule inqanaba elifanelekileyo lezinto ezithengwayo. Qinisekisa ukuba iresipontisi kwisebe yanele, iphialwe kwaye isebenza kakuhle. Nikezela indawo ekhuselekileyo, eyaphila kwaye ihlanzekileyo. Nceda ekwaziseni, ekungeniseni nasekukhokeleni bonke abasebenzi bazojongoe ngendlela yokusingathwa kolunye uhlobo. Bonisa ukuqonda kweZixhobo zeBantu nokuLawula kwemali emithetho nangokusembaxweni. Qwalasela uze ulinganise ukusingathwa nokulawula amaguli kwaye ugcine irekhodi echanekileyo neyanelisa yamaguli. Nikela ngenkxaso kwiinkonzo zokusingathwa kwezempilo. IIMBUZO : Nkosazana N.R. Tshabalala Inombolo yefowuni: (034) 328 0000

jobs.title: Lecturer- (GRADE 1, Grade 2) (NEPHROLOGY Nursing Science
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum plus 13th cheque, medical aid (optional), Homeowners allowance (employee must meet the prescribed requirements
jobs.summary: Lecturer in Nephrology Nursing Science at Grey's Hospital, Pietermaritzburg, requiring nursing qualifications and SANC registration to train student nurses.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Grade 12 Plus A Diploma/Degree in General Nursing, Community, Psychiatric & Midwifery that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse Plus A post registration qualification in Nursing Education registered with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) Plus A Post Basic Qualification in Nephrology Nursing Science registered with SANC Current Registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) 2026 Plus A minimum of four (4) years appropriate/recognizable experience after registration as a Professional Nurse with the South African Nursing Council in General Nursing (in the case of grade 1 PND 1) Or A minimum of fourteen (14) years appropriate/recognizable experience after registration as a Professional Nurse with the South African Nursing Council in General Nursing of which ten (10) years of the period referred to above must be appropriate / recognizable experience in Nursing Education after obtaining the 1 year post-basic qualification (in the case of grade 2 PND 2) NB (Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of all documents and certificate of Service endorsed by Human Resources) The Employment Equity Target For This Post Is: African Male, Coloured Male, White Male, White Female Additional Information Required: Unendorsed valid Code EB driver’s licence (code 08) Master’s degree in Nursing Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competencies Required: Possess knowledge of Public Service Administration Acts and Legislation such as Health Act, Higher Education Act, SAQA Act, NQF, Nursing Act, Rules and Regulations, Council on Higher Education Policies, College Policies, PSR, Disciplinary Code and Procedure, Labour Relations Act, etc. Possess sound knowledge and understanding of nursing code of ethics and professional practice of the South African Nursing Council. Thorough knowledge and understanding of Nursing Standard of Practice and Scope of Practice. Possess knowledge of curriculum development and review. Knowledge of procedures and processes related to co-ordination of Post Graduate Diploma in Nephrology Nursing. Possess proficiency in teaching and assessment in Nursing Education. Possess sound knowledge of planning, scheduling, implementation of Nephrology Nursing training programme Possess sound conflict and decision-making/problem solving skills. Have good research and analytical skills. Have excellent communication and presentation skills (both verbal and written). Computer literacy with proficiency in MS Office package, Excel, Power Point and Outlook. Good interpersonal relations. Ability to work within set deadlines. Proficiency in teaching and assessment of Post Graduate Diploma in Nephrology Nursing evaluation approaches. Possess good communication (written & verbal) and presentation skills.
jobs.duties: Provide education and training to student nurses. Coordinate clinical learning exposure of student nurses between campus and clinical areas. Support the mission and promote the image of the college. Implement assessment strategies to determine student nurses’ competencies Exercise control over student nurses Participate in quality assurance programs Participate in policy analysis, development and implementation. Development and review of nursing curricula for Nephrology Nursing Implement the new nursing programs in line with SANC and CHE regulations Participates in the provisioning of continuous Professional Development activities at the Campus Participates in all government structures of the College.

af.title: Lektor - (GRADE 1, Grade 2) (NEPHROLOGY Nurstenskap
af.summary: Lektor in Nefrologie Nurstenskap by Grey's Hospital, Pietermaritzburg, wat verpleegkwalifikasies en SANC-registrasie vereis om verpleegstudente op te lei.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate/Grade 12 Plus 'n Diploma/Degree in Algemene Verpleegkunde, Gemeenskap, Psigiatrie en Vroedkunde wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat Plus 'n Post-registrasie-kwalifikasie in Verpleegopleiding wat by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) geregistreer is Plus 'n Post-Basiese Kwalifikasie in Nefrologie Nurstenskap wat by SANC geregistreer is Huidige registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) 2026 Plus 'n Minimum van vier (4) jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die South African Nursing Council in Algemene Verpleegkunde (in die geval van grade 1 PND 1) Of 'n Minimum van veertien (14) jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die South African Nursing Council in Algemene Verpleegkunde waarvan tien (10) jaar van bogenoemde periode gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in Verpleegopleiding moet wees na die verwerwing van die 1-jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie (in die geval van grade 2 PND 2) NB (Slegs gekorte lys kandidate sal vereis word om bewys van alle dokumente en 'n dienssertifikaat wat deur Menslike Hulpbronne geëndorseer is, voor te lê) Die Indiensneming Billikheidsteiken vir hierdie pos is: African Male, Coloured Male, White Male, White Female Addisionele inligting vereis: Ongeëndorseerde geldige Code EB-bestuurslisensie (code 08) Meestersgraad in Verpleegkunde Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Kompetensies vereis: Beskik oor kennis van Openbare Diensadministrasiewette en -wetgewing soos die Health Act, Higher Education Act, SAQA Act, NQF, Nursing Act, Reëls en Regulasies, Council on Higher Education-beleide, Kollegebeleid, PSR, Dissiplinêre Kode en Prosedure, Labour Relations Act, ens. Beskik oor deeglike kennis en begrip van die verpleegkode van etiek en professionele praktyk van die South African Nursing Council. Deeglike kennis en begrip van Verpleegstandaarde vanpraktyk en die Omvang van Praktyk. Beskik oor kennis van kurrikulumontwikkeling en hersiening. Kennis van prosedures en prosesse verbonde aan die koördinering van die Post Graduate Diploma in Nephrology Nursing. Beskik oor vaardigheid in onderrig en assessering in Verpleegopleiding. Beskik oor deeglike kennis van beplanning, skedulering en implementering van die Nefrologie Verpleegkunde-opleidingsprogram. Beskik oor goeie konflikhanterings-, besluitnemings- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Het goeie navorsings- en analitiese vaardighede. Het uitstekende kommunikasie- en aanbiedingsvaardighede (sowel mondeling as skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardigheid met beheersing van MS Office-pakket, Excel, PowerPoint en Outlook. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Vermoë om binne vasgestelde sperdatums te werk. Vaardigheid in onderrig en assessering van evaluasiebenaderings vir die Post Graduate Diploma in Nephrology Nursing. Beskik oor goeie kommunikasie- (skriftelik en mondeling) en aanbiedingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf onderwys en opleiding aan verpleegstudente. Koördineer kliniese leersistelingsblootstelling van verpleegstudente tussen die kampus en kliniese areas. Ondersteun die sending en bevorder die beeld van die kollege. Implementeer assesseringsstrategieë om die bevoegdhede van verpleegstudente te bepaal. Oefen beheer uit oor verpleegstudente. Neem deel aan gehalteversekeringsprogramme. Neem deel aan beleidsontleding, -ontwikkeling en -implementering. Ontwikkeling en hersiening van verpleegkurrikula vir Nefrologie Verpleegkunde. Implementeer die nuwe verpleegprogramme in ooreenstemming met SANC- en CHE-regulasies. Neem deel aan die voorsiening van deurlopende Professionele Ontwikkelingsaktiwiteite by die Kampus. Neem deel aan alle regeringsstrukture van die Kollege.

zu.title: Onjiniyela- (GRADE 1, Grade 2) (NEPHROLOGY Nursing Science
zu.summary: Onjiniyela kwe-Nephrology Nursing Science e-Grey's Hospital, Pietermaritzburg, ofuna iziqu zokuhlonza kanye nokubhaliswa ku-SANC ukuze kafundise abafundi bokuhlonza.
zu.requirements: Senior Certificate/Grade 12 kanye ne-Diploma/Degree kwi-General Nursing, Community, Psychiatric & Midwifery evumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoba ngu-Professional Nurse kanye nokuqinisekiswa okubhalisiwe kokuhlonza emumva kokubhaliswa kwi-Nursing Education kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) kanye ne-Post Basic Qualification kwi-Nephrology Nursing Science ebhalisiwe ku-SANC Ukubhaliswa kwangoku kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) 2026 kanye nokuhlola okuncane kweminyaka emine (4) kokuhlonza ngemva kokubhaliswa njengoba ngu-Professional Nurse kwi-South African Nursing Council kwi-General Nursing (kwelime le-grade 1 PND 1) Noma ukuhlola okuncane kweminyaka eyishuminane (14) okuhlonzayo/emumva kokubhaliswa njengoba ngu-Professional Nurse kwi-South African Nursing Council kwi-General Nursing lapho iminyaka yeshumi (10) yaleso sikhathi okushiwo ngenhla kumele ibe yihlolo lokuhlonza/emumva kokuthola i-post-basic qualification yonyaka owodwa (kwelime le-grade 2 PND 2) NB (Kuphela abagqinsi abakhethiwe abazofuneka ukuthi bethule ubufakazi bazo yonke imibhalo kanye ne-Certificate of Service egunyaziwe yi-Human Resources) I-Employment Equity Target Yalesi Sikhwundla Yile: African Male, Coloured Male, White Male, White Female Ulwazi Olwengeziwe Olufunwayo: I-Code EB driver's licence (code 08) ehlukanisiwe ethi lisebenza i-Master's degree kwi-Nursing Ulwazi, Amafunda, Ukuqeqeshwa Nekhono Elidingekayo: Ukuba nolwazi lwe-Public Service Administration Acts and Legislation njenge-Health Act, Higher Education Act, SAQA Act, NQF, Nursing Act, Rules and Regulations, Council on Higher Education Policies, College Policies, PSR, Disciplinary Code and Procedure, Labour Relations Act, njll. Ukuba nolwazi oluhle nokuqonda ikhodi yokuhlonza yabahlonza kanye nokusebenza okukhulu kokuhlonza kwe-South African Nursing Council. Ulwazi oluqotho nokuqonda i-Nursing Standard of Practice kanye ne-Scope of Practice. Ukuba nolwazi lokuthuthukisa kanye nokubuyekeza ikharikhulamu. Ulwazi lwenqubo kanye namanye amaphathi ahlobene nokuhlanganisa i-Post Graduate Diploma kwi-Nephrology Nursing. Ukuba nokukghona ukufundisa kanye nokuqagula kwi-Nursing Education. Ukuba nolwazi oluhle lokuqamba, ukulungisa isikhathi, nokuphumeza uhlelo lokuqeqeshwa kwe-Nephrology Nursing Ukuba nolwazi oluhle lokuxazulula izingxabano kanye nokwenza izinqumo/ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuba namafunda ayouhlolo nokuqagula mahle. Ukuba namakhono mahle okuxhumana kanye nokuhamba kahle (okubhalayo nokukhulunwayo). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngokuqonda okuhle kwi-MS Office package, Excel, Power Point kanye ne-Outlook. Ukuba nokuxhumana kahle nomunye nomunye. Ukukghona ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekelwe. Ukukghona ukufundisa kanye nokuqagula izindlela zokuqagula i-Post Graduate Diploma kwi-Nephrology Nursing. Ukuba nolwazi oluhle lokuxhumana (okubhalayo nokukhulunwayo) kanye namakhono okuhamba kahle.
zu.duties: Nikela nolwazi kanye nokuqeqesha abafundi bokuhlonza. Hlanganisa isikhathi sokufunda okubonakalayo kwabafundi bokuhlonza phakathi kwekhampasi kanye namabhala okuhlonza. Sekela umqondo kanye nokuthuthukisa isithombe sekholishi. Phumeza izindlela zokuqagula ukuze uqinise amakhono abafudi bokuhlonza Lawula abafundi bokuhlonza Thatha inxaxheba kumaphrogramu emithombo yokwenza okuhle Thatha inxaxheba kukuqagula inqubo, ukuthuthukisa nokuphumeza. Ukuthuthukisa nokubuyekeza amakharihhulamu okuhlonza we-Nephrology Nursing Phumeza amaphrogramu amasha okuhlonza ngokuhambisana nemithetho ye-SANC ne-CHE Lathatha inxaxheba ekunikeni izenzo ze-Professional Development ezinqwabelanako e-Campus Lathatha inxaxheba kuzo zonke izakhiwo zahulumeni ze-College.

Ulwazi lwekhompyutha ngobuchule kwi-MS Office package, Excel, Power Point kwaye no-Outlook. Ukuba namakhono amabenzi wokuziphatha kakuhle nabantu. Ukuba nokuqamba ukusebenza ngexesha elixesiweyo. Ubuchule bokufundisa nokuqeqesha kwi-Post Graduate Diploma kwiNephrology Nursing nokuqonda iindlela zokuqaphela. Ukuba nolwazi olusigqithisileyo lokubhala nokuthetha nokuqamba iindlela zokubonisa.
xh.duties: Nika imfundo noQeqesho abafundi basebingcali lokhusela. Qondanisa ulwazi olufundwayo lwabafundi basebingcali phakathi kwekhasi nakummandla wonyuso. Sebenzela inkqubo nokuqinisekisa umbono wekholeji. Sebenzisa iindlela zokuqaphela ukuqonda ubuchule babafundi basebingcali Lokhusela Lawula abafundi basebingcali Lokhusela Thatha inxaxheba kumaxhego wokuqinisekisa umgangatho Thatha inxaxheba kwandiso lwezigqibo, ekuthi ngowuphi na umthetho nokuwusebenzisa. Ekuthi ngowuphi na nokuphonononga imithetho yokhusela yeNephrology Nursing Qamba iinkqubo zokhusela ezintsha ngokulandela imigaqo yeSANC ne-CHE Thatha inxaxheba ekunikezeni ngezinto ezininzi ezingunyononono lokuQeqeshwa ngobuGqirana eKhasi Thatha inxaxheba kuzo zonke iinkqubo zoRhulumente zeKholeji.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Specialty
jobs.centre: Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital
jobs.city: Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 – R581 931 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 – R752 913 per annum Other Benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (Optional) & Housing Allowance (Employees to meet the Prescribe requirements)
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse Specialty position at Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring SANC registration and four to fourteen years of nursing experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 (fourteen) years appropriate/ recognizable experience in Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing of which at least 10 (ten) years of the period referred above must be appropriate/recognizable experience in the speciality after obtaining 1 (one) year post basic qualification in relevant speciality. Senior Certificate or equivalent. Degree/Diploma in General nursing. A relevant one (01) year Post Basic qualification in Operating Theatre Nursing Science. Registration certificate with South African Nursing Council (SANC). Current SANC receipt (2026). A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognisable experience after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competence Required: Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal framework. Good communication skills-verbal and written. Co-ordination and liaison skills. Problem solving skills and critical thinking skills. Ability to work within the multidisciplinary team. Maintain Professional growth/ethical standard and self-development. Assist in reduction of complaints within the directorate.
jobs.duties: Effective management of patients, display a concern for patients, promoting and advocating. Proper treatment and care including awareness and willingness to respond to patient’s needs, requirements and expectations. Provision of quality services through setting of standards, policies and procedures. Participate in the implementation of National Priorities clinical guidelines, protocols. Maintain accurate and complete patient records according to legal requirements. Exercise control over discipline, grievance and labour relations issues. Promote good working relationships amongst staff and patients. Assist in supervision and development of all nursing staff. Reduction of maternal and child mortality and morbidity rate. Ensure effective participation in all hospital programs e.g. IPC, Quality Assurance, etc. Provide a Safe, therapeutic and hygienic environment for patients, visitors and staff.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs YYN Ngema: Assistant Manager Nursing – Dr PKISMH Tel No: (031) 530
jobs.applications: To be hand delivered to 310 Bhejane Street (Hospital Gate Number 2) Kwamashu or emailed to: pixley.recruitment@kznhealth.gov.za or Couriered To: 310 Bhejane Street (Hospital Gate Number 2) Kwamashu FOR ATTENTION : Deputy Director: HRM
jobs.notes: The Employment Equity Target for the posts above is an African Male. The following documents must be submitted, Application for employment form (Z83), which is obtainable at any Government Department or form website- www.kznhealth.gov.za. Originally signed Z83 must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of current/previous work experience endorsed and stamped by Human Resource Department & other required documents. Applications must be submitted on or before the closing date. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83 e.g. DPKISMH 14/2023. NB: Failure to comply with the above instruction will disqualify applicants. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Due to the number of applications anticipated, applications will not be acknowledged. Correspondence will be limited to short listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within two months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from NIA to the following checks (security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience employment verifications and verification from the company Intellectual Property (CIPC). The Department reserves the right not to fill the post (s). This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative employer, whose aim is to promote representivity in all levels of all occupational categories in the Department. Persons with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit pos by Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, waarvoor SANC-registrasie en vier tot veertien jaar verpleegervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenningswaardige ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 (veertien) jaar toepaslike/erkenningswaardige ervaring in Verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging waarvan ten minste 10 (tien) jaar van bogenoemde periode toepaslike/erkenningswaardige ervaring in die spesialiteit moet wees na verkryging van 1 (een) jaar postbasiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Senior Sertifikaat of ekwivalent. Graad/Diploma in Algemene verpleging. 'n Ter sake een (01) jaar Postbasiese kwalifikasie in Operasiesaal-verpleegkunde. Registrasiesertifikaat met die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad (SANC). Huidige SANC-kwitansie (2026). 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenningswaardige ervaring na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Vereiste Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegwetgewing en ander tersaaklike regskader. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede-mondelings en skriftelik. Koördinasie- en skakelvaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede en kritiese denkvaardighede. Vermoë om binne die multidissiplinêre span te werk. Handhaaf professionele groei/etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling. Bystand verleen tot vermindering van klagtes binne die direktoraat.
af.duties: Effektiewe bestuur van pasiënte, toon sorg vir pasiënte, bevordering en voorspraak. Behoorlike behandeling en sorg insluitend bewustheid en bereidwilligheid om op pasiënte se behoeftes, vereistes en verwagtings te reageer. Verskaffing van gehaltdienste deur die instelling van standaarde, beleide en prosedures. Deelneem aan die implementering van Nasionale Prioriteite kliniese riglyne, protokolle. Onderhou akkurate en volledige pasiëntrekords ooreenkomstig wetlike vereistes. Oefen beheer uit oor dissipline, klagtes en arbeidsverhoudingsake. Bevorder goeie werkverhoudinge tussen personeel en pasiënte. Bystand verleen aan toezig en ontwikkeling van alle verpleegpersoneel. Vermindering van moeder- en kindersterfte en -morbiditeitskoers. Verseker effektiewe deelname aan alle hospitaalprogramme bv. IPC, Kwaliteitsversekering, ens. Verskaf 'n veilige, terapeutiese en higiëniese omgewing vir pasiënte, besoekers en personeel.

zu.title: Unesi Ohlolwa Ngobuchwepheshe
zu.summary: Isikhundla sonesi ohlolwa ngobuchwepheshe esibhedlela i-Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal, esidinga ukubhaliswa ku-SANC nokuba namava eminye yamashumi amane kuya kwayisikhombisa neshumi emsebenzini wokwelusa.
zu.requirements: Grade 1: Okungenani amava eminyaka emi-4 ahambisana/okubonakalayo emsebenzini wokwelusa ngemuva kokubhalisa njengonesi ohlolwa ngobuchwepheshe ne-SANC ekweluseni jikelele. Grade 2: Okungenani amava eminyaka eyi-14 (eyishumi nane) ahambisana/okubonakalayo ekweluseni ngemuva kokubhalisa njengonesi ohlolwa ngobuchwepheshe ne-SANC ekweluseni jikelele, okuhlanganisa okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 (eshumi) ebekwe ngaphezulu kumele ibe amava ahambisana/okubonakalayo enkundleni yobuchwepheshe ngemuva kokuthola isitifiketi somnyaka owodwa (1) sokufundela ngemuva kwesidingo esisisekelo enkundleni yobuchwepheshe ehambisana. Senior Certificate noma okulinganayo. I-Degree/Diploma ekweluseni jikelele. Isitifiketi somnyaka owodwa (01) sokufundela ngemuva kwesidingo esisisekelo enkundleni yobuchwepheshe ekuSayensi Lokwelusa Kwigumbi Lokuhlinza. Isitifiketi sokubhalisa ne-South African Nursing Council (SANC). Ukwaziswa kwamanje ko-SANC (2026). Okungenani amava eminyaka emi-4 ahambisana/okubonakalayo ngemuva kokubhalisa njengonesi ohlolwa ngobuchwepheshe ne-SANC ekweluseni jikelele. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa nokuQonde Okudingekayo: Ulwazi ngemikhuba nendlela yokwelusa ngokunakekelwa kwabaguli, izimoto zokwelusa, nezinye izakhiwo zomthetho ezihambisana. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle-botho-okubhaliwe nokukhulunywa. Amakhono okuhlela futhi axhumane. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga kanye namakhono okucabanga ngokujulile. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphakathi kwethimba elihlangene. Ukugcina ukukhula komsebenzi/izinga lokuziphatha okuhle kanye nokuzithuthukisa. Ukusiza ekwehliseni izikhungo ezibikwayo ngaphakathi kwedirektorathi.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha abaguli ngokusebenzayo, ukubonisa ukunakwa ngabaguli, ukukhuthaza futhi ukumela. Ukuphathwa nokunakekelwa okufanele okuhlanganisa ukuqonda nokuthanda ukuphendula izidingo, izidingo nolindelekwengqondo yomguli. Ukunikezwa kwezinsiza ezinhle ngokusebenzisa ukumiswa kwezinga, izinqubomgomo namakhasimende. Ukubamba iqhaza ekusebenziseni imihlahlandlela yezokwelapha yezinto eziyimiqulu ezibalulekwe esifundeni, ama-protocols. Ukugcina amarekhodi abaguli aphelele nokuqinisekile ngokusho imithetho edingekayo. Ukusebenzisa ulawulo phezu kokuziphatha, izikhungo kanye nezindaba zobudlelwano bemisebenzi. Ukukhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza phakathi kwabasebenzi nabaguli. Ukusiza ekulawuleni nasekuthuthukiseni bonke abasebenzi bokwelusa. Ukwehlisa izinga lokufa nokugula kwababelethi nabantwana. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kunomthelela osebenzayo kuyo yonke imikhakha yesibhedlela njengama-IPC, i-Quality Assurance, njll. Ukunikeza imvelo ephephile, enokwelapha nehlanzekile kubaguli, abavakashi nabasebenzi.

xh.title: Umongikazi oGwebileyo oZemiyalezo ethile
xh.summary: Isithuba somongikazi ogwebileyo ozemiyalezo ethile kwiDr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, sifuna ubhaliso kwi-SANC kunye neminyaka yamava emi phakathi kweyine neli-14 yokusingatha abaguli.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Ubuncinane beminyaka emi-4 yamava afanelekileyo/abaziwayo ekusingathweni abaguli emva kobhaliso njengomongikazi oGwebileyo kwi-SANC kwi-General Nursing. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-14 (nelishumi elinane) yamava afanelekileyo/abaziwayo ekusingathweni abaguli emva kobhaliso njengomongikazi oGwebileyo kwi-SANC kwi-General Nursing apho ubuncinane kwiminyaka eli-10 (lishumi) kwelixesha elalishiwo ngasentla kufuneka kube ngamava afanelekileyo/abaziwayo kule miyalezo ethile emva kokufumana isiqinisekiso seminyaka eli-1 (elinye) sasesidanga se-post basic kule miyalezo ethile. I-Senior Certificate okanye esingakulinganayo. I-Degree/Diploma kwi-General nursing. Isiqinisekiso seminyaka eli-1 (01) se-Post Basic kule miyalezo ethile kwi-Operating Theatre Nursing Science. Isatifikethi sobhaliso ne-South African Nursing Council (SANC). Iresiti yangoku ye-SANC (2026). Ubuncinane beminyaka emi-4 yamava afanelekileyo/abaziwayo emva kobhaliso njengomongikazi oGwebileyo kwi-SANC kwi-General Nursing. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Uqeqesho kunye noNako eFunekayo: Ulwazi ngemigaqo kunye namacebo okusingatha abaguli, izigaba zomthetho wokusingatha abaguli, nolunye ulwazi lwangokomthetho oluhambelana nalo. Amakhono amathe aphakathi kolwazi-xelelan nabantu nokubhala-phendula. Amakhono okulungelelanisa nokuseka unxibelelwano. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki nokucinga ngokujonga izinto ngokwendlela echanekileyo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphakathi kwethimba elinezigaba ezahlukeneyo. Ukugcina ukukhula komsebenzi/izinga zomthetho zokuziphatha nokuziphucela. Ukunced ekunciphiseni iingxaki/phipezeko kule ndebe.
xh.duties: Ukulawula ngokusebenzayo abaguli, ukubonisa ingqondo ngekhuselo kubaguli, ukukhuthaza nokuba ngamathambo abaguli. Ukunyanga nokuqonda ukukhathalela kubandakanya ukuqonda nokulungele ukuphendula kwiimfuno, iimfuno nolindlele zabaguli. Ukunikezela iinkonzo zomgangatho ophezulu ngokumisela imilinganiselo, iinkqubo kunye namacebo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekusebenziseni iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokunyanga iingxaki ezisoloko zibakho emhlabeni jikelele, iinkqubo. Ukugcina amarekhodi abaguli accekileyo aze agqitywe ngokweemfuno zomthetho. Ukulawula inkqubo yekhadi lomsebenzi nolawulo olusemgangathweni wobuntu, iingxaki ngokuthintana abantu namanye amacandelo. Ukukhuthaza ubudlelwane obuhle bokusebenza phakathi kwabasebenzi naxa babaguli. Ukuncedza ekulawuleni kunye nakuqeqeshweni bonke oomongikazi. Ukunciphisa izinga lokubulawa nokugula kwezaza nabantwana abasekhululekileyo. Kuqinisekiswe ukuthathwa kwentsa yonke imikhakha yokusebenza ehlelwe kakhulu, kubandakanya icandelo lempilo yehhashi, iinkonzo zokuqinisekisa, nkqu. I-Lock down and abuse of children. Ukunika amandla abasebenzi nabaqaphi ukuba basebenze ngendlela ekhuselekileyo kakhulu ngokomthetho nokuziphatha.

jobs.title: Diagnostic Radiographer (GRADE 1-3)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R413 121 – R472 359 per annum Grade 2: R482 499 – R550 389 per annum Grade 3: R564 822 – R683 808 per annum Other Benefits: 13th cheque, Plus Medical Aid (Optional), 12% inhospitable allowance, Plus Housing Allowance (Employee must meet prescribed condition)
jobs.summary: Diagnostic Radiographer position at Newcastle Regional Hospital requiring HPCSA registration and experience in paediatric, neonatal and obstetric imaging.
jobs.requirements: Matric/ Senior Certificate Plus. National Diploma/ b Tech/ Degree in Diagnostic Radiography. Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Radiographer. Current registration as Radiographer (2026/2027). One (01) year experience as an independent practitioner Radiographer. Experience in Paediatrics, Neonatal and Obstetrics’ & Gynaecology imaging or dual qualification in Diagnostic and Ultrasound will be an added advantage. Grade 1: Nil Experience after registration with HPCSA in respect of RSA qualified who have performed community services and the appropriate/recognizable experience in respect of foreign qualified not required to perform community service. Grade 2: minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognizable experience after registration as a Radiographer with the HPCSA in respect of RSA-qualified who have performed community service, and the appropriate/recognizable experience after registration as a Radiographer with the HPCSA in respect of foreign-qualified not required to perform community service. Grade 3: minimum of 20 years with appropriate/recognizable experience after registration as a Radiographer with the HPCSA in respect of RSA-qualified who have performed community service, and 21 year appropriate/recognized experience after registration as a Radiographer with the HPCSA in respect of foreign-qualified not required to perform community service. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: In-depth understanding of paediatric anatomy, pathology and radiation risks. Ability to operate modern digital radiography systems, computer radiography and mobile units. Sound knowledge of radiation control and safety measures. Computer literacy. Knowledge of relevant health and safety Acts. Ability to communicate effectively and problem-solving skills. Good interpersonal skills to be able to perform in a multi-disciplinary team setting. Ability to perform basic quality assurance tests. Ability to work under pressure in a high-volume public health environment.
jobs.duties: Provide high-quality diagnostic imaging i.e. perform highly specialized paediatric and obstetric radiographic procedures, including neonatal chest X- Rays, mobile/ bedside imaging in the NICU/ PICU and theatre imaging. Maintain strict radiation protection standards. Participate in quality assurance and equipment maintenance. Participate in image quality audits to eliminate repeat exposures. Promote good health practice and ensure optimal care of patients. To perform reception, clerical duties as required. Ensure the safety of paediatric patients, pregnant mothers accompanying custodians and health care staff. Identify and escalate suspected physical abuse in compliance with Child Protection legislation. Able to use compassionate communication, distraction techniques and appropriate immobilisation strategies to manage uncooperative and anxious minors. Educate parents on the risks and benefits of radiation. Implement infection prevention and health & safety protocols. To comply with and promote Batho Pele principals. Ensure compliance with the Ideal Hospital Framework and OHSC (Office of Health Standards Compliance). Participate in 24/7 shift rosters, standby duties, and after-hours emergency cover. Participate in implementation of departmental and institutional quality improvement plan. ENQURIES : Mrs. N. Mbatha – Assistant Director: Radiographer Tel No: (034) 328 0000

af.title: Diagnostiese Radiograaf (GRAAD 1-3)
af.summary: Diagnostiese Radiograaf-pos by Newcastle Regional Hospital wat HPCSA-registrasie en ervaring in pediatriese, neonatale en verloskundige beelding vereis.
af.requirements: Matric/ Senior Certificate Plus. Nasionale Diploma/ b Tech/ Graad in Diagnostiese Radiografie. Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Radiograaf. Huidige registrasie as Radiograaf (2026/2027). Een (01) jaar ervaring as 'n onafhanklike praktisyn Radiograaf. Ervaring in Pedatrie, Neonatale en Verloskunde & Ginekologie beelding of 'n dubbele kwalifikasie in Diagnostiese en Ultrageluid sal 'n voordeel wees. Graad 1: Geen ervaring na registrasie met HPCSA ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerdes wat gemeenskapsdiens gelewer het nie, en die toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerdes wat nie verplig is om gemeenskapsdiens te lewer nie, word nie vereis nie. Graad 2: minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie as 'n Radiograaf met die HPCSA ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerdes wat gemeenskapsdiens gelewer het, en die toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie as 'n Radiograaf met die HPCSA ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerdes wat nie verplig is om gemeenskapsdiens te lewer nie. Graad 3: minimum van 20 jaar met toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie as 'n Radiograaf met die HPCSA ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerdes wat gemeenskapsdiens gelewer het, en 21 jaar toepaslike/erkende ervaring na registrasie as 'n Radiograaf met die HPCSA ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerdes wat nie verplig is om gemeenskapsdiens te lewer nie. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Diepgaande begrip van pediatriese anatomie, patologie en stralingsrisiko's. Vermoë om moderne digitale radiografiestelsels, rekenaarradiografie en mobiele eenhede te bedryf. Deeglike kennis van stralingsbeheer en veiligheidsmaatreëls. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Kennis van relevante gesondheids- en veiligheidswette. Vermoë om effektief te kommunikeer en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede om in 'n multidissiplinêre spansopset te funksioneer. Vermoë om basiese gehalteversekeringtoetse uit te voer. Vermoë om onder druk in 'n hoëvolume openbare gesondheidsomgewing te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf hoëgehalte diagnostiese beelding d.w.s. voer hoogs gespesialiseerde pediatriese en verloskundige radiografiese prosedures uit, insluitend neonatale borskas-X-strale, mobiele/bedkantbeelding in die NICU/PICU en teaterbeelding. Handhaaf strene stralingsbeskermingsstandaarde. Neem deel aan gehalteversekering en toerustingonderhoud. Neem deel aan beeldgehalte-oudits om herhaalde bloostellings te elimineer. Bevorder goeie gesondheidspraktyk en verseker optimale sorg van pasiënte. Voer ontvangs- en klerieke pligte uit soos vereis. Verseker die veiligheid van pediatriese pasiënte, swanger moeders wat vergesellende voogde vergesel en gesondheidsorgpersoneel. Identifiseer en escaleer vermoedelike fisieke mishandeling in ooreenstemming met Kinderbeskermingswetgewing. In staat om deernisvolle kommunikasie, afleidings tegnieke en toepaslike immobilisasie strategieë te gebruik om onsamewerkende en angstige minderjariges te bestuur. Opvoed ouers oor die risiko's en voordele van straling. Implementeer infeksievoorkoming en gesondheids- en veiligheidsprotokolle. Voldoen aan en bevorder Batho Pele-beginsels. Verseker voldoening aan die Ideal Hospital Framework en OHSC (Office of Health Standards Compliance). Neem deel aan 24/7-skofroosters, wagpligte en buite-ure nooddekking. Neem deel aan implementering van departementele en institusionele gehalteverbeteringsplan. NAVRAE: Mev. N. Mbatha – Assistentdirekteur: Radiograaf Tel No: (034) 328 0000

zu.title: Umthwebuli Wezithombe Zokuhlola (GRADE 1-3)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somthwebuli wezithombe zokuhlola e-Newcastle Regional Hospital esidinga ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA namava ekuthwebulweni kwezithombe zabantwana, abasanda kuzalwa nabezalu.
zu.requirements: I-Matric/ Isitifikedi Senior kanye nalokhu okulandelayo. I-National Diploma/ b Tech/ Degree ekuthwebulweni kwezithombe zokuhlola. Ukubhalisa ne-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomthwebuli wezithombe. Ukubhalisa okwamanje njengomthwebuli wezithombe (2026/2027). Unyaka (01) owodwa wamava njengomthwebuli wezithombe osebenza eyedwa. Amava ekuthwebulweni kwezithombe zabantwana, abasanda kuzalwa, ezokubeletha nabezifazane, noma iziqu eziphindwe kabili ekuthwebulweni kwezithombe zokuhlola nase-Ultrasound kuzoba yinzuzo. I-Grade 1: Alikho amava emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA labo abathweswe iziqu kwi-RSA abenze imisebenzi yomphakathi, kanye namava afanele/abonakalayo labo abathweswe iziqu kwamanye amazwe abangadingeki ukuba benze imisebenzi yomphakathi. I-Grade 2: okuncane iminyaka eyi-10 yamava afanele/abonakalayo emva kokubhalisa njengomthwebuli wezithombe ne-HPCSA labo abathweswe iziqu kwi-RSA abenze imisebenzi yomphakathi, kanye namava afanele/abonakalayo emva kokubhalisa njengomthwebuli wezithombe ne-HPCSA labo abathweswe iziqu kwamanye amazwe abangadingeki ukuba benze imisebenzi yomphakathi. I-Grade 3: okuncane iminyaka eyi-20 namava afanele/abonakalayo emva kokubhalisa njengomthwebuli wezithombe ne-HPCSA labo abathweswe iziqu kwi-RSA abenze imisebenzi yomphakathi, kanye nonyaka oyi-21 wamava afanele/abonakalayo emva kokubhalisa njengomthwebuli wezithombe ne-HPCSA labo abathweswe iziqu kwamanye amazwe abangadingeki ukuba benze imisebenzi yomphakathi. Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho namandla adingekayo: Ukuqonda okujulile ngomzimba wabantwana, izifo nengozi yemisebe. Ikono lokusebenzisa izinhlelo zanamuhla zedijithali zokuthwebula izithombe, ukuthwebula izithombe ngekhompyutha namayunithi ahambayo. Ulwazi oluhle lokulawula imisebe nezinyathelo zokuphepha. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngemiThetho ehambisanayo mayelana nezempilo nokuphepha. Ikono lokuxhumana kahle namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu ukuze ukwazi ukusebenza eqenjini elinezifundo ezahlukene. Ikono lokwenza izivivinyo eziyisisekelo zokuqinisekisa izinga. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkuthazo endaweni yezempilo yomphakathi enomthamo ophezulu.
zu.duties: Nikeza izithombe zokuhlola ezizinga eliphezulu, okungukuthi yenza izinqubo ezikhethekile kakhulu zokuthwebula izithombe zabantwana nezokubeletha, okuhlanganisa izithombe ze-X-Ray zesifuba sabasanda kuzalwa, ukuthwebula izithombe ezihambayo/ eceleni kwesiguli kwi-NICU/ PICU nasekuthwebulweni kwezithombe egumbini lokuhlinza. Gcina izinga eliphezulu lokuvikelwa kwemisebe. Thatha inhlangothi ekuqinisekisweni kwezinga nasekugcineni izinto zokusebenza. Thatha inhlangothi ekuhloleni izinga lezithombe ukuze kugwemwe ukuphinda kwenziwe izithombe. Khuthaza amasiko amahle ezempilo futhi qinisekisa ukunakekelwa okuhle kakhulu kwabaguli. Yenza imisebenzi yokwamukela izivakashi nemisebenzi yolawulo lwamaphepha njengoba kudingekwa. Qinisekisa ukuphepha kwabaguli abancane, ababelethisi abakhulelwe, abalondolozi abahamba nabo kanye nabasebenzi bezempilo. Qaphela futhi dlulisela kubaphezulu izimo ezingase zibe nokuqubulwa ngokomzimba ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuvikela Izingane. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ukuxhumana ngokuzwelana, izindlela zokususa ukunaka kanye nezindlela ezifanele zokuvimbela ukunyakaza ekuphathweni abancane abangasebenzisani nabakhathazekile. Fundisa abazali ngengozi nenzuzo yemisebe. Faka izindlela zokuvikela ukutheleleka kanye namaphrotokholu wezempilo nokuphepha. Yamukela futhi ukhuthaze izimiso ze-Batho Pele. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana ne-Ideal Hospital Framework ne-OHSC (Office of Health Standards Compliance). Thatha inhlangothi kumashidi okusebenza amahora angu-24/7, imisebenzi yokulinda, kanye nokubhekele izimo eziphuthumayo ngemva kwamahora. Thatha inhlangothi ekusebenziseni uhlelo lokuthuthukisa izinga lomnyango nenhlangano. IMIBUZO: Nkk. N. Mbatha – Umphathi Oncedisayo: Ukuthwebula izithombe Tel No: (034) 328 0000

xh.title: Isixhobi sesiXhobo-Mesigodi (INQANABA 1-3)
xh.summary: Isithuba sesiXhobi sesiXhobo-Mesigodi esibekelwe iNewcastle Regional Hospital sifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA nolwazi kumfanekiso wobuzala, wabaseBengamanwangasana nakwabakhulelweyo.
xh.requirements: Imatikuletshala/ Isatifikethala sePhezulu ezongezelelweyo. I-Diploma yesiZwe/ i-b Tech/ i-Digri kumFanekiso-Mesigodi woBulingwe. Ukubhaliswa kwiKhomishoni yamaGqirha ezeMiphakathi eMzantsi Afrika (HPCSA) njengomMesigodi weRadiography. Ukubhaliswa okwangoku njengomMesigodi weRadiography (2026/2027). Unyaka omnye (01) wolwazi njengomMesigodi weRadiigraphy ozenza ngokwakhe. Ulwazi kumFanekiso woBengamanwangasana, abaseBengamanwangasana nabakhulelweyo & nokuFuzeka okube ngumonuso ongongezelelweyo kumFanekiso-Mesigodi noKuhlalwini ngokulinganayo kumFanekiso woBulingwe nakuPonopondo kuya kuba ngamandla ongezelelweyo. Inqanaba 1: Akukho lwazi emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA ngokwabagqithiweyo abavela e-RSA abo benze inkonzo yomphakathi nolwazi olufanelekileyo/oluhlonelwayo ngokwabavela kwamanye amazwe abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi. Inqanaba 2: ubuncinane beminyaka eli-10 yolwazi olufanelekileyo/oluhlonelwayo emva kokubhaliswa njengomMesigodi weRadiography kwi-HPCSA ngokwabagqithiweyo abavela e-RSA abo benze inkonzo yomphakathi, nolwazi olufanelekileyo/oluhlonelwayo emva kokubhaliswa njengomMesigodi weRadiography kwi-HPCSA ngokwabavela kwamanye amazwe abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi. Inqanaba 3: ubuncinane beminyaka eli-20 yolwazi olufanelekileyo/oluhlonelwayo emva kokubhaliswa njengomMesigodi weRadiography kwi-HPCSA ngokwabagqithiweyo abavela e-RSA abo benze inkonzo yomphakathi, neminyaka eli-21 yolwazi olufanelekileyo/oluhlonelwayo emva kokubhaliswa njengomMesigodi weRadiography kwi-HPCSA ngokwabavela kwamanye amazwe abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi. Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho nemisebenzi eFunekayo: Ukuqonda ngobunzulu i-anathomi, i-pathology namonzima womlilo osekelayo wabantwana. Ikhono lokusebenzisa iinkqubo zamaxesha athylula zemfesigodi, umfanekiso-mfesigodi kunye namayunithi ahamba-hambayo. Ulwazi olululo ngokulawula umlilo osekelayo nezithintelo zokhuseleko. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene nezoNtsilo noKhuselo. Ikhono lokuthetha ngokusebenziseko nekhono lokusombulula iingxaki. Amandla ahle abantu ukwenza ukuba ukwazi ukusebenza eqela elinabasebenzi abavela kumacandelo amaninzi. Ikhono lokwenza iindlela zokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi yamanqanaba abalulekileyo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kwexinzelelo endaweni ekwiNkonzo yoNtsilo yoLuntu enemithamo ephezulu.
xh.duties: Nika umFanekiso-Mesigodi weNgangamini othile weNgangamini ubulungu obubalaseleyo obunje ngokwenza iindlela ezibuzisa kakhulu zemFanekiso-Mesigodi yabantwana nabakhulelweyo, kuquka nemifanekiso ye-radiography yelifuba labaBengamanwangasana, umFanekiso-Mesigodi ohamba/okufikhlwa emGqengeni kwi-NICU/ PICU nakuMzeko. Gcina amanqanaba angamanqanaba aqinisekileyo okhuseleko lomlilo osekelayo. Thatha inxaxheba ekugqinisekiseni ikhwalithi nokugcina izixhobo. Thatha inxaxheba ekuphononongweni ikhwalithi yomFanekiso ukuze kugqithwe ngaphezulu iindlela zokuphinda umFanekiso. Khuthaza izinto ezilulu zempilo uze uqinisekise ukhatho oluhle kwezigulana. Ukwenza ukwamkelwa, nemisebenzi yomgcaşi njengoko kufuneka. Qinisekisa ukhuseleko lwababengamanwangasana, kwezishiyekhaya abakhulelweyo nabasebenzi beempilo. Jonga uze uphakamise okuqula ngokuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba ngokuvumelana neMithetho yoKhuselo loMntwana. Ukuba nakho ukusebenzisa inkathazo-nkcubeko, iindlela zokususa ingqondo ezilungileyo neendidi ezifanelekileyo zokuvala ukuze kusize abathanda ukwenza isixhobo abangavumelani nabo abanesikhathi sobunzima bobukhosi bengqondo. Fundisa abazali ngamonzima nangamandla omlilo osekelayo. Zisebenzisa iNkqubo yokuthintela isrhitsho neMithetho yoNtsilo noKhuselo. Ukuvumelana nokukhuthaza iimvisiswelo zeBatho Pele. Qinisekisa ukuvumelana neKhowudi yoGqibo oluQaqambileyo leSibhedlele ne-OHSC (iKhowudi yamagunya oKhuselo lwezoNtsilo). Thatha inxaxheba ekudweliseni iiroster zamashift ama-24/7, ukulinda, nolwazi Iwemisebenzi yalo mhla wokuhlala. Thatha inxaxheba ekusebenziseni icandelo nendlu yolwazi olungathandwa ngokwenziwa iNkqubo yokuphucula noma ivili eliphezulu. IMIBUZO: Nkosazana. N. zu.duties: Nikela ngokwesekwa okuphakeme kobupila kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha eziphakeme kulesi dolobha nasekuNdaweni okungaphansi kwe dolobha. Phendla amakholi ezibucayi kulesi dolobha. Siza ngohlelo lokuqondisa umphakathi kulezi dolobha. Yenza ukwelashwa kohlelo lwe-Hepatitis B kwabasebenzi bese ulawula inqubekelaphambili yawo. Siza izikhulu ze-Emergency Care ngamakholi ezibucayi (amakhodi abomvu) kanye nabagulayo ababucayile. Thatha inxaxheba ngokuzethemba kumaphrojekthi oqinisekiso lwekhwalithi. Lawula, khishela futhi uhlole imishanguzo, bhala okukhishiwe kwabhaliswe uze uhambise okubhaliwe. Hlanzwa, cocisa futhi uqede ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwezimoto, imishini bese ulondolozela ithuluzi emsimbenzi ohle kakhulu. Yenza ukudluliswa kolwazi okufanele phakathi kweshifthi. Bika okungahambisani emishinini, kwezimoto, izinsiza bese unikeza izincomo kumholi wesihifti. Gcina ukutholakala kolwazi okuchanekile nokuthembekile. Zithobe ngazo zonke izinqubo eziyisisekelo zokusebenza.
