jobs.title: Director: Economic Analysis
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development and Tourism
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), total cost to employer that consists of basic salary, state contribution to Government Employee Pension Fund and flexible portion that an employee may structure according to personal needs
jobs.summary: Director-level role leading economic analysis, inflation bulletins, and labour reports for the Mpumalanga Department of Economic Development and Tourism.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor's Degree in Economics at NQF Level 7 as recognised by SAQA. A Post Graduate Degree in Economics will serve as an added advantage. A minimum of five (5) years' at Middle/Senior Managerial level experience focusing on Economic Analysis, Economic Modelling, Economic Research. Completion of Nyukela Certificate for entry into the SMS (Senior Management Service) upon appointment. A valid driver's licence. The successful candidate must have: A rigorous and in-depth knowledge of Economic Analysis, Applied Statistics, and Econometrics, data management, and strategies in the public sector. Knowledge of information sharing mechanisms and platforms. A thorough understanding of relevant legislation, best practices, and frameworks. Sound Knowledge and understanding of the Public Service Regulatory Framework, e.g. Public Service Act, PFMA, Municipal Finance Management Act (MFMA), Economic Modelling Packages (such as EViews, Stata and others), Treasury Regulations, Provincial Growth and Development Strategy (PGDS), National Development Plan (NDP), Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Skills Development Act, Service Delivery Frameworks, policies, and strategies. Ability to provide leadership in provincial and national economic analysis, forecasting, economic modelling, applied statistical data analysis, strategic management, and people skills, and use of advanced Excel and other data analysis tools. The successful candidate must be able to display the following competencies: strong analytical capabilities report writing, leadership, programme and project management, financial management, service delivery innovation, problem solving and analysis, people management and empowerment, client orientation, communication, honesty and integrity, advanced computer skills. strategic capability, leadership.
jobs.duties: Manage the analysis of Statistics South Africa (Stats SA) consumer price index (CPI) reports and develop monthly Provincial Inflation Bulletins. Coordinate the production of quarterly Provincial Labour Bulletin after Stats SA Quarterly Labour Force Survey (QLFS) releases. Manage the collection of data and production of Socio-Economic Profiles of each district and local municipality. Manage and analyze the potential and constraints for growth and development in the province and their interaction within governmental spending and revenue patterns/trends. Manage and coordinate key socio-economic indicators by means of trend and comparative analysis and produce an annual PERO (Provincial Economic Review and Outlook) and SERO (Socio-Economic Review and Outlook) reports bi-annually. Prepare and deliver presentations to convey complex economic data and insights. Coordinate, manage, conduct and disseminate socio-economic research & analysis to inform the departmental and provincial planning, policy, strategy and budget processes. Manage, co-ordinate and commission socio-economic research to analyze, amongst others, the impact of economic developments and economic policy on the provincial economy, the performance of various economic industries/sectors in Mpumalanga. Oversee the compilation of relevant quality and credible economic research reports on a quarterly basis in line with Government economic priorities. Present research findings to relevant decision-making fora in the province for evidence-based decision making. Participate in relevant socio-economic forums in Mpumalanga such as LED, IDP, DDM, OTP research forums, as well as inter-provincial economic forums such as the Public Sector Economist Forum (PSEF) and Tourism Statistics Forum. Manage and provide input into socio-economic section of the IDPs and LED strategies. Manage, conduct, compile and disseminate e-based research reports that are relevant in providing support and advice to economic planning and decision-making processes. Provide technical assistance and support in the application of economic analysis tools. Scrutinize technical reports and provide subject matter expertise. Manage the provision of economics data into research and departmental publications. Manage the provision of administrative support services: Manage the delivery of the Annual Performance Plan (APP) and AOP (Annual Operational Plan) targets. Manage budget of the directorate. Manage human resources. Monitor proper utilization of assets allocated to the directorate. Develop and implement strategies to address identified risk and complete risk management reports. Manage the improvement of internal controls.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. SJ Xaba Tel No: (013) 766 4164 OTHER POSTS
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted online through the Provincial e-Recruitment Portal at https://erecruitment.mpg.gov.za Applicants are required to register and create a profile on the system before submitting their applications. A comprehensive, recently updated Curriculum Vitae (CV) including three (3) contactable references and all mandatory documents must be uploaded on the portal to apply for these opportunities. No manual, emailed or faxed applications will be accepted.
jobs.notes: Applications received after closing date will, as a rule not be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates for the post will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation report (only when shortlisted). Applicants must disclose if she/he is not a Director/Shareholder of a company or conducting any business with Organ of State and whether is performing any additional remunerative work outside his/her normal duties. The question related to conditions that prevents re-appointment under Part F – “applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete the section intended for those seeking re-employment, as their prior employment can be verified”. It will be expected of the shortlisted candidate(s) to be available for interview process on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The top 2 candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks, which include criminal records, citizenship, financial credits/assets, qualifications verification and previous employment background/reference checks will be verified. The successful candidate will enter into an Annual Performance Agreement, and also annually disclose his/her financial interest. The Department reserves the right not to make appointment. Communication and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. SMS Posts: The requirements for appointment at Senior Management Service level include the successful completion of Senior Management Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government, which can be accessed using the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme. Candidates must provide proof of successful completion of the course prior to appointment. Candidates requiring additional information regarding advertised post must direct their enquiries to the relevant person indicated. Communication and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Ekonomiese Analise
af.summary: Direkteursvlakpos wat ekonomiese analise, inflasie-bulletins en arbeidsverslae vir die Mpumalanga Department of Economic Development and Tourism lei.
af.requirements: 'n Geskikte Bachelorsgraad in Ekonomie op NQF Level 7 soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Nagraadse graad in Ekonomie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ondervinding op Middel-/Seniorbestuursvlak met die fokus op Ekonomiese Analise, Ekonomiese Modellering, Ekonomiese Navorsing. Voltooiing van Nyukela-sertifikaat vir toetrede tot die SMS (Senior Management Service) by aanstelling. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet oor die volgende beskik: 'n Deeglike en diepgaande kennis van Ekonomiese Analise, Toegepaste Statistiek en Ekonometrie, databestuur en strategieë in die openbare sektor. Kennis van inligtingsdelingsmeganismes en platforms. 'n Deeglike begrip van relevante wetgewing, beste praktyke en raamwerke. 'n Goeie kennis en begrip van die Regulerende Raamwerk van die Openbare Diens, bv. Public Service Act, PFMA, Municipal Finance Management Act (MFMA), Ekonomiese Modelleringpakette (soos EViews, Stata en andere), Treasury Regulations, Provincial Growth and Development Strategy (PGDS), National Development Plan (NDP), Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Skills Development Act, Diensleweringsraamwerke, beleide en strategieë. Vermoë om leierskap te bied in provinsiale en nasionale ekonomiese analise, vooruitskattings, ekonomiese modellering, toegepaste statistiese data-analise, strategiese bestuur en mensevaardighede, en gebruik van gevorderde Excel en ander data-analise-instrumente. Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet die volgende bevoegdhede toon: sterk analitiese vermoëns, verslagskrywing, leierskap, program- en projektebestuur, finansiële bestuur, diensleweringsinnovasie, probleemoplossing en analise, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, kliëntoriëntasie, kommunikasie, eerlikheid en integriteit, gevorderde rekenaarvaardighede. strategiese vermoë, leierskap.
af.duties: Bestuur die analise van Statistics South Africa (Stats SA) verbruikersprysindeks (CPI)-verslae en ontwikkel maandelikse Provinsiale Inflasie-bulletins. Koördineer die produksie van kwartaallikse Provinsiale Arbeidsbulletins na Stats SA Quarterly Labour Force Survey (QLFS)-vrystellings. Bestuur die insameling van data en produksie van Sosio-ekonomiese Profiele van elke distrik en plaaslike munisipaliteit. Bestuur en ontleed die potensiaal en beperkings vir groei en ontwikkeling in die provinsie en hul wisselwerking met regeringsbesteding en inkomste patrone/tendense. Bestuur en koördineer sleutel-sosio-ekonomiese aanwysers deur middel van tendens- en vergelykende analise en produseer jaarliks 'n PERO (Provincial Economic Review and Outlook) en SERO (Socio-Economic Review and Outlook)-verslae tweemaal per jaar. Berei voor en lewer aanbiedings om komplekse ekonomiese data en insigte oor te dra. Koördineer, bestuur, voer uit en versprei sosio-ekonomiese navorsing en analise om departementele en provinsiale beplanning, beleid, strategie en begrotingsprosesse in te lig. Bestuur, koördineer en kommissioneer sosio-ekonomiese navorsing om, onder andere, die impak van ekonomiese ontwikkelinge en ekonomiese beleid op die provinsiale ekonomie, asook die prestasie van verskeie ekonomiese industrieë/sektore in Mpumalanga te ontleed. Hou toezig op die samestelling van relevante hoë-kwaliteit en geloofwaardige ekonomiese navorsingsverslae op 'n kwartaallikse basis in ooreenstemming met regerings se ekonomiese prioriteite. Lewer navorsingsbevindings aan relevante besluitnemingsfora in die provinsie vir bewysgebaseerde besluitneming. Neem deel aan relevante sosio-ekonomiese forums in Mpumalanga soos LED, IDP, DDM, OTP-navorsingsforums, asook interprovinsiale ekonomiese forums soos die Public Sector Economist Forum (PSEF) en Tourism Statistics Forum. Bestuur en verskaf insette tot die sosio-ekonomiese afdeling van die IDP's en LED-strategieë. Bestuur, voer uit, stel saam en versprei e-gebaseerde navorsingsverslae wat relevant is vir die verskaffing van ondersteuning en advies aan ekonomiese beplanning- en besluitnemingsprosesse. Verskaf tegniese bystand en ondersteuning in die toepassing van ekonomiese analise-instrumente. Ondersoek tegniese verslae en verskaf vakgebiedkennis. Bestuur die verskaffing van ekonomiese data tot navorsings- en departementele publikasies. Bestuur die verskaffing van administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste: Bestuur die lewer van die Annual Performance Plan (APP) en AOP (Annual Operational Plan)-teikens. Bestuur die begroting van die direktoraat. Bestuur menslike hulpbronne. Monitor behoorlike benutting van bates wat aan die direktoraat toegewys is. ontwikkel en implementeer strategieë om geïdentifiseerde risiko's aan te spreek en voltooi risikobestuurverslae. Bestuur die verbetering van interne kontroles.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ulwazi Lwezomnotho
zu.summary: Isikhundla esingeni lomphathi esihola ulwazi lwezomnotho, amabhulethi okweqanda kwezintengo, nemibiko yabasebenzi e-Mpumalanga Department of Economic Development and Tourism.
zu.requirements: I-Degree yesiqu ebanzi kwezomnotho ezingeni le-NQF Level 7 njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. I-Post Graduate Degree kwezomnotho izoba nenzuzo eyengeziwe. Ukube ukutholakala kweminyaka engu- five (5) ngaphezulu enqabeni lomphathi ophakathi/omkhulu okugxile ku-Economic Analysis, Economic Modelling, Economic Research. Ukuphothulwa kwe-Nyukela Certificate ukungena ku-SMS (Senior Management Service) ngemuva kokwethweswa isikhundla. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela. Ophumelele kumele abe nalokhu: Ulwazi olujulile nokuchwepheshe ko-Economic Analysis, Applied Statistics, kanye ne-Econometrics, ukuphathwa kwemininingwane, kanye nezindlela ohulumeni wacentral kanye nowaseningizimu. Ulwazi ngemishini yokwabelana ngolwazi kanye nendawo yokwabelana ngemininingwane. Ukuqonda okujulile ngemithetho ehlobene, izindlela ezinhle, kanye namashekethe. Ulwazi oluqinile nokusisisekelo ngo-Public Service Regulatory Framework, okwenze i-Public Service Act, PFMA, i-Municipal Finance Management Act (MFMA), amaphakheji wokumodela isimo sezomnotho (njengo-EViews, Stata nezinye), i-Treasury Regulations, i-Provincial Growth and Development Strategy (PGDS), i-National Development Plan (NDP), i-Public Service Regulations, i-Labour Relations Act, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, i-Basic Conditions of Employment Act, i-Skills Development Act, Amashekethe Asevisi Yokulethwa Kwezinsizakalo, izinqamula, kanye nezindlela. Ikakhulu ekuphateni isimo sezomnotho esifundeni naseningizimu, ukuqagela ikusasa, ukumodela isimo sezomnotho, ukuhlaziwa kwemininingwane kwezibalo, ukuphathwa ngokuqonda kwezinqamela, kanye namakhono abantu, nokusetshenzwa kwe-Excel ebanzi nezinye izinto zokuqamba imininingwane. Ophumelele kumele akwazi ukubonisa amakhono alandelayo: ikhono elikhulu lokuhlaziwa, ukubhala imibiko, ukubusa, ukuphatwa kwezinhlelo kanye nezinhlela zokusebenza, ukuphatwa kwezimali, ukwakhiwa kwezinsizakalo ezintsha, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuwaqonda, ukuphathwa kwabantu nokuqinisekisa ukuzethemba, ukuqonda izidingo zabathengi, ukuxhumana, ukuqonda nokuziphatha kokuqinisekisa, amakhono wekhompyutha aphantse khona. ikhono lokubusa ngakho, ukubusa.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuhlazwa kwemibiko ye-Statistics South Africa (Stats SA) consumer price index (CPI) futhi lukhiqize amabhulethi e-Provincial Inflation Bulletins nyanga zonke. Hlela ukukhiqizwa kwemibiko ye-Provincial Labour Bulletin kanye nenyanga ngemuva kokukhishwa kwe-Stats SA Quarterly Labour Force Survey (QLFS). Phatha ukuqoqwa kwemininingwane nokukhiqizwa kwe-Socio-Economic Profiles yensimbi ngayinye kamasipala wezwe. Phatha futhi uhlaze isimo esingaba khona futhi nobunzima ekukhuliseni nasezintweni ezinhle ezingabakhona kule sayensi, kanye nokuhlangen kwazo nezindlela ezikahulumeni mayelana nokushiza kwemali kanye nezindlela ezinkulu ezisetshenziswa ngakho. Phatha futhi uhlele izinkomba eziyisisekelo ngokuhlangana nokuhlobana nasezintweni ezinkulu ngokuthi ngokuqonda kahle izindlela nezinye izinto okufanele zenziwe njalo futhi ukhiqize imibiko ye-PERO (Provincial Economic Review and Outlook) kanye ne-SERO (Socio-Economic Review and Outlook) izikhathi ezimbili ngonyaka. Lungele futhi unikeze okubhalwayo okudlulisa ulwazi oluyisisekelo nolunzima kwezomnotho. Hlela, phatha futhi ukwenza kanye nokwazisa abantu ngolwazi nokuqagela ulwazi mayelana nezimo zomnotho zendawo ukuze kusize ukuphathwa ngokuhle ukwenza izinqamela zohulumeni kule sayensi, izinqamula, izinhlelo nokuphathwa kwemali. Phatha, hlela futhi ukukhweshwa kwemibiko yomnotho futhi wenze ukuqagela ngakho mayelana nengqikithi yokuqhuba kwezinto eziyisisekelo eziyisikhombisi noma ezibukhali ezintweni ezikuqhuba ukuthuthuka kwale sayensi, noma ukuthula kwezinsizakalo kuleso sayensi kanye nengxenye yawo wonke amasiko asezinhlelweni zendawo e-Mpumalanga. Qaphela ukubhalwa kwemibiko ehle ngokulingene njalo futhi ethembekile ngokuqonda ngakho ngesikhathi esifanele sonyaka ngokulandelana ngokulawula izinhlelo ezibalulekile kahulumeni ezinkulu. Yethula imibiko evezwa ohlalweni mayelana nezinkomba eziphathwa kuleso sayensi ukuthi kubone abantu abenza izinqamela ngolwazi. Thatha inxaxheba ohlweni oluhlobene nolucishe lube khona njengalo-LED, IDP, DDM, OTP research forums, kanye namaphanela ohlelo lwazo zozonke njengoba kuyi-Public Sector Economist Forum (PSEF) kanye ne-Tourism Statistics Forum. Phatha futhi ungene ngaphakathi ngezansi ohlelweni ngakho futhi uluntu oluyisisekelo kuleso sayensi ngakho-ke IDPs kanye ne-LED strategies. Phatha, yenza futhi wenze futhi usakaze imibiko emaphakethe eza ngokusebenzisa ama-computers ehlela izinto abazidingayo futhi oke ukubakhombise futhi abe nolwazi lwezomnotho ekubalulekeni kwawo mayelana nesimo nezindlela ezisetshenziswa kahulumeni. Nikeza ukwesekwa ngokwobuchwepheshe ekusetshenzweni kwamathuluzi okuhlola isimo sezomnotho. Qamba imibiko ngobuchwepheshe futhi unikeze izinkomba ngokwephuzu nangokobuchwepheshe. Phatha inikho lwemininingwane kumibiko ekuyimibiko kathisha ukuseseka nokuthuthukisa ulwazi. Phatha ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo ezifana nokulawula ukwenza okuhle okubalulekile: Phatha ukulethwa kokuhlelwa kwe-APP (Annual Performance Plan) kanye nezinhloso ze-AOP (Annual Operational Plan). Phatha imali ebalulekile eyilawula ngakho-ke. Phatha izisebenzi. Qaphela ukusetshenziswa kahle kwemali ebelwe ngakho-ke kule minyaka. Hlela futhi usebenzise izindlela zokubhekana nezingozi eziyitholakalayo futhi uqedele imibiko yokuphathwa kwezinguquki. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kokulawula izinto ngaphakathi.

xh.title: Umntu ongumlawuli: Uhlalutyo lwezoqoqosho
xh.summary: Inkundla yomsebenzi esinqanaba somlawuli ehola uhlalutyo lwezoqoqosho, iindaba ezimalunga nentengiso, namaxwebhu okushicilela ngabasebenzi kwi Ngingqi iMpumalanga Department of Economic Development and Tourism.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor's Degree ezifanelekileyo kwi-Economics kwinqanaba le-NQF Level 7 njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA. Iziqu ze-Post Graduate Degree kwi-Economics ziza kuba ngumdla olongezelelekileyo. Amava ambalwa weminyaka emihlanu (5) kwinqanaba lomlawuli ophakathi/omkhulu ejolise kuHLalutyo lwezoQoqosho, ukuKlasiwe kobume bezoQoqosho, nokuPhengulwa kwezoQoqosho. Ukuqwalaselwa kwe-Nyukela Certificate engena kwi-SMS (Senior Management Service) ekubekweni esikhundleni. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni. Umntu ophumeleleyo kufuneka abenalo: Ukuqonda okusondeleyo nangobunzulu kokuHLalutya izoQoqosho, iziBalo eziSetyenzisiweyo, ne-Econometrics, ulawulo lwedata, namacebo kurhulumente. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yabelwano nolwazi namaziko alo. Ukuqonda kakuhle umthetho ofanelekileyo, iinkqubo ezilungileyo, namaxwebhu. Ulwazi oluqinileyo nokuqonda iNkqubo yeZezomthetho yoRhulumente ngokwesibini, umzekelo i-Public Service Act, PFMA, i-Municipal Finance Management Act (MFMA), iinkqubo zokwakhiwa kwezoqoqosho (njenge-EViews, i-Stata nezinye), i-Treasury Regulations, i-Provincial Growth and Development Strategy (PGDS), i-National Development Plan (NDP), i-Public Service Regulations, i-Labour Relations Act, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, i-Basic Conditions of Employment Act, i-Skills Development Act, ama-Service Delivery Frameworks, iinkqubo namacebo. Ulwazi lokunika isakhokelo kuHLalutyo lwezoQoqosho lwengingqi nelwelo livelkulu, ukubikeka okungaphambili, ukwakhiwa kobume bezoqoqosho, uhlalutyo lwedata esetyenziswa izibalo, ulawulo olubhekisa phambili namakhono abantu, nokuSebenzisa i-Excel eNyukela nezinye izixhobo zohlalutyo lwedata. Umntu ophumeleleyo kufuneka abekho nakho ukuBonakalisa ekulandelayo: amakhono oHLalutyo amandla ubugcisa bokuBhala amaxwebhu, isikhokelo, ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphrojekthi, ulawulo lweemali, intsingiselo yentengiso yezinkonzo, ukuSombulula iingxaki nokuZahlulela, ulawulo lwabantu nokuBa nakho, ukujolisa kumxhasi, unxibelelwano, inyaniso nokuQinisekisa, amakhono ekhompyutha aNyukela. isakhokelo esibhekisa phambili.
xh.duties: Lawula uhlalutyo lweendaba ze-Statistics South Africa (Stats SA) ezimalunga nalachasi labathengi (CPI) kwaye wenze iindaba ezinyanga zididiyelwe ngentengiso kwengingqi. Hlanganisa ukwenziwa kwamaxwebhu axoxa ngabasebenzi kwikota kwengingqi emva kokukhutshwa kweendaba ze-Stats SA Quarterly Labour Force Survey (QLFS). Lawula ukuqokelelwa kwedata nokwenziwa kwezifundo zomzoqoqosho nemidlalo yoluntu kumaziko ngamanye neendawo zorhulumente. Lawula ukuhlalutya amandla nokusilela ukhula nentlalo enkundleni yazo nondibaniselwano wazo ekuchithweni nemali kwindalo ekurhulumente nemigaqo yemali. Lawula ukuhlanganisa izalathiso ezibalulekileyo zomzoqoqosho nemidlalo yoluntu ngeendlela zohlalutyo nokuqhathanisa ukwenza iindaba zonyaka ze-PERO (Provincial Economic Review and Outlook) ne-SERO (Socio-Economic Review and Outlook) iindaba njalo ngenyaka. Lungiselela unikezelo lwezibonakaliso ezinkqubo zokuvezwa kolwazi nokuqonde lwezoqoqosho. Hlanganisa, lawula, qhuba kwaye usasaze ulwazi lomzoqoqosho nemidlalo yoluntu ukwazi ukulawula iplani, iplani yesebe, iplani yengingqi namacebo nemali. Lawula, hlanganisa kwaye uzenze iingcango zomzoqoqosho nemidlalo yoluntu ukuhlalutya, kwa njalo nakwezinye iziphithiphithi, umphumo wemisebenzi yamacebo wezoqoqosho nobume beemarike kwindalo iMpumalanga. Qwalasela ukuqokelelwa kolwazi osemthethweni loqoqosho nendalo yocingo kuqhutywa rhoqo ekoteni ngokwezikhokelo zamaphupha korhulumente. Nikezela ngemiphumela yolwazi kwamaziko othatha iigqibo ekundleni yengingqi ukwazi ukwazi ukuthabatha iigqibo. Thatha inxaxheba kooma-fora obalulekileyo bomzoqoqosho kwindala iMpumalanga abanjengama-LED, IDP, DDM, ama-fora olwazi OTP, njengoko nakuwo ama-fora obuzoqoqosho phakathi kweengingqi abanjenge-Public Sector Economist Forum (PSEF) ne-Tourism Statistics Forum. Lawula unikezelo ngenkcubeko kwiqela lesifundo somzoqoqosho nemidlalo yoluntu kumaziko ye-IDP namacebo e-LED. Lawula, qhuba, qokelela unikeze ngamaxwebhu olwazi ohlelwe nge-internet aqukene kubaluleke kwindawo yolwazi lwezoqoqosho nokuThatha iigqibo. Nikeza ngosetyenziso kunye n enkxaso ekusetyenzisweni koxhobo oluhlalutya ubalo beqoqosho. Hlola amaxwebhu ohlelo ze-zezobuchwepheshe unikeze ngolwazi kundaba le nto. Lawula unikezelo lwezoqoqosho nxaxheba kulwazi nemibhalo yendatsho. Lawula unikezelo lweenkxaso zolawulo ezizezowokuphatha: Lawula unikezelo ngokuhlangatshwa kwe-Annual Performance Plan (APP) kwaye neenjongo ezi-AOP (Annual Operational Plan). Lawula imali yeqela labasebenzi. Lawula abantu abasebenzayo. Qwalasela ukusetyenziswa okufanelekileyo kwempahla enikezelwe kwindawo yokusebenza. Yila kwaye usebenzise namacebo ukwazi ukuSombulula iingxaki ezibonwayo kwaye uqokelele iindaba zolawulo iingxaki. Lawula ukuphuculwa kolawulo lwangaphakathi.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Trade and Investment Promotion
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development and Tourism
jobs.summary: Assistant Director in the Department of Economic Development and Tourism, based in Ermelo, promoting trade and investment policies and strategies at salary level 10.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate SAQA recognized NQF level six (06) tertiary qualification in Economics/Business Administration with three (3) years work experience in trade and development promotion/sector development/industry development. Valid driver’s license. Knowledge of the legal framework, Public Finance Management Act, International Trade and Promotion. Work experience in export and training of emerging businesses, understanding of the South African economy, economic data and the ability to draw inference from them, understanding of the National and Provincial sectors. Ability to interact with industry key players across sectors. The successful candidate must be able to display the following competencies: strong analytical capabilities report writing, leadership, programme and project management, financial management, service delivery innovation, problem solving and analysis, people management and empowerment, client orientation, communication, honesty and integrity, advanced computer skills.
jobs.duties: Assist and provide support in the development and the implementation of export, investment promotion policies and strategies. Promote all opportunities. Lead the implementation of bi-lateral trade agreements. Facilitate and coordinate trade and commerce activities to support industry development. Liaise with all spheres of government and all stakeholders on trade and investment related initiatives. Provide support in the coordination of both domestic and international and trade exhibitions. Provide inputs in the preparation of awareness workshops for trade and investment sessions. Supervising staff as assigned including prioritizing and assigning work.
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted online through the Provincial e-Recruitment Portal at https://erecruitment.mpg.gov.za Applicants are required to register and create a profile on the system before submitting their applications. A comprehensive, recently updated Curriculum Vitae (CV) including three (3) contactable references and all mandatory documents must be uploaded on the portal to apply for these opportunities. No manual, emailed or faxed applications will be accepted.
jobs.notes: Applications received after closing date will, as a rule not be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates for the post will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation report (only when shortlisted). Applicants must disclose if she/he is not a Director/Shareholder of a company or conducting any business with Organ of State and whether is performing any additional remunerative work outside his/her normal duties. The question related to conditions that prevents re-appointment under Part F – “applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete the section intended for those seeking re-employment, as their prior employment can be verified”. It will be expected of the shortlisted candidate(s) to be available for interview process on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The top 2 candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks, which include criminal records, citizenship, financial credits/assets, qualifications verification and previous employment background/reference checks will be verified. The successful candidate will enter into an Annual Performance Agreement, and also annually disclose his/her financial interest. The Department reserves the right not to make appointment. Communication and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. SMS Posts: The requirements for appointment at Senior Management Service level include the successful completion of Senior Management Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government, which can be accessed using the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme. Candidates must provide proof of successful completion of the course prior to appointment. Candidates requiring additional information regarding advertised post must direct their enquiries to the relevant person indicated. Communication and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Handel- en Beleggingsbevordering
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur in die Department of Economic Development and Tourism, gebaseer in Ermelo, wat handel- en beleggingsbeleid en -strategieë bevorder op salarisvlak 10.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike SAQA-erkende NQF-vlak ses (06) tersiêre kwalifikasie in Ekonomie/Besbestuursadministrasie met drie (3) jaar werkervaring in handels- en ontwikkelingsbevordering/sektorentwikkeling/bedryfsontwikkeling. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van die regsraamwerk, Public Finance Management Act, internasionale handel en bevordering. Werkervaring in uitvoer en opleiding van opkomende besighede, begrip van die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie, ekonomiese data en die vermoë om gevolgtrekkings daaruit te maak, begrip van die nasionale en provinsiale sektore. Vermoë om met sleutelrolspelers in die bedryf oor sektore heen te skakel. Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet die volgende bevoegdhede kan toon: sterk analitiese vermoëns, verslagskrywing, leierskap, program- en projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur, diensleweringsinnovasie, probleemoplossing en analise, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, kliëntgerigtheid, kommunikasie, eerlikheid en integriteit, gevorderde rekenaarvaardighede.
af.duties: Bystand en ondersteuning bied in die ontwikkeling en implementering van uitvoer- en beleggingsbevorderingsbeleid en -strategieë. Alle geleenthede bevorder. Leiding gee aan die implementering van bilaterale handelooreenkomste. Handel- en kommersiële aktiwiteite fasiliteer en koördineer om bedryfsontwikkeling te ondersteun. Skakel met alle regeringsvlakke en alle belanghebbendes oor handels- en beleggingsverwante inisiatiewe. Ondersteuning bied in die koördinering van beide binnelandse en internasionale handelskoue. Insets lewer by die voorbereiding van bewustheidswerkswinkels vir handels- en beleggingssessies. Personeel toes hou soos toegewys, insluitend die prioritisering en toewys van werk.

zu.title: Umncedi weNhloko: Ukukhuthaza ukuhweba nezimali-mthombo
zu.summary: Umncedi weNhloko eMnyangweni weZomnotho Wezinhlelo Zentuthuko nezokuvakasha, ose-Ermelo, okhuthaza izinqubomgomo nezindlela zokuhweba nezimali-mthongo ezingeni leholo 10.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikwesaba ezihlonzelwe yi-SAQA ezingeni le-NQF lesithupha (06) kwezoMnotho/okuLawula Ibhizinisi ezinamaphuzu amathathu (3) okuhlolwa ngokusebenza ekukhuthazeni ukuhweba nentuthuko/ukuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi/ukuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi amakhulu. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukwazi umthethosisekelo, uMthetho Wokuphatha Izimali Zomphakathi, ukuHweba Kwamazwe Ngamazwe nokukhuthaza. Uhambo lokuqeqesha ekuthumelweni kwemikhiqizo ngaphandle nakumanenjimenti amabhizinisi asakhula, ukuqonda imphilo yezomnotho yaseNingizimu Afrika, ukubutha imininingwane yezomnotho nakhono yokukhipha iziphetho kuyo, ukuqonda amabhizinisi omphakathi nemesifili wesifunda. Ikhono lokuxhumana nezinhloko zemikhakha ezahlukene. Ukuze okhethekile, okhethwe kumele akwazi ukubonisa amakhono alandelayo: ukulunga ngokuhlola nokuqhathanisa, ukubhala imibiko, ukubusa, ukuphatha izinhlela namaphrojekthi, ukuphatha imali, ukuthula nezinto ezintsha ekulethwa emzameni wokufeza izinhloso, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuqeqeswa kwazo, ukuphatha nokuqinisekisa isikhundla sabantu, ukumela izinkampani mayelana nezidingo zesivakashi, ukuxhumana, ukwethembeka nokwazi ukuqhathanisa, amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompuyutha anamandla.
zu.duties: Okwesekelayo, nokubonakalisa ukwesekwa ekuthuthukisweni nokusetshenzisweni kwezinqubomgomo nezindlela zokukhuthaza izimali-mthombo, nokukhuthaza ukuthumela imikhiqizo ngaphandle. Ukukhuthaza onke amathuba. Ukubusa ekusetshenzisweni kwezivumelwano zokuqashwa kwemali phakathi kwamazwe amabili. Ukubiza kanye nesixhumanisi sokunqwabelanisa izinhlelo zokuhweba kanye nezokutengisa ukweseka ukuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi amakhulu. Ukuhlanganisa bonke abalamuleli bomphakathi ngokuhlanganyela kanye namanye omlando bezinhlelo ezimali-mthonto nezokuvakasha. Ukusekela ukuhlelwa kokubukwa kwamathrendi enkampani kahulumeni nakulabo abathengisela amanye amazwe imikhiqizo. Ukubeka imibono ukuhlela kwezinsizakalo zokuqeqesha abantu ukubaqeqesha emisebenzini yezimali-mthonto nokuvakasha. Ukulalela nokuqondanisa abasebenzi bokunakekelwa kwamathrendi omsebenzi nemisebenzi ekhethiwe ngohlelo, ngokuhlelela izinhlelo zokuhlela umgomo wokunakekelwa kwabasebenzi.

xh.title: Umncedisi woMlawuli: Ukukhuthaza uRhwebo noKutyalo-mali
xh.summary: UMncedisi woMlawuli kwiSebe lePhuhliso loQoqosho noKhenketho, ese Ermelo, ekukhuthazeni iinkqubo zohwebo netyalo-mali namasu elinqanaba lomvuzo 10.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekileyo samabakala esiNqanaba lesithandathu (06) seNQF esiqinisekiswa yiSAQA kwiQoqosho/iQondo loBizise ngeminyaka emithathu (3) yamava emsebenzini ekukhuthazeni urhwebo nophuhliso/ukuphuhlisa iindawo/ukuphuhlisa ishishini. Ilayisenesi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yomthetho, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente, uRhwebo lwamazwe ngamazwe noKukhuthaza. Amaxesha emisebenzi ekuthumeleni izithwamlanji nasekuyalelweni iinkamva ezincinci zamashishini, ukuqonda iqoqosho leMzantsi Afrika, iingxelo zedatha yeqoqosho nolawulo lokuthatha iziphumo kuzo, ukuqonda iindawo eZikwiziko nasePhondo. Amandla okunxibelelana nabaphathi abalulekileyo beshishini kumacandelo onke. Ophumeleleyo kufuneko abe nakho ukubonisa amandla alandelayo: amandla amakhulu okuhlalutya, ukubhala iingxelo, ukulawula, ulawulo lwenkqubo nolwamaprojekthi, ulawulo lwemali, intsingiselo yonikezelo lweenkonzo, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya, ulawulo labantu nokubanika amandla, ukumisela iindlela kwabathengi, unxibelelwano, inyaniso nokuzithembisa, amandla aphakamileyo ekhompyutha.
xh.duties: Kuncediswa kwaye kunikwa inkxaso ekuphuhliseni nasekusebenziseni iinkqubo zokuthumela izithwamlanji, iinkqubo zokukhuthaza ityalo-mali namasu. Kukhuthazwa onke amathuba. Kuyakulawulwa ukusebenza kolwazi-mthetho olubini ngokwerhwebo. Kuncediswa kwaye kuqukaniswa imisebenzi yorhwebo noshisho ukuxhasa uphuhliso lweshishini. Kunxibelelwana namakumkani onke karhulumente nabo bonke abathweswe isikhundla ngenkqubo zorhwebo netyalo-mali. Kunikwa inkxaso ekusingathweni kweziboniso zorhwebo zaselikhaya nakwamanye amazwe. Kungeniswa izimvo ekuqelelweni kwamaza aphakamisa ukuqonda ngeendibano zohwebo netyalo-mali. Kulawulwa abasebenzi njengoko belungiweyo kuquka nokubeka izinto ezibalulekileyo nokuqabela umsebenzi.

jobs.title: Industry Advisor: Trade and Development
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development and Tourism
jobs.summary: Industry Advisor needed at Ermelo to support trade and development initiatives, identify export markets, and assist with trade policy reviews.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate SAQA recognized NQF level 6 tertiary qualification in Economics or Business Management with two (2) years work experience in trade and development environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, good interpersonal skills, analytical skills, report writing and good computer skills. Valid Driver's License.
jobs.duties: Assist in conducting capacity building on trade matters. Assist in identifying new export markets in and outside South Africa. Assist in identifying gaps in the export market. Make inputs to the reviewing trade and investment policies and strategies, assistance to emerging and current provincial exporters on export matters and the export awareness programme. Provide support activities of ad-hoc projects i.e. water, bottling plant, Mkhondo Agri-hub.
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted online through the Provincial e-Recruitment Portal at https://erecruitment.mpg.gov.za Applicants are required to register and create a profile on the system before submitting their applications. A comprehensive, recently updated Curriculum Vitae (CV) including three (3) contactable references and all mandatory documents must be uploaded on the portal to apply for these opportunities. No manual, emailed or faxed applications will be accepted.
jobs.notes: Applications received after closing date will, as a rule not be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates for the post will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation report (only when shortlisted). Applicants must disclose if she/he is not a Director/Shareholder of a company or conducting any business with Organ of State and whether is performing any additional remunerative work outside his/her normal duties. The question related to conditions that prevents re-appointment under Part F – “applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete the section intended for those seeking re-employment, as their prior employment can be verified”. It will be expected of the shortlisted candidate(s) to be available for interview process on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The top 2 candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks, which include criminal records, citizenship, financial credits/assets, qualifications verification and previous employment background/reference checks will be verified. The successful candidate will enter into an Annual Performance Agreement, and also annually disclose his/her financial interest. The Department reserves the right not to make appointment. Communication and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. SMS Posts: The requirements for appointment at Senior Management Service level include the successful completion of Senior Management Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government, which can be accessed using the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme. Candidates must provide proof of successful completion of the course prior to appointment. Candidates requiring additional information regarding advertised post must direct their enquiries to the relevant person indicated. Communication and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

zu.title: Umcebisi Wezemikhakha: Ukuhweba Nentuthuko
zu.summary: Kudingeka umcebisi wezemikhakha e-Ermelo ukusekela izinhloso zokuhweba nentuthuko, ukuthola imimakethe yokuhweba ngaphandle, kanye nokusiza ekuhloleni izinqubomgomo zokuhweba.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikhungo semfundo ephakeme ezibonakaliswe yi-SAQA ezingeni le-NQF level 6 ku-Economics noma Business Management ezinkondlweni zomsebenzi eminyakeni emibili (2) edlule ohlotsheni lokuhweba nentuthuko. Amakhono amahle okubhaliwe nakukhuluma, amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu, amakhono ukuhlaziya, ukubhala imibiko namakhono amahle ekusebenziseni ikhompuyutha. Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo.
zu.duties: Siza ekwenzeni ukwakha amandla ezindaba zokuhweba. Siza ekutholeni imimakethe entsha yokuhweba ngaphandle ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwe-South Africa. Siza ekutholeni izikhala emimaketheni yokuhweba ngaphandle. Nikela ngeminikelo ekuhloleni izinqubomgomo namasu okuhweba nokutshala imali, ukusiza abahwebi abasha nabamanje abaningiliziwe ezindabeni zokuhweba ngaphandle nenhlelo yokwazisa ngokuhweba ngaphandle. Nikeza inkxaso emisebenzini yamaphrojekthi avakashayo okuthiwa amanzi, iplathi yokubhotela, i-Mkhondo Agri-hub.

xh.title: Umcebisi weMbonakarhulumente: uRhwebo nokuPhuhlisa
xh.summary: Kufuneka umcebisi wembonakarhulumente kwi-Ermelo ukuxhasa iinqobo zokurhwebo nokuphuhlisa, ukuchaza iimarike zokurhweba ngaphandle, kunye nokunceda nokuphonononga iinkqubo zokurhwebo.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekileyo samabanga aphezulu esamkelwe yi-SAQA kwinqanaba le-NQF level 6 kwi-Economics okanye i-Business Management kunye neminyaka emibili (2) yamava okusebenza kwindawo yokurhwebo nokuphuhlisa. Amakhono amhle ebhalwe nokuThetha, amakhono amhle okusingathwana nabantu, amakhono okuhlola, ukubhala iingxelo kunye namakhono amdle amakhono ekhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela eseleyo.
xh.duties: Unceda ekwenzeni amandla kwimiba yokuRhwebo. Unceda ekuchazeni iimarike ezitsha zokurhweba ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwi-South Africa. Unceda ekuboneni izikroba kwimarike yokuRhwebo ngaphandle. Ukwenza izigqibo ekuphononongweni kweenkqubo kunye neendlela zokuRhwebo nokutyalwa imali, incedo kubantu bokurhweba ngaphandle abavela baza kuthi abanjalo kwiphondo malunga nemiba yokurhweba ngaphandle nanenqubo yokuziva ngokurhwebo ngaphandle. Ukunika inkxaso kwiinkqubo zeeprojekthi ezingaqhelekanga njengomthombo wamanzi, isiseko sokubhotala, i-Mkhondo Agri-hub.

jobs.title: Asset Controller
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development and Tourism
jobs.summary: Asset Controller at the Department of Economic Development and Tourism in Mbombela, requiring an NQF level 6 qualification and two years of asset management experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate SAQA recognized NQF level six (06) tertiary qualification in Financial Management/ Supply Chain Management/ Purchasing / Logistics / Public Administration/ Finance / Accounting with two (2) years experience in Asset Management environment. Valid Driver's License. Knowledge of Basic Accounting System (BAS), GRAP and LOGIS. Computer literacy with sound knowledge of the MS Office suite preferably Excel. Demonstrate leadership/ interpersonal relationship and asset management skills. Good client service orientation skills.
jobs.duties: Ensure that assets are properly accounted for in the Asset Register and comply with National Treasury Guidelines. Update new additions, movements, transfers and disposals. Reconcile BAS with the Asset Register on monthly basis. Monitor all entries made on the Asset Register as per minimum requirements. Retiring of all losses and disposed of assets in the register. Update inventory lists. Ensure that asset policies, procedures and guidelines are reviewed, updated and implemented and ensure compliance thereof. Ensure that the Department’s asset requirements are included in the budget. Perform quarterly asset count. Conduct bi–annual physical verification of movable assets and reconcile against the Asset Register. Implement and manage registers for finance/operating Leases. Verify the existence of Finance/operating Leases and prepare monthly reconciliation between BAS and amortization tables versus the Finance/operating Lease registers. Ensure monthly payments are processed on the basis of invoices received. Ensure reconciling items on ledger, registers and supplier accounts are cleared. Ensure proper annual reporting and reconciliations. Quality assurance of asset management processes.

af.title: Batebeheerder
af.summary: Batebeheerder by die Department of Economic Development and Tourism in Mbombela, wat 'n NQF vlak 6 kwalifikasie en twee jaar se batebestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike SAQA-erkende NQF vlak ses (06) tersiêre kwalifikasie in Finansiële Bestuur/ Voorsieningskettingbestuur/ Aankope / Logistiek / Publieke Administrasie/ Finansies / Rekeningkunde met twee (2) jaar ervaring in 'n Batebestuursomgewing. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van Basic Accounting System (BAS), GRAP en LOGIS. Rekenaarvaardigheid met goeie kennis van die MS Office-pakket, by voorkeur Excel. Toon leierskaps-/ interpersoonlike verhoudings- en batebestuursvaardighede. Goeie kliëntediens-oriëntasievaardighede.
af.duties: Verseker dat bate behoorlik in die Bateregister verantwoord word en voldoen aan die Nasionale Tesourie se Riglyne. Werk nuwe byvoegings, bewegings, oordragte en beskikkingstelling by. Versoen BAS maandeliks met die Bateregister. Monitor alle inskrywings op die Bateregister volgens minimum vereistes. Uitskryf van alle verliese en beskikkinggestelde bates in die register. Werk voorraadlyste by. Verseker dat batebeleid, prosedures en riglyne hersien, bygewerk en geïmplementeer word en verseker nakoming daarvan. Verseker dat die departement se batevereistes in die begroting ingesluit word. Voer kwartaallikse batetelling uit. Voer halfjaarlikse fisiese verifikasie van roerende bates uit en versoen teen die Bateregister. Implementeer en bestuur registers vir finansie-/bedryfs huurkontrakte. Verifieer die bestaan van Finansie-/bedryfs huurkontrakte en berei maandelikse versoenings voor tussen BAS en amortisasietabelle teenoor die Finansie-/bedryfs huurkontrakregisters. Verseker maandelikse betalings verwerk word op grond van fakture ontvang. Verseker dat versoenende poste op grootboek, registers en verskafferrekeninge uitgeklaar word. Verseker behoorlike jaarlikse verslagdoening en versoenings. Kwaliteitsversekering van batebestuursprosesse.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezimpahla
zu.summary: Umphathi Wezimpahla eDepartment of Economic Development and Tourism eMbombela, ofuna izifundo ezikwizinga NQF level 6 namava eminyaka emibili ekuphathweni kwezimpahla.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esifanele esivunywe yi-SAQA esikwizinga lesibili ngesikhundla lesithupha (06) tertiary qualification eFinancial Management/ Supply Chain Management/ Purchasing / Logistics / Public Administration/ Finance / Accounting ngamava eminyaka emibili (2) ekuphathweni kwezimpahla. Licence evumelekile yokushayela. Ulwazi nge-Basic Accounting System (BAS), GRAP kanye ne-LOGIS. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ngolwazi oluhle ohlelweni i-MS Office suite ikakhulukazi i-Excel. Ukubonisa amakhono okubusa/ ubudlelwano abantu kanye namakhono okuphatha izimpahla. Amakhono amahle okukhonza abathengi.
zu.duties: Qiniseka ukuthi izimpahla zibalwe kahle ku-Asset Register futhi zihambisana nezinqubo ze-National Treasury Guidelines. Bhalisa okushiwo okusha, ukunyakaza, ukudluliselwa kanye nokulahla. Hambisa idatha phakathi kwe-BAS ne-Asset Register nyanga zonke. Qaphela okuphansi okokuthi yonke iminingwane engenisiwe kwi-Asset Register. Khipha konke okulahlekile kanye nezimpahla ezilahliwe kureshida. Bhalisa izinto zesitoko. Qiniseka ukuthi izinqubomgomo, izinqubo kanye nokuqukethwe mayelana nezimpahla zibuyekezwa, zibhaliswe futhi zisetshenziswe futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuhambisana kwenziwe. Qiniseka ukuthi izidingo zezimpahla zomnyango zifakwe kwesabelomali. Yenza ukubala kwezimpahla nkathi ngamunye. Yenza ukuqinisekisa okubhalwayo ngokwesibhakela kwazonyakazisayo futhi uhambisane le-Asset Register. Setha futhi uphathe izibhalo ze-finance/operating Leases. Qinisekisa ukuba khona kwe-Finance/operating Leases futhi ulungise ukuhambisaniswa nyanga zonke phakathi kwe-BAS namatafula wokwenza okulinganiselwayo ahambisana nezibhalo ze-finance/operating Lease. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinkokhelo zeminye yonke zithathwe ngokwesabelo esitholiwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi okungahambisani ohlelweni, ezibhalweni nasezibalweni zabahlinzeki kusulwe. Qinisekisa ukubika nemibiko yokuhambisana ngokwaminyaka yonke kahle. Ukulungiselela ukuphathwa kahle kwezinqubo zokulawula izimpahla.

xh.title: Umlawuli weempahla
xh.summary: Umlawuli weempahla kwiSebe lePhuhliso lezoQoqosho lezeNkululeko nokuZihamba nokwenza iNtoMbiyela, efunwa ngemfuno yesidanga se-NQF level 6 namava eminyaka emibini ekulawulweni kweepahla.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esamkelwe yi-SAQA sesidanga se-NQF level six (06) samabanga aphakamileyo kwi-Financial Management/ Supply Chain Management/ Purchasing / Logistics / Public Administration/ Finance / Accounting kunye namava eminyaka emibini (2) ekusingathweni kweepahla. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi nge-Basic Accounting System (BAS), i-GRAP nayo i-LOGIS. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngononophelo oluhle ngelwazi eliqinileyo ngesuite ye-MS Office ngokukodwa i-Excel. Ukuza phambili ngamava obuqu ngokukhokela/ ubudlelwane nobunye abantu nangamava ekulawulweni kweepahla. Amava amahle ekukhengelela ngokukhuthaza ukukhonza abathengi.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuba iimpahla zibalwe ngokuchanekileyo kwi-Asset Register zize zihambisane neenkqubo ze-National Treasury Guidelines. Hlaziya izongezo ezintsha, iintshukumo, iintshekelo nokusetyenziswa kwezinye izinto. Qikelela i-BAS nge-Asset Register nyanga zonke. Lilinde onke amagalelo agenwe kwi-Asset Register njengoko kufuneka ngokomlinganiselo ongaphantsi. Ukuphelisa konke ukulahleka nokuwa kweempahla ezisetyenziselwa ezinye izinto kwirejista. Hlaziya uluhlu lwezinto ezingenanto. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo, iinkqubo zomsebenzi neenkqubo zolawulo zihlaziwa, zihlaziywa zize zisetenziswe ngokweenkqubo, ukuqinisekisa ukuzihambelana kwazo. Qinisekisa ukuba iimfuno zeempahla zeSebe zifakwe kwindawo yemali. Yenza ukubala iimpahla rhoqo kwiveki nethathu. Yenza ukuqinisekisa ngokomzimba ngeqondo lemihla emibini ngonyaka ngeempahla ezihambayo uze uqikelele ngokuchasene ne-Asset Register. Setenzise ulawule amarejista e-Finance/operating Leases. Qinisekisa ukuba ukho i-Finance/operating Leases ulungiselele ukuqikelelwa nyanga zonke phakathi kwe-BAS namatafula wokuchithwa kwemali achasene namarejista e-Finance/operating Lease. Qinisekisa ukuba intlawulo yenyanga nganye yenziwa ngokwemali efuniweyo etholwe kumvuzo. Qinisekisa ukuba izinto ezingaqikelelwa kwithileyidi, amarejista ne-akhawunti zabathengi zicocwa ngokupheleleyo. Qinisekisa ukukhankanywa ngonyaka nokuqikelelwa ngokupheleleyo. Ukuvakaliseka kolwazi ngokuqinisekisa iinkqubo zokulawula iimpahla.

jobs.summary: Business Economist needed at the Ehlanzeni District Office in Mbombela to facilitate BBBEE implementation and economic empowerment initiatives.

Knowledge of BBBEE Act, BBBEE Codes of Good Practice, Sector Charters, Employment Equity Act, Provincial & National Macro-economic policies. Good verbal and written communication skills, Analytical skills and Presentation skills. Computer skills and valid driver’s license.

Monitor the implementation of BBBEE codes of good practice and Sector codes in all sectors of the provincial economy. Facilitate procurement by government and private sector from BEE establishments. af.title: Beskafsekonom: Ekonomiese Bemagtiging
af.summary: Beskafsekonom benodig by die Ehlanzeni-distrikkantoor in Mbombela om BBBEE-implementering en ekonomiese bemagtinginisiatiewe te fasiliteer.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike SAQA-erkende NQF-vlak 6 tersiêre kwalifikasie in Ekonomie/Besigheidsbestuur met twee (02) jaar werkervaring in 'n ekonomiese bemagtingsomgewing. Kennis van BBBEE-wet, BBBEE-kodes van goeie praktyk, sektorhandvese, Indienstnemingserfte-wet, provinsiale en nasionale makro-ekonomiese beleide. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike Kommunikasievaardighede, analitiese vaardighede en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede en geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die totstandkoming van BEE-ondernemings in die voordoeingsketting. Monitor die implementering van BBBEE-kodes van goeie praktyk en sektorkodes in alle sektore van die provinsiale ekonomie. Fasiliteer aankope deur regering en die privaatsektor by BEE-instansies. zu.title: I-Business Economist: Ukuzinza kwezomnotho

zu.title: Isikhundla Sokuxhumana: Community and Intra-departmental
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuxhumana emnyangweni we Mpumalanga Department of Economic Development and Tourism e Mbombela, sifuna iziqu ze NQF level 6 namava eminyaka emibili kokuxhumana.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekile ze SAQA NQF level 6 kwi Communication/Journalism/Marketing/Public Relations hambe nomva eminyakeni emibili (02) ekusebenzeni kwindawo yokuxhumana. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni. Kube nethuba lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegcinze; ukulungele ukusebenza amahora angajwayelekile (okuqukethe amasonto nokholikholi); ukuze uhamba kakhulu, lapho kudingeka ukuze ugcwalise izibopho esikhathini esingakhathali. Ukuqonda kahle igunya lomnyango ngokomthetho osetshenzwayo, imiyalo nemithetho. Umuntu ophumelelo kufanele akwazi ukubonisa amakhono alandelayo: ukwenza izinto eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa, ubudlelwano obuhle nomphakathi, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukuphatha isikhathi namakhono okubeka izinto ngendlela ebaluleke kakhulu, nendlela yokubuka phambili, amakhono aphakeme okuxhumana ngokubhala nangokukhuluma, nokunaka imininingwane, ulwazi nokuzwa ngamasiko namagugu kahulumeni. Umuntu ofuna isikhundla kufanele akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha okuhlanganisa nokusebenzisa izinhlelo zekhompyutha ezahlukene ngobuchule obuphakeme.
zu.duties: Ukuvuselela njalo isiqukathi sedatha yabathintana njalo; Ukuyilunga ulwangu lwezinkathi zemnyango; Ukusiza ekuyilungeni izinhlelo zokubamba iqhaza komphakathi zemnyango nemikhankaso; Ukuphatha wonke amebhishini omnyango; Ukukhiqiza okufakwe kumapapasho angaphakathi nangaphandle; Ukukhiqiza okuqukethe konke ukwaziswa kwemikhiqizo; Ukusakaza ukwaziswa nokuxhumana nabathintana ngezinhlelo zomnyango zokuxhumana kumasentsha; Ukunikeza inkonzo yokumakiwa; Ukunikeza inkonzo yokuthatha izithombe; Ukuxhumana nokusebenza eduze kwezinhlangano zomphakathi zomnyango nabanye abathintana; Ukuqamba bese unikeza imibiko edingekayo; Ukunikeza inkxaso yolawulo evamile; Ukwenza noma yimiphi eminye imisebenzi ehlobene njengokuqondiwe.

xh.title: Nothuli Wokunxibelelane: Uluntu Nakwingxilumko yaseKwiebe
xh.summary: Indima yonothuli wokunxibelelane kwisebe leMpumalanga Department of Economic Development and Tourism eMbombela, efunwa ngemfundo yenguqulaka inqanaba le-6 nemyaka emibini yamava okunxibelelane.

Ilayisensi yokuqamba enesigqibo sokusebenza. Ukuba nakho isakhono sokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo; ulungele ukusebenza iiyure ezingaqhelananga (kuquka iweeke ends nasemihla yamacandelo alo); aze uhambe kakhulu, xa kufuneka ukuze ugqibezele ngexesha elinqinelweyo. Ukuqonda kakuhle umthetho wesebe ngokwemiGaqo, imigaqo namalungiselelo asebenzayo. Umphakhamli opumeleleyo kufuneka abe nakho ukubonisa amakhono alandelayo: ukwenza izinto ezininhi kunye, ubuhlobo obukhulu noluntu, uLawulo loMsebenzi, ulawulo lwexesha namakhono okubeka izinto ngendlela ebalulekileyo, ngonendlela ephilayo, amakhono amaninzi okubhalisa nokunxibelelana ngomlomo, nokunqumama kwiinkcukacha, ulwazi nokuqonda ngemigaqo nangamaxabiso karhulumente. Umphakhamli oqhubekayo kufuneka akwazi ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha kuquka nokusetyenziswa kweenkqubo ezahlukeneyo zesoftware kwinqanaba eliphezulu lobuchule.
xh.duties: Kutsha ngokutsha uhlaziye isiseko sedatha sabahlobo; Lawula ukuqulunqwa kweNkqadi yemiNhlabo yesebe;nceda ekulawuleni iinkqaba zoNyuko oluNzulu lweNyani neNkululeko lwaMaqabane; Lawula zonke iimbukiso zesebe; Velisa okuqukiweyo kokubeni kokushicilelwa ngaphakathi nakunaphandle; Yenza okuqukiweyo kuzo zonke iinkcukacha eziphakamiswayo; Saza inkcazelo uze unxibelelane nabahlobo ngeendlela zentlalo yoxinzelelo zesebe; Nikezela inkonzo yokwenza iimpawu; Nikezela inkonzo yokuthatha iifoto; Chinxisa uze usebenze ngokucacileyo namaqumbe aHluziweyo eSebe nayo mamanye abahlobo; Qulunqa uze ungenise iingxelo eziyimfuneko; Nikezela inkxaso yolawulo jikelele; Zenza nayo nanj na imisebenzi eqeqeshiweyo njengoko uleliwe.

af.title: HR-praktisyn: HR-beplanning en PMDS
af.summary: HR-praktisyn benodig by Mpumalanga Department of Economic Development and Tourism om HR-beplanning en PMDS by Hoofkantoor, Mbombela, te bestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike SAQA-erkende NQF-vlak 6 tersiêre kwalifikasie in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur/Openbare Bestuur/Openbare Administrasie met twee (2) jaar se ondervinding in 'n MHB-omgewing. Geldige bestuurderlisensie. Begrip van die regeringsraamwerke, kennis van die PERSAL-stelsel, prestasiebestuurs- en ontwikkelingsisteem, menslike hulpbron en verwante voorskrifte, Wet op Basiese Diensvoorwaardes, EEA met mondelinge en geskrewe kommunikasievaardighede, rekenaargeletterdheid d.w.s. Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, vermoë om konflik te bestuur en onder druk te werk en vermoë om wetgewing, beleide en voorskrifte te ontleed, te interpreteer en toe te pas.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die indiening van Prestasie-ooreenkomste, Middeltermyn- en Jaarlikse Assessering. Voer gehaltversekering uit op die ingediende PMDS-dokumente. Vang Prestasie-ooreenkomste, Middeltermyn- en Jaarlikse Assessering op PERSAL. Verseker die beskikbaarheid van 'n akkurate en opgedateerde PMDS-databasis. Fasiliteer die implementering van Jaarlikse Assessering-uitkomste (salarisvordering) en berei moderasie-uitslae-briewe voor. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van die EE-plan en EE-verslag. Bystand in die ontwikkeling van die koste-per-hoof-dokument. Administereer sekretariatsdienste aan komitees wat deur die Menslike Hulpbronbeplanning en PMDS-subdirektoraat gefasiliteer word. Onderhou 'n HR-beleideregister, en 'n databasis van posbeskrywings en posevaluasie-uitslae.

zu.title: Umsebenzi we-HR: Ukuhlelwa kwe-HR kanye ne-PMDS
zu.summary: Kudingeka umsebenzi we-HR e-Mpumalanga Department of Economic Development and Tourism ukuphatha ukuhlelwa kwe-HR kanye ne-PMDS e-Head Office, Mbombela.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikole ephakeme ezivunyiwe yi-SAQA ezingeni le-NQF level 6 kwe-Human Resource Management/Public Management/Public Administration okuhambisana neminyaka emibili (2) yemfundo yokusebenza emkhakheni we-HRM. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukuqonda izakhiwo zahulumeni, ulwazi lwesistimu ye-PERSAL, isistimu yokuphatha nokuthuthukisa ukusebenza, umthetho ohlobene nemithetho yokuphatha abasebenzi, i-Basic Conditions of Employment Act, i-EEA okuhambisana nobuchophobuchopho bokukhuluma nokubhala, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha okungathi yi-Microsoft word, excel, PowerPoint, ikhono lokuphathisa izingxabano nokusebenza ngomzimba ongaphantsi kwenkinga kanye nenkingusi yokuhlaziya, ukuhumusha nokusebenzisa umthetho, izinqubomgomo kanye nemithetho.
zu.duties: Siza ekunikeni ngaphambili izivumelwano zokusebenza, ukuhlola ngephakathi komnyaka kanye nokuhlola ngonyaka. Yenza ukuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi emafayela e-PMDS anikwe ngaphambili. Faka izivumelwano zokusebenza, ukuhlola ngaphakathi komnyaka kanye nokuhlola ngonyaka ku-PERSAL. Qinisekisa ukutholakala kwesisekelo sedatha ye-PMDS esiqinisekile futhi esihlaziyiwe. Siza ekwenzeni isiphumo sokuhlola ngonyaka (ukuqhubeleka phambili kokuqashwa) futhi ulungiselela izinhlamvu zeziphumo zokulinganisela. Siza ekuqaliseni i-EE Plan kanye ne-EE Report. Siza ekuqaliseni umthetho wentsengo ngayinye. Hlela izinkonzo zokuba nesikhulumi kwamakomidi ahlotshaniswe nesebe elincane le-Human Resource Planning and PMDS. Gcina ukubhaliswa kwezinqubomgomo ze-HR, kanye nesisekelo sedatha seminikelo yezinkalo kanye nezumphumela zokuhlola imisebenzi.

xh.title: UmPractitioner we-HR: Iplano ye-HR kunye ne-PMDS
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umPractitioner we-HR kwisebe leMpumalanga Department of Economic Development and Tourism ukulawula iplano ye-HR kunye ne-PMDS kwiNtloko eNkulu, e-Mbombela.
xh.requirements: Isifundo se-siqinisekiso i-SAQA i-SAQA esamkelwe i-NQF level 6 kwikhampasi yokufundela kwi-Human Resource Management/Public Management/Public Administration kunye neminyaka emibini (2) yamava kwindawo yamava ye-HRM. Ifayili yelayisense yomqhubi egqamelayo. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zolawulo lukarhulumente, ulwazi ngesixhobo se-PERSAL, inkqubo yophuhliso kunye nokulawula ukusebenza, ulwazi ngoluntu nangemigaqo ebandakanyekayo, i-Basic Conditions of Employment Act, i-EEA kunye namakhono onxibelelwano olulumathyo nolubhaliweyo, ulwazi lokusebenza ngaphakathi ngaphakathi kwekhompyutha njenge-Microsoft word, excel, PowerPoint, amakhono okulawula iingxabano nokusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo kunye namakhono okuhlalutya, okutolika nokusebenzisa amagazethi elawulo, iinkqubo kunye nemigaqo.
xh.duties: Kulawule ukungeniswa kweziVumelwano zoMsebenzi ongummiselo wolawulo, iNqubo yokuHlolwa phakathi kwexesha kunye neNqubo yokuHlolwa ngomnyaka. Qhuba iinkcukacha zokuqinisekisa ngomgangatho kumaxwebhu e-PMDS anikelweyo. Faka iziVumelwano zoMsebenzi ongummiselo wolawulo, iNqubo yokuHlolwa phakathi kwexesha kunye neNqubo yokuHlolwa ngomnyaka kwi-PERSAL. Qinisekisa ukubakho kwesiseko sedatha e-PMDS esinengile nesihlaziyweyo. Kulawule ukusetyenziswa kweziphumo zeNqubo yokuHlolwa ngomnyaka (intshintsho yemivuzo) kwaye ulungise iileta zeziphumo zenqubo yolungelelwaniso. Kulawule ukuveliswa kweNqubo ye-EE kunye neNgxelo ye-EE. Nceda ekuvunjini kwengxelo yamaxabiso nganthundu. Lawula iinkonzo zabaseki kwikomiti eziqhubwa yiNgcwebo eLawulayo yoQoqosho kunye ne-PMDS. Gcina okubhaliweyo kweenqumzamthetho ze-HR, iinkcazelo zemisebenzi kunye nesiseko sedatha yeziphumo zokuqokelelwa kwemisebenzi.

jobs.title: Messenger/driver
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development and Tourism
jobs.summary: Drive and deliver mail and documents for the Department of Economic Development and Tourism in Kwamhlanga, maintaining vehicle logs and reporting defects.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate, valid driver’s license, Skills and Knowledge: Knowledge of messenger services. Knowledge of planning and organising, valid PDP licence. Knowledge of roads and places, Knowledge of Batho Pele Principles, Knowledge of messenger services. Good people skills. High level of reliability. Basic written communication skills. The ability to act with tact and discretion. Good grooming and presentation skills. Ability to operate photocopier machine. Organisational skills.
jobs.duties: Drive light and medium motor vehicles to transport passengers and deliver other items such as mail and documents. Do routine maintenance on the allocated vehicle and report defects timely. Complete all the required and prescribed records and logs books with regard to the vehicle and the goods handled. Collect mail and documents from all over as requested. Collect mail from post office or courier services, including heavy boxes. Deliver invitations to stakeholders e.g. business group. Collect stationery and goods from stores. Collect and deliver documentation and related items in the department. Copy and fax documents. Assist in the registry activities. Attend to district logistical support services. Provide transport services for the district officials.
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted online through the Provincial e-Recruitment Portal at https://erecruitment.mpg.gov.za Applicants are required to register and create a profile on the system before submitting their applications. A comprehensive, recently updated Curriculum Vitae (CV) including three (3) contactable references and all mandatory documents must be uploaded on the portal to apply for these opportunities. No manual, emailed or faxed applications will be accepted.
jobs.notes: Applications received after closing date will, as a rule not be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates for the post will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation report (only when shortlisted). af.title: Bode/Bestuurder
af.summary: Bestuur en lewer pos en dokumente vir die Department of Economic Development and Tourism in Kwamhlanga, hou voertuiglogboeke by en rapporteer foute.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat, geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vaardighede en kennis: Kennis van bodedienste. Kennis van beplanning en organisasie, geldige PDP-lisensie. Kennis van paaie en plekke, kennis van Batho Pele-beginsels, kennis van bodedienste. Goeie mensevaardighede. Hoë vlak van betroubaarheid. Basiese skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Die vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree. Goeie versorging en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Vermoë om fotostaatmasjien te bedryf. Organisasievaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur ligte en medium motorvoertuie om passasiers te vervoer en ander items soos pos en dokumente te lewer. Doen roetine-onderhoud aan die toegewysde voertuig en rapporteer foute betyds. Voltooi al die vereiste en voorgeskrewe rekords en logboeke ten opsigte van die voertuig en die goedere wat hanteer word. Versamel pos en dokumente oral soos versoek. Versamel pos by die poskantoor of koerierdienste, insluitend swaar bokse. Lewer uitnodigings aan belanghebbendes bv. besigheidsgroep. Versamel skryfbehoeftes en goedere by winkels. Versamel en lewer dokumentasie en verwante items in die departement. Kopieer en faks dokumente. Bystand in die registeraktiwiteite. Spreek distrik se logistieke ondersteuningsdienste. Verskaf vervoerdienste vir die distrikbeamptes.

zu.title: Umthumeli/umshayeli
zu.summary: Shayela bese ethumela iposi namadokhumenti ku-Department of Economic Development and Tourism e-Kwamhlanga, ulondoloze irekhodi lezimoto ubize iziphazamiso.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12, ilayisense elisebenzayo lokushayela, Amakhono nolwazi: Ulwazi ngamasevisi okuthumela. Ulwazi lokuhlulela nokuhlela, ilayisense elisebenzayo le-PDP. Ulwazi ngezindlela nezindawo, Ulwazi ngezimiso ze-Batho Pele, Ulwazi ngamasevisi okuthumela. Amakhono amahle abantu. Izinga eliphezulu lokuthembeka. Amakhono abhalo okusesikhathini. Ikono lokuziphatha ngobuhlakani nokugcina umfihlo. Amakhono amahle okuziqamba nokubukeka kahle. Ikono lokusebenzisa imishini yokushaja kopi. Amakhono ohlelo.
zu.duties: Shayela izimoto ezincane nezilinganisi ezithuthukwana ukuthutha abagibeli bese uthumela ezinye izinto njengalokhu iposi namadokhumenti. Yenza ukulondolozwa okujwayelekile kwesimoto enikiwe ubize iziphazamiso ngesikhathi. Qedela yonke imirekhodi efunekayo necacisiwe namabhuku okuloga ngokuvisisana ngesimoto nezinto eziphethwe. Qoqa iposi namadokhumenti kuyo yonke indawo njengoba kucelwe. Qoqa iposi eposini noma emasevisini okuthumela abathunyiwe, okuhlanganisa amabhokisi ansindayo. Thumela izimemo abathintekayo isb. iqembu lebhizinisi. Qoqa amapeni nezinto ezisitolo. Qoqa futhi uthumele amadokhumenti nezinto ezihlobene kuleso mnyango. Kopa futhi ufake amadokhumenti. Siza emisebenzini yeregistri. Yezela emasevisini okwesekwa ngokulogi esifundeni. Nikeza ngamasevisi okuthutha abasebenzi besifunda.

xh.title: Umthunywa/umqhubi
xh.summary: Qhuba kwaye uzele iimeyile namaxwebhu kuSebe lePhuhliso lamava nezokuQhingqwa kwiKwamhlanga, zigcine irekhodi lezithuthi kwaye uxele ngeempazamo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12, ilayisense elisezantsi lokusebenza yonxibelelwano; Amakhono oluNolwazi: Ulwazi ngeenkonzo zabathunywa. Ulwazi ngeplani noluhlolojio, i-PDP elisezantsi. Ulwazi ngeendawo namagama, Ulwazi ngeMigaqo yeBatho Pele, Ulwazi ngeenkonzo zabathunywa. Imakhono ebalasela kwabantu. Iqondo eliphezulu lobuzithiba. Imakhono esisiseko yokuvela kubhalo. Ulawulo lokubhabatha ngaphandle kwegqondo kunye ne kunomsithi wexwebhu. Imakhono ezokuvela kubhalo elisikiwa kubhalo lombuzo. Ukuba namakhono okubika ngokuzithiba. Imakhono yokubika ngokuzinikela. Ukuba nolwazi lokubika ngesiphatho somzekiso wengxoxo. Iphini elingekabonwa ngelinye. Ukwenza izigqibo ngokubika ngokuzinikela.
xh.duties: Qhuba izithuthi ezize ezincinci neziphakathi ukuthutha abahamba nokuletha ezinye izinto njenge iimeyile namaxwebhu. Yiza kwaye wenze ulungelelwaniso ngesithuthi esinikiweyo kwaye uxele iimpazamo ngesithuba. Qedela yonke irekhodi nezesincwadi ezifunekayo ngokusesithuthi nokutshatshazelwa kwezinto ezifunekayo. Qokelela iimeyile namaxwebhu kulo lonke iqondo njengoko kucelwe. Qokelela iimeyile ezivela kofisi yeposi okanye kwiinkonzo zokuhanjiswa amaxwebhu, kuquka nezibokisi ezinzima. Yaza izimemo kubahlali abasemagunyeni isb. iqela leshishini. Qokelela izixhobo zokubhala namayeza ezithi zikwiiwindowe. Qokelela kwaye uzele amaxwebhu namanye amalungu asemabahleni kwisebe. Kopisha kwaye ufakse amaxwebhu. Ncedisa kumsebenzi wezarejistari. Yala ngenkonzo zokulungelelwaniso zesithili. Zezela izithuthi ngenkonzo zabasebenzi kwizithili.

af.title: Receptionis
af.summary: Receptionis benodig by die Department of Economic Development and Tourism se hoofkantoor in Mbombela om telefoonoprope, resepsiedienste en posroetering te bestuur.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat. Moet bereid wees om outonoom en onder druk te werk. Kennis van Batho Pele-beginsels, die bedryf van telekommunikasiestelsels en voor kantoor etiket is noodsaaklik. Die aansoeker moet oor die volgende vaardighede beskik probleemoplossing, kommunikasie, rekenaarvaardigheid, kliëntgerigtheid.
af.duties: Hanteer alle inkomende en uitgaande telefoonoprope, stuur oprope deur na die relevante beampte/kantoor, verskaf terplekke en aanlyn resepsiedienste, behoorlike instandhouding van toerusting en telefoonoproepe. Onderhou die telefoongids vir die Kantoor. Ontvang en herroeteer inkomende pos en pakkette. Verseker dat geen besoeker na kantore gaan voordat eers met die relevante kantoor geverifieer is en ingeteken is nie. Onderhou die netheid en orde van die resepsie-area.

zu.title: Umamukeli wezivakashi
zu.summary: Kudingeka umamukeli wezivakashi ehhovisi elikhulu le-Department of Economic Development and Tourism e-Mbombela ukuphatha amakholi efoni, izinkonzo zokwamukela izivakashi nokuhlola imeyili.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12. Kumele afake icebo lokusebenza aze ayikwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezela. Kuwudingo ukuba nokwazi ngemigaqo ye-Batho Pele, ukusebenza kohlelo lokuxhumana kumacingwana kanye nemikhuba yehhovisi elingaphambili. Umfakisicelo kumele abe nalamakhono okulungisa izinkinga, ukuxhumana, ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha, nokubhekise kubathengi.
zu.duties: Kumele aphathewonke amakholi afaka naphuma efoni, adlulele amakholi kumnyango/ofisini okufanele, anike izinkonzo zokwamukela izivakashi ngesikhungo nakwi-inthanethi, agcine ngokufanele izinto zokusebenza nakholi zefoni. Ugcinise uhlu lwamakheli wefoni leHHovisi. Amukele futhi adlulele imeyili nezinkandiso ezifakwayo. Qiniseka ukuthi akukho sivakashi siyayiyona kuwo amayofisi ngaphandle kokuhlola kuqala nefisi okufanele bese sibhala ngokungena. Gcina ukuhlanzeka nokuhleleka kwendawo yokwamukela izivakashi.

xh.title: Umamkeli weentango
xh.summary: Kufuneka umamkeli weentango eDepartment of Economic Development and Tourism Head Office eMbombela ukulawula amacango efowuni, iinkonzo zokwamkela nokuhamba kweposi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12. Kufuneka abe kulungele ukusebenza yedwa nangaphantsi koxinzelelo. Kuyimfuneko ukuba nalwazi ngemigaqo yeBatho Pele, ukusebenza kwenkqubo yetharihamsi kunye nemigaqo yekampani yangaphambili. Umfundi kufuneka anezakhono ezilandelayo ukusombulula iingxaki, ukunxibelelana, ukusebenza ngekhompyutha, nokubhekisa kumthengi.
xh.duties: Kunyanzeliswa amacango efowuni ongenayo nayaphumayo, ukuqhuba amacango kulawulelekile ofisi/orhulumente, ukunika iinkonzo zokwamkela kwindawo nakwi-intanethi, ukugcina ngokuchanekileyo izixhobo kunye namacango efowuni. Kufuneki sigcinwe incwadi yamagama eefowuni yoMnyango. Kwamkelwe kwaye kphinde kqhelwe indlela iposti nakwisiphelo sephakheji ezayo. Kuqinisekiswe akukho mntu urhamba kumawofisi ngaphandle kokuqinisekisa kwindawo ofisi olawulekayo kokubala asayine. Kugcinwe inkcubeko nokuqwalaselwa kwindawo yokwamkela.

jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 1
jobs.centre: Amajuba Memorial Hospital (Gert Sibande District) Themba Hospital (Ehlanzeni District)
jobs.summary: Medical Officer Grade 1 sought for hospitals in Mpumalanga's Gert Sibande and Ehlanzeni districts, requiring MBChB and HPCSA registration.
jobs.requirements: MBChB degree (qualification) that allows registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner. Current registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner (2026) (Independent Practice). NB: The appointed Medical Officer must be able to work shifts. A valid work permit will be required from non-South Africans. Sound knowledge of medical ethics. Multidisciplinary management and teamwork and experience in the respective medical discipline. Knowledge of current Health and Public Service regulations and policies. Skills in terms of consultations, history taking, examination, clinical assessment and clinical management. Grade 1: No experience required after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice). Minimum of 1-year relevant experience after registration with a recognised Foreign Health Professions and / or the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice) for foreign qualified employees. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competences Required: Sound knowledge of medical ethics. Multidisciplinary management and teamwork and experience in the respective medical discipline. Sound clinical knowledge, competency and skills in general clinical domains. The ability to work under supervision as an efficient team member. Good communication, leadership, interpersonal, and supervisory skills. Ability to manage patients independently, diligently, responsibility and engage when necessary. Knowledge of current health policies, legislation, programmes and priorities within the domain. Ability to teach, guide and junior staff within the department. Behavioural Attributes: Stress tolerance, to work within a team, self-confidence and the ability to build and maintain good relationship. Sound clinical knowledge with regard to medicine. Ability to deal with all medical emergencies. Knowledge of ethical medical practice.
jobs.duties: To execute duties and functions with proficiency, to support the aims and objectives of the Institution that consistent with standards of patient care. Accept responsibility for the management of patients admitted in a level 2/3 package of service facility. Assist in the preparation and implementation of guidelines and protocols. Participate in academic and training programmes. Assist with clinical audits actively participate in continuous professional development. Provide support to hospital management towards an efficient standard of patient care and services is maintained.
