af.title: Mediese Beampte Vlak 1
af.summary: Mediese Beampte Vlak 1 gesoek vir hospitale in Mpumalanga se Gert Sibande- en Ehlanzeni-distrikte, wat MBChB en HPCSA-registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: MBChB-graad (kwalifikasie) wat registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. huidige registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn (2026) (Onafhanklike Praktyk). NB: Die aangestelde Mediese Beampte moet skofte kan werk. 'n Geldige werkpermit sal van nie-Suid-Afrikaners vereis word. Deeglike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ervaring in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Kennis van huidige Gesondheids- en Openbare Diens-regulasies en -beleide. Vaardighede ten opsigte van konsultasies, anamnese, ondersoek, kliniese assessering en kliniese bestuur. Vlak 1: Geen ervaring vereis na registrasie met die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn (Onafhanklike Praktyk). Minimum van 1-jarige relevante ervaring na registrasie met 'n erkende Buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessies en / of die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn (Onafhanklike Praktyk) vir buitelands gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Deeglike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ervaring in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Deeglike kliniese kennis, bevoegdheid en vaardighede in algemene kliniese domeine. Die vermoë om onder toesig as 'n doeltreffende spanlid te werk. Goeie kommunikasie-, leierskaps-, interpersoonlike en toesighoudende vaardighede. Vermoeë om pasiënte onafhanklik, ywerig, verantwoordelik te bestuur en betrokke te raak wanneer nodig. Kennis van huidige gesondheidsbeleide, -wetgewing, -programme en -prioriteite binne die domein. Vermoeë om junior personeel binne die departement te onderrig en te begelei. Gedragskenmerke: Strestoleransie, om binne 'n span te werk, selfvertroue en die vermoë om goeie verhoudings te bou en te handhaaf. Deeglike kliniese kennis ten opsigte van geneeskunde. Vermoeë om alle mediese noodgevalle te hanteer. Kennis van etiese mediese praktyk.
af.duties: Om pligte en funksies met vaardigheid uit te voer, om die doelwitte en oogmerke van die Instelling te ondersteun wat ooreenstem met standaarde van pasiëntsorg. Neem verantwoordelikheid vir die bestuur van pasiënte wat in 'n vlak 2/3 dienspakkie-fasiliteit opgeneem is. Bystand verleen by die voorbereiding en implementering van riglyne en protokolle. Deelneem aan akademiese en opleidingsprogramme. Bystand verleen met kliniese oudits en aktief deelneem aan deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling. Ondersteuning verleen aan hospitaalbestuur om te verseker dat 'n doeltreffende standaard van pasiëntsorg en -dienste gehandhaaf word.

zu.title: I-Officer Yezokwelapha Izinga 1
zu.summary: Kufunwa i-Officer Yezokwelapha Izinga 1 ezibhedlela kumakhonza ase-Gert Sibande nase-Ehlanzeni esifundazweni sase-Mpumalanga, kudingwa i-MBChB nokubhalisele ku-HPCSA.
zu.requirements: I-degree ye-MBChB (iziqu) evumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomprakthisi wezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa kwamanje ku-HPCSA njengomprakthisi wezokwelapha (2026) (I-Independent Practice). OKUQAPHELWAYO: I-Officer Yezokwelapha oyakhethwa kumele akwazi ukusebenza ngokushintshana. Izakudingwa i-permit yomsebenzi esemthethweni ebantu abangeyona abaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukwazi okuhle ngezomthetho zokuziphatha ezokwelapha. Ukuqondisa kwabaningi futhi ukusebenza njengqembu nokuba namava kwelika-theji yezokwelapha ehlotshaniswe nayo. Ukwazi ngemithetho nezinqubomgomo zamanu zezempilo kanye nezokwenzakamo konzabantu. Amakhono ohlwini lokweluleka, ukuthatha umlando, ukuhlola, ukulinganisa ngokwesifo kanye nokuphatha izifo. Izinga 1: Akudingwa namava ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomprakthisi wezokwelapha (I-Independent Practice). Okuncane ukuthi unamava okungenani kwangu-1 unyaka ngemva kokubhalisa ku-Foreign Health Professions ebutunyelwe noma ku-HPCSA njengomprakthisi wezokwelapha (I-Independent Practice) kubasebenzi abafundele kunhlanzela abangaphandle. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa namakhono adingekayo: Ukwazi okuhle ngezomthetho zokuziphatha ezokwelapha. Ukuqondisa kwabaningi futhi ukusebenza njengqembu nokuba namava kwelika-theji yezokwelapha ehlotshaniswe nayo. Ukwazi okuhle ngezifo, amakhono nokuziqonda kumagatsha jikelele ezokwelapha. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kolawulelo njengelunga elisebenza kahle leqembu. Amakhono ohlelelokuxhumana, ukuba ngumholi, amakhono ohlelo lokusebenza nabantu, kanye nokuhlola. Ikhono lokuphatha iziguli uzimele, ngokuzigqatshezi, ngomthwalo kanye nokubakho lapho kudingeka khona. Ukwazi ngemithetho, izinqubomgomo, izinhlelo, nezihloko zamanu kwezempilo endaweni yawo wonke. Ikhono lokufundisa, ukukhomba abasebenzi abaseshashalazini ngaphakathi kumninyango. Iminikelo yokuziphatha: Ukubekezela ekuhlaziywa inkinga, ukusebenza eqenjini, ukuzethemba kanye nethando lokwakha futhi ugcine ubuhlobo obuhle. Ukwazi okuhle ngezifo ngokusesikhathini. Ikhono lokubhekana nazo zonke izikhashana zezokwelapha. Ukwazi ngokuziphatha okusesikhunyeni ezokwelapha.
zu.duties: Ukwenza imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngokuziqonda ukuze ukusekela amagagu nemiyinge yesikhungo esihambisana nemizinga yekhono lokunakekelwa kwesiguli. Ukumisa ngomthwalo ukuphatha iziguli zingenisiwe kumgomo wesevisi wezinga 2/3. Ukusiza ekulungiseleleni nokusetshenzisweni imiyalo nezinqubo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumahlelo wokufunda kanye newokuziqeqesha. Ukusiza izibekeleko zezifo futhi ukuthathe inxaxheba ngokusobala ekuthuthukiseni iziqu ngokoqobo. Ukunikeza inkexhe ekuphathweni esibhedlela ukuze zigcinwe izinga eliphezulu lekhono lokunakekelwa kwesiguli nezinkonzo.

xh.title: Isebe lokuQondisa ezempilweni Inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Kufunwa Isebe lokuQondisa ezempilweni Inqanaba 1 lezibhedlele kumaphondo aGert Sibande nakuEhlanzeni eMpumalanga, kufuneka kubekho MBChB nokuBhaliswa kwiHPCSA.
xh.requirements: IDigri yeMBChB (izidanga) evumela ukubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengokoPraktisa weZonyango. Ukubhaliswa okwangoku kwiHPCSA njengokoPraktisa weZonyango (2026) (Ukuzilolonga ngokuzimele). BALULEKILEYO: Isebe lokuQondisa ezempilweni elikhethiweyo kufuneka libe nakho ukusebenza ngokutshintshwa kweeshifu. Ipermiti yomsebenzi egqityiweyo iya kufuneka kubantu abangeyiwo basemZantsi Afrika. Ulwazi olunzulu ngezobunyulu bezonyango. Ukulawula iindidi ezahlukeneyo nokusebenza njengesiqhamba nolwaziswinini kumagatya apheleleyo enyango. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nemigaqo-nkqubo yamanye amazwe yezeMpiIlo neQela loMphakathi okwangoku. Amandla okuqondisa, ukuthabatha imbali, ukuhlola, ukulinganisa ngokwezempilo nokulawula iziguli ngokwezempilo. Inqanaba 1: Akukho lwaziswinini lufunekayo emva kokubhaliswa kwiHPCSA njengoPraktisa weZonyango (Ukuzilolonga ngokuzimele). Ubuncinane beminyaka engu-1 yolwaziswinini oluhambelana naye emva kokubhaliswa kwiBhunga lezeMpiIlo laseMzantsi Afrika eliqatyweyo okanye kwiHPCSA njengoPraktisa weZonyango (Ukuzilolonga ngokuzimele) abasebenzi abagqityiweyo kwamanye amazwe. Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho namAba afunekayo: Ulwazi olunzulu ngezobunyulu bezonyango. Ukulawula iindidi ezahlukeneyo nokusebenza njengesiqhamba nolwaziswinini kumagatya apheleleyo enyango. Ulwazi olunzulu ngokwezempilo, ukuzinza namandla kumagatya apheleleyo ezempilo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kolawulo njengelungu elisebenzayo leqela. Amandla amaninzi okunxibelelwana, kukulawula, nokuhlola nabantu, namandla okulawula. Ikhono lokulawula iziguli ngokuzimele, ngokuzimisela, ngokubathatha ixabiso kwaye uthathe inxaxheba xa kuyimfuneko. Ulwazi ngemigaqo-nkqubo ezempilweni, kwimithetho, iinkqubo nezinto ezibalulekileyo kwicandelo okwangoku. Ikhono lokufundisa, nokuhamba nabasebenzi abasekuncinci kwisebe. Iimpawu zobundlobongela: Ukuzinza ngokumngcipheko, ukusebenza eqeleni, inkuzisela nokuzethemba nokwakha ukulondoloza ubuhlobo obuhle. Ulwazi olunzulu ngokwezempilo ngokuballwa kwezonyango. Ikhono lokujongana nayo yonke imeko yexesha ezempilweni. Ulwazi ngenkqubo ethikkayo yokwenza unyango.
xh.duties: Ukuze kuphunyezwe imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngenkululeko, ukuxhasa iinjongo nezijongo zeNkundla ezihambelana namazinga okunakekelwa kwesiguli. Ukubamba inxaxheba kulawulo lweziguli ezingeni elilinganiselwe kwisebe 2/3. Ukunceda ekulungiseleleni nasekuphunyezweni kwemigaqo nemiqathanga. Ukuthabatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokufunda noqeqesho. Ukunceda ekuhlolweni kwemisebenzi ezempilweni ukuthabatha inxaxheba ngokuzimisela ekuphuhliswa ngamandla ochwepheshe. Ukunika inkxaso kulawulo lesibhedlele ukuba kuqhubekekela phambili izinga elisebenzayo lokunakekelwa kweziguli nezebenzi.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1-2 (PN-B1-2): Nephrology
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 - R581 931 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 - R752 913 per annum
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse Grade 1-2 specialising in Nephrology sought for Ermelo Hospital in Mpumalanga to provide specialised holistic nursing care in the Nephrology Unit.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 qualification or equivalent plus Basic qualification accredited with the SANC in terms of Government Notice R425 (i.e. Diploma / Degree in General Nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse and Midwifery (2026), a post-basic nursing qualification, with a duration of at least 1 year, accredited with the SANC in terms of Government Notice R212 specialty in Nephrology Nursing Science. Grade 1: A minimum of four (4) years appropriate /recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the (SANC). Grade 2: A minimum of fourteen (14) years appropriate /recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) in General Nursing. At least ten (10) years of the period referred to above must be appropriate / recognisable experience in the specific speciality after obtaining the 1-year post basic qualification in relevant specialty. Ability to function independently and to prioritize work. Leadership and sound interpersonal skills, problem solving and decision- making skills. Good supervisory and teaching skills.
jobs.duties: Provision of optimal, holistic specialized nursing care with set standards and within a professional/legal framework. Provide comprehensive health care services in the Nephrology Unit. Ensure effective and efficient management of resources. Provide quality patient care, follow norms and standards. Participate in quality improvement programs. Supervise and implement patient care standards. Implement and practice nursing health care in accordance with the statutory laws governing the nursing profession, labour and health care. Implement constructive working relations with nurses and other stake holders. Ensure compliance of Infection Prevention and Control policies. Ensure that the equipment is functional and ready all the time. Ability to prioritize, coordinate activities of patient management according to protocols. Able to plan and organize your own work and that of support personnel to ensure proper nursing care. Participate in staff development and performance management. Report patient safety incidence, challenges and deficiencies within the unit. Work effectively, co-operatively amicably with people of diverse intellectual, cultural, racial or religious differences. Ensure adherence to Batho - Pele Principles and Patient’s Right Charter.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1-2 (PN-B1-2): Nefrologie
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1-2 met spesialisasie in Nefrologie gesoek vir Ermelo-hospitaal in Mpumalanga om gespesialiseerde holistiese verpleegsorg in die Nefrologie-eenheid te verskaf.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12-kwalifikasie of ekwivalent plus Basiese kwalifikasie geakkrediteer by die SANC ingevolge Goewermentskennisgewing R425 (d.w.s. Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige en Vrouekunde (2026) toelaat, 'n post-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer by die SANC ingevolge Goewermentskennisgewing R212 spesialiteit in Nefrologie Verpleegkunde Wetenskap. Graad 1: 'n Minimum van vier (4) jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die (SANC). Graad 2: 'n Minimum van veertien (14) jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad (SANC) in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste tien (10) jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit wees na verkryging van die 1-jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Vermoë om onafhanklik te funksioneer en werk te prioritiseer. Leierskap en goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, probleemoplossing en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Goeie toesighoudende en onderrigvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaffing van optimale, holistiese gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg met vasgestelde standaarde en binne 'n professionele/regtelike raamwerk. Verskaf omvattende gesondheidsorgdienste in die Nefrologie-eenheid. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van hulpbronne. Verskaf gehalte pasiëntversorging, volg norme en standaarde. Neem deel aan gehalteverbeteringsprogramme. Hou toesig oor en implementeer pasiëntversorgingsstandaarde. Implementeer en beoefen verpleegsorg en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die statutêre wette wat die verpleegberoep, arbeid en gesondheidsorg regeer. Implementeer konstruktiewe werksverhoudings met verpleegkundiges en ander belanghebbendes. Verseker nakoming van Infeksievoorkoming en Beheer-beleide. Verseker dat die toerusting funksioneel en te alle tye gereed is. Vermoë om te prioritiseer en aktiwiteite van pasiëntbestuur volgens protokolle te koördineer. In staat om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Neem deel aan personeelontwikkeling en prestasiebestuur. Rapporteer pasiëntveiligheidsvoorvalle, uitdagings en tekortkominge binne die eenheid. Werk effektief, saamwerkend en vriendelik met mense van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdienstige verskille. Verseker nakoming van Batho - Pele-beginsels en die Pasiënteregtehandves.

zu.title: Umenziwe wokulinga kahle wezesayensi sempilo Ezingeni 1-2 (PN-B1-2): i-Nephrology
zu.summary: Kufunwa umenziwe wokulinga kahle wezesayensi yezempilo Ezingeni 1-2 oqeqeshiwe kwi-Nephrology e-Ermelo Hospital e-Mpumalanga ukuze anikele nokunakekelwa ngokwamanke amaqhaza ehleli okukhethekileko e-Nephrology Unit.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Senior Certificate / Grade 12 noma okulinganayo kanye nesiqu esisisekelo esamukelwe yi-SANC ngokwe-Government Notice R425 (okungukuthi, i-Diploma / i-Degree General Nursing) noma isiqu esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengomenziwe wokulinga kahle wezesayensi yezempilo ne-Midwifery (2026), isiqu sokulinga esingaphezu kwesisekelo, ngobude bonyanga obungakapheli unyaka o-1, esamukelwe yi-SANC ngokwe-Government Notice R212 ekuqeqeshweni okukhethekileko ekwansebenziseni izayensi yokulinga i-Nephrology. Izinga 1: Okungenani iminyaka emine (4) yokuhlala/okubonakalayo ekwenzeni isayensi yezempilo emuva kokubhalisa njengomenziwe wokulinga kahle wezesayensi yezempilo e-(SANC). Izinga 2: Okungenani iminyaka elishiyagalombili (14) yokuhlala/okubonakalayo ekwenzeni isayensi yezempilo emuva kokubhalisa njengomenziwe wokulinga kahle wezesayensi yezempilo e-South African Nursing Council (SANC) kwi-General Nursing. Okungenani iminyaka elishumi (10) yesikhathi esikhulunywe ngenhla kufanele ibe ukuhlala/okubonakalayo kokwenza isayensi yezempilo ekwindima ekhethekileko emuva kokuthola isiqu sokulinga esingaphezu kwesisekelo sonyaka o-1 ekwindeni ekhethekileko. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimela nokubeka ukubaluleka komsebenzi. Ikhono lekhono lokukhokha nokuqhathanisa nabantu, lokuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo. Ikhono elihle lekuqondisa nokufundisa.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwamakhono amanakekelo amakhulu kanye nokuhlangenwe ngokwamanke ngokwemigomo esethiwe nangaphakathi kohlaka olusemthethweni/okwesayensi yezempilo. Ukunikeza izinsiza ezibanzi zokunakekelwa kwamakhono e-Nephrology Unit. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezinsiza ngokusebenza kakhulu nangokuphumelelayo. Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kweziguli okumanke, ukulandela imigomo nemigomo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekwenzeni izinhlelo zokuphucula amakhono. Ukulawula nokwethula imigomo yokunakekelwa kweziguli. Ukwenza nokwenza isayensi yezempilo ngokwemithetho yesayensi yezempilo ebheke inqeqe yamandla, umsebenzi nempilo. Ukwenza ubuhlobo obuhle nabasebenzi nabo bonke abanomthelela. Ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwemigomo yokuvikela ukuhambisa infeksiyo nokuvala. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ziyasebenza futhi zilungele njalo. Ikhono lokubeka ukubaluleka, ukuhlanganisa imigomo yokunakekelwa kweziguli ngokomthetho. Ukukwazi ukulawula ukuqamba ukuphatha umsebenzi wakho kanye nowabasekeli ukuze kuqiniseke ukunakekelwa okuhle. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuphuculeni abasebenzi kanye nokuphathwa kokusebenza. Ukubika izenzakalo eziphathelene nokuphatha kweziguli, izinkinga nokuwohloka ngaphakathi kwindima. Ukusebenza kakhulu ngomoya kubantu abohluke ngokwengqondo,amasiko, isibi noma inkolo. Ukuqinisekisa ukulandelwa kwemigomo ye-Batho Pele namalungelo abaguli.

xh.title: Umagumbane weNhogome eliloba iQela 1-2 (PN-B1-2): I-Nephrology
xh.summary: Kufunwa uMagumbane weNhogome eliloba iQela 1-2 ogqitha kwi-Nephrology esibhedlele i-Ermelo e-Mpumalanga ukunika inkathalo egqithisileyo, epheleleyo yokhathalelo lwamagumbane kwiNgcaciso ye-Nephrology.
xh.requirements: Izatifikethi zeSini / iGadi 12 okanye isifanekiselwa sayo kunye nengqwalaselo esisiseko eqinisekiswe yi-SANC ngokweSaziso likaRhulumente R425 (oko kukuthi iDiploma / iYekhe ekuKhathalelweni kwamagumbane jikelele) okanye isifanekiselwa seNgqwalaselo esivumela ukuBhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomagumbane weNhogome kwaye uphumile kule minyaka ka-2026, ukuba negqwesha lengqwalaselo yokuba liloba umagumbane, ngexesha elinga ngaphezulu kweenyanga ezi-1, elicinywa yi-SANC ngokweSaziso likaRhulumente R212 ngesiganga sokuloba amagumbane kwizifundo zase-Nephrology. iGadi 1: Ukuqonda okungephi phantsi kweminyaka emine (4) yamava afanelekileyo / aqaqambiswayo ekuKhathalelweni kwamagumbane emva kokuBhaliswa njengomagumbane weNhogome kwi-(SANC). iGadi 2: Ukuqonda okungephi phantsi kweminyaka elishumi eline (14) yamava afanelekileyo / aqaqambiswayo ekuKhathalelweni kwamagumbane emva kokuBhaliswa njengomagumbane weNhogome kuRhulumente waseNingizimu Afrika oKhathalela amaGumbane (SANC) ekuKhathalelweni kwamagumbane jikelele. Okungenani iminyaka elishumi (10) yelo xesha elithiwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo / aqaphambiswayo kulo ngxelo ngasemva kokufumana iNgqwalaselo yogqozo eNgqi weNyanga e-1 eqwalaselwa kuso. Isakhono sokusebenza kodwa nokugqiba umsebenzi ngokubaluleka kwawo. Iakhono lokuba ngumongameli kwawo nawo amanye amakhono okusebenza nabantu, ukuxazula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo. Amakhono amabalwe aqinisekileyo okulawula nakokufundisa.
xh.duties: Inkathalo yokunika ukhathalelo lugqithisileyo, olupheleleyo lonyango lwamagumbane ngokwemigangatho efunekayo naphakathi kwesakhiwo sophuhliso olusemthethweni. Kuncedwa iinkonzo zobulawa ezipheleleyo kwiNgcaciso ye-Nephrology. Kuqinisekiswa ukulawula ngokuchanekileyo nangokusebenza kakuhle amadebe. Kuncedwa ukhathalelo olungcono lwesiguliguli, kwaye kulandelwa imigangatho nemilinganiselo. Kunxibelelwana kwiinkqubo zokuphucula iNdlela yokusebenza ngcono. Kulawulwa kwaye kusetyenziswa imigangatho yokhathalelo lwesiguliguli. Kusetyenziswa kwaye kwenziwa ukhathalelo lonyango lokhathalelo lonyango ngokomthetho oqwalaselwa urhulumente kumagumbane nomsebenzi nokuKhathalelwa kobulele. Kwakhiwa ubudlelwane obusebenzayo nabasebenzi nabanye abahluleli. Kuqinisekiswa ukuzithoba kweziculo ezingazange zibi nhlobo zifakwe kwindlela yokuba ingangabi nento ethintelwe ulawulo. Kuqinisekiswa ukuba isixhobo sisebenza kwaye silele ngonaphakade. Isakhono sokuqamba uthotho, ngokulungiselela imisebenzi yolawulo lwesiguliguli ngokomthetho oqwalaselwayo. Ukwenza umsebenzi wokucwangcisa kwaye ulungisele umsebenzi wakho nini nangamanye amaxhuba eqela okuqinisekisa ukukhathalelwa kwamagumbane. Unxibelelwano lokuqhuba abasebenzi phantsi kobugqatsha nokulawula ukwenza umsebenzi. Iinkcazelo zokhathalelo lwesiguliguli, iingxaki kunye nemida ebangelwa ukungabi namathuba ngaphakathi kwengcaciso. Ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo, ngokubakwaneliseko ngokulunga kwaye amaxesha amaninzi kunye nabantu abanobulumko bokwazi ukuba bangabantu abahlukeneyo, besini, beNKOSI yamanyathelo, okanye iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo. Ukubakwaneliseko ukuba kusenokwenzeka ngokulandelwa imigaqo yeBatho - Pele kunye noMgqatswana weelungelo zeSazulu esisiguli.

zu.summary: Umuntu osebenza ngabasebenzi eKulelelweni kwe-HR e-Department of Health Provincial Office e-Mbombela, ofuna ibhasikili le-Grade 12 leminyaka emithathu yohlu lolwazi kwe-HR noma idiploma noma idigri ehambisana nalokho.
zu.requirements: Ibhasikili le-Senior Certificate / Grade 12 noma okulinganayo kanye neminyaka emithathu (3) yohlu lolwazi kokuphathwa kwe-Human Resource Management, ngokujwayelana noKulelelwa kwe-HR, ukuphathwa kwe-Establishment, ukuqasha nokukhetha, nemithelela ehambisana naleso noma iDiploma / iDegree (NQF Level 6/7) ku-Human Resource Management, Public Administration / Public Management njengoba kuhambisana ne-SAQA. Ukwazi i-PERSAL kanye nemithelela yokuphathwa kwe-establishment. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ohlelweni lwe-Microsoft Office. Amakhono ahlolwe e-MS Excel esikhundleni samaphakathi. Amakhono aphathwayo okubonakalisa, okuhlaziya, okulela, okubhala imibiko, nokuhlobana nomunye umuntu. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela izuziso okwengeziwe. Amakhono nakho konke okufunekayo: Ukulela nokuhlela abantu noma izinto. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Amakhono aphathwayo okukhuluma nokubhala abathembekileyo. Ukubhala imibiko kanye nokuba nakhono ukubhukuda ngokusho kwabantu abaningi. Ukusetshenziswa kwakhompyutha. Ukubambisana komqondo namakhasimende. Isikhundla nokuba nengqondo yokuziphendulela.

Siza ekuphathweni kobuqwembu be-organisation nokulawula i-establishment. Qaphela izikhundla ezibhadalekayo noma ezingabhadalwa ngaphakathi kwe-establishment evunyiwe. Khuthaza ukubhaliswa kwemibiko noma okuhambisana nokulelelwa kwe-HR. Sekela ukuphathwa kwezikhundla ezingangenwe muntu kanye nemithelela yokubikezela abasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukubambelela ezindleleni ezihambisana nemithelela yokulelelwa kwe-HR. Nikeza ngesekelo ngokwemibuzo nezenzo ngokulelelwa kwe-HR. Xhumana nabanikazi bendawo yangaphakathi noma yangaphandle ngokwezinhlelo ezimalunga nokulelelwa kwe-HR.

xh.summary: Umntu oqhuba iNqubo yoCwangciso lwe-HR kw-Isebe leZempilo kwiNdiwa yoNgamuzela eMbombela, efunwa iNqanaba lesi-12 (Ibheyile ye-12) eneminyaka emithathu yamava kwi-HR okanye isidanga esifanelekileyo.
xh.requirements:
Isatifikethi Samabakala Aphezulu / Ibheyile ye-12 okanye okulinganayo nayo kunye neminyaka emithathu (3) yamava kwilawulo lweZabantu, lube kukuvela kwiNqubo yoCwangciso lwe-HR, uLawulo lweNhlangano, ukuBumba abasebenzi nokuKhethwa kwindawo, okanye iincwadana ezahlukeneyo / izidanga (NQF Level 6/7) kuLawulo lweZabantu, uLawulo lwamaHlalomhlaba kaRhulumente / uLawulo lukaRhulumente njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woCango lukaRhulumente, Izicwangciso zoCango lukaRhulumente, uMthetho weeSiseko zeemeko zoQesho, uMthetho weeNhlangano zeQesho, uMthetho weQeqesho elinganayo, namagqabantshathi eDPSA ahambelanayo. Ulwazi ngePERSAL nokuqonda iinkqubo zolawulo lwabalungiselelwe. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwiinkqubo zeMicrosoft Office. Amandla abonakalayo oqinisekisiweyo kwi-MS Excel kwinqanaba eliphakathi. Amandla alungileyo okunxibelelana, ekuhlaluyenweni, kucwangciso, ekubhaleni iingxelo, nakunxibelelwano lohlobo lwabantu. Ilaysensi yokuqhuba egqithisiweyo iya kuba ngowongezo.

Xhasa inkqubo yolawulo lwezithuba ezingasebenziyo kunye nokubikeka phambili kwamandla abasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthobela iinkqubo kunye nemigaqo eguquguqukayo efanelekileyo yocwangciso lwe-HR. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme soos onderskryf deur die National School of Government beskikbaar as 'n aanlyn kursus op https://www. thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, voor afhandeling van 'n aanstelling. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Uitgebreide kennis en praktiese begrip van openbare-sektor infrastruktuurlewering, insluitend die PFMA, Treasury Regulations, Infrastructure Delivery Management System (IDMS), Framework for Infrastructure Delivery and Procurement Management (FIDPM), CIDB-voorskrifte, voorsieningskettingbestuursvereistes en toepaslike bou-omgewingswetgewing en standaarde. Kennis van infrastruktuurprogram- en projekbeplanning, multidissiplinêre ontwerpbestuur, verkrygingsdokumentasie, konstruksiekontrakbestuur, kostebestuur, risikobestuur, projekmonitering en infrastruktuurafsluiting. Registrasie of geregtigheid tot registrasie by 'n toepaslike statutêre/professionele raad in die bou-omgewing sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese en operasionele leierskap in die beplanning, ontwerp, oplewerings- en bestuursproses van provinsiale gebou-infrastruktuurprogramme en -projekte. Stuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van infrastruktuurprojekpyplyne, en verseker belyning tussen kliëntdepartementvereistes, goedgekeurde infrastruktuurplanne en beskikbare begrotings. Hou toesig oor multidissiplinêre beplannings- en ontwerpsprosesse, projkgereedheidsassessering, verkrygingsbeplanning, kontraktereadheid en infrastruktuurimplementering. Verseker effektiewe bestuur van konsultante, kontrakteurs en gebou-omgewingsprofessionele persone, terwyl projekprestasie, gehalte, besteding, risiko's, voldoening en leweringsdoelwitte gemonitor word. Neem die leiding in belanghebbendebetrekkinge met kliëntdepartemente, Provinsiale Tesourie, munisipaliteite en ander strategiese vennote om infrastruktuurlewering te fasiliteer. Verseker gesonde bestuursreëls, finansiële bestuur, risikobestuur en voldoening aan toepaslike wetgewing, Tesourie-voorskrifte, IDMS, FIDPM en verwante regulasieraamwerke. Hou toesig oor projekvoltooiing, inbedryfstelling, oorhandiging en afsluitingsprosesse, en bestuur menslike, finansiële en ander hulpbronne van die Programbestuureenheid om departementele infrastruktuurleweringdoelwitte te bereik.

zu.title: Umphathi Wenkuliso YeNkolakwalwakho Kwakhiwo
zu.summary: Umphathi ongumholi wenkuliso yohlelo lwezokuphathwa kwenkolakwalwakho kwakhiwo esifundeni, obuka ipulo, ukuklanywa nokuhlinzwa ngemigqo yonkolakwalwakho kwakhiwo eNdayo eMpumalanga.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye nedigri ye-Bachelor evunyiweyo efanelekile (i-NQF Level 7) ku-Architecture / Construction Management / Quantity Surveying / Engineering / Project Management / Town Planning noma iziqu eziyisithuthi esingemuva kwe-Built Environment. Iziqu zesiqu esiphezulu ku-Built Environment, Infrastructure / Project Management noma esikhundleni esihlobene kuzoba yinzuzo. Okungenani iminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yesiphephelo senkinga ezingeni laphathi / laphathi abaphezulu. endlini yokuphathwa kwenkolakwalwakho kwakhiwo, ukuphathwa komqondo, ukuphathwa komqondo wokwakhiwa noma ukuphathwa kohlaka / umgqo. Ukumiselwa komsebenzi kuxhomeke ekusayineni isivumelwano senkonzo kanye nokwazisa ngemali. Ukuqedela ngempumelelo i-Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme njengoba kuvunyiwe yi-National School of Government ekhona njengomgqo ku-inthanethi ku-https://www. thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, ngaphambi kokugqibezela ukumiswa komsebenzi Ulwazi, amakhono namandla okukghona: Ulwazi olubanzi kanye nokuqonda ngamava ngokuhanjiswa kwenkolakwalwakho kwakhiwo kwantanga, okubandakanya i-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations, i-Infrastructure Delivery Management System (IDMS), i-Framework for Infrastructure Delivery and Procurement Management (FIDPM), imiyalo ye-CIDB, izidingo zokuqasha izinto ezihambisana kanye nomthetho namazinga ohlelo lwakho lonke azqwayiweyo. Ulwazi ngohlelo lwemigqo yonkolakwalwakho kwakhiwo kanye nokuqamba imigqo eminingi, ukuphathwa kokuthengwa kwemibhalo, ukuphathwa kwezivumelwano zokwakhiwa, ukuphathwa kwamasheya, ukuphathwa kweengozi, ukubuka umgqo nokugqiba inkolakwalwakho kwakhiwo. Ukuqanjwa noma ukuqashwa ngemvume kuhlelelwe emthethweni ophathwa amakhulu emisebenzi kuzoba yinzuzo. Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo.
zu.duties: Hlinza ngekhono elikhulu kanye neshugu ngokuhamba phambili ekuhleleni, ekuqambeni, ekulethe ukwakhiwa nakuphathweni kohlelo lwenkolakwalwakho kwakhiwo nangemigqo yesifunda. Qondisa ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlelwa kwezitsha zemigqo, uqinisekise kuhambisana nezidingo zomnyango wexhaswe, amapulo ezokwakhiwa avunyiwe kanye namabhajethi atholakalayo. Buka imigqo yokuhlelwa nokuklanywa kwezinhlobonhlobo, ukubuka ukubeletha kwemigqo, ukuhlelwa kwemigqo yokuqashwa, ukubeletha kwezivumelwano nokuhlelwa kwezokuthuthwa kwamasheya. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okuphumelelayo kwababhekisi, abashaya izinkontileka kanye nabakwazi ukuqhakambisa imisebenzi, ngokuhamba nje ubuka ukusebenza kwemigqo, ikhwalithi, ukusetshenziswa kwemali, izengozi, ukuhambisana nemigqo kanye nemiqondiso yokuhlinzwa. Hola ukuhlanganyela nabathintekayo emakhasini, amaphoyisa e-Treasury, abaphathi bamabhange nabalingani abakhulu ukukhonyza ukufakwa kwenkolakwalwakho kwakhiwo. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezomthetho okuhle, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuphathwa kwezikhathi ezincane nokuhambisana nomthetho osetshenziswayo, imiyalo ye-Treasury, i-IDMS, i-FIDPM kanye nezinye izindlela zokuphathwa ezingemthetho. Buka ukuphela kogqo, ukumiswa kwamandla, ukunikelwa kanye nezinqumo zokugcina, bese uphatha abantu, imali kanye nezinye izinto ze-Rophihramu yokuphathwa ukuze ufinyelele imigqo yohlelo lomnyango lokuhlinzwa ngenkolakwalwakho kwakhiwo.

xh.title: Umphathi wenkqubo yokulawula iinfrastraksha zokwakha
xh.summary: Umphathi okhokela ulawulo lwenkqubo yamaphrojekthi einfrastraksha zokwakha esifundweni, elibukele uqeqesho, ukwakhiwa kunye nokuhanjiswa kwamaphrojekthi einfrastraksha kwisiKophasi eMpumalanga.
xh.requirements: Izidanga grade 12 kunye nedigri yeBachelor eyamileyo eqashiweyo (NQF Level 7) kwi-Arhitektha / Ulawulo lokuQakatha / uLinganiso lweziNtengiso / uNjineli / uLawulo lweeNkqubo / uCwangciso loBomi beSixeko okanye izifundo ezinxulumene nendalo eYakhiweyo. Ikwafika kulindeleke inqanaba leposi-graduate kwizifundo ze-Built Environment, ulawulo lweenkqubo zeeprojekthi okanye indawo enxulumene nayo kuya kuba ngumonde olongezelelekileyo. Kufuneka ube namava amabalwa angaphezulu kweminyaka emihlanu (5) kulawulo lwesiphakathi okanye esinqanaba somphathi ophakamileyo. Kwicandelo lolucwangciso lweinfrastraksha, ukuyila, ukwakha okanye ulawulo lweenkqubo. Ukumiselwa kule ndawo kuxhomekeka ekubhaleni isivumelwano sokuvelisa iziphumo nokuvezwa kwemali. Kufuneka uqale ugcobe iNyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme njengoko igunyaziswe yi-National School of Government efumaneka njengenkqubo online kwi https://www. thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, ngaphambi kokugqiba kokumiselwa. Ulwazi, amakhono namandla okwenza umsebenzi: Ilwazi elibanzi neliqondeka ngokusebenzisa ukuba nolwazi ngokuhanjiswa kweinfrastraksha kwicala likarhulumente, kuquka i-PFMA, iTreasury Regulations, Infrastructure Delivery Management System (IDMS), Framework for Infrastructure Delivery and Procurement Management (FIDPM), i-CIDB prescripts, iimfuno zolawulo lwe-supply chain kunye namagazeti nezilinganiso zendalo eyakhiweyo. Ulwazi ngocwangciso lwenkqubo yamaphrojekthi einfrastraksha kunye noyilo lwe-multidisciplinary design management, amaxwebhu okuthenga, ulawulo lwezenzo zokwakha, ulawulo lweexabiso, ulawulo lengozi, ukulandelela amaphrojekthi kwaye ugcibe i-infrastraksha. Ukubhaliswa okanye ukufaneleka ukubhaliswa, kwikomiti yomthetho nenhlangano yamabungane kwicala le-Built environment kuya kuba ngumonde olongezelelekileyo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba eyamkelekileyo.
xh.duties: Nika isikhokelo esibalulekileyo nesesabelo kokusebenza ekucwangciseni, ekuqweneni, ekuhanjisweni nasekulawuleni iinkqubo namaphrojekthi einfrastraksha zokwakha esifundweni. Qondisa ukuphuhliswa nokusebenza kweenkqubo zamaphrojekthi we-infrastraksha, ukuqinisekisa ukuba ngqinelelana phakathi kwemfuno yesebe lomthengi, izicwangciso ze-infrastraksha ezamkelekileyo nengeniso eqothingwayo. Lilole iinkqubo zocwangciso loyilo lwe-multidisciplinary, ukuvavanya ukulungiselelwa kwephrojekthi, ucwangciso lokuthenga, ukulungiselelwa kwesivumelwano nokuhanjiswa kwe-infrastraksha. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo lwabaqeqeshi, abakhi ziindlu, nabaphathi be-Built environment, ngelixa ulandela indlela evelisa iziphumo, umgangatho, imali echithwayo, ingozi, ukuthobela imithetho nemiqondiso, nokuhanjiswa. Khokela ukuququmbela nabashwebhile kuwo onke amasebe, kwi-Provincial Treasury, iimb municipalities nakubalingane abanamandla ukunceda ekubeni kweso zokuhambisa i-infrastraksha. Qinisekisa ulawulo olulungileyo lomthetho, ulawulo lweemali, ulawulo lengozi nokuzithobela imithetho egqithisiweyo, iTreasury prescripts, i-IDMS, i-FIDPM nolunye ulawulo lwe-Regular Framework. Yalela ukugqitywa, ukubhalwa ngokusemthethweni, ukunikelwa nokuvalwa kwephrojekthi, ulawule umntu, imali nanye izixhobo ze-Programme Management Unit ukufeza iinjongo zokuhanjiswa kwe-infrastraksha kwisebe.

jobs.title: Director District Services
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Transport
jobs.centre: Bohlabela District Ref No: D/DH/BO/03 Nkangala District Ref No: D/DH/NK/99
jobs.summary: Provide strategic leadership and manage administrative functions, public infrastructure maintenance and capital projects across Mpumalanga districts.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 plus Bachelor’s Degree / Advanced Diploma (NQF Level 7) in Public Management/Public Administration/ Finance/ Business Administration or a directly relevant functional field. A minimum of five (5) years’ experience at Middle / Senior Managerial level. A valid driver’s licence. Appointment is subject to the signing of a performance agreement and financial disclosure. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government available as an online course on https://www. thensg.gov.za/training- course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, prior to finalisation of an appointment Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: Knowledge of Legislation governing Human Resources within Public Service and SMS handbook. Knowledge of the following functional fields is critical: In-depth understanding of dynamics of the Public Service, Government Systems and Operations, good understanding of the PFMA, good understanding of the Public Service Human Resource Regulatory Framework, ability to work in cross/functional projects/teams, excellent coordination and project management skills, good understanding of Government policies and initiatives and the role of information in government decision-making, Demonstrated strategic and operational management ability and experience, experience in leading and managing transformation.
jobs.duties: Manage all administrative aspects in the district. Provide strategic leadership within the district. Render the maintenance public infrastructure (i.e. Public Works building, Roads maintenance services, EPWP and Immovable Assets). Manage the implementation of capital projects. Manage district transport management services. Ensure compliance with National policy frameworks and standards. Report and participate in all appropriate provincial, departmental and other structures and processes. Manage and ensure effective and efficient utilisation of financial, human and physical resources of the directorate in line with applicable legislation.
jobs.enquiries: Ms PN Yingwane Tel No: (013) 766 6780 e-Recruitment Mpumalanga
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted online through the link erecruitment.mpg.gov.za
jobs.notes: A recent comprehensive CV, and contactable references (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). (Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents; on or before the day of the interviews). Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. The successful candidate will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as completing a financial disclosure interests’ declaration form within one month of appointment and annually thereafter. Faxed or emailed applications will not be considered. Failure to comply with the above instructions will result in your application being disqualified. The Department is committed to provide equal opportunities and practice affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representability in terms of race, gender, and disability when filling the vacant positions. Women and people with disabilities are encouraged to apply. The Department reserves the right to fill or not to fill any advertised posts. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur Distrikdienste
af.summary: Verskaf strategiese leierskap en bestuur administratiewe funksies, instandhouding van openbare infrastruktuur en kapitale projekte oor Mpumalanga distrikte.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus Bachelor se Graad / Gevorderde Diploma (NQF Vlak 7) in Openbare Bestuur/Openbare Administrasie/ Finansies/ Besigheidsadministrasie of 'n direk tersaaklike funksionele veld. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar ervaring op Midde-/Seniorbestuursvlak. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Aanstelling is onderhewig aan die ondertekening van 'n prestasie-ooreenkoms en finansiële openbaarmaking. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme soos onderskryf deur die National School of Government beskikbaar as 'n aanlyn kursus op https://www. thensg.gov.za/training- course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, voor afhandeling van 'n aanstelling Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Kennis van Wetgewing wat Menslike Hulpbronne binne die Public Service en SMS-handboek regeer. Kennis van die volgende funksionele velde is krities: Diepgaande begrip van die dinamika van die Public Service, Regeringstelsels en -bedrywighede, goeie begrip van die PFMA, goeie begrip van die Public Service Human Resource Regulatory Framework, vermoë om in kruis/funksionele projekte/spanne te werk, uitstekende koördinasie- en projekbestuursvaardighede, goeie begrip van Regeringsbeleid en -inisiatiewe en die rol van inligting in regeringsbesluitneming, Getoonde strategiese en operasionele bestuursvermoë en ervaring, ervaring in die leiding en bestuur van transformasie.
af.duties: Bestuur alle administratiewe aspekte in die distrik. Verskaf strategiese leierskap binne die distrik. Lewer die instandhouding van openbare infrastruktuur (d.w.s. Openbare Werke geboue, paaie-instandhoudingsdienste, EPWP en Onroerende Bates). Bestuur die implementering van kapitale projekte. Bestuur distrik vervoerbestuursdienste. Verseker nakoming van nasionale beleidsraamwerke en standaarde. Rapporteer en neem deel aan alle toepaslike provinsiale, departementele en ander strukture en prosesse. Bestuur en verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende benutting van finansiële, menslike en fisieke hulpbronne van die direkteoraat in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezinsizakalo Zesifunda
zu.summary: Hlinzeka ngokuholo oluhleliwe futhi uphathe imisebenzi yabalawuli, ukugcinwa kwezakhiwo zomphakathi namaphrojekthi amakhulu kumasifunda aseMpumalanga.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor’s Degree / i-Advanced Diploma (i-NQF Level 7) ku-Public Management/i-Public Administration/ i-Finance/ i-Business Administration noma indawo ebambene ngqo nemisebenzi ehlobene. Isiphepho seminyaka yokuqashwa emihlanu (5) esikhundleni sokuba ngumphathi ophakathi noma ophakeme. Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo. Ukugqoshwa kusekwe esibophweni sokuqasha isivumelwano sokusebenza kanye nokwaziswa ngemali. Ukuqedwa ngempumelelo kwe-Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme njengokuqinisexiswa i-National School of Government etholakala njengenkosi yoku-inthanethi ku-https://www. thensg.gov.za/training- course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, ngaphambi kokugcinwa kokugqashwa. Ulwazi, Amakhono Namandla Okusebenza: Ulwazi ngemithetho elawula Izinsizakalo Zabantu ngaphakathi koMphakathi Womphakathi kanye nesincwadi esikhundleni se-SMS. Ulwazi ngalawa masekelo emisebenzi lubaluleke kakhulu: Ukuqonda ngokujulile ukuguquguquka koMphakathi Womphakathi, Izinhlelo Nokusebenza Kahulumeni, ukuqonda kahle i-PFMA, ukuqonda kahle Ubulungisi Bezinsizakalo Zabantu Zomphakathi Womphakathe, ikono lokusebenza kwamaphrojekthi/amaqembu avela kwezinye/izindawo zomsebenzi, amakhono aphumelelayo okuhlelwa nokuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukuqonda kahle izinqubomgomo zahulumeni kanye nezinhlelo kanye nendima yalulwazi ekuqumbululweni kwezinqumo kahulumeni, Ubudlelwano obubonwayo bokuphatwa ngokuholo nangokusebenza, isiphepho ekubeni nokukhokhelwa ukuqeqeshwa nokuguqulwa.
zu.duties: Phatha wonke amaphuzu obalawuli esifundeni. Hlinzeka ngokuholo oluhleliwe esifundeni. Hlinzela ukugcinwa kwezakhiwo zomphakathi (okungukuthi Izakhiwo Zezomsebenzi Zomphakathi, Izinsizakulo zokugcina izindlela, i-EPWP kanye nempahla engahambeki). Phatha ukuphathwa kokusetshenziswa kwamaphrojekthi amakhulu. Phatha izinsizakalo zokuphatha ukuhamba nendawo yesifunda. Qinisekisa ukuzilandela izinkangiso zezinqubomgomo Zikazwelonke kanye nemigomo. Phawula futhi uthathe inxaxheba kuzo zonke izakhiwo kanye namaqoqo ezohulumeni bamaphrovinsi, umnyango nezinye futhi kumapulsecesi. Phatha futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kwezimali,abantu nokuzipha kwesigaba ngokulandela imithetho ezayo.

Qinisekisa ukuvunywa kweenkqubo zeSizwe kunye neemilinganiselo. Xela kwaye ungenelele kuzo zonke iindawo, iisebe kwaye nakwezinye iindawo kwaye kuqhubeka. Lawula kwaye uqinisekise ukusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo nangempumelelo kwemali, abantu kunye nezibonelelo zangokwenyama zenkundla yodidi ngokwemigaqo-ngqangaliswano esebenzayo.

Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Faxed or emailed applications will not be considered. Failure to comply with the above instructions will result in your application being disqualified. The Department is committed to provide equal opportunities and practice affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representability in terms of race, gender, and disability when filling the vacant positions. Women and people with disabilities are encouraged to apply. The Department reserves the right to fill or not to fill any advertised posts. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

zu.title: Umlawuli: Ukuphathwa Kolwazi

Ukube ngaphezulu kweminyaka eyisihlanu (5) kokusebenza okuhlobene ezingeni lokuba nguMphathi ophakathi / ophakeme ekuleyo ndawo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ukuphumelela kokuqeda i-Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme njengokuqinisekiswe yi-National School of Government etholakala njengesifundo se-inthanethi ku-https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, ngaphambi kokugcina ukubekwa esikhundleni Ulwazi, Amakhono namandla: Ukuba nguMholi wolwazi olubanzi; ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo; ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo; ukuphathwa kwezimali nabantu; ukulawula; ukuphathwa kwezingozi; ukuphathwa kwabanomzinkathi; ukuxhumana.
zu.duties: Kuphathe ulwazi kanye namasevisi okuphathwa kwezinkamelo, okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa, ukuqashwa nokubuyekezwa kwezinqubomgomo, izinga namasheya okuphathwa kwezinkamelo nolwazi. Kuphathe amasevisiobuchwepheshe bolwazi, okuhlanganisa ukwesekwa kwe-ICT help-desk, izinsiza kanye nokwesekwa kwenethiwekhi. Kuqinisekiswe ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo, izinga, uhlaka lwe-ICT ngokuvumelana nezidingo ze-DPSA. Kubukele ukuguqulwa kwedijithali, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo zebhizinisi, ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlelo kuyo yonke i-Department. Kunikezele ngokubuka olubanzi kokuhambisana kwe-Department ne-PAIA kanye ne-POPIA. Kuqinisekiswe izinqubo nokulawulwa okufanele ekutholeni ulwazi, ekubumnini futhi ekuvikeleni ulwazi lwangasese. Kuphathe ukunikezwa kwamasevisi okwesekwa ngokwezombuso futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuhlelwa okusebenzayo, ukuphathwa kwezinsiza, ukuphathwa kokwenza kuhle kanye nokuhambisana ngaphakathi kwoMnyango.

xh.title: Umongameli: Ukulawula ulwazi
xh.summary: Umongameli woKulawula ulwazi kwisebe lezaMisebenzi zoLuntu saseMpumalanga, elibukelela iinkonzo zolwazi, ukulawula amarekhodi neenkonzo ze-ICT.

Qinisekisa iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo nokulawula ukufikelela kwulwazi, yangasese nokukhusela ulwazi lwangasese. Lawula ukunikwa kweekonzo zoxhaso lolawulo uze uqinisekise uqwalaselo olusebenzayo, ulawulo lweempahla, ulawulo lokwenza nokuzithoba ngaphakathi koMnyhadala.

jobs.title: Director: Asset Management
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Transport
jobs.summary: Director of Asset Management at the Mpumalanga Department of Public Works, Roads and Transport, requiring a relevant bachelor's degree and five years' senior managerial experience in asset or financial management.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 plus nan appropriate Bachelor’s Degree / Advanced Diploma (NQF Level 7) in Accounting, Financial Management, Cost and Management Accounting, Public Finance, Supply Chain Management, Asset Management, Business Management or a related field, as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of five (5) years’ relevant experience at Middle/Senior Managerial level in Asset Management, Financial Management, Supply Chain Management or a related environment. Appointment is subject to the signing of a performance agreement and financial disclosure. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government available as an online course on https://www. thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, prior to finalisation of an appointment Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: Sound and in-depth knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, National Treasury Framework for the Management of Assets, Generally Recognised Accounting Practice (GRAP), Modified Cash Standard (MCS), Public Service regulatory framework, Supply Chain Management prescripts and applicable asset management policies and procedures. Good understanding of audit processes and requirements of the Auditor-General of South Africa (AGSA), including the management and resolution of audit findings relating to assets. Proven management, strategic leadership, analytical, financial management, risk management, problem- solving, communication and stakeholder-management skills. A valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Develop, implement and monitor the Department’s Asset Management Strategy, policies, procedures and internal controls in line with the PFMA, Treasury Regulations and applicable National and Provincial Treasury prescripts. Manage the full asset lifecycle, including asset planning, acquisition, receipt, recording, identification/barcoding, allocation, movement, maintenance, verification, impairment, transfer and disposal. Ensure that the Department maintains complete, accurate and reliable movable and immovable asset registers and that assets are appropriately classified, valued and disclosed. Ensure regular reconciliation of the Asset Register with BAS, LOGIS and other applicable financial and asset management systems, and ensure timely resolution of reconciling items. Ensure accurate preparation and submission of asset-related financial information and disclosures for Interim and Annual Financial Statements (IFS/AFS). Develop and maintain effective controls to prevent and detect asset losses, theft, misuse, unauthorised movements and irregular disposals, and ensure that losses and damages are investigated and dealt with in accordance with applicable prescripts. Manage the disposal of redundant, obsolete, unserviceable and surplus assets in accordance with prescribed disposal processes and ensure appropriate updating of asset records. Identify asset-related risks and implement appropriate risk mitigation and internal control measures.

af.title: Direkteur: Batebestuur
af.summary: Direkteur van Batebestuur by die Mpumalanga Department of Public Works, Roads and Transport, wat 'n tersaaklike bachelorsgraad en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring in bate- of finansiële bestuur vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n toepaslike Bachelorsgraad / Gevorderde Diploma (NQF Vlak 7) in Rekeningkunde, Finansiële Bestuur, Koste- en Bestuursrekeningkunde, Openbare Finansies, Voorsieningskettingbestuur, Batebestuur, Besigheidsbestuur of 'n verwante veld, soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se tersaaklike ervaring op Middle/Senior Bestuursvlak in Batebestuur, Finansiële Bestuur, Voorsieningskettingbestuur of 'n verwante omgewing. Aanstelling is onderhewig aan die ondertekening van 'n prestasieooreenkoms en finansiële openbaarmaking. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme soos deur die National School of Government goedgekeur en beskikbaar as 'n aanlyn kursus op https://www. thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, voor afhandeling van 'n aanstelling. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Diep en deeglike kennis van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, National Treasury Framework for the Management of Assets, Generally Recognised Accounting Practice (GRAP), Modified Cash Standard (MCS), die regulerende raamwerk van die Public Service, voorskrifte vir Voorsieningskettingbestuur en toepaslike batebestuursbeleid en -prosedures. Goeie begrip van ouditprosesse en vereistes van die Auditor-General of South Africa (AGSA), insluitend die bestuur en oplossing van ouditbevindinge rakende bates. Bewese bestuurs-, strategiese leierskaps-, analitiese, finansiële bestuurs-, risikobestuurs-, probleemoplossings-, kommunikasie- en belanghebbendebestuursvaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor die departement se Batebestuursstrategie, beleid, prosedures en interne beheer in ooreenstemming met die PFMA, Treasury Regulations en toepaslike National en Provincial Treasury-voorskrifte. Bestuur die volledige batelewenssiklus, insluitend batebeplanning, verkryging, ontvangs, optekening, identifikering/strepieskodering, toekenning, beweging, instandhouding, verifikasiëring, benadeling, oordrag en beskikking. Verseker dat die departement volledige, akkurate en betroubare roerende en onroerende bateregisters handhaaf en dat bates toepaslik geklassifiseer, gewaardeer en openbaar word. Verseker gereelde rekonsiliasie van die Bateregister met BAS, LOGIS en ander toepaslike finansiële en batebestuurstelsels, en verseker tydige oplossing van rekonsiliasie-items. Verseker akkurate voorbereiding en indiening van bate-verwante finansiële inligting en openbaarmakings vir Interim en Annual Financial Statements (IFS/AFS). Ontwikkel en handhaaf doeltreffende beheer om bateverliese, diefstal, wan gebruik, ongeoorloofde bewegings en onreëlmatige beskikking te voorkom en op te spoor, en verseker dat verliese en skade ondersoek en ooreenkomstig toepaslike voorskrifte hanteer word. Bestuur die beskikking van oortollige, verouderde, onbruikbare en surplus bates in ooreenstemming met voorgeskrewe beskikkingsprosesse en verseker toepaslike bywerking van baterekords. Identifiseer bate-verwante risiko's en implementeer toepaslike risikobeperking en interne beheermaatreëls.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukuphathwa Kwempahla
zu.summary: Umphathi wokuphathwa kwempahla osekelwe eMpumalanga kwi-Department of Public Works, Roads and Transport, ofuna iziqu ze-bachelor ezifanelekile kanye neminyaka emihlanu yemfundo yokuphatha ezingeni eliphezulu ekuphathweni kwempahla noma kwezimali.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor’s Degree / Advanced Degree (NQF Level 7) efanelekile (NQF Level 7) kwi-Accounting, Financial Management, Cost and Management Accounting, Public Finance, Supply Chain Management, Asset Management, Business Management noma enye indawo ehlobene, njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani iminyaka emihlanu (5) yemfundo efanelekile ezingeni laphakathi/eliphezulu lokuphatha ekuphathweni kwempahla, ekuphathweni kwezimali, ekuphathweni kwenkokhelo noma endaweni ehlobene. Ukumiswa kusekelwe ekusayineni isivumelwano sokusebenza nasekubalulekeni kwezimali. Ukuphothula ngemvume i-Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme njengokuqashelwe yi-National School of Government etholakala njengenkosi yamabhuku ku-inthanethi ku-https://www. thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, ngaphambi kokugqiba ukumiswa. Ulwazi, amakhono namandla okwenza izinto: Ukuqonda okuzinile kanye nolwazi olujulile ngo-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), izimiso ze-Treasury, i-National Treasury Framework for the Management of Assets, i-Generally Recognised Accounting Practice (GRAP), i-Modified Cash Standard (MCS), isimiso sokulawula kwesevisi yomphakathi, imiyalo ye-Supply Chain Management namapholisi namasu okuphathwa kwempahla. Ukuqonda kahle izinqubo zokuhlola nezidingo ze-Auditor-General of South Africa (AGSA), okuhlanganisa nokuqondisa nokuqeda iziphetho zokuhlola ezihlobene nempahla. Amakhono obuqhwayiya bokuphatha, ukuba ngumholi webhizinisi, ukuhlaziya, ukuphatha izimali, ukuphatha ubungozi, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuxhumana nabantu nabashwebekile. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Bumba, faka esebenzini futhi ulawule i-Asset Management Strategy yomnyango, amapholisi, amasu okulawula angaphakathi ngokuvumelana ne-PFMA, izimiso ze-Treasury namasiko e-Treasury yezwe neyeshifaki ezifanelekile. Phatha impilo yonke yempahla, okuhlanganisa nokusungula impahla, ukuthenga, ukwamukela, ukurekhoda, ukuqondiswa/ukubhikoda, ukwabiwa, ukunyakaza, ukulungiswa, ukuqinisekiswa, ukwehlela, ukudluliswa kanye nokulahla. Qinisekisa ukuthi umnyango ugcina amarekhodi aphelele, aqinisekile athembekile empahleni ehambayo nengahambi, nokuthi impahla ihlukaniswa, ibizwa inani futhi ivezwe ngendlela efanele. Qinisekisa ukuqondanisa okuvamile kwesikhathi sama-rekhodi empahla nama-BAS, LOGIS namanye amasistimu okuphatha izimali nempahla, futhi qinisekisa ukuxazulula ngokushesha izinto ezingaqondani. Qinisekisa ukulungiswa okuqinisekile nokuhambiswa kolwazi nokuvezwa kwezimali eziyimpahla ezihlobene nezitatimende ze-Interim and Annual Financial Statements (IFS/AFS). Phakamisa futhi ugcine izilawula ezifanele ukuthi kuthintelwe futhi kuqashelwe ukulahleka kwempahla, ukweba, ukusebenzisi kabi, okuholela okungemukelekile nokulahla okungalawuleki, futhi qinisekisa ukuthi ukulahleka nokonakala kuphenya kanti kuhlatshwa njengokuqondene namasiko asuke abekelwe. Phatha ukulahla impahla engasebenzi, edala kakhulu, engasebenzi kahle nengaphezulu ngokuvumelana nezinqubo zokulahla ezimisiwe futhi qinisekisa ukuvuselelwa okufanele kwamarekhodi empahla. Hlola ubungozi ebuyela empahleni futhi usebenzise izinyathelo zokunciphisa ubungozi nezokulawula okungaphakathi ezifanele.

xh.title: Umphathi: Ukulawula Izinto
xh.summary: Umphathi woKulawula Izinto kwisebe leMpumalanga lezoLwakhiwo lokuSebenzwayo, iindlela zoThutho noRhwebo, lifuna izidanga ezifanelekileyo zebachelor kunye namava eminyaka emihlanu ekwenzeni umsebenzi ongaphezulu wolawulo ekulawuleni izinto okanye ekulawuleni imali.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-12 kunye ne-Degree yesiQanga / iDiploma ePhakamileyo (NQF Level 7) kwakuKhongozwa kweMali, ukuLawulwa kweMali, ukuBala iNxaho nokuLawulwa kwayo, iMali yoLuntu, ukuLawulwa kwe- Supply Chain, ukuLawulwa kwezinto, ukuLawulwa kweShishini okanye indawo enxulumene nayo, njengoko ivunywa yi-SAQA. Amava afanelekileyo ubuncinane beminyaka emihlanu (5) kulawulo lolinge loPhakathi/lophezulu ekulawuleni izinto, ekulawuleni imali, ekulawulweni kwe- Supply Chain okanye kwindawo enxulumene nayo. Ukwabiwa komsebenzi kuxhomekeka kwisayini isivumelwano sokuSebenza nesaziso sezezimali. Ukuqeda ngempumelelo i-Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme njengoko kugunyaziswe yi-National School of Government efumaneka njengenkqubo ye-inthanethi kwi- https://www. thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, ngaphambi kokugqibezela ukuqeshwa. Ulwazi, amakhono namandla okwenza umsebenzi: Ulwazi olubanzi nolunjalo malunga ne-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), iimigaqo zeTreasury, i-National Treasury Framework for the Management of Assets, i-Generally Recognised Accounting Practice (GRAP), i-Modified Cash Standard (MCS), iinderule zolawulo lokuQeshwa koLuntu, iimiyalelo ze- Supply Chain Management namapolicy namasu okulawula izinto afanelekileyo. Ukuqonda okuhle iinkqubo zokuhlola kunye neemfuno ze-Auditor-General of South Africa (AGSA), kuquka ukulawula nokusombulula iziphumo zokuhola ezithinta izinto. Amakhoni obuqu obuqinisekisiweyo obulawulayo, obuhola ngokwezicwangqiso, obuhlalutyo, obulawula imali, obulawula ingozi, obusombulula iingxaki, obuthetha nabantu kunye nobulawula abathintekayo. Ilayisense yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Phuma, yenze ulandele iNkqubo, iipolicy, iinkqubo nolawulo lwangaphakathi loQoqosho lokuLawulwa kwezinto lwesebe ngokwemigaqo ye-PFMA, iimigaqo zeTreasury nemiyalelo yeTreasury yoLuntu neyeBhunga efanelekileyo. Lawula i-cycle yonke yezinto, kuquka nokuCwangcisa izinto, ukuzifumana, ukuzamkela, ukuzirekhoda, ukuzichaza/ukuzibhala ngekhodi, ukuzabelwa, ukunyuka kwazo, ukuzigcina, ukuqinisekisa, ukusilela kwazo, ukuzidlulisa nokuzilahla. Qinisekisa ukuba isebbe sigcina ngokupela, ngokuchanekileyo nangokuthembekileyo irekhodi lezinto ezihambahambayo nangezozingahambahambayo nokuba izinto zibhalwe ngokufanelekileyo, zixabise kwaye ziboniswe. Qinisekisa ukuthelekisa rhoqo irekhodi lezinto naba kwi-BAS, i-LOGIS nakwezinye iinkqubo zokulawula imali ngezinto ezifanelekileyo, kwaye uqinisekise ukusombulula ngexesha elifanelekileyo izinto ezingadityanisiyo. Qinisekisa ulungiselelo oluchanekileyo nokungenisa kolwazi ngesaziso sezimali ngezinto kumagazini wezezimali angaphakathi nawonyaka (IFS/AFS). Phuma zigcine izinto ezisebenzayo nokuze zithintele nokuqonda ukulahleka kwezinto, ukuzibiwa, ukusetyenziswa ngendlela engalunganga, iintshukumo ezingavunyelwanga nokulahleka okungalunganga, kwaye uqinisekise ukuba ukulahleka nokuonakala kuphononongwe kwaye kusetyenziswe ngokweemigaqo ezifanelekileyo. Lawula ukulahleka kwezinto ezingasafunekiyo, ezindala, ezingasasebenzayo nanezalutho ngokwinkqubo yokulahla ezijunywe kwaye uqinisekise ukuvuselelwa okufanelekileyo kwiirekhodi zezinto. Chonga iingozi ezinxulumene nezinto kwaye usebenzise izigqibo ezifanelekileyo zokunciphisa iingozi nolawulo olungaphakathi.

jobs.title: Chief Quantity Surveyor Grade a
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Transport
jobs.summary: Chief Quantity Surveyor at the Mpumalanga Department of Public Works Head Office, providing cost management and professional quantity surveying services for infrastructure projects.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 plus Bachelor of Science in Quantity Surveying / Bachelor of Quantity Surveying (NQF Level 8), BTech in Quantity Surveying (legacy NQF Level 7), or a recognised equivalent qualification. Compulsory Registration with South African Council for the Quantity Surveying Profession (SACQSP) as a Professional Quantity Surveyor (PrQS). Valid drivers’ licence and proficiency in computer applications are essential. Relevant work experience as a Professional Quantity Surveyor, with at least 5 years post professional registration. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: Sound knowledge of construction legislation, regulations, and frameworks applicable in the public sector, including the PFMA, Treasury Regulations, CIDB Act, GIAMA, Construction Regulations, and National Building Regulations. Proficiency in quantity surveying software such as WinQS, as well as AutoCAD, MS Project, and Microsoft Office Suite. In depth knowledge of cost planning, contract administration (JBCC, NEC, GCC), building cost norms, and lifecycle costing. Programme and project management. Quantity Survey legal and operational compliance. Quantity Survey operational communication. Process knowledge and skills. Maintenance skills and knowledge. Mobile equipment operating skills. Research and development. Computer-aided engineering applications. Creating high-performance culture. Technical consulting. Professional judgment. Analytical, planning, problem-solving, and report-writing skills. Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills. Ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and multiple infrastructure projects simultaneously.
jobs.duties: Provide professional quantity surveying and cost management services to the Departments. Ensure financial control, value engineering, and cost optimisation in the delivery of infrastructure projects. Evaluate, appoint, and monitor the performance of consultants and contractors in compliance with departmental policies. Manage the implementation and monitoring of construction contracts, including certification of payments and resolution of contractual claims. Conduct feasibility studies, develop cost estimates, and maintain accurate project budgets and cash flows. Undertake research and implement new methods, technologies, and sustainable solutions in infrastructure delivery. Ensure alignment with the Infrastructure Delivery Management System (IDMS), Infrastructure Procurement and Delivery Management (IPDM) toolkit, and relevant prescripts. Provide technical support in the preparation of tender documentation, bid evaluations, and adjudication processes.
jobs.enquiries: Ms PN Yingwane Tel No: (013) 766 6780 e-Recruitment Mpumalanga
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted online through the link erecruitment.mpg.gov.za
jobs.notes: A recent comprehensive CV, and contactable references (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). (Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents; on or before the day of the interviews). Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. The successful candidate will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as completing a financial disclosure interests’ declaration form within one month of appointment and annually thereafter. Faxed or emailed applications will not be considered. Failure to comply with the above instructions will result in your application being disqualified. The Department is committed to provide equal opportunities and practice affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representability in terms of race, gender, and disability when filling the vacant positions. Women and people with disabilities are encouraged to apply. The Department reserves the right to fill or not to fill any advertised posts. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofhoeveelheidslandmeter Graad a
af.summary: Hoofhoeveelheidslandmeter by die Mpumalanga Department of Public Works Hoofkantoor, wat kostebestuur- en professionele hoeveelheidslandmeetdienste vir infrastruktuurprojekte lewer.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus Bachelor of Science in Quantity Surveying / Bachelor of Quantity Surveying (NQF Level 8), BTech in Quantity Surveying (legacy NQF Level 7), of 'n erkende ewekwaardige kwalifikasie. Verpligte registrasie by die South African Council for the Quantity Surveying Profession (SACQSP) as 'n Professionele Hoeveelheidslandmeter (PrQS). Geldige bestuurslisensie en beheerking van rekenaartoepassings is essensieel. Relevante werkervaring as 'n Professionele Hoeveelheidslandmeter, met ten minste 5 jaar na professionele registrasie. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Deeglike kennis van konstruksiewetgewing, regulasies en raamwerke wat in die openbare sektor van toepassing is, insluitend die PFMA, Treasury Regulations, CIDB Act, GIAMA, Construction Regulations en National Building Regulations. Beheerking van hoeveelheidslandmeetprogrammatuur soos WinQS, asook AutoCAD, MS Project en Microsoft Office Suite. Diepgaande kennis van kostebeplanning, kontrakadministrasie (JBCC, NEC, GCC), boukomsnorme en lewenssikluskoste. Program- en projektbestuur. Hoeveelheidslandmeet regs- en operasionele nakoming. Hoeveelheidslandmeet operasionele kommunikasie. Proseskennis en -vaardighede. Onderhoudsvaardighede en -kennis. Mobiele toerustingbedryfsvaardighede. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Tegniese konsultasie. Professionele oordeel. Analitiese, beplannings-, probleemoplossings- en verslagskryfvaardighede. Sterk interpersoonlike, mondelinge en geskrewe kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om multidissiplinêre spanne en veelvuldige infrastruktuurprojekte gelyktydig te bestuur.
af.duties: Lewer professionele hoeveelheidslandmeet- en kostebestuurdienste aan die departemente. Evalueer, benoem en monitor die prestasie van konsultante en kontrakteurs in ooreenstemming met departementele beleide. Bestuur die implementering en monitering van konstruksiekontrakte, insluitend sertifisering van betalings en skikking van kontraktuele eise. Voer haalbaarheidstudies uit, ontwikkel kosteberamings en handhaaf akkurate projekbegrotings en kontantvloeiie. Ondersoek en implementeer nuwe metodes, tegnologieë en volhoubare oplossings in infrastruktuurlewerings. Verseker belyning met die Infrastructure Delivery Management System (IDMS), Infrastructure Procurement and Delivery Management (IPDM) nutsgoed en relevante voorskryfte. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning by die voorbereiding van tenderdokumentasie, bie-evaluerings en adjudikasieprosesse.

zu.title: I-Quantity Surveyor Eyinhloko Izinga a
zu.summary: I-Quantity Surveyor Eyinhloko eMpumalanga Department of Public Works Head Office, inikeza izinsiza zokuphatha izindleko kanye nezinsiza zomqondo wezobungoti we-quantity surveying emphakathini wezokwakhiwa kwezindawo eziphakeme.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor of Science in Quantity Surveying / Bachelor of Quantity Surveying (NQF Level 8), BTech in Quantity Surveying (legacy NQF Level 7), noma izifundo ezihlonishwa ezilingana nalezi. Ukuqokwa ngokuyibophezela kwi-South African Council for the Quantity Surveying Profession (SACQSP) njengo-Professional Quantity Surveyor (PrQS) kuyadingeka. Ilayisense yokuqasha esetshenziswayo kanye nobuqhawe ekusebenziseni izinhlelo zekhompyutha kuyadingeka. Ukuvezwa okuhambisana nomsebenzi njengo-Professional Quantity Surveyor, okungenani eminyaka engu-5 ngemuva kokuqokwa ngokuyiyona. Ulwazi, Amakhono kanye Namandla Okusebenza: Ulwazi olujulile ngemithetho, imithetho yesimo, kanye namakhekheba ahlobene nokwakhiwa asetshenziswa emcakathini kahulumeni, okuhlanganisa i-PFMA, Treasury Regulations, CIDB Act, GIAMA, Construction Regulations, kanye ne-National Building Regulations. Ubuqhawe ekusebenziseni izinhlelo ze-quantity surveying ezifana ne-WinQS, kanye ne-AutoCAD, MS Project, kanye ne-Microsoft Office Suite. Ulwazi olujulile ngokuhlela izindleko, ukuphatha izinkontileka (JBCC, NEC, GCC), amanani ezindleko zokwakha, kanye nezindleko zomjikelezo wempilo. Ukuphatha amaprojekthi nohlelo. Ukuzinikela ngokomthetho nangokusebenza kwe-Quantity Survey. Unxibelelwano lokusebenza kwe-Quantity Survey. Ulwazi namakhono emikhuba. Amakhono nalwazi lokugcina. Amakhono okuphatha izinsiza eziyahamba. Ukuqhuba nokuthuthukisa. Izinhlelo ze-computer-aided engineering. Ukudala isiko lokuvela kahle kakhulu. Ukubonisana ngobuchwepheshe. Isahluleko sobungcali. Amakhono okuhlaziya, ukuhlela, ukuxazulula izinkinga, kanye nokubhala imibiko. Amakhono aqinile onxibelelwano nabantu, okwenziwa ngomlomo, nakubhalwayo. Ikhono elokuphatha amaqembu ahlukene futhi amaprojekthi amaningi ezokwakhiwa ngasikhathi sinye.
zu.duties: Nikeza izinsiza zobungoti we-quantity surveying kanye nokuphatha izindleko ema-Minyangweni. Qinisekisa ukulawula izimali, ukuhlela inani, kanye nokulungiselela izindleko ekulekeni amaprojekthi ezingxenye zezindawo eziphakeme. Hlola, qoka, futhi ulawule ukusebenza kwabaqaphi kanye nabakhi bezinkontileka ngokuvumelana nemigomo yomnyango. Phatha ukusetshenziswa nokulawula izinkontileka zokwakha, okuhlanganisa ukuqinisekiswa kokukhokhelwa kanye nokuxazulula izigqibo zezinkontileka. Yenza izifundo zokuqinisekisa ukufeza, hakaba izindleko, futhi ugcine ama-budget amaprojekthi kanye nemithi yokuphuma kwezimali ngokunembile. Thatha inhlangano yokuqhuba futhi usebenzise izindlela ezintsha, amasu nobuchwepheshe, kanye nezixazululo ezihlala ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ekulekeni izindawo eziphakeme. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana ne-Infrastructure Delivery Management System (IDMS), i-Infrastructure Procurement and Delivery Management (IPDM) toolkit, kanye nezincwadi ezihambisana nalokhu. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe ekulungiseleleni imibhalo ye-tender, ekuqoqweni kwemikhiqizo, nakumajiga azekelwe ukuthathwa kwezigqibo.

xh.title: Iba yomlinganisi wezixa ozingcwetyiweyo inqanaba
xh.summary: Mlinganisi wezixa ozingcwetyiweyo kwiqela lokwakha iindlu kunye neMpumalanga Department of Public Works Head Office, unika inkxaso ngokulawula ixabiso ngenkqubo yomsebenzi wobugcisa bokulinganisa izixa.
xh.requirements: Qela le-12 kunye ne-Bachelor of Science in Quantity Surveying / Bachelor of Quantity Surveying (NQF Level 8), BTech in Quantity Surveying (legacy NQF Level 7), okanye isidanga esamkelwayo esilinganayo. Ubhalo okuyimfuno kunye ne-South African Council for the Quantity Surveying Profession (SACQSP) njengomlinganisi wezixa ozingcwatywa (PrQS). Ilayisenisi yomqhubi eyiyo kunye nobuchule ekusebenziseni iinkqubo zekhompyutha kuyimfuno ngempela. Ulwonakalo oluhambelana nomsebenzi njengoMlinganisi wezixa ozingcwatywa, ongazibe ngaphantsi kweminyaka emi-5 emva kokubhalwa kwakhe njengomlinganisi ozingcwatywa. Ulwazi, amakhono, namandla okusebenza: Ulwazi olubalulekileyo ngemigaqo yokwakha, iingqinamba, nokuqulunqwa kweemigaqo ephilayo kurhulumente, kuquka i-PFMA, iTreasury Regulations, i-CIDB Act, i-GIAMA, i-Construction Regulations, kunye ne-National Building Regulations. Ubuchule kwisoftware yokulinganisa izixa njenge-WinQS, kunye ne-AutoCAD, i-MS Project, kunye ne-Microsoft Office Suite. Ulwazi olubanzi lwokuqulunqwa ixabiso, ulawulo lwemigaqo (JBCC, NEC, GCC), iingxobo zexabiso lokwakha, kunye nexabiso lobomi beleprojekthi. Ulawulo lweenkqubo kunye neeprojekthi. Ukwahlulelwa komthetho nokuhambelana komsebenzi kokulinganisa izixa. Unxibelelwano lwemisebenzi yokulinganisa izixa. Ulwazi namakhono emigaqo yokuqhuba imisebenzi. Amakhono nolwazi lokulondoloza. Amakhono okusebenzisa izixhobo ezihambahambayo. Uphando nophuhliso. Iinkqubo zengcaphephe yekhompyutha. Ukwakha inkqubo yokusebenza ngamandla aphezulu. Iingcebiso zobugcisa. Isigqibo sobugcisa. Amakhono oqondo-lwazi, uqulunqwo,okusombulula iingxaki, kunye nobhala iingxelo. Amanqanaba amakhulu okunxibelelana, okuthetha, nokuqamba kwamagama; ukuqonda nokubhala. Ikhowudi yokuba nakho ukulawula amaqela ahlukeneyo ngokwemisebenzo yamagatya aliqela ngasinye, kunye neeprojekthi eziliqela ngexesha elinye.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zobugcisa bokulinganisa izixa nolawulo lwexabiso kumasebe. Qinisekisa ulawulo lweemali, injiniqondo yexabiso, nokuqonda ngokwexabiso ekunikweni iiprojekthi ezingundoqo. Hlola, misela, uze ulandele inkqubela yomsebenzi bathembekileyo kunye nabakhi bazibasebenziseni urhulumente ngokwemigaqo yesebe. Lawula ukusebenziswa nokuqonda iinkqubo zolawulo lwemivuzo yokuakha, kuquka ukuqinisekiswa kwemali yokuhlawula nokusombulula iimbekiso zemigaqo. Yenza izifundo ezimalunga neyanokwenziwa, hlengahlengisa ukuqikelela ixabiso, uze ulonde ngokuchanileyo iingcali zemali ezimalunga neiprojekthi kunye nokujiya kwemali. Zama uphande uze usebenzise iindlela ezintsha, iinkqulubalo, kunye nosombululo olungayonakalisa indalo ekunikweni izinto ezingundoqo. Qinisekisa ukulandelana kwendlela yeNkqubo yokulawula ukuhanjwa kwezinto ezingundoqo (IDMS), isixhobo solawulo loluniselwe nokuhanjwa kwezinto ezingundoqo (IPDM), nemigaqo ephathelene noko. Nika inkxaso yobugcisa ekulunguweni kwemibhalo yokuthengisa, ukuhlola kwabadingi, nakuqhuba iinkqubo zoonyulo.

af.requirements: Graad 12 plus Baccalaureusgraad, BTech, of Gevorderde Diploma op NQF-vlak 7 in Konstruksiebestuur, Konstruksieprojekbestuur, Projekbestuur, of 'n tersaaklike Geboude-omgewingsveld soos erken deur SAQA, Professionele Registrasie: Professionele Registrasie: Verpligte registrasie as 'n Professionele Konstruksieprojekbestuurder by die South African Council for the Project and Construction Management Professions (SACPCMP). Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Omvattende kennis van program- en projekbestuurmetodologieë binne die geboude omgewing, Kundigheid in projekontwerp, ontleding en implementering, met spesifieke fokus op onderhoud van vervoerinfrastruktuur, Sterk begrip van regs- en operasionele nakoming, finansiële bestuur en toevoerkettingbestuursprosesse, Getoonde vermoë om 'n hoëprestasiekultuur te bevorder en effektiewe strategiese leierskap te bied, Gevorderde kommunikasie-, onderhandelings- en belanghebbende-betrokkenheidsvaardighede, Uitstekende probleemoplossings-, besluitnemings- en konflikbestuursvermoëns, Navorsings- en ontwikkelingsgerigtheid om innovasie in die aflewering van onderhoudsprojekte te dryf, Degelijke kennis van regerings- en departementele beleide, prosedures en verslagdoeningsvereistes, Bedryfsvaardigheid in tersaaklike projekbestuur- en kantoorprogrammatuur.

zu.title: Umphathi Omkhuli Weprojekthi Yokwakha: Ukugcinwa Kokuhamba
zu.summary: Umphathi Omkhuli Weprojekthi Yokwakha okuzobhekele iphakheji lezinhlela zokwakha nezokugcina izindlela eNdayo Yesihlalo seMpumalanga, okudinga ukubhaliswa ngobungcweti nesifundo esihambisana esigabeni i-NQF Level 7.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor's Degree, i-BTech, noma i-Advanced Diploma esigabeni i-NQF Level 7 kwi-Construction Management, i-Construction Project Management, i-Project Management, noma inkundla efanayo ye-Built Environment njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Ukubhaliswa Kobungcweti: Ukubhaliswa Kobungcweti: Ukubhaliswa ngokuyimethando njengoMphathi Weprojekthi Yokwakha Ogwetiwe ne-South African Council for the Project and Construction Management Professions (SACPCMP). Isiphephelo: Okungenani eminyaka yeshumi nhlanu (5) yesiphephelo ngemuva kokuthola iziqu ekuphathweni kweprojekthi yokwakha, okungenani eminyaka yamathathu (3) osezingeni lokuhola noma lokuphatha (okukhethwa kakhulu ekugcineni ukuhamba kwamasokhaya okuthutha), ilayisense yomshayeli evumelekile nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi, Amakhono namandla: Ukuqonda okuphelele kwezindlela zokuphatha amaphrogremu namaprojekthi endaweni ezakhiwe, Ukwazi ukwakha amaphrojekthi, ukuhlaziya, nokuphumeza, ngokugqamisa ukugcinwa kwezinsiza zokuthutha, Ukuqonda okuqotho komthetho nokuqonda ngokusebenza, kuphathwa kwezimali, nezinqubo zokuqoqa izinto ezithunyelwe, Ukukhombisa ukwazi ukukhulisa isiko lokusebenza ngamandla amakhulu nokunika inkulezobuzela ephumelelayo, Amakhono aphezulu okuxoxa ngamagama, ukuxoxisana, nokuxhumana nabahlomuli amaphrojekthi, Ukuba namandla okuxazulula izinkinga, okuthatha izinqumo, nokuphatha izinkinga, Ukuzijwayeza ukuphenya nokuqamba ukuze kwandise ithuba lokuletha izinto ezintsha ekuphatweni kweprojekthi yokugcina, Ulwazi oluhle ngezinqumo zahulumeni nezomnyango, izinqubo, nezidingo zokubika, Ukusebenzisana kahle ngamaphrogremu okuphatha amaphrojekthi namaphiliso ahlobene nawo.
zu.duties: Ukuqapha, ukwelisa, nokusekela abaphathi bamaphrojekthi abangaphansi kwakho, ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza okuhle kakhulu nokuqhubekela phambili kwamakhono. Ukuphatha iphakheji yamaphrojekthi okwakhiwe, okuhlanganisa imisebenzi enkulu yezimali, ukugcinwa kwezindlela, namakontrathi asebenzayo, kusukela ekuqaleni kuye kusebuyweni. Ukuguqula izidingo zabathengi abanguwo baprojekthi abacace bakaqondakalayo bese uqinisekisa ukuthi bahambisana namagugu enhlangano. Ukukhokula ukuthola abantu abakhoyo endaweni ezakhiwe ngokuhambisana nezinqubo zokuqoqa izinto ezithunyelwe. Ukuhlanganisa amaqembu amaningi, ukuqinisekisa izinga lobungcweti ekwakheni, emadokhumentini, nakulethweni kweprojekthi njengakuhlelo lokuphumeza. Ukubheka futhi ukweseka inqubo yokumiswa kontratha, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imithombo yamandla yangaphakathi ihanjisiwe ukwenza ukuthengiselana nokuphatha kontrathi okuphumelelayo. Ukuqapha futhi uqinisekise izinga lomsebenzi owenziwe ngabahola nangabathwebuli, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bahambisana nemigomo yekontrathi nobungcweti. Ukwehlulela iziyalezo zoshintsho nezicelo zokwenzisa isikhathi, wenze izincomo ezihlakaniphile kunikazi womnyango ovunyelwe ukwamukela. Ukucubungula izinkokhela zanyanga zonke futhi uqinisekise ukuthi izithembiso zokukhokha kahulumeni zihambisana nemigomo yekontrathi. Ukulungiselela, ukuthumela, futhi ugcine ulwazi lweprojekthi ngokuhambisana nezidingo zangaphakathi nokuqinisekiswa. Ukuthola imali yeprojekthi ngamaphathi asunguliwe angaphakathi bese uphatha ukulawula imali yokuqashwa konke ekuhambeni kweprojekthi. Ukukhulisa isiko lokusebenza ndawonye, amandla, nokuqeqesha ngaphakathi komnyango nakubo bonke abahlotshiswe nabo.
