zu.title: Injiniela Oyinhloko Izinga a (CONTRACT Admin)
zu.summary: Injiniela Oyinhloko onikeza ubuholo obuyingqayizivele bokuhlakaniphile emikhakheni yezokwakhiwa kwezindlela, amabhuloho namaphrojekthi wokwakha izakhiwo eMpumalanga Head Office.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor of Engineering (BEng) / Bachelor of Science (BSc) ekuqashelweyo kwi-Civil Engineering. Ukuqopha okuyisibopho ku-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengo-Professional Engineer (Pr. Eng). Okungenani iminyaka eyishumi (10) yokuhlola okuhlobene nakho emva kokuthola izifundo ezindaweni zezindlela, amabhuloho nokwakhiwa kwezakhiwa, okuhlanganisa okungenani iminyaka eyisithupha (06) yokuhlola emva kokuqopha njengomunywe. Okuguqulweyo okuhlobene nokulawula ukwakhiwa kanye nokuphathwa kwezivumelwano zezindlela, amabhuloho nezakhiwo. Okubonisiwe kokuhola amaqembu abasebenzi benjiniela abaningi abanemikhakha ehlukene nokuphatha amaphrojekthi ezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi, abeluleki nabobagijimi bezivumelwano. Okuqinisekisiwe kokuphatha izivumelwano zokwakha nokuhlola okusha, izitifikedi zentela, ukwelulwa kwesikhathi nezikhwezane zezivumelwano. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile nokuzimisela ukuhamba ezindaweni zamaphrojekthi, okuhlanganisa nezindawo ezikude. Okuhlola kokwakha okudinga umsebenzi wabaningi, ukuthuthukiswa kwebagijimi kanye nokwenziwa kwe-Expanded Public Works Programme kuzokuba yinzuzo ephawulekayo. Ulwazi, Amakhono namakhono okuqonda: Ukuqonda okumakhulu kokubuyekeza ukwakhiwa, ukwakheka kwendawo, izindlela zokwakha, ukuhlolwa kwezinto nokuqinisekiswa kwegugu. Isisekelo ekuthengeni okuhlobene nokwakhiwa, emabhukwini okuthengisa, ekwazisweni, ekuyini imali kanye nokuphathwa kwezivumelwano. Ikono lokuhlola izivumelwano nokuhlola ukuthi umuntu unelungelo ngemuphi, isizathu kanye nemithelela yemali kanye neqhaza lemikhakha yokweseka. Ulwazi lokuphatha imali yokusebenza, ukuthenga, ukuphathwa kokuthintana komsebenzi kwezempilo nokuphepha, emasimongi nakwizidingo zejiniela. Amakhono obuholo, ukuxoxisana, ukuhlaziya, ukuthumela imiyalezo nokubhala imibhalo yezobuchwepheshe. Ukuzethemba ngobungcali, ukuzithiba nokuba nengcebo ekwenzeni izinqumo ezingakuxhosalwa ngaphakathi kwamandla anikeziwe.
zu.duties: Ukunikela ngobuholo bokuhlakaniphile nobuchwepheshe bejiniela ekuhlongozweni kwemibhalo yokuqasha nokweseka izivumelwano, ekulawuleni ukwakhiwa nokuphathweni kwezindlela, amabhuloho nezakhiwo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaphrojekthi ezakhiwo adluliselwa ngaphakathi kwesibopho esamukelekwe, emaphakethe nasezikhathini, ahambelane nezindinganiso zezinga elihloliwe futhi asekelwe izilawuli zezivumelwano nezomuzi ezisebenzayo.

xh.title: Injiniya Omkhulu Inqanaba a (ISIVUMELWANO Admin)
xh.summary: Injiniya Omkhulu onika ubuqhawe obusemthethweni kwimisebenzi yobuchwepheshe ekwakhiweni kwamagepha, amabhozo nezakhiwo eMpumalanga Head Office.
xh.requirements: Grade 12 kunye ne-Bachelor of Engineering (BEng) / Bachelor of Science (BSc) ekuqatywa kuyo kwisifundo se-Civil Engineering. Ukwaziswa kuyinyanzeleko kwi-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengomProfessionali we-Engineer (Pr. Eng). Amava angaphezulu kweminyaka elishumi (10) ekubeni ugqatile kwimisebenzi ekubakhiweni kwamagepha, amabhozo nezakhiwo, kuquka amava angaphezulu kweminyaka esixhenxe (06) ukususela kukwaziswa njengomProfessional. Amava amaninzi akumisebenzi ekulawuleni ukuqatshelwa kweekontrathi nasekuphathweni kweekontrathi kwamagepha, amabhozo nezakhiwo. Ukubonisa amava ekukhokeleni amaqela obuchwepheshe ahlukeneyo nasekulawuleni iinkqubo zeziseko ezingundoqo, abacebisi nabaqeshi bekontrathi. Amava abonwayo ekuphathweni kweekontrathi zokwakha nasekuhlolweni iindlela ezahlukeneyo, iifom zentlawulo, ukwandiswa kwexesha namagama ekontrathi. Ilayisensi yokushayela eSemthethweni nokuzimisela ukuhamba kwiindawo zomsebenzi, kuquka iindawo eziqhelekileyo kude. Amava ekwakheni ngendlela edla abasebenzi, ekuphuhliseni abaqeshi bekontrathi nakuchasenjwa i-Expanded Public Works Programme kuya kuba lusizo olungaphezulu. Ulwazi, Amandla nobuqhawe: Ukuqonda okuqinileyo ekuphawulweni ngokutsha kweziseko, ukwakheka, iindlela zokwakha, ukuhlolwa kwesixhobo nokuqinisekiswa kwakhona ubumnini. Ubuchwepheshe ekuthengeni izixhobo zokwakha, iinxalenxalemba zethenda, iinkcazelo zamagama, iibhili ezidityanisiwe nasekuphathweni kweekontrathi. Ikhono lokutolika iinkcazelo zekontrathi nokulinganisa amalungelo, iimeko neziphumo zemali kwaye kwiprogram ngenxa yamagama ekontrathi. Ulwazi ngolawulo lwemali loluntu, ukuthengwa kwezinto, impilo yabantu basebenzayo nokhuseleko, imo yendalo neemfuno zokuba ngumProfessional we-Engineer. Amandla aqinileyo okukhokela, ukuxoxisana, ukuhlalutywa, ukunxibelelana nokubhala iingxelo zezixhobo ezingundoqo. Isigqibo sokusebenza njengomProfessional, ukuzithembisa nakhono lokwenza izigqibo ezingenasiphithiphithi ngamagunya anikiweyo.
xh.duties: Ukubonelela ngobuqhawe obusemthethweni nabobuchwepheshe ekulungiseleleni iinxalenxalemba zethenda nekontrathi, nasekulawulweni ukuqatshelwa kwekontrathi nasekuphathweni kweekontrathi kwamagepha, amabhozo nezakhiwo. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zeziseko zihamba ngokomelelo obugunyaziweyo, ngemali yokwendalo yemihla nangemithetho yexesha, zahlangabezana nemiqathango yomgangatho edla abasebenzi, zize zixhaswe ngolawulo olululo lwemali nekontrathi.

af.duties: Verskaf ingenieursleierskap en toesig in die beplanning, uitvoering en monitering van siviele ingenieurs- en infrastruktuurprojekte onder die PMU, Keur ontwerpe, tegniese verslae en kontrakdokumentasie goed om ooreenstemming met statutêre vereistes en departementele standaarde te verseker, Hou toesig oor die lewerings van projekte en kontrakte en verseker nakoming van tegniese gehalte, veiligheid, bestuur en prestasie-doelwitte, Verseker dat professionele en tegniese advies aan interne spanne en belanghebbendes verskaf word ter ondersteuning van deurdagte besluitneming en risikobeperking, Monitor en bestuur die werk van projekbestuurders en ingenieurs onder jou toesig en bevorder vaardigheidsontwikkeling en hoë prestasie, Lei projekspanne in die verkryging en bestuur van konsultante en kontrakteurs in ooreenstemming met toeleweringskettingprosesse, Dryf innovasie en deurlopende verbetering in ingenieurs- en projekbestuurspraktyke aan, Stel omvattende projekdokumentasie, verslae en ouditrekords vir alle toegewysde projekte op en onderhou dit, Bou effektiewe werksverhoudinge met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes om suksesvolle projeklewering en departementele doelwitte te ondersteun

zu.title: Injiniyela Ohamba Wezokwakha Izinga a (IMIQANGO YOKUPHATHA INKONTIREKA (PMU)
zu.summary: Ukubhejwa kukainjiniyela ohamba wezokwakha nguMnyango weZemizila kahulumende waseMpumalanga ukuba ahoze izinhlela zokwakuhlela izindawo ezisiza ukukhula komnotho ngaphansi kwePMU, okudinga ukubhalisa ku-ECSA nokuqashelwa okubanzi kokusebenza kwindawo yokwakha.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanti futhi kudingeka i-Bachelor of Engineering (BEng) / Bachelor of Science (BSc) ebulawe kwezobunjiniyela zokwakha. Ukubhalisa okuyikho ngesikhathi esithile ku-ECSA njengengcaphependo (Pr. Eng). Ukuze othole lesikhundla kudingeka kube nokuthi ube nomzamo omkhulu, uneminyaka eyishumi (10) yokusebenza ezinhlelweni, ukuphathwa kwezinhlela nezinkundla zokwakha kwakha izindawo, okuhlanganisa neminyaka eyisithupha (06) yokusebenza emva kokuqeqeshwa okusesimweni sokuba ngumpathimfundo. Ukube ungomuntu ohole amalungu weqembu njiniyela eminye yeminye yemimoya ehlukene, ukube ungomuntu ohlakaniphile ekuphathweni kwezinhlela ezinkundla zokwakha izindawo, nezenkuntanela. Kudinga oqinisekisiwe ukuba ulawula konke okuhlobene nemikhandlu yokwakuhlela izinkundla, ukuhlola izinto ezenziwa ngokushintsha, izitifikedi sezikokhi, ukuhlaselwa kwesikhathi nesimilo sokushintsha okuhlobene nemikhandlu. Kudinga ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela nokuba ukulungele ukuhamba uye ezindaweni ezikude nezingafiki kalula. Ukusebenza ezindaweni ezidla amandla abantu abaningi, ukukhulisa abaphathi bokuqashisa nokusebenza kwi-Expanded Public Works Programme kuzokwenza ube nguムuzi ongcono. Izinto okufanele uzazi, amakhono kanye nobuhlakani: ukuqonda konke okumayelana nezinhlela zokuphathwa kwezinhlela ezinkundla zokwakha izindawo kanye nokwakha izindawo zikahulumende, ulwazi olujulile ekuklanyweni kwezokwakha, ukuhlaziya amaphulo, kanye nokuqeqesheka ngokomthetho, okuhlanganisa nezindinganiso zobuchwepheshe, ukwazi konke okumayelana nomthetho ngokwemisebenzi, kanye nezinhlela ezilawula ukwakhiwa kwezindlu namakhethelo ezimali, ukulawula izindleko, kanye nobuhlakani bokuphathwa kwemigqa wemibono yoluhlelo, amakhono obuchule ekulungiseleleni izinhlelo zokusinda phambili, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga, ukuba nomuzwa omuhle wokukhulisa abantu abanamakhono aphezulu, ukukhombisa ubuholi, nokuba ngumsizi abantu abayizihlulu sabo, ukwazi ukukhuluma kahle kanye nokuqonda abanye, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono aphakeme ekuqondisiseni izinkinga kubuniwe ukuzenzela izinqumo, ukwazi ukubhala izibalo ezihlukene, amadokhumenti, kanye nezinhlelo ezihlukene ezingasetshenziswa ekuphathweni kwamaphulo.
zu.duties: Nikeza ngobuholi kanye nokuqapha ekucubunguleni, ekwenzeni kanye nokubukeleni imisebenzi yezokwakha nezindlu ngezinhlela ze-PMU. Yemukela izinto eziyisiqiniso ekuklanyweni, emabhalowe, kanye namadokhumenti emikhandlu ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ahambisana nemithetho yezwe kanye nezidingo zomnyango. Qaphela ukwethulwa kwamaphulo kanye namakontraka, ukuqinisekise ukuthi ahambisana namandla, ukuphepha, ukulawula kanye nemigomo yenkondlo. Yenza kuqinisekiswa ukuthi kuphathwa kufakwe amasu obuchwepheshe nakwisimemo sakho sebantu abangaphakathi nangaphandle, ukuxhasa ukwenza izinqumo ezilungile nokususa izinsongavu. Qaphela uphathe imisebenzi yabaphathi baphulo kanye namainjiniyela abangaphansi kwakho, ukukhulisa amakhono kanye nemisebenzi ekuhle. Hola amaqembu abasebenzi ekuthengeni nasekuphathweni kwabakwamakhono kanye na makontraka ngendlela ehambisana namaphuzu wokuqashisa. Fundisa ukukhulu kwezinto ezintsha ekwenzeni izinto ezingcono ekwakheni nasokuphathweni kwamaphulo. Hlela futhi ulondoloze konke ukubhalwa kwamaphulo neemfuyo kanye nezibalo ukugcina amaphulo onawo konke. Yenza izinhlobonhlobo zokusebenza okuhle ngezihlobi ezingaphakathi nangaphandle ukuxhasa ukuqeda ukusetshenziswa kohlelo ngempumelelo kanye nemigomo yomnyango.

xh.title: IInjiniyela Ezingundoqo Zophuhliso lweZakhiwo inqanaba a (ISIVUMELWANO Sokulawula (PMU)
xh.summary: Isebe leZoLuntu laseMpumalanga sifuna iNjiniyela Ezingundoqo yoBuchwepheshe boPhuhliso lweZakhiwo ukuba ihulule iiprojekthi zezakhiwo phantsi kwe-PMU, kufuneka kubekho ukubhaliswa kwi-ECSA kunye nolwazi oluqinileyo olubonelela ngezicwangciso zeendawo eziyakhiwayo.
xh.requirements: IGrade 12 kunye nesidanga se-Bachelor of Engineering (BEng) esiqinisekisiweyo okanye i-Bachelor of Science (BSc) kwi-Civil Engineering. Ukubhaliswa okuyiyo nge-ECSA njengoko kukhethwa kwi-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengeNjiniyela eYingcali (Pr. Eng). Ukuba ngowesixhenxe (06) kwiminyaka eyi-10 (lishumi) ekugqibeleni kwemisebenzi ekugqibeleni ekwazi ukulawula iiprojekthi kwakunye neenkqubo zokulawula ezifana nemisebenzi yonke, into eza kubakho isixa esingenamda kwi-7 kwiminyaka eyi-10. Ukuba ngowesithathu kwiminyaka eyi-3 ekugqibeleni kwi-programme and project management kwindawo ezakhiwayo, kubandakanya unyaka owodwa (1) wokubhaliswa kwenkonzo ekugqibeleni. Ulwazi lokuba ngowesithathu ekulawuleni iiteyim zobuchwepheshe ezahlukeneyo nokulawula iinkqubo eziyakhiwayo ezinzima, abacengileyo kunye nabakhweli. Ulwazi lokuba ngowesithathu ekusebenziseni amagqabi esivumelwano nezicwangciso ezahlukeneyo, izatifikethi zentlawulo, usuku olwandisiweyo nezivumelwano ezingundoqo. Ilayisenisi yokushayela eiyileyo nokuzimisela ukuhamba esiya kwiindawo zeeprojekthi, kuquka iindawo ezikude. Ulwazi ekwakhiweni okusebenzisa abasebenzi abaninzi, ekuphuhliseni abakhweli nakusebenziseni iNkqubo yoBalo Lwamagqabi eYandisiweyo kuya kuba lusizo. Ulwazi, Amandla namaphulo: Ukuqonda okubanzi ngeenkqubo nokulawula iiprojekthi kwizakhiwo eziyakhiwayo nakwishishini lolawulo lwentlalo, amandla ekujoliseni ekwakheni, ekwahlulweni iiprojekthi, nakulawulweni amagqabi, kuquka ukulawula, ukuvumelana, namazinga obungcali, ulwazi ngezakhiwo ezilawula iiprojekthi ezakhiwayo, ekusebenziseni imali, ekulawuleni ixabiso, nakulawulweni konikezelo lweempahla, ukucwangcisa ngeenjongo, ukuphanda nokuphuhlisa, namandla okulawula ingozi, amandla okuqhuba inkqubo yamandla aphezulu, ukubonisa obunkokeli, nokukhokela iiteyim ezingcali, amandla okuzwakalisa, ukuxoxisana, nokusombulula iingxaki, amandla aphezulu okusombulula iingxaki nokuthatha izigqibo, ukusebenzisa iireports ezicwangcisiweyo, ukubhala iigqabi, nakwiliso yokwenza iiprojekthi.
xh.duties: Nika abakwabhala abanjiniyela amandla ngokulawula, ukwenza nokuqwalasela iiprojekthi zobuchwepheshe kunye nezosakhiwo phantsi kwe-PMU. Vumela izicwangciso, iireports zobuchwepheshe, namagqabi esivumelwano kuqinisekise ukuvumelana nemigangatho yesizwe kunye namagunya esebe. Qhoboshela ukunikwa iiprojekthi kunye namagqabi esivumelwano, ukuqinisekisa ukuvumelana nobungangcali obuchwepheshe, ukhuseleko, ukulawula, namagunya aqondene nento ekwenzwayo. Qinisekisa ukuba kunikwa inkundla ngamandla ngokuchanekileyo kunye nabakwabaso ababiniyo ukuxhasa ukwenza isigqibo esilungileyo nokususa ingozi. Qwalasela nokulawula umsebenzi wabalawuli beprojekthi kunye neenjiniyela abakulawulweni lwakho, ukukhulisa amandla okusebenza ngokuqinileyo. Qhuba iiteyim zeeprojekthi ekuthengeni nasekulawuleni abacengileyo kunye nabakhweli ngokulandela iinkqubo zikonkezo. Qhoboshela iidrafu nobuchule obutsha ekusebenziseni iinkqubo ezintsha zobuchwepheshe nakulawulweni iiprojekthi. Lungiselela zigqibe ukubhala iireports, iigqabi, iinkqubo ezikwamagqabi ezipheleleyo nakulo lonke iprojekthi onikelwe yona. Yakha ubudlelwane obusebenzayo ngokuchanekileyo kunye nabakwabaso abangaphakathi kunye nangaphandle ukuxhasa ukuphumelela iiprojekthi namagunya aQotho.

jobs.title: Chief Engineer: Special Maintenance
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Transport
jobs.summary: Chief Engineer needed at Mpumalanga Public Works Head Office to lead road pavement investigation, design and maintenance, requiring ECSA registration and ten years' experience.
jobs.requirements: A recognised Bachelor of Engineering (BEng) / Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Civil Engineering. Compulsory registration with the Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as a Professional Engineer (Pr. Eng). A minimum of ten (10) years’ relevant post-qualification engineering experience in road infrastructure, including substantial experience in pavement investigation, pavement design, materials engineering and rehabilitation design, including at least six (06) years’ post-professional registration experience. Demonstrated experience in preparing and reviewing pavement designs, technical specifications, tender documentation and engineering reports. Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and managing complex infrastructure programmes, consultants and contractors. A valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel to project sites, including remote locations. Experience in labour-intensive construction, contractor development and Expanded Public Works Programme implementation will be an added advantage. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: Flexible and rigid pavement design principles, pavement deterioration mechanisms and rehabilitation methods. Mechanistic- empirical analysis, traffic loading estimation, and design traffic assessment. Subgrade characterisation, geotechnical investigations, material testing and interpretation of laboratory and field results. Granular, stabilised, asphalt and concrete pavement materials, including recycled materials. Pavement drainage, moisture sensitivity, climatic influences and construction variability. Pavement evaluation methods, including visual assessment. The South African Pavement Engineering Manual, applicable TRH and TMH guidance, COTO specifications and departmental design standards. Lifecycle costing, economic evaluation, constructability and sustainable pavement design. Infrastructure procurement, engineering contract administration, quality assurance and construction supervision. Applicable public finance, occupational health and safety, environmental and professional engineering requirements.
jobs.duties: Provide professional engineering leadership in the investigation, design and evaluation of road pavements for new construction, upgrading, rehabilitation and maintenance. Ensure that pavement solutions are safe, durable, cost- effective and appropriate to traffic loading, material availability, environmental conditions and the department’s road asset management objectives.
jobs.enquiries: Ms PN Yingwane Tel No: (013) 766 6780 e-Recruitment Mpumalanga
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted online through the link erecruitment.mpg.gov.za
jobs.notes: A recent comprehensive CV, and contactable references (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). (Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents; on or before the day of the interviews). Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. The successful candidate will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as completing a financial disclosure interests’ declaration form within one month of appointment and annually thereafter. Faxed or emailed applications will not be considered. Failure to comply with the above instructions will result in your application being disqualified. The Department is committed to provide equal opportunities and practice affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representability in terms of race, gender, and disability when filling the vacant positions. Women and people with disabilities are encouraged to apply. The Department reserves the right to fill or not to fill any advertised posts. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

zu.title: Injiniyahamba: Ukugcinwa Okukhethekile
zu.summary: Ifuna Injiniyahamba eMpumalanga Public Works Head Office ukuba ihhole ucwaningo lwendlela yokuphakamisa, ukuklama kanye nokugcina, kudingeka ukubhaliswa kwi-ECSA kanye neminyaka yishumi yeminyaso yokusebenza.
zu.requirements: I-Bachelor of Engineering (BEng) / Bachelor of Science (BSc) ekuqashelwa kuyo e-Civil Engineering. Ukubhaliswa okuyimfuneko ku-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengo-Professional Engineer (Pr. Eng). Okuncane iminyaka eyishumi (10) yeminyaso yokuqashelwa ekusebenzeni njengenjiniya kwizakhiwo zendlu, okuhlanganisa ulwazi olunzulu ocwaningweni kokuphakamisa, ukuklama kokuphakamisa, ukuqashelwa kwemishini kanye nokuklama kokuvuselela, okuhlanganisa okungenani iminyaka eyisithupha (06) yeminyaso yokusebenza ngemva kokubhalisa ngobungcweti. Ulwazi olubonisiwe ekulungiseleleni nasekuhlola ukuklama kokuphakamisa, imininingwane yobuchwepheshe, amadokhumenti okuthengisa kanye nemibhalo yezinjiniya. Ulwazi lokuhola amaqembu ezinjiniya ahlukene futhi ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo zezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi, abacebisi kanye nabanikazi bamasekhethi. Ilayisense yasesihlahleni esebenzayo kanye nesifiso sokuhamba eyitholakala kwiziteshi sezinhlelo, okuhlanganisa nendawo ebuya kude. Ulwazi ekwakheni okudinga umzila omnandi, ekuqophiseni abanikazi bamasekhethi nasekuqhashweni kwe-Expanded Public Works Programme kuzoba yinzuzo eyenziwe. Ulwazi, Amakhono kanye namandla okwenza umsebenzi: Imigomo yokuklama indlela eguquguqukayo neqinile, izindlela zokuchithwa kwendlu kanye nezindlela zokuqasha kabusha. Ukuhlaziywa ngokwesistimu, ukulinganisa ukushaja kwegciwane, kanye nekuhlolwa kokushaja kwesistimu yokuklama. Ukuqashwa kwesizinda ngaphansi, ucwaningo lwemvelo, ukuhlolwa kwemishini kanye nekuhumusha imiphumela yelabhulethri naseveldi. Imishini yokuphakamisa eqiniswa noma eguquguqukayo, imishini ye-asphalt neyethuli, okuhlanganisa nemishini ephindwe kabusha. Ukuphuma kwamanzi endlela ekuqashweni kokuphakamisa, ukuzwela kwamanzi, ukuthonywa isimo sezulu kanye nokwehluka ekwakheni. Izindlela zokuqashwa kokuphakamisa, okuhlanganisa ukuhlola ngokubona. I-South African Pavement Engineering Manual, isiqondiso esifanele se-TRH ne-TMH, imininingwane ye-COTO kanye namazinga okuklama umnyango. Ixabiso elihamba nomyaka wempilo, ukuhlolwa kwezomnotho, ukwakheka kanye nokuklama okuhlala isikhathi eside. Ukuthenga izakhiwo, ukuphatwa kwezinkontileka zezinjiniya, ukuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi kanye nokuqashwa ekwakheni. Imininingwane efanele yezimali zomphakathi, impilo yezisebenzi nokuphepha, imvelo kanye nezidingo zezinjiniya zobuchwepheshe.
zu.duties: Nikela ngobuholi bezinjiniya zobuchwepheshe ocwaningweni, ekuklamweni nasekuhlolweni kwendlela ezakhiwa kutsha, eziyisibonelo, eziyisibonelo sokuvuselela nokugcina. Qinisekisa ukuthi izixazululi zendlela zokuqashwa ziqinile, zihlala isikhathi eside, ziba ngesixabisa okulingene futhi zifanele ukushaja kwegciwane, ukutholakala kwemishini, izimo zomvelo kanye nemigomo yomnyango yokuphatha izimpahla zendlu.

xh.title: Injiniya Yohlelo: Ulondolozo Olukhethekileyo
xh.summary: Kufuneka iNjiniya Yohlelo kwiMpumalanga Public Works Head Office ukuyenza inkokeli kophando, uyilo nolondolozo lwendlela yomjeka, kufuneka kubekho ukubhalisa kwi-ECSA neminyaka elishumi yamava.
xh.requirements: I-Bachelor of Engineering (BEng) / i-Bachelor of Science (BSc) ebatyelwe kwi-Civil Engineering. Ukubhaliswa ngokuyimfuneko kwi-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njenge-Professional Engineer (Pr. Eng). Amava anguqondo afanelekileyo emva kokufumana isidanga kwizicelo zolwelwesi kwiminyaka elishumi (10) kumazwe eendlela, kuquka amava amaninzi kophando lomjeka, uyilo lomjeka, ulwelwesi lwamasuntswana nolungiselelo uyilo lokubuyisa, kuquka amava anguqondo emva kokubhalisa ngobuchwephesha abangaphezulu kweenyanga ezingeshlanu (06). Ukuqinisekiswa kwamava ekulungiseni nokuqamba amaxabiso ayilo lomjeka, iinkcukacha zobugcisa, amaxabiso athengiswa nengxelo yolwelwesi. Amava ekulawuleni amaqela olwelwesi ahlukeneyo nokuphatha iinkqubo zolwelwesi ezintsundu, abaQambi-bazincwadi nabakhiqizi. Ilayisensi yokushuka esemthethweni nokuzimisela ukuhamba kumhlaba wamaphulo, kuquka iindawo ezikude. Amava kwakhiwo lomsebenzi owetyaliswa nzima, ukuphuhliswa kwabakhiqizi nokuphuhliswa kwe-Expanded Public Works Programme kuya kuba ngaphezulu kumjongomphezulu. Ulwazi, Amandla nobuchwephesha: Iinkqubo zolwazi zokuyila iindlela eziguquguqukayo nezinqamlezileyo, iindlela zothotyho lomjeka nendlela zokubuyisa. Uqondo lwenkqubo yokulinganisela nokulinganisa umthwalo wegqithiso, kwaye ulinganise umthwalo wegqithiso ngokomsebenzi wolwazi. Ukuchaza isiseko, imibuzo yamabala phantsi komhlaba, ukuqokelela ngeendlela zolwazi amaxabiso obugcisa nokuqondakorisa iziphumo. Iindlela zamafayili ngokunzulu, ukuzinziswa, i-asphalt ngee-tiles zendlela, kuquka iindlela eziphindaphindwayo. Ulondolozo lwegazi lendlela, ukuziva kwamanzi, iimpembelelo zemozulu nokungaguquguquki kwesakhiwo. Iindlela zokulinganisa imigca, kuquka ukuqwalasela ngokweso. Ingcaciso ye-South African Pavement Engineering Manual, e-TRH naku-TMH, iinkcukacha ze-COTO nemiqathango yesebe ngeendlela ezingagqibekanga. Iindlela ezixabisa amaxabiso ubomi, ukuguqulelwa ngokwezoqoqosho, amandla okwakha kunye neendlela zokuzinza ezingagqibekanga. Iindlela zokuthengisa izicelo ezahlukeneyo, ulawulo lwezivumelwano ezahlukeneyo zolwazi, ukuqinisekisa umgangatho nokulawulwa kwesakhiwo. Iindlela zolwazi zolwazi lwentlalo, umgdangatsha wezempilo nakusebenza, iindlela zomoya wendalo nokuqinisekiswa ngokwemfuno yolwazi.
xh.duties: Yiba ngumlawuli weNjiniya wolwazi kwindlela yokuxilonga, ukuyila nokulinganisa amaxabiso obugcisa kwimveliso yamajeka endlela ekuyilelweni, ukulungelelanisa umxholo, ukubuyisa nokulondoloza. Qinisekisa ukuba iindlela zeendlela zingapheleli, zigqibele ngokuchanekileyo, zibalulekile ngokwamaxabiso, kwaye zikwazi ukumelana nokugqithiswa kolwazi, ukubakho komsuka wezinto, iimeko zendalo nemiqathango yemigca yendlela yesebe.

jobs.title: Chief Engineer: Structural and Bridges

jobs.summary: Chief Engineer position in the Mpumalanga Department of Public Works, Roads and Transport, providing specialist technical leadership on structural and bridge infrastructure projects.
jobs.requirements: A recognised Bachelor of Engineering (BEng) / Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Civil Engineering. Compulsory registration with the Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as a Professional Engineer (Pr. Eng). A minimum of ten (10) years’ relevant experience in civil and structural engineering, including at least five years’ post-professional registration experience. Extensive relevant experience in the design, construction and contract administration of roads, bridges and buildings, including experience after professional registration. Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and managing complex infrastructure programmes, consultants and contractors. A recognised Bridge Inspector certification will be an added advantage. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: Advanced knowledge of structural behaviour and the design of reinforced concrete, prestressed concrete, steel and masonry structures. Knowledge of applicable engineering codes, design standards, construction specifications and quality assurance procedures. Understanding of geotechnical conditions, foundations, hydrology, hydraulics, drainage and their implications for structural integrity. Competence in structural inspections, condition ratings, failure investigations, remaining-life assessments and maintenance planning. Knowledge of procurement, infrastructure delivery, occupational health and safety, environmental requirements and professional engineering responsibilities. Familiarity with relevant legislation, codes of practice, and technical standards (e.g., SANS, TMH, COLTO, and SANRAL guidelines). Competency in managing budgets, variations, claims, payment certification and contractual disputes. Strong analytical, report-writing, communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills. The ability to exercise independent engineering judgement. Strong leadership and team management abilities to drive high- performance teams.

Ensure that infrastructure is safe, functional, durable and cost- effective throughout its service life.

Agetoonde ervaring in die leiding van multidissiplinêre ingenieursspanne en die bestuur van komplekse infrastruktuurprogramme, konsultante en kontrakteurs. zu.title: Isiphikulu Sobunjiniyela: Izakhiwo Namabhuloho
zu.summary: Isikhundla sika-Construction Project Coordinator esikhungweni sama-National School of Government e-Pretoria; sibhekene nokubusa ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lokuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi obunjiniyela neminye yezinsimbi zomsebenzi, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezimali nokuhlelwa kwamaphrojekthi.
zu.requirements: I-Bachelor of Engineering (BEng) / I-Bachelor of Science (BSc) ekuqashelwa kwe-Civil Engineering. Ukuqashiswa okuyingcindebi phansi kwe-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengoba uyingcali yobunjiniyela (Pr. Eng). Ukwaziswa okuncane kweminyaka eyishumi (10) eyisipho esihlobene nomyango we-civil and structural engineering, okuhlanganisa okungenani iminyaka emihlanu yokuhlelwa ngemva kokubhaliswa njengengcali. Ukwaziswa okulingene futhi okudlulele ekwenzeni izinhlelo, ukwakhiwa kanye nokuqashiswa kwezinkulumo zamabhuloho, endaweni yezimoto, kanye nezakhiwo, okuhlanganisa nokuhlelwa ngemva kokubhaliswa njengengcali. Ukubonisa isipiliyoni sokuhola amaqembu abasebenzi be-multidisciplinary engineering kanye nokulawula amaphrojekthi anzima, abakhiqizi, kanye nabathengi abavela emaphoyintini. Ukuthola isitifikedi se-Bridge Inspector kuzongeke kuholele ekutheni abantu bathole isikhundla esihle. Ulwazi, amakhono namakhono okuqeqesha: Ulwazi lwedlulelo lokuziphatha kokwakhiwa kanye nokwakhiwa kwamathiphu ethangini, ithangini elifakwe ngamandla, insimbi, kanye nezakhiwo ezakhiwe ngobuchwepheshe obusekelwe ngamathiphu. Ulwazi ngamakhodi obunjiniyela asetuswa, izinkomba zobunjiniyela, izinkomba zokwakhiwa kanye nezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi konke kusebenza ngendlela. Ukuqonda izimo zegeotechnical, izisekelo, amanzi, izinto ezenza amanzi ahambe, ukuphuma kwamanzi kanye nezindlela ezingase zithinte ukuqiniseka kwakho. Amandla okubuka, okuhlolayo, okuhlola ukwehluleka, okulinganisa ukusala kwesikhathi kanye nokuhlela ukugcinwa kokwakhiwa. Ulwazi ngokuthengisa, ukuletha insimbi yomsebenzi, ukuvikeleka komzimba, izidingo zokwakhiwa kanye nezinkinga ezithinta abasebenzi bokwakha. Ukwazi imithetho exhunyiwe, amakhodi okusebenza, kanye namazinga obuchwepheshe (okwesibonelo, SANS, TMH, COLTO, kanye nama-SANRAL guidelines). Amandla okulawula amabhajethi, ukushintsha izinto, izinkingo, ukugunyazwa kwamakhredithi nezinkinga eziphathelene nezinkulumo. Amandla aqinisekile okuhlaziya, okubhala umbiko, okuxhumana, okuxoxa kanye nokuphathwa kwabantu. Amandla okwenza izinqumo zobunjiniyela ngokuzimele. Amandla obuholi kanye nokuphathwa kweqembu ukuze athuthukise amaqembu akhiqiza okuhle.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza izinsizakalo zobunjiniyela ezikhethekile kanye nobuholi obunobuchwepheshe ekuhloleni, ukwenza izinhlelo, ukwakhiwa, okokulawula ukwakhiwa, ukubuka, ukulungisa futhi ukugcina i-culverts, amabhuloho nezakhiwo. Qinisekisa ukuthi insimbi yomsebenzi ikhuselekile, isebenza kahle, ihlala isikhathi eside futhi inikeza inani elihle lemalaziwo yonke leminyaka yayo yokusebenza.

'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om na projekterreine te reis, insluitend afgeleë plekke. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Soliede kennis van ingenieursontwerp, projekondersoek en kontrakbestuur in die konteks van infrastruktuur- en PMU-funksies, Tegniese bevoegdheid in die opstel van spesifikasies, tegniese verslae en projekdokumentasie, Ervaring in projekt- en kontrakbestuur, insluitend risiko-, gehalte- en veiligheidsbestuur, Begrip van regulatoriese nakoming met betrekking tot openbare sektor-infrastruktuurprojekte, Vermoë om ingenieursprojekte te beplan, te implementeer en te monitor om departementele doelwitte te bereik, Uitstekende probleemoplossings-, analitiese en besluitnemingsvaardighede, Sterk kommunikasie- en verslagskryfvaardighede, Rekenaarvaardigheid, insluitend die gebruik van relevante ingenieurs- en projekbestuursagteware.
af.duties: Beplan, ontwerp en monitor ingenieurswerk aan infrastruktuurprojekte in ooreenstemming met departement- en PMU-standaarde, Stel spesifikasies, tegniese verslae en projekdokumentasie op in ooreenstemming met statutêre en departementele vereistes, Bestuur en hou toezig oor kontrakte om optimale lewering van infrastruktuurprogramme en nakoming van kontrakvoorwaardes te verseker, Identifiseer, evalueer en bestuur risiko's wat met ingenieursprojekte gepaard gaan, Monitor en verseker gehalte, veiligheid en regulatoriese nakoming deur alle projekfases heen, Verskaf tegniese leiding en ondersteuning binne die PMU en aan belanghebbendes soos vereis.

zu.title: Injiniya Yokukhiqiza Izinga A: PMU
zu.summary: Injiniya Yokukhiqiza Izinga A ngaphakathi kwe-Mpumalanga Public Works PMU, edinga ukubhalisa kwi-ECSA njengenjiniya osecalisweni nobuhle obuncike ekubeni nobunzima bokusebenza iminyaka engangaphezulu kwayedwa emuva kokuthola izifundo.
zu.requirements: I-Bachelor of Engineering (BEng) / Bachelor of Science (BSc) / Bachelor of Technology (BTech) eyaziwayo kwi-Civil Engineering. Ukubhalisa ngobungcweti: Ukubhalisa okuyimfuneko ne-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengenjiniya osecalisweni (Pr. Eng). Ubunzima bokusebenza eminyaka engangaphansi kwayedwa (03) emuva kokuthola izifundo zendlela yokwenza. Ubunzima obuhambisanayo ekuphathweni kwephrojekthi nenohlelo, ekwakheni, ekubhaliseni, ekuqaphehleni nasekuphathweni kwesivumelwano kwezindlela, izixhobo ezihamba phezulu nasezakhiweni. Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo nokuthanda ukuhamba kumawebhusayithi wephrojekthi, okuhlanganisa nezindawo ezikude. Ulwazi, Amakhono Namandla Okwenza Izinto: Ulwazi olujulile ngokuklanywa kobuchwepheshe, ukuphenya iphrojekthi, nokuphathwa kwasivumelwano ngaphakathi kwesimo sezakhiwo nemisebenzi ye-PMU. Amakhono obuchwepheshe ekulungiseni izinto ezichaziwe, emibhalweni yobuchwepheshe, nasezixukukeni zephrojekthi. Ubunzima ekuphathweni kwephrojekthi nesesivumelwano, okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwezingozi, ikhwalithi, nokuphathwa kokuhamba kahle. Ukuqonda ngokuhambisana nemithetho ehlobene nezakhiwo zomphakathi. Ikono lokucubungula, ukuqaliswa, kanye nokuqapha iimphrojekthi zezobuchwepheshe ukufeza izinhloso zomnyango. Amakhono aphambili okuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlaziya, kanye nokwenza izinqumo. Amakhono anamandla ekuxhumeni nasekubhaleni imibhalo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngakomakhalekhukhwini, okuhlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo ezihlobene nobuchwepheshe bokwenza nokuphathwa kweephrojekthi.
zu.duties: Cubungula, klanya, futhi uqaphele imisebenzi yezobuchwepheshe kumaphrojekthi wezakhiwo ahambisana nemigidingo yomnyango kanye ne-PMU. Lungiselela izinto ezichaziwe, imibhalo yobuchwepheshe, nezixukukeni zephrojekthi ngokuhambisana nemithetho nezidingo zomnyango. Phatha futhi ulawule izivumelwano ukuze kuqiniseke ukulethwa okuhamba kahle kwenkqubo yezenzakalo kanye nokuhambisana nemigidingo yesivumelwano. Hlaba, hlole, futhi uphathe izingozi ezingase zihlotshaniswa nemiphrojekthi yezobuchwepheshe. Qapha futhi uqiniseke ukuthi kukhona ikhwalithi, ukuphepha, nokuhambisana nemithetho kulo lonke amanqamu omsebenzi. Nikeza imiqondo yobuchwepheshe kanye nokuweseka ngaphakathi kwi-PMU nakubantu abahlobene njengoba kudingeka.

xh.title: Injiniya Yokuvelisa Inqanaba A: PMU
xh.summary: Injiniya Yokuvelisa Inqanaba A ngaphakathi kwi-PMU yaseBala loMsebenzi kaRhulumente waseMpumalanga, efuna ukubhalisa kwi-ECSA njengenjiniya yobungcali nobugcisa obungazingenwa naluphi na uphando, kwaye kube n'amava okungenwa kwangaphambili emsebenzini wokwenza iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezingathathi khawulela kwaye zibe lula ukuziphilisa.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-Bachelor of Engineering (BEng) / Bachelor of Science (BSc) / Bachelor of Technology (BTech) eNjinini yolwakhiwo esemthethweni. Ukubhalisa njengenjiniya yobungcali nobugcisa obungazingenwa naluphi na uphando: Kuyimfuneko ukubhalisa kwi-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengenjiniya yobungcali (Pr. Eng). Amava angazizi ngaphantsi kwamathathu (03) emisebenzini yamava angazizi ngaphambili, ngexesha elifunekayo ekuphumeleleni kwesidanga sam. Amava afanelekileyo ekulawulweni kwamaprojekthi, ekwakhiweni iinkqubo, ekwakhiweni kwakho nasekubeni ngumlawuli wamagama eendawo, iindonga kunye neendawo eziluhlaza. Ilayisensi yokushitya esemthethweni nokuzimisela ukutya iindlela eziya kwizithuba zokulawulwa kwamaprojekthi, ngakumbi ezindaweni ezingabikho. Ulwazi, Ulwazi ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo, kunye namava amakhulu ekwenzeni iinkqubo ngendlela ezakha uluntu nakwi-PMU: Ulwazi ngokubakho kwamava amakhulu ekuyini i-engineering design, nokuphonononga amaprojekthi, kunye nokuba ngumlawuli wamagama, kukwaye ulwazi nge-PMU, amava angangenwa naluphi na uphando ekulawulweni kwamaprojekthi kunye neqela lamagama, ulwazi olwenziweyo lweempawu, amagama eziNjinithi nabalinganiswa bamaprojekthi, ulwazi ngeendlela zokusebenza nokuseta amaxhoba eempawu zesixhobo samaprojekthi kwilizwe, amava amakhulu ekulawulweni kwamaprojekthi kunye namagama.
xh.duties: Cwangcisa, yakha, kwaye ulawule imisebenzi yeNjinithi kumaprojekthi wolwakhiwo ngokwemilinganiselo yesebe kunye ne-PMU, ukulungisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo, amagama eNjinithi, kunye namaxwebhu aprojekthi ngokwemfuno yokuvelisa amagama, ulawule kwaye ulawule amagama ukuqinisekisa ukuziphatha okupheleleyo kweziNjinithi nokuziphatha okulandelayo kwesivumelwano sokwenza olusemthethweni, qaphela, linganisa kwaye ulawule ingozi ebandakanya amaprojekthi eNjinithi, linganisa kwaye uqinisekise ukuziphatha okupheleleyo kolwakhiwo, ukhuseleko, kwaye ulawule ukuhlala kuqinisekisile ukuphumelela kwemithetho kumaprojekthi onke, nikeza ngolwazi ngokutsha kweNjinithi kunye nencedo ngaphakathi kwi-PMU nakumazu ahlukeneyo ngokwemfuneko.

jobs.title: Engineer Production Grade a (CIVIL) Building Maintenance
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Transport
jobs.summary: Civil engineer needed to provide professional maintenance support for government buildings, including asset management planning and strategy implementation.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate plus NQF Level 7 in Bsc or BEng Degree Civil Engineering (minimum of 3 year Degree as recognised by SAQA). Compulsory Registration with South African Council for the Engineer Profession (ECSA) as a Professional: Engineer/ Technologist. Valid drivers’ licence and proficiency in computer applications are essential. A relevant work experience as an Engineer, with at least 2 years being post-registration. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: Sound knowledge of the planning, implementation, and management of building maintenance and refurbishment projects in the public sector. Familiarity with relevant legislation, policies, and regulations including the PFMA, GIAMA, CIDB Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, and National Building Regulations. Experience in contract documentation, procurement processes, and administration (JBCC, GCC, or similar). Understanding of building condition assessments, life cycle costing, and facilities maintenance management systems. Good knowledge of engineering and maintenance planning software (e.g., Civil Designer, Prokon, AutoCAD). Advanced proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and project tracking tools. Strong written and verbal communication, negotiation, planning, and organisational skills. Ability to manage contractors and service providers on site and coordinate multiple maintenance teams.
jobs.duties: Provide professional engineering support for the delivery of planned, routine, and emergency maintenance of government buildings and facilities. Support the development, implementation, and review of the Comprehensive Asset Management Plan (CAMP) and maintenance strategies aligned to GIAMA and departmental priorities. Develop and monitor annual maintenance plans and budgets, including day-to-day, preventative, and emergency maintenance. Coordinate the procurement and performance management of framework contracts for general maintenance and specialist services in collaboration with Supply Chain Management. Oversee maintenance activities across district offices, ensuring compliance with specifications, standards, and quality assurance protocols. Manage and report on maintenance backlogs, call centre requests, and resolution of infrastructure faults logged by users. Conduct technical evaluations, building condition assessments, and implement corrective actions where required. Prepare technical and performance reports, assist in budgeting processes, and contribute to infrastructure reporting to oversight bodies

af.title: Ingenieur Produksie Graad a (SIVIEL) Gebouonderhoud
af.summary: Siviele ingenieur benodig om professionele onderhoudsteun vir regeringsgeboue te verskaf, insluitend batesbestuurbeplanning en strategie-implementering.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat plus NQF-vlak 7 in BSc- of BEng-graad in Siviele Ingenieurswese (minimum van 3-jarige graad soos deur SAQA erken). Verpligte registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir die Ingenieursprofessie (ECSA) as 'n Professionele: Ingenieur/Tegnoloog. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie en vaardigheid in rekenaartoepassings is noodsaaklik. Relevante werkservaring as 'n Ingenieur, met ten minste 2 jaar wat na registrasie is. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Deglike kennis van die beplanning, implementering en bestuur van gebouonderhoud en opknappingsprojekte in die openbare sektor. Bekendheid met relevante wetgewing, beleide en regulasies, insluitend die PFMA, GIAMA, CIDB-wet, Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid, en Nasionale Gebouregulasies. Ervaring in kontrakdokumentasie, verkrygingsprosesse en administrasie (JBCC, GCC of soortgelyk). Begrip van geboutoestandassesserings, lewensikluskosteberekening en fasiliteiteonderhoudbestuurstelsels. Goeie kennis van ingenieurs- en onderhoudsbeplanningsagteware (bv. Civil Designer, Prokon, AutoCAD). Gevorderde vaardigheid in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) en projekspoorsgewingsnutsgoed. Ster skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie-, onderhandelings-, beplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede. Vermoë om kontrakteurs en diensverskaffers op die terrein te bestuur en veelvuldige onderhoudspane te koördineer.
af.duties: Verskaf professionele ingenieursteun vir die lewering van beplande, roetine- en noodonderhoud van regeringsgeboue en -fasiliteite. Ondersteun die ontwikkeling, implementering en hersiening van die Omvattende Batesbestuurplan (CAMP) en onderhoudstrategieë in ooreenstemming met GIAMA en departementele prioriteite. Ontwikkel en monitor jaarlikse onderhoudsplanne en -begrotings, insluitend daaglikse, voorkomende en noodonderhoud. Koördineer die verkryging en prestasiebestuur van raamwerkkontrakte vir algemene onderhoud en spialisdiens in samewerking met Toevoerkettingbestuur. Hou toesig oor onderhoudsaktiwiteite by distrikkantore, en verseker nakoming van spesifikasies, standaarde en gehalteversekeringsprotokolle. Bestuur en rapporteer oor onderhoudsagterstande, oproepsentrumversoeke en die oplossing van infrastruktuurfoute wat deur gebruikers aangeteken is. Voer tegniese evaluerings en geboutoestandassesserings uit en implementeer korrigerende maatreëls waar nodig. Berei tegniese en prestasieverslae voor, help met begrotingsprosesse en dra by tot infrastruktuurverslagdoening aan toesigliggame

zu.title: InjiniyezokuQamba Izinga a (CIVIL) Ukugcina Izakhiwo
zu.summary: Kudingeka injiniye yabantu menyuka ukunikeza inkxaso yobungcweti ekugcineni izakhiwo zahulumeni, kuhlanganise ukulungelelisa ukuphathwa kwamafa kanye nokuphumeza izindlela.
zu.requirements: Isitifikathi se-Grade 12 kahle nenqanaba le-NQF Level 7 kumasters we-Bsc noma i-BEng Degree ku-Civil Engineering (izinga le-degree elinganiselwa kuminyaka emithathu njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA). Ukubhalisa ngokuphoqele kwi-South African Council for the Engineer Profession (ECSA) njengengcweti: Injiniye/Injiniyetheknoloji. Ilaysensi yokuqasha evumelekile kakhulu kanye nokuzazi ukusebenzisa amasinhlelokusebenza ekhompyutha ziyisidingo esibalulekile. Isipiliyoni sokusebenza esifanele njengenjiniye, okungenani okweminyaka engu-2 kusuke kubhalisile. Ukwazi, Amakhono namandla okwenza: Ulwazi oluhlakaniphile lokulungelela, ukuphumeza, nokuphatha amaphrojekthi okugcina kanye nokuqamba kabusha izakhiwo kumkhakha kahulumeni. Ukuqonda iziqu zomthetho ezifanele, izinqubomgomo, namashe wokuhamba kahle kuhlanganise i-PFMA, i-GIAMA, umthetho we-CIDB, umthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act, kanye namashe wakwa-National Building Regulations. Isipiliyoni emafayeleni esivumelwano, inqubo yomthetho wokuqasha, kanye nokuqasha (i-JBCC, i-GCC, noma okufanayo). Ukuqonda isiqikili sokuhlola isimo sezakhiwo, ukubala ikusasa lezindleko, kanye namasistimu okuphatha ukugcinwa kwamakhasithi. Ulwazi oluhle kakhulu ngamasinhlelokusebenza okulungelela kwezokunjinya kanye nokugcina (isb, i-Civil Designer, i-Prokon, i-AutoCAD). Ukuzazi okusezingeni eliphezulu kwi-MS Office (i-Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint) kanye namathuluzi okulandela iphrojekthi. Amakhono amahle okubhala nokuKhuluma, ukuxoxa, ukulungelela, nokuhlela. Ikono lokuphatha abahlinzeki bemisebenzi kanye nabanikeli besevisi endaweni yokusebenza kanye nokuqondanisa amaqembu amaningi okugcina izakhiwo.
zu.duties: Yinika inkxaso yobunjinia obungcweti ekulethweni kwesidingo esilungelwe, njalo, kanye nokugcina okuphuthumayo izakhiwo nezinto zokusebenza zahulumeni. Xhasa ukwakhiwa, ukuphumeza, kanye nokucubungula iComprehensive Asset Management Plan (CAMP) kanye nezindlela zokugcina ezihambisana ne-GIAMA kanye nezinto eziyinhloko komnyango. Lakela kanye nokuqaphela iplani yomnyaka yasekhaya yokugcina kanye nezibhodo, kuhlanganise ukugcina kwansuku zonke, ngokuzivikela, kanye nokugcina okuphuthumayo. Qondanisa inqubo yokuthenga nokuphatha ukusebenza kwamasivumelwano emigwaqo mayelana nokugcina okuvamile kanye nesevisi yezingcweti ngokusebenzisana ne-Supply Chain Management. Qaphela imisebenzi yokugcina kulo lonke amahhovisiwesifunda, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nemininingwane, amazinga, kanye nemithetho yokulolonga izinga lokuhamba kahle. Phatha kanye nokubika ngokuqhubeka kokugcina, izicelo zenanixeba, kanye nokulungisa amaphutha ezinto ezibhaliswe abasebenzisi. Yenza izivivinyo zobuchwepheshe, ukuhlolwa kwezimo zokwakhiwa, futhi uphumeze izenzo zokulungisa lapho kudingeka khona. Lungathela umbiko wobuchwepheshe kanye nokuqhuba kahle, usize inqubo yokuqamba izibhodo, kanye nokufaka izigqabo ezindaweni ezithinta izindawo zokuxhumana mayelana nobuchwepheshe bakulawulo

xh.title: Injiniyezulu Yenkqubo YeNqanaba a (CIVIL) Ulondolozo Lwezakhiwo
xh.summary: Kufuneka injiniyezulu civil ukunika inkxaso yemisebenzi yolondolozo lwezakhiwo zorhulumente, kuquka uqwalaselo lolawulo lwempahla nokuphunyezwa kwenkqubo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 negunya leNQF Level 7 kwiBsc okanye iBEng Degree Civil Engineering (idigri yeminyaka e3 ubuncinane njengoko ivunywe yiSAQA). Ukuqatshelwa ngokunyanzelekisayo kwiSouth African Council for the Engineer Profession (ECSA) njengomsebenzi ogqithisileyo: Injiniyezulu/Injiniyezobuchwepheshe. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni nokuqonda ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zekhompyutha zinto ezingaqwenengwa. Amava ahambelanayo okusebenza njengenjiniyezulu, kubandakonya unyaka bengaphezulu kwe2 esimva sokuba nguye oqatshiwe. Ulwazi, Amakhono namandla: Ulwazi oluzo lwemigaqo yokucwangcisa, ukuphumeza, nokulawula iiprojekthi zolondolozo nokuqwalasela kabusha izakhiwo kwicandelo likarhulumente. Ukuqonda emthethweni, iinkqubo, namagunya ahambelanayo kuquka iPFMA, iGIAMA, iCIDB Act, iOccupational Health and Safety Act, kunye neNational Building Regulations. Amava emixholweni yeenkonzo, iinkqubo zokuthenga, nolawulo (iJBCC, iGCC, okanye ezifanayo). Ukuqonda ukqwalaselo lwemimeko yezakhiwo, iindleko zexesha lokuphila, kunye nenkqubo yolawulo lolondolazo lwesikhululo. Ulwazi olululo kwesoftware yokucwangcisa injiniyohlaziyo nolondolozo (umz., Civil Designer, Prokon, AutoCAD). Ukuqonda ngokuphezulu kwi-MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) nezixhobo zoku landela iiprojekthi. Amakhono amandla okubhala nokuqhathanisa ngomlomo, ukuxoxisana, ukucwangcisa, nokuqwalasela. Ulawulo lokulawula abathengisi bankonzo nabahanisi kwisiza nokuhambelanisa iqela lolondolozo.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yemisebenzi yolondolozo yezakhiwo nezikhululo zorhulumente. Yixa inkxaso kwinkqubo, ukuphumeza, nokuqwalasela iComprehensive Asset Management Plan (CAMP) nemiyinge yolondolozo ehambelana neGIAMA neenkulungqane zesebe. Qamba ulandele iinkqubo zonyaka zolondolozo nezemali, kuquka nangemini yonke, ngokuthintela, nangexesha lokubakho. Hlanganisa inkqubo yokuthenga nolawulo lokuqhutywa kweenkonzo zejhiji yethangi jikelele nolondolazo lweenkonzo ezingagqithiswa ngokubambisana noLawulo lwesikrini samathumba. Qwalasela imisebenzi yolondolazo kuziko olulinganiselwe, kuqinisekisa ukuthobela imigaqo, imilinganiso, nolawulo lwesigqibo. Lawula kwaye uchaze ngolondolazo olungalunganga, izicelo zekholi centre, kwaye ulungise imiba yonakaliswe ibhalwe ngumsebenzisi. Qwalasela isigqibo samava ezingundoqo, ukqwalaselo ngokubakho kwemimeko yezakhiwo, ukuphumeza izigqibo ezilungisayo apho kuyimfuneko. Lungisa iinkcukacha zemisebenzi kwaye uxamile inkqubo yokwenza izigqibo zolondolazo lweenkonzo kwii-oversight bodies.

jobs.title: Architect Production Grade a
jobs.department: Department of Public Works, Roads and Transport
jobs.summary: The Department of Public Works, Roads and Transport seeks a registered Professional Architect at Head Office in Mpumalanga to provide cost management and infrastructure project services.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 plus BTech Architecture/ Bachelor of Architectural Studies / Bachelor of Architecture / Master of Architecture Professional at the NQF level 7 (minimum 3 year Degree as recognised by SAQA). Registration as a Professional Architect with the South African Council for the Architectural Profession (SACAP) in terms of the Architectural Profession Act, 2000 (Act No. 4 of 2000) is compulsory. A minimum of 5 years work experience as an Architect, of which 3 years should be post professional registration. A valid driver’s licence. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: Sound knowledge of construction legislation, regulations, and frameworks applicable in the public sector, including the PFMA, Treasury Regulations, CIDB Act, GIAMA, Construction Regulations, and National Building Regulations. Proficiency in quantity surveying software such as WinQS, as well as AutoCAD, MS Project, and Microsoft Office Suite. In depth knowledge of cost planning, contract administration (JBCC, NEC, GCC), building cost norms, and lifecycle costing. Analytical, planning, problem-solving, and report-writing skills. Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills. Ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and multiple infrastructure projects simultaneously.

Ensure financial control, value engineering, and cost optimisation in the delivery of infrastructure projects. Evaluate, appoint, and monitor the performance of consultants and contractors in compliance with departmental policies. Manage the implementation and monitoring of construction contracts, including certification of payments and resolution of contractual claims. Conduct feasibility studies, develop cost estimates, and maintain accurate project budgets and cash flows. Undertake research and implement new methods, technologies, and sustainable solutions in infrastructure delivery. Ensure alignment with the Infrastructure Delivery Management System (IDMS), Infrastructure Procurement and Delivery Management (IPDM) toolkit, and relevant prescripts. Provide technical support in the preparation of tender documentation, bid evaluations, and adjudication processes

Ulwazi olujulile mayelana nokuhlela izindleko, ukuphathwa kwezivumelwano (i-JBCC, NEC, GCC), izinga lezindleko zokwakha, kanye nokuqokomisa izindleko kuso sonke isikhathi. Ikhono lokuphatha amaqembu ahlukene kanti futhi nawo wonke amaphrojekthi ezakhiwo ngasikhathi sinye.
zu.duties: Nikeza izinsiza zobuchwepheshe zokuqasha izingidi kanye nokuphathwa kwezindleko eminyangweni yabathengi nemitshatweni yezifundazwe. Qinisekisa ukulawula izimali, ubuchwepheshe bokuthola inani, kanye nokulungiselela izindleko ekulethweni kwamaphrojekthi ezakhiwo. Hlola, qamba, futhi ulawule ukusebenza kwabakushiwo nabaqashwayo ngokuhambisana namapolisi omnyango. Phatha ukuqashwa nokulandwa kwemithetho yezivumelwano zokwakha, okuhlanganisa ukufakazela izimali ezikhokhwayo kanye nokuxazulula izigwebo zezivumelwano. Yenza izifundo zokwazi ukuzenzakalela, huhlela izibalo sezindleko, futhi zigcinimbe izibalo eziqondile zamaphrojekthi nezinkomba zokuhamba kwemali. Yeziphenyo futhi usebenzise izindlela ezintsha, amathuluzi amasha, kanye nezixazululi ezihlala isikhathi eside ekulethweni kwezakhiwo. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana ne-Infrastructure Delivery Management System (IDMS), i-Infrastructure Procurement and Delivery Management (IPDM) toolkit, kanye nemithetho ehlobene. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe ekulungiseni amadokhumenti okuthengiselana, ukuhlola izinkomba, kanye namaphrocessi okwezwa iziphetho

Yenza uphando uze usebenzise iindlela ezintsha, iinkqubo zobugcisa, naniindlela ezingabangeli tshintsho ekunikelweni kumagumbi. af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Batebestuur
af.summary: Hou toesig oor batebestuur, insluitend monitering, vaslegging, verifikasie en voorraadtoekenning vir die Department of Public Works in Ehlanzeni District.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus Nasionale Diploma / Graad in Rekenkunde / Finansiële Bestuur / Openbare Finansies / Koste- en Bestuursrekenkunde (NQF-vlak 6). Minimum 3 jaar se relevante ervaring. zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma / i-Degree ku-Accounting / i-Financial Management / i-Public Finance / i-Cost and Management Accounting (NQF Level 6). Uzothola ubuncwane bangaphezu kuka-3 emsebenzini ohambisana nalokhu. Ulwazi, Amakhono Namandla: Ukubeka abantu ngendlela okufanele benze ngayo; ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo; ukuletha; ukuphathwa kwezibhalo nalwazi; ukuxazulula izinkinga; ukuxhumana; ukubhalwa kwezibiko, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.

Siza ekwakheni izinqubomgomo nemihlahambili yokuphathwa kwempahla. Beka abasebenzi ngendlela okufanele ukuze kuqiniseke ukuphathwa okuhle kwempahla ezhanywayo. Lalela indlela okuchithwa ngayo imali kuzo zonke izigaba. Xhumana nabakhiqizi bezimpahla. Hlanganisa futhi ulinganise izibiko ezifanele.

xh.title: Assistant Director: Asset Management
xh.summary: Lawula ulawulo lwempahla, kuquku monitara, ukuqokelela, ukuqinisekisa nokuqokelelwa kwesitokhwe kwiNgcenye Public Works ehlobo lase Ehlanzeni District.

Lawula abasebenzi ukuze kuqiniseke ulawulo oluhle lwempahla eshukumiswayo. Lilinde iindlela zokusebenzisa imali kuzo zonke iindawo. Xoxa nabathengisi bezinto. af.summary: Eiendomsinspekteur word in Bohlabela Distrik benodig om nakomingsinspeksies op provinsiale eiendomme uit te voer, tariefskedules te verifieer, en staatsbesit residensiële akkommodasie toe te ken.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus Nasionale Diploma (NQF vlak 6) in Real Estate, Property Studies/Property Valuation/Real Estate/Facilities Management. Ten minste drie jaar se relevante ervaring. Fasiliteer die invordering van inkomste op maandelikse basis uit die verhuring van staatsbesit eiendomme. Berei fakture en rekeningstate voor en versprei dit aan huurders. zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) ku-Real Estate, Property Studies/Property Valuation/Real Estate/Facilities Management. Waba indawo yokuhlala yomphakathi ngokohlubo lolindelayo, ukulawula amakhompyutha amanzi, ukukhanya nezinkolezi zesewula amasipala. Sithuthukise ukuqoqa imali engenayo nsuku zonkenye ngenyanga kusukela ekwabeni impahla yomphakathi. Lungiselela futhi wqabanise izipesheli nezinkomba zamakhompyutha kubahliki. Lungiselela futhi ulawule amakhompyutha aba tikidi. Qinisekisa impahla enezayo esifundazweni. Nikeza izinsizakalo ezibhalwe phansi.

Lungiselela ulungelelaniso lwe-akhawunti yekhadi labatshoyo imali. Qinisekisa iimpahla ezinikiweyo ngurhulumente yephondo. Yenza iinkonzo zolawulo.

zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 kahle nesisetshenziswa sokuvivinya kobugcweti kanye nenzuzo yokuba ngumncedisi wesikhobbo. Kumele abafaki babenomhlatshalo futhi bazibekezelele ukusebenza ngemuva kwesikhathi nokuma njengabasindisi, ulwazi, amakhono namandla okwenza umsebenzi okubalwa kuwo inhlangano: ulwazi lokuhlola ngobuchwepheshe, izinhlelo zesijobelelo esibhekise kobuchwepheshe, ulwazi mayelana nokuhambisana nomthetho. Isixazululi sezinkinga nokuwahola, ukwenza izinqumo, ukuhlela nokuhlelabusa, amakhono okuzwa nokuxhumana, nobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Abaphakeli kumele bazibekezelele ukusebenza ngaphansi kwesimo esinzima.

xh.title: Umsebenzi wokuQamba izinto weQela A: Peinta
xh.summary: Isebe loMisebenzi kaLuntu, iindlela noThutho lifuna uPeinta wokuQamba izinto weQela A e Acornhoek ukuba enza izibilongwelo, iindlela zokuqwalasela, uqiniseko lwekhwalithi nokubika.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seQela le-12 kananj nesatifikethi esifanelekileyo soVavanyo lwensebenzi kananj nolwazi loMsizi wensebenzi. Abafaki-magaba kufunekeba bafuna kwaye bazimisele ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo nokumilisela Ulwazi, Amandla namakhono obuChwepheshe bokuhlalutya, Izicelo zobuChwepheshe ezidityaniswe ngekhompyutha, Ulwazi ngokuThobela umthetho kwiNgxelo zobuChwepheshe. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuHlalutya,ukuThatha iziGqibo,uCoco nokuMisela, Amandla okuMamela nokuThetha, namakhonzelo oluntu alungileyo. Abafaki-magaba kufuneka bazimisele ukusebenza ngcindezelo.
xh.duties: Yenza umsebenzi wokuqamba izinto, izibilongwelo, iindlela zokuqwalasela, uqiniseko lwekhwalithi, ukuthobela umthethi nokubika.

jobs.title: Artisan Production Grade A: Carpenter

af.title: Ambagsman Produksie Graad A: Timmerman
af.summary: Timmerman gesoek vir ambagsman-produktsiewerk, herstelwerk, inspeksies en gehaltesversekering by die Department of Public Works in Mpumalanga, waar 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n ambagstoetskwalifikasie vereis word.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat plus toepaslike ambagstoetsertifikaat plus ervaring as 'n ambagsman-assistent. Die kandidate moet 'n wees en gewillig wees om oortyd en wagdiens te werk. Kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Tegniese analisekennis, rekenaargesteunde tegniese toepassings, kennis van wetlike nakoming tegniese verslae. Probleemoplossing en analise, besluitneming, beplanning en organisering, luister- en kommunikasievaardighede, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings. Kandidate moet gewillig wees om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Voer ambagsman-produktsiewerk, herstelwerk, inspeksies, gehaltesversekering, wetlike nakoming en verslagdoening uit.

zu.title: Isenklasi Sokukhiqiza Izinga A: Umkhandi Wezinkuni
zu.summary: Kufunwa umkhandi wezinkuni osenyenzweni sokukhiqiza izenklasi, ukulungisa, ukuhlola nokuqinisekisa izinga emnyangweni wezezeMisebenzi Zikahulumeni eMpumalanga, okudinga izifundo zeThangi 12 nesitifiketi sokuhlola ubuchwepheshe.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seThangi 12 kakulesi nesitifiketi sokuhlola ubuchwepheshe esifanelekile nokuhlangana namava okuba ngumncedi webuchwepheshe. Abafaka izeluleko kufanele babe nethando lokusebenza ngesikhathi esingejwayelekile nasikhundleni sokulindela. Ulwazi, Amandla Namakhono Obuchwepheshe: Ulwazi lokuhlola ubuchwepheshe ngokwenza, izinhlelo zokusiza ekubhaleni ezikhaleni, ulwazi lokuqinisekisa izincwadi ezithilengenhla. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nohlolo, Ukwenza izinqumo, ukucubungula nokuqamba, amandla okuzwa ukhuluma nokuqondana ngokuvumelana, ukuhlobana kahle nabantu. Abafaka izeluleko kufanele bazithobe ukusebenza phansi kwezinsuku ezinengcindezeli.
zu.duties: Ukwenza umsebenzi wokukhiqiza izenklasi, ukulungisa, ukuhlola, ukuqinisekisa izinga, ukuqinisekisa ukuziphendulela ngokomthetho nokubika.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wokukhiqiza Wonobumba Inqanaba A: Umqambibezinkuni
xh.summary: Kufunwa umqambibezinkuni kumisebenzi yokukhiqiza yonobumba, izilungiso, ukuhlola nokuchenula ubuhle kwisebe lezeMisebenzi eZidlangaleni eMpumalanga, kufuneka ifakwe isatifikethi seGredy 12 nesitifikethi sovavayo webhakade.

Omganyeli kufuneka abe nokulungelelana ukusebenza ngaphezu kwexesha eliqabiweyo nokulungelelana ukulalela Ulwazi, Amakhono namakhono obuchwepheshe: Ulwazi lohlolo lobuchwepheshe, izicelo zobuchwepheshe ezixhaswa yikhompyutha, ulwazi ngemigaqo yomthetho Iingxelo zobuchwepheshe. Ukuxazula iingxaki nokuqonda, ukwenza izigqibo, ukucwangcisa nokuqamba, amakhono okulalela noku communicada, ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Omganyeli kufuneka alungelelana ukusebenza ngaphezulu komlinganiselo.
xh.duties: Ukuze kwenzike umsebenzi wokukhiqiza wonobumba, izilungiso, ukuhlola, ukuqinisekisa ubuhle, ukuthobela umthetho nokubika.

af.title: Ambagsman Produksie Graad A: Loodgieter
af.summary: Loodgieter benodig by Nkangala Distrik vir loodgieteronderhoud en herstel van departementinfrastruktuur, waarvoor Graad 12 en 'n Vaktoetssertifikaat vereis word.

Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Kennis van wetgewende voorskrifte wat die Staatsdiens regeer, OHS; gehaltebeheer; rekordhouding, rekenaarvaardigheid, mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Voer loodgieteronderhoud van departementinfrastruktuur uit en bestuur dit. Vervaardig voorwerpe met materiaal en toerusting volgens die werkspecificasie en erkende standaarde. Kwaliteitsversekering van produksievoorwerpe. Inspekteer toerusting en fasiliteite vir tegniese foute. Herstel toerusting en fasiliteite volgens standaarde. Onderhou toerusting en fasiliteite volgens skedules. Stel verslae op en dien dit in. Verskaf insette tot die operasionele plan. Hou en onderhou werksrekords en bestuur en begelei personeel.

zu.title: I-Artisan Production Grade A: Umpayiphetha
zu.summary: Umpayiphetha odingekwa esigabeni iNkangala District ukugcina nokulungisa izimpahla zomnyango, kudingwa ibhali le-Grade 12 nesitifiketi se-Trade Test.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye nesitifiketi se-Trade Test esifanele kanye nokuhlola njengo-Tradesman Aid. Abafaki imibhalo kufanele babe nokuthanda ukusebenza amahora amaningi futhi babe sebungeni lokwazi izindlela ezaziwayo, amakhono kanye namandla okwenza umsebenzi: Ulwazi ngemithetho elawula konkeza komphakathi, i-OHS; ukulawula izinga; ukugcina amarekhodi, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, amakhano okukhuluma nokubhala.
zu.duties: Ukwenza nokuphatha ukugcwalwa kwezimpahla zomnyango ngumpayiphetha. Ukukhiqiza izinto ngezinsiza namathuluzi ngokusho imiyalelo yomsebenzi nezinhlelo ezamukelekile. Ukulolonga izinga lezinto ezenziwe. Ukukhola izinsiza namathuluzi ukubona iziphazamiso. Ukulungisa izinsiza namathuluzi ngokusho izinhlelo ezamukelekile. Ukukhotha izinsiza namathuluzi ngokuhlelela. Ukulungisa nokuhambisa izibiko. Ukunikela imibiko ohlelweni lokusebenza. Ukugcina ukulandelwa komsebenzi nokuhlola ukuyala abasebenzi.

xh.title: Umsebenzi wokuQamba izinto ngesandla ukukuQwalasela ukukhiqiza inqanaba A: Umplumberi
xh.summary: Kufuneka umplumberi kwiNgingu kwiNgingu yeSithili iNkangala wokugcina nokulungisa izinxulumelelane zamaplumbi kwisebe leziseko-zakhiwo, kwayo kufuneka abe neGrade 12 kunye nesatifikethi seVivo loMzobo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 kwakunye nesatifikethi esifanelekileyo seVivo loMzobo kwakunye namava njengakwiMncedi woMsebenzisi wokuQamba izinto ngesandla. Ikhandidethi kufuneka ibe nakholo ngokusebenza iiyure ezongezelelekileyo kunye nokulungele ukumisela uluhlu lokulindileyo ulwazi, amakhono namandla okwenza umsebenzi: Ulwazi ngemigca yesigaba egcwalisa izinto ngomthetho elawula Inkonzo kaWonke-wonke, i-OHS; ulawulo lwemilinganiselo; ukugcina iirekhodi, ukusebenza ngekhompyutha, amakhono okuthetha nabhalayo.
xh.duties: Zenza ulawulo lwegcino lamaplumbi kwisebe leziseko-zakhiwo. Dala izinto ngesixhobo nempahla ngokwezicwangciso zomsebenzi nangokwemigangatho eqatywayo. Qinisekisa umgangatho wezinto ezenziwayo. Hlola isixhobo neendawo zokusebenza ukujonga iziphene ngezobunini. Lungisa isixhobo nendawo ngokwemigangatho phatha ngokulungiselela isixhobo nendawo ngokwesihlwele. Hlaza ulwazi kwaye uze unikeze iingxelo. Nikela ngezinto kwingcaca yesicwangciso somsebenzi. Gcina ulwazi olumandla logcino lwemisebenzi, ulawule kwaye ulungise iziqu zabasebenzi.

af.summary: Baksteenmaker benodig om Regeringsgeboue regdeur Nkangala-distrik te onderhou en te bou, wat Grade 12 en 'n handelstoetssertifikaat vereis.

zu.summary: Kudingeka umakhi wezitini ozogcina futhi akhe izakhiwo zahulumathi kulo lonke i-Nkangala District, kudingeka abe ne-Grade 12 nesitifiketi sokuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 kahle nesitifiketi sokuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe esifanele nahuba ohambile njengomsizi womuntu osebenza ngobuchwepheshe. Abafaki izicelo kufanele babe nakube belungele ukusebenza ngamahora adlule kweyansuku nasekumilelweni. Ulwazi, Amakhono namandla okwenza umsebenzi: Ulwazi ngemithetho elawula Inkonzo Yomphakathi, i-OHS; lawula izinga; ukugcina amarekhodi, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, amakhono okuxoxa nokubhala.
zu.duties: Qoqa inani izinto zokwakha ngaphakathi kwephrojekthi, uzodingeka ukuthi ugcidle wonke Izakhiwo Zahulumathi kuhlanganise nomsebenzi omusha ezakhiweni, kufanele ube nelungelo lokusebenza amahora adlule lapho nasesikhathini kudingeka, futhi uqoqe imibiko yokuqhubekayo ngamaphrojekthi ubuke nomuntu osebenza ngobuchwepheshe kanye naboMfundi. Qhuba umsebenzi wokukhiqiza ngobuchwepheshe, ukulungisa, ukuhlola, ukuqinisekisa izinga, ukuziphendukela emthethweni nokubika.

xh.requirements: Isitifiketi seGrade 12 kunye nesifanelekileyo sesitifiketi sesivivinyo sobuchwepheshe kunye noluhlu lobuchwepheshe njengosizedo weentshukumo zobuchwepheshe. xh.duties: Qamba iindlela zamafa ezixhobo ngalinye ngesiprojekhthi, kuya kufuneka kugcinwe zonke izakhiwo zoRhulumente kuqatshwe neenkqubo ezintsha kumanzi, kufuneka kulungele ukusebenza ixesha elidlulileyo xa kudityaniswa nasiphi na isikhathi, qamba iingxelo zentlaseko kumaproxthi ulawule osizedo webuchwepheshe nakwisidanga sabafundi. Sebenza inkqubo yobuchwepheshe, izilungiso, iimpilo ezichaziweyo, isiqinisekiso sokugqibelela, ulawulo ngokomthetho nokuvela kwamanzi

af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 6 (ekwivalent of hoër); 'n Minimum van 3 jaar relevante ervaring. Bevoegdhede: Werkende kennis en begrip van die volgende: Wetgewing, regulerende raamwerke, beleide en beste praktyke wat betrekking het op die lynfunksies; Inligtingstelsels wat help met die bestuur van kennis en inligting wat op die lynfunksie betrekking het; Projektebestuur; Operasionele bestuurspraktyke; Inkope en aanbiedingsprosesse; Beleidsontwikkeling, en operasionele bestuur, monitering en hersieningsprosesse; Moderne stelsels van bestuur en administrasie; Openbare diensprosedures, prosesse en stelsels; Streek- en plaaslike politieke, ekonomiese en sosiale sake wat 'n impak het op die provinsiale regering van die Western Cape; Konstitusionele, regs- en instituisionele reëlings wat die Suid-Afrikaanse openbare sektor regeer; Openbare finansies, menslike hulpbronne en diskoersbestuursprosesse; Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, ander finansiële beleide, voorskrifte, direktiewe en kollektiewe ooreenkomste; Werking van die Provinsie en die aktiwiteite van sustersdepartemente/verwante funksionele areas; Beleide van die regering van die dag; Arbeidsverhoudingswetgewing en regulasies; Prestasiebestuur in die algemeen. Vaardighede in die volgende: Syferkundigheid; Rekenvaardigheid; Taalvaardighede; Projektebestuur; Rekeningkunde, Finansies en Oudit.
af.duties: Verleen sekretariaatsondersteuning aan die HOD; Verskaf 'n Administratiewe Ondersteuningsdiens; Kommunikasie en Skakeling; Bestuursfunksies.

Ukuguquguquka: Ulwazi lokusebenza nokuyekelela okulandelayo: Izinto zomthetho, izindlela zolawulo, izinqubo nemihlahlandlela egcina kumisebenzi yemigqa; Izingxensimiso yolwazi ezisetshenziswa ekuphatheni ulwazi nolwazi mayelana nomsebenzi wemigqa; Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo; Izindlela zokuphatha imisebenzi yansuku zonke; Izinqubo zokuthenga nokuthengisa; Ukuthuthwa kwezinqongo zombuso, ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi, ukuqapha nokuphinda ubuke izinqubo; Izimiso zangamuva zegunya lokuphatha nolawulo; Izinqubo, izindlela nezimiso zomphath wesifunda; Izindaba ezomthetho wezezwe nendawo, ezozezimali nentlalo ezithinta urhulumente wesiFundazwe se-Western Cape; Izindlela zomthetho, esomthetho nezesikhungo ezilawula umkhakha womphath womphakathi we-Ningizimu Afrika; Izinto ezingamaphayinensi omphakathi, izinsizakusebenza zomuntu nokuphathwa kokungabikho kwentamaisi; Umthetho woMphath weMali Yomphakathi, ukuqajululwa koMnyango weBhange Likazwelonke nesiFundazwe, eminye imitheshwana yamaphayinansi, imiyalo, neminikelo yesivumelwano; Ukusebenza kwesiFundazwe nemisebenzi ngaphansi kwabafundi besifunda noma kwabasekela imisebenzi; Izinqongo zombuso wanamuhla; Umthetho wobudlelwano nabasebenzi; Ukuphathwa kokuhamba emsebenzini. Amandla okulandelayo: Amandla okubala; Amandla okusebenzisa ikhompuyutha; Amandla kolimi; Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo; Ukubala imali, imali neze-Audit.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokusekela okabunikezi ku-HOD; Nikela nesevisi yokusekela ngokomphatho; Unxibelelwano nentsebenziswano; Imisebenzi yabaphathi.

Amandla okulandelayo: Amandla okubala; Amandla okusebenza ngekhompyutha; Amandla kolwimi; Ukuqulunqwa kweenkqubo; Ukuqulunqwa kweenkqubo.

jobs.title: Environmental Support Officer: Waste Management
jobs.department: Department of Environmental Affairs and Development Planning
jobs.centre: Department of Environmental Affairs and Development Planning, Western Cape Government.
jobs.summary: Provide administrative and procedural support for waste management operations, including environmental data systems, logistics, and secretariat services within the Western Cape Government.
jobs.requirements: A qualification at NQF level 6 (equivalent or higher) as recognised by SAQA; A minimum of 3 years administrative experience. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Financial and administrative prescripts governing the public sector, the Western Cape Government and the Department; Legislation, regulations, policies, and prescripts that are relevant to the Department and the component; General office administration processes; Database and information management processes; Project administration processes; Record-keeping legislation, regulations, policies, prescripts and processes; People management prescripts, policies and processes; Supply Chain Management. Skills in the following: Computer literacy in MS Office Package (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook); Supervisory; Communication (written and verbal, literacy and language skills); Numeracy; Accounting, Finance and Audit; Project Management; Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
jobs.duties: Facilitate procedural and administrative functions aligned with operational compliance; Coordinate and maintain environmental data systems to support policy implementation and regulatory reporting; Provide logistics and secretariat services to relevant stakeholders within the component; Administer financial processes to support environmentally aligned procurement, budgeting, and reporting functions; Asset management; Perform supervisory functions.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Ondersteuningsbeampte vir Omgewingsake: Afvalbestuur

af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 6 (gelykstaande of hoër) soos deur SAQA erken; 'n Minimum van 3 jaar administratiewe ervaring. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Finansiële en administratiewe voorskrifte wat die openbare sektor, die Western Cape-regering en die Departement regeer; Wetgewing, regulasies, beleide en voorskrifte wat relevant is tot die Departement en die komponent; Algemene kantooradministrasieprosesse; Databasis- en inligtingsbestuursprosesse; Projektadministrasieprosesse; Rekordhoudingswetgewing, regulasies, beleide, voorskrifte en prosesse; Mensbestuursvoorskrifte, beleide en prosesse; Supply Chain Management. Vaardighede in die volgende: Rekenaargeletterdheid in MS Office-pakket (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook); Supervisories; Kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondeling, geletterdheid en taalvaardighede); Syfergeletterdheid; Rekeningkunde, Finansies en Oudit; Projekbestuur; Vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Fasiliteer proseduruele en administratiewe funksies wat belyn is met operasionele nakoming; Koördineer en onderhou omgewingsdatastelsels om beleidimplementering en regulatoriese verslagdoening te ondersteun; Verskaf logistieke en sekretariatsdienste aan tersaaklike belanghebbendes binne die komponent; Administreer finansiële prosesse om omgewingsgeoriënteerde verkryging, begroting en verslagdoeningsfunksies te ondersteun; Batebestuur; Voer supervisoriese funksies uit.
