jobs.title: Chief Director: Facilities and Infrastructure Management
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs).
jobs.summary: Chief Director role overseeing facilities and infrastructure management for the Department of Health and Wellness in Cape Town.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: An appropriate tertiary qualification (NQF level 7) within a Built related environment as recognized by SAQA with at least 5 years’ experience at a senior managerial level. Pre-entry Certificate for the Senior Management Services is a requirement (Candidates not in possession of this entry requirement can still apply but are requested to register for the course and complete it as no appointment can be made in the absence thereof. The course is available at the National School of Governance (NSG) under the name “Certificate for entry into the SMS” and the full details can be sourced from the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre- entry-programme/. All costs associated herewith are the responsibility of the applicant). Experience: Extensive experience in health infrastructure management with the focus on planning and maintenance. 8 to 10 years’ post qualifications experience within a Built related environment. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel extensively in the province. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge and understanding of health infrastructure management. Knowledge and working experience with legislation, regulatory framework, policies and best practices. Strong leadership in terms of strategic planning, and project management. Knowledge and understanding of global, regional and local political, economic and social affairs impacting on the provincial government of the Western Cape. Computer literacy (Ms Office).
jobs.duties: Manage the development and implementation of infrastructure policies, norms, standards, planning frameworks, business cases and strategic plans. Build and steward strategic relationships with intergovernmental, institutional and external partnership to enable coordinated infrastructure planning and delivery, proactively resolve dependencies and delivery constraints, and ensure shared accountability for infrastructure outcomes. Monitor project delivery, performance, commissioning and compliance with approved plans, standards and Service Delivery Agreements. Oversee the planning, procurement, commissioning, maintenance, and lifecycle management, of medical equipment, moveable assets and health technology. Develop and implement relevant policies, standards and procurement requirements to ensure functionality, value for money and service continuity. Responsible to lead the development of the Chief Directorate’s strategic planning process. Development and management of the strategic and business plans for the Chief Directorate including change management. Build and steward strategic relationships with intergovernmental, institutional and external partnership to enable coordinated infrastructure planning and delivery, proactively resolve dependencies and delivery constraints, and ensure shared accountability for infrastructure outcomes. Manage the corporate service of the Chief Directorate. This includes Financial, Supply Chain, and People Management. Provide strategic leadership and oversight for nutrition and food services, security services, laundry and linen services, cleaning and hygiene services, waste management, environmental health, occupational and equipment safety, estate management and other facilities management support services through the development, implement and monitoring of policies, norms, standards and service delivery framework. Drive sustainable, climate resilience, utilities management, energy efficiency, digital enablement and facilities modernisation initiatives to enhance operational resilience, service continuity and value for money.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. OTHER POSTS It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Fasiliteite en Infrastruktuur Bestuur
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur rol wat toesig hou oor fasiliteite- en infrastruktuur bestuur vir die Department of Health and Wellness in Cape Town.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) binne 'n Bou-voorbeeld verwante omgewing soos erken deur SAQA met ten minste 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak. Voor-toetrede sertifikaat vir die Senior Management Services is 'n vereiste (Kandidate wat nie oor hierdie toetredingsvereiste beskik nie, kan steeds aansoek doen, maar word versoek om vir die kursus te registreer en dit te voltooi aangesien geen aanstelling gemaak kan word in die afwesigheid daarvan nie. Die kursus is beskikbaar by die National School of Governance (NSG) onder die naam “Certificate for entry into the SMS” en die volle besonderhede kan verkry word by die volgende skakel: https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre- entry-programme/. Alle koste wat daarmee gepaard gaan is die verantwoordelikheid van die aansoeker). Ervaring: Uitgebreide ervaring in gesondheidsinfrastruktuur bestuur met die fokus op beplanning en instandhouding. 8 tot 10 jaar se post-kwalifikasie ervaring binne 'n Bou-voorbeeld verwante omgewing. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige bestuurderlisensie en bereidwilligheid om uitgebreid in die provinsie te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis en begrip van gesondheidsinfrastruktuur bestuur. Kennis en werkservaring met wetgewing, regulatoriese raamwerke, beleide en best practices. Sterk leierskap in terme van strategiese beplanning en projekbestuur. Kennis en begrip van globale, streeks- en plaaslike politieke, ekonomiese en sosiale aangeleenthede wat 'n impak het op die provinsiale regering van die Western Cape. Rekenaargeletterdheid (Ms Office).
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van infrastruktuurbeleid, norms, standaarde, beplanningsraamwerke, besigheidsgevalle en strategiese planne. Bou en bestuur strategiese verhoudings met intergovernmental, institutional en eksterne vennootskappe om gekoördineerde infrastruktuurbeplanning en -aflewering moontlik te maak, afhanklikhede en afleweringsbeperkings proaktief op te los, en om gedeelde verantwoordelikheid vir infrastruktuuruitkomste te verseker. Monitor projekaflewering, prestasie, inbedryfstelling en voldoening aan goedgekeurde planne, standaarde en Service Delivery Agreements. Hou toesig oor die beplanning, procureering, inbedryfstelling, instandhouding, en lewensiklusbestuur van mediese toerusting, roerende bates en gesondheidstegnologie. Ontwikkel en implementeer relevante beleid, standaarde en procureeringsvereistes om funksionaliteit, waarde vir geld en dienskontinuïteit te verseker. Verantwoordelik om die ontwikkeling van die Chief Directorate se strategiese beplanningsproses te lei. Ontwikkeling en bestuur van die strategiese en besigheidsplanne vir die Chief Directorate, insluitend verandingsbestuur. Bou en bestuur strategiese verhoudings met intergovernmental, institutional en eksterne vennootskappe om gekoördineerde infrastruktuurbeplanning en -aflewering moontlik te maak, afhanklikhede en afleweringsbeperkings proaktief op te los, en om gedeelde verantwoordelikheid vir infrastruktuuruitkomste te verseker. Bestuur die korporatiewe dienste van die Chief Directorate. Dit sluit Financial, Supply Chain, en People Management in. Verskaf strategiese leierskap en toesig vir voedings- en voedseldienste, sekuriteitsdienste, was- en linnebenodigdhede, skoonmaak- en higiënedienste, afvalbestuur, omgewingsgesondheid, beroeps- en toerustingveiligheid, landgoedbestuur en ander fasiliteitebestuursdienste deur die ontwikkeling, implementering en monitering van beleid, norms, standaarde en diensafleweringraamwerk. Dryf volhoubare, klimaatweerbaarheids-, nutsbestuurs-, energie-doeltreffendheids-, digitale bemagtigings- en fasiliteite-moderniseringsinisiatiewe aan om operasionele weerbaarheid, dienskontinuïteit en waarde vir geld te verbeter.

zu.title: Umphathi Ohamba Phambili: Ukuphathwa Kwezinto Zokwakha Nempahla Esebenzayo
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi ohamba phambili sokugada ukuphathwa kwezinto zokwakha nempahla esebenzayo kuMnyango Wezempilo Nezempilo Ezinhle eCape Town.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esingaphansi kokufunda: Ithifikheyithi edingekayo lesikole esiphakeme (NQF level 7) ngaphakathi kwendawo ehlobene nokwakha njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-SAQA okuhambisana nomsebenzi wangemva kweminyaka engu-5 ohlwini lokuqondisa abaphelele. Ithifikheyithi yangaphambilini yokungena kwiSenior Management Service iyisidingo (Abangaphethe lesi sidingo sokungena basengakwazi ukufaka izicelo kodwa bayacelwa ukuthi babhalisele ikhosi bayiqede njengoba kungeke kwenziwe umsebenzi ngokungabikhona kwalo. Ikhosi itholakala eNational School of Governance (NSG) ngaphansi kwegama elithi “Certificate for entry into the SMS” futhi imininingwane ephelele ingatholwa kulesi sixhumanisi: https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre- entry-programme/. Zonke izindleko eziphathelene nalokhu ngumthwalo womfaki wesicelo). Isiphalu: Isiphalu esibanzi ekuphathweni kwezinto zokwakha zezempilo kugqamise ukuhlela nokugcina. Iminyaka engu-8 kuya kweyi-10 yomsebenzi wangemva kuthifikheyithi ngaphakathi kwendawo ehlobene nokwakha. Isidingo esibangelwe umsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile nesifiso sokuhamba kakhulu esifundazweni. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikhali): Ulwazi nokukuqonda ukuphathwa kwezinto zokwakha zezempilo. Ulwazi nomsebenzi ohlobene nomthetho, ohlelo lokulawula, izinqubo nemisebenzi ehamba phambili. Ukuguquguquka okuqinile ekubuseni uma kuzi ekucubunguleni izinhlelo kanye nokuphathwa kwemiklomelo. Ulwazi nokukuqonda izindaba zezwe nezomnotho ezingaba namthelela kukahulumeni wesifundazwe saKwaZulu-Natali eNtshonalanga Kapa. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Ms Office).
zu.duties: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinqubo zokwakha, izimiso, izinga, izinhlelo zokuqamba, izindaba zebhizinisi kanye nezinhlelo eziqondiswe phambili. Yakha futhi ulondoloze ubudlelwane bokubusisa obuhle kwezinyanga ezingaphakathi kahulumeni, ngaphakathi kwemikhakha nokwabelana ngolwazi namanye amaqembu ukuze kuqedwe ukucubungulwa kwezinhlelo zokwakha nokuqedwa kwezinsizakusebenza, uxazulule ngokuzikhashana izinkinga ezingaphansi kokuhlinzekwa futhi uqinisekise ukubekezela ngokuhlanganyela kwezinyanga eziphathelene nezinto zokwakha. Gqamisa ukuqedwa kwemiklomelo, ukusebenza nokubhaliswa kwezinyanga ezivunyiwe, izinga kanye Nezivumelwano Zokuqedela. Qapha ekubusiseni, ekuthengweni, ekuqedweni, ekugcineni, nokuphathweni kwesikhathi eside impahla yezokwelapha, izimpahla ezihambahambayo nobuchwepheshe bezempilo. Thiya futhi usebenzise izinqubo eziyinhloko, izinga kanye nezidingo zokuthenga ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza, inani lempahla ngemali kanye nokuqhubecka kwesevisi. Ubophiwe ukuthi uhole ekuthuthukisweni kohlelo lokubusisa oluqondiswe phambili kubalandeli bakho. Ukuthuthukiswa nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo eziqondiswe phambili kanye nezindaba zebhizinisi kuMnyango Ohamba Phambili okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa koshintsho. Yakha futhi ulondoloze ubudlelwane bokubusisa obuhle kwezinyanga ezingaphakathi kahulumeni, ngaphakathi kwemikhakha nokwabelana ngolwazi namanye amaqembu ukuze kuqedwe ukucubungulwa kwezinhlelo zokwakha nokuqedwa kwezinsizakusebenza, uxazulule ngokuzikhashana izinkinga ezingaphansi kokuhlinzekwa futhi uqinisekise ukubekezela ngokuhlanganyela kwezinyanga eziphathelene nezinto zokwakha. Phatha inkonzo yebhizinisi kuMnyango Ohamba Phambili. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kweMali, uKuqasha, kanye Nokuqondisa Abantu. Nikeza inkombandlela eqondiswe phambili futhi uqapha ulwazi olubheke phambili ngaphandle kokuba kukhona ongaphezulu kwakho ekubusiseni ukudla, ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zokuvikela, izinkonzo zokwasha kanye nalokhu okuhlobene nendawo, ukucwasha kanye nokuqashwa kolwazi, ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zokulondoloza izingozi ezivela emsebenzini, ukuphathwa kwezimpahla kanye nezinye izinsiza zokwakha ngokuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa futhi kwezinqubo zokusebenzisa izinsizakusebenza. Qondisa ukubekezela kokugcina imvelo, ukuphathwa kwamandla, ukusebenza kahle kwamandla, ukukhuthazwa kwezobuchwepheshe kanye nokuqiniswa kwezinsiza ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukubekezela, ukuqhubecka kwesevisi kanye nennani lempahla.

xh.title: Umntu ophethe kakhulu: Ulawulo lweziseko kunye nolwakhiwo
xh.summary: Inkqubo yomntu ophethe kakhulu elawula ulawulo lweziseko kunye nolwakhiwo lwiSebe lezeMpilo kunye noMfanelo eCape Town.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esincedisayo semfundo: Isidanga esifanelekileyo sesikolo sesiqui (NQF level 7) kwikhondo elinxulumene nokuXhaswa njengesiqinisekiso yiSAQA elineminye eli-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphezulu lolawulo. Isatifikethi somngeniso ongaphambili kwiSebe loLawulo lwabaPhambili simeko (Abagqatswa abangenaso esi safuno bangasafaka isicelo kodwa bacelwa ukuba babhalise kwinkqubo yemfundo kwaye bayigqibe njengoko akukho mthunywa unokuwenziwa ngaphandle kwayo. Inkqubo iyafumaneka kwiSikolo sikaRhulumente (NSG) ngaphantsi kwegama elithi “Isatifikethi sokungena kwiSMS” kwaye iinkcukacha ezizelelweyo zingafumaniswa kule nkca ihlonzelekayo: https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre- entry-programme/. Onke amaxabiso anxulumene noku anemfanelo yomfaki). Amaxesha: Amaxesha amaninzi kwilawulo lolwakhiwo lwezempilo kunye nokujolisa ekucwangcisweni nasekulondolozeni. Umva kweziqu ukuba neminye engu-8 ukuya kwe-10 yamava kwikhondo elinxulumene nokuXhaswa. Isimfuno esingaphakathi somsebenzi: Ilayisenesi yomqhubi egqithisiweyo nokulungele ukuhamba ubuncinane elinguzulu kule provinsi. Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi nokuqonda ukulawula ulwakhiwo lwezempilo. Ulwazi namava okusebenza ngomthetho, inkqubo yokulawula iimpolisa, namacebo amabalase kwaye aselwe kumasebe omthetho. Ukulwelisa okuqinileyo ngokomsebenzi wokuCwangcisa ngakumbi nangokulawula iiprojekthi. Ulwazi nokuqonda iindaba zamazwe ngamazwe, ezommandla nasekhaya ezinezopolitiko, ezoqoqosho nasezantlalo ezithinta urhulumente we provinsi kwelase Western Cape. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Ms Office).
xh.duties: Lawula uphuhliso nokuphunyezwa kwezimpolisa zelwakhiwo, iinkqubo ezisemthethweni, iindawo zomgangatho, iinkqubo zokuCwangcisa, iinkqubo zoshishino kunye neendawo ezingamanqanaba ezoMdlalo. Qhakamshela ulwe kwaye ugcine iindibaniselwano ezibalaseleyo neentsapho zamaphondo, ezesixeko kunye namaphatho angaphandle ukwenza ukuba luncedo ukuCwangciswa nokuhambiswa kolwakhiwa, ukuzithabatha ngokuchaneleko ekuxazululeni iingxaki ezithintelwayo ekuhambiseni iziphumo, nokuqinisekisa amaxanduva afaneleyo ngemiba yolwakhiwo. Qwalasela ukuhambiswa kweprojekthi, ukusebenza ngokugqibeleleyo, ukuqinisekiswa nokuhambelana neeNdawo eziCwangiweyo, iindawo zomgangatho kunye neeNdawo zoNcedo lokuHambisa iziPhumo. Qhatha iindawo zokuCwangcisa, ukuthenga, ukuqinisekiswa, ukulondoloza, nokuLawulwa kokusingqongileyo, kwimixhobho yezempilo, izinto ezihambahambayo kunye netekhnoloji yezempilo. Phuhlisa uphinde usebenzise izimpolisa, iindawo zomgangatho nokuThenga okufanelekileyo ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza, ixabiso elifanelekileyo nelwelo lokuHamba rhoqo. Uyakuxanduva kuqhuba uphuhliso lokuCwangcisa ngakumbi kwinkqubo yeNkululeko yokuLawula iindawo ezinkulu. Uphuhliso nokuLawulwa kweekhaya ezomgama kunye neekhaya zeshishino kwiNkululeko yokuLawulwa iindawo kuquka nokulawula iinguquko. Qhakamshela ulwe kwaye ugcine iindibaniselwano ezibalaseleyo neentsapho zamaphondo, ezesixeko kunye namaphatho angaphandle ukwenza ukuba luncedo ukuCwangciswa nokuhambiswa kolwakhiwa, ukuzithabatha ngokuchaneleko ekuxazululeni iingxaki ezithintelwayo ekuhambiseni iziphumo, nokuqinisekisa amaxanduva afaneleyo ngemiba yolwakhiwo. Lawula iinkonzo zeNkululeko yokuLawulwa iindawo ezinkulu. Oku kuquka iimali, iNkcitho yokuHambisa izinto, kunye nokuLawulwa kwabaNtu. Nyusa iNkululeko ezibalaseleyo kwaye uqwalasele izixhobo zokutya ngenkonzo yokuHamba rhoqo, iinkonzo zokhuseleko, iinkonzo zokuHamba rhoqo, iinkonzo zokuCoca, ukuphathwa kokuhla, ukusingqongileyo kwezempilo, umsebenzi nokuKhuseleka kolwazi, ukulawulwa kolwakhiwa nazo onke ezi nxalenye zenkonzo yolwakhiwa ezingancedo ngokuphuhlisa, ukusebenzisa nokuQwalasela izimpolisa, iinkqubo ezisemthethweni, iindawo zomgangatho kunye nokuHambiswa kweenkonzo. Qhutyela amasebe aya phambili, aqiniselekileyo, alawula amandla, usebenzisa amandla ngokuchanekileyo, inkxaso yamakhono okubala nokuQaliswa kolwakhiwa olutsha ukuncedisa ukuBa ngamandla, ukunqamla kwamathuba nokuBa nexabiso elifanelekileyo.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist Grade 1 to 3 (SUB-SPECIALITY: Paediatric
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 615 818 per annum Grade 2: R1 844 151 per annum Grade 3: R2 014 278 per annum (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Paediatric Critical Care sought for Tygerberg Hospital to provide clinical service, teaching and research across three grade levels.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Paediatric Critical Care. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist in Paediatric Critical Care. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist in Paediatric Critical Care. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees) as Medical Specialist in Paediatric Critical Care. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employee) as a Medical Specialist in Paediatric Critical Care. Inherent requirement of the job: A valid driver’s license. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Appropriate experience working in Paediatric Critical Care. Appropriate experience in Paediatric Critical Care of post-cardiac surgery patients. Ability to function independently at a level of a Specialist in Paediatric Critical Care. Demonstrated interest in Paediatric Critical Care research. Working with multi-disciplinary teams. Computer literacy (e.g. Word, Exel, PowerPoint, etc.).
jobs.duties: To render a comprehensive clinical service in Paediatric Critical Care. To provide clinical teaching in Paediatric Critical Care. To engage in Paediatric Critical Care research. Ecosystem support.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. “Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration as Medical Specialist in Paediatric Critical Care with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status)”. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Mediese Spesialis Vlak 1 tot 3 (SUBSPESIALITEIT: Pediatriese
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Pediatriese Intensiewe Sorg gesoek vir Tygerberg Hospital om kliniese diens, onderrig en navorsing oor drie vlakke te lewer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Spesialis in Pediatriese Intensiewe Sorg toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis in Pediatriese Intensiewe Sorg. Ervaring: Vlak 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis in Pediatriese Intensiewe Sorg nie. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of erkenning van 'n buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers) as Mediese Spesialis in Pediatriese Intensiewe Sorg. Vlak 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of erkenning van 'n buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer) as Mediese Spesialis in Pediatriese Intensiewe Sorg. Inherente vereiste van die werk: 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Toepaslike ervaring in die werk in Pediatriese Intensiewe Sorg. Toepaslike ervaring in Pediatriese Intensiewe Sorg van pasiënte na hartchirurgie. Vermoë om onafhanklik te funksioneer op die vlak van 'n Spesialis in Pediatriese Intensiewe Sorg. Agetoonde belangstelling in Pediatriese Intensiewe Sorg-navorsing. Werk met multidissiplinêre spanne. Rekenaarvaardigheid (bv. Word, Exel, PowerPoint, ens.).
af.duties: Om 'n omvattende kliniese diens in Pediatriese Intensiewe Sorg te lewer. Om kliniese onderrig in Pediatriese Intensiewe Sorg te verskaf. Om betrokke te raak by Pediatriese Intensiewe Sorg-navorsing. Ekosisteunondersteuning.

zu.title: Izinkangezwe Esezokwelapha Ezinga 1 kuya ku-3 (ISIGABA ESINGAPHAKATHI: Izezinklubalunga
zu.summary: Isiphakamiswa senkangezwe sezokwelapha ezinakekelweni okubalulekile kwezezinklubalunga kusendaweni yokwelashwa eTygerberg Hospital ukunikeza insiza yezokwelapha, ukufundisa nokucwaninga kuzo zonke izinga ezintathu.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi: Isifundo esifanele esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengenkangezwe sezokwelapha ezinakekelweni okubalulekile kwezezinklubalunga. Ukubhaliswa ekhomishini yezigengezi: Ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengenkangezwe sezokwelapha ezinakekelweni okubalulekile kwezezinklubalunga. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo ngemuva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengenkangezwe sezokwelapha ezinakekelweni okubalulekile kwezezinklubalunga. Izinga 2: Isipiliyoni esingezansi seminyaka eyi-5 esifanele njengenkangezwe sezokwelapha ngemuva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA (noma ekhomishini yezigengezi zegazi elihlonishwe ezokwelapha mayelana nabasebenzi abafunde ebelwini) njengenkangezwe sezokwelapha ezinakekelweni okubalulekile kwezezinklubalunga. Izinga 3: Isipiliyoni esingezansi kweminyaka eyi-10 esifanele njengenkangezwe sezokwelapha ngemuva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA (noma ekhomishini yezigengezi zegazi elihlonishwe ezokwelapha mayelana nomsebenzi ofunde ebelwini) njengenkangezwe sezokwelapha ezinakekelweni okubalulekile kwezezinklubalunga. Isidingo esibangelwa umsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono (ulwazi/amasheya): Isipiliyoni esifanele sokusebenla ezinakekelweni okubalulekile kwezezinklubalunga. Isipiliyoni esifanele ezinakekelweni okubalulekile kwezezinklubalunga kubangisimva bedluliselwa inhliziyo. Ikhono lokusebenzela ngabodwa ezingeni lenkangezwe ezinakekelweni okubalulekile kwezezinklubalunga. Ukuthakasela okuboniswe ocwaningweni lwesinakekelo okubalulekile kwezezinklubalunga. Ukusebenza namakilabhu ohlelo oluningi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (isb. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, nokunye).
zu.duties: Ukunikeza insiza ebanzi yezokwelapha ezinakekelweni okubalulekile kwezezinklubalunga. Ukunikeza ukufundisa ngokwelashwa ezinakekelweni okubalulekile kwezezinklubalunga. Ukuhlomula ocwaningweni lwezinakekelo okubalulekile kwezezinklubalunga. Ukusekela isimiso sangaphandle.

xh.title: Isithanga sesiCiko sezonyango isidanga 1 ukuya kwesi-3 (ISEBE-SICIKO: i-Paediatric
xh.summary: Isithanga kunyango sobugcisa sityhafa kwabantwana abasesichengeni sokungalunganga sifunwa kwi Tygerberg Hospital ukubonelela inkonzo yokunyanga, ukufundisa nokuqhuba uphando phantsi kwamanqanaba amatyhatfu.
xh.requirements: Isidanga semfundo esingezantsi: Isidanga esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiKhomishoni yabaMfundi boBaqhirha kwiMimandla eYilo nokuLawulwa kwezeMpilo yiNdlu yoBuchule yoMzantsi Afrika (HPCSA) njengesithanga kunyango lutyhafa kwabantwana abasesichengeni sokungalunganga. Ukubhalisa kwiBhunga labaMfundi boBaqhirha: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesithanga kunyango lutyhafa kwabantwana abasesichengeni sokungalunganga. Esonzo: Isidanga 1: Akukho sonzo na emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesithanga kunyango lutyhafa kwabantwana abasesichengeni sokungalunganga. Isidanga 2: Inani elingaphantsi kweminyaka emi-5 esonzo esifanelekileyo njengesithanga kunyango emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye iBhunga leMimandla eLawulwayo yeMfundo yabaQaqhulushi baseLwandle kwabasebenzi ababhaliswe ngaphandle baseLwandle abaqinisekisiweyo) njengesithanga kunyango lutyhafa kwabantwana abasesichengeni sokungalunganga. Isidanga 3: Inani elingaphantsi kweminyaka elikhulu (10) esonzo esifanelekileyo njengesithanga kunyango emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye iBhunga leMimandla eLawulwayo yeMfundo yabaQaqhulushi baseLwandle kwabasebenzi ababhaliswe ngaphandle baseLwandle abaqinisekisiweyo) njengesithanga kunyango lutyhafa kwabantwana abasesichengeni sokungalunganga. Isinyikima sendlela efuneka kwisithuba: Ileyisensi yomqhubi egunyazisiweyo. Ukukwazi ukwenza (ukwaziswa/amanqanaba): Sonzo esifanelekileyo kwisebe lokunyanga uTyhafa kwabantwana abasesichengeni sokungalunganga. Sonzo esifanelekileyo ekunyangekeni koTyhafa kwabantwana abasesichengeni sokungalunganga kwigagawo lesibetha lokunyanga sentswela yentliziyo. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ze-odwa kwinqanaba lesiThanga kunyango lutyhafa kwabantwana abasesichengeni sokungalunganga. Ukutshaqisela ukufumana ulwazi kuTyhafa kwabantwana abasesichengeni sokungalunganga. Ukusebenza kumacandelo amaninzi. Isifundo sekhompyutha (umz. iWord, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint, njl.).
xh.duties: Ukubonelela ngesebe lokwenguqulo ngokubanzi ekunyangekeni koTyhafa kwabantwana abasesichengeni sokungalunganga. Ukubonelela nokufundisa ngokonyango kuTyhafa kwabantwana abasesichengeni sokungalunganga. Ukuzibandakanya kwiponelwano yokutyholo kutyhafa kwabantwana abasesichengeni sokungalunganga. Inkxaso yendalo.

jobs.title: Manager: Medical Services Grade 1
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 479 723 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs).
jobs.summary: Manage strategic and operational health services at Citrusdal Hospital in the Cederberg Sub-district, requiring HPCSA registration and three years' post-registration experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Experience: A minimum of 3 years appropriate experience as a Medical Officer after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Inherent requirements of the job: Willingness and essential skills to do after hour’s work. Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s licence. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Strong business orientation with proven skills and abilities in the clinical management of a health service. Proven management competencies specific to a health-care environment. Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Internet). Appropriate knowledge of managing clinical services.
jobs.duties: Strategic and operational management of all health services in the Cederberg Sub-district, including PHC and district hospital services. Ensure safe clinical services and acceptable practices that comply with the professional laws of the country. Establish systems to manage risks and quality in the Cederberg Sub- district in order to ensure support of the patient centred experience, compliance to national core standards and ideal clinics as well as improved information management. Ensure effective and efficient utilisation of allocated human, financial, infrastructure and health technology resources and support service delivery of all the health service platforms in the Cederberg Sub-district. Promote community involvement in the management of the Hospital and Clinic Services and ensure the active functioning of the Hospital Board.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution/ Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render managerial and clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery. Candidates may be subjected to a competency test. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a practical test. No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Bestuurder: Geneeskundige Dienste Graad 1
af.summary: Bestuur strategiese en operasionele gesondheidsdienste by Citrusdal Hospitaal in die Cederberg Sub-distrik, wat HPCSA-registrasie en drie jaar se na-registrasie-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 3 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Beampte na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Bereidwilligheid en noodsaaklike vaardighede om buite-ure werk te doen. Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Sterk besigheidsoriëntasie met bewese vaardighede en vermoëns in die kliniese bestuur van 'n gesondheidsdiens. Bewese bestuursbevoegdhede spesifiek tot 'n gesondheidsorgomgewing. Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook en Internet). Toepaslike kennis van die bestuur van kliniese dienste.
af.duties: Strategiese en operasionele bestuur van alle gesondheidsdienste in die Cederberg Sub-distrik, insluitend PHC- en distrikshospitaaldienste. Verseker veilige kliniese dienste en aanvaarbare praktyke wat aan die professionele wette van die land voldoen. Stel stelsels in om risiko's en gehalte in die Cederberg Sub-distrik te bestuur om sodoende ondersteuning van die pasiëntgesentreerde ervaring, nakoming van nasionale kernstandaarde en ideale klinieke asook verbeterde inligtingsbestuur te verseker. Verseker doeltreffende en doelmatige benutting van toegewysde menslike, finansiële, infrastruktuur- en gesondheidstegnologie-hulpbronne en ondersteun dienslewering van al die gesondheidsdiensplatforms in die Cederberg Sub-distrik. Bevogt gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid by die bestuur van die Hospitaal- en Kliniekdienste en verseker die aktiewe funksionering van die Hospitaalraad.

zu.title: Abaphathi: Amasevisi Ezokwelapha Isibili 1
zu.summary: Phatha amasevisi ezempilo azelelwe isuqonda nokuqhutywa kwisebe lezempilo le-Citrusdal Hospital e-Cederberg Sub-district, okufuna ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA kanye neminyaka emithathu yamava emva kokubhaliswa.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomunyazi Wezokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa kunhlaka yezizwe: Ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengomunyazi Wezokwelapha. Ulwazi: Ukwazi okungenani iminyaka engu-3 okufanele njengoMphathi Wezokwelapha emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengomunyazi Wezokwelapha. Izidingo ezingokoqobo somsebenzi: Ukuzithoba nokuba namakhono abalulekile okusebenza emva kwamahora. Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukuqonda okuqinile kobuhle kwezentengiso ngamakhono namandla abonwayo ekuphathweni kwezokwelapha kwesevisi ezempilo. Ikhono lezokuphatha ebonwayo elihambisana nendawo yamasevisi ezempilo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook kanye ne-Internet). Ulwazi olufanele lokuphatha amasevisi ezokwelapha.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha ngesuqonda nangokuqhutywa wonke amasevisi ezempilo e-Cederberg Sub-district, okuhlanganisa i-PHC kanye namasevisi esibhedlela sesifunda. Qinisekisa amasevisi ezokwelapha aphephile nemikhuba eyamukelekayo ehlombe ngomthetho wamakhulu ngamakhulu wezizwe. Sitha izindlela zokuphatha ingozi kakhulu nobuhle kwi-Cederberg Sub-district ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwesekwa kokuhlaliswa kwegula, ukuhambisana namazinga abalulekile kazwelonke kanye namakliniki afe loludala kakhulu kanye nokuphatha ulwazi. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo nakhoqwayo kwemali kagesi, ezimali, ezakhiwo kanye namathuluzi ezobuchwepheshe ezempilo kanye nokwesekwa ukulethwa kwamasevisi kuyo yonke izinkomba zamasevisi ezempilo e-Cederberg Sub-district. Khuthaza ukubandakanywa komphakathi ekuphathweni kwe-Citrusdal Hospital namasevisi wezibhedlela futhi uqinisekise ukusebenza kakhulu kwe-Hospital Board.

xh.title: Umphathi: Iinkonzo zeMesebenzisi eGazini lesiQibo 1
xh.summary: Ukulawula iinkonzo zempilo ezisesikweni nangemisebenzi esebenzayo eCitrusdal Hospital kwisithili esingaphantsi seCederberg, kufuneka kubekho bhaliso kwiHPCSA neminyaka imithathu yamava emva kwebhaliso.
xh.requirements: IQualification yemfundo elinganayo: Iqualification elufaneleyo evumela ibhaliso kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomGqatswa weMesebenzisi yeMpilo. Ibhaliiso kwibhunga lemsebenzi: Ibhaliiso kwiHPCSA njengomGqatswa weMesebenzisi yeMipilo. Irlambo: Inani elinganayo lemiva yeminyaka engu3 njengomLawuli weMesebenzisi yeMipilo emva kwebhaliso kwiHPCSA njengomGqatswa weMesebenzisi yeMipilo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ukuzithanda kunye nobuchule obubalulekileyo bokuqhuba umsebenzi wemiyelo yangaphandle kwiiyure ezicwangcisiweyo. Iilayisensi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esemthethweni. Ukuzibophelela kwabasebenzi (ulwazi/obuchule): Ukuzinikela kwangqondo kwishishini ngobuchule obuqinisiweyo namandla ekulawulweni kwezempilo kwenkonzò yempilo. Obuchule bolawulo obuqinisiweyo obuthile kwimeko yempilo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyuthà (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook kunye neIntanethi). Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lokulawula iinkonzo zempilo.
xh.duties: Ukulawula ngokusesikweni nangemisebenzi esebenzayo zonke iinkonzo zempilo kwisithili esingaphantsi seCederberg, kuquka iPHC nezenzo zesibhedlele sesithili. Qinisekisa iinkonzo zempilo ezikhuselekileyo nolutsha olwamkelekileyo oluhambelana namashishini esimisela karhulumente. Misela iinkqubo zokulawula iingcuphi nobuntu kufundesiweyo okwesikwathi esingaphantsi seCederberg ukuze kuqinisekiswe inkxaso yamava ogqibelelayo kumthengi, ukuthobela iinkqubo zekhaya ezikumgangatho ophezulu nii clinic ezigqibeleleyo, nangokuphuculwa kolawulo lolwazi. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okusebenzayo kakuhle nekuluncedayo kweziboneelo zoluntu, zemali, zolwakhiwo, nesesixhobo sempilo ezabelwe lona kunye ngenkxaso yohlu lweenkornzo zonke iinkonzo zempilo kwisithili esingaphantsi seCederberg. Khuthaza ithotywa loluntu ekulawuleni iinkonzo zeSibhedlele nezeClinic, uze uqinisekise ukusebenza kwasemandla kweBhunga leSibhedlele.

jobs.title: Deputy Manager Nursing (LEVEL 1 and 2)
jobs.salary_text: R1 069 215 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Deputy Manager Nursing position at Paarl Hospital requiring a nursing diploma or degree with SANC registration, offering R1,069,215 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse OR A 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse OR A 3 year Diploma in Nursing (R171) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) AS A General Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse or General Nurse. Experience: A minimum of nine (9) years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse. At least 4 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate / recognizable experience at management level. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s licence. Willingness to be on call and available in cases of emergency. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of the relevant statutory and policy frameworks. Knowledge of quality assurance, infection prevention control and occupational health and safety. Demonstratable knowledge and experience of human resource and financial management. Good organizational, interpersonal, leadership, research and creative problem solving skills. Ability to communicate (written and verbal) and the ability to work on MS packages (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook).
jobs.duties: Provide guidance and leadership towards the realization of strategic goals and objectives in participation with the executive management team. Provide professional, technical and management support for the provision of high- quality patient care through the management of nursing care programs. Develop and monitor the implementation of nursing policies, programmes regulations, practices, procedures and standards pertaining to nursing care. Responsible for clinical governance for nursing services and advocate to ensure the promotion of nursing ethos and professionalism. Ensure the efficient financial planning, control, and effective use of resources in areas such as procurement, budget control, assets and service prioritisation. Comprehensive human resource management, including staff development, motivation and performance improvement. Utilising technology and other information systems to collect, monitor and analyse data in order to enhance service delivery. Establish, maintain and participate in inter-professional and multi-disciplinary teamwork to the benefit of holistic patient care. Able to apply stakeholder engagement, change management and continuous improvement principles to the benefit of the patients and staff of Paarl Hospital
jobs.enquiries: Mr FM van der Watt, email: Francois.vanderwatt@westerncape.gove.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates may be subjected to a competency and practical test. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkbestuurder Verpleging (VLAK 1 en 2)
af.summary: Adjunkbestuurder Verpleging-pos by Paarl Hospital wat 'n verpleegdiploma of -graad met SANC-registrasie vereis, teen R1,069,215 per jaar.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleging) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak OF 'n 4-jarige Bachelorgaad in Verpleging (R174) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak OF 'n 3-jarige Diploma in Verpleging (R171) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) AS 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige of Algemene Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van nege (9) jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ten minste 4 jaar van bogenoemde tydperk moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring op bestuursvlak wees. Inheemse vereistes van die pos: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om oproep te wees en beskikbaar te wees in noodgevalle. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van die tersaaklike statutêre en beleid-raamwerke. Kennis van gehaltversekering, infeksievoorkoming en -beheer en beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid. Aantoonbare kennis en ervaring van menslike hulpbron- en finansiële bestuur. Goeie organisatoriese, interpersoonlike, leierskaps-, navorsings- en kreatiewe probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Vermoë om te kommunikeer (skriftelik en mondelings) en die vermoë om op MS-pakkette (Word, Excel, PowerPoint en Outlook) te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf leiding en leierskap ter bereiking van strategiese doelwitte en oogmerke in samewerking met die uitvoerende bestuurspan. Verskaf professionele, tegniese en bestuursondersteuning vir die voorsiening van hoë-kwaliteit pasiëntesorg deur die bestuur van verpleegsorgprogramme. Ontwikkel en monitor die implementering van verpleegbeleid, -programme, regulasies, praktyke, prosedures en standaarde rakende verpleegsorg. Verantwoordelik vir kliniese bestuur vir verpleegdienste en pleitbesorger om die bevordering van verplegetos en professionaliteit te verseker. Verseker doeltreffende finansiële beplanning, beheer en effektiewe gebruik van hulpbronne in areas soos verkryging, begrotingsbeheer, bates en diensprioritisering. Omvattende menslike hulpbronbestuur, insluitend personeelontwikkeling, motivering en prestasieverbetering. Benutting van tegnologie en ander inligtingstelsels om data in te samel, te monitor en te ontleed ten einde dienslewering te verbeter. Vestig, handhaaf en neem deel aan interprofessionele en multidissiplinêre spanwerk tot voordeel van holistiese pasiëntesorg. In staat om belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, veranderingsbestuurs- en deurlopende verbeteringsbeginsels toe te pas tot voordeel van die pasiënte en personeel van Paarl Hospital

zu.title: Iselula Meliwebo Kokunakekela Abagulayo (IZINGA 1 no-2)
zu.summary: Isikhundla seselela somphathi sokunakekela abagulayo esibhedlela i-Paarl Hospital esidinga idiploma noma i-degree yokunakekela abagulayo nokuqashelwa kwi-SANC, esinikeza i-R1,069,215 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Ithuba elimncane lemfuno yemfundo: Isibophezelo esiyisisekelo se-R425 (okuwukuthi idiploma/degree yokunakekela abagulayo) noma isibophezelo esilinganayo (R683) esivumela ukuqashelwa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengongunesi osemthethweni NGE Degree yeminyaka eyi-4 eYokunakekela Abagulayo (R174) evumela ukuqashelwa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengongunesi osemthethweni NGE Diploma yeminyaka eyi-3 eYokunakekela Abagulayo (R171) evumela ukuqashelwa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) NJENGE Gunesi Jikelele. Ukuqashelwa kubhodi yezewe: Ukuqashelwa kwi-SANC njengongunesi osemthethweni nongunesi jikelele. Isipiliyoni: Ubuncwane beminyaka engu-9 (9) yesipiliyoni esifanele/esivezwayo sokunakekela abagulayo emva kokuqashelwa njengongunesi osemthethweni. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-4 kohlelo olushiwo ngenhla kumele ibe yisipiliyoni esifanele/esivezwayo ezingeni lokuqondisa. Izidingo ezibekelwe emsebenzini: Ilayisenisi yokuqasha evumelekile (i-Code B/EB). Ukuzithoba ukuba kwingumlando kanye nokuba nokwazi kuleyime lezimo eziphuthumayo. Amandla (ulwazi/amasu): Ulwazi ngezinhlaka zomthetho namapholisi ahlobene. Ulwazi ngeqiniso lokuhlola, ukuthintela ukutheleleka nokuphathwa kwezempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi. Ulwazi nesipiliyoni esibonakalayo sokuphathwa kwabantu nezimali. Amasu amahle okuhlela, okuhlobana nabantu, okukhokhela, ukuphenya kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga ngokudala. Ikhono lokuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokukhulunywa) kanye nekhono lokusebenza kumaphakheji e-MS (i-Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint ne-Outlook).
zu.duties: Nikeza isiqondiso nobuqhawe ekuzukeni izinjongo ezinhle kwaye nize nibambe iqhaza kuhlelo lokuphathwa okuphezulu. Nikeza inkxaso yezobuchwepheshe, yobuchwepheshe nokuphathwa ngenhloso yokunikeza ukunakekelwa kwabagulayo okulingenampela ngokuphatha iinkqubo zokunakekelwa kwabagulayo. Yaza uqaphele ukusetshenziswa kwamapholisi, iinkqubo, imithetho, izenzele, iinkqubo kwaye nemigangatho enxulumene nokunakekelwa kwabagulayo. Uxanduva lokulawula izempilo ngezenzo zokunakekelwa kwaye uze ungcine ukwenyuswa kwesiko lokunakekela abagulayo nobungcali. Qinisekisa ukucwangciswa kwemali okusebenzayo, ukulawula, nokusetshenziswa kwezibizo ezinjengokuthenga, ukulawula isabelo, izinto ezingenisa inzuzo nokuqamba izinkonzo. Ukuphathwa kwezabantu okubandakanya, ukukhula kwabasebenzi, ukuzigqatsa kwaye nokuphucula ukusebenza. Ukusebenzisa iteknoloji nolunye ulwazi lohlelo ukuze kuqokelelwe, kulawulwe kwaye kuqatshwe ulwazi ngenhloso yokuphucula ukuletha inkonzo. Mis, gcina kwaye uthathe inxaxheba kuhlelo lokusebenza ngokwesiqu nokuhlanganyela phakathi kwamaphulo kwaye kuhambe phambili ukulunga kokunakekelwa kwabagulayo okuziwa. Ukuba nekhalo lokusebenza nabantu abathintekayo, ukulawula ushintsho kwaye nokuqhuba izigaba zokuphucula ngokuzinikelwa kumagula abantu basebenza esibhedlela i-Paarl Hospital.

xh.title: ISekela-Nyathi-Mnya (Nqanaba 1 and 2)
xh.summary: Isithuba sokuba nguSomalathiso wabaPhathi baseZibhediya sisePaarl Hospital, sifuna idiploma okanye idegree yenzululwane enokusayina kwi-SANC, kunye nomvuzo ka R1,069,215 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemigaqo yemfundo: I_basic R425 qualification (oko kukuthi idiploma/idegree kwenzylwana) okanye isifanekiso esimangalisayo (R683) esinokubhaliswa kwi South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengento eqeshwe ngokomsebenzi yezibhediya OKUZE i-degree yeminyaka emi-4 kwenzylwana (R174) esinokubhaliswa kwi South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengento eqeshwe ngokomsebenzi yezibhediya OKUZE idiploma yeminyaka emi-3 kwenzylwana (R171) esinokubhaliswa kwi South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengento eqeshwe ngokubanzi. Ukubhaliswa kwengangingcango yobugcisa: Ukubhaliswa kwi SANC njengento eqeshwe ngokomsebenzi okanye njengento eqeshwe ngokubanzi. Isipilingo: Isipilingo esingaphantsi kweminyaka elishoba (9) yomsebenzi oqondileyo/ongaqondwa kakuhle kwenzylwana emva kokubhaliswa njengento eqeshwe ngokomsebenzi yezibhediya. Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-4 kwelixesha elitshiwo ngasentla kufuneka kusebenze ngokutshintshiswa kwemisebenzi / eyamkelwayo kwinqanaba lolawulo. Iimfuno ezifihlakeleyo zomsebenzi: Ilaisensi yokutyala (Code B/EB) edlulisiweyo. Ukukhululeka ukuba kwindlela yokubizwa nokuba khona kwiimeko eziphuthazayo. Isakhono sesaziso (isazisi esingangenandaba nezesibhakabhaka): Ulwazi olungaqondisiswa kwemithetho ejoliswe kuyo ngokomgaqo-nkqubo kunye nezikhuthazo ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi ngokulawula izinga lokuchaneka, ekuthinteleni ukutsha kwemifuno nokhuselo kwempilo yoikhmpileyo nendalo. Ulwazi olubonakaliswayo ngoluntu nempilo yabantu nokulingana ngokomzekelo woluntu olusenzo lulwa kwemfihlelo yokubakwoluntu nolwazi. Isakhono esisemgangathweni ophakamileyo sokulungisa iindaba, ukusebenza nomntu omnye, ukulawula ulwazi nezibalo ngokwemveliso ezingathintwa ngokulula. Isakhono sokulawula ulwazi nokuqamba izisombululo eziqhakamshisiweyo, ukuphuhliswa kobugcisa bomtshini wokuba ulawule nolunye ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kwesoftware (Word, Excel, PowerPoint kunye ne-Outlook).
xh.duties: Ukubonelela iindlela kunye nobuqhawe ekufezweni iinjongo ezibalulekileyo neemigangatho ngokusebenzisana nethumba labaphathi abagcinelweyo. Ukubonelela inkxaso yobuchwepheshe, kobunini nolawulo ekubonelelweni kwesigqxu esinzulu sezigulana ngokulawula iinkqubo zonakekelo lweszibhedyana. Ukulungelelanisa nokujonga phantsi ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo ezahlukeneyo zenkunzinyana, iinkqubo, imithetho, iinkqubo, iingqubo kunye nemigangatho engathwaliyo ngokunakekelwa kwezibhediya. Ukuba nobambe lxaxheba kulawulo ngokwezilungelelaniso sezibhediya nokuba ngumtshini wezinto ezikhusayo ukuze qinisekiswe ukuthuthwa kolwazio kwindlela yokunyathelisa kwesibhediya nobugcisa. Ukuqinisekisa iplani yokubhalisa kwemithelelo emali, ulawulo, nokuzezingqondo kwemithombo yezinto ekwiindawo ezinjengokuthengwa kwemveliso, ulawulo loxabiso lwemali, iimpahla nokuqwalasela iinkonzo. Ulawulo oluqulunqwe ngokupheleleyo lwabantu abaqeshiweyo, okuquka ukuphuhliswa kwabasebenzi, ukhuthazo nokuphuculwa kokusebenza koluntu. Ukusebenzisa iindlela zobuchwephesha nakwezinye iindalo ezininzi zokuthungela ulwazi ukuze uqokele, ulawule uhlobo lwemigaqo ngokwemigaqo ukuba ncedisane nokuphucula ukulawulwa kweenkonzo. Ukwakha, zigcine kwaye uthathe inxaxheba ekusebenziseni okubakwoluntu nakuwo onke amasebe ukuba konke kuqhaxamleni ngomzamo wokunakekelwa okupheleleyo kwesigulana. Ukuba nokuguquguquka ngokubandakanya kwabathintekayo, ulawulo lokutshintsha nokuqhubela phambili ngokusoloko kulawulo, ukulunga ngenjongo yokuba kwenzakalize kwiintsapho neabasebenzi be Paarl Hospital.

jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 (EMERGENCY Medicine)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 041 402 per annum Grade 2: R1 188 255 per annum Grade 3: R1 375 245 per annum (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: The Department of Health seeks a Medical Officer for Emergency Medicine at Karl Bremer Hospital to deliver clinical services and administrative governance.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Practitioner. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as Medical Practitioner with the HPCSA in respect of SA qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 6 years relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 11 years relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid driver’s license. Willingness and ability to travel. Full commuted overtime is mandatory. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to render high-quality Emergency Medicine service and appropriate experience in Emergency Medicine at District level. Strong ethical principles, relevant clinical & counselling skills, computer literacy, interpersonal skills, conflict resolution skills and teaching & training skills at undergraduate and medical intern level. Excellent clinical expertise and clinical governance. Team ethos, good leadership, communication, interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving skills.
jobs.duties: Clinical service delivery in Emergency Medicine, performed in all areas of the Emergency Center Complex, including short stay units, with relevant procedural interventions. Clinical and administrative governance with effective self-organization, stewardship of scarce resources, participation in clinical reviews, with quality improvement, accurate medical record keeping and compliance with human resources and other policies. Teaching, training & research including supervision of undergraduate students, interns and junior doctors as well as participation in the hospital academic program. Systems management and domain specific outputs (Metro East Ecosystem) - rendering of high-quality care in all aspects of Emergency Medicine within the district level package of care, in a professional & collegial manner, aligned with the requirements & outputs of Emergency Medicine in the Metro East ecosystem.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). Candidates will be subjected to a written/practical and oral assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Mediese Offisier Vlak 1 tot 3 (Noodgeneeskunde)
af.summary: Die Departement van Gesondheid soek 'n Mediese Offisier vir Noodgeneeskunde by Karl Bremer Hospitaal om kliniese dienste en administratiewe bestuur te lewer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Praktisyn. Ervaring: Vlak 1: Geen na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by die HPCSA ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 1 jaar tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 6 jaar tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Vlak 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bereidwilligheid en vermoë om te reis. Volle pendel-oortyd is verpligtend. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om hoëgehalte-noodgeneeskundige diens te lewer en toepaslike ervaring in Noodgeneeskunde op distrikvlak. Sterk etiese beginsels, tersaaklike kliniese en beradingsvaardighede, rekenaargeletterdheid, interpersoonlike vaardighede, konflikoplossingsvaardighede en onderrig- en opleidingsvaardighede op voorgraadse en mediese internvlak. Uitstekende kliniese kundigheid en kliniese bestuur. Span etos, goeie leierskap, kommunikasie, interpersoonlike, analitiese en probleemoplossingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Kliniese dienslewering in Noodgeneeskunde, uitgevoer in alle areas van die Noodsentrum-kompleks, insluitend kortbly-eenhede, met tersaaklike prosedurele ingrypings. Kliniese en administratiewe bestuur met effektiewe selforganisasie, bestuur van skaars hulpbronne, deelname aan kliniese oorsigte, met gehaltsverbetering, akkurate mediese rekordhouding en voldoening aan menslike hulpbronne en ander beleide. Onderrig, opleiding en navorsing, insluitende toesig oor voorgraadse studente, internskappe en junior dokters, asook deelname aan die akademiese program van die hospitaal. Stelselbestuur en domein-spesifieke uitsette (Metro East Ekosisteem) - lewering van hoëgehaltesorg in alle aspekte van Noodgeneeskunde binne die distrikvlak-pakket van sorg, op 'n professionele en kollegiale wyse, in ooreenstemming met die vereistes en uitsette van Noodgeneeskunde in die Metro East-ekosisteem.

zu.title: Onkhemela Wezokwelapha Isigaba 1 kuya ku-3 (I-EmerGENCY Medicine)
zu.summary: Umnyango Wezempiro ufuna Onkhemela Wezokwelapha we-Emergency Medicine e-Karl Bremer Hospital ukuze ahlinze ngesevisi yezokwelapha nokubusa ngokomphatho ezinsizweni.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esincane semfundo: Iqualification efanele evumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengesidumbu sezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa kumkhandlu ochwepheshe: Ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengesidumbu sezokwelapha. Isiphephelo: Isigaba 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokubhalisa njengesidumbu sezokwelapha ne-HPCSA ngokubhekisele kubasebenzi abaneziqu e-SA. Umnyaka o-1 woluhlu lwemisebenzi efanele emva kokubhalisa njengesidumbu sezokwelapha nakumkhandlu wezempilo ochwepheshe ovunyelwe wamanye amazwe ngokubhekisele kubasebenzi abaneziqu kwamanye amazwe, ongadingwa ukwenza i-Community Service njengokuqophelelkile e-South Africa. Isigaba 2: Umcobo ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-5 oluhla lwemisebenzi efanele njengesidumbu sezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa ne-HPCSA njengesidumbu sezokwelapha ngokubhekisele kubasebenzi abaneziqu e-SA. Umcobo ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-6 oluhlu lwemisebenzi efanele emva kokubhalisa njengesidumbu sezokwelapha nakumkhandlu wezempilo wamanye amazwe ovunyelwe ngokubhekisele kubasebenzi abaneziqu kwamanye amazwe, ongadingwa ukwenza i-Community Service njengokuqophelelkile e-South Africa. Isigaba 3: Umcobo ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-10 oluhla lwemisebenzi efanele njengesidumbu sezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa ne-HPCSA njengesidumbu sezokwelapha ngokubhekisele kubasebenzi abaneziqu e-SA. Umcobo ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-11 oluhlu lwemisebenzi efanele emva kokubhalisa njengesidumbu sezokwelapha nakumkhandlu wezempilo ochwepheshe ovunyelwe wamanye amazwe ngokubhekisele kubasebenzi abaneziqu kwamanye amazwe, ongadingwa ukwenza i-Community Service njengokuqophelelkile e-South Africa. Izidingo ezingokwemvelo somsebenzi: I-license evumelekile yokushayela. Ukuzithoba kanye nesikhathi sokuhamba. I-overtime ebalulekile ngokugcwele iyadingwa. Izakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ikhono lokunika isevisi yephakeme ye-Emergency Medicine kanye noluhlu lwemisebenzi olufanele kwi-Emergency Medicine ezingeni lesifunda. Izimiso zokuziphatha ezinamandla, amakhono afanele okukwelapha nokweluleka, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, amakhono okuxhumana nabantu, amakhono okuxazulula ingxabano kanye namakhono okufundisa nokuqeqesha ezingeni laphansi kweziqu kanye neziqu zabathandazi bezokwelapha. Ukwazi okuphezulu kokukwelapha kanye nokubusa ngokwezokwelapha. Isiphithiphithi sehlelo, ukubeka kahle ngokuhola, ukuxhumana, abantu, ukuhlaziya kanye namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi yezokwelapha kwi-Emergency Medicine, kwenziwa kuzo zonke izindawo ze-Emergency Center Complex, kuhlanganise namayunithi okuhlala isikhashana, nangokungenelela ngezenzo ezifanele. Ukubusa ngokwezokwelapha kanye nokuphathwa kwezinsiza, kuhlanganise ukuzihlela ngokusebenzayo, ukulondoloza izinsiza ezincane, ukuthatha inxaxhele ekubukeni iziguli ngokwezokwelapha, ngokusunguzisa ukuphucula izinga, ukugcina amarekhodi ezokwelapha ngokunembile kanye nokuzilandela izinqubomgomo zezinsiza zabantu kanye nezinye. Ukufundisa, ukuqeqesha nokucwaninga kuhlanganise ukulawula abafundi abangaphansi kweziqu, iziguli nezinsiza, kanye namadokheta abancane kanye nokuthatha inxaxhele ohlelweni lokufunda ibhededethe. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo kanye nokuphuma okuhlezelwe ngokwendawo (Metro East Ecosystem) - ukunika ukunakekelwa okuphezulu kuyo yonke imikhakha ye-Emergency Medicine ngaphakathi kwelunga elingeniswa ngenkatha yezokwelapha esizeni sesifunda, ngendlela yochwepheshe nenhlonipho, kuhambisana nezidingo nokuphuma okufunwayo kwi-Emergency Medicine kuhlelo lwe-Metro East ecosystem.

xh.title: Isikhedlela Sezempilo Esingangenela iNqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (i-EMERGENCY Medicine)
xh.summary: Isebe lezeMPilo lifuna Isikhedlela Sezempilo kwi-EMERGENCY Medicine eKarl Bremer Hospital ukunikeza iinkonzo zempilo nolawulo okusezantsi.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezizingunaphakathi: Ifikhwelifikheyo elifumene ukubhalisa kwiHealth Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoko nguPraktisa weZempilo. Ukubhalisa kwikomkhulu lwabasebenzi: Ukubhalisa kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoko nguPraktisa weZempilo. Isiphiwo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho mfuneko emva kokubhalisa njengoko nguPraktisa weZempilo kwiHPCSA malunga nabaqeqeshiweyo basezwekazinke (SA). Umnyaka we-1 wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengoko nguPraktisa weZempilo kwikomkhulu lwamagazwe lwezempilo elinqatshiweyo malunga nabaqeqeshiweyo bamazwe ngaphandle, abangekho mfuneko wenze iNkonzo yomXhoti njengoko kufunwa kumZantsi Afrika. Inqanaba 2: Ukuncitshiswa konyaka we-5 wamava afanelekileyo njengoko nguPraktisa weZempilo emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengoko nguPraktisa weZempilo malunga nabaqeqeshiweyo basezwekazinke (SA). Ukuncitshiswa konyaka we-6 wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengoko nguPraktisa weZempilo kwikomkhulu lwamagazwe lwezempilo elinqatshiweyo malunga nabaqeqeshiweyo bamazwe ngaphandle, abangekho mfuneko wenze iNkonzo yomXhoti njengoko kufunwa kumZantsi Afrika. Inqanaba 3: Ukuncitshiswa konyaka we-10 wamava afanelekileyo njengoko nguPraktisa weZempilo emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengoko nguPraktisa weZempilo malunga nabaqeqeshiweyo basezwekazinke (SA). Ukuncitshiswa konyaka we-11 wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengoko nguPraktisa weZempilo kwikomkhulu lwamagazwe lwezempilo elinqatshiweyo malunga nabaqeqeshiweyo bamazwe ngaphandle, abangekho mfuneko wenze iNkonzo yomXhoti njengoko kufunwa kumZantsi Afrika. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kolusebenzo: Ilayisensi yokushayela enye. Ukuzithanda nokuba nokuba nakho ukuhamba. I-overtime epheleleyo iyakufuneka. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukuba nakho ukunikeza inkonzo ye-EMERGENCY Medicine yamgangatho ophezulu namava afanelekileyo kwi-EMERGENCY Medicine kwinqanaba loMmandla. Amagama amaninzi okuziphatha, amakhono omlinganiselo wempilo kwanempilo, ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, amakhono okudibanisa nabantu, amakhono okulunga izingxaki nokufundisa ukuqeqesha kwinqanaba lwe-undengraduate namakhorasi abaphakathi bempilo. Amakhono aphakamileyo omlinganiselo wempilo nolawulo olusezantsi. Umoya wokusebenza njengosapho, ulawulo oluhle, ukunxibelelana, amakhono okudibanisa nabantu, ukuhlalutya nokusombulula iingxaki.
xh.duties: Ukuhanjiswa kwenkonzo yempilo kwi-EMERGENCY Medicine, kwenziwa kuzo zonke iindawo ze-Emergency Center Complex, kuquka neendawo zokuhlala zexeshana, nenyathelo elichanekileyo lokungenelela. Ulawulo olusezantsi olusentsimbi nolusemthethweni ngokuzihlengahlengisa, ukulondolozwa kwamathuba amancinci, ukuthatha inxaxheba kokuhlola izinto zomzimba, ngokuphucula umgangatho, ukugcina irekhodi yezempilo ngokuchanekileyo nokuhambelana nemigaqo yabasebenzi nayeyamanye. Ukufundisa, ukuqeqesha nokuphandela ngokulawula abafundi abangangenanga kwinkonzo, abaphakathi nabadosiweyo bezempilo, kanjalo nokuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yezemfundo yosibhedlele. Ukulawula iinkqubo nokuvelisa iziphumo ezithintelelayo (i-Metro East Ecosystem) - ukunikeza inkonzo yamgangatho ophezulu kuzo zonke iindawo ze-EMERGENCY Medicine ngaphakathi kwenqanaba lommandla lenkonzo, ngendlela echanekileyo enobugcisa, ehambelana neemfuno neziphumo ze-EMERGENCY Medicine kwinkqubo ye-Metro East.

Vlak 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van SA gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Beleieroorsig, formulering, instandhouding en verspreiding van belede en prosedures om die veiligheid van personeel in die instelling te verbeter. OHS Dienstebestuur, administrasie en bestuur van bestuursstrukture. Verskaf beroepsgesondheids tegniese insette oor verkryging, opvoeding en opleiding binne areas van beheer, ontwikkel personeel se geletterdheid oor Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheidsbeginsels, -praktyke en -riglyne binne die distrik en die fasiliteite. Dokumentasie, databestuur en verslagdoening.

zu.title: Isikhundla Sofakazi Bokwelapha izinga 1 kuya ku-3 (STAFF/OCCUPATIONAL Health
zu.summary: Isikhundla Sofakazi Bokwelapha izinga 1 kuya ku-3 kwensebenzo Yezempilo zabasebenzi naseKusebenzeni komnyango we-Health wesifundazwe se-Western Cape, obheke ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ekusebenzeni kanye nokuqashelwa kwezingozi.
zu.requirements: Ithuba elincane lemfundiso: Ithuba elifanele elicwazisa ukubhalisa ku-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengesidakamizwa. Ukubhalisa kwabafundi bomkhakha: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengesidakamizwa. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho esibuye kuphothwe ukubhalisa njengesidakamizwa ku-HPCSA mayelana nabasebenzi abaqothwe e-SA. Unyaka oyi-1 wesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokubhalisa njengesidakamizwa ku-HPCSA oqashwe kahle webandla labafundi bemikhakha yezempilo yangaphandle mayelana nabasebenzi abaqothwe phesheya, ongadingi ukwenza Inkonzomphakathi njengoba kudingeka e-South Africa. Izinga 2: Okuncane iminyaka engu-5 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengesidakamizwa emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengesidakamizwa mayelana nabasebenzi abaqothwe e-SA. Okuncane iminyaka engu-6 yesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokubhalisa njengesidakamizwa ku-HPCSA oqashwe kahle webandla labafundi bemikhakha yezempilo yangaphandle mayelana nabasebenzi abaqothwe phesheya, ongadingi ukwenza Inkonzomphakathi njengoba kudingeka e-South Africa. Izinga 3: Okuncane iminyaka engu-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengesidakamizwa emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengesidakamizwa mayelana nabasebenzi abaqothwe e-SA. Okuncane iminyaka engu-11 yesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokubhalisa njengesidakamizwa ku-HPCSA oqashwe kahle webandla labafundi bemikhakha yezempilo yangaphandle mayelana nabasebenzi abaqothwe phesheya, ongadingi ukwenza Inkonzomphakathi njengoba kudingeka e-South Africa. Izidingo ezingokwalelo lethuba: Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ukuhamba waye ezikhungweni zezempilo kulo lonke elase-Cape Metro. I-Post Graduate Diploma in Occupational Health (DOH). Ukuzithoba ekubambeleleni ekusebenzeni ngaphezulu ngesikhathi (Commuted Overtime) uma izidingo zendlela yokusebenza zifuna njalo. Amandla (ulwazi/izikhali): Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (MS Office). Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwezingozi zezempilo (HRA, Occ. Hygiene report assessment). Ulwazi lokucwaningwa kokwelapha (return to work medicals) kanye nezinsizakalo ze-District Health.
zu.duties: Ukusungula, ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo ze-Occupational Health kanye nokuqashwa nokuhlolwa kwazo zonke izifo nezilimalo ezenzakalayo ekusebenzeni. Ukuhlukaniswa kwezingozi nokuphathwa kwezingozi kanye nohlolo Lwezingozi Zempilo Esebenzweni (HRA) kanye nokuqondiswa kwemikhuba yokuvezwa kwezingozi zokusebenza. Ukuhlola imigomo, ukuyakha, ukuyigcina kanye nokuyihambisa imigono kanye nemikhakha yakho yomsebenzi ukwenza ukuthi kube khona impilo yabasebenzi esikhungweni. Ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo ze-OHS, ukuphathwa kwemibhalo, kanye nokulawulwa kwakho ngokomkhakha wezinsizakalo. Ukunikeza umbono ogqamile ngobuchwepheshe bezempilo zokusebenza ekuthengweni, emfundeni nasekuqeqeshweni kulawulo olulawulayo, ukuqeqesha abasebenzi ngemigomo nangezindlela ezimayelana nokuphathwa kwezempilo kanye nokugcina isikhungo esiphephile esifundeni nakulezo zikhungo. Imibalo, ukuphathwa kwemininingwane kanye nokwenza umbiko.

xh.title: Unongqongqo wezempilo inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (Izempilo zabasebenzi/nomsebenzi
xh.summary: Unongqongqo wezempilo inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 kwizempilo zabasebenzi nomsebenzi kwi Western Cape Department of Health, unoxanduva lokulawula iinkonzo zempilo yomsebenzi nokuqwalasela iingozi.
xh.requirements: Iifundo ezisingezantsi eziyimfuno: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengompraktishuni wezempilo. Ukubhalisa kwikhabhini yabaprofeshinali: Ukubhalisa kwi HPCSA njengompraktishuni wezempilo. Amava: Inqanaba 1: Akukho mfuno yamava emva kokubhalisa njengompraktishuni wezempilo kwi HPCSA kubasebenzi abagqithiswe e SA. 1 unyaka wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengompraktishuni wezempilo kwikhabhini yamanye amazwe yamaprofeshinali bezempilo eqinisekisiweyo kubasebenzi abagqithiswe kwamanye amazwe, abangafunwa ukwenza iinkonzo zomthonyama njengoko kufuneka e South Africa. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinci be-5 iminyaka yamava afanelekileyo njengompraktishuni wezempilo emva kokubhalisa kwi HPCSA njengompraktishuni wezempilo kubasebenzi abagqithiswe e SA. Ubuncinci be-6 iminyaka yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengompraktishuni wezempilo kwikhabhini yezeempilo yamanye amazwe eqinisekisiweyo kubasebenzi abagqithiswe kwamanye amazwe, abangafunwa ukwenza iinkonzo zomthonyama njengoko kufuneka e South Africa. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinci be-10 iminyaka yamava afanelekileyo njengompraktishuni wezempilo emva kokubhalisa kwi HPCSA njengompraktishuni wezempilo kubasebenzi abagqithiswe e SA. Ubuncinci be-11 iminyaka yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengompraktishuni wezempilo kwikhabhini yamanye amazwe yamaprofeshinali bezempilo eqinisekisiweyo kubasebenzi abagqithiswe kwamanye amazwe, abangafunwa ukwenza iinkonzo zomthonyama njengoko kufuneka e South Africa. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilaysensi yokuqhuba esebenzayo. Ukuhamba kwiindawo zezempilo kulo lonke ulawu lase Cape Metro. I-Post Graduate Diploma kwi-Impilo yomsebenzi (DOH). Kulindeleke ukuba ubenolwelo lokuthatha inxaxheba kwi-Commuted Overtime ukuba iimfuno zokusebenza zifuna njalo. Iikhompetensi (ulwazi/akhoni): Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office). Ulwazi lolawulo lwengozi yezempilo (HRA, ukuqwalasela ingxelo ye-Occ. Hygiene). Ulwazi lwe-Medical Adjudication (iinkcukacha zezempilo zokubuyela emsebenzini) kunye neenkonzo ze-District Health.
xh.duties: Ukuseka, ukulawula iinkonzo ze-Impilo yomsebenzi nokujonga nokuqwalasela zonke iigulo kunye neenzonakalo ezalusebenzweni. Ukuqonda iingozi nolawulo lweengozi nokuqwalasela iingozi zeempilo esebeni (HRA) nokudalwa kweenkcazelo zokubakho kweengozi ezalusebenzweni. Ukuqwalasela, ukuyila, ukulondoloza nokusasaza imigaqo-nkqubo nemiqathango ukunyusa ukhuseleko lwabasebenzi kwiziko. Ulawulo lweenkonzo ze-OHS, ukulawula, nolawulo lwezakwozo ezilawulayo. Ukunikeza izigqibo zobuchwepheshe bezempilo yomsebenzi mayela nokuthenga, imfundo nokuqeqesha ngaphakathi kweendawo ezilawulwayo, ukuphuhlisa ulwazi lokubhaliweyo lwabasebenzi malunga neemigaqo, iindlela zokwenza nemigaqo ye-Impilo nokhuseleko lomsebenzi ngaphakathi kwesithili nakwiindawo. Ukubhaliswa kwamaxwebhu, ulawulo lwedatha nokuvelisa iingxelo.

jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 (CLINICAL HUB)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 041 402 per annum Grade 2: R1 188 255 per annum Grade 3: R1 375 245 per annum (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 providing clinical leadership and telephonic assessment within the EMS Clinical Hub in the Western Cape.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as a Medical Practitioner with the HPCSA in respect of SA qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of who is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 6 years relevant experience after registration as a Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, who are not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 11 years’ relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Inherent requirement of the job: A valid code (B/EB) drivers licence. Willingness to participate in after-hours operational support when required. Ability to work within a dynamic healthcare environment. Ability to make independent clinical decisions and provide clinical leadership. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of healthcare systems, emergency care pathways and patient referral processes. Knowledge of clinical governance, patient safety and quality improvement methodologies. Understanding of emergency medical services and health system integration. Ability to perform telephonic clinical assessments and risk stratification. Strong communication, presentation and interpersonal skills. Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Computer literacy in Microsoft Office applications. Ability to establish and maintain effective partnerships with healthcare providers and stakeholders.
jobs.duties: Provide clinical leadership and governance within the EMS Clinical Hub. Conduct telephonic clinical assessment, prioritisation and risk stratification of selected patients. Support appropriate EMS resource allocation, escalation and patient navigation. Provide clinical oversight of alternative care pathways, including Hear and Treat, Hear and Refer and non-conveyance. Coordinate care across EMS, Primary Healthcare, Community Based Services, Palliative Care and Emergency Centre pathways. Develop, review and maintain clinical protocols, guidelines and standard operating procedures. Monitor patient safety, clinical quality and adherence to governance requirements. Analyse and report on clinical activity, outcomes and service performance. Provide training, mentoring and clinical support to EMS and Clinical Hub staff. Support service redesign initiatives to improve access to care and patient outcomes. Contribute to evaluation and continuous improvement of the Clinical Hub model.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON
