Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 6 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as 'n Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsraad ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, wat nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Inherente vereiste van die werk: 'n Geldige kode (B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om aan buite-ure bedryfsondersteuning deel te neem wanneer nodig. Vermoë om binne 'n dinamiese gesondheidsorgomgewing te werk. Vermoë om onafhanklike kliniese besluite te neem en kliniese leierskap te verskaf. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van gesondheidsorgstelsels, noodlyke sorgroetes en pasiëntverwysingsprosesse. Kennis van kliniese bestuur, pasiëntveiligheid en gehalteverbeteringsmetodologieë. Begrip van noodmediese dienste en gesondheidsstelselintegrasie. Vermoë om telefooniese kliniese assesserings en risikostratifikasie uit te voer. Sterk kommunikasie-, aanbiedings- en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Uitstekende analitiese, probleemoplossings- en besluitnemingsvermoëns. Rekenaargeletterdheid in Microsoft Office-toepassings. Vermoë om effektiewe vennootskappe met gesondheidsorgverskaffers en belanghebbendes te vestig en te handhaaf.
af.duties: Verskaf kliniese leierskap en bestuur binne die EMS Kliniese Hub. Voer telefooniese kliniese assessering, prioritisering en risikostratifikasie van geselekteerde pasiënte uit. Ondersteun toepaslike EMS hulpbronbesteding, eskalering en pasiëntnavigasie. Verskaf kliniese toesig oor alternatiewe sorgroetes, insluitend Hear and Treat, Hear and Refer en nie-vervoer. Koördineer sorg oor EMS, Primêre Gesondheidsorg, Gemeenskapsgebaseerde Dienste, Palliatiewe Sorg en Noodsentrum-roetes. Ontwikkel, hersien en handhaaf kliniese protokolle, riglyne en standaard bedryfsprosedures. Monitor pasiëntveiligheid, kliniese gehalte en voldoening aan bestuursvereistes. Analiseer en rapporteer oor kliniese aktiwiteit, uitkomste en diensprestasie. Verskaf opleiding, mentorskap en kliniese ondersteuning aan EMS- en Kliniese Hub-personeel. Ondersteun diensherontwerp-inisiatiewe om toegang tot sorg en pasiëntuitkomste te verbeter. Dra by tot evaluering en deurlopende verbetering van die Kliniese Hub-model.

zu.title: Umoguli wezezemplilo izinga 1 kuya ku-3 (CLINICAL HUB)
zu.summary: Umoguli wezezemplilo izinga 1 kuya ku-3 ohlinzeka ngobuqhatshe bezezemplilo nokuhlola ngocingo ngaphakathi kwe-EMS Clinical Hub e-Western Cape.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zemfundo ezingaphansi kwazo: Isitifiketi esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa kwinzubongxaxha yabasebenzi besikhathi: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezokwelapha. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho sipiliyoni lapho kubhaliswe njengompraktisi wezokwelapha kwi-HPCSA maqondana nasebasebenzini abatholiswe iziqu eSouth Africa. Isipiliyoni esihleli unyaka owodwa lapho kubhaliswe njengompraktisi wezokwelapha kwinzubongxaxha yamaprofeshini wezempilo ebaliwe ngaphandle, maqondana nasebasebenzini abatholiswe iziqu ngaphandle, abangadingi ukwenza isevisi yomphakathi njengokuqanjwe eSouth Africa. Izinga 2: Ucobo oluncane kweminyaka engu-5 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengompraktisi wezokwelapha lapho kubhaliswe kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezokwelapha maqondana nasebasebenzini abatholiswe iziqu eSouth Africa. Ucobo oluncane kweminyaka engu-6 yesipiliyoni elihleli lapho kubhaliswe njengompraktisi wezokwelapha kwinzubongxaxha yezempilo ebaliwe ngaphandle maqondana nasebasebenzini abatholiswe iziqu ngaphandle, abangadingi ukwenza isevisi yomphakathi njengokuqanjwe eSouth Africa. Izinga 3: Ucobo oluncane kweminyaka engu-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengompraktisi wezokwelapha lapho kubhaliswe kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezokwelapha maqondana nasebasebenzini abatholiswe iziqu eSouth Africa. Ucobo oluncane kweminyaka engu-11 yesipiliyoni elihleli lapho kubhaliswe njengompraktisi wezokwelapha kwinzubongxaxha yamaprofeshini wezempilo ebaliwe ngaphandle maqondana nasebasebenzini abatholiswe iziqu ngaphandle, abangadingi ukwenza isevisi yomphakathi njengokuqanjwe eSouth Africa. Isidingo esingaphakathi somsebenzi: Ilayisense yokuqasha ekhona (B/EB). Ukulungele ukubamba ingxenye ekusekeleni izimiso emva kwehora lomsebenzi ngenxa yesidingo. Ikhono elokusebenza ngaphakathi kwendawo ephilayo yezokwelapha. Ikhono elokwenza izinqumo eziyimbuso ngokwezokwelapha nokuhlinzeka ngobuqhatshe bezezemplilo. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikhali): Ulwazi ngamasistimu wezokwelapha, izindlela eziseduze zezokwelapha kanye nokuqondisa iziphezulu. Ulwazi ngolawulo lezokwelapha, ukuphepha kwesiguli kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa izinga. Ukuqonda okumayelana namasevisi wezokwelapha wesimo esiphuthumayo kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwamasistimu wezokwelapha. Ikhono lokwenza ukwahlwa ngocingo ngokwezokwelapha kanye nokuqoqaniswa kobungozi. Izikhali eziphezulu zokuxhumana, okubonwayo nokuhlobana nabantu. Ikhono elihle elokuhlaziya, lokuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha kumuhle wokuqasha e-Microsoft Office. Ikhono elokwakha kanye nolondoloza ubudlelwano obuphilayo nabahlinzeki bezokwelapha kanye nabanikazi bomphakathi.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngobuqhatshe bezezemplilo kanye nolawulo ngaphakathi kwe-EMS Clinical Hub. Yenza ukwahlwa ngocingo ngokwezokwelapha, ukuqondisa kanye nokuqoqaniswa kobungozi kwabakhethiwe abasigulini. Sekela ukwabiwa kwamasistimu e-EMS okufanele, ukuphakanyiswa kanye nokuqondisa isiguli. Hlinzeka ngolawulo oluphilayo kwezindlela ezihlukene zezokwelapha, okuhlanganisa ukuLalela futhi uWelapha, ukuLalela futhi uQondise, kanye nokungahambisi. Qondanisa inakekelwa emaweni e-EMS, e-Primary Healthcare, e-Community Based Services, e-Palliative Care kwezindlela ze-Emergency Centre. Yakhisa, phinda ubuke futhi ulondoloze izinqumo zezokwelapha, imihlolowalo kanye nemiyalo yokusebenza ewujwayelo. Lengisa ukuphepha kwesiguli, izinga lezokwelapha kanye nokuzelelwa kwezidingo zolawulo. Hlaziya futhi wenze umbiko ngezenzo eziphilayo, imiphumela kanye nentengo yesevisi. Hlinzeka ngokuqeqesha, ukuyala kanye nosekelo lwezezemplilo kubasebenzi be-EMS kanye ne-EMS Clinical Hub. Sekela ukushintshwa kwezinhlelo zesevisi ukuze kulungise ukufinyelela ezokunakekelwa kanye nemiphumela yesiguli. Yidale kwelokuhlola nokuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo kohlelo lwe-Clinical Hub.

Ukubhalisa kwibhungo lemveli: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezonyundo. Ikwakhululeko lokusebenza: Inqanaba 1: Akukho kufunekayo emva kokubhalisa njengompraktisi wezonyundo kwi-HPCSA malunga nabasebenzi abafunde e-South Africa. Umva wonyaka owodwa wokufunda okubalulekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengompraktisi wezonyundo kwiBhungo Lezonyundo Lemveli elivunyelweyo malunga nabasebenzi abafunde kwamanye amazwe, abangafunekiyo ukwenza Inkonzo Yoluntu njengoko kufunwa e-South Africa. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-5 yokuhlala ibali lokusebenza njengompraktisi wezonyundo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezonyundo malunga nabasebenzi abafunde e-South Africa. Ubuncinane beminyaka esi-6 yokufunda okubalulekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengompraktisi wezonyundo kwiBhungo Lezonyundo Lemveli elivunyelweyo malunga nabasebenzi abafunde kwamanye amazwe, abangafunekiyo ukwenza Inkonzo Yoluntu njengoko kufunwa e-South Africa. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-10 yokuhlala ibali lokusebenza njengompraktisi wezonyundo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezonyundo malunga nabasebenzi abafunde e-South Africa. Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-11 yokufunda okubalulekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengompraktisi wezonyundo kwiBhungo Lezonyundo Lemveli elivunyelweyo malunga nabasebenzi abafunde kwamanye amazwe, abangafunekiyo ukwenza Inkonzo Yoluntu njengoko kufunwa e-South Africa. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kumsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (B/EB) esemthethweni. Ukuzithanda ukuthatha inxaxheba kuncedo lokuqhuba emva kweeyure zokusebenza xa kufunwa. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphakathi kweNdalo yezempilo eguquguqukayo. Ukuba nakho ukwenza izigqibo ezize ngokwezonyundo kwaye unike intshayelelo yezonyundo. Iimpawu zokuba nakho (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi ngamacebo ezeempilo, iindlela zokusingatha iigumba ezingeziyo kunye neenkqubo zokuqhelisa abaguli. Ulwazi ngolawulo lwezonyundo, ikhuselo labaguli kunye neendlela zokuphucula umgangatho. Ukuqonda iinkonzo zonyango lwegeza ezingeziyo kunye nokuqhagamshelwa kweNdalo yezeempilo. Ukuba nakho ukwenza iinkqubo zokuqwalasela ngomnxeba kwaye uqwalasele ingozi. Amakhono amakhulu okunxibelelanayo, okubonisa nokuqonda ngabanye. Ukuba namakhono amakhulu okuhlalutya, ukuxazulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo. Ukubhalisele ekusebenziseni iinkqubo zeMicrosoft Office. Ukuba nakho ukuyila kwaye ugcine ubudlelwane obusebenzayo nabakho nkqubo ezezonjongo zonyango namalungu abanelo.
xh.duties: Nika intshayelelo yezonyundo nolawulo ngaphakathi kweZiko Lezonyundo le-EMS. Qwalasela izigulo ngokunxibelelwana ngefowuni, uqwalasele ukubaluleka nengozi kwabaguli abakhethiweyo. Nceda ngokusetyenziswa kweempahla ze-EMS, ukunyuswa kweenqanaba nokuqhagamshela kwabaguli. Nika ulawulo lwezonyundo kwiindlela ezize zonke zokunyanga, kuquka ukuva kwaye ulungelelise, ukuva kwaye wabeleke, kwaye ungasuki nabaguli. Linganisa inkonzo kwi-EMS, ezeMpilo Ephantsi, Iinkonzo Ezenziwa Kwindlu, Ukunyanga Amanyathelo Okugqibela kunye neNdlela ezoKuvakalelwa iNgxwabangxwaba. Yila, phinda uqwalasele kwaye ugcine iinkqubo ezize zona ezibhekisa kwezonyundo, iinkqubo ezisemthethweni nendlela entle yokusebenza. Qwalasela ikhuselo labaguli, umgangatho wezonyundo nokuqwalasela iimfuno zolawulo. Hlalutya kwaye ingabha ngomsebenzi wezonyundo, iziphumo ngenkonzo. Yazi kwaye ncedisa nabasebenzi be-EMS nabaSebenzi beZiko Lezonyundo ngokukhanya. Nceda nokuqwalasela iinkqubo zokuyila ngokutsha inkonzo ukuphucula ukufikelela kulonyango kwizigulo. Yenda kwiZiko Lezonyundo ukunokuba namandla okulunga nalisebe lesi.

jobs.title: Operational Manager Nursing (SPECIALTY: Psychiatry)
jobs.summary: Operational Manager Nursing post at Valkenburg Hospital specialising in psychiatry, requiring SANC registration and a post-basic qualification in Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R880) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year accredited with the SANC in Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science (R212). OR a 4-year bachelor’s degree in nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Mental Health Nursing. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. Experience: A minimum of 9 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 5 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience in Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science after obtaining the one-year post-basic qualification in Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science(R212) or a post-graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Mental Health Nursing. Inherent requirements of the job: Work night duty on a planned schedule to relief the night manager. A Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s licence. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of legal framework and regulations regarding nursing practice. Good leadership and people management skills, maintain constructive relationships with members of the multi-disciplinary team. Computer literacy. Basic financial management skills. The ability to communicate (verbal and written).
jobs.duties: Ensure adherence to MHCA prescripts and other legislation. Effective management of the ward, hospital after hours, over weekends and public holidays on a planned basis and maintain good working relationships amongst all members of staff. Manage and monitor the effective utilisation of human, financial and physical resources as per departmental policies. Co-ordinate and actively participate in focused training and development of permanent staff and nursing students according to development plan. Participate in analysis, formulation and implementation of nursing guidelines, practices, standards and procedures.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleegkunde (SPESIALITEIT: Psigiatrie)
af.summary: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleegkunde-pos by Valkenburg Hospital wat in psigiatrie spesialiseer, waarvoor SANC-registrasie en 'n na-grondse kwalifikasie in Gevorderde Psigiatriese Verpleegkunde-wetenskap vereis word.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R880) wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegstersraad (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 'n Na-grondse verpleegkunde-kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar wat by die SANC geakkrediteer is in Gevorderde Psigiatriese Verpleegkunde-wetenskap (R212). OF 'n 4-jarige bachelorsgraad in verpleegkunde (R174) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegstersraad (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) wat by die SANC geakkrediteer is in Gesondheidsorg-verpleegkunde. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 9 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 5 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in Gevorderde Psigiatriese Verpleegkunde-wetenskap wees na verkryging van die eenjarige na-grondse kwalifikasie in Gevorderde Psigiatriese Verpleegkunde-wetenskap (R212) of 'n nagraadse diploma (R635) wat by die SANC geakkrediteer is in Gesondheidsorg-verpleegkunde. Inherent vereistes van die pos: Werk nagdiens volgens 'n beplande rooster om die nagbestuurder te ontlast. 'n Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van die regsraamwerk en regulasies rakende verpleegkundepraktyk. Goeie leierskap en mensebestuursvaardighede, handhaaf konstruktiewe verhoudings met lede van die multidissiplinêre span. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Basiese finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Die vermoë om te kommunikeer (mondelings en skriftelik).
af.duties: Verseker nakoming van MHCA-voorskrifte en ander wetgewing. Effektiewe bestuur van die saal, die hospitaal buite kantoorure, oor naweke en openbare vakansiedae op 'n beplande basis en handhaaf goeie werksverhoudinge onder alle lede van die personeel. Bestuur en monitor die effektiewe benutting van menslike, finansiële en fisiese hulpbronne volgens departementele beleid. Koördineer en neem aktief deel aan gefokusde opleiding en ontwikkeling van permanente personeel en verpleegkunde-studente volgens die ontwikkelingsplan. Neem deel aan ontleding, formulering en implementering van verpleegkunde-riglyne, praktyke, standaarde en prosedures.

zu.title: Umphathi Womsebenzi Wezokunakekelwa Abagulayo (ISIKHUNGUZO: Izingqondo)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi womsebenzi wezokunakekelwa abagulayo eValkenburg Hospital esigxile ezingqondweni, esifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC nethemuzi elingenamazinga abhaliswe ekuqalisweni kwemfundo ephakeme eNzululwazi Yokunakekela Abagula Beningqondo.
zu.requirements: Ithemu lokufundela okuncane: Ithemu elisisiseko R425 (okuyi-diploma/degree yokunakekela abagulayo) noma elithemu elilinganayo (R683 kanye ne-R880) elivumela ukubhaliswa kunhlaka yaseNingizimu Afrika Yokunakekela Abagulayo (SANC) njengongongikazi oPhezulu. Ithemu lokunakekela abagulayo elingenamazinga ngenani unyaka oyedwa oseduze nobhaliswe kwi-SANC eNzululwazi Yokunakekela Abagula Beningqondo eNqulu (R212). Noma i-bachelor's degree eminyaka emine yokunakekela abagulayo (R174) noma elithemu elilinganayo (R171 kanye no-R1497) elivumela ukubhaliswa kunhlaka yaseNingizimu Afrika Yokunakekela Abagulayo (SANC) njengongongikazi oPhezulu. I-post graduate diploma (R635) eseduze nobhaliswe kwi-SANC eNokunakekela Abagula Bezokuhlakanipha. Ukubhaliswa kunhlaka yemisebenzi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengongongikazi oPhezulu. Isipiliyoni: Unyaka angu-9 ophumelelayo/obubonakalayo bokunakekela abagulayo emva kokubhaliswa njengongongikazi oPhezulu kwi-SANC eNokunakekela Abagulayo Abajwayelekile. okungenani iminyaka engu-5 yesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube yisipiliyoni esifanele/esibonakalayo eNzululwazi Yokunakekela Abagula Beningqondo eNqulu emva kokuthola ithemu elingenamazinga elingunyaka oyedwa eNzululwazi Yokunakekela Abagula Beningqondo eNqulu(R212) noma i-post-graduate diploma (R635) eseduze nobhaliswe kwi-SANC eNokunakekela Abagula Bezokuhlakanipha. Izidingo ezingokwemvelo womsebenzi: Ukusebenza umsebenzi wasebusuku ngohlelo olucwangqisiwe ukuze lusise umphathi webusuku. Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Ikhono (ulwazi/izindlela): Ulwazi ngemigidingo nemithetho mayelana nomzamo wokunakekela abagulayo. Ikhono elihle lokuba ngumholi nokuphatha abantu, ukugcina ubudlelwano obwakha phakathi kwamalungu eqembu elikhethwe emikhakheni eminingi. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ikhono elisisiseko lokuphi imali. Ikhono lokuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe).
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukulandelela imithetho ye-MHCA neminye imithetho. Ukuphatha ngokusebenzayo kwendlale, esibhedlela emva kwamahora asemthethweni, phakathi kweekhomishini ngezinsuku zokuphumula zomphakathi ngohlelo olucwangqisiwe kanye nokugcina ubuhlobo obuhle bokusebenza phakathi kwabo bonke abasebenzi. Phatha futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwemali, kwezimali nakwezinto ngokwemigagnonqondo yomnyango. Yibambisise futhi ubambe iqhaza elibaluleke ekufundeni nasekuthuthukiseni abasebenzi abasisigxile kanye nabafundi abanakekela abagulayo ngokohlulelweni lomtholampilo. Bukela iqhaza ekuhlaziyeni, ekubhaleni nasekuqaliseni imigagnonqondo yokunakekela abagulayo, izinto ezenziwayo, amazinga nasezinqumweni.

xh.title: UMlawuli weMisebenzi yoKhathalelo (IINDABA EZIKHETHILEYO: Ukuxilunga kwengcinga)
xh.summary: Isithuba somLawuli weMisebenzi yoQhathalelo eValkenburg Hospital eQhathalelweni lokhathalelo lweengcinga, efunwa ukuba abhalwe kwiSANC abe nakhondo epheleleyo eAdvanced Psychiatric Nursing Science.
xh.requirements: Imininngcango yokugqithisa kwamakhondo ubuchule: Ikhwalifayeshoni yamakhondo e-R425 (okt. iDiploma/Zalo mfundo kwikhathalelo) okanye ikhwalifayeshoni elingenelo (R683 plus R880) evumayo ubhalo kunye neSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomrhululiwe wokhathalelo. Ikhwalifayeshoni yakhondo epheleleyo kwindlela eqhuba phakathi kweminyaka eyi-1 edityaniswe kunye ne-SANC kwiAdvanced Psychiatric Nursing Science (R212). OKT. iBachelors ye-Zalo mfundo kwikhathalelo kwiminyaka eyi-4 (R174) okanye ikhwalifayeshoni elinganeko (R171 plus R1497) evumayo ubhalo kunye ne-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomrhululiwe. Ikhwalifayeshoni epheleleyo (R635) edityaniswe kunye ne-SANC kwiMental Health Nursing. Ubhalo kunye lenkundla yamakhondo: Ubhalo kunye ne-SANC njengomrhululiwe. Isipili: Ukusuka kwakhona okanye oluvilekileyo eminyakeni elithi-11 kwiAdvanced Psychiatric Nursing Science kwindlela eqhuba phakathi kweminyaka eyi-1 epheleleyo kwiAdvanced Psychiatric Nursing Science (R212) okanye ekhwalifayeshoni epheleleyo (R635) edityaniswe kunye ne-SANC kwiMental Health Nursing.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuthobela imigaqo ye-MHCA nemithetho eseqongqothweni. Ukulawula ngokusebenzayo igumbi lokhululewe, isibhedlele emva womsebenzi wemini, nangaphezu kweweekend nakumihla yikhofu ngohlengo olucwangcisweyo, kwaye ugcine ubuhlobo obulokuqhubana kubo bonke abasebenzi. Lawula kwakunye nokulola ukusebenziswa ngokusebenzayo koBoyiko bezimali, abantu neendawo njengoko kubekwe ngumgaqo-nkqubo we-isebe. Qhagamshela kwaye uthathe inxaxheba ekuyivenesi nakuphuhliswa ngokukhethwa kwabasebenki abasisigxina nabafundi bokhathalelo njengoko kucaciswe kwicebo lokuphuhliswa. Thathe inxaxheba kumanalisi, ukubakwa nokuphunywa kwemigaqo yokhathalelo, iinkqubo, amilinganiselo neendlela zokwenza.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Manager Hospital Development (5/8TH
jobs.salary_text: R582 684 (5/8th) per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs).
jobs.summary: Manage strategic planning and implementation of the Tygerberg Hospital PPP redevelopment project, engaging stakeholders and supporting the Director.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: An appropriate qualification (NQF level 7) in a related field (Business Administration / Economics or Property Studies). Experience: Appropriate experience in the role of Manager or Senior Manager at complex institutions involving multiple stakeholders and professional disciplines. Appropriate experience in planning and/or delivery of PPP projects. Appropriate experience in infrastructure project management. Appropriate experience in Health facility management. Appropriate experience in Stakeholder engagement. Appropriate experience in public Private Partnerships (PPP) from inception to implementation (I.e. drafting of PPP contract documentation, negotiations and implementation). Appropriate experience in contract management. Inherent requirements of the job: Ability to work extended hours (after hours and weekends) when required. Valid driver’s license Code B/EB. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge and experience of programme and project management processes and methodologies related to the health environment, including planning, financial management, information systems, monitoring, and reporting. Knowledge and experience of relevant public sector legislation (e.g., PFMA) and infrastructure delivery processes and systems, with reference to the National Treasury PPP Regulation 16. Advanced computer literacy (Microsoft Office) and ability to use Project Management and graphics applications. Excellent verbal and written communication skills including presentations. The ability to independently analyse information and produce documents of a high standard.
jobs.duties: Strategic planning for the redevelopment, management and implementation of the PPP central hospital project. Engage with relevant stakeholders of affected institutions in the project cycle and ensure on going consultation and buy-in from relevant stakeholders. Assist the Director with the development of Request for Proposal (RFP) documentation for a new Central Hospital. Assist the Director with negotiations and management of the PPP contract as directed. Budget management updating of expenditure and output targets. Assist the Director with administration and development functions.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Bestuurder Hospitaalontwikkeling (5/8TH
af.summary: Bestuur strategiese beplanning en implementering van die Tygerberg Hospital PPP-herontwikkelingsprojek, betrek belanghebbendes en ondersteun die Direkteur.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) in 'n verwante veld (Besigsheidsadministrasie / Ekonomie of Eiendomstudies). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in die rol van Bestuurder of Senior Bestuurder by komplekse instellings wat veelvuldige belanghebbendes en professionele dissiplines behels. Toepaslike ervaring in beplanning en/of aflewering van PPP-projekte. Toepaslike ervaring in infrastruktuurprojekbestuur. Toepaslike ervaring in gesondheidsfasiliteitsbestuur. Toepaslike ervaring in belanghebbedebetrokkenheid. Toepaslike ervaring in openbaar-privaat vennootskappe (PPP) vanaf ontstaan tot implementering (d.w.s. opstel van PPP-kontrakdokumentasie, onderhandelinge en implementering). Toepaslike ervaring in kontrakbestuur. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Vermoë om lang ure (na ure en naweke) te werk wanneer nodig. Geldige bestuurderslisensie Kode B/EB. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis en ervaring van program- en projekbestuursprosesse en -metodologieë wat verband hou met die gesondheidsomgewing, insluitend beplanning, finansiële bestuur, inligtingstelsels, monitering en verslagdoening. Kennis en ervaring van relevante openbare sektor wetgewing (bv. PFMA) en infrastruktuurafleweringsprosesse en -stelsels, met verwysing na die National Treasury PPP Regulasie 16. Gevorderde rekenaarvaardigheid (Microsoft Office) en vermoë om Projekbestuur- en grafikatoepassings te gebruik. Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede insluitend voorleggings. Die vermoë om onafhanklik inligting te ontleed en dokumente van 'n hoë standaard te produseer.
af.duties: Strategiese beplanning vir die herontwikkeling, bestuur en implementering van die PPP-sentrale hospitaalprojek. Raadpleeg relevante belanghebbendes van geaffekteerde instellings in die projek siklus en verseker voortdurende konsultasie en ondersteuning van relevante belanghebbendes. Ondersteun die Direkteur met die ontwikkeling van Request for Proposal (RFP)-dokumentasie vir 'n nuwe sentrale hospitaal. Ondersteun die Direkteur met onderhandelinge en bestuur van die PPP-kontrak soos aangewys. Begrotingsbestuur opdatering van uitgawes en uitsetteikens. Ondersteun die Direkteur met administrasie- en ontwikkelingsfunksies.

zu.title: Iseluleki: Umphathi Wokuthuthukiswa KweSibhedlela (5/8TH
zu.summary: Phatha ukuhlela okuyisinqumo nokuphumezisa iphrojekthi yokuthuthukisa kabusha i-Tygerberg Hospital PPP, ukuxoxa nabahlotshanisi nokusekela uMqondisi.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo okuncane kakhulu: Ithifikheyithi elifanele (NQF level 7) enkundleni ehlobene (Business Administration / Economics noma Property Studies). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele esibukweni somphathi noma umphathi ophakeme ezikhungweni eziyinkimbinkimbi ezibandakanya abahlotshanisi abaningi nezinkalo zobuchwepheshe. Isipiliyoni esifanele ekuhleleni noma ekulethweni kwezinhlelo ze-PPP. Isipiliyoni esifanele ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo zokwakheka. Isipiliyoni esifanele ekuphathweni kwemitholombo yezempilo. Isipiliyoni esifanele ekuxosheni nabahlotshanisi. Isipiliyoni esifanele kuma-Public Private Partnerships (PPP) ukusuka ekuqaleni kokuhlela kuye kokuphumezisa (okungukuthi. ukulunga kwamadokhumenti esivumelwano se-PPP, izingxoxo nokuphumezisa). Isipiliyoni esifanele ekuphathweni kwezivumelwano. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ikono lokusebenza amahora amude (emva kwamahora nangasonto) lapho kudingeka khona. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile Code B/EB. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikhono): Ulwazi nesipiliyoni mayelana nezinhlaka zokuqondisa izinhlelo nemikhuba yokuphatha izinhlelo ohlotshaneni lezempilo, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela, ukuphatha imali, izinhlelo zolwazi, ukulawula, nokubika. Ulwazi nesipiliyono semithetho yomphakathi ehlobene (isb., PFMA) kanye nezinhlaka namakhalendi wokuletha izinto zokwakha, ngereferensi ku-National Treasury PPP Regulation 16. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngobuchwepheshe (Microsoft Office) n ikhono lokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuqondisa amaphrojekthi nezinhlela zomdwebo. Amakhono aphumelelayo okuxoxa nokuqamba ngomlomo nangokubhala okuhlanganisa izethulo. Ikhono lokuhlaziya ulwazi ngokuzimele nokukhiqiza amadokhumenti akumazinga aphezulu.
zu.duties: Ukuhlela okuyisinqumo mayelana nokuthuthukisa kabusha, ukuphatha nokuphumezisa iphrojekthi yesibhedlela esikhulu se-PPP. Xoxa nabahlotshanisi abahlobene bezikhungo ezithintekayo kwesangqa sephrojekthi futhi qinisekisa ukuxoxwa kabusha nokwamukeleka ngabahlotshanisi abahlobene. Siza uMqondisi ekwakheni amadokhumenti e-Request for Proposal (RFP) asesibhedlela Esikhulu Esisha. Siza uMqondisi kuzinkingxoxo nasekuphathweni kwesivumelwano se-PPP njengokuqondisiwe. Ukuphatha ukwaziswa kwezimali ukuhlaziya izindleko nemiqondo yokukhipha. Siza uMqondisi emisebenzini yokulawula nasekuthuthukisweni.

xh.title: Isekela-Mongameli: Mphathi Wezophulo Lwezigulo (5/8TH
xh.summary: Phatha uqeqesho-lwemigaqo nokuqwalaselwa kweprojekthi yokwazisa kwakhona i-Tygerberg Hospital PPP, ukuzibandakanya nabathathi-nxaxheba kwaye uncede uMongameli.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ephakamileyo: Isifundo esifanelekileyo (NQF level 7) kwicala elinxulumene nalo (Business Administration / Economics or Property Studies). Isipili: Isipili esifanelekileyo kwicala likaMphathi okanye uMphathi oPhakamileyo kweziwele ezinobunzima nabanabathathi-nxaxheba abaninzi nemiyinge yabongenzi-bungcali. Isipili esifanelekileyo ekulungeniseni kunye/nokuphatha iiprojekthi ze-PPP. Isipili esifanelekileyo ekulawulweni kweeprojekthi zolwakhiwo. Isipili esifanelekileyo ekulawulweni kweziko lezigulo. Isipili esifanelekileyo ekubambisweni nabathathi-nxaxheba. Isipili esifanelekilezo kwi-Public Private Partnerships (PPP) ekuqaleni kwaye nakusebenzisweni (okt. ukulungiswa kwamagama esiNxaxheba se-PPP, iingxoxo nokuqwalaselwa). Isipili esifanelekileyo ekulawulweni kweenkonzo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kwomsebenzi: Ukuba nakho ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo (emva kweeyure nangamawekendi) xa kufuneka. Ilayiseni yokuqhuba esemthethweni ye-Code B/EB. Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi nisipili kwiinkqubo nendlela zolawulo lweenkqubo neeprojekthi ezinxulumene nemo yezempiro, kuquka uqeqesho, ulawulo lweemali, iinkqubo zolwazi, ulawulo lwengxelo nokuvelisa iingxelo. Ulwazi nisipili ngomthetho wepalamente ofanelekileyo (umz., PFMA) nasekuqhubeni iinkqubo nendlela zolwakhiwo, ngereferensi ku-National Treasury PPP Regulation 16. Ulwazi oluphezulu lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Office) nendlela yokusebenzisa ulawulo lweeprojekthi nosetyenziso lwemizobo. Amakhono aphezulu okuthetha nobhalo nokuvezwa kolwazi. Ukuba nakho ukuhlaziya ulwazi ngokuzimeleyo nokuphatha amaxwebhu angumgangatho ophezulu.
xh.duties: Uqeqesho-lwemigaqo lokwazisa kwakhona, ulawulo nokuqwalaselwa kweprojekthi ye-PPP yaseziko lezigulo eliphakathi. Ukubamba isithiyo nabathathi-nxaxheba abafanelekileyo basezikhululo ezithintekayo kwisikhathi seprojekthi nokuqinisekisa intsebenziswano ngokuqhubekayo nokuqinisekiswa ngabathathi-nxaxheba. Ukunceda uMongameli ekuphathweni kolwazi lwe-Request for Proposal (RFP) lwaseziko lezigulo eliphakathi elitsha. Ukunceda uMongameli kwiingxoxo nolawulo lesivumelwano se-PPP njengako. Ulawulo lwe-nga-mali lweeKhompyutha nokuhlaziya iindleko nemiqulu yokuphuma. Ukunceda uMongameli kwimisebenzi yolawulo nentlculo-ntlwano.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Human Resource Management (PEOPLE
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Human Resource Management at the Department of Health and Wellness Head Office in Cape Town, overseeing people administration services.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate National Diploma (NQF 6) or equivalent in Human Resources or related field. Experience: Extensive experience in People Administration. Appropriate supervisory or management experience. Extensive experience in PERSAL and Conditions of Service. Inherent requirements of the job: A valid Code B/EB driver’s license. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Sound knowledge of relevant government and departmental policies, legislation and People Administration practices. Good managerial, strategic thinking and planning skills. Strong computer literacy, including proficiency in Microsoft Office. Sound knowledge of employee relations practices and policies.
jobs.duties: Manage People Administration services for Head Office, including appointments, secondments, transfers, probation, OSD matters, terminations, allowances and leave administration. Coordinate transversal People Administration functions, including Long Service Awards, SMS employment contracts and related transversal matters. Manage PERSAL, salaries and allowances, ensuring accurate and compliant administration. Coordinate audit and compliance requirements, including HR audits, Internal Audit and Auditor- General processes for Head Office. Administer ORW and financial disclosure requirements for Head Office. Optimal management and development of staff in the component. Provide advice and guidance to Head Office management and institutions on People Administration policies, practices and Conditions of Service.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Applicants will be required to undergo practical and competency testing. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Menslike Hulpbronbestuur (PEOPLE
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir Menslike Hulpbronbestuur by die Department of Health and Wellness se Hoofkantoor in Cape Town, wat die administrasie van personeelsdienste oorsien.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike National Diploma (NQF 6) of gelykwaardig in Menslike Hulpbronne of verwante veld. Ervaring: Uitgebreide ervaring in personeelsadministrasie. Toepaslike toesig- of bestuurservaring. Uitgebreide ervaring in PERSAL en Diensvoorwaardes. Inherent vereistes van die werk: 'n Geldige Code B/EB-bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Deeglike kennis van toepaslike regerings- en departementele beleide, wetgewing en personeelsadministrasiepraktyke. Goeie bestuurs-, strategiese denke en beplanningsvaardighede. Sterk rekenaarvaardigheid, insluitend vaardigheid in Microsoft Office. Deeglike kennis van werknemerverhoudingspraktyke en -beleid.
af.duties: Bestuur personeelsadministrasiedienste vir die Hoofkantoor, insluitend aanstellings, tweedings, oorplasings, proefperiodes, OSD-aangeleenthede, beëindigings, toelaes en verlofadministrasie. Koördineer transversale personeelsadministrasiefunksies, insluitend Langdienspryse, SMS-dienskontrakte en verwante transversale aangeleenthede. Bestuur PERSAL, salarisse en toelaes, en verseker akkurate en voldoenende administrasie. Koördineer oudit- en nakomingsvereistes, insluitend HR-oudits, Interne Oudit en Auditor-General-prosesse vir die Hoofkantoor. Administreer ORW- en finansiële openbaarmakingsvereistes vir die Hoofkantoor. Optimale bestuur en ontwikkeling van personeel in die komponent. Verskaf advies en leiding aan Hoofkantoorbestuur en instellings oor personeelsadministrasiebeleid, -praktyke en Diensvoorwaardes.

zu.title: Isikhundla sikasomlungisi: Izinsiza Zomuntu (ABANTU
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikasomlungisi sezinsiza zabantu eNqulajini Ephambili yomnyango wezempilo kahle kulesikhungo eCape Town, sibuka izinsiza zokuphathwa kabantu.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo okuncane kakhudu: I-diploma yesizwe efanele (NQF 6) noma okulinganayo kwezinsiza zabantu noma endaweni ehlobene. Isipilihongo: Isipilihongo esibanzi ekuphathweni kabantu. Isipilihongo esifanele sokubukeka noma sokuphatha. Isipilihongo esibanzi kwi-PERSAL nezimo zokusebenza. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela ye-Code B/EB esemthethweni. Amandla (ulwazi/izikhali): Ulwazi oluhle lwemithetho yokuphathwa kahle kahulumeni nomyango, nezinqamuleli nezindlela zokuphathwa kabantu. Izikhali eziphatha kahle, zokuqonda isimo ngokobuchwepheshe nezokuhlela. Ulwazi olunamandla ngokusebenzisa isikhombi, okuhlanganisa nokwazi kahle iMicrosoft Office. Ulwazi oluhle ngenqubo namapholisi ezinhlangano zabasebenzi.
zu.duties: Phatha izinsiza zokuphathwa kabantu zeNqola Ephambili, okuhlanganisa ukumiswa kwabasebenzi, ukuhlelwa kabusha, ukudluliswa, isikhathi sokuzama, izindaba ze-OSD, ukupheliswa kwesikhathi, izimali ezongeziwe nokuphathwa kweholo. Hlela ngokubambisana imisebenzi yokuphathwa kabantu ezungezile, okuhlanganisa nezibekelo zokukhonza isikhathi eside, amakhasimisi abasebenzi be-SMS nezinye izindaba ezungezile. Phatha i-PERSAL, amaholo nezimali ezongeziwe, ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa okuyiqiniso nokuqondana nemithetho. Hlela ngokubambisana izidingo zokuqinisekiswa nokubukeka, okuhlanganisa nokubukeka kwe-HR, ukubukeka kwangaphakathi kanye nendlela yeAuditor-General yeNqola Ephambili. Phatha izidingo ze-ORW nezokwaziswa ngezimali zeNqola Ephambili. Phonga ukuphathwa nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi endaweni. Nikeza izeluleki nokuqondisa abaphathi beNqola Ephambili nezikhungo ngenqubo yokuphathwa kabantu, izindlela nezimo zokusebenza.

xh.title: Oncedo limestone: Ulawulo lwezeNzala zomXholo (ABANTU
xh.summary: Oncedo limestone woLawulo lwezeNzala zomXholo eNtabeni iSebe lezeMpilo neZemihlala eKapa Town, oluphatha iinkonzo zolawulo labantu.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso sobungangichwanga esincinci: iDiploma yeSizwe efanelekileyo (NQF 6) okanye esilinganayo kwindawo yabaNtu abasebenzayo okwaloo ndawo edibana nayo. Isipili: Isipili esibanzi ekulawulweni kweNqubo zolawulo abaNtu. Isipili esifanelekileyo sokulawula okanye sokulawula nendlela ebanzi. Isipili esibanzi kwiPERSAL nakuMigaqo yoLwazi lomSebenzi. Iimfuno zangaphakathi zomsebenzi: ilayisenisi yokuqhuba evakalayo yeCode B/EB. Iimfundo (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi oluqinileyo ngemigaqo karhulumente nesebe, ulwesi-mthetho nendlela zokuLawula abaNtu. Amakhono obulungisa oluhle, okucinga ngendlela eqondo kwaye uluhlelo lokuqamba. Ulwazi olunamandla ngokusebenzisa iikhompyutha, kuquka nobuchule kwiMicrosoft Office. Ulwazi oluqinileyo ngendleza namagqaqoob bokunxulumana nabasebenzi.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkonzo zokuLawula abaNtu kundlu enkulu yeNdawo, kuquka ukumisela abantu, ukubekwa kwesikhundla, ukudlulisela, ukuzama, izindaba zeOSD, ukuphela kweekontrakti, imvuzo yongezelelweyo nolawulo lwango-yeseti. Hlanganisa iinkonzo ezijikeleze zokuLawula abaNtu, kuquka iNkomfa ziNxibelelwana zoBude obuDe, iinkontrakti zobusebenzi beSMS nendlebo ezijikeleze edibana nazo. Lawula iPERSAL, imivuzo namvuzo yongezelelweyo, ukuqinisekisa ukuba kulawulo oluchanekileyo nolulandela imigaqo. Hlanganisa iimfuno zokuvavanya nokuzelelana, kuquka ukuvavanya iHR, ukuVavanya ngaphakathi kwaye iinkqubo zeVavanyi-Jikelelezendlu enkulu yeNdawo. Lawula iORW neemfuno zokuvelisa izibongo ezimaliniendlu enkulu yeNdawo. Lawula ngokufanelekileyo kuphuhliso lwabasebenzi kwicala. Nikeza isalathiso namacebiso abaphathi bendlu enkulu yeNdawo neendawo malunga namagqaqo nolwazi lweNqubo zokuLawula abaNtu namigaqo yoLwazi lomSebenzi.

jobs.title: Oral Hygienist Grade 1 to 3
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R413 121 per annum Grade 2: R482 499 per annum Grade 3: R564 822 per annum
jobs.summary: Oral Hygienist position with the Western Cape Department of Health offering Grade 1 to 3 roles at primary healthcare clinics and schools in Breede Valley.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows for the required registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as an Oral Hygienist. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Oral Hygienist. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as Oral Hygienist with the HPCSA in respect of SA qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration as Oral Hygienist with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience as Oral Hygienist after registration with the HPCSA as Oral Hygienist in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 11 years relevant experience after registration as Oral Hygienist with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate experience as Oral Hygienist after registration with the HPCSA as Oral Hygienist in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 21 years relevant experience after registration as Oral Hygienist with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid Code EB driver’s licence. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to function independently, as well as in a multi- disciplinary team. Good communication, interpersonal and organising skills, Problem-solving abilities and analytical thinking. Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint).
jobs.duties: Organise and conduct oral health promotion campaigns throughout the Breede Valley Sub District. Rendering of preventive and other oral health services throughout the Breede Valley Sub District at all identified clinics, at creches and schools. Referral to dentist and other health care professionals. Monitoring and evaluation of preventive programmes. Performing administrative duties. Quality Clinical Governance. Professional Ethics. Training. Support Functions.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution/ Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Mondhigiënis Graad 1 tot 3

'n Minimum van 11 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mondhigiënis by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council met betrekking tot buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Mondhigiënis na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mondhigiënis met betrekking tot Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 21 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mondhigiënis by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council met betrekking tot buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Inheemse vereistes van die werk: Geldige Code EB-bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om selfstandig te funksioneer, sowel as in 'n multidissiplinêre span. Goeie kommunikasie-, interpersoonlike en organisatoriese vaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvermoë en analitiese denke. Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Word, Excel en PowerPoint).
af.duties: Organiseer en voer mondgesondheidsbevorderingsveldtogte deur die Breede Valley Sub-distrik. Lewering van preventiewe en ander mondgesondheidsdienste deur die Breede Valley Sub-distrik by alle geïdentifiseerde klinieke, by kleuterskole en skole. Verwysing na tandarts en ander gesondheidsorgprofessionele. Monitering en evaluering van preventiewe programme. Uitvoering van administratiewe pligte. Gehalte Kliniese Bestuur. Professionele Etiek. Opleiding. Ondersteuningsfunksies.

Ikhono elihle lokuxhumana, kwabanye abantu nolokuhlela, Ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga nokucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint).
zu.duties: Hlela futhi wenze imikhankaso yokukhuthaza izempilo yomlomo kulo lonke i-Breede Valley Sub District. Unikeza izinkonzo zokuvikela kanye nezinye izinkonzo zezempilo yomlomo kulo lonke i-Breede Valley Sub District kuzo zonke izikhungo ezitholakalayo, emakreshini nasezikoleni. Ukuthumela kumadokotela bamazinyo nalabo bonke abanye ochwepheshe bezempilo. Ukulawula nokuhlola izinhlelo zokuvikela. Ukwenza imisebenzi yolawulo. I-Quality Clinical Governance. I-Professional Ethics. Ukwafundisa. Imisebenzi Yokwesekela.

xh.summary: Isithuba somhlengi-wezinyo kwiSebe lezempilo leWestern Cape esinika iindima zeGrade 1 ukuya ku-3 kumaziko ezempilo ezenzelwe uluntu nakumaziko emfundweni eBreede Valley.

Grade 3: Isiqondo seeminyaka engama-20 yamava afanelekileyo njengomHlengi-wezinyo emva kokubhaliswa kwiHPCSA njengomHlengi-wezinyo malunga nabasebenzi abathweswe isidanga eMzantsi Afrika. Iimfuno ezibambeneyo zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqhuba ekhoyo yeCode EB. Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Amandla okusebenza aze aze, nakwitim elsebenza ngokuhlanganiswayo. Ukuthumela kubhedi bezinyo nakubanye abasebenzi bempilo. Okuqatshiweyo nokuhlolwa kweenkqubo ezithintela izifo. Ukwenza imisebenzi yolawulo. ISigqeba seMida soQeqesho. Inguqu yabaSozobe ngobuchopho. UQeqesho. Iinkonzo zoKuxhasa.

jobs.title: Senior State Accountant: Financial Accounting
jobs.summary: Senior State Accountant needed at the Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness Head Office to compile financial statements and assess AFS templates.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: An appropriate National Diploma (NQF 6) or equivalent in Accounting/Auditing, or any other relevant qualification inclusive of Financial Accounting III. Experience: Appropriate experience in an accounting environment and preparation of financial statements. Inherent requirements of the job: A valid code B/EB driver’s licence and willingness to travel. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Practical experience with compilation of Financial Statements. Advanced computer literacy in Microsoft Office applications (Excel spreadsheets, report writing and drafting of Word documents, MS PowerPoint presentations), Analytical and presentation skills. Working experience of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and/ or International Standards on Auditing. Knowledge of Modified Cash Standard (MCS) and/or Generally Recognised Accounting. Practice (GRAP) Standards.
jobs.duties: Overall assessment of AFS Template and analysis of the Modified Cash Standard. Compilation of Interim and Annual Financial Statements and assist with implementation/compliance iro AFS Disclosure Notes inputs. Provide guidance/advice around accounting issues iro AFS. Research, analyse and compile implementation plans iro Accounting standards. Compliance: Monthly/quarterly disclosure/financial reporting. Research, analyse and interpret accounting information. Project Management. Supervisory functions.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Short-listed candidates may be required to do a computer literacy test and presentation as part of the evaluation process. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Senior Staatrekenmeester: Finansiële Rekenkunde
af.summary: Senior Staatrekenmeester benodig by die Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness Hoofkantoor om finansiële state op te stel en AFS-sjablone te assesseer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) of ekwivalent in Rekenkunde/Oudit, of enige ander tersaaklike kwalifikasie ingesluit Finansiële Rekenkunde III. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in 'n rekenkundige omgewing en die opstel van finansiële state. Inherent vereistes van die werk: 'n Geldige kode B/EB-bestuurslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Praktiese ervaring met die opstel van Finansiële State. Gevorderde rekenaarvaardigheid in Microsoft Office-toepassings (Excel-sigblaaie, verslagskrywing en opstel van Word-dokumente, MS PowerPoint-aanbiedings), Analitiese en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Werkervaring van International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) en/of International Standards on Auditing. Kennis van Modified Cash Standard (MCS) en/of Generally Recognised Accounting. Practice (GRAP) Standards.
af.duties: Algehele assessering van AFS-sjabloon en ontleding van die Modified Cash Standard. Opstel van Tussentydse en Jaarlikse Finansiële State en bystand met implementering/nakoming iro AFS-openbaringsnotas insette. Verskaf leiding/advies rondom rekenkundige kwessies iro AFS. Navorsing, analise en opstel van implementeringsplanne iro Rekenkundige standaarde. Nakoming: Maandelikse/kwartaaliklike openbaring/finansiële verslagdoening. Navorsing, analise en interpretasie van rekenkundige inligting. Projekbestuur. Toesighoudende funksies.

zu.title: Umcelimangqondo Ophakeme Wezabelo: Ukuze Kusetshenziswe Izimali
zu.summary: Kudingeka umcelimangqondo ophakeme wezabelo eWestern Cape Department of Health and Wellness Head Office ukuze ahlanganise izitatimende zezimali futhi ahlolisise amathempleythi e-AFS.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zemfundo ezingaphansi kwezinga: I-National Diploma (NQF 6) elifanele noma esilinganayo ku-Accounting/Auditing, noma noma yisiphi esinye isifundo esihambisana nalokhu esibandakanya i-Financial Accounting III. Isipiliyono: Isipiliyono esifanele endaweni yezimali nasekulungiseni izitatimende zezimali. Izindingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisense lokushayela lesikhashana i-code B/EB kanye nesifiso sokuhamba. Ikhono (ulwazi/amashebo): Isipiliyono sokwenza ngokomzimba ukuhlunga kwezitatimende zezimali. Ulwazi oluthuthukilewe lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kumohlelo we-Microsoft Office (amaspejula e-Excel, ukubhala imibiko kanye nokubhala amadokhumenti e-Word, imibhalo ye-MS PowerPoint), amashebo wokuqonda kanye nokwethula. Isipiliyono sokusebenza ngemizwelo ye-International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) kanye/noma ngemizwelo yokuhlolisiswa yamazwe ngamazwe. Ulwazi lwe-Modified Cash Standard (MCS) kanye/noma ngaphezulu kokuqashelwa kwezabelo. Amalawu (GRAP) Standards.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola kabusha ngokuphelele ithempleythi ye-AFS nokuhlolisisa i-Modified Cash Standard. Ukuhlanganisa izitatimende zezimali ze-Interim kanye ne-Annual futhi usize ngokuphatha/ukuhambisana okuphathelene nezinkingo zokuvezwa kwe-AFS Disclosure Notes. Ukunika izeluleko/ngeseluleko ngemibuzo yezabelo okuphathelene ne-AFS. Ukucwaninga, ukuhlazisisa futhi uhlanganise izinhlelo zokuphathwa okuphathelene nemizwelo yezabelo. Ukuhambisana: Ukubika kwanyanga zenyanga/ngemakhwetha okuphathelene nokuzulazula/imibiko yezimali. Ukucwaninga, ukuhlazisisa nokuhumusha ulwazi oluphathelene nezabelo. Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi. Imisebenzi yokuhlola abasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho.

xh.title: Ofilembe Lombuso Ophakamileyo: iFaynanshiyali Akhawunting
xh.summary: Kufuneka Ofilembe Lombuso Ophakamileyo kwi Head Office yesebe leWestern Cape Department of Health and Wellness ukwakha iimpawu zefaynanshi kwaye ahloliswe iitempleyiti ze-AFS.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezingaphantsi kwesigaba esifunekayo: I-National Diploma (NQF 6) efanelekileyo okanye eselingana nayo kwi-Accounting/Auditing, okanye nayiphi na nye izifundo ezifanelekileyo eziquka i-Financial Accounting III. Isiphaluka: Isiphaluka esifanelekileyo kwimeko yokwenza ukhawunto kunye nokulungiselela iimpawu zefaynanshi. Iimfuno ezisezimweni zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela ye-code B/EB esebenzayo nokuthanda ukuhamba. Iikhompetensi (ulwazi/amakhono): Isiphaluka esibonwayo ekwakheni iimpawu zefaynanshi. Ulwazi oluphakamileyo lokusebenzisa iikhompyutha kwiinkqubo zeMicrosoft Office (ii-spreadsheet ze-Excel, ukubhala iingxelo nokulungelelanisa amaxwebhu eWord, iinkqubo ze-MS PowerPoint), amakhono okucazulula nokuqhuba iinkqubo. Isiphaluka sokusebenza kwi-International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) nokanye i-International Standards on Auditing. Ulwazi nge-Modified Cash Standard (MCS) nakanye kwi-Generally Recognised Accounting. Iziqendu ze-Practice (GRAP) Standards.
xh.duties: Ukuhlolwa okubanzi kwakhe i-AFS Template nokucazulula i-Modified Cash Standard. Ukwakha iimpawu zefaynanshi ze-Interim nakoNyaka kunye noncedo ekusebenziseni/ukuthobeni iimithetho mayelana ne-AFS Disclosure Notes inputs. Unika inkqubo/icebo malunga neengxaki zakhawunto mayelana ne-AFS. Uphononongo, ukucazulula nokuqokelela iiplani zokusebenzisa iziqendu zakhawunto. Ukuthobela iimithetho: Iingxelo zenyanga/zexeshana ngezifundo/iingxelo zefaynanshi. Uphononongo, ukucazulula nokutolika ulwazi lwakhawunto. Ukuqonda ukulawula amaprojekthi. Imisebenzi yolawulo.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 3 (GENERAL) (NURSING Relief
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R337 359 per annum Grade 2: R411 978 per annum Grade 3: R495 423 per annum
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 3 providing general nursing relief at Alexandra Hospital in the Western Cape, requiring SANC registration.

Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleging. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleging. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om skofte te werk, dag- en nagdiens, naweke en openbare vakansiedae om aan die operasionele vereistes te voldoen. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis en begrip van verpleegsorgprosesse, prosedures, statusse, en ander relevante regs- en etiese praktyke. Rekenaarvaardigheid: MS Office, MS Outlook. Goeie Kommunikasievaardighede en Verslagdoening. Toepaslike ervaring in omvattende verplegingbehandeling en -sorg aan pasiënte in 'n Geestesgesondheidsunit.

zu.title: Ummeli Wezokunakekela Abagulayo Izinga 1 kuya ku-3 (OKUJWAYELEKILE) (UKULUNGISA KWEZOKUNAKEKELA)
zu.summary: Ummeli Wezokunakekela Abagulayo Izinga 1 kuya ku-3 ohlinzeka ngokulungisa izokunakekela okujwayelekile e-Alexandra Hospital e-Western Cape, okudinga ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi kwesidingo: Ikhwalifayeshini ye-Basic R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/idigri ezokunakekela) noma ikhwalifayeshini elingana naleyo (R683 kanye ne-R880) evumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoba ummeli wezokunakekela abagulayo. Ukubhaliswa komkhandlu waboprofeshonale: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoba ummeli wezokunakekela abagulayo. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho. Izinga 2: Isibalo esingaphansi kweminyaka engu-10 yesipiliyoni esivunyelwe ezokunakekela emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoba ummeli wezokunakekela abagulayo ezokunakekela okujwayelekile. Izinga 3: Isibalo esingaphansi kweminyaka engu-20 yesipiliyoni esivunyelwe ezokunakekela emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoba ummeli wezokunakekela abagulayo ezokunakekela okujwayelekile. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ukuzithoba ekusebenzeni amashiphthi, umsebenzi wasemini nasobusuku, ngezonjalo nangamaholide ezithombe ukuze kuhlangabezwe izidingo zokusebenza. Ukulungele ukusebenza kuyo yonke iminyango/iziguli ngokwezidingo zokusebenza zesibhedlela. Ikhomphethensi (ulwazi/amaskhilha): Ulwazi nokuqonda izinqubo, izimiso, izimo, kanye nezinye izinqubo zomthetho nezomagama ezihambisana nezokunakekela. zu.duties: Ukunikezwa kokunakekela okuhle kakhulu, okubanzi ngaphakathi kwezimiso ezisetshiwe nangaphakathi kohlelo lomthetho/lobuprofeshonale. Ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwezinsiza. Ukugcina ukukhula kobuprofeshonale/izimiso zomagama kanye nentuthuko yomuntu. Ukunikezwa kokesekela Kwinzinkonzo Zokunakekela. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekweloleni nasekuviciveni.

I-Grade 3: Isipiliyoni esingaphansi kweminyaka engu-20 okuhambisana/okwaziwayo ekunakekelweni kwezempilo emva kokubhaliswa njengoba umhlengikazi ohleziwe SANC General Nursing. Isidingo esingezelwa: Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi lapho kudingeka. I-License yokushayela evumelekile nokuzithoba ukushayela isithuthi sezempilo esihambahambayo. Ulwazi/ikhono: Ikhono lokuhlela nokuhlela kahle. Ukuzithiba nokuzikhandela. Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa ngaphansi kokucindezela. Ikhono elihle lokuxoxa.
zu.duties: Nika isiqondiso nokuhlola ukusetshenziswa kwenakekelo eliphelele elifanele ngaphakathi kwezinsiza ezingokwezempilo ezisebenza emazingeni okuqala. GCINA ukusebenza okuziphendule okufanele kahle emigqeni yomthetho nemithetho. Hlola ubudlelwano bokusebenza obuhle nabanye bonke abahlose ekhasini lesihei lezempilo. Sebenzisa kahle nangokusebenza ngempumelelo abantu, izinto, izinsiza zemali nemitholampilo etholakalayo. Zibandakanya ezinhlelweni zokuqeqesha futhi uphonsa imibuzo engadla. Gcina ukulawula abantu abangaphansi.

xh.title: Umhlengi Ochwepheshe Inqanaba 1 ukusa kwi-3 (NGOKUBANINZILO: Iinkonzo zeMpilo eziPhambili
xh.summary: Kufuneka umhlengi ochwepheshe eLadismith Clinic eKannaland ukubonelela ngenkonzo yokuhlengwa komzimba ezingabonakalisa imveliso yeenkonzo ezibonelela ngeemfuno zasemaphandleni.
xh.requirements: Isigungi esingentla emfundo: Isigungi esisisiseko se-R425 (okt. idiploma/izidanga kuhlengwa) okt esilinganayo (i-R683 nge-R254) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomHlengi oChwepheshe. OKT Izidanga ezine zobugcisa obuncinane kuhlengwa (i-R174) okt esilinganayo (i-R683 nge-R1497 okt i-R171 nge-R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomHlengi oChwepheshe. Ukubhalisa koluntu ochwepheshe: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengomHlengi oChwepheshe. Isipili: Inqanaba 1: Akukho. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-10 isipili esifanelekileyo/esiqondakalayo kuhlengwa emva kokubhalisa njengomHlengi oChwepheshe e-SANC kuQeqesho ngokuBaninzilo. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-20 isipili esifanelekileyo/esiqondakalayo kuhlengwa emva kokubhalisa njengomHlengi oChwepheshe e-SANC kuQeqesho ngokuBaninzilo. Imfuna engaphezu koku yomsebenzi: Ukuzithanda ukusebenza ngaphezu kweyure xa kufuneka. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni nokuqinisekisa ukuba uya kuya kushukumisa isithuthi se-clinic esihambahambayo. Iimpawu zokwenza umsebenzi (ulwazi/izakhono): Ukuqamba nokuqwalasela izakhono. Ukuqeqeswa komzi nokuqondisa. Ikhono lokwenza umsebenzi ngodwa nangoxinzelelo. Izakhono zokunxibelelana ezilungileyo.
xh.duties: Nika inkomba nolawulo lokusebenzisa ukunakekelwa koluntu okubakwalitya kuqhubekeko kweeNkonzo zoMpilo eziPhambili. Songela inkqubo ngomthetho kunye nemithetho yoyilo kwaye igcinwe ngokomthetho yakwawo. Gcina ukuxakeka koluntu ngokusebenzisana nabakho bonke abasebenzisi bemiQathango yeNkonzo yoMpilo eziPhambili. Sebenzisa abantu, izinto nezinto ezingamzimba ngokusetyenziswa okulungileyo kakuhle. Zibandakanye kwiinkqubo zokuqeqesha nentlalo yokuphanda. Gcina inqubo yokulawula abasebenzisi abangaphansi.

jobs.title: Pharmacist Assistant (POST Basic) Grade 1 to 3
jobs.centre: Mitchells Plain CHC (X1 Post) Mitchells Plain District Hospital (X1 Post)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R275 340 per annum Grade 2: R318 666 per annum Grade 3: R343 761 per annum
jobs.summary: Pharmacist Assistant Post-Basic positions at Mitchells Plain CHC and District Hospital, involving dispensing, stock control and manufacturing under pharmacist supervision.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: As required by the training facility and the South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) plus Post-Basic Pharmacist Assistant qualification that allows registration with the SAPC as a Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) (Institutional). Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SAPC as a Pharmacist’s Assistant (Post-Basic) or as Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) (Institutional). Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the SAPC as Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic). Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Pharmacist Assistant after registration as a Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) with the SAPC. Grade 3: A minimum of 13 years’ appropriate experience as Pharmacist Assistant after registration as a Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) with the SAPC.
jobs.duties: Dispensing and capturing prescriptions under supervision of pharmacists. Receiving stock from supplier and capturing thereof and stock control management. Ordering and issuing stock. Manufacturing mixtures under the supervision of the pharmacist. Provide instructions regarding the correct use of medicines supplied. Provide information to individuals to promote health. Support and assist pharmacist with regards to administrative tasks.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointments on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). Candidates will be subjected to a written/practical and oral assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Aptekerassistent (POST Basic) Graad 1 tot 3
af.summary: Aptekerassistent Post-Basic posisies by Mitchells Plain CHC en Distrikshospitaal, wat apteekdienste, voorraadbeheer en vervaardiging onder toesig van 'n apteker behels.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Soos vereis deur die opleidingsfasiliteit en die South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) plus Post-Basic Aptekerassistent-kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SAPC as Aptekerassistent (Post-Basic) (Institutioneel) moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SAPC as Aptekerassistent (Post-Basic) of as Aptekerassistent (Post-Basic) (Institutioneel). Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die SAPC as Aptekerassistent (Post-Basic). Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Aptekerassistent na registrasie as Aptekerassistent (Post-Basic) by die SAPC. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 13 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Aptekerassistent na registrasie as Aptekerassistent (Post-Basic) by die SAPC.
af.duties: Uitreik en vaslê van voorskrifte onder toesig van apteekdienspersoneel. Ontvangs van voorraad van die verskaffer en die vaslegging daarvan asook voorraadbeheerbestuur. Bestel en uitreik van voorraad. Vervaardiging van mengsels onder toesig van die apteker. Verskaf instruksies rakende die korrekte gebruik van voorsiene medisyne. Verskaf inligting aan individue om gesondheid te bevorder. Ondersteun en help die apteker met betrekking tot administratiewe take.

zu.title: OsizaKokwelapha ngeziqhinga (POST Basic) Isigaba 1 kuye ku-3
zu.summary: Izikhundla zaboSizaKwelapha ngeziqhinga e-Mitchells Plain CHC nase-District Hospital, okuhlobene nokunikeza iziqhinga, ukulawula izitokhwe nokukhiqiza izidakamuzi ngaphansi kokugcina komwelapha ngeziqhinga.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezidingekayo ezincane: Njengoba kudingwa isikhungo sokolotsha kanye ne-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) kanye nesidanga sokuba nguMswanaKwelapha ngeziqhinga (Post-Basic) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SAPC njengoMsizaKwelapha ngeziqhinga (Post-Basic) (Institutional). Ukubhaliswa kwi-SAPC njengoSizaKwelapha (Post-Basic) noma njengoMsizaKwelapha ngeziqhinga (Post-Basic) (Institutional). Isiphephelo: Isigaba 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SAPC njengoMsizaKwelapha ngeziqhinga (Post-Basic). Isigaba 2: okuncane iminyaka eyi-5 yokuhlangenwe nakho okufanele njengoMsizaKwelapha ngeziqhinga emva kokubhaliswa njengoMsizaKwelapha ngeziqhinga (Post-Basic) kwi-SAPC. Isigaba 3: okuncane iminyaka eyi-13 yokuhlangenwe nakho okufanele njengoMsizaKwelapha ngeziqhinga emva kokubhaliswa njengoMsizaKwelapha ngeziqhinga (Post-Basic) kwi-SAPC.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza nokubhala izinkomba zezidakamuzi ngaphansi kolawulo bomwelapha ngeziqhinga. Ukuthola izitokhwe kusomnikezi nokuzibhala kanye nokulawula izitokhwe. Uku-oda nokuphiwa kwezitokhwe. Ukukhiqiza nokuxuba izidakamuzi ngaphansi kolawulo lomwelapha ngeziqhinga. Ukunika izinkomba ngendlela efanele yokusebenzisa izidakamuzi ezinikezwe. Ukunika ulwazi kubantu ukuze kube khona ukuthuthukiswa kwezempilo. Ukusekela futhi usize umwelapha ngeziqhinga ngenkabazalo yemisebenzi ye-afiso.

xh.title: Umncedisi weFama (POST Basic) Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3
xh.summary: Izithuba zomncedisi weFama Post-Basic kwi-Mitchells Plain CHC ne-District Hospital, eziquka ukunikela iyuretho, ukulawula isitokhwe nokuvelisa ngaphantsi kolawulo lomfama.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingunaphakade esisezantsi: njengoko kufunwa sisisimo sokuqeqesha ne-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) ngesi sifundo sePost-Basic Pharmacist Assistant esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SAPC njengoMncedisi weFama (Post-Basic) (Institutional). Ukubhalisa kwiNkundla yamagunya: Ukubhalisa kwi-SAPC njengoMncedisi weFama (Post-Basic) okanye njengoMncedisi weFama (Post-Basic) (Institutional). Isiphiwo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho mfuneko emva kokubhalisa kwi-SAPC njengoMncedisi weFama (Post-Basic). Inqanaba 2: Iminyaka elingu-5 ubuncinane yamava afanelekileyo njengoMncedisi weFama emva kokubhalisa njengoMncedisi weFama (Post-Basic) kwi-SAPC. Inqanaba 3: Iminyaka elingu-13 ubuncinane yamava afanelekileyo njengoMncedisi weFama emva kokubhalisa njengoMncedisi weFama (Post-Basic) kwi-SAPC.
xh.duties: Ukunika amayeza kwaye uqaphele ireskrisiphon ngaphantsi kolawulo lomfama. Ukufumana isitokhwe kumthengisi nokuqikelela oko kunye nolawulo lokuqhathanisa kwisitokhwe. Ukucelela nokunika isitokhwe. Ukuvelisa imixube ngaphantsi kolawulo lomfama. Uknika iindlela zokusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo kwamayeza anikiweyo. Ukunika ulwazi kumntu ngamnye ukuze kugutyungelwe impilo. Ukuxhasa kunye nokuncedisa umfama malunga nomsebenzi wokuqhelanisa.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Finance
jobs.summary: Administration clerk role in finance at New Somerset Hospital, Western Cape, involving capturing and processing BAS and Logis payments with a minimum Senior Certificate and relevant finance experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (or equivalent) with Mathematics or Accountancy as a passed subject or Senior Certificate (or equivalent) with experience/competencies that focuses on the Key Performance Areas (KRA’s) of the post. Experience: Appropriate Experience in Financial Management, specifically focused on Creditor Management and Asset & Liability Accounting. Inherent requirements of the job: Willingness to work overtime when required. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer literacy. Numerical skills. Ability to interpret and apply policies. Systematic thinking and attention to detail.
jobs.duties: Capturing and processing of Logis and BAS payments on receipt and in compliance to the PFMA, NTR’s, PTI’s and Departmental Finance Instructions and Circulars. Confirming accuracy, completeness and validity of payment supporting documentation. Batching and filing of supporting documentation. Timeous resolution of supplier and management queries. Reconciliation of Creditors’ Statements monthly and remittance of payments made. Monitoring and clearing of Asset and Liability accounts reporting on a monthly basis. Processing of Journals to correct incorrect expenditure. Allocation of expenditure according to the correct SCOA. Provide assistance and support within the Finance and Supply Chain Management components.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates will be subjected to a written/practical and oral assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Finansies
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk-rol in finansies by New Somerset Hospital, Western Cape, wat die vaslegging en verwerking van BAS- en Logis-betalings behels met 'n minimum Senior Certificate en tersaaklike finansie-ervaring.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Certificate (of ekwivalent) met Wiskunde of Rekenkunde as 'n geslaagde vak of Senior Certificate (of ekwivalent) met ervaring/bevoegdhede wat op die Kernprestasiegebiede (KRA's) van die pos fokus. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in Finansiële Bestuur, spesifiek gefokus op Skuldeiserbestuur en Bate- en Lasafdelingsrekeningkunde. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk wanneer vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaarvaardigheid. Numeriese vaardighede. Vermoë om beleide te interpreteer en toe te pas. Stelselmatige denke en aandag aan detail.
af.duties: Vaslegging en verwerking van Logis- en BAS-betalings by ontvangs en in ooreenstemming met die PFMA, NTR's, PTI's en Departementele Finansies-instruksies en Sirkulaires. Bevestiging van akkuraatheid, volledigheid en geldigheid van betaling-ondersteunende dokumentasie. Groepering en lêering van ondersteunende dokumentasie. Tydige oplossing van verskaffer- en bestuursnavrae. Maandelikse afstemming van Skuldeisers se state en oorbetaling van gedane betalings. Monitering en skakeling van Bate- en Lasrekeninge en maandelikse verslagdoening. Verwerking van joernale om onjuiste besteding reg te stel. Toedeling van besteding volgens die korrekte SCOA. Verskaffing van bystand en ondersteuning binne die Finansies- en Voorsieningskettingbestuur-komponente.

zu.title: Clerk Wezolawulo: Izimali
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba nguclerk wezolawulo ezimali e-New Somerset Hospital, e-Western Cape, okuhlanganisa ukufaka nokucubungula izinkokhelo ze-BAS ne-Logis njengoba kunengcaphephe yesitifiketi samatikithi aphakeme kanye namava ohile ole ngemali.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sokungena esikoleni esiphakeme: Senior Certificate (noma okulinganayo) ongikho kakhulu kulolu hlelo. Isipiliyensi esifanelekileyo kwindlela yokulawula imali, ngokukodwa kwiNtengiso yokulawula aba dayimani nabasebenzi bendawo. Amava: Amava afanelekileyo kulawulo lwemali, ngokukodwa egqithiswe kwilawulo laba dayimani kwi-Akhawundi zeMali. Iimfuno zendalo yomsebenzi: Ukuzimisela ukusebenza ngeyure evezwa. Ukuzinza (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukuzinza ekwazini ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha. Amakhono okubala. Ukuzinza ekulawuleni iindlela ezahlukeneyo. Imbonakalo epheleleyo nokunakela imigaqo.
zu.duties: Ukubhalisa nokucubungula inkokhelo ze-Logis noBAS kuxhomekeke kumthetho we-PFMA, weNTR, wePTI nezimiso zelizwe. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba inkokhelo ixhaswa zixhobo ezifanelekileyo. Ukuqamba neziqu izixhobo ezixhasa inkokhelo. Ukusombulula ngokuchasileyo imibuzo yababoneleli nabalawuli. Ukulinganisa i-Akhawundi zentengiso ngenyanga ngenyanga nokuhlola ukuba inkokhelo izalwe ngokufanelekileyo. Ukulawula nokucoca i-Akhawundi zeMali nokubika ngenyanga ngenyanga. Ukucubungula amajonweli endlela yokulawula imali. Ukwahlula imali ngokwendlela evunyelwe yoMthetho weSCOA. Ukunika inkxaso ncedo kwindawo eLawulwa ngokulawula imali nezibonelelo ezikwinkxaso yokuqokelela imali.

xh.title: Iclerki yoLulo: ezeMali
xh.summary: Isithuba seclerki yolulo kumazwe emali kwiNew Somerset Hospital, eWestern Cape, siquka ukubamba kunye nokucocisa ngezimali zeBAS kunye nezeLogis ngesatifikethi esincinci yeSenior Certificate kunye namava ahambelanayo kumazwe emali.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kolwazi oluncinci: Senior Certificate (okanye olulinganayo) ineMathematics okanye iAccountancy njengomthetho odluliweyo okanye Senior Certificate (okanye olulinganayo) nameva/amandla ajolise kummandla woMsebenzi obalulekileyo (iKRA) wesithuba. Amava: Amava afanelekileyo kuLawulo lwezeMali, ngokukodwa ajolise kuLawulo babaTyala kunye ne-Akhawunti yeNkcubeka kunye neTyala. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kwomsebenzi: Ukuzimisela ukusebenza ngaphezu kwexesha xa kufuneka. Amand (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukubhalisa ngomthi. Amakhono okubala. Ikelo lokutolika nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zomanyano. Ukucinga ngendlela esebenzayo nokunaka iinkcukacha.
xh.duties: Ukubamba nokucocisa iimali zeLogis nezeBAS kwi-carduthi nangokuthobela iPFMA, iNTR, iPTI kunye neziSikhokelo zezeMali zeSebe kunye ne-Somlayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuchaneka, ukupela kunye nokusemthethweni kwamaxwebhu axhasa imali. Ukwabhatala ngamagqulu kunye nokugcina iaxwebhu axhasa imali. Ukusombulula ngexesha elifanelekileyo imibuzo yabahanisi kunye nolawulo. Ukuthelekisa iNkcazamali zabaTyala nyanga zonke kunye nokuthumela iimali ezihlawuliweyo. Ukulawula kunye nokucoca i-Akhawunti zeNkcubeka kunye neTyala ukwenza ingxelo nyanga zonke. Ukucocisa amaJournals ukulungisa ukuchithwa okungalunganga. Ukwabelana ukuchithwa ngokweSCOA efanelekileyo. Ukunikela ngenkxaso kunye nencedo ngaphakathi kumacandelo ezeMali kunye noLawulo loQhagamshelo loLawulo.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Support (MEDICAL Records)
jobs.summary: Administration clerk needed to manage medical records, patient files, archiving and statistics at Brackengate Transitional Care Facility in the Western Cape.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (or equivalent). Experience: Appropriate experience in a Medical Records environment in a hospital setting. Appropriate experience in patient administration. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid driver’s license. Expected to travel between Western Cape Rehabilitation Centre and Brackengate Transitional Care Facility to provide support when operationally required. Willingness to provide support within the Admissions and Fees departments when operationally required. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of data capturing, preparation, quality assurance of files. Knowledge of the Western Cape Archive Act. Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel). Knowledge of Clinicom System.
jobs.duties: To deliver an effective medical records service to the hospital. To manage and maintain patient files. Archiving and disposal of patient files. Collect, compile and submit statistics to supervisor. Printing of reports and retrieving files for various departments. Provide effective support to supervisor, colleagues and other departments.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Ondersteuning (MEDIESE Rekords)
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk benodig om mediese rekords, pasiëntlêers, argivering en statistiek by Brackengate Transitional Care Facility in die Western Cape te bestuur.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Certificate (of ekwivalent). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in 'n Mediese Rekords-omgewing in 'n hospitaalopset. Toepaslike ervaring in pasiëntadministrasie. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige bestuurslisensie. Word verwag om tussen Western Cape Rehabilitation Centre en Brackengate Transitional Care Facility te reis om ondersteuning te bied wanneer operasioneel vereis.
