Bereidwilligheid om ondersteuning binne die Toelatings- en Fooie-departement te bied wanneer operasioneel vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van data vaslegging, voorbereiding, gehalteversekering van lêers. Kennis van die Western Cape Archive Act. Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, Excel). Kennis van Clinicom-stelsel.
af.duties: Om 'n doeltreffende mediese rekorddiens aan die hospitaal te lewer. Om pasiëntlêers te bestuur en te onderhou. Argivering en vernietiging van pasiëntlêers. Versamel, stel saam en dien statistiek aan toesighouer voor. Druk van verslae en verkryging van lêers vir verskeie departemente. Bied doeltreffende ondersteuning aan toesighouer, kollegas en ander departemente.

zu.title: Ikhirki Lokuphathwa Kweminye Yezinto: Ukusekelwa (AMAREKHODI EZEMPILO)
zu.summary: Kudingeka ikhirki lokuphathwa kweminye yezinto ukuphatha amarekhodi ezempilo, amafayela abaphathi, ukuqoqa ukwaziswa okwedlule isikhathi kanye nokuhlanganisa izibalo e Brackengate Transitional Care Facility e Western Cape.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi kwesiya: Isitifiketi Samatrikhetsheni (noma okulinganayo). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanelele endaweni yamarekhodi ezempilo esibhedlela. Isipiliyoni esifanelele ekuphathweni kwabaphathi. Izidingo zendima emsebenzini: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Kulindeleke ukuba uhamba phakathi kwe Western Cape Rehabilitation Centre kanye ne Brackengate Transitional Care Facility ukunikeza ukusekelwa lapho kudingeka ngokomsebenzi. Ukuzithoba ekunikeni ukusekelwa ngaphakathi kwamanyango okwamukelwa ngezimali lapho kudingeka ngokomsebenzi. Ukukhululeka (ulwazi/izikhokelo): Ulwazi lokufaka idatha, ukuhlongoza, kanye nokuqinisekisa izinga lamafayela. Ulwazi lwe Western Cape Archive Act. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompuyutha (MS Word, Excel). Ulwazi lwenkleleko ye Clinicom System.
zu.duties: Ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi yamarekhodi ezempilo esebenzayo esibhedlela. Ukuphatha kanye nokugcina amafayela abaphathi. Ukuqoqa okwedlule isikhathi nokulahla amafayela abaphathi. Ukuqoqa, ukuhlanganisa kanye nokuthumela izibalo kumlawuli. Ukuphrinta umbiko kanye nokulanda amafayela azele amanyango ahlukene. Ukunikeza ukusekelwa okusebenzayo kumlawuli, abalingane kanye namanye amanyango.

xh.title: Iclerki yolawulo: Inkxaso (Iirekhodi zeZEMBEZO)
xh.summary: Kufuneka kuye kwabe kukho iclerki yolawulo ekwazi ukulawula iirekhodi zezembezo, iifayile zabaguli, ukuzigcina kwindawo eqongelelwayo nedayatha kwifasilithi yeBrackengate Transitional Care Facility kwi-Western Cape.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingqongeleyo: Senior Certificate (okanye ezilinganayo). Isipho: Isipho esifanelekileyo kwimoyika weZembezo kwindawo yesibhedlele. Isipho esifanelekileko ekulawulweni kwabaguli. Iimfuno zangaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayiseni yokuqeshisa esebenzayo. Kulindeleke ukuba uhame phakathi kwe-Western Cape Rehabilitation Centre nase-Brackengate Transitional Care Facility ukuze unike inkxaso xa kufuneka ngokusebenza. Ukuza ngentliziyo ukunika inkxaso ngaphakathi kumasebe okuNgenisa nokuRhola xa kufuneka ngokusebenza. Iikhompetensi (ulwazi/akhono): Ulwazi ngokungena koolwazi, ukulungiselela, ukuqinisekiswa kweemfanelo zeefayile. Ulwazi nge-Western Cape Archive Act. Ukuba namakhono ekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel). Ulwazi nge-Clinicom System.
xh.duties: Ukuze kubekho inkonzo ephumeleleyo yemizekelo yemizekelo kwisibhedlele. Ukulawula nasekugcineni iifayile zabaguli. Ukuhombisa nasekutshatyalaliseni iifayile zabaguli. Ukuqokelela, ukuhlanganisa kwaye ungenise ngemvuzo koosiba abanikezelayo. Ukuprinta iingxelo nasekukhupheni iifayile kumasebe ahlukeneyo.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Finance (EXPENDITURE Control)
jobs.summary: Administration clerk needed at Victoria Hospital in the Western Cape to verify and process creditors' payments, perform supplier reconciliations and maintain accounting systems.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (or equivalent) with Mathematics and/or Accountancy as a passed subject. Experience: Appropriate and relevant experience of Creditors Maintenance. Experience of Bas and Logis. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Analytical thinking, planning and organisational skills. Knowledge of ESL, and EPS systems. Computer literate (MS Office: Excel, Word and Outlook). Good interpersonal and communication skills. Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), National Treasury Regulations and Procurement and Finance related prescripts.
jobs.duties: Verify and process creditor’s payments within the 30day payment threshold on Logis & Bas. Apply and verify SCOA application. Perform supplier reconciliations and accounts maintenance. Document control and timeous resolution of supplier and management queries. Maintain an accurate accounting system. Perform relief duties and assist with general tasks within Supply Chain Management Maintain accurate filling system.
jobs.enquiries: Ms A Delcarme Tel No: (021) 799-1289 or email: Andrea.Delcarme@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Finansies (Bestedingsbeheer)
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk benodig by Victoria Hospital in die Western Cape om skuldeisers se betalings te verifieer en te verwerk, verskafferversoenings uit te voer en rekeningkundige stelsels te handhaaf.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Sertifikaat (of ekwivalent) met Wiskunde en/of Rekenkunde as 'n geslaagde vak. Ervaring: Toepaslike en relevante ervaring in Skuldeisersonderhoud. Ervaring van Bas en Logis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Analitiese denke, beplanning- en organisasievaardighede. Kennis van ESL- en EPS-stelsels. Rekenaarvaardig (MS Office: Excel, Word en Outlook). Goeie interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), National Treasury Regulations en Inkoop- en Finansiesverwante verordeninge.
af.duties: Verifieer en verwerk skuldeiser se betalings binne die 30dag-betalingsdrempel op Logis & Bas. Pas SCOA-toepassing toe en verifieer dit. Voer verskafferversoenings en rekeningonderhoud uit. Dokumentbeheer en tydige oplossing van verskaffer- en bestuursnavrae. Handhaaf 'n akkurate rekeningkundige stelsel. Voer noodpligte uit en help met algemene take binne Supply Chain Management. Handhaaf 'n akkurate lêerstelsel.

zu.title: Iklekhi Yokuphathwa: Izimali (UkuLawula Ukusetshenziswa Kwezimali)
zu.summary: Kudingeka iklekhi yokuphathwa esibhedlela i-Victoria Hospital e-Western Cape ukuqinisekisa futhi iphathhe imibandela yokukhokha abanikazi-bhange, yenze ukuqinisekisa kobuhlobo bokubambisana nabahlinzeki, futhi igcine izinhlelo zokubala izimali.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esiphansi: Isitifiketi Samabanga Aphakeme (noma esilinganayo) ne-Mathematics kanye/noma i-Accountancy njengesisubject esidlulile. Isipho: Isipho esifanele nesihlobene nokugcina imibandela yabanikizi-bhange. Isipho se-Bas ne-Logis. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikhono): Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukucubungula kanye nezikhono zokuhlela. Ulwazi lwamazinhlelo ze-ESL kanye ne-EPS. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office: Excel, Word ne-Outlook). Izikhono ezinhle zokuxhumana nabantu kanye nokukhuluma. Ulwazi lwe-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), izimiso ze-National Treasury kanye nemiyalo ehlobene nokuthenga nokuphathwa kwezimali.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa futhi uphathe imali yokukhokha abanikizi-bhange ngaphakathi kwesikhathi sokukhokha kwangosuku loku-30 ku-Logis & Bas. Faka futhi qinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwe-SCOA. Yenza ukuqinisekisa kobuhlobo bokubambisana nabahlinzeki kanye nokugcina izinkomba zezimali. Lawula ukuhlotshaniswa kwamadokhumenti nokuqondiswa ngesikhathi esifanele kwemibuzo yabahlinzeki kanye neyabaphathi. Gcina isinhlelo esiqinisekile sokubala izimali. Yenza imisebenzi yokweseka futhi usize nemisebenzi jikelele ngaphakathi kwe-Supply Chain Management Gcina isinhlelo esiqinisekile sokugcina amafayela.

xh.title: Iclerka yolawulo: eMali (Lawulo leMali eHlawulwayo)
xh.summary: Kufuneka iclerka yolawulo kwindawo yokuhlola iindleko eWestern Cape, ukuba ngenxa yokwenza nokugqibezela amaxwebhu okuHLAWULA ABANTU abanikela ngezinto, ukuqhuba ukuvumelanisa kwabahlinzeki nokugcina iinkqubo ezibala imali.
xh.requirements: Isiqualifyingi esingaphantsi: Isatifikethi ephezulu (ok ngokulinganayo) inazo iMathematics ok i-Accountancy njengesifundi esidlulileyo. Isipili: Isipili esifanelekileyo nokuqhayiselekileyo ekugcineni abanikela ngezinto. Isipili se-Bas ne-Logis. Iimpawu (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukucinga ngesiXhoba ngeengcali, ukuqamba izicwangciso kunye namakhono olawulo. Ulwazi lwamasistim we-ESL n we-EPS. Ulwazi olugqibeleleyo lwekhompyutha (I-MS Office: i-Excel, i-Word ne-Outlook). Amakhono amabalwimi kunye nokuThetha athandathu. Ulwazi loMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoRhulumente (PFMA), iZimiso zeNceba yeSizwe kunye nezimiso ezinxulumene nokuThengwa kweZinto n iMali.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ugqibo lwezinto ezinxulumene nabanikela ngezinto ngaphakathi kwemida yentsimbi yeentsuku zii-30 kwamasistim e-Logis ne-Bas. Sebenzisa kuqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwe-SCOA. Qhuba ukuvumelanisa kwabahlinzeki nokugcina iifayili ezinxulumene nabahlinzeki. Lawula amaxwebhu nokusombulula ngokukhawuleza iimbuzo ezivela kwabahlinzeki nakubaphathi. Gcina inkqubo yokubala imali eneNgqondo. Zinze imisebenzi yokuncedisa ncedise kwimisebenzi eqhelisayo kLawulo lweNgcambu yokuThengisa. Gcina inkqubo yokulondoloza iifayili ngokuchanekileyo.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Support (TRANSPORT)
jobs.summary: Administration clerk providing administrative and fleet management support services, including vehicle maintenance and odometer capturing, at Tygerberg Hospital.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (or equivalent). Experience: Appropriate Transport and Support Services experience. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B) driver’s licence. Willingness to rotate to other departments within the support service component if the need arises. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Appropriate computer skills in MS Office (MS Word, Excel, Outlook). Appropriate administrative experience and knowledge of policies and practices. Knowledge of Human Resource Management, Labour legislation and sound knowledge of Transport Circular 4 of 2000 and Government Motor Transport Handbook Version 1 of 2019. Good interpersonal skills, organizational skills, the ability to function under pressure and maintain confidentiality and excellent communication skills (verbal and written). Ability to accept accountability, responsibility to work independently, good interpersonal skills and sober habits. Knowledge of Transport Regulations and Circular no 4 of 2000. Knowledge of routine, maintenance, Inspections for defects on vehicles and safe driving skills. Applied knowledge of the Transport Handbook 1 of 2019. Knowledge on PERMIS/SPMS system. Working knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service.
jobs.duties: Provide an effective administrative service to the Support Services component. Responsible for Fleet management and ensure that vehicles are maintained (roadworthy, clean, regularly serviced and inspected). Capturing of Odometers and log sheets for audit purposes. Ensure that all accidents reports are captured. Provide a support function to the Supervisor with regards to prevention and reporting of misuse of Government Motor Transport and fraud investigation. Complete and maintain registers. Effective control and ordering of stock and equipment.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates may be subjected to a practical test. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Administrasieklerk: Ondersteuning (TRANSPORT)
af.summary: Administrasieklerk wat administratiewe en vlootbestuursondersteuningsdienste verskaf, insluitend voertuigonderhoud en kilometerregistrasie, by Tygerberg Hospital.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Certificate (of gelykwaardig). Ervaring: Geskikte Transport- en Ondersteuningsdienste-ervaring. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige (Code B) bestuurslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om na ander departemente binne die ondersteuningsdienskomponent te roteer indien die behoefte ontstaan. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Geskikte rekenaarvaardighede in MS Office (MS Word, Excel, Outlook). Geskikte administratiewe ervaring en kennis van beleide en gebruike. Kennis van Menslikehulpbronbestuur, Arbeidswetgewing en deeglike kennis van Transport Circular 4 of 2000 en Government Motor Transport Handbook Version 1 of 2019. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, organisasievaardighede, die vermoë om onder druk te funksioneer en vertroulikheid te handhaaf en uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Vermoë om verantwoordelikheid te aanvaar, verantwoordelikheid om onafhanklik te werk, goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede en nugterheid. Kennis van Transportregulasies en Circular no 4 of 2000. Kennis van roetine, onderhoud, inspeksies vir gebreke aan voertuie en veilige bestuursvaardighede. Toegepaste kennis van die Transport Handbook 1 of 2019. Kennis van PERMIS/SPMS-stelsel. Werkende kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens beheer.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n doeltreffende administratiewe diens aan die Ondersteuningsdienste-komponent. Verantwoordelik vir Vlootbestuur en verseker dat voertuie onderhou word (padwaardig, skoon, gereeld gedien en geïnspekteer). Registrasie van kilometerlesings en logblaaie vir ouditdoeleindes. Verseker dat alle ongelukverslae vasgelê word. Verskaf 'n ondersteuningsfunksie aan die toesighouer met betrekking tot die voorkoming en rapportering van misbruik van Government Motor Transport en bedrogondersoek. Voltooi en handhaaf registers. Doeltreffende beheer en bestelling van voorraad en toerusting.

zu.title: Iclerk Lokuphathabhuphi: Ukusekela (TRANSPORT)
zu.summary: Iclerk lokuphathabhuphi elinikeza izinsiza zokusekela izokuphathabhuphi kanye nezokulawula ithimba, okihlukanisa ukugcinwa kwezimoto nokuqopha ibanga lemithwathwa, eTygerberg Hospital.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezingavunyelwe ukunciphiswa: Senior Certificate (noma okulinganayo). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele sokuthutha nokusekela izinsiza. Isidingo sokuzalwa somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqamba evumelekile (Code B). Ukuthanda ukushintshela kwezinye iminyango ngaphakathi komgangatho wokusekela izinsiza uma kunesidingo. Amandla (ulwazi/izikhathi): Ulwazi olufanele lwekhompyutha kuMS Office (MS Word, Excel, Outlook). Isipiliyoni sokuphathabhuphi esifanele nelwazi lezinqubomgomo nezinqubo. Ulwazi Lokuphathwa Kwabasebenzi, umthetho wezisebenzi nelwazi eliqinile leTransport Circular 4 of 2000 kanye noGovernment Motor Transport Handbook Version 1 of 2019. Amandi amahle okuxhumana nobantu, amandla okuhlela, ikhono lokusebenza phansi kwenkucuba kanye nogwinya ukulondoloza ubumfihlo kanye namandlo amahle okuxhumana (abaphayo nobhaliwe). Ikhono lokwamukela ubuzwe, ubudlelwano bokusebenza zinceni, amandlo amahle okuxhumana nobantu kanye nokuziphila ngendlela ehanjiswayo. Ulwazi lwezinqubomgomo zokuThutha noCircular no 4 of 2000. Ulwazi lwezinsizakusebenza ezivamile, ukulondoloza, ukuhlola izimoto ngamaphutha namandlo abucayile okushayela. Ulwazi olusetshenziswayo lokuTransport Handbook 1 of 2019. Ulwazi ngohlelo I-PERMIS/SPMS. Ulwazi olusebenzayo kanye nekuqonda ukwakheka komthetho okuphatha Inkonzo Yomphakathi.
zu.duties: Nikela insiza yokuphathabhuphi esebenzayo kumgango wokusekela izinsiza. Ubhekene nolawulo lwethimba uze uqiniseke ukuthi izimoto zisolwe zikwazi ukuhamba emgwaqeni, zihlakiwe, zihlollwe njalo kanye nokuhlolwa. Ukuqopha Ibanga lemithwathwa kanye namaphepha okuhlela ngenhloso yokuhlola. Qina ukuthi zonke izibalo zezenzakalo ziqoshwa. Nikeza insiza yokusekela osompembelele ngokuthi bathintene nokuzivikela kanye nokubika ukusetshenziswa kabi kweGovernment Motor Transport kanye nophando lwenkohlakalo. Qedelela ugcine izinkomba. Ukulawula ukusebenza nokuthumela izimpahla kanye nempahla.

xh.title: Mkhuseli Wezolawulo: Inkxaso (TRANSPORT)
xh.summary: Mkhuseli wezolawulo onika inkxaso yezolonikezelo ezimalunga nolawulo lwamathambo kunye nokugcinwa kwezithuthi, kuquka ukulungiswa kwezithuthi nokubhala iinkelathi ezibala ibhanoyi, eTygerberg Hospital.
xh.requirements: Isigqibo sokugqibela semfundo: Senior Certificate (okanye esilinganayo). Isipho: Isipho esifanelekileyo sokusebenza kwiTransport nakwinkxaso. Iimfuno ezibhalwe kumsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokushayela (Code B) eseyasekayo. Ukulungelelanisa ukutshintshela kwezinye iisebe ngaphakathi komnxeba wonkonzo yokunkxasa xa kunjalo. Iimpawu (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono obugcisa okusebenza eMS Office (MS Word, Excel, Outlook). Isipho esifanelekileyo sezolawulo nolwazi lwezokuhlongolwa nemigaqo. Ulwazi loLawulo lwemithombo yabantu, ngokumthetho wabasebenzi nolwazi olulu¬lelo ngakuthi Transport Circular 4 of 2000 nakwisihlwele iGovernment Motor Transport Handbook Version 1 of 2019. Amakhono amabalana abantu, amakhono obuhlengahlengisi, isakhono sokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokuogcina iyimfihlo ngenxa yamakhono abalulekileyo ekuthetheni nokubhali (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Isakhono sokuzimela, ukwabela uxanduva ngokwawo, isiphokazi sokusebenza ngokwawo, amakhono amahle abantu nokuziphatha kakuhle. Ulwazi ngokumgaqo weTransport Regulations nakwiCircular no 4 of 2000. Ulwazi lwenkqubo yemihla ngemihla, ukulungiswa, ukuphepha izithuthi nokuqinisekisa ukuba zisemthethweni. Ulwazi ngomthetho obhalwe ukuthi Transport Handbook 1 of 2019. Ulwazi ngenkqubo iPERMIS/SPMS. Ulwazi lokusebenza nokuqonda inkqubo yomthetho ephatha uRhulumente.
xh.duties: Kuvakalelwa inkonzo yolawulo echanekileyo kwicala lenkxaso. Uxanduva lokulawula izithuthi nokuqinisekisa ukuba zilungisiwe (zinokuhamba, zicocekile, zihinjwe rhoqo kunye neenkqubo zokuzihlola). Ukuqamba iinkelathi ezibala ibhanoyi namaphepha e-log malunga nokuhlahlulwa. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba zinikezelwa iingxelo zonke ngakuthi na iingozi. Unika inkxaso kumkhuseleki ngomhlaba wokuthintela nokwenza ingxelo ngesetyhenziswa ngendlela engafanelekanga uRhulumente wezithuthi negxelo yokuphenya ukurhoxiswa. Ukuqinisekisa ukugqitywa kokubhalwa kwiindlela ezilandelwayo. Ukuqinisekisa ulawulo nokuhlela okulungele ukusetyenziswa izixhobo ezilungele.

jobs.title: Staff Nurse Grade 1 to 3
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R229 440 per annum Grade 2: R272 778 per annum Grade 3: R319 071 per annum
jobs.summary: Staff Nurse (Grade 1 to 3) position at Moorreesburg Clinic in the Western Cape, providing basic clinical nursing care to the community.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Qualification that allows registration with the SANC as a Staff Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with SANC as a Staff Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: None. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as a Staff Nurse. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as a Staff Nurse. Inherent requirements of the job: Willingness to work overtime when necessary. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good communication and interpersonal relationships. Basic computer skills in MS Word, Excel, Outlook. Knowledge of relevant legislation and policies of the Department of Health Western Cape.
jobs.duties: Provide basic clinical nursing care. Development and implementation of basic patient care plans. Effective utilization of resources. Maintain professional growth/ethical standards and self-development. Community Participation.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a practical test. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution/ Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Personeelverpleegkundige Graad 1 tot 3
af.summary: Personeelverpleegkundige (Graad 1 tot 3) pos by Moorreesburg Kliniek in die Western Cape, wat basiese kliniese verpleegsorg aan die gemeenskap verskaf.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as 'n Personeelverpleegkundige moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by SANC as 'n Personeelverpleegkundige. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkende ervaring in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC as 'n Personeelverpleegkundige. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike/erkende ervaring in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC as 'n Personeelverpleegkundige. Inheemse vereistes van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk wanneer nodig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike verhoudings. Basiese rekenaarvaardighede in MS Word, Excel, Outlook. Kennis van tersaaklike wetgewing en beleide van die Department of Health Western Cape.
af.duties: Verskaf basiese kliniese verpleegsorg. Ontwikkeling en implementering van basiese pasiëntsorgplanne. Effektiewe benutting van hulpbronne. Handhaaf professionele groei/etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling. Gemeenskapsdeelname.

zu.title: Uhlelekiziwe Kwezokwelapha Izinga 1 kuya ku-3
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokaHlelekiziwe Kwezokwelapha (Izinga 1 kuya ku-3) e-Moorreesburg Clinic e-Western Cape, sokunikeza ukunakekelwa kwezokwelapha okuyisisekelo emphakathini.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi kwezinye: Izifundo ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengoHlelekiziwe Kwezokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa kwababekezayo: Ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengoHlekekiziwe Kwezokwelapha. Isiphalaphala: Izinga 1: Akukho. Izinga 2: Okuncane kakhulu iminyaka engu-10 yesiphalaphala esifanele/esiyaziwayo ezokwelapha ngemva kokubhaliswa ku-SANC njengoHlekekiziwe Kwezokwelapha. Izinga 3: Okuncane kakhulu iminyaka engu-20 yesiphalaphala esifanele/esiyaziwayo ezokwelapha ngemva kokubhaliswa ku-SANC njengoHlekekiziwe Kwezokwelapha. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngale kwesikhathi lapho kudingeka khona. Izindlela (ulwazi/izikhokelo): Ukuxhumana okuhle nobuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Izikhokelo eziyisisekelo ze-khomputha kwi-MS Word, Excel, Outlook. Ulwazi ngemithetho nezinhlelo ezihlobene kwe-Minyango yezempilo i-Western Cape.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha okuyisisekelo. Ukuthuthukiswa nokuphathiwa kwezinhlelo eziyisisekelo zokunakekelwa kwabagulayo. Ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwezinsiza. Ukugcina ukukhula komsebenzi/izinga zokuziphatha kanye nentuthuko yomuntu ngamunye. Ukuhlanganyela kwemiphakathi.

xh.title: Umongikazi wokuQeqesha uNqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3
xh.summary: Isithuba somongikazi wokuQeqesha (UNqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3) kwiKliniki yaseMoorreesburg eWestern Cape, kunika inxaxheba yezikliniki ezisisiseko kummandla.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingowona cacileyo: Iziqu ezivumela ukuqatshelwa kwesoSazizi seSANC njengomongikazi wokuQeqesha. Ukuqatshelwa koluntu olunemigaqo: Ukuqatshelwa kwesoSazizi seSABC njengomongikazi wokuQeqesha. Isipili: Inqanaba 1: Akukho. Inqanaba 2: Uqondo ogqithisweyo kwiminyaka elingu-10 yamava ahambelanayo/okuqatshelwayo ekunyuzeni emva kokuqatshelwa kwesoSazizi seSABC njengomongikazi wokuQeqesha. Inqanaba 3: Uqondo ogqithisweyo kwiminyaka elingu-20 yamava ahambelanayo/okuqatshelwayo ekunyuzeni emva kokuqatshelwa kwesoSazizi seSABC njengomongikazi wokuQeqesha. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ukulangazelelwa kokusebenza ngaphezu kweyure xa kuyimfuneko. Iimfuneko (ulwazi/iziqu): Unxibelelwano oluhle nokwakha izidibaniso neziqu zomntu. Amakhono abhalwe aphansi eKhompyutha kwi-MS Word, Excel, Outlook. Ulwazi ngemithetho echaza ummandla nemigaqo yeSebe lezeMpilo eWestern Cape.
xh.duties: Nika inxaxheba yezikliniki ezisisiseko. Uphuhliso nokusebenzisa iindawo ezisisiseko zokunakekelwa kwegazi. Ukusebenzisa izixhobo ngokusebenzisekayo. Ukuhlala ukhula ngomsebenzi/iindinganiso zokuziphatha nokuziphuhlisa. Inxaxheba yoMmandla.

jobs.title: Director: Grant and Municipal Performance Management
jobs.centre: Department of Infrastructure, Western Cape Government
jobs.summary: Director position in the Western Cape Department of Infrastructure responsible for grant and municipal performance management, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and 5 years' senior management experience.
jobs.requirements: A relevant NQF level 7 qualification or equivalent as recognised by SAQA; - A minimum of 5 years' experience middle/senior management experience. Competencies: Knowledge: Proven knowledge and understanding of public service procedures, processes and systems, Proven knowledge and understanding of engineering, legal and operational compliance, Proven knowledge and practical application of the National and Provincial Housing Act, Western Cape Housing Development Act, National Housing Code, guidelines and other related housing policies and prescripts, Proven knowledge and practical application of the Construction Industries Development Board (CIDB) guidelines, National Home Builders Registration Council (NHBRC) guidelines, as well as the National Building Regulations, Proven knowledge and understanding of the latest building legislation, building contracts and Contract Administration, Proven knowledge and understanding of project design and project management in the built environment, Proven knowledge and understanding of strategic policies, guidelines, standard procedures and best practices relevant to human settlement implementation., Proven knowledge and understanding of Human Settlements and Local Government delivery issues , Proven knowledge and understanding of the global and local political economics and social affairs impacting on the Province of the Western Cape, Proven knowledge and practical application of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Proven knowledge and practical application of financial management processes and related Acts, regulations and the ability to set up budgets, Proven knowledge and practical application of the Occupational Health and Safety Act (OCHSA), Proven knowledge and understanding of legislation, regulatory frameworks, policies and best practices that have a bearing on the line functions, Proven knowledge and understanding of information systems that aid in the management of knowledge and information pertaining to the line function, Proven knowledge and understanding of procurement and tendering processes, Proven knowledge and understanding of policy development, and strategy management, monitoring and review processes, Proven knowledge and understanding of modern systems of governance and administration, Proven knowledge and understanding of the global, regional and local political, economic and social affairs impacting on the provincial government of the Western Cape, Proven knowledge and understanding of Constitutional, legal and institutional arrangements governing the South African public sector, Proven knowledge and understanding of public finance, human resources and discourse management processes, Proven knowledge and understanding of the functioning of the Province and the activities of sister departments, Proven knowledge and understanding of the policies of the government of the day, Basic knowledge and understanding of Labour Relations legislation and regulations, Proven knowledge and understanding of performance management in general. Skills: Numeracy, Literacy, Computer Literacy, Language skills, Project Management, Economic, financial analysis, Legal Administration, Strategic Planning Competencies: Strategic Capability and Leadership, Project and Programme Management, Change Management, People Management and Empowerment, Financial Management.
jobs.duties: Line Management: Strategic management, advice and guidance in respect of the following functional areas: Monitor housing expenditure and administer housing project claims related to all the National Housing Programmes: Cashflow meetings, Municipal Engagements, DORA reporting; Assess overall housing delivery performance of municipalities: Municipal Engagements, DORA reporting, Interim delivery reporting Strategic Management (including change management): Define and review on a continual basis the purpose, objectives, priorities and activities of the Directorate, Evaluate the performance of the Directorate on a continuing basis against pre-determined key measurable objectives and standards, Report to the Chief Director: Human Settlements Implementation on a regular basis on the activities of the Directorate and on matters of substantial importance relating to operational management support, Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant legislation and prescripts in respect of adequate and appropriate record keeping of the activities of the Directorate, and of the resources (people, finances and assets) employed by it, Foster and promote a culture of innovation within the Directorate, and the Branch Human Settlements, Diligently perform all duties assigned to the post of Director. People Management: Participate in the recruitment of employees in the numbers and grades appropriate to ensure the achievement of the Directorate’s Business Plan, Motivate, train and guide employees within the Directorate, to achieve and maintain excellence in service delivery, Actively manage the performance, evaluation and rewarding of employees within the Directorate, Monitor information capacity building within the Directorate, Ensure involvement in the compilation of a workforce plan, a service delivery improvement programme, and an information resources plan for the Directorate, Promote sound labour relations within the Directorate, Actively manage and promote the maintenance of discipline within the Directorate. Financial Management: Manage participation in the budgeting process at Directorate level, Ensure the preparation of the Annual and Adjustment Budgets for the Directorate, Assume direct accountability for the efficient, economic and effective control and management of the Directorate’s budget and expenditure, Assume direct accountability for ensuring that the correct tender and procurement procedures are adhered to in respect of purchases for the Directorate, Assume direct accountability for ensuring contracts are managed effectively and efficiently for the Directorate, Ensure that all spending is aligned with the strategic objectives of the Directorate and the Branch Human Settlements, Report to the Chief Director: Human Settlements Planning and relevant oversight role players/committees on all aspects of the Directorate’s finances, Assume overall accountability for the management, maintenance and safekeeping of the Directorate assets, Assume direct accountability for ensuring that appropriate risk management procedures are in place and adhered to for the Directorate, Ensure that full and proper records of the financial affairs of the Directorate are kept in accordance with any prescribed norms and standards.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. Kindly note that technical support is only available from Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 16:00. Should you experience any difficulties with your online application you may contact the helpline on 0861 370 214. Please ensure that you submit your application on or before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this post, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. All shortlisted candidates must make themselves available to be interviewed at a date, time and place as decided by the selection panel. All shortlisted candidates will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to assess relevant functional elements of the job and an interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will be required to complete the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) and submit the certificate before he/she can be appointed to this post. The purpose of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme, which is a public service specific training programme applicable to all applicants who aspire to join the SMS, is to ensure that potential SMS members have a background in processes and procedures linked to the SMS. The duration of the online Pre-Entry Programme is 120 notional hours (15 days). Full details may be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training- course/sms-preentryprogramme . The successful candidate shall be subjected to a leadership assessment, within one (1) month of appointment, to assess the managerial competencies required for SMS members in the Public Service as specified under Chapter Five (5) of the SMS handbook. This assessment shall be conducted to determine an individual’s ability to lead, manage, and direct others and to identify developmental gaps in core generic leadership and management competencies. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. The successful candidate will be subject to security vetting; and the candidate will have to disclose her/his financial interests. Furthermore, thank you, to the huge public interest, we receive many applications for our posts, and as such will not be able to respond personally to all applications. Therefore, should you not hear from us within 10 weeks from close of the advert please consider your application unsuccessful. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Subsidie- en Munisipale Prestasiebestuur
af.summary: Direkteurspos in die Western Cape Department of Infrastructure verantwoordelik vir subsidie- en munisipale prestasiebestuur, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en 5 jaar se bestuurservaring op seniorsvlak vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Terwylike NQF vlak 7-kwalifikasie of ekwivalent soos deur SAQA erken; - 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op middel-/seniorbestuursvlak. Bevoegdhede: Kennis: Bewese kennis en begrip van openbare diensprosedures, prosesse en stelsels, Bewese kennis en begrip van ingenieurs-, regs- en operasionele nakoming, Bewese kennis en praktiese toepassing van die National and Provincial Housing Act, Western Cape Housing Development Act, National Housing Code, riglyne en ander verwante behuisingbeleide en voorskrifte, Bewese kennis en praktiese toepassing van die Construction Industries Development Board (CIDB) riglyne, National Home Builders Registration Council (NHBRC) riglyne, asook die National Building Regulations, Bewese kennis en begrip van die jongste bouwetgewing, boukontrakte en kontrakadministrasie, Bewese kennis en begrip van projekontwerp en projekbestuur in die beboude omgewing, Bewese kennis en begrip van strategiese beleide, riglyne, standaardprosedures en beste praktyke wat relevant is tot menslike nedersettingsimplementering., Bewese kennis en begrip van Menslike Nedersettings en Plaaslike Regering se afleweringkwessies , Bewese kennis en begrip van die globale en plaaslike politieke ekonomie en sosiale aangeleenthede wat 'n uitwerking het op die Province of the Western Cape, Bewese kennis en praktiese toepassing van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Bewese kennis en praktiese toepassing van finansiële bestuursprosesse en verwante Wette, regulasies en die vermoë om begrotings op te stel, Bewese kennis en praktiese toepassing van die Occupational Health and Safety Act (OCHSA), Bewese kennis en begrip van wetgewing, regulerende raamwerke, beleide en beste praktyke wat 'n uitwerking het op die lynfunksies, Bewese kennis en begrip van inligtingstelsels wat help met die bestuur van kennis en inligting met betrekking tot die lynfunksie, Bewese kennis en begrip van verkrygings en tenderprosesse, Bewese kennis en begrip van beleidsontwikkeling, en strategiebestuur, monitering en hersieningsprosesse, Bewese kennis en begrip van moderne stelsels van bestuur en administrasie, Bewese kennis en begrip van die globale, streeks- en plaaslike politieke, ekonomiese en sosiale aangeleenthede wat 'n uitwerking het op die provinsiale regering van die Western Cape, Bewese kennis en begrip van konstitusionele, regtelike en institutionele reëlings wat die Suid-Afrikaanse openbare sektor regeer, Bewese kennis en begrip van openbare finansies, menslike hulpbronne en diskoersbestuursprosesse, Bewese kennis en begrip van die funksionering van die Provinsie en die aktiwiteite van susterdepartemente, Bewese kennis en begrip van die beleide van die regering van die dag, Basiese kennis en begrip van Arbeidsverhoudingswetgewing en regulasies, Bewese kennis en begrip van prestasiebestuur in die algemeen. Vaardighede: Syfergeletterdheid, Geletterdheid, Rekenaargeletterdheid, Taalvaardighede, Projekbestuur, Ekonomiese, finansiële analise, Regsadministrasie, Strategiese beplanning Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, Projekte- en programbestuur, Veranderingsbestuur, Mensebestuur en bemagtiging, Finansiële bestuur.
af.duties: Lynbestuur: Strategiese bestuur, advies en leiding met betrekking tot die volgende funksionele areas: Monitor behuisingbesteding en administreer behuisingprojek-eise wat verband hou met al die National Housing Programmes: Kontantvloeivergaderings, Munisipale betrokkenheid, DORA-verslagdoening; Evalueer die algehele behuisingafleweringprestasie van munisipaliteite: Munisipale betrokkenheid, DORA-verslagdoening, tussentydse afleweringverslagdoening Strategiese bestuur (insluitend veranderingsbestuur): Definieer en hersien op 'n deurlopende basis die doel, doelwitte, prioriteite en aktiwiteite van die Direktoraat, Evalueer die prestasie van die Direktoraat op 'n deurlopende basis teen voorafbepaalde sleutel meetbare doelwitte en standaarde, Rapporteer op 'n gereelde basis aan die Hoofdirekteur: Menslike Nedersettingsimplementering oor die aktiwiteite van die Direktoraat en oor aangeleenthede van wesenlike belang met betrekking tot operasionele bestuursondersteuning, Monitor en verseker nakoming van toepaslike wetgewing en voorskrifte met betrekking tot voldoende en toepaslike rekordhouding van die aktiwiteite van die Direktoraat, en van die hulpbronne (mense, finansies en bates) wat daardeur aangewend word, Voed en bevorder 'n kultuur van innovasie binne die Direktoraat, en die Tak Menslike Nedersettings, Voer ywerig alle pligte uit wat aan die pos van Direkteur opgedra is. Mensebestuur: Neem deel aan die werwing van werknemers in die getalle en grade wat toepaslik is om die bereiking van die Direktoraat se Besigheidsplan te verseker, Motiveer, trein en begelei werknemers binne die Direktoraat om uitnemendheid in diensaflewering te bereik en te handhaaf, Bestuur aktief die prestasie, evaluering en beloning van werknemers binne die Direktoraat, Monitor inligtingskapasiteitsbou binne die Direktoraat, Verseker betrokkenheid by die opstel van 'n werksmagplan, 'n diensafleweringverbeteringsprogram, en 'n inligtingshulpbronneplan vir die Direktoraat, Bevorder gesonde arbeidsverhoudinge binne die Direktoraat, Bestuur aktief en bevorder die handhawing van dissipline binne die Direktoraat. Finansiële bestuur: Bestuur deelname aan die begrotingsproses op Direktoraatsvlak, Verseker die voorbereiding van die Jaarlikse en Aanpassingsbegrotings vir die Direktoraat, Neem direkte verantwoordelikheid vir die doeltreffende, ekonomiese en effektiewe beheer en bestuur van die Direktoraat se begroting en besteding, Neem direkte verantwoordelikheid om te verseker dat die korrekte tender- en verkrygingsprosedures nagekom word met betrekking tot aankope vir die Direktoraat, Neem direkte verantwoordelikheid om te verseker dat kontrakte doeltreffend en effektief vir die Direktoraat bestuur word, Verseker dat alle besteding in lyn is met die strategiese doelwitte van die Direktoraat en die Tak Menslike Nedersettings, Rapporteer aan die Hoofdirekteur: Menslike Nedersettingsbeplanning en relevante toesigrolspelers/komitees oor alle aspekte van die Direktoraat se finansies, Neem algehele verantwoordelikheid vir die bestuur, onderhoud en veilig bewaring van die Direktoraat se bates, Neem direkte verantwoordelikheid om te verseker dat toepaslike risikobestuursprosedures in plek is en nagekom word vir die Direktoraat, Verseker dat volledige en behoorlike rekords van die finansiële sake van die Direktoraat gehou word in ooreenstemming met enige voorgeskrewe norms en standaarde.

zu.title: Umdidiyeli: Ukuphathwa Kwenkokhelo Yemibhalo NezeMizimba YasoMasipala
zu.summary: Isikhundla somdidiyeli kuWestern Cape Department of Infrastructure esibhekele ukuphathwa kwenkokhelo yemibhalo nezempumelelo zaso masipala, esidinga izifundo ze-NQF 7 namava eminyaka eyi-5 ekuwenza isimo sikaqhwebu / uphathi ophakeme.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezihambisana ne-NQF level 7 noma ezilinganayo njengoba kubonwa yi-SAQA; - Amava abuncwane eminyaka eyi-5 ekuwenza isimo sikaqhwebu / uphathi ophakeme. Ikhono: Ulwazi: Ulwazi oluveziwe nokuqonda izinqubo, izindlela namasistimu asebenza wona umnyango, Ulwazi oluveziwe nokuqonda ukuziphendulela kwemisebenzi yokwakha, emthethweni nasekuhambiseni imisebenzi, Ulwazi oluveziwe nokusetshenziswa kwalo kuleso sikhathi kwesiMthetho sikaHulumeni WesiZwe nesiPhondo ngeziZindo, esiMthetho sokuThuthukisa iziZindo sikaWestern Cape, i-National Housing Code, izinhlela zokweluleka kanye nezinye izinqumela-mithetho ezihambisana nezindlu, Ulwazi oluveziwe nokusetshenziswa kwalo kuleso sikhathi kwezinhlela zokweluleka ze-Construction Industries Development Board (CIDB), izinhlela zokweluleka ze-National Home Builders Registration Council (NHBRC), kanye nokuMthethwa kokuMakwa, Ulwazi oluveziwe nokuqonda okusha ngeMithetho yokuMakwa, izinkontiloka zokuMakwa nokuphathwa kwezinkontiloka, Ulwazi oluveziwe nokuqonda ukuklama amaphrojekthi nokuphatha amaphrojekthi endaweni yakhiwo, Ulwazi oluveziwe nokuqonda izinqumela-mithetho ezibhekwa kuso isikhundla, izinhlela zokweluleka, izinqubo ezijwayelekile nezindalo eziphambili eziyinhloko ekusebenziseni izindlu eziyisimo sokuHlaliswa koluntu, Ulwazi oluveziwe nokuqonda izindlu eziyisimo sokuHlaliswa koluntu nezinkinga zokulethwa koluntu kahulumeni wasekhaya, Ulwazi oluveziwe nokuqonda imithethongqondo yezepolitiki namnotho kwelize labo nasenhlabathini kanye nezomphakathi ezithinta iPhondo likaWestern Cape, Ulwazi oluveziwe nokusetshenziswa kwalo kuleso sikhathi kwe-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Ulwazi oluveziwe nokusetshenziswa kwalo kuleso sikhathi kwezinqubo zokuphathwa kwezimali kanye neziMithetho ezihlobene nakho, imithetho ikhomba nolwazi lokwakha ama-budget, Ulwazi oluveziwe nokusetshenziswa kwalo kuleso sikhathi kwe-Occupational Health and Safety Act (OCHSA), Ulwazi oluveziwe nokuqonda imithetho, izinsimbi ezingaqondisiswa, izinqumela-mithetho kanye nezinhlela ezihlukile phakathi kwezinsizakalo. Ulwazi oluveziwe nokuqonda i-information systems ezisiza ekuphathweni kolwazi ne-message ngolwazi oluthinta imisebenzi, Ulwazi oluveziwe nokuqonda izinqubo zokuthenga nokuthengisa nge-tender, Ulwazi oluveziwe nokuqonda ukwakhiwa kwezinqumela-mithetho, ukuphathwa kwenqubomgomo, ukulandela nokubuyekeza izinqubo, Ulwazi oluveziwe nokuqonda izinsimbi zanamuhla zokuphathwa koluntu nokubhaliswa kwezinto, Ulwazi oluveziwe nokuqonda imithethongqondo yezepolitiki kweliza labo, nasemzini nasenhlabathini, namnotho kanye nezomphakathi ezithinta uhulumeni wephondo likaWestern Cape, Ulwazi oluveziwe nokuqonda isimiso somthethosisekelo, sestilo semithetho kanye nezinhlelo zezikhungo eziphatha umnyango womphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika, Ulwazi oluveziwe nokuqonda imali kahulumeni, ukuphathwa koluntu kanye nezinkulumo ezithinta ukuphathwa, Ulwazi oluveziwe nokuqonda ukusebenza kwePhondo kanye nemisebenzi yeminyango ehlukene kuyo. Ulwazi oluveziwe nokuqonda imigomo yohulumeni waleso sikhathi, Ulwazi olusisekelo nokuqonda imithetho neMithetho yezimo zabasebenzi. Ulwazi oluveziwe nokuqonda ukuphathwa kobukhabezizempumelelo ngokubheka zayo. Amakhono: Ukubala, Ukuqamba imibhalo, Amakhono ekhompyutha, Amakhono olwimi, ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi, ukuhlaziywa kwezomnotho nezimali, ukuphathwa kwemithetho, ukucabanga ngokuhlela. Ikhono elibheke phezulu: Ikhono elidonsa phezulu kanye noBukhosi, ukuphathwa kwePprojekthi nesiNqubo, ukuphathwa kweShintsho, ukuphathwa koluntu nakubuyisela amandla, ukuphathwa kwezimali.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa Komkhondo: Ukuphathwa kweNqubomgomo, ukukhuthaza ukucutshungula inkinga nokunikelwa ngokwanelesa imikhondo ebalulekile. Ukulandela izimali ezichitshiwe ezindaweni zokuhlala nokugqoka izinkokhelo zePphrojekthi ezindaweni zokuhlala ezihlobene nazohlelo bonke beNational Housing Programmes: ukuhlangana okubuka imali edlalayo, ukuhlangana naloMasipala, ukunikwa ngemibiko ye-DORA; ukuqonda nokubuka ukuphumelela kwamaphrojekthi onke asoMasipala ezindaweni zokwakha: ukuhlangana naloMasipala, ukunikwa ngemibiko ye-DORA, ukunikwa ngemibiko evela ekuhanjisweni. Ukuphathwa kweNqubomgomo (ehlanganisa ukuphathwa kweShintsho): ukuchaza nokubuyekeza njalo ngamunye umuntu ngenhloso, imigogo, izinkomba ezibalulekile kanye nemisebenzi yoMnyango. Ukubuka ngokuqhubeka ukuphumelela koMnyango ngokuqhathaniswa izinhloso ezibalulekile, ezimiswe ngaphambilini, eziningiziwe nezigawu. Ukuhlinzeka umbiko kuMdidiyeli oMkhulu: ukuSetshenziswa koluntu ekusebenziseni izindlu ngokuvamile nangemisebenzi yeMnyango nangezinto ezingabantu nezimali, nokubeka irekhodi ehambisana nemithetho nezinganekwane, ngemva kokubuka imali ehamba, ukuba nokuthuthukiswa kolwazi oluthile nangemali yokulawula amaphrojekthi asemthethweni ohlelweni lukahulumeni, nokwenza noma yimuphi umsebenzi ohlotshaniswa neSikhundla sikaMdidiyeli. Ukuphathwa koluntu: Ukubamba iqhaza ekuthatheni koluntu abasebenza, izinga ngalinganiselwe ukuthi kuvunyelwe ukuphumelela uMnyango, ukumangaliswa ngemfundo nokuhola abantu abangaphakathi kwaloMnyango. Ukuphathwa ngokuqhubeka ngokuphumelela kwakhe nokubuyisa ngokubamba iqhaza emisebenzini yakhe, ukubuka imisebenzi engaphezulu, ukuqoqwa kokuhlola nokukhokha abasebenzi bomnyango. Ukulandela nokubuka imisebenzi yokwakhiwa ngemfundo kanye nokubuka imisebenzi yakho, ukubandakanya ekubukeni kwakhe ngemfundo yezimali ekuchithwa imali, ukuhlongoza, ukuqeqesha nokuhlola abasebenzi abangaphakathi kwaloMnyango ukuthi bafike futhi bagcine ukuphumelela ekuletheni koluntu, nokuba nomthelela ekubukeni nangokuhlela imisebenzi ekufanele ngokuthuthukiswa koluntu abangaphakathi, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imali ihambisana nezinhloso ezinhle zikaMnyango neseMnyango Wamaphrojekthi Abantu. Ukuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi emisebenzi kahulumeni nasemali ebalulekile ekusebenziseni amaphrojekthi, nokuba nokuthuthukiswa kolwazi kanye nokuhlela imisebenzi ekufanele ibe nokuhlelwa kahle eMnyangweni, ukuhlinzeka umbiko kuMdidiyeli oMkhulu: ukuHlelwa koluntu kwamaphrojekthi nasemibhungweni ebalulekile ngezimali zikaMnyango kanye nokuba nokubika ngokuphelele ukuthi izimali zikaMnyango zihamba kahle na. Ukuphathwa kwezimali: Ukuphatha ukubandakanyeka ekwenziweni kwezimali eMnyangweni. Ukubika ngemali yokwenziwa kwemisebenzi nokuNgqongqosha kwezimali zokuQedela imisebenzi yakho, nokubuka imisebenzi yokuCwazisa imali yokwakhiwa, ukuphendula ngokuphelele ngokuHlela kwezimali nokuchitheka kwawo wonke amaphrojekthi akho. Ukuphendula ngokuqhubeka ngokusebenzisa amandla akho okuthi izinkontiloka ezihamba kahle zinamathiselwe ngemisebenzi yakho, nokuba khona emzini wakho. Ukuphendula ngokuqhubeka ngokusebenzisa amandla akho okuthi izinkontiloka ezihamba kahle zinamathiselwe ngemisebenzi yakho, nokuba khona emzini wakho. Ukubika ngemali ehanjiswa nangemisebenzi ekufanele mayelana neMnyangweni nakumabhulo ahamba kahle neNkantolo eNkulu ukulandela imisebenzi yeMnyango ekuphetheni kweSikhundla, nokulalela imisebenzi ekufanele nokuba namandla okuphatha konke okuhle mayelana nezimali zikaMnyango, nokuba nomthelela wokuphatha ukuphathwa nokugcina izimali zikaMnyango. Ukubeka izinto ezibalulekile ezinhle zokuphatha izinsimbi zokubeka eMnyangweni ezohlelweni lokuBeka amaphrojekthi ahamba kahle nakwezinye izinkomba ezinhle.

xh.title: Umphathi: Ulawulo loMvuzo nokuSebenza koMaspala
xh.summary: Isithuba somphathi kwisebe leenkonzo zeempahla eWestern Cape elibhekene nolawulo lomvuzo nokuqhuba kwamaspala, lifuna iziqulqo ezikumgangatho weNQF 7 kunye namashumi eminyaka emi-5 yamava ohloliweyo ohlalo.
xh.requirements: Isiqu esifanelekileyo semviwo yamagama esimlinganisweni weNQF level 7 okwa singathwa ngokulingana njengoko kuhlonitshwa ngumZAC; - Iqondo elingaphantsi kweminyaka emi-5 yamava ohlalo oluphakathi/ophezulu wabaphathi. Iimfuno: Ulwazi: Ulwazi olusikwayo nokuqonda iinkqubo, iinkqubo zokuqhuba nezixhobo zenkonzo engurhulumende, Ulwazi olusikwayo nokusiqonda ukuzaliseka kweekonkara zobugcisa, zomthetho nezokusetyenziswa kolawulo, Ulwazi olusikwayo nokuqamba esetyenzisweni kuMthetho wekaNaka neNdlu kwesiPhondo, kuMthetho woPhuhliso lweNdlu eWestern Cape, kuKhowudi yeNdlu yelizwe, iinkqobo zokuziphatha nezinye iinkqubo ezahlobene nezicwangciso zenkonzo yendlu, Ulwazi olusikwayo nokuqamba esetyenziswinizincwadi ezahlobene kwiNdlu yophuhliso lobuMakade (CIDB), ezahlobene kwiNkomithi yoBhaliso lwaBakhiwo beZindlu beliZwe (NHBRC), nakwiMimisela yoMthetho yakuAkha amaNdamo, Ulwazi olusikwayo nokusiqonda imithetho yokwakha egqithiswe kamva, iinkqubo ezenziwa phakathi kwamakhiwo nokuLawulwa kweenkonzo ezibhaliweyo, Ulwazi olusikwayo nokusiqonda ukwakhiwa kweenkcukacha kwaye ulawule amaphrojekthi kulwakhiwo lwendawo, Ulwazi olusikwayo nokusiqonda iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo zokuziphatha, iinkqubo, iinkqubo ezisemgangathweni nezinto ezilungileyo ezinomdla kokuqhubwa kwezonqwelo zemizi ekusebenziseni., Ulwazi olusikwayo nokusiqonda iingxwagu zoNgeniso lweZonwamso nokuHamba koluntu, Ulwazi olusikwayo nokusiqonda iindaba zepolitiki nezomquba-mali kwelizwe naphakathi nasemhlabeni jikelele ezichukumisa esiPhondo seWestern Cape, Ulwazi olusikwayo nokuqamba esetyenzisweni koMthetho woLawulo lweMali oNgurhulumente (PFMA), Ulwazi olusikwayo nokuqamba esetyenzisweniweenkqubo zolawulo lweemali nemiThetho exhulunayo, iimiso kunye nobukrelekrele bokwenza iikhomiti zemali, Ulwazi olusikwayo nokuqamba esetyenzisweni koMthetho wokuHlengwa kwaye kuKhuseleke kuMsebenzi (OCHSA), Ulwazi olusikwayo nokusiqonda imithetho, iinkqubo zolawulo, iinkqubo zokuziphatha neendlela ezilungileyo ezinomthelela kumashishini, Ulwazi olusikwayo nokusiqonda iinkqubo zolwazi ezinceda ekulawuleni ulwazi ngenkcazelo ngaloo mashishini, Ulwazi olusikwayo nokusiqonda iinkqubo zokuThengisa nokukhetha abakhiwo beemveliso, Ulwazi olusikwayo nokusiqonda ukuphuhliswa kweekhava, ulawulo loqhagamshelo nokuqwalasela iinkqubo ezilungele ukwenziwa, Ulwazi olusikwayo nokusiqonda iinkqubo zangoku zolawulo loluntu noMphathi, Ulwazi olusikwayo nokusiqonda iindaba zepolitiki, zomquba-mali nezoluntu ezilawula urhulumente kumazwe ngamazwe, kwimimandla nakumapondo eWestern Cape, Ulwazi olusikwayo nokusiqonda iinkqubo zoluntu, zomthetho nethiyori zamashishini alawula inkonzo yelizwe koluntu eSouth Africa, Ulwazi olusikwayo nokusiqonda iindlela zoluntu ezimala, zokuqhuba abantu nokuLawulwa kweenkqubo, Ulwazi olusikwayo nokusiqonda ukusebenza koluntu nakumashishini oonjineli abakwindalo yesiPhondo, Ulwazi olusikwayo nokusiqonda iinkqubo zokuziphatha zikorhulumende wasemzini, Ulwazi olusisiseko nokuqonda imithetho nemiThetho eeLunga loluntu, Ulwazi olusikwayo nokusiqonda uLawulo loKwenza ulwazi nengqiqo ngokubanzi. Amandla: ukubala nokuqonda amanani, ukufunda nokubhala, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, amandla olimi, uLawulo lweNkqubo, uQeqesho ngokomquba-mali, iNkqubo yoMthetho woLawulo, uCwangciso olusesini. Iinkqubo ezingamandla: Amandla okuQamba izicwangciso eNkulu kunye noLawulo, uLawulo lweNkqubo noLawulo lweNkqubo, uLawulo loNtotho, uLawulo koluntu noKhululeko, uLawulo lweMali.
xh.duties: Ulawulo oluqotho: Ulawulo oluqhuba izicwangciso, inceda alungiselela ekuqhubeni koluntu phantsi kolwazi kwaba mandla alandelayo: Qwalasela ukuchithwa kwemali kwindlu ukuze ulawule izigqibo zemisebenzi ephefumlelwa kumaphulo onke okubhatawe kumaphulo onke eMbuso: Amanani emali ethi ikhawule, iintlangano kwindlu ukuze iqhutshwe, amanani eDora; Linganisa ngokubanzi inkcitha yamaspala: Amatsumba endlu, amanani eDora, amanani eNgqokelela. Ulawulo oluKhululekileyo (oluqulathe nolawulo olungenamthetho): Misela uphelo olucwangciswayo ngokungatshintsha ukusuka kumagama oqobo, nentsingiselo, izinto eziphambili nokwenza okuqhuba kweSebe leMifula, Qonda ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha yamagama amakhulu ukuze ulinganise ukwenza koluntu kwiNkqubo ngokuchaneka kwamagama aqhutywa yonke imihla esigqibele ukulunga ngokomgangatho, Linganisa ulwazi olukhoyo oluvela kuluntu ngokubanzi ekuhambeni kwexesha nangakwabo babantu abakhoyo ngokomsebenzi wokuba balungise uluntu ngokugqibeleleyo ngokusemthethweni, Qhuba iinkqubo nendlela entsha ukwenza okukhoyo kuluntu nakwindlu yolonwamso lweNdlu, Zonke izigqibo mazibhekwe ngqo ngokugqibeleleyo kwindlu ekuzameleni ukwenza iinkonzo ngokusemthethweni nezigqibo ezisemthethweni.

jobs.title: Director: Land and Asset Management
jobs.centre: Department of Infrastructure, Western Cape Government
jobs.summary: Director of Land and Asset Management position within the Western Cape Department of Infrastructure, requiring an NQF level 7 qualification and five years of senior management experience.
jobs.requirements: A relevant NQF level 7 qualification or equivalent as recognised by SAQA; A minimum of 5 years' experience middle/senior management. Competencies: Knowledge: Proven knowledge and understanding of public service procedures, processes and systems, Proven knowledge and understanding of engineering, legal and operational compliance, Knowledge of property management, Proven knowledge and practical application of the National and Provincial Housing Act, Western Cape Housing Development Act, National Housing Code, guidelines and other related housing policies and prescripts, Proven knowledge and practical application of the Construction Industries Development Board (CIDB) guidelines, National Home Builders Registration Council (NHBRC) guidelines, as well as the National Building Regulations, Proven knowledge and understanding of the latest building legislation, building contracts and Contract Administration. Proven knowledge and understanding of project design and project management in the built environment, Proven knowledge and understanding of strategic policies, guidelines, standard procedures and best practices relevant to human settlement implementation, Proven knowledge and understanding of Human Settlements and Local Government delivery issues, Proven knowledge and understanding of the global and local political economics and social affairs impacting on the Province of the Western Cape, Proven knowledge and practical application of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Proven knowledge and practical application of financial management processes and related Acts, regulations and the ability to set up budgets, Proven knowledge and practical application of the Occupational Health and Safety Act (OCHSA), Proven knowledge and understanding of legislation, regulatory frameworks, policies and best practices that have a bearing on the line functions, Proven knowledge and understanding of information systems that aid in the management of knowledge and information pertaining to the line function, Proven knowledge and understanding of procurement and tendering processes, Proven knowledge and understanding of policy development, and strategy management, monitoring and review processes, Proven knowledge and understanding of modern systems of governance and administration, Proven knowledge and understanding of the global, regional and local political, economic and social affairs impacting on the provincial government of the Western Cape, Proven knowledge and understanding of Constitutional, legal and institutional arrangements governing the South African public sector, Proven knowledge and understanding of public finance, human resources and discourse management processes, Proven knowledge and understanding of the functioning of the Province and the activities of sister departments, Proven knowledge and understanding of the policies of the government of the day, Basic knowledge and understanding of Labour Relations legislation and regulations, Proven knowledge and understanding of performance management in general. Skills: Numeracy, Literacy, Computer Literacy, Language skills, Project Management, Economic, financial analysis, Legal Administration, Strategic Planning Competencies: Strategic Capability and Leadership, Project and Programme Management, Change Management, People Management and Empowerment, Financial Management.
jobs.duties: Line Management: Strategic management, advice and guidance in respect of the following functional areas: Promote the issuing of title deeds, manage the transfer of properties to housing debtors and manage the rental housing portfolio of the Department, Manage the following in respect of Title Deed Administration: Conveyancing, Title Deed Vault Management, the Pre-Emptive Rights process and the Title Deed Restoration Process' ,Manage the following in respect of leasing: sourcing of tenants, the terms of the lease agreement, efficient implementation of the maintenance budget and maximizing rental collection, Manage and facilitate the disposal of properties/land, Implement the disposal plan (devolution of property to Municipalities) in terms of section 15 of the Housing Act (Act 107 of 1997)., Facilitate the finalization of outstanding Land Availability Agreements, Manage the immovable assets and update the property register, Verification of the Housing Immoveable Assets of the Department of Infrastructure, Sanitisation of the National Debtor System with respect to immoveable assets Strategic Management (including change management): Define and review on a continual basis the purpose, objectives, priorities and activities of the Directorate, Drive the Directorate’s strategic planning process, Drive the development and management of the strategic and business plans for the Directorate, Evaluate the performance of the Directorate on a continuing basis against pre-determined key measurable objectives and standards, Report to the Chief Director: Human Settlements Planning on a regular basis on the activities of the Directorate and on matters of substantial importance relating to operational management support, Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant legislation and prescripts in respect of adequate and appropriate record keeping of the activities of the Directorate, and of the resources (people, finances and assets) employed by it, Foster and promote a culture of innovation within the Directorate, and the Branch Human Settlements, Diligently perform all duties assigned to the post of Director. People Management: Participate in the recruitment of employees in the numbers and grades appropriate to ensure the achievement of the Directorate’s Business Plan, Motivate, train and guide employees within the Directorate, to achieve and maintain excellence in service delivery, Actively manage the performance, evaluation and rewarding of employees within the Directorate, Monitor information capacity building within the Directorate, Ensure involvement in the compilation of a workforce plan, a service delivery improvement programme, and an information resources plan for the Directorate, Promote sound labour relations within the Directorate, Actively manage and promote the maintenance of discipline within the Directorate. Financial Management: Manage participation in the budgeting process at Directorate level, Ensure the preparation of the Annual and Adjustment Budgets for the Directorate, Assume direct accountability for the efficient, economic and effective control and management of the Directorate’s budget and expenditure, Assume direct accountability for ensuring that the correct tender and procurement procedures are adhered to in respect of purchases for the Directorate, Assume direct accountability for ensuring contracts are managed effectively and efficiently for the Directorate, Ensure that all spending is aligned with the strategic objectives of the Directorate and the Branch Human Settlements, Report to the Chief Director: Human Settlements Planning and relevant oversight role players/committees on all aspects of the Directorate’s finances, Assume overall accountability for the management, maintenance and safekeeping of the Directorate assets, Assume direct accountability for ensuring that appropriate risk management procedures are in place and adhered to for the Directorate, Ensure that full and proper records of the financial affairs of the Directorate are kept in accordance with any prescribed norms and standards.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co OTHER POSTS
jobs.notes: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. Kindly note that technical support is only available from Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 16:00. Should you experience any difficulties with your online application you may contact the helpline on 0861 370 214. Please ensure that you submit your application on or before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this post, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. All shortlisted candidates must make themselves available to be interviewed at a date, time and place as decided by the selection panel. All shortlisted candidates will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to assess relevant functional elements of the job and an interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will be required to complete the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) and submit the certificate before he/she can be appointed to this post. The purpose of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme, which is a public service specific training programme applicable to all applicants who aspire to join the SMS, is to ensure that potential SMS members have a background in processes and procedures linked to the SMS. The duration of the online Pre-Entry Programme is 120 notional hours (15 days). Full details may be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training- course/sms-preentryprogramme . The successful candidate shall be subjected to a leadership assessment, within one (1) month of appointment, to assess the managerial competencies required for SMS members in the Public Service as specified under Chapter Five (5) of the SMS handbook. This assessment shall be conducted to determine an individual’s ability to lead, manage, and direct others and to identify developmental gaps in core generic leadership and management competencies. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. The successful candidate will be subject to security vetting; and the candidate will have to disclose her/his financial interests. Furthermore, thank you, to the huge public interest, we receive many applications for our posts, and as such will not be able to respond personally to all applications. Therefore, should you not hear from us within 10 weeks from close of the advert please consider your application unsuccessful. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Land- en Batebestuur
af.summary: Pos as Direkteur van Land- en Batebestuur binne die Western Cape Department of Infrastructure, waar 'n NQF vlak 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis word.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike NQF vlak 7-kwalifikasie of ekwivalent soos deur SAQA erken; 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring in middel-/seniorbestuur. Bevoegdhede: Kennis: Bewese kennis en begrip van openbare diensprosedures, prosesse en stelsels, Bewese kennis en begrip van ingenieurs-, regsonderhange en operasionele nakoming, Kennis van eiendomsbestuur, Bewese kennis en praktiese toepassing van die National and Provincial Housing Act, Western Cape Housing Development Act, National Housing Code, riglyne en ander verwante behuisingbeleid en voorskrifte, Bewese kennis en praktiese toepassing van die Construction Industries Development Board (CIDB) riglyne, National Home Builders Registration Council (NHBRC) riglyne, asook die National Building Regulations, Bewese kennis en begrip van die jongste bouwetgewing, boukontrakte en Kontrakadministrasie. Bewese kennis en begrip van projekontwerp en projekbestuur in die bou-omgewing, Bewese kennis en begrip van strategiese beleide, riglyne, standaardprosedures en beste praktyke wat van toepassing is op die implementering van menslike nedersettings, Bewese kennis en begrip van kwessies rakende die lewering van Menslike Nedersettings en Plaaslike Regering, Bewese kennis en begrip van die globale en plaaslike politieke ekonomie en sosiale aangeleenthede wat 'n impak het op die Province of the Western Cape, Bewese kennis en praktiese toepassing van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Bewese kennis en praktiese toepassing van finansiële bestuursprosesse en verwante Wette, regulasies en die vermoë om begrotings op te stel, Bewese kennis en praktiese toepassing van die Occupational Health and Safety Act (OCHSA), Bewese kennis en begrip van wetgewing, regulatoriese raamwerke, beleide en beste praktyke wat 'n uitwerking het op die lynfunksies, Bewese kennis en begrip van inligtingstelsels wat help met die bestuur van kennis en inligting wat verband hou met die lynfunksie, Bewese kennis en begrip van verkrygings en tenderprosesse, Bewese kennis en begrip van beleidontwikkeling en strategiebestuur, monitering en hersieningsprosesse, Bewese kennis en begrip van moderne stelsels van goederedery en administrasie, Bewese kennis en begrip van die globale, streek- en plaaslike politieke, ekonomiese en sosiale aangeleenthede wat 'n impak het op die provinsiale regering van die Western Cape, Bewese kennis en begrip van Konstitusionele, regtelike en institutionele reëlings wat die Suid-Afrikaanse openbare sektor regeer, Bewese kennis en begrip van openbare finansies, menslike hulpbronne en diskoersbestuursprosesse, Bewese kennis en begrip van die funksionering van die Provinsie en die bedrywighede van susterdepartemente, Bewese kennis en begrip van die beleide van die regering van die dag, Basiese kennis en begrip van Arbeidsverhoudingwetgewing en regulasies, Bewese kennis en begrip van prestasiebestuur in die algemeen. Vaardighede: Syfergeletterdheid, Geletterdheid, Rekenaargeletterdheid, Taalvaardighede, Projekbestuur, Ekonomiese, finansiële ontleding, Regsadministrasie, Strategiese Beplanning Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, Projekte en programbestuur, Veranderingsbestuur, Menslike bestuur en bemagtiging, Finansiële bestuur.
af.duties: Lynbestuur: Strategiese bestuur, advies en leiding ten opsigte van die volgende funksionele areas: Bevorder die uitreiking van titelaktes, bestuur die oordrag van eiendomme aan behuisingskuldenders en bestuur die huurbehuisingportfolio van die Departement; Bestuur die volgende ten opsigte van Titelakteadministrasie: Konvansering, Titelaktekluisbestuur, die voorkeurregteproses en die Titelakteherstelproses; Bestuur die volgende ten opsigte van verhuring: verkryging van huurders, die bepalings van die huurooreenkoms, doeltreffende implementering van die instandhoudingsbegroting en maksimalisering van huurinvordering; Bestuur en fasiliteer die beskikking van eiendomme/grond; Implementeer die beskikkingsplan (devolusie van eiendom aan Munisipaliteite) ooreenkomstig artikel 15 van die Housing Act (Act 107 of 1997).; Fasiliteer die finalisering van uitstaande Land Availability Agreements; Bestuur die roerende bates en werk die eiendomsregister by; Verifikasie van die Housing Immoveable Assets van die Department of Infrastructure; Suiwering van die National Debtor System ten opsigte van roerende bates Strategiese bestuur (insluitend veranderingsbestuur): Bepaal en hersien op 'n deurlopende basis die doel, doelwitte, prioriteite en bedrywighede van die Direktoraat; Dryf die Direktoraat se strategiese beplanningsproses aan; Dryf die ontwikkeling en bestuur van die strategiese en besigheidsplanne vir die Direktoraat aan; Evalueer die prestasie van die Direktoraat op 'n deurlopende basis teen vooraf bepaalde sleutel meetbare doelwitte en standaarde; Rapporteer op 'n gereelde basis aan die Hoofdirekteur: Menslike Nedersettingsbeplanning oor die bedrywighede van die Direktoraat en oor aangeleenthede van wesenlike belang rakende operasionele bestuursondersteuning; Monitor en verseker nakoming van toepaslike wetgewing en voorskrifte ten opsigte van voldoende en gepaste rekordhouding van die bedrywighede van die Direktoraat, en van die hulpbronne (mense, finansies en bates) wat daardeur gebruik word; Bevorder en hou 'n kultuur van innovasie binne die Direktoraat, en die Tak Menslike Nedersettings aan; Voer versigtig alle pligte uit wat aan die pos van Direkteur opgedra is. Menslike bestuur: Neem deel aan die werwing van werknemers in die getalle en grade wat toepaslik is om die bereiking van die Direktoraat se Besigheidsplan te verseker; motiveer, leer en lei werknemers binne die Direktoraat om uitmuntendheid in dienslewering te bereik en te handhaaf; Bestuur aktief die prestasie, evaluering en beloning van werknemers binne die Direktoraat; Monitor inligtingskapasiteitsbou binne die Direktoraat; Verseker betrokkenheid by die opstel van 'n werksmagplan, 'n diensleweringverbeteringsprogram en 'n inligtingshulpbronplan vir die Direktoraat; Bevorder goeie arbeidsverhoudinge binne die Direktoraat; Bestuur aktief en bevorder die handhawing van dissipline binne die Direktoraat. Finansiële bestuur: Bestuur deelname aan die begrotingsproses op Direktoraatvlak; Verseker die voorbereiding van die Jaarlikse en Aanpassingsbegrotings vir die Direktoraat; Aanvaar direkte verantwoordelikheid vir die doeltreffende, ekonomiese en effektiewe beheer en bestuur van die Direktoraat se begroting en besteding; Aanvaar direkte verantwoordelikheid daarvoor om te verseker dat die korrekte tender- en verkrygingsprosedures nagekom word ten opsigte van aankope vir die Direktoraat; Aanvaar direkte verantwoordelikheid daarvoor om te verseker dat kontrakte doeltreffend en effektief vir die Direktoraat bestuur word; Verseker dat alle besteding in lyn is met die strategiese doelwitte van die Direktoraat en die Tak Menslike Nedersettings; Rapporteer aan die Hoofdirekteur: Menslike Nedersettingsbeplanning en relevante toesigrolspelers/komitees oor alle aspekte van die Direktoraat se finansies; Aanvaar algehele verantwoordelikheid vir die bestuur, instandhouding en veilige bewaring van die Direktoraat se bates; Aanvaar direkte verantwoordelikheid daarvoor om te verseker dat toepaslike risikobestuurprosedures in plek is en nagekom word vir die Direktoraat; Verseker dat volledige en behoorlike rekords van die finansiële sake van die Direktoraat gehou word ooreenkomstig enige voorgeskrewe norme en standaarde.

zu.title: Umlawuli: Ukuqashwa Kwomhlaba Nezimpahla

eziyisizulu kanye nezindlela ezihamba phambili ezihambisana nokwakhiwa kwezindlu zabantu, Ulwazi oluchaziwe ngqo nezulu ngezindlu zabantu kanye ngezinkinga zokuhanjiswa kwazo ohulumeni basekhaya, Ulwazi oluchaziwe ngqo nezulu ngezomnotho zezepolitiki zomhlaba wonke nasedolobheni kanye nezindaba ezenzvelwano ezithinta i-Province of the Western Cape, Ulwazi oluchaziwe ngqo nokusetshenziswa kwe-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Ulwazi oluchaziwe ngqo nokusetshenziswa kwezinqubo zokuqashwa komnotho kanye ne-Mithetho ehlobene nawo, imithetho kanye namandla okubhaqa imibhalo yokuhlola, Ulwazi oluchaziwe ngqo nokusetshenziswa kwe-Occupational Health and Safety Act (OCHSA), Ulwazi oluchaziwe ngqo nezulu ngomthetho, izinhlelo zomthetho, izinqubomgomo kanye nezindlela eziyisibonelo ezinomthelela kumisebenzi yohlelo, Ulwazi oluchaziwe ngqo nezulu ngezinhlelo zolwazi ezisiza ekuphathweni kolwazi nolwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi ohleliwe, Ulwazi oluchaziwe ngqo nezulu ngemiklamo yokuthenga nokuqashisa imisebenzi, Ulwazi oluchaziwe ngqo nezulu ngokwakhiwa kwezinqubomgomo, nokuphathwa kwenqubomgomo, ukuqashwa nokubuyekeza izinhlelo, Ulwazi oluchaziwe ngqo nezulu ngohlelo lwanamuhla lokubusa nokuphatha izwe, Ulwazi oluchaziwe ngqo nezulu ngezepolitiki zomhlaba, zesifundazwe nasedolobheni, ezenzvelwano ezipolitiki nezomnotho ezithinta uhulumeni wesifundazwe i-Western
