Ukuphathwa kwemali: Ukubamba iqhaza ekubhaleni nasekubunjweni kwezimali ohlelweni, Ukuqinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kwe-Bhajethi Yonyaka kanye nokuqashwa ngokuvumela i-Bhajethi ohlelweni, Ukuzibophezela ngokuqondile ngokuzifela ngokuphila kokuphathwa kwe-Bhajethi yohlelo kanye nemali edlula kuyo, Ukuzibophezela ngokuqondile ngokuzifela ukuthi izindlela ezifanele zokubamba imisebenzi nezokuthengisa ziyalandelwa ohlelweni ekuthengeni izinto, Ukuzibophezela ngokuqondile ngokuzifela ukuthi izinkondzo ziyaphathwa kahle futhi ngokuphila ohlelweni, Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi konke ukuchithwa kwemali kuhambisana nezinhloso ezibalulekile zohlelo, Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi konke ukuchithwa kwemali kuhambisana nezinhloso eziyisibonelo zohlelo kanye neNhleko Yokubeka Abantu Kude, Ukubika ngoMlawuli Ohlelo: KokuHlelela Okubeka Abantu Kude nakubo bonke abadlula kumkhakha wokugqamisa noma amakomidi ngakho konke okuphathelene nezimali zohlelo, Ukuzibophezela ngokuphelele ngokuphathwa, ukulondolozwa nokugcinwa izimpahla zohlelo, Ukuzibophezela ngokuqondile ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi zikhona futhi ziyalandelwa izindlela zokuphathwa kwezingozi ezifanele ohlelweni, Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kugcinwa umkhondo ozele futhi ohlelekile wemali yangaphakathi kanye nezimali zohlelo ngokuhambisana nanoma yimiphi imithetho ekuqashwe ngayo.

xh.title: Umlawuli: Ulawulo Lomhlaba Nee-Asethi
xh.summary: Isithuba somLawuli Wolawulo Lomhlaba Nee-Asethi kwisebe leZenzo eZakhiwayo laseWestern Cape, sifuna isifikelelo esingangoqophamalo lwe-NQF level 7 namava eminyaka emihlanu ebalulekileyo yolawulo.
xh.requirements: Isifikelelo esifanelekileyo esingangoqophamalo lwe-NQF level 7 okanye esilinganayo njengoko samkelwe yi-SAQA; Ubuncinane bemava eminyaka engama-5 kwindima ephakathi nolawulo oluphakamileyo. Ikhono ezifunekayo: Ulwazi: Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo kuqonda iinkqubo, iinkqubo zokuqhuba neendlela zolawulo lwabasebenzi baseburhulumente, Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo lokuqonda iyanjingalwazi, ulwento lomthetho nokuhambelana nokusebenza, Ulwazi ngolawulo lwepropati, Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo nokusetyenziswa okubonwayo koMthetho wezeNdlu yaseNasional nasePhondo, uMthetho wokuPhuhlisa iNdlu yaseWestern Cape, iKhowudi yeNdlu yeNasional, izikhokelo namanye amapholisi ahambelana nendlu namagunya athile, Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo nokusetyenziswa okubonwayo kwezikhokelo ze-Construction Industries Development Board (CIDB), izikhokelo ze-National Home Builders Registration Council (NHBRC), nakuzo iMigaqo yeZakhiwo yeNasional, Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo lokuqonda umthetho wamva nje wezakhiwo, iinkqubo zokwakha nokuLawulwa kweNkqubo yokuqamba. Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo lokuqonda uyilo lomprojekthi nolawulo lomprojekthi kwindawo esakhiweyo, Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo lokuqonda amapholisi ohambele phambili, izikhokelo, iinkqubo eziqhelekileyo neendlela ezilungileyo ezihambelana nokuphuhliswa kwezindlu, Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo lokuqonda iindaba zokuhanjiswa kweZindlu koRhulumente waseKhaya, Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo lokuqonda urhwebo lwezopolitiko lwehlabathi nasedawini nemicimba yentlalo echaphazela iPhondo le-Western Cape, Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo nokusetyenziswa okubonwayo koMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoRhulumente (PFMA), Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo nokusetyenziswa okubonwayo kweendlela zolawulo lweemali nkoMthetho, iimigaqo ezinxulumene nazo nakho ukwazi ukuhla uluhlu lweemali, Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo nokusetyenziswa okubonwayo koMthetho woKhuseleko loMsebenzi nokuQhuba (OCHSA), Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo lokuqonda umthetho, iinkqubo zolawulo, amapholisi neendlela ezilungileyo ezinomdla kumisebenzi yomgca, Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo lokuqonda iinkqubo zolwazi eziluncedo ekulawulweni kolwazi nolwazi olunomdla kumsebenzi womgca, Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo lokuqonda iinkqubo zokuthenga nokwenza izicelo zenani, Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo lokuqonda ukuphuhliswa kwamapholisi, nolawulo lwezicwangciso, ukuqokelelwa kolwazi nokuqwalasela iinkqubo, Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo lokuqonda iinkqubo zanamhlanje zolawulo nezolawulo lweenkonzo, Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo lokuqonda imicimba yezopolitiko, yezoqoqosho nentlalo yehlabathi, yolawulo nakwindawo echaphazela urhulumente wephondo le-Western Cape, Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo lokuqonda ukuqhelaniswa komgaqo-nkqubo, iingqinelwano zomthetho neziko ekulawulweni kwicala likawonke-wonke laseMzantsi Afrika, Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo lokuqonda iimali zikawonke-wonke, imithombo yabantu nendlela zokuqhuba iingxoxo, Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo lokuqonda ukusebenza kwePhondo nemisebenzi yamanye amasebe, Ulwazi olubonakalisiweyo lokuqonda amapholisi orhulumente wanamhlanje, Ulwazi olubuncinane nokuqonda umthetho nokuqatshwa kolawulo abasebenzi. Amakhono: Amanani, Ukufunda nokubhala, Ulwazi lweKhompyutha, Amakhono oLwimi, uLawulo lomProjekthi, Ulwazi lwezoQoqosho, uQwalaselo lweMali, uLawulo lomThetho, uQwalaselo lweZicwangciso eziQhubela Phambili Ikhono: Ikhono eliQhubela phambili nokuBaNhlahli, uLawulo lomProjekthi nokuQhutywa kweNkqubo, uLawulo lotshintsho, uLawulo lwaBantu nokuBa mandla, uLawulo lweMali.
xh.duties: ULawulo lomGca: ULawulo oluhambela phambili, iingcebiso nokuqondisa ngenkqubo yamagaba osebenzo alandelayo: Khuthaza ukunikwa kwezatyi zetayitile, ulawule ukudluliswa kwepropati kumatyala ezindlu ulawule ilungelo elihlawulelwayo lepropati yesebe, ULawule oku kulandelayo malunga noLawulo lweSatyi zeTayitile: ukuQhuba iinkonzo zomthetho, ULawulo lweSatyi zeTayitile eZigcinwayo, inkqubo yamaLungelo aqalisayo nokuQaliswa kwesatyi yetayitile, ULawule oku kulandelayo malunga noqesho: ukukhangela abaqeshwayo, iimeko zesivumelwano soqesho, ukuphumeza ngokusebenzayo umvuzo wolawulo lweemizi nokuqokelela ngaphezela inqokelelo yokuqeshwa, ULawule uncedise ukulahleka kwepropati/omhlaba, Phumeza isicwangciso sokulahleka (ukunikwa kwepropati kwiMassipala) ngokwesigaba sika-15 soMthetho weNdlu (uMthetho 107 ka-1997)., Uncede ukugqitywa kwezivumelwano ezingagqitywanga zoMhlaba oFumanekayo, ULawule ii-asethi ezingatshukiyo uhlaziye irekhodi lepropati, uQinisekiso kweAsethi ezingatshukiyo ezeNdlu zesebe leZenzo eZakhiwayo, Ukucotha inkqubo yeMatyala eNasional malunga nee-asethi ezingatshukiyo. ULawulo oluHambela phambili (kuquka noLawulo lotshintsho): Misela uqwalasele ngokuqhubekayo injongo, iinjongo, iinkqabelo nemisebenzi yeNdiki, Qhobosha inkqubo yesicwangciso esihambela phambili seNdiki, Qhobosha ukuphuhliswa nolawulo lwesicwangciso nesicwangciso sehloro seNdiki, Qwalasela inkqubo yeNdiki ngokuqhubekayo ngokumelene neenjongo ezikhaliphusiyo eziphawulekayo nemiqathango, Icwangcise kuQondisi oPhambili: uQwalaselo loLwakho lweNdlozi ngokujongeleyo ngeenkqubo zeNdiki nangemicimba ebalulekileyo enxulumene nencedo yolawulo lokusebenza, Qwalasela uqinisekise ukuhambelana nomthetho namagunya ahambelanayo malunga nokugcina iirekhodi ezaneleyo nangokufanelekileyo zemisebenzi yeNdiki, nemiqobo (abantu, iimali nee-asethi) esetyenziswe kuyo, Khuthaza uqhubise ulwazi olutsha oluqhamakelayo ngaphakathi kweNdiki, naseQhwakaxa uLwakho lweNdlozi, Yenza ngokuzinikela yonke imisebenzi enikwa kule ndawo yoMlawuli. ULawulo lwaBantu: Thatha inxaxheba ekuzuzeni abasebenzi ngokwamanani namanqanaba afanelekileyo ukuqinisekisa ukufezwa kweHloro lweNdiki, Phefumbuzisa, qeqesha uqondise abasebenzi ngaphakathi kweNdiki, ukuze kufezwe kugcinwe ulwamilombo ekunikezweni kweenkonzo, Yenza ngokusebenzayo ulawulo lwenkqubo, uqwalaselo nokuzuzwa abasebenzi ngaphakathi kweNdiki, Qwalasela ukwakhiwa kwamakhono kolwazi ngaphakathi kweNdiki, Qinisekisa ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuyileni isicwangciso sabasebenzi, inkqubo yonikezelo lweenkonzo eziphuculwayo, nenhlobo yolwazi ngaphakathi kweNdiki, Khuthaza amaxesha alungileyo amava abasebenzi ngaphakathi kweNdiki, Yenza ngokusebenzayo uqhubise ukugcinwa kwesithintelo ngaphakathi kweNdiki. ULawulo lweMali: ULawule inxaxheba kule nkqubo yokwenza i-bhajethi kwinqanaba leNdiki, Qinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kweBhajethi yeNyaka nokuLungelelanisa ngeNdiki, Thatha inxaxheba ngokuthe ngqo ekubeni yinyani ekulawulweni okusebenzayo, okutyhilekileyo nokuqhuba kakhulu i-bhajethi neentlawulo zeNdiki, Thatha inxaxheba ngokuthe ngqo ekuzinikezeleni ukwenza ngokuqinisekileyo iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo zokuthengisa nokuthenga ngokwemithetho ezidingwa kumthengiso weNdiki, Thatha inxaxheba ngokuthe ngqo ekuzinikezeleni ukuba iinkqubo ziyaphathwa ngokusebenzayo ngokuchanekileyo kwiNdiki, Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imali echithwayo ihambelana neenjongo ezihambela phambili zeNdiki neQhwakaxa eYakhiweyo, Icwangcise kuQondisi oPhambili: uQwalaselo loLwakho lweNdlozi nabadlali beQembu/qalaselo/iindlu ezibalulekileyo ngakunye na zonke iindaba zothutho ngenkqubo yeNdiki, Thatha inxaxheba ngokupheleleyo ekuzinikezeleni ekulawulweni, ekugcineni nasekugcineni ngokhuseleko kweNdiki yeNdiki, Thatha inxaxheba ngokuthe ngqo ekuzinikezeleni ukuba iinkqubo zolawulo lengozi ezifanelekileyo zikho zihambelane nazo zeNdiki, Qinisekisa ukuba iirekhodi ezize nezenyaniso zezindaba zothutho zisebe zigcinwa ngokumthetho nangokwemilinganiselo echazwayo.

jobs.title: Chief Engineer (GRADE A): Materials
jobs.centre: Department of Infrastructure, Western Cape Government.
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R1 317 108 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), (OSD as prescribed).
jobs.summary: Chief Engineer (Grade A) in Materials at the Western Cape Department of Infrastructure, requiring an engineering degree, ECSA registration and six years' experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Engineering degree (B Eng/BSC (Eng)) or relevant qualification); Six years post qualification engineering experience required; Compulsory registration with ECSA as a Professional Engineer; A valid code B driving license. Competencies: Technical: Programme and project management; Engineering, legal and operational compliance; Engineering operational communication; Process knowledge and skills; Maintenance skills and knowledge; Mobile equipment operating skills; Engineering design and analysis knowledge; Research and development; Computer-aided engineering applications; Creating high performance culture; Technical consulting; Ensure material design standards, specifications and quality control processes are applied and continuously improved; Lead innovation and improvements in road materials; Support asset management through the use of materials performance data; Provide technical advice on materials for development applications, abnormal loads and impacts on the road network; Guide laboratory testing, field investigations and material monitoring to support sound decision-making. Generic: Strategic capability and leadership; Problem solving and analysis; Decision making; Team leadership; Creativity; Financial management; Customer focus and responsiveness; Communication; Computer skills; People management; Planning and organising; Conflict management; Negotiation skills; Change management.
jobs.duties: Engineering design and analysis effectiveness; Maintain engineering operational effectiveness: Governance: Allocate, control, monitor and report on all resources; Financial Management; People management.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department by applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. Only applications submitted online will be accepted. Kindly note that technical support is only available from Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 16:00. Should you experience any difficulties with your online application you may contact the helpline on 0861 370 214. Please ensure that you submit your application on or before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this post, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. All shortlisted candidates must make themselves available to be interviewed at a date, time and place as decided by the selection panel. All shortlisted candidates will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to assess relevant functional elements of the job and an interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will be required to complete the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) and submit the certificate before he/she can be appointed to this post. The purpose of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme, which is a public service specific training programme applicable to all applicants who aspire to join the SMS, is to ensure that potential SMS members have a background in processes and procedures linked to the SMS. The duration of the online Pre-Entry Programme is 120 notional hours (15 days). Full details may be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training- course/sms-preentryprogramme . The successful candidate shall be subjected to a leadership assessment, within one (1) month of appointment, to assess the managerial competencies required for SMS members in the Public Service as specified under Chapter Five (5) of the SMS handbook. This assessment shall be conducted to determine an individual’s ability to lead, manage, and direct others and to identify developmental gaps in core generic leadership and management competencies. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. The successful candidate will be subject to security vetting; and the candidate will have to disclose her/his financial interests. Furthermore, thank you, to the huge public interest, we receive many applications for our posts, and as such will not be able to respond personally to all applications. Therefore, should you not hear from us within 10 weeks from close of the advert please consider your application unsuccessful. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofingenieur (GRADE A): Materiale

jobs.title: Control Engineering Technologist: Materials Laboratory
jobs.centre: Department of Infrastructure, Western Cape Government.
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R958 776 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), (OSD as prescribed).
jobs.summary: Control Engineering Technologist needed to manage materials laboratory advisory services and technological support within the Department of Infrastructure.
jobs.requirements: Bachelor of Technology in Engineering (B Tech) or relevant qualification; Six years post qualification Engineering Technologist experience required; Compulsory registration with ECSA as a Professional Engineering Technologist; A valid code B driving license. Competencies: Technical: Project management; Technical design and analysis knowledge; Research and development; Computer-aided engineering applications; Knowledge of legal compliance; Technical report writing; Technical consulting; Networking; Professional judgment; Knowledge of road construction materials and testing methods; Understanding of applicable standards and laboratory accreditation systems; Materials data analysis and interpretation; Laboratory quality management. Generic: Problem solving and analysis; Decision making; Team leadership; Creativity; Change management; Financial management; Customer focus and responsiveness; Communication; Computer skills; Planning and organising; People management.
jobs.duties: Manage technological advisory services: Plan technological support to Engineers and associate professionals in the field; Ensure the adherence and promotion of safety standards in line with statutory and regulatory requirements; Solve broadly defined technological challenges through application of proven techniques and procedures; and Develop, maintain and manage current technologies; Monitoring and evaluation of technological designs; Evaluate and monitor existing technical manuals, standard drawings and procedures to incorporate new technology; Ensure quality assurance of technical designs with specifications and make recommendations for approval by the relevant authority; and Identify and optimize technical solutions by applying engineering principles; Manage administrative and related functions: Provide inputs into the budgeting process; Compile and submit reports as required; Provide and consolidate inputs to the technological/engineering operational plan; Ensure the development, implementation and maintenance databases; and Manage and supervise technological and related personnel and assets; Research and development: Continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures; Research/literature studies on engineering technology to improve expertise; To liaise with relevant bodies/councils on engineering-related matters.

af.title: Beheeringenieurtegnoloog: Materiaallaboratorium
af.summary: Beheeringenieurtegnoloog benodig om materiaallaboratorium-adviesdienste en tegnologiese ondersteuning binne die Department of Infrastructure te bestuur.
af.requirements: Bachelor of Technology in Engineering (B Tech) of tersaaklike kwalifikasie; Ses jaar post-kwalifikasie Ingenieurtegnoloog-ervaring vereis; Verpligte registrasie by ECSA as 'n Professionele Ingenieurtegnoloog; 'n Geldige kode B-bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Tegnies: Projekbestuur; Tegniese ontwerp- en analise-kennis; Navorsing en ontwikkeling; Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings; Kennis van regsgeleenthede; Tegniese verslagskrywing; Tegniese konsultasie; Netwerking; Professionele oordeel; Kennis van padkonstruksiemateriale en toetsmetodes; Begrip van toepaslike standaarde en laboratoriumakkreditasiestelsels; Materiaaldata-analise en -interpretasie; Laboratoriumkwaliteitsbestuur. To submit your application, there are 3 methods in which you can apply, please only use 1 of the following: 1.Hand deliver your application for Attention: Western Cape Government Jobs, 44 Gannet Street Pelican Heights, Cape Town (From Monday to Friday between 07:00am to 17:00pm); Or 2.Post your application for Attention: Western Cape Government Jobs, PO Box 22432, Fish Hoek, 7974, Or 3.Email your application to, westerncape@respond.co.za Clearly indicate the reference number of post in email subject line and ensure attachments are in the appropriate format (MS Word or PDF).
jobs.notes: Applications not submitted on or before the closing date as well as faxed copies will not be considered. If you did not receive any correspondence within 3 months of closing date, consider your application as unsuccessful. NB: Applicants from relevant local communities will receive preferences. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Kindly note that technical support is only available from Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 16:00. Should you experience any difficulties with your online application you may contact the helpline on 0861 370 214. Please ensure that you submit your application on or before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. By applying for this post, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. All shortlisted candidates must make themselves available to be interviewed at a date, time and place as decided by the selection panel. All shortlisted candidates will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to assess relevant functional elements of the job and an interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will be required to complete the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) and submit the certificate before he/she can be appointed to this post. The purpose of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme, which is a public service specific training programme applicable to all applicants who aspire to join the SMS, is to ensure that potential SMS members have a background in processes and procedures linked to the SMS. The duration of the online Pre-Entry Programme is 120 notional hours (15 days). Full details may be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training- course/sms-preentryprogramme . The successful candidate shall be subjected to a leadership assessment, within one (1) month of appointment, to assess the managerial competencies required for SMS members in the Public Service as specified under Chapter Five (5) of the SMS handbook. This assessment shall be conducted to determine an individual’s ability to lead, manage, and direct others and to identify developmental gaps in core generic leadership and management competencies. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. The successful candidate will be subject to security vetting; and the candidate will have to disclose her/his financial interests. Furthermore, thank you, to the huge public interest, we receive many applications for our posts, and as such will not be able to respond personally to all applications. Therefore, should you not hear from us within 10 weeks from close of the advert please consider your application unsuccessful. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Store-assistent: Voorsieningskettingbestuur en Vloot
af.summary: Store-assistent wat voorsieningskettingbestuur en vlootbedrywighede ondersteun, en voorraadbeheer, store-administrasie en batebestuur vir die Western Cape Department of Infrastructure hanteer.
af.requirements: Grade 9/ NQF level 1 (ekwivalent of hoër kwalifikasie). Bevoegdhede: Kennis en begrip van die volgende: Basiese store- en voorraadbeheerprosedures; Ontvangs, registrasie, bewaring en uitreiking van voorraad; Voorraadbeheer en voorraadtellingprosese; Rekordbestuur en liasseerprosedures; Occupational Health and Safety vereistes; Batebestuursbeginsels; Veilige hantering en berging van brandstof, smeermiddels en chemikalieë; Vaardighede in die volgende: Syfer- en taalvaardigheid; Basiese rekenaarvaardigheid; Betrede van toerusting en hantering van voorraad; Kommunikasie; Voorraadbeheer-rekordhouding; Interpersoonlike vaardighede en spanwerk; Organisering en beplanning.
af.duties: Store-administrasie en voorraadrekordbestuur; Store-bedrywighede, voorraadbeheer en bewaring; Brandstof- en verbruikstowwebestuur; Operasionele ondersteuning en bystand met batebestuur.

zu.title: Umsizi Wesitoreji: Ukuphathwa Kwenhlanganisela Yokulethwa Nokubuyiselwa Nokuphathwa Kwemoto
zu.summary: Umsizi Wesitoreji osekela ukuphathwa kwenhlanganisela yokulethwa nokubuyiselwa kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwemoto, elibambe ukulawula izinto ezigcinwa, ukuphathwa kwezinto zesitoreji nokuphathwa kwempahla kwa Western Cape Department of Infrastructure.

xh.title: Umlweli weenkcukacha zesitokh: uLawulo loMthengiso kunye neeFleet
xh.summary: Umlweli weenkcukacha zesitokh oxhasa ulawulo lomthengiso kunye nemisebenzi yeeFleet, uphatha ulawulo lwesitokh, ulawulo lwebhala zesitokh kunye nolawulo lwefa lukaSebe leMisinga eNtshona Koloni.

Ikhompetensi: Ulwazi nokuqonda oku kulandelayo: Iindlela ezisisiseko zokulondolozo nesilawulo sesitokh; Ukamkelwa, ukubhalisa, ukhuselo nokunikwa kwesitokh; Ulawulo lwesitokh kunye neenkqubo zokuqhuba ukubala kwesitokh; Ulawulo lweekhordh kunye neenkqubo zokulondoloza iifayile; Iimfuno zoLawulo loKhuseleko nokuQhwalela emsebenzini; Iimigaqo yolawulo lwefa; Ukuphatha ngokhuseleko noku gcina ifowudi, iiolubrikhenti namanqwana; Amakhono oku kulandelayo: Ukubala nokuqonda; Ulwazi olusisiseko lweekhompyutha; Ukusebenzisa isixhobo nokuphatha isitokh; Unxibelelwano; Ukugcina iirekhodi zoLawulo lweSitokh; Unxibelelwano nomanyano komsebenzi; Ukuhlela nokuqamba.
xh.duties: Ulawulo lwebhala zesitokh nokuqhuba iirekhodi zolawulo lwesitokh; Imisebenzi yesitokh, ulawulo lwesitokh nokuqidisa; Ulawulo lwefowudi nezinto ezisetyenziswa; Inkxaso yemisebenzi noluncedo lolawulo lwefa.

af.title: Direkteur: Munisipale Infrastruktuur
af.summary: Direkteur verantwoordelik vir die monitering en fasilitering van munisipale infrastruktuurbeplanning, instandhouding, ontwikkeling en begroting regoor die Western Cape.
af.requirements: 'n Relevante kwalifikasie op NQF level 7 soos deur SAQA erken; 5 jaar se middel-/seniorbestuurservaring. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap; Projekte en programbestuur; Veranderingsbestuur; Personeelbestuur en bemagtiging; Finansiële bestuur.
af.duties: Moniteer munisipale infrastruktuurbeplanning, instandhouding, ontwikkeling en begroting; Fasiliteer langtermyn munisipale infrastruktuurbeplanning en befondsing met behoorlike inagneming van munisipale begrotings en gesamentlike distriks- en metro-benaderingsprosesse; Fasiliteer ondersteuning aan munisipaliteite met vollewatigerflikbaan batesbeplanning, raamwerke, beleide en stelsels; Ondersteun munisipaliteite met infrastruktuurbeheer en dienslewering; Verseker dat prestasie van munisipaliteite gemonitor word en verskaf professionele en tegniese ondersteuning met betrekking tot die implementering van die Munisipale Kapitaalbegroting; Strategiese bestuur (insluitend veranderingsbestuur); en Finansiële en personeelbestuur.

zu.title: Umphathi: Isisekelo Sabaholi
zu.summary: Umphathi obheke ukugcina amehlo futhi athuthukise ukulungiselelwa, ukugcinwa, ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokubeka amabhajethi esisekelo sabaholi kuyo yonke i-Western Cape.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezihambisana nalesi sikhundla ezingeni le-NQF 7 njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA; 5 weminyaka yamava okuphathi emazingeni aphakathi/aphezulu. Amakhono: Ukukwazi Ukuphatha Ngohlaka Namandla Okukhokela; Ukuphatha Amaphrojekthi Namaphrogramu; Ukuphatha Ushintsho; Ukuphatha Abasebenzi Nokubakhulisa; Ukuphatha Izimali.
zu.duties: Ukugcina amehlo ukulungiselelwa, ukugcinwa, ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokubeka amabhajethi esisekelo sabaholi; Ukuthuthukisa ukulungiselelwa esikhathini eside nesisekelo sabaholi nokuxhaswa ngemali ngokuqaphela amabhajethi abaholi kanye namasu okuhlanganisa izifunda namadolobha amakhulu; Ukuthuthukisa ukweseka abaholi ngokulungiselela ipulani yempahla kuyo yonke impilo yayo, uhlaka, izinqobo kanye namasistimu; Ukusekela abaholi ngokuphatha isisekelo nabakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokulethwa kwezinsizakalo; Ukuqinisekisa ukugcinwa kwamehlo ukwenzela abaholi nokunika ukweseka ngamandla nobuchwepheshe ngokuqondene nokusetshenziswa kweBhajethi Yamaphrojekthi Abaholi; Ukuphatha Ngohlaka (okuhlanganisa nokuphatha ushintsho); kanye Nokuphatha Izimali nabasebenzi.

xh.title: Um lawuli: Isakhiwo Sesixeko
xh.summary: Umlawuli onoxanduva lokugqola kwaye uncinge uqeqesho lwesakhiwo sesixeko, ukonza, uphuhliso kunye nokubhala ngemali echanekileyo kulo lonke elase Western Cape.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekileyo kwinqanaba le-7 le-NQF njengoko evunyelwe yi-SAQA; 5 iminyaka yamava aphakathi/phezulu ekulawuleni. Iikhompetensi: Ikhowudi yoBuchule beNtshukumo kunye noBuntloloko; uLawulo lweProjekthi neNkqubo; uLawulo lweenguqu; uLawulo labaBantu nokuBanika amandla; uLawulo lweMali.
xh.duties: Gqola uqeqesho lwesakhiwo sesixeko, ukonza, uphuhliso nokubhala ngemali echanekileyo; Cincisa uqeqesho lwesakhiwo sesixeko nxesha elide kunye nefundo ngokucingela ngemali yasesixeko nendlela edibana nayo iithawula zesixeko nolwazi lweendawo nakumanxulumo apho kusetyenziswa iindlela ezisetyenziswa ngawo; Cincisa inkxaso emasixekweni ngokwakhiwa kwezinto eziqheliswayo ubomi babo bonke, iinkqubo, iinkqubo zemigaqo nezohlwayo; Xhasa amasixeko ngokulawula isakhiwo nokunikela iinkonzo; Qinisekisa ukugqola inkqubo yamava amasixeko anayo kunye nokunikela inkxaso ngobuchule nakngobugcisa bokusebenza ngokusetyenziswa kweMali eChanekileyo yeSixeko; uLawulo oluvakalayo (kuquka uLawulo lweenguqu); nokuLawula koBantu nakoMali.

jobs.title: Personal Assistant: HOD Support
jobs.centre: Department of Local Government, Western Cape Government
jobs.summary: Personal assistant providing secretarial and administrative support to the Head of Department in the Western Cape Department of Local Government.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 (Senior Certificate or equivalent qualification) plus an accredited secretarial diploma and/or administrative qualification on the level of NQF level 5 or relevant higher tertiary qualification; A minimum of 3 years experience in rendering secretarial/ administrative support services to management/ senior management. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: In-depth knowledge and understanding of the relevant legislation/policies / prescripts and procedures; Financial administration; Professional ethics, integrity, confidentiality and discretion; Effective time Management and ability to meet deadlines; Excellent interpersonal relations; Planning, organising and coordinating tasks effectively; Sound judgement and decision-making; Customer service orientation. Skills in the following: Excellent telephone etiquette; Computer literacy in MS Office Package (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook and Internet); Financial Management; Strong Language and Communication Skills (written and verbal); Good interpersonal and people- management skills; High level of reliability and dependability; Sound organisational and planning skills; Ability to act with tact and discretion; Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgement in handling sensitive matters; Self-management and self-motivation; Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities; Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
jobs.duties: Provide a secretarial/receptionist support service to the manager; Render administrative support services to the manager; Provide support to manager regarding meetings; Support the manager with the administration of the manager’s budget; Study the relevant Public Service and departmental prescripts/ policies and other documents and ensure that the application thereof is understood properly.

af.title: Persoonlike Assistent: Ondersteuning aan Hoof van Departement
af.summary: Persoonlike assistent wat sekretariële en administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Hoof van Departement in die Western Cape Department of Local Government verleen.
af.requirements: Grade 12 (Senior Certificate or equivalent qualification) plus 'n geakkrediteerde sekretariële diploma en/of administratiewe kwalifikasie op die vlak van NQF level 5 of relevante hoër tersiêre kwalifikasie; 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in die lewer van sekretariële/administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste aan bestuur/seniorbestuur. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Diepgaande kennis en begrip van die relevante wetgewing/beleide/voorskrifte en prosedures; Finansiële administrasie; Professionele etiek, integriteit, vertroulikheid en diskresie; Effektiewe tydbestuur en vermoë om sperdatums na te kom; Uitstekende interpersoonlike verhoudings; Doeltreffende beplanning, organisering en koördinering van take; Goeie oordeel en besluitneming; Klantediensgerigtheid. Vaardighede in die volgende: Uitstekende telefoonetiket; Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Office Package (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook and Internet); Finansiële bestuur; Sterk taal- en kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling); Goeie interpersoonlike en mensebestuursvaardighede; Hoë vlak van betroubaarheid en afhanklikheid; Degelike organisatoriese en beplanningsvaardighede; Vermoe om met takt en diskresie op te tree; Vermoe om vertroulikheid te handhaaf en goeie oordeel te gebruik in die hantering van sensitiewe sake; Selfbestuur en selfmotivering; Vermoe om onder druk te werk en mededingende prioriteite te bestuur; Vermoe om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk.

zu.title: Insiza Yomuntu: Ukusekela uNobhala
zu.summary: Insiza yomuntu ehlinzeka ngokusekela ngomsebenzi wokubhalisa kanye nokusebenza ngokuphatheka kwezokubhalisa kwiNkundla yeNyango kusenleminyango iWestern Cape Department of Local Government.

Bevoegdhede: Kennis van en werkervaring in die volgende: wetgewing, reguleringsraamwerke, beleide en beste praktyke wat relevant is tot die lynfunksies; gebruik van inligtingstelsels wat die bestuur van kennis en inligting met betrekking tot die lynfunksie ondersteun; bestuur van projekte; implementering van operasionele bestuurspraktyke; implementering van mentorskap en afrigtingspraktyke; bestuur van nasionale en provinsiale menslike hulpbron-, finansiële bestuurs- en voorsieningskettingbestuursinstrumente en -wetgewing; ondersteuning en implementering van nasionale en provinsiale beleide van die regering van die dag; begrip en ondersteuning van provinsiale regeringsfunksies en -dienste; bestuur van die statutêre raamwerk wat die breë bestuur van die staatsdiens regeer; bestuur van personeelprestasiebestuurstelsels; bestuur van dissiplinêre en grieprocedures; Vaardighede: uitvoer van geletterdheids en syvaardigheidsfunksies; effektiewe gebruik van rekenaarstelsels; effektiewe kommunikasie in die vereiste taal; bestuur van projekte; uitvoer van rekenmeester-, finansies- en ouditfunksies; Anders: voer ontleding uit; voer meting uit; pas konseptuele, interpretatiewe en formuleringsvaardighede toe; voer diagnostiese assesserings uit; fasiliteer en verskaf proseskonsultasie; beïnvloed belanghebbendes; implementeer innoverende probleemoplossing; ontwerp intervensies; voer onderhoude; verskaf leierskap; luister doeltreffend; gee mentorskap en afrigting; motiveer personeel en belanghebbendes; onderhandel effektief; bou en onderhou professionele netwerke; beplan en organiseer aktiwiteite; lewer aanbiedings; voer navorsing uit; bou effektiewe spanne; handhaaf sterk interpersoonlike verhoudings.
af.duties: Benoem die instandhouding en verbetering van digitale burgerbetrokkenheid oor WCG-kanale; Verskaf inwoners met die nodige infrastruktuur en vaardigheidsontwikkelingsgeleenthede om regeringsdienste deur middel van tegnologie te gebruik en te ontsluit; Lewer doeltreffende, burgergesentreerde dienste oor digitale kanale; Verskaf 'n data- en verslagdoeningsdiens vir WCG-digitale kanale; Beplan en bestuur die werk en verantwoord vir die algehele prestasie van die Subdirektoraat; Bestuur personeel en finansies.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Forensic Investigations
jobs.centre: Department of the Premier, Western Cape Government.
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 - R1 098 195 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive salary package)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director needed to manage forensic investigations, lifestyle audits and case reporting at the Department of the Premier, Western Cape Government.
jobs.requirements: A qualification at NQF level 7 or equivalent in Commerce / Law / Auditing / Forensics / BCom IT or Informatics, or another relevant qualification. A minimum of 3 years’ relevant middle-management experience, or 6 years operational experience in a forensic investigation, governance or related environment, with practical experience in conducting and reporting on forensic investigations. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: legislation, regulatory frameworks, policies and best practices relevant to the line functions; use information systems that support the management of knowledge and information relating to the line function; conduct data analytics and use digital forensic tools, including Audit Command Language, IBM i2 Analyst’s Notebook, Intella or similar tools, to collect, analyse and preserve evidence; manage projects; implement operational management practices; manage procurement and tendering processes; develop, implement, monitor and review policies and operational processes; manage modern systems of governance and administration; manage public service procedures, processes and systems; understand regional and local political, economic and social affairs impacting on the provincial government of the Western Cape; understand Constitutional, legal and institutional arrangements governing the South African public sector; manage public finance, human resources and related administrative processes; implement the Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations and other applicable financial policies, prescripts, directives and collective agreements; understand the functioning of the Province and the activities of sister departments and related functional areas; support the policies of the government of the day; manage Labour Relations legislation and regulations; manage performance management processes; Skills: perform numeracy and literacy functions; perform literacy functions; use computer systems effectively; communicate effectively in the required language; manage projects; perform accounting, finance and audit functions; perform legal administration; conduct forensic investigations and analysis; Other: conduct forensic interviews and evaluate evidence; draft forensic reports, legal documents and presentations; analyse, interpret and conceptualise complex information; solve problems; collect, analyse and visualise large datasets and draw appropriate conclusions; negotiate, resolve conflicts, consult and liaise with stakeholders; use digital forensic tools, data analytics and relevant forensic IT applications; plan and organise activities; conduct quality assurance; manage projects; manage people; coach and mentor staff; manage performance; work effectively under pressure; manage ambiguity; maintain confidentiality, independence, ethical conduct and professional standards.
jobs.duties: Manage forensic investigation intake, assessment, planning and prevention support; Manage and quality assure the execution of forensic investigations and lifestyle investigations / audit; Manage investigation reporting, recommendations and case finalisation; Plan and manage the work of and account for the overall performance of the allocated departments; People Management; Financial Management.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Forensiese Ondersoeke
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur benodig om forensiese ondersoeke, leefstyloudits en gevalverslagdoening by die Department of the Premier, Western Cape Government te bestuur.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasie op NQF level 7 of gelykwaardig in Commerce / Law / Auditing / Forensics / BCom IT of Informatics, of 'n ander relevante kwalifikasie. Minimum van 3 jaar se relevante bestuurservaring op middelvlak, of 6 jaar operasionele ervaring in 'n forensiese ondersoek-, beheer- of verwante omgewing, met praktiese ervaring in die uitvoer en rapportering van forensiese ondersoeke. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: wetgewing, reguleringsraamwerke, beleide en beste praktyke wat relevant is tot die lynfunksies; gebruik van inligtingstelsels wat die bestuur van kennis en inligting rakende die lynfunksie ondersteun; uitvoer van data-analise en gebruik van digitale forensiese gereedskap, insluitend Audit Command Language, IBM i2 Analyst's Notebook, Intella of soortgelyke gereedskap, om bewyse te versamel, ontleed en bewaar; bestuur van projekte; implementering van operasionele bestuurspraktyke; bestuur van verkrygings- en tenderprosesse; ontwikkeling, implementering, monitering en hersiening van beleide en operasionele prosesse; bestuur van moderne stelsels van beheer en administrasie; bestuur van openbare diensprosedures, prosesse en stelsels; begrip van streek- en plaaslike politieke, ekonomiese en sosiale aangeleenthede wat 'n impak het op die provinsiale regering van die Western Cape; begrip van grondwetlike, regtelike en institusionele reëlings wat die Suid-Afrikaanse openbare sektor regeer; bestuur van openbare finansies, menslike hulpbronne en verwante administratiewe prosesse; implementering van die Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations en ander toepaslike finansiële beleide, voorskrifte, riglyne en kollektiewe ooreenkomste; begrip van die funksionering van die Provinsie en die aktiwiteite van susterdepartemente en verwante funksionele areas; ondersteuning van die beleide van die regering van die dag; bestuur van Arbeidsverhoudingswetgewing en regulasies; bestuur van prestasiebestuursprosesse; Vaardighede: uitvoer van syfer- en geletterdheidsfunksies; uitvoer van geletterdheidsfunksies; doeltreffende gebruik van rekenaarstelsels; doeltreffende kommunikasie in die vereiste taal; bestuur van projekte; uitvoer van rekenkundige, finansiële en ouditfunksies; uitvoer van regtelike administrasie; uitvoer van forensiese ondersoeke en analise; Ander: uitvoer van forensiese onderhoude en evaluering van bewyse; opstel van forensiese verslae, regtelike dokumente en aanbiedings; analise, interpretasie en konseptualisering van komplekse inligting; oplossing van probleme; versameling, analise en visualisering van groot datastelle en trek van toepaslike gevolgtrekkings; onderhandeling, oplossing van konflikte, konsultasie en skakeling met belanghebbendes; gebruik van digitale forensiese gereedskap, data-analise en relevante forensiese IT-toepassings; beplanning en organisering van aktiwiteite; uitvoer van gehaltversekering; bestuur van projekte; bestuur van mense; afrigting en mentorskap van personeel; bestuur van prestasie; doeltreffende werk onder druk; bestuur van dubbelsinnigheid; handhawing van vertroulikheid, onafhanklikheid, etiese gedrag en professionele standaarde.
af.duties: Bestuur van forensiese ondersoek-intake, assessering, beplanning en voorkomingsondersteuning; Bestuur en gehaltversekering van die uitvoering van forensiese ondersoeke en leefstylondersoeke / oudits; Bestuur van ondersoekverslagdoening, aanbevelings en gevalsfinalisering; Beplanning en bestuur van die werk van en verantwoording vir die algehele prestasie van die toegekende departemente; Menslikehulpbronbestuur; Finansiële bestuur.

zu.title: Isiphathamandi: Ukuhlola Izehlakalo Ezingezansi Komthetho
zu.summary: Kudingeka isiphathamandi esizophatha ukuhlola izehlakalo ezingezansi komthetho, ukuhlola isimo sokuphila nokubikaamacala eKundini KaNdunankulu, Hulumende Wase Western Cape.

ukuphatha imali yomphakathi, abasebenzi nezinqubomgomo zokuphathwa okuhlobene; ukuphatha umthetho we-Actoaphathwa Imali yoMphakathi, emiGomo yoHulumende kazwelonke nowesifundaze kanye nezinye izinqubomgomo zamali, imiyalo, imiyalo ehamba phambili nezivumelwano ezihlangene; ukuqonda ukusebenza kwesiFunda nemicimbi yeminyango ezingamaphiwo namakhandawo ahlobene; ukusekela izinqubomgomo zohulumende waso sonke isikhathi; ukuphatha umthetho weMibambo yoBasebenzi; ukuphatha izinqubo zokuqashwa ngokusebenza kahle; Ukuzakhöla: ukwenza imisebenzi yezibalo nolimi; ukwenza imisebenzi yolimi; ukusebenzisa izinkqubo zekhompyutha kahle; ukuxhumana ngokuphumelelayo ngolimi oludingekayo; ukuphatha imiklomelo; ukwenza imisebenzi yamafayinansi, ukweHlolwa nokuQashwa; ukwenza izinqubo zomthetho; ukwenza ukulolwa kwamacala ezingezansi komthetho nokuHlolwa; Okunye: ukwenza izingcingo zamacala ezingezansi komthetho futhi uhlole ubufakela; ukuloba umbiko wamacala ezingezansi komthetho, amadokhumenti omthetho nezinkulumo; ukuHlolwa, ukutolika futhi ucabange ngemininingwane enzima; ukuxazula izinkinga; ukuqoqa, ukuhlazamula futhi ubonise izethi zemininingwane ezinkulu futhi ukhiphe iziphetho ezifanele; ukuxhumana, ukuxazula izingxabano, ukubonisana futhi uxhumane nabanikazi bamacala; ukusebenzisa amathuluzi wekhompyutha wezehlakalo ezingezansi komthetho, ukuHlolwa kwemininingwane nezinhlelo ze-IT ezihlobene namacala; ukuhlela futhi ulungelelisa imisebenzi; ukuHlolwa ngemikhiqizo emihle; xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Impzobo Phando

ukulawula iiprojekthi; ukwenza imisebenzi ye-akhawunti, ye-mali nokuqwalasela; ukwenza ulawulo lomthetho; ukuqhuba imzobo yophando nokuhlola; Ezinye: ukuqhuba iintervyu zemzobo yophando nokuqwalasela ubungqina; zu.title: Umenzi womsebenzi wokuqonda intuthuko yenhlekelele: Kwabanye
zu.summary: Nika amasevisi okuqonda intuthuko nokuklama kwenhlekelele, ukwesekwa kokuklama umsebenzi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhanjiswa kwezinsizakalo ezingangenela eminye iminyango yaso Western Cape Department of the Premier.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezinga le-NQF 6 (iziqu ezilingana noma eziphezwe kunalezo); Ubuncwane beminyaka eyi-1 yohlelo oluhambisana nalesi sikhundla. Amakhono: Ukwazi okuwukulandelayo: Ukusebenza kwenhlekelele ngokwendlela okuhlobene nolwazi ngentuthuko yenhlekelele; Inqubo, umkhuba, kanye nezindlela zokwenza ngokwemithetho yokwenza izinto ngokwentuthuko yenhlekelele, ngokupathwa nokuqhutshwa kwemikhiqizo yentuthuko yemidlalo, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubo nokwenza izinto okuhambisana nendlela okuziphatha ngayo; Okuhunyushwe ngemithetho, izakhiwo ezilawula izinto, izinqubo namakhalendu okusebenza kanye namakhulu okwaziyo axhumanayo; Izinhlelo zolwazi ezesekwa ukuphathwa kolwazi nemiyalo ngokwemithetho kahulumeni; Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo; Amakhulu okwenza ngokwemisebenzi; Amakhulu okwenza ngokwemithetho kanye nezele imithetho ebusayo; Ukulungiselela izinqubo, amakhulu okwenza umsebenzi, ukuqashwa kokutholakala kwemali kanye nokuqhathanisa izindlela; Izinhlelo zokulawula kahle kanye nokuqapha imikhuba entsha; Izinhlelo zangaphakathi, zomphakathi nezenhlalo nezomnotho zendawo ezingena ezweni elithi Western Cape; Izinhlelo ezibhekene nemithetho, ezomthetho kanye nangokwamaphoyisa, imfundo, impilo kanye nemithelela ngokomthetho wezwe; Indlela yokwenza ngokwemithetho, imali yomphakathi, abantu abangangeni, ezokusiza ukuba wazi okuhle kanye nezele imithetho; Imithetho yokuphathwa kwemali, kanye nemithetho ezilawula imali, kanye namakhulu okwenza ngokwemithetho; Imisebenzi yomthetho phakathi kwamaphoyisa, imfundo, ukuphathwa kwabantu; Ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni ezikwilizinga elifanayo nesikwabanye; Imithetho engangeni yamanye amaphoyisa; Imithetho ebusa abantu abangangeni kanye namakhulu okwenza umsebenzi wokuxazulula izinkinga; Izinqubo ezilawula imithetho yabasebenzi; Ukwazi ukwenza kahle imisebenzi yonke yokuphathwa. Amakhono eadingekayo: Ukufunda nokuqonda izibalo; Ukufunda nokubhala; Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Ukuthumela nokwamukela imiyalezo; Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo; Amakhono okuhlola; Amakhono okwenza izinto ezintsha; Amakhono okuhlola, ahlukanise futhi abeke ngokwendlela ekwenzeni izinto; Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga ezintsha; Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu; Amakhono okukhuthaza, okuxoxa futhi okukhuthaza; Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga ngendlela entsha; Amakhono okubuziswa imibuzo nokulalela; Amakhono okukhulisa kanye nokukhuthaza.
zu.duties: Nika nokusekela ukwenza ngcono amakhulu okwenza umsebenzi kahulumeni; Yedlula amasevisi okuklama umsebenzi; Nikeza amasevisi wokuhlanganisa amaphoyisa aphathwa kahle amaphoyisa; Nika nokwenza kube lula ukubuyisela izinsizakalo kanye nezinhlelo zokwenza izinto ezintsha; Nikeza imibuzo nokusekela ukwenza kube lula amakhulu abantu bokusebenza ngendlela entsha.

xh.title: Umntu oqhuba iinkqubo zophuhliso lwephondo: Ecaleni kweSebe
xh.summary: Unikeze iinkonzo zokwakhiwa nolungelelwaniso lwenhlangano, inkxaso ekwakhiweni komsebenzi, nokuqalwa kweenkonzo ezingangenangabeko kwiWestern Cape Department of the Premier.
xh.requirements: Iba na iziqu kwinqanaba leNQF 6 (iziqu ezilinganayo okanye eziphakamileyo); Iba nobungqondo obulingeneyo beminyaka elingu-1 ngokubalulekileyo. Iimfuno: Ulwazi ngokuqwalasela kwaba landelayo: Impumelelo yenhlangano njengoko idibanisa nolwandle lophuhliso wenhlangano; Itheory, indlela yomsebenzi nolwazi ngoluhlobo ekwakhiweni kwenhlangano, ekuphuhliseni iinkqubo nasekulungiseleleni iimveliso ngendlela entsha nasekuthintweni; Umthetho, iinkqubo ezilawulayo, iingqungquthela nendlela ezilungileyo ezinomthelela kwimisebenzi eqhuba iqela; Iinkqubo ezibonisa ulwazi ezenza lula ukulawula ulwazi nanabiso olumayela nesebe elenza imisebenzi; Ukulawula iiprojekthi; Indlela yokwenza imisebenzi yaloo ndalo; Iinkqubo zokuqamba nokuthenga iinkonzo eziyimfuno; Ukuphuhlisa iingqungquthela nendlela yokulawula, ukuqwalasela nokuphonononga iinkqubo; Iinkqubo entsha zolawulo nolawulo lwentsapho; Iinkqubo, iindlela neenkqubo zenkonzo zabantu ekuMontlwini nasemzantsi; Izinto ezithintelwa nguMgaqo-siseko, ngumthetho nangolawulo lwentsapho olubambe iqondo kummandla woluntu; Ulawulo lwemali yamanyano, abantu nobunkqonqodoxhwego kubakho namakhalaba aphuma kuwo; Umthetho oLawula iNzuzo zaVelu naMazwe ngamanye, nalawanye amathethomigaqo ewe nolunye ulwazi olumayela nemali, iziqendu, nalamagqabantshintshi phakathi kwemigqatswa namadyunivesithi; Isiphithiphithi seNguni nabiwezo, izinto ezininzi nemizamo yoluntu emva kwemithetho yephondo leNtshona Koloni; Iinkqubo ngokomthetho nangokwentsapho ezilawula inkonzo yamanyano eMzantsi Afrika; Iinkqubo zokulawula imali yamanyano, abantu nendlela yokuqhuba iinkqubo eziyinkqubo; Umthetho oLawula iNzuzo zaVelu naMazwe ngamanye, iMithetho yeTreasury yaseNgingini naseNtshona, nolunye ulwazi ngemigaqo yemali, iziqendu, nalamagqabantshintshi athunyelwe nakwindalo elungileyo njengoko kuxelwe ngumthetho; Ukwenza kwePhondo nendlela ekusingwa ngayo iisebe ezikwisihluthulelo/nendawo apho kubakho imisebenzi efanayo; Iingqungquthela karhulumente welo mini; Umthetho nobugcisa bokulawula iintlangano nabasebenzi; Ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi ngokubanzi. Iakhobho efunekayo: Isiphithiphithi sokubala; Isiphithiphithi sokufunda; Isiphithiphithi sekhompyutha; Ithungelwano elibhalwayo nokuwela. Ukulawula iiprojekthi; Iindidi zokuqwalasela; Iindidi ezibukisa iindawo ezahlukeneyo; Iindidi ezidibanisa izinto, ezingathathwa njengazo njengezinye zezinye; Iindidi zokuvavanya nokuqamba iindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto; Iindidi zokusasaza ulwazi nezinkcazelo; Iindidi zokuthembisa, ukuhlongandlela nokunika amandla; Iindidi ezintsha zokuxazula iingxaki; Iindidi zokubuza nokuva; Iindidi zokukhuthaza nokukhokeza abanye.
xh.duties: Unikeze nze inkxaso ekuweni ulwande kumandla entlalo yoluhlobo lomsebenzi ngaphakathi kwesebe; Unikeze inkonzo yokwakhiwa komsebenzi; Unikeze iinkonzo zolunyulo nolungelelwaniso loluhlobo iinkonzo ezingangenangabeko; Unikeze nze uluncedo kolunikezelo lweekonzo ezingangenangabeko nemiqulunqo yeBatho Pele; Unikeze umbono ngenkxaso ngokunika amandla nophuhliso kwenkonzo.

jobs.title: Organisational Development Practitioner: Transversal
jobs.centre: Department of the Premier, Western Cape Government
jobs.summary: Organisational Development Practitioner supporting capacity improvements, job design and OD interventions within the Western Cape Department of the Premier.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate 3-year National Diploma/B-Degree (equivalent or higher qualification); A minimum of 1 year relevant experience. Competencies: Knowledge and understanding of the following: Organisational performance as they relate to the field of organisation development; Organisation development theory, practice and techniques regarding organisation design, process development and improvement and behaviour; Understanding of information systems that aid in the management of knowledge and information pertaining to the line function; Understanding of project management; Working experience with the legislation, regulatory frameworks, policies and best practices that have a bearing on the line functions; Operational management practices; Understanding of procurement and tendering processes; Policy development, and operational management, monitoring and review processes; Modern systems of governance and administration; Public service procedures, processes and systems; Regional and local political, economic and social affairs impacting on the provincial government of the Western Cape; Constitutional, legal and institutional arrangements governing the South African public sector; Public finance, human resources and discourse management processes; Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, other financial policies, prescripts, directives and collective agreements; Functioning of the province and the activities of sister departments/related functional areas; Policies of the government of the day; Labour Relations legislation and regulations; Performance management in general. Skills needed: Numeracy; Literacy; Computer literacy in MS Office Package (Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc); Written and verbal communication skills; Project Management; Analytical skills; Benchmarking skills; Conceptual, interpretive and formulation skills; Diagnostic and intervention design skills; Facilitation and presentation skills; Influencing, negotiation and motivation skills; Innovative problem-solving skills; Interviewing and listening skills; Mentoring and coaching skills.
jobs.duties: Provide and support departmental work organisation capacity improvements (Supporting organisational diagnostics and implementing organisation design, business process improvement and OD interventions); Provide a job design service (Supporting job design and job evaluation processes, including developing competency-based job descriptions and assisting with job evaluation activities); Provide transversal organisation design and alignment services (Supporting organisation design work and alignment of structures, mandates and processes across departments); Provide and facilitate transversal service delivery and Batho Pele initiatives (Supporting the implementation of service delivery improvement initiatives, including Batho Pele-related activities and reporting); Provide input and support with practice enablement and development (Contributing to the development, maintenance and application of OD tools, methodologies, systems and information management).
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Organisasie-ontwikkelingspraktisyn: Transversaal
af.summary: Organisasie-ontwikkelingspraktisyn wat kapasiteitsverbeterings, werkontwerp en OD-intervensies binne die Western Cape Department of the Premier ondersteun.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma/B-Degree (ekwivalent of hoër kwalifikasie); 'n Minimum van 1 jaar relevante ervaring. Bevoegdhede: Kennis en begrip van die volgende: Organisasieprestasie soos dit verband hou met die veld van organisasie-ontwikkeling; Organisasie-ontwikkelingsteorie, -praktyk en -tegnieke met betrekking tot organisasie-ontwerp, prosesontwikkeling en -verbetering en gedrag; Begrip van inligtingstelsels wat help met die bestuur van kennis en inligting rakende die lynfunksie; Begrip van projbestuur; Werkervaring met die wetgewing, regulatoriese raamwerke, beleide en beste praktyke wat op die lynfunksies van toepassing is; Operasionele bestuurspraktyke; Begrip van verkrygings- en tenderaanbiedingsprosesse; Beleidsontwikkeling, en operasionele bestuur, monitering en hersieningsprosesse; Moderne stelsels van bestuur en administrasie; Openbare diens prosedures, prosesse en stelsels; Streeks- en plaaslike politieke, ekonomiese en sosiale aangeleenthede wat 'n uitwerking het op die provinsiale regering van die Western Cape; Konstitusionele, regtelike en institutionele reëlings wat die Suid-Afrikaanse openbare sektor regeer; Openbare finansies, menslike hulpbronne en diskoersbestuursprosesse; Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, ander finansiële beleide, voorskrifte, richtlyne en kollektiewe ooreenkomste; Funksionering van die provinsie en die bedrywighede van susterdepartemente/verwante funksionele areas; Beleide van die regering van die dag; Arbeidsverhoudingswetgewing en -regulasies; Prestasiebestuur in die algemeen. Vaardighede benodig: Syfervaardigheid; Geletterdheid; Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Office-pakket (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ens); Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede; Projbestuur; Analitiese vaardighede; Vergelykingsvaardighede; Konseptuele, interpretatiewe en formuleringsvaardighede; Diagnostiese en intervensie-ontwerpvaardighede; Fasiliterings- en aanbiedingsvaardighede; Beïnvloedings-, onderhandelings- en motiveringsvaardighede; Innoverende probleemoplossingsvaardighede; Onderhoudvoerings- en luistervaardighede; Mentorskaps- en afrigtingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf en ondersteun departementele werkorganisasie-kapasiteitsverbeterings (Ondersteun organisasie-diagnostiek en implementeer organisasie-ontwerp, besigheidsprosesverbetering en OD-intervensies); Verskaf 'n werkontwerpsdiens (Ondersteun werkontwerp- en werkevalueringsprosesse, insluitend die ontwikkeling van kompetensiegebaseerde werksbeskrywings en bystand met werkevalueringsaktiwiteite); Verskaf transversale organisasie-ontwerp- en belyningsdienste (Ondersteun organisasie-ontwerpswerk en belyning van strukture, mandate en prosesse oor departemente heen); Verskaf en fasiliteer transversale dienslewering en Batho Pele-inisiatiewe (Ondersteun die implementering van diensleweringverbeteringsinisiatiewe, insluitend Batho Pele-verwante aktiwiteite en verslagdoening); Verskaf insette en ondersteuning met praktykaktivering en -ontwikkeling (Dra by tot die ontwikkeling, instandhouding en toepassing van OD-instrumente, metodologieë, stelsels en inligtingsbestuur).

zu.title: Umuntu Oseqimeni Lokuthuthukiswa Kwenhlangano: Transversal
zu.summary: Umuntu oseqimeni lokuthuthukiswa kwenhlangano osekela ukuthuthukiswa kwamandla, ukwakhiwa kwezikhundla kanye nokungenelela kwe-OD ngaphakathi kwe-Western Cape Department of the Premier.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma ye-3 unyaka noma i-B-Degree efanele (izifundo ezingaba ngaphezulu noma ezilinganayo); Okungenani unyaka owodwa wamuva nje kokuba namava. Ikhono: Ulwazi nokuziqonda okumayelana nokulandelayo: Ukusebenza kwenhlangano okuhlobene nenhlangano yokuthuthukiswa kwenhlangano; Inqubo, amasu kanye nobuchwepheshe bokuthuthukiswa kwenhlangano mayelana nokwakhiwa kwenhlangano, ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubo nokuthuthukiswa kanye nokuziphatha; Ukuqonda izinhlelo zolwazi ezisiza ekuphathweni kolwazi nolwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi womugqa; Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi; Amava okusebenza nomthetho, izinhlelo zokulawula, izinqobo kanye nezinye izindlela ezinhle ezinomthelela kumisebenzi yomugqa; Amasu okuphatha ukusebenza; Ukuqonda izinqubo zokuthenga kanye namamakhulu amaNtshazantsha; Ukuthuthukiswa kwenqobo, ukuphathwa kokusebenza, ukugqamisa kanye nezinqubo zokuqagula; Izinhlelo zanamuhla zokuphathwa kanye nolawulo; Izinqobo, izinqubo kanye nezinhlelo zensevisi yomphakathi; Izindaba zezepolitiki, zawoqobo kanye nomphakathi zendawo ezinomthelela kurhulumente wesifundazwe sa-Western Cape; Izinhlelomthetho, zomthetho kanye nokuqashelwa kolawulo ebusa umphakathi kazwelonke wase-Ningizimu Afrika; Iziphoqo-mali zomphakathi, ulwazi labantu kanye nezinqubo zokuphathwa koxhumano; Umthetho Wokuphathwa KweziNkochi Zomphakathi, IziNgogo Zomnotho Kazwelonke NaseSifundazweni, kanye neminye imigomo yamaphahla, imiyalo, kanye noma izivumelwano; Ukusebenza kwesifundazwe kanye nemisebenzi yeminyango ehlobene/nezindawo zomsebenzi ezihlobene; Izinqobo zomrhulumente wanamuhla; Umthetho kanye nemiyalo yezibopho zomsebenzi; Ukuphathwa kokusebenza ngokujwayelekile. Amakhono adingekayo: Ubuchwepheshe bokubala; Ukufunda nokubhala; Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ohlelweni lwe-MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, njl); Amakhono okuxhumana ngokubhala nangokukhuluma; Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi; Amakhono okuhlaziya; Amakhono okulinganisa; Amakhono okucabanga, okutolika kanye nokuhlakahla; Amakhono okuxilonga nokuklama ukungenelela; Amakhono okukhulisa inkulumo kanye nokubhalela; Amakhono okuthonya, ukuxoxisana kanye nokukhuthaza; Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga ngokwesimanje; Amakhono okubuzwa imibuzo nokulalela; Amakhono okukhuthaza nakokubonisana.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka kwayesekele ukuthuthukiswa kwamandla okuhlela umsebenzi womnyango (Ukusekela ukuhlaziya kwenhlangano nokuphatha ukwakhiwa kwenhlangano, ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubo yebhizinisi kanye nokungenelela kwe-OD); Hlinzeka ngesevisi yokwakhiwa kwezikhundla (Ukusekela ukwakhiwa kwezikhundla kanye nezinqubo zokuqagula izikhundla, okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa izincazelo sezikhundla ezisekelwe ekhonweni kanye ukusiza kumasebenzi okuqagula izikhundla); Hlinzeka ngesevisi yokwakhiwa kwenhlangano etshazantsha kanye nokuqondanisa (Ukusekela umsebenzi wokwakhiwa kwenhlangano kanye nokuqondanisa kwezakhiwo, imigomo kanye nezinqubo kuzo zonke iminyango); Hlinzeka futhi uhwebise ngezinqubo zokulethwa kwensevisi etshazantsha kanye nemiyinge yentwasahlobo (Ukusekela ukuphatha imigomo yokuthuthukiswa kokulethwa kwensevisi, okuhlanganisa imisebenzi ehlobene nentwasahlobo kanye nokubika); Nikeza ngesibonelelo kwaye usekele ukwenza kwaye kukhulise isipiliyoni (Ukufaka isandla ekuthuthukisweni, ekuqophelweni nasekusetshenzisweni kwamathuluzi e-OD, izindlela, izinhlelo kanye nokuphathwa kolwazi).

xh.title: Umphathi woPhuhliso lweNhlangano: i-Transversal
xh.summary: Umphathi woPhuhliso lweNhlangano oxhasa ukuphuculwa kwamandla, ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi nangaphakathi kukaRhulumente weNtshona Koloni.

jobs.requirements: An appropriate qualification (NQF Level 7) or higher, as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). A minimum of five (5) years’ relevant experience at a senior managerial level. Competencies: Knowledge Proven knowledge of and working experience with the legislation, regulatory frameworks, policies and best practices that have a bearing on the line functions, Proven knowledge and understanding of information systems that aid in the management of knowledge and information pertaining to the line function, Proven knowledge and understanding of programme and project management, Proven knowledge and understanding of procurement and tendering processes, Proven knowledge and understanding of policy development, and strategy management, monitoring and review processes, Proven knowledge and understanding of modern systems of governance and administration, Proven knowledge and understanding of public service procedures, processes and systems, Proven knowledge and understanding of the global, regional and local political, economic and social affairs impacting on the provincial government of the Western Cape, Proven knowledge and understanding of Constitutional, legal and institutional arrangements governing the South African public sector, Proven knowledge and understanding of public finance, human resources and discourse management processes, Proven knowledge and understanding of the Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, other financial policies, prescripts, directives and collective agreements, Proven knowledge and understanding of the functioning of the Province and the activities of sister departments, Proven knowledge and understanding of the policies of the government of the day, Proven knowledge and understanding of Labour Relations legislation and regulations, Proven knowledge and understanding of performance management in general, Proven Knowledge on strategic sourcing, preferential procurement and Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment (B-BEE), Knowledge of financial management processes, Knowledge of industry trends and best practices per commodity groups, Knowledge of procurement best practices including sourcing strategies and the different mechanisms for procurement, Knowledge on procurement policies, procedures and contract management, Knowledge of records management, inclusive of registry services and policy and procedures governing these functions. Core Competencies: Strategic Capability and Leadership, Project and Programme Management, Change Management, People Management and Empowerment, Financial Management. Skills: Numeracy, Literacy, Computer Literacy, Language skills, Project Management, Accounting/ Finance/ Audit, Economic, Financial and Statistical analysis, Legal Administration |Strategic Planning, Excellent networking and network formation skills, Strong conceptual and formulation skills, Strong leadership skills with specific reference to the ability to display thought leadership in complex applications, Team building and strong inter-personal skills, Excellent communication skills (verbal and written), Outstanding planning, organising and people management skills, Highly developed interpretive and conceptualisation and formulation ability, Ability to multi-task, deal with ambiguity and manage under rapidly changing and pressurised circumstances, the ability to persuade and influence, Ability to deal with wide variety of external and internal stakeholders.
jobs.duties: Line management: Strategic management, advice and guidance in respect of the following functional areas: Ensure departmental management and financial accounting services; Ensure a departmental management accounting service, Budgeting and planning, Budget monitoring and reporting, Ensure a departmental financial accounting service, Expenditure management, Bookkeeping and financial statements, Salary administration and debt management, Banking and cash management, Provide and manage supply chain management (SCM) services; Manage governance and contract management, Manage bid- and quotation, logistics and LOGIS, Manage departmental assets and fleet management, Render a service with regard to planning, compliance, performance management, capacity building and risk management, Provide an operational support service; Ensure the rendering of information and communication technology (ICT), human capital, corporate assurance, legal and communication support services, Manage the professional development of occupation specific dispensation (OSD) professions, Provide executive support to the HoD, Coordinate security management, occupational health and safety (OHS) and accommodation matters, Ensure sound internal control practices; Ensure proper governance, Render assurance services, Provide effective and efficient fraud and losses management service Strategic Management (including change management) Define and review on a continual basis the purpose, objectives, priorities and activities of the Chief Directorate, Drive the Chief Directorate’s strategic planning process, Drive the development and management of the strategic and business plans for the Chief Directorate, Evaluate the performance of the Chief Directorate on a continuing basis against pre-determined key measurable objectives and standards, Report to the HoD on a regular basis on the activities of the Chief Directorate and on matters of substantial importance relating to operational management support, Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant legislation and prescripts in respect of adequate and appropriate record keeping of the activities of the Chief Directorate, and of the resources (people, finances and assets) employed by it, Foster and promote a culture of innovation within the Chief Directorate, and the Department, Diligently perform all duties assigned to the post of Chief Director. People Management: Participate in the recruitment of employees in the numbers and grades appropriate to ensure the achievement of the Chief Directorate’s Business Plan, Motivate, train and guide employees within the Chief Directorate, to achieve and maintain excellence in service delivery, Actively manage the performance, evaluation and rewarding of employees within the Chief Directorate, Monitor information capacity building within the Chief Directorate, Ensure involvement in the compilation of a workforce plan, a service delivery improvement programme, and an information resources plan for the Chief Directorate, Promote sound labour relations within the Chief Directorate, Actively manage and promote the maintenance of discipline within the Chief Directorate. Financial Management: Manage participation in the budgeting process at Chief Directorate level, Ensure the preparation of the Annual and Adjustment Budgets for the Chief Directorate, Assume direct accountability for the efficient, economic and effective control and management of the Chief Directorate’s budget and expenditure, Assume direct accountability for ensuring that the correct tender and procurement procedures are adhered to in respect of purchases for the Chief Directorate, Assume direct accountability for ensuring contracts are managed effectively and efficiently for the Chief Directorate and Department, Report to the Head of Department and relevant oversight role players/ committees on all aspects of the Chief Directorate’s finances, Assume overall accountability for the management, maintenance and safekeeping of the Chief Directorate assets, Assume direct accountability for ensuring that appropriate risk management procedures are in place and adhered to for the Chief Directorate, Ensure that full and proper records of the financial affairs of the Chief Directorate are kept in accordance with any prescribed norms and standards.
