Mensebestuur: Neem deel aan die werwing van werknemers in die getalle en grade wat toepaslik is om die bereiking van die Hoofdirektoraat se Besigheidsplan te verseker, Motiveer, lei en oplei werknemers binne die Hoofdirektoraat, om uitmuntendheid in dienslewering te bereik en te handhaaf, Bestuur aktief die prestasie, evaluering en beloning van werknemers binne die Hoofdirektoraat, Monitor inligtingskapasiteitsbou binne die Hoofdirektoraat, Verseker betrokkenheid by die samestelling van 'n werksmagplan, 'n diensleweringverbeteringsprogram, en 'n inligtingshulpbronplan vir die Hoofdirektoraat, Bevorder goeie arbeidsverhoudinge binne die Hoofdirektoraat, Bestuur aktief en bevorder die handhawing van dissipline binne die Hoofdirektoraat. Finansiële bestuur: Bestuur deelname aan die begrotingsproses op Hoofdirektoraatsvlak, Verseker die voorbereiding van die Jaarlikse en Aanpassingsbegrotings vir die Hoofdirektoraat, Neem direkte aanspreeklikheid vir die doeltreffende, ekonomiese en effektiewe beheer en bestuur van die Hoofdirektoraat se begroting en uitgawes, Neem direkte aanspreeklikheid om te verseker dat die korrekte tender- en verkrygingsprosedures nagekom word ten opsigte van aankope vir die Hoofdirektoraat, Neem direkte aanspreeklikheid om te verseker dat kontrakte doeltreffend en effektief bestuur word vir die Hoofdirektoraat en Departement, Rapporteer aan die Head of Department en tersaaklike toesigrolspelers/komitees oor alle aspekte van die Hoofdirektoraat se finansies, Neem algehele aanspreeklikheid vir die bestuur, instandhouding en veilige bewaring van die Hoofdirektoraat se bates, Neem direkte aanspreeklikheid om te verseker dat toepaslike risikobestuursprosedures in plek is en nagekom word vir die Hoofdirektoraat, Verseker dat volledige en behoorlike rekords van die finansiële sake van die Hoofdirektoraat gehou word ooreenkomstig enige voorgeskrewe norme en standaarde.

zu.title: Umongameli Ohamba Phambili: Ukulawula Izimali
zu.summary: Umongameli Ohamba Phambili: Ukulawula Izimali we-Department of Social Development, Western Cape, ofuna izifundo ze-NQF Level 7 namaphuzu eminyaka yisihlanu yemisipili ithisha abaphathi abaphezulu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele (NQF Level 7) noma ngaphezulu, njengoba kunikwa isihlonipho yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Umkhawulo ongaphansi kweminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yemisipili ehambisana nalesikhundla ezingeni eliphezulu lomphathi. Amandla okusebenza: Ukwazi Ulwazi oluzwakalayo ngawo nolusebenza ngomthethosisekelo, uhlaka lokulawula, izinqubomgomo nezindlela ezinhle ezithinta imisebenzi yomkhakha, Ulwazi oluzwakalayo nokuqonda izinhlelo zelwazi ezisiza ekulawulweni kolwazi nolwazi oluhlobene nomkhakha, Ulwazi oluzwakalayo nokuqonda ukulawula izinhlelo namaphrojekthi, Ulwazi oluzwakalayo nokuqonda inqubo yokuthenga nokuqashwa kwemitheshwana, Ulwazi oluzwakalayo nokuqonda ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo, nokulawula isu, ukuqapha nokubuyekezwa kwezinqubo, Ulwazi oluzwakalayo nokuqonda izindlela zanamuhla zokulawula nentokozo, Ulwazi oluzwakalayo nokuqonda izinqubo, izinhlelo nezimiso zesevisi yomphakathi, Ulwazi oluzwakalayo nokuqonda izindaba zezwe somhlaba, wesifunda nasedolobheni ezezombusazwe, ezenotshala nezenhlalo ezithinta hurumente yesifunda se-Western Cape, Ulwazi oluzwakalayo nokuqonda ukuhlelwa kwe-Constitutional, komthetho nasezikhungweni okulawula umkhakpha wabezomphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika, Ulwazi oluzwakalayo nokuqonda imali yomphakathi, izinsiza zabantu nokuqashwa kwezinkulumo, Ulwazi oluzwakalayo nokuqonda i-Public Finance Management Act, i-National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, ezinye izinqubomgomo zezimali, imiyalo, izinkomba nezivumelwano ngokuhlangene, Ulwazi oluzwakalayo nokuqonda ukusebenza kweSifunda nemisebenzi yeminyango esiselayo, Ulwazi oluzwakalayo nokuqonda izinqubomgomo zikahulumeni wasemanjeni, Ulwazi oluzwakalayo nokuqonda umthetho nemiyalo yezohwebo, Ulwazi oluzwakalayo nokuqonda ukulawula ukusebenza ngokuvamile, Ulwazi oluzwakalayo mayelana nokuthenga ngokobuchule, ukuthenga ngokuncintisana nokuNikwa Amandla Amandla Amafutha Avulekile wama-Afrika (B-BEE), Ulwazi ngezenqubo zokulawula izimali, Ulwazi ngamathrendi emboni nezindlela ezinhle ngehlelo lwawo wonke amaqembu, Ulwazi ngezindlela ezinhle zokuthonga okuhlanganisa izu zokuthenga nendlela ezahlukene zokuthenga, Ulwazi ngaphezulu kwezinqubomgomo zokuthenga, izinqubo nokuqashwa kwezinkontileka, Ulwazi ngokuqashwa kwemibhalo, okuhlanganisa amasevisi wesibalo sezincwadi nezinqubomgomo nokuqhuba lemisebenzi. Amandla Okuyinhloko: Amandla Ekuhlela Isu Nokuholwa, Ukulawula Izinhlelo Namaphrojekthi, Ukulawula Intshukumo, Ukuphatha Abantu Nokubanika Amandla, Ukulawula Imali. Amakhono: ukubala, ukufunda nokubhala, ukusebenzisa ikhomyutha, amakhono olimi, ukulawula izinhlelo, ukubala imali/ezimali/ukuhlola, ukuhlaziya ngezohwebo, ezezimali nangokubala, Ukugcina Izinkulumo | ukuhlela isu, amakhono aphambili wokwakha uxhumo nokuqamba uxhumo, amakhono aphezulu wokuqamba umbono wokuhlela, amakhono aphezulu ekuholwa ahlinzeka ngokukhethekile ngamandla okubonisa buhholo bokucabanga kwezinsiza ezibucayi, ukwakha iqhaza namakhono aphambili okuxhumana nabantu, amakhono aphambili okuxhumana (okuthunyelwe nokuqoshiwe), amakhono aphambili wokuhlela, ukuhlela izinto nokuphatha abantu, amandla aphakeme wokuqukatha incazelo nokuqamba umbono wokuhlela, amandla okwenza imisebenzi eminingi, ukwenza izimo ezingaquki kwayedwa nokuphatha ngesikhathi esishintsha ngokushesha nesinenguzingozi, amandla okukhombisa futhi anamandla, amandla okusebenza nohlu olubanzi labantu abangaphandle nangaphakathi.
zu.duties: Ukulawula umkhakha: Ukulawula ngokobuchule, inesimilo nokuhlakanipha ngenkulumo yezinkundla zemisebenzi ezilandelayo: Qinisekisa izinsiza zokuphatha komnyango nezimali, Qhasha izinsiza zokuphatha imali yomnyango, ukubhajetha nokuhlela, ukuqapha kwebhajethi nokubika, Qinisekisa insiza yokuphatha imali yomnyango, Ukulawula izinkokhelo, ugogo bemali nezinkomba zezimali, Ukuphatha iholo namatholakalo, Ukuphatha ibhange nolunye uhlelo lwamaholo, Nikeza futhi ulawule izinsiza zokuqashwa kwamaketangangakho (SCM); Lawula izinsiza zokuphatha nokuqashwa kwezinkontileka, Lawula izinkintsho nezinketho, amalogisitiksi ne-LOGIS, Lawula izimpahla zomnyango nokuqashwa kwamimoto, Hlinzeka ngesevisi mayelana nokuqashwa kwemibhalo, ukuhambisana nomthetho, ukulawula ukusebenza, ukwakha amandla nokulawula amath risk, Nikeza ngenkundo yocingo yensize, Qhasha ukunikezwa kokuxhumana nokuqwashisa ngemiyalo (ICT), izinsiza zomntho, isiqiniseko sangaphakathi, okungenhloko, icese lenkulumo nezisebenzelo zokuxhasa, Lawula ukuthukisa ngobuchule bamaphrofeshini abakhethwe ngokomsebenzi (OSD), Nikeza ngokuxhasa ukuphatha iHoD, Hlanganisa ukuphatha kokuvikela, ukuphathwa kwezempilo nokuphepha (OHS) nendawo yokuhlala, Qinisekisa izinkambo zangaphakathi ezilungele; Qhasha ukuhlongozwa, Hlinzeka ngezinkonzo zokuqinisekisa, Nikeza isiza esilungele nelisebenzayo sokuphatha ukukhohlwa nokulahlekelwa kwezimali. Ukulawula Ngobuchule (okuhlanganisa ukuphatha intshukumo) Chaza futhi ubuyekeze ngokuqhubekayo ngenhloso, izinhloso, izinto eziyisihluthulelo, ukubaluleka nemisebenzi yegunya elihamba phambili, Qhubeza inqubo yokuhlela isu kwegunya elihamba phambili, Qhubeza ukuthukiswa nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo zesisu nezoshishino ngokobuchule bakho, Hlaziya ukusebenza kwakho ngesikhathi esihlala sinqamula ngokumelene nezinhloso eziyisihluthulelo ezingaqashwa ngaphambilini, Bika ngeHoD ngokuqhubekayo ngezinhloso zegunya lakho nangendaba ezingokubaluleka ezihlobene nokuqinisekwa nokuqashwa ngokuhlela ngokushesha, Hlola futhi uqinisekise ukuhambisana nomthethosisekelo othintayo futhi ulondoloze umkhondo omningi ohambisana nokuqashwa kwemibhalo yemisebenzi yakho, namagunya (abantu, izimali nezimpahla) asetshenziswa, Khululeza futhi ukhuthaze inhlalo yokuba yisifundo ngaphakathi kwakho, nakwomnyango, Yenza ngokuziphendulela yonke imisebenzi enikiwe isikhundla somongameli ohamba phambili. Ukuphatha Abantu: Ngena kubasebenzi abayisibalo nangamazinga afanele ukuqinisekisa ukufeza iNhlelo loShishino, Khuthaze, qeqesha futhi uhola abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwakho, ukuze kutholwe futhi kugcinwe ukuphumelela ekuletheni isabelo, Yenza ngokuzimisela ukuphatha, ukuhlolwa nokuhlinzwa kwabasebenzi ngaphakathi, Qapha ukwakhiwa kwamandla kolwazi, Qhasha ukubandakanywa ekwenziweni kohlelo lwabasebenzi, uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza, nokuqashwa kwemibhalo yolwazi, Khuthaze izinhlobo ezinhle zobudlelwano bokusebenza, Qhasha ngokuzimisela ukuphatha nokugcina isisekelo ngaphakathi.

xh.title: Um lawuli ophambili: Ulawulo lwezeMali
xh.summary: Umlawuli ophambili: Ulawulo lwezeMali kwiSebe lezeNzululwazi nokuPhuhlisa, e-Western Cape, elifuna izidanga ze-NQF Level 7 kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava ohlola abantu ngowogqirha ophakamileyo.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekileyo (NQF Level 7) okanye esiphezudaka, njengokuvunyelwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Isiqaka esincinci seminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava ahambelanayo kwinqanaba lolawulo ophakamileyo. Ikhono: Ulwazi Ulwazi oluchaziweyo nolusebenzayo ngomthetho, iinkqubo zolawulo, iinkqabo kunye neendlela ezilungileyo ezinomthelela kumsebenzi womgca, Ulwazi oluchaziweyo noluyiloqwembu lolwazi malunga nezithulagqibo ezinxibelela ekuqokeleleni ulwazi nolunye ulwazi ohambelana nomsebenzi womgca, Ulwazi oluchaziweyo noluyiloqwembu lolwazi malunga nolawulo lweenkqubo namaphulo, Ulwazi oluchaziweyo noluyiloqwembu lolwazi malunga neenkqubo zokuthenga nokuqwalasela izikhuselo, Ulwazi oluchaziweyo noluyiloqwembu lolwazi malunga nophuhliso lweenkqabo, nolawulo lwe-strategy, ukuqwalasela ukuqwalasela kwakhona iinkqubo, Ulwazi oluchaziweyo noluyiloqwembu lolwazi malunga neendlela zanamhlanje zolawulo loluntu nolawulo, Ulwazi oluchaziweyo noluyiloqwembu lolwazi malunga neenkqubo, iinkqubo nezithulagqibo zenkonzo karhulumente, Ulwazi oluchaziweyo noluyiloqwembu lolwazi malunga nezopolitiko zehlabathi, imithetho yaye zendawo, ezoqoqosho noluntu ezinomthelela kurhulumente wephondo le-Western Cape, Ulwazi oluchaziweyo noluyiloqwembu lolwazi malunga neelungelo, emithethweni nasemilweni eqokelela indalo idlula ikhaya kunye nolawulo kurhulumente, Ulwazi oluchaziweyo noluyiloqwembu lolwazi malunga nolawulo lweemali karhulumente, ukuqokelela nolawulo lwethutyana, Ulwazi oluchaziweyo noluyiloqwembu lolwazi malunga neMthetho woLawulo lwezeMali karhulumente, iNgqungquthela yeQondo kunye nePhondo, namanye amakhodithiso eemali, izalathiso neziyalezo kunye namaxwebhu asungulwa ngokubambisana, Ulwazi oluchaziweyo noluyiloqwembu lolwazi malunga nokusebenza kwePhondo nokuqhubwa kwamanye amasebe afanayo, Ulwazi oluchaziweyo noluyiloqwembu lolwazi malunga neenkqabo zolawulo lwamhlanje, Ulwazi oluchaziweyo noluyiloqwembu lolwazi malunga nomthetho nolawulo lobundlu lwabasebenzi, Ulwazi oluchaziweyo noluyiloqwembu lolwazi malunga nolawulo loqwalaselo ukuba singanazinto ngokubanzi, Ulwazi oluchaziweyo ngokuzingela ngobuchule, uthenga ngokukhethwa kunye ne-Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment (B-BEE), Ulwazi malunga neenkqubo zolawulo lweemali, Ulwazi malunga neendlela ezihamba phambili kwishishini ngakweliqela lemveliso, Ulwazi malunga neendlela ezilungileyo zokuthenga kuquka iindlela zokuzingela iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuthenga, Ulwazi malunga neenkqabo zokuthenga, iinkqubo nolawulo lweenkonzo, Ulwazi malunga nolawulo lwamagatya, kuquka iinkonzo zegumbi lemibhalo nolawulo loqwalasela iinkqabo nolawulo. Iimfuno eziyimfuneko: Ikhalithi yeQhinga noBunkokeli, uLawulo lwePhulo nokuQwalasela iNkqubo, uLawulo lokuTshintsha, uLawulo lwabantu nokunika amandla, uLawulo lwezeMali. Amakhono: Amanani, ukufunda nokubhala, ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha, amakhono olwimi, uLawulo lwePhulo, i-Accounting/ Finance/ Audit, uQwalaselo lwezoQoqosho, lweMali nolwezibalo, uLawulo ngokomthetho /uQhinga lokuCwangcisa, amakhono amakhulu okwenza ibhodi yabahlobo kunye nokuvelisa ibhodi yabahlobo, amakhono amakhulu okuqamba ingqondo nokuqamba iingcamango, amakhono amakhulu obunkokeli anentsingiselo ekuboniseni inkokeli ekuboniseni ulwazi olumfini, ukwakhiwa kwethimba nolunxibelelwano olunamandla, amakhono khulula-ntetho (esinye ngokuthetha esinye ngokubhala), amakhono amakhulu okucwangcisa, ukuqamba nolawulo, amakhono amakhulu ngokuphuhliswa okukhulu okuyingcamango nokuqamba iingcamango, ukwazi ukwenza izinto ezininzi, ukubhekana neenkulumbuzo nolawulo ngeenkcetha ezitshintsha ngokukhawuleza kwaye zibeka nginawo umuzila, ukwazi ukuzingisa nokuba nomfutsha kwakunye nentsholo, amakhono okubhekana neentshaba ezahlukeneyo zangaphakathi nangaphandle.
xh.duties: Ulawulo lomgca: Ulawulo lwe-strategy, iphunga nolulumkiso ngokwemimandla yomsebenzi elandelayo: Qinisekisa ulawulo lwesebe nakonikezelo lweemali ze-akhawunti; Qinisekisa inkonzo yolawulo lwesebe nge-akhawunti yemali, ukucwangcisa iNgqikithi zeMali nokuqwalasela nokubika, Qinisekisa inkonzo yolawulo lwesebe nge-akhawunti yemali, ulawulo lokuhambisa imali, ukuqamba iikhodi nolwazi, ulawulo lomvuzo nolawulo lwetyala, ukurhweba nolawulo lwemali esiyingxweme, Nikeza nolawula iinkonzo zolawulo loqhinga lokuhambisa imali (SCM); Lawula ulawulo nolawulo lweenkonzo, Lawula izikhuselo nokuqwalasela amaxabiso, i-logistics ne-LOGIS, Lawula iimpahla zesebe nolawulo lwamafleeti, Nikeza inkonzo ngeenkqabo, ukuzithoba, ulawulo loqwalaselo, ukwakha amandla nolawulo lwengozi, Nikeza inkonzo yokuxhasa ekuhambeni; Qinisekisa ukunikwa kwezithulagqibo nokuqhoboshwa kobugcisa (ICT), ulwazi ngabantu, ukuzinikela ngokwenkampani, inkxaso yomthetho nolunxulumano, Lawula ukuphuhliswa ngobuchule bobuchule bobugcisa obwahlulwe ngokwemisebenzi (OSD), Nikeza inkxaso ekubungumeni kwi-HoD, Lawula ukuqwalasela nokuphuhliswa kokhuseleko, ukhuseleko kwemisebenzi nemithetho yobomi, Qinisekisa iinkqubo ezilungileyo zolawulo lwangaphakathi; Qinisekisa ulawulo olulungileyo, Nikeza iinkonzo zokuqinisekisa, Nikeza inkonzo elungileyo nesebenzayo yokulawula ukurubula nemi squo Ulawulo lwe-Strategy (kuquka ulawulo lokuTshintsha) Chaza ukuze uqwalasele ngokungapheli kwexesha injongo, iinjongo, izinto eziphambili nemisebenzi yoLawuli oPhambili, Qhuba inkqubo yokuqamba kwakunye neyokuqwalasela i-strategy, Qhuba ukuqamba nokulawula iiplani ze-strategy nezoshishino, Qwalasela ngokungangqrweni ukuphumelela kolawulo ngokuchasene neenjongo eziphanyayo eziyimfuneko nolungelelwaniso, Bika kwi-HoD rhoqo ngemisebenzi yolawulo kunye neendaba ezibalulekileyo ezinxulumene nenkxaso yolawulo, Qwalasela ukuze uqinisekise ukuzithoba nolawulo ngokwemithetho nemi thetho ngokwemibhalo esemthethweni yemisebenzi yolawulo, kunye namandla (abantu, iimali nempahla) aveliswa, Qokelela khonda, ukhuthaze inkqubo yokutshintsha ngaphakathi kolawulo, nasekuSebeni, Yenza ngokuzimisela yonke imisebenzi enikwe kwindawo kaMlawuli oPhambili. Ulawulo lwabantu: Thatha inxaxheba kokubiza abantu abasebenzayo kwiziphakamiso namanani afanelekileyo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufezwa kweNkqubo yokuQamba iNgqikithi yolawulo, Qhobosha, qeqsha nokuqwalasela abantu ngaphakathi kolawulo, ukufezwa nokugcina ukuphumelela kwangokuchanekileyo kule nkxaso karhulumente, Yenza umsebenzi wolawulo ngokugqithiswa kwesigqeba, ukuqwalasela kakhulu nokuphuhliswa kwamandla, Qwalasela ulwazi lwamava ngokwakha amandla ngaphakathi kolawulo, Qinisekisa ukuthatha inxaxheba kokuqamba iplani yabasebenzi, inkqubo yokuphucula inkxaso karhulumente, iplani yolwazi ngamandla, Khuthaza ukuzinikela ngenkulumbuzo yemfuno ngokulawulo ngaphakathi kolawulo, Lawula ngamandla khonda khuthaza ukugcina ulawulo ngokwemithetho ngaphakathi kolawulo. Ulawulo lwezeMali: Lawula ukuthatha inxaxheba kwindlela yokuqamba inkqabi kwinqanaba lolawulo, Qinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kweNgqikithi yeMali yonyaka nokuqwalaselwa kwayo, Thatha uxanduva lokuqonda ngokulawula ngokuchanekileyo nangokusebenzisa amandla iNgqikithi yemali yolawulo, Thatha uxanduva ngokuchanekileyo lokuqinisekisa ukuzithoba kwindlela ezifanelekileyo zokuqhathwa kwezinto ezithengwayo, Thatha uxanduva ngokuchanekileyo lokuqinisekisa ukulawula iinkonzo ngokuchanekileyo kwangokunyulu, Bika kwuLawuli weSebe nakumaxhoba abo balawula/ amakomiti ngazo zonke iindaba zolawulo, Thatha uxanduva lokuqamba nokuqokelela ulwazi ngokuchanekileyo lweemali zolawulo, Thatha uxanduva lokuqinisekisa ukuba kusekho iindlela ezifanelekileyo zolawulo, Qinisekisa ukuba imibhalo ngokuchanekileyo yemali yolawulo igcinwa ngokulandela nayiphi na iindlela ezithi zibe khona.

jobs.title: Director: Financial Management
jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government.
jobs.summary: Director of Financial Management for the Western Cape Department of Social Development, requiring an NQF Level 7 qualification and five years' senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate undergraduate qualification (NQF Level 7) or higher, as recognised (SAQA) A minimum of five (5) years’ experience at a middle/senior managerial level. Competencies: Proven Knowledge of: Proven knowledge of and working experience with the legislation, regulatory frameworks, policies and best practices that have a bearing on the line functions, Proven knowledge and understanding of information systems that aid in the management of knowledge and information pertaining to the line function, Proven knowledge and understanding of programme and project management, Proven knowledge and understanding of procurement and tendering processes, Proven knowledge and understanding of policy development, and strategy management, monitoring and review processes, Proven knowledge and understanding of modern systems of governance and administration. Core Competencies: Strategic Capability and Leadership, Project and Programme Management, Change Management, People Management and Empowerment, Financial Management Skills: Numeracy, Literacy, Computer Literacy, Language skills, Project Management, Accounting, Finance, Audit, Strategic Planning.
jobs.duties: Strategic management, advice and guidance in respect of the following functional areas: Ensure a departmental management accounting service. Management Accounting: Ensure an integrated, effective and efficient budget planning system in respect of revenue and expenditure, Manage the departmental budget process, Prepare inputs for strategic plan and annual performance plan, Manage the departmental Medium Term, expenditure Committee (MTEC) process, Maintain and monitor financial information, Prepare a breakdown of estimated revenue and expenditure, Manage roll overs of funds, Develop and maintain policies, procedures and processes, Ensure an integrated, effective and efficient in-year budget monitoring, reporting and adjustment system, Manage the monitoring of revenue and expenditure, Manage the monthly, quarterly and annual reporting processes , Manage the revenue and expenditure adjustments estimates process, Develop and maintain policies, procedures and processes, Ensure a departmental financial accounting service. Financial Accounting: Provide expenditure and general payment services, Ensure an effective and efficient accounting system for transfers and subsidies, Ensure an effective and efficient Basic Accounting System (BAS) payment system, Ensure an effective and efficient Logistical Information System (LOGIS) payment system, Provide bookkeeping and financial accounting services, Ensure an effective and efficient accounting system, inclusive of liaison and coordination of policies, procedures and processes, Perform BAS systems control, Compile financial statements, Perform credit control services, Provide salary administration and debt management services. Strategic Management (including change management): Define and review on a continual basis the purpose, objectives, priorities and activities of the Directorate, Drive the Directorate’s strategic planning process, Drive the development and management of the strategic and business plans for the Directorate, Evaluate the performance of the Directorate on a continuing basis against pre-determined key measurable objectives and standards, Report to the Chief Director on a regular basis on the activities of the Directorate and on matters of substantial importance relating operational management support, Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant legislation and prescripts in respect of adequate and appropriate record keeping of the activities of the Directorate, and of the resources (people, finances and assets) employed by it, Foster and promote a culture of innovation within the Directorate, and the Department, Diligently perform all duties assigned to the post of Director. People Management: Participate in the recruitment of employees in the numbers and grades appropriate to ensure the achievement of the Directorate’s Business Plan, Motivate, train and guide employees within the Directorate, to achieve and maintain excellence in service delivery, Actively manage the performance, evaluation and rewarding of employees within the Directorate, Monitor information capacity building within the Directorate, Ensure involvement in the compilation of a workforce plan, a service delivery improvement programme, and an information resources plan for the Directorate, Promote sound labour relations within the Directorate, Actively manage and promote the maintenance of discipline within the Directorate. Financial Management: Manage participation in the budgeting process at Directorate level, Ensure the preparation of the Annual and Adjustment Budgets for the Directorate, Assume direct accountability for the efficient, economic and effective control and management of the Directorate’s budget and expenditure, Assume direct accountability for ensuring that the correct tender and procurement procedures are adhered to in respect of purchases for the Directorate, Assume direct accountability for ensuring contracts are managed effectively and efficiently for the Directorate, Ensure that all spending is aligned with the strategic objectives of the Directorate and Department, Report to the Chief Director and relevant oversight role players/committees on all aspects of the Directorate’s finances, Assume overall accountability for the management, maintenance and safekeeping of the Directorate’s assets, Assume direct accountability for ensuring that appropriate risk management procedures are in place and adhered to for the Directorate, Ensure that full and proper records of the financial affairs of the Directorate are kept in accordance with any prescribed norms and standards.

jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. Kindly note that technical support is only available from Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 16:00. Should you experience any difficulties with your online application you may contact the helpline on 0861 370 214. Please ensure that you submit your application on or before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this post, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. All shortlisted candidates must make themselves available to be interviewed at a date, time and place as decided by the selection panel. All shortlisted candidates will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to assess relevant functional elements of the job and an interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will be required to complete the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) and submit the certificate before he/she can be appointed to this post. The purpose of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme, which is a public service specific training programme applicable to all applicants who aspire to join the SMS, is to ensure that potential SMS members have a background in processes and procedures linked to the SMS. The duration of the online Pre-Entry Programme is 120 notional hours (15 days). Full details may be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training- course/sms-preentryprogramme . The successful candidate shall be subjected to a leadership assessment, within one (1) month of appointment, to assess the managerial competencies required for SMS members in the Public Service as specified under Chapter Five (5) of the SMS handbook. This assessment shall be conducted to determine an individual’s ability to lead, manage, and direct others and to identify developmental gaps in core generic leadership and management competencies. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. The successful candidate will be subject to security vetting; and the candidate will have to disclose her/his financial interests. Furthermore, thank you, to the huge public interest, we receive many applications for our posts, and as such will not be able to respond personally to all applications. Therefore, should you not hear from us within 10 weeks from close of the advert please consider your application unsuccessful. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Finansiële Bestuur
af.summary: Direkteur van Finansiële Bestuur vir die Western Cape Department of Social Development, wat 'n NQF Level 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Gesikte voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF Level 7) of hoër, soos deur (SAQA) erken. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak. Bevoegdhede: Bewese kennis van: Bewese kennis van en werkservaring met die wetgewing, regulerende raamwerke, beleide en beste praktyke wat 'n uitwerking het op die lynfunksies; Bewese kennis en begrip van inligtingstelsels wat help met die bestuur van kennis en inligting met betrekking tot die lynfunksie; Bewese kennis en begrip van program- en projekbestuur; Bewese kennis en begrip van verkrygings en tendeerprosesse; Bewese kennis en begrip van beleidsontwikkeling, en strategiebestuur, monitering en hersieningsprosesse; Bewese kennis en begrip van moderne stelsels van bestuur en administrasie. Kernbevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, projek- en programbestuur, veranderingbestuur, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, finansiële bestuur. Vaardighede: Syfergeletterdheid, geletterdheid, rekenaargeletterdheid, taalvaardighede, projekbestuur, rekeningkunde, finansies, oudit, strategiese beplanning.
af.duties: Strategiese bestuur, advies en leiding ten opsigte van die volgende funksionele areas: Verseker 'n departementele bestuursrekenkundediens. Bestuursrekeningkunde: Verseker 'n geïntegreerde, doeltreffende en doelmatige begrotingsbeplanningstelsel ten opsigte van inkomste en uitgawes; Bestuur die departementele begrotingsproses; Berei insette voor vir strategiese plan en jaarlikse prestasieplan; Bestuur die departementele Medium Term, expenditure Committee (MTEC) proses; Onderhou en monitor finansiële inligting; Berei 'n uiteensetting van geraamde inkomste en uitgawes voor; Bestuur oorplasing van fondse; Ontwikkel en onderhou beleide, prosedures en prosesse; Verseker 'n geïntegreerde, doeltreffende en doelmatige in-jaar begrotingsmonitering, verslagdoenings en aanpassingstelsel; Bestuur die monitering van inkomste en uitgawes; Bestuur die maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse verslagdoeningsprosesse; Bestuur die inkomste- en uitgaweaanpassingsramingsproses; Ontwikkel en onderhou beleide, prosedures en prosesse; Verseker 'n departementele finansiële rekeningkundediens. Finansiële rekeningkunde: Verskaf uitgawe- en algemene betalingsdienste; Verseker 'n doeltreffende en doelmatige rekeningkundige stelsel vir oordragte en subsidies; Verseker 'n doeltreffende en doelmatige Basic Accounting System (BAS) betalingstelsel; Verseker 'n doeltreffende en doelmatige Logistical Information System (LOGIS) betalingstelsel; Verskaf boekhoud- en finansiële rekeningkundedienste; Verseker 'n doeltreffende en doelmatige rekeningkundige stelsel, insluitend skakeling en koördinering van beleide, prosedures en prosesse; Voer BAS-stelselbeheer uit; Stel finansiële state op; Voer kredietbeheerdienste uit; Verskaf salarisadministrasie- en skuldbestuursdienste. Strategiese bestuur (insluitend veranderingbestuur): Definieer en hersien deurlopend die doel, doelwitte, prioriteite en aktiwiteite van die Direktoraat; Dryf die Direktoraat se strategiese beplanningsproses; Dryf die ontwikkeling en bestuur van die strategiese en besigheidsplanne vir die Direktoraat; Evalueer die prestasie van die Direktoraat deurlopend teen vooraf bepaalde sleutel meetbare doelwitte en standaarde; Doen gereeld verslag aan die Hoofdirekteur oor die aktiwiteite van die Direktoraat en oor sake van wesenlike belang rakende operasionele bestuursondersteuning; Monitor en verseker nakoming van toepaslike wetgewing en voorskrifte ten opsigte van voldoende en gepaste rekordhouding van die aktiwiteite van die Direktoraat, en van die bronne (mense, finansies en bates) wat daardeur aangewend word; Bevorder en bevorder 'n kultuur van innovasie binne die Direktoraat, en die departement; Voer getrou alle pligte uit wat aan die pos van Direkteur opgedra word. Mensebestuur: Neem deel aan die werwing van werknemers in die getalle en grade wat gepas is om die bereiking van die Direktoraat se besigheidsplan te verseker; Motiveer, lei en begelei werknemers binne die Direktoraat, om uitmuntendheid in dienslewering te bereik en te handhaaf; Bestuur aktief die prestasie, evaluering en beloning van werknemers binne die Direktoraat; Monitor inligtingkapasiteitsopbou binne die Direktoraat; Verseker betrokkenheid by die opstel van 'n werksmagplan, 'n diensleweringverbeteringsprogram, en 'n inligtingsbronneplan vir die Direktoraat; Bevorder goeie arbeidsverhoudinge binne die Direktoraat; Bestuur aktief en bevorder die handhawing van dissipline binne die Direktoraat. Finansiële bestuur: Bestuur deelname aan die begrotingsproses op Direktoraatvlak; Verseker die voorbereiding van die jaarlikse en aanpassingsbegrotings vir die Direktoraat; Aanvaar direkte aanspreeklikheid vir die doeltreffende, ekonomiese en doelmatige beheer en bestuur van die Direktoraat se begroting en uitgawes; Aanvaar direkte aanspreeklikheid om te verseker dat die korrekte tender- en verkrygingsprosedures ten opsigte van aankope vir die Direktoraat nagekom word; Aanvaar direkte aanspreeklikheid om te verseker dat kontrakte doeltreffend en doelmatig vir die Direktoraat bestuur word; Verseker dat alle besteding in ooreenstemming is met die strategiese doelwitte van die Direktoraat en die departement; Doen verslag aan die Hoofdirekteur en relevante toezighoudende rolspelers/komitees oor alle aspekte van die Direktoraat se finansies; Aanvaar algehele aanspreeklikheid vir die bestuur, onderhoud en veilige bewaring van die Direktoraat se bates; Aanvaar direkte aanspreeklikheid om te verseker dat toepaslike risikobestuurprosedures in plek is en nagekom word vir die Direktoraat; Verseker dat volledige en behoorlike rekords van die finansiële sake van die Direktoraat gehou word in ooreenstemming met enige voorgeskrewe norme en standaarde.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukuphathwa Kwezimali
zu.summary: Umphathi Wokuphathwa Kwezimali osebenzela Western Cape Department of Social Development, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF Level 7 namava eminyaka emihlanu esikhundleni sokuba ngumphathi ophakeme.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekile zesikhathi esingaphansi kwedigri (NQF Level 7) noma ngaphezulu, njengokuqashelwa yi-(SAQA). Ubuncwane beminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava esikhundleni sokuba ngumphathi ophakathi/ophakeme. Ikhono: Ulwazi oluchaziwe mayelana: Ulwazi oluchaziwe nomsebenzi ohlotshaniswa nomthetho, izindlela zolawulo, izinqubo namasu ahlehlukile anomthelela kumisebenzi yomkhakha, Ulwazi oluchaziwe nokuqonda izinhlelo zolwazi ezisiza ekuphathweni kolwazi nemininingwane ehlobene nomsebenzi womkhakha, Ulwazi oluchaziwe nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi, Ulwazi oluchaziwe nokuqonda inqubo yokuthola izinkonzo nokuqasha, Ulwazi oluchaziwe nokuqonda ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubo, nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo, ukuqapha nokubuyekeza izinqubo, Ulwazi oluchaziwe nokuqonda izindlela zanamuhla zolawulo nokuphathwa. Ikhono Esiyisiseko: Ikhono Lokuhlela Amasu Nokuqonda Ukubusa, Ukuphathwa Kwamaphrojekthi Namasu, Ukuphathwa Izinguquko, Ukuphathwa Abantu Namandla Abanikwa Abantu, Amakhono Okuphathwa Izimali: Ukubala, Ukufunda Nokubhala, Ukusebenzisa Ikhompyutha, Amakhono Olimi, Ukuphathwa Kwamaphrojekthi, Ukubala Izimali, Izimali, Ukuhlola, Ukuhlela Amasu.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwamasu, incazelo nesiqondiso ngokwemikhakha elandelayo: Qinisekisa isevisi yokubala izimali yomnyango. Ukubala Izimali: Qinisekisa uhlelo oluhlangene, olusebenza kahle nolunamandla lokuhlela izikweletu kwezimali ezizingenayo neziharlwayo ngokwemali ezingenayo neyokuharlwa, Phatha inqubo yesikweletu somnyango, Lungela okungenayo kwesu elihlelekile nesu lokusebenza kwaminyaka yonke, Phatha inqubo yomnyango ye-Medium Term, expenditure Committee (MTEC), Gcina futhi ulawule imininingwane yezimali, Lungela ukuhlukaniswa kwemali eyingenayo neyokuharlwa eqikelelwayo, Phatha ukudluliswa kwemali, Thuthukisa futhi ulondoloze izinqubo, izindlela namasu, Qinisekisa uhlelo oluhlangene, olusebenza kahle nolunamandla lokubuka, ukubika nokuhlela izikweletu phakathi kweminyaka, Phatha ukubukwa kwemali ezingenayo neyokuharlwa, Phatha izinqubo zokubika zanyanga zonke, zexeshana nezomnyaka yonke, Phatha inqubo yokubika kokulungiswa kwemali ezingenayo neyokuharlwa, Thuthukisa futhi ulondoloze izinqubo, izindlela namasu, Qinisekisa isevisi yokubala izimali yomnyango. Ukubala Izimali Kwezimali: Nikeza isevisi yokuhahlwa kwezimali nokukhokha ngokuvamile, Qinisekisa uhlelo lokubala izimali olusebenza kahle nolunamandla malunge neziy transfers and subsidies, Qinisekisa uhlelo olusebenza kahle nolunamandla lokukhokha lwe-Basic Accounting System (BAS), Qinisekisa uhlelo olusebenza kahle nolunamandla lokukhokha lwe-Logistical Information System (LOGIS), Nikeza isevisi yokugcina izincwadi nezimali, Qinisekisa uhlelo lokubala izimali olusebenza kahle nolunamandla, okuhlanganisa uxhumano noqoqo Izinqubo, izindlela namasu, Yenza ulawulo lwesistimu ye-BAS, Hlela izitatimende zezimali, Yenza isevisi yolawulo lwe-credit, Nikeza isevisi yolawulo lweholo nokuphathwa kwamikweletu. Ukuphathwa Kwamasu (okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwezinguquko): Chaza futhi ubuyekeze njalo injongo, imigomo, izinto ebalulekile nemisebenzi ye-Directorate, Qhuba inqubo yokuhlela amasu ye-Directorate, Qhuba ukuthuthukiswa nokuphathwa kwamasu nezinhlela zebhizinisi le-Directorate, Hlola ukusebenza kwe-Directorate njalo ngokumelana nemigomo ebalulekile emiswayo nemizingcelela, Bika ku- Chief Director njalo ngemisebenzi ye-Directorate nangezindaba ezibaluleke kakhulu ezihlobene nokuqukethwa kokusebenza kokweseka, Qapha futhi qinisekise ukuziphatha ngokomthetho nangokwezinqobo ezingokulondoloza kanye nokubhalwa kokuqhekekile kwezindaba ze- Directorate, namathaluzi (abantu, imali nezimpahla) esetshenziswa, Khuthaza futhi useke inhlalo yokuthuthukisa izinto ezintsha ngaphakathi kwe- Directorate, kanye nayo-Department, Yenza ngokuzinikela yonke imisebenzi enikezwe isikhundla sika-Director. Ukuphathwa Abantu: Hlanganyela ekubeni ngabasebenzi ngesibalo nangesigaba esifanelekile sokwenza kuzuza uhlelo lwebhizinisi le- Directorate, Khuthaza, holela futhi uqonde abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwe-Directorate, ukufeza futhi zigcine uphakeme ekulethweni kwesevisi, Phatha ngokuzimisela ukusebenza, ukuhlola nokuhlinzeka abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwe-Directorate, Qapha ukwakhiwa kwamandla kolwazi ngaphakathi kwe-Directorate, Qinisekisa ukuzibandakanya ekuhleni uhlelo lwabasebenzi, uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwesevisi, kanye nokuhlela ukutholwa kolwazi kwe-Directorate, Khuthaza izinhlangano ezinhle zomsebenzi ngaphakathi kwe-Directorate, Phatha ngokuzimisela futhi ukuthuthukisa ukugcina inhliziyo ngaphakathi kwe-Directorate. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali: Phatha ukuzibandakanya eqoqweni lezikweletu esigabeni se-Directorate, Qinisekisa ukuhlelwa kokwesikweletu kwaminyaka yonke nokuqwalaselwa kwezimali ze-Directorate, Thathe ibango elaqondile ngokulawula, ukusebenza kwezimali kakhulu nokuphathwa kwe- Directorate ngokusebenza ngokwezimali eziharlwayo, Thathe ibango eliqondile ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo ezifanele zokuqasha nokuvesula zilandwa ngokwesibambi se-Directorate, Thathe ibango eliqondile ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkontileka ziphathwa ngokusebenza kahle kwe-Directorate, Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke umshwalense uhambisana nemigomo yamasu ye-Directorate ne-Department, Bika ku- Chief Director futhi kubaplayi bemiqapho abahlobene/amasomiti ngazo zonke izindaba zezimali ze-Directorate, Thathe ibango lonke ngokuphathwa, ukugcina nokugcina kahle izimpahla ze-Directorate, Thathe ibango eliqondile ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo ezifanele zokuqapha ingozi zikhona futhi zilandwa yi- Directorate, Qinisekisa ukuthi izibhalo eziphelele nanezokuningi zezindaba zezimali ze- Directorate zilondolozwa ngokwemithetho noma imigomo noma izindinganiso.

xh.title: Umgqibi: Ukulawula Imali
xh.summary: Umgqibi wokulawula imali we-Western Cape Department of Social Development, efuna izidanga ezingangowesixhenxe se-NQF kunene namashumi amahlanu eminyaka yohlu lwengqondo ekuqaleni kwesikhundla.
xh.requirements: Izidanga ezifanelekileyo ezingapantsi (NQF Level 7) okanye ezingaphezulu, njengokusiMtelekiso-bakamva (SAQA). Iqondo lenyango elingaphantsi kwamashumi amahlanu (5) eminyaka yohlu lwengqondo ngokusebenza ekuqaleni kwesikhundla. Izinto eziphakamileyo: Ulwazi olungagqibekiyo ngeemithetho kunene nangokomsebenzi okwenziwa kwakunye nangokwesiqendu sokusebenza ngesiseko soyilo nokuthi kuye kwenzeke ntoni na ngokomthetho nakwiinkqubo ze-Mthetho-nkqubo. Ulwazi olungagqibekiyo lokulungelelwa nokuqonda ngeenknqubo zamakhompyutha ezisiza ekulawulweni kolwazi nangolwazi olungxangxgaxayo ngokwakhe ukugcinwa kwabasebenzi ekhaya-kuqwalaselweni kokulungiselelwa ngokomthetho. Ulwazi olungagqibekiyo nokuqonda ngesiseko samaxabiso ekhaya-kuqwalaselweni kokwenziwa kwamaphulo ezahlule. Ulwazi olungagqibekiyo nokuqonda ngokusetyenziswa kokwenziwa kwamaphulo amakhulu kunene neze nhlobo zakho zonke ezenza ngokuchaneka ngokomthetho. Ulwazi olungagqibekiyo nokuqonda kwakunye nokuqonda kwinkqubo yoqhagamshelwano nokulawula amacebo, ukulawula uluhlu lwezinto ezikwindlu nokuhamba-hamba kwamaxabiso nangokuhamba ngokusesikweni. Ulwazi olungagqibekiyo nokuqonda ngenkqubo yamakhompyutha ekulawulweni kwesikhundla nakwindlela ekugcinwa ngayo iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokulunga. Ulwazi oluQambisayo olukuyo ngokusesikweni: Ulwazi olungagqibekiyo nokuqonda kwimithetho-nkqubo kwakhona nangokomthetho wekhusi elilungelelwaniso, nangokomthetho wekhusi elilungelelwaniso. Ulwazi olungagqibekiyo nokuqonda ngokunika iindaba ezisize ekwazisweni nakuqondwa iindaba ezingqangxangxagayo ezihlobene noluhlu lwemisebenzi. Ulwazi olungagqibekiyo nokuqonda ngokukhuthaza nakwinkqubo yokuhamba phambili kakhulu kolwazi lwemiqatho. Ulwazi olungagqibekiyo nokuqonda ngokwenza uluhlu lwezinto ezinkqabakunye namaphulo. Ulwazi olungagqibekiyo nokuqonda ngokwemisebenzi yokulunga nokuhambisa phambili iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi olungagqibekiyo nokuqonda ngamakhompyutha kwinkqubo esebenza.
xh.duties: Isimo sebhelekakubi sokuqulunqa, inkcumbisa kunye nokulaya nangamabala emisebenzi elandelayo: Qinisekisa inkonzo yokulawulakubakweseye phakathi kwesebe. Ukulawulakubakwe Iseyi: Qinisekisa inkqubo efanelekileyo yokucwangcja amaxabiso esebenza ngokupheleleyo ngokusesikweni ngesebenza ekubeni kwengeniso kunye nokuchithwa kwemali, Lawula inkqubo yamaxedebhu kukuhlaba iimali kwesebe, Lungisa izinto ezikulungele iplani esimisela iindidi kunye nelangomiso oluthe ngasenyanga, Lawula inkqubo ye-Medium Term Expenditure Committee (MTEC) kwesebe, Khongozela ilandele inkqubo yokusebenza kwamaxabiso namali, Lungida ukwahlulwa kubakokulinganiselwa kwingeniso nakuchithwa kwemali, Lawula ukuthumela kwaphela kwemali, Hlaziya nokugcina amagqina-kakubi, iinkqubo namayala, Qinisekisa inkqubo efanelekileyo yokulawula abaxabisi phakathi kwengcaka nangexa ihamba xa uxabisa, iindlela zokuveza iingxelo nakulungelelwaniso kwamaxabiso, Lawula ukulawula kokulinganiselwa kwingeniso nakuchithwa kwemali, Lawula iinkqubo zokuvela iingxelo ngokwexesha elifunwa qho ngenyanga, nakwindlovana, kunene nakulo nyaka onke, Lawula inkqubo yokulungelelwanisa amaxabiso wengeniso nakuchithwa kwemali, Hlaziya nokugcina amagqina-kakubi, iinkqubo namayala, Qinisekisa inkonzo yokulawulakubakwe iseyi kwesebe. Ukulawulakubakwe Iseyi: Luika inkonzo yamaxabiso kunye nakuhlengahlengiso konke kweentlawa kwemali, Qinisekisa iinkqubo ezisebenzayo kakhuphiswana nabasebenzi kweseyi kwabathwala-kamva, Qinisekisa iinkqubo ezisebenzayo zokuhruba kokuhlengahlengiswa kakade kolwandle-asebenzi, Qinisekisa iinkqubo ezisebenzayo zokuhruba kwe-Logistical Information System (LOGIS), Ukupakela iindaba zeseyi kakhulu neenkqubo zekhompyutha, Qinisekisa inkqubo efanelekileyo yokwaziswa kweseyi ehlanganisa nokusebenzisana amaxabiso namayala asolusinkqubo, Phatha ezokuqinisekisa inkqubo ye-BAS systems, Qamba iingxelo ezimalini ze-financial statements, Phatha inkonzo yokutiyatya-abakhweli, Luika inkonzo yolawulo lokumaxabiso wabasebenzi kunene nolawulo lweenyikima. Isimo Sebhelekakubi (ngokuhlanganisa lolawulo lweentshintsho): Misela kalula kwaye uluqhele ngokusesikweni iindidi, amaphupha okufikelela kwemigqibelo eqikunqunqulele, ziinkqubo zamaqela kunene nesimo sebhloko kwi-Directorate, Phakatha i-Directorate ukuba iphathwe ngokweplani yemida yokugqiba kwamaxabiso akuqondwa nawe qekele ngokupheleleyo, Cusa ku-Gqirka Ohl. Phatha iinkqubo ezikukulawula kwinkqubo yesebe, Qinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kweekhomityi ezingqamana nakuzo zonke iinkqubo ezilawula imisebenzi yekhaya-nqunqunqu, Hlola ngokupheleleyo ukusebenza i-Directorate ngokusesikweni, Suka lude luxhome iindaba ngokusuka phandle kwengxangxgaxa, Banisa iingxangxgaxa ezikhoyo kwindalo namagunya ehlabathi, Qinisekisa iindlela ezifanelekileyo zokulandelela nokuqonda ngamachibi ngokusesikweni nasebenza i-Directorate, Qinisekisa inqanaba elundwendwe lwe-Directorate kwamanye amachibi nezikhululo, Khangela nokulawula indlela yokwenza iinkqubo zamachibi ezithilelakayo kunene zilonke iinkqubo zolwazi ezahlukeneyo, Khangela ngokusuka kwinkqubo yamachibi e-Directorate ze zenzeke ngokusesikweni zombono wendalo, Ukubeka iindaba ezingathanda ukutshintsheleka phantsi kwengxangxgaxa ngokungqongqo ngexesha lokuqhuba inkqubo yakho, Qinisekisa ulonwabo kwaye ukhuthaze isiko elingasokuqaliyo kuqhagamshelwano ne-Directorate kunye ne-sebe, Sekela ngokusesikweni konke ukusebenza okuqwalaselwe kwisithuba sika-Director. Ukulawula Abantu: Ngenxa yokuba ngumsebenzi omnye kulungelelwaniso lwabasebenzi ngokobunjana nobukhulu beqhinga elifanelekileyo lokuvunywa iplani yoqhagamshelwano ne-Directorate's Business Plan, Khuthaza khona ufundo lomsebenzi nakukhokelwa abasebenzi kwakhona kunene kulula ulwazi lwakho, Lawula ngokubakakhulu ulawulo nokunyuka kwamakhono lokuphanga abasebenzi kulungelelwaniso nakwindlovana i-Directorate, Khangela nokulawula imiba yokwakha khono iimfihloze ngokusesikweni kwemisebenzi ehambisa phakathi kwawo-Directorate's, Qinisekisa ulathandabuxholo ekubakeni iplani yokusebenza abantu, inkqubo yokuphucula inkonzo nokulungiselelwa kwamathuba oqhagamshelwano, Khuthaza ubudlelwane obuhle obungqongqo buzasebenzi phakathi kwe-Directorate, Lawula ngokubakakhulu nakho ukuba lwe-Directorate kuwo ubuntu namakhwenkwe nkwenkwenkwe kuphucula nokuqabamba inkqubo yokulawula abantu. Ukulawula Imali: Khangela nokwenza iplani ekwamachibi wokuba yengxenye yaloo nkqubo kulungelelwaniso ngemali mayelandlu, Qinisekisa ulungiselelwa kwexesha eliyiminyaka yonke kunene nakulungelelwaniso yamaxedebhu ngemali yendlu yonke, Qinisekisa amaxabiso ukuba ngelona liqondo kwakhona ke uvakale ngokupheleleyo ukuba ngowekhaya xa kusetyenziswa amaxabiso e-Directorate, Qinisekisa ukuba uxhome ekhaya ekuqwalaselweni kwesiya nakwindlu ukulungiselelwa ukuyaqhuba kwindlela yokugqitha kwamaxedebhu kunene nakwindlela yokusebenza kwamaxedebhu, Qinisekisa ukuba uxhome ekhaya ekuqwalaselweni kokuba yasekhaya xa kusetyenzwa izinto ezifuna ukuba kusetyenziswe ngokomthetho ekhaya-kuqaliwa iindlela ezilula kwi-Directorate ngokweqondo langokuthe ngakunye, Qinisekisa ukuba konke ukuchithwa kumali kusemthonjeni kokulungelelwaniso nangokusesikweni kwesiseko nokuba ngamacebo akhoyo ekhaya nakwi-Directorate, Qinisekisa ukuba singabakwaqwalaselo abaqinisekisa iiNdinge-mthetho ekhaya kunene kwabanye abo bathwele khondolo ikhaya xa kunokusetyenzwa konke oko kusetyenziswa ngokomthetho, Qinisekisa ukuba ngowekhaya nakumaphephezelo alo alindelekileyo kokuba ngowakhona xaqhuba ukwenza izinto ezinje ngokomthetho ngokweqondo.

jobs.title: Regional Director: West Coast
jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government
jobs.summary: Regional Director for the West Coast at the Department of Social Development, offering R1,317,384 per annum at SMS Level 13.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate NQF 7 or higher qualification as recognised by SAQA; A minimum of 5 years relevant middle/senior management level experience; Successful completion of Certificate for entry into the SMS (Senior Management Service) prior to appointment is requirement. The nominated candidate will be required to complete the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) before the candidate can be appointed into this post. Please see notes below. Competencies: Extensive knowledge of applicable policies and procedures: Educational environment; Knowledge of the following: Applicable policies and procedures; Management principles; Core Competencies: Strategic Capability and leadership, People Management and Empowerment, Programme and Project Management, Financial Management and Change Management; Skills: Interpret and apply relevant policies and procedures; People Management planning; Problem solving; Sound Budgeting skills; Communication and facilitation skills; Strategic thinking and planning.
jobs.duties: Line Management: Strategic management, advice and guidance in respect of the following functional areas: Families and Children Programmes, Special Programmes, Social Crime Prevention, Programmes, Support the service delivery unit (SDU) and service delivery partners with the implementation of programmes (children and families, and restorative services: Victim empowerment, crime Prevention and support, and substance abuse), District Business Planning, Information & Stakeholder Management, Manage operational business planning and monitoring processes, Community Development Programmes, Manage Corporate Services at Regional Level, Strategic Management (including Change Management: Define and review on a continual basis the purpose, objectives, priorities and activities of the Directorate, Drive the Directorate’s strategic planning process, Drive the development and management of the strategic and business plans for the Directorate ,Evaluate the performance of the Directorate on a continuing basis against pre-determined key measurable objectives and standards, Evaluate regional performance against predetermined objectives and standards and report to the HOD, Report to the Chief Director on a regular basis on the activities of the Directorate and on matters of substantial importance relating to operational management support, Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant legislation and prescripts in respect of adequate and appropriate record keeping of the activities of the Directorate, and of the resources (people, finances and assets) employed by it, Foster and promote a culture of innovation within the Directorate, and the Department, Diligently perform all duties assigned to the post of Director. People Management: Participate in the recruitment of employees in the numbers and grades appropriate to ensure the achievement of the Directorate’s Business Plan, Motivate, train and guide employees within the Directorate, to achieve and maintain excellence in service delivery, Actively manage the performance, evaluation and rewarding of employees within the Directorate , Monitor information capacity building within the Directorate, Ensure involvement in the compilation of a workforce plan, a service delivery improvement programme, and an information resources plan for the Directorate, Promote sound labour relations within the Directorate, Actively manage and promote the maintenance of discipline within the Directorate. Financial Management: Manage participation in the budgeting process at Directorate level, Ensure the preparation of the Annual and Adjustment Budgets for the Directorate, Assume direct accountability for the efficient, economic and effective control and management of the Directorate’s budget and expenditure, Assume direct accountability for ensuring that the correct tender and procurement procedures are adhered to in respect of purchases for the Directorate, Assume direct accountability for ensuring contracts are managed effectively and efficiently for the Directorate, Ensure that all spending is aligned with the strategic objectives of the Directorate and Department, Report to the Chief Director and relevant oversight role players/committees on all aspects of the Directorate’s finances, Assume overall accountability for the management, maintenance and safekeeping of the Directorate’s assets, Assume direct accountability for ensuring that appropriate risk management procedures are in place and adhered to for the Directorate, Ensure that full and proper records of the financial affairs of the Directorate are kept in accordance with any prescribed norms and standards.
jobs.enquiries: Ms A van Reenen Tel No: (021) 483 3996 / Annemie.vanReenen@westerncape.gov.za OTHER POSTS
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. Kindly note that technical support is only available from Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 16:00. Should you experience any difficulties with your online application you may contact the helpline on 0861 370 214. Please ensure that you submit your application on or before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this post, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. All shortlisted candidates must make themselves available to be interviewed at a date, time and place as decided by the selection panel. All shortlisted candidates will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to assess relevant functional elements of the job and an interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will be required to complete the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) and submit the certificate before he/she can be appointed to this post. The purpose of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme, which is a public service specific training programme applicable to all applicants who aspire to join the SMS, is to ensure that potential SMS members have a background in processes and procedures linked to the SMS. The duration of the online Pre-Entry Programme is 120 notional hours (15 days). Full details may be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training- course/sms-preentryprogramme . The successful candidate shall be subjected to a leadership assessment, within one (1) month of appointment, to assess the managerial competencies required for SMS members in the Public Service as specified under Chapter Five (5) of the SMS handbook. This assessment shall be conducted to determine an individual’s ability to lead, manage, and direct others and to identify developmental gaps in core generic leadership and management competencies. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. The successful candidate will be subject to security vetting; and the candidate will have to disclose her/his financial interests. Furthermore, thank you, to the huge public interest, we receive many applications for our posts, and as such will not be able to respond personally to all applications. Therefore, should you not hear from us within 10 weeks from close of the advert please consider your application unsuccessful. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Streeksdirekteur: Weskus
af.summary: Streeksdirekteur vir die Weskus by die Department of Social Development, teen R1,317,384 per jaar op SMS Vlak 13.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike NQF 7 of hoër kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken; 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se relevante midde-/seniorbestuursvlak-ervaring; Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Sertifikaat vir toetrede tot die SMS (Senior Management Service) voor aanstelling is 'n vereiste. Die benoemde kandidaat sal vereis word om die Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) te voltooi voordat die kandidaat in hierdie pos aangestel kan word. Sien asseblief notas hieronder. Bevoegdhede: Uitgebreide kennis van toepaslike beleide en prosedures: Opvoedkundige omgewing; Kennis van die volgende: Toepaslike beleide en prosedures; Bestuursbeginsels; Kernbevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, Mensbestuur en bemagtiging, Program- en projekbestuur, Finansiële bestuur en veranderingsbestuur; Vaardighede: Interpreteer en pas toepaslike beleide en prosedures toe; Mensbestuursbeplanning; Probleemoplossing; Bevoegde begrotingsvaardighede; Kommunikasie en fasiliteringsvaardighede; Strategiese denke en beplanning.
af.duties: Lynebestuur: Strategiese bestuur, advies en leiding ten opsigte van die volgende funksionele areas: Gesins- en kinderprogramme, Spesiale programme, Maatskaplike misdaadvoorkoming, Programme, Ondersteun die diensleweringseenheid (SDU) en diensleweringvennote met die implementering van programme (kinder en gesinne, en hersteldienste: slagofferbemagtiging, misdaadvoorkoming en ondersteuning, en middelmisbruik), Distriksakebeplanning, Inligting- en belanghebbendebestuur, Bestuur operasionele sakebeplanning en moniteringsprosesse, Gemeenskapsontwikkelingsprogramme, Bestuur Korporatiewe Dienste op Streeksvlak, Strategiese bestuur (insluitend Veranderingsbestuur: Definieer en hersien deurlopend die doel, doelwitte, prioriteite en aktiwiteite van die Direktoraat, Druk die Direktoraat se strategiese beplanningsproses voort, Druk die ontwikkeling en bestuur van die strategiese en sakeplanne vir die Direktoraat voort, Evalueer die prestasie van die Direktoraat deurlopend teen vooraf bepaalde sleutel meetbare doelwitte en standaarde, Evalueer streeksprestasie teen vooraf bepaalde doelwitte en standaarde en rapporteer aan die HOD, Rapporteer gereeld aan die Hoofdirekteur oor die aktiwiteite van die Direktoraat en oor aangeleenthede van wesenlike belang rakende operasionele bestuursondersteuning, Monitor en verseker nakoming van toepaslike wetgewing en voorskrifte ten opsigte van voldoende en toepaslike rekordhouding van die aktiwiteite van die Direktoraat, en van die hulpbronne (mense, finansies en bates) wat daardeur aangewend word, Bevorder en bevorder 'n kultuur van innovasie binne die Direktoraat, en die departement, Voer ywerig alle pligte wat aan die pos van Direkteur opgedra word, uit. Mensbestuur: Neem deel aan die werwing van werknemers in die getalle en vlakke wat toepaslik is om die bereiking van die Direktoraat se Sakeplan te verseker, Motiveer, leer en begelei werknemers binne die Direktoraat, om uitnemendheid in dienslewering te bereik en te handhaaf, Bestuur aktief die prestasie, evaluering en beloning van werknemers binne die Direktoraat, Monitor inligtingskapasiteitsopbou binne die Direktoraat, Verseer betrokkenheid by die opstel van 'n werksmagplan, 'n diensleweringverbeteringsprogram, en 'n inligtingshulpbronplan vir die Direktoraat, Bevorder goeie arbeidsverhoudinge binne die Direktoraat, Bestuur aktief en bevorder die handhawing van dissipline binne die Direktoraat. Finansiële bestuur: Bestuur deelname aan die begrotingsproses op Direktoraatsvlak, Verseker die voorbereiding van die Jaarlikse en Aanpassingsbegrotings vir die Direktoraat, Neem direkte aanspreeklikheid vir die doeltreffende, ekonomiese en effektiewe beheer en bestuur van die Direktoraat se begroting en uitgawes, Neem direkte aanspreeklikheid om te verseker dat die korrekte tender- en voorraadprosedures ten opsigte van aankope vir die Direktoraat nagekom word, Neem direkte aanspreeklikheid om te verseker dat kontrakte doeltreffend en effektief vir die Direktoraat bestuur word, Verseker dat alle besteding met die strategiese doelwitte van die Direktoraat en departement ooreenstem, Rapporteer aan die Hoofdirekteur en toepaslike toesigrolspelers/komitees oor alle aspekte van die Direktoraat se finansies, Neem algehele aanspreeklikheid vir die bestuur, onderhoud en veilige bewaring van die Direktoraat se bates, Neem direkte aanspreeklikheid om te verseer dat toepaslike risikobestuurprosedures in plek is en vir die Direktoraat nagekom word, Verseker dat volledige en behoorlike rekords van die finansiële aangeleenthede van die Direktoraat gehou word ooreenkomstig enige voorgeskrewe norme en standaarde.

zu.title: Umqondisi Wendawo: West Coast
zu.summary: Umqondisi Wendawo wesifundazwe i-West Coast eDepartment of Social Development, enikeza i-R1,317,384 ngonyaka ezingeni le-SMS Level 13.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezinga le-NQF 7 noma eziphezule ezingunyawunyawo lwe-SAQA; Okungeziwe eminyakeni engu-5 yamava ahambisanayo ohlelweni lwalawulo oluphakathi noluphezulu; Ukugcwaliseka ngempumelelo kwe-Certificate yokungena kwi-SMS (Senior Management Service) ngaphambi kokuqashwa kuyisidingo. Umqashi onquliwe uzodinga ukugcwalisa i-Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) ngaphambi kokuba aqashwe kulesi sikhundla. Sicela ubuke izaziso ngezansi. Ikhono: Ulwazi olubanzi emigomweni nemiyalo ethintekayo: Endaweni yokufundela; Ulwazi ngalokhu: Imigomo nemiyalo ethintekayo; Imigomo yalawulo; Ikhono Esiyini: Ikhono lokubeka ihlelo neziqukoqela, Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokuqinisekisa amandla, Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi, Ukuphathwa kwezimali nokuqashwa kokushintsha; Amakhono: Ukutolikwa nokusebenzisa imigomo nemiyalo ethintekayo; Ukuhlela ukuphathwa kwabantu; Ukuxazulula izinkinga; Amakhono aphelele okwenza isabelomali; Amakhono okuxhumana nokuqondisa; Ukucabanga nokuhlela ngokuhleleka.
zu.duties: Ukulawula umugqa: Ukuphathwa ngokuhleleka, ukweluleka nokuholela mayelana nalawa mashemu alandelayo: Izinhlelo zomndeni nabantwana, Izinhlelo ezikhethekile, Ukuvikela ubugebengu ngokomthetho, Izinhlela, Ukusekela iyunithi yokulethwa kwezinsiza (SDU) nabalingani bokulethwa kwezinsiza ekusebenziseni izinhlelo (abantwana nomndeni, nezinsiza zokulungisa: Ukuqiniswa amandla komphumuphulu, ukuvikela ubugebengu nokusekela, nenhlanzi yezidakamizwa), Ukuhlela ibhizinisi lesifunda, Ukuphathwa kolwazi nabaluzayo, Ukuphatha ukuhlela ibhizinisi lokusebenza nezinqubo zokuqapha, Izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, Ukuphatha izinsiza zenhlangano ezingeni lendawo, Ukuphathwa ngokuhleleka (okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kokushintsha: Chaza futhi uhlole ngokuhamba kwesikhathi injongo, izinhloso, izimo zokubaluleka nemisebenzi yoMnyango weziNgqangi, Xhumanisa inqubo yokuhlela ngokuhleleka koMnyango weziNgqangi, Xhumanisa ukuthuthukiswa nokuphathwa kwezinhlela ezihleleka nezohlelo loMnyango weziNgqangi, Hlola imikhiqizo yoMnyango weziNgqangi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngokwezinhloso eziphathwayo nezigaba esibekiwe, Hlola imikhiqizo yesifunda ngokwezinhloso eziphathwayo nezigamba esibekiwe futhi uthule kwi-HOD, Thula kuChief Director njalo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngemisebenzi yoMnyango weziNgqangi nangalezi zindaba ezibaluleke kakhulu ezihlobene nokusekela ukuphathwa kokusebenza, Qapha futhi uqinisekise ukulandelwa kwezindleko nemiyalo ethintekayo ngokugcina ibhala elifanele nelihambisana nemisebenzi yoMnyango weziNgqangi, nezinsiza (abantu, imali nezimpahla) ezingeniswa ukuthi, Xhumanisa futhi ukhuthaze isiko lokwakha okusha ngaphakathi koMnyango weziNgqangi, newoMnyango, Wenze ngokuzikhandla konke okusebenzi okunikelwa kulesi sikhundla sokuqondisa. Ukuphathwa kwabantu: Thatha inxaxheba ekuqashweni kwabasebenzi ngemibhala efanayo nangaphezulu ukuze uqinisekise ukufeza ihlelo loMnyango weziNgqangi, Khuthaza, qeqesha futhi uholele abasebenzi ngaphakathi koMnyango weziNgqangi, ukufeza futhi ugcine ukuphumelela okukhulu ekuletheni izinsiza, Yenza isibonelo ekuphatheni, ukuhlolweni nokuhlakaniphiseni abasebenzi ngaphakathi koMnyango weziNgqangi, Qapha ukukhiqizwa kolwazi ngokwandisa amandla ngaphakathi koMnyango weziNgqangi, Qinisekisa ukuthathwa kwenxaxheba ekwakheni uhlelo lomsebenzi, inhlelo yokuthuthukisa ukuletha izinsiza, nohlelo lolwazi loMnyango weziNgqangi, Khuthaza ubuhlobo obuhle bomsebenzi ngaphakathi koMnyango weziNgqangi, Yenza isibonelo ekuphatheni futhi uthuthukise ukugcinwa kwenhloso ngaphakathi koMnyango weziNgqangi. Ukuphathwa kwezimali: Phatha ukuthathwa kwenxaxheba ekwenzeni isabelomali ezingeni loMnyango weziNgqangi, Qinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kwezabelomali zonyaka kanye nezokulungisa uMnyango weziNgqangi, Thathe inxaxheba ngqo ekubhaleni i-Annual and Adjustment Budgets yoMnyango weziNgqangi, Thathe inxaxheba ngqo eqinisekiseni ukulawula nokuphatha ngempumelelo isabelomali kanye nokuqhutshwa koMnyango weziNgqangi, Thathe inxaxheba ngqo eqinisekiseni ukulandelwa kwezindleko ezifanele zokuqasha nokuthenga ngokwemigomo kaMnyango weziNgqangi, Thathe inxaxheba ngqo eqinisekiseni ukuphathwa kwezinkulumo-zomsebenzi ngempumelelo nangokuzikhandla koMnyango weziNgqangi, Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imali ejiqhayo ihambisana nezinhloso ezihleleka zomnyango wezinhlela nowoMnyango, Thula kuChief Director kubaluleki bokuhlola/bakomidi ngazo zonke izindaba zezimali zoMnyango weziNgqangi, Thathe inxaxheba ngqo ngokuphela ekuphatheni, ukugcinweni nokulondolozweni izimpahla zoMnyango weziNgqangi, Thathe inxaxheba ngqo eqinisekiseni ukuthi kunezindleko zokuphatha izingozi ezifanele futhi zilandelaywa ngokomumoMnyango weziNgqangi, Qinisekisa ukuthi kugcinwa ibhala eliphelele nangokufanele ngemali yoMnyango weziNgqangi ngokuya nganoma yimiphi imithetho nemiqingo eshiwo.

xh.title: Umqondisi woMmandla: West Coast
xh.summary: Umqondisi woMmandla we-West Coast kwiSebe lezaPhuhliso loLuntu,elinika i-R1,317,384 ngonyaka kwinqanaba le-SMS Level 13.
xh.requirements: Isifanelekezo esifanelekileyo se-NQF 7 okanye siphezulu njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA; Okungenani ihle ngeyure ezi-5 zemfuno ebandakanya amava ohlelo lwapakathi/ophezulu lolawulo; Ukuphumelela uQeqesho loBungqina bokuNgenisa kwi-SMS (Senior Management Service) ngaphambi kokuba kubekwe ngumntu kuyimfuno. Umkelikeli oqokiweyouya kufuneka aqedele iNkqubo yeNyukela ye-Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) ngaphambi kokuba anganiselwa kule sithuba. Nceda jonga iimbinzana ngezantsi. Ikhono: Ulwimo olubanzi lwemigaqo nayinkqubo ezicetyiswayo: Okusingathwa kwemfundo; Ulwazi ngalwemi: Imigaqo nayinkqubo ezicetyiswayo; Iinkqubo zolawulo; Ikhono ePhambili: Ikhono leMigaqo nokulawula, uLawulo labaBenzi noMdayo wabo, uLawulo lweenkqubo namaPhojekthi, uLawulo leeMali noLawulo luTshintsho; Amanqanaba amakhono: Ukucazulula nokusebenzisa imigaqo nayinkqubo ezicetyiswayo; Uqeqesho kolawulo lwabantu; Ukuxazula iingxaki; Amanqanaba amakhono okwenza ibhajethi ngokuchanekileyo; Amanqanaba amakhono okunxibelelanisa nokuqhuba iindibano; Ukuqonda nokuceba ngokwemigaqo.
xh.duties: ULawulo lweNkundla: ULawulo lokuqonda ngakumbi, ingcebiso nokuqondisa ngakwela mandla alandelayo asebenzayo: Iinkqubo zoLutshaba nezeNgane, Iinkqubo eziBalulekileyo, UkuThintela iNgculaza eZenziwa ngokuHlawula, Iinkqubo, uNxibelelwano neSebe lokuYalela iNkonzo (SDU) nabaSekeli bokuYalela iNkonzo ngokuphumeza iinkqubo (abantwana nosapho, naye nkqubo yonikezelo lweenkonzo ezilungiswayo: uNyango lweNtsholongwane, ukuThintela iNgculaza nonikezelo, nokuSetyenziswa kwezinto ezikhoyo), uQeqesho lweNkundla, uLawulo nokuQonda iNkcukacha nokuQonda iindaba, uLawulo lweNkqubo yokuQonda iQela leDeshi, Iinkqubo zoPhuhliso loBomi beNkundla, uLawulo lweekonzo zeQela eNkundleni, uLawulo lokuQonda ngakumbi (kuqulathe uLawulo luTshintsho: MisA nokujonga ngonaphakade injongo, iinjongo ezibalulewayo, iinkqubo namagqabantshintshi oQeqesho, Qhuba inkqubo yokucela uQeqesho, Qhuba uPhuhliso nokuLawula iplani yokugqiba iQela ngokomoya, Pima ukusebenza koQeqesho ngokuhlala kukho uQeqesho ngokuchasene neenjongo ezibekiweyo ezibalulekileyo nezingqinisisiyo, Pima ukusebenza koQeqesho ngokuchasene neenjongo ezibekiweyo nezingqinisisiyo kwaye wenze ingxelo ku-HOD, Yenza ingxelo kuMqondisi oPhezulu ngokuhlala kukho iinkqubo ezenzeka kwoQeqesho nangemiba ebalulekileyo ehlobene nolawulo lokuLawula iinkqubo, Qaphela kuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzinikwa kumthetho nayinkqubo ngokwokuGcina amagama afanelekileyo nokuQaphela iinkqubo, kwaye ngaphezu koko ugcinwe lulwazi Iinkqubo ezikumandla oQeqesho, nakuLawulwa kuko konke okuGcinayo kwiNkundla, Sakhela nokuQaphela kwinkqubo ekhulayo kwaseQeleni, yaye iSebe nalo lisebenza ngokuzinikela kuzo zonke iinkqubo ezibekiweyo kwisithuba soMqondisi. ULawulo labaBenzi: Thatha inxaxheba ekubekeni abasebenzi ngokomgxba nangokwamaza afanelekileyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphumelelwa koQeqesho ngokwamaPhojekthi ezoQeqesho, Yakhisa, qeqesha uze wakhule abasebenzi abakule ndlu yoQeqesho, ukuze baQonde baGcine isimo esiphumelelisayo kwinkonzo, Yenza ngokuzinikela ukulawula, ukuqonda nokuNikezela ngeziko kwinkqubo abakule ndlu yoQeqesho, Qaphela ukwazi ngokuphuhliswa kwemisebenzi kwinkqubo yeNdlu, Qaphela iinkqubo ezithileyo ezikwindlu, Qaphela ngokufakwa kwendawo kaqeqesho, Yenza ingxelo kwinkqubo ekujoliswe kuyo, Inkqubo yokwenza ibhajethi, yaye iSebe nalo ligcine iinkqubo ngokomthetho nokuzinza kwawo onke amasebe. jobs.title: Community Development Manager: Social Relief
jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government.
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 009 512 per annum, (OSD as prescribed), (all-inclusive salary package)
jobs.summary: Manage integrated community development interventions and social relief programmes in the Western Cape, requiring a relevant degree and 10 years of experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate 3-year tertiary qualification (National Diploma/B-Degree or equivalent); A minimum of 10 years recognisable experience in Community Development after obtaining the required qualification of which 5 years must be appropriate experience in community policy development. Competencies: Knowledge and understanding of the following: Theories and systems, skills, attitudes and values in community development to guide employees on its application; Individual and group behaviour, its inter-relations within community structures, dynamics of the community and current legislation to enable interventions; Develop community development policies and strategies. Skills in the following: Presentation; Problem-solving skills; Financial management; Project management; Computer literacy; Communication (written and verbal); Staff management; Policy formulation and implementation.
jobs.duties: To manage the identification, facilitation and implementation of integrated development interventions in partnership with the community and other relevant stakeholders through the efficient, effective and economical utilisation of resources by the unit/sub directorate; Manage a community development policy unit to ensure that the required legislative policies and procedures are developed through the efficient and effective utilisation of human resources; Manage the development of policies for rendering a community development service in departments; Keep up to date with new developments in community development and management fields; Plan and ensure that community development policy research is undertaken. Undertake complex community development research.

af.title: Gemeenskapsontwikkelingsbestuurder: Sosiale Lenings
af.summary: Bestuur geïntegreerde gemeenskapsontwikkelingsintervensies en sosiale leningsprogramme in die Western Cape, wat 'n tersaaklike graad en 10 jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike 3-jaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (Nasionale Diploma/B-Degree of gelykwaardig); 'n Minimum van 10 jaar herkenbare ervaring in Gemeenskapsontwikkeling na verkryging van die vereiste kwalifikasie waarvan 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring in gemeenskapsbeleidontwikkeling moet wees. Bevoegdhede: Kennis en begrip van die volgende: Teorieë en stelsels, vaardighede, houdings en waardes in gemeenskapsontwikkeling om werknemers te lei oor die toepassing daarvan; Individuele en groepgedrag, die onderlinge verhoudings binne gemeenskapstrukture, dinamika van die gemeenskap en huidige wetgewing om intervenisies moontlik te maak; Ontwikkel gemeenskapsontwikkelingsbeleide en -strategieë. Vaardighede in die volgende: Voorlegging; Probleemoplossingsvaardighede; Finansiële bestuur; Projektbestuur; Rekenaargeletterdheid; Kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings); Personeelbestuur; Beleidformulering en -implementering.
af.duties: Om die identifisering, fasilitering en implementering van geïntegreerde ontwikkelingsintervensies in samewerking met die gemeenskap en ander relevante belanghebbendes te bestuur deur die doeltreffende, effektiewe en ekonomiese benutting van hulpbronne deur die eenheid/sub-direktoraat; Bestuur 'n gemeenskapsontwikkelingsbeleidseenheid om te verseker dat die vereiste wetgewendebeleide en prosedures ontwikkel word deur die doeltreffende en effektiewe benutting van menslike hulpbronne; Bestuur die ontwikkeling van beleide vir die lewer van 'n gemeenskapsontwikkelingsdiens in departemente; Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelinge in die gemeenskapsontwikkelings- en bestuursvelde; Beplan en verseker dat gemeenskapsontwikkelingsbeleidnavorsing gedoen word. Onderneem komplekse gemeenskapsontwikkelingsnavorsing.

zu.title: Umphathi Wentuthuko Yomphakathi: Usizo Lomphakathi
zu.summary: Phatha izinkomba zentuthuko yomphakathi ehlangene namaphrogramu wosizo lomphakathi e-Western Cape, okudinga iziqu ezifanele kanye neminyaka eyi-10 yesisipho.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikhashana ezifanele zeminyaka engu-3 (National Diploma/B-Degree noma okulinganayo); Umkhawulo weminyaka engu-10 yesipho esibonakalayo entuthukweni yomphakathi emva kokuthola izidingo ezidingekile, lapho kuyadingeka khona iminyaka engu-5 yesipho esifanele entuthukweni yenqubomgomo yomphakathi. Ikhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda okulandelayo: Izindlela nezimiso, amakhono, imikhuba namagugu entuthukweni yomphakathi ukuqondisa abasebenzi ngokusetshenziswa kwayo; Ukuziphatha komuntu ngamunye nakweqembu, ubudlelwano balo ngaphakathi kwezakhiwo zomphakathi, amandla okuqhubekayo komphakathi nomthetho wamanje ukwenza kwenzeke izinkomba; Butha izinqubomgomo namasu entuthuko yomphakathi. Amakhono okulandelayo: Okokubonisa; Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga; Ukuphathwa kwezimali; Ukuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Ukuxhumana (okubhaliwe noku Khulunywa); Ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi; Ukwenza nokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha ukuhlukaniswa, ukwenza kusebenze nokusetshenziswa kwezinkomba zentuthuko eziyisiyingi nxulumene nomphakathi nanabanye baphathi abafanele ngokusebenzisa ngempumelelo, ngokusebenza kahle nangokugcaphula izinsiza yiqembu/isigaba esingaphansi; Phatha iqembu lezinqubomgomo yentuthuko yomphakathi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo nezinqubo ezidingekile ngomthetho zenziwa ngokusebenzisa ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kahle izinsiza zabantu; Phatha entuthukweni kwezinqubomgomo zokunikeza isevisi yentuthuko yomphakathi kumamnyango; Gcina ulwazi olusha entuthukweni yomphakathi nasemkhakheni wokuphathwa; Hlela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuphenywa inqubomgomo yentuthuko yomphakathi. Yenza ucwaningo oludkinga lwezinkinga entuthukweni yomphakathi.

xh.title: Umphathi wePhuhliso loBomi beMaqabane: uNcedo loBuntu
xh.summary: Lawula iindlela ezidityanisiweyo zophuhliso lobomi bemaqabane kunye nenkqubo zencedo lobuntu kwi-Western Cape, kufuneka ibe nedigri efanelekileyo kunye neminyaka eyi-10 yamava.
xh.requirements: Izifundo eziphakamileyo ezifanelekileyo zeminyaka eyi-3 (National Diploma/B-Degree okwaqathaniswa nazo); Iminyaka elungileyo engaphantsi kwayi-10 yamava kwi-Community Development emva koku fumana izifundo ezifunekayo, apho iminyaka esi-5 kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo kophuhliso lweenkqubo zoluntu. Iimfuno: Ulwazi nokuqonda oku kulandelayo: Iitheori nendlela zokusebenza, amakhono, imimoya nenkqubo zexabiso kophuhliso lobomi bemaqabane ukuze akhokele abasebenzi ngokusetyenziswa kwazo; Ukuziphatha komntu ngamnye nabadala, ukunxibelelana kwabo phakathi kwezakhiwo zoluntu, iziganeko zoluntu kunye nemithetho yamvanje ukwenzela ukuba kubenzele iindlela zokungenelela; Puhlisa iinkqubo zoluntu kunye neendlela. Amakhono koku kulandelayo: Okubonakalayo; Amakhono oxazululozi kwiingxaki; ulawulo lwezemali; ulawulo lweprojekthi; Ukufunda nokubhala ngokwekhompyutha; Unxibelelwano (okubhaliweyo nolwelomlomo); ulawulo lwabasebenzi; Ukwakha nokusebenzisa iinkqubo.
xh.duties: Ukuqwalasela, ukwenza lula nokuphuza iindlela ezidityanisiweyo zophuhliso koluntu ngokwenyana naloluntu kunye namanye abahluki abafanelekileyo ngokusebenzisa ngokusebenza kakuhle, ngokuchaneka, nangokugcina izixhobo ngenqanaba lenqanaba elingezantsi; Lawula iyunithi yeenkqubo zophuhliso koluntu ukuze qinisekiswe ukuba iinkqubo neendlela ezifunekayo ngokomthetho zithathwa ngokusebenzisa ngokusebenza kakuhle ngokuchaneka abantu; Lawula uphuhliso lweenkqubo zokuvelisa inkonzo yophuhliso koluntu kumasebe; Gcina ulwazi ngophuhliso olutsha kwiindawo zophuhliso koluntu nolawulo; Cwangcisa ukuze qinisekiswe ukuba kwenziwa uphononongo lweenkqubo zophuhliso koluntu. Yenza uphononongo olunzima lophuhliso koluntu.

jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government
jobs.salary_text: R496 668 - R583 833 per annum, (OSD as prescribed)
jobs.summary: Social Work Supervisor position in the Western Cape requiring a Social Work qualification, SACSSP registration, seven years post-registration experience, and a valid driving licence.

af.title: Maatskaplikewerk toesighouer
af.summary: Maatskaplikewerk toesighouer-pos in die Western Cape wat 'n maatskaplikewerkkwalifikasie, SACSSP-registrasie, sewe jaar se ervaring na registrasie en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie vereis.
af.requirements: Formele tersiêre kwalifikasie in Maatskaplike Werk (bv. Bachelor of Social Work) wat professionele registrasie by die SACSSP moontlik maak; 'n Minimum van 7 jaar gepaste ervaring in maatskaplike werk na registrasie as Maatskaplike Werker by die SACSSP; 'n Geldige (Code B of hoër) bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Analitiese, diagnostiese, assesseringsinstrumente, evalueringsmetodes en -prosesse (Maatskaplike Werker); Personeelbestuur; Toesigkader vir Maatskaplike Werkers; Maatskaplikewerkwetgewing rakende kinders; Maatskaplikewerkteorie en -intervensies; Inligting- en kennisbestuur; Protokol en professionele etiek. Vaardighede in die volgende: Organisering en beplanning; Projekteplanning; Psigososiale intervensie; Kommunikasie en taal; Mensbestuurspraktyke; Konflikbestuur; Interpersoonlik; Verslagdoening; Rekenaargeletterdheid; Voorlegging en fasilitering; Probleemoplossing en analitiese vaardighede.
af.duties: Om te verseker dat maatskaplikewerkdienste gelewer word ten opsigte van die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe deur die tersaaklike programme. Aandag skenk aan enige ander aangeleenthede wat tot, of voortspruit uit, sosiale onstabiliteit in enige vorm kan lei. Werknemers toesien wat by hierdie funksies betrokke is; Toesig hou oor en maatskaplike werkers, maatskaplike hulpwerkers en vrywilligers adviseer om 'n doeltreffende maatskaplikewerkdiens te verseker; Tred hou met nuwe ontwikkelinge in die maatskaplikewerkveld; Toesig hou oor al die administratiewe funksies wat in die eenheid vereis word en die hoërvlak-administratiewe funksies onderneem.
