zu.summary: Isikhundla somPhathi Womsebenzi Wokuxhumana Komphakathi eWestern Cape esifuna iziqu zomsebenzi wokuxhumana komphakathi, ukubhaliswa ku-SACSSP, isiphephelo seminyaka eyisikhombisa ngemva kokubhaliswa, nephasipoti ekhethekile yokuqhuba.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zendabuko zezifundo eziphakeme ezingeni le-Tertiary ku-Social Work (isb. Bachelor of Social Work) ezivumela ukubhaliswa ngobungcweti ku-SACSSP; Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-7 yohlu lokuqeqeshwa emsebenzini wokuxhumana komphakathi ngemva kokubhaliswa njengoSocial Worker ku-SACSSP; Iphasiyedi elikhoyo (i-Code B noma elingaphezulu). Ikhono: Ulwazi ngokulandelayo: Okuhlaziya, okuhlola, amathuluzi okuhlola, izindlela zokuqinisekisa kanye nenqubo (i-Social Worker); Ukuqondiswa kwabasebenzi; Inqubo Yokuhlola abaSocial Worker; Umthetho womsebenzi wokuxhumana komphakathi ohlobene nezingane; Inqubo yomsebenzi wokuxhumana komphakathi kanye nezindlela zokungenelela; Ukuqondiswa kolwazi nolwazi mayelana nokulawula; Iphrothokholi kanye nokuqondiswa kwemithetho yobungcweti. Amandla okulandelayo: Ukulungiselela futhi uhlele; Ukuhlela amaphrojekthi; Ukungenelela ngokomsebenzi wokuxhumana komphakathi; Ukuxhumana kolimi; Amasu okulawula abantu; Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga; Ukuxhumana komuntu nomuntu; Ukubhala imibiko; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Ukubamba iqhaza nokuhola; Amandla okuxazulula izinkinga futhi uhlolahle.
zu.duties: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kunikezwa imisebenzi yokuxhumana komphakathi ehlobene nokunakekelwa, ukusekela, ukuvikela kanye nentuthuko yabantu, amaqembu, imindeni namaphakathi abangenampilo ngokweminhlebe ehlobene. Ukuphathela kweminye imikhakha engase ibangele, noma iholele, ekukungabeni okuzinzile komphakathi nganoma yisiphi isimo. Ukuqondisa abasebenzi ababambe iqhaza kule misebenzi; Ukuhlola kanye nokweluleka abaSocial Worker, abaSocial Auxiliary Worker nabathandibezindiza ukuze kuqinisekiswe insiza ekahle yomsebenzi wokuxhumana komphakathi; Ukuhlala ulwazi ngemisebenzi emitsha kumkhakha womsebenzi wokuxhumana komphakathi; Ukuqondisa yonke imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwemibhalo edingekayo kwilunga kanye nokwenza imisebenzi ezingeni eliphezulu yokuphathwa kwemibhalo.

xh.title: Mlawuli Wemisebenzi Yeentsapho
xh.summary: Isikhundla somlawuli wezabelo zeentsapho kwelase Western Cape esimfuno ube nesidanga kwiinkonzo zeentsapho, kubekho isibhalo kwi-SACSSP, kube neminyaka elishumi elinesixhenxe kwiminyaka yakho emva kokuqinisekiswa njengomsebenzi wezantsi, ube nawolawulo lokushayela oluqinisekisiweyo.
xh.requirements: The following competencies: Ulwazi lolu kulandelayo: Analytic, diagnostic, assessment tools, evaluation methods and processes (Social Worker); Personnel Management; Supervision Framework for Social Workers; Social Work legislation related to children; Social work theory and interventions; Information and Knowledge Management; Protocol and professional ethics. Skills in the following: Organising and planning; Project planning; Psychosocial intervention; Communication and language; People management practices; Conflict Management; Interpersonal; Report writing; Computer literacy; Presentation and facilitation; Problem solving and analytical skills.

Nokuqwalasela nawo nanoma yimiphi na iminyhad eyinxaxheba ekungabakho okuyahlwayo, okukhokelela kwiimeko ezingathamsanqa kuye nawo nawo nawe nawo nawo nawe. Othatha isikhundla sokulawula abasebenzi ababandakanyeka kwinkalo; yaye makalawule, angaceba kubasebenzi bakho, abancedisi bemisebenzi yabantu kookhweduxi ukuba kuqinisekiswa ngokufanelekileyo ukuba iinkonzo zinikwa ngokusemthethweni; agcine esiikhundleni ukwenza iindlela ezintsha ekuhlaleni, ngokusebenza njengesakhono sokulawula imisebenzi yamakhaya awayeyiyo; nokugcina amaxwebhu okuqinisekisa ukuba abakho kwindawo apho sele enikwa isikhundla somsebenzi.

jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government.
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R338 208 - R397 668 per annum, (OSD as prescribed) Grade 2: R413 004 - R478 395 per annum, (OSD as prescribed) Grade 3: R496 668 – R583 833 per annum, (OSD as prescribed) Grade 4: R608 859 - R754 785 per annum, (OSD as prescribed).
jobs.summary: Social worker providing care, support, protection and development services to vulnerable individuals, groups, families and communities in the Western Cape.
jobs.requirements: A relevant tertiary qualification in Social Work (Bachelor of Social Work) that allows professional registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions as Social Worker; Registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions as a Social Worker; Grade 1: No experience; Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 4: A minimum of 30 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Supervision Framework for Social Workers; Human behaviour and social systems and skills to intervene at the points where people interact with their environments in order to promote social well- being; Social work theory and interventions; Information and Knowledge Management; Protocol and professional ethics; Relevant legislations, policies and prescripts (norms and standards); Social dynamics, work values and principles; Developing and empowering others. Skills in the following: Challenge structural sources of poverty, inequality, oppression, discrimination and exclusion; Written and verbal communication; Report-writing; Self- management; Motivation; Good planning and organizing; Problem solving and analytical; Computer literacy; Presentation and facilitation; Client orientation and customer focus; Ability and competence to assist, develop, advocate for, and empower individuals, families, groups, organisations and communities to enhance their social functioning and their problem-solving capabilities; Ability to promote, restore, maintain, advocate for and enhance the functioning of individuals, families, groups and communities by enabling them to accomplish tasks, prevent and alleviate distress and use resources effectively; Understanding and ability to provide social work services towards protecting people who are vulnerable, at risk and unable to protect themselves; Ability to mentor and coach Social Workers Grade 1.
jobs.duties: Render a social work service with regard to the care, support, protection and development of vulnerable individuals, groups, families and communities through the relevant programmes (Case work, group work and Community work); Attend to any other matters that could result in, or stem from, social instability in any form; Supervise and Support Social Auxiliary Workers; Continuous Professional Development; Keep up to date with new developments in the social work and social welfare fields; Perform all the administrative functions required of the job.

af.title: Maatskaplike Werker: Maatskaplikewerkdienste
af.summary: Maatskaplike werker wat sorg-, ondersteunings-, beskermings- en ontwikkelingsdienste aan kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe in die Western Cape bied.
af.requirements: 'n Tersière kwalifikasie in Maatskaplike Werk (Bachelor of Social Work) wat professionele registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions as Maatskaplike Werker moontlik maak; Registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions as 'n Maatskaplike Werker; Grade 1: Geen ondervinding nie; Grade 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ondervinding in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as 'n Maatskaplike Werker by die South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike ondervinding in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as 'n Maatskaplike Werker by die South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 4: 'n Minimum van 30 jaar toepaslike ondervinding in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as 'n Maatskaplike Werker by die South African Council for Social Service Professions. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Toesigkader vir Maatskaplike Werkers; Menslike gedrag en sosiale stelsels en vaardighede om in te gryp by die punte waar mense met hul omgewings interaksie het om sosiale welsyn te bevorder; Maatskaplikewerkteorie en -ingrypings; Inligting- en kennisbestuur; Protokol en professionele etiek; Terugwaartse wetgewing, beleide en voorskrifte (norme en standaarde); Sosiale dinamika, werkswaardes en -beginsels; Ontwikkeling en bemagtiging van ander. Vaardighede in die volgende: Daag strukturele bronne van armoede, ongelykheid, onderdrukking, diskriminasie en uitsluiting uit; Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie; Verslagskrywing; Selfbestuur; Motivering; Beplanning en organiseer; Probleemoplossing en analities; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Voorlegging en fasilitering; Kliëntoriëntasie en klantfokus; Vermoeë en bevoegdheid om individue, gesinne, groepe, organisasies en gemeenskappe by te staan, te ontwikkel, vir hulle op te tree en hulle te bemagtig om hul sosiale funksionering en probleemoplossingsvermoë te verbeter; Vermoeë om die funksionering van individue, gesinne, groepe en gemeenskappe te bevorder, te herstel, te handhaaf, daarvoor op te tree en te verbeter deur hulle in staat te stel om take te voltooi, nood te voorkom en te verlig en hulpbronne doeltreffend te gebruik; Begrip en vermoë om maatskaplikewerkdienste te bied ter beskerming van mense wat kwesbaar, tot risiko blootgestel en nie in staat is om hulself te beskerm nie; Vermoeë om Maatskaplike Werkers Grade 1 te mentorskap en af te rig.
af.duties: Lewer 'n maatskaplikewerkdiens met betrekking tot die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe deur die relevante programme (Gevallewerk, groepswerk en gemeenskapswerk); Bied aandag aan enige ander sake wat tot sosiale onstabiliteit in enige vorm kan lei of daaruit kan voortspruit; Hou toesig oor en ondersteun Maatskaplike Auxiliêre Werkers; Deurlopende Professionele Ontwikkeling; Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelings in die maatskaplikewerk- en sosiale welsynsvelde; Voer al die administratiewe funksies uit wat die werk vereis.

zu.summary: Umsebenzi wokwelapha ngokomphakathi onikeza izinkonzo zokunakekela, ukusekela, ukuvikela nokuthuthukisa abantu ababusileyo, amaqela, oosapho namakhaya kwingingqi ye Western Cape.
zu.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo sesikolo samazinga aphakamileyo ekwelapheni ngokomphakathi (iDegree ekwelapheni ngokomphakathi) esivumela ubhaliso lolwazi nempilo nakwi South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi weSocial Worker; Ubhaliso kwi South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi weSocial Worker; IGrade 1: Akukho mphumelelo; IGrade 2: Okungenani iminyaka eli-10 yomphumelelo olufanelekileyo ekwelapheni ngokomphakathi emva kobhaliso njengomsebenzi weSocial Worker nakwi South African Council for Social Service Professions; IGrade 3: Okungenani iminyaka eli-20 yomphumelelo olufanelekileyo ekwelapheni ngokomphakathi emva kobhaliso njengomsebenzi weSocial Worker nakwi South African Council for Social Service Professions; IGrade 4: Okungenani iminyaka eli-30 yomphumelelo olufanelekileyo ekwelapheni ngokomphakathi emva kobhaliso njengomsebenzi weSocial Worker nakwi South African Council for Social Service Professions. Amandla: Ulwazi ngokuqondana nalokhu: iSupervision Framework for Social Workers; Ukuziphatha komntu nolwazi olusezigidini somphakathi namakhono apha kumazwe apho abantu bachasana nendalo yabo ukuze bakho ukuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi; Itheori yomsebenzi wokwelapha ngokomphakathi neendlela zokungenelela; Ulwazi nolawulo lolwazi; IProtocol namaziko obugcisa obungcali; Imithetho, iinkqubo neendlela ezimalunga naye (iindlela namazinga); Iindaba zomphakathi, amaxabiso nomsebenzi nemiYelela; Ukuthuthukisa nokwakhusela abanye. Amandla kule miyalelo ilandelayo: Ukusuka kumthombo wocinezelo, ukungalunga kwezimali, ukucinezwa, ukwahlukaniswa nokusetywa ngaphandle; Ukuvakalisa nokuqamba ngolwimi; Ukubhala iinkcazelo; Ukwazimisele ngokwakho; Ukuzikhuthaza; Ukuceba okuhle nokuhlelela; Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqonda; Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha; Ukubonisa nokuququzelela; Ukuqonda umthengi nokujonge; Amandla nakho lokunceda, ukuthuthukisa, ukuzithabazela, nokuqinisela abantu, oosapho, amaqela, iinqobi namakhaya ukuze kuphuculwe ukusebenza kwemiphakathi namakhaya; Amandla okukhuthuza, ukuphinda ubuse, ukugcina, ukuzithabazela nokulungisa ukusebenza kwemiphakathi namakhaya ngokubenza bakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi, bakuthintele bagweme iingxaki besebenzisa amathuba; Ukuqonda nokwazi ukunikeza inkonzo yomsebenzi wokwelapha ngokomphakathi yokhusela abantu abasengozini, abangakhuselekanga abanako ukuzikhusela; Amandla okuba nguthisha nomxhasi weSocial Workers Grade 1.
zu.duties: Nika inkonzo yomsebenzi wokwelapha ngokomphakathi ngakumbi ngenkcazelo mayela nonakekelo, usekelo, ukhuselo nokuthuthukisa abantu abasengozini, amaqela, oosapho namakhaya ngeenkqabo ezifanelekileyo (inkonzo yetha, umsebenzi weqela nomsebenzi womphakathi); Qwalasela nazo yonke ezinye iingxaki ezingavela, okanye ezenzeke, ngakumbi xa kunokubakho ingxaki yomphakathi nanjani; Qwalasele usekele abaSocial Auxiliary Workers; Ukuthuthukiswa kolwazi olutsha ngokuphela; Gcina ulwazi ngokuqhubekayo phantsi kweendaba ezitsha ekwelapheni ngokomphakathi nakundwendwelo yemiphakathi; Yenza zonke iinkqubo zolawulo ezifunekayo kulo msebenzi.

xh.title: Umsebenzi wezeNtlalo: Iinkonzo zoBusebenzi bezeNtlalo
xh.summary: Umsebenzi wezeNtlalo onikezela ngenkonzo yokunakekelwa, inkxaso, ukhuselo nentlasebenziswano kumntu ngamnye, kwiqela, kwintsapho nakuluntu abangenamdla kwi-Western Cape.
xh.requirements: Ifomali yemfundo ephakamileyo ehambelana noBusebenzi bezeNtlalo (i-Bachelor of Social Work) evumela ukubhalisa ngobuchwephesha kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomSebenzi wezeNtlalo; Ukuze kubhaliswe kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomSebenzi wezeNtlalo; i-Grade 1: Akukho nqanaba lamava lifunekayo; i-Grade 2: Amava afanelekileyo angentla kweminyaka eli-10 kwiNkonzo yezeNtlalo emva kokuqinisekiswa njengomSebenzi wezeNtlalo kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions; i-Grade 3: Amava afanelekileyo angentla kweminyaka engama-20 kwiNkonzo yezeNtlalo emva kokuqinisekiswa njengomSebenzi wezeNtlalo kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions; i-Grade 4: Amava afanelekileyo angentla kweminyaka engama-30 kwiNkonzo yezeNtlalo emva kokuqinisekiswa njengomSebenzi wezeNtlalo kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngokuLandela: iNqanaba loLawulo ngabasebenzi bezeNtlalo; Ukuziphatha kwabantu nendlela asebenza ngayo uhlelo lwentlalo, nangekhono lokungena phakathi kweendawo abantu befunda ngokusebenzisana nemizekelo yemihlaba ngomgama wokwandisa ubomi obuziyo bentlalo; Iindlela zokubakha imisebenzi yezentlalo nemitindamo; iNkonzo yolwazi; uMrhumo wokuSebenzisa nemigaqo; iMithetho, iNgqongqo noBizo obuzayo; amakhondo entlalo, amaxabiso kunye nemigaqo; Uluntu olubumbayo nabakwazi ukubancedisa. Amandla emisebenzi yokuLandela: ukuze kubekho isihlandlo sendlela entsundu nengakalunganga, ukungalingani, ukubandlanyelwa, kwankcalo nokwaluswa; ulwimi olubaliweyo noluthethwayo; iNkqubo yokubhala iinkxaso; ukuzenzela ukulawula; ukukhuthaza; ukucwangcisa okulungileyo nokuhlelwa; ukusombulula iingxaki; iNkqubo yekhompyutha; iNkqubo yokubonakalisa; ukujolisa kumthengi; Amandla namava wokuncedisa, ukulunga, nokubumbisa abantu, iintsapho, amaqela, iziko noluntu ukwazi ukubakho obomi obuziyo nokusombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi; Amandla okuba kugqitywe iinkonzo; ukuqondisisa nengaphandle; ukubhaliswa kwemigaqo; iNkqubo yokuqamba; iNkqubo yolawulo.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo yomsebenzi wezentlalo ngendlela yokunakekela, inkxaso, ukhuselo nophuhliso komntu ngamnye oneengxaki, kwiqela, kwintsapho noluntu ngemiyalezo elandelewayo; Ngenisana ngezinye iingxaki ezinokubakho ngaphandle kwezinto ezinokubangelwa zize zithintele entlalo; Lawula inkxaso kubasebenzi bengenamava; ZiNkqubo zokuQhubela phambili ngaphakathi kolwazi; Qhubeza nolonwabo ngezinto ezintsha ngokuphuhlisa inkxaso yoluntu ezikuyo; Yenza imisebenzi yonke yeofisi ekufunekayo.

jobs.title: Social Worker: Social Work Services
jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government.
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R338 208 - R397 668 per annum, (OSD as prescribed) Grade 2: R413 004 - R478 395 per annum, (OSD as prescribed) Grade 3: R496 668 - R583 833 per annum, (OSD as prescribed) Grade 4: R608 859 - R754 785 per annum, (OSD as prescribed).
jobs.summary: Social Worker position in the Western Cape providing care, support and protection to vulnerable individuals and communities across multiple grade levels.
jobs.requirements: A relevant tertiary qualification in Social Work (Bachelor of Social Work) that allows professional registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions as Social Worker; Registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions as a Social Worker; Grade 1: No experience; Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 4: A minimum of 30 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Supervision Framework for Social Workers; Human behaviour and social systems and skills to intervene at the points where people interact with their environments in order to promote social well-being; Social work theory and interventions; Information and Knowledge Management; Protocol and professional ethics; Relevant legislations, policies and prescripts (norms and standards); Social dynamics, work values and principles; Developing and empowering others. Skills in the following: Challenge structural sources of poverty, inequality, oppression, discrimination and exclusion; Written and verbal communication; Report-writing; Self- management; Motivation; Good planning and organizing; Problem solving and analytical; Computer literacy; Presentation and facilitation; Client orientation and customer focus; Ability and competence to assist, develop, advocate for, and empower individuals, families, groups, organisations and communities to enhance their social functioning and their problem-solving capabilities; Ability to promote, restore, maintain, advocate for and enhance the functioning of individuals, families, groups and communities by enabling them to accomplish tasks, prevent and alleviate distress and use resources effectively; Understanding and ability to provide social work services towards protecting people who are vulnerable, at risk and unable to protect themselves; Ability to mentor and coach Social Workers Grade 1.
jobs.duties: Render a social work service with regard to the care, support, protection and development of vulnerable individuals, groups, families and communities through the relevant programmes (Case work, group work and Community work); Attend to any other matters that could result in, or stem from, social instability in any form; Supervise and Support Social Auxiliary Workers; Continuous Professional Development; Keep up to date with new developments in the social work and social welfare fields; Perform all the administrative functions required of the job.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department by applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. Only applications submitted online will be accepted. Kindly note that technical support is only available from Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 16:00. Should you experience any difficulties with your online application you may contact the helpline on 0861 370 214. Please ensure that you submit your application on or before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this post, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. All shortlisted candidates must make themselves available to be interviewed at a date, time and place as decided by the selection panel. All shortlisted candidates will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to assess relevant functional elements of the job and an interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will be required to complete the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) and submit the certificate before he/she can be appointed to this post. The purpose of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme, which is a public service specific training programme applicable to all applicants who aspire to join the SMS, is to ensure that potential SMS members have a background in processes and procedures linked to the SMS. The duration of the online Pre-Entry Programme is 120 notional hours (15 days). Full details may be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training- course/sms-preentryprogramme . The successful candidate shall be subjected to a leadership assessment, within one (1) month of appointment, to assess the managerial competencies required for SMS members in the Public Service as specified under Chapter Five (5) of the SMS handbook. This assessment shall be conducted to determine an individual’s ability to lead, manage, and direct others and to identify developmental gaps in core generic leadership and management competencies. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. The successful candidate will be subject to security vetting; and the candidate will have to disclose her/his financial interests. Furthermore, thank you, to the huge public interest, we receive many applications for our posts, and as such will not be able to respond personally to all applications. Therefore, should you not hear from us within 10 weeks from close of the advert please consider your application unsuccessful. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Maatskaplike Werker: Maatskaplike Werkdienste
af.summary: Maatskaplike Werker-posisie in die Western Cape wat sorg, ondersteuning en beskerming aan kwesbare individue en gemeenskappe oor verskeie graadvlakke bied.
af.requirements: Nterdêre relevante tersiêre kwalifikasie in Maatskaplike Werk (Bachelor of Social Work) wat professionele registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions as Maatskaplike Werker toelaat; Registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions as 'n Maatskaplike Werker; Grade 1: Geen ervaring nie; Grade 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as 'n Maatskaplike Werker by die South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as 'n Maatskaplike Werker by die South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 4: 'n Minimum van 30 jaar toepaslike ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as 'n Maatskaplike Werker by die South African Council for Social Service Professions. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Toezichtkader vir Maatskaplike Werkers; Menslike gedrag en sosiale stelsels en vaardighede om in te gryp by die punte waar mense met hul omgewings interakteer ten einde sosiale welstand te bevorder; Maatskaplike werksteorie en -ingrypings; Inligting- en Kennisbestuur; Protokol en professionele etiek; Terseëre relevante wetgewing, beleide en voorskrifte (norme en standaarde); Sosiale dinamika, werkswaardes en -beginsels; Ontwikkeling en bemagtiging van ander. Vaardighede in die volgende: Daag strukturele bronne van armoede, ongelykheid, onderdrukking, diskriminasie en uitsluiting uit; Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie; Verslagskrywing; Selfbestuur; Motivering; goeie beplanning en organisering; Probleemoplossing en analities; Rekenaargeletterdheid; Voorlegging en fasilitering; Kliëntoriëntasie en klienstefokus; Vermoe en bevoegdheid om individue, gesinne, groepe, organisasies en gemeenskappe te help, ontwikkel, vir hulle te pleit en te bemagtig ten einde hul sosiale funksionering en hul probleemoplossingsvermoëns te verbeter; Vermoe om die funksionering van individue, gesinne, groepe en gemeenskappe te bevorder, te herstel, te handhaaf, daarvoor te pleit en te verbeter deur hul in staat te stel om take te voltooi, nood te voorkom en te verlig en hulpbronne doeltreffend te gebruik; Begrip en vermoe om maatskaplike werkdienste te lewer ter beskerming van mense wat kwesbaar, at risk is en nie in staat is om hulself te beskerm nie; Vermoe om Maatskaplike Werkers Grade 1 te mentor en af te rig.
af.duties: Lewer 'n maatskaplike werkdiens met betrekking tot die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe deur die tersëre relevante programme (Gevallewerk, groepswerk en Gemeenskapswerk); Woon enige andere aangeleenthede by wat tot, of voortspruit uit, sosiale onstabiliteit in enige vorm kan lei of lei; Toezich hou op en ondersteun Maatskaplike Auxiliêre Werkers; Deurlopende Professionele Ontwikkeling; Hou tred met nuwe ontwikkelings in die velde van maatskaplike werk en maatskaplike welsyn; Voer al die administratiewe funksies uit wat vir die werk vereis word.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wokwelula Abantu: Izinkonzo Zokwelula Abantu
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngumsebenzi wokwelula abantu e-Western Cape sokunikeza ukunakekelwa, ukusekela nokuvikela abantu abasengozini namaphakathi ahlukene kumazinga ahlukene amagadi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingundotho ezihambisana nomsebenzi wokwelula abantu (I-Bachelor of Social Work) ezivumela ukubhalisa ngobungcweti ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wokwelula abantu; Ukubhalisa ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wokwelula abantu; Grade 1: Akukho mpilo yomsebenzi; Grade 2: Okungenani unyaka we-10 wempilo yomsebenzi ehambisana nomsebenzi wokwelula abantu ngemva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wokwelula abantu ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 3: Okungenani unyaka we-20 wempilo yomsebenzi ehambisana nomsebenzi wokwelula abantu ngemva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wokwelula abantu ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 4: Okungenani unyaka we-30 wempilo yomsebenzi ehambisana nomsebenzi wokwelula abantu ngemva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wokwelula abantu ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions. Izindlela ezingangeni emsebenzini: Ulwazi ngakho okulandelayo: Umqondo wokuqondisa abasebenzi bokwelula abantu; Ukuziphatha kwabantu kanye namasistimu omphakathi kanye namakhono okungenelela kumaphoyinti lapho abantu baye bahlangana khona nemvelo yabo ukuze kukhuliswe inhlalakahle emphakathini; Imininingwane yomsebenzi wokwelula abantu kanye nokuze kungenelelwe; Ukuphathwa kolwazi nolwazi; Iziphetho zomsebenzi kanye nezimiso zobungcweti; Umthetho, inqubo nemiyalo ephathelene nakho (izilinganiso nezindinganiso; Iminikelo yomphakathi, amagugu omsebenzi kanye nemigomo; Ukukhulisa futhi sakaze abanye. Amakhono okulandelayo: Ukuphikisana nemithombo yokungalungi kobuphakathi, okungalingani, ukwenyukwa, ukucwaswa nokukhishwa kolwandle; Ukuxhumana ngokubhaliwe nangokukhulunywa; Ukubhala imibiko; Ukuziphatha; Ukwesekwa; Ukulungela kahle futhi uhlele; Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya; Ulwazi lwekhompyutha; Ukulawula futhi ukweseka; Ukugxila kumthengi kanye nenkinga yokuthinteka; Ikholo lokusekela, ukuthuthukisa, ukulwisela futhi ukukhulisa abantu, emindenini, emaqenjini, emashishini nasemiphakathini ukuze kuthuthuke ukusebenza kwabo komphakathi kanye namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga; Ikholo lokukhulisa, ukubuyisa, ukugcina, ukulwisela futhi ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwabantu, emindenini, emaqenjini nasemiphakathini ngokubasiza bakwazi ukufeza imisebenzi, bakwazi futhi bavikele futhi baphakamise izinsizi ezisetshenziswa kahle; Ukuqonda kanye nokuze nikeze izinkonzo zomsebenzi wokwelula abantu ngokuqondene nokuvikela abantu abasengozini, abasureslekile futhi abangakwazi ukuzivikela; Ikholo lokulawula futhi okweseka abasebenzi bokwelula abantu be-Grade 1.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngomsebenzi wokwelula abantu ngokuqondene nokunakekelwa, ukusekela, ukuvikela nokuthuthukisa abantu abasengozini, amaqembu, emaphakathi kanye namaphakathi ngamaphrogramu ahambisana nakho (Umsebenzi wosumo, umsebenzi weqembu kanye noMsebenzi womphakathi); Yiba necici ekunakweni konke okunye okungase kubangele, nokuphuma kwenkungca yomphakathi nganoma yisiphi isimo; Lawula kanye nokweseka abasebenzi abasiza kumsebenzi wokwelula abantu; Ukuthuthuka okuqhutshwa njalo ngesikhathi; Ukuze uhlale usezindangeni zemvelo ezingalungi ohhotela kumsebenzini wokwelula abantu kanye nasezinkonzo zezenhlalakahle; Wenze yonke imisebenzi yokuqondisa edingekile ohhotela.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wokwengulwa: Iinkonzo Zokwengulwa
xh.summary: Isithuba somsebenzi wokwengulwa kwi-Western Cape sokunika inkathazo, inkxaso nokhuselo abantu abakhethazekekileyo namaphakathi kumanqanaba amaninzi amanqanaba.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zesifundo esifanelekileyo esiphakamileyo kwi-Social Work (Bachelor of Social Work) ezivumela ukubhalisa njengomsebenzi wokwengulwa kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Ukubhalisa kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wokwengulwa; Grade 1: Akukho nqanaba lolwazi; Grade 2: Ubuncinane leminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo kwi-Social Work emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wokwengulwa kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 3: Ubuncinane leminyaka eli-20 yamava afanelekileyo kwi-Social Work emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wokwengulwa kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 4: Ubuncinane leminyaka eli-30 yamava afanelekileyo kwi-Social Work emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wokwengulwa kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions. Iimpawu zokwazi: Ulwazi ngokulandelayo: Isiseko Sokulawula Abasebenzi Bobugcisa bokwengulwa; Ukuziphatha kwabantu namaphakathi nezakhono zokungena kumaphondo apho abantu basebenzisana khona namaphakathi abo ukuze bakhusule impilo entle yomphakathi; Iindlela zokwengulwa nemisebenzi yokungena; Ulawulo lolwazi nolwazi mayela nolwazi; Iprotoke nendlela yokuziphatha yobugcisa; Imithetho, iinkqubo nemiyalelo ekhoyo (iindlela nezilinganiso); Ukujikeleza komphakathi, amaxabiso omsebenzi nemiqathango; Ukuphucula nokwakhisa abanye. Izakhono ezilandelayo: Ukuphelisa iimbombo ezingundoqo zobusweli, ngokungalilingani, ukucindwa, ukucinezelwa nokurhoxiswa; Unxibelelwano lokubhaliweyo nolwenziwa ngomlomo; Ukwabhala iingxelo; Ukuzilawula; Ukukhuthaza; Ulwele lokuceba nokuqamba; Ukuzalisa iingxaki nokuhlola ngokwenza inqaku; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Ukubonelela nokukhuthaza iintlanganiso; Ukumiselwa kumthengi nokuqwalasela umthengi; Ikhono nempilo yokusiza, ukuphucula, ukuzela, nokwakhisa abantu, osapho, amaqela, iindaba namaphakathi ukuziphilisa indlela yabo yokusebenza kumphakathi nokuqonda iinkxaki; Ikhono lokukhusula, ukubuyisela, ukugcina, ukuzela nokuphucula ukusebenza kwabantu, osapho, amaqela namaphakathi ngokubavumela ukuba bakwenze imisebenzi, bathintele kwaye banciphise iintlungu basebenzise amathuba ngokuchanekileyo; Ikhono lokuziphilisa nokuba nakho ukunikela iinkonzo zokwengulwa ukukhusula abantu abakhethazekekileyo, abasengozini abangakwazi ukuzikhusela; Ikhono lokuyala nokufundisa Abasebenzi Bobugcisa bokwengulwa Grade 1.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zokwengulwa ngokuchasene nenkathazo, inkxaso, ukhuselo nophuculo abantu abakhethazekekileyo, amaqela, osapho namaphakathi ngenkqubo ezifanelekileyo (Umsebenzi weziqendu, umsebenzi weziqendu nomsebenzi wamaphakathi); Jonga nayiphi na enye into enokubangela, okanye iphumo koku, ukungabikho kokuzinza komphakathi nakuphi na inkqubo; Lawula nokuNxiba Abasebenzi Abancedisayo Bomsebenzi Wokwengulwa; Ukuphucula uLwazi Lobugcisa Ngokuqhubeka; Hlala utya ulwazi ngokuphuculwa kwezinto ezintsha kumaphakatha okwengulwa nokuNxiba Umphakathi; Yenza onke amaphando okulawula afunekayo kumsebenzi.

jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R338 208 - R397 668 per annum, (OSD as prescribed) Grade 2: R413 004 - R478 395 per annum, (OSD as prescribed) Grade 3: R496 668 - R583 833 per annum, (OSD as prescribed) Grade 4: R608 859 - R754 785 per annum, (OSD as prescribed)
jobs.summary: Social worker position in Delft with the Western Cape Department of Social Development, providing care and support to vulnerable individuals, families and communities.
jobs.requirements: A relevant tertiary qualification in Social Work (Bachelor of Social Work) that allows professional registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions as Social Worker; Registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions as a Social Worker; Grade 1: No experience; Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 4: A minimum of 30 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Supervision Framework for Social Workers; Human behaviour and social systems and skills to intervene at the points where people interact with their environments in order to promote social well-being; Social work theory and interventions; Information and Knowledge Management; Protocol and professional ethics; Relevant legislations, policies and prescripts (norms and standards); Social dynamics, work values and principles; Developing and empowering others. Skills in the following: Challenge structural sources of poverty, inequality, oppression, discrimination and exclusion; Written and verbal communication; Report-writing; Self- management; Motivation; Good planning and organizing; Problem solving and analytical; Computer literacy; Presentation and facilitation; Client orientation and customer focus; Ability and competence to assist, develop, advocate for, and empower individuals, families, groups, organisations and communities to enhance their social functioning and their problem-solving capabilities; Ability to promote, restore, maintain, advocate for and enhance the functioning of individuals, families, groups and communities by enabling them to accomplish tasks, prevent and alleviate distress and use resources effectively; Understanding and ability to provide social work services towards protecting people who are vulnerable, at risk and unable to protect themselves; Ability to mentor and coach Social Workers Grade 1.
jobs.duties: Render a social work service with regard to the care, support, protection and development of vulnerable individuals, groups, families and communities through the relevant programmes (Case work, group work and Community work); Attend to any other matters that could result in, or stem from, social instability in any form; Supervise and Support Social Auxiliary Workers; Continuous Professional Development; Keep up to date with new developments in the social work and social welfare fields; Perform all the administrative functions required of the job.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. af.title: Maatskaplike Werker: Maatskaplike Werkdienste (DELFT)
af.summary: Maatskaplike werker-posisie in Delft by die Western Cape Department of Social Development, wat sorg en ondersteuning aan kwesbare individue, gesinne en gemeenskappe bied.
af.requirements: 'n Reisante tersiêre kwalifikasie in Maatskaplike Werk (Bachelor of Social Work) wat professionele registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions as Maatskaplike Werker moontlik maak; Registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions as 'n Maatskaplike Werker; Graad 1: Geen ondervinding nie; Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ondervinding in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as 'n Maatskaplike Werker by die South African Council for Social Service Professions; Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike ondervinding in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as 'n Maatskaplike Werker by die South African Council for Social Service Professions; Graad 4: 'n Minimum van 30 jaar toepaslike ondervinding in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as 'n Maatskaplike Werker by die South African Council for Social Service Professions. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Toezigingsraamwerk vir Maatskaplike Werkers; Menslike gedrag en sosiale stelsels en vaardighede om in te gryp by die punte waar mense met hul omgewings interakteer ten einde maatskaplike welsyn te bevorder; Maatskaplike werkteorie en intervensies; Inligting- en Kennisbestuur; Protokol en professionele etiek; Ter sake wetgewing, beleide en voorskrifte (norme en standaarde); Sosiale dinamika, werkswaardes en beginsels; Ontwikkeling en bemagtiging van ander. Vaardighede in die volgende: Daag strukturele bronne van armoede, ongelykheid, onderdrukking, diskriminasie en uitsluiting uit; Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie; Verslagskrywing; Selfbestuur; Motivering; Goed beplanning en organisering; Probleemoplossing en analities; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Voorlegging en fasilitering; Kliëntoriëntasie en klie˝nfokus; Vermoë en bevoegdheid om individue, gesinne, groepe, organisasies en gemeenskappe by te staan, te ontwikkel, vir hulle op te tree en hulle te bemagtig ten einde hul maatskaplike funksionering en hul probleemoplossingsvermoëns te verbeter; Vermoë om die funksionering van individue, gesinne, groepe en gemeenskappe te bevorder, te herstel, te handhaaf, daarvoor op te tree en te verbeter deur hul in staat te stel om take te voltooi, nood te voorkom en te verlig en hulpbronne doeltreffend te gebruik; Begrip en vermoë om maatskaplike werkdienste te lewer ter beskerming van mense wat kwesbaar, tot risiko en onbekwaam is om hulleself te beskerm; Vermoë om Maatskaplike Werkers Graad 1 te mentor en af te rig.
af.duties: Lewer 'n maatskaplike werkdiens met betrekking tot die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe deur die ter sake programme (Gevallewerk, groepswerk en Gemeenskapswerk); Spreek enige ander aangeleenthede aan wat tot maatskaplike onstabiliteit in enige vorm kan lei of daaruit voortvloei; Hou toesig oor en ondersteun Maatskaplike Hulpwerkers; Deurlopende Professionele Ontwikkeling; Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelinge in die velde van maatskaplike werk en maatskaplike welsyn; Voer al die administratiewe funksies uit wat vir die pos vereis word.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Womphakathi: Iinsiza Zomsebenzi Womphakathi (DELFT)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somsebenzi womphakathi e Delft ku Western Cape Department of Social Development, sinikeza ukunakekelwa nokusekelwa abantu abasengozini, imindeni namaphakathi.
zu.requirements: Izifundo eziphezulu ezifanelekileyo kumsebenzi womphakathi (Bachelor of Social Work) ezivumela ukubhalisa ngobuchwepheshe ku South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi womphakathi; Ukubhaliswa ku South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi womphakathi; Grade 1: Akukho mva wenkathla; Grade 2: Ubuncinane iminyaka eyi-10 yamava afanelekileyo kumsebenzi womphakathi emva kokubhaliswa njengomsebenzi womphakathi ku South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 3: Ubuncinane iminyaka eyi-20 yamava afanelekileyo kumsebenzi womphakathi emva kokubhaliswa njengomsebenzi womphakathi ku South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 4: Ubuncinane iminyaka eyi-30 yamava afanelekileyo kumsebenzi womphakathi emva kokubhaliswa njengomsebenzi womphakathi ku South African Council for Social Service Professions. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngalokhu okulandelayo: Isixhobo sokulawula abasebenzi bomphakathi; Ukuziphatha kwabantu namasystem anomphakathi nakhono ukungenelela kwindawo lapho abantu bexhumana namazinga abo khona ukuze kukhuliswe inhlalakahle; Itheori nomsebenzi womphakathi; Ulawulo lwolwazi nolwazi mayelana; Ithiyori nemikhakha yomsebenzi womphakathi; Iphrothokholi nomphatho ochwepheshile; Izimali ezifanelekileyo, izinqubomgomo nemiyalo (izinga nemigangatho); Imisindo yomphakathi, amagugu omsebenzi; Ukuthuthukisa futhi sikhusela abanye; Khono kwabo okulandelayo: Ukusiza ukuba bathuse imithombo yokusiza eziyingozi ezingalungile, ngalokho abantu bakwazi ukuze baxhumane namazinga, ukuze kukhuliswe inhlalakahle; Ukuxhumana ngokubhaliwe nokukhulunywa; Ukubhala imibiko; Ukuzilawula; Ukuzikhuthaza; Ukuhlela ukuqondisa; Ukuxazulula izinkinga futhi ukuhlaziya; Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha; Ukuthwala izinkomba nokuthumela; Ukugxila kumthengi; Amakhono nokuhlakanipha ukusiza, ukuthuthukisa, ukukhuthuza, futhi ukukhululeka ngocingo, imindeni, amaphakathi; Ukusebenzisa ngokusuka kwisibhaxu; Ukutholwa kolwazi ngamaphoyisa; Ikhono lokuthuthukisa, ukuqinisa, ukusekela, ukukhuthaza nokukhululeka komphakathi; Ukutholwa kwamathuluzi ahlukene ukutholwa kolwazi ngokukhuluma nokuxhasa kolwazi mayelana; Ukutholwa kwamathuluzi wokuthuthukisa, ukuqinisa, ukukhuthaza nokulondolozwa abantu kanye nezingozi; Ikhono lokukhuthaza kwaye sikhulule abantu abangakwazi ukuzivikela; Ikhono lokuthuthukisa nokuxhasa abasebenzi bomphakathi abakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa nokukhuthuza abantu abanye abangenamakhono.
zu.duties: : Yenza isikhundla somsebenzi womphakathi ngokuhlobene nokunakekelwa, ukusekela, ukuvikela nokuthuthukiswa kwabantu ababucayile, amaphakathi, imindeni namaphakathi ngokuhlanganisela (umsebenzi weziqapho, umsebenzi oqeqeshayo kanye nomsebenzi womphakathi); Ukunaka noma yikuphi okunye okungabangela, noma okusuka koku, ukungalungelelani komphakathi nanoma yisiphi isimo; Ukulawula nokuxhasa abasebenzi bomphakathi abo rhabe; Ukuthuthukiswa komsebenzi njalo ngesikhathi; Ukuhlala ulwazi olusha emkhakheni womsebenzi womphakathi nakuleyo yokuthuthukiswa komphakathi; Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi ye-ofisi efunwayo.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wokuxhumana nomphakathi: Iinkonzo ZoMsebenzi Wokuxhumana nomphakathi (DELFT)
xh.summary: Isikhundla somsebenzi wokuxhumana nomphakathi kwi-Delft nasebe leNtshona Koloni elibhekelephaya uPhuhliso loLuntu, sibandakanya ukunika ukhathalo nentsekelo abantu abasengozini, abayimaphakathi neentlambo.
xh.requirements: Izifundo eziphakamileyo ezifanelekileyo ekuMsebenzini Wokuxhumana nomphakathi (I-degree ye-Bachelor of Social Work) ezivumela ukubhalisa ngokubambisana ne-South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wokuxhumana nomphakathi; Ukubhalisa kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wokuxhumana nomphakathi; Inqanaba 1: Akukho mpazamo; Inqanaba 2: Ungakanani we-10 iminyaka yempazamo efanelekileyo kuMsebenzi Wokuxhumana nomphakathi emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wokuxhumana nomphakathi kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Inqanaba 3: Ungakanani we-20 iminyaka yempazamo efanelekileyo kuMsebenzi Wokuxhumana nomphakathi emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wokuxhumana nomphakathi kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Inqanaba 4: Ungakanani we-30 iminyaka yempazamo efanelekileyo kuMsebenzi Wokuxhumana nomphakathi emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wokuxhumana nomphakathi kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions. Iimpawu zokwazi: Ulwazi ngale mephulo ilandelayo: Isakhelo sokuhlola abasebenzi bokuxhumana nomphakathi; Ukuziphatha kwabantu namagqabantshintshi alo nerhuluphelo yoluntu, namakhono okungenelela kumacandawo apho abantu banomdibanisano namakhuso abo ukuze bakhusule iliso elilungileyo loluntu; Iyori yomsebenzi wokuxhumana nomphakathi nokingozi kwawo; Ulawulo lolwazi nenkcazelo; Umthetho-bhalisi wabasebenzi kwaye nengqondo yobugcisa; Imithetho, iinkqubo namagqabantshintshi (iindingulwana neemigangatho); Isantya selizwe njengoko siphila kwaye namaxabiso osemthethweni nemigaqo; Ukuphuhlisa nokuqinisa abanye. Iikhono ngale ndikam venelo: Ukuvisisisa iindonga ezingahlaziyiyo lisebe lendlala nobukhohlakali, ukugxothwa kwabampofu nokuhlukunyezwa kwaye nokubayekwazwa; Ileta nokuthetha; Ukubhala iingxelo; Ukuzilawula ngokwakho; Ukuqhutywa komdlalo; Ulwakhiwo olulungileyo lolungiselelo lwezinto; Ukusombulula iingxaki ngeenkcukacha; Ulwazi lwekhompyutha; Okubonakalayo kwakho nokuhola ingqungumbala; Ulondolozo lomthengi nolondolozo lwalowo oluzayo; Ikhono nemigaqo yokunceda, ukuphuhlisa, ukugqibela nokuqinisa abantu, iintsapho, amaqela, oorhulumente namaphakathi ukuziphakamisa ngokusebenzisa imisebenzi yoluntu namakhono abo okusombulula iingxaki; Ikhono lokuxhasa, okubuyisele, okulondoloza, ukugqibela nokuqinisa ukwakheka kwabantu, iintsapho, amaqela namaphakathi ngokubanika ithuba lokuzala iinkqubo, ukuthintela nokukhawuleza umonakalo wengqondo nokusebenzisa oovimba ngokukhuseleyo; Ukuqonda nakhono lokunikela iinkonzo zomsebenzi wokuxhumana nomphakathi ngokukhusula abantu abasengozini kwaye abangenako ukuzikhusela; Ikhono lokukhokela ngokubonelela nokuqamba kubasebenzi bakuxhumana nomphakathi Inqanaba 1.
xh.duties: Ukuvelisa inkonzo yoluntu ngokubhekele, ukuxhasa, ukukhusela nokuphuhlisa abantu abakhandiweyo, amaqela, iintsapho namaphakathi ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo (Umsebenzi wecala, umsebenzi weqela nokuMsebenzi woluntu); Ukuqwalasela naziphi na ezinye iingxaki ezingadala, okanye ezingavela kuzo, ukungabikho komoya wokuzinza nganomatshini ngamnye; Ukuqeqesha nokuxhasa abasebenzi abalawulayo bomsebenzi wokuxhumana nomphakathi; Ikhondo elihlala lilungileyo lobugcisa bomsebenzi; Ukugcina ulwazi ngamaphakathi amatsha ngakumbi kwindalo yomsebenzi woluntu nophuhliso lwentsekelo yasekuhlaleni; Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi yolawulo efunekayo kule misebenzi.

jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government

af.title: Persoonlike Assistent: Operasionele Bestuursondersteuning
af.summary: Verskaf sekretariële en administratiewe ondersteuning aan bestuur by die Departement van Sosiale Ontwikkeling in die Wes-Kaap, wat Graad 12 plus 'n sekretariële diploma en drie jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie) plus 'n geakkrediteerde sekretariële diploma en/of administratiewe kwalifikasie op die vlak van NQF-vlak 5 of 'n relevante hoër tersiêre kwalifikasie; 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in die lewer van sekretariële/administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste aan bestuur/seniorbestuur. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Wetgewing, regulatoriese raamwerke, beleide en beste praktyke wat betrekking het op die lynfunksies; Inligtingstelsels wat help met die bestuur van kennis en inligting wat op die lynfunksie betrekking het; Projektebestuur; Operasionele bestuurspraktyke; Aanbestedings en tenderprosesse; Beleidontwikkeling, en operasionele bestuur, monitering en hersieningsprosesse; Moderne stelsels van bestuur en administrasie; Openbare diens prosedures, prosesse en stelsels; Streeks- en plaaslike politieke, ekonomiese en sosiale aangeleenthede wat 'n uitwerking het op die provinsiale regering van die Wes-Kaap; Konstitusionele, regs- en instellingsreëlings wat die Suid-Afrikaanse openbare sektor regeer; Openbare finansies, menslike hulpbronne en diskoersbestuursprosesse; Openbare Finansiesbestuurswet, Nasionale en Provinsiale Tesourie-regulasies, ander finansiële beleide, voorskrifte, riglyne en kollektiewe ooreenkomste; Werking van die Provinsie en die bedrywighede van susterdepartemente/verwante funksionele areas; Beleide van die regering van die dag; Arbeidsverhoudingswetgewing en -regulasies; Prestasiebestuur in die algemeen. Vaardighede in die volgende: Syferkundigheid; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Taalvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n sekretariële/onthaaldiensondersteuningsdiens aan die bestuurder; Lewer administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste aan die bestuurder; Verskaf ondersteuning aan die bestuurder met betrekking tot vergaderings; Ondersteun die bestuurder met die administrasie van die bestuurder se begroting; Bestudeer die relevante Openbare Diens en departementele voorskrifte/beleide en ander dokumente en verseker dat die toepassing daarvan behoorlik verstaan word.

zu.title: Umncedisi Omfana: Ukusekela Ukuphathwa Kwezokusebenza
zu.summary: Nikela ngenkxaso yokwemisebenzi yolwazi nokwahlulela ezingeni eliphezulu kubaphathi eDepartment of Social Development Western Cape, kudingeka i-Grade 12 kanye nediploma emisebenzini yolwazi kanye neminyaka emithathu yemisebenzi ehambisana naleyo.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 (Isitifikedi Samabanga Aphakeme noma iziqu ezingalinganiselwa) kanye nediploma egunyaziwe emisebenzini yolwazi kanye/noma iziqu zokwahlulela ezingeni le-NQF level 5 noma iziqu eziphakeme ezihambisana nalezo; Umkhawulo ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-3 wokupha inkxaso yokwemisebenzi yolwazi/okwahlulela abaphathi/abaphathi abaphezulu. Izinkomba: Ukuqonda okulandelayo: Umthetho, uhlaka olulawulayo, izinqubomgomo namanye amasiko ahambisana nomsebenzi othile; Izinhlelo zolwazi ezisiza ekuphatheni ulwazi nolwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi othile; Ukuphatha izinhlela; Amasimu okuphatha; Izinkqubo zokuthenga nokuqashisa; Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo, nokuqondiswa kwemisebenzi, ukulawula nokubuyekeza; Izinhlelo zanamuhla zokuphatha nokwahlulela; Izinqubo, izinkqubo namasistimu osemphakathini; Izindaba zaseduze nasedolobheni ezingezwe izwe ngokwezombusazwe, ezomnotho nangokomphakathi ezithinta urhulumende wesifundazale Western Cape; Izinhlelo zobumbano, zomthetho nezikhungo ezibusa ingxenye yomphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika; Izimali zomphakathi, izinsizakuxhumanana nabantu, futhi nokuphatha izingxoxo; Umthetho Wokuphatha Izimali Zomphakathi, Izinqubo Ze-National kanye Ne-Provincial, ezinye izinqubomgomo zamandla, izibhalo, izalathiso nezivumelwano ngokuhlangenwe nakho; Ukusebenza kwesifundazale kanye nemisebenzi yeminyango ebandlanyele/izindawo ezihlobene; Izinqubomgomo zurhulumende wanamuhla; Umthetho kanye nemithetho yokubhana ngemisebenzi; Ukuphatha ukusebenza ngokuvamile. Izikhiye ezilandelayo: Ukubala; Ukuqonda ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Amakhono olwimi.
zu.duties: Nikela ngenkxaso yokwemisebenzi yolwazi/okwamabalisi kumqondisi; Nikela ngemisebenzi yokwahlulela kumqondisi; Nikeza inkxaso kumqondisi ngokuhlobene nezintela; Sekela umqondisi ngokwahlulela imali yokusebenza kaqondisi; Funda izibhalo/izinqubomgomo zomphakathi, neminyango futhi nezenye izinkqubo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezinto kutholwa ngokufanele.

xh.title: Umncedisi wobuntu: Inkxaso yeNkululo ekuLawuleni iMisebenzi
xh.summary: Ukubonelela ngenkxaso yomsebenzi wababhalisi nolawulo kubaphathi kwiSebe lePhuhliso loLuntu eWestern Cape, kufuneka ibe neGrade 12 ncedwa nesidanga sobubhali kwaye abe neminyaka emi-3 yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Grade 12 (Isatifikethi senqanaba eliphezulu okanye isifikelelo esilinganayo) ncedwa nesidanga sobubhali esimiselweyo kunye/nokwesolawulo kwinqanaba le-NQF level 5 okanye isifikelelo esiphezulu esihambelanayo esikwiziko lesidanga; Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-3 yamava ekuboneleleni iinkxaso zemisebenzi yababhalisi/olawulo kubaphathi/abaphathi abaphezulu. Iimfuno zakhono: Ulwazi ngaloku: Iimithetho, iinkqubo ezilawulayo, iindlela zokusebenza nezinye iindlela ezilungileyo ezinomfuziselo kumsebenzi ongaphakathi; Iinkqubo zolwazi ezisiza ekulawuleni ulwazi nolwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi ongaphakathi; Ukulawula iiprojekthi; Iindlela zokulawula imisebenzi; Iinkqubo zokuzelela nokuqashisa; uPhuhliso lwemigaqo, nolawulo lomsebenzi, ulwamo necandelo lokuhlola; Iinkqubo zamanqanoba zobulungiselelo bolawulo; Iinkqubo, iinkqubo nezixhobo zensebenzi kaRhulumende; Izindaba zoluntu, ezamntwonina nezentlalo ekuwohloka nasemimandla ezithintela urhulumente wesifunda weWestern Cape; Iintchekesha, iimithetho nolungiselelo olulawula ingcali yoluntu yaseMzantsi Afrika; Iimali zorhulumente, amabhala obomi nolawulo lweenkulumo; UMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumende, Iimigaqo zeQongo nezesiFunda, ezinye iimigaqo zomanyano, iimiyalelo, iinkqubo nezivumelwano eziyintlandlo; Ukusebenza kweSifunda nemisebenzi yamasebe ohlotshi/ iindawo zomsebenzi ezihambelanayo; Iimigaqo yorhulumente wezelo; Iimithetho nezicwangciso zoBudlelwane baseMsebenzini; Ukulawula ulwazi lokusebenza ngokubanzi. Amandla kuloku: ukubala; Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha; Amandla abolwimi.
xh.duties: Kubonelele ngenkxaso yomsebenzi wommeli/abamamkelayo kuyena manager; Kubonekele ngenkxazo yolawulo kuyena manager; Kubonelele ngenkxaso kumongameli ngokwemibuthano; Kuxhase umongameli ngenkxazo yolawulo lwesaphetha somongameli; Kufunde iinkqubo/iimigaqo zensebenzi kaRhulumende nesebe nakwezinye iintsimi, kuqinisekiswe ukuba ukuze kwayo kugqunywa ngokufanelekileyo.

jobs.title: Community Development Practitioner: Community
jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government.
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R289 296 - Grade 3: R564 846 per annum, (OSD as prescribed).
jobs.summary: Community Development Practitioner position in the Western Cape, requiring a tertiary qualification and involving integrated community development interventions with stakeholders.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: An appropriate 3-year tertiary qualification (National Diploma/B- Degree or higher); No experience required. Grade 2: An appropriate 3-year tertiary qualification (National Diploma/B-Degree or higher); A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience in Community Development work after obtaining the required tertiary qualification. Grade 3: An appropriate 3-year tertiary qualification (National Diploma/B-Degree or higher); A minimum of 20 years appropriate experience in Community Development work after obtaining the required tertiary qualification. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Community development work, skills, attitudes and values of communities; Human behaviour and social systems and legislation to assist with interventions at the points where people interact with their environments in order to promote self-empowerment; The ability and competence to co- ordinate community development structures and ability to manage projects; The ability to influence individuals and group to participate in their own self- empowerment ventures; The understanding of social dynamics of communities; Skills needed: Presentation; Proven computer literacy; Written and verbal communication; Facilitation; Research; Knowledge and understanding of basic Financial Management.
jobs.duties: Identify and facilitate the implementation of integrated community development interventions in partnership with the community and other relevant stakeholders; Liaise and co-ordinate with all relevant role players, internal and external and stakeholders (e.g. in departments/provinces, NGOs, local community structures and faith-based organisations) to facilitate collaboration and to establish partnerships to ensure the sustainability of development actions within the community; Support communities and perform administrative support on community development and related activities; Keep up to date with new developments in the community development field to enhance service delivery.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co

af.title: Gemeenskapsontwikkelingsbeoefenaar: Gemeenskap
af.summary: Pos as Gemeenskapsontwikkelingsbeoefenaar in die Western Cape, wat 'n tersière kwalifikasie vereis en geïntegreerde gemeenskapsontwikkelingsintervensies met belanghebbendes behels.
af.requirements: Graad 1: 'n Toepaslike 3-jaar tersière kwalifikasie (National Diploma/B-Degree of hoër); Geen ondervinding vereis. Graad 2: 'n Toepaslike 3-jaar tersière kwalifikasie (National Diploma/B-Degree of hoër); 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ondervinding in Gemeenskapsontwikkelingswerk na verkryging van die vereiste tersière kwalifikasie. Graad 3: 'n Toepaslike 3-jaar tersière kwalifikasie (National Diploma/B-Degree of hoër); 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike ondervinding in Gemeenskapsontwikkelingswerk na verkryging van die vereiste tersière kwalifikasie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Gemeenskapsontwikkelingswerk, vaardighede, gesindhede en waardes van gemeenskappe; Menslike gedrag en sosiale stelsels en wetgewing om te help met intervensies by die punte waar mense met hul omgewings in wisselwerking tree om selfbemagtiging te bevorder; Die vermoë en bevoegheid om gemeenskapsontwikkelingsstrukture te koördineer en die vermoë om projekte te bestuur; Die vermoë om individue en groepe te beïnvloed om deel te neem aan hul eie selfbemagtigingsinisiatiewe; Die begrip van sosiale dinamiek van gemeenskappe; Vereiste vaardighede: Voorlegging; Bewese rekenaarvaardigheid; Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie; Fasilitering; Navorsing; Kennis en begrip van basiese Finansiële Bestuur.
af.duties: Identifiseer en fasiliteer die implementering van geïntegreerde gemeenskapsontwikkelingsintervensies in vennootskap met die gemeenskap en ander relevante belanghebbendes; Skakel en koördineer met alle relevante rolspelers, intern en extern en belanghebbendes (bv. in departemente/provinsies, NGOs, plaaslike gemeenskapsstrukture en geloofsgebaseerde organisasies) om samewerking te fasiliteer en vennootskappe te vestig om die volhoubaarheid van ontwikkelingsaksies binne die gemeenskap te verseker; Ondersteun gemeenskappe en verrig administratiewe ondersteuning oor gemeenskapsontwikkeling en verwante aktiwiteite; Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelings in die veld van gemeenskapsontwikkeling om dienslewering te verbeter.

zu.title: Umprathithi Wokuthuthukisa Umphakathi: Umphakathi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somprathithi wokuthuthukisa umphakathi e-Western Cape, esifuna iziqu zemfundo ephakeme kanye nokubandakanyeka ekwenzeni imizamo ehlangene yokuthuthukisa umphakathi ehlangene nalabo abaneshwa ngalokho.
zu.requirements: Izinga 1: Iziqu ezifanelekile zemfundo ephakeme zithatha iminyaka engu-3 (National Diploma/B-Degree noma iphezulu); Akukho hlulumunye okudingeka. Izinga 2: Iziqu ezifanelekile zemfundo ephakeme zithatha iminyaka engu-3 (National Diploma/B-Degree noma iphezulu); Okungenani ungaminyaka angu-10 hlulumunye olufanelekile emsebenzini wokuthuthukisa umphakathi emva kokuthola iziqu ezidingekayo zemfundo ephakeme. Izinga 3: Iziqu ezifanelekilezemfundo ephakeme zithatha iminyaka engu-3 (National Diploma/B-Degree noma iphezulu); Okungenani ungaminyaka angu-20 hlulumunye olufanelekile emsebenzini wokuthuthukisa umphakathi emva kokuthola iziqu ezidingekayo zemfundo ephakeme. Amakhono: Ulwazi ngokulandelayo: Umsebenzi wokuthuthukisa umphakathi, amakhono, izinkalo kanye namagugu emiphakathini; Ukuziphatha kwabantu kanye namasistimu emphakathini kanye nemithetho ukusiza ekubandakanyeni ukuthi abantu bahlanganisana kanjani namaphakathi abo ukuze bakhande ukuzinikela; Ikhalo nethonya lokuhlanganisa izakhiwo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi kanye nethonya lokuphatha amaphrojekthi; Ikhalo lokukhuthaza abantu nabantu abaningi ukuthi bahlanganyele ekuzibophezeleni kwabo; Ukweseka ukwenza kwasimaphakathi kwemiphakathi; Amafashini amadingekayo: Okubonwayo; Ubuhlakani obushibhile bekhompyutha okugqamiwe; Ukuxhumana okulotshiwe nangomlomo; Ukwenza lula izinto; Ukuphenya; Ulwazi nokuqonda okuyisisekelo Kokuqonda Imali.
zu.duties: Ukuqapha futhi kukhusele ukusetshenziswa kwezinyathelo ezihlangene zokuthuthukisa umphakathi ngokubambisana nomphakathi nalaboabaneshwa ngalokho abafanelekile; Ukuhlangana nokuhlanganisa bonke abadlali indima abafanelekile, abangaphakathi nangaphandle, nabaneshwa ngalokho (isb. eminyangeni/ezifundazweni, ama-NGO, izakhiwo zomphakathi wendawo kanye namahlelo asuselwa enkholweni) ukuze kukhuthazwe ukusebenza kwabantu kokuqamba izindaba bese kusungulwa izibambisela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi emphakathini kuhlale kuqhubeka; Ukusekela imiphakathi kanye nokwenza imisebenzi yokulawula kumsebenzi wokuthuthukisa umphakathi nezinye izinkalo ezihlobene; Ukuhlala usemugqeni ngokuthuthukiswa okusha emkhakheni wokuthuthukisa umphakathi ukuze kube khona ukunikeza ngcono izinsiza ezingangemthetho.

xh.title: Isikhuthazi ekwazisweni lomphakathi: Uluntu
xh.summary: Isithuba sesebe lokukhulisa uluntu kwi-Western Cape, esifuna isidanga sengeso nakwamanyathelo ebangatazana ephantsi entloko yentlalo, esisebenzisa imisebenzi ezingathiswa ngokusebenzisana nabasebenzi bemimango yekhomikhuni.
xh.requirements: Grade 1: Isidanga esifanelekileyo se-National Diploma okanye i-B-Degree ubuncinane besikhathi seminyaka ebango-3 kwisikhululo ephakamileyo sengeso nalelona laziwayo; Akukho lwazi-liseko ladingelwayo. Grade 2: Isidanga esifanelekileyo se-National Diploma okanye i-B-Degree ubuncinane besikhathi seminyaka ebango-3 kwisikhululo ephakamileyo sengeso nalelona laziwayo; Ubuncinane beminyaka elingu-10 yamava afanelekileyo emisebenzi ekujoliswe kuso ekuphakamiseni koluntu emva kokufumana isidanga esidingelwayo kwisikhululo ephakamileyo. Grade 3: Isidanga esifanelekileyo se-National Diploma okanye i-B-Degree ubuncinane besikhathi seminyaka ebango-3 kwisikhululo ephakamileyo sengeso nalelona laziwayo; Ubuncinane beminyaka elingu-20 yamava afanelekileyo emisebenzi ekujoliswe kuso ekuphakamiseni koluntu emva kokufumana isidanga esidingelwayo kwisikhululo ephakamileyo. Ikhono lokusebenza koluntu, amakhono amakhulu, ngamazwi nangemigca yendlela ezibambe ngayo abantu abangezixhakwa kunye nemveli. Ikhono lokuxhasa inkqubo yokusebenza ngokuhambelana nemimiselo yalal' elungiselelwa uluntu ekujoliswe ekunyamezeleni imiba yoluntu kunye nokwenza umntu agqamiswe ngokwemali. Isikwa sabo bonke abantu abakowunobungu benqweno ekujoliswe kokugqamisa kwabo. Ukuvakalisa nokwenza uluntu lube ngalawo olufanelekileyo kulwazi-lwazi lokuza nokujongana neengxaki zalo ngokuphatheleyo nokusebenzisa imali. Iziko lokubanamava amaninzi ekubeni ngaphandle kokwenza okusemthethweni nabantu abasentsimbi yophuhliso kule ndawo.
xh.duties: Zichaze ngokuchanekileyo kwaye zenze ukuba kusebenze imisebenzi ehlanganiseyo yentlalahlala kwinxalenye yentsimbiyo-phakamiso koluntu nakwezinye iindlela ezinomdla; Nxibelelane kwaye uqhube ngokunye nabo bonke abadlali beendima ababalulekileyo, ngaphakathi nangaphandle, kunye nabanomdla (ngokomzekelo kwiisebe/kumazwe, kwi-Ngo, kwiindido zoluntu lwasekuhlaleni nakwiibhodi ezingqwevu ngokwenkolo) ukuze kuncedwe ekusebenzeni ngokunye nakusekweni kweziqinisekiso ukuze kuqiniseke ubuso bokusingatha kwimisebenzi yophuhliso engaphakathi koluntu; Axhasa iindidi ezahlukeneyo zoluntu kwaye unikeze inkxaso yolawulo ngemisebenzi ejolise ekuphakameni koluntu nakwezinye iindaba eziyiyo; Uhlale ufuna ukwaziswa ngemisebenzi yamva ekwindawo yophuhliso koluntu ukuze kuphuculwe inkonzo ekunikwayo.

af.title: Rekenmeesterklerk: Salarisadministrasie
af.summary: Rekenmeesterklerk gesoek vir salarisadministrasie, klein kontant en boekhouding binne die Western Cape Department of Social Development.

Ukukwaziswa: Ulwazi nokuqonda ngokuhlangenwe nakho mayelana: nomthetho, izakhiwo ezilawula, izinqubomgomo nezindlela ezinhle ezihambisana nemisebenzi yelayini; ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zolwazi ezisekela ukuphathwa kolwazi nemininingwane ehlobene nomsebenzi welayini; ukuphatha amaphulo; ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela zokuphathwa kwezenzo; ukuphatha inqubo yokuthenga nokwenza izithakazelo; ukuthuthukisa, ukusebenzisa, okubuka kabusha izinqubomgomo nendlela zokuphathwa kwezenzo; ukuphatha izinqubo, inqubo nezinhlelo zezikhonza zikahulumeni; ukuphatha imali yomphakathi, izinsizakusebenza zabantu nezinye izenzo ezihlobene nolawulo; ukuphatha izinqubo zemali ngokuhambisana ne-Public Finance Management Act, 1999, i-National Treasury Regulations, i-Provincial Treasury Instructions namanye amapholisi emiswakama okuthintwa imali, imiyalo, iziqondiso noma izivumelwano ngokuhlangene; ukwenza ukuphathwa kwezensi kahle kahle konke kwamahhovisi nokuqondanisa amapholisi; ukuphatha izinqubo zokuphathwa kokusebenza kahle; Ikhono: ukwenza imisebenzi yeziyalo nabalingisi; ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zekhompyutha ngempumelelo; ukuxhumana ngempumelelo ngolimi oludingekayo; ukuphatha amaphulo; ukwenza imisebenzi yamahesela kwezimali nokuhlolwa kwamapholisi; Okunye: ukusebenza ngempumelelo ngaphansi kwezinkinga; ukusebenza ngehora ezingajwayelekile ngenxa yesidingo; ukufeza izingemuva eziyisikhathi esiphezulu.
zu.duties: Ukuhlinzeka ngezenzo zokusekelwa kwezimali; Ukuphatha izenzo zokuphathwa kwamadokhumenti; Ukuphatha imisebenzi ejwayelekile yokusekelwa ngolawulo; Imisebenzi yokuphatha.

Izindondo: Ulwazi kanye nokuqeqeshwa kokusebenza: umthetho, izinhlelo ezilawulayo, izinqubomgomo namasu aphezulu ahlobene nemisebenzi yohlelo; ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zolwazi ezisekela ukuphathwa kolwazi nolwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi wohlelo; ukuphatha i-National Land Transport Act (Act No. 5 of 2009); ukuphatha i-Road Transportation Act (Act No. 74 of 1977); ukuphatha i-Western Cape Road Transportation Amendment Law Act (Act No. 8 of 1996); ukuphatha i-National Land Transport Regulations, 2009; ukuphatha imisebenzi, imikhakha, inqubo namasimu e-Provincial Regulatory Entity; ukucubungula izicelo zelayisensi zokusebenza; ukuphatha lolu lwabo lwezimali, okubukiwe nokubika, izinhlelo kanye namabikho e-Directorate; ukwenza lolu lwabo lwejhheshi ejwayelekile kanye nolwazi lwesizinda; ukuphatha inqubo yezimali ngokuhambisana ne-Public Finance Management Act, 1999, National Treasury Regulations, Provincial Treasury Instructions kanye nezinye izinqubomgomo zezimali, imiyalo, imithetho kanye nezivumelwano ngokubambisene; Amandla: ukwenza imisebenzi yezibalo nolimi; ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zekhompyutha ngempumelelo; ukuxhumana ngempumelelo ngolimi oludingwayo; ukuphatha amaphrojekthi; ukwenza imisebenzi yezimali,zezimali kanye nokuhlola; ukwenza ukuhlaziywa kwezomnotho, izimali nezibalo; ukwenza lolu lwabo lomthetho; Okunye: ukuhlela kanye nokubika amabikho; ukuxazulula izinkinga; ukuxhumana ngempumelelo; ukuhlela kanye nokuhlela imikhakha; ukwenza ucwaningo; ukusebenza ngempumelelo ngaphansi kwegcembu; ukusebenza amahora ahlukene uma kudingeka; ukuhlanganisa izikhathi eziyinhlawulezima.
zu.duties: Nika usizo ekubhekeni imibuzo; Isevisi Yeziklayenti kanye Nololwabo Lwezicelo; Ukuthuthukiswa Kohlelo Lwebhizinisi kanye Nokwesekwa Kwemisebenzi; Nikeza izinsiza zokwesekwa kololwabo.

xh.title: Umlawuli woBudlelwano neeNkalo zoMthengi, iNtlangano yomGaqo weNtshona
xh.summary: Indima yoMlawuli woBudlelwano abaThengi kwisebe leWestern Cape Mobility Department umatshini weMiqondo yeNtshona Koloni ophatha imibuzo, iinkonzo zoMthengi, uLawulo lweNkqubo yoMgaqo nokunikela ngenkqabo ngomSebenzi.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso esifanelekileyo seqela lenyanga elingama-3 (iNtsinga yeSikolo samabanga aphakamileyo/iNqanaba le-B degree okweqela elingaphezulu kweli); Ukutyhila isithuba esingaphantsi kwesoonyupe iwaka elingeni elithile kwindalo yemisebenzi yobukhoki-base ekufunyenwe kuyo kwaye kugqitywe ngokuchanekileyo kwinto ethileyo ethile. Ikhono ekufuneka lisetyenziswe: ULwazi ngokusebenza koluntu kumaze amathathu: urhelo, ngokumisela imithetho nokuqinisekiswa kwamagama athile, amacebo athile akhoyo nendlela yokwenza into ethile ngendlela echaphazela iinkalo ezahlukeneyo zoluntu; ukusetyenziswa kolwazi lweenkqubo ezixhasa ulawulo ngokwamanye amagama athile, amacebo okulungelelanisa uluntu namagunya ophando lwamaziko ngokwamanye amagunya amaninzi ngokwecandelo elo lawulo; ukulawula iNdingo-lwa-aria yeSizwe yiNkqubo yezeNdlululo (Act No. 5 of 2009); ukulawula iNkqubo yezeNdlululo yeZitolo ezahlukeneyo (Act No. 74 of 1977); ukulawula iNkqubo yezeNdululo yokulungiswa kweNdlela zakuLwandle ekumazwe ngamagunya eNtshona Koloni (Act No. 8 of 1996); ukulawula iNkqubo yeNdlela yeSizwe ngokuTyhala iZixhobo zokuThwala komAdi ka-2009; ukuphatha iinkalo, imisebenzi, iinkqubo neendlela zoqobo ezahlukeneyo zeNdlela yokulawula iNtlangano yomgaqo weNtshona; ukulungiselela izicelo zamalungiselelo okusebenzisa iilayisenisi; ukulawula ulawulo lweemali, ulwazi olunxulumene nokuqinisekiswa kwemali kunye nemibalo yemali yeNkomfa yomGama weNgqungquthela; ukwenza ulawulo oluluhlebeni lwe-ofisi nakwinkqubo yolawulo lwesikhokelo sokugcina iinkcukacha ezahlukeneyo ezibhaliweyo neentsimi ezahlukeneyo; ukulawula iinkqubo zemali ngokwemigaqo yeSizwe egqitha iMV yemali ka-1999, iNkqubo yoLawulo lweZimali zeLwandle, imiyalelo yePalamente yeNtshona Koloni namanye amacebo okulawula amanye amanani ezimali, iinkqubo, iimiyalelo neenkqubo ezidityaniswe ngokwemigaqo eqhagamshelanayo; Amakhono: ukusebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezibaliweyo neentsimi ezahlukeneyo zokubala nokuqamba iimpawu ezingangenwa ntshontsho; ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zekhompyutha ngokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo; ukunxibelelana ngokuchanekileyo ngolwimi olunxulumene nento ethileyo; ukulawula amaphulo athile; ukusebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokubala iimali, nemali ezahlukeneyo nezinye iinkalo ezahlukeneyo; ukwenza isifundo sengqondo nokuqonda iimpawu ezahlukeneyo zeemali ezibaliweyo; ukusebenza ngokulawula iNkqubo yeMvume yoShishino; Eminye imifuno: ukulungiselela kwaye kwakhona ukuvelisa iingxelo ezahlukeneyo ngokwenziwa kwazo; ukuyenza imbali ngokuxazulula iingxaki ezahlukeneyo; ukunxibelelana ngokuchanekileyo; ukulungiselela kwaye uqhelanise imisebenzi; ukwenza izifundo ezahlukeneyo ngokuphonononga izinto ezahlukeneyo; ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo ngaphantsi kweenkqubo ezinamandla; ukusebenza iiyure ezahlukeneyo kwaye kungenwa iiyure ezinamandla xa kufunwa; ukugqiba iinkqubo ezinamandla ngexesha elithile.
xh.duties: Phatha imibuzo ngokunika uncedo; Iinkonzo zoMthengi kunye noLawulo lweNkqubo yoMgcazo; Ukuphuculwa kweenkqubo zoShishino nokuNxibelelana loQeqesho; Nikezela iinkonzo zolawulo ngokunika uncedo.

jobs.title: Senior Provincial Inspector: LAW Enforcement Operations
jobs.centre: Western Cape Mobility Department, Western Cape Government
jobs.summary: Senior Provincial Inspector enforcing road traffic and transport legislation in the Western Cape, requiring Grade 12, a basic traffic diploma, and 3 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of a Senior Certificate (Grade 12 or equivalent or higher qualification); A minimum of 3 years of practical experience as a provincial inspector; must be in possession of a basic traffic diploma or equivalent qualification; A valid Code B/EB (or higher) driving license. Note: People with disabilities that restrict driving abilities but have reasonable access to transport may also apply. No criminal record. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Implement legislation, regulatory frameworks, policies and best practices relevant to the line functions; use information systems that support the management of knowledge and information relating to the line function; manage the operational functioning of the Directorate Traffic Law Enforcement; administer the National Road Traffic Act, 1996 (Act 93 of 1996); administer the National Road Traffic Amendment Act, 2008 (Act 64 of 2008); administer the Firearms Control Act, 2000 (Act 60 of 2000); administer the Criminal Procedure Act, 1977 (Act 51 of 1977); administer the Firearms Control Regulations, 2004; administer the National Road Traffic Regulations, 2000; manage dimensional and mass limitations and the requirements for abnormal load vehicles in accordance with TRH 11; implement guidelines from the Director of Public Prosecutions; conduct driver fitness inspections; conduct vehicle fitness inspections; manage impoundment procedures; complete traffic law enforcement documents; manage traffic law enforcement equipment in accordance with operational guidelines; manage the storage and transportation of dangerous goods in accordance with national and international statutory requirements; manage Labour Relations legislation and regulations; manage performance management processes; Skills: perform numeracy and literacy functions; perform literacy functions; use computer systems effectively; communicate effectively in the required language; manage projects; perform legal administration; Other: communicate effectively; plan and organise activities; solve problems; manage conflicts; manage resources; manage customer relationships; provide leadership; control and monitor activities; manage people; maintain records; manage service delivery; make sound decisions; manage results and quality; draft and compile written reports; drive vehicles; conduct investigations; motivate staff and stakeholders; conduct analytical assessments; manage operational and project activities; negotiate with stakeholders; interpret legislation and information; evaluate legal evidence; conduct observations; mentor and coach staff; drive innovation and continuous improvement; work effectively under pressure; work irregular hours when required; meet tight deadlines; travel regularly away from the office when required.
jobs.duties: Enforce Road Traffic, Public Passenger, Transport and other relevant legislations; Examine Vehicles and Monitor Compliance with Vehicle Fitness and Roadworthiness: Requirements: Provide visible Traffic Control/Policing and promote/ensure crime prevention activities; Perform all administrative activities and related duties; Assess Road conditions; Mentor and coach Provincial Inspector’s (PI’s) on probation and appointed PI’s; Supervisory functions.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Senior Provinsiale Inspekteur: Regshandhawingsbedrywighede
