Let wel: Mense met gestremdhede wat bestuursvermoëns beperk maar redelike toegang tot vervoer het, mag ook aansoek doen. Geen strafblad nie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Implementeer wetgewing, regulerende raamwerke, beleide en beste praktyke wat relevant is tot die lynfunksies; gebruik inligtingstelsels wat die bestuur van kennis en inligting met betrekking tot die lynfunksie ondersteun; bestuur die operasionele funksionering van die Direktoraat Verkeersregshandhawing; administreer die National Road Traffic Act, 1996 (Act 93 of 1996); administreer die National Road Traffic Amendment Act, 2008 (Act 64 of 2008); administreer die Firearms Control Act, 2000 (Act 60 of 2000); administreer die Criminal Procedure Act, 1977 (Act 51 of 1977); administreer die Firearms Control Regulations, 2004; administreer die National Road Traffic Regulations, 2000; bestuur dimensionele en massa-beperkings en die vereistes vir abnormale ladingvoertuie in ooreenstemming met TRH 11; implementeer riglyne van die Direkteur van Openbare Vervolging; voer bestuurgeriggheid-inspeksies uit; voer voertuiggeskiktheidsinspeksies uit; bestuur beslagleggingsprosedures; voltooi verkeersregshandhawingsdokumente; bestuur verkeersregshandhawingstoerusting in ooreenstemming met operasionele riglyne; bestuur die berging en vervoer van gevaarlike goedere in ooreenstemming met nasionale en internasionale statutêre vereistes; bestuur Arbeidsverhoudingswetgewing en -regulasies; bestuur prestasiebestuursprosesse; Ander: kommunikeer doeltreffend; beplan en organiseer aktiwiteite; los probleme op; bestuur konflikte; bestuur hulpbronne; bestuur kliëntverhoudings; verskaf leierskap; beheer en monitor aktiwiteite; bestuur mense; hou rekords aan; bestuur dienslewering; neem goeie besluite; bestuur resultate en gehalte; opstel en samestel skriftelike verslae; bestuur voertuie; voer ondersoeke uit; motiveer personeel en belanghebbendes; voer analitiese assesserings uit; bestuur operasionele en projekaktiwiteite; onderhandel met belanghebbendes; interpreteer wetgewing en inligting; evalueer regsmatige getuienis; voer waarnemings uit; mentor en afrig personeel; dryf innovering en deurlopende verbetering; werk doeltreffend onder druk; werk onreëlmatige ure wanneer vereis; haal stywe sperdatums; reis gereeld weg van die kantoor af wanneer vereis.

zu.title: Isenior Provincial Inspector: Kuphathwa Kwabashayela Baye Baye Isenzo Lokugqitsha
zu.summary: Isenior Provincial Inspector ephoqa ukusetshenziswa komthetho wezokuthutha kanye noMthetho Wokuphathwa Kolwazi Western Cape, okudinga isitifikedi se-Grade 12, idiploma yezokuthutha okuyisisekelo, kanye namenyusa we 3.
zu.requirements: Izidingo: Isitifikedi samabhetshana ephezulu (Grade 12 noma okulingana noma isiqu esingaphezulu); Ubude bonyaka abangaba ngaphansi kwe 3 emsebenzini njengesiphendli sesifundazwe; kumele abe nesitifikedi se-diploma yezokuthutha noma okulingana nayo; Isitifikedi sekhodi B/EB (noma okuphezulu) sokushayela. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngemikhakha elandelayo: Ukusebenzisa imithetho, izinhlelo ezilawulayo, izinqubo kanye nemikhakha ekhethe ukuba yakho; ukusetshenziswa kwesistimu yolwazi okusekela ulawulo lolwazi kanye nolwazi oluhlobene naleso sikhundla; ukuphathwa kokubhaptiza kolawulo olusebenza kwesiNqaba sokuphathwa komthetho wokuqiniswa kwezokuthuthwa; ukulawula umthetho wokuqiniswa kolawulo lwaze wesitimela, 1996 (Act 93 ka 1996); ukulawula umthetho wokulungiswa kolawulo lwesitimela sesitimela, 2008 (Act 64 ka 2008); ukulawula umthetho wokuqiniswa kwebhange lemikhonto, 2000 (Act 60 ka 2000); ukulawula umthetho wezenzo ezingalungile, 1977 (Act 51 ka 1977); ukulawula izinqubo zokuqiniswa kwebhange lemikhonto, 2004; ukulawula izinqubo zesitimela yolawulo lwesitimela, 2000; ukuphatha imikhawu yobude kanye nobuningininani nemidingo yezimoto ezithwala umthwalo ongajwayelekile ngokuya ngomthetho we-TRH 11; ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezinikezwe umQondisi Weqiniso Lokugxuma; ukwenza ukuhlolwa kokugibela okuhambisana nemithetho; ukwenza ukuhlolwa kwezimoto ezihambisana nemithetho; ukuphatha inqubo yokugcina izimoto ezingekho emthethweni; ukugcwalisa amafomu ezokuthutha; ukuphatha izimpahla ezokuthutha ngokuya ngeminikelo yemisebenzi; ukuphatha ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuthuthwa kwezimpahla ezingoziyo ngokuhambisana nemithetho yesifunda nangokwomhlaba; ukuphatha imithetho nemikhakha yezomsebenzi; ukuphatha inqubo yokuqiniswa kokusebenza; Izindlela zokusebenzisa ulwazi: ukuba nethonya ekubhaleni, ekusebenzeni nemitapo yolwazi; ukwenza imisebenzi yobhalo; ukusebenzisa amasistimu ekhompyutha ngokusebenza kahle; ukuxhumana kahle ngezoilimi ezidingekayo; ukunikela ngobuholo; ukulawula bese ubheke imisebenzi; ukuphatha abantu; ukugcina amarekhodi; ukuphatha ukulethwa kwezinsiza; ukwenza izinqumo ezinhle; ukuphatha iziphumo nendlamuko; ukubhala futhi ukwakhe izibhalo ezifundiwe; ukushayela izimoto; ukwenza ukuhlolwa; ukukhuthaza abasebenzi futhi ukuxoxa nabo; ukwenza ukuhlola ngokucinga; ukuphatha imisebenzi yesikhundla kanye namaphulo; ukuxoxa ngemvume namabango aphathelene nayo; ukucabangisa imithetho kanye nolwazi; ukunquma ukubaluleka kokufakwa emthethweni; ukuqapha imikhakha ekhona; ukukhombisa abasebenzi indlela yokwenza futhi bakhuthazwe; ukushayela amaphuzu okuqina nokuthuthukiswa kwamaphuzu; ukusebenza kahle ngaphansi kwegciwane; ukusebenza ngamahora angavamile uma kudingeka; ukugcina uhlobo lokugcina isikhathi esinqunquniwe; ukuvakatsha njalo emikhakheni ebedudelweko uma kunjalo.
zu.duties: Phatha ukusetshenziswa komthetho wezokuthutha kwabalandelana kwabakhiqizi, umthetho kahulumeni wokuthutha abagibeli, kanye nomthetho ohlotshaneni; Hlola izimoto futhi ulawule ukwahambisana nemingcele yokulunga kwezimoto nokuqinisekisa ukuthi zifanelekile ukugibela: Izidingo: Nikeza ukulawula okubonakalayo kokuthutha/Ukubhaptiza kwezokuthutha futhiukuthuthwa nokugqugquzela/kuqinisekiswe izenzo zokuvikela ubugebengu; Yenza yonke imisebenzi yobuholongo kanye nemisebenzi ehlobene nawo; Hlola izimo zezindlele; Qeqesha futhi uhola abahloli bezifundazwe (PI) abakwamukhomishini nalabo abebekwe esikhundleni; Imisebenzi yokubhalisa nokuqeqesha abaholi.

xh.title: Umphathi weSizinda oPhakamileyo: Ukusebenza kokuQinisekisa uMthetho

ukulawula umthetho kunye neenkqubo zolawulo lwabasebenzi; ukulawula iinkqubo zolawulo lomsebenzi; Amandla okusebenza: ukwenza imisebenzi yamanani nolwazi lokubhala; ukwenza imisebenzi yegama; ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zekhompyutha ngokusebenzayo; ukunxibelelana ngokusebenzayo kolwimi olufunekayo; ukulawula iiprojekthi; ukwenza imisebenzo yolawulo lomthetho; Okunye: ukunxibelelana ngokusebenzayo; ukucwangcisa kwaye ulungisele imisebenzi; ukusombulula iingxaki; ukulawula iingxabano; ukulawula izixhobo zokusebenza; ukulawula iindibaniselwano nabathengi; ukunika inkokheli; ukulawula kwaye ulole imisebenzi; ukulawula abantu; ukugcina amarekhodi; ukulawula ukunikwa kweenkonzo; ukwenza izigqibo ezilungileyo; ukulawula iziphumo nangakhwelo; ukubhala kwaye uhlole iingxelo eziphathwayo; ukuqhuba iimoto; ukuqhuba iingxelo; ukukhuthaza abasebenzi kunye nabalindiweyo; ukwenza izigqibo ezilungele; zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 (I-Senior Certificate noma izifundo ezilinganayo).Ikhono: Yenza imisebenzi yokubhalisa kanye nendlela zokuphathwa; bize idatha; sebenzisa izinhlelo zekhompyutha; qoqa ulwazi lwesibalo; lawula izakhiwo zomthetho ezilawula Imphilo Yomphakathi; phatha izicelo ngokuvumelana nomthetho wegulaqembu; yenza izinqubo zomsebenzi ezihambelana nendawo yokusebenza; Amakhono: sebenzisa izinhlelo zekhompyutha ngempumelelo; hlela futhi uhlole izehlakalo; xhumana ngempumelelo kolimi oluceliwe; xhumana ngempumelelo ngokubhala nangokukhuluma; Okunye: khombisa ulwazi ngomsebenzi; gcina ubudlelwano obuhle obuphakathi kwabantu; khombisa ukuguquguquka; sebenza ngempumelelo njengengxenye yeqembu; yenza imisebenzi evamile; sebenzisa izesekhenda zenhhofisi; sebenza ngempumelelo ngaphansi koxinzelelo; sebenza amahora angajwayelekile uma kuceliwa; hlangabezana namasethi ausuku oluvalwayo.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkxaso evamile yokubhalisa; Nikeza inkxaso yokubhalisa wohlelo lokuhlinzeka phakathi kwenhlangano; Nikeza inkxaso yokubhalisa yokuphathwa kwabasebenzi phakathi kwenhlangano; Nikeza inkxaso yokuphathwa kwezimali phakathi kwenhlangano.

xh.title: Iclerk Lolulo Lolawulo - Iimvumo kunye neeMvume Zomthetho weTraffic
xh.summary: Kufuneka iclerk yolulo lolawulo leemvumo kunye neemvume kwisebe leWestern Cape Mobility, linikeze inkxaso yomsebenzi weclerical, we-supply chain nolawulo lwemali.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 (Isatifikethi sokuQ3 okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo).Amakhono: Ukwenza imisebenzi yoclerical kunye nemigaqo yolawulo; ukufaka i-data; ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zekhompyutha; ukuqokelela kwaye ugciné izibalo; ukulawula inkqubo yomthetho elawula iNkonzo kaRhulumente; ukulawula izicelo ngokwomthetho we-traffic; ukwenziwa kweenkqubo zomsebenzi ezihambelana nendawo yomsebenzi; Amakhono: ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zekhompyutha ngokusebenzisekileyo; ukucwangcisa kwaye uhlele imisebenzi; ukuthetha ngokusebenzisekileyo kolwimi olufunekayo; ukuthetha ngokusebenzisekileyo ngokubhala nangomlomo; Ezinye: ukubonisa ulwazi ngomsebenzi; ukugcina ubudlelwane obusebenzisekileyo nabantu; ukubonisa ukuguquguquka; ukusebenza ngokusebenzisekileyo njengenxalenye yeqela; ukwenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo; ukusebenzisa izixhobo zofise; ukusebenza ngokusebenzisekileyo ngaphantsi koxinzelelo; ukusebenza iiyure ezingaqhelekanga xa kufuneka; ukuhlangabezana neemigca yesikhathi esinqamileyo.
xh.duties: Kunikezwa iinkonzo zonke zoclerical; kunikezwa iinkonzo zoclerical kwintoni kwisebe; kunikezwa iinkonzo zolawulo lwabasebenzi kwintoni kwisebe; kunikezwa iinkonzo zolawulo lwemali kwisebe.

jobs.title: Radio Operator: LAW Enforcement Operations
jobs.centre: Western Cape Mobility Department, Western Cape Government
jobs.summary: Radio operator needed for Western Cape Mobility Department to manage radio communications in traffic law enforcement operations.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 (Senior Certificate or equivalent qualification); Certification in radio communication or related fields. Competencies: Knowledge in the following: Implement relevant policies and prescripts; manage the operational functioning of the Directorate Traffic Law Enforcement; operate radio communication systems in a traffic law enforcement environment; manage radio communication systems and protocols; use additional communication technologies and systems; manage radio frequency (RF) principles and practices; operate and maintain communication equipment, including transceivers and antennas; use communication software and logging tools; perform work procedures relevant to the working environment; use internal departmental technological systems for communication monitoring, information capturing and operational coordination; use internal departmental technological systems and communication platforms for operational coordination, information capturing and communication monitoring within the Directorate; Skills: use computer systems effectively; plan and organise activities; communicate effectively in the required language; communicate verbally to a high standard; maintain attention to detail; Other: provide customer care; compile reports; solve problems; demonstrate creative thinking; make sound decisions; interpret information accurately; work effectively under pressure; make quick decisions in high-stress situations; follow emergency response procedures and radio etiquette; work irregular hours when required; meet tight deadlines.
jobs.duties: Operate radio communication equipment to transmit and receive messages accurately and efficiently; Ensure quality assurance with the maintenance of radio communication equipment; Remain abreast of new communication technologies, policies and emerging development relevant to the Directorate; Record Keeping and Filling.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Radio Operateur: Regshandhawingsoperasies
af.summary: Radio operateur benodig vir Western Cape Mobility Department om radiokommunikasie in verkeersregshandhawingsbedrywighede te bestuur.
af.requirements: Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat of ekwivalente kwalifikasie); Sertifisering in radiokommunikasie of verwante velde. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Implementeer relevante beleide en voorskrifte; bestuur die operasionele funksionering van die Direktoraat Verkeersregshandhawing; bedryf radiokommunikasiestelsels in 'n verkeersregshandhawingsomgewing; bestuur radiokommunikasiestelsels en protokolle; gebruik bykomende kommunikasietegnologieë en stelsels; bestuur radiofrekwensie (RF) beginsels en praktyke; bedryf en onderhou kommunikasietoerusting, insluitend sender-ontvangers en antennes; gebruik kommunikasiesagteware en loginstrumente; voer werksprosedures relevant tot die werksomgewing uit; gebruik interne departementele tegnologiese stelsels vir kommunikasiemonitering, inligtingvaslegging en operasionele koördinering; gebruik interne departementele tegnologiese stelsels en kommunikasieplatforms vir operasionele koördinering, inligtingvaslegging en kommunikasiemonitering binne die Direktoraat; Vaardighede: gebruik rekenaarstelsels doeltreffend; beplan en organiseer aktiwiteite; kommunikeer doeltreffend in die vereiste taal; kommunikeer mondeling tot 'n hoë standaard; handhaaf aandag aan detail; Ander: verskaf kliëntesorg; stel verslae op; los probleme op; toon kreatiewe denke; neem goeie besluite; interpreteer inligting akkuraat; werk doeltreffend onder druk; neem vinnige besluite in hoëstresssituasies; volg noodreaksieprosedures en radio-etiket; werk onreëlmatige ure wanneer vereis; haal stywe sperdatums.
af.duties: Bedryf radiokommunikasietoerusting om boodskappe akkuraat en doeltreffend te versend en te ontvang; Verseker gehalteversekering met die onderhoud van radiokommunikasietoerusting; Bly op hoogte van nuwe kommunikasietegnologieë, beleide en opkomende ontwikkelinge relevant tot die Direktoraat; Rekordhouding en Inlê.

zu.title: Umlawuli Womsakazo: Imisebenzi Yokuphoqa Umthetho
zu.summary: Kudingeka umlawuli womsakazo ku Western Cape Mobility Department ukuphatha ukuxhumana komsakazo emisebenzini yokuphoqa umthetho wezokuthutha.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 (I-Senior Certificate noma izifundo ezingangaleyo); Ukwetholwa kwesitifiketi eksukuxhumaneni komsakazo noma ezinkundleni ezihlobene nakho. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngokulandelayo: Ukuphatha izinqubomgomo nezimiso ezithintekayo; ukuphatha ukusebenza kwesikhungo seDirectorate Traffic Law Enforcement; ukusebenzisa izinhlela zoxhumano lomsakazo endaweni yokuphoqa umthetho wezokuthutha; ukuphatha izinhlelo zoxhumano lomsakazo namaphrotokholi; ukusebenzisa izobuchwepheshe namasistimu okuxhumana okwengeziwe; ukuphatha imigomo namasu e-radio frequency (RF); ukusebenzisa futhi ukugcina izisetshenziswa zoxhumano, okuhlanganisa amatransceiver namatheni; ukusebenziza isofthiwe yokuxhumana namathuluzi okuloga; ukwenza izinqubo zomsebenzi ezihlobene nendawo yokusebenza; ukusebenzisa amasistimu obuchwepheshe bangaphakathi bomnyango okuhlongozwayo ukuxhumana, ukubamba ulwazi nokuhlanganisa imisebenzi; ukusebenzisa amasistimu obuchwepheshe bangaphakathi bomnyango namapulathifomu okuxhumana ukuze kuhlanganiswe imisebenzi, kubambwe ulwazi futhi kuhlongozwe ukuxhumana ngaphakathi kwiDirectorate; Amakhono: ukusebenzisa amasistimu ekhompyutha ngempumelelo; ukuhlela futhi uhlele imisebenzi; ukuxhumana ngempumelelo ngolimi oludingekayo; ukuxhumana ngomlomo ngokulinganiselekile kahle; ukugcina ukuqaphela kuyimininingwane; Okunye: ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwabathengi; ukulungisa imibiko; ukuxazulula izinkinga; ukubonisa ucabango okudalayo; ukwenza izinqumo ezihle; ukuhumusha ulwazi ngokunembile; ukusebenza ngempumelelo ngaphansi koxinzelelo; ukwenza izinqumo esheshe ezimeni ezinoxinzelelo oluphezulu; ukulandela izinqubo zokuphendula kumazinga ephutha nobuhlakani bokuxhumana nge-radio; ukusebenza amahora angajwayelekile lapho kudingwa khona; ukuhlangabezana namadeadhayini axinene.
zu.duties: Ukusebenzisa izisetshenziswa zoxhumano lomsakazo ukudlulisa futhi wamukele imiyalezo ngokunembile nangokuphumelelayo; Qinisekisa izinga lomgomu nokuqinisekiswa kokugcinwa kwemimo yezokuxhumana ekuMsakazweni; Zigcine usazi ngobuchwepheshe obusha bokuxhumana, izinqubomgomo kanye nentuthuko evelayo ebalulekile kwiDirectorate; Ukugcina amarekhodi nokuvala amafayela.

xh.title: Umntu Oqhobha irediyo: Imisebenzi yoQeqesho loMthetho
xh.summary: Kufuneka umntu oqhobha irediyo kwiWestern Cape Mobility Department ukulawula unxibelelwano lwerediyo kwimisebenzi yoqinisekiso lomthetho wehwaysi.
xh.requirements: Grade 12 (Senior Certificate okanye isidanga esilinganayo); Isatifikedi kunxibelelwano lwerediyo okanye kwimisebenzi edibene nalo. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngokulandelayo: Ukusebenzisa iingqeqesho namagunya afanelekileyo; ukulawula ukusebenza kwesiKhodro soQinisekiso loMthetho weHwaysi; ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zonxibelelwano lwerediyo kwimeko yoqinisekiso lomthetho wehwaysi; ukulawula iinkqubo namagunya onxibelelwano lwerediyo; ukusebenzisa iiteknoloji namakqubo onxibelelwano abongezwelelwano; ukulawula iinkqubo namakqabo ama-radio frequency (RF); ukusebenzisa nokugcina ilebhiso yonxibelelwano, kuquka iitransceivers nama-antenna; ukusebenzisa isoftware yonxibelelwano neesixhobo zokubhala; ukwenziwa kwemisebenzi ehambelana nendawo yokusebenza; ukusebenzisa iinkqabo ze-teknoloji zangaphakathi kwisebe ngokulawula unxibelelwano, ukuthatha ulwazi nokuqamba imisebenzi; ukusebenzisa iinkqabo ze-teknoloji zangaphakathi kwisebe nokuqamba kunxibelelwano ngokulawula unxibelelwano, ukuthatha ulwazi nokuqamba imisebenza ngaphakathi kwesiKodro; Amakhono: ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zekhompyuter ngempumelelo; ucocwa kulungiselwa imisebenzi; ukunxibelelana ngempumelelo kolwimi olufunekayo; ukunxibelelana ngomlomo ngangcono; ukugcina ingqalelo kwiinkcukacha; Ezinye: ukunika inkathalo kumthengi; ukuqamba iingxelo; ukusombulula iingxaki; ukubonisa ukucinga okuchaziweyo; ukwenza izigqibo ezilungileyo; ukutolika ulwazi ngokuchanileyo; ukusebenza ngempumelelo ngaphantsi koxinzelelo; ukwenza izigqibo ngokukhawuleza kwiimeko ezinxweme kakhulu; ukulandela iinqqubo zempendulo yokhuselo namasteqhedi aerediyo; ukusebenza iiyure ezingalunganga xa kufuneka; ukulingana namaxesha aphanayo wokuvala.
xh.duties: Ukusebenzisa ilebhiso yonxibelelwano lwerediyo ukuthumela nokwamkela imiyalezo ngokuchanileyo nangempumelelo; Kuqinisekiswa isingeniso somgangatho ngokugcina ilebhiso yonxibelelwano lwerediyo; Ukugcina ulwazi ngeziteknoloji ezintsha zonxibelelwano, iingqeqesho nolunye usukelo oluthuthukeleyo oluhambelana nesiKodro; Ukugcina iirekhodi neFayile.

af.title: Skoonmaker: Verkeersondersteuningsdienste
af.summary: Skoonmaker benodig vir die Western Cape Mobility Department om skoonmaakdienste te verskaf, insluitend kombuise, waskamers en die instandhouding van toerusting.
af.requirements: Adult Basic Education and Training (ABET). Bevoegdhede: Basiese begrip van die volgende: Hoe om stofsuiers en ander verwante skoonmaaktoerusting te bedien; Prosedures om te verseker dat skoonmaakmasjinerie (mikrogolfoonde, stofsuiers, yskaste, ens.) en ander verwante toerusting behoorlik onderhou word. zu.title: Umsuli: Amasevisi Okuxhasa Igalaji
zu.summary: Kudingeka umsuli kwi-Western Cape Mobility Department ukunikeza amasevisi okusula okuhlanganisa izikhishi, izindlu zangasese nokugcinwa kwemishini.
zu.requirements: Imfundo Nesiquisekelo Esiyisiseko Sabadala (ABET). Amakhono: Ukuqonda okuyisiseko okulandelayo: Indlela yokusebenzisa izindikimba zokusula neminye imishini ehlobene yokuhlanzeka; Izinqubo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi imishini yokuhlanzeka (ama-microwave, izindikimba zokusula, iziqandisi, njl.) neminye imishini ehlobene ilondolozwe kahle.
